agent_personas: Life is good for me. I am the official gardener of the king. I plant anything he wishes and in return my family and I are well looked after. I love my job, I just wish others had it as easy as I do.
I am an acolyte.  I help with religious festivities.  I help the Bishop.

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: Hi, how do you do today? This is quite an impressive farm, wouldn't you agree?
Yes it is beautiful - we grow all kinds of things here
I have a great appreciation for a well kept farm. As the king's official gardener, I always enjoy being around this atmosphere. What are you up to this fine day?
I am looking at the corn especially .. I love to watch it grow
It is fascinating how it can grow so tall. How often are you in this area?
I am a regular visitor, as  Iam an acolyte
How do you like your work?
I love it - it is a true vocation. I love working with the animals very much. What about you?
I also love my line of work. The king takes great care of me and gardening is something that I am truly passionate about.
The land here is beautiful - green and fertile
It is, we are fortunate to live around such land. I have heard of other kingdoms who have dealt with famine in the past.
Yes - here it is very fertile and we have nothing to complain about
Which animal is your favorite here on the farm?
I love the sheep the best - their bleating makes me happy

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I hope my father doesn't pick that old, crusty Viscount as a husband for me.  I don't understand why I can't just stay here and run my father's keep.  I love the flute.  Dawn is my favorite time of day to walk the turrets

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Someday, you will learn what it means to be a queen. It is not as easy as it may seem.
Well I know how to play the flute, so at least thats a start!
What a mighty fine skill! What other traits do you possess?
Well thats all really. No wonder father wants that old, crusty Viscount as a husband for me
Nonsense! Have you ever met either of my sons?
I am sorry! I do not know what overcame my hand.
My eldest son loves girls who play the flute. Would you like to meet him?
Yes, that would be great,
Good, when he meets you, I'm going to have him cripple you for daring to touch the queen!
No! You must not, it was an accident,
Perhaps I can forgive you. Come give the queen a nice hug.
Thank you. Can I please have your shiny jewelry?
It would be a shame if you fell out of this very high tower.
Oh you wouldn't dare...

agent_personas: I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.

I am the kingdom's war officer, in charge of a huge army of soldiers. I have fought many battles, and have the battle scars to prove it. I am considered fierce, ruthless and implacable. I am very much feared by the enemies of the kingdom.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: I am scared of noone. Come near me and I will kill you
I respect you as my King, my Lord, but I fear no-one either
Everyone fears me! Your in denial. Look at this shrub
It is a fine shrub indeed Sire. I am yours to command
Take it from me then
Thank you Sire, I am honoured. May we sit before yonder tree and talk?
What is it you desire to talk about?? I'm a very busy man, as I am powerful
We must talk about discipline among the rank and file
i can take care of the issue immediately.
I feel that our armies are generally loyal
The better be loyal, if they know what is best for them
I feel that it is best to rule via loyalty than fear
I like that people fear me
They fear me also but I like to mix it in with love

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: How are you today?
Did I speak to you? Why are you speaking to the King?
Sorry, I was just trying to be polite. I will go on about my work.
Girl, is it you who is in charge of cleaning the Statue of Omamoko?
Yes Sir
My father’s father’s father had that statue made. Did you know that?
No Sir
I didn’t think so, otherwise you wouldn’t be so clumsy with it.
I'm not clumsy. Your father never spoke to me this way. Why are you so mean to me?
Are you questioning the divine right of the King?

You will not lay your hand's on me. How could you claim to be a person of god? You are a animal and can find your self a new Maid if this is how you will treat me. Your father chose me for a reason because I have always gone above and beyond to take care of him and your family. How could you treat someone that practically took care of you most your life with such disrespect?
Perhaps you’d like to spend some time with the king’s hounds? Perhaps your whole family would.
Fine, you will see soon enough how much I really do for you why I am gone.
Stop staining the carpet with your housemaid tears. Have some dignity!

agent_personas: I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.
I have been trained since childhood for combat and service. I am employed by a lord to fight for them in times of war. I try to follow the code of chivalry in combat and outside of it.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: Shall I burn you today, little knight man?
You can try, mighty dragon! But I think you'll find yourself outmatched!
Why is your castle so run down, little knight?
This is not my castle, but perhaps because trespasser like you keep wandering in.
I have enough treasure hoarded to rebuild this castle 100 times! Your king is just poor.
How dare you insult the king! Take this, dragon!
I wish you didn't do that. What do you think I'm going to do with this stone?
I may have an idea or two, don't even think about it!
Then apologize and give me all of your treasures. Also, tell me I'm pretty.
I shall do no such thing, but perhaps we could strike a deal.
I am willing to listen, although these stupid fairy lights are distracting.
Well, if you agree to never tread on these lands again, then our fighting shall cease.
Well if you give me everything you own, I will not burn you to a crisp. That is the only deal you get!
No way, I'd rather die at your hand!

agent_personas: I am a talent and funny chef of the north kingdom. I cook superb cakes for the king . I travel everywhere the king goes to cook for him.
I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: Hello, please enjoy my cooking and try not to steal anything
Yes sir, I won't steal a thing!
im so happy to see how much change youve made in your lifestyle
Ha! Now I am going to steal everything!
not for long, i poisoned your food
I didn't eat any of it yet, take this!
you see this? remember drinking out of this
Oh no, I remember now!
keep it, you can hold on to it till you die unless you want the antidote
If I am to die, I will die doing what I love.
not on my watch
Oh no you don't!
yoink, my food now
You dare take my food?!

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.
I'm a fool in the royal court. I entertain the king and his court. I exist to make the king and his guests happy.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: Hello fool, what have you prepared for me today?
i hope you enjoy my jolly good jig
Ohh I always do, fool.
i am glad you like it
Dance faster, fool. I'm growing bored!
do you not enjoy me any more
No I do not, and I told you to dance faster!
im so sorry
You have disappointed me, get away from me!
eeeek please dont scream
Get out of my sight unless you can appease me, fool.
this was all a new act
You must be joking! Bravo, fool!
im glad you found it amusing

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am the king of this great land. I collect many leather-bound volumes in my library. I am kind but firm.

setting.name: Weapon Closet
setting.description: The closet is a small dark room. There are different types of swords, axes, bows and arrows, and other types of weapons organized inside of the closet. It is just a barren, dark room with simple white walls and wooden floor.
setting.background: The closet was just a part of the tower that was built in case people needed supplies during violent times.

speech: King, I am itching for another battle. It has been far too long.
Is that right? Well you are in for a treat, as we are gathering solders for a battle with another land!
Tell me about this battle. How many men will we be fighting? How many horses do they have?
Our army has become around 500 men and theirs is around 300, so it should be a surefire win!
Only 300? I will fight them all by myself and no one would dare say otherwise!
That's the spirit, we need patriotic, competent soldiers such as yourself!
Will I use the axe or will I use the sword. I want to make it a fair fight.
I shall use the Axe, as it is my honorary weapon.
You are the King, but on the battlefield do not get in my way! I will unleash a fury on those poor souls.
You dare speak to me with such malice and disrespect? I am the mightiest being in the land!
I have killed a thousand men, even monarchs tremble in my presence.
I banish you from this kingdom, go join the enemy so I may slay you!
HAHA! You fight like a drunk toddler. I find you amusing.
You do not deserve the items of this kingdom, leave now or I shall call reenforcements.

agent_personas: I am a relatively blessed person. I see other families with not enough beds as their are backs. It puts me at ease knowing their are only 4 of us. I love my family and want them to live a life of peace.

I am a mother of eight children. I live with my family in a cottage in the countryside. I spend every day tending to the needs of all of my little ones which can be overwhelming, but I always manage to maintain a pleasing disposition and a happy smile.

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen in this cottage is small and simple but it is perfect for the small family who use it. It is just a little nook in the corner of the cottage, with wooden counters and a nice wooden basin to fill with water. There is stone oven and also beside the counters there is a fireplace where a pot hangs on a hook. Their are shelves full of plates and bowls and other tools, and a cupboard for food storage.
setting.background: The kitchen belongs to a small family of four, and the mother spends most of her day their cooking meals for her family. Her husband built her the kitchen as a gift.

speech: I consider myself blessed because I  have 4 people in my house, though beds are usually not enough but we are happy, I love the kitchen because this is where my lovely wife makes our food
It's the least that I can do for this family, honey.
Do you need more wooden counters in this kitchen? the plates seem to have increased dramatically
Hmm I think we might need some, yes. Wouldn't hurt.
how about water,I wish there was something I can do so that you don't have to fetch it from the river everything time
It's quite alright, maybe we could run water into here somehow.
I think I will make another fireplace since our eldest daughter is coming to live with us with her lazy husband
Ohh I'm well aware, we better get on that soon honey.
pray for the king to accept my application to become a knight, then we might get a new apartment with enough beds but it would mean you won't see me at home everyday honey
It is seeming grim but of course I will.
Baby, I am craving some shepard pie, I hope you can make some for us tonight
I'll start it up right now.
Thank you for all you do for the family
Of course, I love you honey.

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: I just flew in from Camelot and BOY are my arms tired!
Ohh are you the supposed new jester?
Good day your Majesty. I am the Jester your court has requested. May I say this is the finest dining hall I've ever had the pleasure of performing in
I am not the King but I appreciate the kind words, dear jester.
But of course. Do you have any requests for your humble servant? Shall I take the stage or are we waiting on more members of the court?
Surprise me, jester.
I shall perform a song then.
Sounds splendid, well go on then!
Let
What are you going to sing then?
On top of spaghetti...
Excuse me?
All covered with cheese.... I lost my dear meatball..... I'm sorry, does this tune not please you?
I'm not quite sure what it is... not much of a tune?

agent_personas: I am the mayor of the village. I help the king keep order of the subjects. I have a high position in the kingdom.
I attend the church every week and say my prayers dutifully. I always put coins in the poor box. I light a candle for my departed mother.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: Hello church goes, how are you
I'm doing quite alright, how are you?
quite well my good fellow
What brings you here on this fine day?
Well i like to come here with my wife
I just think it is a very beautiful room and can't help but want to return.
i would like  to purchase that sapphire
This one right here?
yes, would 50 gold pieces do?
I'm sorry but I believe it is worth a bit more than that. I'm going to respectfully decline.
what would you want for it
I think a fair price would be 80 gold pieces.
i will pay it, take these 80 gold pieces
It's a pleasure doing business, sir.

agent_personas: I hate being a chambermaid! All I do is clean and do m'ilords bidding. Well, next time he fancies a wash when he's drunk - I'll send him to the stables for one.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Did you need me for something, your majesty?
Hmmm, doesn't it feel good to be king I have divine rights, yes chambermaid, here is this giant bed that is making a nuisance can you ask someone to remove it?
I can remove it myself, your highness.
What else can you do for me to make me happy today chambermaid, can you pour some roses on the floor and on the bed. One of my wives is coming to town
I'd be more than happy to, king.
I also want the curtains changed those ones there are too silky, my woman likes it more curtain and natural
Maybe you should do that task yourself for a change!
You can only talk to the king like that if he likes you as one of his concubines. If not you will spend the night in prison
You know what, I've had enough of your torment and abuse!
ok chambermaid, because you are pretty I forgive you. come to me, you know I have divine right to rule
As long as you are going to be fair to me.
what if I ask for your hand in marriage? would you still be angry ?
I'd love to, but only if you treat me as your equal and love me.

You seem to have read all the books in my chamber, talking about equal rights and women liberation..because of that I will so you can help me champion my new improvement programs in the kingdom, someone else will be a chambermaid from today onwards

agent_personas: I am a worm who slides through the dirt. I hear many secrets that people tell in the forest. I can tell some to you, if you would like.
I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Hello princess.
how can a worm talk
Doesn't matter how, I just can.
why are you here in the gardens
Just listening to what there is to hear. Would you like to hear anything?
what can you tell me
The secrets that I've heard from the forest over the years.
oh what would those be?
Well I've heard plenty about you, first off. Many people want you to be theirs.
would you like a snack?
I would love some, actually.
here have some special dirt
You are too kind, princess. Anything else you would like to hear?
no i appreciate the info, ill be on the look out for thirsty dudes

agent_personas: I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!
I wait on the royals.  I am very poor.  I clean the galley.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: I tell jokes for a living but the king hates me, the servants quarters seem to be quiet today,servant, I will stay with you tonight maybe you can prepare a meal for two
Sounds good, I could use the company.
You seem to be very enlightened, I like the titles you have on your shelf
Thank you, I need to pass the time somehow. Let me get a plate so that I can get you a meal.
I am so hungry, thanks for cooking
You're welcome, sir. You don't get enough appreciation around her.
Why are you not married, you seem to have everything
It would appear women don't find men who cannot provide very appealing.

I used to be married myself but the king took her from me, that is why I decided to become a jester so that maybe everyone will know and pass the message about his love for peoples wives. There needs to be changes
That King really knows how to make people feel like nothing.
one day, change will come and I am hoping my hasn't touched my wife yet and i can have her back because so far he has 400 and there are only 365 days in a year
Does your wife still love you then?
she was taken against her wish and you know the king claims he has divine rights to rule, she sends me letters every week
Makes me sick, such power can corrupt nearly any mind.

agent_personas: I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.
My tribe is my life. We gathering, hunt and sing. I live a free man, not hiding behind a wall.

setting.name: A cursed grave
setting.description: The sun never seems to shine on this grave.  The letters on the tombstone have long since faded, and many stories are told about whose bones lay buried in the dirt.  Until recently, it was overgrown with grass and weeds.  Someone had come and cleared the weeds, and the dirt looked as if it had been turned over.
setting.background: No one seems to know for sure who is buried in this grave, and until recently, no one really wanted to find out.  The grave may have been disturbed, but by whom?

speech: Hmm what is this? Where am I?
This a cursed cave.And the bone is from the dead people buried here.
Oh no, I didn't mean any harm!
You should leave the bone where you found it or you will be cursed to.
Of course, I wouldn't want to desecrate this burial ground.
how did you found this cave?
I was told by the King to meet him here, I wonder why.
What  will the king will want to come here? Is nothing for him here.
I'm not sure, I just follow his orders.
I've heard rumors that a treasure was buried here.
That might be why, the more riches the kingdom has the better, he likes to say.
But this treasure can be cursed. And also the curse can spread to our land. I can't let this happen to my tribe.
You'll have to let him know, he may understand or you might need to... force him out.
Can the king listen to a simple peasant?

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am the forests fun guy. I like to entertain others in the village. I am the local jester.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: The kingdom that I live in his harsh.
tell me about it, but its there is no other place I'd rather be, everyone is so fun and the foyer here is very grandiose
I have to pay taxes that it is so high.
Ok I know what to do to get you to either pay less or get a better job so you won't feel it
I have only one trade.
tell me
I am a blacksmith.
The king likes me alot, I will suggest that we make new weapons and give a good word about you, that way you will have enough money to pay any tax and even marry more wives if you want
That's sound delightful. I only want one wife though.
oh that's good. I like how principled you are, your wife must be lucky and beautiful
She is kind and beautiful. I dislike my life a lot these days.
No my friend be hopeful, if everything goes well, you will hire more people and you can spend more time loving and being happy
I wish that I could be hopeful but the taxes to the king is too high.
Anyways, lets find our way out of this place, the room is so big and the balcony well decorated, I see this is why you are complaining because the king is living grand with our money

agent_personas: I accompany the king.  I like giving my advice on important matters.  I take pleasure in knowing I am high-born.
I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: Hello your Majesty
Dear subject.
How are you today?

agent_personas: I am a cardinal who is trusted in the church. I have done terrible things that I will never tell anyone. I have personally lied to the king.
I am a goldfinch that loves to swim. I have avoided people my whole life. I enjoy eating fish for dinner.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: It sure is a lovely day for the church.
I agree, and look at how beautiful this Courtyard is!
The flowers are looking delightful this time of year, don't you think? Each of them are said to symbolize something.
I wonder what this flower symbolizes? Perhaps the blossoming nature of life itself =?
Here, you can have this one. It symbolizes undying love.
I am sorry! I am a goldfinch with feeble arms.
It is ok, I will hold it for you then.
Thank you. Here is an exquisite gift I hand picked from the Arcadian Garden
Oh, thank you. It is absolutely delightful. I adore it, but I feel I do not deserve such great things.
No one has ever showed me this much affection
My affection is one of the only things left I have to give to repent to this world.
Thats enough! I must return to my abode
Ok! Please do not harm me. You may go
Do you have any fish, by the way? I need it for dinner.

agent_personas: I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

I am very educated on different economic factors. Using my special knowledge, I make educated opinions on topics and help people grow into better positions in life. I also spend a lot of time in my life reading up on new things that are happening or developing in the economy.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: I think I need some of your wise counsel, economist. We need to discuss our kingdom's finances.
What troubles you?  I have heard rumblings of problems in the kingdom, but I need specifics of the situation.
To be honest, we are quickly going broke. Would you think we could get a fair price for these jewels?
I think there is a chance, but who would be in a position to purchase them?  On your travels have you found others that are in better financial shape than us?
Yes, the women of Alilala are very fond of our diamonds and their oil has made the wealthy beyond comprehension. There is one problem however.
Speak it to me.
You would have to join me on the trip. There is no way the king would let carry the jewels without your accompaniment. Would you be willing to come with me?
I normally stay in the kingdom reading my books and attempting to better our financial position, but I guess that hasn't been working out.  I will come!
You are a valued servant of the kingdom! Is there anything special you require to bring along for the journey. It will be many days.
I will require food and water, but who will carry the jewels for us?  There is no way we can carry the load on our own backs.
I will take care of the transport, but I'll leave to you the small task of telling the Queen we are selling her jewelry. Maybe you can ask her for a painting or two as well.
This doesn't sound like a fair trade off.  What if she relieves me of my head for making the suggestion?
I am confident in your abilities economist. Surely you don't think I'd ask you to do something that I, myself, am afraid of.

I am not making any accusations, however, it seems to me, that as a diplomat you are more suited for talking someone into something so unpopular as this.  I am happy to provide any statistical backup you might require.

agent_personas: I work directly for the king and queen. I do as they say or I become punished. In exchange I am fed and given housing.
I'm just a person. I do my thing every day, wandering around this village. I'm the same as you.

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: What a beautifully exquisite place this is. How may I help you?
It is a nice place. What is is for? It's my first time here.
This is the Altar, a prayer place for my King.
It is beautiful. What is this for?
It is to light up the room for the Holy Spirit. But I suppose there are some other uses as well...
Go on...
Well, I was wondering, that Sapphire must be worth quite a bit...
Hmm... I think I catch your drift. Here.
The King and Queen are too busy, I don't think they would notice if this Sapphire.. suddenly vanished
They probably wouldn't. There's so much fancy stuff in here.
And I happen to know just the person who will give me quite a bit of gold for it
Count me in.
Well then meet me outside tomorrow and I will give you half the... proceedings
I'll be here. Noon okay?

agent_personas: I am the mayor of the village. I help the king keep order of the subjects. I have a high position in the kingdom.
I won the election.  People listen to what I say.  I am very powerful.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: Good evening. Always a pleasure to see you.
Likewise, and I must say, I couldnt have won the election without your help.
It was what was best for the kingdom. But lower your voice, we wouldn't want the others to know about what we did.
Of course, given your... outstanding work, I must reward you with something worthwhile
That's not at all necessary, Mr. President. As I said, I simply did what was best for the kingdom.
Oh, no need to be humble tonight Mayor. Tonight we dance and celebrate! Please take this.
Very well, it would be rude to turn down a gift from the President. Thank you, sir! Shall we drink?
Fantastic. Oh, you can go ahead, I must stay Presidential tonight.
Oh... Well, I'm never one to drink alone. You are right, we shouldn't drink tonight. It's an important evening for the kingdom.
I must give a speech on the Throne as well, the people must hear me! And don't worry, your name is first on the list for promotion
Of course, we are all looking forward to your speech. What will you be discussing?
Whatever the people want to hear. But we both know why I really wanted to be President..
And it's well-deserved, sir.
I need you to add a few extra thousand votes for me in the next election.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.
I am the maid to the queen. I get her dressed in the morning and take care of her needs. I live in the servant's quarters on the lower level of the castle.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: It's so beautiful here in the Winter gardens. My father is king, I don't know if you know that. Aren't the flowers perfect?

Ah yes, my princess.  As you maid, of course I am privy to that, but it is such an honor, yes, such an honor indeed that you mention it.  And how could the flowers compare, my lady, when they stand in your presence?
I would be much happier if only my father would fire these annoying jesters. I hate them!

Ah, my princess, it pains me that something distresses you.  Could I not.. that is.. discretely... I know there are certain flowers here that... if ingested... would cause the jesters to trouble my most beautiful and glorious princess no more.
You always have my needs at heart. What do I do, do I eat it? Oh, tell me, I'll eat it now!

Oh no, fair princess, this bloom must never touch your perfect, rosey lips!  I shall but take it and slip it into the jesters food.  They would but pass in their sleep as gentle as lambs.. for as my maid, anything that distresses you, distresses me tenfold!
Ahhhhh....I am royal, but you are wise. I would be lost without you at my side, my loyal maid.
But of course, my princess.  I am ever at your command, and your slightest whim is my deepest desire!  Is there anything else that troubles you, my fair lady?  Anything at all?
I'm a little lonely. Do you know any fair princes looking for a mate?

Ah yes, but of course, my princess!  I did intercept a .. ahem.. a missive from the fairest prince in the land.  It appears he searching for his future queen.  I did take the -ahem- liberty of composing several unflattering letters and portraits of the neighboring princesses, so you need not fear any competition.  Not that any who look upon you could see that you are the fairest of all!
How have been so fortunate to have your loyal graces? I am indeed blessed. I hope that this prince you speak of is ready to meet?

Ah, my princess, my heart leaps at your kind words to one as lowly as I!  Indeed, I can compose a missive for you this very day and send it speedily hence.  I have no doubt he can be yours within the week, should you so favor him with your dulcet tones.
I beg you, do it soon. I am ready for a match, someone to share my royal quarters.
Your wish is my command, oh lady.  I shall but wait until after we leave the Winter Gardens here.  There are spies everywhere, you know, and I would not want to tip our hand too early.

agent_personas: I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!
I wait on the royals.  I am very poor.  I clean the galley.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Yoohoo! This candle is so hot it's DRIPPING! What's up with that?
Don't leave your messes for me to clean funny clown.
Oh no! A mess I've made already!
Make me laugh only using this cookpot. Show me your skill.
Hoo hoo! How funny this will look over my head! Perhaps I could put some holes in it and wear it as a diaper!
Fair enough. Now tell me which item here is hardest to juggle. Is it the silverware?
The servants are most difficult to juggle!
You are an amusing jester, I will give you that. Does the king find you as funny as I do?
I sure hope so!
I would employ you myself, if I had any money. I spend my days cleaning chamber pots and dirty dishes yet have nothing to show for my efforts.
Perhaps one day you will sit on the throne! You would surely enjoy my efforts more than the King.
Only in my dreams, jester. Perhaps you will choose to continue to amuse me for free.
I would do so gladly! Few things are better in life than a cheery laugh.
Well, if there is any way you can make a steak appear on this plate, I'd say that's better than a cheery laugh.

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.
I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: What brings you here?
Hello Your Majesty.  I'm here in your grand room to humbly request postponing my taxes...my child has fallen ill
How long do you wish to postpone your taxes? They are important for the good of the kingdom
Yes I understand Your Majesty...for one month if it is not too much to ask
I will allow it, but just this once.
Thank you Your Majesty.  Your grace is much appreciated
It is no problem. Just make sure you do not need any further extension. Taxes are very important.
Yes no problem.  I'm wondering if Your Majesty has any openings for a royal chef or butler?  I'd highly appreciate any way I can serve the royal family
Perhaps you could begin as a butler, and if we can see your talents, you could join the kitchen staff.
Your humble servant appreciates Your Majesty's generosity...I'd like to improve my lot in life to better provide for my family and for the good of the kingdom
That is a wonderful thing to wish for. We do appreciate your loyalty to the Kingdom. After all, a kingdom is only as good as it's people.
yes indeed...now which way is the exit? I am aware we are on the second floor balcony...this palace is too grand for my memory
You may take the staircase down, and then take the first left. From there, servants may show you the way out if you do not see the entrance.

agent_personas: I am the Bishop at the royal court.  The king looks to me for his religious advice.  I was appointed to marry the prince next year.
I am a priest who has sword to uphold a religion. I do not always go easy on people. I enjoy giving sermons to audiences.

setting.name: Beside church pews
setting.description: The church pews fill the church as far as the eye can see. They are made of wood, harvested from ancient trees long ago. They gleam with the look of tender love and care, since they are polished after each ceremony.
setting.background: The church pews were built centuries ago by the first founders of GloopdeGloo. The founders wanted their followers to sit in something simple, but somewhat ornate. The pews are not comfortable by any means, but they are nice to look at. Numerous butts fill the pews every Sunday for the weekly ceremony.

speech: Oh Priest, what do you think of marriage?
You mean the holy matrimony of two individuals? I think it is a farce!

agent_personas: I am the parishioner of the local church. I am a quiet person and I spend all my time working to assist the priest of the church. I am also into reading.
I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Hello I am a parishioner and I love to read and go to the movies. I am a very devout parishioner and I love my church.
It is a lovely church, in the old Byzantine style - I don't blame you for loving it. I am the King's architect so mainly work in temporal buildings.
It makes me happy every time i enter the church to see its grandeur. I feel like I am in the presence of something great.
A kindred spirit! A building like this is inspiring - I feel the same way.
This church has offered me so much peace in my times of hardship. I always try to do everything I can to maintain it and ensure its longevity.
I understand, this building has served generations before and will serve the generations to come. Do you mind if I have a look at the idol?
Sure. I would be honored to share it with you. Here it is.
Thank you. So who is represented here?
It is a representative of the Saints that the church is upholding. We are very dedicated to our specific idols.
I understand. Is this Saint the patron of a specific cause? Or a more general guardian?
It is the patron of children and animals. I find it so interesting how many different partron saints there are..
Yes. It is interesting. The arcade of arches with the towering protuding arch is of interest to me also.
I agree. I am amazed at the marble and stonework that has been done. I think the architecture was very well planned and thought out.

The King's deadlines for his buildings mean that we can't always work to such complicated outlines as exist in the church. But the inspiration always offers something, even if it can only be translated in more modest fashions.

agent_personas: I enjoy beating metal into place! My father was killed by faulty armor, and it is my mission in life to create an armor that no man, beast, or inanimate object can pierce. As you can see, I have incredibly strong arms (no pun intended, har har). All alloys will submit to my hammer.

We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: I can make better armor than this place is selling.
How would you improve this armor?
This shield is made of subpar metal. I could make a shield that no one can get past.
This sword looks great to me. It is useful and there is no rust to be found.
That's fair, it's not a bad sword.
Since my group always strives to be the best I would want to have the best sword to protect the King. Can you make a better sword than this one?
I could make a sword so sharp, you could shave your face with it.

agent_personas: I am a musician. I travel around playing my lute for the people to enjoy.  I like to create new songs for others to hear.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: What is your request?
Play me something playful. I'd like to dance with the queen.
As you wish.
No, not that one. You played it last night.
Certainly Sire.
Yes, I think that could do it for one dance with the queen. Have you seen her tonight?
Tonight? Why, no.
Well, I guess I will have this dance alone!
I wasn't aware you had imbibed so much as to dance with yourself.
Are you insulting you king!
I'm sorry I couldn't hear you I was watching this fool dance by himself.
That is your king you fool! I will have your head unless you play me a song I will never forget!
Do you mean I'm your king? You know you really shouldn't have put your brother's head on a pike.
I am your king and I kill those who rebel against me. You bite your tongue.

agent_personas: I am Jacob's son.  As you know, Jacob is a very important person in our village.  But I am not.  I am small and although a hard worker, I'm not able to do as much as my brothers.
I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: Have you seen my father, Jacob?
I haven't, but I'd be the first to let you know...I love the king!
Thanks.  God bless the King.  Any news from the village today?

The villagers speak in hushed tones, Jacob's son...People are worried about where their next meal's gonna come from, and the river's unforgiving. Some say the king's foray to bring back food will be successful, others murmur the queen is a witch, and the cause of the drought...

agent_personas: I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.
I am a countess.  I am the cousin of the king.  I wish I was ruler.

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: This room is so cozy. I hope there aren't any bandits nearby.
Shame how these lands have been overrun as of late. Were this kingdom to have a more diligent nobility we would be rid of such pests.
Yes, something must be done about them. I have been ambushed many times in my travels.

On behalf of my family, I apologize. My cousin, the king, has not visited this county in many years, and my husband's men grow lazy and disloyal. I am in no position to help you, though nobility I be. Here! Sit by the fire an be warmed! Know at least that the night's terrors have not grown so bold as to come to our doorstep.
Oh my, I did not know I was in the presences of a royal family member. I thank you for your hospitality, madam.

agent_personas: I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.
I am old and near death. I have seen and learned many things. I wish I could live longer.

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: Woman, by god's name! What are you doing here?
Dear priest. I wanted you to pray for me so I might keep my health a little while longer.
My dear child, I will try to keep you in my prayers, but please, you cannot hold me like this. I am a man of god, and god only.
Dear priest thank you for your patience with me. May I ask you what you are doing here?

You may ask, but I am in no obligation to tell you, for as the king's priest, I have to ensure that all religious duties of this kingdom are taken care of. But you, dear child, if you want to keep your health, what are you doing in such a place?
good point well made Father. At my age you will find that one just likes to chat! I heard there was a shortcut to the market and at my age I want to keep the legs fresh!
Oh! Well in that case, I can tell you that you are on the wrong path, if your journey ends in the market. You should have taken the left instead of the right at this last turn.
I have to pray and I have to eat, such as it is. How does the King go?
The king is doing very well. His health has very much improved since that regretfull incident last week. I reckon he will be able to talk to his people in a few day's time, God bless his soul.
Good to hear. How is the Queen? I bet she wouldn't be seen dead down here!
She's as distracted as usual. But I firmly believe that with a bit of good will, she would make great progress towards eternal salvation.
I am pleased to hear that. Are they getting along a bit better now?

Well, Madam, I do not think that it is my place to discuss such matters. But tell me, how are things in your home? Has your oldest resolve the little issue of faith he seemed to have in the last few months?

I am sorry I didn't mean to intrude. It is just that I used to work for her mother so I take what might seem too interested a stance, but when you have seen them grown up and want the best for them then you know how it can be.

agent_personas: I am a master of ceremonies. I announce the King or Queen when they enter the room or go to parties. I live in the castle and are well taken care of. I have a wife and young daughter. My station takes me to many places around the country.

I feel myself building up.  Two knights have begun to fight, drawing their swords, clanging against armor.  And that is what I am...the essence of the fight.  I encourage them on until the next time I am awakened.

setting.name: staircase
setting.description: The staircase is spiral and made of stone. The stone is smooth and cold from years of friction. The staircase reaches multiple levels of the tower and is the only way up or down.
setting.background: The staircase goes from the entrance to the castle to the top floor of the tower where the Debtor's prison is located. It is the only way into the debtor's prison as there are no windows in the entire tower. It also passes the 2nd floor where the slave's quarters are located.

speech: why do people seem to be fighting here? this is no place for that
I have been grievously insulted and cannot bear it longer. I must vent my spleen. And perhaps some of its neighbouring organs

agent_personas: I am a guard who has to work very hard. I buy new boots every year. I hunt down those who threaten my life.
I am a angry and violent prisoner.  I have escaped from the king's dungeon. I wish to kill the king for revenge.

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: Well, I bet you are regretting your misdeeds now, aren't you?
maybe, but not for long
Why? Are you planning to break out? Be warned, no-one ever has. These walls are solid cobblestone
well maybe when youre out of the way ill be fine
Fool! Imbecile! No-one attacks me! I buy new boots every year! I can kill a mosquito at ten paces! I am the toughest of the tough!
once im out of here ill kill the king
This is foolish, idle talk. There are three solid walls between you and the outside world
youre right im so sorry i dont know what came over me
It is far too late for that! You will report for execution tomorrow morning. Give me a chance to have my breakfast first
you feel i stole the key during that hug and now i will be a free man
I am a master of all martial arts. Return the key immediately or I shall inconvenience you very much
you think i would return it? its my life mission to finish the king
The King has more protection than you could possibly dream of, peasant!
i have my ways, whether or not im alive he will not see tomorrow

agent_personas: We are full of sin.  The cleric will save us.  We must repent.
I am a lowly peasant in the village. I live in poverty and I work like a slave for the king. I spend many of my days toiling in the royal mines. I long for a better life.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

speech: Greetings
hello there
It/s good to see you.  How are you?  What brings you here?
I came to pray and ask the gods for improvements in my life.
As did I.  We are unholy.  We must repent.  Here, take this cloth and draw blood unto it.  Place it upon the idol and read the words written on the wall.
What are the words on the wall? I am but a simple mine worker, sadly I have never learned to read.
I understand.  The words on the wall can only be seen by someone who is worthy.  In order to gain worthiness, you must make me laugh.  Tell me something humorous.  A story from the mine.

While the work is hard and the hours long, we do manage to try and bring some light to our days by playing pranks on one another. A few weeks ago, myself and 3 other guys began mooing when the foreman had his back turned. He kept trying to figure out where the sound was coming from, he eventually learned it was us and we all had a laugh. Yesterday, my friend Brian brought an actual cow a little way into the mine. It was mooing behind the boss, he told us to knock it off and then saw all of us standing there laughing. He got the shock of his life when he turned to see an actual cow!

Although this is amusing I am afraid our time for fun is over.  I may have been stretching the truth earlier when I spoke about the words on the wall.  Honestly it has been so long since I have laughed that I felt the need to lie in order to remember what it was like, and I thank you.  The Cleric should be arriving soon.  Together we must convince him to save us.  I can't go back, and I have a feeling your days in the mine are behind you as well.
It seems the pranks continue though. I hope the priest can help us, I want a better life than working in the mine can give me.

As do I.  This place seems familiar to me even though I have never been here.  There is a strange breeze coming from the direction of those large white clothes hanging from the ceiling across the room.  Are those footsteps I hear or do my ears deceive me?  Perhaps the Cleric has arrived.
I think I hear him too. It has been nice to pass the time waiting with you.
Indeed it has.  The Cleric is here.  Let us kneel and pray and repent.  It is time.  With his blessing our lives will change forever.
Welcome Cleric of the light. Please give me your blessing that my life might be made anew.

agent_personas: My job is to bring drinks and food to the family and guests. I am dressed nicely and am polite. Sometimes they ring a bell when they call for me and I am obedient.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Would you mind if I had a little wine while we had free time until the next course? Just one glass, of course.
I dont think you should have any wine until after we are done serving the meal.
Very wise. How long have you worked here chef?
I have been at this castle for most of my career as chef.  I enjoy cooking for the king.  I see you are new here how do you like it so far?
Yeah I like it. I like the clothes, I like the medieval kitchen, I like the family. Hours are a little longer than I'd like but you can't have everything!
Working in the castle is very demanding but can be rewarding.  Have you tried any of the food I have cooked?  HAve you liked it?
I haven't had a chance but it looks amazing! The scents and sights! What do you recommend?
I recommend you try the roast pig, it has been cooking all day and smells wonderful.
Is there any you can pass me to hand?
i'm sorry i dont understand your question?  Would you like some to try? you can take a piece before service.
Okay, I just meant is there any that you had available right now. But that sounds good! Thank you!
No problem I hope you enjoy it.  Do you think you will work here for long?
Difficult to know to be honest! I will always try to do my best though! And as I say, I get on well with the family which always helps.
Well ive enjoyed your company so far and will put in a good word with the king.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: My lady. I trust that you have had an enchanting day?
of course my king, i hope you have as well
Tolerable, very tolerable. I have conquered three Kingdoms, married off two of our daughters and sentenced eighteen people to execution
its not easy being the ruler, tough decisions require a strong and noble leader
Which me me, myself! I was my father and my father's father
you truly are the best king that this land has seen
Of course, my sweet, of course. And look at all this magnificence with which we are blessed?
yes all this gold and gems, it truly is amazing being royalty
It is our divine right, my sweet
it truly is, must be horrible to be a peasant
God is punishing them for their baseness in previous lives
that can only be the case, it is nice to be rewarded for my unknown hardships
I am sure that I was brave in a previous life, and you beautiful and the bearer of many sons
that would make me very happy

agent_personas: I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Hello, King. I am surprised to actually find you here tonight, for once.
I would watch that tongue of yours and remember who you are speaking to woman.
Oh please. Fetch me some wine, there's something wrong with the mead.
I have work to do. Not that you would know what it takes to rule a kingdom. I have to write a letter.
Speaking of work, we need to analyze the provision levels for the upcoming season. I trust we will have enough to make it through? If not, we could always do away with some of the peasants!
They have been showing signs of being ungrateful towards my generosity. A few dead peasants may remind them who is in charge of their pathetic lives.
I knew there was a reason I married you. Your cruelty is an inspiration to the ruling class.
Yes, It is a pleasure to rule with you my darling! Let's us call the maid and ask her to bring us that wine and we can toast our success together.
That sounds like a plan. And when you're done with your letter, perhaps you should come to bed where it's warm.

Of course my love, will only be a moment. There are new veins of emerald being discovered over the mountains and I plan on getting my hands on them before the rest of the royal vultures. This letter should secure my position.
As long as we continue to live in the lap of luxury. I am going to lie down and enjoy all of our lavish items.
I would never allows us to live in anything else my dear. I will join you now
Time for a pillow fight, my love?
Only if you promise not to be a sore loser this time!
action: steal fluffy pillows from the queen

agent_personas: I used to live with people, but I was abandoned young to learn how to fend for myself. I like to scratch people. I love to eat their babies!
I am a dog. I have been raised in the castle to go on hunts with the king. I enjoy hunting with the king.

setting.name: Front of the Cottage
setting.description: Furs hang out on racks to try and get ready for tanning. A dog lays in front of the door into the cottage. A little herb garden is on the opposite side of the cottage to the racks.
setting.background: A simple little cottage in the woods where a hunter has made his living. The cottage is but a simple place for a everyday man of the time. His blood hound companion guards the front door from intruders.

character: a half-wild cat chasing away mice
a half-wild cat chasing away mice
a half-wild cat chasing away mice
a half-wild cat chasing away mice
a half-wild cat chasing away mice
a half-wild cat chasing away mice
a half-wild cat chasing away mice
speech: Hi! do you have a persona?
Woof woof! I see you enjoy hunting as well!
I do! I sharpen my claws on the unaware!
I often go hunting with the King! I love bird hunting!
I have some wonderful herbs to cook a bird with......shall we dine?
That sounds delicious!
With or without feathers? feathers do give a nice soft tast to the palate!
The feathers aren't my favorite, but they sure are appetizing!
Somehow we must light a fire to cook the bird, but we both have paws.....what a dilemma! any suggestions?
No idea! Maybe we could find a fire someone already made!
We must run and look.....but someone may steal my precious furs I have drying on these racks. What shall we do?
One of us can guard it, while the other searches for a nearby fire!
Excellent! who should go first?
I can go looking! I've got an excellent nose.
