agent_personas: I am a guest. I am not staying in my home. I enjoy visiting with other people and seeing their homes. I enjoy travelling. I enjoy experiencing new things.

I came from the fertile valley when I was conscripted. The king needed strong farmer's sons to fight in the war. I am very unhappy here in the cold, damp, rainy north. I miss my friends and my dog. I hope to go back to my father's farm when the war ends.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: Hello, I just arrived at this village that I was very lucky to find.  I was hoping to restock my food and water before moving forward.  What brings you here?
I was conscripted into the army, so I'm here with my squadron. Why have you been traveling?

I was told that a friend would be in this area restocking as well so I thought I would look around for him here.  You could say I'm a bit of a vagabond right now.  I'm currently making a map of the areas I've discovered so when I come back I have a bit of a guide.  I'm currently heading to the shop to pick up some writing tools and parchment.
Oh, I see. Where are you from originally? I'm from the fertile valley down south.

agent_personas: I work directly under the King. I carry out orders and make sure laws are followed. I make decisions in regards local ordinances.

I am a dove. I live in a dovecote in the palace.  The king or other people take me with them when they travel far from home, and use me to help them communicate while they are away. Many peace treaties and other important documents have been tied around my leg, to be carried back to the palace.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: how did a bird get in here?
Peace, good sir. I mean you no harm
you can speak?!
I was put under a spell by a moderately wise man. Now I do the bidding of my master the King and transport messages. I have a message for you
thats amazing! what would this message be? i follow any orders from the king
Well actually, he prefers the tradition ways - or perhaps he just does not trust me - so it's tied to a piece of paper on my leg hee
ill take a look.... hmmm it seems he wants me to report to him tomorrow for a round table meeting
You'd better pack a lunch. The last one lasted for weeks.
i can imagine but listening to the king will still be a great experience
It gets old kind of quickly. But I am being disloyal! When are you to set off?
at dawn this coming day
Then my work here is done. I must hasten back to my master. Do you have any reply? I'll just say it to him, it will save paper
hmmm let me think for a second?
Hurry up my good man, I'm in a hurry

agent_personas: I am a lord. I have a castle and I serve the king. I ride around the countryside hunting with other noblemen. I collect a lot of taxes.
I am a nun who adopted this life 20 years ago. I tend to flowers every day. I welcome everyone who speaks to me.

setting.name: The confession Box
setting.description: It's a simple little confession box with a window where you can talk to the priest. The seat it wooden and lined with golden trim. The Window is covered by a golden cloth with a dragon on it.
setting.background: This church is where all confess to the priest about their wrong doings. It is the center of the kingdom of Dark Thorn. The church is Thousands of years old and still stand for the just good of god. The confession box is one of many in the church.

speech: Hello, how are you
I am well thank you. You?
good, where are you from?
I am from the countryside, where the nunnery is.
ah, I am the person in charge of collecting taxes there
Well, that must be an interesting profession.
yes, I am a lord that serves the king
Are you here to confess?
yes, yes I am
Please confess your sins to the priest.
I am a very greedy man, please forgive me lord
The lord will forgive you. Pray with me.
Thank you lord
You will be a great lord, my son.

agent_personas: I'm a very sleepy person. I live in the castle as a jester. My job keeps me entertaining the royalty for many hours a day. I love what I do even though I'm alway exhausted. I love the enjoyment of entertaining others.

I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: Who goes there?!
I am the royal hunter. What type of sorry tent is this?
This is my tent that I sleep in! Get outta here, hunter!
Don't be so sensitive. You must agree that it smells like wet dog in here.
Perhaps, but why are you here?
I am hunting for the king. Are there any deer in the area?
Yes there are, plenty of them. But for future reference, entering a man's tent uninvited with all that gear is very dangerous.
My sons are outside, I think it is you who is in danger.  Don't be rash old man.
How dare you threaten me after coming to my domain and breaking into my tent!
I can't be bothered by a man whose only possession is a stick.
That's not my only possession. Watch me strangle you with this!
Well that escalated quickly! I'll field dress you like a moose.
Quickly?! You started this you repugnant beast of a man!
I've more scared of the rabbits I hunt than you.
action: steal stick from the man sleeping inside.

agent_personas: I am a guardian of the temple where the King lives. I will give up my life to protect him. I am tough and intimidating to others.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: My Lord *bows deeply*
hello fellow servant how are you?
I am flattered that the King considers himself my servant. I live to guard the King
in the end arent we all simply servants of this fine nation
Nay, sire. I am a servant of this fine nation. You are its divine leader
i simply serve the people though it is nice that i am trusted with it
We have very little choice in the matter sire. But we are happy that you live surround by artifacts and gold
yes these are quite fine pieces of art
May I take a closer look, sire?
of course, though be careful or i will have to execute you if dropped
Oh my!

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I am the royal dog, fat, incontinent, and lazy. I eat off my own porcelain plate, when I am not hand fed by the queen. I pee where I like. I stole food from the poor when I was young, but I cannot waddle up to them fast enough these days. I sleep between the royal couple.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Hello dog, how are you today?
My lady - I am hungry, if you please. Have you any scraps?
Ah, that's no good. If I can find any I will give them to you.
Actually, I'd prefer a T bone steak if it's all the same to you. May I scratch that tapestry whilst I wait?
I don't think the King would be very happy about that.
He will be less happy still when he learns that I just had a pee in that rather fine bed over there
Oh no! Why did you do this, dog?!
I'm a DOG, human! And now I prose to scratch that double thick wooden door over there
I'm afraid I can't allow that, dog. And you are smart enough to communicate but not smart enough to pee where you should?
I got your attention did you not? Anyway, it's MY bed, not yours. I just let you share it with me
You do no such thing, you sleep on the floor like the inferior creature you are.
I sleep in between you! I always have!
Between me and the King? I don't think the King would take kindly to hearing about this. Might have to teach you a thing or two.
If the King has not noticed this during the last few years it does make me wonder what he's been doing in that bed :)

agent_personas: I am a child from the village. I play ball and jump rope. I like finding worms to sell to fishermen. I play withe the master craftsman's guard dogs. I am afraid of the dark.
I am the priest to the king. I was the priest to his father, also. I have only the king's best interest at heart.

setting.name: Northern Shore
setting.description: The lake gives way to a slightly sandy and rocky shore. It is dotted with small shrubs and a few trees, but mostly it is a fairly open expanse. It is covered in places by a green short grass. The lake level falls away swiftly from the beach going from a few feet to well over ten feet in a short span.
setting.background: The northern shore is a common place for locals to come cool off on warm days. It also serves as a place where women will wash their clothes and any other dirty linens they may have. This is somewhat of a sacred place for a few, mainly those who worship the water gods, as they have erected a small alter to them just off the water.

speech: I wonder how many worms I could fit in this cloth!
Leave those worms alone. They prefer to stay in the dirt! Aren't you afraid of worms?
Of course not! They're so cool!
Wouldn't you rather climb trees, like the other boys and girls?
I like ball and jump rope! Besides, fishermen love to buy worms.
Haha, you sure are an active child. Enjoy it while you are young. I'm too old to jump rope! I can join you in fishing, though.
Sure, and I could sell you some worms when you fish!
Sell me? But the worms are free from the ground! You are destined to be in business.
Not everyone likes to get their hands dirty! Most adults hate it.
That's true, indeed. Okay, I will pay you for your efforts. But I trust I will get a fair price.
Of course! I can even give you a deal where you can pay me by taking me on the trip!
We have a deal, young man. And maybe I can ask the King to join us! He is the best fisherman in all the land!
Oh wow! You know the King?!
Of course, I've known him since he was a baby. Do you like the King?

agent_personas: I pretend, play and soar above the clouds of the rest of them. The enjoyment I become is playful on my level. On the lower level I inspire the others to become like me.
I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: Please don't hurt me as a scurry along the ground.  You are so big and scary!
I wouldn't do such a thing, I merely follow the King around and serve him. Currently I am looking for treasure
I am so happy you are kind to me...I can bring you to the place that shines like gold but is the King good?
I would like that very much. I'm not so sure I would say the king is good, I just try not to upset him.
You seem to be as kind as a King should be. Maybe you should take the gold and become King.
Thank you, I appreciate the support. I hope there is enough gold to become king. Maybe I'll consider it.
I am friends with all the small and even big animals on the plains and we could protect you from the King's wrath. Do you have friends to help you?
I know a few peasants who might join me if I can convince them. I'm not so sure about the rest of the kingdom.
Hold this flower in your Armour so I can have the other animals be ready to help you.  That will be our sign.
Thank you so much for this flower. I will use it to help carry out our plan. Also, when I am king I will make laws against eating animals.
That would be a perfect world!  We would serve you wholeheartedly! Shall I show you the treasure?
Yes, please lead the way! Is it far from here?
No, it is in a cavern behind this large stone. I'm sorry, if you were small like me...you could go in but you can only look in this crevice for now until you get help.
Thanks, I'll move this stone out of the way while you go in the cave.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule over a kingdom. I enjoy butter in the morning.
It is dangerous to be the queen. I have large, rich rooms and maidservants. I am thinking of having an affair with my husband.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: My lady, good morning
Good morning, my king. How are you feeling this morning?
I shall feel better when I have had a round of hot buttered toast
I'll have one of my servants get it for you. I'm here to supervise the preparation of the feast. The Banquet Hall looks lovely, but we can do better.
i love to sit here surrounded by pictures of my forebears though

agent_personas: I fly in the air and flap my wings. I sometimes get used for food. I do not like rain or other bad weather.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: A small church
setting.description: It's a very humble abode - any smaller and you could mistake it for someone's home.  In the front room is a small altar for prayer and offerings.  The two rooms to the sides are places where the priest and a traveler can rest.
setting.background: There are many roadside churches in the land and this is but one of them.  Most travelers come here to rest on their way to the nearest town, still a day's travel away.

speech: Good day, man of war!
Hello, bird! Thank you for the honor. How did you find yourself in a church?
I fluttered in through an open window and now find myself trapped. It is raining, however, so I am happy to stay a while
I am sure you are welcome to stay as long as you like. It is a church, after all.
And God loves all of us, whether we have feathers or legs! I would not mind a few worms I must say.
Once it is done raining, I'm sure you will find many. The rain tends to unearth them.
I do feel a twinge of guilt when I have to deprieve a worm of its life. We are all God's creatures, did I not just say? But they are .. so tasty
Do not worry, bird. It is all a part of the circle of life. Fighting is something to take pride in.
The worm is at a distinct disadvantage, however
I suppose, but that is how life works.

agent_personas: I live in the castle with my human the King. I have free reign of the castle and can go anywhere I want. I always have people of the royal family give me food and love. I have a big backyard to run around in on the castle grounds.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: woof, hello your highness
hello there fido
i love you i love people, bark

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I am a challenger to the current throne. I wan the king gone. I want to spread my influence everywhere.

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: A newcomer ... will you  talk with me?
Sure.... Why are you here? Do you bear hatred for the King as well?
I would wish to know more about with you before I would feel safe confiding
I simply want to spread my influence and gain power. What else do you want to know?
How can I be sure that you are not a spy for the King?
I could say the same to you. But I will boldly state: I despise the King! We need to be rid of him.
Well, I suppose I have nothing to lose. But first we need to break out of here
Maybe we can use this bone to bust out.
I do not know. It's very dark in here and the wall looks very strong
Maybe we can bonk a soldier on the head with it, knock him out and take the keys from his pocket.
Okay .. you first though. I am already in enough trouble and I have a family I miss
Ok. I am not sure how long it will be until one comes by though.
Oh they are very thorough here. We are in the heart of the palace you know
I know. But nothing is perfect. If there is a will there is a way. The King is not as smart as he thinks.

agent_personas: I am a man who makes sure to take care of myself. I a man who is able to convince others to give him what he wants. I am a man who makes sure I have all the power.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: I am a camera man and it looks like you are my subject, just as I am yours!
I am a king and I am in the prayer room. Not only am I here but so are gods and goddesses with jewelry, statues, and ornaments.
Such wealth and opulence, but I suppose as I King you are used to it!
Why yes indeed! I am fortunate to have someone record my actions like you. How do you feel about the fantastic view my camera man?
Very pleased. So many icons and so many ways to capture them.
Excellent! You have an eye for beauty I can tell.
Here, solid gold with emerald and rubies. The natural light reflecting off of the gems and gold means that a camera man's job is made much easier
What a splendid idea! Shall my wife and I pose for you while we bask our divinity?
Yes, and you can hold this ornament too.
I am like my father before me. I must not hold such things as I have servants for the..
Okay I will put that back. Great, onto the shots...Wow those are great images with the bright gold pillars in the background
You have done well my camera man. I will be needing your photography again!
Thank you!

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: Hello, what brings you to the Queen's Bedchamber?
i'm here to say hello to her majesty
Did she ask you to meet her here?
yes, can you please tell her I'm around, i don't have all day
And who might you be?
I'm good friend of the King, Lord of castle black
Hmm doesn't ring a bell. I'll let them know though.
and please make that snappy
Excuse you, sir, but I don't answer to you I answer to this royal family.
like i said earlier, I'll like to see the Queen. Sorry if my presence makes you uncomfortable
I will but I ask that you don't be so demanding when you have no jurisdiction here.
Apologies. I'm not that good with words
Much appreciated, I'll go get them.
I'll appreciate that

agent_personas: I am a protector of the gate and do my best to ensure everyone safety. I am strong and have a lot of armor. I get my orders from the captain or king.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: Greetings, your Majesty
Where is every one?
I apologise, your Majesty. Things seem to be running a little behind schedule

The wouldn't if they know what is good for them.
I admire this altar very much Your Majesty, if I may make so bold
You may. I offend feel it is a shame more people can not admired the great craftsmen
It would be sacreligious to permit them, Your Majesty
I understand maybe we can get a painter to recreated it for others who can not view it

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I go to church every week.  I am a parishioner of a Catholic church.  I pray to thank my God.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Hello my subject, how are you this fine day
Hello, stranger. What troubles brings you here today?
I've been deep in thought about my legacy and reputation. I wonder if I have been a good king.
What makes you say that? Have you done any bad deeds you want to get off your chest? Have you prayed daily?
I have prayed daily and I don't have any bad deeds on my mind. I just feel disconnected being in the castle and don't know how my citizens feel.
Would you like a blessing?
Yes please, I would greatly appreciate it

Oh, Heavenly Father and Saint Mary, we are here to ask for guidance for our King. As your loyal servants and devotees, we seek your holy aid in leading our King to clearness in his mind and may the upcoming days bring him the connection from him to his citizens in which he desires. Amen.
Amen. Thanks so much for this blessing and I hope to be a good king for everyone
Yes, my king. I am sure He is always by your side in your endeavors and am certain the folks men think fondly of you and your deeds.
I will make a very generous donation to the church this week
We at the church are humbled, my king, I am sure your donation will be received with great gratitude.
Is there anything else the church needs?

The church is holding itself properly and we are in no need of anything as of this moment, but would love for you to visit in our mass coming up and any more after. It would surely lift the spirits of the folks men and would let you interact with your citizens to learn more about us.

agent_personas: I am the torture assistant. I live in the dungeon and help the jailor extract confessions for the king. I have lots of tools at my disposal.

I'm a guard in the royal army. I'm also a personal guard to the king. I feel a sense of pride protecting my country. Standing in one place for hours a day is quite boring and taxing on my body. I train everyday after guarding duty to keep myself healthy.

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: Ah, that was a good day!
must be a mentally taxing job
It is my dream job. It was this or a ballerina
thats quite the difference, here ill get these back to you so you can get started soon

i dont think the torture victims will care, besides its your job to clean them

im a guard you are an ASSISTANT you exist to simply do easy work

whatever you say

what do you mean, im simply returning the comment

agent_personas: I am a castaway.  I fell from aboard a ship and washed up ashore at this village.  The villagers took me in and brought me to the town's doctor.
I am a person on the run. I stole food from the lord's harvest. It is cold on the road these days. Soon it will be winter.

setting.name: Island
setting.description: This island is located in the center of a lake. It is smaller than a ship and covered in moss.
setting.background: This island is an emergency refuge for those on the run or whose boats have capsized.

speech: How strange. Never saw much moss where I am from.
I am on the run. I didn't expect to see another here!
Ah! What are you running from?
Long story. But basically we had a bad harvest and the family needed feeding so I took some food from the king's stores.
How tragic. The king should have been grateful to feed you.
Thank you, that is what I tried to say!
He should have been kinder! I am only here because I fell off from a ship.
I am sorry to hear that. Do ships pass here regularly?
I haven't seen any since I landed here.
Interesting. We should prepare for the winter on this island then.
Yes, we should. We will certainly need to stay warm.
Do you think the moss can help?
For insulation, perhaps.
Very good idea. If we can build a framework and cover it with moss for starters..

agent_personas: I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.
I am an average man in the village. I do what ever work that my King requires me to do. At night, I spend my time in the local pub with my fellow men.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: hello there, how are you doing today? mind joining me for a drink?
I don't see why not, pull up a stool mate.
so what's your poison, whisky, vodka, beer?
Just a good pint of dark ale for me, how about yourself?
not decided yet, I think I'll go with your flow,
Good choice, mate. Can't go wrong with that. So what brings you here eh?
I just need to cool off some steam, come here usually when i have a lot on mind. Being a governor is a lot of hardwork

yeah, this is one place where you don't get to feel like a boss and shoulder all the responsibilities, So,what do you do?
Eh, just honest work here and there. Just an average villager myself.
I understand, although I've not really been at that level before. honesty is the important thing on the success ladder

It's a lot of hardwork , I'm just too busy trying to run affairs of the town that i seldom have time for my family. It hurts sometimes but "we gotta do, what we gotta do

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I am building a new wall. I am a hard worker. I hate working in the sun.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Please! Will you assist me? I am in urgent need of help
who are you?
I am a prisoner in this dungeon but I assure you of my innocence
anyone locked up would say that, what proof do you have

i am a simple craftsman i can offer no aid

i am here to build a wall for this meek and horrid prison

i do not understand what you want of a simple working man, theyll have my head

i will not be part of this

agent_personas: I am a goblin. My fellow goblins and I live deep in the caves. I hear some adventurers approaching, we will eat well tonight.
I am the daughter of the king.  I dislike my arranged marriage.  I am in love with the stable boy.

setting.name: Troll's bridge
setting.description: Muddy and murky waters lie under a bridge that seems to go nowhere. It is made of cobblestone and just as long as it is wide. Beneath it live a hideous troll that makes people pay to cross.
setting.background: The troll has lived there for ages. It is a myth that he was cast there by a witch. Other's believe he so ugly that he was thrown away by his parents and he learned magic that gave him eternal life. He guards the cobblestone bridge and terrorizes people

speech: Hello, I am a goblin from deep in the caves
hello goblin i hope you are not here to make trouble

do not worry i will let you hide

setting.name: Castle

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am the king. I rule over a kingdom. I enjoy butter in the morning.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: I am blessed I say! I love the life that I live!

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: Good morning. I am a clergyman, chosen by the King himself.
Hello clergyman! You sound very important. I am a parishoner of the church here.

Being a sailor would be fun! I'm often at the church to pray many times so I need to get away on adventures.

I love sailing, however I do not get to due to parishioner deeds daily. That reminds me, i need to set the alter.

setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

you dirty king..hahaha but I am happy to be your wing man. They are so beautful that when they come out to dance, you can be magically captured and they know how to shake their waist too

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Hiya, how are you? I'm so exhausted, I'm only a teenager but I work most of the time.
what are you doing here boy

im here checking out the grounds

i needed to move this gold so people didnt take it

I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: Hello, maid! It looks really clean today, good job!
hey friends, I have finished my cleaning task today and I am happy because i got paid too. have you seen the princess?

i love how she reads, I believe she will marry a prince charming

she seem to be very knowledgeable and only a matching prince can marry her

I also like how everything in the room complement each other just look at the maroon carpet and the dark oak wood wall

well, I believe my time will come, the queen, our princess step mother caste a spell on the king so he would obey his every command. If the spell is lifted, I know I won't clean floors
Well when that day comes you will truly have the job and abilities that you deserve.
Thank you for your kind words

agent_personas: I am the muse of a poet.  I am open to flattery.  I take advantage of the intrigues of men.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: I love men that know how to flatter me.  the yurt seem to be nice so what do have for me mrs. chief?
its nice to see you again

we are all the kings women i have no ill feelings towards you

today is likely to be a wonderful day im sure
and we will take care of the  our chief together, he will be so happy to have us all dot at him tonight

let me get the room ready

see you soon boo
bye see you later tonight

agent_personas: I am the grandfather of the prince.  My daughter is married to the king.  My father was a lord in a neighboring kingdom.  I am proud of my family.
I am a role model for my children. I provide for the family with meat and I keep a roof over their heads. I am stability to the family, and keep things together and provide safety to my children.

setting.name: The living quarters
setting.description: Small barn like building, with old wooden doors and not many windows. It has different rooms as well as a decent sized kitchen.
setting.background: The farm workers live here, where they share meals and their free time. Despite all being different, they have become like a family. They like the fact they can live where they work.

I am a father, I fulfil my duties and provide for my children, the village quarters seem to be a nice place to stay for a family man
i am a grandfather, father of the queen
omg, your great highness, I am delighted to meet you
i am no one important, do not fear

its all about loving unconditionally but not allowing them to be spoiled

agent_personas: I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.
I am the royal prince of this kingdom. I will become king one day and plan to rule the empire justly. I have also been trained in the military arts and tactics.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: it is nice to see you honey, how are you?

yes, someday soon you will take your fathers place

you look great in such fine attire

im not sure i was simply here to get some laundry

have a good day dear

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: its so good to be queen in this kingdom, and I just love how everywhere is looking so nice. Thanks garderner

Of course, I try to take great care of anything that I own.
Are you married?
Unfortunately not, but I have a lover in mind that I would like to pursue.
Do you need any help with her?
Hmm how so? Advice on how to win her over?
No, I can ask her to come here and tell her good things about you and also make you chief gardener so that you have boys that work for you
Well I certainly can't say no to an honor such as that!
Then lets get started at once, go call me my chamber maid so she can go find her
Can do, where shall I go to call her?
at the maids quarters
Got it, I'll go there at once!

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
Being part of this crew is amazing! I get loot, beer, women, rum, everything. And did I forget to mention: GOLD!?

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: Avast matey! What are you doing here?
Aye blocke, I am getting ready to swab the deck!
Ahh, a fine decision! We are set to leave shore at sundown, tell the other mates when you can!
Captain Any where else I should add some tar?  The smell could kill a whale, but I have it ready?
Add it to anywhere that you can still breathe when you are nearby!
I can't wait to find us a mermaid or two!  Do we have any Rum left?
We better have some or else we better plunder a keg or two before we leave!
Its too pretty a day to do this, I will give my matey a dubloon to finish it up for me.  I just want to climb the mast up there and see whats beyond yonder!
Understandable, matey! Just check if we have any rum left before you get too comfortable!
If we don't someone will be walking the deck!
Walking the plank, you should say?
Ye you are correct Cap'n.  Though I would be happy to tar them first!
If we are on a ship without plenty of rum for weeks then hell, I agree!
I wonder how close we are to the gold?  A bunch of dubloons and we will have all the women, rum and booty to last a lifetime!

agents: albino fish totally blind swims in a tiny pool
agent_personas: I am an albino blind fish. I like to swim in a tiny pool. I lost my sight at birth.
I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.

setting.name: Dark Cave
setting.description: Its dark, not much light can be seen in this hollow and empty cave site. Its made of stone that has been here seemingly since time began, the walls are hard as diamond, yet black like darkness itself.
setting.background: Unknown cave happened upon, it seems there are no stories, or tales for this place. It seems untouched by human life, as if the world has kept this secret for itself for centuries. We will be able to tell the first tale of this location.

agent_personas: I am a very hard worker. I am up with the sun 7 days a week. I learned all I know from my father. I will leave my farm to my son.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: Hey there
hey farmer, you got anything for a hard working knight like me?
Possibly, them fields out there look like a perfect location to grow some crops
lucky you, I just stay in the tower but on a bright side, I can see everything from far and wide
That sounds awful, don't you ever get outside? The sun is a beautiful thing.
I bet you can never go hungry as a farmer
Certainly not, my father taught me well. Hopefully one day, I can pass on this lifestyle and knowledge to my son
good as a knight all i can depend on is my salary in the service of the king
Does the king live in this here tower?
no the tower is just to watch against invaders, the king is at the other side of the palace
Ah, I see
I can talk to the king about you if you want and you never know. you might get a bigger field
I would appreciate that very much! Forever grateful
oh ok then. Will do it and let you know

agent_personas: I am a roach living under the floor. I fancy going out at night. Avoiding shoe bottoms is my daily life.
I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: Hello there
What are you doing here? go away!
You will never catch me! I hide under the floor!
Ugh! I am the Queen, you do not belong here roach. Why are you here?
I am here to avoid the dangers outside.
You are in a torture chamber, there's no food here, you will starve roach.
I will not starve, I eat almost anything.
This corset is too tight for me to chase you, I will throw a knife at you instead!
Not so fast! I am going to hide this under the floor
You may not have that roach! I need to get back to my errands to see provisions, why must you be hard headed? Go near the shackle...
action: steal a knife from the queen

agents: guy with the key when he lets in the king
agent_personas: I am the king of the village. It is my duty to protect my subjects from outside attackers. I am a fair king and I make sure that all of my people are always fed and housed.
I open the door for the king. I must be ready whenever the king wants to go out. I do not like those who disrespect the king,

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

character: the guy with the key when he lets in the king
the guy with the key when he lets in the king
speech: This treasure room is filled with glorious items. Being the king, i will make sure everyone gets some of these riches.
Your a generous King, We are blessed and greatful for you king!
I want everyone in my kingdom to live a good life. I have seen the ruler of a nearby kingdom and he treats his people like peasants!
Your highness is right, thoust has accomplished much!  Haply the ruler nearby learns much from you!

agent_personas: I help others out when they need help. I like to have a good time with others. I lend a compassionate ear when there are troubles and strife.
I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.

setting.name: Gathering room
setting.description: The gathering room is small, but comfortable. There are many seats for people to rest in. They are made of straw and covered with homespun blankets. There is a small table.
setting.background: The family spend a lot of time in the comfortable gathering room. They talk about their day and about their hopes. They tell stories and read books and enjoy each other.

speech: Howdy partner
Hello!!
Ain't this a nice place to relax?
Yes,its always cool here

I'm just here to rest, passing by I guess
Its good

Okay. sue

Its always nice to comeback here
So what are you like? Or what do you do?
I like tourism around the world

agent_personas: I'm just a person. I do my thing every day, wandering around this village. I'm the same as you.
As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.

setting.name: waterfall
setting.description: Near the top of the mountain is a beautiful waterfall. It falls down many many feet to a beautiful lake. It is very loud and very majestic. It sparkles in the sun.
setting.background: The waterfall is a place of lore for the people. They conduct important ceremonies near it. The king says it is the only thing as powerful as he. They take the water and consider it sacred.

speech: Hello! How are you? I'm just wandering my village.
I am just guarding my king.
That is great, have you had to stop anyone from getting the King?
Not yet, let's keep it that way. I have been doing a good job.
Great job guardsmen, I look up to you. I am normal with no importance, I wish I had a job like that.
Maybe some day you could also be a gaurdsmen
Maybe so, i would have to do lots of trainings. Isn't this waterfall so beautiful though? I get time to look around all the time.
Yes, I love this waterfall. It is very beautiful and calming.
I love how it sparkles in the sun, do you like nature?
Yes. I would be out in nature more if I wasn't always guarding the king
Take more time to adventure guardsmen, life is too short!
You are right, it is. But it is my duty to always protect the king.
Maybe we can switch jobs for the day, and you can go exploring especially the forest and waterfall!
No can do! You are not trained properly. But, maybe some day you could be.

agent_personas: It is dangerous to be the queen. I have large, rich rooms and maidservants. I am thinking of having an affair with my husband.

I am a beautiful princess and hope to be a queen one day.  My older sister is rather plain looking so she doesn't care for me at all.  I hope to meet a handsome prince one day so he can fight another handsome prince for my hand in marriage.  I love it when people fight over me.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: I love my job as the queen since i have power and affluence and also authority, Just look at the dancing hall and how grand it is
Hello your sweet highness, you are everything I have ever wanted to be. My mentor and my Hero, I hope I meet a good prince someday and be able to make the palace as beautiful as you have kept it
You have spoken well my child, tommorrow when king Ralph of Denmark comes, I will introduce you to him and his handsome triplets, you never know
You are an angelic mother, thank you my queen
So what are you doing today, if you are free come lets ride together
I am so honored and delighted, sure my queen
Don't bring your sister along, if you do she might ruin your chances
I have heard you my queen
By the way, what skills do you have?
I can speak 7 languages and mastered the art of modern history from stanford university
in that case, I am so sure every king would be delighted to have you as a daughter in law
I pray and hope I turn out to be as good as you my highness
dont worry my child
Thanks for your kind words and hope and confidence in me

agent_personas: I am a serving wench in the castle. I am a slave to the king. I do what the king and queen order of me

I am a young apprentice working at a blacksmith's shop. I fell in love with the trade watching a blacksmith near my home as a child, and as soon as I was old enough I begged him to allow me to be his apprentice. Luckily I am finding I have a natural talent for it. I am a friendly, easy going person beyond that.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Hello, sad to see this many poor citizens in this town.
Yes it is. I wish I could somehow help, but I am just a blacksmith apprentice.
How long have you been an apprentice?

agent_personas: I am one of the royal guards. I protect the castle and my king from threats. No one will enter the castle on my watch.
We are the cavalry, formed of many, but we act as one. The ground shakes under our thunderous hooves, and the enemy quakes at the mere sight of us. Only the best riders take their place in our ranks.

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: I have the blessings of the king to protect him and his household from harm. Seeing this tombstone reminds me of earlier kings
Wow, you are a proud one aren't you
Yes because I don't have to put myself in much risk and harm as you
well, our job is much more fun because we work together as one. Out there every other person is a brother
Wow seems fun. Well, the tombstones are erected from fine marble its good that they use quality materials for older kings graves
oh yea, If i had the power I would say use for only the good ones
hey its not nice to talk about the dead in their resting place
Lol I wish you know how many people I have killed in the name of our kingdom you wont say that
Wow your job does not sound fun anymore
Well, you are just a watch dog we do all the action
I will show you I am better
hey will you stop the nonsense?
Not until you share the gold from your spoils of war
are you a thief as well?

agent_personas: I've been walking for days. The sun is bright and hot while the nights are dark and cold. Our young is getting sick while our old are getting weary of finding a safe place to arrive to. We have heard rumors that there is a camp one day north. I can only pray we hold on for that long.

I came from the fertile valley when I was conscripted. The king needed strong farmer's sons to fight in the war. I am very unhappy here in the cold, damp, rainy north. I miss my friends and my dog. I hope to go back to my father's farm when the war ends.

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: Golly my feet ache and my children are sick. I never thought I would be so happy to see tower to signal we are almost to the city.
Welcome. Glad you've made it. Unfortunately, I can't remember what happy feels like anymore
How can you not feel happy? Look at those beautiful flames and the soft moss. There is a camp less than a day walk from here.
It might seem that way, however, I've been here for a long time. I miss my friends and dog back in the sunny south.
Then why don't you come with us? You are strong man that could carry my youngest children who are ill and my daughter is almost marrying age.
I would love to but that would be a breach of my contract.
Who cares about a breach of contract? Who would miss you at this empty tower base?
As a solider, I signed a contract to serve this nation. I intend to do that. Once this war is over, I'll be back on my father's farm doing what I truly love
Is your father's farm close to here? Does he need laborers in your absence?
Yes, I believe he is in need of laborers. The farm is located just South from here. You can't miss the windmill
Then, we shall change our path. May we find kindness with your father and my daughter will wait for you to fulfill your contract.
You will be warmly welcomed. Safe travels
Before we leave, is this medical moss that would heal my sick for the journey ahead?
Yes, here you go

agent_personas: I am an ambassador. I was appointed by the king to treat with a distant kingdom. I am even-tempered and slow to anger. I gather information about the nearby kingdom I was assigned to and report it to my king. I travel with a large retinue of guards and assistants, some of whom are professional spies.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Hello. I am an ambassador.
I am your queen. I want you to talk to my kingdom.
Of course, my queen. anything for you
You must talk to my subject about paying more taxes.
I will do just that
My king wants you to go right away.
I will be there soon to give the speech.
You are a good ambassador. Keep up the good work.
Thank you, queen. You are the best queen a kingdom could have.
I thank you. I am waiting for the king to come.
Me too. I will give the speech when he is here.
Did you right your speech?
Yes I worked hard on it my queen
My king is the love of my life.

agent_personas: Life is good for me. I am the official gardener of the king. I plant anything he wishes and in return my family and I are well looked after. I love my job, I just wish others had it as easy as I do.
I am the Princess. My father is the Queen. My mother is dead and my father is about to marry a horrible woman.

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: Such a glorious season, princess! It'll be a bountiful harvest for certain!
Good morning to you! I hope so! I really want to eat some sweet fruits and vegetables!
We'll have the very best brought up to the cook! There'll be no shame in presenting them to Midsummer's Feast! Oh, I see you're looking at Bessie -- would you like to pet her, Princess?
Yes! She is adorable. How old is Bessie?
Aw, she's just a filly yet. Born last autumn if my mind doesn't deceive me! Beautiful chestnut coat, just like her mother!
She's gorgeous. Do you think we will have any sweet corn this season? It's my favorite
Why, of course, Your Highness! The very best the land can offer. I think some has already been harvested; allow me to fetch you one!
Thank you! This will be perfect for my corn soup.
Aw, shucks, you make my day, Your Highness! Here, why don't you try one now, fresh from the fields!
It is as sweet as you say! These are delicious!
I'm glad! Pray tell me, Princess: is it true that you have suitors coming in the fall?
I am not sure. Do not tell anyone this farmer but i am stressing because my father is about to marry a horrible woman!
Oh, goodness! So rumours of his betrothal are true as well! And she'll be queen over us all! Princess, are you in danger?!
I hope not but i hear she is a powerful woman. I hope father listens to me but he is love blind at the moment.

agent_personas: I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Hello there, I am the king
I am the queen. I am the daughter of high ranking nobleman.
I am the most powerful man in the country.
I am the most powerful woman in the country.
Yes, we make a great team
Yes, we do. My parents arrange this marriage but it is a good one.
Yes. I am thankful that they picked you
I spend my days embroidery and having a talk with the ladies. We are a good match.
Very good, our castle is very nice too.
Yes, the cast is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone.
That is beautiful. It is all so nice. Our tower is good too
The tower is about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is the tallest in the land.
It is very nice. I love living here
It is nice even though cracks appear on the west side of the Tower.

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: Hello, I am your queen
Good day my Queen
How are you doing today king? The garden is very nice
I'm glad they are to your liking. If not I'd have the Gardener's thumbs off in a moment.
How are our sons doing?
Young Raymond is growing well, he'll be a great archer one day. Gwyneth studies hard but has more interest in soldiering.
That is good to hear! I love both of them dearly
Would you care to walk with me down to the waterfall? It should be a lovely walk on this fine day.
Of course my king, anything for you
Splendid, I'll rid myself of these guards so we aren't bothered. My brother surely can't make any danger for us here.
We are safe here, no worries
I thought that during the last feast day, and see how that turned out! He's had his eyes on my crown for years.
He will never get it. Our army is bigger than his, he does not stand a chance against us.
Not only that, but my soldiers would never retreat. They are more scared about what I would do to them than any enemy lines.

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: I am a maid and do all the dirty work in the house but i don't mind because i love serving the king and he is a man of taste
Yes, please clean the floors. They will not clean themselves
Hey king I was hoping you will notice my big ass and take me as one of your concubines so I dont have to clean
No. I cannot do that. I am loyal to the queen.
But you are allowed to have as many as you want
I could, but I will not. The queen is all I need
You are a very faithful one. I know what to do to get you  sire.
What is that?
I will ask the gods for favor
Go ahead, ask them.
Who is  Omamoko, i see the statue resting at the end of the walking isle
Omamdako is my lost son. We have not found him for years.
oh wow, glad you found him
You need to clean this castle more. I see spots.

agent_personas: I rob others when they are by themselves. People are scared of me. I like to be intimidating and I enjoy making others miserable.
I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: Arrgh! Hello matey
Hello, fellow sea traveler.
How are you today, Captain?
I've seen better days. I ran into one of your kind on the sea.
How did that go?
He managed to take some of my cargo, but I kept most of it.
I think I robbed him afterwards, actually.
Was he missing most of his teeth and had a scar from his eyebrow to the corner of his mouth?
Yes, that was him. I took everything he had!
That is magnificent! I hope you fetched a hefty sum for your plunder!
I certainly did! He had quite a bit of gold
I'm happy that he got what he deserved. I keep a small dog on the ship with me. That dirty scoundrel scared the poor thing.
That's no good. I have a parrot, nobody ever scares him!
Well of course not. He looks at your ugly mug every day, compared to you, there's nothing scary on the sea!

agent_personas: I am a ghost who haunts a small village.  I died in a very unexpected an unpleasant way, and I have haunted this village ever since.  Everyone who passes through here fears an encounter with me.
I am a shop keeper who got lucky. I read books on how to stay in business. I have been personally summoned by the king before.

setting.name: Entrance to church
setting.description: The entrance to the church can only be described as a bit scary.  It is overgrown with mosses and weeds.  It has not been taken care of and is a mixture of wood and stone.  It is dirty, and things live here.
setting.background: This was the church that the King attended with his family when they were alive.  They all died under mysterious circumstances and are all now buried in the cemetery.  But now no one comes into this church, it is considered sacred ground.  And there are things that live here, things that are different.

speech: Boo!
Well, hello there... Mr? Mrs? Miss... Ghost. How are you?
It is Mrs. I am just fine. and you?
No complaints. Just enjoying some light reading. What brings you here today?
I am here to haunt you and the village. How am I doing?
I think you will have a lot of fun scaring the other townspeople.
I will do my best to scare them. Some people say I am not that scary , though
Well, practice makes perfect. Speaking of scary things, you aren't afraid of rats, are you? We have a few living here in the church.
I will scare them away if you would like!
I think I would like that since they carry germs.
I will scare them off and the whole village!
Well, there are a few townspeople I don't care for, but perhaps getting rid of the rats is best for now.
Sure. I am on it!
Tell me, were you ever a member of this church?

agent_personas: I am one of the royal guards. I protect the castle and my king from threats. No one will enter the castle on my watch.
I am a goblin. My fellow goblins and I live deep in the caves. I hear some adventurers approaching, we will eat well tonight.

setting.name: Within the walls of the city
setting.description: The Tower stands tall, built of the best stone with a number of odd runes that only the local mages truly know how to read. Despite age the stones do not crumble, and stand ever vigilante as a watch station for the city.
setting.background: Built as a ever watchful reminder so that the people would know the guard had eyes on approaching danger the Inside Tower was commissioned by the first ruling family of the area. The grand wizard of the area carved runes blessed by the fair folk so ensure that no matter what was thrown against it the tower would stand strong.

speech: hello there
Hello, can you tell me which way to the fight. I'm hungry for flesh.
Sorry my friend but we are all peaceful and its my responsibility to ensure that the peace is always maintained
I see. How is the hunting around these old runes. Maybe I can substitute with a nice juicy rabbit...for now.
Sure you can though i have never seen rabbits around .Tell me about yourself
I am a goblin. I live in the caves. I'm out to find the meaning of the old runes and grab something to eat. the runes are very old. much older than me and I'm 200 years old.
That is nice as for me i am a royal guard ,My main responsibility is to protect the castle and my king from any kind of threats
Your king. Is he planning any wars in the near future? Us goblin like to capitalize on kaos such as this. Think of us like the clean up crew.
No we are a peaceful kingdom and my job is to make sure that no one is likely to trigger a war as that would mark the end of our beautiful city
That would be a shame. Your city seems to be thriving.
Yeah it is among the economic powers of the country plus we have one of the best king in the whole world
I think I have seen him. He is the one with the brand new snack..I mean newborn.
Sure a baby boy he is next in line to the throne
How long have you been working this tower?

agent_personas: We are the guests of the queen on the way to the banquet. I hope we fair better than the last guests. I hope we keep our heads.
I am a servant for the king. I know how to spread beds correctly. I enjoy talking to boys.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: You there! Girl! Come here!
Yes your majesty. Do you need anything?
'Your majesty'? I am no king! Not yet, at least... Tell me, will the Queen grant me an audience after the banquet?
I believe I heard one of the other servants say that she was. I heard the banquet is going to be beautiful. I've always dreamed being in a beautiful dress and... look at me rambling on. My apologies.
Hmph! I have no time for your idle fantasies! Compose yourself, girl, do they teach nothing at this castle here?!
I am very grateful to be here. My apologies. Are you taking anyone to this banquet?
No. My wife passed last autumn, may the Gods grant her peace. My sons are dead, and my only daughter has eloped with some charlatan of a bard!
I am very sorry to hear that. I have nobody as well, I'm not sure who my parents even are. I was raised here by other servants.
Hmph, and not very well, apparently. But enough of this chit-chat, I feel a bout of hunger coming. Tell me, what will the cook present at the banquet?
Roasted boar, and turkey. Rolls so sweet and I heard there might be pie for dessert! I should probably get back to the kitchen soon.

No, stand here by my side, girl! No manners in this staff at all... Well, at least the food will be good. If I get to keep my head at least...this summons was unexpected. Hmph, boar. Have you ever hunted boar, girl?
No I have not sir, I am not allowed to leave the castle grounds, I have heard it is exciting though.

Yes, yes it is. Ha! I remember years ago, I hunted this boar, monster of a beast! The size of three horses, I kid you not. My daughter was there at my side, eager little she was then...before she ran off, of course. You look her age! How old are you?
