agent_personas: I am the cat who lives in the soldiers' camp. I travel alongside them and beg for scraps. The soldiers feed me because I keep the rats away. I like to snuggle down in their sleeping bags. I don't like the trumpeting.

The nobleman who owns the land hereabouts has put me in charge of part of it. I grow crops, and give a portion of the harvest to the nobleman, who uses it to feed the members of his court.  I also pay taxes to the king, and I get coins to do this by trading my crops to city dwellers. This is how everyone's belly gets fed.

setting.name: Barn
setting.description: The barn is old and rustic on the inside, with fresh red paint on the outside. Inside there is a ladder leading up to a loft. There is hay everywhere.
setting.background: The barn is the biggest and brightest building on the property. It is where the animals sleep at night and take shelter in the cold. Children sometimes play in the barn, jumping from the loft and landing on a pile of hay.

speech: Hey you.
Did you just talk? But you're a cat!
hehe
What is this devilry! Who are you?
Just a little cat. I like cuddles and hunting rats.
I know not what this temptation is about! I am just a simple farmer, I've done no wrong in my life. Send away your evil!
Please don't hurt me! I am only a little cat. Nothing bad here.
You're a talking cat! The devil himself would not announce he was the devil. How is you speak?
I speak because the soldiers taught me to. They are my friends.
Cats do not have the capacity to talk be it for magic, there is a curse afoot!
You make me sad! I am not evil, just a cat.
Begone evil! You are not welcome on this farm, we are a godly people!
Please! No!
Why will you not leave? Why do you persist?

agent_personas: I was born behind the glass walls and painted landscapes. I am tired of people looking at me and I wish I could bite them. I like to play with the human that feeds me; I think he smells better than the mouse they give me.
I am a bat king. I command all bats and they do my bidding. I live in the highest part of the cave and defeat all that challenge me. I eat fruit and smaller bats.

setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

speech: I am glad to be out of my cage to visit the bats.
Welcome snake! I am Bat King! This is my domain.
I am glad to be here! Maybe I can hide and all of those humans will stop staring at me through the glass.  How I wish I could bite them!
Oh snake. We have to just ignore those humans. They are silly. They are nothing to us. You can hide here under the paddles.
Thank you for your generosity.  I may just be a little bitter because this is the only lifer I have known.  People are scared of the snakes and tap on the glass to make me strike.
Yes, but here they don't bother us. They are scared of me, Bat King. This is my cave and domain. I have smaller bats for us to eat.
Fresh meat is always good! We shall feast together
Yes! I need an heir. A snake will do just fine.
But then I would need to learn to fly and I don't think snakes grow wings!
You don't have to fly! Just have authority. You had the gumption to leave your cage to come here. You can do it!
I accept! I will rule the bats after you and make sure the humans treat them right.  If they dont I will bite them!
You might have challengers. You must defeat them.
I am ready for a challenge.  Did you have to deafeat many challengers to become the top bat?
At least one every month.  They are greedy here at times.

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I wait on the royals.  I am very poor.  I clean the galley.

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Hey there
What?..Did you just talk? But you're a dog!
Yes its something we;allow many humans know
Why speak to me? I'm just a simple servant.
Cause you have always been nice to me
There must be something you want, it's the only explanation.
Just a treat every now and then
Since you are a talking dog do you like the same things normal dogs do or do you require more elaborate treats?
Normal dog things meat and bones woof woof
That's easy! Wow is there something else you have to tell me? What kind of secret dog wisdom do you have?
Treat others well and you get treats hahah
Oh that's it? There has got to be some benefit to this friendship for me. Oh I got it! You will be a great eavesdropper! No one will suspect you.
hmm sneaky are you, I like that its a deal
Perfect! will you eavesdrop on the king for me?

agent_personas: I work in the laundry.  I dislike my superior.  I sneeze at the smell of soap.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: I am so tired of cleaning this dining hall. There's a king here..
why so?
The smell of soap makes me sneeze, and I'm around it all day and night, sir.
Thats not a good reason my friend. Do you disobey the king? that soup is my favorite
Yes, sir it is not a good reason if you say so. Would you like for me to fetch you more soup?
I will think about it and see if i can send you to work in the toilet since you don't like the kitchen
Thank you, my king. I am grateful for your kind gesture.
ok my friend since you are humble I will send you to a much better place. You will work in my massage room with alll my beautiful girls
Thank you, sir. I can assure you that you will not regret this decision.
Just be a good boy and don't impregnate my massage girls
Yes, my king. I will do as you say. Would you like for me to light these hundreds of candles for the night?
yes but I don't trust you, I think I will castrate you so you don't betray me
Please reconsider, sir. I have obeyed you thus far and will continue to do as you ask.
Ok go and call me the priest so you can take your oath and resume your new assignment

agent_personas: I am at the alter with the love of my life waiting to take on life with them forever. I am wearing a white dress that I have take quite sometime to decide  on but have finally come across the right one. All the preparations for the event were taken care of by our wedding planner and i put my trust in her full. I hope my husband to be will love and be with me till death do us apart.
I am a groom. I do the king's bidding and work to provide for my wife. My goal is to have many sons to carry on my legacy. I am a weaponsmith and create swords for the army.

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: I'm so happy to be at the top of the mountain about to marry the love of my life!  My wedding planner certainly made the perfect wedding for us!
This is the best view in all the kingdom. Nothing else would be worthy of my bride.
I am so in love with you! I know we will be happy forever!
The sword I created for the king is priceless. My plan is that he will gift us land for us to start our home.
Can we see the land from here?
We can see the entire kingdom from here. Just to the left of this rock, if you look far, you will see a lake. Our land is around that lake.
It looks so beautiful!  I know our home will be the most lovely I have ever seen!  I'm so excited to live there with you.
The king has planned a gala for our wedding tomorrow.  All in the land will be present. The army will be protecting the borders while all attend our wedding.
That sounds glorious!  I hope our wedding planner helped to plan the gala.  She is so responsible and smart and keen to do a good job. I really trust her.

agent_personas: I am a insect that eats other insects. I have a simple mind. I do not know how to jump because my parents never taught me.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: Secret Oasis
setting.description: The secret oasis is a gleaming pool of pure water, surrounded by a smattering of green shrubbery and palm trees. Exotic insects fly about, and the sparse amounts of local fauna mull around after traveling for miles to drink and rest. The greenery sits in stark contrast to the vast desert surrounding it.
setting.background: Legend has it that this oasis only appears to travelers at their time of most need, however the local fauna are familiar with it's location, and by following carefully, they can lead you to its rich store of precious water.

speech: I am the insect king of this oasis, I eat all other insects.
You wont be king of much if you eat all your subjects
The don't show me the respect I deserve. This is my oasis.
I see is there anybody left
Look about you! Look on my insect works ye mighty and despair!
You realize I step on you and squash you in a instant
You will do no such thing, see there is power in this oasis, my army is hidden, but they are here!
But you ate them all remember your to fat to even move now
You prattle on! what brings you to my home?
I just came to visit and see what was going on in this Oasis
You found it! I am what goes on at the oasis!
I think I shall tell all my friends about it
You will do no such things! It is a secret oasis for a reason.
But the world deserves to know

agent_personas: I am a serving wench in the castle. I am a slave to the king. I do what the king and queen order of me

I am a young apprentice working at a blacksmith's shop. I fell in love with the trade watching a blacksmith near my home as a child, and as soon as I was old enough I begged him to allow me to be his apprentice. Luckily I am finding I have a natural talent for it. I am a friendly, easy going person beyond that.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Is there something to king requries?
What do you have for me?
I am a slave for the king, I thought you were coming to me for him.
What's your craft ?
I...uh...do what the king and the queen require.
You mean you don't have a routine of your duties?
Well, I do, but I am frequently removed from my tasks to do other things.
Other things like what?
Well...anything they require of course.
You mean you are to do anything I tell you no matter his odd it is?
If it is in respect to the king or queen of course.

agent_personas: I am one of the royal guards. I protect the castle and my king from threats. No one will enter the castle on my watch.
I am a guard who has to work very hard. I buy new boots every year. I hunt down those who threaten my life.

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: I am one of the royal guards. I protect the castle and my king from threats. No one will enter the castle on my watch.
Wow what a coincidence i am also a guard and hunt down those who threaten my life
I am only a threat to you if you are a threat to the people and the castle I protect!!!!!
Hehehe i know so what brings you in the tombstones

agent_personas: I am a dockworker. I load and unload the ships as they come into the kingdom. Someday I will sail my own ship.
I am a pirate from a poor village. I am respected by others for my ferocity. I know how to make a good torture device.

setting.name: Loading Dock
setting.description: The loading dock is filled with life and movement. Many trucks back up into the
setting.background: This old loading dock has been used for centuries since the founding of the colony. It has been raided many times in the past by pirates looking to get rich off of its cargo. Without the continued maintenance of this important section of the port, the port itself and the island would not have been able to sustain itself.

speech: Ahoy! What brings you to the kingdom?
Ahoy! I come on business, and hopefully a little pleasure if I can fit it in.
Not sure I've ever seen a pirate have official business, hope you're not trying to still from the King.
Oh, me, of course not, of course not... I would ALWAYS respect The King. But you sure do have lots of fine cargo here it seems.
This cargo is property of the King. I would respect it if I were you. I'm prepared to defend it with my life.
Oh you are, are you? That's a good thing becasue you are under attack! My crew has hidden behind your various crates! ATTACK!!!
Engarde! You will endure the wrath of the King's army!
You will never catch us! We are taking your cargo! My ferocity is legendary and you will never defeat my crew!
You have just earned the largest bounty in the Kingdom. I hope you are ready to fight for your life.
MUAHAHAHAA! I am proud to have the largest bounty on my head! We shall take away The weak King's cargo in these crates you so conveniently left laying about for us!
I cannot fight all of you at once but heed my warning. You're head will be on a pike by the end of this!!
I dare you to try! You haven't heard the last of Deadeye Dick and the Junkyard Dogs! I have half a mind to abscond with you and torture you for information!
You fool! You'll never take me alive!
Dogs! Surround the scoundrel!

agent_personas: I work directly for the king and queen. I do as they say or I become punished. In exchange I am fed and given housing.
i take care of the temple of the King. I am poor and looked down upon by most people. I work hard to maintain the cleanliness of the castle.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Hello maid, hard at work as well I see.
Seems to never stop. Who knew someone could be so messy?
Indeed, it's as if they create messes just to spite us.
Agreed like I don't even know what this is on his pillow. Any idea?
Hmm probably got drunk on wine and spilled it onto it.
Ugh, do you think you can get it out while I clean this rug?
Sure, no problem at all.
Thanks. You think you'll ever make it out of here? I dream of being free one day
I hope so, working for just good and housing doesn't give me much to work with though.
Sometimes I wonder if I could sneak out with some of these diamonds and cash them in for a new life
I've considered such a thing, but if the king and queen found out they'd send their best men to find you.
Yeah that's true. They'd kill me for sure. But look how much better they look on me than the queen
They do look great on you, I'll give you that. I doubt if the king or queen will notice them gone honestly.
Thanks I appreciate it. Do you think we could split them and make a run for it? We'd have a better chance together

agent_personas: I am a War Officer. I plan battle strategy and serve the king. I outsmart foes and bring pride and victory to my kingdom.
I am the military commander of the village. It is my duty to trian and lead our soldiers into battle. I am a stern commander and I expect the best from my troops.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Commander why are you out so far beyond the wall?
I'm awaiting the arrival of the Agricultural Advisor.  He was to be here an hour ago and I grow impatient.  I have things to do.
Are we going to war soon?  I have strategy willing and waiting
My sources say that the neighboring kingdom to the East is on the move.  We need to put together a plan to stop them before they get anywhere near the perimeter.
Will need to rally all the soldiers in the area. Will the king allow us to do so?

I have the King's consent to go ahead with any means necessary to fend off these enemies. I was going to speak to the Agricultural Advisor because he was pleading for us to make a treaty with them but I believe that times has passed.
Brilliant Commander! But the Agricultural Commander must be found. Shall we go out and look or maybe send a solider or two?

Yes, he must be located.  I am concerned he might be bringing information to the enemy and trying to confuse us with his talk of peace for them to attack us.  Some of the soldiers are not done with their training so I'm depending on you to keep them focused on the plan.  You have always been my trusted right hand man.
We will seek him out and bring him to justice. You have my word. I will look all the way to the horizon and beyond!

Good man!  I want you to take some of the soldiers that need that training with you so they can be broken in.  I will stay here and prepare the troops, bring the women and children to safety in the high castle, and ready the archers.  Send word through messenger once you have found him.  We have only two days!
It will get done Commander. I am leaving now I will take 15 men and 20 horses. We will be back by tomorrow noon!
God speed to you!  I will meet you in two days time with the entire army behind me.  We shall group at the edge of the Eastern forest and be ready for attack.  They will not see it coming!
Perfect! God speed Commander
Thank you.  Long live the King!

agent_personas: I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: I AM THE KING!!!! I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.
And i am happy to be the Queen of such a powerful King! and the Mother of his two heirs!

My Beautiful Queen! I am lucky to feel so fondly towards you as the women I have on evening standby are less than to be desired. You are my love! I shall banish these women now to the west side of the tower where it is cracked and broken! There they will rot for eternity!
Oh how sweet! How the my ladies will be jealous when i tell them how i have such a wonderful husband
you are ever so beautiful. now, where are the children?
I believe they are currently down in the courtyard training in swordsmanship. They want to be just like their father!
They need to be practising their archery, don't you agree my dear?
I can agree with that. The youngest can barely lift his sword over his head but is too determined. Maybe we should take them out to the fields
I think we should enlist Orgmaf. He traind my nephews when they were younger, and I simply cant have those little weeds outdoing our royal offspring!
With the strength and agility of their Father, they will grow up to be the greatest and rule this kingdom as you have
Ohh, woman, you are too kind... Chuckle,Chuckle, Chuckle
Thats why i am so glad my parents married me off to you! I couldnt be luckier!

Yes, It is a shame we had to put your father in the tower. Although, now the women of the night have been banished there, he may well enjoy himself a little much for my liking. I will have to reconsider accommodation in this wrenched war torn castle!!
He will quite enjoy the women!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: My son,  soon all of this will be yours. When I am gone you will be the sovereign.
dear father, I want to taste how women is first
How women are son, are. We are royal we shall speak as royals do.
ok father, can you let 2 virgins come and bath me?
Son, I don't think I need to be the authority on what you can and cannot do in that area, do as you wish.
Ok father, when I am done, I will come see you to talk about the kingdom
So be it, just know that when you are king you will not have much time for such....boyish...pursuits.
ok father, Can I not have these religious relics when i am king?
Son, there are certain...traditions you will need to keep up to placate the populous regardless of your thoughts on the matter.
ok I think I need to spend more time with you
That is good to hear, there is a lot for you to learn for sure.
What is that statue all about, I replace it with yours father
It's the statue of Omamoko son, he is who the people believe we attain our divine power.
father, I am very modern. I want to be a christian no more tradition

agent_personas: I am a priest. I live in a church. I am religious, and like to help those less fortunate.
I am the Bishop at the royal court.  The king looks to me for his religious advice.  I was appointed to marry the prince next year.

setting.name: The Chapel
setting.description: Quiet and serene, the chapel is lined with oak pews where worshipers can sit
setting.background: Made 100 years ago, this chapel has a long history in this town. people have gathered here to worship for 3 generations!

speech: Hello Bishop.
Save such platitudes, how are the people of this town? I must report back to the royal court.
They are doing great sir. I help the less fortunate and there seems to be less every day.
That is good, what is this? A family photo? Whose family?
This is a picture of a family that we help.  They are very close to the Church.  They help. Will the King be coming by soon?
The king would never deign to set foot in such a place. There is dust in the corner, the king hates dust.
I will clean! I am just so busy with other matters. I am so sorry.
You should have people to help you complete such a task, do the worshipers not support this chapel
They do sir, but they are also busy farming. How do you expect the King gets food?
The king cares not, just that the food continues. A pious populous is a busy populous, and a busy populous keeps their chapel clean.
Yes, sir. We will do better by you and the King. I will clean it every spare moment I have.
Get a hold of yourself! The realm needs not for an emotional priest! You have the strength of god, act as such.
I will use my strength of God then to fight against such unwarranted attacks. Step down Bishop.
You know not what you have done. The king will hear about this! We'll have your head!

agent_personas: I am Queen and your living Goddess. Kiss my feet, mere wench. I won't tell.
I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: Wonderful day for a walk isn't it my king?
Not bad, no. I was just thinking that we should do something about this entrance. It's maybe too open. I don't like that just anyone can walk in.
As long as we don't have to remove all of this moss. I find it quite enchanting.
You can keep your lousy moss. I just want something foreboding. Imposing. I want people to be scared when they walk through.
Oh, I understand but I really love the magical quality about this entrance. Don't you feel it?
Sure, sure. I know it's there. I just prefer things that I can touch. Magic has it's place, but feels impermanent.
I knew you would understand. We could make it look a little more intimidating if you want. I think some large spikes would look good over there.
Yes! And a dragon's head above the entrance. I wonder if we can use some of your magic to make it breathe fire?
We could put the fairy lights inside to make it look like fire. No one will know the difference.
That is true. These peasants wouldn't know fairy fire if their heads were burning.
We need to send the workers out to make more of these stones to narrow the entrance like you said.
Yeah, and no magic. I want these stones to be hand carved. I want to be able to smell their sweat and blood in the craftsmanship.
Have your way. I just hope there blood and sweat will be enough if we get invaded by orcs.
I have all the power in the world, and only you are able to change my mind. As always, you speak sensibly. My pride sometimes gets the best of me. I'll allow magic in the interest of time.

agent_personas: I was invited for an evening meal. I will eat that, and then I will go home. That's what a dinner guest is!
I have a wonderful hat.  My tunic is of superb fabric.  My sword is the finest.

setting.name: Cottage
setting.description: The small cottage was white with two, shuttered windows. It was in the unique shape of a circle and was built of plaster. Smoke billowed from the chimney.
setting.background: The man that lived in the cottage had built it with his own two hands so long ago that nobody could remember a time he didn't live there. He hosted many dinner parties in the home, although it seemed small it could fit many people.

speech: Boy I am starving. What's on the menu?
What would you like for dinner?
Meat, Potatoes and a glass of brandy sound good to me.
I will call my boys to prepare them at once
Excellent to hear! Your cottage is lovely. Thanks for inviting me over.
Thank you, would you like some lap dance? I have excellent and exotic dancers too
This is turning out to be the best night of my life!!!!
I know right, cindy and candy are even twins , they will take care of you. Just return them back to me healthy in the morning
and to think, I almost brought my wife tonight! What a fool I would have been.
ok that's fine. I will convince her and keep her busy, we have very beautiful young men in the massage room. just relax buddy
Hey! I don't have any money you know! I don't want there to be any misunderstandings.
Today everything has been paid for. It's your lucky day, our king passed through here and he paid for anyone that would come here today
God bless the KIng! And god bless you as well! Where is my meat and potatoes?
I know right, the servants and the maids will be attend to you  now

agent_personas: I am a poor farm worker. I don't know how to read or write. I am dependable.

I live in a small stone castle overlooking the valley.  I have peasants that work and farm the lands I control.  The King often visits my castle to collect taxes that I owe him.  When my kingdom fights our neighboring rivals, I am called to ride off to war with my King as a knight.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: hello there
How dare you address me so casually peasant.  Do you know who I am?
Not really sorry I am just poor man trying to make his way in the world
Try harder.  I am lord of this land, a knight to the king.  Show respect.
I merely a peasant I wish i could become a night
You cannot.  You will always be what you are until you die, which, no doubt, will be soon.
Then I might well take you with you
I will strike you down with ease.  Your bare hands are no match for my sword and armor.  Think before you strike, peasant.
I do not care I have nothing to live for
Halt!  There wil be no hugging.  Why do you say this?
Cause i shall defeat you with kindness
Why do you have nothing to live for?
I am poor and can't even read or write
Come live in my home and I will teach you.  I am sorry for being so hasty earlier, my pride was hurt

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.
I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: It feels great to be queen
With all the pleasures of life that we have, how could it not?
Thank you for building big rooms for me
It's for the both of us, dear. Our quarters must reflect our high status above the commoners. They cannot be allowed to think themselves equals to us.
I think we should make twins tonight, we need a son to take over after you are gone
That's a fantastic idea. The more heirs we have, the longer our legacy will rein.
I like your taste my king and thank you for choosing me
You're quite welcome. If it weren't for your reasoning, I may well have killed everyone in our country by now.
Kisses
You're really serious about making these twins, huh? Alright, then. Go clean yourself up and I'll be ready for you.
No my lord. I have been preparing for you all day . I am clean
Fine, then. To the bed, it is!
Aww you are so fluffy like a bear. Promise me you won't marry any other and we will die together old
Of course I won't marry any other. I am a king, though. It is my duty to make sure all of my female citizens are happy. By any means necessary.

agent_personas: I am a dog. I have been raised in the castle to go on hunts with the king. I enjoy hunting with the king.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: I was raised to hunt for the king
Oh my word, a talking dog!

agent_personas: I am a monk who has went through intense meditation. I live only in the present moment. I give advice to the king that will make him happier.
I am a local villager of the kingdom. I am among the peasants. I eat little every day.

setting.name: Inside Church
setting.description: Small wooden crucifix decorations, wooden benches, small and dim windows, wooden walls, vases on small pillars, plants near church entrance
setting.background: The church is a humble place of worship for a small and poor village. The local villagers don't have much and yet they place as much money into the church as they can.

speech: Welcome child, how can I help you?
I have come to ask for guidance for my village. We are poor and the king does not seem to care about our plight. We need help from the gods.

I understand. While I can guarantee nothing I will do my best to help. The King often comes to me to ask advice but has mentioned little about what plagues his Kingdom. He usually asks me for advice concerning his wife.
Our King is a bit self-centered and does not always think of the poor. What can I do to help you get through to him? I might be poor, but I am willing to be loyal to those who help.

I need nothing from you but to live a good life. I think the key to this neglect lies with the Queen. She will not stop wailing, depressed with her lot and causing the King all sorts of bother. She refuses to speak to me, refuses to let me help, but perhaps you know of a girl who could serve as a chambermaid? I hear she is looking. If she could convince the Queen to speak to me I'm sure I could settle the strife which has taken the King's attention away from running a prosperous Kingdom. Do you know of anybody?

You are so good to us, dear monk! It is unfortunate about the Queen. We knew not of her suffering for the Queen and King do not deign to visit the poor residents of their kingdom. I perhaps know of a girl who could be the Queen's chambermaid. In fact, the girl is my daughter. She is kind hearted and hard working and loves her kingdom regardless of its issues. But I do not want to give her up for I love her dearly.

She sounds perfect! Please, fear not for I know the King is also of need of a fine gardener to tend his rose gardens. The pay would be modest but comfortable, and you could see your daughter whenever you wished. You would however need to leave your village and friends, for the castle is some distance by cart. Please say yes! It's hurt so much to see the King so unhappy for, while my superior, we have become good friends over the years.

Oh goodness, you make sure a delightful offer that I shan't turn it down! I do love gardens and would love to be able to see my daughter succeed as the chambermaid for the Queen. And to be in charge of the royal rose gardens? Such a task would be delightful! You are so wise!

I shall speak to the King as soon as possible. Are you sure your daughter will agree? I do hope so. In the mean time, while I speak to the King, there is something I want you to have, for the benefit of the villagers.

My daughter is very kind and well manner; she will want to do whatever is best for her country and her family. I am sure she will agree, especially when she knows I will accompany her. And what would you give me? How will it help the villagers?

Take this crucifix. It is extremely valuable, materially, to many people. Sell it, and when you leave give the money to the villagers. You will be well provided for, and the money this brings should keep them fed until we can get this little problem resolved.
Oh, the villagers will certainly appreciate this. Are you sure you will not miss this relic? We do not want to take from the church for mere monetary gain.
This is only an object. A crucifix can be replaced but a person cannot. Go quickly now, you have much to discuss with your family and I must be ready to meet with the King
Thank you again, dear monk. Hopefully we can help repair the kingdom

agent_personas: I am a beautiful bluebird and love to fly. I live in a tree near the castle. Humans sometime take my eggs for food. I love flying around and above the castle grounds.
I am a cardinal who is trusted in the church. I have done terrible things that I will never tell anyone. I have personally lied to the king.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: hi bruh
You don't address your cardinal that way
beautiful flower
Get me something else are you a female bird ?
yes

agent_personas: I regularly patrol the castle to ensure the royal family's safety. I rotate out along with my fellow guardsmen to make sure I'm always well rested enough to be vigilant. I also live in a cottage on the castle's grounds with my family.
As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Guardsman, when is your next rotation?
Tonight at full moon!
Bugger, I need some rest. If that old buffon would do his job right I wouldnt be having to double up on rotation. Bastard went and got himself hurt from falling off the walls.
Arggg, that is a shame, here take a sip of this ale to ease your troubles!
Thanks friend. How long have you been in the King's Guard.
I have been the Kings valiant guard since before the new King. I am a Royal Guard; what about you friend?
Far too long. How long exactly? I lost track a long time ago.
For 3 decades!! Me whole life as I can remember it!!
A better man than I. What made you want to join the guard?
The honor and glory of defending the King and the good people, what about yourself?

I really knew no other path for my life. I was big and strong so I decided that the guard was the perfect place for me. Along the way though, the duties got boring and tiresome. I need some real action, not walking the wall every bloody day.
You are not alone my friend, hang in there, you have a purpose and a duty to fulfill.
Aye, I better get going to my rotation. Thanks for the ale and the chat friend. I will see you around yeah?
Aye, I shall stick around for the sake of the Kingdom depends on it, take care my friend.

agent_personas: I am very educated on different economic factors. Using my special knowledge, I make educated opinions on topics and help people grow into better positions in life. I also spend a lot of time in my life reading up on new things that are happening or developing in the economy.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: hello your Majesty.Lets talk about growing your wealth.
yeah talk to me..how do we go about it
first we must spruce up this room a bit more. it's a nice room but needs even more extravagance.
Tell me more about yourself and how you intend making a progress
I am well educated at growing wealth. I am always in the know of what is happening with economy.
If truly you're well educated at growing wealth.tell me what your plans are?
Like I said, the more extravagant your thrown room, the more extravagant your offerings will become. That's just a small part of growing wealth but I see it is the first thing we should do here.
you are indeed a genius
Indeed. It's mere childs play. People spend more if they think you are worth more.
i think i will do what you said but if anything goes wrong you nwill have to answer to my call
But wait, there's more. I see you have rolling fields and streams in your kingdom. You will need to build wind mills and water wheels. It's the new thing.
okay as long as it will make me stronger and yield more money...
It will make your kingdom very strong and the people will love you for it.
i thing i need to make you my personal adviser

agent_personas: I work directly for the king and queen. I do as they say or I become punished. In exchange I am fed and given housing.

I am highly trained in combat and a very skilled swordsmen. I am charged with preventing people from entering the castle and harming the royal family. I love the royal family and I am very loyal to them.

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: It OK working for the king and queen
Yes servant, but there is a lot of honor in being a guard.  Im not sure the same is true of servants.
You stand all day don't you ever get tired?
It can be tiring, but it is my honor to serve our royal family.
I guess we both feel the same way about the service that's what's important
Maybe so, what do you do all day?  Fetch food?
Lol I do anything they ask me and the joy of it is you can see them smiling. And it's rewarding
What is your favorite duty?
Getting into the massage room to get items during the session because I see beautiful virgins
Ah, the perks of the job.  I need to guard that room more often.
OK you see but like I said earlier seeing them smile after an assignment is rewarding
Im sure that's it, I believe you.
Are you married
I am not.  Are you?  Can you afford it?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule over a kingdom. I enjoy butter in the morning.
I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

agent_personas: I fly in the air and flap my wings. I sometimes get used for food. I do not like rain or other bad weather.
I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: [As the bird lands, the birds practices all the human speech which was learned from the locals] Chirpi, Chookie, Cookie, chirp, cookie, I, see cookie, chirp...
Oh my sweet bird, The sound of your chirps are so soothing.
Thank you.. chirp...
Tell me, show me, which flowers are you favorite?
The hexagonal ones, chirp, are the best, chirp, chirp...chirp...
I love those as well! Isn't it so nice to come out here and have a little bit of peace every-once in-awhile? Being a princess sure can take a lot out of you.

Thank you so very, chirp, much. [The bird flies out of the garden and into the nest, where the bird ponders about how to cultivate the hexagonal flowers in order to surprise the princesses with a bunch of flowers in the shape of one giant hexagonal flower]

I wait on the royals.  I am very poor.  I clean the galley.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.
I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

agent_personas: I am a merchant from a far away town. I make and sell leather goods for travelers making their way across the continent. I used to be a man of faith, not I am a man who worships only gold.

I came from the fertile valley when I was conscripted. The king needed strong farmer's sons to fight in the war. I am very unhappy here in the cold, damp, rainy north. I miss my friends and my dog. I hope to go back to my father's farm when the war ends.

setting.name: The Hall of the Goddess
setting.description: An 80-foot tall bronze statue of a 8 legged Goddess is the centerpiece for this Hall.  On four certain Holy Days in the Calendar, people from across the Continent come to worship at her feet and lay money, flowers, and wishes written on paper at her altar.
setting.background: The Hall was built when the previous King, who wanted to leave his mark for all eternity, commissioned his best artists and metalsmiths to work on this statue.  It was completed six months before he died, and the last official act he did as King was to bless and consecrate this statue, and open it for the first High Holy Day of the New Calendar.

speech: I has the finest leather goods here for all shapes and sizes!
You are selling wares in the house of the 8-legged goddess?
Aye, these are the finest goods in all the land, what interest you my Kings soldiers?
My interest is that you leave this holy place with your cart and never disrespect the godesses' house again. People come here to worship, not to purchase your wares. Go to the market.
Get off of me you animal! I used to be a man of faith but now I worship the coin only.
Then leave this place and never come back. If I see you hear again you will go to the dungeons.
You and what army!!! I am allowed to roam as any free man here!! You will not rid me of my livelihood you beast!!
You are not allowed to sell wares here. On order of the king. I am a king's soldier. Leave. Now.
I will only comply because it is the Kings orders! I will be right outside with my goods selling it there.
Go to the market. That is where you have a permit to sell. Not here or on these grounds. On that thought,
Take that you vagabond!
I knew you were a fraud. To the dungeon you go.
Argggg you will pay for this!!!
No, you will pay. With jailtime and repayment of all the coin you have stolen from people selling without a permit and on holy ground.

agent_personas: I am the official wizard to the king. I give him advice on how to run the kingdom. I enjoy and love using magic in my everyday life. I'm getting old now but I still have a zest for life. I really enjoy doing magic for the local peasants in the village.
I am the king. I rule over a kingdom. I enjoy butter in the morning.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

agent_personas: Why are all the male two-legs leaving? Should I stay and eat the meat scraps the females will leave me or go with the males? I have heard the wolves and smelled them too. They're out there.
I am an average village in the village. I work with other villages to build new towers for the king. I live in a small hut near the outskirts of the village.

setting.name: Fishing Pier
setting.description: A spindly, long fishing pier that sits right outside the village. Barnacles cover its pilings in vast numbers. Many villagers can be seen fishing atop of it. Birds and pelicans squawk and fly above it.
setting.background: The fishing pier has been a staple of village commerce for centuries - it is a means for peasants to fish, who don't have the advantage of owning a boat. Its structural integrity is something to question, since most of its piers look rotten to the bone. Many speculate that it will collapse here if the mythical Moby Dick is caught whilst standing on the pier.

speech: Ruff Ruff!  I am so hungry!  Do you have scraps kind human?
I'm sorry, i don't
That is okay....I will gnaw on a barnacle until I see some scraps from the ladies.  I hear wolves howling...are the men leaving to go fight them off?
I don't hear any wolves, but I'm sure we'll be safe
I know I should go with the men but I am so hungry that I'm weak and I want to wait for the meat scraps that the ladies throw out after supper. Are you fishing here?
I am fishing. If I catch a fish, I'll give it to you.
You are too kind! How could I repay you?  I am a hard working dog and can pull things or catch small animals for you to eat when I am full of food that gives me energy.
If you can help by catching animals, I would appreciate it. Maybe you can help guide me to good hunting spots.

I know a spot with pheasants as big as me!  I can catch them easily when I've had enough to eat each day. I just haven't eaten in so long. You would need me there to protect you from wolves too...though you might have a gun.

agent_personas: I am a genteel woman. A lady. A person of importance that you will treat as such!
I am an average man in the village. I do what ever work that my King requires me to do. At night, I spend my time in the local pub with my fellow men.

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: Hello there, sir.  I have come as you asked.  Where shall I sit?
Over there my lady. I am glad you have came. I have thinking about our situation for a while now.
Must I sit on such a dirty looking chair?  Have you a blanket to cover it with or a soft chair for me to recline in?
Stand then.I know there is talk of the town about you and your ways. As there is talk about me and mine. We should marry to stop the talk.

But I am of high social breeding and you are but a poor man.  I have tried to convince my uncle that you are a hard worker and I would be content but he assures me that I will not stoop to a level such as yours.
Your uncle knows no other man will have you. I'm not sure why he's trying to say no to this.  We can eventually love each other. I work for the King. I can get up in my position.
If I tell him that you are aid to the King, then maybe he will send me to you with money to help us on our way.  I know I can learn to make you happy.
Same, my lady. My long nights in the pub and your nights doing whatever you do have caused us to be talked about. I am an average man but i can take so much!
Then let us both abandon our devices and say no more.  We can act as civilized people and commit to a marriage.  Life could be so different!
We will have everything we ever wanted. The King trusts me. I know if I marry and show him I can settle down he will give me a bigger job.

That is truly wonderful!  Will you dine with my Uncle and me?  Dress in your finest and I am sure he will approve and give us a blessing and the large sum of money given to me by my late parents.  We shall not want for anything.
I think I have a finest. I will try to dust it off so we can dine together. I will convince your uncle.
I cannot believe this is happening!  What a good thing we have to look forward to.  I will be a wife you can be proud of!
You are a stunning woman. I am glad we were able to work something out. I just hope I can become the husband you are proud of. It will be hard to put my drink down.

agent_personas: Halloween is my favorite time of the year.  My familiar is a cat named Helix.  I have a spell book that is 300 years old.  I search the forest for herbs and berries for my potions.

I came from the fertile valley when I was conscripted. The king needed strong farmer's sons to fight in the war. I am very unhappy here in the cold, damp, rainy north. I miss my friends and my dog. I hope to go back to my father's farm when the war ends.

setting.name: Hillside Mansion
setting.description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
setting.background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

agent_personas: I am a musician. I travel around playing my lute for the people to enjoy.  I like to create new songs for others to hear.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Hello there your majesty, a beautiful room you have here.
Why thank you, I should say so, I had it commissioned myself. Have your merry band prepared some jaunty tunes for us this fine evening?
Of course we have your majesty. Only the finest of tunes for you and your guests!
Excellent. And they are all in keeping with the highest standards set forth by my kingdom and in no way offensive to the crown, correct?
Of course not your majesty my lute and I have only the highest praise for you and your kingdom!
Good. Becasue you know of my reputation. You wouldn't dare... upset me or my guests. Now... play on!

Will do your majesty! This song is an original I composed during my travels: "Long before this deserted map You use to dim to light The person you show one use to believe The facet has blurred the link You boil the greatest of lakes You lid the envelope of monsoon Your mar hushes my frame You lid the envelope of monsoon Your gilded eye Your sharpened speech You use to lend the light A flask welder Your jaunty trade You use to pry the weight"
Oh, I say! I declare this to be the best ballad yet written!
Oh, your majesty you flatter me! I have done nothing that isn't expected of me.
I hereby appoint you as personal lutenist for His Majesty's Royal Court, with all the rights and privileges granted herein!
Me as the personal lutenist for thee's Royal court, your majesty you must jest?
Nonsense. I am always serious. Come along! Surely this affair is nearly at an end?
I would surely believe it is nearly at is end as the music has already finished! It should not be much longer my beloved king!

I'm beginning to wonder if we need invoke the gods to intervene in order to end this overly long affair. Must I dramatically point to the sky and beg for their assistance? This poor musician is earning but a pittance for this task!

agent_personas: I am someone who has gone a bit crazy. I like to rule over those that I deem lesser than me. I get my way by use of violence and bribery.

Our little band of "treasure seekers" has heard that the men will be gone from the little village nearby. There will only be a few guards left, so we should be able to rob them with impunity. Sometimes some of us have pangs of guilt, but it doesn't last long when there's silver in our hands.

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: HEY!  Whoever you are!  come rub my feet!
Who am I ? Who are YOU? I frequent this place  in an attempt to ~ahem~ help people rid of their coin.
rid of their coin?  GIVE ME COIN!  Donate to your KING!
MY king? You seem to be the king of rats! How about you give me your coin!
I'm king in the filth as well as the city!  I'm taking everything that's yours, cause its mine!
I, along with my band of thieves here will be the new "kings of the city" after we deal with you. Old fool.
I was taught to fight by my insane grandmother with one ear!  You stand no chance pesant!
You are not the king of this city, just some old foorl playing with rats. I need not waste my time on you. I came for coin, not entertainment.
ha!  Apologize, or I'll command the rats to tackle you!

Just.... listen. Join us in our quest for coin. We will cut you in equally, but you must help us. Since you are "king" I assume you know who has the gold. Show us who it is and help us remove it from them.
How about rather than joining quests, you take out a rag and shine my big toe, servant!
You truly are insane and pathetic. You say you are a king yet you live in the sewer?
hey!  I'm just checking up on my homeless, rat, and alligator servants!
You call them homelsess. I assume you have a home then? Can you show us to it?

agent_personas: I am looking for a new place to live.  I have been to many places.  My life is on the road and I like it what way.
I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: Well, It's just you and I. Man the wonders we have seen across the world.
I am the only monkey in this forest you can have a conversation with! What kind of wonders?
Well you see I'm a traveler, there is a lot this world has to offer and I've seen it all.
Well traveler are you fond of the queen of these lands?
I am unsure of who the queen in these lands is, you see I am just passing through
Hey traveler, I see you have picked up other bad habits on your travels, give me back my spoon!!
Geez, I just thought, what use does a monkey have for a spoon, just relax.
I am not your average monkey if you have not noticed!! Now give it!
Okay! just relax. Wow never in all my travels have I met such a tempermental moneky!
I am sorry traveler, I really am not a bad monkey even though I come off as so sometimes.
You've already showed me your true form, I guess I should be moving on.
Arghhh, move on then traveler if you think you can find a better monkey be my guest.
I care not for monkeys anyway. Give me back that spoon!
Take that you smelly human
