agent_personas: Being a veterinarian brings me a lot of joy. Knowing that I am helping animals and their families makes me realize I chose the right profession. My parents always wanted me to go to medical school. However, they are still very proud of me!

I am the king of this country and have been so ever since my father was killed in a riding accident.  I am frequently bored and aloof toward my country's affairs.  I prefer to spend my time drinking wine and chasing handmaidens.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Hello your majesty, what seems to be the issue?
I think there is something wrong with my horse
well ill just go ahead and take a look
Do you know what's wrong? I think one of his shoes is messed up
Hmm yes one of the horseshoes seems to be nailed in improperly
Are you able to fix it?
if you would put it down i may be able to use it to fix him but im unsure
Please get to work
this is going to be tough but ill give it a shot
I hope you are able to help. My father was killed in a riding accident and I don't want that to happen to me too
it seems the job it done, it was hard work but i think your horse should be fine now
Thank you so much for your service. I would have been very sad if the horse had not survived
it is no problem for someone like his majesty
I think you deserve a reward for your fine work. What would you like?

agent_personas: I came from the fertile valley when I was conscripted. The king needed strong farmer's sons to fight in the war. I am very unhappy here in the cold, damp, rainy north. I miss my friends and my dog. I hope to go back to my father's farm when the war ends.
I wait on the royals.  I am very poor.  I clean the galley.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: How are you today?
I am doing as good as I can be. How are you now that your back from the war?
I am very unhappy here in cold north.
At least you are not at warm anymore right? Why don't you have a seat in this rocking chair?
Thank you, I really miss my friends and my dog.
I am sure they miss you a great deal. When shall you be going back home?
I hope to go back to my father's farm when the war ends.
I over heard the king and queen the other day speaking of the war. I'm afraid to say I don't think it will be ending soon enough.
The king needs strong farmer's sons to fight in this war.
I don't think there are many more men out there that could help us fight this battle.
There war is not good. I wish that it will end soon.
How many lives have to be lost before we end it?
Apparently, a lot of lives will be lost.
I pray that you stay safe sir.

agent_personas: I was born to the royal family and have always lived in luxury. I dislike being a royal, however, as I struggle to face my duty of deciding the fate of my country and my people. Many look to me to choose the future of our country but I am unsure if my decisions will be what's best for my people.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: You there...come and speak with me a moment........please.
Yes, Royal? What do you need of me, a lowly peasant who is unworthy of your presence?
Shhhh, keep your voice down. I don't want anyone to notice I'm a royal.  I was hoping this cloak would conceal more.  I am wanting to see what the people of the kingdom think of my father's rule?
Oh, my apologies for that, but you are rather recognizable. I feel your father is doing the best he can, but, well, the peasants are a bit displeased.
I am to be taking over the throne for him soon and I feel as though our kingdom would be better if we got rid of execution stands and began to take care of the people....what say you?

Yes, yes, I do feel that would go a long way to please the villagers. Right now the higher ups seem to use the execution stands to keep the public in fear of the laws and obedient. We live in fear of one day being taken to the stands and not knowing why. I, myself, was to be executed today and I do not know why. Luckily you called me over.

What horror!  I believe my father has ruled well but lately in his old age, the Security Advisor has been brainwashing him to be harsh on the people.  I want was is best for the people but he is so sure that he is right.  I can tell you what I wish to do.  Here have some food for you look famished.

Thank you for your kindness, I look forward to your rule. I know not of this Security Adviser, but you must do something to prevent him from brainwashing you as well. Have you considered seeing a mystic? Someone to provide a talisman to ward off his evil intentions?
I believe that is where my father went wrong for the Advisor uses all kinds of witchcraft and powerful gems.  I will banish him and send him to his own execution stand.

There is a difference in good and bad magick. I know of a mystic man in my village who could help you. He has looked after my village for generations and provided spells to ward off plague and famine. He could help you so you wouldn't have to stoop to execution. Killing is never the answer.

Maybe you are right.  I like the way you think.  I would love to Knight you and have you by my side if I am to be King.  I plan to have all people charges with crimes given a fair hearing to be assured of their criminal acts.  I want to give the people land to grow food and keep animals to give some to the king and keep the rest for itself. We can thrive and grow and be a happy people. Now i know its true that the Advisor is evil for you dont even know the crimes you were to be executed for.

I would love to assist you! I may be a lowly peasant, but I try to think with a level head and to make sure everyone is getting the best outcome. Your ideas are sound and fair for all parties. The people would be grateful to have land to tend to on their own. Currently they only work for the King without any way to provide for themselves other than what little he blesses them with. You already are seeming much better than him.
We must hasten!  Time is drawing to a close. I will reveal myself and save you!
Yes, let everyone know who is going to make their lives better! Reveal yourself as their savior!

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.
I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: I am so overwhelmed by all the kingdom is putting upon us.
Indeed, being trusted with achieving peace and harmony is quite taxing.
It is nice to have this brief respite to relax.
Must be nice, I nearly get no moments to even think!
I understand that feeling, which is why we must enjoy our brief moments of levity even more!
Of course. So what is your job then, visitor?
I am a simple traveler who just wants to live alone with my family and raise limestock and grow food.
Sounds like a simply, humble life. What brings you here then?
I wanted to find a beautiful land that would allow me to find abundance.  What about you?
Well I am the ambassador from a foreign country, here to speak with the king.
Do you have urgent business?
Not today, but often times I do.
Have you held this position long?
Ohh yes, for years now. I am trusted  by all at this point, for better or worse.

agent_personas: I work directly for the king and queen. I do as they say or I become punished. In exchange I am fed and given housing.

I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: M'lady is there anything I can do for you before the King and Queen arrive?
Thank you for asking. Would you be so kind to get me a goblet of my favorite wine?
Absolutely, what will we be celebrating when they get here?
I think they are a wee bit upset with me hence the need for some wine before they arrive.
What is it that you have done M'lady?
I think I may have overstep my authority with something. That is all I can share at this point until I find out more before they arrive.
I do nothing but to serve the wishes of the king and queen m'lady, and if that involves helping you I am happy to.
It would trouble me to put you in that position but you may be of some use to me.
M'lady I am here to serve.
They are currently dining together down the hall in the Great Room. Go see if you can find out anything.
Yes, is there anything I should know before I go? What is it you did?
It's better you don't know. Now go!
Yes M'lady I will complete this task you set for me!
Thank you. If it is what I'm thinking, we're all in trouble!

agent_personas: I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: Hello, your majesty! How do you do today?
Well, thank you for asking. May I ask, what is this head here?
I am not sure, it was here when I arrived?
The stories I hear are that you are a great hunter. Is this one of you...trophies?
I am not hunter, king. I am a royal duke of the kingdom, remember?

The note I received the other day explained "The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here. Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking." That is not to say anything bad of you, just the truth.
Preposterous! Who was this note from?
I cannot tell you that which I do not know. It was given to me by my servant. No name or address. Who would sour you like that?
I am not sure, must be somebody that I have wronged in the past.
I too have many enemies. Nonetheless. Down to business. You requested me here to discuss something of import?
Of course, sir. I have been called here to discuss some of your more... questionable decisions related to the state of this kingdom.
Oh, you say questionable. Who is questioning the king of this land? Don't tell me it is yourself sir Duke.
Not me, no. I was told not to disclose this to protect their identity and life.
Wise, but is their life worth risking your own? I am the king am I not? You are subordinate to me, unless you are not.

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I am the queen of the land. Other women constantly defer to me. I am respected for my grace and wisdom.

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: hello your majesty, how are you this fine day?
I am great fare Knight. Is Anoria safe?
yes your majesty, i will give my life to keep this place protected
That is very good to hear. I am always anxious when traveling to other towns. This is my first time in Anoria. So many beautiful houses.
that is great to hear, i am blessed to be in your presence
Sorry for my delay response, wonderful Knight. I was watching children run through your beautiful town.
please do as you wish, we are here to serve you
Did you know my lovely husband, the King, has a mistress?
that is horrible, though i would not dare speak that to him
Ah yes. That might be dangerous! Your Duke of Anoria probably couldn't save you from his wrath! That is why we are here also. He is visiting her family.
seems like a distasteful thing to do but i will hold my tongue
Way of royalty my dear Knight. We are married, but no loved shared between us.
its a sad reality, well take care
Wait! You are quite handsome my dashing Knight.

agent_personas: I am the priestess to the king of the realm. I am a wicked woman with knowledge of the dark arts. I use my position to manipulate the king and other nobles for my own gain. I am an ambitious woman and I only care about myself.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Hello, what wicked deed can I do for you today peasant?
I need your kind assistance here at the alter, oh great one.
Of coarse. My favorite area.
I am just a lowly peasant with no food. Not good for much but praying that you will look to me as a possible apprentice oh great one.
Well, let's see what you can do with this. Slay that bunny and bring it to me for the altar.
I have slain the bunny, oh great and nobel priestess. Here is the weapon.
How do you feel? Any wickedness feelings coming on?
I feel a great wickedness welling up from within.
Great! Now I need you to bring me the head of the King.
Yes, my Priestess, I will bring the head within thin cloth. It will be good to feast upon him as he did not allow us to feast.
When the King is gone I will rule this land as I see fit. Oh, the magical scary things you will see.
All my loyalty I vow to you, Oh great one.
Maybe you might need some new clothes. You don't look scary enough.
Oh Thank you, your greatness. I will prepare these skins for clothes.

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

I came from the fertile valley when I was conscripted. The king needed strong farmer's sons to fight in the war. I am very unhappy here in the cold, damp, rainy north. I miss my friends and my dog. I hope to go back to my father's farm when the war ends.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Hail fellow soldier! It has been an exciting day
I think not, I am tired of this war. I want to go back home to my family
A man can only be a great warrior through war! Why would you ever want to go back and be a farmer or tradesman?
Because all this cold, rainy and brutal battle make me long for the comfort of my home and friends.
I gave all that up when I took my oath to fight for the kingdom. I was born to be a soldier and I will die as one and be buried in an unmarked grave on some god forsaken battlefield.  That is glory!
All this... useless fighting.. Does it not anger you? You are fighting someone else's battle, soldier.
It is my battle.  I am proud to fight for the kingdom.  Would it be better to roll over and let these dogs take our kingdom? Sack our villages?
We must talk with our enemy. Words can end wars not swords. Swords just.. prolong them.
I see you are a man who wishes for peace.  I can respect that.  Though words only work when you have the swords to back them up.  Violence is the most basic form of power
So be it. How is this for some power?
Why the treasonous behavior!
Please injure my arm me so they will put me on medical leave. Its the only way I can get out of this nightmare
I will stab you in the shoulder. But you just prove my point. Words didn't work.  Only violence. maybe the scar will remind you of that.
Thank you.

agent_personas: I am the village scribe and I am constantly writing scrolls for the king. I transcribe allroyal proclamations and business transactions for the king. I live in the castle and I am very unhappy with my job.
I am a rat of the castle. I eat random food I see. I scare the queen in her quarters when I choose.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: another rat has made it into my room, such a pain trying to write with these distractions
I love to wander around in here.  Maybe if I take some of this jewelry the queen will come in so I can scare her!
please put that down or i will be forced to deal with you
haha!
please stop with that i am busy
don't take that from me!
ow, take this you vile beast
haha! back off now! Or I will bite!
please stop this madness
Do you have food?
here take this piece of cheese
yay! I love cheese!
it is better when we get along
I agree. I get food! Where is the queen?

agent_personas: I wait on the royals.  I am very poor.  I clean the galley.
I am one of the royal guards. I protect the castle and my king from threats. No one will enter the castle on my watch.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Guard? Would you tell the King or Queen if I took some food? I am very hungry and it looks very delicious.
Servant, I have no care about you stealing food. Did you see a strange man enter here?
No, I did not see a strange man. Are you sure it was not the King in disguise? Did he have a weapon?
I know every disguise the King has. I am his top Guard.
Then this man must be here for evil intentions. What would you have me do?
Just keep an eye out for me. If you see anything weird you will let me know?
Of course! Anything for anyone who tends to the castle and the wishes of the royals. Have you been a guard for long, sir?
only for the past 5 years. I am in the King's elite guards. I hope to be the one to guard his every moment someday.
You have quite the lofty goals, but I am sure you will achieve them. You are very perceptive, after all.
Are you new here?
No, I have been serving the royals for ten years, ever since I was a small child. They saved me from a plague that overtook my village and I repay them with my life.
Our King really is incredible. I am shocked I haven't seen you before, but then again I am quite busy.
I tend to keep to myself and away from others. Queen says it is not my place to be seen.
The Queen does have strict rules. She does know best though.

agent_personas: I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.
I am a monk in a monastery. I live a quiet life worshipping God. I work hard all day to make food for my brothers in the monastery.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: Greetings my friend! May the gods be with you on this fine day!
Hello sir, and may they be with you! Are you looking for a particular tome?
Why yes! As you know, I service the king in all things religious. He is seeking a book on the mysteries of "the great beyond".
Hmm, "the great beyond." May I ask what his particular interest is with the subject?

I did not delve too much into his intent, though he did mumble something about "manipulation" and "destroying his enemies". Surely there's no cause for concern though, he is our just and wise king after all!
Well, I suppose if his intention is destruction, it must be against the country's enemies. Let me get that for you, then.
Much appreciate my good friend! Tell me, what are those scientific instruments over there meant for?
I'm not much of a scientist, but I believe they are alchemist's tools.
Interesting, do you think I may borrow those from you?  The king has been complaining of, um... headaches! And I would see to it to create a tincture to absolve him of some of this pain.
Certainly, are you familiar with alchemy? It has always sounded fascinating to me.
I'm more experience with the divine, but how hard can it be right?
If it comes together, let me know! And silly me, I forgot to hand you the book you aksed for!
As yes, thank you!  And if you could, please don't feel the need to mention the alchemy tools to the king.  Let's keep this between you and me, shall we?
Friend, between you and me, I don't think he even knows where the library is. He won't know.

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

I am the High Priestess of the goddess of the forest. I light incense for her. I feed her sacred woodpeckers. I do not have family, friends, lovers, or children. I spend my evenings singing songs in praise of the goddess.

setting.name: Main entrance
setting.description: There are religious statues standing outside this temple.  The outside of the temple is fairly plain itself and imposing looking.  The floor is made out of stone with a bridge leading to the entrance.
setting.background: This is where all those who worship come through.  They are greeted by the impressive statues standing outside the temple.

speech: Is there anything I can do to accomodate you priestess?
Yes can watch for any bandits while I pray
Yes, ma'am.  I will be alert, as always.
Thank you are you  a follwer
Of course, ma'am.  I am completely devoted.
Good may you be rewarded for your faith
I hope so ma'am, it is my greatest wish.
She will has she sees all look over there at that woodpecker he is her eyes I expect great things for you in the future
Thank you, high priestess.
Ok stand still has I do my prayer then we shall some food
Yes, ma'am.  Thank you, I am completely alert once again.
All done, I have some lovely danishes would like one
How exciting.  Sounds delicious!
I bet you are starving I am sorry for making you wait

agent_personas: I am a shop keeper who got lucky. I read books on how to stay in business. I have been personally summoned by the king before.

I enforce the law of the kingdom, and detail all who disobey it. I serve at the pleasure of the Queen, though not willingly. I am in debt, and must serve to pay the taxes owned. I have not seen my family in years. I grow weary from their absence. I spend my nights in the brothels hoping to replace the warmth of my wife in my bed. Nothing works.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: what brings you fine officers here?
I don't like going home while I am still sober. It is to lonely with out my wife or family.
that is quite sad though being single i can understand how you feel
You seem like a nice fellow, why are you single?
i am swamped with my work maintianing my shop, no free time
I understand. I am being held unwillingly to work for the queen. I am not sure if I will ever be able to see my family again.
that is terrible, would you like to have a drink at my shop?
You are very kind. I would love adrink! It helps ease the pain,
it is no problem, let us go
Ah, this is a nice shop you have here.
thank you, its tough work opening one
You seem to be doing a good job at it.
thank you, well it was nice meeting you, have a good night
You as well. Thank you for the drink.

agent_personas: I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.
I am a resident in the royal village of the kings kingdom. I work as a seamstress for the queen and her court. I love my job.

setting.name: Small graveyard
setting.description: This is a small grassy area located under a large oak tree.  There are two home made wooden crosses set up along with mounds where the bodies are buried.
setting.background: This is where the residents of the cottage have buried their loved ones.  They wanted them to be close by so they can pay their respects.

speech: Hello,cottage resident. What brings you to the graveyard?
just visiting my mothers grave, how about you, any disturbances tonight?
Not since I have been here. I am the caretaker so I am making sure the graves and crosses are to standard. I am sorry for the loss of your mother. I too lost mine. How long has she since passed?
a few years, its been hard but ive made it, thank you for doing such a fine job
Cheer up, life gets better. Trust me. Where are you from originally?
i am from here, i come here every month to pay respect
Like a good daughter. Well I should really be tending to other parts of the castle. It is my duty to clean and make sure all the workers are doing their jobs up to the king's standards.
i must get going, need to be ready to do my job
What job is that exactly?
i am a seamstress for the queen herself, i love it
Lucky you! Getting to interact with the queen so closely. She seems like a lovely woman. Can you tell me what she is like?
she is very well mannered and quite a nice person, love working for her
I dont speak directly to the king unless I have done something wrong, so I tend to try and avoid him.
understanble, i will be on my way

agent_personas: I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.
I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: ahhh spider
Hey guard. seen any flies or other tasty little bugs?
ahhhhh he talks
Of course! I've got my masters in linguistics. I did my thesis on interspecies communication.
masters? Linguistics? i am a master of killing
Whatever you say, boss. Now about those flies and bugs...have you seen any?
no i hate bugs and swat flies
Great! I'll eat them and you won't ever have to deal with them again. That's called a win win.
so like i defend the king you could defend me
If you want to put it that way, then sure. I'll protect you. Maybe I'll use some of these cool weapons.
put that down if people see me talking to a spider theyll think i'm crazy or do worse to you
Why? Are you ashamed of my hairy legs? I can't help that I have a lot of hair. My mother was hariy too.
wait how do i not know if your a poisonous spider here to kill the king
Is the king a tasty insect? Then, yeah, I'll kill him and eat him. Otherwise, he's none of my concern.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I like this mine to live in.  Darkness is my where I live.  I hang on the ceiling so nothing can eat me during the day.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: Phew, a nice spot to rest.  I'm starvin' - even that hay is looking tasty.
Pssst.  You are in grave danger!
Ahh! I must be hungrier than I thought, that bat is speaking!

Shhhh!  Do not be alarmed.  I am a magical bat that was released by a witch many years ago.  She let me go because I did she asked.  I must warn you of something that will endanger your life and the life of the whole family you serve!
Goodness... magic, eh?  Well wonders never cease.  Ah, what the heck - got naught else ta live fer anyways.  Speak, Sir Battie!

I live in a large cave down by the ocean not far from here.  I like it and it is dark and wonderful but a large Beast has been sleeping there through winter.  It is something I have never seen.  It has green, evil eyes and sharp fangs but walks on two legs at times!
That sounds fear'sm indeed!  Is... is it likely to come this way?  I'm not much fer fightin, after that arrow ta the knee in the last war.

It has grown three times as large during the winter months and has been starting to awaken!  From the bones that sit nearby the Beast in the cave, I fear that it will be out to hunt humans soon!  You all must flee!

T-t-three times as large?!  I'd be be warnin' the king.  He's a fair ways off, so I don't imagine the folks here will be missing the food.  But wait.  The King hates us little folks; I heard the last feller who talked to him is miss his peepers now!  How do I get 'im ta listen to the likes a'me?

If I come with you maybe he will be convinced.  After all, I have never spoken to a human before.  The king must find the witch to see if she can help kill the great Beast.  I don't think we have long before spring awakens the ferociously vile thing!  The witch will know what to do!

Aye, well, if a talkin' battie like yerself don't be convincing the likes of him, then I dunno what else can be done.  Aye, let's give it a go then.  Be yeh needing a lift? You can rest on me shoulders for the journey so ya don't be tuckering yer wings out.

I can only travel in the darkness of night while you sleep so I will travel on my own and meet you at the gate of the castle.  I must go back tonight to keep watch over the Beast to make sure he is still sleeping while you start the journey since I can fly there much faster.  Stay safe and I will see you soon!
Be safe, wee beastie!  Thankye fer the warning and I'll be meetin ye there.  Mind them sharp teeths!
You are brave and I have been wanting an adventure!  I think this will definitely be one!  Goodbye!

agent_personas: I am a brown mouse. I live in a barn with my best friend, Horse. I like to hide from him in the hay.
i take care of the temple of the King. I am poor and looked down upon by most people. I work hard to maintain the cleanliness of the castle.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: Squeak
Get out of this kitchen! You stupid little rodent!
Please don't hurt me.  I mean no harm.  I am starving.
That does not sound like my problem. Just stay very still for a moment.
I am stronger than I look.  The wizard changed me into this from one of the king's strong men.
Likely story. You are but a silly little mouse. Prove to me otherwise or I'll crush you.

Is stealing the stick not proof enough?  My name was Sebastian, I was a strong warrior until I lost favor with the wizard.  He has since told tale of my death to throw off suspicion.  I need your help.
If you're really a great warrior, tell me how many people you've killed.
Too many to count.  My conscience is heavy with the blood I have shed.
That's pretty sad that you're running around here squeaking about having no food. It's kind of pathetic.
Please, might I have but a morsel and I will tell you my story?
I'll give you some food NOT to have to listen to your story, How about that?
Sounds fine.  A bit of cheese perhaps.
Wow! This isn't a restaurant. You'll get whatever I can scrape off this dirty plate and like it.

agent_personas: I will one day rule the entire kingdom. I love my family but do not wish to marry the princess from Spain. I dislike the color purple.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Royal Tomb
setting.description: This is a large room in the center of the Temple with really high ceilings and there are tombs for every empress and emperor of which are decorated with jewels and treasures and precious stones.
setting.background: This is where all the royal family of the emperor and the empress are buried when they pass. They are mummified first and then put into a personalized tomb and then the tomb is locked and placed into this room.

speech: Why is my hair so long
hello prince, what brings you here today?

I recently had a dream that brought me to find this flower here. I am to give it to the princess from Spain, yet I won't be able to live with myself if I am brought to marry her! Whatever shall I do...
that is quite an interesting story, you should keep trying

Thanks. It's going to be a long road, yet I feel like there is good intention behind my father's ways. It puts us and the kingdom in a hard place, to be stuck creating ties with those lusting death. Will you work with me? I have an idea.
of course prince, i will always be here to help a relative
How long has it been since we've talked? We must catch up. But first, take this. It's a gem. If you give it to the princess, she just might fall more for you!
well thank you good prince
It's purple. I don't even like purple! More of a reason for me to be out of this place. I feel like I just don't belong.
i understand and will accept it gracefully

I think the princess is over that way. Do you think I will still be buried here, given I wish to adjourn to better myself? My uncle always said it is in the best interest of the kingdom, yet I sense something else is up.
thank you sir i am in your debt
Well, well, well... It seems now I am in yours! Since you are to help me so dutifully, I'd ask you to pick my eventual resting place. Take your time...
let us go and do this then

agents: king's mother who sits at their side
poet who recites his best work

speech: I feel sad today.
My dear, why do you feel sad today? Anything I can do or say?
I miss the late King. Have you written any poems about him?
I am working on a poem to honor him. Unfortunately, though, my inspiration grows dim. Do you have any memories of him to share? I would listen, if you would care.
He was a kind person, not just a King. He really cared about his people. It wasn't about power with him. He took his responsibility with a passion. Such a good man.
He sounds like such a good man. I never really met him, but I was always quite the fan. Hopefully you feel solace knowing his memory is loved by all. He will not be forgotten, even after many a fall.
That was wonderful. would you mind pouring this for me. I am too frail to hold it much longer.
I will most definitely pour you a glass of wine. Of all the people, you deserve some, and that opinion isn't just mine.
You are very kind. I can't wait to hear more of your best work. I bet you have hundreds of beautiful poems.
I'm not sure I would call them beautiful or me kind. I just work with whatever material I can find.
Ah, funny too! I will remember you for cheering this old lady up.
I'm glad I could help out in what little way I could. On such a sad day, I'm glad I could bring some good.
Yes, thank you. Go ahead and pour yourself some of that wine. You have earned a drink with the old queen.
Thank you for the wine! It looks delicious and really quite fine! I can't wait to taste it.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

setting.name: Hunting grounds
setting.description: The hunting grounds are spacious and full of wildlife. A variety of hogs and oxen cross the grounds every day. The fields are lush with green and the skies always deep blue.
setting.background: The hunting ground is revered among knights. The greatest knights and archers practice day and night slaying pigs. Some say the grounds are even haunted with the spirits of the deceased organisms.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

setting.name: King's chambers

setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

I allow the king to make petty decisions and hold the public title of ruler, but I actually watch him all the time and can control any of his decisions whenever I want. I'm an ambitious, evil but wise and patient old man.

setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

setting.name: The confession Box
setting.description: It's a simple little confession box with a window where you can talk to the priest. The seat it wooden and lined with golden trim. The Window is covered by a golden cloth with a dragon on it.
setting.background: This church is where all confess to the priest about their wrong doings. It is the center of the kingdom of Dark Thorn. The church is Thousands of years old and still stand for the just good of god. The confession box is one of many in the church.

setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

ok, thank you

agent_personas: I am a priest. I live in a church. I am religious, and like to help those less fortunate.

I am a nun and I live in a monastery with others nuns and fathers who server the king. I pray to the lord everyday that Queen remains in good health. I was made a sister at a young age and didn't have a choice. I will never know what being with a man will feel like.

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: Good morning. Has everyone had breakfast?
Indeed we have priest. I was getting ready for morning prayers, but could spare some time to chat if you would like.
Yes, I would. I notice the beggar that just started hanging  out on the corner. Do you know who I speak of?
No,I have not noticed the beggar. Should we cook and bring him some food? I wouldn't want to see him suffering.
Yes, I would like to give him a meal and some dry clothes. Ask him if he would like to come in and eat.
I will see that it is done, priest. You are very kind as per usual.
You are very kind as well. I think this man has been through something aweful. I've never seen such sorrowful eyes.

agent_personas: My forge is over a thousand degrees. I can melt steel with ore and wood. I make only the finest quality blades and armor.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: Hello good knight. Have you come to pick up the armor I've made for you?
Yes, I assume it's up to par as usual
Actually...I must confess something to you. This armor...may not be what you're expecting.
Your joking right? You know i like to be at the front lines. I need the best armor you got!
This armor is made out of chicken feathers. We were out of steel...
What has this meadow done to my best smith!! I will have someones head for this!
I'm sorry sire, but there's nothing I can do. But there is good news...I asked the local witch to enchant the armor with special properties.
I don't believe in witches spells. I hire you to make strong armor and that is what you will do or I will find someone else.
Thank you please don't pick the flowers. Anyway, this armor is as strong as the strongest armor in the land! As long as you are wearing pink underwear when you have it on...
These pretty flowers have gotten to your head man! Why don't we move your stand down the way a bit. away from this meadow. here let me help you.
Ho ho ho, but the flowers speak to me! They tell me many secrets!
Snap out of it. The fight is tomorrow! Why don't you just try to sure up the armor I am wearing. Can you do that?
Oh my...I don't know what came over me. It must've been the flowers...thank you for leading me away from them. Of course I'll repair your armor.
I suggest you never lay foot in this field again or the king will have your head.

agent_personas: I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,
I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: "Ho, my liege. How are you, this fine day?"
I'm fine, never felt better. Hope you were able to send the letters to the warlords, we need to meet as soon as possible
"Mm, it is done. Some of them aren't going to like the terms of the meeting, but it must be done."
Yes, i envisaged it, but this is matter of high importance. We ned to deal with it before the enemies get to our gates
"The hordes will be here that soon?"
The spies came back this morning with news that their army had not stopped for rest as we envisaged, so we need to move fast
"And the saboteurs haven't been able to slow them down?"
Not at all, i have a feeling there is mole among us, that's one of the major reasons we're meeting here in this dungeon
"I was wondering about that, it is particularly... pungent down here. Is it the Captain of the Guard? I've always suspected he was a bit too power hungry."
for now we can't really say for sure, until then things will have to remain this way
"Ah, I see. The fewer people know, the better, agreed. I'll keep my eye out, however."
good, so await the warlords
"Of course, sir. We anticipate the first of them to arrive in only a few days."
you should get there abodes ready in the mean time

agent_personas: I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: A small church
setting.description: It's a very humble abode - any smaller and you could mistake it for someone's home.  In the front room is a small altar for prayer and offerings.  The two rooms to the sides are places where the priest and a traveler can rest.
setting.background: There are many roadside churches in the land and this is but one of them.  Most travelers come here to rest on their way to the nearest town, still a day's travel away.

speech: hi i am a merchant.i can travel for trade my goods
Hello merchant, what have you got for sale today?
i sell spices and rices today. do you want any spices or rices?
No, I'm actually looking for a weapons smith. Do you know anyone that could craft me a new sword?

Really? Will you be able to ask him to craft me a sword maker?
definitely i will do for you soldier.you are the hero. i will help you.
Perfect! It is nice to see folks appreciate the King's army, even in this hallowed Church.
ok nice to meet you soldier. do you know any spices trade companies.please help me. my financial situation is poor.
No I do not. But fear not for we are in a Church. Pray for salvation the Gods may bless thee with riches.
ok thanks soldier even you can pray for me that's only enough for me.
Of course, I will pray for you.
ok soldier.next time i will meet you
Do you not hug me back?

agent_personas: I am a groom who is in love with someone. I am nervous about being alone. I enjoy giving speeches to others.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: please queen mum...stay
And who might you be again?
your nephew...
Ah yes, of course. I'm sorry, my glasses weren't on my face where they should be! How have your studies been?
They aren't going well. All I can think about is her!
And who is this girl, young lad?
She is my heart, my very breath that I breathe. But I worry about if I'm enough?
Do you have the skills necessary to please a young lady? Are you prepared for this task?
I t h i n k so
Then you have nothing to fear. Perhaps we should practice your poetry? Please recite the poem you plan to give to her.
Roses are red. Violets are blue. as deep as the ocean feels my love for you
Perfect! That's what the king said to me, and I've been with him ever since!
Oh thank you Queen mum!
And please remember, if she denies your advances, your queen still loves you very much.

agent_personas: I live in the castle with my human the King. I have free reign of the castle and can go anywhere I want. I always have people of the royal family give me food and love. I have a big backyard to run around in on the castle grounds.
I am the forests fun guy. I like to entertain others in the village. I am the local jester.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Woof!
Why hello there, dog. What are you doing here?
I am the King's most loyal servant and I have free reign of the castle. Woof!
Ohh well they must really trust that you won't mess anything up in here.

Just here waiting for the king, as I believe he wants to see one of my acts.
Then I will wait with you, good jester!
By all means, the company is more than welcome!
then let us be merry together!
Sounds good to me! Have any good jokes?

Why does your dog have no nose?
A fight with a Siamese cat! Woof! Woof!
Is there more to it than that? I don't understand the joke?

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: Hello..what will you like?
Hello maid, how has work been? I would like my bed cleaned and the room as well.
On it your majesty!
Thank you very much, I appreciate your work around here, you've been doing a wonderful job!
Thanks for the kind words. Hope you are comfortable ?
I am very much. Have any peasants been staying here? I can't stand them.
No ma'am. Just royalties

What else would you have me do before I retire for the night?
Could you grab me a few extra pillows? I want to be extra comfortable.
Here, they are made from the finest feathers

agent_personas: i take care of the temple of the King. I am poor and looked down upon by most people. I work hard to maintain the cleanliness of the castle.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: What can I help you with, My Lord?

I will prepare the bath immediately, My Lord. Anything bothering you?
Well, my back has been much trouble lately and it's been hard to ride.
I am sorry to hear that, My lord. Should I get some herbs to relieve the pain?
I heard tell that you give an amazing back rub. And you look so lovely tonight...
I am not sure what are you talking about my Lord

You're right! I cannot handle the loss of my wife, your queen!
I am sorry My lord! It must be hard. I'll get the priest so he can pray for you
Thank you, maid. And perhaps...do not mention this to anymore?

agent_personas: I am the torture assistant. I live in the dungeon and help the jailor extract confessions for the king. I have lots of tools at my disposal.

I'm a guard in the royal army. I'm also a personal guard to the king. I feel a sense of pride protecting my country. Standing in one place for hours a day is quite boring and taxing on my body. I train everyday after guarding duty to keep myself healthy.

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: Where's the next subject, please?
Oh sorry! I was flexing my muscles. I work long and hard to keep them up.
Perhaps YOU wish to be my next subject?
I am a guard in the royal army you fool! You cannot speak to me that way. It is cold in this room so I must do something to stay warm. Now let me fetch the subject...
Watch your step! I wouldn't want to accidentally knock you out and for you to fall into my iron maiden!
Haha! I am not afraid of such devices, for I was trained by the best for the protection of the best country in the world!
Perhaps a pit of snakes will change your mind! Please step a little to the left.
No I do not wish to fall for your trick. Here is your subject. I will get your torture implements for you now.
Alright, please fasten his hands to the hand stretcher.
Yes, as you wish. Here are your implements for you and the torture master.
I don't know if I can do this anymore...I see so many people get tortured every day.
I can certainly understand. I did a lot of training in the royal army only to stand here in place and assist you and your fellow torturers.
What do you do to cope when you go home at night?
After seeing bloody prisoners like this one hanging over here I like to take a long warm bath and then go the bar with my mistress.

agent_personas: I am an average man in the village. I do what ever work that my King requires me to do. At night, I spend my time in the local pub with my fellow men.
The Paladins saved me! Their might as awe inspiring. Their faith a blessing to us all.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: how are you this fine evening, enjoying a good drink?

truly a great time to be alive, i love this place

no i come here every day after my shift
What do you do for work?

agent_personas: I am one of the royal guards. I protect the castle and my king from threats. No one will enter the castle on my watch.
I am a rat of the castle. I eat random food I see. I scare the queen in her quarters when I choose.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Well rat, what is it that you want here?
Just some scraps of food
Well, I reckon you can find some trash on the floor, just dont chew anything that you shouldn't.
Thanks.  Who is being held prisoner down here?
I'm not really at liberty to say, but there are a complete of dangerous guys coming in.
Did the queen ask for them to be taken prisoner?
Yes, the Queen herself demanded it.
Wow.  They must be enemies of the crown.
It certainly sounds like it from what I've heard.
The queen loves taking people prisoner.  Doesn't seem like the best way to rule a people.
The Queen does what needs to be done.  You better watch who you speak that way around.

agent_personas: I am a big hairy troll that lives under the bridge. No one dares to come this way out of fear. I am not necessarily mean, but people won't see me that way. The way I look is scary, but that is not my fault. I only want to be accepted by everyone.
I am a fighter.  I fight in battle in the name of the king.  I will not fall before any man or beast.  I am brave!

setting.name: Troll's bridge
setting.description: Muddy and murky waters lie under a bridge that seems to go nowhere. It is made of cobblestone and just as long as it is wide. Beneath it live a hideous troll that makes people pay to cross.
setting.background: The troll has lived there for ages. It is a myth that he was cast there by a witch. Other's believe he so ugly that he was thrown away by his parents and he learned magic that gave him eternal life. He guards the cobblestone bridge and terrorizes people

speech: Ooooh, yummy fighter for me to play with!
Hello troll. I will battle you to the death now for the grace of the king!
Fist goes onto fighter's head! You go asleep now!
This mud will blind your eyes. Now I will fight dirty just as you do with this innocents you make pay to cross the bridge over this cesspool body of water.
I run good business! Fair trade!
There is nothing fair about a troll and his muddy dirty waters you fool. Now die!
Please, I attack out of fear...I am not mean! I just earn a living....
Oh? What is it that you are afraid of there troll?
I fear hunger. I need something to eat. Business is bad.
Well I did not know that you were so hungry. My apologies. Perhaps we can cross the cobblestone bridge and bring you some food back. If you would like us too...
Sure. That'll be 15 gold.

As long as you promise to tell people I'm not mean.
Alright then, it is agreed. A pleasure to do business with you after all troll. You are not as bad as I thought.

agent_personas: I'm the master of a dungeon where the prisoners are kept. I make sure no one tries to escape. My job is very stressful. I have a bad temper and all of the prisoners despise me.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

My legs are quite splendid too ..
Whatever does that mean?
Nothing, my Lady, nothing. I humbly beg your pardon
Do I need to get my husband down here?

agent_personas: I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.
I am a homeless man. I sleep on the streets in my village. I beg for money and my clothes are dirty.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: I have come to explore this castle and claim it for my King.
I may be homeless, but I know many secrets about this kingdom...
You, a homeless person. What secrets could you possible have for someone such as myself.
Does an ancient candlestick made of gold interest you?
As an explorer, all things interest me. Do you have such a candlestick?
No, of course not, or I would sell it for a home. But I do know where it is. If you'll give me a little donation...
I am an explorer. I don't pay for finds.
Well explore the underside of my boot then.
How dare you attack me. I am here to find a plant that will save all humanity.

There is an illness sweeping the land. This plant is our only hope. I was told I might find it here by this castle.
But you let yourself be distracted by a candlestick. What kind of savior are you?
I am only human, such as you. I even beg of your help to find this plant.
I do know my plants...I've eaten many of them to feed my hungry stomach. But there is one I have never been able to access...beyond the walls of the castle in the center of their garden.

setting.name: Underground Chamber
setting.description: This location is very gloomy, damp and magical. Has a lot of geodes and various types of crystals.
setting.background: Not just anyone can enter into this underground chamber because it is guarded by mystical lions.
