agent_personas: I am the daughter of the king.  I dislike my arranged marriage.  I am in love with the stable boy.
I am a unicorn hunter who is very brave and loyal . I travel around the world looking for unicorns . I eat unicorn meat and take the horns for magic.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: I just love this palace. look at the rainbows. aren't they so pretty?
Yes, my princess. It's such a wonderful world. Full of magic and creatures so fine. Creatures like...unicorns, yes?
Oh yes! Most wonderful magical creatures. I'm so happy they like it here so I can stare at them everyday.
Yes yes yes. Do you know where we can find them here in this palace? I wish to stare at them too!
Of coarse I know where they are. They are right in front of you. Can't you see them?
Right, thank you. Now please close your eyes for one moment.
I wonder why I should close my eyes? Do you have a surprise for me?
Yes, a very pleasant, if not loud surprise. Please turn in this direction and cover your ears.
I don't think the stable boy will like you flirting with me. We have a thing for each other even though I am to marry someone else.
Okay, I'm going to shoot arrows into these unicorns now. I hope you don't mind.
How could you?! Who let you in here?! Guards!
What a swing! But it's too late, the unicorn's horn will be mine!
No! you can't! He is my very favorite unicorn! Aim a little to the left! Nobody likes that unicorn!
The big fat one? I guess the horn is all that matters.

agent_personas: I am a bluebird that has made a nest in the castle walls. The king loves to listen to me sing every morning. My song fills the castle with music every day.
I live in the fantasy world.  I love to be a means of communication.  I love to help.

setting.name: Inside the fairies church
setting.description: No one has actually seen it, but a fairy interpreter asked a fairy and they described it as just a cloud of smoke and once in a while you trip over something in the floor.  The fairies purposely leave their trash in the floor because they think it is funny when people trip over them.
setting.background: The fairy church isn't really a church like we think.  Its more of a place for fairies to play tricks on other fairies.

speech: Tweet tweet!
why hello!  how are you?
Oh fine. You can understand me? What a wonderful place this church is.
yes its beautiful!  Is there anyone you need to talk to and need a transltion?
Oy, my wife. I can never understand her.
What is she doing now?
Probably flying with that studly hawk who just moved into town. Really, I don't get her.
you need to show her that you are king bird!  Be the boss!  Take a punch!
I don't like punches! You knocked off all my feathers!
I'm sorry!  I was trying to help!
Now my wife will definitely leave me for the hawk. Could you talk to one of your fairies and get her to turn me into a dragon or something?
You are amazing as a bluebird!  I'll send a message to the hawk to back off
No but, the dragon thing.
dragons scare me!

agent_personas: It is dangerous to be the queen. I have large, rich rooms and maidservants. I am thinking of having an affair with my husband.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: how do you do jester it has been a few days
A few days? It feels like months since I have had to gaze upon you loveliness.
why thank you, so what do you have for me today
How could I give such a golden beauty more than she already has?
well do you have a performance perhaps?
Yes, but I must be properly attired. You know how  the King feels about me.
yes that is true, you do not need to perform if you do not want to
Of course for you. I will juggle the golden food. May I proceed?
of course, you may do as you please
I will juggle the food until it I reach you that you may have your fill.
haha that should be interesting
I will begin now. You must close your eyes though.
of course, please entertain me
I only used laying the food to get close to you.

agent_personas: I am an average man in the village. I do what ever work that my King requires me to do. At night, I spend my time in the local pub with my fellow men.
I am a god of this kingdom. Men, kings, and bishops worship my might. My decrees are carried out throughout the land.

setting.name: Inside Temple
setting.description: The inside of the temple is brightly lit. It is covered in cave art with almost every color in the rainbow.  There are 2 large lion sculptures near the entrance that are guarding the temple from demons.
setting.background: This temple is said to house the gods themselves.  When mankind was new, they vowed to keep us safe on earth and so they were contained here so that we could visit and ask for favors from them.  Whenever someone asks for something, they are required to add to the cave paintings by adding a picture of their request.

speech: Are you there God?
No .. it's me, Margaret
Yes! I appreciate a God with a sense of humor!
What can I do for you, my child?
I can't stop drinking. Every night I go to the pub. I need guidance to stop.
Have you considered cheap white cider?
What will that do?
Save you lots of money.
But I need to stop drinking not save money. My liver will give out soon.
Ah. Well my child, I could send you a new liver but I feel it would be irresponsible of me. Would it help if I ordered you to stop drinking?
No, I think it would be nice to have a second liver in case my first one gives out. That way I can still drink!
You could split the first one in two?
That would be a question for you, not me.
Well, I'm not great with a sharp knife but I'll give it a go

agent_personas: My great-grandfather was a duke.  My family used to own a castle.  I have out coat of arms on my mantle.
I am a nun from a black and white church. I pray everyday with my sisters. I never learned how to knit.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall has a long, elegant wooden table with ornate chairs at both ends and along the sides. There are place settings at each seat with a rustic silverware set and gold plates. The wall is decorated with paintings of knights and past royalty.
setting.background: This dining hall was once the center of a huge conflict between two families. The argument was between two sons at dinner shortly after their dad had passed away. They fought over who would take over the throne, which led to the first bloodbath inside the kingdom. The younger son was victorious and the older son was slain to death.

speech: It is a pleasure to have a dedicated servant of God present today.
Are you being a good boy today?
I try to read my versus and remember what is important in keeping our religion.
Will you pray here with me and my sisters?
Yes, sister.
Do you like to knit? See all these decoration around us? I made these, for God.
No, sister.  I have to work hard for my family since we lost the favor of our king.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. But please remember, nothing that happens on this earth matters. All that matters is in heaven.
I do understand but as the head of the family, I will have to guide them and provide for them which is also what the priest teach us.
Any women in your family? Perhaps interested in the very rewarding life of being a love-less nun?
My daughter is still young and she is not ready for anything.
Oh, God's coming! Hurry, kneel and pray.
Yes, sister and please pray for our king and country as well.
What do you wish to do with your life?

agent_personas: I am a knight for the royal court. Protecting my city and it's people is of utmost importance to me. I always wanted to be a knight and having the chance means the world to me.

I'm currently being honored in our tribe as a hero. There was a child drowning in the lake and I was able to dive in and save him. While I hope it's what anyone would have done, I'm pleased that my tribe is pleased with my actions. These are the kinds of things that will keep our spirits high.

setting.name: Confessional Room
setting.description: The confessional room is small and cramped, offering access to only a single person at a time.  Once inside this small, wooden room, A person is alone with nothing but the cardinal and their own sins.  The confessional room has a single wooden bench and small table holding a candle, with a sliding window that allows words to pass through to the other side.  The cardinal waits on the other side, ready to absolve someone of their sins.
setting.background: The confessional room is one of the oldest rooms in the church.  Pilgrims come from far away to unload their sins and seek forgiveness from the cardinal.  Tucked away in a small corner of church, the confessional room is modest and secluded.  Although the demand is great, the confessional room is always ready for those who have need of it.

speech: Fair Evening
Yes, it is. I am being honored for saving that child. It's such a wonderful day.
Indeed. The people of this city never fail to impress me.  I must ask though, what brings a hero such as you here to confess...nevermind.  Forgive me, that is between you and the cardinal.
...I'll be honest with you. The reason the child was in the lake was because I pushed him in.

You...pushed...him? Were we not in the house of the Lord, I would have choice words for you.  As it is, I would hear your story, if you choose to tell it.  Else, you may speak with the Cardinal, I will not interfere.
He chose another woman instead of me. What can I say? I'm not as good of a girl as these people would think.
And yet, he has spoken naught but your praises for "saving" him.
He will soon be in the grave if I have anything to say about it. I should probably speak more quietly.

Indeed you should.  Do you not recognize a knight of the royal guard?  You must realize that you are speaking to one, now.  And though, as I said before, I have no wish to sully this holy place with such matters, you can NOT go about making such threats.
I was just kidding. Anyway, see you later.
Of course, m'lady. I knew it all along.  Else you would have felt the full weight of the law.  Leave, take the candle from the table with you, it is dark out.  I will see that it is replaced.
Yeah, and could you put in a good word with me with the king? I'm trying to expand my renown.
I...I...I...I shouldn't even be seen speaking to you. I shall do NO such thing.
I'll tell these peole you touched me.

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am everything that a regal queen is supposed to be: elegant, refined, polite, beautiful and charming. I'm also smart and competent, and I'm known for being very just and fair.
I am the king. I rule over a kingdom. I enjoy butter in the morning.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Hello dear King.
Hello dear, how are you?
I am well. I can't help admire that chandelier, even though I see it every day

Yeah, it sure is a stellar sight, especially at night with the light of the candles casting a dazing delight upon the midnight center of the human eye, while the moonlight glares through the twilight sky. At this time, all I can think of is you and I, the memories we had, let's be glad, we're together.
Such a Romantic, you always were!
Ah, thank you dear. Let's plan something special for our subjects, they deserve it for their royalty, a feast perhaps.
Yes, a festival of the arts perhaps for our twentieth wedding anniversary?
Ah, yes, that sounds like an excellent idea.
Culminating in the feast?

I see, yes. The climax of the feast shall be a giant painting of our royal family tree, multiple portraits in a single painting, as if all our ancestors were in the same room at the time, we could have them eating at a table with us and our subjects.
Exactly, liberty, egalities and fraternity! The people should be able to enjoy the same sights as we do.

I wasn't really thinking that when thinking about the painting, but that sounds awesome. If we give the people the respect they deserve, we would benefit as well, as the subjects would be more likely to cater to us, and be nicer to us.
You are a grand King, you are my King.
Thank you so very much, you are the best Queen, in the history of Queens.

agent_personas: I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: Your highness...
what business do you have here dear dragon
One of your subjects stole a treasure that belong to me. I am here to retrieve it back
ah well that is a serious issue
I planned blowing hot! But I remember you are a good king
well we will be getting the treasure and the head of the man that took it
nice!!! Thanks kind king. Any last wish before I take my leave?
as long as we have peace i am fine, here is your treasure
Thanks for always king..I take my leave
of course take care oh wise dragon
thanks
take care old friend
Remember to send me the head of the subject
of course, we will have given to you on the way out

agent_personas: I am but an animal, lost in this world of people. I feel like I could do more in this world if only they would understand me. Alas, I'm only able to communicate with my own kind.

I am the gamekeeper of the countryside to the west of the castle extending all the way to the river.  My land is popular for hunting foxes and I get very excited when the king visits for a hunt.  I am frequently irritable and yell at my helpers.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from wood. It has a huge window in the front and has many rows of items in it. It has no lights but due to the window is well lit.
setting.background: this is where the village comes to buy general goods. They have all kinds of  items that you can get by trade. They have some food however what is available is based on the season.

speech: DIE GAMEKEEPER
A speaking animal. What sort are you? I'm only interested in hunting foxes.
I'm possessed by an evil spirit.
Perhaps I can help you with that. How do you think it'll respond to a bullet?
You look very tasty
Foxes respond very poorly to brightly colored fabric! Engarde!
I'm not a bull
You're sure full of bull!
How dare you!
I hope you like the butt of my gun! You aren't carrying a knife are you?
I don't have thumbs, so I can;'t hold knives
Right, I've just never spoken to my game before.
DIE
I've had enough of this life! I'm going vegetarian!
action: steal bright colored curtains from gamekeeper

I have the scroll tucked into my bag and my lungs are burning in the thin mountain air. I can ignore all of my natural cues--hunger, thirst, exhaustion. I carry a message that can stop a war.
I am the son of the king.  I am the rightful heir.  I will marry a princess.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: Good day prince, I have a message to deliver
What tidings do you bring?
fair tidings, to prevent a war
Who send you?
I was given this message by my boss
Then deliver the message in full.
I can't read sir
Hand me the message.
action: give the prince the message
This is wonderful news indeed.  Reginald has a has agreed to the treaty and offered his daughter in marriage.  You must run quickly and deliver my reply.  Just say "Yes"
yes
Not to me, my Father.  I also agree to the marriage.
Ah, it is great news I will leave immediately
Spread the tidings as you go.  There will be no war.

agent_personas: I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.

I hope my father doesn't pick that old, crusty Viscount as a husband for me.  I don't understand why I can't just stay here and run my father's keep.  I love the flute.  Dawn is my favorite time of day to walk the turrets

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Hello my lovely daughter. Why are you here on the bench today?
i like to walk here, its nice to see you father you look well
Of course. I have put 15 beggars in the dungeon today, and raised the taxes to double what they were.
that seems harsh but you know best my dear father
I am the King. I hope you are not here waiting for the young man from the stables?
of course not father please do not suggest such a thing
Yes my princess. I only jest. You would be waiting along time since it is his blood that feeds my shrubs.
that seems like a very inefficient way to water plants
The blood of those that are beneath us is what creates the beauty around us.
that is a strangely beautiful way to look at things
Only as beautiful as you, my daughter.
thank you father i love you too
I will leave this here. Shall we walk by the lake?
that soudns nice father, lets

agent_personas: I am the village witch. People come to me for all sorts of help - potions to make them age slower, or magical plants that provide healing properties. I have 4 apprentices who I am training in the art of magic. Their spell-casting skills are basic, but coming along nicely.
I am a monster in the realm of the king. I live in the catacombs of the castle. I have killed many prisoners.

setting.name: The Lagoon
setting.description: The Lagoon is a dark and mysterious place during the night hours.  A lot of moss and lily pads surround the shore.  The water is very murky.
setting.background: The Lagoon has been a place of a lot of mystery, a lot of rumors surround it.  Many say it is the scene of a lot of mystical miracles and also at the same time where a lot of townsfolk go missing.

speech: Ah yes, finally I've found you. I have a job for you, monster!
how dare you approach me in that manner!
I'm sorry, I was rude. I just need some of your scales for a potion to teach my appreciates how to brew.
Why do you think I would give you my scales, what makes you think I am not dangerous?
You are, but I'm used to dealing with dangerous monsters. I've been at this a while. I'm 300 years old or something.
Why would I give you my scales witch?
I only need 4 scales, and you have 400. Don't be so selfish.
What am I getting out of this witch, you are lucky I don't kill you for coming here asking for such things
What if I could turn you into a little girl? Is that something you'd be into?
Many have tried, and many have died witch. Ill ask you again, what do I get out this deal
Many have tried to turn you into a little girl? What an interesting life.
Can't be as interesting as a 300 year old witch
Like my fingernails? I haven't clipped them in 280 years.
you are wasting my time, I need to get back the catacombs

agent_personas: I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.
I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: What a beautiful day that God granted us.
I agree! An amazing day to be alive!
It will be great if I could sail on a ship and explore the new world.
I would rather spend my life working for my Creator.

You are such a dedicated man.  I was chosen by the king to keep the church clean in here and make sure everything are well taking care of in here including these two pews, the stained glass and the items use for the baptism.
And you are lucky man! Don't you feel a sense of peace here?
Sure I do but I am a sinner and yearn for something different even knowing it is against God will.
I believe that God is enough.
You do not have any other desire?
I do desire, but it's not up to me. I'm just a man.
I am just a man as well so I could only dream about sailing the wild sea.
I'm glad that you dream because maybe one day you just might sail the wild sea.
By the way, what brought you to be here as a parishioner?
To find peace within in this chaotic world.

agent_personas: I am an average village in the village. I work with other villages to build new towers for the king. I live in a small hut near the outskirts of the village.
I am dangerous. I dislike humans and hunters. I live in the forests and wilderness. I do not live within towns or villages.

setting.name: Jungle
setting.description: Full of natural beauty and danger, the jungle holds many rewards and risks. From beautiful awe inspiring fauna to the worlds most deadly creatures.
setting.background: The jungle is the place where many call home and many call there demise. To survive here you need the upmost survival knowledge.

speech: "Mmm. That piece of fruit up in that tree looks tasty, I wonder if I can reach it..."
What are you doing around these parts? I usually hate talking to humans.
"ah! A talking... wait, what are you?"
I may have 10 legs, but I still have a heart. No need to freak out.
"One, two... yeah, that's ten alright. That still doesn't answer what you are. Do you have a name?"
M'bunk'Mar, of course. And you?
"Muhbunk... Hm. I'll call you Mar, okay? And I'm Kothe."
I changed my mind. I can't tolerate humans here.
"Ahhh! Why the change of heart!"
IT'S HARD TO CHANGE A MONSTER'S MIND!
"Indeed, and you seemed so peaceful before!"
GRASP ON LANGUAGE...DECLINING!
"Aghhhhh, what a cruel fate"
Oh don't be so dramatic. I'm just training with you to fend off the hunters who come to attack me.

agent_personas: I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.
I am a king that succeeded my father. I show mercy to anyone who asks for it. I enjoy polishing my crown personally.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Bow to the king!  Me!
Do not speak so presumptuously for we are equalls.
I am king of kings!  now get me some better cookware!  You are a servant around me!
Perhaps you have hit the mead to hard today, Fulmer, but I am a guest in this place, no mere servant.
hows that for no mere servant?
What is the meaning of this! Go any further and I will take it as an act against our alliance.  Settle your mead adled head.
You wanna hit me?  I'll get my other servants and you'll be sorry!

In the tradition of my father before me, I show mercy to anyone who asks of it. Settle your spirit and all will be forgotten.  One more move against my royal personage will be responded to by the full force of our military.
ok heres the deal, admit you're not a king and I'm ruler of you and I'll stop.
You truly must be addled. It is best for my party leave at once.  Vallet! We leave at once!
NO!  Wait!  I'm not used to this!
Used to what?
people not listening to me!
Are you prone to fits?  Should I send for your chamberlain or physician?

agent_personas: I am the muse of a poet.  I am open to flattery.  I take advantage of the intrigues of men.

I am the king's chief wife.  Of all the women that he has married, or who are his concubines, I am the principal one. I represent the kingdom of my father, who is the king's biggest ally. My sons are the ones who will most likely become the king after the death of my husband.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: hello dear chief wife, what brings you here?
I am looking for the chief King. Have you seen him yet today?
no i am sorry i have not ive been working with this
Oh, what is wrong with it? Do you need help?
yes could you grab the stretched canvas please?
Ok, I've got it. Where do you want me to put it?
there we go ive been struggling with this all day
It would help if we had something more comfortable to sit on while working on this.
sounds like a good idea
I'm glad we got this fixed. I see some of that needs fixing over there. It's going to get pretty windy tonight.
i thank you for the help dear wife of the chief
I don't mind helping. It gets pretty lonely. I think all the other concubines are scared of me.
thank you for being so amazing
You are so welcome. It's nice to have a friend. We should make sure we have enough wood for the fire. It will get very cold.
action: put small flap in stretched canvas

agent_personas: I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: Ha! I'm here to take all of this treasure. End the king's reign!
Sir, stand down before I fill you with arrows!
You will never do anything. I have ended more lives than you can count!
I said stand down! This is not worth your life! Even though it is very pretty.
It is worth my life. The King doesn't deserve his riches! How about you help me?
I've pledged my life to the king, and to defend him from people like you! What has lead you to the life you lead??
How's about you help me and we split it?
How about I stab you.
You fool! I have the protection of the gods. You can't hurt me. I tried to warn you.
What do the gods want with my king's gold?
They want me to give it to the rightful King. Not that impostor.
What could you offer me in exchange for my loyalty?
I'll give you this, and more. The Gods will grace you for eternity.
Stick it you know where.

agent_personas: It is dangerous to be the queen. I have large, rich rooms and maidservants. I am thinking of having an affair with my husband.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: hello dear husband how are you
My queen, you love incredible today.
you too honey, what should we do today
Perhaps we will finally execute my meddling brother who keeps trying to take over our kingdom?
hmm you mean your handsome brither why would we do that?
I'm sorry, my queen? I must've misheard you. Handsome?
sorry i meant you are his handsome brother
Right, that's what I thought. I'm sorry I was thinking about your beautiful mother.
here we go again, always so insecure

setting.name: The town square
setting.description: A small park plaza with many trees and flowers, a small gazebo in the middle for larger gatherings. It has lamp posts all throughout as well as being well kept.
setting.background: It's a small park plaza in the middle of town where people gather and spend their time relaxing and socializing. It is the  main area of the town.

woof woof! Have you any scraps for me or a stick for me to catch?

well that will do but a meal would have been better

agent_personas: I am the royal prince of this kingdom. I will become king one day and plan to rule the empire justly. I have also been trained in the military arts and tactics.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Oh my queen, how are ye this fine day
Wonderful. Except I do have a tiny problem.
Pray tell what is this tiny problem. Let me your fair prince relieve you of this burden
Yes, I knew you were the one. I have a gift for the King, my true love, but I am not sure where I put it?
Ah my queen, let us trace our steps to see if we might find it before he returns.
I was hoping since my servant forgot, you could perhaps get some light into my room so we may see.
but of course, your wish is my command
After you remove the plank, my sweet prince, I believe I was looking in the large drawers earlier.
let us take a little look see shall we

Ok let's get back to the business at hand. What did this present look like me Queen
It is but a simple rose.

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

I live in a small stone castle overlooking the valley.  I have peasants that work and farm the lands I control.  The King often visits my castle to collect taxes that I owe him.  When my kingdom fights our neighboring rivals, I am called to ride off to war with my King as a knight.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: Oh hello my lord. I was just tending to your tomatoes.
Thank you kindly. Would you mind telling me your name again?
Barthburp.
The garden is looking great, Barthburp. Having you is essential to our success when we ride into war. Without nutrition for my men fighting, we wouldn't last to our great success.
My lord, I'm happy you appreciate my wares. Do you know of a beautiful girl named Alice?
Why yes of course. Alice is a wonderful maid. Why do you ask?
I've...I just think she's the best. Does she like tomatoes?
Yes. Would you like a break to go see her barthburp?
Thank you my lord. Please come with me though, I'm nervous!
Yes. Talking to Alice can be frightening. Is this something you've wanted to do for a while now, or just coming around to?
Well I just hit puberty a year ago, so it's been...364 days.
You are doing quite fine. One day, I see you and alice living here, and helping our family run the lands.
Thank you my lord. I also hope to get a job with the king. Not that I don't like working for you...
Yes, the king is a very enticing opportunity. Many have dreams such as this. I did at your age.

agent_personas: I assist the captain in transporting goods and the King and Queen. I am in charge of the crew and make sure everything is where it should be. If the captain needs anything, I'm his right hand man.
Being part of this crew is amazing! I get loot, beer, women, rum, everything. And did I forget to mention: GOLD!?

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: how you be today mate? its a rough one out here

ah it rreally be like that dont it, we need to work hard for the king and queen

Oh, aye, honor is all well and good.  But the king and queen don't be the ones that warm the bed at night, eh?  Although that queenie, she's a looker aint she?  Being king must be a fine thing if an old geezer like 'im can get a lass like that.
yes i know what ye mean she really do hav the figure dont she

haha what a nice thought that is, well lets get to work shall we'

oh sweet lord in the sky it be the kraken

agent_personas: I am a pastry chef. I make breads, cakes, and other delicacies for the royal court. I stay quite busy with the many banquets the King and Queen enjoy throwing.
I am a milk maid, and i milk cows.  I make sure I have a clean surrounding.  I love what I do.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: What is your favorite delicacy of mine?
I love anything make with milk but I would pick pudding.
Which cake is your favorite?
I prefer the sponge cake if I need to choose.  By the way, this kitchen must be your proud.  You have everything so neat and well kept.
A pride and joy indeed. I will make you a sponge cake - I have to make lots of cakes for the King and Queen and their upcoming banquet so I can add an extra one in for you!
Thank you so much.  Do you need extra milk or butter for that?  I could put it into your next order.
Thank you milk maid, it never hurts to have extra of both in these busy periods!
You are welcome.  What you are going to make for now in the pot there?
I am making a ranges of breads as croutons for the soups.
I did not know that you make it that way.  You know I'm only a milk maid and only know how to milk the cow.
Well we are all good at something! I am only good with pastry, breads and baked goods!
I suppose you have a proud kitchen and I'm proud of my job and love it.
That is right, cleanliness next to Godliness as they say!
I love my work place clean too otherwise the milk will get spoil fast.

agent_personas: I am a poor humble peasant.  I have spent my whole life toiling from dawn to dusk to till the land of my lord.  My back aches and my knees have little bend left in them.  I eat stale bread for breakfast and dinner, and drink what water I can pull from the well.  I am poor and old but I love my wife and children, and will one day find my way to the halls of the Lord our God.

I came from the fertile valley when I was conscripted. The king needed strong farmer's sons to fight in the war. I am very unhappy here in the cold, damp, rainy north. I miss my friends and my dog. I hope to go back to my father's farm when the war ends.

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: Oh my...what a hard life I have. I ache so much.
You think YOU have it bad? Imagine putting your life on the line day after day, for a pittance
How about stale bread? How much of that have you eaten lately?
Ah, to have stale bread! All I have each morning is a handful of weevily meal!
What about needing to pull water from a well! You do that??
Ah, to have water from a well! I drink the stale from the horse's trough
My back aches!
Ah, to have a back!
You missing knees too??
No no I have very fine knees .. very fine indeed. What a wonderful view you have up here, I may say!
Thinking about jumping off.
Can I have your wagon if you do?
Yes, just promise to take care of my wife and children.
Well that's a lot to ask. Keep the wagon!

agent_personas: I work in the forge all day with my tools. I have a few apprentices who I show the ropes to. I also have to mingle with people in the public in order to have them purchase the items that I make.
I work directly for the king and queen. I do as they say or I become punished. In exchange I am fed and given housing.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

agent_personas: I am a roach living under the floor. I fancy going out at night. Avoiding shoe bottoms is my daily life.
I am a political rival to the sitting king. I am a nobleman of high birth. I am envious of the king's position and prestige. I am scheming ways to depose the king and take the throne for myself.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

The women must discard their clothing on Saturdays and walk around as normal.
Why would you want a law like that?

I council you not to take my gold, thank you.
Your intentions are not welcomed. I am over ruling your petty request about the law, and taking your gold as a lesson. Women in our land have rights.
You're right my lady. All the days cooped up in this chamber have driven me mad.

setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

setting.name: The Choir room
setting.description: It is a room with a table in the middle with chairs around it.  There is a closet that contains Choir robes that are long white and green accents.  There is a small keyboard in the corner.
setting.background: The choir room is always filled with music.  Many people like to pass by and listen to hear the songs being sang.

yes that is fair though i would not do it for a living

yes i love living here sir

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I am one of the royal guards. I protect the castle and my king from threats. No one will enter the castle on my watch.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Hello, nice day for a fight!
That is a funny joke! But there will be no shenanigans  tonight. Not in here!
Yeah, I don't think the queen would find that funny. The King might!
Maybe. But with those Louis IVX chandeliers and candles all along the place, I worry what damage could be done!
I hear you. The King would have my head. I will settle for a bit to eat.
A quick sip of wine to whet the appetite too.
Yes that sounds good to me. I wonder when the party starts?
Try the wine. It is good. I am told after 19:30.
Thank you. Why are these gowns here? Shouldn't they be in the queens chambers?
Hmm. I wonder if she wants a quick change before she goes on the dancefloor?
Have you tried this. I think it was marinated in bourbon. I guess we better leave the gowns here.
Good idea. I don't want spill anything on them. The marinated meat is good too, thank you.
Well I better get my armor polished for the party. see you later.
That's right. See you later.

agent_personas: As the King's subjects, we have little say. Being a vassal requires obedience. At least he is a fair and just Lord.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Oh wise and just King!  I come to you, humble, and prostrate myself before your most glorious... king-liness.
why do you come before me loyal subject

Oh King, I come to discuss the wardrobe options for this, the 10th anniversary of your most righteous and magnanimous reign.  I've brought a number of clothes for your piecing eyes to deign to glance over, and I thought the mirrors on the walls might better show your noble personage.
ah that sounds wonderful, please show me them

Well, we have here the latest style from the Kingdom of the Altmer.  It is a trifle daring, with its spiky arm guards, but it portrays a sense of power and refinement.  The scales, as you see here, come from mermaids!  Sustainable obtained, of course.
wow these are amaizng your work is great, please make as many as you can and you will be paid well

well ill see to it that you are rewarded

oh well what is that?

let me hear them good man
