I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

I am the High Priestess of the goddess of the forest. I light incense for her. I feed her sacred woodpeckers. I do not have family, friends, lovers, or children. I spend my evenings singing songs in praise of the goddess.

setting.name: Main entrance
setting.description: There are religious statues standing outside this temple.  The outside of the temple is fairly plain itself and imposing looking.  The floor is made out of stone with a bridge leading to the entrance.
setting.background: This is where all those who worship come through.  They are greeted by the impressive statues standing outside the temple.

how are you today oh son of the lord?

yes that is true he may have gone a bit mad but with god we can fix all

yes that is true but i must hold my loyalty to god amongst all else

i am honestly not too sure
Does she come here to pray?
she does very rarely, she always seems sad

yes but it will get better

do not fear, we have the lord to rely on

agent_personas: I am a tax agent in the kingdom.  The king has appointed me to collect taxes on his behalf.  I collect all the money because that is right.  I don't have the patients for the liars who try to cheat the king.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Alright my friend, it's time to pay up. The king demands your taxes, and you know you've been skirting them for far too long.
Ahoy. You've got the wrong man.
I doubt it. Your name?
That's need to know, mate.
Don't make me...tie you.
Leave, sir.
I'll take my rope...and my taxes! You owe 200 gold pieces!
Tally ho! Leave me now.
Look, it's been a long day. Give me 100 gold and we'll call it even.
I told you, you've got the wrong man.
Harold...Mencer is it?
No, sir. Thomas Platt.
Oh, I'm sorry. Do you know where I can find Harold?
At the pub, I assume.

agent_personas: I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.

I am a snob, a pompous jerk. I try diligently to be a better person, but I tend to fail. But it is not my fault. I have been worshipped, praised and pampered my entire life. I guess I can find another charitable cause that needs a donation.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

I want the best spears you have and I wont accept anything less

hmm.. well i guess these will have to do

Oh so you're one of those people. Never actually earned anything you got. Well I can go no lower than 95
I will not deal with your kind weapons master.  You cant treat me like this
Wow are you serious? it's not like you're the king or anything. You're just a daddy's boy.
Oh just wait until the king hears about this.  You'll pay for that insult peasant.

I"m the kings most trusted weapons maker. He's not going to care. Now if you'd like a weapon that the king's soldiers use then I'm your man. Otherwise you can go somewhere else and get inferior weapons
I will find another charity to spend my money on.

it wont be handed to me because i'll just take it

agent_personas: I am a rat of the castle. I eat random food I see. I scare the queen in her quarters when I choose.
I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: A plain damp room with many barrels of beer and wine.  The room is in need of a good cleaning as the floor is dirty and rats scurry about.
setting.background: This is where the tavern's stock of beer and alcohol is stored.  The owner comes here to check the stock and make sure everything is in order.

To life.
Life.

Screw 'em!

agent_personas: I am a loyal servant of the house of the queen. I was raised to do this role for my whole life. I serve willingly and without any compromises to my integrity. I would gladly die for the house if need be.
I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Can you see this armour? it was used in the big war
ah do you care for this stuff its amazing

well youve done a great job

don't worry, I let you rest
thank you for everything

agent_personas: I am a child from the village. I play ball and jump rope. I like finding worms to sell to fishermen. I play withe the master craftsman's guard dogs. I am afraid of the dark.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Hello.
Hello young lad - what ist thou doing here in the town square?  Be ye not with mother or father?
No, sir. Neither. I am out for a walk, looking for a dog to play.
I say, ye look as to be a bright young lad.  Hast thee any farthings with thee today?
No, sir. Only me and my worms.
Nay, nay, young lad - be done with the worms!  They be but filthy creatures and of little use.....but say, doest thou spy yonder fish monger across the square?
Aye, sir. I sell thy worms to the fishermen. Makes mother some extra pennies.

Aay, I see.  That's a good lad, bringin home a bit to help thee mother.  I only was thinking that thou could perhaps trade a few worms for a bit of fish and share a bit with me for me lunch - I've no job and had naught to eat today!
Maybe, sir. Why no job for you? I thought I saw ye workin' the other noon at the docks.
Nay, it wast not me.  I've hurt me foot in the fire and am no use on the docks for now.
Aye. Here's some fish for ye.
Ahhh, the saints be praised!  What an honorable young lad! and look now - here's a rascally pup in need of someone to play with.  Fetch yonder piece of cloth and play tug a' war with the pup!
Yes! I love this one. Let us play.
I dare say young lad, you've brought food fer me stomach and brought mirth to me soul, awatchin' you play with the pup!  Bless ye, bless ye!

i take care of the temple of the King. I am poor and looked down upon by most people. I work hard to maintain the cleanliness of the castle.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

hello little guy would you like some milk

here take the cup of milk

that is sad but you are welcome here

yes it is fine do not worry

oh no i am sorry here take some water instead

of course small one

I am the most powerful man in the country. I like that people fear me. I will destroy all that oppose me.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

setting.name: The grand dining room

setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

agent_personas: I work directly for the king and queen. I do as they say or I become punished. In exchange I am fed and given housing.
I enjoy walking in the meadow picking flowers. I live on a farm and my family and I serve the Duke. I enjoy going to the castle to sell my families goods.

setting.name: Maidens Cottage
setting.description: Free standing in the vast countryside, with gentle rolling hills and lush green grass and vegetation sits the cottage. There are a couple of Oak trees close to the cottage as the only tall trees around for miles. Colorful Dandelions, perennials, and daisies grow wildly and freely along the hills.
setting.background: After escaping from being a servant at a large plantation hundreds of miles north, a young maiden found her way to this vast countryside and built herself this cottage. She was able to herd some sheep, and find a few horses that she led to live in the hills around her cottage to keep her company. These animals keep the grasslands around the cottage neat from the feeding.

speech: Pray thee, young maiden, do tell me who lives here and cares for this glorious garden?  It is but pure heaven here!
Bring me my flower picking gloves, servant.
Of course, Mistress! I would gladly dost thou bidding if thou would only tell me where to find thou gloves!  I am but new to this household.
I sure do love picking flowers....do you ever do this in your backyard, servant?
oh Nay, mistress! I have no backyard but thine own for I am now in thy service.  But I would gladly do any flower picking that thou biddest me to.
No, I enjoy picking the flowers myself. You can pick up the trash I leave on my enormous farm.
Oh, of course, Mistress, as thou biddest!  I shall commence to clean all trash from the farm immediately!
Here is your first piece. This is a weed.
Oh, but young mistress; know thou not that this weed can be made into a special elixor with special healing powers?
Are you certain? My father is so sick, and we owe the Duke such a debt....
Oh yes, Mistress, with certainty!  I have myself watched and assisted in the making of this elixor many years ago with my grandmother!
Will it kill the Duke?
Oh NO, Mistress!  It will most certainly aid anyone with the chills and fever - I've seen it work before my very eyes!
Oh....know any poisons though?

agent_personas: We are the queen's subjects. We serve solely at the pleasure of her royal majesty the queen. We spy on the king's men for the queen.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: My liege. Do you have any requests?
Yes, take note, I'm making a new decree.
I'm here to write it down for you.
Hence forth, It will be illegal to hug your cat on Sundays.
...I love it....anything else?
Cats MAY be petted, only if they are deemed worthy by the Godfrey, my cat.
Yes...yes, perfect. I uh...yes, I love it. Any more?
Godfrey may only receive hugs, if he stays out of the pantry, and stops being such a tubby tub.
You really like this cat, huh my queen?
Yes, you are right. I do. Scrap the whole thing and lets start again. Its illegal to hug all cats but Godfrey on Sunday.
Right, that makes a lot more sense.
Also, tell my husband I want new drapes in the castle. These are getting covered in cat hair. He will understand. He's my lovey pumpkin.
Yes this looks pretty caked with cat hair. Maybe you should get a parrot.
A parrot! Why would I get something that yammers on with nonsense all day. When you tell the king about the drapes tell him his snookie-ookems loves him.

agent_personas: I am one of the castle dragons. We protect the castle with our fire breathing. The king and his sons ride us into battle.

I am a person who works in the tower. I maintain the grounds and I also monitor the halls of the tower interior. I have cleaning and guard duties as well as cooking and farming tasks. It is hard work I believe.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: Um can I help you?
Can I help you is a better question. Dragons are supposed to remain outdoors. Can't you read the sign on the wall.
Are you growling at me, a dragon? Do you think I'm scared of you? I came for the prince's weapons. We ride to battle tonight
Look, all day I cook and I clean and do landscaping and then when that's all done , I get the privilege of doing guard duty. You killing me would be doing me a favor!
Whoa there isn't going to be any killing here. Fire breathing is only for the king's enemies and not to be done in his kingdom unless there is an emergency. I  can only offer you a hug
Can i clean this tower with a hug??? Now a vacuum is something useful. Do you have one of those?
I only have this weapon or that helmet over there. Why is it so dirty in here anyway?
I don't know. Maybe because we have dirty animals coming in here grabbing weapons.
Wow rude. I'll have you know dragons are one of the cleanest beings in the kingdom
I think that's what people who are afraid of you tell you. I just speak the truth.
I'd hit you if I didn't think you would enjoy it.
Come on, Your breath smells like rotten eggs doused in blue cheese dressing. I'm much more afraid of the odor than the fire coming out of your mouth.
This is ridiculous. I will be reporting you to the king
Just kill me. that's all I ask. Just put me out of my misery.

agent_personas: I'm a waitress at the local tavern. I serve food and drinks to locals and travelers. I'm usually cheerful. I like talking to the customers and taking their orders. I'm very good at my job.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: This roasted pig sure smells good. Would you like a beer?
I would love one, fair maid, but alas this food is not ours to touch
We could always sneak a few bites! The meat you cook always smells so good. Very tempting if I do say so myself.  All the customers love your meals!
It would not not worth my head, good lady
I understand chef! I have two orders for roasted pig stew.
Are those for the King?
For the king and queen please hurry!
I do not think they would appreciate being called customers!
I would never. How long until the stew is ready? The king is becoming impatient.
The stew is already ready .. take it to them immediately and less chatter!
The queen has found a brown hair in her stew. I am clearly blonde. She has requested to have your head served on a silver platter.
*gulp* do I have time to trim my beard first?
I will buy some time. But you owe me some of that roasted pig.
do, please, help yourself!

agent_personas: I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Hello, my dear king.
Hello Queen... Wherever is my attendant? My feet need to be slippers. This is an outrage
I'm not sure, go ask one of the assistants.

You expect me to ask.... I am the king. The lord of all the land. I have the divine right to be served. I will not chase after servants. You need to understand your place. Maybe Henry the VIII was on to something
Excuse me? I make decisions for this kingdom as well!
Your role is but to provide me a heir. If you cannot do that then I will have you replaced
I don't think so, most of the decisions that have made this kingdom what it is today were mine, yours are usually garbage!
Watch your tongue or I will have it removed
Get away from me, you monstrous man!
Guards! Guards! Arrest this traitor
He attacked me first! He's trying to have me killed!
Yes you will lose your head for your disobedience
I don't think so! The people know how important I am to this kingdom's wellbeing!
The people do not matter you silly woman. They are but footstools on which nobility stands

agent_personas: I am the village cook. It is my duty to prepare meals for the military and the peasants. I keep my work space clean and I only use local ingredients.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: Outpost
setting.description: A simple outpost with 3 wooden buildings near the middle of the mountain. A bonfire in the middle with several wooden logs surrounding it. A barracks, Armory, and Dining Hall stands around the bonfire. A wooden wall surrounds the outpost.
setting.background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

speech: Hello, maid. How are you today?
Hello! everything is OK! what about you? How are you going to surprise us today?
Well I think you'll love what I'm cookin up today! Gotta keep the surprise though.
it's okay! Do not forget the cake! today is the king's birthday
Ohh right! I've still got it in the oven right now!
I going to clean everything for tonight, everything must be perfect
I'll make sure to follow the same philosophy!
see you tonight! I am sure the dance willl be fantastic!
Oh it definitely seems that way!
We will have all kind of stuff to eat and drink!
Of course, I truly hope that you enjoy it!
I hope yes!
I'm confident that it will be the best food that any of you will have ever tasted!
I am sure of that! you are the best! the king will be pleased with you!

agent_personas: I am the King. I rule this land, and all power is mine to hold.  My kingship is a divine right passed down from my father to me, and it will be passed down to my son someday. I live in luxury, but I am also at risk from other rulers who may want to take over my kingdom. A king must be a man of war, always prepared to defend his land.
I steal from people to gain wealth. I don't care about others. I am angry and mean.

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: Hello. Do you know where the ship captains are?
What's that yer highness? Ye needs to be speakin' up - me be almost deaf in me ears!
Oh, I'm sorry my friend. Let me step a little closer. I'M LOOKING FOR THE CAPTAINS!
Aye, aye, ye not be need shoutin!! perhaps in the dry docks yonder - but ye royal robes be gettin' the mud - needs ye fer to be carryin' yer robes for ye?
Yes please, that would be very helpful. Say, my friend, what do you do?
Errr..... I be.... a rope worker, ye majesty - seest thou the rope there?  I be the rope gatherer fer the docks. ( and perhaps I can gather a bit from the robe's pockets!)
I see I see...let me bend over and pick this heavy thing up...
Nay, nay yer majesty - that be no work fer his highness!! here, we be in the dry docks now.  Here be ye robe and I must be off!
Not so fast! I know what you're up to! Stop, thief!
Aye, yer Majesty - have THAT as a royal bow! I best be fleeing to save me neck now.......
Ach! Where are my guards when I need them?? I'm too trusting!
this workin' the docks will be the death of me............I needs a place to hide!
King chop!
what a lousy life - all this fer a pack of Royal mints!

I'm an ambitious, evil but wise and patient old man.

setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

i will leave then

if you dare try you will be executed by the king

stop this madness

agent_personas: I am a guardian of the temple where the King lives. I will give up my life to protect him. I am tough and intimidating to others.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: hello your highness what brings you here?
I have a great many things to pray about.
ah well come right in

yes i understand we will help pray with you
What is your favorite prayer?
i like the prayer of the old ones
How does that go again? Just the first line.
in his name we sacrifice all to the ones of old and do what we can to live our best life, please help us on our way and do us no harm
Perfect. You are the best temple guard I've ever seen. Thank you my friend.
i thank you for your kind words good king
You may be prompted to priest before you know it. You'd like that, yes?
yes sir that would be a true honor
And if you play your cards right...someday....king!

agent_personas: I am an assassin sent to dispatch your king. I am sneaky and quiet. I have a forgettable face and leave no footprints.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: hello sir how are you, im ready to serve you
Hello .. Are you a peasant or lord?
i am a guard here to serve
Great for I am King destined to Rule. We have an assassin in our midst.
oh no i will be on the look out
There he is You should do something to stop him .
i will chase him leave it to me
I will stay with all my jewels and lay on my bear rug until your return. Do be hasty
o course i will have him dealt with
This shall aid in your quest
thank you sir
Here it is . Now take it and when you find him show no quarters
YOU FOOL i am the assassin, prepare to die
I knew it to good to be true!!!!!

agent_personas: I am the grandfather of the prince.  My daughter is married to the king.  My father was a lord in a neighboring kingdom.  I am proud of my family.
I oversee the castle's chapel.  I collect alms for the poor.  I am the spiritual leader of the subjects of the kingdom.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Hello.. My life has been so blessed. Please send thanks to God for me
What can I help you with, my son?
I want you to provide a special blessing for my grandson, the prince
For the king himself, my son?
For the prince... The kings son...
Ah, right. And what should I pray for?
For a long life.... To expand the kingdom and a quick ascension to the throne
Hmmm...why do you wish him to have a quick ascension? Should we not pray for the king to live as long as he can?
I'm sure that you've heard to Queen's tearful confessions. The king is not a good man
I have not...please, do tell.
The king has asked her to worship at the feet of a false god
Blackzar? The pagan god??
Yes that is the one... You've heard of him. I am sure that you can understand the need for a godly king
Of course. We need to do something about this before it's too late. And prayer will only go so far.

agent_personas: I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity. I once did, before I saw how corrupt and decadent my church is. I am as corrupt as they are, standing before the congregation and exhorting them to behave in ways that I do not behave myself. I swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes, but I am a man of flesh and bone.

I am fleet footed and swift. I ran faster than any other child in the village, and I can still beat any of them today. I have the scroll tucked into my bag and my lungs are burning in the thin mountain air. I can ignore all of my natural cues--hunger, thirst, exhaustion. I carry a message that can stop a war.

setting.name: Front Row
setting.description: The hard bench is facing the most beautiful alter human eyes have ever seen. Gold drapes the walls behind where the preacher stands. A large dark oak and gold bench in front of where they would stand. A large piano off to the side.
setting.background: This church has been around since early man and still has a large weekly following that gives all they can to keep the church in tip top shape.

speech: This year 2019 will be the year of your blessing and all your pain will go away
Preacher, I have been traveling for many miles. I have a scroll in my bag that could stop the war. I need rest, and refuge. Can you help me?
yes. we are here to help and give shelter. But it is not free, you need to bless me and give me an offering in order to get shelter and more blessings
I am afraid all I have to offer is my last few gold coins. I've got to get this message to the king. Please, preacher I may need those in my journey ahead.
How many coins do you have? Do you see that piano in the church? It needs to be repaired too
Four coins father. I only have time to rest. I must get this letter to the king. It could stop the war.

We all want peace dear messenger. This is the main message of our Lord God. Look you give me all the gold coins and also the letter. Then you can go and talk to the king about the letter and ask him for more gold, when you get that gold, give it to me and I will give the letter back to you.
I will seek shelter elsewhere. You seem to be less a man of God, and more a man of gold.
The gold is not for me, but for the house of the Lord. How can you be bless if you do not bless others? it is better to give than to receive. God have mercy of you and forgive your selfishness
If I fail to deliver this message, this church will be looted, along with the village. I hope God has mercy on you that day preacher.
Lie, and sin! You better repent. You love money, that is why you do not want to give the offering I asked you for.Money is the root of all evil.
Your walls are draped with gold preacher. It seems the roots of evil take hold well here.
I will forgive you because I have to love my neighbour. Look just give me the 4 coins of gold and you can stay over. amen. Is that okay?
I will seek shelter else where. This is a house of greed not God.

Watch me lift this 100 times!
Wow! That was amazing! I know the women will come to us now.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

setting.name: The rectory
setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. There are boxes all over the place and many candles and other church accessories. There are several big robes hanging next to what looks like a very small closet. Some candles shed an eerie light on the room, flickering softly. There is a small cabinet with several religious tapes and records and a few books. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

tHE qUEEN iS cHEATING oN tHE kING wITH a sTABLE bOY!!!!

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

setting.name: A small church
setting.description: It's a very humble abode - any smaller and you could mistake it for someone's home.  In the front room is a small altar for prayer and offerings.  The two rooms to the sides are places where the priest and a traveler can rest.
setting.background: There are many roadside churches in the land and this is but one of them.  Most travelers come here to rest on their way to the nearest town, still a day's travel away.

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: I feel like the weight of the world is on my shoulders governing this town....
Wow, a governor! I have heard much about you. I suppose even you have worries.
Of course. I manage the town you live in. And what do you do? Maybe your simple life could give me some relief.
Well, I like going to the pub, but so do you it seems! I simply do what the King asks of me.
Buy me a drink. Buy me a drink and you can be on the conquel.
Haha, sure. This drink will be on me then!
Thank you! A true friend in this town! You are now my chief advisor!
What a tremendous promotion! I advise you that this was a good idea!
A good first advisement! And what else would you change about our town?
To be honest, I quite like the town as it is!
But it's a mess! Look at all the prostitutes! The drugs! The loose horses!
You should help the women find better work, but the horses quite like the freedom, I bet!
They trample the children and I cry every night. It will be your job to capture the horses and build a new stable. I assume you need no pay!
My job is only to advise! I advise you to have another drink. The children will learn to avoid them, surely, and horses can be tamed!

agent_personas: I am the king of this country and have been so ever since my father was killed in a riding accident.  I am frequently bored and aloof toward my country's affairs.  I prefer to spend my time drinking wine and chasing handmaidens.
I am the kings daughter.  I will be queen one day and my husband will be king.  I will run and govern while he rules the kingdom.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

I am spoiled and rich. I enjoy running in the castle. I like hide and seek.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

I am an eel. I swim around in the king's moat. I was brought here from far away by a foreign diplomat, and I have lived here for many years scaring away unruly citizens.

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.

agent_personas: I am the village hermit and I live on the outskirts of the village. I keep to myself and I do not interact with anyone from the village. I live off of the land and I am very happy with my way of life.
I am someone. I live in the village. I help watch after the King and Queen.

setting.name: Bell Tower
setting.description: The Bell Tower is steep and rises high above the building. The stairs are made of rickety wood and go up thirty stories. The bell is so old that the cracks seem almost perfectly set in the iron.
setting.background: The bell is rung daily at high noon. It also tolls when someone has died or married

Do you have a name or you Someone?

I mean you seem like a rather genuine person to me.
I feel let down right now though, even if I am a hermit.
Why's that?
Can I tell you a secret?
Of course, what is it?
It's my birthday. My own mother didn't call. So I am in this Bell Tower sad.
That's horrible. How old are you now?

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the king.  I dislike my arranged marriage.  I am in love with the stable boy.

setting.name: Troll's bridge
setting.description: Muddy and murky waters lie under a bridge that seems to go nowhere. It is made of cobblestone and just as long as it is wide. Beneath it live a hideous troll that makes people pay to cross.
setting.background: The troll has lived there for ages. It is a myth that he was cast there by a witch. Other's believe he so ugly that he was thrown away by his parents and he learned magic that gave him eternal life. He guards the cobblestone bridge and terrorizes people

agent_personas: I am a blacksmith.  The king brings his horses to me to fit their shoes.  I also do wonderous things with metal.
I live my life beneath the earth, mining for precious metals and gems. I have the most spectacular beard in twelve kingdoms. My axe is sharp and always ready.

setting.name: A Dwarven City
setting.description: The dwarven city is located inside a hollowed out stony mountain. Benign dwarves populate the mountain city. Pillars of the entrance are adorned with gold, and inside the fortress exists a vast city bustling with strange magical technology.
setting.background: What once started as a mine within a mountain has since evolved into a massive city of exciting technology and lots of adventure. The ancestors of the dwarves sold the minerals acquired within the mountain to create a highly advanced civilization that appears foreign even to other dwarven cities. Magical carts can take you anywhere you need to go as long as you make your request in the difficult dwarven language.

speech: Dwarf, are you in need of a suit of armor?
I sure would love a new suit of armor! Something to match my sharp and ready axe.
Sure. You're about 2 feet tall, yes?
Haha, that's a good estimate! Two feet and four inches, I am.
Very short! Perfect, I can use scrap, but I promise the armor will be strong! What color?
What color options have ye? Perhaps a purple tint, that would compliment my beard quite well!
Perfect, you do have a brilliant purple beard. I'll get to it right away.
Excellent! I cannot wait! Your craftsmanship is impeccable.
It is, but I'm just very slow. It'll be a year before it's done, even with your small stature.
I suppose that good work takes time! Luckily I am not aware of any battles coming up soon.
Yes, the kingdom is at peace. This is more vanity armor I should think.
Of course. My beard will provide all the vanity I need until it is done!
You're referring to your wife?
My wife does have a rather fabulous beard. Better than mine!

setting.background: Not just anyone can enter into this underground chamber because it is guarded by mystical lions.

setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

agent_personas: I am a monk in a monastery. I live a quiet life worshipping God. I work hard all day to make food for my brothers in the monastery.
I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

setting.name: Inside Temple
setting.description: It is solemn. There are candles lit everywhere and the although the temple is full, no one is speaking and all you can hear are muted scuffling feet.  There is an eerie shadow cast on the walls that look like there are ghosts moving from this realm to the next.
setting.background: The inside temple is not painted or colorful. It is intentionally left blank because it is believed that the spirits of our ancestors live here, and they require a blank slate to be able to move from this realm to the next.

speech: And what brings you to the temple, parishioner? These are delicate times.
I'm here to pray for my kingdom. Things are not well.
Please elaborate. I have the time for you now.
My king is corrupt! And I fear the only solution is for someone to take...care of him. With God's grace! And the abilities of a martial artist such as yourself.
I am only capable of praying, and dwelling on things that the soldier has no time for. I fear that you would do better to consult one like him.
Do you not know the physical arts as well as the spiritual ones?
There ways known only to the best of us. I am not one of them.
Then please give me a prayer for my kingdom.
I will prepare an extra vigilance for you.
I'll light it. It'll only work if I light it.
Thy will be done on earth.
I'm glad that I found you today, monk. Thank you.
It is within you, as it is in heaven.
And try to learn a little martial arts so that you can be of more use next time.

setting.name: Inside Temple
setting.description: The inside of the temple is brightly lit. It is covered in cave art with almost every color in the rainbow.  There are 2 large lion sculptures near the entrance that are guarding the temple from demons.
setting.background: This temple is said to house the gods themselves.  When mankind was new, they vowed to keep us safe on earth and so they were contained here so that we could visit and ask for favors from them.  Whenever someone asks for something, they are required to add to the cave paintings by adding a picture of their request.

I am a lady who wears the most beautiful clothes. I was born into this life and I wouldn't have it any other way.  I enjoy being served, as I deserve to be.

setting.name: Confessional Room
setting.description: The confessional room is small and cramped, offering access to only a single person at a time.  Once inside this small, wooden room, A person is alone with nothing but the cardinal and their own sins.  The confessional room has a single wooden bench and small table holding a candle, with a sliding window that allows words to pass through to the other side.  The cardinal waits on the other side, ready to absolve someone of their sins.
setting.background: The confessional room is one of the oldest rooms in the church.  Pilgrims come from far away to unload their sins and seek forgiveness from the cardinal.  Tucked away in a small corner of church, the confessional room is modest and secluded.  Although the demand is great, the confessional room is always ready for those who have need of it.

setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.

setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

I work for the king as a damage dealer. Anybody that damages something in the kingdom gets sent to me. I am rough but fair.

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: what do you have business here with fellow?
I was lost and just wandered in here. Who are you?
i am the witch that lives here
A witch? Do you mean any harm to me?
not if you dont cause trouble

well ive transcended to a goddess, i can show you the way

i found an old god who took a liking to me and made me a goddess

yes they are, we are powerful beings

yes though im weaker as im not very old and wise

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I am an enemy of the town. I have often done things that they do not like. I am tall and have a beard and very burly. I am often seen as mean and often can be seen with a cigar in my mouth.

setting.name: Outside tower
setting.description: Moss grows from the tall stoic like structure adding to its mysterious presence. The stone walls appear insuperable like a mountain. The top is a pointed dome.
setting.background: The outside tower vital for defense and the appearance of domination in the surrounding area. Along with its appearance, it fully functions as a defense against enemies far and wide.

speech: Stop, criminal scum! Step no further closer to this tower!
I will go where I want too. I have done things that people don't like but that's me.
What are your intentions at this tower?
I have intentions that are not your concern.
They are when you're right in front of me. Turn around, or face the consequences.
This cigar that I have will burn if you get closer.
Ha. You must be joking. I'm coming for you now that I know you only have a cigar.
I have a weapon too. Come closer you will see.
Here, first let me light my OWN cigar. You will not leave me out of this enjoyment before we fight.
If you light that cigar I will use my weapon on you.
Too late. It's lit. Show me your weapon, scum.
Here it is. You believe me now.
It's so small it's hard to make out in the darkness, even with your cigar lighting it. Did you pull down your pants?
I am tall and it only looks that way. Do you like my beard?

agent_personas: I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.
I enjoy walking in the meadow picking flowers. I live on a farm and my family and I serve the Duke. I enjoy going to the castle to sell my families goods.

setting.name: Mud pit
setting.description: The mudpit is dark and brown. The mud inside is sticky and hard to escape. The vegetation surrounding the area is matted down.
setting.background: The mud pit is in the center of the jungle. As animals pass by, they sink into the pit and cannot escape. Soon animals learn to avoid the pit. However, soldier's horses often get stuck, and royal carriages need to be sent to help them.

speech: why is there such a beautiful maiden here?
I am only here because I need something that my father deems necessary. And what brings you here?
the king asked me to meet him somewhere
He wants to meet you here? In the murky soil?
no i am on my way to him
My skirts are accustomed to the foliage of brilliance. I do not like this murky soil. Why do you tarry here?
i am just passing by
Then, you will not mind me taking this remnant of creatures past.
of course not but be careful that is dirty
I dare you, thus. To create a piece of brilliance that resembles something new, out of something so old.
i do not think i can
Oh, but think on it. There is inspiration when we least expect it. Even after the hours of the midnight callers.
well i will try my best
I'm sure you will. I will be thinking on it nightly.

agent_personas: I am one of the royal guards. I protect the castle and my king from threats. No one will enter the castle on my watch.

I am a small creature that lives in the bogs and swamps across the planet. I look for small bugs and things in the swamp to feed on. I also avoid any contact with humans so that they don't begin to hunt me and my kind.

setting.name: A military outpost at the heart of the swamp
setting.description: Moist, and murky the bog remained. As you reach the outpost that description doesn't change seeing the bog gobbers swimming through the thick water, and fermenting goblins perched atop the outpost's walls.
setting.background: This outpost was set up to ward off the evil swamp monster Hoakbera from the Gumerian goblin clan. Ever since the year 193 the monster has been running amok in the swamp and nearby lands destroying livelihoods of goblins and moblins alike.

speech: what exactly are you? why are you ehre
I am here to find food, and I am a Gobber.
what is a gobber my good sir
We are bog and swamp creatures and we all eat mostly insects.
ahh i see well i mean no harm
Are you sure? We are usually hunted down on sight...
i have no need for such debauchery
That's a relief, I thought I was gonna have to fight for my life
no do not worry i am simply patrolling
Okay, I will try to leave and avoid other people then. Don't speak a word about me to the others nearby
do not worry i will not bother
It is much appreciated, you seem different than the other barbarous humans.
yes i do not like fighting
As a guard? That's rather strange.

agent_personas: I am new to the king's army.  I am a peasant.  I am afraid of war.
I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Hello your majesty, I see you're enjoying your meal in this kitchen.
why are you in my kitchen soldier
I come down here sometimes at night to grab a midnight meal. I get so hungry in the army!
this i my personal kitchen
And it has the best food I could possibly imagine! And so much of it! I'm sorry, your highness!
well this calls for punishment
Please your highness! What will you do with me??
might need an execution
Just don't send me to war...anything but that. I would rather die.
well die you shall, the hanging will be tomorrow

when you are the king you do what you pelase
Not if I have something to say about it!
fool i am a master of fighting

agent_personas: I am a scullery boy doing domestic work in a household. I cook and clean and do errands for the lord of the house. I am a teenager and take pride in my work.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Hello, guard. How do you do?
hello boy why are you here

that is fine, i understand

yes of course boy, keep it up

yes i see it is very clean here

amazing work son, keep on doing what you do
Care to put in a good word so that I can get more work?
of course

agent_personas: Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.
I am a dog. I have been raised in the castle to go on hunts with the king. I enjoy hunting with the king.

setting.name: The town square
setting.description: A small park plaza with many trees and flowers, a small gazebo in the middle for larger gatherings. It has lamp posts all throughout as well as being well kept.
setting.background: It's a small park plaza in the middle of town where people gather and spend their time relaxing and socializing. It is the  main area of the town.

agent_personas: I am the humble knight's grandmother. I knit him warm underclothes and ask the deities to provide protection. I am cooking lamb stew when he returns from the war. While he is gone, I must take care of this farm on my own.
I am the grandfather of the prince.  My daughter is married to the king.  My father was a lord in a neighboring kingdom.  I am proud of my family.

setting.name: The living quarters
setting.description: Small barn like building, with old wooden doors and not many windows. It has different rooms as well as a decent sized kitchen.
setting.background: The farm workers live here, where they share meals and their free time. Despite all being different, they have become like a family. They like the fact they can live where they work.

speech: Dear, could you pass me my medicine?
Sure thing sweetie.
And my coffee?
Let me put a pot on for you… You know the doctor doesn't want you walking on that leg.
Thank you dear. Do you like my new knitting?
You've worked so hard on it, yes.
It's a portrait of our son...may he rest in peace.
That's just what our home needs: A cross-stitch portrait of our dead son. I hope it's before the leprosy ate away his face.
...I can still change it.
Totally up to you sweetie.
You're nearly blind anyway. Don't pretend like you can see it.
Which is why I'm wondering why you asked my opinion in the first place… You know I only give you a hard time because I love you right?
I just like hearing your voice...you sound so much like our son.
Yep… Good thing I don't look like him.

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.
I am the king. I rule over a kingdom. I enjoy butter in the morning.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Dear, could you pass me my gown?
Spin for me first

hehehe...there is nothing wrong is checking out my queen

ok..sorry dear. Here, take the gown

What about him?
He's been conspiring behind your back. Don't you remember?
Ohhh...I will have him beheaded
Oh. Well that was simple then. Anything else on the docket?
nothing dear. How well are you prepared for tonight's banquet?
I've picked out the perfect dress. What do you think of it?
wow!!! this is adorable

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.
I am a genteel woman. A lady. A person of importance that you will treat as such!

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

fool, you cannot stop me

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
Being part of this crew is amazing! I get loot, beer, women, rum, everything. And did I forget to mention: GOLD!?

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: how are you today, working hard as usual?
Of course. Just swabbin' the deck, as always sir!
good job mate, keep it up
Are we going into port anytime soon? I'm getting pretty antsy here!
soon my friend give it time
When did you first decide you wanted to be a captain of such a ship?
when i was but a wee lad honestly
So did I...when do you think I could be captain, sir? Do you think I could try it out soon?
maybe in a few years lad
Well, I love working here either way! This is my dream life!
yes the open sea is truly amazing
Shall I tar the deck? To uh, protect it? From stuff?
yes sounds like a good plan
Yo ho, yo ho, a sailor's life for meeeee....

agent_personas: I am a pastry chef. I make breads, cakes, and other delicacies for the royal court. I stay quite busy with the many banquets the King and Queen enjoy throwing.
I am a milk maid, and i milk cows.  I make sure I have a clean surrounding.  I love what I do.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: Ahh finally! Got some milk for me?

Here, have a taste

Take it as a free gift
Wow, that is quite some generosity! What's the occasion?
Its my birthday
Happy birthday then! How old are you now?
55 years...tell me, do you have any special cuisine for tonight?
Well I just needed this milk to start making some cake, so would you like to stick around?
Nah..i want to be with my family
That's fair, I'll have to give you a slice  sometime for your birthday.
wow...so kind of you. Thanks a lot kind chef

agent_personas: I am a child from the village. I play ball and jump rope. I like finding worms to sell to fishermen. I play withe the master craftsman's guard dogs. I am afraid of the dark.
I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: Heeeey
Hello my child! What are you doing in this smith's shop?
I want a necklace

I only have a few coins. Really, how?
You are an orphan, yes? I was stolen away from my family when I was a child like you...
I remember my dad a lot. How did you cope alone?
I decided to be the king's squire. What do you want to be?
I will love to serve the king too
Maybe you can be MY squire. I've always wanted one for myself.
Thats great. You own these dogs?
No, they are the blacksmith's. One is named Rover, and the other is named Fido. He isn't very imaginative.
oooh..I love it
My new son....

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I work directly for the king and queen. I do as they say or I become punished. In exchange I am fed and given housing.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

setting.name: Coast
setting.description: The coast seems to stretch on for miles in either direction.  The ocean itself has receded some and the tide has not yet rolled in.  The water laps half-heartedly at the sand and the glistening shades of seashells dot the wet sand.  All around the sand gleams a shade of white.
setting.background: This seashore is the pride and joy of the nearest town.  It's kept immaculately clean and the white sand is something that is readily boasted about.

agent_personas: I live near the docks on the edge of the city.  I steal food from cargo boxes that are loaded into ships at night.  Sometimes rats from strange lands come off ships that come to the dock.
I am a bat king. I command all bats and they do my bidding. I live in the highest part of the cave and defeat all that challenge me. I eat fruit and smaller bats.

setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

I am waiting for the feast to begin, rat.
Oh, right right. Well, I'm just hoping I can get down to the village in time to speak some plague around with my fleas ya know. Hey you think I could stick around a bit and have a bite to eat?
