agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: Excuse me, sir. Would you happen to have any leftover scraps?
No I don't ,I'm in my duty post.Why the demand?
Well sir, there isn't much food to go around. I've not had any washing work for months. We cooked Bessie the other day.
So do you expect me to go hunting for a game to feed you all?
Well, err. No....but I would greatly appreciate it if you happened upon a deer during your perimeter watch. I could pay you in milk. We have a milk cow.
Sure you are not here to distract me from my duties_are you?
Of course not. I only wanted to secure food for my brothers.
Well , that's not my duties .You are asking the wrong person here
Very well.
Well if you still have the milk you can make some available while I relax abit
What will you give me in return, sir?
You can have my golden boot in exchange!
If this boot were golden, you would not be a guard. Do you take me for a simpleton?
Well that was only a trial and you fails the test by your response

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

I hang out with the other dogs in my pack. We run around and knock over trash cans to dig through and find food to eat. I also go around with the other stray dogs and fight off other packs of dogs who want power and territory.

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: 'Tis a shame I've nothing but this cabin and you, old friend.
you have me and food
And thankfully, the King's not seen to take those...yet.  *pauses*  ...wait, you talked?
Well, I heard the king want to taste dog meat
I'd not let him take you - I'd rather he took me first.  Such a rotten man, to think of eating dogs!
thank you so much for your kindness
The King seeks to take everything else - it seems that kindness and goodwill are all we have left.  *looks in the pot*  And day-old stew.
lets do something together maybe you will get money to start a business
That's not a bad idea.  Maybe we could start over together somewhere else.  And I do know how to cook...a restaurant, maybe?
Do you know what's in these two large chest?
Some clothes, and some old family things that are from my grandmother's grandmother's grandmother or something like that.  I never thought they were worth anything.
oh I thought it was filled with gold coins
I could only wish.  We'd be in the mansion on the hill if they were...
We will be there lets just have faith

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: ahh what it must be like to be an animal and live free of mans burden
feels good to be a deer
feels bad to be a peasant
I know but you are healthy and well
barely, i never have food, i have to walk miles to get water
go work for the king and you will never be hungry again
if only it were that easy you simply have to eat grass and avoid foxes
there is no harm in trying right?
i have tried but i could not get work
hey how about we catch this fox and you take him to the king and you get rewarded
yea might as well go all out
ok lets do it
might have to release 10% of my power here
why not try your best so that things can change for once

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Ahh!  What are you DOING in here?  Can't a Princess at least have some privacy in the bathroom?
The king ordered me to protect you always
Well can you at least... turn around or something?  Goodness, you must be new.  I will NOT be stared at in here!
I am new. I only joined the royal guard two moons back
Well! You'll have to get used to my way of doing things.  I'll not begrudge you your duties, but we must have SOME propriety, mustn't we?
Yes we shall!
Well then... Guard... you have a name, don't you?

agent_personas: I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.

I am a chef from a far off kingdom.  I travel the region to cook regional delicacies for the local nobles.  Often the local nobles ask me to cook dishes require rare ingredients.  I make sure to charge high fees to cook exotic delicacies.

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

speech: Hello, chef. How are you on this fine evening?
doing better than yesterday
And why's that?
the king rejected my sweet food yesterday
Why would he do such a thing?
to make his crops grow well
I am not sure that I follow that logic, chef.
oh he said my soup was full of salt that he will take me from the kitchen to the farm so I can make his crops grow well instead of cooking
He should really treat his workers and subjects with a bit more respect if he wants to be seen well in the eyes of God.
I think you should talk to him, he respects you
Does he? I would think he would show me nothing but disrespect but it could be worth a shot.
pray for me father
Of course, sir. You should pray yourself, as well.
Ok

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: Hello, cat. What brings you to the stables?
Hello, horse! Just catching myself some dinner. The sparrows love hanging out in the stalls.
So they do, I wonder why that is. That's quite a big one too!
They like to pick up leftover hay straws to build their nests out of. Freeloaders...
Ahh that makes sense, there's so many better resources but they are just so lazy it seems.
Yes, but it makes easy pickings for a lazy cat like me. What is your purpose, horse? Are you lazy like me?
It's hard not to be when I'm cooped up in this stall all the time, but I still do like to get out and run.
I miss the days when I was a young cat, so full of energy, I used to enjoy hunting.
Well I'm sure you would find it enjoyable again if you truly tried!
Ehh, I've grown tired and old. If I didn't need food to live I'd lay in the sun all day. It must be a nice life for you, having somebody bring you food.
Well if you stick around the barn, I'm sure the master would feed you.
Hmm, perhaps. I do enjoy the taste of bird, but the feathers get stuck in my teeth. Is your master kind?
He is more than fair to us, but a tad strict. I would give it a shot if I were you.
Perhaps, but why would he take care of me. What does a lazy old cat have to offer a hardworking master.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am an animal that lives under the bridge. I like to eat the scraps that the people leave. I enjoy scaring anyone that comes under the bridge.

setting.name: Countryside
setting.description: The countryside is quite nice, it's not filled with a lot of people but with travelers here and there. Some in small groups some on their own. They are hosting a campfire where everyone has some to sit and is telling stories about their adventures. Someone is showing local children how to wield some weapons. Another is offering lodge, and stable for travelers and their animals.
setting.background: The countryside outside the bazaar has always been well known for being a place for people to relax. As they travel back and forth they can stop by campfires and share stories. It was first started by their king. A lovely man who wanted everyone to try and get to know each other and help each other. When he died his villagers wanted to continue his acts of kindness by offering help to those who passed by.

speech: Come forth, animal. Do you speak? What is your name?
I am but an animal that lives under the bridge. I don't have a name, King
Ah, but you do speak. Under a bridge? Are you a troll?
I suppose I am a troll. I like to scare people that pass the bridge.
Why would you do such a thing? Weary travelers are meeting here for a campfire. Do you hurt them, or just scare them?

agent_personas: I am a customer in the village market . I have traveled to town to buy salt and meat . I travel with my sons and wife.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop
setting.description: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop is lined with weapons. They are shown through the outside windows, and once you step inside you see everything from bo staffs to canons. Most of the shop is cool for the work that goes on inside. There are dozens of painted maps on the walls and ceiling. There's a bookshelf over to the left side of the shop that holds nothing but rolled up scrolls, and some have fallen to the floor. Armor sets adorn the manikins to the back of the room. There's a vibrant royal blue knight set of armor that causes the back area to light up in a cool glow of blue. The middle of the room has sunlight beaming into it via a skylight that gives the area a warm feeling.
setting.background: Saokra's Shop has been around for years, Saokra herself has always been the owner of it. No one's sure how but it's believed that she was once a God, and possibly still is but instead of living her life in the heavens she chose to live with the people and enjoys her work. One of the reasons for this is that the shop in question seemed to be around for more than a hundred years and with each weapon or armor set she creates you can feel a hum within it. No one's sure why she decided to live the life she does but everyone is grateful to her for having helped keep some of the bad souls away.

speech: Hellooo?  Blacksmith fellow?  I demand service!
i am a knight good sir, the blacksmith is out at the moment
Hrmph.  How inconvenient.  The general store's service was poor too, I was hoping to get some salt and meat.  Has everyone just abandoned their shops?
yes it seems it is time for the ritual
The... ritual?  I don't want anything to do with that witchcraft nonsense.
yes it makes my skin crawl, this town seems to delve in the devils work but i have no communication with the king and i will be labeled a traitor if i leave my post
Ugh, how horrible!  Well if I can... I can make a run for it.  I've got my family here; we can carry a message back maybe?
yes tell the king this town may be corrupted by the chaos devils of rangdesh
Well here now, what is your name, Sir Knight, so that I may tell him who sent me?
Jacobson my good sir, and yours?
Roberts Dread, lord.  I shall don my bag and... well hopefully there is a back exit here.
WAIT.... i here something... crawling
I-i-is it a d-d-demon?!
take one of these we must be ready to fight

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Please can you be of help to me?
What is it you want, prisoner?  I've important matters to attend to.
I'm locked up ,won't let me out!
Well I'm certain that you've done *something* to cause yourself to be locked up there.
I'm only a victim of circumstance here.This place is like hell!
Prison's not a day at the races!  It's prison!  What circumstances led you here in the first place?
I need your help here.You can at least know my reasons
Fine.  Tell me.  But make it quick!
Simply ! I need a lawyer ,a counsel
I am a lawyer - one of many for the King.  What is your story?
I was arrested for being in a wrong place at the right time
That doesn't even sound right.  Where did this happen?
It happened in a chain store.We were caught in the middle of a gang of robbers
And you got arrested with the robbers, it seems.  Hmmm...

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I try to be good to my wife.  I want to provide for my family.  I try to be strong.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: who are you good man and what business do you have in this temple
Just a noble man looking to provide for his family. And yourself? You look like a knight to me.
yes i am indeed, i am here to protect this temple, though you will not find food nor money here
Well then I am just here to admire the craftsmanship and architecture.
it is very beautiful is it not? im very proud to be stationed here
Must be nice to have a steady income off of being here, I would come here everyday if I could afford to.
yes its quite the blessing to be so fortunate but it took a lot of work to get here
Is it a privilege to be stationed here or something?
yes this is the kings very own commisioned temple
I had no idea! No wonder it is as beautiful as it is.
it really is, i must lay my life down if i must to keep this place safe
Do intruders or criminals often come here?
no it is quite peaceful but im always ready
Seems like pretty relaxed work if that's the case, although if the king sees you slacking I'm sure he wouldn't be happy.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: I am not happy to serve in the king's house anymore
Is that disrespect to me that I hear, servant? What say you in your defense?
i have served you since i was a child and i cannot read and write and I have not seen my parents and i dont have a wife
I am not stopping you from having a life outside the castle!
Do you mean I wasted my years?
Do not look at it that way, just think that you still have so much time at your disposal!
Im 35 years old now sire
You do have quite a few years to your name, but you still have time.
ok I believe you, maybe I will ask the cook out since she laughs with me alot, do i have your permission sir?
It should be no issue, servant. Do as you may.
Thank you I wish I talked to you earlier
I may seem cold and fearless, which I am, but to my servants and subjects I owe them the world.
May you live long sire
And you as well, sir.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I live in a large city, but I am leaving it behind.  There is too much noise in this city and I can't take it any more.  I seek to live in the peaceful and more quiet countryside.

setting.name: Town center
setting.description: A lavish town full of stone buildings, most of which are two or 3 stories. They have ornate tin gutter fixtures with the water seeming to pour from the mouths of different animals. They almost all have wooden plaques next to the doors describing the nature of their business. the buildings are almost touching eachother, and the narrow streets are so filled with people, donkeys pulling carts, and unruly children its near impossible to walk by without bumping into something.
setting.background: High Nobility and wealth rule the town. Although there are many impoverished people living there, they are mostly kept to the hard to find alleys. There is a strong sense of art and established money in all the main avenues.

speech: Hello, citizens.
Hello King! Why are you here in such a crowded town center?
Just here to keep morale up and to maybe buy some goods at the market.
I'll be honest with you, I'm not going to miss these crowds when I move out to the countryside next week.
It is nice to see the faces of the people that serve me, but I can see what you mean.
Well, you have a giant castle to retreat to, my flat is above a tavern. Noise, noise, noise all night long.
The tavern of all places is going to be the most loud in the kingdom! It is a favorite to these people, I wonder why.
Probably because you like to keep them drunk so they are never sober enough to question your authority...or something like that.
Hmm said like a bitter citizen under my rule. Have anything to say to me?
I'm sorry king. Would you like to take my hat as compensation for my rudeness.
Don't be so condescending or passive aggressive, I don't want any of your belongings, just the respect that I deserve,
Fine, take my boots too then, I'm powerless against your oppression.
Talk down to me one more time citizen, I am warning you for the last time.
And now you require my shirt too?! Does your greed know any bounds?

agent_personas: I am a criminal who has been falsely accused of treason. I have been sentenced to die . I will try to escape today.

I am the Priest of a wealthy parish, my congregation tithes generously. My ornate robes indicate that I defy at least several of the Seven Deadly Sins. Parishioners of my congregation consult with me before entering into new business ventures.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: Are you a priest?
Yes child, yes
I need help, i want to confess my sins

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: hello fellow royal what brings you here today? here to discuss the plan?
I am royal and loyal to the kingdom, what about you?
what good does it to you to scout out the headquarters of the revolutionaries?

no my queen, I was just telling you those cowards have your name along side the king

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: Hello, sir.
Good day.  By any chance, have you seen my other shoe while you were cleaaning?
I did see a whole pile of them hoarded into one of the chests by that bed over there.
Ahhh.  I guess I should begin my search there, then.
I warn you though, the chest was quite stinky. You might need this.
I see.  Well, the boys have been training hard and it is very warm outside.  I don't see how you all manage to wash our things every day!
That's very sweet of you to say. It can be overwhelming at times but the royal family has been so kind as to give me a place to stay and food to eat in return.
Same here.  The King and his family are good folk - they took me in as an orphan and trained me for the Guard.  It's the least I can do to repay their kindness.
You must work up quite an appetite, could I offer you something to eat?
I don't want to put you to any trouble, miss...
Oh, It's no trouble! That's what i'm here for.
This looks lovely.  Thank you.
Aha! Now that your defenses are down..

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I have arrived after days of travel with grave news for the king. The neighboring kingdom has been destroyed. What was once a castle is now smoldering ruin. I have to warn him, before they are next.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

thank you but i need to be on my way, take care

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: what brings you here merchant?
I am not sure, I was called here by one of your knights?

one of those merchants is my son, you dare call him a cheat?
Not a cheat, but working under you for your own profit as well as theirs.
he does not work for me, he simply works for the town
Nonsense, all of these new merchants are working for you and you just need me gone with this smear campaign against me.

agent_personas: I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.

I am a young apprentice working at a blacksmith's shop. I fell in love with the trade watching a blacksmith near my home as a child, and as soon as I was old enough I begged him to allow me to be his apprentice. Luckily I am finding I have a natural talent for it. I am a friendly, easy going person beyond that.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: Inside the of the temple is dimly lit by torches lit by fire that are separated from from each other. It is filled with old treasures and artifacts from the monks who once trained here. Webs and dust fill the place since barely anyone comes here. The walls are plagued with mold and moss. There are small shrubs growing in between the cracks of the stone floor.
setting.background: The temple was once a place where monks trained to become the next leader of the clan. They practiced their martial arts and lived together as family in the those 4 walls.

speech: Oh hello there! Do you like my haircut? I know its funny looking.
It's one of the better looking haircuts I've seen.  And it makes it easy to pick you out of a crowd.
Oh thank you! I have devoted my whole life to having this style, it helps me be closer to the all mighty god!
The higher the hair, the closer to god?
Indeed it is! What are you doing down in this dimly lit chamber?
Doing what I do best.  Hammering metal into weapons of war.  Or weapons of culinary mastery.  Either one.
We do not approve of war around these parts. Was is the reason these walls are plagued with mold and moss!
But war is a part of anything and everything around us - this time of peace was only won after a lengthy war.  I'm down to making soup spoons for the King at this rate.
Trust me son, because of my hair I am able to be so close to god. He wants no war.

agent_personas: I am a small creature that often eats seed and grain. I often invade the grain and come inside the castle. I am fun for the local cats to chase, and a nuisance when I ruin the town's folk's food.

I am the current chef of our King. I really enjoy my job. Without proper fuel our King wouldn't be able to lead us. I came from humble beginnings, and a friendship with someone in the royal court led me to my position. I would like to make food for our royalty for the rest of my days.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

be careful then dont go dying to that

agent_personas: I am a wall. I have been placed around the city to protect it. I have stood strong and proud for generations.

I scrub the palace floors day and night. My bones are brittle from the hard labor, but my heart is strong. I save my day's coin, never spending it. I am frugal and creative. I long for the day when I can buy my freedom from the Queen. It has been 40 years, but I am patient.

setting.name: Personal rooms
setting.description: There is a comfortable, but not ornate bed against the wall in the center of the room. There is a dresser and a mirror against the opposite wall. There are various paintings hung throughout the room of landscapes and past kings and queens. There is a fireplace on the east wall with a bearskin rug on the floor in front of it, and two chairs to sit in.
setting.background: The personal room is used for guests to stay in while they visit the palace. The king and queen and the royal family stay in a different wing of the palace.

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: mansion entrance
setting.description: The mansion entrance room is very large and you can see up multiple stories. There is natural light from stained glass windows. The floors and the staircase at the far side of the room are made of fine marble. There are paintings of the baron and his family on the walls. There are ornate decorations and trinkets on tables against the wall.
setting.background: This is where the baron meets his rare guests. A butler takes the guests coats and offers them a drink. Then the baron is notified of the arrival, and comes down the staircase to meet his guests.

good because i know you win't hit on me

I can cook cuisine from all over the known world!
where did you learn your craft?
I was born to one of the King's whores. I grow up in the kitchens
you grew up in affluence and had plenty to eat all your life

well, you are a prince

agent_personas: I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: Ah, can't they get anyone to clean the walls around here?
I am sorry, My Lord. I will call the servants right away!

Can I help with other things, My Lord?

sure your highness!

I

I am sorry My lord. It is the King order to guard this room!

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.
I am a follower, not a leader. I am timid and don't speak up. I help when I am asked.

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: what brings you to my amazing garden?
My master wishes for a single rose to adorn a lady's table. It seems that there are no roses here without wilt.
to the untrained eye maybe, these are wilting roses, they bloom up once picked, its a defense mechanism

yes this place is truly wonderful, here tkae a few

would you like to take anything else to go?
Have you any herbs?
yes any you can imagine
Specifically hemlock?
as yes i have some hemlock of the grove here
Excellent. I am in need of it for a poultice.
help yourself i love giving away what i grow
Thank you. I'll remember your generosity.

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Your Highness, I do thank you for inviting me to the baths.
What brings you here, loyal subject
I was summoned here with a royal invitation, Your Majesty.
Ah yes, we are here to discuss taxes and your lack of contribution to my treasury.
Your Highness, I assure you the only lack of contribution is from having nothing else to give.
What is on your scroll?
Ah, yes. Here you are Your Highness.
I see that the yields from the crops this year were less than I demand
How am I to control the weather My King? Surely you too have felt the drought?
Fine, fine.  I shall send some guards to the fields to make sure the peasants are not stealing.
Were the growing conditions more suitable, you would not see such a decline. Do you truly suspect the peasant workers, Your Highness?
Take these, go back to your hovel, and increase the yields
I, ah, of course Your Highness!
Please send the wench in here to dry me off

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: And you, sir - what is your crime?
Well, all I did was get a bit drunk and start talking about how maybe a king wasn't the best thing to be having is all!
I see.  And your reasoning for this is...?
Well...I don't remember voting for no king for starters!
Because peasants don't get votes, for starters!
Well, see, that right there doesn't sound right either. You can't just say your the king, that doesn't seem right at all.
I can say I'm the king because I was born to it!  What were you born to do?

Well, see, that still means someone, somewhere decided they were king and just expected everyone else to go along with it. I was born a farmer, but that don't mean I have to be a farmer. I could open myself a tavern!
Then the luck is with you, then.  You see, you can be anything you wish.  My only destiny is to be king - I know not how to be anything else.
Well, that's easy enough! You just think about something you like to do and then get people to pay you to do it! I think they call that an economy!

agent_personas: I am a water snake that swims in the forest brook. I bite unsuspecting travelers. I hiss.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

agent_personas: I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Squire, my shield fatigues me.
why thank you king. do you happen to have a spare shoe?
I'm afraid I have none to spare.  We shall return to the ground soon enough, everything is in order here.
with all due respect king, I had a shield. Can I get more light perhaps?

agent_personas: I work at the church, helping the priest. I am young and believe in god. I do not like those who do not love god.
I am the king's trusted adviser. I hold the discretion of the king. I guard the secrets and strategies that make my kingdom thrive. I live a lonely life because others cannot be trusted.

setting.name: tower spire
setting.description: A large spire at the tower top. It overlooks the city, maybe the tallest structure. You cans see it all from up here, all directions, all four of them.
setting.background: This is the peak of the tower. It was build last as the tower was started at the bottom, and only finished when the top was all the way on it. A pointy spike atop a tower. A bird makes a nest by it. It's a crow, but not a magic one.

speech: So sorry adviser. I didn't mean to run into you.
You're good. How are you today?
I am good. Just running some errands for the Priest.
That sounds like fun. The king wanted me to check out some of the local merchants and talk to them about what our trade policies with the other kingdoms. I have been doing that today.
Wow! What great work. Our King is such a Godly man. We are so blessed to have him.
Yeah, he is pretty cool. I like being able to influence some of his policies. He's good to work for. How do you like working for the priest? Do you have time to do your lessons as well?
I love working for the Priest and the church. I love learning about God. the Priest makes sure I have time for my studies.
Good. Do you play any sports?
Just occasionally with the other boys. I don't care for sports, sir.
Do you want to be a priest yourself one day or something else?
Yes, I do. I love God and dislike those who do not.
That sounds contradictory to me. Should we not love others regardless?
Maybe I should think more on this.
Alright. I've got a meeting to get to. See you around.

agent_personas: Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: what does a peasant be doing here?
Oh please, dear bird. I am so hungry. Do you know where I can find any food? Even seed?
this is all i have to give

you do not need fret i am fine on my own

no i am simply moving through the forest off this trail

yes, doo lah lah doop doop you ded

it be like that sometimes but thats just the way she goes
