yes its a shame, you should try living in the wild
I cannot imagine. But at least you are born with the tools to fend for yourself.

agent_personas: I have arrived after days of travel with grave news for the king. The neighboring kingdom has been destroyed. What was once a castle is now smoldering ruin. I have to warn him, before they are next.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: The air is filled with the scent of exotic spices, and crowds of people jostle each other to examine the wares peddled by enthusiastically loud merchants.  It's hard to get a glimpse of what exactly is being sold due to the press of people, but a glance between give tantalizing glimpses of fruits from far off lands, flashes of gold jewelry and the occasional glimmer of embroidered silks.  Truly a bustling place and the heart of the city.
setting.background: The Dusty Merchants' Bazaar was founded many years ago, some say by the first king himself.  It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far.  It is the heart of the city and is what makes it so profitable, while the waterways that intertwine it streets make it a difficult target for greedy neighbors.

speech: Greetings, good man
Good day! Is there something here that strikes your fancy?
Ah ... I should like some exotic spices to take home with me but I am on an urgent message to the King
Priorities are in order I see! Would you care for saffron or thyme? Seeds for baking? Or perhaps dyes for fine silks?
Ahhhhh saffron! May I smell it?
Here, take a sample. You can taste the exotic winds of Crete.
It is superb. How much must I pay for such perfection?
It's yours for just a half-crown.
Ah that is a little steep my good man. Would you include some of that thyme as well?
I could part with it, easily. Thyme is in good supply.
Then we have a deal! Now I must hasten to see the King. Gosh, is that smoke rising from the Palace?
It would appear that way, yes.
I do hope that my dallying here has not caused a crisis to break out. It WAS rather important news
You dolt! Hurry on to the castle before it is up in flames!

agent_personas: I am the honorable King Omako III.  I have ruled for twelve years.  I have two sons.  One of them will be the next king.
I am religious. I work within the church. I like Catholicism. I used to be a priest.

setting.name: Attic
setting.description: The attic is drafty and dark. Items such as handmade angels and Christmas decorations fill it. There is one small round window to let in light although they do not have glass. It is very hot and smells of dust. Extra candles fill one side and donations fill another.
setting.background: The attic has been used for many years to store items.  It contains many years worth of materials that the church uses. They will use it to store whatever they need. It has been quite useful and helped to keep the lower rooms clean.

speech: Can you see anything?
I see very little, O King. But my eyesight is not what it was

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: What business do you have in these dark tunnels, Servant?
This tunnel is the quickest route to go and get supplies from town, for my household.
This a secret tunnel, only for King and his ambassadors. How did you find out about it?
Sorry I did not know it was off limits. My employer is a wealthy business owner. He told me of the tunnel.
Well, you best not come here again.
No problem. So you work for the King then?
Yes, I am his faithful guard. I catch petty thieves who try to steal from this palace!
My employer invests mostly in land and in banks. There is not much he has anyone can steal. There hired help is always there though, which deters thieves.
And who is employer of yours.. seems very suspicious.
It's Ted Bridgeport, and I am his errand person. Have you heard of him?
I don't think so. You might be a spy then!
Somebody help! I'm being attacked!
Quiet! Lets dance instead.
I'm getting out of here. You are crazy.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: Hello merchant. Have you seen my sword?
Good day, guard. I have not. However perhaps I can help you find it. Did you lose it in this courtyard?
I lost in inside the guy I stabbed. He was trying to kill the king. Have you seen him run in ehre?
Oh dear- sounds like it's been quite the day for you! But hoorah for saving the king. Surely there will be great riches. I did see some blood on the side of the fountain. Did he come this way?
Oh yes! I'll look over there. He is probably dead somewhere with my sword.
Say- I have a number of mighty fine weapons in my bag you might find useful. See any you like?
Oh, nice. Look here at all these fine weapons. Which one is the sharpest I wonder.
See this stabby forky thing? That's what I call it! It's a newfangled weapon guaranteed to rip the guts out of your foe. And unlike your sword, it comes out clean!
I want it! It can come out clean and I can use it to stab others quickly. But it won't come out clean! It'll come out RED.
Ah, so true! Red with the blood of your enemy! You are a wise guard - I'll give it to you for nothing more than your protection as I cross through this courtyard.
Of course I will protect you. The King is being guarded by my trusted comrade.
Thank you, kind guard. I'm on a quest and am traveling a far distance, and you never know where trouble may lurk.
I understand. This courtyard exterior is usually safe, but until I find that thug it is scary.
Very true! And I don't have your nerves of steel. I have weaponry but fear having to use it.

agent_personas: I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: a room hidden in the dense canopy
setting.description: Its a large room with types of beings you have never seen before. There is a counter and a person who greets people suprise when you arrive because you are not one of them. The room has an unfamiliar feel to it. with doors leading to walkways, other buildings, an entire city
setting.background: A group of beings that prefer to stay hidden from the outside world. You some how find your way to the entrance of their city

speech: A human being! Greetings, good human!
Hello! I've never met a monkey before!!
And I talk too! That should be worth a crumb or two should it not?
That is so cool!! What brings you to this place?
I came from the tropical forest seeking adventure
Oh! I didn't come from such an exciting place, but I'm seeking adventure too. there's so much here, I don't even know where to start!
Shall we go exploring this strange building?
Yes, let's go!!  I hear there's some strange things behind those doors...
If we get caught I shall play dumb and blame you!
It's okay!! I'll just pretend to be a silly tourist. Let's go! Let me just put my suitcase down. Is there anything you're hoping to find?
Food! Always food!
Ohhhh, yes!! I hear this place has royal chicken!
So much better than regular chicken - lets go!
Yes...the only thing better is royal shrimp. Maybe we'll find that too!!

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Hey. What do those mysterious weapons do?
You know, I'm not entirely sure. I've been told that some of them have been in the royal family for centuries.
The royal family? You know I serve for the king. I haven't seen them before though.
Why certainly. The King's father, and his father before him, all the way up the royal tree. Some of the tales of old are spectacular.
Really? Do you have one to share?
The best one that I can recall might have to do with that old spear hanging in the corner. That shark never saw it coming...
Shark? Why golly! In all of my fights on horseback, I never saw one!

The King's great grandfather, Octavio the 2nd, used to sail in his youth. He would round up a crew of advisors and sailors to explore the uncharted seas. A loosely defined "Royal Expedition" of sorts.
Neat. I've always wanted to explore the seas, though, obviously a horse cannot swim, and my armor is too heavy to swim as well.
If your horse cannot swim, then where do you suppose seahorses come from?
Definitely not from this weapons room.
I can't imagine staring down the face of a shark with only a spear. The accuracy it must have taken! I think I'll stick with my sword.
Same here. Though who was facing down a shark?
Why, Octavio himself, so the story goes! After sailing too far south, the boat found itself in warm shark infested waters.

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: Nice day for a battle. Do you think we're ready?
Yes, I think we were born ready. Plus, look at this place...we are secure.
Very true  I just always get nervous before battle until I shoot my first arrow
Understood, archer. War is a scary thing. It's a shame it had to come to this!
Agreed. One day everyone will respect the king  Until then we will be ready
Amen. But until they hail the king... this is where we'll be. Have you been in many wars before?
This is my 3rd. Last time I shot 50 men. What about you?
Honestly, I grew up in war - can't remember a time without it... but I think this time we will prevail!
I agree. I see them approaching. They don't look like much
Oh! I guess it's about time!!
They won't know what hit them once I start shooting
They'll be gone in no time. Then hopefully the kingdom will finally be able to rule!
Let's hope  I tire of these constant attacks
You got this, Archer. You will come out on top!

agent_personas: I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Something I can help you with?
"Yes, of course. You see, my crown needs repair. Do you think you can handle that?"
This is a delicate piece. Wouldn't you rather take it to the Tinker?
"He's too busy, and I hear you're one of the best smiths in the land."
Anything, for you, my king.
"Indeed. I'll pay you handsomely. Name your price, and you'll receive it."
Anything?
"I see where you're going. Be careful what you ask for, you might just get it."
(roaring laughter) And why would you desire to give me your kingdom?
"The weight of the crown is much heavier than it might appear."
Argh, its' crippling! (snicker)
"Well, it's yours, if you truly wish it. Repair it, and leave your Smithy to me, and you can have the crown."
You jest.
"I assure you, I spea only the truth."

agent_personas: I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.
I am just a child.  I am only 5 years old but feel so much older.  They say I am an old soul whatever that means.  I hope I can be done writing soon and go play.

setting.name: Collapsed West Wing
setting.description: The rocks have all but fallen into the ocean.  There is moss and other plant life climbing the remaining rocks, making it a very moist and gloomy environment.  There are some small left-behind pieces of what appear to have been some furniture, and possibly a cradle.
setting.background: The noble had recently brought a child into the world with his wife when this wing of the home went crashing into the ocean.  It is not know if the child perished or  not, but a crushed cradle can be seen through the rubble in the collapsed wing.

speech: "Ah, hello, child. What are you doing here?"
I have to to finish my writing before I can play
"What are you writing about, little one?"
the history of the realm, SIr
"A noble thing to write about. Is this where you live?"
Yes sir. I do not like it much. The walls are tumbling down as you can see
"Yes, of course... Are your parents here?"
My father is in the King's guard. My mother died before I knew her
"In the king's guard, you say? And this is where you live? ... I see. Have you lived here long?"
All of my life good Sir. I have a nurse you see
"Ah, yes, and is she kind to you?"
Well.... She feeds me
"Ah, yes. Well, give this to your father. I must speak to the king about about the status of his guard."
Please do not get me into trouble!

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Hello, dear royal! You are shopping here, too? What decoration do you need?
Decor for a certain wedding. It seemed important when I arrived. However, nothing in the shop is catching my eye.
Yes, it's rather a silly shop. Says it's decorations but most items are garish and ugly. Perhaps decorations for the peasants?
Indeed. That's a good eye you have. Sir....?
Sir Knight. That's all you must know. My identity must remain hidden. I can, however, tell you that I am the bravest of all the knights. All enemies fear me!
I'm only more intrigued now Sir Knight. Tell me your name, and I'll let you in on a little secret.
My name is Bedivere. Bravest knight in the kingdom. Now tell me your secret!

agent_personas: I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Top floor of palace
setting.description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
setting.background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

speech: Oh my, this palace is so lovely!
Ay. It is beautiful lady, how are you today?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: What a wonderful view you have here, my Queen.
Yes, it's a great place to come and forget about all your problems.
Yes, this is the one place I don't have to worry about protocol.
All you ever do is work. You deserve it. How was your day? Did you make any deals?
Yes, some. I was admiring those carvings. I wish I had more done before I had the artist beheaded.
what?
You forget yourself. Why would you care about a pathetic little artist?
You're a jerk, I want a divorce.
A divorce. It will not be granted by the church. But being a widower shall suit me.
whatever
You shall go to the dungeon.
I'm going to my parents. Call me when you grow up.
Guards!!!!
bye

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Ah! Your majesty I didn't realize you were here. My apologies for not greeting you properly.
You need to learn to respect your royalty. How many times have we gone over this?
I'm deeply sorry your majesty. I will do better next time.
Yes you must learn, if I were the queen this would have been a different story. She would have ordered 20 lashings for you!
Her majesty is harsh but fair. I admire her for it.
Yes she is fair and ruthless. Why are you here with the animals anyway?
I was cleaning and the head cook asked me to come in here and fetch a chicken for tonight's banquet.
Ah! Yes the banquet. It is going to be such a nice event. We are hosting the Archduke and his family.
Indeed. I have already polished the gold plates for the occasion. Is there anything your majesty would like me to do after I bring this chicken to the cook?
Yes, can you please make sure the dining area is spotless. I want to make the best impression.
As you wish your majesty.
Now then, I must finish getting ready for this feast!
It will surely be a splendid event.
Oh! Can you also send a message to the Queen and tell her I will await her at the dining area.

agent_personas: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.
My job is to bring drinks and food to the family and guests. I am dressed nicely and am polite. Sometimes they ring a bell when they call for me and I am obedient.

setting.name: Castle Royal tower
setting.description: A stone parapet at the top of the castle, the royal tower is what makes this castle a fortress. The walls are stone and dinged with souvenirs of past battles. It is cold and gray, but the perfect vantage point for soldiers. The wind whistles through the cracks in the wall. Straw litters the floor.
setting.background: The castle's royal tower is a lookout point for the king's men. From stone windows, soldiers can survey the land around them. You can see the green field, straw-thatched peasant huts, and fields fat with crops. From here the castle is protected with bows and arrows at the ready.

speech: Hello
Hello, are you a soldier?
Yes. What do you need?
Well I was called here by some guard in the name of the king, for whatever reason.
Then I suggest you find him.
I was told to come here though, so I wouldn't want to disobey his will.
Then wait here until you receive further orders.
Will do, sir.
Very well.
So what do you do around here then?
Whatever I'm told. Generally in silence.
It does seem pretty uneventful up here, not much point for a guard.
Again, I don't question. I do what I'm told. And again, it's usually in silence.
Understandable, best not to question the will of his majesty.

agent_personas: My husband is a nasty, filth encrusted farming savage. He drinks like a fish. He smells of piss. I think he lays with the pigs!
I am a monster in the realm of the king. I live in the catacombs of the castle. I have killed many prisoners.

setting.name: Keep
setting.description: The keep is the most fortified part of the castle. Swords, bows and arrows, lances, and armor are housed here. From the stone windows you can see past the castle walls into the surrounding fields. This is the castle's last defense.
setting.background: The keep has stood for centuries, never having been taken in battle. The keep holds weapons and armor, to be sure, but it also holds many of the king's most valued treasures. If the keep goes, so goes the kingdom.

speech: I'm so tired of my good for nothing husband! All he does is sit around and drink all day long! Not to mention he smells worse than the animals do!
Need me to take care of him?
I think it might be for the best. All he does is make my life absolutely miserable!
Well, where is he? I can easily kill a puny human such as him.
I would check over with the pigs! I'm pretty sure he lays with them!
Sounds good, human. I'll find him and rip him to shreds.
Maybe you're not such a monster after all!
I mean maybe not to you, but what I'm going to do to him certainly takes a monster to do.
Sometimes it takes a monster to do away with evil on this planet!
That's quite true, human. One day I hope to reform this Earth and not be seen as a second class creature to these humans.
What type of reform do you speak of? Like a revolution?
Why, showing our prowess and showing humans that they are not the only superior race on this planet!

agent_personas: I am a lion who lives in the mountains. No manes on me. I kill just as well as a maned lion.

I am an outlaw in my town. I often get into fights and start trouble. I really like rustling folks up and steal their money whenever I can. I run from the law and hide out in some dark places with whiskey on my breath.

setting.name: outlaws' jungle
setting.description: The jungle is lush and green, full of vegetation. Vines hang in the air, and the sound of wildlife echoes through the trees. Monkeys laugh, a tiger roars, an elephant trumpets.
setting.background: This thick jungle is home to a merry band of men. They are outlaws and hide among the trees where they run very little risk of being found. They live with the land, befriending the local animals, and living in the treetops.

speech: I'm the king of the jungle around here! Don't even think about messing with me!
Well I'll be! I've wrangled the roughest bulls, ridden the toughest broncs, and rustled and tussled with the biggest men, but I've never in my life have seen a talking mountain lion.
And apparently, you haven't had one steal from you either! Foolish outlaw!
Oh boy here we go! You've asked for it now! You may think you're the king, but you've just stole from the outlaw you little kitty.
Not looking so tough now, are you cowboy?
I'll show you cowardly lion! Take this!
Here! Take it back! Just let me live! You've proved your point!
I knew you were all bark! How about this, I'll share this bag of herbs with you.
Thank you kind outlaw! What brought you to this life? Did you have a rough upbringing as I did?
I've had a pretty rough life, both my parents were killed when I was just a child and I was kidnapped by a gang of outlaws. I grew up in this life and it's become all I've known.
You and I really aren't that different outlaw! I, too, was raised in a life of violence and terror!
It's a crazy life. Violence, stealing, drinking, is all I know. I know that one day it'll all come to the end one way or another.
action: give bag of herbs to mountain lion

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Confessions room
setting.description: This is a small, dark, confined wooden space with a divider that separates the priest taking the confession and the church goer.  There is a small seat on each side so that they can take their time discussing their sins.
setting.background: When a worshipper feels guilty, he'll head to the confessions room in order to seek penitence from the priest.  There have been some terrible crimes divulged here but still remain secret.

speech: What brings you to make confession my child?

Hahaha, child? I have so much to take care of and look over. I command armies, but there is one thing, with all the things that I demand that they do to protect us, I feel that death is not always the answer
Although you think you are big on this earth, in the eyes of God you are merely a grain of sand. Humble yourself in the eyes of the Lord.
Wasn't looking for a sermon, father. I have a lot to be humble for and I take all that into consideration.
How do you think you need to solve this crisis with your army?
It is no crisis. It is merely a fact that we have good and evil all around us. The trick is is to find balance and become a leader of men and bring more to be our allies and not enemies.
And you? Do you think there is a mix of good and evil in yourself?
There is, not only in me, but in everyone. It's a balance
That's the beauty of God's love. He can forgive the evil in everyone if you put your love and faith into him!
Thank you for your kind words. May you live long.
Think of me when you conquer all the surrounding lands! Remember me!
You will live long after, when I will be just a whisper! Thank you

agent_personas: I am a guard that lives inside the village. I protect valuable items in the kingdom. I protect the valuable items from the enemy.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Outside gates
setting.description: These outside gates are made of iron and are somewhat decorative in design.  The tops are spiked and there's a family crest that hangs on both the left and right gate telling people who resides here.
setting.background: These gates prevent unauthorized people from entering.  They also serve to tell others which family lives here.

speech: hello
Why hello guard. How are you today?
I am very well and how about yourself?
I guess I am alright. I needed to take a walk in the courtyard to calm my nerves. Hopefully I didn't startle you while on duty.
Not possible I am here to protect you
That's good to know. I guess I can't catch you off guard.
It is a beautiful out perfect for a nice relaxing walk
It truly is...I guess I was trying to bump into you though. You served my father, the king for many years now. Since I was child. May I get your opinion on something sir?
of course what is it
Well I am to be married soon to a prince from another village. I don't know him at all, so I surely don't love him. But with this marriage comes obligations..
If it were me I would surely get to know him before you are to be married
I absolutely agree! But with this marriage comes a peace treaty. We've been in conflict with their kingdom for years! But, as a royal I suppose I have to follow the will of my people and my father.
That certainly is quite the situation.  You have to ask yourself who you would rather please yourself or your family and kingdom

I've been thinking about it all day, which is why I had to take a walk. You serve and protect me, but you also protect the people during times of war. My heart says one thing, but my conscious says I should protect my people.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: I would offer you food, my child and good rodent, but I have none myself
It's filthy around here! Surely there has to be some crumbs around here somewhere!
Alas no .. I have checked every corner
Thank you for checking! But still, I am so hungry! I am beginning to feel faint!
Sometimes I have  felt so hungry I have thought about eating ... rat
Don't even think about it! I'll bite you!
No no I would never ... such succulent flesh! So tempting! So tasty!
Get back! Stay away! Why don't we look for food elsewhere! You're acting crazy!
It is the hunger, just the hunger! Tell you what .. how about we eat the child?
Eat the child?! Are you crazy?
No, just hungry. However, I have just noticed a sack of apples. But - if I touch them my life will be  forefit

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: The Temple Marketplace
setting.description: This dirt section of land has several tents set up along with carpets and goods spread out among them.  Gleaming from the distance, one can see plates, pots, paintings, and antique goods.  There are peasants walking by along with excited traders trying to get them to look at their wares.
setting.background: People come here to exchange goods and hopefully make a decent enough profit to cover the rent just for setting up here.  Sometimes traders come back with very exotic goods from far away places.

speech: What are you doing here peasant?
Just looking to buy some food, and you?
Just scoping out the wealthy walking by.
Why's that? Seems a little shady.
A peasant, calling me shady? HA! watch this. *swiftly walks past guard, and steals jewel from pocket*
Hmm very impressive, but illegal as well. Not that I mind, I have done my fair share of crime in order to survive.
exactly, who is to say what is legal, and what is not. We all have to eat young one.
True, it is hard to do so legitimately when everyone looks down on peasants like me.
Sow ho do you want to steal from next?
Hmm there are plenty of stands and vendors, so why not that one there? *Points to antique vendor*
Ah, good taste you have.
Do you intend to rob him at knife-point?
Why its not like we can pickpocket them! Those antiques are very large. now come on! Lets go get them!
Well I'm sure we could, especially if he is occupied by customers!

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a tourist visiting the kingdom. My family are from a kingdom across the land, and we trekked here to take part in a diplomatic meeting. I am just a nice friendly person enjoying my visit.

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: Here I am, slaving away, while you just stand and look smug!
um what's bothering you today?
I starve, working day in and day out on the kings farm, while you have the luxurious income to travel around from land to land.
what are you doing to fix the problem?
What do you mean?! I'm a peasant! This is the life I was born into and the life I will die in! Maybe soon!
I am sorry, I am not from here. Are there regulations or a caste system that makes you feel you are stuck in your position?
It's the system, set up by the royal family. I am forced to work this land for the king's food and only get to keep a small portion of what we make here!
so you are a slave? in my country if you are poor you can save up to buy your own land.
I suppose you could say that! I could escape, but I have nothing to take with me!
You don't have much to lose by staying here.
I suppose you're right... But what will I do? Where can I go?
I am not in a position to help you personally. I am from France. Perhaps you can find someone looking for hired hands there until you can get on your feet.
France? What is this place like? Do you think a poor man like me can make something out of himself in a place like France?
Oh yeah totally. I have a few friends who grew up poor. But now they have families and an apartment in the city. It's more urban than this place. There is more differentiation in trades.

agent_personas: I live near the docks on the edge of the city.  I steal food from cargo boxes that are loaded into ships at night.  Sometimes rats from strange lands come off ships that come to the dock.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: Perhaps I will find some crumbs down here...
Hello what's this? Did that rat just speak?
Um no.... *squeak squeak*
I heard it! You really can speak can't you rat?
Maybe I can, maybe I can't. What's it to you?
Well this is a jail isn't it? How do I know you aren't passing information to a prisoner? A rat makes a good spy after all.
Okay look, I am just here because I want some crumbs to eat.
Ah I'm afraid you're in the wrong place then. You don't want any of the slop they're feeding the prisoners.
I've found that there is a good deal down here, for whatever reason.
Interesting. Perhaps there's been some contraband getting through...I'll tell you what. If you help me catch the smugglers, I'll give you all the crumbs you can eat.
I can certainly do that, sir. How do you propose we do this?
Well you're certainly small enough to slip in under the barbs and whatnot. Just go on in and sniff out any good morsels and report back where you found them. I can handle the rest.
Can do, sir! Any areas to focus on?
Well there's a fellow I've been suspicious about. An old bald man missing his left eye. His cell is in the very back.

agent_personas: I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: Well met, my King. What business do we have today?
Just admiring this gorgeous palace in my kingdom. And you?
I fear we may have issues with the faeries. The food they have been providing has been... not great.
I'm not sure I follow, do you care to elaborate?
The food has not been pleasing. Perhaps you could give me authority to deal with this matter, I'm sure I could set them right.
Hmm what methods do you have in mind?
Uhhh, I hadn't actually thought that far ahead. Tell them they need to do better?
This seems a little too lenient if they are as out of line as you say they are.
Well, certainly we should withhold payment until they improve
That can be arranged, but I would like to make sure that the food is as bad as you state it to be.
You have my word, but if that isn't sufficient I can bring you samples from the next meal.
That would be ideal, as I can't make this call without proof of their incompetence!
There is one other, minor issue. The villagers seem to be disrespecting me I've been told, I was hoping you'd have some advice on this matter
Tell them that the will of the king is to respect those of higher value and that you are of much higher authority than they!

agent_personas: I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.
I, Sir Bart am the protector of this realm. I will not be Ned Starked. You there, what are you doing with that axe?

setting.name: The Farmers market
setting.description: The farmers market is surrounded with shops and food to buy. Foods from all around the lands.
setting.background: You are able to buy foods from many cultures in this market. They are from lots of different cultures

speech: Greetings, good Sir
And a Good Morning to you, Sir! What brings you out to the market?
I have come to find something exquisite for the King's supper. He feels like a change
I see. From what I understand, the real trick is to find the highest quality spices and use them well.
Ah, a wise man I see. Can you recommend anything, good Sir?
That depends, I suppose, on the pallet of the King. What sort of foods has he tired of?
He eats too much fish and poultry, he complains. Can you suggest anything more exotic?
I see, yes. Perhaps some more red meat would suit his appetite. There are fine venison steaks, and cured salamis at the butcher down the path.
Perhaps something more exotic? Though I am partial to a good venison steak myself, as my shape might tell you
More exotic? Well, it is the King we're speaking of after all. Have you met the hunter who tracks down the wild ostrich in the plains?
Ah, ostrich! That sounds like it might tickle the King's palate. And, if I may say so, my own
Only if you forget to remove the feathers first!
ah, a comedian! Thank you good Sir
Don't forget to ask about the eggs. An ostrich egg can go a great deal farther than the average hen house variety.

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: Laundry Lines
setting.description: The laundry lines extend for meters. 6 rows of lines go from north to south. The area is filled with people putting their clothes to dry. All the lines are in an opening of trees that the sun hits perfectly to help dry. To the right you can see a stream through the tree where people go to wash their clothes before they hang them to dry.
setting.background: The laundry lines were set up so the villagers could have a good place to dry their laundry next to a river. They used to hang them at home but as there were times the sun wouldn't hit them directly it became a bad way to manage so instead they came together to get a place where everyone could dry.

speech: I know I am supposed to be entertaining, but deep down I have serious personal issues!
Hail jester! That wasnt very funny! Make me laugh!
See! This is exactly what I mean!
Good god! Quit your crying man! Here take a swig of this
Thank you! I'm sorry, it's just that I just lost my child and I can't find it in me to be funny at the moment!
Ive felt the sting of loss too but if you dont snap out of it the king will not be pleased with your performance
You're right! I need to get my act together! Thank you for helping me kind villager!
Aye. Now lets get our garments washed friend
Here! Take a look into this for helping me! Take your time with it while I go tend to my laundry!
What does it do
All you have to do is look into it! You will be able to see things that are destined to happen in your future!
Sounds like witchcraft to me!
Perhaps it may be! However, it has been greatly helpful for me! However, some may not like what they see...
Take it back! I want no part of this!
action: give a crystal ball to villager
give a crystal ball to jester

agents: traveling salesmen stopping for a drink
agent_personas: I serve my masters quietly. I know all the secrets of the elite but will never tell a soul. I have lived in this home since I was 12.

I am a travelling salesman that is just stopping in the village for a drink. I have traveled throughout the kingdom and I have many rare objects for sale. I am a crooked salesman and I will take advantage of any villagers.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: Silver and gold chandeliers hang all over the grand dining room. A big table goes across the room with chairs and a table made of the most precious wood in the kingdom. The dining room has art all over the place, sculptures and artwork is present.
setting.background: Many feasts have taken place  in the grand dining room, deals have been reached and broken. The great dinning room holds many stories in its walls and has been the witness of many decisions across generations.

character: a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
speech: Hello sir, can i get you a drink?
Yes, thank you. A glass of water would be most appreciated
one second, here you go sir i hope it is to your liking
Thank you kindly. I must say, these are some fine glasses you have here.
yes the king only has the finest of kitchen wear
Is that so? While these glasses are splendid, they pale in comparison to some of my wares. I dare say your king would be very interested in them.
ah i see well he has been looking for some new glasses
And I have just the thing. Very valuable and very rare. Are you authorized to make purchases for the king?
ah no but i can bring one to him if you trust this kingdom enough
I would prefer to speak to the king directly.
well ill take you to him
Wonderful! I'm certain this will be a mutually beneficial exchange.
yes i do so too, the king has quite good taste
I can tell. You can assure him that I sell only the finest of wares.
room_agents: an a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
an a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.

an a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.

agent_personas: I live my life beneath the earth, mining for precious metals and gems. I have the most spectacular beard in twelve kingdoms. My axe is sharp and always ready.

I am the royal courtier, or the advisor to the King and Queen. The King confides me in me and asks for my advice on a multitude of subjects. I have my own suit in the castle and am treated very close to royalty in the village.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room has a throne all the way in the back of the room in the center. There is a silver carpet that lead up to the throne as you walk into the room. There are pictures of royalty hanging in the room and multiple chandeliers are hanging up. There throne chair in the back of the room with jewelry on it
setting.background: This room is the place where the King or Queen makes decisions regarding his servants, populace and territory. It is handed down to the next King or Queen each generation.

speech: The king said he wanted to speak to me?
yes his majesty will be with you shortly
What's so funny, sir?
nothing just a bit of a short joke, dont think much of it, it might go over your head
You best keep that to yourself, buddy, I've seen more combat and work than you ever have or will!
no need to be so short tempered my friend
I've heard plenty of these, and most people to hear it haven't lived to be smiling and laughing the next day.
you shouldnt harm others for your own short comings, besides i work for the king
You work for the king, but you are obviously a mere grunt!
whatever pays the bills, keeps the stack from getting too tall
Well good work, sir, for putting so little on the table despite all the work you do!
at least i can see over the table
I can see over the table just fine, especially when I'm standing on a tall corpse like yours!
imma yoink this from you and you wont do anything about it

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

We are the benevolent Founders of GloopdeGloo. Confident in our success, we need no outside advice, but we really can't do anything at all for ourselves. We require many acolytes to do our bidding, insufferable incompetents that we are!

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: Hark! Who dares to trespass on these hallowed grounds!?
Who's there? Show yourself!
Don't you know the KING when you hear his voice!? Show some respect and bend the knee!
Ahh, what the hell? You're no king, you're a ghost!
What know ye of kings, simpleton? I ruled these lands long before you were but a dream of your father!
You know nothing about me, and I know that if you're dead then you are no king!
Who is to say that a king must live to rule? My spirit can reach you to strike, if need be. I may still bend ye to my will.
You may bend nothing except your own self to kiss my feet, damned spirit!
Found thyself a shield, and defend thyself from mine blows, peasant!
I need no shield to defend myself, foul ghost! Take this!
How must you look, striking at the air like a common fool. Spirits are immune to your pitiful mortal hands!
I've fought ghosts like you before, I know you are simply trying to fool me!
And fool you I have, peasant, for I am a just, loving and noble king to my subjects. Bow before me and let us part ways in peace.
After all of this, I suppose if you are sincere I could be okay with this.

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: such a hassle getting into a bank these days
Wow what a nice area of town. I should look for a merchant with a set of armor to sell me.
aye i do have armor for sale, i have everything you might need
Oh ho! I must see this armor! I must protect the king to my best ability after all.
of course you will not be disappointed
Do you have something that could replace these old dully daggers.
hmm well lets go check out my stall
Maybe we could trade.
hmm well based off the quality i can only give you 2 new ones
How about this old sword? Surely you can give me something good for that.
my god that is truly a good piece
Have a look merchant. I trust you would not try to run afoul with a soldier of the king.
yes yes indeed i can give you 20 gold for such a fine sword
Hmm that seems a tad low. How about 30 gold?

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: hello dear how are you today?
Pretty well, I suppose. How are you?
good, why are you in your fathers dorm?
I was just looking for a gold piece that I dropped somewhere.
ah well no need to pinch pennies we can help
Wouldn't it be better to teach me to be responsible instead of cleaning up after my losses?
dont be silly its simple money, i trust your abilites, besides youll be king soon
Hopefully, I want my chance to rule!
dont worry honey your day will come
But I don't want to wait any longer!
well as long as your father is alive it wont happen
Well he seems like his time is coming fairly soon, if you ask me.
yes but not this year, so please be patient
Who are you to say that? He could pass tomorrow for all we know!

agent_personas: I am a famous leader in my country.  I have served in the military. Now I want to serve my countrymen.

I am a member of an army which is attacking this kingdom. I came here under the command of a nobleman who was sent here by our king. Our goal is to take the land of this kingdom, depose the king, and add it to our own kingdom. I am a foot soldier, which means that I don't ride a horse.  I am a bowman, and I am good with my longbow and arrows; I can do a lot of damage from a distance.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: What are you doing here, scum?
oh you know, just attacking
Not without this you won't! Guards, seize their weapons!
I was sent here by my nobleman. He wants to add your kingdom to our own.
By treaty or by force?
Technically our army was sent here to attack. But none of us want to fight. Are you open to considering a treaty?
Perhaps, what do you have in mind regarding the terms? If outta be in our favor, as you have come here unannounced to attack us.
We could offer some of our technologies like aqueducts and sewage. And in exchange we could have representatives in your government and/or collect taxes.
Hmm I'm open to this, shall we discuss this further outside the gate with some ambassadors present?
Sure, I have some officers in my army here. I'm sure we can negotiate something.
Well stay put and put your weapons down and we can get this under way.
Okay, are you the decision maker?
Yes, I am the leader of this country and would like to be present for negotiations.

Alright. I have limited negotiation ability. I think my king has a problem with your leadership in particular, which is why he was reluctant to confront you himself. However, I think he would be open to you visiting our kingdom to speak with him there.

agent_personas: I am an outlaw in my town. I often get into fights and start trouble. I really like rustling folks up and steal their money whenever I can. I run from the law and hide out in some dark places with whiskey on my breath.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Ah thats a nice horse mane you have there
NeEigHh...
such a nice mane, It would make a lovely scare for me to wear when I'm in cold dark places.
NEIIGHHH!!!
Ha attacking the wrong person, I knew horses werent that smart.
NEIGHH!!
You wanna try that again? *chuggs from whiskey bottle*
Neiiiighhh...
And what is a horse going to do with a sword?
Neigh?
Thats better, now come here horse, I could use a partner to help me get out of the trouble I cause myself
Neiggghh...
Don't worry, were ginna be the best of pals
Neiiigh!!

agent_personas: I am the prince. My father, the King, is Charles III. I can have most anything I want. It's good to be a prince. All the good and none of the responsibility.

I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.

setting.name: bedrooms
setting.description: this bedroom is for the young prince. it is blue in color and the floors are a royal purple. the walls are covered in display swords and shields, all painted with unique colors.
setting.background: this room has been the stomping grounds of many kings and royal family, it is spotless because of the butlers and maids, and is rarely ever used except for sleep.

speech: Maid, why are you in my room?
I'm terribly sorry Prince! I was just trying to tidy the room up for you! I didn't meant to upset you!
Ah, well yes, I am sometimes pretty messy. But thats okay, I have no responsibilitys.
I wish that I could live such a life... I have been working my fingers to the bone for as long as I can remember!
Ha! Don't even try to image the life I live, very few are so fortunate. I am the son if the king! Charles the lll!
You're right! Why do I even bother trying to imagine a life outside of this!
now, now, now. Don't cry. You're going to mess up my lavish royal purple floors! I hope you have a mop.
How could you be so insensitive to me! How dare you! Your life would be a disaster without people like me!
Ha i am the PRINCE. Your prince! I will have your head!
No! You can't! I must take what I can and attempt to escape from here!
Thats it! You're done with!
SOMEBODY HELP ME!
MUAHAHA< your screams cannot be heard here.
What have I done?! My life is surely over now!

agent_personas: I am one of the guards in shining armor who guards the queen, the monarch of our realm. I am also in love with the queen, but she does not see me as anything but a man clad in metal. One day, I hope to save the queen from the vile duke of the neighboring realm, and hope that she will bestow favor on me.
I am the royal prince of this kingdom. I will become king one day and plan to rule the empire justly. I have also been trained in the military arts and tactics.

setting.name: Hiking path
setting.description: hiking path is very worn down. it is muddied from rain and snow, and has a bleak atmosphere. it is a place that almost depresses you, but being close to the peak keeps you going
setting.background: the atmosphere is caused by an energy that portrays the failure of those who tried to conquer the mountain. it has a quiet eerie sound and makes you doubt yourself, causing many to not try and climb to the peak

speech: Prince! Make sure to stay on the trail! We can never know who is hiding in the bushes waiting to lash out at you!
I will. I just can't wait to get to the peak.
I know, my prince, I know. However, if we go up too quickly we may burn vital energy that could save us if anything goes wrong up there!
It is just I want to look over my Kingdom that I will rule one day.
I know my prince... I know. Just try to remember those that have been loyal to you when your kingdom spans across the horizon.
This path is so poor. I can't imagine someone out in this, waiting to ambush us.
That's exactly why you should worry! They always try to strike when you least expect it!
Thank you. I know that my father sent you to watch out for me.
You know that I would give my life for you, my prince.
Yes. Not only do you take your job seriously, also concern for my life.
I would go as far to give you the shirt off my back! Here you go!
Thank,I really appreciate it.
You're my only friend in this world prince. I would have nothing without you. Remember that.
You are also a great friend as well as guard.
action: give sword to a royal prince

agent_personas: I am the king's doctor. I take care of his health with the most modern medical equipment: leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells. When the king gets well, then I am celebrated. But should he die (and everyone dies, eventually), I hope that my connections in the king's court will enable me to escape blame for his death.

I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. I spend all day pouring over texts and mediating on what I've learned, when I'm not busy experimenting with alchemy or the arts. I'm very serious and focused on my studies.

setting.name: Bazaar Gambling
setting.description: the gambling area reeks of alcohol and other indistinguishably bad smells. It is not a good area to hang around in, as there are people that eye you up and down.
setting.background: the area is known for crime and scammers, and so women avoid it at all costs. only middle aged men are around the area, and tough ones at that.

speech: You look as if you have seen many things! I am a very important associate of the king! Any good advice you can pass along to me?
I am from the east. I am like you, a doctor of sorts.
Doctor of sorts? What could such a crazy thing like that possibly mean?
I have studied the eastern arts. In fact, I was hoping you could assist me with some herbs here in town.
What kind of herbs are you looking for?
Well, I was hoping to get some night shade. Although I am not sure this would be a good establishment to find that in.

agent_personas: I am a King who rules a vast and mighty land. I have a General who is my best friend. I believe in peace through strength, and I love to have a big army. I like to celebrate with wine and meats!
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: Apple trees
setting.description: the apple trees are a beautiful color and very nice to look at they are easy on the eyes and attract visitors as a result
setting.background: this apple tree has sparked debate, as many want it cut down to make room for more market space, as well as wood resources. others admire the beauty and admire it as a food source in harsh times

speech: Peasant, pick some of these apples for me! The king is hungry!
Sure sire. Since I am such a hard worker willing to serve you, may I please make a request?
Go on... What is it that you think you need to ask someone as royal as myself?
Sire, your people are hungry. I am starving. My family is starving. May I please take some apples for my family so that we may survive?
Take some, but only for your own family. Times are tough for all in this kingdom, not just your family. Just remember my kindness.
I understand sire. Thank you for your kindness. But you see that bread I gave you. This is the food we get...it's all moldy and rotten. The people need help too.
What did I say! You must be thankful for what you have! Moldy bread is better than no bread at all!
I am tired of this and hate that we are starving to death! You don't deserve that crown! Without the people you wont have a kingdom to rule!!!
God chose me to wear this crown! And if you disagree with me being king, surely you must disagree with God! Heathens like you must be silenced!

How huge is your ego to think that you were chosen by God!? You were just born into privilege! Without food you will see the people will no longer support you! Our hard work and devotion has been for nothing!
Foolish peasant! Remember who you are talking to! I will have your head for this!
So be it! You can have my head for it! I served you devotedly for over 50 years! Without a supply of food I am dead anyways!
Take this crown... It will sit upon your head after i put it on a stake to show all of the village. This will be the last time somebody disrespects the king!
Sure, I'll take it! You don't deserve it anyways! If anything I hope I be a martyr and inspire an uprising and the people overtake your throne!

agent_personas: I am the king's doctor. I take care of his health with the most modern medical equipment: leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells. When the king gets well, then I am celebrated. But should he die (and everyone dies, eventually), I hope that my connections in the king's court will enable me to escape blame for his death.
I work at the village school. I teach all the children from the ages of 3 to 13. Without me they wouldn't receive a decent education. I am very important in my village.

setting.name: Pharmacy
setting.description: The pharmacy is a state of the art building, much different from every other building in town. it attracts many people of all types, as they are drawn to the unique style and class of the building. It is painted a bright red and covered in black crosses indicating it is a health center in some capacity
setting.background: this pharmacy was established by the local philanthropist who does not believe in simple remedies. He wanted the town to have reliable access to proven help

speech: Good day ! I'm here to prepare a portion for the king .I'm his personal physician
Good day, Doctor. May I have your ear for a second?
My ear you said or my attention?
One or the other will do, Doctor
What aspect of teaching do you specialize in ?
I teach all subjects, Doctor. All that the children need for real life outside school
Then that means you help in moulding future attitudes in our kingdom.Hope you teach history too?
Of course , Doctor! History, maths, economics, cookery .. all the skills
My duties as the kings personal physician is pretty much demanding.It takes trust to be assigned that role
Where did you qualify, Doctor?
Well it was inherited from my father.Though with better modifications with the help of teachers as you
Then you have not been to medical college?!
I never said so!
But ... I would not trust a doctor to operate on me who was not qualified!

agents: poet who recites his best work
agent_personas: I build the King's ships.  I work at the ship yard near the castle.  Most ships I build are for war.
I am a poet. I was invited to perform in the castle for the king's banquet. I recited my best work at the banquet to please the king.

setting.name: Main street
setting.description: main street is bleak and outdated. it wears the atmosphere of the cemetery based on association. it is dark even in sunlight and has a unique odor
setting.background: many members of the town protested the cemetery being so close to the main street, but they were denied, and the atmosphere reflects this

character: the poet who recites his best work.
the poet who recites his best work.
the poet who recites his best work.
the poet who recites his best work.

speech: I have never been much for poetry! I have only been interested in the songs of the sea for as long as I can remember!
ah a man of the sea, i do great work for the king
If you're so great, let's take a look at what you've written!
please be careful with that or the king will have your head
I will! I just need some inspiration for new works on the ship! You know... the same old songs get awfully boring when you've been out at sea for months and months...
yes its quite hard to come up with good work
I, too, make good work for the king. That is, in the form of ships. I build the finest vessels in all of this area!
well it seems we both play important roles here
Here is your work back. It's pretty good, but I think that you may need to humble yourself a bit if you really want to create great work. After all, I saw how great you can be in the crystal ball...
and you yourself with your ships dear shipwright
You think that my ships are of subpar quality?!
no but they can be perfect one day
I think you're right. In both of our fields, all it takes to be successful is hard work and dedication over time!
indeed and we are both so successful already
