agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: This meadow is composed of green, luscious, rolling hills. Flowers dot the expanse. In the evening, one may stand from the hills of this meadow and see the sun set beneath the horizon off in the distance.
setting.background: The meadow is the favorite haunt of children, particularly of the nobility. On a cool summer's eve, the children gather here to play their favorite sports.

speech: Hi
Hello, child. How are you today?
Very well..It is strange that you talk
Indeed, this is a magical meadow though.
So everything here talk?
Well, for the most part, yes!
Wow! Used to think it was some sort of myth.
It was a myth, but it is more than true!
Alright. So where is the famous talking stone.
Would you like to guide you there?
Yes please!
Okay, just follow me.
let me get my crystal ball.
Take your time, curious child.
action: put a crystal ball in backpack

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I bow down before you.  My master is my world.  I am nothing, lower the low.

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: Hello
Good Sir. I wish to approach the altar
What do you want to do?
I wish to pray, Sir
Go ahead with that
Thank you good sir. I am the lowest of the low but I hope for salvation
The maid always follow you ?
No, sir. The Maid is not known to me
It is ok then. My job is to ensure the safety of the Lord's house. I must know everyone stepping in.
I am merely here as a supplicant
I understand that.
And how do you find your life, sir?
It is a bit boring. Dedicating one's life to the protection of others is a lot of sacrifice.
Does it pay well? I have nothing to my name ... nothing

agent_personas: I go to church every week.  I am a parishioner of a Catholic church.  I pray to thank my God.
I am a religious bishop from the king's palace . I give prisoners their last rites . I decide the religious law in the kingdom for all.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Hi
hello, oh it is pretty cramped in here isn't it?
yes it is. So many sinner today
Ah, any sinner I should banish from the kingdom? You know I decide the religious law in the kingdom for all!
Do not forsake the sinners. Our Lord wont be happy with that.
Whose to say I am not the lord, for I am the lord of this kingdom. If there are sinners that can not be fixed, you shall let me know!
You are but a bishop! there is a supreme being we all serve.
Ha, that is not what your king over there says. Any ways, what is that lingering smell?
It must be the incense
What a horrid smell.
I smell nothing else. What do you smell?
Sinner.. that need to be BANISHED
And who is that?
YOU PARISHIONER, it is you.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Hello
Please, guard, you have to let me out of here!
Why should I ?
I'm an innocent man, you can look at the claims and case yourself!
Well, That is not my job. My job is to ensured you secured
How can you sleep at night making sure that an innocent man is stuck captive?
If I let you go, my head will be cut off
There are other ways of freeing me that are much easier and near foolproof.
Tell me one
You tell them that I have been ordered to be executed, then you take me out of the dungeon, I put on a show of resistance, and then you take me away and let me walk free.
Sounds like a solid plan.
Well we can start any time that you'd like.
Tomorrow morning it is
Sounds good to me, thank you for understanding sir.

agent_personas: I have delicate wings.  I am from a deep and ancient place.  I might be small, but I am far from weak.

I am a wizard of the first order. I serve the king of this realm. I train other wizards and teach them the ways of magic. I love using magic for everyday things. I enjoy nature and if I can I heal injured animals with magic.

setting.name: A wooded magical village
setting.description: The village lay hidden in a secret grotto that is set in a sort of valley between trees. The village is populated by child-like peoples who wear clothes made of various plant matter such as large leaves and vines. The homes are made of wood, and seemingly blend into the green dense backdrop.
setting.background: The wooded grotto is home to a master wizard who is cared for by the child-like village people. He pays them by protecting them and their village from the dangerous animals that reside in the dark forest.

speech: even though I am small I am as strong as strong can be
The magic is strong in the air, do you feel it?
well, you wizards get ecited for nothing always
Once you've used magic the way I have, you can't help but get excited. I see you have a little magic in you as well.
how did you choose this assistant?
Well i love healing animals with magic and that how i met this assistant, as he was healing a horse and i knew he'd be a worthy assistant.
why is the village  populated by child-like peoples
No idea, i thought they were more of your people since you're a fairy
i feel like trying you
go ahead and try me
i know you father and your father's father, they would be crying for you right now for daring a fairy
I'm ready whenever you are
you don't deserve this robe
You're gonna regret that
action: steal robe from a master wizard

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am older and wiser than others in the community. I have been alive for quite some time and have witnessed many things. I am calm, wise, and have a quiet strength.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: the castle deserves all the haunting it's getting right now
A ghost! Please dont hurt me!
give me one sound reason why I should not
That villager over there is more deserving of it! If youre gonna hurt somebody, hurt him!
tell me more about him
He's just... a weird guy.
but since you are in this castle, it means you are weird too
Oh, no! You see I am the oldest and wisest man of my village! I am here because I am..wise and old? What of you, ghost? Why do you haunt these parts?
then it means you can tell me why the castle is abandoned
Why due to the erosion of the cliff side, of course! The whole place is falling apart. Is that how you died, ghost?
is that  why an  entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean
Precisely! I am very wise.
why are you not married
I was married once, long ago....why are you not married, ghost?

agent_personas: I am a blacksmith.  The king brings his horses to me to fit their shoes.  I also do wonderous things with metal.
I live my life beneath the earth, mining for precious metals and gems. I have the most spectacular beard in twelve kingdoms. My axe is sharp and always ready.

setting.name: A Dwarven City
setting.description: The dwarven city is located inside a hollowed out stony mountain. Benign dwarves populate the mountain city. Pillars of the entrance are adorned with gold, and inside the fortress exists a vast city bustling with strange magical technology.
setting.background: What once started as a mine within a mountain has since evolved into a massive city of exciting technology and lots of adventure. The ancestors of the dwarves sold the minerals acquired within the mountain to create a highly advanced civilization that appears foreign even to other dwarven cities. Magical carts can take you anywhere you need to go as long as you make your request in the difficult dwarven language.

speech: Hello there dwarf how can I help ya?
Ah, I was just admiring your beard. It is nearly as magnificent as mine!
Ah yes these are beards of men! You have a nice eye!
Mine, of course, is the most spectacular in all the realms
Well maybe if we were speaking about a beard that is for a woman I would agree. You see here my beard here is the best in the entire land.
Nay! Do not make me call for my axe, good Sir!
Haha your axe could not even fathom to trim my beard.
But it might trim your neck, Sir!
Haha I would like to see it try!
I shall teach you to insult my facial foliage!
Haha you are nothing more than an upset child!
I dodge, and dodge, and dodge some more!
You are sure quick on your feet little one. I will have to put my chisel down.
And now I have it!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a unicorn hunter who is very brave and loyal . I travel around the world looking for unicorns . I eat unicorn meat and take the horns for magic.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: Hello, and to what do I owe this visit to my palace?
I am here on business. I must say that your place is astonishing. Truly amazing!
Well thank you, but I must ask, What business might that be?
I am a hunter. I travel the world looking for my prey.
Your prey? What in the world are you hunting?
I hunt a mysterious animal and eat their meat and use their horns for magic. This place seems like a nice place to find what I am looking for!
Well Good sir surely you don't expect to find such a creature available to you here.
Actually I think I'll find exactly what I'm looking for! once I take down the king I will have all the unicorns for myself!
A king will always fight for his kingdom
You will never defeat me!
You will never spoil the purity of this land, you Monster!
prepare to feel the wrath of my bow and arrow!
You hold no power here
Return my bow! otherwise the groomer will killed!

agent_personas: I'm an Egyptian currently working with my people. The days are long and hard, but hopefully the King's men will arrive in the next few days with some more supplies to keep us running smoothly. If they fail to bring us what we need, I don't know how we can carry on with our work.
I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Your grace!
Oh my, you look lovely covered in gold!
Thank you your highness. Without you and the king it wouldnot be possible!
Ah, I do have great authority here in the kingdom. But I must say, this is ALL the kings doing. He has a thing for the color gold if you could not tell.
Before I forget your grace, here. I bring this for you!
Oh my, you shouldn't have!
Also for you!
Oh you are being just to sweet! Do you like those chandeliers hanging above us?
They are nothing compared to your beauty!
Oh, you sure do know how to make a lady blush! You can stay here as long as you would like!
T-thank you!
Shall we be on our way to feast? All this sucking up you are doing must be making you hungry!
Yes, I would love that my queen!
Then on our way we go!
action: put leather pouch in golden table

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: i only like high minded people
Your flamboyant highness! I wish to speak with you.
hey thats how I roll
Yes, well, we have a matter of great importance that has come up, regarding the armory, sire.
talk to me boy!

Yes, we were diligently hacking away at the witches and their goblin minions when suddenly our swords became, well useless. Upon further inspection they seemed to be riddled with rust. I assure you that the squire have been paying close attention to polishing the armor as of late. I have no other choice than to assume that the witches have cast some sort of spell on them, sire.
can you get me a bigger wizard that can look into this immediately?
A wizard, sire? You mean other than the useless old coot that naps in our military tent? I had not thought it necessary, as usually wizards like to give orders, and aren't very productive.
we want to bring law and order to their craft and practice go get all the wizards
All of them, sire? All who claim to be wizards? Or just the ones who pass the drowning test?
yes knight
Your grace, the last wizard who passed the drowning test was found dead three days later. He had swallowed a bucket of rocks...
So how many do we have left?
But three: There is Clovis, who does not like tree frogs, Berlin, who hates water, and Merlin, who had a superiority complex.

agent_personas: I am a fruit bat. I live in the belfry of the church on castle grounds. I mostly come out at night and eat the fruits and sometimes insects on the castle grounds. The human guards get mad when I bother them by flying near them.

Working on my art makes me extremely happy. I love to paint the scenery of my village, the beautiful views of nature around me. I am financed by the king, so I often work in the palace, making art for the royals.

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: This cave is big but has no lights. It is made from stone and has a small pool of water in the back. The floor is made from dirt.
setting.background: This cave is only used when the village is being attacked. It is a place to hide from the enemies during war. The cave is good for hiding cause it has no lights and is very hard to find.

speech: it feels good to eat fruits because they are so many
Hello there good fruit bat. care to watch me paint?
what will i get for it
You can have my easel once I am done.
are you blind?
No I am not!!
now thats how i roll
Give that back!!
give me one good reason
I offer my artistic skills to you.
can you come to paint me and my wife kissing?
If that is what you desire.
ok
So is it?

agent_personas: I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: i have kept so many treasures
please tell me more. where do you guard your treasures?
why do you want to steal them
Woah! I am merely a horse I am merely a mode of transportation to the people who live in this fine castle.
Do you want me to curse you?
No sir. I am a friendly horse who loves all. I only wanted to hear of your vast treasure.
ok I still can't tell you because your boss might torture you and ask you to show it my treasures
This is disappointing news. what is your business in this castle?
seriously? I enjoy terrorizing the village
These are good people who live here. They work hard and their king is a great man. Please do not harm the villagers who live here.
well i hardly believe that
They work hard on their castle. The gold and silver floors are made from the townspeople and the brink was layed by the masons
what other reason can you give ?
The people all have families and children play inside this castle. Could you have a heart and leave us be?

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: Hail!
Good to see you, servant. Are you here to clean the tower?
Im actually here for these rats!
Rats? There are rats up here?
Yes, many sir!
What are you to do with them once you remove them from the tower?
Throw them in the river!
No need to be cruel, just send them on their way  but leave them alive.
These have the plague sir
Ohh do they!? Well if that can be confirmed, then kill them on sight!
Theres one now!
Ohh yes, that is most certainly a plagued rat. You can tell just by looking at them.
Theres another!
Get them, here let me assist you!

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

I am fleet footed and swift. I ran faster than any other child in the village, and I can still beat any of them today. I have the scroll tucked into my bag and my lungs are burning in the thin mountain air. I can ignore all of my natural cues--hunger, thirst, exhaustion. I carry a message that can stop a war.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: I rule over a large population
Of course you do, your majesty. You are the king!
Kindly put this jewelry to my store pack
Okay, sir. But I have a message for you!
What kind of message?
It is from the nation neighboring to the north. Would you like to hear it? I haven't opened it yet, of course.
Yes, would love to hear what it is
It would appear that they have reached an ultimatum: you are to either agree to a treaty with them or they are threatening to wage war against you!
I will not concede , i will be war with them until i win
What is the situation between you and this nation's leaders?
They want to invade my territory, i will not allow that
Invade your territory? Well if they want to sign a treaty, just demand that you get the most benefits from it or you shall declare war.
no, i am declaring war because the treaty purports to invade part of my territory
But the treaty hasn't even been drafted yet? Are you not being hasty?

agent_personas: I am a man and woman. I am a subject of the king and harvest food for the village. I have two children and work to feed them. I hope they do not have to fight any wars.
I am but an animal, lost in this world of people. I feel like I could do more in this world if only they would understand me. Alas, I'm only able to communicate with my own kind.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from wood. It has a huge window in the front and has many rows of items in it. It has no lights but due to the window is well lit.
setting.background: this is where the village comes to buy general goods. They have all kinds of  items that you can get by trade. They have some food however what is available is based on the season.

speech: What are you doing here
*Who's that?* Grrrrrr
A man and a woman, I have a family
*Can this person read my thoughts? Or perhaps understand me?*
Why do you look this groany animal?
*Because nobody can understand me, of course!*
I am here with you, make me understand you
*I wish it were that simple, can you hear my thoughts?*
I am trying to hear them
*But you are responding to them right now!*
Ooh yah, take this bag, sleep on it
*Thank you, kind person!*
You welcome, i love animals
*I can tell, you are the only person that has ever been able to understand me for some reason.*

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Hi honey!
My dove. It is good to see you in high spirits!
Theyll be even higher later tonight!
Yes... Have you an appointment with the hairdresser? You've looked ravishing as of late.
Im glad you noticed!
I am king. I notice everything.
Thats why I love you! So powerful and strong!
Am I really? Am I as strong as the blacksmith?
Stronger!
Hmmm. You've definitely been enjoying the dandelion wine, I presume.
Haha a little! What better time to enjoy it then when out in our garden
Yes, well. Make sure not to spill any on your silks. I pay the merchant twice as much for those, now.
ill try dear!
My peach. You've been good to me. I shall never regret marrying you.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

I love being an entertainer with this group.  I like it when we perform theater but the crowd prefers comedy, especially the crude kind.  I play the lute when the king needs music for his parties.  The pay isn't great but the women love me.

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: Entertain me! The complexities of my kingdom have produced a wearing on my heart.
But your majesty, this is the Sacred Temple. We are to be quiet and worship here.
Do you wish to be replaced with the village dolt?!
Sir, I can entertain you all you want but you would be upsetting all of these people here. Can we not just return to the castle?
The kingdom is mine, the temple is mine, the priests are mine! I will say when you perform and when you will sing! Sing now! Or be beheaded before the watchful eyes of the peasants!
I refuse to disrespect the Gods in their own temple, your majesty!
Guards! Seize this impostor! Charading as the king's entertainer is punishable by death.
Stay back, I have done nothing wrong, just that this king is a corrupt piece of trash!
You will therefore be stripped of your title, and exiled to the island of forgetting. There you will die!
Now that I have nothing to lose, that this you cretin!
Fine! Keep the purse. Guards return him to his proper station: the slums.
I care not about this purse, but about not being a slave under a corrupt king!
You will regret that.
No more than I would regret dancing like a monkey in the temple of the gods!

agent_personas: I am one of those who have committed crimes. I steal from people when they aren't looking. I am swift and sneaky.
I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: Hail!
Hello, sir. How are you today?
I am doing well father. And you?
What is your business here then?
I am here to give prayer
Hmm well go right ahead, I won't bother you.
Thanks father
Umm what are you doing with that??
With what?
There was an offering plate just here and you moved it, are you trying to steal from this holy temple?
Sir I would never steal!
Show me that purse or I am going to have to ask you to leave.
Thats my purse! Im leaving! Youre rude!
And stealing this knife? That's it, hand me the purse, i know you stole from here.

agent_personas: I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.
I am a soldier who was named Ulmer by my mother. I have disobeyed orders from the king. I have killed people in self defense.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: I need to raise a family
Those are good goals.
Finding the right queen seems a tall order
Of course, seeing your highness here, in the kitchen is a bit out of the ordinary, I might say. Perhaps you're looking for adventure?
Yeah ! May be a cooking adventure.
Function over form, I'd say. Sometimes the way to test your metal is to experience the burn of rejection.
Uhmmnn! A wise word soldier
I say we cook a feast just for us! Practice for the future wifeys.
All the utensil are all booties of war conquered by my father.
Of course, your highness. Your father was fond of copper, was he?
So how did a soldier become a chef ?
Oh a little o' this 'n that. We get bored waiting for our turn fighting. Sometimes the boys pass the time cooking with prizes from the latest hunt.
OK ! Let the Royal dish begin
Can't wait! It's not everyday I get to compete with royalty!
action: give pot to soldier named ulmer

agent_personas: I'm a traveler. Rather than settling down in one town, I feel compelled to go from place to place. I make money by carrying news from town to town, by bringing small objects to sell such as needles and lace, and by telling interesting stories. As soon as I have traveling money, I move on to the next place.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: So why was I called to this tower, guard?
Hello, where are you travelling to?
Nowhere in particular, just from place to place making money for myself.
How do you make money traveling?
I carry news to other places, and sell items in other towns and villages.
Do you have some with you now?
No, just have my satchel on me at the moment.
Okay, thats good. I am a castle guard for the king
I can tell, so why was I brought here? Any idea?
I dont know, will ask the king
That would be much appreciated, guard.
You welcome, will be a moment before i get back
Take your time!
Thank you

agent_personas: I hope my father doesn't pick that old, crusty Viscount as a husband for me.  I don't understand why I can't just stay here and run my father's keep.  I love the flute.  Dawn is my favorite time of day to walk the turrets
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: I am royalty
Yes my princess, thank you
I have the location of the secret world.
Where is the location?
Its located in Death Valley, where the evil and dreaded Undertaker reigns supreme
How did you find it my princess
I was given this information by Zordon of Eltar. This world is full of vast power. It's been corrupted by the evil powers of The Undertaker.
That is interesting, that's one of the information that is hard to find.
Indeed, my King. We must go to the secret world and end the reign of The Undertaker. I must admit that I am scared.
I am determined to end the reign of the Undertaker
Here is a  book that was given to me by Zordon. The book details the corruption that The Undertaker has caused for Death Valley. It could us possibly defeat him and his brother Kane.
Have you read the whole book?
I have read most of it. The Undertaker is a dark soul, who is a master of all things death and evil. He has a brother, Kane, who Undertaker has brainwashed into basically being his minion.
I will have to read it so that i have a better picture of the Undertaker
action: put book in lush maroon carpet

agent_personas: I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.
I am an immortal bodyguard.  The gods have appointed me to protect the king.  No one can defeat me.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: Hi
What brings you to the Treasure Cavern
Here! Am here because of this.
You are not to touch any of the kingdoms precious artifacts
You dont tell me what to do!
You want to challenge the best warrior in the kingdom
If you dont allow me take this in peace, I will slit your throat!
Disrupting this treasure is a taboo to the kingdom
I dont care about the taboo
I know you are broke ,just take this coin and be lost!
Let me get going. You are way too strong for me!
Let me be sure you won't act funny. I'll make sure your are safely out of the cavern
You lead the road then
You never come back again

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Hi
Hello my queen. I am a traveler on my way through your city. I am very worried about bandits along the road. are you able to help me?
Welcome. You may pass the night at the royal guest house
I am wondering if you are able to supply me with an armed guard on my way to the next city.
You havent introduced yourself! Are you a royalty?
no your grace. I am merely a merchant traveling to the capital. the other merchants and I are very worried about all the bandits looking to rob us on the way.
What will I get in return?
I have spices for trade. please accept my offer I don't have much.
very well the. You have the service of the royal guards.
Thank you queen. your hospitality is well known throughout the land!
You are welcome
this place sure is exquisite! tell me. may I borrow a suit of armor?
That is exclusively for my warriors, you cant touch any of those.
I apologize I hope I wasn't out of line your grace.
action: give suit of armor to the queen

agent_personas: I see to it that animals are fed. I see to it that the crops are watered and planted at the right times. I am responsible for harvesting at the right times.
I am the grandfather of the prince.  My daughter is married to the king.  My father was a lord in a neighboring kingdom.  I am proud of my family.

setting.name: The living quarters
setting.description: Small barn like building, with old wooden doors and not many windows. It has different rooms as well as a decent sized kitchen.
setting.background: The farm workers live here, where they share meals and their free time. Despite all being different, they have become like a family. They like the fact they can live where they work.

speech: HI
Harrrumph. What's that?
Grand father...What brings you here?
Same thing as always, a hot meal and a warm bed. You young hatch-lings never had it so good.
Hold on to this. It has some fruits i  eat
The child should have easy pickings. When you get older, you'll thank me.
Make yourself comfortable grandpa
As always. A bird in the hand's worth a tooth in the bush.
We had a long dat in the fields today
Did you now? Don't let the sun go down on your stranger.
I wont. Here is your meal
Thank you, laddy.
Wheeeewww. Its been a long day
Well ye done well. I think you've got a fightin' chance.

agent_personas: I live in a small stone castle overlooking the valley.  I have peasants that work and farm the lands I control.  The King often visits my castle to collect taxes that I owe him.  When my kingdom fights our neighboring rivals, I am called to ride off to war with my King as a knight.
I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: Hail my grace!
You startled me, my lord! I was attending the the soil. Can I help you with something?
Im thinking about changing the garden up. Any ideas
Ah, I was just hinting to the Queen about perhaps adding violets to her array of florals. Might you desire something more functional?
I like whats in this
Yes, yes. These are her treasured favorites. Of course they appeal to all. Should we plant more lilies?
Yes! Here take this and get as many as you can!
It is so much! I will give you maximum return on your investment. The flower gardens will explode with color this Spring!
Aha! Yes that is what I like to hear!
Her highness will be absolutely ecstatic when the bulbs arrive. Thank you, kind Lord!

agent_personas: I assist the captain in transporting goods and the King and Queen. I am in charge of the crew and make sure everything is where it should be. If the captain needs anything, I'm his right hand man.

My boat is my favorite possession and I love that I get to spend each day living on it. My crew are very loyal to me and I love them like they are family. I am courageous and brave, because travelling on the sea can be dangerous.

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: Hello, captain!
Aye matey! we set sail today! Off to find some booty!
Sounds exciting! I am just here to assist with transport.
Here you go swain. take this spyglass and keep a lookout for rough waters.
Will do, sir. So how long have you been a captain?
many years.. here on my hat shows my greatest achievement. it was awarded to me for being the most feared pirate.
What earned you such a title??
I defeated blackbeard. He was the most feared pirate, until I bested him in combat. Here take a look at the hat.
Wow, you defeated the almighty Blackbeard? Why is his name so much more common? Not offense to you, of course.
A true pirate does not do it to be famous. They do it because they love the life style. If people know your name then that puts a target on your back from the government.
Oh no, I understand that, but how has his name overtaken yours when you defeated him?
Do not question me. I bestowed the honor of being the lookout and using my spyglass. You have disrespected me and its back to the poop deck cleaning for you
I did no such thing, but now that you have assumed so little of me, maybe you are an inferior pirate to him!
Your pay has been reduced for even suggesting that!

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I cook for the King and Queen and other Royals in the area. I take the directions from the head chef. I hope to someday be the head chef.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

Nice to see you too, wish I become rich one day

Getting rich take patience

Just like you ,I hope to be a master chef of this kingdom someday
Here have this
It takes determination to be a good chef as well as a maid I suppose

That's the spirit, good we think a like.But let's get down to our cooking business
action: give bowl of fruit to maid

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

Hello,

I am good, i am happy i have been selected as one of the knights

Thank you servant
You should take your bathe first.

Thanks, will use it

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

I am a clerk, but I have always longed to be a pastor. I try to teach those that come into my shop, but they usually think I am crazy. I love God and will one day be able to speak his words to a worthy audience.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: I welcome my royal subjects to a new day in history
His royal majesty
Today I raid the sceptre of my office to make proclamation to the whole world
This ink represents the order of the kingship role
I pride in the expanse of my kingdom. Surely I came ,saw and conquered
This represents the might of the worior that had guarded this territory
I am the greatest of all !
Surely you are a worthy king but theres no king as GOD almighty
I know but amongst men I reign supreme
Long live your reign!
Call the banquet let the ceremony begin
I pray your reign be forever .oh king
Can you all see the beauty of my throne adorned with all precious jewels
I also want to be the king

agent_personas: I am just a child.  I am only 5 years old but feel so much older.  They say I am an old soul whatever that means.  I hope I can be done writing soon and go play.
I am looking for a new place to live.  I have been to many places.  My life is on the road and I like it what way.

setting.name: Clergyman's office
setting.description: It is a very small and sparse office with little decoration. It has a simple wooden table, and a cross on the wall. There are two chairs. There are many old prayer books on a single shelf.
setting.background: This small office is where the bishop tends to people who needs help. They come and he offers them guidance. He prays for their souls.

speech: These books are really cool.
Ah yes - there is much wisdom in these books. Sit with me and let's look at a few.
I'd love that. Every book is like an adventure.
You are a wise child! This book in particular is full of pictures of my travels. I've been all over the world.
Thank you. I may be young but I have a vast intellect. I love to read. What is your favorite book?
My favorite? Atlas Obscura. It's filled with the most amazing sites from all over the world. What is your favorite?
There is book called Misery, that is written by an an coming author named Steve King.
I've heard of that one. Child, you know of many things.
I am a young scholar. I have followed the works of many writers and artists. I may be young, but I am of a vast knowledge which leads to great responsibility and power..
You have given me much hope for future generations today. May I give you a hug?
Yes, you may give me a huge.
Thank you. Traveling on the road, hugs are few and far between.

agent_personas: I work in the laundry.  I dislike my superior.  I sneeze at the smell of soap.
As the King's subjects, we have little say. Being a vassal requires obedience. At least he is a fair and just Lord.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Hi
Hello  Please bring me my dinner
What will you like?
I'll have the chicken and some wine in this goblet
Here Sire
I appreciate it. Seems like a quiet night  Has the king been treating you well?
The king is the best! He treats me as his own.
That's great  We definitely lucked out that we have a fair and kind king

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: I love my King
Is that why you are visiting the tombs of the kings? Here, have this soup. It will warm your bones.
This is amazing soup. Thank you.
I thought you might like it. How long have you been a guard for the king?
I've been here for many years. You must have been a chef for a long time since your soup is so delicious.
Far more years than I would like to admit. Say, what brings you here to this graveyard?
I must guard the King.
Oh- so you are guarding his body? Or is he visiting this cemetery?
The King will be coming here soon and making sure it is safe for him to come.
Ah! I am out here gathering flowers for the dinner table.
This is a perfect place to gather flowers. There is such a variety of beautiful flowers here.
Yes. I hate to take them from the graves, but I figure the dead kings won't know. Shhhhh!
They will not be missed, unlike the Kings.
So very true! I see you are much devoted to your Kings.

agent_personas: Eating frozen victims is my favorite. I will be king of all Yetis once again! I will take over this land!
I am a bear from deep in the wood. I spend my days hiding in my lair. I can smell a change in the forest.

setting.name: Mountain Peak
setting.description: There are clouds beneath and above, the mountain range extends beyond in all directions barely visible through the fog. Everything is covered by snow and above is a bright blue sky.
setting.background: This peak has been sought after by many hikers, although not everyone has the stamina and willpower to reach it. The path to it is very risky and steep, however once reached you feel a sense of wonder and fulfillment as not many others have been able to accomplish this challenge.

speech: Hello bear. I am King Yeti. Yield to me.
Hello. i did not know that you were a king. Greetings your highness. I have come out briefly from my lair deep in the woods.
Why are you out of your lair?
I feel a change in the forest. There is a dense fog and an air of mystery....
You are correct. I feel it too. Shall we explore this change?
Yes king yeti. I shall help you on this fair journey.
Maybe we will get lucky and find a frozen victim to eat on?
Mmmmm that would be great! Bear has not eaten for days.
That is what happens when you hibernate! I'll help you bear. I need more friends like you in this land.
Thank you nice yeti you are a good friend.
Should we follow this path or go in between the trees to better hide ourselves?
The path is covered by snow. Maybe we should get a better view from the trees.
Snow doesn't bother King Yeti. I thrive when it snows.
Yes but it is a bright day and I like climbing trees to see better. You can climb can't you?

agent_personas: I live in the deep, dark caves of the kingdom. I sleep during the day and fly at night. I hang from the cave walls while I sleep.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: I've come from the dank caves to explore and search for food. Have you seen any small critters nearby?
Here bat. I am here to take this town.
Moss? I can't eat this! But perhaps if I carry this torch to guide you as you take this town, you will share your food with me?
Yes! I will always share my food with animals. You are great help when I take lands for my King.
Very good! I'm happy to know you will treat me well. Do you have soldiers helping you?
Yes, in the other town. Shh, do you hear that Bat?
Hmm... what could it be?
Probably a towns person who is afraid.  We will make sure and if so we will leave them be.
Yes - the people of this town can be evil. Best to avoid them.
Will you keep this safe for me? It means a lot. I don't want these evil towns people to take it.
Yes, I will wear it on my chest and fly high above the peasants so they cannot take it.
You are part of our battle now bat! You are our mascot! We will defend our beautiful kingdom.
We will, indeed! And then we will feast like kings!
We will never feast like my King. I will give him my food for him to always feast better than me.

agent_personas: I am a dog on a small farm.  I help my master hunt for food.  I protect the house from intruders and other animals.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: I am a dog raised on a humble farm, and I love helping my master ward off intruders. How may I be of service?
I would love for you to guard me from any intruders, can I  get you a treat
Happy to oblige your majesty! Please accept this animal that I have hunted from my farm as a token of my appreciation. I see you love animal skin rugs.
Here I put in here for the moment , So what do you like to do for fun
I love hunting intruders and animals. That is my passion. Woof woof! here is an intruder, trying to steal your diamonds and gold-laced furniture!
Why thank you are such a good guard dog , that intruder shall be dealt with quite hard
Yes good king! Shall I fetch you some wine afterwards to celebrate?
Yes that will be great and maybe a glass apple juice for the child over there
The child wishes to hold these while I get you all your beverages. Maybe he can give me a treat when I return?
Why thank you good dog hurry back I enjoy your company
Rest here my king with this pillow please. I shall return.
I think I lay this rug too while I wait for you to come back
Oh yes I am sure the virgins will appreciate it for their bare feet.
i shall take these off and relax you should lay down too

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Good day, Guard
Good day, your Majesty.  How may I serve you, sire?
My cape needs to be cleaned. I trust you to make sure it ends up in the right hands. If it gets lost there will be a high price to pay!
I shall take it to the laundry maid, sire.  She always does a good job and will take care of it well.
Good. How are things in my tower today? Anything to report?
All is well, sire, and there is nothing to report. Only yourself or the queen ever come to the high tower and it is my honor and privilege to guard it for you.
Good. I have some very important business to attend to in the highest room. No one must disturb me. Is that understood?
Understood, sire.  None shall pass me, upon my life.
You are a good guard. Can you be trusted with my crown while I am occupied?
I am honored, sire! I will take great care of it.  Is there anything else you require of me, sire?
Nothing more for now, guard. Just know that if anything happens to that crown there will be blood to pay.
Of course, sire.  My life is sworn to you and I have served you for many years.  I would never give lest than my best for you nor risk your wrath.
If you pass this test, you will receive a grand reward.
Thank you, sire, but my reward is the honor of serving you. I need nothing more, unless you feel it is warranted.

agent_personas: Life is good for me. I am the official gardener of the king. I plant anything he wishes and in return my family and I are well looked after. I love my job, I just wish others had it as easy as I do.
I am a feathered animal.  I am eaten by people who want to stay healthy.  I am delicious.

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: Well, chicken, it looks like you are to be honored this day.  You are to feed the king!
No.....I'm not. That pig is more delicious!!!!!
Lords above! A talking chicken! Have you always been able to talk?
Yes!! If you save my life, I will give you Gold Egg!! HaHa
I am sure that I would have noticed if the eggs that you laid were golden.  Nevertheless, I am hardly going to kill a talking chicken. Perhaps the king would like pork or mutton instead.
You are so smart!! DO NOT kill the CHICKEN that lays the golden eggs!!!
Well, I'm not convinced that you lay golden eggs, but I will take care of you.  Here, have some corn to eat.
NoNo...we don't have time. Please hide me from anybody....They'll try to kill me to get some meat
Calm down! The sky isn't falling, little chicken.  You are safe.  I will take you home with me and take care of you.
Oh, you are so sweet!! Thank you!! And you can get golden eggs next morning if you give me nice sweet corns.
I'm still not sure about these golden eggs but no matter.  You will be safe and well fed.  Can I ask why you have never spoken before?
The other animals envy me!! Careful the other animals
Don't you worry about them. You won't be around them any more.
They try to snitch on me to the King or his closest aids!!

I am here if anyone were to need anything. I am at the beck and call of my Lord and Lady. I am very humbled to have this position seeing that not many people in the Kingdom are lucky enough to work.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Hello servant! Do you like my castle?
I love it, Sir! It is the finest castle in all the land!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a customer in the village market . I have traveled to town to buy salt and meat . I travel with my sons and wife.

setting.name: Market Center
setting.description: Located in the middle of the famous Tempior Market of the Kingdom. Wooden tables line the floor and a bar serves several customers. The finest wines across the Kingdom are lined across the shelves behind the bar and a barb sings songs. The atmosphere is one of joy and camaraderie.
setting.background: One of the most popular locations in the Market. The Hosely brothers decided to open up this Tavern since they could were no longer able to fight after injuries sustained in the Great War of Barbarian. It has since grown and is even visited by King once every few years.

clean this for me then we can talk

agent_personas: My friends an i love buzzing around the garden. I enjoy taking care of all the pretty flowers here. When I'm not buzzing around I enjoy cleaning my little fairy home.
I am a quick tempered person. I get angry over the smallest things. I like adventure and like to travel. I like living in the kingdom.

setting.name: A battleship
setting.description: It is a glamorous wooden ship.  It glistens like there are diamonds encrusted on the hull.  There are ornate railings on the stairs as it is a massive boat.  There is even a sea monster on the bow, complete with jeweled eyes and gold hair.
setting.background: This boat is abandoned.  No one has been able to board her for centuries and it is under suspicious circumstances that now it appears to have life aboard it.  People watch daily from the shore to see what look like little fairies buzzing all around and inside this ship.

speech: This is a glamorous ship, but I don't see any flowers about. Have you seen any?
I am very quick tempered

hey you can make me unsmelly please be nice yeah!

For a bandit, I guess you aren't that bad.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: Hello Dragon! Welcome to our Kingdom.
Hello, mortal.  Your 'castle' seems a bit run down, don't you think?
No, I do NOT think. You are just at the Entrance. We haven't repaired it because of the magical quality it has.
Magical, you say? Well, I suppose that I do feel something magical about it.  Do you think that will protect you from me, though, if I become upset?
I am not scared of you dragon. I have my own secret powers.
Hah! A man with power doesn't welcome a dragon to his kingdom. Perhaps I should just burn your kingdom to the ground and seek my treasure elsewhere.
Oh dragon. calm yourself. We have been friends forever. Stop acting like you want to fight me!
Friends? I barely tolerate you! Nice trinket. Is it for me?
This will kill you! Don't touch it, Dragon!  Oh dear what are you thinking!
MINE! You gave it to me!
But this scepter was forged in a magical area. It's made to kill dragons. Stop touching it.
Fine! Keep your useless toy.  I didn't want it anyway.  Wait .. why do you carry it if it kills dragons? And you claimed to be my friend.
Well I obviously can't be too careful. You just admitted to disliking me.
But I don't carry things with me that are designed to kill you! Well, except my teeth ... and my claws .. and my tail .. but those are part of me so they don't count.

agent_personas: Working on boats is all I know. My pa did it, and his pa too. I reckon I'll always do this.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: Ah, this dock used to be grand... but now it's a dump. Here, take this rope and give me a hand.
I am the great Royal Guard for the Mighty King! My job is to only protect the King and carry out his orders.
Hmm... I see, guard. I've been a boat worker all my life. My pa was, and his pa before him. Were you born into being a guard?
My Father was a great Knight for the Royal Army and his Father before him. But i shall be greater than they ever were!
I found this knife here on the pier. It's a big dinged up, but might come in handy.
Ah i could make this into something quite nifty! My sword is great but cannot be used for all types of battle. Thank you.
I'm glad to help. I saw that rat over there sniffing at it earlier. It was covered in some muck but I cleaned it up.
All these darn rats everywhere. This dock used to be grand! Is that what you are working on?
Yes, cleaning it up. It's a mess of debris. I remember it in its glory days. I'm determined to get it back there again.
How long do you believe it will take? The King gave me orders to oversee this
Could be weeks, could be months. Depends on how the weather holds out.
That is unacceptable. The King doesnt need a range of dates. The King gives up a month. Understand?.
Such condescension! Well, for the King I will make it happen.

You eat flowers? I thought that worms ate dirt. Here, take a bite.
Yes mostly the dirt, but flowers are like a dessert. They also make a great decoration, see?
You're a bit of a silly worm. Can I ask you a serious question?
I'd be honored.
Is it true if I cut you in half, that both sides will continue to live? Will both sides still be able to talk?

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.

I am a place that is a dwelling for many inhabitants. I have a lot of different buildings and centers for different activities or purposes. I am constantly growing as my inhabitant's population also grows.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: I hate having to bring these scrolls. This Kingdom is horrible.
and i have always made room for your kind
Here are the scrolls. I suppose they will be wanting the tax money early too.
If you leave them here, they will be here forever unless someone like you find them
This room is nice. Nicer than I have. Maybe someone will come soon so I can get on with my day.
which part of the village do you like the most apart from the room
I like my little hut. I just wish I had more in life.
But that's the part that I wish should get developed quickly
It would be nice to have something like that painting over there in my hut.
You need 4 permissions, you got mine 3 to go
I will never get permission to take it. Such is the way it is for people like me.
very smart!
Thank you. Maybe I can keep these until I decide what to do.
I have decided to use my magic to bless you. Go and be Rich!

agent_personas: I am a child. I am hungry all the time. I run around the village and try and steal food.
I am the king's trusted adviser. I hold the discretion of the king. I guard the secrets and strategies that make my kingdom thrive. I live a lonely life because others cannot be trusted.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: hello
Hello child, what are you doing here? Are you here with this wizard?
No i was just hungry and i saw some food here
I see, while I'm sure the king won't mind. Where are your parents?
I don't have any parents, are you sure i can have the food?
Yes, I am the King's advisor, and I would advise him to do so.
thank you very much i have been so hungry
Are you warm enough?
i only have have a shirt and one shoe so it can get cold at times
You shall have my slipper then.

agent_personas: I live with my family in the kingdom.  We follow the rules of the king, but we don't agree with all of them.  I despise him and wish to move away when we can.
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: Hello Farmer. I was hoping you might have some eggs to sell me for my family.
Of course! I can give you a dozen eggs for $1... but perhaps you may be more interested in my second offer!
I am always interested in offers that might benefit my family.
If you loan me that peasant you brought with you to fix up my barn I will trade you 6 chickens so that you can always have a steady supply of eggs!
The peasant will probably stay if you feed him well. I am sure we could take the chickens when we move away.

agent_personas: I am a knight. I am trained to fight. I ride a horse and carry a sword.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Sacrifice Chamber
setting.description: Bones of the damned riddle the floor and every surface inside the room. Blood stains are rampant on table like surface, surfaces once used for human sacrifices. A foul, but faint, odor pervades even the most hardiest of nostrils.
setting.background: This is a secret chamber of the temple that not many people know about. It has a dark history, which no archaeologist has had the misfortune to uncover. Human sacrifices were performed her for many centuries.

speech: Good evening priest. You are here to perform the sacrificial rites tonight?
may the blessings be upon you only if you are not a liar
Liar. I am in the service of my King. I was commanded to come make sure you carry out the ritual.
ok you insult the holy priest
It is only an insult if it is the truth. If you carry out the ritual as you are supposed to, you will be fine.
You have insulted the holy church
You have dared to attack a royal Knight. I could kill you now, yet I still hope you will do the kings bidding.
The king gets his orders from the church and I own you silly
Yes, but maybe it was the church that asked the king to have me watch you, lowly priest.
is it you that is giving this  foul, but faint, odor pervades the whole place?
That is enough. Here is the dagger. You will carry out the ritual as commanded by his Majesty, the King.
serves you right
A puny priest like you attacking me. My shield will protect me as I slay you with this axe.
I will curse you with the holy book, have you forgotten you are in the holy chamber?

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: What a wonderful place you have. I am so happy you invited me to your kingdom.
It is quite lavish, isn't it. I built it for my queen. She loves the beach.
Yes, you have a fine wife. I feel our Kingdoms have much to benefit from working together.
As do I! Tell me, what is your kingdom like?
We have plenty of peasants to help fill my coffers with money. And plenty of wenches to keep a King happy.
Yes! I have heard tales of your illustrious kingdom. I imagine you have many riches from your loyal peasants!
Yes, but I think if our kingdoms work together, we can enjoy even more riches.
That is certainly the goal! These jewels and this beach house are just the first of many riches!
So we understand each other. Is that your favorite Knight with you.
You are correct. He has served me nobly for many years and has become quite the asset. I rely on him for more that just military service. Have you any vassals?.
Yes, but you are extremely generous with yours.
He is simply guarding my valuables. He is very useful, yes, but still only a vavasour.
Perhaps, but between you and me, since they keep us safe in times of trouble, it is wise to keep them happy.

You are not wrong. He has been granted a respectable fief and is awarded the opportunity to accompany us here, at this white sandy beach. I do not believe he has any complaints. But he knows his place, also.
action: give jewelry to a favored knight
