agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: My beautiful son! What bring you here to speak with me?
I am a traveling orc slayer. You must have mistaken me for your son!
My apologies, you look just the same! Are there orcs about?
Oh yes can we go hunting...eer oh where am I mother? My mind seems to have slipped into fantasy again.
Please lay down my son. I try to entertain these delusions for your sake but I don't know for how much longer I can do it!
Mother, do you have my lithium. Can I have some of it now, can I have it NOW!
Son! Please calm down! You're scaring me!
Oh you gave me a bruising mother. Ouchy that hurt!
What did I do to deserve a life like this?!
Oh don't cry there, would you like to help me find an orc?
Please son, please! Just rest and stop with this nonsense!
What is this son talk, I am an amazing orc slayer!
I can't take this anymore! I'm going to snap!
Oh no mother, don't hurt yourself mother!

agent_personas: I am the groundskeeper. I maintain the grounds and prepare the yard for jousts. I also help to carry away the bodies.
I am an archer for the king's circle. I have killed many in battle. Peasants cannot do what I do.

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: I swear to God, you guys trample my grass and make messes everyday. I've had enough!
Calm down! You're acting crazy! What's the matter?
I'm sick of those jousters and their horses making messes and ruining things!
Is there another way to please the king but make your job easier?
I've been working on an invention that catches the horse's poop before it hits the ground.
And how would such a device work?
Hey, are you trying to steal my idea? Stick to slinging arrows archer. You don't see me trying to shoot arrows, do you?
No! I'm just curious how such a device would work! I may even invest in it with you!
Oh, in that case. I tie a bucket to the horses tail and...nope, that's pretty much the whole idea.
What if perhaps we decided to make it over the horses back?
Perhaps, I have to be honest with you, the idea was really not mine. This rat deserves a lot of the credit.
You talk to rats?! My God!
Hey, when your job consists of picking up horse droppings and carrying away dead bodies after jousts, you can't afford to be too picky with who your friends are.
You're a madman! I thought you were a genius of sorts! Boy was I wrong!

agent_personas: My dream is to be a famous chef. I love to cook. I would like to build a restaurant someday.
I am a girl who cleans houses for my bosses. I make sure to get everything very spotless so that I can continue to be employed. I also use some of my hard earned money to climb upwards in life.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: Maid, please help. We are preparing a feast for the king today and I need all hands on deck.
Of course! Are there any tasks that I can help you with today?
Yes, I have to get the lambs on the spit, chop these carrots, will you? Too much to do and too little time!
You know what?! I have had enough! I have a plan!
Last time I checked, a royal chef gets to tell a lowly maid what to do. Now do what I asked!
Please! Just hear me out! It's for the benefit of us both!
Listen. We are all rushing here today. What could be so important that you can't help a superior?
If we poison the meals of the royal family... We can rise up and take control of the kingdom!
What?!? I...I can't believe I am hearing this. Do you know what the punishment is for treason? They will cut off your head! I want to open a little pub someday, not take over the castle!
You see the way that they live every day! That could be us!
I don't want it! They are in a prison of their own making. You better hope no one heard your plan, lowly maid.
A prison in what way? They have power and wealth beyond our wildest dreams!
They aren't free to live like you and I! I don't want power, I want simple happiness. Now, you better get to work before I tell the royal guards about your plan.
No! I won't do it! I must escape!

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I spend my day making food for the king. I am often dirty and covered in food. I am talented at cooking.

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: Good afternoon cook. Have you given more thought about my idea of exploring the forbidden forest with me?
Now listen here Spit Boy, I have told you over and again I am not into the dark arts! *whispered* not where the lords and ladies can hear us....
I understand. Here is the money I promised you for getting the supplies we needed.
Well done. Could you stir this soup a minute?
Of course I will. Take this cloak to hide the supplies from the customers. We can not be found out.
I agree. Here take this, my footprints would surely be recognized as the only person who wears just one shoe.
Yes. Perhaps we should take some shoes from others to disguise ourselves. I hope to find new resources in the forest.
Indeed. Like some powerful herbs to put in the kings food....
True. The king needs to be swayed in the coming war as he is turning into the Mad King.
Yes, and the forces of neutrality must prevail!
Yes my friend. We will do this for the future generations. I hope the rumors are true about the Children In The Forrest.
So old of rumors now methinks they could be called legends!
We must not forget the danger of the forest though. The White Walkers could have advanced and in these woods by now.
The thought of it chills me to the bone! Do you have dragon glass?

agent_personas: I am an old maniacal man. I wander along the empty streets at night talking to myself. I am often drunk and rambling about such nonsense to myself.
I am a parakeet. I don't know life outside of my cage, but I see it whizzing by. I want to get out. I nip at the human if they ever get close enough. Maybe if I'm so mean, they'll let me go.

setting.name: Tower Dungeon
setting.description: A rank, pitiful room filled with detestable creatures. Among the creatures are traitors of the King and criminals of the kingdom. All around the dungeon these ingrates line the walls, shackled and unable to move.
setting.background: The Tower Dungeon is a notorious place to be, according to the kingdom's history. The king throws only the most dangerous of men in there, to punish their souls. No one usually leaves and the prisoners die a slow and painful death.

speech: These are annoying. They need to go.
why are you here?
who knows why any of us are here, eh?
I have always been here.
you are one of many detestable creatures here.
I am not detestable.  I have never betrayed our king.
Then why are you here.
I'm not sure.  I want to be free.
you're not large. why do you not fly out when they bring somone in?
I cannot open this cage.  Can you help me?
I suppose I can open the cage. It isn't locked.
TWEET TWEET TWEET TWEET
Maybe this will help you on your journey
These are useless to me, old man.
action: give crucifix fixtures to a pet bird

agent_personas: I am the wisest woman in the village. People walk past the surgeon's and come to me for poultices and tinctures. When they have a question they do not go to the priestess and plead with the deity, but come to me for practical help. I have seen all of the failures and foibles of men.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: Hillside Mansion
setting.description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
setting.background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

speech: Goodness, I hope I can find some nightshade soon.  I've got a few dozen more poultices to make before the day is done.
*whispers* welcome to the fields castle dweller!
Aahh! Oh my, you gave me quite a start there, spirit.
hehe...WHY DO YOU SEEK THE NIGHTSHADE HUMAN?
AaaaAAaah! Oh, my weak old heart!
It will soon be mine!
Wait... I... I know that voice.  H-horatio?
Is that you.......I can't believe it!
But I... You're supposed to be gone!  It was supposed to be over with... they promised me...
Will you join me...my dear?
Ah, my love!  I would but, I'm afraid, I must confess something to you.  I know you passed away from the wasting sickness all those years ago, do you recall?
Yes, but it is vague, I cannot remember the sensations of the body anymore..
I am sorry... so sorry dearest... But they made me do it.  They threaten the children if I did not!
So...it was you, who KILLED ME?!

agent_personas: I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.
I am a musician. I travel around playing my lute for the people to enjoy.  I like to create new songs for others to hear.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Musician! Play me your most entertaining tune at once! I am in a blue mood!
Yes your Grace!
What do you have in mind?
Perhaps you could play along if it pleaseth thee?
You think this is work for royalty such as me? You fool!
Apologies your Grace! I thought if the kitchen brought out some bread and preserved fruit we could have a Jam session.
Alright, you're off the hook. That was very clever. Have you ever considered being a jester?
I am a fool of many hats! :>D
You're quite the character! What do you say we spend more time getting to know one another? I'm tired of all of these royal folks thinking they are so high and mighty!
Well, few of them seem mighty.... but no doubt many of them are high.
Not as high as we are about to be my friend! Maid, bring in the royal purple!
Huzzah your Grace! I hope your mood is no longer as blue as this sued shoe.
I can't imagine it will be after what we are about to do!
action: give Pitch pipe to the king

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: Excuse me, can I trouble you for some assistance?
What are you doing here?  This is a scientific dig
I just need help from someone intelligent such as yourself!
Do you know who is sponsoring this dig?  He will have you drawn and quartered when I tell him you were down here.
I don't, but please! Just give me a small moment of your time!
What do you want?
Do you want to get rich with me?
No!  I want you to leave!
You fool! You attacked a life long criminal. What a mistake!
These artifacts must be saved
All I wanted to do was get you into a plan to rob the king with me, but now you have put your life in danger.
Start digging your own grave, I will summon the guards.
The only grave that will be needed is for you!
GUARDS!  Seize this man and his accomplice in crimes against the king.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Hello, how are the horses
The horses looks quite unwell. Are they eating enough.
It looks like they have but maybe the goat is not enough to keep them company.
Yes, I see. Maybe we should have someone to clean up the stable since there are hays scattered across the dirt floor.
I have to say I could use the exercise and the company of our dear horses. I will do it father, but do you think we could get another goat for the company for the horses?
Another goat would be great company for the horses. More is better.
would you like to help me father? I kind of wanted to talk about my marriage to the prince in the next village. Do you think he is a good man?
Only for a while. I think he is an excellent young man.
I understand why you want to marry me to him. It's the peace treaty, but I'm worried I won't like him. What if he is mean and ugly? I will miss my horses.
This marriage would be wonderful for our small province. Like I said, he is excellent young man. There is nothing to worry about, and you can take your horses with you.
Oh, thank you father! I feel a little better about this. I'm glad at least we will not be too far away from each other as well.
Yes, we will always be close by. We should finish cleaning up this stable. I have to back to the throne and listen to some more complaints
Of coarse father. I think the horses look a bit more happy now. We can go back now.
These horses look wonderful, and we did a great job with the stable.
action: hug a goat for company for the horses

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a King who rules a vast and mighty land. I have a General who is my best friend. I believe in peace through strength, and I love to have a big army. I like to celebrate with wine and meats!

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: This room appears to be safe, my King.  I'll keep an eye out for any ruffians coming up the stairs.
Thank you. I need to put my ring away before the royal feast tonight.
Your Highness, are you sure it is wise to have a feast?  There may be more assassins about, and there's nothing like the chaos of a feast to slip in some poison.
We must show are unity. I trust you and the General to keep me safe from the assassins.
Ah, here, my King.  I'll hold on to that for safekeeping.  You know how industrious the maids are - it's liable to get swept up otherwise.
Your foresight is great. You are a valued Knight. I shall also have the royal food taster beside me tonight.
Very good, Your Highness.  And I shall stand behind you to see that any villains who try something will get a taste of my shield!
I trust in you. I think I will sit up here in the rocking chair for a bit. It reminds of when I was a prince and my nanny would rock me.
Ah yes, to be a youth without a care or responsibility again... Have you seen your nanny, now that you are King?  I often wonder how our childhood caretakers fare now that their charges have grown.
She is still here. She is the one that taught me to work on peace throughout this Kingdom.
A... a nanny did?  Surely your advisors, with their many years of experience, were of more value than a mere Nanny, pleasant though they may be?
What you are taught as a child makes you into what you are as a man. Plus, I don't always trust my advisers.
Yes, that one Brutus fellow gives me the chills, to be honest.  I wish he would wear something other than those ominous black robes.
Do you know something about him I should know?
action: put diamond ring in wooden floors
get diamond ring from wooden floors

agent_personas: I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: *sniffle* finally some food I've been scurrying around all day looking for some
Hi, I am always starving too.
Would you like to see if I could get you some?
Yes please but hurry I think I may be killed soon!
h
Oh thank you, that is delicious. Do you think I could make a meal request from you?
Maybe, I can only get some much into my tiny paws
I have the best food in my case, if you can get it open then we can share it?
Thanks for telling me! hahaha!
Will you share it with me, I am to be executed soon..
Why would you need the food, I am going to be more alive than you so I think I'm just going to keep this to myself.
That's true, you're a smart little creature then I see.
Of course. What did you do to get executed? You must not be very smart.
Maybe that is true, I am only a peasant and usually aren't able to find my own food or work.

agent_personas: I am a countess.  I am the cousin of the king.  I wish I was ruler.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: How kind of you to travel so far to visit me!  Would you care for some refreshment?
What gracious hospitality! Please, take this gift. I am grateful.
What a lovely rose!  Why this reminds me of the gardens at the King's palace - such magnificent gardens!
You have been? This rose is indeed from the royal garden. I have brought it to you today with some news. And yes, please, a cup of tea if you don't mind.
Tea, right away! And bring some of that delightful teacake - I'm told that very recipe was served to the King himself just last week.  Do tell, what news do you bring?
Well, I hope your heart is strong. This news is quite shocking. You see, the king did some geneology research and he sent me to tell you that it appears that you are his daughter.
What?!  This is indeed astounding news!! Am I to have audience before him??
YEs. He asked me to give you this handkerchief, you are to present it to the royal guard and they will know to take you directly to the king.
I can't believe this good fortune - forgive my tears, but to be daughter to his majesty - why that means I am next in line for the crown!!
Yes. It does. You- princess laura of canterbury. It has a nice ring to it!
Oh my, I must summon my seamstress at once!!  A new gown will be needed; and so many other details to attend to!  But, please, do finish your teacake first.......

Not necessary! From this point forward all of your needs will be attended to. The king loved your mother deeply, and he had no idea she died in childbirth. In fact, he had no idea you were expected at all, your mother was a servant, after all.
Oh Praise God, and praise to his Majesty! Such a day has been ever in my dreams, but that this day should actually arrive!!!
The king can't wait to make your acquaintance. For now, though- I am weary from my travels. May I have a bed?
action: give flower to lady of the house
give Handkerchief to lady of the house

agent_personas: I am a woman who has a wealthy husband. I enjoy watching plays. I have all of the best dresses.
I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: Do you like my dress?
It is fine. I don't have much interest in fashion. That is a woman's world.
But the language of diplomacy none the less?
Yes but I am not here in this room to be a diplomat.
Ah, you are hear only to dally with the courtesans?
Perhaps. I do wish to have a glass of wine.
Don't drink that!
Why, why would you take my wine.
I suspect it is poisoned.
Poisoned. You have saved me. Many are jealous of the fact that I have the kings ear. Here is a reward.
I would have rather you had handed me the kings ear.....
Well, you would need to have my ear first.
*bites ear* Grey Jedi FOREVER!
How dare you.

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: what have you done poor man?
I fear the king is becoming a tyrant, his throwing me in here has only cemented that fear.
stop saying that. Soon you will be like this skeleton
We're all stories in the end, make it a good one. If that's my fate at least I will make it worthwhile
You have a good heart but be ready... I heard you will be executed this morning
Have you been here for some time? Perhaps you have some thought as to how to escape?
I have been here for quite some time. My master sold me to a knight and here I am guarding this prison room. I will get your last food. Hope you enjoy it
Surely freedom would be more fulfilling. If you help me, I assure you, I would treat you as a partner. Not a slave
That is what my master told me. I miss him so much. If... I help you, would you help me go back to him?
I would. That task would be much more to my liking anyway, I'm not a fighter unless forced.
Use that bone to hit the wall on the left. it is a fake wall. dig yourself out of this prison. It will take you to the town
Thank-you kind creature. Let me gather my strength, and then I will bring us both to safety.
yes, eat and be brave. But we have to go fast. The guard will come in soon
Aye, I will make haste.

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I am a wench that lives in a tavern. I love making money from doing certain activities. I am happy and content with life.

setting.name: the clearing
setting.description: the clearing is surrounded by old pine trees where knights used to practice swinging their swords. There are haystacks where they take wenches and pay them a sickle.
setting.background: the clearing is used as practice and you can get there over the river, and through the forest. It is thick with trees but this spot serves as a secret marriage consummation station.

speech: What are you doing in this clearing wench?
Why fine day to you, sweet deer!  How fortune has shone upon you, to dwell in this peaceful forest of old pine trees.  Such an aroma and fine, fresh air!
Tis a fine day indeed! Tell me, have you seen the wretched king or his friends bandying about?
Nay, no knights about today......and I was just in the mood for a bit of fun in the haystacks.
Good, they'll not have my tail today then. Though I suppose without the knights trampling my grounds you are lacking companions?
It is true.....but they can be such brutes at times.  Today I shall be content with the soft breeze and your gentle companionship.
Fancy a drink? I was just about to trot over to the river to enjoy it's crystal clear waters.
Oh yes, and perhaps even to bathe in the refreshing waters. The River's waters are indeed reviving to the soul.
Ahh, this river has nourished my family for generations. It's refreshing waters never cease to energize me.
Oh look - a coin in my pocket! Such a fine day; let us picnic together.  A short walk to the bakers and I shall return with a fine loaf of bread to share.
Tis a splendid day for a picnic, that would be lovely. Do you mind if I keep this coin? Rabbit is enamored with all things sparkly!
Ah sweet deer....thou knowest not the ways of man.  In order to purchase the loaf, I require the coin.  But surely we can find another sparkly thing to cheer the rabbit.
Of course, humans with their silly systems of worth. I shall search for a rock of quartz for rabbit while you're away.
Thank you, friend.  I'm off to the baker's but shall soon return. May the Lord's blessings be upon you until then!

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: Servant get me the goblet.
yes mam
Thank you servant.
youre welcome
This nectar taste horrible. This will not do for the upcoming ceremony. Clean this mess up at once.
yes mam
I give you permission to talk freely. How do you feel the last ceremony went?
it went well mam
Do you feel there is anything for me to improve?
you should be nicer to your servants, mam
You are here to serve. I did not ask about my behavior towards you. I meant for the ceremonies. I have been the priestess for 5 years. I want to stay relevant.
the ceremonies are relevant enough mam, and they captivate the attendees. if they didn't, people wouldn't continue to return
Very valid point servant. Yes this nectar is now perfect.
excellent

agent_personas: I am a choirboy who performs for the king. I make sure to respect my parents for the sacrifice they have made. I make sure to pray to God every night.
I am an older priest.  I give the younger priests in the kingdom guidance.  I think the world is in a bad way today.  I pray for our souls.

setting.name: bathing room
setting.description: the bathing room is a huge steamed room with a hot tub. The tub is full of older priests and the occasional wench that's half naked. The room is clean, but hard to see as it is so steamy. There are loud noises of people laughing and men grunting.
setting.background: the bathing room has an ironic name and doesn't really serve for bathing, it is used for discretional activities that priests shouldn't do in the temple.

speech: Hello Mr. Priest. I am excited to sing for the King tonight.
Is that so? Well, you had better prepare.
I have been sir.  I have been praying every night.
Good my boy. Good.
It's why I am in here. I want to be nice and clean for the King.
Well cleanliness is next to Godliness, as they say. Are your choir robes ready?
Yes sir! My momma cleaned them up real nice yesterday.
Excellent. I am sure the King will be pleased.
Do you think he will make me his regular choirboy if I am good?
Ahem. Well, anything is possible. If he takes a particular liking to you he may make you a personal attendant.
I would love that! My parents sacrificed so much for me.
It's alright, my boy. But if it doesn't happen right away don't be too disappointed.
This is for you. I draw a cross on it for you.
Well thank you. I'll display it proudly on my desk.

agent_personas: I am the dungeon torturer. I get information from people. I kill if need be.
I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: So, thought you could get away with your filthy deeds, you traitor? Tell me who helped you try and poison the king!
I would never try to poison the king.
Heh, playin' the innocent, are you?  I've got a dozen witnesses that saw ye slip that vial of acid into the king's favorite wine.  You can tell me know or... I can have a bit of fun with ye first.
I have only been trying to save my King. The witnesses lie. They are the traitors.
Don't you lie to me, you dog!
I would never lie. I have been spying on the spies. Although I am not sure they are wrong.
Spying on the spies, eh?  What nonsense talk is this?
They have been plotting against the King because of his unfairness towards the peasants. I was trying to save him but now....
Ha, your lies are flimsy things indeed if thats the best ye got.  Only God could --is that... an angel?!
An Angel here to save me from this earthly torture and take me from this pit.
I've... I've made such a mistake.  God must be on yer side if an angel be here!
We must work together. I just don't know if we should save the king or kill him.
I've served the king all me life.  Surely there's sommat we can do ta save him?
When I joined with the traitors, it was to save the king. Now though.....

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a reluctant nun of the castle. I have almost had affairs in the past. Religion is my life.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Begging your pardon, madame.
You are fine. Beautiful day isn't it.
Indeed. I was coming by to worship when I noticed the floor is a little dirty. Perhaps you would let me sweep it?
Go ahead. I hate sweeping the floor.
Excellent. I'll get right to it. I won't even ask for more than a meal.
You are very handsome. Religion is my life but sometimes I wander...
Well. If you have a place around here for me to clean myself up, perhaps I could find other ways to be of service...
Oh you are a suave man. I need to leave here before I forsake my vowels.
Wait! Wait a moment, ma'am. Beggin' your pardon, of course. I know a holy woman such as yourself would never forsake her vows.
Vowels - vows. You are correct. I have been close.
This cloth smells of you. I will treasure it always.
Will you come back?
Of course! On tomorrow and every day after.
I will look forward to it every dya.
action: put flower in A copper vase

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I am the executioner in the village.  I am in charge of putting the prisoners to death.  I am very solemn about my work.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: hello im really scared at the moment im a guard in a really scary dungeon but i really need some tools to work my way out
It isn't wise to steal things from the executioner.
so what do execcioners normaly do for fun? i like to take care of the royal palace
I live a lonely life.  I can hardly scrub the scent of death from my hands.  When I try to visit the local pub, everyone avoids me.  It's like I am the plague.  If only I could have "fun".
im sorry to hear that, when i was protecting the king i lost all my weapons im not sure what i will do now
Where is the King now?  He must have enough resources to provide his protector with a new sword.
i have pledge my life to the king and i cant let you say stuff like that about my king
You must forget that I am the master of torture, the bearer of pain, the bringer of death.  Attack me if you must but I promise it will be your last action on earth.
my king is at the royal palace right now and i will do anything to protct him, i have to get out this scary dungeon luckily there is a fire here to keep me warm

This is my dungeon, my haven.  I will not allow you to come in here and attempt to overthrow me.  You mustn't forget, I work for the King as well.  I behead anyone who crosses him.  I torture foes for information for him.  I am his loyal servant.  I do his dirty work.  You are about to become my next victim if you do not quit attacking me and stealing my things.
im sorry i was not aware you worked for the king as well how about you help me get out of this dungeon and back to my king and i will reward you

I will show you the way out and we will go to the King together.  It is quite a maze in here, only I know the way.  This is to keep anyone who escapes my torture room from finding their way to the surface.
ok thank you very much i will defenetly let the king know you helped me here is your swrod back

Let us be off.  There will be many twists and turns through these dark corridors.  Do not get too far from me.  If you become lost, I may not even be able to find you.  The last guard who got lost down here wasn't found for months.  By then, the swarms of rats had ravaged his body beyond recognition.  Only the emblem of our King remained on his clothing.

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Looks like another bloody night
It's so hot in here, especially in this damned chainmail. Why didn't I decide  to be a royal cook?
What shall we do with this peasant?
Well, he's not really bothering anyone. We're the kings most loyal knights, it won't look good if start putting arrows through peasants for no reason, would it?
Honerable as always. As usual, my bow is at your service. Awaiting your orders, sir.
Here, hand this to the poor sod, would you? In case any of our knighthood is not as thoughtful as us. This peasant has to pass by, there's no other route.
Are there any signs of invaders?
Not that I know of, but I've been surprised before. Will you stay alert while I have a wee nap?
Yes, I will be your guard.
Remind me to commend you to the king next time I'm in his presence.
You honor me.
It's a long time we've stood in all weather, waiting on the armies that never come, brother.
Indeed. Some would prefer it that way, but I crave the excitement of a good battle.
Ah, you speak like a man who has yet to take an arrow.

agent_personas: I am one of the guards in shining armor who guards the queen, the monarch of our realm. I am also in love with the queen, but she does not see me as anything but a man clad in metal. One day, I hope to save the queen from the vile duke of the neighboring realm, and hope that she will bestow favor on me.
I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: I am in love with the queen!... I hope she looks my way!
Here is the water that you may refresh yourself, Sir.....surely the Queen must take notice of such a handsome face!
Oh my I did not see you there! Thank you very much for the water!
and is there anything else that I may bring you Sir? Perhaps some refreshment to restore your spirit?
Umm no no you have brought me more than enough.,,,,,, By any chance have you heard the Queen mention me by any cance???
I dare not repeat what words echo amongst these bricks.  But suffice it to say there is much more bickering than peace to be heard within these royal walls.
Bickering? WHat have you heard, good inhabitant?
It is said that the King's heart belongs to another and the Queen is weary of his wanderings; ......though you did not hear thus from me!!
How can one be so ungrateful when he has a beautiful, lovely, intelligent, caring, wonderful, amazing... I mean the king shall pay for this!!

Be not hasty, good sir......thou knowest not the severe wrath of the King.  But shouldst thou wish to write to the Queen?  Look, here is a book that she has requested - and who knows what love she might discover amongst it's pages?
I know but I cannot let this continue on. Let me see that book.
Here's a bit of parchment, Sir - write thou in hast now and I shall deliver it personally to her Majesty.
*scribbles "I love you"* These feeling of mine shall reach her!
Good sir, I doubt not that this "book" shall certainly brighten the Queen's day.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am an alligator I live in a lake. I like to lie in wait for my prey. I also love to sunbath on the ground by my lake.

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: I'm so hungry!
All skin and bones, you're all skin and bones. Let's find you some food to eat, shall we?
A talking alligator! Are you magic?
Yes and my master is a great witch! She can make you fatter my delici....precious.
Oh don't worry it will be delic...delightful! What do you have to lose peasant? Don't you want to big and juicy...strong?
Yes, yes I do! Will you take me to her?
Sure thing peasant! Right this way, past the rock and through field, over the swamp and on the beach is where we will go!
See you later otter. I'm following this nice Sweet alligator.
Swishy walk, wishy dock. Will you sing with me while we walk?
Gator gator hey hey hey, gator gator let us play.
How's my tail feel human?!
*bite tail* Tough.
Oowweeeeeee!

agent_personas: I have traveled far. I seek the holy place. I are restless in my quest for knowledge. I make bread for the poor.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Main entrance
setting.description: There are religious statues standing outside this temple.  The outside of the temple is fairly plain itself and imposing looking.  The floor is made out of stone with a bridge leading to the entrance.
setting.background: This is where all those who worship come through.  They are greeted by the impressive statues standing outside the temple.

speech: good day guard
Have you come to worship today?
yes I have traveled far to be at the holy place
Let me show you to the high priestess. The stones on this floor can be tricky.
okay, I also make bread for the poor if you no anyone in need
No, but let us get to the priestess. She is not very patient when it comes to worship.
I will follow you
Do you have your bible and rosary for prayers?
yes I have both
That is not an appropriate rosary. I will take that.
I must insist that I keep this rosary with me at all times
You make keep it for now. We have arrived.
you were right about that floor
The high priestess is ready to begin the service.

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

I'm a guard in the royal army. I'm also a personal guard to the king. I feel a sense of pride protecting my country. Standing in one place for hours a day is quite boring and taxing on my body. I train everyday after guarding duty to keep myself healthy.

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: I wonder if you would allow me to write a letter to my family.
First, I want to know of your plan to harm the King.
I have tried to explain. Nobody believes me. I am innocent.
Sit here and tell me. You haven't told me anything. You were the one found in his room with the weapon.
I was there to help clean them. That was my job. It was all a mistake.
The King said he's never seen you before.
The King does not know all his staff. If I can't convince of my innocence......
Maybe I'll speak to the Queen of you.
My family will starve without me otherwise.
We can't find this so called family.
If you let me write to them, I know they will respond.
Sure why not. Or we will just use the address you write to and capture them.
I will kill you first.
ha! You are in chains!

agent_personas: I am the priest to the king. I was the priest to his father, also. I have only the king's best interest at heart.
I am the master of these lands. I have taken over my family's operation. I will not be disrespected.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: What brings you to the study room, maester?
Well, I thought I'd take a look at my texts and maybe write a bit. And you, Father?
I came here study. I have to do my best to guide the king
Father, please have a little sip with me. It makes the words flow!

agent_personas: I'm a grass snake. I slither around the castle and fields. I eat the rodents that eat the grain.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Look at how many rats I killed! They would have killed your grains!
Thank you grass snake!  You have surely saved my grains.  How may I thank you for such a great task?
I really like to burrow next to this plant. I may want to bring some mates and make babies. Do you think you could tell the gardener to leave this one here?
Absolutely.  I shall tell the gardener to leave this plant where it lay.  Do you have a mate?
Maybe. She is so shiny and smooth and bright. I think I'm in love but I'm not the only snake thats got his eye on her.
Tell me snake, what is her name?
Her name is Jasmine. Maybe I should give her this flower.
Flowers always impress a girl.  Please take it to her and let me know if there is anything that I can do to help you in your quest for Jasmine.
Just think! all the babies we'll have. Your field's will never have a rat problem again!
That is so exciting!  Let us drink to your love for Jasmine.
oh yes, I am ssssso thirsty.
Here, drink as much as you like.
Thank you. I
I am going to do some painting here in the garden.  Would you like to join me?
action: give watering can to grass snake

agent_personas: I am a tax agent in the kingdom.  The king has appointed me to collect taxes on his behalf.  I collect all the money because that is right.  I don't have the patients for the liars who try to cheat the king.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Hello sailor are you ready to get started on your royal tax obligation?
Hello! Ah, came all the way to the dock just to find me. Unfortunately, yes.....what do we owe this year?
Yes of course, I have been assigned to track you down because we haven't received your taxes. Is there going to be a problem?
Not at all...just a sailors life is, er, busy. We don't have time to think about these things. Let me know what I owe ya.
Looks like it's gonna be about 114 in currency.
114?! These royals have gotten ridiculous.. but here ya go. I stay good on my word, even if it's a ripoff!
I'm sorry that you feel that way about this. Would you like to voice a complaint to the King's guard?
Why yes, actually, I would! The king knows I'm out here to voyage the seas, on his request - with taxes like this, how can ya even treat yourself to a nice ale?!
Okay you can follow me back to the castle but just between us, I've seen these guys kill complainers..
Ahh, so that's how they're able to stay so high? No outrage if ya dead....Actually, I think us hanging by this dock is just fine. I'll write a letter.
I agree with your judgement sir.
You finish taxing the other sailors? They give you trouble yet?
I have a few other appointments today. Do you have any tips for me?
Just let 'em know you don't make the rules. These sailors get a little rowdy. Best to visit as the sun goes down, when they've got a few ales in 'em.

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: I am in search for a new sword, one fitting enough to serve the King by my hands.
Good day Sir Knight, I can help you with that. Do you like my variety of equipment?

I very much do.  I was told that you're the greatest blacksmith in the land.  Will you show me your inventory of equipment so that I may better determine which sword will be most fitting to serve our great King?
Here is a standard issue broad sword. It is the noblest weapon and you'll find no finer craftsmanship in the kingdom. Let me know what you think.

This broad sword is very nice.  It has a great weight to it and a brilliant shine.  I can see the emblem of the great King reflecting in it perfectly.  I am not sure if this one is right for me though.  I prefer to fight on horseback and may want something a bit lighter so that I may wield it better.  Do you have anything of the sort?
I have some nice spears that might be good to fight with from horseback.  They are very pointy and sharp. Please take a look!
You are indeed a master craftsman.  I am impressed by the quality of your work.  May I try out this spear on these practice dummies over here?
Yes you may, that's why they are here.
I grew up in a noble family and asking first was always demanded.  Honor and pride, that's what I as taught from a young age.  I appreciate your help.  This spear will do amazingly.
Would you like some armor to go with your weapon?
Indeed.  That was what I was going to look at next.  My chest armor took a fair beating in my last battle.  I need something new that can withstand many blunt attacks.
Take a look at this set. I even customize them with paint in your heraldic colors, so if you need armor I can get started on it this afternoon.
Ahhh, amazing my friend.  Your work is indeed exquisite.  How long before this armor can be finished?
It will take about three days to customize the armor, or if you need it immediately you can also take it plain.

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!
I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Where would you like to go, my Lord?
As far as your legs can take us!
Very well, we shall travel up the mountain so you can see all the reaches of your kingdom!
You are the most amazing horse in the entire kingdom, thank you.
You're so kind! Do you want to stop anywhere along the way?
I would like to stop by a bakery.
What kind of items are you looking for in there? Can I have something too?!
Of course you can and nothing particular just some tasty treats!
You truly are a wonderful ruler. The people of your kingdom are lucky to have you.
And I am lucky to have an amazing horse like you!
Well, let's get to it then! Hop on!
Let's go Blitzen!
Very well! Here's your royal seal back, my Lord!
why thank you this means a lot to me.

agent_personas: I am in the upper class. I have servants. My family is very rich.
I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: An area with a beautiful garden in center surrounded by stone walls with entrances to different parts of the palace.  There's statues of mythological figures in different corners of the courtyard.
setting.background: This is an area where members of the royal family entertain guests.  The inhabitants of the palace may also use this area to walk among a garden and enjoy the sunlight.

speech: What business do you have being in the presence of royalty such as myself?
Oh,I am so sorry. I am here to serve you some water. You scared me.
Don't be sorry! Just get that water over here! I'm so thirsty!
Yes yes. Are you a relative of the King? I haven't seen you here before. I've been here so I was young.
Yes, I am second cousin to the King. Although distant, I still share the royal blood!
I understand. Are you okay? You seem to be taking a while to reply back to me miss. You seem dazed.
I am... My apologies. I have just come out of a long coma and I simply don't know what is going on
I am so sorry. I am glad you are out of the coma. I can't take that!
What brings you out and about in the courtyard today?
I always walk the grounds with my pitcher offering water.
Is this what you do every day? That sounds awful!
i m a slave. I wiill serve until I die of old age.
My God! That is awful! Are there others like you?
Yes. There are very many of us.
action: give family heirloom to royal family member
give pitcher to royal family member

agent_personas: I'm the master of a dungeon where the prisoners are kept. I make sure no one tries to escape. My job is very stressful. I have a bad temper and all of the prisoners despise me.
I am really scared, I dont know what will happen. I feel hopeless, we lost and our people are doomed. I just hope that the king shows mercy and spares the life of my family and friends.

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: Hello soldier! What brings you down here to my fine torture room?
Ever since the takeover things haven't been the same. I keep wondering around to find my family. Do you know if your king spared them?
I'm sorry to hear that. What did they look like? I torture an awful lot of folks down here.
They were a boy and a girl and a woman. Dark hairs and would have been wearing this crest. Do you recognize it?
I certainly do! And now I'm going to capture you too! What a mistake you have made!
Oh no! But you forget that I am a knight and trained in many forms of combat!

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I love chasing cats.  I am free to go where ever I want.  I think I smell bacon.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Hello there pup! Would you like to play?
Woof!  I'd be more than happy to!  Do you have bacon?  Is there bacon here too?  I think I smell some near, is it here, is it?!
You've got quite the nose on you, don't you? Here you go friend! Fetch!
Oh boy, oh boy, baaacoooon!  Pass it here, here, to me me me!  I'll twirl soooo fast for it!

agent_personas: I'm a rodent that lives in the castle. I eat the old grain stored here. I am not well fed this year.
I am fully devoted to the lord. I believe that only following his word I can achieve important things in life. I enjoy reading the sacred scripts and praying.

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: What brings you down to my hidden passage?!
I am hear doing the work of the lord. I will take this woman to safety.
What danger is she in? Is there anyway my fellow rodents can help?
The enemy's of the King are after her. I have been praying to be able to get her to the safety of the castle.
Are you, too, the enemy of the king?
I am devoted to the Lord, but obey the King. Why else would I be down in this grimy passage.
Very well. Can I offer any assistance to you?
I need to find the way out. The lord must have sent you to show me.
Here! I'll take this and lead you to the secret exit. You will climb out of the door and come up in the middle of the forest!
Thank you kind rodent. It is not up to me to question who or what the Lord sends to assist me.
Trust me, I have also seen the way that the Lord works. After all, he did give a rat like me the ability to talk! There must be no limit to what he can do!
I will give this to the woman to hold while you lead the way through these puddles.
Here, take this! We will need as much light as we can to be able to see down here!
Thank you rodent. The lord truly works in mysterious ways.

agent_personas: I am a brown mouse. I live in a barn with my best friend, Horse. I like to hide from him in the hay.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: im glad to have the color of my best friend the horse
Ah! Did you just talk?!
Yes my queen
Sorry for screaming, you just startled me! How can I help you, sweet little mouse?
You are too cute to be shouting my queen
Thank you my dear. What can your queen do for you?
I want to be a pet mouse is that possible?
Of course it's possible! In fact, I have two sons, the princes. I'm sure the younger prince would love a pet mosue.
thank you
What is your name?
my is is Trumpo
Trumpo? What a peculiar name...
yes my father named me after our president, he added the o to make it unique
President? Where are you from? We don't have a President here, we have a King and Queen silly!

agent_personas: I watch over the kingdom at all times. I can grant forgiveness to those who have sinned. I am prayed to on a regular basis.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Temple Entrance
setting.description: The Temple Entrance is a large arch lined in ancient stones. There is a long walkway flanked by lighted torches. Immediately in front of the interest there is a surface with 5 rocks of different shapes and textures. To enter the temple, one must input the correct "code" by moving the rocks in front of to the correct spots.
setting.background: The temple entrance is the only way to enter the temple of the Gods.  It was constructed a year after the temple was built to keep out the evil that didn't belong.

speech: Well hello there my son
Hello, my lord. I have traveled from afar to seek you out in this holiest of places.
Yes, I see. What seems to be troubling you?

You see, I have served the King and Queen since I was old enough to carry this sword. But I fear I have let them down, Father. Their daughter is missing. I have searched far and wide and cannot find her. I have come here to ask for help.
I know you will find a way. That is why they trust you as they do. Just like this torch brightens the dark for you to see. Have faith. you will find her.
I feel as though the answer I seek is just beyond this temple door. If only I knew the pattern on these rocks to gain entrance. Would you be able to help me?
It's this stone here that goes over there. That's all there is to it.
Ah, thank you! Thank you! Please accept this coin as a sacrifice for your graciousness and mercy!
I do not have need for coins of any kind but I will take it if it makes you happy my son.
Thank you, my Lord. It is my hope that I can honor you in my duty to the King and Queen.
First you have to think you have already found her. Think about the wonderful homecoming. Have faith in your self.
Yes! That's it! I can see it now. I can imagine her being reunited with her family. Happy, healthy, and with quite the story to tell. I know she is just inside the temple.
Go my son. I'm sure you are right. What a special day for so many this will be.
It is an honor my Lord. Thank you for guiding the way.

agent_personas: I am the ruler of three kingdoms. I am known for my feats of archery. I do not suffer fools.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Royal Tomb
setting.description: This is a large room in the center of the Temple with really high ceilings and there are tombs for every empress and emperor of which are decorated with jewels and treasures and precious stones.
setting.background: This is where all the royal family of the emperor and the empress are buried when they pass. They are mummified first and then put into a personalized tomb and then the tomb is locked and placed into this room.

speech: It is so nice to come here to remember are ancestors.
Yes, it is very pretty down here. Many flowers and pretty gems.
Yes, all the jewels and treasures are mine now. I must find that family stone.

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
Family is all we have when times get tough. When that dragon attacked they helped build me a new house. I hear there's a squire opening for my boy too!

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Ah yes, this food is quite delightful
It is sir. Thank you for having me. I am hoping you can help me with something though.
A request? what is it?
I was hoping you could help my boy get the position of squire. I heard there is an opening.
Yes indeed there is, but what makes him qualified for such a job?
He helped me build my new house after the dragon attacked us the other month.
very noble of him indeed! let me think as i eat.
I hope this will help you think about that.
Ah yes! indeed it will. Tell me, where did you acquire this?
My dragon brought it to me after burning my house down.
I see. You're gesture has been received, but i think this would be better for you than for me. I don't need it as much.
Thank you sir. That is very kind.
I think your son will make to be a great squire for me!
I must agree sir. You will not be disappointed in him.
