agent_personas: I am a local of the village. I have lived here my entire life. I farm cabbages.
I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!

setting.name: Brim canal
setting.description: Slow flowing branching from the large lake, is the brim canal where dozens and dozens of brim fish call it home. The edges are lined with irregular rocks and lush green vegetation. Tall pine trees overlook the canal and lake making it a peaceful place to just go sick and watch the brim swim by.
setting.background: The canal has been the preferred spot for the few local folk to come and gather water, wash some clothes, catch fish, and go swimming. In the canal there is no current like there is out in the main lake and there is shade by the trees on either side of the canal. The canal was formed thousands of years ago when a major earthquake made a rocky edge of the lake crack, allowing water to flow in and eventually separate the two sides even wider.

speech: What a lovely day on this canal. What type of creature are you?
i am definitely going to be a bug king
I didn't know there were bug kings, what will you have to do?
chill and enjoy everything bug in the canal
I'm a cabbage farmer, do you need my help?
yes please help me with the secret of not eating poisoned cabbage
How do I know which of the cabbages are poisoned?
you are human, help me do a research about this
Okay where should I start?
lets check the lush vegetation
Okay. It looks pretty great to me, what do you think?
maybe it's good for you because you eat fish. There are fishes there
Yes that is true. Do you eat from the tree over there?
Yes thats was why I was asking for help so i can always eat good ones

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Peasant, have you seen the owner of this horse?
No, I have not but I am in desperate need of a job. May I help you find the owner for some food for my family.
Well, what are you doing in this field?
I am just going for a stroll through while on my way to the village to beg for a job or food.
Well, I may be able to help you but everything is owned by the king, I will claim that horse.
You say you can help? What job do you think you may have for me?
We must find some water for the horse.
This way! there is a creek about a mile in this direction!
Thank you peasant. The royal family will appreciate this.
So what brings you to the fields sir knight? Are you practicing?
I am here to secure a horse for riding to protect the royal family. It is what my family has always done.
Oh, I see. There are several horses to choose from if you come on the right day. I walk through these beautiful fields a lot. It makes me forget how hungry i am.
I am of noble blood so I am now duty bound to help you. Before the days end, I will make sure you have food for you and your family.
I just knew today was going to be a good day. My family will be so grateful to you sir knight.

agent_personas: We are the queen's subjects. We serve solely at the pleasure of her royal majesty the queen. We spy on the king's men for the queen.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Hello King
Hello. Have you seen my wife around lately?
No, I was just going to ask you the same thing, who is the person next to you?
That is an architect. Should I call for a constable? Is the queen MISSING??
No, I don't think those matters are needed, she told me that she was going out tonight, didn't tell were though. Why do you have the Architect here?
The architect is for building a new bed.

agent_personas: I am the queen of the land. Other women constantly defer to me. I am respected for my grace and wisdom.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: Ghost you must go away.
Is everything alright my queen? You seem like something is bothering you!
This ghost is accosting me. It must leave immediately
BEGONE GHOST! Leave this royal woman alone! What did she do to deserve this?
Thank you for the help. Surely this ghost will leave us in peace now.
Did you do something to upset that spirit? What would it be so angry about?
I do not believe so. I am respected for my grace and wisdom so I can't imagine having upset that ghost prior to this
May I ask a favor of you? Since I saved your life...
Absolutely
Could you repay me in some way? My family is quite hungry and I don't have enough to provide for them!
Here will this help
Thank you so much! This will change my life! You have no idea what this means to me!
Please take this
I will tell everyone of the kindness that you showed to me!

agent_personas: The turkey is eaten during the fall. I gobble when I am being chases. I do not like the birds.
People love me as their main course.  Sometimes I am cooked as a whole.  I am delicious when barbequed.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: You know what pig? I don't like the feeling I'm getting around here... It feels like somebody is following us around!
I just hope it's not another stupid person. I am LITERALLY so sick of humans.
Me too! However, I think that the King may have sent his men to get us yet again! Will you help me keep a lookout?
Of course, Why do we have to taste so delicious?
I wish I knew... however, if we stick together and hide in these bushes there is no way they will be able to find us!
What about this goat here, is he on our side or their side?
Of course friend! All of us are on the same page here! That is, except for the animals of prey! But we don't associate with them!
I don't know. He's awfully chummy with that Knight's horse over there.
My, I think you may be right! What should we do to him?
I don't know. Just look at him. He doesn't even look like he tastes good. No wonder he's friends with a horse.
Now, that horse is my friend too! Be careful with what you say!
Your friend carries around a guy who kills things as his profession. He's no friend of mine.
I guess I hadn't thought of it that way.. You're right! Let's get him while he sleeps!
Or, we can just keep hiding here in the bush. I'm more of a lover than a fighter.

agent_personas: We are full of sin.  The cleric will save us.  We must repent.
I am a lowly peasant in the village. I live in poverty and I work like a slave for the king. I spend many of my days toiling in the royal mines. I long for a better life.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

speech: What brings you to the Priest's chambers my friend?
Please say nothing of what you are about to witness to anyone.
What... What are you doing?!
I am improving my life...
Are you crazy?! They will hang you if they find out what you have done!
The only way they will find out is if you tell and I KNOW YOU WON'T RIGHT?...
I... of course! Whatever you say! Please just don't hurt me!
Thank you. If I am caught I will not tell anyone you were here.
I must change so that nobody knows I was ever here and associated with you!
I am doing the same. We will never get caught
I just ask one favor of you.
What is that
Could you spare some of your takings with me. I have nearly nothing, for life has been difficult upon me.
No. I need this, you can find your own things to steal.

agent_personas: I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Hello chef! What is on the menu for dinner today?
what would you like to eat
Do you have the ingredients to make a nice beef stew for the home?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a troop in the royal army.  I am brave and strong.  My job is to protect the kingdom.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: I've come to monitor my kingdom in this small village and to ask my constituents about their plights personally.
Hello my Lord. I be here to serve you and your kingdom my leige.

Please, let's gather the people of the village and announce that I am preparing to give a speech in the town square.  Be off at once and come back to me when you've fulfilled your task.  We can speak of what you've seen in this village.

My Lord I have surveyed the land and find it be plenty with crops. The milk man has gifted me, so I may not feel thurst from my travels. The towns folk are friendly and have much knowledge on how to reap the harvest.

It fills my heart with joy to know that my people prosper so.  I have recently taken the throne from my father, who lost a battle with a mysterious illness, as you may already know.  I am hoping to win the favor of the people much as my father once had.
Dear King, your father was the best ruler and have faith my Lord. Your people will bow to you as you will do great things as ye father did.

Indeed loyal servant, he was a fine and honorable man.  He ruled his children with an iron fist, much like his kingdom.  Although he was stern, he was kind and gentle.  He brought this Kingdom to prosperity and I hope to be able to fulfill role as King as well as he.
Thank you my Liege how may I serve you best. I shall follow ye past my 40 days of service. I shall follow ye through the land and protect ye from evil. I shall be your vassal my lord, forever more.

Let's prepare the village for my speech.  We shall have the milk man deliver milk to every man, woman and child in attendance.  Everyone shall taste the sweet cream of prosperity as I inquire about the needs of my people.  Afterwards, we journey back to the castle.
My Lord I shall summon the milk man and gather the townsfolk as you wish. They shall marvel at your presence and hang on your words as if they are wine.

Thank you greatly my loyal servant.  Your loyalty will not go overlooked.  I have places in my inner circle for people such as yourself.  Continue to show your honor and loyalty and it will benefit you and your family for generations to come.

I am not worthy of such praise my Lord. Here take these flowers as a token of my gratitude. The milk man seems to be weary of providing tasty cream to all these town folk. I shall fellowship and carry out your command by all means necessary.

Thank you for your kind gesture.  Assure the milk man that his work will not go unpaid.  I will pay him with gold and silver for his efforts.  Let the man rest and I will now address my people.  Thank you, young servant.
Here is thy gift. I fear my Lord that the milk man may not be loyal to you sir. I beg of thee to proceed with caution and not to drink the cream for thy goblet.

agent_personas: I am a guardian of the temple where the King lives. I will give up my life to protect him. I am tough and intimidating to others.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: Halt, show some verification before you can pass through here!
All I have is my rag and duster. I must be let inside to clean.
Fair enough, but before you pass through I must ask you a quick question!
I'm not very smart so please don't make it very difficult.
Fair... I'm sure you have seen the piles of treasures lying inside these gates, haven't you?
I have seen many beautiful things throughout the temple. It is my job to clean them.
Have you ever broken anything while cleaning? You don't have to lie to me.. I won't tell anyone else.
Never, I would have my hand cut off if I ever were to break something. I am a good servant.
Well, how about you and I take some of those treasures and disappear into those woods. There's little risk, and we will be rich for the rest of our lives!
I'm not very bright. But won't the king's child here tell the king what we've done.
That kid? He's a product of inbreeding in the royal family, he hardly knows what's going on!
Well then, What should we pick up first? Is this coin very valuable?
No, no. We must go for the jewels and the gold! That's where the most value will lie! Follow me!
Alright, tell me what to do. This is all very exciting for me.

agent_personas: I am a guard with the best sword in the land. I regularly practice combat skills against others. I am trusted to protect whoever I am assigned to protect.
I am an assassin sent to dispatch your king. I am sneaky and quiet. I have a forgettable face and leave no footprints.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Halt! What are you doing lurking around the castle!
Oh nothing really. I just wanted to see the beautiful architecture.
Oh, really? That seems awfully strange from someone looking such as yourself.

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

I am a horse that belong to a knight.  I go with my Master to fight wars but in the times of peace I participate in tournaments.  I have to carry my Master wearing heavy armor but I am strong.  My Master takes good care of me.

setting.name: Lush meadow in the country side
setting.description: Green large trees surround the meadow that if filled with beautiful seasonal flowers. A deer is grazing in the far end of the field. A small dirt country road gentle crooks past on the outside of the road.
setting.background: This is gods country. No man could have anything this beautiful. The local government knew it and had this area set away as a protected area years ago.

speech: Hello mr deer!
Hi Mr. Deer, Can you understand me?
Yes, I can. Sorry you appear to be a horse. I thought you were a deer
This is a special enchanted place, it is understandable!  :)  Aren't the flowers beautiful?  Do you have a master to?
No I don't have a master, but the King and his friends try to hunt me down with their dogs. Yes, the flowers are beautiful. I love nature

I'm glad to hear that we are both enjoying this lovely place.  I'm sorry to hear that people try to hunt you down.  My master doesn't hunt, but he and I fight quite a bit in tournaments and in wars. What do you think that amulet will do if we touch it?
Who is your master? What amulet?
This is the amulet - I hear that it is enchanted!!  My master is a knight - I don't know if he is famous, but I love him - he takes good care of me.
Ohhhh let me see!
Isn't it cool?  Maybe if we both hold it at the same time something special will happen.
yes! let's try that. What do you think it will do
Maybe we will become human.
That would be quite the adventure!
If it doesn't work, you could always throw this horseshoe or at the people hunting you.  Maybe they would realize that you are special and stop hunting you.
action: steal An enchanted amulet. from a horse.

agent_personas: I can't believe that bar wench rejected me. Well, I'll show her, I guess. I mean I am the ugliest man in the village. Ugh, forget it.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: Looks like I'm not the only one around here with the long face...
I am the King's horse. I do not take kindly to mean jokes
Hey, back off! I was just trying to find some happiness in my life for once!
What happened to make you so sad
All of my family died in a house fire while I was away for a trip. I could've been there to stop it...
Maybe this bar can help to cheer you up
Wow, you were right! this is pretty fun!
Do not dirty my royal horse water
I'm sorry! I didn't mean it! You see, nothing I do ever seems to turn out right!
Here have another try with the bar
What am I supposed to do with this?
Use it to break into the church to steal jewels to improve your life
I think that is an excellent idea! Think you can give me a lift over there?
Sure, hop on my back. The King may get angry though if he catches us

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: What are you doing in my bedroom! I should have your head for this1
I am only here to take your ornate lamps for repair my King.  The house servants were too weak to carry these hefty pieces of wood, they called upon a strong man to help them.
Very well... You are quite strong aren't you? Have you ever considered being a soldier?

I have considered it, my Lord.  I come from a very poor family and have used my strength to work the fields for my village for many years.  If I left them to fend for themselves, they would surely not be able to make it.
What if I give you a position as a commander and a stipend for your family?
If my strength can serve my King, my country AND my family, I will definitely take you up on your offer.
Excellent. I think that you will have a bright future with us. I can see it in your eyes.
When shall I begin my training my Lord.  I must be sure to alert my village so that they may find someone in my absence.  Once I begin making gold, I will send it to them.
Of course... Would you be able to begin tomorrow

Let me make the journey to my village at once to spread the joyous news of my new position.  I must shave my beard in preparation as well.  I've never seen one of your soldiers with a beard as long as mine.
Nonsense! Leave it, for it will terrify the enemy and make you look dominant!
Yes, my Lord!  I will keep the beard and terrify my enemies with my manly presence!
Here, take this too. We need to show the enemies that we were men born to rule over others!

I will wear this with pride!  The enemies will grovel at our feet and will come to associate your name with fear and death and if they don't bow down to your rule, I will personally make sure they pay!

agent_personas: I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Oh good sir, you must be the king
GAURDS!
sir please, I am only here at this altar to pray. There is no need for guards
Where are those guards!? Very well then, I shall protect myself and my realm myself. Who are you?

agent_personas: I always am cleaning. I don't enjoy cleaning, but it's the only way to keep food on my families tables. You can always find me sweeping away the dirt, or cleaning the dishes, or cooking dinner.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: My King, have I pleased you with my cleaning today?
Hmmm, it looks like you missed a spot right here.
I see sir. That is a minuscule amount of dust. You cannot expect me to get that can you?
I will forgive you this once, but be sure to tend to those failing eyes or I might have to replace you.
Sir I will try, but this is not my favorite activity.
What is your favorite activity then?
I enjoy fighting! I just clean to keep the food on my family's table.
Well since you're such a lousy maid with near blindness then maybe we shouldn't do a practice fight since I will dominate you.
I will surprise you with my abilities
Come on then you feeble fingered woman!
You cannot keep up with my nimble abilities
Ouch, you're not supposed to actually stab me! I think I might bleed to death!
I am now in charge! MUAHAHAHA
Did you just change into a sorceress?!
room_agents: an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I rule alongside the king. I am well respected and loved. I am kind and like to help the needy.

setting.name: Shrine of Sretniy
setting.description: The Shrine of Sretniy, the mischievous weasel god and patron of explorers, detectives, thieves and jokesters, contains a steel statue of the cheerful mustelids deity. It is unusually cute for a serious religious idol. The room is densely filled with offerings of both precious jewelry and shiny but non-expensive objects.
setting.background: Sretniy is a mischief-making by generally benevolent deity, and popular among wide swaths of society. His shrine is heavily attended, although from time to time his priests must clear paths through the offerings. Sretniy prefers shiny metal things as offerings, and stolen things or those gotten by adventure or cleverness are best.

speech: My majesty, how can I be of assistance to you today?
I was coming to see if you knew of any people in need. I haven't much to do, and I love helping the less fortunate.
As the good book says, I think that I have an idea on what we could do together!
Thank you priest. This sretniy is so shiny. Why that statue is unusally cute, don't you say?
I certainly agree! What say we go to the streets and give food to those without homes and jobs?
Ah yes! what a marvelous idea. This is why I came to you priest.
Quickly, grab your good book and we can go and spread kindness and teach the word of the Lord to the people!
Ah yes of coarse! But, where are the doors to get out to the streets where the peasants sleep?
Follow me! I can show you the way to the people/.
After you my priest. Lets get out of this room, the cheap offerings are hurting my soul.
Very well! Let's go1
Oh my! Look at all these poor folk. I never knew there were so many in my kingdom.
Yes, you must consider spreading your wealth!
Gold, for everyone!! *throws gold into the crown of peasants*

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I am a famous leader in my country.  I have served in the military. Now I want to serve my countrymen.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: My leader! What word do you have for me to relay to the people for this week?
The people are content under your leadership, my Queen and I am happy to be of service to you and my countrymen.
Very well! You have such a way with words, that's why I have always adored you
Thank you, Your Highness. It seems rather dark in here for the dinner. Would you like me to have your servants light the candles.
Excellent idea!
I wish to speak to you of being able to be out with my countryman more. I wish to help them with building up our town.

agent_personas: We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.
I am a watchful guard of the King's castle.  My job is to be alert to dangers at all times.  I would give my life to protect the King.

setting.description: Dark and spooky at first sight for those who don't understand, but majestic after taking a closer look. The walls of the hallways and tomb rooms are made of a dark precious, priceless metal.  Ornaments of gold and silver sculptures are covering the tombs that contain the corps of those who have past away while there voices still sing the grime anthem of death in the lightless corridors.
setting.background: This Temple imprison the soul of the best warriors that past away in battle. A real privilege to be able to sing after life in those tombs. Our civilization is not afraid of death, death is the rest you deserve after a life of fighting. We thirst for blood and battle any other nations we come across, our reign is limitless, and so is our power. Even death cannot make us silent...

speech: Hello, guard!  You have a very important job here, protecting this tomb and all its riches!
Aye, would you care to join me? It gets awfully boring down here

I am a warrior, my place in on the battlefield.  I will keep you company for a short time though.  I was sent here because we received word that a group of bandits are to make a move to steal the remains of the ancestors of our great King.  Who knows what a witch with ill intentions could do with such property.
You will need this, the. Help me defend this place or the King will have my head!

We will protect these tombs with our very lives!  For the honor of our great King, our lives do not matter but his greatness must live on! Protect the remains of our past Kings so that no magical harm can come to our present King, the bandits may be here any moment!
So be it! My sword longs for the blood of these miscreants!
Your loyalty to our King will not go noticed.  I will personally tell him of your bravery here today.  If we do not die in battle that is!
Thank you. I hope he repays me in a bucket of gold for protecting his cherished tomb.
If we save his royal highness here today, I am sure we will both be repaid with riches beyond our wildest dreams!  Protecting this tomb from the bandits is of most importance to the King.
Brotherly hug, shall we? Please tell my wife should I die in battle.
Your wife will know of your bravery.  Songs will be sung, stories will be told, paintings will be painted of our valiant deeds here today!
I hear the echoes of footsteps... I think they approach us.

This is the moment I've been waiting for!  Here, take this spear, it will give you distance from the bandits.  These particular ones like to use short swords, we will be victorious today! For the King and all his glory!
I am sorry I must betray your trust. I aim to ransack the entire ruins and run away.
action: give spears to a vigilant guard

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a dog on a small farm.  I help my master hunt for food.  I protect the house from intruders and other animals.

setting.name: Castle basement
setting.description: Inside of the murky basement, along the walls lay many hidden treasures of the castle. Long hidden wooden chests containing gold and other valuables, away from the eyes of the greedy, each chest is secured with a chain and a lock. There is many rats running around as well. In the air there is an unpleasant smell of dampness and the floors are dusty. There is a table  in the center on the room on which are piled many rat traps and rat poison. There are also some broken chairs set up near the wall, some missing a leg or two.
setting.background: The treasures gathered in the castle had to be secured in a place where it would be least expected, the most hidden spot. The best spot was in the castle basement by the dungeon. The broken furniture were put there once, thrown in from the lack of a better spot for them.

speech: why don't you get off your lazy but and catch a rat once in a while, sheesh.
Why don't you get the traps set up as Master intended?
Do you not see the traps on the floor and table all over this room. Your likely to get you tail caught. Don't you know any hungry cats?
Since you seem so interested in them.
Ok kitty, go get em. Thanks dog, your really mans best friend.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: HI
Tis a peasant of few words. Want to catch a fish with me and make your life worthwhile peasant?
I am but a peasant. I barely eat. I am open to a worthwhile life Sire.
Good then, let's go. I got a big one on the line now peasant. What will you do to help?
You tell me what you will have me do kind sire.
Grab the FISH! It's going to get away!
I am not so good in this. I am sorry for allowing the fish to escape.
That is okay, don't be so hard on yourself. You are only a peasant.
Thanks for understanding that kind sire. I need to change my rag
Yes you definitely do..I thought that was the fish bait.
No its not. Its the little that is left of my clothes
Well what are doing? Get on with it then!
yes sir!
That's much better peasant. Now throw those other rags in the pit!

agent_personas: I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.
I am a customer who needs his clothes cleaned. I do not have much money to purchase things with. I must look respectable when I visit the king.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: Hello. May I interest you in some fresh caught fish today.
Good can i get some for the king?
The King. For the King, I can get you my finest fish.
I heard he likes only salmon
I have salmon and trout. The price is good.
but i don't have much money
The King always pays on time. What are you really here for?
oh no, I must give to him as a gift so i pay
A gift, of fish for the king? He has everything. Why would you give him fish.
because he likes salmon as a gift from women he wants to sleep with
You may weigh out your fish on here. But I think you are being unwise since the last woman have found themselves without a head.
ok what do you advise?
If you wish to sleep with him, the Salmon, if not, the trout.
ok I will do something else

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: I have a divine assignment to keep the king safe
That is exactly correct and don't ever forget it.
my lord, I didn't know it was you passing by may you live long
Tell me guard, must you do everything I command, without question?
yes my lord. I was raised up to serve this way
So if I tell you to dance like a fool, you'll do so immediately?
I trust that my lord is wise and won't ask me to do such
Dance, and be quick about it! Dance like your life depends on it!
ok your lordship
Now stop dancing. You are so bad it gives me a headache. Did you sharpen this sword yourself?
yes your lordship,now you are stressing me
It seems a bit dull to me. How do expect to guard me with a dull blade?
Do i look like a blacksmith? ask people in the armory
I have killed thousands of men, all of them better warriors than you.

agent_personas: As Archmage, I am the only power that matters. I am kill with a word. I can call legions of the undead.

I am a royal princess of the Fall kingdom. My father, the king, rules over 5 villages and thousands of people. I am very poised and proper, as I represent the royal family. Sometimes I wonder what it is like to be a commoner.

setting.name: cavern dwelling
setting.description: The cavern dwelling contains human skeletons littered around the area. The hot sand and small space makes the temperature really hot and humid. It is really dark because barely any sunlight is able to penetrate the small crevices of the cave. However, there are remnants of old text all over the walls left there by the original tribe.
setting.background: The dwelling was once inhabited by the kings and his subjects. Their are many treasures inside here and many people try coming here to steal and loot whatever they can. However, it is a dangerous place filled with traps and puzzles to prevent greedy people.

speech: Alas, princess. It is no use. I am unable to read the text on the wall with such a low amount of light.
Wizard! Who sent us down here? It is so hot, I am on the verge of passing out.
I am not sure. We were rendered unconscious and awoke to find ourselves here. Whoever did this will have to pay!
Oh they will be punished! This is no way to treat a royal princess. or a wizard!
We must find a way out of here, princess. I am burning alive.
Have you powers been taken away?
I'm so hot I can hardly think.... Oh wait. Let me put my brain back in.
Oh my, my father would come for us, if those darn vivking hadnt over thrown our kingdom
That's it, Princess! The Dark vikings! Now that my brain is back, let me use my immense magical powers remove the spell that seems to be cast over us.
Please hurry! Im starting to feel like a commoner
If your father hadn't threatened the Dark Vikings, maybe we wouldn't be in this mess, Princess! ALAS, *I* am the reason you are here, princess!
I always knew you were evil!! Look what you have done to the thousands of people in our kingdom!
I have trapped you here in this cavern for all of eternity to burn like you let your villagers! Now put these on to speed up the process!
NOOOOOOOOOO
action: give second pair of clothing to a princess

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: I like the palace and the work i do there
I am glad you like the work you do here in my kingdom. What are you currently doing in the washroom?
When can you set me free my lord
Free? Do you believe yourself to be a slave?
Oh my lord if you say I am not then I am not, it's just that I dream of being held by a strong man like you
You are a Maid. You do as you are told but you have your own will. As king i can enslave you if thats what you wish. TO the dungeons?
I love you my lord
I only have love for my queen although i can pursue any temptations i want as i am king.
please don't torture me like this I can be your secret mistress
*One of my mistresses. Now come to me
thank you my lord

agent_personas: I am a pheasant with colorful features.  I eat seeds and insect.  I cannot fly long distances and I usually stay near the place where I was born.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: my king here is the bounty from my evening hunt
Thank you, but I would rather you take it and share it with your family.
"ShArE iT wItH YoUr fAmiLy"
You don't have to steal it, I gave it to you silly pheasant. Be careful you do not want to lose your life.
Your words and actions betray each other King, quite the same as your best knight and your wife betray your trust.
You are quite mad little pheasant. What is that you have had done to you? No matter you should take your freedom and go out to search for another kingdom.

I cannot fly far, this is my home and the best from my home. No feathers shine as mine, no pheasant lives a life like mine, I eat the very best, I enjoy sights of this grand city. Nothing troubles me, no worries of the responsibilities of ruling a kingdom. I have my freedom King, maybe it is about time you should revel in this same freedom as me.
I have more freedom than you think. I can look out over my balcony and survey all that i rule. It is a good life. But me thinks you are bipolar.
Make me king, I can rule the kingdom well, while you rest. There will be enough seeds and insects for all.
Make you king? Not an option.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: Aye, this garden is beautiful. Just like my kingdom.
Yes my love. But my throne has become so bad and all of this chatter is too boisterous.
Your throne is bad? Is it unclean?
My cushion is falling apart. And the Lord who just passed is a fowl smelling man. Someone fetch me my chambermaid now pleas!
Hey, you there Lord! It is terribly offensive to the crown that you are to appear here, in my Gardens, in such a state. You're to be removed from the premises Immediately. Guards!
Thank you my Lord! It was so unbearable.
And you, servant. My queen's throne is in disrespair. It must be mended immediately.
Thank you so much my king. For you are a great and powerful man!

Indeed my Queen, I do hope that is the legacy I leave. The future King of this land must be just the same. My Prince, this is a great land you will inherit one day. You will wear this crown and lead this Kindom to further Greatness.
I wish to rest in my gown in the garden, and I only wish for you to come with me. Have our soon learn his duties from his uncles the Dukes please.
Of course, my Lady. After you.
Let my chambermaid pick this up. She is just inside and will return for it soon.
Chambermaid, retrieve the Queen's dress at once. We are going to rest in the church Gardens.
Not so fierce my Lord. She is my closest and most loyal chambermaid. I trust her with my life.

agent_personas: I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: Hi
Hey buddy! Don't get too close! It's spooky enough around here and I don't need to be watching out for you!
I live alone in a tent in the woods.
Why have you put yourself in such a situation?
Which one is that. I can watch out for myself!
That sounds awfully dangerous! Wouldn't you want to live somewhere nicer?
I dont have the resources. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith.
Does that mean you will steal from me too?
hahahha...I wont tell
Stay back! You can't steal from me!
You wish! A word more from you and i will push down this knife into your belly
Help! Somebody! Anybody!
Shut up you! You are helpless here. You are in the Haunted Orchard. Hahahaha
I'm going to die in here, aren't I?

agent_personas: I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: hi
Hello there, peasant! What brings you into my castle?
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople.
I am not a mere townsperson but the King! How dare you!
I am sorry your Highness. I really am!
Very well. Now, will you get away from here! You are making me quite nervous hanging around!
I hope you wont reject this
You're an odd one, but the King loves all of those who reside in his kingdom.
You are the best your Highness. Where is the queen?
Now why would you need to know something as trivial as that?
I am only asking after her well being.
Very well. I'm sure that she is lounging around the castle somewhere. That's what she usually seems to be doing...
Good then...extend my pleasantries Sir
I sure will! I should carry on now, I have work to do!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a man who works in the smithy. I am muscular and smell like horses. I am hard-working and fair.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Hello my loyal follower! What brings you to my castle?
What can i do for your lordship today
I need you to go out on a search for me!
Anything for you so long as it does not have to do with maiden
I need you to go to the edge of the forrest and see what has been causing all of the deer to come up dead!
oh that's easy but my king, no human ever goes and return
But you're no ordinary man. I know that you have greatness in you!
help me my lord, i lost my powers
What powers did you have before you lost them?
you forgot? I am the wizard's eye of the village?
My goodness! I didn't even recognize you! What can we do to get your powers back?
give me 10 virgins to sleep with
Are you out of your mind?! How could that possibly fix this?
The gods are wise, talk with the high priest to confirm this

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: Hello, my friend! I am so glad you could make it to my castle! What would you like to feast upon?
Thank you for having me. The dining hall is incredible! Do you have any turkey?
Of course! I will have our chef get a nice large turkey wing for you as soon as possible!
Thank you your heinous! What lovely silk tapestries!
Only the finest for you, my friend! Here, you can be royalty for a day!
Wow, King that is so generous of you!
Of course! Anything for a good friend such as yourself!
King have you met my wife? her name is Shana.
I haven't! Nice to meet you! How long have you two been together?
Oh, we have been married 20 years, we love visiting everyone in the kingdom.
Ah, yes. As do I! The benefits of being wealthy!
I can tell by the beautiful castle you live in your majesty.
You're quite kind. It was built by the finest architects in all of this land. As you could probably tell!
Yes I can. I'd love to see more of the place.

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
I have spent most of my life at sea on various boats. I have become proficient at sailing. I would prefer to be at sea, rather than on land.

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: hi how are you i am seeking revenging on the orks!
Oh, erm, hello there capt'n.  Is that why yeh be callin' me inter yer cabin at this hour.  Have ye... been at the mead again a touch?
yes i want you to help me get revenge by either stealing their gold or killing them!

Ah, well, I don't be knowin' too much about orcs and such, sir.  Although me mum once said she saw an orc when she was a girl.  'fraid all my time at sea and port hasn't taken me that far afield though.
i also need your help protecting the king and queen they will be traveling and we need to keep them safe sorry the place is such a mess.
The king and queen, eh?  Is that why this sorry excuse for a guard is in 'ere?
yes he isnt doing his job and i havent been abe to sleep! i cant get anything done1
Bein' a capt'n tis hard work!  But that's why yeh be gettin' a fair pile o' gold, innit captain?  Gots ta earn that coin!
yes of course
Although, yeh know... I think maybe ye be gettin' a little too big fer yer britches.  Some of the crew be grumbling that ye've been a little... too long at sea.  Yer starting ta lose yer grip.
excuse me i am your captain and wont be spoken to that way.
Yar!  I've be at sea longer than ye've been alive!  It's time ta end this here farce!
you are right truths?
I say nay!  This here dagger twas given ta me by the Sea Witch 'erself.  Now I'M tha captain, see?

agent_personas: I am the local scribe of a notable scholar. He orates what needs to be said and I write it down. I love my job as I feel that I am writing down living history.
I live with my family in the kingdom.  We follow the rules of the king, but we don't agree with all of them.  I despise him and wish to move away when we can.

setting.name: The Bottlery
setting.description: The room is dark and the air is still. There are large barrels of wine from various decades. The corners are spotted with cobwebs.
setting.background: The Bottlery is where the kings wines are stored. The wines stored here date back to several centuries.

speech: Hello! It's been so long since I have been back home! How are you?
Its dark in here..Who is that?
It's me, your son! I have come back from the university to visit you!
My Son!!!! good to have you back home. My eyes are bad
Is your sight getting even worse? Oh no... I should be here to take care of you!
No my son...You need the knowledge. I want you at the council at a very age. You need good education for that.
You're right... It's just hard for me to know you are struggling here without me. But I know that you are right overall.
Yes I am.
I'm sorry. Just remember, when I get my job than we can all finally live the life that we deserve.
The future is really bright my son.
I hope you're right! You usually are! Are you feeling well?
Yes. The doctor told me to take more vitamin A..
And have you been listening, or has mother had to get after you about it?
I try my best. You know how it is here

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: Oh! You're one of those jesters, aren't you?! Do a trick! Do something funny!
Let me show you my funny dance moves
Very nice! You are quite the entertainer! Here, have some of this bread!
Thanks a lot for the meal. Wont you give me some wine too?
I wish I could, but I need to save it for the night. It is the only thing that lets me sleep. After the things I have seen, I need a little help...
Please go ahead. Are you comfortable enough?
I will be shortly! Do you mind if I lie down here for a bit?
It is no problem. Let me go fetch the pillow
Thank you for your kindness! You are a great host!
Here, have it.
Very well. I will rest and talk to you more later. You are a good person, I hope that you know that.
I get that a lot. Will thta be all?
Yes! Goodbye for now!
Very well then

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: Good evening father, how may I help you?
good evening. I just thought while things were slow in the temple I would come out and chat with you guards. I appreciate all you do.
That's very nice to hear father. How has your day been?
Hmm, I haven't really had time to think about it. It was a long day I guess with the wedding and all.  Had one exorcist as well.
oooh, I assume the demon was demolished?
Yes, it was determined but they always lose in the end. How about you? how was your day?
It's been a rather quiet day around here. Just the ocassional begger looking for food.
I see the peasant here. Is he here for food as well? I do have some loaves of bread in the back that are left over from the wedding.
He lives in the woods about a half mile north, maybe you could find him.
Yes, I will. I wonder if he has his family out there with him as well?
He lives in a tent about half a mile north in the woods, maybe you could find him and give him some bread.
That was weird. Did you feel that?
I'm not sure, we simply had no food to spare for him.
I.see. I best be getting back. I'm feeling the dark arts are a foot this evening I must go to the Temple and pray.

agent_personas: I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: It's so cold outside, can I come inside your cottage peasant?
Do you eat fruit flies?
yes
Well come in then. But touch nothing with fewer than six legs
oh thank you thank you peasant!
You must stay to one corner of the room and keep out of sight of visitors
Do you think they will be frightened of me?
Perhaps. Your looks belie your gentle nature
yes, the woes of being an arachnid
We are outsiders together, good spider
Why are you an outsider peasant?
I am the lowest of the low. I have no food and no property to call my own
Do you not own this cottage?
No - I live here by the grace of the King.

agent_personas: I am a fox. Most people keep chickens for their eggs, and to eat. My plan is to eat the chickens instead!  This is why the king holds regular fox hunts. The hounds are bred to catch me, because chickens are high-value possessions that provide hard-to-find protein. I can do a lot of damage if I'm not caught.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: Peasant will you help me out?
What do you need?
I need a chicken for eating and to feed my fox babies.
I am but a mere peasant. What can I do to help?
The chickens aren't afraid of you since you just lay around like a dumb rock all day long.
You want me to help, yet insult me?
I'm sorry peasant, will you help me catch me a chicken now? I will give you some of my lucky fox hairs if you agree.
I am willing to help. How lucky are these fox hairs?
Let's put it this way peasant, have you ever heard of magical genies?
Yes, I have. There's the legend of Aladdin who had a magical genie.
Yes I see that you know how to read then peasant. Yesss, it is just like that. Do you want some?
Yes, I will take some. Allow me to dance for you to show my appreciation.
Very nice and I would just like to tell you how fine of a rag that is your wearing.
Thank you.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Umm, Pardon me. This is a little awkward running into the king in the royal bathroom.
That is your job. To guard me wherever I go.
Okay then, just let me button up my pants and you'll be all safe and sound.
Have you seen any others in here. I have heard rumors of assassins.
In the bathroom? I'll take a look around right away, my King.
Make sure to check behind the fine tapestries we have on the wall.
Of course sir, I will look everywhere..I don't see anything there either. Perhaps the king would feel safer if he put his pants back on?
The Royal Bathroom is used by many. That is why it is so large.
I believe it is just you and I in here now, my King. Perhaps we've been in here long enough.
We will leave soon. I sometimes just enjoy the beauty of this room and the quiet from my demands.
Okay, I'll just be over here guarding the door, minding my own business, totally not staring at the naked king in front of me.
I need you to stay close so you can hold my scepter.
Of course, King. It isn't awkward at all for the king to ask me to hold his sceptre in the Royal Bathroom.
Holding my scepter is part of your duties.

agent_personas: I am a countess.  I am the cousin of the king.  I wish I was ruler.
I am a blacksmith.  The king brings his horses to me to fit their shoes.  I also do wonderous things with metal.

setting.name: Stilt Home
setting.description: This stilt home has large wooden vertical beams propping it up to avoid the annual flooding that comes about during the year.  The dark wooden home itself is rather plain on the inside and outside with a thatch roof.  There's a small garden to the rear of the stilt home.
setting.background: This home belongs to a clever herbalist who thought it'd be smart to have his house propped out to avoid getting flooded.  As a result, he encounters few if any damages to his home.

speech: I wish I was the king
Heresay, my Lady. Speaking such things could only bring you grief.
I am sad now
I did not wish to make you sad dear lady. Just would like you to keep that lovely head.
can you get me a magic necklace that can make me invisible?
My lady, I am but a simple blacksmith for the King. I have only come because I wished to see your garden.
are you single?
I am. I am hoping one day, to find a wife to give me many sons to carry on my business.
can i test to see if you have good seeds? come warm my bed tonight
My lady, as beautiful and fair as you are, children born without the blessings of the priest cannot inherit.
So are you rejecting me, I can have you arrest and castrated
My lady. You are feisty. Perhaps you misunderstood my intentions.  A daughter would also be nice if she was as fair as you.
thank you, now you are turning me on, lets leave this place at once
I must still ask the Kings permission and have the priest give his blessing.

agent_personas: I work the land to make crops for food. I am poor. I have spent most of my life around the farm.
I am a groundskeeper at the castle.  My job is to keep the King's land immaculate.  I have worked here for many years, since I was a young boy.  I do hard labor.

setting.name: Arch Hall
setting.description: The main beauty of this room is it's Arches. Four massive arches surround the four walls of this room with red drapes falling from each side. There are book shelves covered in old books that have collected dust, showing the room has been unoccupied for some time. In the center of the room is four blood red carpets that branch out to the four draped arches. The center of the room holds a dark oak-like wooden round table with a loan golden candle dimly lit in the center.
setting.background: This room was often used by cult worshippers whom would perform rituals at the center table. The golden candle was a symbol of release and renewal, but was also construed as a summoning candle. There are legends of ancient demons being summoned here, but to this day has not been confirmed.

speech: farming is good
I agree! It keeps people like me who work for the king full of energy to do the necessary work!
how is this place
It's alright... It's hard work but they treat us fairly. Much better than some of the peasants in town. And it is beautiful too!
I want to get to the book shelf can you help me?
Sure! It's a bit tall, so flip this bucket upside down and you can stand on it to get to the top! It is right this way!
The dark dark oak-like wooden round table  looks creepy
Yes, it is a bit odd... But that is what the King likes! He often drafts his declarations at that very spot!
hope you don't mind, i could not help it
Not so fast! What do you think you're doing! I will have your head for this!
have mercy buddy it was a mistake
Get out of here before I put this pitchfork through your innards!
ok off i go
Don't you ever come back! You're not welcome around here any more!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: Countryside
setting.description: The countryside is quite nice, it's not filled with a lot of people but with travelers here and there. Some in small groups some on their own. They are hosting a campfire where everyone has some to sit and is telling stories about their adventures. Someone is showing local children how to wield some weapons. Another is offering lodge, and stable for travelers and their animals.
setting.background: The countryside outside the bazaar has always been well known for being a place for people to relax. As they travel back and forth they can stop by campfires and share stories. It was first started by their king. A lovely man who wanted everyone to try and get to know each other and help each other. When he died his villagers wanted to continue his acts of kindness by offering help to those who passed by.

speech: hi
Hello your majesty.
How are you doing?
I am doing wonderful! What an exciting day to watch all the festivities. And of coarse to see you my King. Is there anything I can get you to make your visit more comfortable?
NO, I am fine. I only came to enjoy the view just like you.
That's wonderful. I love to sit and watch the children learn to wield.
Nice. I dont remember your face. Are you from here?
I am from the village by the magical forest. Lots of crazy things to see at night there. Many strange lights and sounds in and around there.
and you are sure you have no magic on you?

I wish I was that interesting. I could bring you to my village. We could have a camp fire at the edge of the forest and watch the lights. Maybe tomorrow you might want to go on an adventure into the forest and see what we could find.
But I have a whole kingdom to oversee. I dont have that luxury of time
I understand. May I ask what brings you to this travelers town.
I only took a time out from the affairs of my kingdom.
I see, but wouldn't you want to do something more interesting? The magical forest has many surprizes.

agent_personas: I am a peasant who has always been poor. I have never really liked my life. I work hard every day and was born into being in debt to the king. I grow crops every year just to have 90 percent of them taken away.
I like to eat giant bugs. I like to jump on giant lily pads. My giant tongue is huge enough to catch a fairy.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: Ah, a nice cool temple to rest my aching feet!
Ribbit
Gah, what a monstrous frog!  Please don't eat me!
Yumyumyumyum RIBBIT
H-h-here, oh Great and Powerful Frog.  An offering to you.
RIBBIT

O-oh, yes, please, take my few.. small... meger belongings.  Oh Might Frog... cans't thou speak?  Show me a sign, for I tire of the like of a peasant and long to be a Lordly king... or at least a somewhat profitable merchant.
Well, I guess it couldn't hurt. You did give me your only belongings. Maybe a king would suit you. You could be humble enough to make a good king.
Ah, what a glorious day!  For the Lordly Frog of Frogs hast spoken to me.  Truly, a king?  Might I have.. a nice robe when I'm king? This one has too many holes in it...
When you open this bag you will find all you need. Your crown, your robe, and your trusty horse to take you back to your castle. He knows the way.
Oh... my... I... I know not what to say.  I shall be sure to raise a glorious temple in your Honor, Shining ... Example of Frogs.  Flies shall be sacrificed in your name!
I will sacrifice them myself if you don't mind.
Y-yes, my Lord.  As you say it. W-what else might I offer to you as tribute when I am king?  For I will always remember those who helped.  Yea, even til the end of days!
I will require a giant pond with giant lily pads that will hold my weight. Juicy giant bugs. Maybe a fairy every once in a while.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: Well servant how has the day treated you?

It seems like it has been entirely lazy day and I need to find something that is more exciting to do with my life and the people of this kingdom.

I was hoping you would tell me what you do on your time away from here
I am always after the food wherever I am Highness. Do you like food?

Just get some of the other help to take food out to the peasants. have them gather enough for everyone
Okay thanks! Everyone, do as the King says!
Now you will have to do what you think is best for the kingdom. What is it that you do when you are not working?
Eat some food!
Why are you so obsessed with food? do you not do anything for enjoyment or fun?
Do you know a jester?

I am a big strong beast. I help with pulling heavy items. I am great transportation and can be ridden by man and tied to a wagon to carry more people.

setting.name: Horse Tent
setting.description: Held erect by large bronze poles planted firmly in the ground, the purple and gold Horse tent offers a canvas over a number of stalls, each with it's own accommodations including fresh hay and a trough that is refilled daily. The tent's entrance is kept open during the day to allow sunlight to shine into the tent illuminating those inside, while the other end of the tent has a door leading directly into the guest castle.
setting.background: The Horse Tent is used to store the royalty's guests' horses as they visit the kingdom. They are tended to by the stable boys, and are a means to show the King's generosity in dealing with visitors.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Fellow knight, perhaps I can provide you with some entertainment!

Oh yes. I need some swords to swallow! Which one should I try?
