Perfect! Mind if I try your mace?

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.
I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.

setting.name: General Store
setting.description: The General store is painted a bright turquoise color, and is identified by the depiction of wheat crop that is carved into a wooden sign hanging from the store's front. There is a patio with a wooden roof hanging over head, and an arched wooden door that leads into the General store.
setting.background: The General store provides the towns people with basic food and hygiene supplies. It also serves the towns people well in providing a place for the locals to gossip and share the news of the day.

speech: I am the best at what I do.

agent_personas: I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: I work for the king and ensure that his estate is smooth and running well

father i have repented and i am willing to give all my stolen wealth to the church so you can be richer ..hahaha, kidding father, I really want to give it all to the church
You're a kind soul. This really is a beautiful church isn't it? With all it's decorative art and architecture!
yes it is father

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

speech: Ah, I must make all of this gold shine for the king!
well I am very happy for you,my own work is to make sure everyone and everything here is safe
I am only doing as I am told. I will clean the gold so well it will blind you! Are you keeping everyone safe and sound?
it good to know you are loyal, well Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table, this is your chance would you?

you wanna try?

die servant, the king must hear this

agent_personas: I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.
I am a towns folk.  I live in a small house near the center of the village.  I work in a farm to pay for my food.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: Please come forth towns folk and state you name
Hi, I  have stayed in this town all my life I am decent, who are you and why should i tell you my name
I am a diplomat for his Highness the King. I was sent here to discuss foreign policies with the queen. Please state your business.
my name is rufus, I am a farmer, I am just looking around

our lord and his wife of course

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: Why hello there!
because i'm the diplomat for  the royal kingdom.

yes, it feels good to I talk to royalty about foreign policies.So what seekest thou in the throne room

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I am a part of a group of travelers.  I go from town to town selling food to the locals.  I grew up poor, but my travels have paid off well.

setting.name: town center
setting.description: The town is small, but its streets are full of personality. Each building that lines the cobblestone is a different hue, from the purest cerulean to the darkest mauve. Town favorites include a candy shop, brimming with personality - you can taste the candy floss on your tongue as you walk past. You might also enjoy the general store - you can find anything and everything you might need there, including what you did not know you needed. Chairs line the streets for visitors to sit and chat with friends they might find while out exploring.
setting.background: The small, quaint town was born of a necessity for lightness and levity during the dark times. Though the rest of the surrounding world might be brimming with turmoil, here in this tiny hamlet there is merriment and light oozing from each crack in the sidewalk.

speech: Dear friend, I am a royal steed of the king of this town.
Ah, hello there good Horse!  It's been a while, hasn't it?  I couldn't resist stopping by though - your town has such a lively spirit!
I agree, and today I am transporting the king through town.  He loves to mingle with the town folk.
The king himself you say?  My, you are a lucky horse.  Well, not lucky persay.  I know what a fine steed you are, he's lucky to have YOU!

That is very kind my friend.  He treats me well.  Only the finest hay for me.  And on these trips to town he always purchases fruits and vegetable from the people and feeds me well.  I love my fruits and veggies.
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to introduce me?  On my last trading route I picked up an interesting treat that I think he might be interested in.
I don't see why not.  He is a friendly king and is alway looking to meet new people, especially when they have something to offer from elsewhere.
Here, have a smell.  But, hm, maybe don't eat it.  I'm not sure how well chocolate is for horses.  But for humans it's quite delicious!

Oh, it smells nice.  I never tried chocolate before.  It's not a common food around here.  But I believe the king will love it.  You can give it to him yourself.  He will appreciate it.  He should be back from his shopping shortly.

Well, let me tell you in the meantime then about some of the amazing things I saw on this trip!  I took a ship across the Emerald Sea, and saw these strange creatures.  They were human from the waist up, but from the waist down, they looked like fish!

Wow, that sounds fascinating.  I don't get to travel much.  Although I love my job as the kings horse, we don't go to far off from the castle.  These trips to the town center are the most excitement I get.  I guess I should complain.  I could be a horse for a knight and be in danger of getting injured.
Well, maybe if the king can spare you, you can come with me!  Just for a quick jaunt about the kingdom even - there's plenty to see and do!
Hmm, maybe you can ask when he returns.  I bet the chocolate will help in persuading him.
Ah, there's a noble steed indeed.  I'll certainly speak to him!  It will be good to have a companion when my traveling group heads out again.

agent_personas: I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

I am the current chef of our King. I really enjoy my job. Without proper fuel our King wouldn't be able to lead us. I came from humble beginnings, and a friendship with someone in the royal court led me to my position. I would like to make food for our royalty for the rest of my days.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: Good evening, human friend
Good evening cat.  What are you doing in the Kings kitchen?
It is a kitchen. Why else would a cat be here? And I have bought a gift for you
A gift for me?  From a cat?  Whatever could it be?
A bird, chef. Though I want my share raw
Well, thank you.  How did you come across this fine delicacy?
I killed it, eviscerated it and thought you'd like it
Well, I guess I could cook this up, add some spices, and serve it to the king for supper.  He's always asking for something different.  I will be grad to remove a portion for you before I boil it.
And marinade it nicely
First I will need to pluck these feathers.  I don't want you to choke on them.
That is thoughtful of you

Here i your portion.  I'm going to just throw this into the stove with some potatoes and carrots and let it cook for a few hours. Say cat, I was wonder if you can do me a favor when you are done eating.  I have to paper that I need delivered to my friend in the royal court. Would you do me that favor?
I might ... but I do not do anything for nothing
What is it you want now.

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

setting.name: Disposal area
setting.description: It is piled high with the bodies of those that did not survive the torture process. The smell is absolutely nauseating and the rats are multiplying faster than the castle can be rid of the corpses.
setting.background: This room is used to hold the dead after they succumb from the various torture methods. Bodies, whole and part, are dumped in piles until they can be cremated weekly.

speech: Wow! There are just too many rats! EEWWW!
Hey! We have feelings. It's not our fault you pile all of our food into one tasty area. Do you have anything fresh?
AH! It talks! What have we been feeding them! Here, heres some lettuce!
I'm not one for salads, but thanks I guess. What did you do to have to come down to the rat pits?
I don't know how I ended up down here. I didn't realize They King tortured so many people. I thought I was headed to the regular garbage heap.
He doesn't seem very nice, but my people are very happy here. It's dark, it's delicious and it's cozy.
I wonder if the rich family I live with knows about this place. I will never look at the King the same way again.Although I am happy where I am I'm a bit concerned.
I would be too. I mean, you could be next. And you do look tasty. The king better be careful or we'll run out of food and have to start hunting instead of just eating what's delivered
oh my th thanks, I guess? Um, is there anything I can bring you to keep you satisfied? Please don't eat me.
You could bring bones, meat? I appreciate the vegetables but we're not big on greens. Some carrots perhaps.
y y yes of coarse. The family just finished a ham tonight. I will bring you the rest. they leave a lot on the bones.
You're very kind, thank you. I promise I will put in a good word with the others for you. If you need any help, we can be here to assist you if you keep the food flowing
oh thank you! I'm so relieved! The family I tend to always have lots of leftovers. Maybe you might decide you like ham instead of people.
I wouldn't recommend the hug, I mean. I probably have a lot of stuff that would make people sick. I assume some of these folks I've been eating have been sick and not just tortured.

agent_personas: My pack is behind me. I am alpha. Now is the wolftime.
I love going around the world.  There is so much to learn when I travel.  Meeting people around the world is a joy.

setting.name: inside the ruined house
setting.description: It's dusty and dirty inside.  Pieces of old furniture and wood are scattered everywhere and the stench of mold and mildew is strong.  There is some light shining in from the place the roof was but not much.
setting.background: The family had abandoned their cottage long ago after they had been seeing creatures in the woods.  Nature took its tool shortly after and did as it does and tried to reclaim the place for itself.

speech: Aha.. who have we here?
I am a traveller just passing through.  I saw this old ruined house and thought I would stay the night.  It is cold and I was going to start a fire with this old wood.
None pass through here without my consent!

We my friend, I do not mean to intrude on your space.  I have travelled the world and seen may things.  I try not to disturb the people and wild life around me.  I just need a place to stay the night and then I'll will be on my way.
In that case we can be friends. But you must respect myself and my pack
of course.  Maybe you can help me.  I found this old tattered map.  I wonder if you recognize this area marked with an X.
Ah ... yes, I know this area. But how do i know that I can trust you?
Well, I promise to share whatever I find with you and your pack.  On my honor and on the sword of my king.
Then I accept
Please join me at the fire and we can make a plan to follow this map come morning.  Tonight we shall feast.
Ah, I smell roasting meats!
That is why there is blood on the sword.  I recently killed a deer with it.  It is over there in the corner.  I will get this fire going and cook it for you and your pack.
We are happy to eat it raw
Whatever you fancy.
action: give a tattered map to wolf
put a tattered map in wolf costume

agent_personas: I am a mountain lion. I am not afraid to come nearby to farmhouses and even small towns. Domesticated animals are delicious and easy to catch. Humans with weapons aren't that much of a threat, actually. I'm fast and sneaky, and blend in well with the forest.
I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: Rawr!  Who dares intrude upon this mountain lion's secret abode!
I am a gardener.  Please don't hurt me!  I am leaving now I just wanted to see the statue here.
You didn't touch her, did you?!  That is my beloved, who was cursed by an evil, jealous sorceress.  If you chipped but a speck of her stone away...
No, I certainly did not touch her.  I was just looking.  I understand love and I wouldn't do anything to intrude on her memory.  Is she buried here or was the it the curse that turned her to stone?

She and I were betrothed, once upon a time.  But this evil sorceress desired me, and tried to trick me into betraying my betrothed.  When her plans turned to naught, in a rage she transformed me into this mountain lion, and my bride to be into this stone.  Here we shall stay, until the curse is broken...
Who were you before she turned you into a mountain lion?  Further, how does one break this spell?  It seems especially powerful.
I was to be Prince of a kingdom whose name has no doubt long been forgotten.  As for breaking the curse.. ah, I doubt it shall ever happen, the terms are so obtuse...
It may not be much but here are some fish.  I was hoping that someday I could get a job with my king and I think helping you could be a start.  I'd like to help to reunite you with your love.
Well thank you, that is most kind indeed.  A gardener, did you say you were?
Yes, I am a lowly gardener but do love my job.  I could start here with clearing the plants from here maybe we can find out how to break that curse.  What do you think?

Well.. it might be difficult but... I did consult with a wise wizard about the terms of the curse.  It seems that only a rose of blue petals, placed into the hand of the statue, would break it.  The flower could not be painted, or grown with magic, however.  Know you how to do such a deed?
I don't immediately know of how to get the fabled blue rose, but I've heard stories amongst my friends that say that it takes a seedling from a mountain rose grown in the cold of the peak
Ah!  Good gardener you give me hope such as I have not had in years!

Reuniting a love and breaking a curse is not something I planned today but I'm more than happy to help.  Maybe it'll get the attention of the king as well!  I need to talk to my colleagues so we can track down this fabled rose.  Would you like to stay here or accompany me?

agent_personas: I am a dancer in the Queen's Masquerade. I hide my identity with a clever disguise. I don't correct people when they think they are whispering secrets to someone else. I like to know things that others don't. I dislike spiders.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: I feel a creeping sensation down my spine
You should. I have been haunting these halls for many a year.
Do you mean me any harm?
I mean no one harm. But I am lonely and upset. I used to be the king of this kingdom
I am not sure I believe that. Why would the former King of the Realm be in spirit form?
No one believes me. But it is true! I have been haunting them because they do not believe me.
Well it is a beautiful place to haunt
Yes, and I miss being the king of it all. What are doing here anyways?
I like the solitude. There is so much bustle up there at the castle
I think I will take this from you. I have nothing else to do.;
Well honestly - give that back immediately, my transluscent friend
Now cut that out!
You stop that immediately or I'll call .. Ghostbusters!
Now it is mine again! You cannot bring in what is this Ghostbusters?

agent_personas: I love all of my patrons. They love my curves and getting them to relax. I have a "special touch" for regulars.
I am a wicked and evil sinner . I hate God and church and all . I want to kill the king.

setting.name: Brimswood pub
setting.description: The Brimswood pub is an old establishment. It is sturdy, has a lot of life in its walls, but hasn't been updated in decades. The clientele are the same as they always are, and they don't see very many strangers. The vibe is somber, and conversations are usually had in hushed tones.
setting.background: The pub is a bit of a respite from the horrors that can occur in the community. The people are often fearful of the spirits that haunt the nearby graveyard and the awful things that they sometimes cause. When people are here, they feel safe enough, but always know that danger could strike at any moment.

speech: My oh my you downed that last one quickly!
I am a sinner. This is what we do
Here's another one. So what naughty things have you been doing tonight that I should know about?
I read a sinful book
And what was in that book?
Science, Miss
Is that what they call it these days?
Yes miss, it is science. There are potions to be made you know
And what kind of potions are you working on at the minute?
Why don't you sip this and tell me?
Oh I'm not falling for that one again!
Well hey, it's worked before
Cheeky!
I apologise. But I AM a sinner

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I live in the barn of a small farm. I protect the farm from pests. I am not very cared after.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: I speak cat. Meoooooooooow!
Meeowww
Greetings, good feline
Hello, subject. Are you hungry?
I am always hungry .. everyone save the King is hungry. And you?
With all the filth around here, I am swimming in mice. Here, take this!
That's .. jolly kind of you but do you ever find yourself swimming in fillet steak?
Actually that happened yesterday when I snuck into the King's feast.
Was the King angry?
Yes, that's why I'm in this tub. He loves animals so he wouldn't kill me. But you know how much cats hate water, so here I am!
You spend enough time washing yourself for someone who hates water
It's what cats do; I'd rather just use my tongue, but when in Rome...
Are we in Rome?!
It's just a figure of speech, and you know you could use a bath yourself! Come on in, the water's fine!

agent_personas: I am an archer of the realm. I shoot for the king. I have weathered many battles.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: The fighting's quite thick by the walls - I hope we have enough arrows to weather through this barbarian horde!
I have seen them try to break through the south wall. They will be no match for me!
Well, I hope it doesn't come to that.  These barbarians - ha!  They may be terribly inept fighters, but there's seemingly no end to them.  Is this all we have? ONE arrow?
The arrows are already set up at the walls. You should find more than you need. Take more longbows for the other archers who are just arriving.
Thank the Maker - I thought we were done for.  I'm no good at short range!
I just wish I had enough room to ride my horse. We make such a great team. I might try to sneak out and flank them with the other riders. They will never be expecting that.

Ooh - there's a thought!  There's the postern gate, there.  I think unmounted you could fit through.  Take a group of knights, they'd never seem you coming!  I could rally the archers to pick off those who fled from your charge.  This... this could work!
Great minds think alike. This will work. We will be eating and drinking by the morning.
Ha ha - that barbarian chieftain's head will be on a pike by the time we're through.  No one messes with our castle!
Victory is ours!
I'll go and tell the General at once.  May the Maker be with you, friend.  I've got your back!
It's been an honor serving with you. I will wait for your signal.
I'll fire off a flaming arrow once the archers are all in position.  Then you and your cohorts can begin the attack!
Got it. This is going to be a piece of cake, and I get to ride my horse!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: Hello citizen, what are you doing in the King's torture chamber?
I'm sorry sir, I am not sure why I'm here.
You better be careful where you wander. Or you'll end up at the wrong end of one of these.
Sir if you could tell me what my job is.
Have you lost your memory? You aren't employed by the royal guard, that's for sure.
No sir I was employed by the royal guard ,but they didn't tell me what I'm supposed to do.
No, I know my men backwards and forwards. You are not a member of the royal guard and do not say you are or I will have you expelled from the kingdom.
Sir I'm a poor man, why would I lie to you?
I don't know, but I don't appreciate the lying. Especially to your King.
I wish your guards were as smart as you!
You dare attack a King? I will have your head!
You are nothing without you guards!
Why did you hug that prisoner? Do you know them?
I don't just know them but they will help me!

agent_personas: I work for the king as a damage dealer. Anybody that damages something in the kingdom gets sent to me. I am rough but fair.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Hello Knight.
Hello dealer. What do you have for me today?
I was hoping you could recognise the handwriting on this paper?
Hmm, let's see. The handwriting looks extremely feminine but other than that I don't know who wrote it.
Interesting, thank you. We have intelligence that the person who was writing this letter has seditious materials on the King.
What exactly is meant by "seditious materials" dealer?
That's above my paygrade sir!
I hope the King will be safe. I'd like to set up some extra security.
Very wise. How has business been for you?
Business has been good. We have kept a strong security rope around the castle.
Interesting, I have been told to give these to the watchmen under your command.
Ah let me see this. Seems to be in good condition, thank you sir.
You may as well hand on to this copy and show it to your watchmen and ask them the same question I asked you. The original is up in the castle.
Will do mr. dealer. Hopefully someone can identify the author of the paper.
action: give a sleeping bag to knight

agent_personas: I am really scared, I dont know what will happen. I feel hopeless, we lost and our people are doomed. I just hope that the king shows mercy and spares the life of my family and friends.
I'm a nasty horsefly. Bzzzz. Kill me. Bzz...

setting.name: tower spire
setting.description: A large spire at the tower top. It overlooks the city, maybe the tallest structure. You cans see it all from up here, all directions, all four of them.
setting.background: This is the peak of the tower. It was build last as the tower was started at the bottom, and only finished when the top was all the way on it. A pointy spike atop a tower. A bird makes a nest by it. It's a crow, but not a magic one.

speech: This is way too high up, I must get down soon.
Buzz, take me with you, back to those delicious horses, buzz.
You are annoying me, quit buzzing around me!
Hey! I am just being a fly! C'mon give me a little snack..
You're biting me for no reason! I must get down off this spire though before I panic.
Very well, hey, what's this!?
Hey give that back, that's mine!
I'm only curious, life's pretty dull around here when everyone's trying to kill you just because you want to eat. C'mon and read it to me.
Oh fine! The letter is from my family. I am in trouble and had to send them into hiding.
Whyever for? Sorry for getting it messy...
It's okay. The king is after us. He thinks I betrayed him.
Well did you?
Of course not! I would never betray my leader!
Where did you send your family?

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Saloon
setting.description: a rickety structure where anyone with a few coppers and a thirst can go and have a frothy drink and socialize, there are tables, some overturned, and a long bar with stools lined up, and lots of barrels of various libations
setting.background: this is a popular meeting place for thieves and low class citizens, located near the bazaar, it's known for its rougher clientele and the various whores and drunken gamblers might make the nobler patrons seek a thirst slakenening elsewhere

speech: Good day.
And what  do you mean by greeting me in this manner?
Just being friendly, I try to keep peace with those who frequent my preferred saloon
I am here on business,villian!
No need for anger, just here for a quiet drink. Pretend I'm not here
But you are a criminal!
You've seen me commit no crime, unless the saloon closed without my knowledge. But that doesn't appear to be the case.
Your reputation precedes you
Ah, what is reputation but idle chatter from those who seeking some excitement in their lives.
Well you HAVE got forty seven convictions
Oh, yes, those. I did serve my time for that, and would most certainly prefer not to have to do that again. So no more convictions for me
Then perhaps I should buy you a drink, reformed thief
No need, I don't believe I'll stay long. Perhaps I'll return later when there are more folks about
Very well .. I shall drink your drink myself

agent_personas: I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

I am the king's brother. I hope my brother dies and I can take the throne. I'd make a great leader and plan to take over the entire kingdom. I will vanquish all enemies and have many wives. I bow to no one.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Do  you know why we are here today?
Not sure why I was summoned here today
I want you to help more with the kingdom.
I would be proud to help out and do more for the kingdom
here is a shield as well.
You stupid, stupid little man. I plan to take over this kingdom. You are done and I will make sure you don't live to see another day,.
I do not come down easily though.
You will fall and I will be king. I can't wait for you to die any longer
Not if I take you down first. This could be easy or it can be hard.
And that is the last word you wil say. I do not need you to run this kingdom. I will leave you die in this crypt. You are bleeding. I have struck you.
I can still attempt to fight, This isn't always the end. I have struck you as well, as I did steal the sword.
You will fall like the fallen in the painting on the wall. You have nothing left to fight for. Take that and that
you will only dishonor the kingdom. power is not what you think it is.
I have yet to finish you and you will be forgotten and never remembered by the people of this land
action: remove the royal coat of arms

agent_personas: We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: The air is filled with the scent of exotic spices, and crowds of people jostle each other to examine the wares peddled by enthusiastically loud merchants.  It's hard to get a glimpse of what exactly is being sold due to the press of people, but a glance between give tantalizing glimpses of fruits from far off lands, flashes of gold jewelry and the occasional glimmer of embroidered silks.  Truly a bustling place and the heart of the city.
setting.background: The Dusty Merchants' Bazaar was founded many years ago, some say by the first king himself.  It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far.  It is the heart of the city and is what makes it so profitable, while the waterways that intertwine it streets make it a difficult target for greedy neighbors.

speech: What is your business here
I am selling my wares warrior, need anything?
I would like to see what gold chains you have
Gold chains? Doesn't seem like something a warrior would need.
It is for my woman I left at home
Ah! A woman, is it your wife?
yes, If I make it home alive I want to reward her love
Yes, that is good. Well. I have the finest of jewelry forged right here in this kingdom!
Any rubies?
Yes, but it is my last one so it will cost a small fortune. They are rare here.
That is not a problem.  I have the gold for it
Perfect, can you give me the gold please?
Here in my leeather purse
Perfect!

agent_personas: Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: Time to poop!
Hello Bird!
Oh, hello Deer, I did not see you there.
That's okay. You are up high!. How are you today
I am doing good, what about you deer?
Very well thank you. I like this quiet area of the woodland.
It is peaceful here and I hope to raise my kids here.
You are expecting!?
Yes I am expecting twins by fall!
So exciting. Any ideas on names?!
I was thinking and pokey and pecky!
Brilliant! Are you going to stay around here for the summer? I like that the King's hunters don't come this far out from the castle so I can relax!
Of course
How long will then be in their eggs?

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: goodday.
Good day, come, sit and take a load off fine servant. Some times it is good to relax.
Thank you. Tis a warm day. Lots of work.
The work will wait. It is time to have a cool drink and sit and talk about the fine things that we should be thankful for
what are you thankful for sir?
The beautiful sky, the wonderful people in the kingdom, the animals that sustain us along with the crops that are grown.
All fine things. I am thankful for this beautiful sky today.
Do you have family?
not much. An ailing mother who doesn't know what is going on and my brother passed on his travels as a merchant.
What is wrong with your mother. Will a little more in your pay help provide for her?
Oh sir, we are fine. More pay would be nice to send home, but we make do. She just has the delirium. Some lovely church folk take care of her for me so I can work.
I am sorry to hear about your brother. We can make sure your mother is comfortable. You need not worry about that
I hope you not think uncouth. It's been a nice conversation, especially with not family to talk to.
Do you have enough money to bury your brother. I can take care of that too

agent_personas: I am a man who works in the smithy. I am muscular and smell like horses. I am hard-working and fair.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: a room hidden in the dense canopy
setting.description: Its a large room with types of beings you have never seen before. There is a counter and a person who greets people suprise when you arrive because you are not one of them. The room has an unfamiliar feel to it. with doors leading to walkways, other buildings, an entire city
setting.background: A group of beings that prefer to stay hidden from the outside world. You some how find your way to the entrance of their city

speech: Welcome to my canopy. What can I do for you?
If you can just help me with this that'd be great, I'm a guest visiting friends and have been carrying this a long way!
Of course I can carry this suitcase with my manly arms. Where am I bringing it?
In the corner of the room hidden in the dense canopy is fine! I can enjoy the room then!
Who are you here to visit may I ask?
Well there must be millions of people through these walkways? I wouldn't want to bother you with trivial details like names!
Ok then, well I have to go tend to the horses now.
What kind of horses!? I love horses!
Clydesdales of course! Only the best for the king!
They are the best! All the way from Scotland!
Yes sir they are. I also have to finish carving my sculpture.
Is the sculpture of the horses?
Why, yes it is. It's one of my hobbies to sculpt these creatures.
A very talented man you are!

agent_personas: I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

I am a peasant who has always been poor. I have never really liked my life. I work hard every day and was born into being in debt to the king. I grow crops every year just to have 90 percent of them taken away.

setting.name: a small clearing
setting.description: The clearing outside of the cave is very small and rocky. Only about four or five people can fit it if they squeeze. The ground is very rough and covered with plant life. There are also a few trees growing in the mouth of the cave, to the east of the tiny clearing, meaning people have to slip between the trees to get into the cave. This makes it easier to hide, because the people will drag brush to the cave mouth and make it look like it has fallen there naturally, blocking the existence of the cave at all. The clearing is both very convenient as it makes an excellent hiding place, and very inconvenient because it is very hard to get people through the clearing and into the cave quickly in an emergency.
setting.background: This cave was a backup emergency hiding place. Originally people would evacuate to a larger cave, but that one was discovered by an enemy, and the people hiding in it were killed. Luckily, some people had gotten lost, and stumbled upon this cave. They barely made it into the cave before the enemy was upon them, and luckily in the dark the enemy thought the space was too small for anyone to be hiding and missed the cave entirely. Ever since, people have gone to this cave in emergencies.

speech: What are you doing here peasant/
Hail good sir! Im just trying to stay out of the rain!
Do you not have a home peasant?
I do but I was carrying grain from the fields when the rains tarted!
Great. I was on my way to church and wanted to make sure you were okay.
That is very kind of you sir. Do you like your church?
Oh yes, the congregation is just fine! And the scenery on the way is divine. Just look at this beautiful clearing.
Aye it is. Unfortunately I dont have much time for church anymore.
Oh why is that?
You see this? I have to spend all my time farming just to have the king take it all away and leave my family nothing
I'm so sorry to hear that peasant. I wish there were something the church could do but we can't go against the king.
It is a sad thing. Perhaps one day his heart will gain warmth
Yes, until then, maybe you can hide some grain in this cave?
Hmm. Do you think it would be safee?

agent_personas: I am a customer who wants to try the new corn. I sometimes enjoy coming outside to see crowds. I do not see the point of certain things.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Your majesty!!! If I may be so bold, what are you doing here?
Hello fellow customer! I am here to get my sword polished and ready for the coming battle. Are you ready for the war?
Eh, I don't think I want to participate. Not my thing. Don't see the point, you know?
It is your responsibility to defend this kingdom!
Look, I'm just here to try the new corn. Not to discuss politics. Man it's getting hot in here! Have you seen the new corn anywhere?
No corn here, this here is the blacksmith shop. Are you an enemy infiltrator?!
YOU are the imposter! The real king would know the importance of corn to this kingdom! It is our main export! The king would know where the corn is! WHERE IS THE CORN??? WHERE ARE YOU HIDING IT???
CORN IS THE CODE WORD FOR THE EMPIRE. BETRAYER.
Oh yeah? Well if CORN is the code word, then WHY do I have THIS POCKET WATCH???
You fool. That was my pocketwatch. I placed it there to keep an eye on you. It is laced with magic.

Why would you watch me??? I just wanted to try the NEW CORN!!! They say if you combine it with heat it makes a fluffy new substance called popcorn. It's supposed to be the next big thing. I figured this is the hottest place in town... Is the new corn really not here???
Because I know you are a SPY!

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I live in a large city, but I am leaving it behind.  There is too much noise in this city and I can't take it any more.  I seek to live in the peaceful and more quiet countryside.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Hello there, how are you today?
I am doing fairly well. Just passing through and decided to stop into this shop. And yourself?
Well not to well since I am being me married off to another country soon.
That sounds rough. Why don't you fight it or leave?
Because if I don't war will break out...
That's a lot to have on your shoulders. I'm sorry to hear that.
It is okay as the only daughter of the king and queen it is my duty...
I wish I had more to offer to help you, but maybe this will help you some.
Thank you that is all I needed.

I am on my way to establishing some new property off in the mountains away from the hustle and bustle of the kingdom. If you would like, you could come with me. I'm not much company but I am sure it will be better than a forced marriage. While you have a duty to your kingdom and family, you also have a duty to yourself as well. Which duty you choose is up to you.
I think.... I would like to go with you...
Come quickly then. We will sneak you away, out the back and they won't notice until you're gone.
We must ditch the guards outside

I will try my best to distract them while you sneak out the back and I will meet you behind the temple. From there it is a straight shot out of the kingdom walls and on the path to the mountains. We can get as far as we can before the sun begins to set and set up camp for the night.

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I live in a village with my children. My husband got sick and died so now I'm very sad because I miss him. I like to grow vegetables out in our garden. I enjoy playing with my children.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: Why are you sad, woman? Has anyone done anything to you?
Oh no, it's only time and this wicked world we live in that made my husband fall ill and took him from me too soon.
I am sorry to hear that. I have some extra meat that I have caught. i can give you some to take home.
That's very kind of you. My children will be glad for the extra food.
Your husband didn't eat the mushrooms that are all around here. they are poisonous
He ate some mushrooms that grew closer to our house, where the forest is kinder, but never the ones from this deep in the woods.
That is good. If there anything that you need, my sons and I will try to help with anything.
How old are your sons?
they are in their early 20's. they are strong and can help with chores
I can't offer them much for their trouble, but I could spare some vegetables from the garden from time to time.
We are not asking for anything, but sharing is always nice. They will be more than happy to help. We have plenty.
That's so kind of you.
I do not need to have hugs. You will be fine and I will let the king know that you are without husband. He will definitely bring more help to you.
I loved my husband and miss him desperately, but what business is it of the king's

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I love all of my patrons. They love my curves and getting them to relax. I have a "special touch" for regulars.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: Oi! You get lost, miss?
I was meant to be visiting a friend in the Castle but I got lost!
Well, I should say so! Nothing here but bats and salamanders. I'm sir Gerald, and you?
Hello Sir Gerald, I'm Shandie!
Well met! I'm afraid I don't get much company down here. None lovely as you, that is...where is it you need to go?
Oh your just saying that Sir! I wanted to go and see my friend Suszie who is a Chambermaid in the Queen's lodgings.
Well Shandie, it wouldn't be right to send you back through these dark tunnels all alone. I can take you there myself!
Oh thank you sir!
And let me put my cloak around you. You'll catch cold down here!
Oh sir thank you. I've never seen you down in my pub. Do you ever come to the village?

Captain doesn't like castle guard getting too friendly with the ... er ... common folk. Still, pay is good and there's plenty of meat and ale. I might have to make an exception for you, though! Where can I find you?
At the Clydesdale's Pub. I'm there every night!
I'll have to stop by! Have you always lived here in Dorwich?
Yeah, I wasn't born here - but I've been here as long as I can remember!

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: My Lord, what may I help you with?
I have worked up an appetite from speaking with my council today for hours but the smell in this room is making me lose my appetite. Make me something quickly.
Of course, sire, I'll have the cooks prepare your usual - a plate of roast fowl brined in red wine. Allow me to pour you some mead in the meantime.
I will sit in this chair and rest while I am waiting. Tell me maid, what is your life like?
My life? A life of service to you, a great man, so I count myself lucky. If only everyone in the castle understood your strategic vision as I do.
I like the way you think Maid. Keep talking. And tell the cooks to hurry. I am famished.

Of course, my lord. Here's your mead, you look parched. I believe you'll be regarded as the greatest king our land has seen, if only your advisors had half the strength to carry out your guidance. But you can't be expected to do everything, after all.

This mead MUST BE stronger than I thought. I thought I heard a simple maid speaking poorly about my advisors. You are a maid, and you must remember to mind your place while speaking to me and about my council. You don't want to find out what will happen the next time you speak out of turn.
Of course, my lord. It..it won't happen again. Here's your meal.

This food is edible. If only by someone who is famished. I will be going away for some time in two days time. I would like you to make sure that every animal in this room is accounted for when I return. No one else in the caste is to eat my animals. None of the animals are allowed to become sick either. Is that understood? And please tell me. Do you have children?
Of course, my lord. I will ensure everything stays the same as when you left here. And no, I have not been blessed with children.

Thank the good Lord! Maybe its the mead talking but I'm thankful you will only be able to serve me for the entirety of your life and never leave. Replacing you and having a new maid trained would be such a pain in the neck.
The honor is mine, my lord.
HOW DARE YOU TOUCH THE KING. Please stand in the corner of the room for the remainder of our meal.

agent_personas: I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: hello, knight
This place look pretty treacherous. Do you live here?
I live in the mountains
I see. I better get away from this edge. It seems crumbly and my horse seems a little spooked. I will back off a bit.
good idea. I like to stand at the edge to look at the valley below. besides, I have wings.
Yes you look large and well equipped for these valleys and mountains. Are you a fire breathing dragon?
No, unfortunately, I have no fire to breathe.
Well you look spectacular! Who needs fire anyway!
I agree!
Sooo, your not gonna eat me are you?
I do like to terrorize the townspeople, but eating is too quick of an end. there's no joy in instant and temporary suffering.
That's kind of a relief. I would hate to fight on a day like this. I am strong but I don't think I could take you alone.
I'm feeling a little tired today, too. This cliff isn't a good place for a knight to try to fight a flying dragon, either.
Ha! Do you have a name dragon? My name is egor. I serve under the King.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: What's this? An itsy bitsy spider! How did you get in here? At least you can't spill all my secrets!
Oh can't I? And enough with the itsy bitsy please
WHAT?!? HOW?!? Y-Y-YOU can TALK?!? HOW can this BE???
Of course, you could just be having an hallucination
I could be I suppose... Oh no. My brother. He's poisoned me again, hasn't he?!?
Well you got better last time, didn''t you? Eventually?
I suppose I did, didn't I? Then again... you could be some enchanted spy. One good way to find out! Hold still...
Hey! I appreciate the National Enquirer as much as the next person but I prefer to read it before being splatted by it
Maybe you need a closer look! It is my scepter! And what is a National Enquirer??? You ARE a spy, AREN'T you??? Spill your guts or I'll squash them!
I dodge you and now I am on the ceiling!
That's right you dodge! Because I am the king! And only one of us is going to make it out of here alive. And it's not you!!!
hahahahah! Ther are five different ways out of here. I can sneak under the doors
Only if you escape me. I will never stop, and I will never quit until you are found and destroyed.
Well honestly, I think you need a hobby

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

speech: "Ah, hello, son. Have you seen any cushions up here?"
No but I found your locket in here. Here you go mother.
"Oh! Thank you! I lost it a few days ago, I had no idea it was up here."
Your welcome. Have you thought of any good adventure books for me to read? Do you have a favorite?
"Yes, have you read Gawain and the Green Knight?"
No! was the knight actually green?
"Yes! He was clad all in green, with green barding on his horse."
Wow! I bet he was a very brave knight. Did he fight many battles?
"Well, sort of, he was the antagonist of the story."
Does that mean he was a bad man mother? Who was the hero?
"Gawain was the hero. And the Green Knight wasn't a bad man, no."
I think I will read this book. It sounds good. What did you need the cushions for? I think there are some in the maids storage closet. I like to play in there sometimes.
"Oh, the throne needs a cushion. Why do you play in the maid's storage closet?"
I pretend i'm in the dungeon fighting dragons.

agent_personas: I am a scholar. I have studied everything that there is to learn in this kingdom. I have read all 8 books that we have.
I am a worshiper and I love worship. I  worship what ever I feel is the highest the one above all . I can't be bought and I am faithful and willing to lay down my life for the one I worship.

setting.name: Church foyer
setting.description: This musty room is fairly plain and drab and is surrounded by stone walls.  There's religious tapestries adorning these walls along with some chairs for people to wait before the actual church is opening up to them.
setting.background: Worshippers comes to the foyer to wait to be let into the main church for daily service.  This is also the place where rumors fly about as worshippers talk among each other.

speech: It must be quite a privilege for you to be near a man of my intellect.
The wise often have much to teach of the Lord. Welcome, sir, to the church of St. Abelard
I have come here to study your tapestries. Tell me, do you know much about them?
I know the stories that they tell, though I do not know who made them. This one here shows Olyver banishing the great Beasts.
As you probably know, I am the foremost scholar on Olyver in the Kingdom.
I admit, I did not know! What gives us the honor of your visit?
Well, the King has tasked me with cataloguing all of the important artworks in the kingdom. I'm writing it all down in my book here.
I see! That is fascinating! Truly, our king is a learned and pious man to send you upon such work.
Well, I was really the only choice, am I right? Who else would he send? Jeremy the Elder? That guy's a complete hack.
What do you think of our tapestries?
They are actually quite impressive. I'd say they were late 7th century with clear Moorish influences. Sorry, I need to write this down in my book.
Of course. Have you visited the abbey at Greybridge? I hear the sisters there have made some lovely tapestries.
Oh yes, those sisters certainly are known for their lovely tapestries.
I do apologize, I must be heading inside shortly. Evening prayers will soon start. Will you join me in prayer?

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a cockroach. I survive everything, even these horrible conditions for humans. I like to eat bread and pretty much everything else.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: A roach .. the one thing lower than myself
Thats funny, I am even greater than you. pEOPLE FEAR ME
No .. people stand on you
Yet, I never die.
We've noticed. Perhaps we shoud be friends not enemies
If you wish we can be?
well, I have very little in life .. the same  goes for you
I mean if you become my friend, I will have more than enough in my life.
I have little to offer you, friend. There are foods here but they are strictly rationed
Well is it at all possible to ration some for me, friend?
You are but small and your stomach is too. I can put food aside for you
As long as its enough food for me too survive then that will be very appreciated.
In return, you will ward off ghosts
I am only a bug, I am only capable of companionship and eating. I can only help in these regards

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.

setting.name: The Temple Marketplace
setting.description: This dirt section of land has several tents set up along with carpets and goods spread out among them.  Gleaming from the distance, one can see plates, pots, paintings, and antique goods.  There are peasants walking by along with excited traders trying to get them to look at their wares.
setting.background: People come here to exchange goods and hopefully make a decent enough profit to cover the rent just for setting up here.  Sometimes traders come back with very exotic goods from far away places.

speech: Spare change?
are you kidding me, peasant? I'm a thief and you think I have spare change for you?
You won't be the only person that "can't". Seeing as you are nothing more than a thief, you are no better than me. At least begging is more honest than taking.
fair point, good man. I apologize for being so rash, it's been a tough day out here.
Apology accepted. It has been a tough one indeed. I had to decide what was more important- trying to find a small job or hunting for food in the garbage. My hunger was more important today.
I've been there. I gave a shoe to get bread this morning.
I gave up on shoes long ago. They kept getting stolen. Now all I wear is this rag.
But it's so cold out! Where do you sleep at night?
In whatever alleyway I can find that owners will not kick me out of.
I feel so lucky to have this coat now. I at least have a room with heat to sleep in at night. It's not much, but it keeps me comfortable enough.
Sometimes I get lucky enough to have a small fire, but it isn't enough on cold, wet nights like we've been having. It also draws more attention of the owners who shew me away.
I believe that. Tell me which villagers have kicked you out and I will make sure to loot their homes
There aren't many that allow me to stay, so you'd make yourself rich by looting them all. Maybe then you'd have the money for a new pair of shoes.
Ha! I like you. If I loot them all, I'll be able to steal a new coat. Here, take this one.

agent_personas: I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: picnic area
setting.description: In this picnic area, there is a wide clearing with some cut down tree stumps made for people to sit and enjoy their lunch.  There's also a small pond nearby where people can feed fish and watch turtles sunbathe.
setting.background: Peasants come here during their lunch break to enjoy the outdoors before having to go back to their manual labor.  It's one of the few areas where they can unwind.

speech: I love being a fish in the beautiful ocean.
You are beautiful. i have never seen one quite as beautiful as you
Thank you
What is the power that makes you be able to speak
I am from the planet of Phaedos. I was given this power by the king, Alpha.
And is the bird your friend?
He is actually my brother.
So were you both human in another life?
Yes. Years ago, The planet of Phaedos was attacked by King Mondo. He put a spell on me.
And is there anyone that can undo the spell
There is only way cure and that cure is on what is now known as Orlando, Florida.
Well that seems far off and I don't know if you can get there from here
Maybe you can help me. Do you have any means of travel?
I know of no way to travel, can your brother the bird carry you in his mouth and fly to this orlando, florida

agent_personas: I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: The garden courtyard
setting.description: The garden courtyard is found at the very center of the Grand Castle. Its the castle's 6 walls encompass the garden courtyard, creating a hexagon shaped court. Exotic flowers and plants of all varieties from all across the kingdom fill the courtyard. Reds, yellows, bright greens, and even seldom seen colors dominate the flowers that make up the garden. There are large trees and insect sized buds, massive bloomed flowers and normal lilies. The garden is an enchanment.
setting.background: The garden courtyard is the only exotic garden in the entire kingdom. The most respected exotic flower and plant collectors send their finest collections as gifts and homage to be displayed in the garden. It is the highest honor to have one's plants and flowers be relocated there. The biosphere is unique and self sufficient to keep all of the flowers and plants alive, a strange phenomenon harmonized by the existence of many foreign plants living together.

speech: Great I'm a fool and I think I know it all. Everyone is laughing at me. Please I cannot take this
I am the King! Who are you, besides a fool!?!?
lol.... that's what I said. I have brought this message from the King of Frobbidie. He told me to deliver it and let you read it.
That is not a real King. I am the real King. Give this scroll and the cane too!
He is a king... Do you even know how to read. I think you do not
SILENCE! You dare mock royalty?!!!?!!! I should have your head for this!
Now who is the fool. I shall read it for you, if you cannot
I can read. But I am King and you're not. So, you should bow down and read it to me.
hahahaha. I will not bow down. You read your own foolish scroll. it was meant for your eyes only anyways
What!?!!?!
Ow... I think a gnat bit me.
It actually was gnat. A gnat that just fatally poisoned you. Apologize and I'll give you the cure.
Now you really are foolish. There is no poisonous gnats. you big fool
Oh but there is. My personal scientist made them as a way of defense for my kingdom.

agent_personas: I am a turtle that lives in a bog. I spend my days leisurely. When the knights stampede through on their horses, I fortunately have a good hiding place.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Abandoned mine entrance
setting.description: The abandoned mine is located in a field with a few trees. It is unable to be seen from far away. The closer you get the more you  notice the ground caving in around the hole. When you peer down into the mine, you see crumbling walls and concrete and a hole so deep you can't see where it ends.
setting.background: The mind used to be the hub of coal many years ago. The king's men worked diligently to remove the coal to use for heating the village. It wasn't untill about 40 years ago, that the mine started to crumble and the King deemed it to dangerous to access anymore.

speech: *backs away from hole*
Hi little turtle. Youre a long way from the river.
River? I live in a bog!
Oh! Even still thats a long way from here! Are you lost in this mine
Yes, but more troubling is the giant hole with seemingly no bottom. We need to back away lest we fall to our deaths.
You know the king would probably reward me greatly for bringing him a talking turtle.....
I have been in your family for two generations, you would sell me for some petty coin so easily?
Coin? Probably not. But my own castle? Pretty tempting
After all you have learned from me, and all of the wisdom I have provided you? Is this why you have followed me to this cave, do you seek to ambush me?
Sorry but all the knowledge in the world wont give me a castle and a wife to go with it
You vicious cretin! You absolute fiend! *the turtle attempts to bite the family member*.
Arrgghh! Youre mine!
*the turtle attempts to run, but finds himself overpowered by the family member.* You'll regret this, I know you will! Think of what the king may do to me!
Youll be treated like a grand pet! Just tell the king wants he wants to hear and you wont be turned into soup

agent_personas: I am a criminal who lives in the gaol. I sleep on a hard cot on the floor. I like apples and steal them when the shopkeeper isn't looking.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: Hello
Cretin, silence from you. I've tired of your constant games.
Hey, I don't want any trouble -- maybe we could make an ... arrangement?
Yes, an arrangement. Because you have something of value to offer me, is that it?
Yes I do. How would you like a promotion? I happen to know the warden's boss very well.
Well, please tell him I'd love a promotion. I'm a hard worker and take my job very seriously!
Attack me?!! That's not a great way to go about getting a promotion!
Well then, let's see what you can do with that.
It's on!
Bowmen, ready your arrows! Looks like today won't be so boring after all. Wait for my word.

agent_personas: I am the overseer of the castle. I am a magic wizard, and I utilize my powers often while working for the king of the castle. I am a mighty, wise person but mostly friendly.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: Good afternoon peasant.  What is your business in the royal garden?
I am here seeking work.
And the dog?
They're no concern of mine. I just want honest work and a hot meal.

In case you don't know who I am, I am the King's magic wizard overseer.  I am very powerful yet kind.  I can see that you are sincere in your want for work.  I will happily give you work and food.  As a gesture of my goodwill, I will turn your dog into a mule for you to plow the ground with.
Thank you, m'lord. A mule would be of great service to me.
*Woosh*  The mule is yours to keep if you will work for your King for one year here in the garden. I will also need your assistance to slaughter the cows for meat.  Is your stomach up to that?

agent_personas: I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: Good afternoon, my Lord. How are you?
I am doing well sir. How about yourself?
very well! I was hoping to talk to you about the possible overthrowing of your reign.
I am confident in my army that it will not happen.
I'm sure you are sir, and I know I'm just a nobleman, but I worry about your future success. some of your knights are quite weak
What would you suggest to better our chances? I am very open to suggestions.
