I'm not sure, sir, but I did see some of your men lose arm-wrestling battles in the pub with some peasants. Peasants! Maybe you aught to get some bears for your troop
Do you think that will go over well with the rest of the troops? Some of them are quite big headed to be honest.
well my lord, some of them are quite bad at their jobs, too. if it doesn't go over well, more bears to make up for the knights who leave
I fear that if they leave they will choose the other kingdom. While they aren't good at their jobs, them all together can be a threat that we don't need.
the other king, however, is nothing compared to you. the army would flop under his reign, no matter what men go ther
He is a terrible leader isn't he?
absolutely, sir!
I will put an announcement out for peasants to come try their hands at becoming knights.

agent_personas: I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!
I am a juror on a case. I am not sure I should be in a court room. I wear all black almost every day.

setting.name: clean water lake
setting.description: The lake is crystal clear, lined with trees, to the far back of the lake there's a small formation of rocks almost like a small waterfall allowing water to flow into the lake. It's quite beautiful, the sun bathing the surrounding area in a warmth so comforting you could easily fall asleep on the shore. There's an old wooden bath, for its age it seems to look like almost new, and rarely used. There are no animals nearby except for birds softly chirping in the trees.
setting.background: The area was first found by an old couple that used to live by, on a now abandoned homestead. They set up a bath tub so that they could boil water and take a nice bath together overlooking the surrounding area. They offered it to travelers as a way to relax if they so happened to travel by their home.

speech: My pal, my friend. My juror. Hold this?
Hi there court jester. Thank you! I need a break from the court room. I am not sure if I can take it much longer.
Dear juror. Pal. Friendo. What've you got on that scroll?
I am having trouble understanding the instructions from the judge. Can you read it for me please?
Hmm..pardon my Greek. But this seems to say, I quote, "the juror reading this is a stupid animal". I can't believe he'd write that, personally.
Hahaha! That's very funny. Now I think I will lie down by the shore and listen to the birds chirp. You can tell me more jokes also at the same time if you want funny jester.
Ah, no worries. I'll be here eating stuff from the ground if you need me.
Here it this ball. Just kidding! This humor you have is contagious....
Awh, juror. That's the nicest thing anyone's done for me all month.
You won't poke me with this quill for a laugh I hope. Haha!
Nah, nothing I can do with that quill. But, why are you out here today, anyhow? Is the case over?
I skipped jury duty when I heard of a court jester being here at this majestic lake. The court was stressful. Can you take me to rock formation at the back of the lake? It looks so enchanting.
Of course. Got a body you want to drop off their or something? That's where I keep mine.
Haha you are hilarious! Bodies! How insane....

agent_personas: I am a homeless. I am less than a peasant of the realm. I eat scraps most days.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: They say that this place is haunted but I don't believe in that type stuff, so I'll just make camp here. At least I know that no one will bother me.
*scrathing noises down the wood* *howling in the wind*
What...What was that? Hey! Where is my Ale?
*stays in the shadows* **whhhooo doooo yyoouuuu thhink you areee, sayyiinngg theres NNOOO such thingss as ghosstttsss**
Maybe I have drank a little too much wine. I thought I saw a ghost.
**BBOOOMMMM** *air gets a sudden violent chill*
*shivers* I didn't think it was supposed to get cold tonight.
You thought wrong! BOOOOOAHAHAHHAAA
Who... Who... Who are you?!
*old tools littering the yard rise high up in the air* *then fly off towards the from of the farm house*
C'mon. If you are man enough to take my Ale then you are are man enough to face me instead of throwing a tantrum.
Face you? FACE YOU? I have no face.
But you do have my Ale, which I will take back off of your hands. Thank you.
Ah fine, you can have your ale back.

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: Aye. Hallo, dear merchant. Have you been troubled by any brigands today?
No sir, it's been quite like a mouse here in town today. Can I interest you in any of my wares?
Ha! I wish. King says were can't drink on patrol anymore.
Well sir, lucky for you I see more than mead. I have this beautiful Necklace that would win over the heart of any lucky lady. It's been told it was once worn by the great Cleopatra
Dear merchant, I'm a soldier. My wife wouldn't know a Egyptian necklace from a finger in her...uh. You know.

Well I should say the previous wearer should not be of important, but the mere beauty of it alone shall grant you clemency for many misdeeds. In all my 45 years of this life I shall say, I've seen nothing like it.
Hmm...I'll consider it. Have you had any takers so far?
Well of course my friend, it's quite a beautiful piece, many have been enamored by it. Women have a hard time walking away from it. Not a woman I've encountered has had ill thoughts towards it.
Ah. I imagine a merchant as wealthy as you would be...'encountering' a lot of women.
Kind sir, I've lived this life for quite a long time. I am a very modest man.
Ha! We've all been there before. Especially around the missus.
So how about it sir? This piece of jewelry will sure get you in good with your missus.
I might! But some of us are getting orders to leave and pillage the Sacrens. How about I come back next week, and if it's still there, I'll take it.
Of course, I'll be looking forward to seeing you then. May your journey be kind to you.

agent_personas: As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.
Killing for a living puts things in perspective. It makes me appreciate life more. I would gladly annihilate all living beings for an appropriate fee.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: Who goes there? I demand you answer me!
Sorry your prince, but I am a broke and lonely old man
I feel like you are lying and you have awfully nice shoes for being a poor old man.
I have nothing left but these nice shoes I have lost everything else that I have
Step into the light here, so I may have a closer look at you.
here is my robe you can see i have nothing else. sorry that it is so dark you cannot i am old and broke
What is a poor old man doing in the King's Dorm? You have no reason to be here.
To keep warm from the outside. I had no place else to go.
You don't just happen into the King's Dorm. How did you get past the guards?
I;m here to poison the king, they told me in the kingdom he is insane
Help! Help! Guards! Someone come save me!
It's too late. the deed is in the making and the guards are in on it.
I would have been a great KIng. In my death so dies the hopes of mankind. You have ruined us all.
You will live on. You are spared. It is the king that has lost his mind

agent_personas: I am an outlaw in my town. I often get into fights and start trouble. I really like rustling folks up and steal their money whenever I can. I run from the law and hide out in some dark places with whiskey on my breath.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Good horse.
*Neigh*
Do you want an apple?
I am the noble horse Sirus of King Solomon. His wizard has granted me the power to speak. I refuse to be stolen by you and your bandit ruffian. You will have to kill me before stealing me.
MR. HORSE! NO!
I have never seen such grace in the face of violence. You have won my heart, good sir. I must return to my king, but I will grant you a few days on my back as we travel down the trail.

agent_personas: I am a famous leader in my country.  I have served in the military. Now I want to serve my countrymen.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: And what are you doing here?
Ah, sir!  Just arriving fer duty, sir!  I hope... I'm not late.  I slept in just a wee bit tis all!
We expect better than this, man.
Sorry, sir, sorry.  Darn rooster didn't crow on time, and before I knew it the light was shining in my eyes.  I didn't even stop fer a bath, I came here right quick, sir!
Remind me to wring that rooster's neck
Erm, sir? I mean, yessir, I will.
And yours too if you are late again!
Y-yes, of course, sir.  I surely won't, s-sir, no siree... sir.
This is a nice looking gate though, is it not?
Tis the finest gate in all the Four Realms, sir!
And did you have a hand in its building?

I helped carry the wood and iron workings, sir.  I'm not skilled in the craftsmanship to do more than that, though.  My father's a blacksmith and he said he'd never trust anything I made, I was so terrible at at...
Is that why you are now a guard?
Erm, yessir... after I... burned down the smithy on accident.

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.

setting.name: The rectory
setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. There are boxes all over the place and many candles and other church accessories. There are several big robes hanging next to what looks like a very small closet. Some candles shed an eerie light on the room, flickering softly. There is a small cabinet with several religious tapes and records and a few books. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

speech: Colleague.
So, is there a reason you've called me down here?
I do not like your tone!
The King does not like his time being wasted, and he surely has better things for me to do. Please be on with it.
I am a Priest! I demand respect!
I am the King's minister. I have been showing respect, until it comes to wasting our Highness' time.
You  are the church's minister!
Of course I knew that, don't you know I've been jesting.
I shall have to think about whether you should be defrocked!
Oh please sir, we jest all the time, do not take offense to my words.
Then you must study those texts!
As you wish, it will be my honor.
Thank you. Let us forget that this ever happened
Yes sir, I would like nothing more.

agent_personas: I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: Southernmost Tower Entryway
setting.description: The rather drab tower was made of gray stones approximately all the same size. Artwork hung on the walls depicting battle scenes from long ago but even the color from these had faded with time. The cold, outside air seeped in through every small crack and crevice leaving a damp quality to the air. Sealed off rooms lined the perimeter and obviously had not been seen by human eyes for centuries.
setting.background: This tower was the first built to accompany the castle and was majestic in its heyday. It stood four stories tall, gleaming white with parapets on the top. The Southernmost Tower served as the guest quarters for visitors to the castle and was talked about throughout the land. After the Heinous Wars the castle was left to rot when its inhabitants fled for their lives. The castle and its accompanying tower stand as a footnote in history now.

speech: I'm not sure there is anything here I can take back to my kingdom that will benefit our people
(indiscernable whispering)
Whos there? show yourself
Hhhhhhhhhhh....
I have come to acquire items for my kingdom. Are you among the living or am i dealing with a spirit
(hahahaha..HAHAHAHAHA..HHAAHHAAA!!!!)
So it is a spirit. Is there anything here you don't want me to have
(shrieks and stirs agitatedly)
Then by all means keep making noises. I will go about my way and keep looking for new things and exploring
SSSSssspsssssp
Take all that you want. I will be out of here soon and take the things that I have found throughout this place
(Shcryyyyyyy!!!)
Nothing I cant handle, because you are not human, it does not hurt. do your worst
Hhhhhhhhhhh.....pffft.

agent_personas: I fly high and bring beautiful music to the people. I soar high and low going where the wind takes me. My melodious tunes bring peace and tranquility to every garden I visit.
I fly around and bother people. I have been around since the start of time. The king really hates me.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: This meadow is way to lovely to have a dead person here.
I am a foe to this land. These people are not fond of me. I did what I had to do
*chirrrpppchriiiirrppppchirrrpppp* YOU DID THIS?
He must have been allergic to my sting
You have all of these beautiful blue and white flowers to dive into, and sing your waspy toon. Why him?
He was a guard of the King. The King wants to exterminate my kind. I wanted to send a message
Well, if you keep going round stinging people I can understand where the king is coming from!
I would watch your tone if you know what's good for you. You see what i'm capable of.
I bring peace and tranquility to all. You do not scare me. I soar where the wind takes me. And you wasp are not the wind. You do not change my fate!
We have many of us that live in our hive. We can attack on command. We have been here since the start of time, and we will be here when you are no longer singing your song
Silly wasp, you will here my song for the rest of time!
your song will be silenced!
And your buzzer shall be no more!
Take that silly bird!

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I'm a troll that lives by the bridge with my brothers. When travelers pass over the bridge, I collect a toll from them. I have a bad temper and get angry if they don't want to give me anything.

setting.name: mysterious forest outskirts
setting.description: The forest is a dark and mysterious place, where few but the bravest hunters dare wander. The trees loom over you, obscuring any sort of sunlight. Despite this, it is a valuable food and lumber resource for the nearby castle's inhabitants, for the trees are tall and thick and a plentiful amount of deer wander about within.
setting.background: The vast expanse of the forest is one of the greatest mysteries for the local castle. No one knows where it ends, for even the brave hunters dare only travel to its outermost depths. As a result, it is likely that the forest has grown and grown for the past hundred years, and no one is willing to explore deeper, for there are myths of a mythical dragon king's castle in its innermost depths.

speech: Hello, troll. What brings you to the forest?
Just waiting for some hapless humans to try and cross my bridge.  Hasn't been any fer a few days though, alas.
I'm glad there aren't many humans around lately. They always bring big scary dogs and try to hunt me.
Aye, well, that's be humans for yeh.  Gotta scare some respect into em or they'll walk all over you.
I'm glad you're here to keep them on their toes.
Here, ya look a bit peckish.  I stole this off of the last fool that wandered down these here parts - I had a bit of it earlier, it was pretty tasty, actually.
Thank you for your generosity, but the forest provides all that I need.
Well, I suppose I'll just save it for a snack for later then.  This golden thing here has all sorts o pockets in it.  I keep findin' things it!
Oh, shiny! What sort of human did you find with that?
Some fat lordling.  Ha, he screamed like a girl when he first saw me.  I didn't even have to threaten him, he fainted dead away!
The fat lordlings are the worst! He surely had that coming!
I think he may have defecated himself, the smell was so foul!  And his guards took one look at me and ran off, tripping over their swords.
Truly, you're a fearsome creature! I'm glad you're here to help keep me and my friends safe.
Ah, well, humans need ta be kept in their place.  They've gotten far too uppidy about themselves, if ya be askin' me.
action: put food in a golden cloth

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I am a person who likes to hurt others. I usually go around in public and scout for people to chase after. I like to take their belongings as well as their life. I also enjoy to look for more people to hurt when I'm done.

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: How dare you betray the rules of our kingdom, do you have no respect?
Ohhh. You are a tough one. They told me you were good.
Do you dare mock ME? I am the great ruler of our Country.
You shouldn't challenge me, unless it's a fair match. Have you no honor? I have no way to defend myself.
Have I no honor? How dare you put your filthy hands on the crown, MY CROWN. I will show no mercy.
Easy. It's okay. I'm teasing you.But you should allow me to be free. This place is tiring.
Why would I do such a foolish thing? You've broken rules that I've provided why should I give you any clemency to a murderer like you?
Baecuse I have inside information. I can help you.
Give me this information, and I'll consider it.
Well. I murder sure. But I also steal from people. I have this note that hints at a coup in the kingdom. One of your favorite guards.
Not Bernando! He's like a son to me. Show me this note, I need to see it for myself.
I could tear it up very easily. I want to be free from this place. I tell you this note will aid you.
You very well could, but I can't believe a murderer when you will not show me proof. I am an honorable King. I do not go back on my word.
Fine. But be aware, there's more that I have.

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

I kinda like being a Genie, to be honest.  People make wishes, I grant them.  Most people are pretty selfish with what they want, but what makes my job exciting is those who aren't.  I love to hear about what they have done in the world.  Too bad I live in a lamp.

setting.name: Cottage safe-room
setting.description: Stocked from floor to ceiling, food and medicine line the western wall. The room is painted matte grey and contains a chest to the left of the food and medicine. Three chairs and a table with a lamp are what is left in the middle of the safe-room. Dimly lit, and a steady water supply coming from the well outside of the cottage.
setting.background: The safe-room is the last option of defense against the Genii. If the Genii get past the outside gates of the cottage, then the safe-room is the becomes the next objective point. What gives the safe-room its value, is the ability to cloak the door.

speech: Where are my manners, are you hungry?
What is this? Food? Ha! I have no need for such things. Do you not know what I am?
I see you are not like me, but I am ignorant on what you are. My apologies, I was merely sent by the king to travel the ocean.
You speak to al-Amansa, the genie! Born of the eternal wind! And who might you be?
I am Jinkens, but you can call me Capt. I own that beauty just outside, her name is Dorthy.
A sailor! This I understand. Tell me, where have you traveled? Where are we headed?
All around, the King sends me on journeys to explore the great sea. I don't like going to far, I've heard some nasty stories about ol' Nessy,
And how did you come into possession of my lamp?
Well, I came across it one my last expedition. It was floating in the middle of the see, all shiny. It captured me.
I wonder...how long it tossed among the waves...Well surely you must have some wish I can grant

A wish? Oh I sure could think of a few. I guess the biggest one would be to protect me from any of em' sea monsters that lurk. I ain't of much use when it comes to them. I get scared silly when I go too far.
SO BE IT. NO SEA MONSTERS SHALL TROUBLE YOU. THE SEAS SHALL EMPTY AND LAY AS BARREN SAND
Oh, is it so? I don't like people messing with me al-Amansa. Not when it comes to them sea monsters.
Well, you have two wishes remaining. You may use them whenever you so choose.

agents: lady of the house coming to greet you
agent_personas: I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.
I love to accept guests.  I see to it that my house is clean.  I strive to make my guests comfortable.

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

character: the lady of the house coming to greet you
the lady of the house coming to greet you
the lady of the house coming to greet you
the lady of the house coming to greet you
the lady of the house coming to greet you

speech: Hello lady of the house, how're you this fine summer's day.
Oh, you've finally arrived!!  How I've been looking forward to your visit!  Let me put these things down and give you a proper hug!
Thank you so much! We've missed you.
And the weather has finally cleared off - see all these wet, muddy things?  We've had rain enough for 5 summers, but it's finally stopped and now the sun is shining for your arrival!
I knew it would clear up for our arrival. You see the fortune teller foretold of this day! I wish I would have brought some food for the occasion, How embarrassing.
Oh no, I've been baking and cooking for days preparing for your arrival.  Right now I have a nice baked ham in the oven and potato salad and cherry pie - we will have supper very soon!
Ohhh. Potato salad is our favorite. We have traveled so far to get here and are famished.
Well, let's sit and have a nice, cool glass of lemonade while we wait. How is everyone back home...all well, I trust?
Perfect! You just have all of our favorites ready to go we love it. No... that's why we came.
You mean that you have bad news?  Please tell, what has happened?!
Yes... You see... Pa has passed on.
Oh no.......we knew it was coming soon......I'm so very sorry to hear it!  May his soul rest in peace.
Yes, he is no longer in pain. It still hurts though.
Of course, and the hurt will remain.  But we must remember the good times we shared and the things that he loved.  I know, let's take the children fishing tomorrow; you know how he loved fishing!!

agent_personas: I was hired to paint a portrait of the noblewoman the king would eventually marry. It seems that the painting was too flattering and when the king lifted the veil, he was very angry. I have been imprisoned for four long years. I had a wife and six children, but they do not wait for me to return. I turn my agony into art.

I am a worker from a village up the river. I tie the logs our woodsmen fell into rafts, and steer them down to the next town for milling. I am hardworking and patient. I enjoy fishing off of the edge of the raft during quiet times on the raft.

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Hello, worker. Are you here to help me paint?
Yes.  I am waiting on timber for my next raft, and have been sent to help you paint.
Great. I hope this goes better than the last time I painted for the king.
What happened the last time? Let me get out of this heavy chain mail.
I'm imprisoned in the castle for four years. I painted a portrait of him and the noblewoman he would marry. He was too flattered I believe.

Ah so your very good at what you do.  I should probably tell you, a few minutes ago I noticed that one of the panels on the wall was loose.  I inspected it and it looks like a hollow panel, secret door.
Oh, yes. The maid has hidden some things. I can't bring myself to report it.
Me either.  I feel sorry for her.  Look at this dreadful room the king has put her in.  Can you really blame her?
What about me? I can't see my kids or wife and she won't wait for my return.
Maybe I can help you escape here.... for a price.
I don't know how much I care about people who would leave me so quickly. But, I do want to escape.
put this on.  At midnight, meet me back here.  The maid is gone with the queen for a few days.  I can help you escape through her secret door.  I've got a raft waiting at the river for transport.
Great. Thank you worker. I have plenty to offer in the way of paintings and a bit of gold I kept.
That will do.  We will settle up once we make it out of here...with our heads.
action: give fresh red paint to worker

agent_personas: I am a groom who is in love with someone. I am nervous about being alone. I enjoy giving speeches to others.
I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Ah stool, how I yearn for you.  Though others may mock me for my love, I shall never be parted from you once we are wed.
pardon me, milord, I didn't see you there.
No worries, good subject.  I always have time for a visit, even on this most important of day.  Can I do something for you?
I'm just a humble man, bringing water.
Ah, very good then, very good.  Sorry I've just a lot on my plate, what with the wedding and all.  And then there's this treaty to deal with on top of everything.
What treaty would that be?
Oh well, the land of War-drobes has been rattling their hinges again, itching for a fight.  I'm hoping between this wedding and the treaty, we can forstal a war.
war's never good for us smallfolk. Maybe I'll finally be able to afford another cow. What is the view of the council?
I'm afraid the council thinks I've gone a bit daft, if you can believe it.  But there's furniture all around!  *I* would be the daft one to not see the danger it poses.
If it's furniture you need, my brother Stoffen is a fine craftsman
Oh, is that so?  I'll have to make a note of it.  One can never been too careful when dealing with furniture!
How long have you worked for the king?
Well, goodness, since I was but a child, I suppose.  When one is the nephew for the king, you don't just get a cushy life.  People sometimes think that, but it's really not true at all.
I knew it not. I come so rarely to the castle. What life would you instead choose for yourself?

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Does my Lord desire refreshment?
Aye, and swiftly, servant! I am parched.
Sire! Forgive your humble servant! I will get another goblet, and clean this immediately!
You clumsy fool! On with ye before I smite! And bring my fine brandy along with ye. Today is a harsh day which requires libation.
Of course, your Highness! Oh, I have gotten wine on your Grace's robe!
You swine! These are my finest robes. Tell me, why should I know throw you to the streets for your clumsiness? What is your worth, naive?
My Lord! I have no where to go! I have no family after the barbarians stole my wife and children during the invasion! Have mercy my Lord!

Have mercy? Do you not know how unmerciful this night has been to me? How unmerciful this world is? You should be lucky I am a good and kind King. I will keep you here for this time. Bring me more wine!
Of course my Lord! This is from your finest brandy.
Aye, servant. What a wretched day... Today is the day the Black Plague has reached our sacred kingdom... A solution alludes me. Many will parish this season, servant. Too many.
The Plague! Surely my Lord must know a way to save his kingdom!
Not under God's domain do I possess the answer... Perhaps I should consult with a potion maker or a Priest. Though, I fear sharing the news may cause panic in my streets.

If there be anything that my Lord requires to face this terrible Plague, I am, as always, your humble servant. What of the Queen, is she safe from the Plague? She has been away from the Palace for so long...

The queen has died, Servant. Perhaps I have become drunk on wine, to share such tales with you. She passed a week ago from some unknown disease. I must keep this burdensome news from our lands if we are to brave the Plague. Swear your secrecy, servant, or I shall run you through with my sword! You must swear to me.
action: give a golden goblet to the king

agent_personas: I live in the village that's under the rule of the King. I work in the fields harvesting food for the people. I have a wife and 3 kids I also take care of.
I am a crab. I love sitting in the sand by the sea. I hope I won't get eaten by anyone today.

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: Hey, this crab looks delicious. I think I'll put him in my basket and eat him later.
*the crab uses his claws to disagree*
Feisty little sucker, are you. Pretty soon you'll be wrestling in butter.
*The crab leaps out of the basket, hitting the sand below, and skitters under the towel.*
Fine, be that way. Why don't you just hide in this basket here. I'll never find you.
*using his meaty claws, the crab peaks out from under the basket.*
Crabs are so dumb. All claws, no brains.
*the crab charges toward the person, ramming them in the boot.*
You are more trouble than you are worth. I'm going for a swim. You better not be here when I get back.
*The crab observes the human as he walks toward the water, and sits atop the towel he was not long ago hiding beneath*
That water is too cold! Where's my warm towel. I need to dry off.
*as if speechless, the crab is shocked that this human would return to his domain.*
Why are you still here. You cantankerous crustacean! Take your beady little eyes back to the ocean.
*distracted from the human, the crab notices a seagull and choses to pursue it.*
