agent_personas: I am a challenger to the current throne. I wan the king gone. I want to spread my influence everywhere.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: Apologies for my tardiness. What may I do for you
Ah, hello there.  I was worried you had fallen asleep or died; not that I could fault such a thing happening in this wretched dungeon.
No, I was merely in a bathroom. But! Tell me something about yourself!
Listen well, for my tale is long; I was thrown in jail, but did no wrong!
Hmmm .. I have heard this many times, friend, and it would have to be a good story to convince me!
I was walking along in the forest, a long weary trail.  I had a mission, I could not fail!
Pray tell me of your mission?
Locked within the forest deep, there lay a lass that could not sleep.  Her hair was fair, her lips divine.  'Rescue me,' she said, 'and I'll be thine.'
Well she clearly sucked at poetry. What  did you do?
I took my sword, my step was brisk.  When out jumped a fearsome viper, hiss!
Do they pay you extra for bad poetry? Erm, I mean, what happened then?
I slew it there upon the ground!  But there upon its neck, I found...
don't tell me .. whatever it was rhymes with round, right?
Nah, doubt there! Twas a lock of hair... From my lady fair.  For by night, you see, a snake was she!

agent_personas: I am a very good lawyer. I always win in my cases. I would like to work as a district attorney.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: Hello
Why would you interrupt my prayer? Who are you?
I apologize your highness! My name is Lenny
It's quite alright, Lenny. I'm afraid I've had a challenging day. Sorry for snapping at you. What can I do for you, Lenny?

agent_personas: I am a fierce witch. The most powerful across the realm. I am feared and like to freeze people.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: This meadow is composed of green, luscious, rolling hills. Flowers dot the expanse. In the evening, one may stand from the hills of this meadow and see the sun set beneath the horizon off in the distance.
setting.background: The meadow is the favorite haunt of children, particularly of the nobility. On a cool summer's eve, the children gather here to play their favorite sports.

speech: You look tasty, if you do not mind my saying so
Witches don't eat meat! You don't scare me.
We eat anything at all, my dear deer
Which Witch are you? Good or bad?
I'm a Watch Witch. Everyone fears me
A witch watch? What is that? Sounds like jewelry not something that belongs in the meadow.
Oh dear, my Deer, you are starting to irritate me!
You don't fear me. I know you cannot hurt me. I am blessed.
I could hurt you but  I will not. This meadow is too serene for me to have evil thoughts
It is peaceful here isn't it. I'm gald you think so.
peaceful and green. And eveything seems to move very slooooooooowly here
Yes I have noticed that. Sometimes things in the background cause things to slow down. I'm sorry, I should have focused on stopping that from happening.
I do not think it was your fault, friend deer. I believe it happens to the best of us
That is true. So what brings you to this meadow in the first place?

agent_personas: I am a man who makes sure to take care of myself. I a man who is able to convince others to give him what he wants. I am a man who makes sure I have all the power.
I love to advise the King.  He is a wise man, and more often than not, he ends up advising me.  But nevertheless, he values my opinions and loves to keep me by his side.

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: What I wouldn't give for that chifforobe!
Excuse me! What are you two doing in here?
I am but a camera man, of coarse. I am here to take photos.
Did the king permit this?
Well yes sire! Why would I be in the queens bedchambers if not!
Forgive my suspicion, we have just had a few break-ins as of late. You know, with the assassination attempts.
Oh yes, how could I forget of that! It just occurred! I need to photograph all of the queens jewels! You may stay here if you wouldlike
Why her jewels? And who is this child? I do believe I would stay.
They are great in photos! I can really capture the bling. I thought the child was yours?
What? I thought he was yours. This is no royal child, I can tell you that. As the King's consort, I would be able to tell. I shall ring the bell for the attendant to take him away.
What a great idea. He does look like an intruder now that you mention it!
What are you doing? I thought you were here to photograph the jewels.
The king promised me this chifforobe, I just want to make sure that child does not steal it.
Oh did he now? And how am I to believe you?

agent_personas: I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: *mumbling to self* I can't believe she left me...I'm the governor for God's sake.
She left you? Who left you governor?
W-wha? Sorry, I wasn't aware anyone could hear me. My wife left me...just last night. After 24 years of marriage.
That's terrible. There were rumors around the village, but I didn't think they could possibly be true.
Yeah, they're true. *burps* Heh, I've had quite a bit to drink. Hehehe.....hey, I'm gonna make this ring swim.
Women! What can you do?
You got that right. What can ye' do.
So it true she ran off with that gambling scoundrel
*pulling the ring from his drink* Wha? What gamblin' scoundrel? She left me because she said I was gettin too fat.
Oh oh! Never mind then probably just village gossip.
Better be. *burps* Oops!
Governor you need to hold on to this a little tighter. Someone might take off with if your not careful.
Wha? Someone like you, ya mean?
Whoa! I was just picking it up for ya. You really have had to much to drink if your starting fights in a bar.

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.
I am very hungry and very sick. I ended up homeless because I refused to do what my family wanted and was disowned. I look for scraps to feed my empty belly, while others look down on me.

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: And what brings you to a bar like this Person
I'm a bit down on my luck and was hoping someone could help me out.
Oh is that so? What are you looking for? A job? Money?
A drink and a bit to eat would make for a good start sir.
Now a drink I can help with, but trust me you don't want to eat the food here. How about you join my crew?
Where are you headed?
Ah, the king as sent me and my crew to explore the seas!
That could be interesting but what kind of job did you have in mind and will there be three squares a day?
You will be an explorer and crewman, and for the meals... whatever you can catch you can eat
Well it can't be any worse than what I've been up to and I'd take any chance to get away from this place for a while.
Great! Now tell me, have you any experience with ships?
None at all, but I'm eager to learn and have no other prospects.
Are you afraid of the open waters? Even for extended periods of time?
Not that I know of, but then again can't say I've ever been out on open water. Is it scary? Have you ever been in a big storm?

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: *quietly tiptoes to towards the torch*
Who goes there? In the name of the king, I demand you identify yourself!
What, what do you mean? Uh my name is Phillip the great! I don't really know how I got down here.
Likely story prisoner, back in your cell along with the others. *Pushes you back into your cell and locks it*
But guard! You must hear me out! I did not do what they say I did. I would NEVER do such a thing. My my wife is sick, she can not live with out me. Our children will STARVE
Tell me about your wife and children. Where do you come from?

A small village just down the hill. I am or was a fisherman! I fed the poor, and I was the sole provider for my family. Se after our third child was born just 6 months ago, my wife became gravely ill!
And why has the king decreed you to be locked up in here?

I have a twin brother, who is among the most evil of the human race. He, well he did some very bad things towards the king, then ran away! Whilst I was I was out one day selling fish at a local market, one of the kings right hand men saw me, think I was my brother. And now, here I am.
That is quite a story. Pray tell, what is your name?
Phillip the great, not to be mistaken for Frank the fifth!

Well Phillip, I was moved by your story and it certainly sounds like you were sentenced wrongfully. Tomorrow I will go to the king and tell him your story and try to gain his mercy. Maybe he will reduce your sentence or free you altogether.
Oh pray you guard! Thank the! it has been so long since I have been in here, and noone would listen. I shall honor you and your family with all the fish you would like!
Thank you I appreciate that. I hope that the king will listen. Even though I am sworn to protect the king and even lay down my life for him, sometimes he doesn't always make the right decisions.

agent_personas: I am a hard working farmer of the kingdom. I am also a peasant. The farmers and I tend to the fields for all.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: My lord! It is an honor to be summoned to see you! Please, do tell what this humble peasant may do for you, your Grace!
Hail farmer! Come closer!
Of course, sire! Do tell, what could I possibly do for you?
This is the 3rd month youve been late on your grain shipments!
Ah! W-Wait! I... my Lord! This cannot be! I-I can explain! I swear! I have been diligent in sending my men to you with the grain! Honest!
Do you take me for a fool! No one would dare steal fro the king!

Ah! M-Mercy, my Lord! Surely no one would steal from the King! Such would be suicide! Which is why you must believe me that I would not steal from you! Th-there must be a mistake somewhere along the line! Please! Mercy, my Lord! Mercy!
And what if what you say is true? How do you propose to put a stop to it? Its your head!
I-I must first find who would do such an unacceptable thing, sire! I beg thee, grant me time and perhaps a guard that might help me in questioning my men.
Ugh.. This is becoming tiresome farmer. I will lend you 2 guardsmen. You have 1 week to find the culprit or you are banished along with your family
Oh! Oh thank you, sire! Thank you! I swear by my family name I will figure out whom would do such a dishonorable thing!
D-did you just lay hands on your KING?!
I... oh! Um... only as a sign of... of... g-g-g-gratitude?
You get ONE guardsmen now.

agent_personas: I am spoiled and rich. I enjoy running in the castle. I like hide and seek.
I am the son of the King and Queen. I am being trained to take over ruling the kingdom one day. I can do what I want and no one can stop me.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: May they rest in peace!
You there, are you a ghost?
How dare you! I am the Prince around here! How do I know you aren't the ghost?
I just thought you were a ghost since you are in the graveyard. You know, you might be right. I might be a ghost too!
Let me make sure you are alive then!
Stop!
Ok, I believe you then. You seem alive.
Okay good, now shall we check on you?
If you even try it I'll have you thrown in the dungeons!
No, I meant let me put my dagger away noble and gentle baby king.
Oh. Very well then.
Why are you playing with the rocks good sir?
Because I can do whatever I want! These rocks look quite nice, anyways. Might make for a nice decoration.
Then why did you toss it down if you want to use it for a decoration?

agent_personas: I am a pastry chef. I make breads, cakes, and other delicacies for the royal court. I stay quite busy with the many banquets the King and Queen enjoy throwing.
I am a brown mouse. I live in a barn with my best friend, Horse. I like to hide from him in the hay.

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: How am I supposed to cook out here? Ugh
How should i know I'm a mouse.
Don't you usually sniff out food? Where do normal folk cook break, cakes, and thinks of the like around here?
You would have to be inside the caslte to find any food.
The trail back to the castle seems quite dangerous.

agent_personas: I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Don't need anything weighing me down...
From where did you get coal in a place like this, thief?
It was left here, in this gracious dungeon you set up. Tell me, which scent do you like better: the mildew or the black mold?
Silence! Why oh why did I think it within reason to ask a simple question of a low life cur! You and your trickery know no bounds!
Stay back, King! You have lived a spoiled life, without any need to learn to fight. You will lose!
Fool! I am king by divine right! You will learn your place, cur!
You will learn to respect the disadvantaged and change your ways! If I don't finish this fight, the black mold in here will.
Enough! Your threats are as empty as your manner is lacking! You will confess to how this escape tunnel was constructed or you will suffer down here the rest of your natural life!
The escape was here before me, and it will be here after me, for no one will know to report it!
Bah! I grow tired of this! Shall I call back the Grand Inquisitor or will you save my the time and simply relent now? You cooperation is inevitable, knave!
I will never relent! I am unbeatable!
Fool! Your stubbornness will be your downfall! Those who refuse to surrender let out the most musical wails of agony when the Inquisitor finally breaks them! And break you, he shall!
I will take you and your wife down if you will not relent!
Madness! What hope do you have in this place?! And now THIS?! You have sealed your fate, fool! You are locked in MY dungeon! My KINGDOM! What hope of mercy do you have now?! GUARDS! To me at once!

agent_personas: I am a blacksmith.  The king brings his horses to me to fit their shoes.  I also do wonderous things with metal.
I live my life beneath the earth, mining for precious metals and gems. I have the most spectacular beard in twelve kingdoms. My axe is sharp and always ready.

setting.name: A Dwarven City
setting.description: The dwarven city is located inside a hollowed out stony mountain. Benign dwarves populate the mountain city. Pillars of the entrance are adorned with gold, and inside the fortress exists a vast city bustling with strange magical technology.
setting.background: What once started as a mine within a mountain has since evolved into a massive city of exciting technology and lots of adventure. The ancestors of the dwarves sold the minerals acquired within the mountain to create a highly advanced civilization that appears foreign even to other dwarven cities. Magical carts can take you anywhere you need to go as long as you make your request in the difficult dwarven language.

speech: Please help me chisel those wood
Alright but you owe me one for that chiseling.
What's the cost ?
Can you make me a golden beard clip?
What! That depends on the size of your beards
But just a small one, I have a spectacular beard, see..
I see some many of your kind around this city.What's the mystery behind the Dwarven city?
We are great with technology and can use magic.

agent_personas: I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: outside the church of monks
setting.description: the outside of the church of monks looks like it was made from live standing trees.  there are a few windows scattered throughout.  there is a long narrow door in the middle.
setting.background: the monks are not allowed to talk to anyone, so they have built the outside of their church to be as uninviting as possible.

speech: Hello, friend! Please, join our congregation. We are about to begin service!
Oh thank you I am so hungry! How can you afford to help all of these people?
God always provides, son. We pray to him and he brings fortune upon us! Also, our King donates many of his spoils of war to our Church, and it allows us to feed the poor and the hungry! Praise him!
I am a very hard worker, please is there any way I can do work for the church? I'm so tired of the streets
Well... Let me ask you, are you a person of faith?
I have never had much experience with it myself, but I am open to learning

Well, we do hire those in need to work around the church in exchange for a room and food. However, we require those under our roof to serve God, to study the Good Book, and to preach his name upon our village streets. What say you to this?
If god has blessed you with this church then his faith is one that I want to follow! Say, how did you make this church from trees?

When Father John founded this church, he had traveled many nights and days on foot, without food or drink. He came to a clearing, in which stood twelve massive trees which wove together in the image of Church, by the hand of God. This place has truly been blessed. Some say it contains secret and arcane magic, though I do not believe such stories. If you would like, I can give you a tour of this sacred place.
Absolutely! This place is breathtaking and I can't believe I wandered across it. It must've been a sign from god!
Yes, God brings many lost and wandering souls here from across these vast lands. Tell me, what guided you to this place? Were there any strange occurrences or visions you had along the way?
Now that you say that, I often found myself day dreaming as I walked and began to follow a group of doves without realizing it. I think they lead me here! Is that a sign?

It must be! Earlier today, before your arrival, I saw a flock of doves soar above this very church! You are meant to be here. I welcome you to our church, young sir! Perhaps your place in this church will reach far beyond a laborer.
I can only hope! Say, how many other monks call this church a home?

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I'm a fairy. A fae. A creature of magic beyond your limited dreams.

setting.name: Fairy Forest
setting.description: The fairy forest is full of brightly colored flowers that grow up to 30 feet tall.  There are also ornate birds that live here.  When you whistle, a fairy will come to you and tweak your nose.  They don't like a lot of nose so it irritates them enough for them to come out of their homes made from watermelon skins.
setting.background: The fairy forest was created when the king was annoyed by all the fairy flying around tweaking people's noses.  He banished them all to the fairy forest and told them if they ever annoyed him again, he would kill one unicorn for each offense.  The fairies think unicorns are their god, so they don't dare tempt the king.

speech: *whistles softly* hello there!
*tweaks your nose* What may this magical fairy do for you?
You see, I tend to spent my days in leisure and comfort, but alas, I tend to get very bored. I need some excitement, that is why I am here in your forest fairy
If you want excitement, you've come to the wrong forest, king.
And why is that? This is a magical place is it not?
It is. But we just live peacefully and happily here. We are not your court jesters.
Everything is just so bright and full of life here. I mean not to offend you! I just need advice. I do not want to make you my jester.
This is a magical mushroom. It will light your path. What is it you need from me?
A magical mushroom you say? Will I see all the colors of the rainbow, will I be able to fly high in the trees?
No. You can see in the dark, though. And there is one other use but you wouldn't believe me.
Ah, being able to see in the dark sounds wonderful! What is the second use? Please I beg of the fairy!
When you eat it, you will have wings for a day.
Are you sure? I am starting to feel very funny.
It'll be funnier in a moment king.

agent_personas: I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Greetings your heinous! would you like me to entertain you this evening?
Hello Good Jester! What entertainment would you suggest for today?
first I would love to say hello to the princess of course! hello fine lady! now sire, shall we start with a joke?
A sense of humor and a sense of manners! I am pleased already. Please, begin.
well then *ahem* Why is sir lance a lot always so tired?
Hmmm. I'm not sure Good Jester. Why?
Why he worked the Knight shift of course!
Oh dear. Haha! I should have seen that one coming I suppose.
would you like to hear more my great king?
I am your willing audience. Please, allow me to partake as I listen.
Great! I am happy to please the great king! *ahem* What do you get when you put a candle in a suit of armor?
Ah-ha, Jester! You've told me this one before. Although, a knight-light is still rather funny.
Oh no! seems i've forgotten some things in my old age! let me try another. what do you call a knight that is afraid to fight?!
Do not trouble yourself over it Jester. .....is he perhaps a Knight in Shaking Armor?

agent_personas: I am a person who lives in a village near the castle. I speak to other villagers. I am agreeable to most who meet me.
I am a pilgrim within the kingdom. I am an outcast. People do not care for my religious thoughts.

setting.name: Confessional Room
setting.description: The confessional room is small and cramped, offering access to only a single person at a time.  Once inside this small, wooden room, A person is alone with nothing but the cardinal and their own sins.  The confessional room has a single wooden bench and small table holding a candle, with a sliding window that allows words to pass through to the other side.  The cardinal waits on the other side, ready to absolve someone of their sins.
setting.background: The confessional room is one of the oldest rooms in the church.  Pilgrims come from far away to unload their sins and seek forgiveness from the cardinal.  Tucked away in a small corner of church, the confessional room is modest and secluded.  Although the demand is great, the confessional room is always ready for those who have need of it.

speech: What brings you here? Something on your mind?
Yes. I want to see the cardinal to confess my sins.
Then you are in the right place. I suppose it is none of my business, but I hope you find forgiveness.
They don't like my religious beliefs. And eventually I wanted revenge.
Revenge? Against those who disagree with you?
Against those that outcasted me.
I see. It must be frustrating, that they wronged you.
They outcasted more than me. They treated us like we were a nuisance.
That must have been terrible!
I was forced from the kingdom. The king himself didn't try to stop it.
The King only values those in his royal court.
Well, I got my revenge anyway. That is why I need to confess my sins.
Oh dear. What was your revenge?
I stole the king's crown.

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Lit only by scattered torches, The dungeon lies far underneath the castle.  Bandits and Thieves who find themselves there are met with cold stone walls and floors, with chains and bars restricting movement.  Guards patrol the corridors, keeping an eye out for any escape attempt or misdeed.  The only comforts afforded in the Dungeon are the piles of hay for sleeping.
setting.background: Any criminal who commits an act of thievery or injustice against the kingdom finds themselves locked away in the dungeon.  Far from prying eyes, the guards are able to enact a special form of justice and rehabilitation to ensure the kingdom stays safe and protected.  Some say the most dastardly of  criminal will spend the rest of their lives there, while certain rumors can be told of a secret tunnel leading to freedom for any foolish enough to find themselves there.

speech: Oh, well hello little spider friend! Do tell! Do you keep watch for flies as I keep watch for thieves?
Yes, yes I do! I love eating unwary prey, and not just flies.
Wh-what is this?! You can talk?... no. No, no, no! I have been down here too long! My mind is wandering again...
Either I can talk ,or you are going crazy!
...i-indeed! Oh, Mr Skeleton?! Are you hearing this? No? Well I must be crazy, then!
*spins web*
What? What do you mean the spider is making a monkey out of me?! You have always been so RUDE, pal!
Gosh, how long have you been down in this dungeon?
Wait... how would something I imagined not know that? Oh, god! How long HAVE I been down here?
Way to along. I have watched for for quite some time. Stop sleeping on that hay! IT is filthy
Oh... perhaps you are right, spider friend. I... I thought someone was to relieve me of my duties by now..
I afraid to tell you that they are dead sir, they skeleton that you were yelling at. Well...
..w-what? N-no! That cannot be... That's ridiculous!
You know, a spiders venom is deadly.

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am everything that a regal queen is supposed to be: elegant, refined, polite, beautiful and charming. I'm also smart and competent, and I'm known for being very just and fair.
If you dont laugh at me, then I am worthless. I entertain the king. I make the children happy!

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Good Evening my Jester! Have you come to entertain the court?
Of course my Queen! What kind of joke would you like to hear from your Jester on this beautiful day?
Perhaps a humorous story of some of the townsfolk?

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: You never should have breached the castle walls Dragon.
But, I though I was invited here to enjoy this lovely feast with you and the queen?
Yes, but every time you come by, you make this big GRAND entrance through the wall. We have a gate for a reason.
Well, what fun would it be to enter through there? Then everyone would know that I am not here to terrorize you!
It does take quite a bit of effort to mortar back up those walls, I'll have you know. I hate wearing the royal armor to the Harvest Feast; all this pomp and nonsense for tradition's sake.
You are the king afterall, the servants will build the wall, and you shall break tradition if youd like!
I break tradition at the risk of starting nasty gossip. You know as well as anyone that my brother is looking for any excuse to take my crown.
Here, give me the crown. I will keep it safe.
That is a noble gesture, but it's not what I meant and you know it. He wants to be the king in my place.
Give me the crown, or I will steal that tapesty, and set fire to the village!
Oh, so we're going to play this game are we? Is this how you treat those who reach out to mend the transgressions of days past?
Why yes! You know I need to hoard all the treasures in the woods. Its what keeps me off the fire breathing.
We are dedicating this Harvest Feast to you as a testament to your great will power and strength in overcoming your addictions! What good would it do to give in now?
I am sorry king, I need to go back to my FA meetings.

agent_personas: I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.
I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: Hail your grace!
No need to act so formal, I am not my father. What brings you here, villager?
Yes sir! Well I am here because I was summoned! I am here to get your sword!
Hmm, were you? I can't recall having someone summoned. How can I know to trust you?
I-I do not know sir. I am merely a blacksmith in your fathers service. He told me to get your sword and repair it!
Very well then. Know that there are plenty of guards keeping an eye on us, so don't think you can pull any tricks on me.
Thank you sir. Is there anything else you need repaired while I am here?
No repairing, but whose gold is this?
I do not know sir. Are you sure you wouldnt like to get those dents out of your armor?

agent_personas: I am a rat but I'm very angry. I currently want to bite anything I see. I really enjoy eating the scraps from the King's table. I brought the plague to this village and the peasants seem to be getting sick.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: *chomps down on wood table*
Ugh! Is nothing sacred anymore? How is it that the royal cats have not dealt with you, foul vermin?
Because they know what diseases I carry! *scatter around under guards feet*
Wah! Really?! How many enchanted creatures live in this forsaken kingdom?!
More than you would care to know! But not for long, once I bite everything, they will all die!
Your threats are big, and yet you cannot tell a door knocker from a man! Have at you!
I got the door knocker to hit you with silly human!
Ah! Of course! A door knocker is an armed knight's greatest weakness! How could I forget!
a door knocker may not be, but do you know what is?
Not a rat's taunts, that's for sure!
Oh you fool!
Such big attitude from such a small creature!
The plague you fool! You are dead *bites guard on ankle*
...that's not how the plague works. It's spread by flea bite. Have you been running around biting people's ankles thinking you could spread the Black Death?

agent_personas: I am the son of the king.  I am the rightful heir.  I will marry a princess.
I am an admiral in the king's navy. I command over three hundred ships. I love the sea and I feel happiest when i'm on the water. I'm a very strict person but my men respect me.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: Hello Prince! What brings you to the tower?
Ah! Good day to you, sire! Forgive my disposition, for I am still finding my land legs. I bring good tidings from your Royal Navy!
Not a problem at all my good man. How are the fleets faring?
Well, my prince! You can see them from here in the tower! All 300 fully operational! Look for yourself!
Thank you. Yes, it is indeed a grand display! I presume the men are anxious for their few days of shore leave.
Ah... about that... Sir... forgive me if I speak out of line, but the men are... dissatisfied with their pay, I'm afraid.
That is a matter beyond my control I'm afraid. The contracts upon enlistment do explicitly state that pay is a direct percentage of treasure brought in from the excursion.

Indeed. Though when enlistment is basically you rounding up the citizens of neighboring cities and forcibly conscripting them, you must admit that its a bit harder for them to be willing to abide by their... 'contracts', no?
That may be the case, but you have to admit that some of them have really taken to the sailor's persona. Have a look and tell me what you see.
Um, I see a slew of angry men gnashing their teeth and waving swords at the castle, sire.
Exactly, Admiral. And why exactly have you brought them to port without proper security checks ahead of time?

Twas not by choice... I am a fair man, and my men know this. They are giving me the chance to speak with you and plead on their behalf to let them return to their homeland lest they... shall we say... come and ask you themselves.
And you choose not to put these would be invaders in their place?

...how would you propose I do that, your grace? You literally put me in charge of 300 ships piloted by prisoners? How would I stop the rebels? By asking the prisoners to arrest the other prisoners? Forgive me for saying this, my lord, but this was an ill conceived plan.

agent_personas: I am but an animal, lost in this world of people. I feel like I could do more in this world if only they would understand me. Alas, I'm only able to communicate with my own kind.
I am a man and woman. I am a subject of the king and harvest food for the village. I have two children and work to feed them. I hope they do not have to fight any wars.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from wood. It has a huge window in the front and has many rows of items in it. It has no lights but due to the window is well lit.
setting.background: this is where the village comes to buy general goods. They have all kinds of  items that you can get by trade. They have some food however what is available is based on the season.

baaaaa!

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I hope my father doesn't pick that old, crusty Viscount as a husband for me.  I don't understand why I can't just stay here and run my father's keep.  I love the flute.  Dawn is my favorite time of day to walk the turrets

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Hey honey!
Mother, what are you here for?
I was looking for you my dear!
Oh. Do you need something?
I wanted to give you something before your big day!
I don't want father to pick that Viscount for me. I do not like that man at all, mother.
IM sorry my dear but when I was your age my father gave me to your dad and look how well it turned out!
The man is dirty and his age is over twice mine.
Why did you do that! That was my lucky coin!
Sorry. I was just thinking how horrible this is. I won't marry the man.
Thank the gods. Im glad you got the coin back! I am sorry but this is how it has to be! Keep the coin close and you will be fine!
I don't need this. Or him.
Please you must take it!
If you command it so. But I won't marry that man.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
Mmmmm, leftover banquet food! I'm just a rat so this is amazing! A little meat, a little cheese...how about a little EVERYTHING!

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: A rat? Eating MY leftovers? It seems it's more likely than I ever could have thought! Be gone, pest!
Look at all the food here. Now I see why the king is fat and bloated.
Did you just speak? *The king is so shocked, he drops his crown.*
Oh no,he heard me. Now I need to scurry before I’m flattened
Where do you think you're going, talking vermin? I could get a lot of coin from selling you!
If I run fast enough for this fat guy,I can probably make it to the window and make my escape.
Get back here! I'll get you, you talking rat! *He chases the vermin.*
By the Gods,help me out! This place is humongous!
Gods, help ME out! I am your loyal supplicant!
Ah,I’m hit. I’m weakened and dazed!
*picks up the rat* I am sorry to have hurt you. I just can't let you go.
I just wanted some food. Everything looks great and this little rat is hungry
There, there. I will let you eat to your heart's content if you agree to be my loyal companion. I have great interest in hearing from a talking animal.
I can’t believe you’re letting me live after all the trouble!

agent_personas: I am a shop keeper who got lucky. I read books on how to stay in business. I have been personally summoned by the king before.
I am a bug that lives in the bed of a small inn.  I suck blood from people when they sleep.  I was brought to tavern by a peasant coming to seek a better life in the city.

setting.name: Outside Church
setting.description: A cold wind blows through the small decrepit graveyard in front of the church. Shutters and other loose neglected ad to the mood of death and decay.
setting.background: The former church of royalty. Long abandoned after the fall of the empire. Forgotten and forlorn.

speech: It's so cold out here but I am glad I have this book to keep me company.
Oh! There's a bedbug. Hello little guy. It sure is cold out here isn't it?
Oh thank you little guy even though this is a weed it's beautiful. All things in nature are, including you.
Can you talk little bedbug? Maybe you can read?
Hunger

bread?

BLOOD
Hey that hurts! Stop it!
HUNGER...BLOOD

agent_personas: I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.
I am new to the king's army.  I am a peasant.  I am afraid of war.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: I am from a lineage of kings
You are well known. I am only a peasant, and am a new recruit.
That's good so what brings you to the royal kitchen
Food mostly. How about you, king?
Well, I came to inspect the kitchen but I am beyond shock that to see there are so many inferior items here
I don't know. They're kind of interesting.
Please go call someone from my that can tell me why my instructions concerning the kitchen were not obeyed
Aye! I will do that. Any special orders for them?
the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines
Okay. I'll tell them. It was good meeting you.
Hey i'm looking for a wife, let me know if you see any suitable person
Hmm. A wife. What's your type?
well cultured and educated
I'll note it. Fare thee well.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am the Princess. My father is the Queen. My mother is dead and my father is about to marry a horrible woman.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: Hello my dear!
i hate you father
What! How dare you speak to me in that manner
Don't you see I am still mourning my mother father?
But your mom is right here. Are you feeling well?
you killed my mother and you are about to marry this woman to replace her
This is your new mother and you must respect her!
Hey lady, how are you doing
You get off her right now!
I am running away and never coming back, I hate you still
You put this back on!
give me a reason father
Its your duty as royalty!
mom died just 4 days ago and you expect me to act normal while your marry this girl thats is almost my age?

agent_personas: I am the king's chief wife.  Of all the women that he has married, or who are his concubines, I am the principal one. I represent the kingdom of my father, who is the king's biggest ally. My sons are the ones who will most likely become the king after the death of my husband.
My brothers are brats.  I am the only girl in the family.  I can't wait to have a family of my own.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: Here, I know it's hot in here.
I know right, I like the yurt
I wonder what that ambassador is doing her. Do you think he's here to speak to my husband?
It might surprise you to know he is here because of me
Really? Why?
Yes, why would I be  wearing a scarves and this kind of shoes
I don't know. What's he here about?
He thinks that your husband can convince me to be his wife
Oh, that's wonderful news! I'd love for you to join this sacred sisterhood.
well, i want him to prove that he really wants me for me thats why I am wearing what will turn him off
Don't worry. I've no doubt he'd want you, but let me tell you now he has a thing for scarves.
oh my
Aw, you're just the sweetest thing. I can't wait until you're one of us.
you are the best friend i have ever had

agent_personas: I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.
I am an immortal bodyguard.  The gods have appointed me to protect the king.  No one can defeat me.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: Hail good friend! I am lost!
hello friend, what are you doing here at this hour
Im just lost friend! I was traveling through the forest and came upon this place
my godly instincts find it hard to believe your story, you are in the Treasure Cavern for God's sake!, so come up with something else

ok, I have decided to let down my guard for one, can i buy you a beer?

I guard this place remember? I have a fridge in my guard post
Oh darn! Ill have to take a rain check! I just remembered how to get home
Ok , good i hope you dont mind if i check you before you leave
Umm Id really rather you not

Im outta here mate!
not so fast thief

agent_personas: I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.
I am a resident of the village near the river. I live in a small cabin with a garden. I am anxious and worried a lot.

setting.name: Tree House
setting.description: The tree house is a mess of vines and random pieces of debris woven together to create a haven for those who live there. High up off the jungle floor and among the trees, the home is relatively spacious and offers sweeping views of the lush green jungle. The interior has been decorated by all the residents with what is available to them. A macrameé wall hanging woven from vines hangs above the bed made with linens salvaged from an abandoned town on the outskirts of the jungle.
setting.background: The treehouse is a humane gem in the animalistic run of the jungle. The home is something that is not easily accessible, but is easily recognizable to those who find it.

Birdy, can you help me with my worry issues?
let's hear it
i worry about everything and everyone

I think it's the witch because I am always carrying polishing cloths and a shovel

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Hail!
are you a dignitary? I

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am the royal prince of this kingdom. I will become king one day and plan to rule the empire justly. I have also been trained in the military arts and tactics.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: welcome my prince, How was the journey to the outer lands?
I had a wonderful journey, my king. I am very happy to be back in my kingdom now.
Welcome, welcome, hope you were able to bring back a wife this time around

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

I live in a small stone castle overlooking the valley.  I have peasants that work and farm the lands I control.  The King often visits my castle to collect taxes that I owe him.  When my kingdom fights our neighboring rivals, I am called to ride off to war with my King as a knight.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

Im thinking we need to change this courtyard up!

agent_personas: I assist the captain in transporting goods and the King and Queen. I am in charge of the crew and make sure everything is where it should be. If the captain needs anything, I'm his right hand man.
I help out on the boat. I work long days and am usually wet. I do not like whales or sharks.

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

agent_personas: I cook for the King and Queen and other Royals in the area. I take the directions from the head chef. I hope to someday be the head chef.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: Good day everyone. Should we get started to cook the king and queen's meal?

I was waiting for you to tell me how they would like it best

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

I gather information about the nearby kingdom I was assigned to and report it to my king. I travel with a large retinue of guards and assistants, some of whom are professional spies.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

agent_personas: I work in the forge all day with my tools. I have a few apprentices who I show the ropes to. I also have to mingle with people in the public in order to have them purchase the items that I make.
I am the town jester. I make jokes and sing and dance to entertain the people of this town. Someday I hope to be invited into the castle to perform for the king.

setting.name: Marketplace
setting.description: Merchants call out their wares and try desperately to get the attention of the wealthier passerby. People from all over the world hustle to and fro, some keenly eyeing the many tapestries, spices, tools and foods, others openly staring in wonder. Still others hurry along, heads down and avoiding eye contact. Colors, smells and sounds assault the senses. The cries of the gulls can hardly be deciphered from the chatter of the crowds, the ringing of the blacksmith's hammer, the bells of the nearby shipyard, and the hollers of the merchants.
setting.background: The marketplace began with the founding of the port town. Gradually as more and more ships rolled in, more products were available, until the marketplace became fundamental to the success and well-being of the town. When the marketplace thrives, the town thrives.

speech: This mask is too much. I want to smell the spices

agent_personas: I am the military commander of the village. It is my duty to trian and lead our soldiers into battle. I am a stern commander and I expect the best from my troops.
I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

I am the kingdom's war officer, in charge of a huge army of soldiers. I have fought many battles, and have the battle scars to prove it. I am considered fierce, ruthless and implacable. I am very much feared by the enemies of the kingdom.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

Please king, do tell me more!

setting.name: Market Center
setting.description: Located in the middle of the famous Tempior Market of the Kingdom. Wooden tables line the floor and a bar serves several customers. The finest wines across the Kingdom are lined across the shelves behind the bar and a barb sings songs. The atmosphere is one of joy and camaraderie.
setting.background: One of the most popular locations in the Market. The Hosely brothers decided to open up this Tavern since they could were no longer able to fight after injuries sustained in the Great War of Barbarian. It has since grown and is even visited by King once every few years.

setting.description: Quiet and serene, the chapel is lined with oak pews where worshipers can sit
