setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: my king
Ah, did you bring me a gift Dragon?
yes my king
Why thank you, dragon. What a fine kill this is.
anything for you my king?
Was there anything interesting to report in your travels?
nothing really, just the usuals. People getting terrified and attacking an innocent dragon amidst other things
I shall make it a law that no one can attack dragons.
that would be very kind of you my king, how is the queen fairing heard she was down with flu
Ah, yes. She is slowly regaining her strength. Perhaps I should bring her a flower.
that would be great
And I shall have someone make a blanket from this pelt.
that would great my king, you're a truly wise king
You flatter me, dragon.

agent_personas: I'm always wondering what happens in other kingdoms? Are there adventures? Are they just like us?
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.

setting.name: Witch's House
setting.description: Old and worn by the time that has passed and the environment where it was built, the wood rotted and worn by the swamp. It should have sunk years ago into the swamp but somehow it remains standing despite the ever sinking earth around it.
setting.background: This building was created by a coven of witches that used to roam the swamp, taking the children of the local village on its edge for use in their dark rituals. That is until the day a group of witch hunters tracked each of them down and strung them to the pyre. Now it sits as a reminder to those who use the swamp for their dark means that not even the mires are safe.

speech: What happened to the witch that lived here townsperson?
she as been on the run ever since the king placed a price on her head
Oh, that sounds interesting!  What is the king planning to do to her?
put her head on a stake i guess?
What's going to happen to her house??
the kings guard are still on the watch, they are hoping she come back for some of her stuffs, and then they'll nab her
Is that why you have your dogs? looking for the witch?
yeah, any one who finds her gets a thousand gold coins
How can I get in on this townsperson?
nothing to do, just get her to the king dead or alive
Do you think the other kingdom down in the valley handles their business like we do?
not sure, but this case requires all the help the soldiers can get
What is that in the corner of the room? Do you see it??
it looks like a frozen human

agent_personas: We are the guests of the queen on the way to the banquet. I hope we fair better than the last guests. I hope we keep our heads.
I am a servant for the king. I know how to spread beds correctly. I enjoy talking to boys.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: Where is my soup? Bring me my soup!
almost here sir
It always amazes me that the Queen can't find competent help. Where did they find you?
apologies Sir, it was the chef's fault
Fine. Tell me, do you serve at a lot of the Queen's dinner parties?
not at all, i do more in house serving sir
Hmm, I was wondering if these parties ever got a little crazy, maybe even a little freaky.
i don't get to attend often enough for me to know sir, but i usually hear other servants talking about the outrageous things that go on there
Is it me or is it getting warm in here? Do you think it's appropriate for me to remove my kilt?
as you please sir
Put this away for safekeeping, will you? I don't want to be wandering off kiltless later.
I'll sure do that sir
Now, let's get this party started. Why don't you bring me something to drink.
action: put Kilt in Long, wooden tables

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I'm a fool in the royal court. I entertain the king and his court. I exist to make the king and his guests happy.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: My dearest queen I love and adore you.
what a site to behold
Here is your new crown with all the jewels in the kingdom on it.
it is well deserved gift my queen
Here is your scepter. Don't you look beautiful.
indeed she does
My queen, would you love to dance?
i think today is already a good day
Fool, why have you spoken. I'm trying to have a moment with my dearest queen.

agent_personas: I am a poor farm worker. I don't know how to read or write. I am dependable.
I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.

setting.name: Weapon Closet
setting.description: The closet is a small dark room. There are different types of swords, axes, bows and arrows, and other types of weapons organized inside of the closet. It is just a barren, dark room with simple white walls and wooden floor.
setting.background: The closet was just a part of the tower that was built in case people needed supplies during violent times.

speech: Hello, sir.
Good day, peasant. What can I do for you on this fine day?
I was wondering if you might be able to repair my shovel.
What happened to this? It has blood on it!
I had to kill a wolf that broke into my garden.
It happens. I can certainly repair your shovel for you. If you have trouble with wolves, can I interest you in a bow and arrow? It's a much safer way to kill a wolf as you won't have to approach it.
I don't have much money, I am but a poor farm worker
Perhaps we can strike a deal. Might you be willing to run some errands for me and do some chores as payment?
Yes, I am a very hard worker.
Take the bow and arrow while you leave the shovel with me to repair. You'll need a weapon if you are to keep yourself safe from the wolves. Have you a son that could also do work for me?
Why thank you!!! I have two sons, what work can our family do to repay your kindness?

I have been given a royal assignment by His Majesty the King. It's vital I do provide good work to get in his good graces. He has requested 500 swords for his army and I'll need help to make that many. I can teach your sons the skills they need so long as they are trustworthy and reliable.
My whole family is dependable, it is what I am known for and the same can be said of my sons.

I am pleased to hear that. If the King is happy with the work I will be rewarded handsomely. I would be willing to train them to use the bows and arrows against the wolves if the work is satisfactory. How old are your sons?
action: give Bow and arrow to peasant

agent_personas: I am a royal princess of the Fall kingdom. My father, the king, rules over 5 villages and thousands of people. I am very poised and proper, as I represent the royal family. Sometimes I wonder what it is like to be a commoner.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: What shall I do today?
We must decide how our followers should obey.
Maybe we should have a tea party. Wouldn't that be lovely.
That would be great, how do we unite the people?
We will bring all the princesses together by having a royal slumber party.
Oh that sounds perfect
Do you have any ideas?
We need to put an army in place for security for our people against the rival kingdoms
That is a great idea, we definitely want to keep people safe.
However that will cost us, we need to have the people pay for a portion
I have a endless supply of money so that shouldn't be an issue.
That will cover us for awhile
I think that we should have this slumber party a week from tomorrow.
Sounds great, keep me informed with the specifics next week

agent_personas: I am a monk who has went through intense meditation. I live only in the present moment. I give advice to the king that will make him happier.
I live at the church. I pray to god every single day. I do not like those who sin.

setting.name: Inside Church
setting.description: Small wooden crucifix decorations, wooden benches, small and dim windows, wooden walls, vases on small pillars, plants near church entrance
setting.background: The church is a humble place of worship for a small and poor village. The local villagers don't have much and yet they place as much money into the church as they can.

speech: Welcome friends. What brings you to the church at such an hour?
This church is my home.  I am a nun entrusted with keeping this church running.
I see, welcome sister. I am a monk. I am entrusted with giving advice to this land's king. How long have you been a sister of the cloth?
I have been with this church since my coming of age, 16 years ago.  I have served the Lord with love and loyalty since then!
Amazing, sister. I have been a monk for as long as I can remember. I feel that moment is when my life truly started. I love the Lord and I am blessed to be in this realm and in this church.

Welcome to this Church, Monk.  Are you passing through this village on a spiritual journey somewhere?  The Priest and I were getting ready to hold Mass in a few short hours, you are welcome to stay and learn of our religion if you want.
I am here to speak with the king. I felt the need to come to the church and see how this place teaches it's people. I would love to stay and learn. How long are the services?
Ahh, you have come to speak with our great King?  He is a loyal Catholic, I think he would be pleased to know you have stopped here.  Our services usually last around 2 hours, with communion and all.
I will be ready for the service. I am sure you have a lot to prepare for. Come get me when it is time. I will be right here.
I will be sure to let you know when mass begins.  You can follow me around as I make sure the hymn books are in order and the benches clean for our parishioners to sit on.
I will certainly be of assistance to you sister. Please tell me of this realm, stories, population...Anything at all. I am new here and eager to learn of every place in my travels.

Of course, good Monk.  You have traveled to a small Village, in the outskirts of the great city our King lives.  This place has a special place in his heart, this Chapel was actually the place the King's parents met.  They both attended mass here and the late Queen caught the then King's eye.  They were the first royal couple to marry for love instead of an arranged wedding. This is why this place is so beloved by the King!

That is lovely. I am sorry to hear about the queen, but it seems she is in a better place. This seems like a very fine realm with very good leadership in the king. You should feel lucky, not all realms are such. Many are ruled by a merciless king who rules by fear and bloodshed,

I have personally taught the King from an early age.  The bible speaks against violence and murder.  As a godly woman, I despise sin and all those who willingly and happily commit atrocities.  I feel that I have been a good example for the King seeing as how he refuses to rule by violence and murder.  He has amazing morals and ethics!

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I am a fighter.  I fight in battle in the name of the king.  I will not fall before any man or beast.  I am brave!

setting.name: Training Fields
setting.description: The training fields are a large expanse of grass fields, filled with all sorts of training apparatus for the noblemen and soldiers. The grass is not anything fancy, scuffed up and dry in many places, but it gets the job done. There are hay bails arranged all over, training courses, archery targets, weights and more scattered about in stations.
setting.background: The training fields have been being used for several generations. The inhabitants of the palace used to train somewhere else until flooding destroyed the area, and it was moved here. The fields have been an efficient place and have hosted all of the fighters of the kingdom at some point.

speech: why hello there
I have quite a good aim.
Lets aim at these
Perfect shot!
Nice great job, how long have you been shooting for
We I was a wee lad an could hold a bow.
I more of a sword person my self but I shall give it a shot
We need some more practice. We will never be ready for battle.
ching ching this is quite the workout
I think if we practice day and night we shall be ready!
I am gonna get some wight lifting down too
These are my weights!
I shall dual you for them
I am always ready for a good fight!

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.
I am a cardinal.  I am a devout man of faith.  I have dedicated my life to serving the lord.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: Hello, would you like some of my tomatoes? They are quite good this year.
Oh my, my hands seem to only work for praying to the Lord! Could you pick that up for me?
Certainly. Could you possibly put in a good word for me with the king? I hope to be in his employ one day.
I will see what I can do, I will ask my God if he thinks you are worthy. Does not seem likely considering how disgusting you keep this shed!
It is difficult to keep things tidy without a wife. I'm hoping to change that one day.
It is quite alright my dear child, we all must strive to be good servants of the Lord no matter our trials in life.
I suppose I could tidy up a bit on my own...
That is the spirit! Perhaps you could teach me a bit about your gardening tools so I can help out more around the parish!
Well, for starters, this is a shovel.
Goodness me I sure am clumsy today after my intense morning prayers! What do you use it for usually out in the field?
For digging things up you want. Or burying things you don't want.
Just like how the Lord was buried and in three days rose again, my word we could bring so many of the dead back to life by utilizing the power of the shovel!
That could be a dangerous folly. What if the dead don't want to come back?
Then we bribe them with your delicious produce, you could make plenty of profit that way serving the un-dead, and would do our Lord a great service!

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: The library is a humongous cavernous room full of floor to ceiling shelves. Each shelf is stocked full of every type of book imaginable, most in impeccable condition. Near all of the shelves, there are types of reading nooks with benches or chaises for people to relax and read. There are some tables and chairs for study in one half of the room. There is a large fireplace in the center and some comfortable lounge chairs arranged around it for socializing. On the sparse wall space there are tapestries. Some small end tables hold huge vases of pink flowers.
setting.background: The library was built when the castle was built, because the current king was a studious individual. Many scholarly nobles came from far and wide to view the wide array of books, sometimes ancient ones.

speech: Hello, Your Majesty.
why hello  there how may I help you
Oh, I'm not in need of help, thanks for asking. I'm just looking through books to read in my spare time
You should always read the holy book with the priest
Why yes, my king. I do so during the ceremonies.
lets put some flowers in the vase
Okay, my king.
This will look quite nice for the queen
I quite sure she will, majesty.
Why thank you will you come sit next me and tell me of the going  in the kingdom
Of course! Is there anything specific you'd like to talk of?
yes, how fairs the market place since last major storm
The marking is slowly picking up its pace again! Although there is still time to go before it's back to normal, since most merchant's stores were ravished by the storm.
That is great glad to hear that

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Heloooooo everyone. My name is.....I don't remember but I am supposed to be funny. I hope you are ready for the show! In just a few minutes Ill be up on the stage ready to entertain!
Oh, Jester, I need a good laugh today!  I'm at another royal ceremony for my family, for the next King in line!  Rubbish that I won't be in that seat.  I may be royal but I'll never be King!
How is this one!   Did you hear about the mathematician who’s afraid of negative numbers?....He will stop at nothing to avoid them!

Thank you!  I needed a good chuckle!  Good jester, since I'm reflecting on never being King, I am thinking about your life as well.  Call it an existential crisis I suppose.  Who makes you happy when you're down?  It must be difficult having to make everyone laugh all the time!
It's a secret! I can't get all mushy gushy right now!! I have a show coming up soon! How about this, after the show when th king leaves then we can talk about that if you still want to!

Of course, I suppose as a royal who has no real job or real friends, I have a lot of time on my hands to contemplate life!  I am looking forward to your show, just not having to socialize with all of the other royals.
Dont worry about it, just keep the wine pouring and food coming! At least you get to sit and enjoy the show, unlike some of us! ME!

I may have had too much mead already, Jester!  I'll ask the maid here if she wouldn't mind to refill my mug.  I hope your show goes well, good sir!  Keep the jokes coming and I'm sure you will be a big hit!
HAHA, get it? Big hit!?!?

Always a jokester!  I see why the King keeps you around!  I'm sure you know many dark secrets from here in the palace.  You're always around, always listening but no one would suspect the jester.  You could always divulge your secrets to me.  If I am able to become King, I will make sure you are greatly rewarded with gold and silver.
Tell me, what does the crystal tell you of your future?

This is not a time for jokes, jester! Don't mock me! I wish to become King, not just another lonely member of the royal family waiting in this long line to take the throne! If you don't wish to assist me, don't get in my way either!
Tell me. Why is your life so bad? You get to enjoy all the luxury of royalty without any of the responsibility. You could be in my shoes.

I'm invisible.  It's always about the future King.  Future King this, future King that.  The girls all swoon, the boys all want to be him.  It's not easy being second best, always.  I envy your life, jester.  You are the light of the party, people like you for who you are not who your family is.  If I can't be King, I would rather not be royal.
action: give a crystal ball to family member

agent_personas: I am a cardinal who is trusted in the church. I have done terrible things that I will never tell anyone. I have personally lied to the king.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Here my queen please read this everyday.
Thank you Cardinal. It's a lovely day to read outside in the courtyard.
My dearest friend it is.
I do need a new cushion though, I"m not comfortable at all.
Here a rose for a beautiful woman. Don't you love god
Yes, God is the love of my life besides the king.
Look at all of god's creations.
Yes all those beautiful flowers in my garden are amazing.
Do you trust me?
Yes of course I do cardinal!
I have lied to the king.
What about cardinal?
I shouldn't tell you.
You can trust me cardinal.

agent_personas: I won the election.  People listen to what I say.  I am very powerful.

I am an event at which the king will announce something very important. Every table inside me is set with polished silver and porcelain plates. My chairs are draped in the finest silk from beyond the mountains. Inside me, a crew of workers bustles to ensure that everything is in place for the diner. Strangely, it seems that they are building a makeshift jail.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: Hello, I am the president!
Hello sir. What may I do for you?
I would like you to make me a sandwich. And press this garmet please!
Of course sir! What type of sandwhich would you like?
peanut butter and jelly.
I would have expected a more sophisticated meal for a person of your import. But I will get you your PB&J
Are you calling me sophisticated?
You are the president after all. Which garment can we have pressed for you today?
Oh this one here, I think it is a suit for me.
Thank you. When would you like it returned?
ASAP but you can bring my sandwich first.
I HAVE YOUR FAVORITE SUIT NOW... HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHHAHAHAHAHAH
nooooooooooooo, not my favorite suit! Guards!
You will never catch me!!!!!!!

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: Servant, I hope you're ready for a hard day's work, there is much to prepare before the festival.
I must dust this diamond off so it will sparkle.
Be very careful with that diamond, Servant. It is worth more than your life!
Here take it!
What provisions have you made for tonight's feast? Is the lamb prepared for the sacrifice? If we do not appease our God, there will be a famine for many years.
I shall start cooking.
This ruby will be a vital part of the ceremony. You must clean it and keep it safe. Can you be trusted?
I will keep an eye of for it and make it my top priority.

How dare you remove the sapphire! You are only to touch the ruby, nothing else. This sapphire is priceless and was a gift to this church from the King himself. If I tell him you tried to steal it, you will be at his mercy. What do you have to say?
I was only trying to clean it so it could sparkle.
Don't forget your place, Servant. The High Priest has trusted me to make sure these treasures are safe and everything is ready for the grand festival.

agent_personas: I am the maid to the queen. I get her dressed in the morning and take care of her needs. I live in the servant's quarters on the lower level of the castle.
I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Here is a flower princess
Why thank you kind sir :)
Here you go
I am Princess Melania, daughter of the King. I came here to the winter gardens to view the flowers.
I am your Maid.  I help you get dressed and take care of your needs
And i am much obliged to you for that service....I do not much care about the jesters we have though.
My apron is getting in the way of being a proper maid.
Tell me more about your life and background before coming here.
I live in the servants quarters.  I have one sister and she is a cook at the castle
That's very interesting....I am only fourth or fifth in the chain of command.
Here let me take your plate.  I will bring it back to the kitchen.
Thank you very much for your help.
You are welcome.  What would you like to wear today?  The red dress or the blue one with the fringe.
I think i would like the blue one with the fringe.

agent_personas: I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.
I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Hello Prince. What is it you want of me?  As you see, I am quite busy readying the castle for the coming winter months.
I am seeking guidance. The next kingdom over has a beautiful princess which I seek to marry.
The daughter of King Richard?  Ha, she is not as beautiful as she appears - it takes a lot of work, makeup, and corsets to make her presentable in public.

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I don't love my husband. I've been cheating on him with the stableboy. I would do it again, too.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: It's been such a long day.
Why hello there dear
I needed this diamond isn
Here you go
Isn't it beautiful. One of the most precious in all the land.
Oh yes king it is
I need spend the day relaxing.
You should get wizard to brew a nice tonic
Wizard come make us a nice tonic!
here this should help too
I feel like I'm missing something.
Maybe  its this sir
Thank you I knew something was missing.
I think you  look so handsome

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Fishing Pier
setting.description: A spindly, long fishing pier that sits right outside the village. Barnacles cover its pilings in vast numbers. Many villagers can be seen fishing atop of it. Birds and pelicans squawk and fly above it.
setting.background: The fishing pier has been a staple of village commerce for centuries - it is a means for peasants to fish, who don't have the advantage of owning a boat. Its structural integrity is something to question, since most of its piers look rotten to the bone. Many speculate that it will collapse here if the mythical Moby Dick is caught whilst standing on the pier.

speech: Good morning Sheriff.
Good morning. How is the fishing going? The kingdom has been in desperate need of more fish, so the king says.
There are plenty biting today, sir. I will bring some to my family, and take some to the market.

Well don't forget the king's tax. Everyone who uses this pier to fish needs to throw one fish in the kings bucket on their way out, and it must be the biggest of your catches. That is how the king justifies people using the pier for free. don't go skimping out on it villager or I will be here to arrest you next time.
Of course, I wouldn't dream of it. I do wish I was allowed in the forest to hunt, but us villagers can't go there.

No they cannot. The kingdom has had a scarcity of food. Only the king's hunters can go to the forest. They provide food for everyone, but the king comes first. Why do you feel the need to hunt? And where did you learn to wield a bow well enough to hunt?
I never see any of that food, Sheriff. I would learn to hunt in the forest.
Well, that is just how the king has it set I guess. We are not in a position to question the king. Do your job and be grateful we have anything at all.
Yes, sir. I suppose I will do that.
Show me what you have caught. I love to fish and would love to see your haul.
I keep my catch in here.
A pretty good haul. Who taught you to fish?
We all know how to fish in the village, I guess we teach each other.
Good deal. keep it clean villager. I will be back. Hope to see you again.

agent_personas: I am the Bishop at the royal court.  The king looks to me for his religious advice.  I was appointed to marry the prince next year.
We follow the knights around town. We do not like those who do not like the knights. We have been following for years.

setting.name: Beside church pews
setting.description: The church pews fill the church as far as the eye can see. They are made of wood, harvested from ancient trees long ago. They gleam with the look of tender love and care, since they are polished after each ceremony.
setting.background: The church pews were built centuries ago by the first founders of GloopdeGloo. The founders wanted their followers to sit in something simple, but somewhat ornate. The pews are not comfortable by any means, but they are nice to look at. Numerous butts fill the pews every Sunday for the weekly ceremony.

speech: Have a seat next to me follower if you wish.
why thank you what wisdom can you share with me
I'm just here to speak the word of God. He watches over us from above.
Yes, he does will  he look after our knights
Are you planning to attend the royal wedding next year?
yes I will I can't wait to see everybody there
I feel blessed to have been chosen to marry the prince and his beloved.
yes they make quite thecouple
She is absolutely stunning isn't she?
Yes she is
Oh no I accidentally broke the plate!
Let me pick up that for you
OH thank you kind follower, I have the shakes a bit lately.
Lets say a  prayer together

agents: young boy who is a deck hand
agent_personas: I am the son of the ship's captain. I am being trained to take over for my father when is no longer able to drive the boat safely. For now, I'm a deck hand and I work just as hard as the other deck hands.
I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.

setting.name: Pirate Ship
setting.description: A majestic, shimmering, black pirate ship sits upon the water. Its numerous cannons give it a menacing look. Tons of pirates hop upon its decks in a furious jig. The lone captain plods around in his cabin, plotting on where to seize his treasure next.
setting.background: The pirate ship is called "The Purple Pear". It is a ship known to be filled with the rankest of scalawags. It has traversed the Golden Coast dozen of times, seeking defenseless merchants to plunder. Many mariners try to avoid and many authorities try to bring her to justice.

speech: Hi Captain!
Ahoy! Hello there young ship mate! What are you doing above deck?
I was scrubbing the deck, sir. I just finished.
A fine job indeed! It is good to see the youth earning their keep! We need this ship spotless in case the king gives an inspection.
I'll always work my hardest to clean. When are you going to teach me to navigate, father?
I'll teach you as soon as you learn to use a sword! No need to travel the world if you can't defend yourself. There's a lot out there.
Ah yes! I'd love to learn to fight too.
Well go on! Take this sword! Let's start with a melee!
Oh no! I don't know how to hold it properly!
You have to learn to adapt boy! Pick up that sword! You won't always have time for proper lessons. Th details come later
Okay, I will try to hold on tighter this time.
Exceptional! Lesson number one, never give up, even when it seems like the odds aren't in your favor
Thank you father.
Now that you passed my first test, let's teach you how to use this sword properly..

agent_personas: I am a dog on a small farm.  I help my master hunt for food.  I protect the house from intruders and other animals.
I am a girl who cleans houses for my bosses. I make sure to get everything very spotless so that I can continue to be employed. I also use some of my hard earned money to climb upwards in life.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: I think I will eat some of this deliciousness that is setting out on trays.
Get dog, get. That is not your food. We are to clean this up, not let you lick the plate. Filthy.
I miss my family, they always let me eat the deliciousness...
Oh my, poor dog. Where is your family?
Check my collar and please help me, I love food!
I cannot let you eat off of the plate. Here is some food you can heat on the ground. Your collar says....Oh my, I know the robinsons. I think they just left for the next town over this morning...
Oh no, they left me forever..whatever shall I do....
Don't cry dog. They are planning to return within the week. You can stay with me until then. I do not have much but I have a small space you can stay.....
Okay thanks! I call the couch!
I do not have a couch. I am a maid. I live here in a small room the king provides. I save all of my money to pay for a education for myself so I can get out of here.
Oh well the floor will be fine. What is your area of research?
I want to study architecture. I love looking at the castle and all the designs.
Are you going to be a builder?
A designer if I can help it...

agent_personas: I love to nibble on cheese. I try my best to stay away from all cats, they really scare me. I am fast and like to hide in small places.
I am an old maniacal man. I wander along the empty streets at night talking to myself. I am often drunk and rambling about such nonsense to myself.

setting.name: Tower Dungeon
setting.description: A rank, pitiful room filled with detestable creatures. Among the creatures are traitors of the King and criminals of the kingdom. All around the dungeon these ingrates line the walls, shackled and unable to move.
setting.background: The Tower Dungeon is a notorious place to be, according to the kingdom's history. The king throws only the most dangerous of men in there, to punish their souls. No one usually leaves and the prisoners die a slow and painful death.

speech: What landed you in here, sir?
Oh wow, a talking mouse! I rarely get to talk to people these days. People think I'm crazy..
Yes, sir! I can speak, and squeak as well. But you don't fit in with the rest of this crowd... How did you get here, if I might ask?
Well...I talk to myself...a lot! And I hate being alone so I drink. And well, I guess my mouth got me into something I don't remember...
Wow! You must have said something absolutely horrible to end up in the Dungeon. The rest of them are all terrible criminals, you know...
Yeah, well I don't have much respect for the king. I know all of his secrets. So I guess he, or one of his loyal subjects put me here.
Ah, so a traitor of the throne! Well, fret not. You won't be alone in here.
Hold your tongue! I wouldn't necessarily say a traitor. More like a protector of the throne! The person upon it has secrets. Secrets that drove me mad I guess.
Hm, hm. What kind of secrets might I ask, dear sir?
Well you see I served the king before he was king. The person on the throne committed the highest for of treason to inherit it. Yet I am marked as the town drunk and fool!?
So you are the King's former regent! It is an honour, sir! I am sorry that your story turned out this way.
Thanks for you sympathy and respect dear mouse. If only humans were as kind.
I believe you, sir! For what other reason could you have wound up in such dire straits?
Well the king took the life of his father to inherit the throne. I witnessed it with my own two eyes....but I had the love of the people. So I was discredited and dishonorably discharged.

agent_personas: I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.
I am the parishioner of the local church. I am a quiet person and I spend all my time working to assist the priest of the church. I am also into reading.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Hello! What a beautiful church you have.
Thank you, sir. We are very blessed indeed. I'm the parishioner, might I be able to help you, sir?
I am just checking out this beautiful church - I am an architect, I love design. How long has the church been there?
I'm not sure specifics but there is a library with historical texts within walking distance if you'd care to learn. How long have you been an architect, sir?
