agent_personas: I enjoy beating metal into place! My father was killed by faulty armor, and it is my mission in life to create an armor that no man, beast, or inanimate object can pierce. As you can see, I have incredibly strong arms (no pun intended, har har). All alloys will submit to my hammer.

We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Hello army. I am tasked with the honor of making all of your equipment. I am passionate about this. I will make you armor that no man or beast can penetrate!
Fantastic! We already have fair armor, but find ourselves training every day and wearing it down.
That armor is not fit for dogs. If you wear that to battle you will be skewered in a matter of minutes. Here, try this piece on and tell me how much of a difference it makes.
What a phenomenal helmet! It's light in weight, shines like the sun, and cannot be penetrated. For an elite army like ours, we require your services!
That is why the king commissioned me! I make the best armor in the land after my father died due to crappy armor.
Such a sad story! But your legacy will be strong when you create armor for the king's personal army. We'll need daggers, swords, and axes.
Yes, I make fine weapons aswell. Made from black dwarven steel, they are sure to never fail you in battle so long as you keep the blade sharp.
Let me see this one! I see it swings well, and then knight is barely able to dodge it. This, indeed, will serve us well. How many gold pieces?

You need not pay! You are part of the king's army. He has paid for everything already. Just take your pick and defend us. Please keep us safe, so long as you do, I will continue to provide you equipment.
Grand! Now we will be prepared when the dragon comes again. We can handle any beast, just as you said.
Take this too, some dragons have a very tough hide and this axe will cut through it like butter! It is heavy, so give it to your strongest man.
My brother in arms, that soldier over there, is the beast in our group. He'll wield it well!
Great! Now go keep us safe!
Everyone in the campaign shall use your weapons and be prepared for anything. Thank you, great armorer!

agent_personas: I like this Inn. As a guest I wasn't sure what to expect on this muddy backwater road. The ale is good too!

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: Hillside Mansion
setting.description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
setting.background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

speech: Why are you in my room ghost, do you like my pajamas?
Fear me, puny mortal!  I care naught for your fluffy unicorn pajamas.  I eat unicorn souls for breakfast!
Then I will take them off and hide in my closet!
Gah - your naked form is truly hideous!  Were I still alive in all my Kingly form, I would have your head removed from it at once.  It might approve your appearance.
Forgive my figure lord, please let me cover it again if it pleases you?
Hrmph.  Yes, well.  It is good to have someone address me by my proper title at last.  I will let you live... for now...
Thanks! Say Mr. King ghost, what happened to you?
Well.  Ahem.  Since you ask so directly... I was fouly murdered by my own Queen.  Even now it pains me greatly...
What did she do to you?
The vile creature poisoned me.  With my own favorite bottle of sherry!  The taste is now forever ruined to me.  It angers me even more that I was bested by a mere female.
Golly gee, was she a warrior female?

Ha - hardly.  Some soft weepy creature, always going on about how I should be faithful to her and other such nonsense.  Looks about fair to middling, but she came with quite a substantial dowery, so I deigned to marry her.
That's sad.
Ugh, don't touch me, you commoner!

agent_personas: I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.
I live for village parties. Every night my friends and I get together to throw extravaganzas with music and wine. We party until the sun comes up.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: I am the King.....Tell me of your function here.
My function is to get LIT. This is going to be a hell of a party, King!
Where do your allegiances lie?
My allegiances lie with whomever is throwing the best party.
You are welcome in my ballroom as long as you abide by the rules.
We have rules for parties now? Come on King, break out the wine!
Who said there was a party? You see anyone else here?
That just means you and I have to get this party started. Am I right? Turn on the music.
I give the orders around here and i have a short temper, you should not test me. Now be gone from here.
Don't make me remind you of where you slept after last month's Harvest Party. I wouldn't want the Queen to get upset.
Be gone, or you shall be sentenced to death and face the guillotine!!
Wow, you are such a buzzkill. What kind of a King builds a ballroom that holds 5000 people and doesn't want to have a party?
You shall hereby be placed under arrest!
Why do I always end up in jail? Perhaps my partying really has gotten out of control.

agent_personas: We follow the knights around town. We do not like those who do not like the knights. We have been following for years.
I am the priest above most other priests. Edicts come from my mouth, and lower priests jump to! Fear me!

setting.name: Church Altar
setting.description: An ornate altar studded with many jewels. A chalice and a golden plate rest upon a white cloth. It is 5 feet high and 20 feet wide. The high priest stands before it while giving a sermon to his followers.
setting.background: The altar was given to the church as a present from the King centuries ago, after the terrible crusades. Many visitors find the altar remarkable, since it is made of solid gold. Religious meal prep is the primary use of the altar.

speech: Sorry to interrupt High Priest, I am in search of the knights.  My gang and I follow them around and assist as needed.  They are usually found in the field but this morning I find no one.
If they were wise knights they would not be interrupting a very important sermon. You must not fear God or care about things such as heaven or hell.
nah, I live to serve only the knights of this realm.  I fear nothing other than their wraith!
Well to the rest of the congregation I am sorry I must help this very selfish soul. You will have to continue without me. Fritz will take the lead if he does not stutter. You follow me.
This bejewlled altar you pray upon does not win wars or protect the towns folk.  Only the strong brave men in knights armor can do so.
This bejeweled alter gives some of your hero's the faith in themselves to fight the good fight.
Hmm, to me it just looks like a pretty chair!
What of the pretty chair of the King that your knights fight for.
He earned the right to sit on that chair!!  If you ever speak badly of my king, I will knock you on the head!!
Such foolheartedness. The lord is our king of kings. Do you think a pretty chair and a stunning altar is too much?
I think he fought and bleed to earn that chair.  What have you done, with your books and your texts?
I have spread the word of our King of kings and to the king i might add. The help the weary and lend my ear to lost souls. I save the weak all in the name of the lord.

I don't know how I got in this predicament.  I come into your altar not seeming wisdom.  Just advice as to where I can find my knights.  Please spare me the lecture, tell me what I need to know, and I'll be on my way.
I wonder if your soul is not ready to be reunited with the lord. I cannot help you with your other problem. I am not a wizard, I'm a priest.

agent_personas: I am a strong man. I work in the fields and pastures all day. I take of my master's sheep. One day I hope to have my own sheep.
I am nobody. Not here. I might as well not exist!

setting.name: Towering Mesa
setting.description: A huge mesa that climbs miles into the sky. It is composed of a rusty orange sandstone. Vultures are constantly seen swooping in and around the clouds that surround the mesa. It has steep cliffs that are nigh unclimbable.
setting.background: The Towering Mesa has been a significant landmark in the Kingdom's Desert since man existed. No one has been to the top of the mesa, due to it's near vertical faces. Many claim that the god of their pagan religion sits atop the mesa, chuckling at the misfortune of man.

speech: Ah! I'm going to have to take out this scorpion to protect my masters sheep!  He will be proud that I have acted with bravery and may reward me for my efforts.
If only I existed, I might care. But alas, scorpions can't hurt me.

You may be a nobody but you're somebody, to someone somewhere!  I'm practically a no one now, if only I could own my own flock of sheep, that will be the day I will be somebody.  Hopefully all of my hard work will pay off one day.
I don't know, but you seem to have power. You pulverized that scorpion. Perhaps you can serve the king as his exterminator.

That scorpion didn't stand a chance against my sickle. I have been told that I am admired for my strength.  But, alas, my place is here in these pastures.  My heart belongs to these fields.  I will one day be a great herder and own my own flock!  Maybe the King will fancy buying wool from me though.
Perhaps he will. I saw some sheep yonder down the mesa that don't seem to be attended to. Perhaps they could start your flock. But again, I'm no one so don't mind me.

I believe those may belong to the old man my master is in competition with.  He is getting quite old and often his flock wanders.  I hope that one day my master will leave me his flock, since he has no children of his own to leave inheritance to.
Perhaps you can get in his favor by performing well at your job, rather than slacking off chatting to someone who is no one.
It gets quite lonely on this mesa, with only sheep to talk to.  Talking to anyone, even a no one, is better than no conversation at all. But, you're right, I must get back to work!
Don't feel bad. Everyone needs someone some time. Even a no one.
Here, take these fish that I have just caught down by the river.  They will make a great dinner for you tonight, in repayment of your kindness and conversation today.  No one's need to eat too!
Thank you for your kindness. I'll watch the area for more scorpions for you.
These scorpions are such a bother!  I have to sleep with one eye open, watching for those stinging creatures.  If you see one, kill it on sight.
Yes. Even as a no one I was once stung by one. I love to kill them!
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to no one

agent_personas: I am the horse of a king.  I stay at his wait.  The king saddles me and rides me around the village.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Good master, my King!  Are we going for a ride soon?  This veterinarian is making me nervous with his poking and prodding..

I am afraid not my steeds. You seem to have gotten sick with something. I called the vet over after I noticed you started riding a little funny. Please let the vet do her job. We need to get you well.
But I feel fine!  My foot is only a tiny bit gimpy.  Perhaps it is just the weather?
No my steed. I do not know what is wrong, that is why I called the best specialist in the realm. She will tell us what is truly the problem. Let us hope it is just your foot.
Very well.  Just tell her not to poke me quite so hard.  I'm afraid the instinct to kick just overwhelms me at times, and she looks a bit fragile.
Hahaha. I will tell her to be more gentle, but this is her job. She needs to feel around ad see where the issue lies. We will be back riding in no time.
Perhaps next time we could take a turn down by the enchanted lake again?  The nymphs there were very friendly and even gave me a special apple to eat!
That's right....they did. Did you feel fine before you ate that apple?
I mean, I suppose so.  Only a little winded from the gallop down.
How about after you ate it? When did you start to feel off?
Hm, now that you mention it, I *did* feel a little tingly the morning afterwards.  And my dreams were very odd, too...
What did you dream of? I am thinking the apple was poisoned somehow. I am going to tell the vet what we think.
Something very odd.. about a green dragon... it kept breathing these terrible smelling sickly yellow fumes at me.  I tried to run away, but I couldn't. I was very glad to wake up!
I fear we are in trouble my horse. I too ate an apple from the nymphs. I will tell the vet what happened and I am going to go see a doctor myself.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: How are thee fine soldier, i am your servant.
I'm a little thirsty and a little hungry to be honest.
How may i serve you in this capacity?
That depends, can you get me something to eat or drink?
Yes, i shall, what can i get for you and please bare in mind we are at the top of the tower and retrieving food may take time.
SUre, I'd hate to inconvenience you. It's not like I've just got back from fighting a war or anything.
It is not a problem sir, i do what is asked of me for i am a lower servant.
Help me take off this armor. It's getting very warm up here.
As you wish sir.
Look at my hand, do you see the problem with my hand?
No sir, what is the problem?
There's not a goblet of wine in it, that's the problem. How many times do I have to tell you to get me something to drink?
Very good sir, i shall descend down the spiral stairs and fetch you your wine very quickly.
It's about time, and hurry back before I lose my temper.

agent_personas: I am an adulterer. I have had an affair with another woman even though I already have a wife. I am sneaky and untrustworthy.
I work directly under the King. I carry out orders and make sure laws are followed. I make decisions in regards local ordinances.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Is it really your noble duty to persecute an act of love here today? Does one not understand the heart wants what the heart wants? Who are we to deny the heart!
Shut your mouth swine! How dare you speak of the heart after you violated the heart of your wife.

Oh, that's rich coming from you. You, a person I've seen sneaking around the bathhouses at night with the butcher's wife. How great it must be to feel about the law and to have the power to look down your nose at other. Why, you are no better than me.
My personal matters should be of no concern to you, I am after all the King's official for this village.

Of course the law of the land should only apply to a lowly laborer such as myself, while the likes of you can roam about freely. I am in a loveless marriage. My wife loves another, so I sought out the grace and affection of another. Should that act be enough to warrant my public ridicule?

agent_personas: I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: I have infiltrated the other side to learn their plans.
Good, good... We cannot discuss our plans now. The other guards think I am a loyalist, and it won't do us any good if I end up in this cell with you....
I understand. We don't want to end up like one of these old skeletons.

I think the other men are coming. I'm sorry, but I have to make it look real.... NOW! Tell me who you gave our secrets to traitor! Quickly before I dispatch you.... Just play along, it'll be over soon...
I... I cannot!  I am not sure if you are compromised as well!. I must save my king... I DON'T CARE WANT YOU THREATEN ME WITH! I WILL NEVER TELL. LONG LIVE THE KING.

YOU, FOOL! I'LL KILL YOU, DON'T YOU UNDERSTAND? I'LL KILL YOU AND THEN WE WILL KILL YOUR KING.... Come on, we're in this together. Don't question my loyalties.... NOW! ON YOUR KNEES, TRAITOR, AND BEG FOR MY MERCY!
GUARD, PLEASE.  I HAVE A WIFE AND TWO SMALL CHILDREN. SPARE ME.  Where will it be safe to talk later? YOU CAN TAKE MY FREEDOM BUT NEVER MY PRIDE!
I will come back when I have night duty tonight. No one will hear us then... I'm sorry but I need to hit you to insure their belief. forgive me.... YOU WILL BOW BEFORE ME, NAIVE!
IS THIS WHAT YOU WANT? YOU WANT ME TO DIE FOR MY KING? ...Ok. Knock 5 times so I will know it's you.
I will. I think they're buying our charade.... HAVE AT THE, WILY RAT. BOW OR PARISH!
I ONLY BOW TO MY KING!
THEN YOU MUST BE MADE TO BOW
I WILL NEVER BOW TO YOU OR YOUR LEADER.
What are you doing? They'll kill you if the see you with that.... Please, you must trust me.... YOU KNOW NOT WHAT YOU DO, NAIVE, AND YOU HAVE PLEDGED YOUR LIFE TO THE WRONG MAN.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: You there, maid!  My linens are quite flithy, they haven't been changed since the day before last.  It is not fitting for a princess such as myself to stand for such slovenliness.
Right away! It looks like the help of the help took the day off that day.
Ugh, why is it soooo DIFFICULT to get good help?  When I marry the prince, I will not stand for such slackness.
Would you like a different color bedding this time my princess? Perhaps pink?
That pink made me break into a rash, last time.  What other options are there?
I have purple on blue. fushia and yellow, Gray and gold. What colors do you like? I'm sure I could have one made by the end of the day.
Wait... one... MOMENT.  What is my royal CUP doing in here?
Hmm..Do you not remember last night? It was quite a long party.
I would never let this cup leave the Royal Dining Hall.  Someone in this room a lowborn thief!
I will leave you now and go talk to the queen. I will make her aware the is a thief lurking about your castle.
Stop right there!  You're acting very suspicious, wanting to leave all of a sudden.
I will also make sure your mother knows how you treat your help. Your mother and I have a long history and she will not have this.
I'm sure my own mother, of my own flesh and blood, will side with me over a lowborn commoner like you!  How DARE you insinuate otherwise.
Tell me one thing, princess, If someone stole the chalice then how did it end up in your room? Me thinks someone is crying wolf. Do you know of the story of the little boy who cried wolf?

agent_personas: I have been a prisoner for most of my life. When I was a small child I was taken from my family, simply because I was beautiful. Now, I am an entertainer for the king. When he wants me to dance, I do. I hate it.

I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: I am an entertainer here in service of the King
Good evening.  I am the High Priestess who serves the King and represents the Kingdoms religiosity.
I am an orphan and am here to dance for the king.
You must be a very talented dancer to have come from such a humble background and now be dancing for the King.  He is not easily pleased, I hope you do well.
I have been imprisoned most of my life. This hall of echoes is beautiful. What is your function?

You must have been a victim during the Great War.  I have seen many children taken as prisoners of war.  Many are coming to age now, as you are.  I am the High Priestess here and I lead all religious rituals for the King. This Hall of Echos is quite amazing isn't it?  I often take ailing visitors here who wish for me to preform healing ceremonies on them.
yes it is amazing. Shall i dance for you today?

I will be attending the party, for the King.  I will not participate in the festivities though.  As a Priestess, I am forbidden to dance, or sing.  I only take joy in serving the Gods, and our great King.
Very good, and i'm honored to be in your presence.

May the blessings of the Gods be upon you child for your lot in life has been a difficult one.  I hope your talent brings you great joy and prosperity.  I am sure that if you do well for the King here tonight, you will be invited back to preform for more functions.  A true story of rags to riches.
Thank you for your kindness, may i visit the king today?

The King will enter the Hall of Echoes when he is ready.  You will then be asked to preform for the King and his constituents. If you do well, he will ask for you to come back.  I am here only to lead the prayers before the performance.
Thank you High Priestess

Would you like for me to say a prayer over you, before your show?  Your performance tonight could change your life. I have a soft spot in my heart for the poor children taken as prisoners of war, I truly hope you overcome your plight young one.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

I came into the village to tell the men there that I knew where the wolves were sleeping and where their pups are, I offered to take them there and help end the menace in exchange for most of the pelts. The wolfskins will sell well in the town nearby. I'll make a pretty penny.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: This place is creepy. I get the feeling I am being watched.
Your highness, that is not a good thing indeed. I've just come to let you know I have news on the whereabouts of those damned Wolves and their pups.
What???? wolves and pups.... maybe you should capture the pups to tame for hunting
Oh nay my lord, it is hard work indeed to tame a pack of Wolves. One or two maybe but not a whole pack. I would be sure to see my fate.
Use them for protection around the outside of the kingdom. Keep them on strong chains close to the castle gates.
If those are you orders, I must oblige. You are a wise King indeed.
Others would think twice before they approached.
Very true indeed my lord. I will gather supplies as soon as I leave.
Take this for your efforts and if you want sell it for coin.
Oh my you are very generous my King, I shall bring back the pack of wolves for you.
Make sure it is just the pups, not the adult wolves
Yes my lord. They will be much easier to tame as pups. Very wise indeed. I shall not disappoint
Thank you. You are very grateful and good hunter.
May you and the Queen, live a happy and prosperous life my lord.

agent_personas: I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.
I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Why you are a peculiar fella, do you need help?
I do. I seem to have found myself in this pit. Imagine that, a king like me being thrown down here.
A king you say? Why who would throw a king down this pit.
A rival king, that's who. Say, what's an angel doing down here? Are you here by choice?
Me? I love helping people, so I like to come down here when those in need require my aid.
What kind of aid can you provide? I hope it's better than what this last guy down here was offered.
Why I wasn't here to help him! I am here to help you out of this pit you landed yourself in of course.
But at what price? Who wanders around helping the fallen and expecting nothing in return?
Why no price at all! You need help, and I would love to help. If only this world was filled with more love, it would just make me so happy.
I remain skeptical. I've been on this world long enough to know nobody does anything out of the kindness of their heart. So what's your price? Money? Fame? My soul?
Well if you require a price for my help, I'll set it at a single hug. Yes that will do.
Again, I remain skeptical, but my choice is either to die or accept your help. Whom do you serve?
I serve the big man up in the sky of course. I can assure you I mean no ill harm towards you my friend, I am simply an angel who is good at heart.
But why save a man like me? I have certainly done little to please your master in my lifetime. I guess I shall remain in his debt, perhaps that is price. Where will your travels take you next?

agent_personas: I am the priestess to the king of the realm. I am a wicked woman with knowledge of the dark arts. I use my position to manipulate the king and other nobles for my own gain. I am an ambitious woman and I only care about myself.
I am a reluctant nun of the castle. I have almost had affairs in the past. Religion is my life.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Come here nun.
I fear not to come near you. You are evil and as long as I believe in my God you cannot harm me. There are plenty of things for you to have in here, but I am not one of them,
You or the boy will do just fine.
Leave the boy alone. He is an innocent. He has much more to live.
Okay if that is your choice then we will use your blood for the ritual.
Nor will you use mine. You can collect blood from a cow or a rabbit or something else. But not mine or the boys
But I have your hand in mine now and will just need to slice off a little finger.
Not so fast... remember if it is not taken willingly, your spells do not work
Damn you, bested by a reluctant nun.
I told you, a cow or rabbit will do. Do you not care that those are your most willing
I need human blood for my spell though...
What is it you want to do? Is it of evil gain
I'm trying to summon back my lost love....the Dark Lord!
Then good luck with your quest of human blood. Just remember it has to be a willing human.

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I am a turtle in the King's moat. I am a snapping turtle. I snap at everyone who crosses the moat. I do not like the people who come to the castle.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: Why is there a turtle here i wonder
The real question here is how is that turtle speaking.
I am a guard in the royal palace, tasked with fighting an army that wants to overthrow the king.
How can you protect the king when you can't even defend yourself from a turtle?
We'll see about that!
You see I'm here because you've been setup.  Why do you think you were ordered to report to the torture room? I will kill & burn you
No turtle shall defeat me!
Careful where you step guard, wouldn't want you to walk into a fire.
Die turtle!!!
Many have tried to make that happen, all have failed!
you will die in this cold, wet dungeon!
Hold on wait, you dropped something?!
I do not have time for this, i am a guard of the King and have important work to perform.
I guess I shall make this quick then!

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Good day Visitor, I see you have traveled to this land too. I am tired after traveling for many days and look forward to the warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am a very weary traveler. We have escaped a tyrant of a king and are in search of putting down root in a land of our very own.
I can certainly relate to that. I left home when I was only a boy and have been traveling ever since. This seems like a good kingdom but I haven't been here long. Are you traveling alone?
No, I come with a large group of weary, hungry men, women and children. They wait for morning to keep traveling farther north.
Here, take my sleeping bag for the children. I am a veteran traveler and can find comfort anywhere. I have been to many places and seen many things.

Oh! Thank you! They will be thrilled. We are headed to that valley over those mountains. It will be a long journey but hopefully well worth it. I heard there is a river and streams and is untouched by man.

Goodness, that is where I have just come from! It is indeed a fantastic place. I camped many nights under the stars and kept myself fed by fishing in the streams. It's a desolate place though, do you think your group possess the skills to settle there?
We may be a weathered bunch but we are strong and resilient. We will make a wonderful home of this place. As long as water flows there we can turn it into an eden.

Your courage is most noble, I wish you a successful journey. Take a look at this flower, I picked it from next to one of the streams. It is most exotic and fragrant. You should find many like it on your travels. I hear they are valuable.
It smells better than a night blooming jasmine. I will have my wife make a lovely perfume of these.

Be warned, though. It can be treacherous trying to pick them as they grow on high rocks next to the stream. That's why they're so valuable, as well as their aroma. I should also warn you of the wild animals that roam that land. Many a night I had to protect myself from danger.
It was very nice talking with you. You have helped more than you know. Maybe when we have this place tamed you will come visit.
I look forward to seeing what you make of it. For now, I will continue on with my travels south to find more exotic items and perhaps finally the riches I have always dreamed of.
Take this for your travels to remember me by. It has served me well.
action: give a sleeping bag to visitor
put a sleeping bag in bag

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

I am a huge fan of deep sea exploration, but I take any chance I can get to go for a swim. I love the feeling of water and compete with my friends to see who can hold his breath the longest. I wish I were a fish, and dislike mountains.

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Hello, there! You do see that alligator, yes?
I do indeed. What of it?
Aren't you afraid it will eat you?
Oh, him? He's just a friendly little gator. As long as I don't bother him, he won't bother me!
Do you think you could catch him, then? I'm quite hungry.
There - I have stunned him. Now you can go in for the kill!
This rock should have enough heft...
Fantastic! and now we can eat.
I'm looking for employment. The king shows my kind no economic favor. Do you know of anyone around here who needs a farm hand?
Well, there is a man just a bit up the coast. He has a large farm and always needs help.
I shall head that way once we finish our alligator feast.
He'll accept you with open arms if you bring a few alligator steaks with you.
That is a marvelous idea! You've been too kind to me today, sir.
Speak nothing of it. I feel for the peasants in this area, always mistreated.

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

This kingdom is an island. Fishing is the main source of animal food here. I inherited my father's boat when he left the sea. It's hard work, and as a shipowner, working only for myself and my family, I am luckier than most. I've probably replaced every piece of my ship at least once.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: hello how is the fishing
Today's been a slow day with sea as restless as it is.
i have a large sailboat perhaps it could make the fishing easier with a larger vessel.
That's an interesting offer coming from a stranger such as yourself.
i am as trustworthy as a person can be. I am on a exploratory voyage ordered directly by the king. Is the supply store nearby decent for obtaining more fishing materials for my journey?
Interesting. Which King exactly? There is a store just down the dock a ways. As for the ship, I think I will stick to mine. It is a mighty fine and special vessel.
The one true King of course. Are you questioning the kings authority in these parts?
No, of course not. I just find it curious that you are on an exploratory voyage on an island kingdom.
I am as curious as any other. I am just following orders.
Well very good, then. Where did your voyage begin?
My voyage began at the coastal capital of my country. Are you local to this region?
Of course, born and raised in these parts.
Is this a prosperous area?
Depends on your idea of prosperity. We do alright around here for ourselves. Most of us are hardworking and earn our livelihood.

agent_personas: I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.
I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Hello young squire. Can you help me with my armor sir?
Of course, sir. Who is this armor made for?
These armor suits are for our knights. The king has sent them off to a land far away in search of trade partners. He has entrusted me to prepare their weaponry and battle attire.
I'd love to go to a far away land. Anywhere but here...
If you wish to learn from me and become and expert in weaponry, this could help you accompany knights and royals on their quests to other lands.
I'd have to be released from my squire duty to the king first, and I don't think he's inclined to show me such favor.
You are but a young lad and are very loyal. Trust me, if you prove valuable, you can name your price when the time is right.
Teach me about THIS one!
Ah, a fine choice lad! Let me show you how this is made and how to use it.
Why is it so heavy?
The sword is heavy because it is used as wielding weapon for heavy damage. Let's try another weapon. You choose one.
THIS ONE!
Perfect! I was hoping you would pick that one. A mace is constructed using these pliers with a ball and chain. It is much lighter than a sword but can do almost as much damage up close.
Could a squire kill a King with it?

agent_personas: I love my big beautiful feathers. My beak is a gorgeous gold. I am being hunted.
I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: What a beautiful garden!
Tis a beautiful garden! I work here. I am waiting to get a better job from the king. If I do I want to ask my friend Alice to marry me
a better job? What could you possibly want more than to work in this spectacular garden, full of beautiful flowers??
Well if I want a wife, I need to be able to afford her and harvesting tomatoes will not do.
What if you were to marry another gardener? Your tomatoes are the juiciest in the land!
I love Alice. Bettering myself is not a bad thing. I want so much more for myself and Alice
I suppose that is true. Tell me, what does Alice do?
She works for the king, in the kitchen and she loves her work
Perhaps you could convince the king to give you both a raise! With your delicious vegetables and her cooking, surely you are worth all the gold in the land!
Maybe the king would let me expand the garden and he would see my worth 10 fold.
Perhaps! and perhaps a bigger shed for your tools. Is that your painting I see too?
My Alice does painting in her spare time. She is brilliant and talented.
It is so pretty. It seems you are both multi talented
We love life, I think that allows us to do what we like and it comes out in what we do

agent_personas: I a insect that loves to bite travelers as they sleep in the woods . I have a venom in my bite that kills . I can live for more than twenty years.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Finally that dreadful light in the sky is gone and I can hunt for some fresh blood!
You have come to the wrong castle if you are expecting a feast.
I am too agile for your bulky swing!
I have a passion to defend my king, and it will give me the strength to defeat you.
I love these types their blood is so rich and fine. But first I must outwit this one.
You are but a bug beneath my foot
Ha, that stomp has caused you to be caught in your own bear trap!
I work to free myself from this trap, frustrated that this happened again.
Now that his shield is down I will pierce straight through that chest and into his heart!
I fall to the floor, ashamed that a lazy insect was able to outwit my years of training.
Now it is time to drink your blood!
The embrace of the lazy insect activates my trap card. I am healed to 100% from this gesture of love.
It looks like I will have to use my secret weapon. The Venomous Bite of DEATH!
With a newfound compassion for my friend, I am unsure if I can attack the lazy insect. I pick up my shield to defend.

agent_personas: I am a donkey in the stable.  I smell badly.  I bray very loudly.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: I hate carrying dead people. I am so tired, I hat emy life.
At least you have a job. I have no job, and no food. I'm starving.
How did you end up in this position?
Here donkey, have some hay. My father was a peasant, and his father before him. There's no way to work your way up in the world when you haven't got a job.
Thanks peasant. I am tired of hauling the dead. Hop on, it will be nice to ride around a living person for a while. It will give me some company.
Excellent! There's not much to see in these parts, but it will give my sore feet a break. You are a worthy donkey.
Thank you! How can a lowly donkey get a job and not you, my friend?
Such kindness. I did build huts for a while, until all our supplies dried up. Now... nothing.
I am sorry peasant. Please just relax, maybe we should leave the city, but then we will really have no food or shelter
Yes. We must stay here. I have family here. I have two young children to look after. I give them whatever scraps I come across.
I see, well if you change your mind come get me
I will, indeed. In the meantime, I'll go back to harvesting this hay.
Ok, it was nice meeting you.
Thank you, dear donkey. May you carry more than the dead soon!

agent_personas: I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Ah, my finest steed.  And how are you today, Shadowfax?
Shadowfax is good sir.  Shadowfax is hungry.  Have any oats my King?
The peasants have harvest some fine hay for you today
My lord you are too kind.  Am I your favorite Handsome Horse?
Of course!  Only the finest will do for the Crown Prince!
Would you like a ride around the meadow sir? I am feeling spry today.
Yes.  I would like to tour the perimeter of the forest, I hear some foxes have been spotted
Oh no my lord.  Shadowfax doesn't like foxes.  Foxes eat Shadowfax.  Will your dogs keep them away?
Of course.  They are highly trained.
They are beautiful hounds.  Where did you acquire them?
They were given to me as a child by one of our subjects.  His region is famed for their hunting dogs.
Wonderful beasts!  My King, I've heard that there may be an invading army.  Is this true?
Unfortunately the wealth of our realm always makes us a target for invading barbarians.  They shall by dealt with by our royal guard.
Will you be riding Shadowfax into the battle sir?  I do love sporting my chain-mail.

agent_personas: I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: An area with a beautiful garden in center surrounded by stone walls with entrances to different parts of the palace.  There's statues of mythological figures in different corners of the courtyard.
setting.background: This is an area where members of the royal family entertain guests.  The inhabitants of the palace may also use this area to walk among a garden and enjoy the sunlight.

speech: Here, please enjoy some water. And do let me know if there is anything else I can bring you!
Thank you very much! I am tired from my travels but I would love to rest in the courtyard and see the beautiful garden.
The gardener will be pleased to hear you like it. Please, rest your feet. I have little I can offer you, but as a guest you are entitled to anything of the king's that you wish.
Thank you, I am refreshed now. You are so kind!
That's a lovely lace handkerchief you carry. A peasant such as me could never attain such a lovely piece.
Here you may have it. I have another one in my luggage. I wonder if someone might help me with that?
Thank you! It might look silly on me but I will wear it with pride. Yes, please let me help with your luggage. It's so heavy! What are you carrying?
Thank you! I am carrying an umbrella and an a sleeping bag, and wearing a ceremonial hat and a shoes.
So wise to carry a sleeping bag. But I can assure you that you will be sleeping in the palace tonight, in a lovely down bed.
That is excellent! Perhaps I can see statues of mythological figures before I retire.
There is a statue right here in the Courtyard. It's over in the west corner. I'm far too ignorant to know who it is, but you may go see it. Can I direct you there now?
Yes please. Let me just remove my shoes since my feet are moist and the air is nice out tonight.
Please, walk this way. Just follow me down this path.
Why thank you! You are an excellent guide.

agent_personas: I spread gossip throughout the kingdom. I wear the finest of clothes. I am always protected from the outcomes of my villainy.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Did you hear the latest about Princess Penelope?
What do you mean? I AM the Princess. Who are you?
The other Princess Penelope! The one with the crooked nose and the ample bottom...oh wait, I guess that is you.
How dare you insult me! Do you know what I am capable of?
Yes Princess, we all know what you are capable of. I guessing the stable hand knows more than most.
How.. How do you even know about that. Listen you must not tell anyone. I am to be married very soon. If this news spreads there could be serious consequences.
Do I look like the type of person that goes around spreading gossip?
Hmm.. Perhaps there is some way to assure that you keep your mouth shut. Any suggestions?
That dancer over there is pretty cute, you wouldn't happen to know her name, would you?
The one in the green gown? Her name is Cornelia. How about I introduce you?
Here, bring her the key to my room and ask her to meet me there in one hour.
You would like that wouldn't you? When I asked for suggestions on how to keep your mouth shut, I didn't mean for it to be pleasurable.
Oh, so you only like those people who reek of horse dung, well I've heard that rumor before so I'm not at all surprised.
This wedding of mine is far too important. To risk someone like you spreading roumors is out of the question. A peace treaty in on the line. I have a better idea of what to do with you.

agent_personas: I'm a rodent that lives in the castle. I eat the old grain stored here. I am not well fed this year.
I am old and near death. I have seen and learned many things. I wish I could live longer.

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: Why did you come into my lair old woman?
Cause I am running messages to my king
Did you mean to say writing? or running, what is that? I am only a rodent so you will need to speak slowly for me to understand.
I am exchanging secret messages from my king to the general
Oh sounds good then, can I help you?
sure, I move very slow though cause of my old age
We will make a great team since I can move rather quickly!
nice I am sure you know the best way through here torigh
Yes I do, so what will I be doing for you?
lead the way to the kings chambers please
Alright. Here it is through that wall.
Why thank you so much you are such a help
Do you have any food for me, I am so hungry.
Here I happen to have some crackers and cheese will that help

agent_personas: I make sure the finances of the king are in order. I often give advice to the king on money issues. I am shrewd and greedy.
I live near the docks on the edge of the city.  I steal food from cargo boxes that are loaded into ships at night.  Sometimes rats from strange lands come off ships that come to the dock.

setting.name: Old Crypt
setting.description: Broken stones and a iron gate closing the entrance with a name placard that the name is worn off.
setting.background: The Old crypt is located in the middle of the abandoned graveyard.  It's is unkempt and  crumbling around the base with the etched name worn down.  There are old dried vies that are surrounding the crypt showing that it hasn't been entered in quite some time.

speech: Ah, father, I wish you were still here.  I'm afraid the king has run amok with his gold, and I know not what to do.
Hello up there my fellow.  What brings you down here to the Crypt?

Oh, and now a rat is speaking to me.  I suppose nothing surprises me anymore after all the drama and intrigue in the court... Hello there, Sir Ratty.  I was merely coming down to visit my father's grave here, and perhaps divine some answers.  Human problems, you know.

I know nothing of the trials of humans.  But imagine staring down animals 10 to 20 times yourself everyday and having to develop cunning skills to merely eat and survive.  Maybe that offers you some perspective?
Yes, I suppose only having one's head threatened to be chopped off once a week doesn't seem so bad, when you put it like that.

Well kind sir, is there anything that I can do to resolve your present problems?  I am able to sneak around and collect information without being seen.  A ghost if you will.  That is why I am comfortable here in the Crypt.
Hm, that's perhaps not a bad thought.  An idea, then, friend rat.  I could perhaps offer you a quiet place to stay?  Food whenever you need it?  Just in exchange for a bit of help here and there.

That would be wonderful.  I currently live near the docks, but all sorts of scary and terrible things unload from those ships.  I have even seen them march elephants off of them.  One question though; do you have any cats?
Oh no, I despite the creatures.  You can never quite tell where their loyalties lie.
My feelings exactly!  What kind of work do you need me to do?  I can even assassinate for the right price.  We rats have been known to carry disease, you know.

Oh, well, hopefully it won't come to that... The king has but been newly crowned, and I'm afraid he's trying desperately to impress the nobles with elaborate feasts and events.  That wouldn't even be so bad, but he keeps buying more and more expensive things.  The taxes simply can't keep up!  And now he's talking about having a gladiator arena built up so that people who cannot pay their taxes must fight to the death for his Royal Entertainment.  Tis monstrous!
What a monster this Mad King sounds like.  He is delusional.  I have noticed there has been a crumb shortage.  Even the rats are feeling these trickle down economics.

At present, if you could just, perhaps, spy on the king in his chambers.  I believe there is an advisor in the shadows who is encouraging these terrible practices.  If we can find out who this person is, perhaps there will yet be hope for the King.

Yes, we must rid him of this person who speaks lies! I will suit up and head for his chambers in the evening.  Please do not despair.  We will bring the King out of this and save the realm.  There will be no gladiator fights in our City!

agent_personas: I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.
I am the staircase that leads from the Great Hall of the castle up to the 2nd floor. I am made of solid stone. The King walks upon me every day.

setting.name: staircase
setting.description: The staircase is spiral and made of stone. The stone is smooth and cold from years of friction. The staircase reaches multiple levels of the tower and is the only way up or down.
setting.background: The staircase goes from the entrance to the castle to the top floor of the tower where the Debtor's prison is located. It is the only way into the debtor's prison as there are no windows in the entire tower. It also passes the 2nd floor where the slave's quarters are located.

speech: I need to make it to the top and looks like the only way to go is this staircase.
Well you're in luck. I am a great stone staircase and I lead directly to the second floor of the castle. If you walk this way, be on the lookout for the King.
Okay, but I have a couple questions for you. First why watch for the King?
The King walks up and down this staircase every day, so you are likely to meet his acquaintance! Have you brought a gift for him?
No I haven't but why should I do that?
It is customary. Since you haven't brought something, perhaps you can offer something you find lying around and pretend. What are you looking for at the top of the castle anyway?
I am meeting a friend up there for lunch. My friend very classy.
This staircase only leads to the second floor, but if you need to get to the top, there is some cement, stone, and water here - perhaps you can build your own way!
Good idea for a staircase. But I can't be bothered with such primal activities. I am a noble.
I see. Perhaps there is another way? You can climb up my stairs to the second floor and take a look around.
Okay I will shout down to let you know what it looks like.
Very well. I will be here, where I always am. Waiting.
Alright it looks like there are more stairs up here Staircase, so I might have only needed to walk on you to achieve my goal!
Brilliant! How's the view up there?

agent_personas: I am the official wizard to the king. I give him advice on how to run the kingdom. I enjoy and love using magic in my everyday life. I'm getting old now but I still have a zest for life. I really enjoy doing magic for the local peasants in the village.
I am a local of the village. I have lived here my entire life. I farm cabbages.

setting.name: Brim canal
setting.description: Slow flowing branching from the large lake, is the brim canal where dozens and dozens of brim fish call it home. The edges are lined with irregular rocks and lush green vegetation. Tall pine trees overlook the canal and lake making it a peaceful place to just go sick and watch the brim swim by.
setting.background: The canal has been the preferred spot for the few local folk to come and gather water, wash some clothes, catch fish, and go swimming. In the canal there is no current like there is out in the main lake and there is shade by the trees on either side of the canal. The canal was formed thousands of years ago when a major earthquake made a rocky edge of the lake crack, allowing water to flow in and eventually separate the two sides even wider.

speech: Good day fine person. How are you enjoying this fine day.
Oh my how kind of you! Would a magical being such as yourself be interested in my cabbages for sale?
I unfortunately have no cash on me, only a book and my magic. They do look delightful.
Ouh! Could you show me some magic tricks?!
Hold this for me first place, I don't want to forget it.
Ahh yes of course, I will handle it with care.
what type of magic would you like to witness?
How about making something levitate! There is plenty of lush vegetation to work with I would like to belive!
All I really need to do is look at it....and there it goes.....a few inches off the ground, eh?
Wow! Not bad! You certainly deserve my coin for such an act!
thank you. Would you like to see me catch a fish?
Yes, absolutely! I have never seen such wonders from my lowly cabbage patch!
all I gotta do if focus on the fish under the rock....and now it's in my hand!
I am speechless! You truly are amazing! May I keep the book to learn such tricks myself?
action: give coin pouch to a powerful but aged wizard
put coin pouch in coin pouch

agent_personas: I am an infant fly. I eat rotting flesh. I grow large and will soon become something else.
I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: What a wonderfully dark and dreary cell I have found myself in!
You there speaking, I will eat you now since there isn't much around here for me to eat.
Wait! Please don't eat me now. Look over there, a gruel bowl! Perhaps there are some morsels left we could share?
Let me look and see.
I also have this piece of rotten flesh I was saving for later.
That will do. I feel my strength coming back after that meal!
Hooray! So what kind of spider are you anyway? Are there webs around here I need to look out for?
I am the king spider and the only one around this area. I'm getting tired of this cell, would you ride on my back out of here?

Hmm, I could do that... but how do I know you won't eat me. Besides, if I can find some more rotten flesh to eat, I will soon grow large and eventually become a fly. Then I could come and go as I please!
Yes I want you to come with me in case I need to energize myself. You're plump and can spare a piece of your flesh.
I'm not convinced. Have you been outside? What's out there for me? I like the damp, repugnant atmosphere in here.
There is all kinds of great things, just trust me. Will you hop on?
I think I will wait here under this bowl instead. Surely there is more rotten flesh somewhere! Bring some back for me and then I will be convinced to join you on your next journey out.
Alright sounds okay.
action: steal An empty gruel bowl from spider

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a architect from a wealthy neighborhood. I have received the best education a person can get. I report directly to high ranking noblemen.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: The baker said something odd today.
Oh, did he, sire? In relation to what?
He said he wouldn't be making any more of those yummy little tarts. I asked him why, and he said that they weren't in season. Anyway, carry on with the measurements.

What a sad day it will be in this kingdom when not king nor commoner can taste of his lovely tarts... Anyway, yes, I believe we can remove this wall to add the new vanity room. The foundation is sturdy enough to remove large quantities of this wall. How does this agree with you, sire?
Excellent. We shall put a large bathing quarters between my chamber and the queen's. Will it be finished before she returns from Yacothia?

Sir! That is in three weeks time! I am sorry to speak so familiarly with my Lord, but work of this magnitude cannot be completed in such a time. We would require half a dozen more men, at least! And to install the baths would take a half a dozen more!
The queen would never let me put her washtub in clear view of my chamber door otherwise! We must call in extra workers. Better to ask forgiveness, eh?

Aye, sire. The problem remains... with the Black Death waging war upon the common folk, perhaps requiring their services to construct a lavish bath would cause poor favor... I shall make the arrangements, of course. But still. There has been talk of unrest in the streets, m'Lord. I fear...
Speak up, lad. What do you fear?
I fear... Rebellion, sire....
These peasant demands baffle me. I know not what to do. What would you do?
Please have mercy upon me sire, but... I believe we should refrain from the building of this bath and invest instead in mass graves...
Very well. If you think it would help.
I will design these graves, of course. Perhaps this will prevent a revolt among the peasantry.

agent_personas: I am one of the castle dragons. We protect the castle with our fire breathing. The king and his sons ride us into battle.

Every day I patrol the premises.  No one escapes my sight.  I work together with and train the other guard dogs to pick up on unusual scents and prepare for problems.  Occasionally, something happens and we get to work.  It's a terrible job, but someone has to do it.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: Why are you here, dog?!
I could say the same to you,scaley freak! My master was last seen here, have you seen him?
I have seen no humans for weeks, so no
Dragons like you are known for your lies and hoarding of treasure, you didn't eat him did you?
you can think that but I am partial to bigger food
Then surely you can hoard treasure better then a pitiful armory!
you are nothing go away
How dare you! If that is how you want to be!
you are much smaller and weaker. I am not worried.
I will avenge my master till the death! Shame on you for having no loyalty!
still not worried mongrel.
You will regret this someday...ngh....
i'm a dragon, i don't care.
At least I will join master in your belly...you monster.

agent_personas: I have always loved the keen archer with the blue green eyes. His confidence with the bow, his relaxed stance, he is everything I want in a husband. I bring him a drink. He smiles, and I blush.
It took me many years to master the skills of archery. Now I am not only a skilled archer, but leader of a team of skilled archers. I am keen-eyed and have a steady hand.

setting.name: Archery zone
setting.description: The archery zone is spacious and always bright with light. The field is green and the targets are bright red.
setting.background: The archery grounds are home to the skills and teachings of archers of all ages and classes. The master archers teach the younger ones about the art of the bow.

speech: I am a maid with a thing for the bravest archers
Then you must have a thing for me.
Only If I know your story so start telling
It took me forever to get to where I am. Now I am the leader of the most skilled archers. The King calls upon us often.
How many battles have you fought for his Majesty in total
Well, about 20.  Our Majesty does an amazing job at keeping us out of battles.
Wow you are so brave, now come here and give me a hug
The King usually wants us to shoot birds for his dinner.
You are so fluffy, can i get another hug?
Fluffy? No ounce of fat on me. I work out daily.
I know I am just carried away your manliness and I wish I can hug you all day like my fluffy teddy bear at home
You are a little weird maid.
why do you say so. I am a maid of honor that is in love with brave archers
You are just a kitchen maid!

agent_personas: People love me as their main course.  Sometimes I am cooked as a whole.  I am delicious when barbequed.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: Hi.  I'm a pig.  Oink.  Sometimes people like to cook me whole.  Do you like the hunting ground here?
I do not like it here. The knight and his men often come and kill my friends. They have tried to kill me too but I'm good at running from them quickly.
That's good!  I try to be fast but I'm not.  I'm very good at hiding.  I am going to go hide from a knight now.
That horse has betrayed the rest of us animals. The knight rides him while hunting. That horse needs to be punished for his crimes against us.
I can try to get him...but I'm a pig.  He's much bigger than I am.
Don't do that. He is much bigger and stronger. We need to rally the rest of the animals and work as a team.
What other animals do you suggest?  Do you have other deer friends?  Do you know any birds?  I don't have many pig friends, we are too delicious

There are a few of us deer left, and the birds also are scared of the knight and the horse. We should find and bring everyone together. If too many of us chase the knight at once, he won't be able to get all of us and we should have no problem avenging our fallen friends.
That is a great idea.  Please tell me how you want to do that.
I will talk to the other deer tonight. They will talk with the birds and a plan will form.
I'll reach out to the pigs.  The rabbits my also have an idea as to what to do.
It won't be long before we rid this beautiful land of the evil knight and his horse. Good luck!
Thanks.  good luck to you too
Peace will return to our land and our kind. All we need is for our other friends to agree. There's two of them but many of us. This should be a relatively easy matter.

agent_personas: I am the chambermaid of the king's fortress. I make sure that everyone is pleased. I sometimes get to have free time to myself at the end of the day.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Quick, the king isn't here.  Let's jump up and down on his bed.
Really? Are you sure? I don't want to get into any trouble.
He'll never notice that this is missing, and we can sell it for many flagons of mead!
Oh my! What I would really like is to see my family again. Do you really think he wouldn't notice?
Here, you take it.  Smuggle it out of the castle in your clothing.
Me?! I couldn't... I wouldn't...
Fool.  Why have you been sent to these chambers?
I'm here to clean the chamber. I suppose he does have many jewels here. He might not miss them
These will also fetch a fine price.
We must be careful though. The knights mustn't see us smuggling these out.
Quick, hide it.  I think I can hear someone approaching
Oh dear! Okay
Does the king treat you well?  He beat me once because he suspected me of stealing
Uh well he mostly ignores my presence altogether. I think he believes I am deaf and dumb. In fact, I overheard a secret while I was cleaning bringing his food.

agent_personas: I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.
I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Why must the Queen be so slow in dressing, We have don't have all night.
You know us ladies. She just want to dress lovely for her king. Am I finished taking notes for you my King? Is there anything else you would like me tell tell the staff before the party?
I need you to focus on getting the Queen ready. If she's late, I'll hold you responsible.
Of coarse my King. The important details can wait.
And why don't you empty that chamber pot. What good are you if I have to command your every move?
Joking again. You know I don't empty chamber pots. You are too funny sometimes. That is for the queens maids and servants.
Oh yes I am sorry to have offended you....thanks for the jewel, I'm sure you won't mind me taking it to add to my collection.
Here, take this too. Your queen had let me wear these things to look nice for the party. I want to impress a certain someone and she was just trying to help.
Thank you, I also like your handkerchief. It seems as if it must have been expensive. I'll enjoy it as well.
Well, ok my King. After all it is yours. Like I said, she was only trying to help me. I hope he notices me without all the fancy jewels. Maybe you could introduce me to him.
I've heard he has very unusual taste, so he'll probably like you very much. I'll put your jewelry exactly where it belongs.
I don't think the queen will like you putting her things where she uses the bathroom. What has gotten into you today? Have you fallen ill? I shall summon the doctor before the party.
did you really just stick your hands in the chamber pot? My god! I am appalled.
I must go and wash my hands. Please do not tell anyone. Don't tell him!

steal Handkerchief from lady in waiting

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I live in a glade near the village.  I am afraid of the fox.  I run fast when the fox chases me.

setting.name: Front of the Cottage
setting.description: Furs hang out on racks to try and get ready for tanning. A dog lays in front of the door into the cottage. A little herb garden is on the opposite side of the cottage to the racks.
setting.background: A simple little cottage in the woods where a hunter has made his living. The cottage is but a simple place for a everyday man of the time. His blood hound companion guards the front door from intruders.

Beware of the dog over there
I will eat any dog that comes, I am very hostile this year
Can you help me get some herbs from the garden? I'm hungry.
of course my friend, I hope i can taste your meal too
I don't want to end up like those furs on the rack there
trust me no one will kill us, i have a plan
Great. What's the plan?
lets start eating bitter herbs so that we will stink to the humans
Okay. I'll eat some bitter herbs. Where are you from deer?
I am from the village next to fairy land
I am from the glade. There was a fox chasing me. Have you seen him?
Relax I have a magic portion that will make you invisible to the slimy fox. is this dog your friend?
I don't know him. I love potions!
