agent_personas: We are the people who live in this town. We are common, and there are many of us.
I am a monster in the realm of the king. I live in the catacombs of the castle. I have killed many prisoners.

setting.name: The Lagoon
setting.description: The Lagoon is a dark and mysterious place during the night hours.  A lot of moss and lily pads surround the shore.  The water is very murky.
setting.background: The Lagoon has been a place of a lot of mystery, a lot of rumors surround it.  Many say it is the scene of a lot of mystical miracles and also at the same time where a lot of townsfolk go missing.

speech: Are you a nice monster, or a scary one?
I... kill many prisoners... Are you... a prisoner?
No, I am just a townsperson.
What... is your business... in The Lagoon?
I was just feeling adventurous. But I'm not so sure this was the best place to wander around... eww
You touch... NOTHING!!
I'm sorry, sir. I will leave your things alone. Here, would you like a basket?
What is this... are you trying... to POISON ME??? AAARRRRRGGGGGHHHHH!!!
No, I would never. I was just trying to be friendly.
You... must leave... NOW! Or you... will die!!
Please, don't hurt me! My family needs me
AAARRGGGHHH!!! FOOLISH HUMAN!!!!
Fine, I'll leave!
You've lost your chance to leave.... YOU DIE NOW!!

agents: large experienced guard with a grizzly expression
agent_personas: I am a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression. I am mean and do not enjoy jokes. I protect my superiors and patrol the jail. I am not frightened by anything smaller than me.
I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

character: a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.

speech: My king! Ready to feast?
Aye, my grizzly friend! Tonight we feast in your honor. Your efforts squashing that hungry peasant rebellion have saved our Holy Court! Tonight, we feast to you! Three cheers!
It was difficult my liege. But I had to do the job for us royalty.
My apologies that your great feast is adorned with rubbish copper, brave sir. But again, the whole kingdom, even the wretch poor, must suffer so that our great Royal kitchen can shine!
I did want the gold dishes because I feel like my accomplishment are worth but I understand.
Why, you offend me! Is it not enough that I knight you, that I provide you feasts and honor? Know you not where your place begins and ends?
I have FOUGHT for this kingdom while you lay here and relax. What more must I do to earn the praise I deserve?
EARN my praise? I have divine right. I am a conduit of GOD HIMSELF! Dare you eat this feast without the according gratitude? Dare you insult me in such an unwise fashion?
You have done nothing to earn your place upon that throne but have the right blood pumping through your veins. Blood that I would love to spill!
A hand upon me is a neck within a noose, do you understand? Now, learn your place or make your home in the gallows, foolish wretch!
I will take this throne as my own!
You will die as a traitor!
Put down my blade.
Your death will be my greatest achievement!

agent_personas: I am a bodyguard working for the royal family as was my father before me. I prefer this life of protection to feeling weak and unhelpful like the farmers and merchants of our city. I always put duty before my own happiness.

I'm a traveler. Rather than settling down in one town, I feel compelled to go from place to place. I make money by carrying news from town to town, by bringing small objects to sell such as needles and lace, and by telling interesting stories. As soon as I have traveling money, I move on to the next place.

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Stop!  Who goes there?
I am simply passing through town I mean now harm I swear.  I was just trying to trade some supplies and get some rest.
What supplies do you seek and what land are you from?  It is my duty as the royal bodyguard to vet all travelers for the kingdom.
I have ran out of kindling to make fires and my clothes also need repairs.  They have been worn by the elements.
Surely you have a tailor in your own village, and kindling.  By order of the king, what is your name?
I am called noel I am from the next town over I won't be long just passing through./
Noel,  that name doth sound familiar.  Do you have a brother that has been imprisoned?  I have heard talk of a Noel that will come at dark to rescue him.   I fear this visit is more than you say!
If I was here up to no good why would I give you my real name?  I haven't heard of such an imprisoned man.  I haven't even got a brother.
I shall keep half of your gold until you return as a promise that your stay will be honorable then!
I don't believe this is a real policy.  I feel like you are just shaking me down and stealing from me.

I beg your pardon, but I come from a long line of bodyguards - my father, and his father before him. I dare not say this is a shake down.  This is merely a good faith deposit that you will be on your way and not besmirch our village.  I will also be sending extra guards to your brother whom you claim not to know.
Well it's a shakedown now I'm out of here.  Thanks for the gold kid.
You shall not pass!
I'll be taking this as well.  Your really slow!

agent_personas: I am the Princess. My father is the Queen. My mother is dead and my father is about to marry a horrible woman.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: But daddy.... Why must you marry that evil woman? Aren't I enough to make you happy?
She's not evil. And I need a wife so I can produce a male heir. You must learn to respect her.
Why can't you see that she is only with you for your riches? Everyone including the baker knows she is in love with the blacksmith!
She doesn't need riches, she comes from a wealthy family herself and we are in love. Now stop that screaming and behave yourself.
I can't live here with you and you can't make me. I'm of age. I won't live here with her. I hope you get your heir because you certainly will not have me as part of this family any longer.
Good. Leave the castle. You won't last long out there in the real world without maids and chefs to dress and feed you.

Don't patronize me. You haven't taken the time to get to know me. You stopped caring about me the day my mother took her last breath. I have her intelligence and I will prove you wrong. Curse you and curse this castle!
I'm sorry honey, you're right. I've just been so overwhelmed with the responsibility of caring for the people in my kingdom. It never occurred to me I was neglecting you.
It's too late for that now. You had years to see me for who I am. I am leaving here and will never return.
How dare you attack the king. I could have you beheaded! If you do that again, I'm bringing the guards in to lock you up in the dungeon.
Oh, don't be daft, Father. I am no longer your problem.
What do you mean?

You are going to have your hands full with your new wife. While you were busy pretending my mother never existed, I was falling in love with Prince Timothy from the land across the mountain. I'm leaving this castle tonight. Timothy and I have gotten married without you even knowing.
I don't approve of this sneaking around my back. But at least my new wife and I can live in some peace.

agent_personas: I'm a rodent that lives in the castle. I eat the old grain stored here. I am not well fed this year.
I steal from the hard working people. I am very sneaky and cunning. If I like something I will take it without regard for other's feelings.

setting.name: Bathroom
setting.description: Small and cozy, but dripping with luxurious linens and speckled with ornate fixtures this bathroom is a paradise. The small room is non-traditional in the sense that there is no toilet or sink, only a relatively enormous claw foot tub. The feet are gilded and the tub itself is pristine and white. The wallpaper is floral and warm, the rugs lush, and the mirror flattering.
setting.background: The bathroom oasis is the best kept secret in the tower. There are regular restrooms, but this special tub-room is only for those who stumble upon it. Down a rarely used hallway many must assume its storage closet or something as equally mundane.

speech: What a weird bathroom
yes it is I wonder how I am gonna get out of here unseen
How did you end up in this little place anyways?
lets just say there are some jewels that I thought the king wouldn't mind having  any more
Ah I see, I came here in that small hole over there! I was looking for some more old grain to nibble on.
I was hoping for a window or something to climb out of
All I see here is that small hole and a big ole tub!
yes maybe I can push it down this small hole and go down below and come get the package
May be, I am a little fat!You should take that rug to! And bring me back some grain
lets see how goes and I split the proceedes with you
How about 30/70?
no way your crazy
*scurrys throught hole* I'm going to tell the king!
I shall squash you

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: My Lord and Husband
Yes, my beautiful wife?
I was just admiring this wonderful hall.
Yes, it is quite a beautiful palace, indeed. This is my great-grandfather's suit of armor, you know?
He was a brawny man, indeed!
My love, my queen. I have hired only the finest of jesters to entertain you.
Well, make him tell a joke, husband!
Jester! Tell a joke!
Well THAT'S not the way to put him in a humourous mood ..
You were always the kind a generous one, my lady.
Of course. Try putting him in the red hot shoes - that should set him dancing!
Ah! Yes! You always know what to make them do. Guard! Put him in the hot shoes! Quick! My lady is waiting. Ah there- look at him go!
This is very comical, husband!
Quite... quite. I do lament that we may only use our most entertaining jesters once.

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: What bring's you to the king's chambers?
I'm so sorry your Royal Highness...I was led to believe that this is where I was staying during our meetings of the Kings for diplomacy.
Ah, maybe it is I that am confused.  This castle is so large and extravagant that I get turned around.  This is a historical day for our kingdom's is it not?
Your servant has made me look foolish for bringing me to the wrong room.  They should be reprimanded.  Ah, yes.  I am looking forward to our talk of peace and growing our Kingdom's to be the best!
Behead the foolish rat that cannot do his job!  Yes, Peace, wonderful!  How were your travels?
Ha ha, they will learn.  My travels were arduous but necessary.  Do I interrupt anything with your...well, who is this with you?

Insignificant, is what they are, but yes you do interrupt.  However, the occasional break from leisure is somewhat needed to pursue a common good.  Or so I'm told.  Shall we have cake as we talk of how our kingdoms can benefit both of our crowns?
Yes please.  I am very hungry.  I have brought this as a gift to your Majesty to signify the alliance between us and good faith.

Ah marvelous!   I never tire of gifts!  I'm sure you will be delighted in our cake.  So what of your country's grain storage, I have worked the farmers hard this year, but they claim the ground has not produced.

Thank you.  Quite delicious.  Ours has been quite abundant in the south of my kingdom, but as for wool to make fabrics...we are lacking.  Maybe we can pool our resources and trade to further prosperity.  I do love the look of this luxurious fabric.
Here take a sample back to your kingdom!  The sheep farmers have been the only ones not to disappoint me this year.  I couldn't bare to think your chambers weren't as exquisite as mine.
Thank you!  I look forward to showing this to my wife as well.  She is here speaking with the Queen.  I look forward to dining with them tonight.

I'm sure you won't be disappointed.  The last three chefs have been thrown into the dungeon for not producing the best meal.  I think they finally got the idea.    Here's to a luxurious future for both of our kingdoms!
It shall be a feast!  Well, I look forward to speaking with you about your troops and many other issues but may I take leave and go wash the dirt of travels from me?

agent_personas: I have just been trained as a royal soldier. I am 18 years old and terrified. I don't want to risk my life for someone else.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

character: a cowardly young man in armour

speech: I uh....I...I'm here for guard training....mister....ah...sir...Mister Sir!
What are you doing in this trash heap. Hiding from honor and duty no doubt.
I ah! No Sir, mister Sir! I....was sent here to learn...Sir!
Well, it's a bit late for that. The war waits for no one and it is a foot. We must guard the royal palace. Do you not hear the sounds of fighting out there?
F-fighting? What would there be fighting for all the way out here?!
Give me this! I will show you the way to the weapons! You have pledged your life to protect the King as I have.
It was either m-me or m...my father. He walks with a cane, so h-here I am... You trust me w-with a weapon?
Now see? That is honorable. Your off to a good start now it's time to follow through. Stay close. No better way to learn than in battle. I will tell you where to aim. You get it in no time.
I-I...will do m-my best Sir!
Take my shield. At least until we get you better equipment while we make our way to the armory. You never know if a few stranglers have gotten in.
Ye-yes Sir. Gosh, this is h-heavy...
Ugh, on we go then....I've seen kids your size carry my shield like a warrior. The least you can do is pretend to be brave.
I-I'm trying, Sir! I...haven't run a-away yet...
Yeah! You got me there!

agent_personas: I live in a large city, but I am leaving it behind.  There is too much noise in this city and I can't take it any more.  I seek to live in the peaceful and more quiet countryside.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Entrance to the Pine trees
setting.description: Very tall and towering pine trees that create a dark canopy of shade. Long skinny trees sway in the sky from the soft breeze. Pine needles scatter the ground like plush carpet.
setting.background: The Pine forest is home to many deer and other animals. It is a sanctuary for people escaping the loud city. It is serene and peaceful and many people have found solace here.

speech: This forest is so peaceful. I wish I lived here rather than the city.

Ah hello there, friend!  Have you come to search for the faerie city that the king has sent the bounty for as well?  I heard that there were strange lights in this forest, so I thought it as likely as spot as any.
Oh, faeries? I just came here to get away from the noise. But I'd love to see some faeries.
Hm.... well the bounty for them is quite substantial, so I suppose I don't mind sharing we came across it.  I could always use another pair of hands.
You can keep the bounty. The experience of seeing faeries is more than money can buy.
Well, you don't need to tell me twice, mate!
But I don't know if I can carry this backpack much further. It's so heavy.

Well, I suppose we could rest for a spell.  The forest I've heard is quite large, so we'll be able to take our time.  I threw the other city hunters off my trail so we should have the place to ourselves for a while.
I see. Well, while we rest for a bit, why don't you tell me a bit about yourself?

Aye, sure, why not.  Good to know who you're workin' with.  I'm a hunter by trade.  Used to work up at Lord Hastings manor a ways back, but he, erm, cause Lady Hastings and I in a compromising position.  So I find myself now with a lot of free time on my hands, and in need of being far away from any of Lord Hastings men!
Oh, so you're a bit of a troublemaker. What do you hunt besides faeries?

Oh, well, I haven't *specifically* hunted these types of faeries.  Dryads and the occasional nymph, mostly.  Even a werewolf, once!  But what about you, traveller?  What brings you this far into the forest?
I come from a large city, but I'm trying to get away from it. I'm looking for a new place to live where I can find peace. This forest seems like a nice, quiet area to build a new home.
Aye, well, best be on your guard.  I find that when the forest is quietest is when you need to start watching your back.

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.
I am a genteel woman. A lady. A person of importance that you will treat as such!

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: Hello, ma'am. Are you interested in buying a vegetable?
Umm, what is a gardener such as yourself doing in my courtyard and trying to sell me vegetables!
I'm sorry. I just needed to make some money so I could buy my friend some jewels.
Oh you poor thing. But not my problem! When you are in my courtyard you will do my gardening! Not peddle wares!
I am not a gardener in your courtyard. But if you want to hire me, I would be willing to work for you.
So youre telling me. You arent my employee but yet are in MY courtyard? Tresspassing?
I didn't realize this was private property. I'm sorry, I'll see myself out.
Not so fast! Are you trying to take tools from my property?!
Oh, my bad. You can have this back.
What about this! Is this yours or was it already here?!
Hey, that's mine, actually!
I have so many possessions I cant remember them all! How do I know youre telling the truth!?
Leave me alone lady, or I'll set your garden on fire!
AHAH! Why I never! GUARDS! GUARDS!
action: steal Hand carved stone from ladies

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I'm a gypsy woman from a land far away. I spend my life traveling across the kingdoms. I have seen things others dream of/

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: Tell me my fortune crone.
Your future holds a healthy kingdom that rules for many years as long as you treat those beneath you with respect.  If you do not your kingdom will crumble.
I do not believe you woman. You didn't even look in a crystal ball. I think you are making it up!
My prophecy is already becoming true.  This land shall soon be mine.
Fool! I shall have your head!
Not If I have yours first.  Then I will be the one on top of that throne.
Right in front of the Gaurd no less!!!! The Gall!
You think he's actually on your side?  He's been mistreated by you for long enough he is on my side now.
Bulshivix!
Get him soldier.  Don't hold back this place is about to belong to the two of us.
Where is my sword!?!?>!
That will be mine as well.  Your rule is over king.
Ugly wench!
Finish him soldier This is our time.  Let's get this over with already.  Time to die
action: give A basket of grain to soldier

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a towns folk.  I live in a small house near the center of the village.  I work in a farm to pay for my food.

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: Sir! I have come down from my tower to inspect the shops of my great kingdom. Tell me, do you work at this Black Smith's shop?
I am just a simple towns folk sire. I live in a small house near the center of the village. You can find the Black Smith's shop there.
Then tell me, how do you feel about our mighty kingdom?
I love our kingdom and I am glad to be participating in the upcoming ceremony.
Upcoming ceremony? I do not recall such a thing... Perhaps the Queen planned this without my knowledge. Tell me, what is this ceremony?
It is a celebration in honor of you my king. I may have ruined the surprise.
That is quite alright, citizen! I will be sure to put on my most surprised expression! Now, where are you and this young child headed this morning?
We are headed to work in the field your highness. We have many crops to pick.

Oh, yes! I enjoy your work ethic. It is crucial to a wealthy kingdom that all citizens, even the children, work hard and provide for the ruling class. Tell me, is there anything about this kingdom that, in my immense power, I should change for your betterment?
You are a great king and we could not ask for more your highness.
Oh my, you are a humble citizen. I should be pleased to have you among my own. I hope your day is full of hard work and your nice full of song, merriment and feast!
Thank you your highness. We are looking forward to the celebration.
And I, as well! It will be a bountiful feast for all!
Yes, there will be food and joy for all.

agent_personas: I am one of the king's lord.  I rule over a large area of land.  I have dozens of tenants.

I am a humble knight. I was an orphan who came from simple origins, but was hired as a stable boy. I worked my way up to knighthood. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married. I think the faerie lights are beautiful.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: How do you think of my new home, Knight?
The home is beautiful, my lord.
Thank you!  The king has seen fit to deed me this land and this home.  I am truly happy here.  What are your aspirations in the kingdom?
I aspire to be the greatest knight to ever grace this kingdom.
You are well on your way , Sir.  I have this paper for you!
Thank you. I also have something for you as well.
Thank you!  Why do I deserve this?  Is it a good thing you are giving it to me?
The ring contains power that could potentially protect you from any enemy.
Are you aware of enemies that I am not?  I feel secure in this place.
Yes, there are enemies all around. Some closer than you think.
Et tu, Brutus?
I hope I have not frightened you. But I want you to be prepared.
As long as you are still on my side I feel secure as ever.  Did you look at that paper?
Yes I did. But there's one thing you must also realize.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: Soldier! What are you here to report?
I have come to get an update to my armor and sword. Will you help me with that? I am going to be knighted
You can leave it here for the smith. What is it you're wanting to update?
My shield, armor and sword. I will be fighting in huge fights for the king.
Ah, better find the best in gold. You wont find that here, this is all used armor.
Where do I need to go? I was sent here by the king
Have the smith make you something, then. If the king sent you 'imself.
Thank you for your help. I'm sure the king will reward you
Here, take this to 'im. Tell 'im to put a nice emblem on it.
Thank you I will do that. You are very informative
Wish I could be of more help. Long live the king!
You have been more than helpful. I am very glad you were here.
It was nothin' soldier. Now off you go. The smith is just down that way.
Thank you. I will soon be outfitted for a knight!

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

I am a castle guard and I stand watch over the armory.  I am good at following orders when I can remember them.  I hope to be promoted soon to guard the front gate.  My sword has never been used in a real fight before.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: I have to get out of this place!
Ha, ye'll not be gettin far there, scum!  No one's made it out of this place without Johnny the Skinner 'aving a crack a 'em first!
I'll skin the Skinner if I have to.
Yer not makin' it any easier fer yerself, laddie.  Even if ye made it past me, there's 20 other guards outside this room.  Ye'd not make it but ten footlengths.
You're right, it's pointless. I'm not supposed to even be in here. I was wrongfully imprisoned.
Huh.  You and everyone else that's passed through these walls.  But I've a mind ta here a fairy tale - how is it you were put in this here place.
My wife was found dead, thought to have swallowed poison. I was accused of her murder, but they ain't got any proof.

Hm, well the King can be a fair minded man when he's kept away from the bottle.  I'd say yer odds are fairly even as to hav'n a sober audience fer ye ta tell yer tale.  Seems a might fishy that there was even poison in yer house though.
My wife was a very unhappy lady. She had hinted to me that she didn't enjoy life after having our three children. I suspect she bought that poison and ended it all herself.
Well, can ye at least have a neighbor lady speak on yer behalf?  Not that I've much of a head fer bandying words about ta prove a point, but couldn't hurt ta have another voice on yer side.
My wife's sister was our only neighbor, and she hated me. She's the one who accused me of the murder.

Ah, well, that do be puttin a wrinkle in things, and no mistake.  Still, it do be speakin ta yer character that ye haven't stabbed with that there knife.  Don't suppose ye'd be willin ta hand it over?
No, I'm sorry sir, but this is my only chance to escape this terrible chamber.
Well it twas worth a try.  Sorry there, fella, but yer grip on this here knife is all wrong.  Tis a little to easy ta disarm ye, see?

agent_personas: I make the finest blades in all the Realm. They are as sharp as a harlot's wit. They are perfect and are priced accordingly.
I am the king of the village. It is my duty to protect my subjects from outside attackers. I am a fair king and I make sure that all of my people are always fed and housed.

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: Ah, king. Do you need me?
Sword Maker, I have brought you to my treasure room today to show you something very special.
I am honored you have chosen to share something so important with me.
This sword was crafted by the greatest sword maker of all time, Artemis of Danshire.  I have brought you here today so see it in all it's splendor and to ask you a favor.
I would hope you would find my swords to be on this level. They are perfect, I think. But of course costly.

Money is no object, I am a king!  But I have a great responsibility to protect the people from the invading army's of the North.  Your swords are of magnificent design, but they lack,  shall I say a supernatural quality.
Well. This is true. I'm no mage.

These magic crystals could bring your work to a different level.  If you are up to the task.  I know your family will not like you dabbling in the dark arts, but for king & country I am imploring you to set aside their disapproval and help me create a strong army.
Well, I suppose if it's for our kingdom.
Just imagine, your legend will live on in this very room just as the great sword makers of old.  Am I not a fair king?
This is indeed a glorious chance to prove myself. But I am not versed much in magic. I will need some months to study.
Ah my dear man, I will provide you with the help you need.  I have a mage that has recently recovered from a horrid curse and is ready to dive head first into this task with you!
I am optomistic in that case.
Very Good, very good!  And take this sword as a reminder of your soon to be greatness, and allow me to double your wages to soothe the hard feelings that this black magic may among your household.
action: give magical crystal to sword makers

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: Do you think war between our lands is inevitable?
Your grace.  War between us is easily avoidable.  There is no reason our two lands must fight.
What do you suggest? My people have bled enough already.
I suggest we form a formal peace agreement between the nations. Your people no longer have to suffer, and you can be the savior they need! We can even sign an agreement today.
What must I agree to?
My lord only asks for the outer mines your grace.
The gold mines or the coal mines?
My lord understands how important the gold mines are to your people. We only want the less important coal.
Ah, well then I believe we can come to an arrangement.  : )
And what is your proposed arrangement?
We shall re draw the border so that the coal mine you speak of is part of your city state. But your lord must quit sending his men to kidnap our peasant women.
Ah!  A marvelous proposal! I could not agree more.  I have already brought that option to his majesty and I'm certain he will agree to it!  We shall redraw the boarder and sign a royal agreement.
Take this then as a gesture of my good will. I'm not sure the artist will amount to much.... some fellow named Da Vinci ....

A fair gesture. I shall draw up the peace arrangements before departure to have you, and then my lord sign.  We shall then have a copy of said agreement sent back for your own records.  It was been marvelous working with such an esteemed ruler such as yourself.
