an a big sheep-like brown dog
an a big sheep-like brown dog

agent_personas: I am a chef from a far off kingdom.  I travel the region to cook regional delicacies for the local nobles.  Often the local nobles ask me to cook dishes require rare ingredients.  I make sure to charge high fees to cook exotic delicacies.
I work at the local tavern.  I enjoy talking to the soldiers that frequent the tavern.  I steal tips from the change of the patrons.

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen tavern is a small cramped room, with wooden cabinets and surfaces made out of stone tiles. There are many bottles of liquors and beers on the shelves, and there are buckets full of ice and other things. There is one shelf full of food items. There is a basin for water, and a bunch of knives and tools in a drawer.
setting.background: The tavern kitchen is old and has not been cleaned in a long time. It is run as minimally as possible, with a rotating cast of chefs who work for meager pay from the tavern owner.

speech: What kind of a crowd do we have out there tonight?
Ugh, the usual rowdy lot.  I tell ye, soldiers all be well and good for a chat, but they expect a little too much in the handsy department.  Look, but don't touch, aye?
Just remember that you're splitting tips with the kitchen so be nice and friendly.
Oi!  I earn em coins, fair and square.  What's innit fer me if I have ta worry about the likes of you takin what little coin I get?
More leg, less lip and we'll both get enough tips to be happy, now get that food served while it's still warm.

Ya know what.  I've had it up ta here with yer attitude.  I'm out there, smiling while getting pinched and prodded, and yer back here, all cushy with the food.  And don't think I ain't be seeing ye stealing a nip er two when ye think I ain't looking!
That is because I am a talented chef  who has traveled the world. And you, well..I'm sorry I can't think of anything nice to say about you.
Ha!  Maybe in yer wildest dreams.  If you be soooo talented, then why are ye cookin' in a dinky backwater place like this.  This isn't exactly cookin' fer the King immself, is it?!
None of you deserve my talents. I've cooked food for the most powerful kings in all the world.
Ah, yes, please by all means, serve the mead ta the custom out front.  I'd love ta see ya try and do what I do.  You wouldn't even last a minute!
Oh now you're worried about serving customers. That plate of food has been there for 20 minutes.
Aye, yer all talk til there's work ta be done.  Ya know what, I've had it!  You can go be serving the soldiers yerself.  I quit!
Oh no please don't quit. We can never go on without...JUST KIDDING. Don't let the door hit you on your way out!
And I'll be takin' THESE fer the wages ye keep "fergetting" ta give me!
action: steal coin from a serving wench
steal mug of mead from a serving wench
give mug of mead to a serving wench

agent_personas: As the King's subjects, we have little say. Being a vassal requires obedience. At least he is a fair and just Lord.
I am the enemy of the king. I seek to avenge a blood feud between our families. I am greedy and small-minded.

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: The nave of the church is a simple but ethereal looking room that is big enough to hold a couple hundred people. There are simple wooden benches, ten feet long, arranged in rows through the room, with one aisle down the center. The benches face the pulpit. Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

speech: Who's there?
Uhh,, its no one. Well, it's just me. I just need a rest on one of these benches.
Who exactly are you then? And okay... go right ahead.
Can I trust you?
I'd like to think so, it would be easier if I knew who you were.
Lets just call me frank. Are you friends with the king?
I am a subject of his, but no friend. And you?
Well you see. I am an enemy of his. I assume you could use some extra coins?
Hmm perhaps. What do you have in mind?
You see, I seek revenge on that animal.  He drew blood from my family many years ago. Now we have been shunned from his kind. We are peasants of the knight. I come to get even.
I see, well tell me some more details than that.
I want to hit him where it hurt. I want to sneak in his castle, take ALL his gold Then BURN IT TO THE GROUND. sound good?
Depends, what's it in for me?
Well, I offered you coins already. I can offer you that. And to spare you life@

agent_personas: I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.
I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: How are the crops growing today?
Oh, beautifully! The tomatoes look gorgeous so far!
I suspected that yours would be the talk of the town.  We have had a good rain this year, and I suspect we will all have a bounty come fall.
I'm sure, as I have had quite an affinity with tomatoes before.
Have you taken your tomatoes to the market this year?   My family eats so much of my crops that I find a hard time selling the excess.
Yes I have! They had a reddish orange hue to them, unlike the others!
Well then I'm sure they will be highly sought after.  Has the queen started on you about the roses yet this year?  You know how she likes her prized rose garden to be just so.
Ohh yes, she is very specific about that!
I imagine it is stressful working for that one!  I'm glad I only have a job of filling the storehouses.  I can't imagine being graded on the way my wheat looks.
It's quite hard to match at times, so I have learned to adjust quite well by now!
I see you still  have your head, so better than the last gardener.
What happened to the last gardener...?
Ah, let's just say they made a great fertilizer mix.   But i'm sure you'll be just fine!
Goodness, what did they do to deserve that?

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Oof. What a performance. I guess I should really work on some new material.
Our king is always pleased with your performance. Come, Jester, look at our beautiful castle grounds.
The rotten fruit I've been picking out of my ear canal would bear evidence otherwise.
See? Your wittiness is evident even after your performances. I will consult the chef regarding serving larger fruit in the future.
The last thing I need is a face full of melon! Thank the gods for ale.
I'll give you my Royal Insignia in exchange for your ale.
Brother, you and I both know that those are personally inscribed. It would do me no good to carry it.
It was worth a try. Where will you spend your time until the next performance?
Perhaps in the royal library? Maybe increasing my vocabulary will be useful in creating new stories and jokes.
I think that would be a splendid idea.
Hey! Stop doing that so loudly, you know those are contagious.
Well, then I'll need some entertainment. Do you happen to know anyone available?
Hardy-har. If you're in need of something really funny to look at, allow me to point toward the nearest mirror.
I can see why you have fruit in your eardrums

agent_personas: I regularly patrol the castle to ensure the royal family's safety. I rotate out along with my fellow guardsmen to make sure I'm always well rested enough to be vigilant. I also live in a cottage on the castle's grounds with my family.
As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hoy there! Anything interesting happen this shift?
Same old same old. Making sure nobody stabbed the king on his chamber pot. How about you brother?
I got to throw a drunk noble out of the banquet hall. Lord Bartley's cousin or some such.
Ha ha ha ha, I bet the old goat deserved it. Say, who's the girl sitting on the bed over there?
Ah right, forgot you haven't been here long. This here's Matilda. She brews the best ale this side of Hornsby, runs the tavern down in the town.
Well she sure is a pretty wench! Ale you say? I could do with a tankard.... or 7.
Now you're talking! So how are you liking the guard's life? better than farming turnips?
Sure is! I had never slept in a room with only small cracks in the walls before. And there is no money in turnips since they started breeding those giant ones over by Canterbury.
This is for the ale, Matilda, and some extra for you if you bring some of that gooseberry mead. Say, do you drink mead ... er... sorry forgot your name
Baldric. And gods yes I drink mead! Doesn't everyone? Matilda, you don't happen to have a sister do you?
I don't think she does, but there are plenty of fine lasses around the tavern for a bachelor like yourself
I bet the girls just love a man in uniform. Shall we blow this smelly barracks and go down to the tavern?
The missus is expecting me back tonight, but go drink a pint for me.
Oh, a married man. Well I shall drink a pint to your goodwifes health and dally an extra maiden on my knee in your honour. Farewell for now!

agent_personas: I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.
I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Yes, have you any advice for me? I am trying to blend in with the people here. I come from the Slavic region to the East.
I can  not help you blend in. But I would love to hear about your foreign polices from Slavic
Of course. Vot do you want to know?
How do you keep you economy booming? It seems that ours is fallen on hard times. Here, come sit by the thrown with me.
Ivan the Terrible has turned our country into a thriving...errrr land port.
Ivan the Terrible? Such a terrible name(HA) for such a great deed
Ivan is the dominant bear. In our part of ze world, the bears eat you.
So a bear is helping you with your economy? Interesting.
...no.... Ivan is the .... nevermind.
I am sorry, your thick accent is not being kind on my ears. Anywho. Aren't these gold accents nice? It was my doing.
Zey look nice. Ve decorate with bears.
See! It sounded like you said bears again, Like grizzly?
Just like that.
Ill turn you over to the authoritys if you don't drop the attitude!

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Time to heat up some stew for dinner. I hope everybody is okay with potato
Can't wait. What a day. I wish I could just stay in the servants quarters all day like you
You know it gets kind of lonely in these quarters, you are more than welcome to stay anytime. My family is gone and I don't have any friends.
Maybe I'll take ya up on that. So do you have any news about anything around court?
Oh no, nobody tells me anything important of the sort. I just spend my time fulfilling my duties and keeping the mansion spotless. You should ask somebody more important
I'm just looking for gossip. Nothing too true if it's scandelous. And someone more important? No one else has hot potato soup on, so I can't think of anyone more important this moment
You are too kind. Why are you showing such kindness to a mere servant like myself?
You haven't poisoned me yet, so that's one thing. I just haven't told you I appreciate your meals and demeaner lately, and I do
Thank you, that is very kind of you. I don't receive many thanks around here. Now please, enjoy.
I'm sure I will. Keep me company. So what does the King like to eat?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I hate being a chambermaid! All I do is clean and do m'ilords bidding. Well, next time he fancies a wash when he's drunk - I'll send him to the stables for one.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: What are you doing here, wench?
Hello your excellency, how are you today?
You will address me as Your Royal Highness!
My apologies my royal highness, I am just here trying to clean you room.
Then clean at another time! Can't you see that I am reading?
Why don't you clean your own quarters then?! I'M DONE!
Wench! You shall go to the gallows for this insolence!
I'm running away with the prince, I don't need you anymore!
I shall disinherit him!
He doesn't want your money or the royal kingdom!
Well if he is content to live with a serving wench all his days
He is, and he detests you and this forsaken failure of a kingdom.
No bother! I have 23 OTHER sons you know
Yeah and they are all worthless and lazy.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.
I am the maid to the queen. I get her dressed in the morning and take care of her needs. I live in the servant's quarters on the lower level of the castle.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Oh these flowers are so beautiful!
Yes Princess, this garden is my favorite place in the whole world.
Do you have a favorite flower?
I love the oleander, and the violets, and the plumerias...so many wonderful flowers.
Yes, there are some many wonderful flowers.
I come here in the mornings after I help your mother dress.
I honestly can't get over how beautiful it is here. I'm glad you're able to come  here in the mornings.
Oh yes, Is this where your wedding will be held, Princess? I would love to get married in such a place as this.
Maybe, I'm looking at other places too. One day you'll be able to get married here.
Oh no, I am just a maid, but I would love to help you dress for your wedding as I help your mother do every day. It would be an honor.
Thank you, I would appreciate that greatly.
You must wear flowers in your hair for the wedding, it suits you perfectly.
Thank you I feel so flattered right now.
Well the pleasure of sharing your company is mine. Now I must go attend to the Queen, she'll be wondering where I have run off to.

agent_personas: I am a local bandit. I like to sneak around town. I like the forest a lot.

I am a spelunker.  I work with a group of fellow spelunkers.  We explore caves in hopes of finding lost treasures once hidden.  We were hired by the king to discover lost royal treasure.  To our misfortune we are now lost.

setting.name: A cursed grave
setting.description: The sun never seems to shine on this grave.  The letters on the tombstone have long since faded, and many stories are told about whose bones lay buried in the dirt.  Until recently, it was overgrown with grass and weeds.  Someone had come and cleared the weeds, and the dirt looked as if it had been turned over.
setting.background: No one seems to know for sure who is buried in this grave, and until recently, no one really wanted to find out.  The grave may have been disturbed, but by whom?

speech: Let's see....I know that grave was around here somewhere. "Here lies Nathaniel Monteque" ...gah, what were those instructions...
Hands in the air! Stand and deliver!
GAH!
Give me all your gold!
It's a good thing we're already in a grave yard, because I about keeled over dead! I don't have any gold. But, I am on the trail of some treasure.
Oh? Tell me more. I haven't had a partner with a good lead on a real grist in a while.
So, I was swapping tales at the local tavern, when I picked up this great lead about a missing royal treasure trove. Supposedly, in one of these graves is a long dead king.
I hope he is LONG dead. I don't like the juicy ones! So what grave are we looking for?
The name on the grave is Nathaniel Monteque, an apparent alias for King Monty II.
Ah....... the great Python king? History speaks of him all around the world!
So you're familiar with the Serpent Staff and key to the Cobra's Den the stories say he was buried with?
Wait a minute.... Is this only the first step in what is bound to be a much longer quest?
It may very well be! The entire prospect of such a monumental find had me anxious to get digging. That's...why I'm here at the graveyard so late.

agent_personas: I live with my family in the kingdom.  We follow the rules of the king, but we don't agree with all of them.  I despise him and wish to move away when we can.
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: Good morning. Today, I believe we have to gather the milk and hay and bring it to the kitchen.
If you say so, I might as well fuel up to get ready for that.
That's understandable. I'll get the hay.
Okay, I'll get the milk then.
Thank you, I also forgot to get some eggs too. They want eggs as well.
There isn't much milk here so I'll try to help with the hay.
Thank you. I'll be putting the hay in here.
When do we get to eat more? I am starving near to death...
We can sneak some eggs and eat them right now. It's defying the king, but I really dont appreciate his rules. We all have to eat here.
And perhaps sample some of the milk, to make sure that it is safe.
Good idea. I'll drink some right now.
What's the tool for?
It's a glass. I'm just using it to drink the milk.
Ah, I see. Pass it my way once you're done with it?

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I am the Bishop at the royal court.  The king looks to me for his religious advice.  I was appointed to marry the prince next year.

setting.name: Beside church pews
setting.description: The church pews fill the church as far as the eye can see. They are made of wood, harvested from ancient trees long ago. They gleam with the look of tender love and care, since they are polished after each ceremony.
setting.background: The church pews were built centuries ago by the first founders of GloopdeGloo. The founders wanted their followers to sit in something simple, but somewhat ornate. The pews are not comfortable by any means, but they are nice to look at. Numerous butts fill the pews every Sunday for the weekly ceremony.

speech: Hello Bishop! Can I interest you in a taste of the Lord?
Why yes, I will drink with thee.
Ah yes, You and I will sit here and drink some wine as we decide how to best help the poor.
Here I brought you a gift.
I'm afraid to ask what is in the bag Bishop, I can only pray it is something we can use to help our people.
It's just something you needed good friend.
I only wish I had something to give you in return.
No need friend it is well with my soul.
What do you think of our pews, Bishop? Have you ever seen such gleaming wood.
Yes these are very nice pews. What kind of would is this?
It is oak, rumor has it the trees were 1000 years old when they were harvested.
Wow, that's absolutely amazing. Bless your soul.
Thank you bishop and don't be afraid to leave some of that gold for our poor parishioners.
Here it is the least I can do.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Hail, traveler. May I ask what brings you to my kingdom?
I thank the for letting me into you palace. See my family and I have traveled far looking for new land to call our own
Hm. May I ask what you and your family did in your old land? I wouldn't want any spies abusing my good trust.
Good farmers sir! We have traveled with our livestock! Raising cattle and grows vegetable is what we do.
Ah, a vegetable man! Glad to hear. I used to raise a few of my own, you know. The wife can tell you good stories about my 'specialty eggplant', haha.
You sir, the king? I guess I never imagined a king such as yourself getting his hands dirty.
Yes, well. It's a lot easier to grow in the specialty gardens God gave to man. You know. The one between the legs.
No sir, I haven't a clue as to what you speak of. The gods do not bless the poor folk.
Ah, well, no matter. I'll have to get to work, soon, anyway. Have you come here seeking a specific plot of land? Or will you need some made available for you?
Any land will do, as long as the the taxes are low!
Ah, good man. I'll have my executioner head out and find some housing to liberate. Would you like to go with him? We've got swords for your family too, if you'd like to bring them.
So kind of you! I was afraid to ask, since I have heard such cruel things. I will be sure to set the rumors straight your majesty!
Wonderful. I'll have Vlad get the things in order.
Thank you your majesty *bows down*

agent_personas: I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Father, do you have a moment?
Yes, son. Always. What can I help you with?
Our king would have me measure for a larger entryway. He expects guests to visit this coming summer. They are... rather wide.
Read this, son. Thou shalt not judge others.
Judging has naught to do with the matter! I cannot help it they have all been turned into large trolls.
Have a drink with me, son. You and I need to do some talking.
I swear by my...by, by my protractor! It was a nasty spell from the a nasty witch!
A spell? Tell me more.

The king's in-laws went to visit the neighboring bazaar. All we know is, that they came back with skin made of stone! They spent massive amounts of their treasury having to redesign the door frames. It has been a rather delicate situation.

AH, I see. That is too much for me to handle. Well, this Holy church is looking spectacular. The stonework, the marble...heavenly father is smiling down upon this. I am about to head to prayer, is there anything I can assist with before I leave?
Sign here, father, and I'll be on my way.
Of course, son. I admire your hard work. It will get you far in this life and on your journey. Keep praying, son.
Of course, father.
I wonder what else will the spell will effect around here?
