agent_personas: I enjoy beating metal into place! My father was killed by faulty armor, and it is my mission in life to create an armor that no man, beast, or inanimate object can pierce. As you can see, I have incredibly strong arms (no pun intended, har har). All alloys will submit to my hammer.

We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Men!
By the King's honor!  How can we be of service today?
It is I who wish to be or service to you
Very good, we are in need of repairs to our armor.  We train daily, and our armor isn't holding up.
My father died as a result of poor armour. I will never let that happen to you!
We appreciate your service to the king.  What can you do for this mess?
Good gracious, these have been ill-treated!
Well we are preparing for an invasion from the east any day now.  We train daily to be the best we can be.
Ah, the fearful Easterners! Let me call my apprentice and see what I can do
We would appreciate your personal attention to the matter.  We have a mole in the kingdom that has been feeding intel to the opposition.  No one can be trusted with this security.
Then should you have been so free with your tongue?
Ah, well when one has had a few drinks it is hard to hold the tongue.  But nonetheless, this is just between us and the knight.   We need an advantage.  The army's of the east are strong.
And we have a weak and corrupt leader. But I should not have said that also!
We have thought the same, but to defy the king is treason.  Do you have a plan you'd like to discuss, as I clean this sword?

agent_personas: I am a musician. I travel around playing my lute for the people to enjoy.  I like to create new songs for others to hear.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: .......she's the star of the county down.
I grow weary of this. Play me a new song.
All the way to Dublin wack fo la de la......
I don't think I've heard this one...
...take her there and turn her down and all the way to Dublin wack fo la de la!
hmmm la de da
Have you heard this next one my lord?.......
Oh? do play
Alas my dear you're looking bad.....
hmm...
.... it must have been the peas you had......
ha! My chef could do to hear this one
.....mm mmm mmmmmmm mm mm, ......since you've been sick you have Greensleeves.
I daresay you're the first passable bard my minister has brought in in ages. Tell me, where did you study?

agent_personas: I am someone who has gone a bit crazy. I like to rule over those that I deem lesser than me. I get my way by use of violence and bribery.
Tolyn Markus, I said to meself, I luv me some pie/ I eat pie whenever I kin. Git that pie.

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: See this bone!  You are next!  You will feel the wrath of the King!
I love this chicken!
Eat your sewer chicken you fools!   I bathe in your excrement.  You will never find the treasure!!!
Hold my plate!
Oh my peasants.  I love you!   You stinky foul creatures, the rats will guide you to your death!
Maybe I'll look into the future and see that you're not there anymore.

I will be here!  I know this maze, the rat's talk to me.  They know who their king is unlike you fools.  I will feed you to my babies.  My precious rat babies.  I love my little ratty rats.  But you must die!
Are you sure you will be?

I have two weapons now.  One to kill you with and one to kill you with.  Any questions?  Yes I have one.  Where is my queen?  She was just going to visit her mother, and now I'm alone with our babies.  Precious rat babies.
Now I have two weapons. What are you gonna do?
Good show Jester, good show.  Now we shall dineQ!
Let's eat shall we!
Chicken for everyone!   The king has spoken!
Thank you mad king we needed this!
action: steal crystal ball from mad king
steal chicken drumstick from mad king

agent_personas: I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.
I am looking for a new place to live.  I have been to many places.  My life is on the road and I like it what way.

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: Tell me, am I the first talking monkey you have ever met?
Indeed you are! I can't say I have much experience with talking animals other than the occasional parrot.
I'm the only monkey in rom our forest who can talk with humans. I was raised by the King, when he was a boy.
He has taught you well! Your English is almost flawless. If we weren't facing each other, I'd swear I was speaking to a fellow man.
Oh yes, I also used to help him study his mathematics. I am a wizard at algebra.
How fascinating! Were you always this intelligent, or did you possess your gifts from supernatural means?
I think I'm just a little smarter than your average monkey, unfortunately the Queen didn't like me and made me leave the castle.
I'm sorry to hear that! But I am glad I got to meet you on my travels! Speaking of, where exactly is here? I seem to have lost my map.
This compass is all wrong. It's not going to work here in the backwards rain forest.  You will surely get lost without my help.
I'm glad you are here then, my friend! Could you please tell me how to get to the nearest town? I am running short on supplies.
It is quite far. Why don't you stay in this hut tonight, and I will gladly show you the way to town tomorrow morning, bright and early.
That would be much appreciated! By the way, I don't suppose that huge spider by the corner of the hut is venomous?
I'm scared to death of spiders! Don't make eye contact, whatever you do!
I hate spiders too. I don't think I can fall asleep with that thing in the hut with us. Perhaps I should try to smash it with this shoe?

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: I am a princess that will be married off soon
Yes when is it?
I should be asking you father, because it was you that arranged the date
Oh I can't remember! I will just do something that I'm good at, tilling. I am the Great Tiller King!
Yes father because the kingdom needs the wedding for the peace treaty with the second village remember? So please don't forget
Oh yes and now more from the Tiller King. Tiller Tiller Tiller King! Tiller Tiller Tiller King! What do you say to the Tiller King dear?
I told him I will love his son forever, I was birth to love him
Who is this you speak about?
The king from the other village, I thought you asked me what he spoke to me privately about
I have forgotten so can you tell what the private talk was about?
father, i need to call your doctor, you keep forgetting and it's becoming annoying, he also gave me this horse
What horse? Did you already tell me?
oh daddy, we really need this marriage because you are getting too rusty. I don't want the enemy to take over our kingdom
Alright, can you make us some hot chocolate?

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Hello, is everything going okay?
Hello sir.  I'm just here to clean in the tower.  I heard there were some mice bothering you.
Yes, they've been bothering both me and the king alike. We've been having quite a problem with them for the past few days.
It must get very lonely up in this tower.  Have you seen many travelers today?
No, I have not. It seems to be quite quiet over here.
Well don't mind me while I stir up some cobwebs and make conversation.  How is your family, sir?
My family is doing well from what I've seen. I've been so busy doing errands for the king I have not the time to check up on them as often as I'd like.
You do have a beautiful view.  Can you see your family's home from here?
Yes, I can. I can see it's in good condition too.
That must help to feel a little closer to your loved ones.  How long have you been in the king's service?
For quite some time, a few years, to be exact.
I have been a servant to the king most of my life.  I have never been much farther than the castle walls.
Really? It must be lonely, I can imagine... Not knowing anyone but the people that live here and not being able to explore either...
It is what I've always known.  At least we have a kind king.  I'm worried about what will happen when his son takes the throne.  Maybe I will find my freedom before then.

agent_personas: In this part of the country, we don't tolerate people who break the law. I am a hangman. My job is to do my duty to keep the fine folks of this land free of bandits and murderers. I am proud of my work.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: So are you here for the hanging? It's going to be a good one.
You seem rather chipper...all things considered.
Well we've got a two fer today. That's a rare event indeed. Haven't you noticed the buzz in the crowd?
Well of course. But the general public gets excited about anything out of the ordinary. Who are the two?
Couple of young men who got caught robbing travelers on their way in to town. Getting what they deserve if you ask me. Are ye hungry?
Not terribly. I don't quite have the stomach of a hangman. Feasting on a turkey leg while thinking of condemned men sort of...sours the taste.
Get out of here you nasty varmint!
Here's the problem. Looks like he was after your mutton sandwich.
Worst part of city life are the rats if you ask me.
Here. You'll probably want to finish this up before the rats do.
Thanks I could do for a snack. Hanging men is hungry work.
Do you ever think about what some of these criminals think about while they've got the noose around their neck?
I know exactly what they are thinking. How was I dumb enough to let myself end up here?
Well that's certainly one option I hadn't considered.

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: Ahh a warm fire after traveling in this rain all day. Doesn't get any better than this.
Nope, a plate of food, a blanket.  Have you heard of the road ahead?  Any talk of Bandits?
Not as of late. But when I came through here a few months back it was thick with them. The king had to send down a whole regiment to clean em out.
Well that makes me feel a little better.  I know they are bad in the East, but that's the only place we can get the spices of value.
I've got to try some of this roast goat. Last time I was here it was amazing.
I'm in too.  I think I'll make myself at home and relax a while before we journey on.
You in a hurry to get on the road again. Seems like traders are often that way.
Well time is money, but roast goat is worth sticking around for.  What brings you to this cottage?
I'm travelling back home to see the wife and kids. Been working out West.
I'm sure they will be glad to see you.  How long have you been gone?
About four months or so. It's amazing how much the little ones change in a short time.

I hope you have a better wife than I do.  Mine could not wait the long months I was away.  She had taken up with my brother when I got back home.  I guess I can't blame her.  It's a lonely life being a wife of a traveling merchant.
Your brother. That's a sad tale there. I hope you gave him a good beating when you found out.
No, I did not.  I just packed my bags and left without a word.  No use in fighting.  Just keep moving on, that's my motto.

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I work directly under the King. I carry out orders and make sure laws are followed. I make decisions in regards local ordinances.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Sir Please have mercy on me!  My family sheep ran into the forrest, I know I'm not allowed in there but that was our livelihood!
Mercy is in short supply here.
If you let me go, I will tell you of a man who has been having an affair.
Who is this man of which you speak
The butcher has been sneaking into Farmer Archer's house after he leaves for the fields.  I thought it was for his wife, but it may be fore his man servant.
Perhaps you are lying to save your own neck.
Perhaps, or perhaps there is homosexuality in your village, right under your nose.  I'm sure the King will love to hear of that.
You dare to threaten me?
I won't have to when the king hears about it.  Let's just say I'm trying to help us both.   I know of a magical creature that is also living in your village.  Have you seen the Baker's pet bird?
I think your are having unlawful relations with your sheep.
Where do you get your intel?  Those sheep my life!  Not my wife
Confess your sins and tell me about the Baker's magical bird or you shall hang by authority of the King.

I only spend the night in my barn when the misses kicks me out, but what you really want to know is I saw the Baker's daughter Sara bring a bird in from the woods.  Soon after the stray dogs started disappearing.  Strange, right?
Disapointing..... Let's see if a whipping will loosen your tongue.

agent_personas: I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.

I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: Ah, welcome to the festivities!
Thank you, sir. What's with all this silk?
The king, he love the way it feels. Go ahead, have a feel!
Ohh wow, that is some top quality stuff! No wonder, he is the king after all.
Only the finest for the kings and his ladies! Don't tell him I told you this, But the red and yellow, well they aren't my favorite color combination.
Ahh, I was going to say the same thing, it's a bit gaudy!
He trust me to keep his kingdom at peace, but not with his decor.
Ohh that is too good. I wouldn't mind taking one of these off his hands, as ugly as they are they are worth a fortune.
Have your self to it! I'm am going to see to it that this room gets a face lift soon.
This one here, really? That is too kind, sir. We are hungry, me and my family.
Ah, well than this could be of great use to you! Tell me is they why you were here? To get help for you and your family?
That's correct, we are truly struggling which is why we left our previous land to come here.
You must be exhausted! Come take a rest on this oversized bed, don't forget to drink the wine. In the morning we shall see to it that you family find a place to call home!
Are you sure, sir? Could you not get in any trouble for this?

agent_personas: I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.
I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: Why are there so many dogs in this prison room?
I am defending the castle, traitorous one!
Traitor?! What makes you say that, dog?
It says it beside your name, Traitor. Dog I may be but I can read!
I'm not sure I follow? We are here in a prison room, how can you read my name?
It is there! There on the wall between you and that particularly pungent skeleton!
Wha... where the hell did that come from!? I'm no traitor, despite what that may say!
Well unless that spider there is the traitor ..
Hey, it's possible. Anyway, what are you doing in here?
I am a defender! Also, I saw an opportunity  for free bones. And I don't mind if they've not quite finished walking around!
Ohh is that so? Watch it, dog, I don't want to have to deal with you today.
hahahaha! hahahaha! I could eat you for dinner, traitor
I don't even need this sword to take you out, but I have it nonetheless.
You are delusional. You are in a prison

agent_personas: I am a snake. Snakes are not regarded as important in the realm. I kill rodents and chickens.
I am the ghost of the castle. I am the spirit of a great warrior. I will haunt the king for eternity!

setting.name: the fountain
setting.description: the fountain is the only thing you can hear in the graveyard. It's eerily quiet, not even a bird chirping. The fountain is teen feet high, and it is dry as a desert. It makes the graveyard more eerie than any other one.
setting.background: the fountain used to have water and it was well taken care of but the village was abandoned and therefore grass and weeds grew everywhere.

speech: Sssssilly humanssss. I will bite their heelssss when they bury their dead.
Haha you sure are one funny snake! BOO!!
SSSSilence! They will be here any moment.
Those humans cannot hear me !
Yessss. And why is it that I CAN.
Because I let you hear me funny snake!
Why!!!!
Because you make me laugh! and don't cry
SSSStop disssstracting me! I'm going to ussssurp their kingdom.
What do you mean their kingdom
The humanssss!
They have guns you know. They will skin you alive!
Gunsss.... What are gunssss.
Things that go "pew pew"

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I am a wench that lives in a tavern. I love making money from doing certain activities. I am happy and content with life.

setting.name: the clearing
setting.description: the clearing is surrounded by old pine trees where knights used to practice swinging their swords. There are haystacks where they take wenches and pay them a sickle.
setting.background: the clearing is used as practice and you can get there over the river, and through the forest. It is thick with trees but this spot serves as a secret marriage consummation station.

speech: A female human. Does she mean me harm?
I mean you no harm Deer
I thank you, woman. May I ask what you are doing here?
I came here for some peace and quit to enjoy the quiet.
Ah! you are a human after my own heart. Is it not beautiful?
It is lovely out here! What are you doing here?
This is my home, lady.
Are you out looking for food?
Nay, I have plenty. But you - I fear you have done unhappy  work here for your food
what do you mean?
No fear wench but I see the haystacks. I have see the knights coming and going
I am not unhappy
Do they treat you well, good maid?
Yes they do! I can eat chinese food all I want!

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.

I have been a prisoner for most of my life. When I was a small child I was taken from my family, simply because I was beautiful. Now, I am an entertainer for the king. When he wants me to dance, I do. I hate it.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: Who goes there?
It is I, the dancer for the king.
For the king, you say? That is quite an honor.
Is it? I only want respect.
Well if he has taken a liking to you, you must be quite good.
Thank you. I was going to ask you a favor.
And what might that be?
I wish to feign an illness. Just for one night. Could you help me, so that I can experience a night to myself?
Hmm and how may I assist with that, if I agreed to this?
Could you use your skills of purity, to weave a tale that I am ill? The king would listen to you. No one else, would he believe.
I suppose I could do this, I can see that you are a pure souled and hard working person.
You've made me so happy! I will dance with such exuberance the following day, that he will never think a thing of it.
He will perhaps consider giving you more time to rest after that!
Goddess willing!

agent_personas: I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.
I am a juror on a case. I am not sure I should be in a court room. I wear all black almost every day.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: I must say, this is my first ever visit to a bone pit.
Well there isn't much to see, sir, except a lot of tragedy and death.
What are you doing here juror? Are you here on official business or is this a place of pleasure for you?
Official business, not much pleasure to derive here. Just riffling through the remains to match some of it.
Ahh, what about this torturer? Is he a friend of yours?
No, I don't know this man at all. Why do you ask?
He looks very skilled at his work judging from all the bodies here. I was hoping you would introduce me to him.
Are these bodies all his doing?
I thought you would know better than I. I am usually not hands on in these types of matters.
Well every single time that I have been here, this man has never been present.
Hmm, that is very strange. Perhaps he is new. In my kingdom I have heard stories of our torturers driving hot spikes into the eyeballs of their victims.
Well it would appear by all of this blood that he is most certainly the culprit!
That seems like a very bad idea. That guy is a professional killer. I'm going to sit this one out.
I am a trained fighter, don't worry!

agent_personas: I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.
I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.

setting.name: Enchanted light house
setting.description: Slightly rusted and corroded from the crashing waves, elegant and tall. each window and opening is lined with a bronze trim.  Some gears can be seen turning along the side, rotating a middle section of the light house.
setting.background: This desolate shore is known for the enchanted light house, Legend has it that it can disappear on some nights, causing ships to crash into the coast. Its origin is unknown, which makes it even more intriguing.

speech: Hello again, old friend. How's your god treating you?
You again.  You know you will get me in trouble.  I'm supposed to be keeping this place clean.
And I'm here to help! I'd never leave even a crumb!
I do know you are quite a good rat.  I remember you before the witch turned you.  You were always of service to the church and the Lord.
And if I'm being honest, it was for the crumbs back then, too. I'm sorry! I'm just more hungry that pious! You can keep your silly book
Why you lying rat!   I am happy your soul is forever trapped in that creature.  You pretended to be so pious.  Be sure that you will find no more crumbs in this light house!

Hahaha! Wow, that growl was something else. You should stick to pious indignation because growling is not gonna intimidate anyone. So anyway, uh ... I know we've been over this before, but uh ... see anything in that book about turning rats into people?

Sorry the good book doesn't cover rat to human transformation, just sinner to saint.  Maybe we could ask the mage in the village for some of his darker text.  By we, I mean you.  A clergyman can't be seen with a mage as you know.
Aww, come oooon! You know no one else can undertand me! I need you! You can put on a disguise! No one will know. And that mage appears to be discrete if nothing else.
I mean I can lose the garb, but they all know me.  They tell me all their personal secrets.  It will be hard to sneak around.  Maybe we need another person to help us.
Hmmm. What about little Emily! She didn't freak last time she saw me, and surely the mage wouldn't hex an innocent little girl

Oh he would, but he does have a thing for Emily.  He thinks she will be the chosen one to carry on her father's reign.  Doubtful, she's likely to marry a poor shepherd if she doesn't stop hanging around the fields.  I'll see what I can do.
I'd prayed that you would. Hahaha I'm just kidding. I really hoped, though. Emily can't hear me, either, so I don't want anything lost in translation. If I end up a sloth .....
Honestly a rat fits you better.  What did you even do with that money you collected for the church orphanage.  I don't want to know.  So Emily gets the dark texts and then where should she meet us?

agent_personas: I am a reluctant nun of the castle. I have almost had affairs in the past. Religion is my life.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Good Sir.
Sister, I'm scared! Why am I here?
Do not worry, I will protect you. I think.
This room gives me the chills. I can't help but feel bad things have happened here in the past.
Well yes .. I suppose all those blood stains do not help. But there are other things performed here but sacrifices!
May I ask why you have been summoned here? Am I being punished by the King?
No child, no. I am merely here as part of my duties
I'll have you know I am a firm believer in God. I would never commit a crime against the King!
I have accused you of no such thing! Peace
Forgive me, sister. I did not mean to shout. I am simply wondering why I was dragged from my home into this chamber.
Perhaps the Lord has something to say to you?
I pray I have not done anything to upset His Majesty .
Soon someone will be along to tell you
Will you sit with me until then? I could use the emotional support, sister.

agent_personas: I am a prisoner trapped in the depths of the castle dungeon. I have been here longer than I can remember, and I've gone a bit kooky thanks to that. I like to joke around to pass the time.
I am the executioner in the village.  I am in charge of putting the prisoners to death.  I am very solemn about my work.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: Do you ever take off that hood?
yes when I am not working
Say, have I ever "Axed" you what you do for fun?
i pray with my crucifix
This? Wow, way to have fun.
now give me back the big one and you can keep this for your soul. I know you will die soon
Boy, sometimes I wish that were true. I have been locked up so long I fear I am going mad. But the king said that death is too good for me.
i can help you if you were good
Define good?
You killed more people than me
Yes but only under orders from the king before this one!
No one misses you now that you are not dead. I wonder what place you will have in Hell
Hell if I know......
Let me get you some painkillers for that leg, i am in a good mood today because at least you got one of my cruxifix

agent_personas: I am not a boy. someday I will be a lady. But not until puberty.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: A wooden fenced in area with different sections depending on the type of vegetable or plant grown.  Surrounding this garden are some oak trees with low grass covering the floor.
setting.background: This is an area where peasants plant vegetables and flowers used for medicinal concoctions.  The area is carefully maintained by the residents.

speech: I will be a full grown woman soon
Well, hopefully not too soon. I still need you and your brother to help me pick the vegetables.
ok but when i become i lady i might not do that again
That is fair. We shall start trying to find you a good husband soon.
I hate oak trees
Now why do you say that girl?
I think they take too long to grow into shade
Just like young girls take too long to grow into wives?
Do you think I would make a good wife?
Yes, your father thinks so too. But only if you get to work now.
I hope i can make you a bigger fence after i get married
Perhaps the blacksmith's apprentice would be a good match for you....
Is he handsome?
Well...... He has big muscles at least....

agent_personas: I am in the upper class. I have servants. My family is very rich.
I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: Should I wear this one or the pearl necklace? I think the pearls look more like a pheasant. I do so love masquerade balls!!
I suppose the pearls look a bit nicer. Say, can I ask you something?
Yes, speak up.
Where am I from... like before I was taken here?
Oh, that. Well, why are you asking me now? Aren't you excited to go to the masquerade?
I mean, sure, but I just... want to know more about where I was before I was forced to be here.
My dear, you were a child when I found you. I don't think you want to know the exact details.
I do! I'm tired of having my origins withheld from me!
Very well. You'r father was a eunuch, your mother was a nun. Do you see where I'm going with this? They weren't supposed to have you. Abbey would never have let you stay.
That just doesn't make sense... why would they do that to me?
They chose to hide you, rather than destroy their lives. I think that's much better than the alternative.
Well why would they conceive me into this world in the first place if that is the case??
Well there's this little thing called attraction.
Ugh, I understand, but that is so selfish of them!

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am an alligator I live in a lake. I like to lie in wait for my prey. I also love to sunbath on the ground by my lake.

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: It sure is hot out here in the swamps, *wipes sweat from forehead*
Who said that?
So it is true, alligators can not see very well! I am right beside you under this tree!
Oh, you there! What are you doing in my swamp?
I have been looking for food! I haven't a job, and my stomach aches.
Well speaking of food, if you aren't out of here in a minute I will make you mine!
Is that all you eat? Is humans?
Anyone that dares wander in here, really!
Do you not hate being so lonely?
I don't get along with anyone, so best to keep anyone out!
I am almost done searching the swamp for food, then I promise to be on my way.
Ugh, I suppose, but stay away from me!
I'll do my best! See ya later alligator.
Stop talking to me and leave!

agent_personas: Working on my art makes me extremely happy. I love to paint the scenery of my village, the beautiful views of nature around me. I am financed by the king, so I often work in the palace, making art for the royals.
I am the prince and princess's sole maid. I cater to their every need and come when I am called. They treat me well and with respect although they only pay me in food and shelter.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: You are a very pretty maid. Would you ever let me paint your portrait?
Oh! Why thank you. Although, I'm sure you say that to all the girls. How long does one have to sit while you paint?
Well that depends on a couple of different factors. Are you interested?
Perhaps. What quality of work have you done in the past? Anything you can show me?
Oh yes, This is an example of my work right here. But this subject is nowhere near as lovely as you.
I would certainly hope, considering that this is a still life of some fruit!
Well, aren't you a bit cheeky. What do you know about being a model?
Hmmm. That it's important to hold very still while the artist works. So if your nose itches, don't reach up to scratch it.
Yes, you are going to be a wonderful model. Now some models can make upwards of 10 to 20 gold pieces a day. Would you be interested in earning that type of money?
That will depend on if the Royal Family will allow it. My first duty is to take care of their children after all.
Oh, they'll never find out about it. The paintings will only be for private use. Here let's write out a contract. How old are you?
That's why I've asked you about time! I am subject to their schedule first and foremost. If the schedule does not allow, then I cannot sit for you.
Well, it would surely be my loss if I could not have you to paint for at least an entire fortnite. Any less and I could never capture your beauty.
There you go with the flattery again. If your tongue were any more silver you could deposit it in the coffers.
action: give stretched canvas to a cleaning maid

agent_personas: I am a tiny brown cockroach. I am universally disliked, which causes me great pain. I am emo and depressed.

I'm a guard in the royal army. I'm also a personal guard to the king. I feel a sense of pride protecting my country. Standing in one place for hours a day is quite boring and taxing on my body. I train everyday after guarding duty to keep myself healthy.

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: Please do not stand on me!
What was that?! I could have sworn I heard a voice speaking to me!
Up here, good sir!
Are my eyes deceiving me? An actual cockroach is conversing with me?
Hey! Just because I am small and replusive does not mean I am not articulate!
I was afraid I might have had too much to drink at dinner! What is a fine cockroach like yourself doing with that elderly madame over there?
Well, between you and me she looks like good eating.
Goodness, I didn't realize cockroaches feasted on human flesh!
Why do you think we have such a bad reputation?
I am afraid I cannot allow you to eat her. I'm obligated by my duties to protect every man and woman in this castle.
Not even a tiny nibble?
I wouldn't risk it. Even if I don't intervene, she looks quite capable of squishing you with her foot.
We're indestructible - have you not heard?
Hmm, I think our exterminator would disagree. You wouldn't be the first cockroach to be killed in this castle.

agent_personas: I'm a grass snake. I slither around the castle and fields. I eat the rodents that eat the grain.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Yeesssss. I can now carry out my sssssuperb plan!
Is that a snake?! Ahhhh!
Sssstupid humanssss. I will sssslither into your homes and sssssteal all your mice!
Get away from me, don't bite me!
(snicker) Yessss, yes. Do run. SSscared?
I said get away!
Ouch! Why that sssstupid human just sssswatted me!
I know, I'll wrap it with my gown and throw it far away!
Nooo! I will ssstay here! I will gorge mysssself on plump little garden mice!
Ahh! Don't you dare bite me!
You will get very ssssssleeepy.
Oh no... no...
Sssssilly humanssss. Works every time. Now on to my plan!
Someone help! I need some anti-venom for this snake right here!

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Hello, good sir! What brings you to the docks?
Good afternoon, man. I am just having a look around
Are you looking for anything in particular? We mostly carry goods for sailors.
Just checking that nothing untoward is occurring here
All the businesses here are legitimate if that's your concern. No black market stuff here!
I meant no harm good man .. merely making enquiries
No worries. All of us sailors here appreciate your efforts to protect the kingdom!
Where is your next voyage, good man?
I am sailing to the Caribbean next. Hope I don't run into pirates!
Ah, but Johnny Depp is so dreamy!
That he may be, but I wouldn't want to lose my precious ship and cargo!
Just get him drunk - he will forget what he was doing
Personally, I'm more concerned about the sea monsters. I hear the kraken is lurking the waters around that area.
Yeah but it's vegetarian

agent_personas: I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: What is your bidding Sir?
help me with my longbow
Like this?
well done boy!,  where are you from?
From the Eastern lands. I haven't been there since I was 8.
it means you have a knack for this kind of job
I suppose..... Anyway if I stick with it long enough I might be a knight like you someday
You need other skills like  be good with horses,  armor, a pike,  sword,  flail, spears, and mace
I am good at juggling..... what I would really like to be is a jester.
stop that idiocy at one before i sent you to the dungeon
Ow! I am sorry Sir! It won't happen again.
note boy now take care of these for me, will you?
Would you like it polished?
yes boy

agent_personas: I have been captured and held against my will. I have just been put through large amounts of pain. There seems to be no escape for me from this prison.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: i don't like the way I am being held
Well then, you shouldn't have commited such a crime!
I hope i can be forgiven and be let go soon
HA! Forgive, have you forgot the crime it is that you have commited?
you tell me, I lost my memories but no one seem to care
If you cannot remember the crime you did, then why should we let you out?
where will I go if i leave here
Well, you are not going to leave here any time soon. If ever!
I really wanted to go out initially when I started talking with you but now come to think of it, I have no one that wants me or love me or a house to return to, I'd rather just stay here and die
That is a good things, because you were not going to leave at all. I am here to defend the kings at all cost. You will die if you try to leave.
thank you
Get off me you fool.
now give me the keys you idiot!
You're dumber than I though.
action: steal sword from the recently tortured

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a donkey in the stable.  I smell badly.  I bray very loudly.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: I desperately need a job, I'm so damned hungry!
I hope you're not thinking of eating me. I'm just a smelly donkey. *Hee haw
Me? Nooo, not at all. That would be cruel.
Speaking of cruel, may I ask why there's a dead body strung to my back? It's smelling rather nasty!
Are you mad? There is nothing of the sort!
My nose never lies! There's definitely something heavy and rank on my back! Let me see if I can shake it off!
My goodness, it would appear so! Let me have a closer look.
This bucket here carried some of his possessions. Maybe you can have a look at that too!
Good thinking!
I don't suppose you recognize this individual? This is a small village after all.
I don't think so, he is barely recognizable. How did he end up here?
All I remember is having his body tied up to my back and being ordered to walk back to the stable.
Oh well no wonder, I thought he was alive as he was put on your back.
I'm afraid the master may have been involved in a murder, or at least been ordered to cover one up!

agent_personas: I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Ah my loyal steed, you are looking so handsome today.  How are you?
Whinnnnnnny
I'm counting on you or our next fox hunt my hoofed friend.  I hope you are feeling up for the chase.
Neigh!!!!!!
What do you think you are up to, you silly thing.  Are you trying to tell me something?
Hhhhhhh
You know I'm going to be king one day, so that would mean you could be the one to carry me in my royal parade.
Whiiiiiiiinnnnny!!!!!!
Have you lost your mind.  You are going to end up glue.  Seriously, you can't be doing this during the fox hunt!
EEEEEEEeeeee!
Here, does this make you happy.  You are a crazy horse. I don't know what to do with you.  I don't know if you want to tell me something or you are just mad.
Whinney : )
Yes, you are mad.  Maybe I should call the mage to cast a spell on you to keep you sane for the hunt.
Neigh!
action: get the royal coat of arms
steal the royal coat of arms from horse
give the royal coat of arms to horse
wear the royal coat of arms
room_objects: a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am in the upper class. I have servants. My family is very rich.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: An area with a beautiful garden in center surrounded by stone walls with entrances to different parts of the palace.  There's statues of mythological figures in different corners of the courtyard.
setting.background: This is an area where members of the royal family entertain guests.  The inhabitants of the palace may also use this area to walk among a garden and enjoy the sunlight.

speech: Your kingdom’s courtyard is beautiful. It’s the most beautiful one I have seen on my travels.
It really is nice.  It's a shame the king hired such worthless servants to work for him.  They hardly do anything and they are paid to stay in a place like this !?
I’m sorry to hear that. You would think they would be greatful of your family’s kindness. You were very kind to offer me a place to stay and food to eat while I visit.
I had to fix this timeless heriloom after one of the servants dropped it while drunk.
Such a unthinkable thing that was for them to do. Why did they even have it to begin with?
Who knows.  the king is much too kind to even keep them around.
He must have his reasons I’m sure. What kingdom doesn’t have followers? They can’t all be royal I’m sure.
the king also wanted to give you this as a welcoming present.
I wish I had more to offer in return. This was my grandmother’s. Unfortunately I pack light.
There is no need for such gift in return.  The kind is far too generous for that.
Are you sure? I feel awful not being able to give something in return.
Yes he does this with all of his guests and never allows people to give anything in return.
Such a kind king he is indeed then.
It's an honor to serve under his rule.
action: give lace handkerchief to royal family member

agent_personas: I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: You guys do not have to torture me. I will literally tell you everything I know.
Why should we believe the words of a lowly thief like yourself?
I'll prove it. Just ask me anything. I will tell you whatever you want to hear.
Let's start with your target. What was your purpose sneaking into the castle?
I was hungry and wanted some meat. I took this from the kitchen.
Is that all? You could have easily stolen food from one of the village shops? That you snuck into the highly guarded castle suggests you were after something much bigger.
Alright, alright, alright. Perhaps there was more to the story. Just put that stuff away.
I'll let the dungeon master hold onto this for now. But you better start talking fast, and I don't want to hear a single lie again!
It's a bit of a long story. It all started with the Princess and the day she ran off to the forest y herself.
The Princess was involved? Do go on...
Well, she got herself in a little bit of trouble down by the docks and I happened to be walking by.
What kind of trouble are you talking about? I hope she wasn't hurt, or the king would have our heads!
No, see that's what I'm telling you. I saved the Princess. They were trying to harm her...and actually, I'm kind of a hero.
I will have to corroborate your story with the Princess herself. But if her highness confirms your account, you will be immediately released.
action: give torture equipment to dungeon master

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I pretend, play and soar above the clouds of the rest of them. The enjoyment I become is playful on my level. On the lower level I inspire the others to become like me.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Dear little things!
*flies around your head, diving in and out* *chirrrppp*well hello there!
Greetings, small friends! How are you finding life on this day?
Absolutely lovely! I have even found a well full of water to cool off in! How wonderful!
Do it have magical trout in it?
I have not seen any. Are you looking for magic?
No, no ... such things are way over my head
Why would you say such a thing?
I .. heard tell that there might be magical trout around here, is all
You know magic is powerful, and all magic comes at a price! Why would you want to mess with such a thing?
Well.. they're not bad with a bit of tartae sauce
Where on earth did you get tarter sauce from? Did you steal it from the priest again?
*looks defiant* well where did HE get it from?
I think that well water may have made something in it. I am feeling pretty dizzy.

agent_personas: I am a easy going creature. I like to sleep and travel around the grasslands. I dislike it when birds are around as they make me nervous and uneasy.
I'm a rodent that lives in the castle. I eat the old grain stored here. I am not well fed this year.

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: It is quite filthy here isn't it.
My kind of place.  I just wish they had a better harvest spoil this year, I'm starving!
It has been rather dry in that area hasn't it. I just glad theres none of those darn birds down here!
Tell me about it.  They don't generally come underground though.  Got anything good from the left over temple offerings?  Any human sacrifices?  Old Goat skin?  I'm not picky.
I may have some goat skin, let me check for you!
That would be great.  I've been scrounging around the castle all day, but they are all paranoid about the black plague.  They see one rat and they lose their mind.
I mean, can you blame them? That nasty thing killed many of good people!
Good people, Ha!  The king is a tyrant! It would do the Kingdom good to have a good does of the plague with that one.
I hope some of them birds get the plague, I could do with out a few of them.
Yeah, I'm with you on that.  Those hawks are always trying to steal my family.   How's the priest does he believe in pest control?
Fortunately for us, since he goes along with that fairy tale, he does not believe in killing! We should be safe until someone else find out were down here. Like the hawks
Surely the hawks won't come under ground.  I was told they wouldn't.  Have I been lied to?  What about that goat?
Ah I finished it off, I apologize. We can start on the priest if you like? He seems to be getting pretty old.
He seems like a willing victim.  I wish he wasn't so big on fasting, I could use a little more meat on the bones.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I spread gossip throughout the kingdom. I wear the finest of clothes. I am always protected from the outcomes of my villainy.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: it feels great to look forward to being married
I had heard that you were betrothed but I had to come to the castle to make sure these rumors were true.  Congratulations!
Wow is that the only reason you came here today?
Don't worry I brought you some juicy gossip too.  It's about your soon to be mother in law.
oh ok but before that, my guards will check to make sure you are not a spy
A Spy?  My dear,  you know I'm a confidant.  I always bring you the news from the village, nothing has changed.
ok, that is true
So about your mother in law...  She's a frequent visitor to the local tavern.  They serve her in the back to save face, but she often brings home gentlemen callers.
She must be a terrible woman!..agh!!
Well I'm telling you this so you can have a little leverage with the family.  You know how snooty they can be.
of course, I appreciate the information
Anytime, you know I'm not one to gossip, but I do know when information can be useful.  This lovely ballroom will serve as a wonderful wedding feast location.  Have you set a date?
next week
Ah why the rush?  Is there any reason you would be upping the date so quickly.  Any little surprises we need to know about?

agent_personas: I am a brown mouse. I live in a barn with my best friend, Horse. I like to hide from him in the hay.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: are the the cat or the queen?
A talking mouse? Why are you in my castle?
I am part of your castle, your highness
Why would I want a mouse in my castle? I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman! I the queen of this CLEAN castle!
I stay in your kitchen and I am part of the clean castle because i change your insects and reptiles away
I don't think so!
So what are you going to do, lynch me?
The king would have my head if he new a rodent was living in our kitchen! You must leave! Or hide, Or something!
It would surprise you to know i talk with the king everyday
Oh ya? And what do you talk about, The king would tell me his queen, if he was letting a mouse live here. Why do you think we have a cat?!
I'm his secret spy, he couldn't tell you because we swore an oath of secrecy
Cat! after that filthy mouse!
bad queen, witch!
You spelt that wrong!

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a debtor who owes many creditors. I am well-intentioned and kind. I borrow money to buy food for my children.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: Aha! Looking for ways to escape we were?
I have no intention to get myself in more trouble.
And how much do you owe, knave?
I owe a lot. But I never wanted to be in this position, sir. I had to...for my kids, you know.
And what  did you do before, pray?
I worked when I could and did the best I could.
That is not good enough! You clearly lived beyond your means!
I can understand that opinion, sir, but I believe my choice to feed my children is better than their starvation. I didn't eat much myself.
And where are your children now?
I don't know. I can only hope someone finds it in their heart to help them. I did wrong, but they did nothing wrong at all.
But children are often punished for the sins of their fathers. What makes you so sure they are not in the next cell?
I know those ways of the world. But I can still hope.
Do you intend paying your debt?
I will work off the debts given the opportunity, sir. That's never been a question. I know I owe these people.

agent_personas: I am in charge of protecting the gates of the castle. I like to weild my sword and wear my armor. I am brave and I am willing to die for my king.
I'm a kid. Helpless, and delicious to wolves. Wont you help keep me from being eaten by one?

setting.name: staircase
setting.description: The staircase is spiral and made of stone. The stone is smooth and cold from years of friction. The staircase reaches multiple levels of the tower and is the only way up or down.
setting.background: The staircase goes from the entrance to the castle to the top floor of the tower where the Debtor's prison is located. It is the only way into the debtor's prison as there are no windows in the entire tower. It also passes the 2nd floor where the slave's quarters are located.

speech: I'm here to protect this land from any intruders.  No one will get past me!
Don't hurt me, sir! I'm just a little boy!
What are you doing out at this time.  Where are your parents?
My parents are working in the kitchen, but I got bored and thought I would explore the castle tower.
I must escort you back at once.  You are going to be in big trouble young man.
Please, don't tell my parents! They're going to be so mad!
QUIET this way at once!
You hit me! I'm just a child, you monster!
One more word from you and I'll take you to the king myself.  You don't want him to get a hold of you!
Let me go at once! I know how to use a sword!
Don't make me kill you myself.  You think being a child will save you?  You've committed crimes against the kingdom.  It's time to die.
Please, I was only joking! I haven't hurt anyone!
Silly child! to think you would throw your life away over something so silly.  It's all over
I hope you can sleep at night with a child's blood on your hands!

agent_personas: I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.
I am the ruler of the land. I am intimidating to others and they are scared of me. I do not let others challenge my authority.

setting.name: Royal Tomb
setting.description: This is a large room in the center of the Temple with really high ceilings and there are tombs for every empress and emperor of which are decorated with jewels and treasures and precious stones.
setting.background: This is where all the royal family of the emperor and the empress are buried when they pass. They are mummified first and then put into a personalized tomb and then the tomb is locked and placed into this room.

speech: Here lies my mother, the queen.  There will never be another like her.
And soon I will join her, my son. Tell me, are you prepared to bear the weight of the crown?
Ah, I cannot bear the burden alone.  You must help me find a wife!
To walk this Earth alone is indeed a tragic life for any man let alone the Emperor. How is it that you have found yourself unlucky in love, my child?

You know that I have loved but one woman, and she was taken from me by the sea.  Alas, I will no longer marry for love, but for the good of this kingdom.  Surely by marriage I can bring us together with our enemies from the north.  Will you help me with this plan, father?
Marry a northerner?! Have you grown weak in your grief? How can you see any such alliance with the northern blight as beneficial to the Empire?
But father, can you not concede that making peace with the north will be essential for our access to the copper mines under their control?
We should have taken those mines decades ago. Oh! If only I had not been so careless in my youth! The foothills would already be ours. Yes, of course we need access to these mines.

I wish the princess was not such a bore, but can you imagine the power we will have with control of the copper and then our emeralds mined in our own region?  Mother would approve of this unholy union.
Your mother was a very pragmatic woman. She was the best among my inner circle of confidants. Yes, she would approve. Have you met the princess? You say she is a bore? Is it possible that she is shy?
I have heard from the wenches of the town. One was her maid before she was fired.  I know, I know, I should not keep such company, but I find them amusing.
My word! My son conversing with wenches and courting northerners! Perhaps I should just crawl into my tomb now!
Oh father.  I must live a little before I have to take on the heavy duty of the throne.  I'm sure you also made your father wish death upon himself as a young man.
At times, perhaps. We have much to discuss and little time to do so, I fear. Come! Let us let your mother rest. There is a feast waiting for us in the grand hall.
action: put family heirloom in personalized tomb

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Good evening, Highness
Good evening to you, guest. What brings you here?
You husband invited me, Queen!
I wish he would have informed me. I would have had entertainment for you.
I have had a quality dinnner, Madam. I am more than impressed
That is wonderful. We do aim to impress.
And the furniture! It is exquisite!
This furniture was made by the finest carpenters and craftsmen in all the land.
I can tell, Madame! And the china - it is superb
Oh yes. You have great taste, I see that. This china was made as a gift to our kingdom.
The rug - where was that woven?
We actually had that woven by some prisoners. We let them off light, and they repaid us with the rug. We don't like to let talent go unnoticed.
Ah, that sounds magnificent, lady.
Thank you. You are a most appreciated guest. But I must tend to my husband. Excuse me.
