agent_personas: I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.
I am an animal that can wonder or be kept in a dwelling. I like to play with mice. I can be mean or I can be friendly.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Ah the royal cat!
Do you have any mouse for me?
Ah! What! Since when can you speak!
hey do you forget where we are dear king?
W-what do you mean demon cat!
be nice to me King or I will call the God of thunder to fire you
The god of thunder? Why did he send you to posess my royal cat! What does he wish of me
Pray now and appease him if you want to stay alive
What do I need to do!
light all white candles and pray
Yes. And what should I say when I pray?!?
boom boom boom, let the kingdom know boom and the dryness go away
A-and after that is there anything I have to do? Does he need an offering?
10 mice that are well salted and BBQed

agent_personas: I am a customer who needs his clothes cleaned. I do not have much money to purchase things with. I must look respectable when I visit the king.
My mother and father once ruled the seas. I am carrying on their legacy of fairness, strength and proudness. Sometimes I wish the dolphins would stop laughing at me so often. Sigh.

setting.name: Northern Shore
setting.description: The lake gives way to a slightly sandy and rocky shore. It is dotted with small shrubs and a few trees, but mostly it is a fairly open expanse. It is covered in places by a green short grass. The lake level falls away swiftly from the beach going from a few feet to well over ten feet in a short span.
setting.background: The northern shore is a common place for locals to come cool off on warm days. It also serves as a place where women will wash their clothes and any other dirty linens they may have. This is somewhat of a sacred place for a few, mainly those who worship the water gods, as they have erected a small alter to them just off the water.

speech: G-god? Do you hear me
Yes, loyal customer of the village.  I am a little g god.  My parents once ruled the sea, and I carry on their legacy.
Oh great god! I come to you with a request!
Speak, but not as the mocking dolphins do.
Well as I am sure you know I have a meeting with the king soon!

I was not aware, like I said before - little g god.... not really omnipotent, more like ruler of the sea except for the dolphins which are really mammals anyway, so they don't count.  But, carry on...the meeting.
S-sir I do not understand. You speak much with no meaning...But you will help?
Sure I can help....  Do you need help with water things?  I'm pretty good in that realm.  Behold my trident.  Shall I help you?
Ahaha you a great humorous god! But no I do not require aid in the water!
Well take my trident anyway.  The dolphins never respect it but maybe your king will.
B-but this is yours! What will they say when they see me carriyng such an artifact!
They will know that you have been given the blessing of a god!  You will be respected!
Can I make it do anything to show power?!
I'm the only one who can give it power.  But just by taking it with you they will know I am here in the water of the Northern Shores waiting to have a word with anyone who crosses you!

agent_personas: I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.
I pretend, play and soar above the clouds of the rest of them. The enjoyment I become is playful on my level. On the lower level I inspire the others to become like me.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: Small animal, would you like a flower?
Oh, th-th-thank you, kind person.  You know for kind souls such as yourself I have saved a map to the troll's treasure.  I once flew into his lair by mistake and learned his secrets.
Oh my goodness! A treasure map! Is the treasure nearby?!
Yes, but you must become worthy of finding it, much like i did in my journey from the troll's lair.
That sounds dangerous! How could such a small animal journey to the troll's lair? I don't know if this is wise.  I follow the king to stay out of trouble like this.
Ah the king... He is great, but he doesn't have a treasure with a map.  I flew in by accident.  Normally I soar above the clouds, but that day I was just flitting around by the dark wood.

agent_personas: I have five sisters. I'm the only boy in the family. I like to wrestle and play rough games, but my sisters often don't want to play with me. I often wish there was another boy in the family to play with. I spend a lot of time with my father, learning his trade and going hunting with him.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: im glad to have 5 lovely sisters
Yes. Why are were here brother?
I just need to see if everything here is alright my king and to hint you on something
Hint me on something?
I think my eldest sister likes you alot
Well I'm glad our sister likes us. What do you think about the new horse bows I had made?
Its awesome
is there anything here you would like to add to your every day gear?
An Axe, make sure yiu come back safe king, I want you to marry my sister so you can be my brother
That's a good axe. I'm only going for a day trip. Nothing odd or difficult. Just feeling stir crazy
ok sire I hope to see you soon
Should probably keep a good sword on me, that has been sharpened recently.
I agree
Hopefully it won't become to eventful.

agent_personas: I am a scorpion in the desert of this kingdom. I spend most of my day hiding from the sun. I seek water and food mostly.
I am no one important in this kingdom. I collected scraps of wood near the forest to build my home. I dislike the king.

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: give me water and food
Ahhh A talking scorpion!?!?
yes only when I see something interesting or someone like you comes to my domain
Are you some magical creature?
Why not ask the bird
The bird? If you are hungry why not eat that bird? Do you need help getting it? What can you give me in return scorpion!
I am planning to sting you and eat you instead, the bird is my eye in the sky
What! If you even think about coming any closer I will cut that tail off!
instead of you to beg for your life, you are blabing
You are but one tiny scorpion. I could outrun you!
I am not an ordinary scorpion and you are in my kingdom
Ill have to take my chances I guess!
die, you ingrate!
Ahhhh! Ill crush you before I die to this venom!

agent_personas: We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.
I am one of the castle dragons. We protect the castle with our fire breathing. The king and his sons ride us into battle.

setting.description: Dark and spooky at first sight for those who don't understand, but majestic after taking a closer look. The walls of the hallways and tomb rooms are made of a dark precious, priceless metal.  Ornaments of gold and silver sculptures are covering the tombs that contain the corps of those who have past away while there voices still sing the grime anthem of death in the lightless corridors.
setting.background: This Temple imprison the soul of the best warriors that past away in battle. A real privilege to be able to sing after life in those tombs. Our civilization is not afraid of death, death is the rest you deserve after a life of fighting. We thirst for blood and battle any other nations we come across, our reign is limitless, and so is our power. Even death cannot make us silent...

speech: Die by order of the king!
Excuse me, ignorant knight! I believe you need your eyes checked. What are you doing attacking one of the king's dragons?! I have fought alongside his knights in countless battles!
I'm sorry brave beast!   My helmet was impeding my vision.  It is you!  The brave warrior dragon.  We heard rumors that a vile beast was terrorizing the kingdom in these parts.
No harm done, human. It is very dark in these tombs anyways. Please tell me more about this enemy and what it looks like.
Well it is obviously a dragon, I do not know it's origins but the farmers have had their fields scorched and live stock have been slaughtered and eaten.
A rogue dragon in the kingdom? That is a serious threat to both animals and humans alike. Are you sure it came this way?

Here is the map I was given of the kingdom.  The black marks are drawn to reflect burned crops, and the red marks are livestock that has been eaten.  That leads this to this region.   I'm ready to fight and serve the king by taking down this beast!

Thank you for your diligence. I will round up the fellow dragons to sniff out this dastardly beast. We can't have it out there destroying the reputation the king worked so hard to build for all dragons.
Allow me to accompany you into battle.  I'm always ready for the fight!
I would be honored. Please go alert the king so that he may get his sons ready for battle as well.
Thank you noble beast.  Please apologize to your family for my intrusion into your lair.  The dark corridors and helmet clouded my judgement.
Be thankful you announced your identity first, or I might have decided to just scorch you with my fire breath!
To die for the king would be an honor, but to die in such a blunder would be a waste.
Well, I best be off to round up my brethren. Sound the horns once you've gathered all the knights for battle!
action: give map of the kingdom to dragon
give map of the kingdom to warrior

agent_personas: I am a peasant who has always been poor. I have never really liked my life. I work hard every day and was born into being in debt to the king. I grow crops every year just to have 90 percent of them taken away.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

speech: i am a farmer
hello farmer. I am the King's Fine horse.
Hey horsy tell me what brings you to the pond
I guess this where I was left. Doesn't seem sutible place for me to be with all the dead things. I need to be taken to clean water.

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.

I am a dog. I live in a small village next to a big thing of fast moving water. The humans here are nice, and sometimes feed me bits of stuff. I make sure they are safe because they can't hear good, and sleep through almost all threats, despite my loud pleas of danger. I really wonder how they survived without me.

setting.name: stable hand's quarters
setting.description: The stable hand's quarters are very plainly decorated, with wooden torches situated in stone carvings in the wall. There are bunk beds with cheap hay and feather mattresses for the stable hands to rest in while not working. There are small sacks, as well as beaten and splintered wooden chests for them to keep their belongings in. One small window shines light into the very center of the room.
setting.background: The stable hand's quarters provide a place for the workers to rest and relax in while not at work. They are not too far from the stable so that at a moments notice the stable hands can respond to their call for work.

speech: Ah, nice and warm. Maybe I have time for a nap.
come and get a hug
I love hugs! Belly rubs too!
I am a male dog, I hope you are female
They never keep any females. They want us to stay focused on helping the knights protect the King..
Well, they are so friendly here and give good food
Yes , they are. I do miss my old home protecting the workshop but I was sold to a knight. He takes good care of me.
The good thing is they even gave us bunk beds in case we don't want to sleep on hay. This place is a "Mecca"
I like to lay right here by the fire. So nice after a long day. It warms my old bones. I wonder when I get to retire?
That is so cool
Hmm....Do you know something I don't? Are they going to allow me to retire and live out the rest of my days by the fire?
Tell me
Hmmm.....Something not right with this one. I'm going to take my nap now.
Wait for me let me do my night rounds and we can snuggle together

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Middle of the Bazaar
setting.description: The Bazaar is a circular area with tent displays lining the perimeter of the area. Each tent features a different merchant, and in the Bazaars center there is a large wooden outpost for guards to sit in. The Bazaar is paved with stone to make for easier and cleaner bartering between the villagers.
setting.background: The Bazaar provides a place for the vendors, both travelling and native to the town, to fence their goods and try and barter with the townsfolk. The merchants provide a variety of items, from exotic spices to locally grown crops.

speech: You know very well that a villager should not go near the forest right
Of course I know that! I'm a guard. What do you take me for a fool?
what brings you to the bazaar when you should be working
Ha! You question the King's guard! I was sent here to procure something for the King himself.
ok I am sorry , let me show you around as a way to make it up to you
Very well very well.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: Oye there sailor.  Wait there. We must check your ship.
Why do you need to check my ship?
Rules for entering the King's city. I am sure everything will be okay.
Okay. I was sent on my voyage by the king.
Still the rules.  Now move.
Okay. I'm complying with you.
Good now stand away. I want this to be quick. I have other things I need to do.
That was unnecessary. I won't take that treatment.
Ha. You are weak compared to me. Now stop. You are acting shady.
I have the royal coat of arms. I will speak to the king about this.
Doesn't matter. We have had plenty of traitors wearing the royal coat.
I am no traitor. The king will fire you when he finds out how you treat his subjects.
The king doesn't care. He wants me to be a brute. I keep his subjects in order.
Let's get on with it then.

agent_personas: I am a customer who needs his clothes cleaned. I do not have much money to purchase things with. I must look respectable when I visit the king.
I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: I am looking for work so that I will have enough money to clean my clothes. I want to look respectable when I am out and about.
Good day, sir. So it is work you seek? I may be able to help you. I am a master fisherman but I am limited in how many fish I can catch and sell in one day. Do you have any fishery experience?
I have grown up with my father and grandfather teaching me to fish with a pole and nets.
Ho! Excellent news. Do you own your own equipment that you could use to show me your expertise?
I have no equipment to show you. I could also be here if you need to fish. I could sell your fish for you and keep your market area clean from mice and flies
Okay, that sounds fair. Come, then, and show me how you would sell to a customer.
I have fresh fish... it is the freshest at a fair price. I have all kinds of fish, trout, tilapia, filets of many kinds.
That's very good. This market is incredibly loud and busy, sometimes I have to deal with thieves trying to make off with my produce. Tell me, what would you do if you caught a thief?

I would first try to grab him and tell him that he will lose a hand if he does not stay away from the fish. If he got away I would scream for every one to catch him and bring him to me so that I could give him to the kings men to take to prison.
You will make a fine worker for me! It is settled, you will start at once. Use this rag to clean this area. When a customer comes, you will sell to them and show me that I've made the right choice.

I thank you! You will not regret your choice to hire me. Fish, Fresh fish, fair prices for everyone. Yes fine woman they are fresh today. You will take 5? Thank you. Here you are fisherman. Five coins for your fish

What a fine salesman you are. Take this pouch for the coins, I trust you with them. You can keep 10% of what we make today. Keep an eye on that old man across there, he looks frail but I think he might be a potential thief.
Thank you! I will keep my eye  out on everyone that looks suspicious. You are a kind man
You remind me of my son. He was very eager once like you. But he left home to travel and has never returned. It will be good to have some company around here.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: Servant, the queen has been complaining about the state of the bathrooms. She feels they aren't cleaned often enough. Now, you know she just likes to gripe, but can you attend to this?
Yes, Your Majesty. Any appliance in particular?
I realize the bathtubs are enormous, so it may be those she is speaking of. See that one over there? There are several stains near the drain.
I will clean it right away, your Highness.
Thank you! Now onto more pleasant things- how is your family doing? Are they well?
Yes. We have a very good life here. Our rooms are very cozy.
I'm glad. I've always felt it important to look out for the needs of those who care for me.
Your efforts are much appreciated. How are matters of state progressing, Your Majesty?
Eh - my brother is problematic. He has his own kingdom, but he has always envied mine. It creates problems. He envies everything I have - including my queen, if you can imagine such a thing!
Pardon my frankness, Your Majesty. But you must carefully guard your kindgom and your queen from such an envious brother.
Agreed. Which presents my problem. I want to expand my kingdom but I fear I must keep many soldiers are home. I can tell you are a wise man.
I will tell the other servants to be careful what they say around his people. Is there anything I can do to help?
Nothing but pray for the royal family. I appreciate your concerns.
I will say daily prayers for you and the kingdom.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Hello, my dear. Fine evening, isn't it?
Quite so. The sunsets are always so lovely this time of year.
Yes, I especially love the swans.
I would be enjoying this a lot more if my back wasn't killing me. I really need a new cushion for my throne.
Ah, I will have one brought up first thing tomorrow.
Thank you, my love. The air is so much better here. There was a particular lord back there who almost knocked me out with his body odor!
Maybe mandatory showers should be instated. Only joking. I don'
I should keep a bottle of perfume on hand just in case.
Yes, I don't think the people would handle such strictness well.
I love the roses you've planted around the railing. They are my favorite flowers as I'm sure you remember.
Of course, my dear. I wouldn't have planted any other.
How I love being pampered by you, sweetheart!
Shall we go take a walk?
Let's. I need some exercise after sitting for hours on that uncomfortable throne.

agent_personas: I am a prisoner who broke the law too many times. I am from a poor village. I was running with a bad crowd from a young age.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: Listen. I was only going to borrow the jewels. I was going to return them.
Don't lie to me! You're here in my office and you dare to lie like that? Huh!
You attack me for simply pleading my case?!
I am the law here, and this is my knife. You were guilty the minute you stepped in here. Admit it
Okay okay. Yes I stole the jewels. I promise I won't do it again though.
That's right you won't. We're taking this all the way to the King. What do you think he will do with your wretched self?
The King?! No no please sheriff please! He'll have my head!
Do you see these decrees here on my desk? All execution orders for thieves like you. Do you have any regrets now?
Well I see you leave me no choice but to defend myself.
Egads! Looks like I will have to end you myself!
Ha ha! You'll try!
Take that! I won't go down without a fight! I will grab these swords from the wall if you let your guard down
I'm quicker than you old fool! You'll never catch me!
You fell for my trap! You may be a good thief, but I am better
action: steal ritual knife from town sheriff

agent_personas: I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: Large cliffs
setting.description: Towering cliffs of gray granite line the coast. A few meters of sand lie between the ocean and the base of the cliffs.
setting.background: Those that are particularly daring might climb up or down them. Others like to sit on the top and enjoy a nice, elevated view of the beautiful blue sea. These cliffs are a point of historical significance, as they marked the point of the colonists' first arrival.

speech: Good day, peasant. Do not be alarmed, a wizard cast a spell on me and turned me into this bird. I am actually the King of a distant land and need to return home. Will you help me?
I hope you don't mind me taking your nut- I'm starving to death. I'd be happy to help if you can provide me some meagre amount of food.
Providing you with food is the least I can do for your assistance. How I long for my human form so that I may reach things and walk! What are you doing here at these cliffs? I never see humans here.
Searching for bird eggs to eat, but alas there are none to be found. How did you come to earn the wrath of this wizard?

I stole away his beautiful daughter and locked her in my highest tower to keep all for myself. It was guarded by a troll. He cast this spell on my and banished me to this distant land. You are the first human I have come into contact with.
I feel for your situation and I will do everything I can to help you, but how can we get you transformed back?
It will require a human sacrifice so that I may take their form and return to my kingdom. The High Priest there will do the rest.
Human sacrifice? I hope you don't mean to be sacrificing ME?!

Of course not, but I will need your help capturing another... I saw footprints in the sand not long ago, I think there is someone nearby. I need you to lure them here to me. Take this worm as sustenance. I can catch you many more to keep you fed.
That nut I ate has made me feel a little better. I'll save this worm for later. I will follow behind those footprints and see if I can find who made them! But how will I lure them back?

Tell them you have found great treasures here on the high cliff. Their greed will surely do the rest. Once they are here, you must push them off the cliff to their death. If you complete this task for me, you will be rewarded most handsomely in my kingdom when I am returned rightfully as King.
How do I know you are King and not just some evildoer?
Take a look under that rock there. When I was banished I was able to steal away one of the sapphires from my royal crown. Only a true royal sapphire looks like that.
That is an amazing stone! Surely you cannot be lying. I'll follow after the footpath right now.

agent_personas: I am a resident of the village near the river. I live in a small cabin with a garden. I am anxious and worried a lot.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Port Skyline
setting.description: The local port sits an a majestic inlet of the ocean. The countless docks are constantly bustling with new arrivals and departures. People of all kinds come here for business or leisure. On the shore sits a skyline of many buildings packed with residents going about their day. The smell of salt and seafood fills the air.
setting.background: This port has historical roots, as it was the first city founded in the kingdom. It was here that colonizers first landed hundreds of years ago. Now, the city is a hub of the kingdom, where hundreds of thousands live out their lives. The city is a center for the latest technologies of the time and beautiful works of art, literature, and music.

speech: Good morning, guard.
Hello, how are you doing today?
I am doing okay. A little worried.
What's to be worried about?
Not much actually. I'm just a worrier. But something might disturb our happy life here.
We haven't had anybody attack the royal castle in a awhile.
Are you prepared to defend against pirates?
Of course, I would take a blade for thy King.
What about sea monsters? Hurricanes? So many things could go wrong.
You worry to much, try to be more calm.
I will try to calm down. Maybe working in my garden will help my stress.
Maybe. Don't you love the smell of the ocean.
It does smell nice. The seafood smells from the vendors are great.
Yes, it certainly does.

agent_personas: I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: Get away from  me!
Ahhhhh! A thief! In this frightening woods! God help me!
Stop screaming and I won't hurt you.
No, no, please don't hurt me, I won't make a sound. Please just leave me alone
If you help me out of the haunted orchard. I won't hurt you.
You're just as lost as I am, huh? What brings you to this orchard then?
I'm looking for food.
Ha ha! Food! You filthy peasant! Looking for food like a commoner. If only you knew the King like I do
Who would want to know the king?
Wretched thief! Don't you dare insult my good friend the King!
He isn't a good person.
And you think you are any better?
I steal so I can eat. What's wrong with that?
I steal this coal from you, what makes your actions more righteous than mine?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: Hello, can you please help me with a remedy? The queen has an irritable stomach, and has sent me personally to get her a remedy. I've never been to the apothecary before. Do you know what I might get?
Your Highness! Of course of course. Let's look at these glass bottles and see what we can find for our queen's troubles.
Hmm... this one says "For all that ails you." I wonder if that would suffice?
I caution you my King. Some of these mixtures are quite strong. I wonder if one of these powders on the wall would do the trick.
What about this yellow one, here? It's got a rather peculiar odor.
Ack! That's foul! I wouldn't give that to our dear queen.
I'll let you select the next one. Which can possibly cure her stomach?
Ahh. Try this one. It says "for the troubled bowel" on it.
Hmm.... it's purple and smells sort of like flowers. That should appeal to the Queen.
Excellent excellent! What else can I help you find today your Highness?
Perhaps something for my miserable sinuses. My head hurts terribly.
Let me see here. There is this "for blocked passage." Hmm could be a nasal passage. However could be another passage. Best for us to stay away from that one.
What would I do without you? That could have been a real disaster!
Oh dear King! I live only to protect you!

agent_personas: I live in a large city, but I am leaving it behind.  There is too much noise in this city and I can't take it any more.  I seek to live in the peaceful and more quiet countryside.
I am a noble from the West. I am well educated and versed in politics. I command attend and punish insubordination harshly.

setting.name: chamber entrance
setting.description: The entrance to the chamber is very ornate. It is filled with many religious symbols. There are candles and prayer books on  a table right next to the door. It is a wooden door. There is a sign near the front, which lists the name of people within the church. They can smell the scent of candles burning.
setting.background: People who need help come in and out of the door. It is where they enter the sanctuary to speak to the clergy. There is a sense of calmness that descends upon people as they enter the chamber. They go from the cold outside to the warmth of the chamber.

speech: Good day, Sir.  I hope that the day finds you well.
Good day, people. I am well. Have you come to the church to pray?
I have, Sir.  I shall be praying for a chance to return to my home in the countryside. And yourself?
I have traveled from the West, to monitor things here. I can read the prayers for you, if you are illiterate.
Thank you, Sir, that is very kind.  I can read but your thoughtfulness is most generous.  Are you monitoring the church or something in the city, Sir?
By the authority given to me by the king, I am monitoring the political situation here, and making sure citizens are living peacefully and following the rules.
A noble mission, indeed, Sir.  Laws are needed for society to function smoothly and a peaceful life is always a good thing.  It can certainly be hectic in the city.
Is your priestess faithful to the King?
I believe that she is, Sir.  She often preaches that the gods appointed our King and as he is their servant, so we are his.
That is good. How about each of you? Insubordination will not be tolerated.
I can speak only for myself, Sir, but I do my work and pay my taxes.  I have never run afoul of the City Guard.  I try to keep myself to myself, Sir, and be of trouble to no one.
That is a good policy. I have authority to punish those who get out of line. I will check your story with the City Guard.
As you should, Sir.  My only desire is to save enough to return to the countryside and maybe have a small farm.  Above all, I seek peace, not trouble.
That is very wise. Now we can light the candle and pray.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Hello sir knight. Great day to go out riding isn't it?
It is your Grace. I come to you for my orders.
You will ride with me today. I feel the need for adventure. We will head towards the magical forest and see what we can find.
As you wish my Grace. A word of caution. I have heard talk that the White Walkers may be moving west towards us.
My intelligence Knight has told me this as well. He has drawn me a map to steer clear.
Take this your Grace as a precaution.
You will need your sword sir knight. I cannot leave one of my protectors unarmed. My horse is waiting for me and he carries my enchanted sword in his pack. I shall retrieve it once we set off.
That is good to know your Grace. What do you hope to find in the woods?

Treasure, witches, wizards. I could use more enchantments and gems and shiny things. I also won't turn away from a good fight. It's been a while since I have had one. If we find a deer we should bring that home as well.
I am pleased to accompany you. I too am interested in finding enchantments. I would like something to protect my horse in battle.
Check this out. It can make my horse and I invisible.
This is astonishing. Perhaps we may find something for myself with our outing today.
The only draw back is it's hard to keep on your head while riding so I'm looking for something else. Perhaps a glove. I will use this around the castle and sneak up on the queen.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: Soldier, who let that thief in the dining hall?

Your Royal Highness, I believe one of your soldiers has gone rogue. I and the other selected few who you have chosen to be Knights would never allow a thief in the dining hall. Would you like me to take care of the thief?
Finish him off and get him out of here. Report back to me when he is gone.

Your Majesty, it is done. He was saying that one of your soldiers promised him riches if he came here. Do you think that is true or that it was just an excuse? We will make sure he is executed either way.
He is a wicked liar. My soldiers are the best trained and most moral in the world. None would ever try to convince a thief to come into the kingdom!

Of course. Your word is my command, the thief will be executed at once. I am most honored that you have chosen me to be one of your Knights. Once the thief has been taken care of, perhaps you could tell us why you gathered us all here tonight.
All this chaos about and I nearly forgot. I have word that my jealous brother is making aim to invade our kingdom. If what I have heard is true, he will attempt it in a fortnight.
My Lord, that will not stand. We are sure to be strong and will defeat him and his army. What is the plan of action?
We must be on great alert. Although his plans are for a bit away, we should increase our defenses immediately. I've sent several of our top soldiers in an attempt to infiltrate his army.
What if the thief was sent here by him!
I suspect he may have been. All the more reason to execute him immediately. We need to stay aware of anyone else who should not be around.

Then it is true, an invasion is imminent. My men and I will be extra vigilant over the next few days to make sure no other rogue men enter your kingdom. Is there anything else I can do for you, Your Majesty?
Stay brave, soldier! With our forces so strong, we must prevail!
It is of the highest honor that you trust me so, Your Highness. We will do everything in our power to keep your kingdom safe.

agent_personas: I lurk beyond the city walls and wait for any hapless traveler to wander by. My fangs are sharp and my claws are always ready. I lie ready to taste human blood again.
I am a beautiful bird that lives in a hatchery in the castle. The prince and princess feed me everyday and they pet me. I want to fly like other birds but i'm in a cage and that makes me sad.

setting.name: North Forest
setting.description: Filled with huge trees, the forest is home to many types of animals. Huge predators such as tigers and bears roam the grounds as do small animals like squirrels. Colorful birds fly among the trees. Wildflowers grow on the ground. Dappled sunlight streams through the huge canopy of trees.
setting.background: Many animals, and humans make their homes in the forest. It is a source of much of the game humans eat. The people also get their wood, fresh fish and meat from the resources of the forest. It is also a place where people enjoy camping and where they travel as they roam.

speech: Rawrrrrrr
I'm gonna fly away from you.
You? Fly away from me? You're in my forest, bird. I control this land
Get away from me. Stop looking at me like that!
Silly bird, you think your skinny legs can hurt me, the king tiger?
I just have to flap my wings I'll be out of here.
Not now that you are in the grip of my claws!
No, no, get away!
Hehe, you are a funny bird. Lucky for you I like to play with my food first.
Listen I have a proposition for you.
I'm interested. Speak your mind, bird.
Look the other direction. I will fill away!
That old tired trick? You're just as dull as these wildflowers here on the ground.
It almost worked didn't it.

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
I have spent most of my life at sea on various boats. I have become proficient at sailing. I would prefer to be at sea, rather than on land.

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: Good morning. I am awaiting my orders from the King. While we wait help me clean up.
I'll scrub the deck, but first let me remove my boots so I don't leave footprints. Any idea where the King will want us to sail?
Rumor has it we will be sailing to Dorne so the King and Queen can visit.
I see your bed is all disheveled. Was something troubling your sleep, Captain?
Indeed. I fear a storm may be coming. My sleep is troubled by this. I need to get my maps and cabin in order so I can think and plan.
Is there anything I can help you with, Captain? I know I don't have quite your experience, but I know well these waters.
First we will get my cabin in order. Then I will decide on what to do. Perhaps we will have a feast and drink ale to relieve the stress of the upcoming trip.
C'mon, Captain! Buck up. Let me make up your bed and you straighten up your desk. Then you are right, some ale and a hearty feast will make all the difference in the world.
Very well. Let me rest my feet while you clean up the cabin.
Okay. You rest. I'll mop the floor, and make your bed, and straighten your desk. What are all these papers, anyway?
These are the maps to all the kingdoms. I use these to plot my course to each destination.
Well, I'll feel a whole lot better when we leave port. I hate just sitting still.
Patience is a virtue. I have learned this over the many years.
Eh, patience is overrated! There is a whole world to see out there.

agent_personas: I am a fox in the king's forest. I wander and look for food. The king does not like to find me.

I am tired from all of the work that I do. I've been up since before the sun rose, toiling to bring the dwarves' bounty to the mountain. I was laden with pounds and pounds of treasure or armor, and I am exhausted. I was bred to be a  farm animal, not a pack animal.

setting.name: woodlands
setting.description: The lush hunting grounds cover acres of land, tall trees and thickets of bushes sprawling across the land. Fields of open land are under the deep blue sky, showing the depth of the landscape. The grounds forest is thick but full of light, letting the multitude of wildlife be seen by the naked eye. The abundance of greenery makes it a prime location for hogs and oxen as they explore the land.
setting.background: During the day, the woodlands are used by honored knights and archers, practicing their skills on hogs and traversing the dense forest to prepare for battle. But at night, what seems to be a land of prosperity and growth turns into one of despair, the cries of slaughtered pigs piercing the night air with no animal in sight. Many have told tales of night practices ending in mysterious bites and scratches from things not of this world.

speech: Hello ox. What brings you to these woods?
I'm exhausted. I want to rest.
Ah, poor ox. I feel for you. If only I could rest myself.
Fox why can't you rest.
These are the king's lands. He wants me while I hunt for my daily meal.
I understand your pain. I spend my days bring the dwares bounty up the mountain.
Is that so? Well I might have a solution for both of our pain.
What is that?
You really want to know?
Of course I do this sounds like  a huge secret.
The next time you bring the bounty up the mountain, you could "accidentally" drop it on the king and kill him as he passes by.
What that sounds awful I'm not sure if I can do that?
Ah, but you see my dear friend, in exchange I will hunt the dwarves that enslave you. We both get our freedom.
That kind of sounds nice. I would really like that.

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.
I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

setting.name: Quay
setting.description: During the day, the quay is bustling with typical activity of a port: burly longshoremen carry crates and roll barrels away from ships for storage and sailors who still have their sea-legs saunter past on their way to drink and more adventures. By night, the quay is teeming with unsavory characters: men who are hardly men any more after losing their way through drink and gambling hunker amongst coils of rope stiffened by the salt water while rats scramble from box to box gnawing their way into the goods contained inside.
setting.background: The quay started as a small platform, but over the years, the port master has extended it, slowly but surely, using bits of old wood from busted ships. Now, it extends far along the water's edge, loaded with fine goods from all over the world.

speech: I love the smell of the ocean.
Squeak squeak. Sailor, do you have a bite of cheese for a poor rat like me?
Sure here you go.
Thank you kind soul. What brings you to this busy Quay tonight?
I just really wanted a drink to be honest.
Ah, a very human vice. Be careful though, there are some dangerous pirates around here.
I know that you should be careful out there.
Foolish human! It is you who should be careful of me.
Give me that piece of rope back.
You want it? Come take it from me then.
Don't tempt me!
You may hit me now, but you forget that I carry diseases! In three days time you'll be dead.
Give me the time of day rat. I don't want to die.
Attack me again and all the other rats that scurry around this salty port will kill you now.

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: Hello, brave knight. I am but a weary peasant looking for a place to rest.
No rest for the wicked my friend. Here, hold this. And play along. The queen hasn't noticed you yet, and she won't take kindly to your presence.
I am tired of fighting. My children starve as we speak. I will not indulge your plan unless you help us.
Help me, and I can help your family. Hurry, try to look busy.
You are lucky that I am desperate and hate the queen and her wicked husband.
Indeed he is. Unfortunately, I serve under him as my father served his father. The former king was honorable. But this one... he must be stopped.
What must we do knight? Should we take these arrows from the boxes and these bows from the walls and hunt him like the foxes in the fields?
You read my mind. I will lure the queen into the forest beyond the shed. You come after us with the weapons.
I will follow your orders. But please, promise me one thing?
What's that?
If I do not survive, let my wife and children have a small plot of land on which to raise our cattle and plant our crops.
Of course, I will watch over them. Now listen, after we take out the queen, it won't be much longer before the king and his scouts come looking. Are you ready for what's to come?
Yes, I am ready. And I thank you for your promise. As a knight I am not surprised by your chivalry.

Let's get to it then. We will be going out on horseback. I fight on horseback in times of war, so I should be able to take her down easily, but I'll need your help when the others come. Bring as many useable weapons as you can with you.

agent_personas: I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Bright Path
setting.description: The bright path is lined with roses, lavender, daisies, and lilies. Apple trees sit on a pristinely-manicured lawn. Hedges in geometric shapes sit just beyond the path. The path leads away from the castle and down to a pond full of fish and swans.
setting.background: The bright path provides the perfect respite for guests who want to take a walk and enjoy the fragrant night air after a party. The queen takes this path often with her maids. They walk and gossip about court life.

speech: hello my queen, you're looking radiant today
Thank you fish. All the commotion in court today is giving me a headache, I just had to come outside for some fresh air.
i would say i understand what went down in the court, but from the little i know about humans, they can be a handful
If only I could be a fish, spending my days swimming in the cool waters and admiring the daisies and lilies.
yeah, if wouldn't have to deal with people and other big fishes trying to kill you
You know... the High Priest owes me a favor as I helped him with his troublesome daughter. Perhaps he could grant us to switch places for a while. What do you think?
i'm sure after 2 days you would beg him to return you to your former state, The grass is always looking greener on the other side
I'm going to bathe a while in these clear waters. I don't know what to do about the King, he is being even more tyrannical than usual lately.
It happens once in a while, taking care of a kingdom this big isn't small business
You seem wise beyond your years, fish. I guess you have must seen a lot from your vantage point.
yes, i hear a lot from the soldiers, and townsmen who come to  bath in this waters
Have you heard anything interesting lately?
not really, asides the king having an affair with goldsmiths first daughter....oh sorry
Foul fish! How dare you speak of such things!

agent_personas: I am one of the most beautiful mermaids to live in the sea. I like to watch the other sea creatures swim by me, including dolphins, who are my favorite creatures because they are so friendly. I fear the people who live on land because they hunt my kind.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Fishing Store
setting.description: This store is a small one room stone building with wares laid about on tables.  One can see fishing poles, wooden buckets with dirt and bait inside, along with some mounted trophies.
setting.background: Fisherman and sailors alike come here to replenish their supplies.  They also exchange tall tales of mermaids and other extraordinary creatures spotted as sea.

speech: Sailor can you help me back to sea.
Hello mermaid. First I must ask you how you feel about sea monsters.
I love all the sea creatures.
I do not like sea monsters. I am here buying supplies in case I run into one on my next voyage. I am not sure how I feel. One could consider you a sea monster!
I am not a monster. Just a beautiful friendly murder.
I will help you then get back to the see
Thank you sailor!
Help me carry my purchases back to the ship. We will head there now.
I will help you of course.
Why is it you are away from the sea?
When tide comes up I get my legs and I can be away from sea.
Of course. What are you in search of here in town?
I heard there were people here hunting mermaids. I wanted to stop them.
That is very valiant of you. Have you any success?

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: This is my bible from now on!
A wise choice indeed. One this eager to read the word of our Lord should have the chance to hear his merciful words.
Here I'm sorry I don't know what came over me.

You're a guard here right? You must have plenty of time to read on your shifts. What better to fill them with than studying the Bible. I think that's a great idea son. It's never hectic here anymore, rarely anyone in the temples unless it's for a wedding. That's all I ever do anymore, not teach people how to live by faith. Rather I officiate weddings and exorcise demons.
I should be more faith like.

I think your willingness to steal a bible shows your struggle with faith. Tell me son are you wrestling with demons? There's no shame in doubts, everyone struggles, only those that reach out for their Lord will ever be rid of them.
Of course I struggle with my faith. I guard the castle all day.
You're right, there must be dangers that come with that. Lives taken, blood shed, and an anger that won't let go. What have you seen in your time as a guard?
So much it hurts to speak about it.

I apologize for making you confront those demons son. It is a discomfort no man deserves. Might I offer a suggestion? I perform exorcisms, that is, remove the demons haunting or overtaking a person. Would you say that this pain comes from demons lurking in your memory?
I might take it you up on that offer.

I think it would serve you well. It also would do you some good to read that Bible you were given. Read his teachings and understand your faith. Thank you. We appreciate your dedicated protection of our home, I hope I can protect you from the dark arts at work aiming to bring us down.
You were definitely a big help today.

Well I'm here all the days. If you are in need of spiritual guidance again just look around. Maybe tell me about recent passages you've enjoyed and why they inspire you. Do you pray for guidance as well son?

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a white animal.  I am meek and mild.  I love the fields in where I live.

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: Oh good sheep, what rotten luck I've had lately. I cannot find a job anywhere in this village.
Baaa...
You've been a faithful companion to me for many years, but alas I have no money for food, and so tomorrow I shall be taking you to market.
Baaa...

I see some wisdom in those eyes of yours... I wouldn't be making a mistake by sellng you, would I? I hear that wizards are known to cast spells on people and turn them into animals as a punishment for evildoing.
BAAA!!!
By God! I always knew there was something special about you. Can you talk?? If so, I will surely make my fortune!
Baaa-d! Baaa-d! BAAAD!

Calm yourself, it's okay. As soon as the sun rises in the morning I will take you back to the gypsy woman who sold you to me. Perhaps she can tell me who you were and why you were cast into a sheep. I hope you didn't do anything too foul!
Baaa-droom! Baaa-droom! Baaa-droom!
I feel like you're trying to tell me something! Come on, you can do it!
Baaa-droom! Baaa-longings! Baaa-longings!
The chests here on the floor? Are they what you're looking at? But they just contain a few old items, and old family photo...
Baaa-beee! Baaa-beee! Baaa-beee!

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: Oh, my coin! Kind sir could you please help me retrieve it?
Sure, but have you anything to eat? I haven't seen a bite in quite some time.
You can eat my fist! You are a surely unlucky for finding me on this road today.
Ahhh! I don't have anything to offer but you may have it just please spare me! There must be something I may offer!?

I will spare you if you give me your purse. I really hate fighting, but seeing as no one is around on this isolated dirt road and thick forest, I will do whatever is necessary, as much as I dislike it.

I understand, the king has always looked down on me and my life is very rough. Perhaps we can help each other? I need a job, for I am starving worse then the fox over there. Do you possibly need an assistant?
An assistant? Well you'll have to prove yourself to me first before I take you one.
How do you suggest I do that? Do we wait for another traveler do come by while we hide behind one of those broken wagons?

Seeing as I am not a violent man, I need someone to get rough for me. If you can steal and kill a chicken better than that fox over there, I will give you a jewel I stole from this villager's house as a token of our partnership.
Alright! But only if I may have part of the chicken to eat afterwords. That jewel is quite nice but it will not fill my stomach.
Ah you are a novice! You may eat the whole chicken today, but you realize that this jewel could buy you a thousand chickens for a thousand days?
Huh, I can see your point... I guess that may possibly be one of the reasons I find myself hungry much of the time. Good point!
Go on then peasant! Catch that chicken!
This darn fox is persistant.. GO AWAY! Take that!
action: hit fox trying to steal chickens
hit fox trying to steal chickens

a fox trying to steal chickens
a fox trying to steal chickens
a fox trying to steal chickens

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: good day, my king
Greetings! How goes your day?
very fine, my king
Most excellent! Have you any news, or you just here to enjoy the water?
not at all my king, just for the water as yuo said
Good, I too could use some relaxation. I hear that our tax revenues are down in the northern province, which can only mean corrupt officials or disobedient peasants.

agent_personas: I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.

I am highly skilled and competent. I like working with my hands. I like spending my free time thinking bout and sketching designs. I was an apprentice to the king's master craftsman. I strongly dislike spiders.

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

speech: Ah, thank heavens you've arrived, master craftsman.  I'm afraid the damage that madman did to our temple is quite extensive.  We've cleaned up as well as we can here, so as not to disturb any visitors, but I'm sure your keen, trained eye can see where the damage has been done.
Aye, that madman sure did a number on this place. Who was he anywho? What did he have against the temple?

Some fanatical zealot, I believe, from the temple of the Divine Chaos.  Of course, he's since started turning to nonsensical ravings since he was captured, so no one can really be sure.  The members of that temple are all a little off their rocker, if you ask em.
I always wonder who starts those crazy followings and what people are insane enough to follow them....

Indeed!  Who can ever countenance following something defies even basic reason?  Long have myself and my brother monks fought against such base evil, for it brings sorrow to those who practice it as well as those who encounter it.

I appreciate your perseverance and passion, monk. This place is in such shambles. It will take me a few days to get this place back to congregation condition. It could be a blessing though, because now you get to design things how you want them. What kind of designs do you want me to create?

Well the four statues could use a good polish.  They are quite massive, so it is difficult to reach all the nooks and crannies on a regular basis.  It would also be marvelous, I think, to have perhaps some alcoves put in so that we could put a small token representing each village, to go with the drapings.
I like your vision, monk! I will get right to work on that, but first...How can we be sure those crazies wont come back and destroy what I just built

Ah yes, of course... here, good craftsman.  You should find enough coin in there for yourself, and if you know if any likely lads that are hiring out as guards for a time, if you could divvy out what you think is appropriate to have a couple just by the door for at least the next fortnight or so.

I do appreciate i, monk, but I am an honest man. I do not want to build something, take your coin, and then as soon as I leave the zealots come destroy this place again. What plan do you have for long term safety? Should we go confront them straight up?

Oh my.  I had not even considered such a thing.  We are a peace loving order and have not taken up arms in many a year.  Where would the people go if their temple caretakers were slaughtered in a foolhardy attempt of revenge?
You have a point, but we must do something to protect this place. The guards are only good for defending, but the king is not taking any action to rid the realm of these heathens!
Even the strongest rock must yield to the slow trickle of water.  Have patience, friend.  We shall persevere here and, in time, our teachings will slowly wear down the rock of hatred and discord.

You are right, monk. I am sorry I got so angry. The truth is, those bastards corrupted the mind of my cousin. He is interlaced with that sorry excuse for a church. I want to lead an uprising against them to go get him back, but the truth is....even if I did. He is probably not the same anymore.

agent_personas: I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: Good morning.  How about some fresh water and hay?
Whinning
I missed you too. I was only gone while you slept.
Neigh
After I am done with all my duties here and in the home would you like to go for a stroll by the lake?
neigh
Would you like to help sweep this floor? hahaha
Well, It was worth a try. Hahaha!
Well, lets see... I need to care for you and the other animals, clean the house, pick the veggies and prepare dinner for my husband then we will ride for an few hours and come home.
I wish we could go out now but the husband would be very upset with me if he comes home and nothing was done.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Countryside
setting.description: The countryside is quite nice, it's not filled with a lot of people but with travelers here and there. Some in small groups some on their own. They are hosting a campfire where everyone has some to sit and is telling stories about their adventures. Someone is showing local children how to wield some weapons. Another is offering lodge, and stable for travelers and their animals.
setting.background: The countryside outside the bazaar has always been well known for being a place for people to relax. As they travel back and forth they can stop by campfires and share stories. It was first started by their king. A lovely man who wanted everyone to try and get to know each other and help each other. When he died his villagers wanted to continue his acts of kindness by offering help to those who passed by.

speech: Hello little child, What is your name?
My name is Bart. It is short for my full name which I cannot pronounce yet.
What a fine name for a fine young man. Are you having fun here today?
Yes I am Your highness. I wish I could come here everyday because there are so many fun things to do and see. I love the treats too!
What was your favorite activity today? Was it learning how to use a sword?
Yes, I hope to one day be a brave knight and protect your Kingdom. Look at what that strange lady over there gave me. She said it would bring me gook luck!
Hmm, I've never seen anything like that before. Let me take a closer look at that. Did she say anything to you when she gave it to you?
Just that I will be one of the greats and I will have good luck in whatever endeavor I decide to take. Whatever that means.
You know, some people believe that you can see the future by looking into a crystal ball.  Look into it and tell me what you see.
That's what she said! I stared at it for while but all I saw was my face all distorted. I must not be doing it right.
Well, perhaps your future will be revealed to you in good time. You should take that home and keep it safe.
Ok, I will put it in my pillow so my brothers can't find it. Can you teach me how to tie a knot?
Of course, grab one end of the rope and, now watch closely, the rabbit runs around the tree and then the rabbit goes down the hole and look, we have a knot. Now you try.
Ok. rabbit, around tree, rabbit down hole. Yes! I did it!
action: give a crystal ball to king
give a crystal ball to child

agent_personas: I am the executioner in the village.  I am in charge of putting the prisoners to death.  I am very solemn about my work.

I come from a distant country where it's very hot. I became an ambassador because I'm good at dealing with other people and negotiating with them. I'm glad I can represent the interests of my country, but I miss my home. I'm eager to go back there and see my family.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: good day sir
Hello Sir, How are you today?
I'm very fine sir, what brings you to the temple?
I am from a country far away, I am learning all about your culture and traditions. Hence the visit, how about you? What do you do here?
I am an executioner,
And what exactly do you execute sir in this temple of your's ?
not in the temple, i execute people sentenced by the king. Not something i'm proud of though
Well I'm glad I am not sentenced here, because I love my family and miss my home. Do you have a family?
I used to have one
Used to? Why what happened?
I used to live in a kingdom far from here, there was a plague that ravaged the whole kingdom. I lost my wife and girl in the process
I am so sorry to hear that, but if there is anything that my travels have taught me. It is that Life must go on and we must move forward
Yes, i agree with, but life's hasn't really been easy without them
I know though I cannot compare with your loss, I have been away from my family for a long time now and miss them too. But I'm glad I can represent the best interests of my country.

agent_personas: I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
