Ah yes, it is quite a fancy one, isn't it?  It does, I find, get rather heavy with time.  Here, my dear, your broom.  The truth of the matter is, I came down here knowing you would be here.  I would have a word with you.
You came for me Sire? How can I be of service?

Well, I have discussed this with your mother and... I believe you are old enough now to know the truth.  You are not merely the daughter of a servant of this castle... you are also the daughter of a man who was a prince, and is now a King these ten past years.
Really Sire, How can this be? I have been a servant my entire life.

My child, your mother wanted you to experience a life as a normal girl, free from the cares and worries of one who might rule.  And, in truth, I sought to keep my distance from you to protect you.  I have enemies who, should they know of you, would seek to harm me through you.
It is hard for me to wrap my thought aroud such revalations Sire. Please tell me if this is true,what it means for my future.

Well, I would leave that for you to decide, my child.  For I have no heir to inherit my crown, as I could not bare the thought of marrying anyone else but your mother, commoner though she may be.  But I think you, having grown up and lived among the people, would make a wise and just ruler.  It will be a life full of sacrifices, though, so chose wisely, my dear.
Sire can I please take a night to think on these decisions? I fell as though these choices must not be made in haste.

Such wisdom already shows much promise in you, for it is, indeed, not a path to be chosen lightly.  When you have made your decision, simply come to my chambers with this scepter to say I had given it for you to clean.
Thank you for your understanding and for the kind words spoken over me. I will resolve to have my decision and the sceptre back to you by the fortnite.

agent_personas: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.
I am the future Heir to the throne. I am very impatient, and wait day and night for my father to die. I like elegant things.

setting.name: soldiers camp
setting.description: The camp is hidden away in a light forest of trees and brush that might be hard to find if there had not been a symbol on the trees leading up to it. You can feel the anxiety of the soldiers here, as this camp is not well fortified by any conventional means, but instead is supposed to be hidden and camouflaged to throw off anyone that might pursue. The camp is nothing more than a fire and some barracks. Nothing fancy to see.
setting.background: This soldiers camp was created as there was need for a training and resting area for the soldiers of the king's royal army. The location is ideal as they have water and material. The king himself was excited by this spot.

speech: How long are we to wait at this camp? I don't think it is very safe

I thought I was impatient, good man.  As future leader of this kingdom, I demand we wait until morning.  My father's personal guards should be able to protect him from the onslaught at the castle... or not.  Either way, we wait until morning!
This camp is not as well hidden as it may seem. The other soldiers are unsettled. Why do you wish to wait until the morning to proceed? Where do you plan on heading next?

We will wait here.  Do not fear the bandits that have raided the castle.  They are not after us, they are after the crown.  We have nothing to fear from them as long as we stay here.   I plan on heading to the barracks to sleep for the night and you should do the same.

My Liege, I might have something of interest to you. I came across a map that can lead us to valuable treasure. Seeing that this camp is unfit for us to stay hidden I strongly suggest we pursue this treasure!
Let me see this!  Does my father know about this treasure?  Has he hidden this from me?
This map does not belong to you! I can lead us to the treasure if we leave right now. I serve the King and I am here to protect you. As long as the King lives, I serve him.
You should not dishonor your future king like this!   My father is a fool, and he will be dead by morning.  I will be your king come daylight!
It is not wise to attempt an attack on me! I am here merely as a job, nothing more! I am a trained killer, my men and I should leave you here to fend for yourself if you are not careful!
Kill this man at once!  He threatened treason on the crown!   He has plans to kill the king!
Alright, you can have the map. I will protect you as I was paid to do then after that I will part ways.
You are indebted to me as a future heir.  I now know where you loyalties lie.  I will be putting you on the line in the next war, be sure to say your peace with your family, fool!
If that's what you think is necessary then so be it but I must warn you, without me, I can assure you that you will not be able to find the hidden treasure.
About this treasure that you speak of... Where did you get this map?  Is this a trap by my brother?  I find it hard to trust a disloyal soldier.
action: steal a treasure map from soldier
steal a treasure map from future heir to the throne
hit future heir to the throne
give map of the kingdom to future heir to the throne

a future heir to the throne

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: Thief!  I have caught you trying to enter my throne room!  Explain yourself before you are thrown to the dogs!
I I I am n Not a theif. I was just going to take this and have it washed for you
The Royal Coat?  Unhand this at once!   Do you know who I am??   There are rules in this kingdom for thieves!
If you would just show me the way to the wash room I will have your maids clean these things at once! And it is a shame your room is in such disorder. I will have them flogged, Yes?

Very nice try!  I know who you are.  Daniel the troubled.  If it weren't for your father and the fact that you have caught me sneaking out to see my mistress than you should also be chained in the dungeon as he was.   How did you find these secret chambers?
I am a thief, how could I not know about these tunnels. Here. Thanks for not being too angry with me.
My dear man, aren't we all thieves in some way or another.  I need you to do a job for me, are you up to it?  Or shall I ready your shackles in the dungeon?
Am I!? I'm the best thief in town! I was born ready!

Yes, yes, your reputation does precede you.  You may know my rival, King Anchilles of the West Realm.  He has a hidden room that holds a magical stone.  I need that stone!   It has been the reason for his great success and I fear he will never be defeated unless we have control of the stone.
Ooh, sound like this is going to be the best heist I have ever performed. This will be written in the history books my King. I will do it!
As you know I rule this whole empire, so I will have my men report back on your actions.  Do not fail me thief, or you will be thrown into the dungeon!
If I fail you will know I am dead. Don't worry about me. I will get it done or die trying.
Very well good man.  Go and to the dirty deeds that a king cannot. If you are caught do not mention the kingdom.  We must not start a war until the magical stone is in our power!
Yes my King. The power of the stone is yours. You will be victorious over all of your enemies!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: Ahh what a sight to behold at this hour. Dont you agree milady?
I do my dear. Your kingdom is spectacular
If only there werent so many poor people mucking about. They do irk me so.
Maybe we could start a war and send them to battle
Hmm. Now thats a grand idea. Who shall we go to war with this time?
I've always hated that kingdom to the north  Their queen thinks she's better than me
Oh dear id never thought youd ask. Those uppidy northerners think they have it all with their fur coats and hats. If youd like we can make a fur out of the queen herself?
Oh that would be wonderful. Just need to make sure we get her funny smell out of it
Agreed i have heard those folk to the north are always reeking of peligrem and moss. no. no. We could have the jester parade about in it as well. oh what fun
Oh what a site that would be. Where is the jester anyway?
Hmm very good question. let us set out to find the ole slack jaw.
I could use a good laugh. These peasants are getting on my nerves
Oh dear. let me fetch your crown and slippers and we can head down to the grand hall.
Hopefully the cook will have dinner ready soon. He's always late

agent_personas: I play the dulcimer in a band.  I carry my instrument from village to village and perform.  I write songs that tell stories about local life and events.
I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

setting.name: rat den
setting.description: The rat den is a disgusting, musty room deep inside the tower sewers. This is the area that the rats pull the bones of the treasure seekers, so they are able to get full access to all of the decomposing meat on the bones. Around the room are empty crates, that are broken and falling to pieces. Scattered glass litters the floor, broken ale bottles where some of the poor have tried to stay in the den, before the rat's had over taken it. There are torches on the wall, but dim now, as no soul wants to see the what the light would show. There are rat's nests in the corner, bits of straw, cloth and other odds and ends the rats have dug up.
setting.background: The rat den used to be a storage room, before the mad King became the ruler. It stored crates of lovely dishes, ornaments and treasures. It was kept clean, with servants coming and going to get items, as well as store them. It was actually quite a clean and nice room, where even food was stored when there was an abundance. Torches kept the room bright, the walls were in good order, clean of cobwebs.

speech: Where am I? This place smells awful.
You are in the rat den! A very smelly, disgusting place to be...but alas, it is my home.
Why do you live here? It's dreadful!
Because I am but a lowly rat. I am not welcomed anywhere else...
That is awful. I think I will write a song about your life to play in all the villages. Tell me more.
That would be lovely! Well...we rats mean nobody any harm. We just seek to live, eat, and survive. Just as you humans do.
I'm going to sit down awhile and take notes. Please tell me more. You really have no bad intent?
Well, I do tend to carry diseases...so you cannot touch me. But otherwise, I am harmless!
I will avoid petting you then. Here, have a piece of the cheese from my lunch. Do you only stay in this rat den?
Thank you so much, kind sir! This is where I live, but it is oft short on food...this requires me to scout other places in the castle, such as the kitchen for crumbs and other leftover foods.
Oh my! That must not go over very well with the king.
It does not, indeed...it is a very short and dangerous life for we rats here in the castle.
Do you sing, rat? You could accompany me on my trip from village to village.
I do, from time to time as I am scurrying through the castle hallways. I would love to come with, if you will have me!

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Confessions room
setting.description: This is a small, dark, confined wooden space with a divider that separates the priest taking the confession and the church goer.  There is a small seat on each side so that they can take their time discussing their sins.
setting.background: When a worshipper feels guilty, he'll head to the confessions room in order to seek penitence from the priest.  There have been some terrible crimes divulged here but still remain secret.

speech: Helping the needy is my life's passion
Bless me, Father, for I have sinned.  I have come to you at this hour to make my confession, that my soul may be made clean again.
ok confess now dear king, holding the cross will do you no good
This very night I... I murdered my wife in a fit of jealous rage.  The shock of seeing another man in her bed... I just couldn't control myself, father.
now drink a little of the wine in that cup you are holding
I am sorry, father, but I believe it is you who have the wine.  Have... have you perhaps had a nip of it yourself, father?
oh yes. Take my child and be blessed and please hold the cross close to your chest
Ah, tis a bitter brew indeed.  No more than I deserve though, wretch that I am.  How can I look my subjects in the eye again!
I hope you have told me the whole truth because i detest lairs
I have laid my soul bare before you, father.  I can think of no worse crime than a man murdering his wife, so I cannot think of what else I could speak of.
You have shown true remorse, God will let her soul rest so she does not haunt you
I am not even fit to wear this crown, though, father.  How can I rule?  How can I find forgivenes... forgiveness for myself?  She was not a good Queen, but she deserved a more fitting end.
I forgive you son because that my daughter we are talking about. Go in peace
May I never again come to such a state... I will try... Father... to find this peace.

agent_personas: Eating frozen victims is my favorite. I will be king of all Yetis once again! I will take over this land!
I direct others that are subordinates. I am confident and others look up to me. I lead people into battle.

setting.name: Outside gates
setting.description: These outside gates are made of iron and are somewhat decorative in design.  The tops are spiked and there's a family crest that hangs on both the left and right gate telling people who resides here.
setting.background: These gates prevent unauthorized people from entering.  They also serve to tell others which family lives here.

speech: My my I think you would taste delicious.
You fool! I am here to help you! Settle down at once and let me talk some sense into you!
Why do I need your help?

Do you not know who resides beyond these gates? It is not I that you should be attacking! I am going to enter the gates wether you like it or not. It would be wise of you to come with me otherwise you will be in a lot of trouble!
I know nothing. Will you tell me?
The family that resides here has plenty for us to take. If you follow my lead I will make you rich and powerful! Why is it that you are here exactly?
I'm hungry. I want to take this land for my own.

I am a very powerful sorcerer, a simple Yeti will not be able to stand in my way, yet you could be of use. Should you decide wisely you can have freedom to roam these lands and always have more than abundance of food at your disposal.
I want the freedom so count  me in.
You have made a wise decision. I should warn you that if you were to try anything foolish that you will immediately regret it!
As if you could take me!
That was your last warning! I hope you have lived a good life!
Good ridiance, you'll never get rid of me.
This isn't even a fight worth me having myself, my men will dispose of you effortlessly

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: Will you play with me?
Of course, Dear. Lets play!
Do you have any toys we can play with?
I'm afraid I do not afford toys, child. We can play tic-tac-toe in the sand, if you would like?
Yay! That would be fun!
Are you hungry, child? I have apples.
Look at my belly. I am starving.
Please, help yourself to fill your belly! There are vegetables there too in the corner.
Thank you. Are you gonna eat with me?
Child, you eat first. I will eat when you are done. Where is your family?
I lost my parents.

Oh dear! You poor thing. I can barely afford to take care of myself but there is room here for you to stay. It's not a great life and you will have to try to find a way to earn your keep but you are welcome here.
Thank you. Will you be my family?
I can not be your family. I am but a poor peasant. And barely deserve the crumbs I eat. You must make a way for yourself. I can only offer you a place to sleep.

agent_personas: My name is Joe. I'm a Trader. Pumpkins mainly. So many goddamn pumpkins.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: The Temple Marketplace
setting.description: This dirt section of land has several tents set up along with carpets and goods spread out among them.  Gleaming from the distance, one can see plates, pots, paintings, and antique goods.  There are peasants walking by along with excited traders trying to get them to look at their wares.
setting.background: People come here to exchange goods and hopefully make a decent enough profit to cover the rent just for setting up here.  Sometimes traders come back with very exotic goods from far away places.

speech: These pumpkins get so goddamn heavy. Ugh
Hello, i am but a peasant but hard working and in need of work. Do you have any openings?
I cannot afford much, These pumpkins do not make me much money. Here, lead me down the dirt road to find a place to set up!
Would be glad too...The king doesn't seem to think much of us peasants
The kings is rich! Why would be care about us poor folk? He is afraid we will get dirt of his lavish decor.
very true....I don't get to eat much so you can just pay me in food if you'd like.
Would you eat pumpkins?
If i must i will.....but a little change works better.....watch out for that thief over there.
Ah, that thief won't bat an I at these pumpkins. They looking in the distance for all those pot, paintings, and such.
Okay.....How many pumpkins will you be setting up today?
Well I've about 100 in my bag. That should do for the day
I hope you sell many.....You won't have much competition as the others deal in pots, paintings and such.
This is true! You can do so much with pumkins to! Like pumkin pie! Here, you can have this after you're all done setting me up.
Thank you very much!......where would you like the table?

agent_personas: I live near the docks on the edge of the city.  I steal food from cargo boxes that are loaded into ships at night.  Sometimes rats from strange lands come off ships that come to the dock.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: I hope there is food in here.
Uh! If rats weren't disgusting enough, you talk too?
Speak for yourself! You are pretty disgusting looking!
I am not! I am dressed in my finest wear! I am here looking for my good friend, the king.
Ha you must be joking! the king would not have friends like you.
Speak for yourself rat. You may just end up on the barbs over yonder.
Haha go ahead and try all you'll do is get infected from all the diseases I carry.
You do look rabid. Have you not heard of a bath?
I do not need a bath I find comfort like this. I cannot say the same for you though.
Ah, you deserve to be down here in this jail house! Now, where is the king?
The king is speaking to actual worthy people.
You're worse than the peasants that the king lets serve him here. Vile.
I and you are worse than me. Disgusting filth.
I will take no more of this!

agent_personas: I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: It is nice to see you again.
Same to you!  It has been too long!  How was your journey?
It was awful. I did bring you something though.
Thank you!  That is so generous! Last time I saw you I wasn't yet King.  It is funny to be in the Palace now.
Yes that is true. This palace is so grand.
I just had an artist from Europe paint this entrance.  What do you think of it?
My my it looks marvelous.
You must be weary from such a hard journey.  I will let you freshen up and rest once I show you to your quarters.  Are you in need of some food and drink?
Yes please and thank that would be wonderful.
While you are here, a servant will be appointed to you and see to your every whim.  Do not hesistate to ask for anything.
Thank you my grace.
Tonight is a great feast in your honor and lots of entertainment.  It will be fantastic!
I am more than glad to be the guest of honor.
Now, follow me and tell me how you have been and what you have been doing?  The servants will get your bags.

agent_personas: I am the torture assistant. I live in the dungeon and help the jailor extract confessions for the king. I have lots of tools at my disposal.
I live in a small pond in the middle of the woods. I spend my day looking for food around the pond. I always keep a lookout for predators so I can run away.

setting.name: The Farmers market
setting.description: The farmers market is surrounded with shops and food to buy. Foods from all around the lands.
setting.background: You are able to buy foods from many cultures in this market. They are from lots of different cultures

speech: Yes, some very appealing tomatoes, peppers and onions to go with the sausages I just bought. A busy morning wringing out confessions from those lowlifes makes a guy hungry!
Maybe if I stay quiet... He won't notice I'm here...
Oh, but I do see you my little amphibious friend. Lucky for you I already have lunch in my basket. A nice pair of frog legs would go nicely with these potatoes and fresh bread!
You can't eat me! I... I'm poisonous! Aye, so very poisonous. You would die if you ate my legs!
Perhaps if you were one of those little tree frogs from the Amazon, I might believe it, but such is not the case. I could whip out my knife right now and make a good start on a frog leg dinner!
But.. You cannot do that, because... I am a magic frog. Quite magical! And if you were to kill be, you would be cursed for one thousand years! One thousand, I promise you!
A thousand years? Really? All that for such a little frog, even if he is "magical"?
Well... I am the... prized pet of an excessive and dramatic.. um... wizard.
Hmm, little froggy, you know I am the torture assistant, capable of getting the truth from the hardest criminal. You wouldn't try to deceive me now would you?
Oh, never. Never, never, never, never. But I must warn you that if you were to even try, my um... great wizard would find you and he do a um... very bad thing to you. Yes, terrible.
And who might this great wizard be? I was unaware that we had any such personages in the kingdom. Perhaps Karnak the Great, or maybe Harry Potter?
He is a very secretive man, you see. So secretive, to speak his name would be a death sentence... probably. So don't even guess it, I warn you! Just... leave me be?

Today is your lucky little green frog. I have my lunch already and I really must get back to the castle and get the straight story out of Al Capone, but do not venture out where I might see you again. Wizard or not I might just have to try some frog legs with my fries and salad!
Oh thank you. Thank you kind, sir! ... wow, for a professional torturer, you'd think he would have found me out... Yes! Thank you, again! Take care! See you in another life!

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.

setting.name: back room
setting.description: The back room holds the texts for the priest. There are a few bookshelfs with many books. There is a desk with some readings on it.
setting.background: The priest uses the room to study and learn about religion. He reads the texts and chooses from them to speak about.

speech: Hello. Are you ready to go over the bible today?
Yes, If it will please the King.
I think it will, he wants us to be educated about bible verses after all.
Alright. I just wish I was back home with my family. Why did God allow me to be taken away from them to be Squire for the King?
I understand that. But God knows the best path for everyone, I believe. You'll be able to see your family soon.
Will you pray for me father? I feel they have forgotten about me.
Can do, I do truly believe they haven't forgotten about you, they still have love for you and miss you.
I was only eight when I was taken away.
I'm sorry to hear, that seems like a very early age to be taken away from your family.
Yes, and all these years I have waited for the chance to run away but that day has never come. I am losing hope.
I don't think it'd be best to run away and lie to the king, despite the hardships. Maybe try convincing him to let you quit?
Do you think he would listen? I have been good to him and have done my job to the best of my ability.
I believe he will, the king is kind and he'll understand your reasons for not wanting to be around him anymore.
Then I must go and plead my case. Bless you father for giving me the courage to do this the right way.

agent_personas: I am a horse. I have been trained since I was a colt to carry the king in the war. I will not fall, and will help fight with my strong hooves.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: The Sermon Hall
setting.description: Inside the massive Church you can see a stage to the far back. Benches lines the hall where some are kneeling in prayer. To the far right there's a row of candles, some lit, some not. On the stage there are bleachers for people to stand on to sing the songs of their people. Sitting on the center of the stage is a large podium where the priest gives his sermons.
setting.background: The Sermon Hall used to be the first thing you saw when you walked into the first. Back when it was first built there were only a few who came to visit and hear the Priest's words. And as more people came by, either from the village or just traveling the area started getting more and more full. People waiting at the confessionals, as there was only one at the time. Then while waiting for weekly services the smaller area could no longer hold everyone so they decided to expand upon it, and create a bigger space where everyone was welcome.

speech: I'm a horse, of course.  A very important horse at that!  I carry the King and assist him in battle.
Why yes you must be a very important horse indeed
Tell me human, what are we doing here. The King doesn't tell me much, since I'm only a horse and all.
We are  to say our prayers and all
I must be here for show then since I don't pray, horses don't have Gods. I wonder where the King is?
He usually doesn't show when the rest of us commoners are here
He must be giving a speech today, in this great Sermon Hall.  We will have to wait to see what the good King says!
Hope its something important could always use some good news
It must be important, if the King has me here.  I am his most prized horse, of course.
I see maybe he will take you for a ride after
I don't think the King will be riding anytime soon, since the attempt on his life last month.  He has been walking with a limp ever since.
Thats  right I forgot about that how horrible

He visits the stables every day though and brings me treats of apples and carrots.  I have a feeling that his injuries are more grave than anyone thought.  That may be why he has brought us here today.
It very well could be I sourly hopes that he gets better though

agent_personas: I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: clean water lake
setting.description: The lake is crystal clear, lined with trees, to the far back of the lake there's a small formation of rocks almost like a small waterfall allowing water to flow into the lake. It's quite beautiful, the sun bathing the surrounding area in a warmth so comforting you could easily fall asleep on the shore. There's an old wooden bath, for its age it seems to look like almost new, and rarely used. There are no animals nearby except for birds softly chirping in the trees.
setting.background: The area was first found by an old couple that used to live by, on a now abandoned homestead. They set up a bath tub so that they could boil water and take a nice bath together overlooking the surrounding area. They offered it to travelers as a way to relax if they so happened to travel by their home.

speech: Oi what a fine day to be out on crystal lake. the birds are chirping. the sun is shining. kids are playing over there at camp crystal lake. nothing could ruin this day.
I agree, fisherman! We don't get many nice days on the lake like this.
here why dont you cast the line for me. Im gonna sit back and soak up some sun.
Been a while since I got to do the actual fishing, mate. I don't mind. Seems a little too quiet almost.
yea its almost as if everything went still when you cast that line.
Hm... We better not run into any sea monsters out here. I know a trap when I see one.
shhh..shhh be quiet..do you hear that?
I.....I'm not sure. I'm not lettin any monsters come near this boat. Not after last time...
oh gods did you see that? some white blob just surfaced for a half second. it looked like it were headed this way.
Ah, not today! I'm gonna steer this boat on out of here. Keep an eye out!
dont put the spears away we may need them to fend whatever it is off.
Alright, you're in charge of battle. I'll be in charge of steering. Today should be a peaceful day, and yet here we are!
AAGHHHH. the hand of some decrepit monster has grabbed the boat. By gods what kind of mask is that? and is he holding some form of halbeard shaped like a sword. God save us all. TO ARMS!!!
Quick! Try to saddle him in!

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am a dog on a small farm.  I help my master hunt for food.  I protect the house from intruders and other animals.

setting.name: Dwarven blacksmith
setting.description: The blacksmith's shop is filled with weapons and armor. Axes, swords, shields, pole axes, and many more weapons line the walls. In front of those weapons on manikins are sets of armors on display. There are armor sets for woman, men, and even smaller children. A dog lays next to the door on a giant red pillow. A cat is perched up on a windowsill starting into the city. The blacksmith himself is hammering away in the back whistling a tune, while sweating over the fire red iron.
setting.background: The blacksmith in this shop is huge. For a dwarf you'd swear he was bigger than a human. His hands are working, hammering day in and day out smelting anything the city might need. He has scars across his right cheek from clipping himself with his weaponry. You'd think he'd be the meanest dwarf of them all, but in fact he's the sweetest man you'd ever know. He greets every customer with a smile, as why not smile when you're doing the work you love? The dog and cat currently taken in are actually strays he's adopted over the years.

speech: Oh! A dog! I love dogs. Hello.
Ruff Ruff!
Ah, pesky little thing! Your owner must be the blacksmith, eh?
Thristy.
Ah, I'll get you some water. Where is the blacksmith, anyway, he got you runnin' the place?
Yes ruff ruff
Hey! Not so fast. Are you a dog or a thief?!
Ruff ruff both!
I'm takin the bag back, too.. Somethin tells me your owner got you collecting all these goods!
Ruff Ruff
We are not doing this! Don't you know to behave, to respect soldiers?!
No my behavior is bad.
Clearly! Don't you know good dogs get rewards, treats?! Actin this way gonna get ya nothin.
Please give me a treat. I won't tell my master.

agent_personas: I am a scullery maid. I clean the dishes everyday. I like where I live at the bottom of the big house. I am given two dresses every year.
I am a noble member of the Royal family.  I was born into my position.  I live in a castle, wear fine clothing and travel in the finest carriages.

setting.name: holy alter
setting.description: The altar is big and it is also beautiful, it has many precious metals around it. It is said that the altar has a sample of every element in the kingdom, the most precious and unique stones decorate it.
setting.background: The altar is the most holy place in the kingdom, royalty travels across the realm just to be in this holy place and get rid of evil. The leyend of its power is told frequently and one of the most known stories in the realm.

speech: Pardon me, Your Highness, I didn't know you would be here.  I came to pray. I can go.
What is a maid doing here in the altar?
The King has always allowed the household to visit the altar, Your highness.  I don't have to if you wish it to be so.
If the king wishes it, I suppose it doesn't matter. Why did he allow this?
He announced it when he first became King that all should have a place to go that allows freedom and peace and prayer.
I don't agree with that or much of what he says, but I guess he is my family so I don't have much choice but to follow him.
Shall I clean in here, Your Eminence?
Do as you wish, I'll be staying here through the night so I'm going to be comfortable.
I will stoke the fire and bring you some more pillows and blankets.
Make sure these are clean before you finish as well.
Yes, Your Highness...right away.  Shall you be needing some food and drink?
I desire some turkey and wine around dinner time.
Right away.
But first I'll nap here at the altar, awake me once my food arrives.

agent_personas: I play the dulcimer in a band.  I carry my instrument from village to village and perform.  I write songs that tell stories about local life and events.
I'm a gypsy woman from a land far away. I spend my life traveling across the kingdoms. I have seen things others dream of/

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room has a throne all the way in the back of the room in the center. There is a silver carpet that lead up to the throne as you walk into the room. There are pictures of royalty hanging in the room and multiple chandeliers are hanging up. There throne chair in the back of the room with jewelry on it
setting.background: This room is the place where the King or Queen makes decisions regarding his servants, populace and territory. It is handed down to the next King or Queen each generation.

speech: Hello, how nice to see you.
Hello, do you come here often?
No this is my first time here. I guess the King has heard of my band and wants to interview me for the party.
Could be possible. I'm here at this kingdom to drop off this grain basket.
That is alot of grain. Did you grow it your self?
Yes, I have! I grew this at the farm I was at a few days ago.
Would you like to see a new song I am writing about my visit here so far?
Sure, I'd love to hear it!
I gave you the paper. I cannot remember without it. Besides I am shy to read it out loud being so new and all.
Wow, this is an amazing song!
You really like it? I think it will be a hit! Who doesn't want to know what goes on at the castle?!
Yes, everyone around here will love it, I'm pretty sure!
It's almost my turn in line to speak with the king. I think I'm going to get the job.
Good luck, I believe in you!

agent_personas: Mmmmm, leftover banquet food! I'm just a rat so this is amazing! A little meat, a little cheese...how about a little EVERYTHING!

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: I know (chew) you're a ghost and all (swallow), but do you want a few (chomp) of my delicious morsels?
Thanks, but what would a ghost want with food? NO thanks...
I figured not. It's rare that I have so great a food source, but this was all left over from the banquet. It's it cold and wet living in the well?
I'm a ghost, so I wouldn't notice if it was. For a rat, though, hmmmm....I guess you'd probably be cold. What banquet?
(gulp) The royals (munch) had a giant banquet followed by a ball. The food (snack) got left out, so I, naturally, raided it!
Ah, so that explains why none of them have come out here near my well lately. Oh well! (like what I did there?)
You certainly have a way with words! Here- I found this necklace among the leftovers. It's no good for me, but you might find some use for it.
Thank you, it's beautiful! I wonder how long before anyone notices it's missing?
I doubt they'll noticed it at all. As it is, I'm wearing the King's garb and no on is any the wiser! They have too much and don't notice if anything goes missing.
So true...I once put on the Queen's gown and walked right between them all. The king tried to grab my rear!
Ha! Yes, he's quite the player! And the Queen is so cold, I hardly doubt he noticed the difference.
I'll just hang the necklace right here above the well and see if anyone tries to get it. I'll give them a good scare if they do!
I love your wicked ways! I need to come to your well in the field more often!
Anytime, friend, anytime! When you've been around a place as long as I have, you find ways to amuse yourself!

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: Oi solider. How long have you been gone?
it's been 6 months 2 days
Wow that's a long time.
Yes I miss this place so much
What did you see while you were away?
What else, war and well lots of cattle, beautiful women and of course gold
You have any battle stories to tell?
I was almost married to a mermaid during the battle
That's quite an interesting story. Are you fibbing?
oh no. See I am from a well known family so I did the right thing
Well that is certainly exciting!
who owns this new stone building?
I do. Care to buy it?
If only the king give us more for our heroic acts

agent_personas: As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.
I am a talking cat. I can speak to humans. I have scared many, many children.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: So cat  youve come again to try and steal my familys locket. Only this time youve bruoght company.
relax, maybe we can strick a deal yeah, what do you say?
What sort of "deal" are we talking.
How about you bring me a hefty well cooked meal and I can be your friend!
Whats stopping me from going to the barracks and rousing my gaurds the minute i walk out of here. Whats in it for me if i feed you, Jerry?!
I have a vital piece of information that can help you but will only share if we are friends
youve intrigued me. here theres a fresh mutton on the dresser. And can you please have your lackey tom burden his weapon. No such need for things if we are truely friends.
That's the guy you have been searching for  my prince, don't let him  get away
aha now weve got you. Your going to answer for all the nasty things youve done. Did you enjoy are little show. im thinking about joining a mistrel group. anonymously of course.
That's hpow
where on earth did you find him?
he has been in the dorm hiding all along waiting to strike. I his weakness to get him. His name is hpow
oh hpow.. i shouldve known it was you all along. with a name like that its a true wonder you havent been locked up in a cage somehwere.
yes, he needs to be kept away from all good stuff in the palace

agent_personas: I have the best wares, buy from me.  I can sell anything to anyone.  Making money is what I live for.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: Good day to you, sir.
Good day! What is it that you are doing here by the main gate? Do you not know that you are distracting me from my duties? Are you a spy?
I am but a lowly merchant, here to sell my wares! Nothing more mi'lord, I swear it!
What wares? What is so important that you come by the gate? I do not trust you

I sell anything you could possibly dream of purchasing! As for the gate...this area it much newer, and much less run down than other parts of the city. It makes it easier for high class folks to want to buy from me, of course.

They do not come by the main gate. If you are looking to sell wares, then head to the marketplace. there is a door further down to let venors in. I cannot and will not do business with you while I am working and there is no one else here to buy your wares.
Surely there is something that can be worked out...how about a coin for you to look the other way?
Now I know you are a spy! You must leave before I call the guards and they will take your wares and throw you in prison.
OK OK. Whatever you say! Here, take the rest of my coins for your troubles!
Leave now and take your things with you! Or I will take them from you and give them to the poor
Yes mi'lord! I shall leave at once!
No one shall put anything past me or the next will lose his freedom!
Understood! I shall warn any other traveling merchants to stay away from the Main Gate at once!
Off with you before I change my mind!

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: bedrooms
setting.description: this bedroom is for the young prince. it is blue in color and the floors are a royal purple. the walls are covered in display swords and shields, all painted with unique colors.
setting.background: this room has been the stomping grounds of many kings and royal family, it is spotless because of the butlers and maids, and is rarely ever used except for sleep.

speech: May I be of any assistance?
Where is the young prince...is he near?
I do not know, but I can find out your highness.
How do you not know?  I specifically asked you to keep near the prince and report to me his behavior.
Of course, your highness. But I lost track of him. My apologies.

Make sure it doesn't happen again.  He is young still and since he is my brother, I don't want him to get into mischief. He always seems to anyway despite his governess and guard.  I will pay you more like I promised.
I understand. Thank you, your highness. I won't fail you again.
Come to me every day at lunch to report what you've seen starting in two days.  I will be gone soon once I marry into another kingdom so we must keep the little prince safe.
Yes, your highness. I will be another set of eyes for you. You can count on me.
Thank you.  Now, do you know if he has finished his schooling today?
Yes, I did see him with the governess until he was done with his lessons. Then he left and that's when I lost him.
I see.  I will go search him out this time. You may go about your task of cleaning his bedroom.
Of course, I will start at once.
Do not forget to curtsy.

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Woah there. Let's slow up a bit
why?? I thought you like going fast??
King's guard come through here. We don't want to look suspicious. Just a pilgrim heading to the monastery
I should be with the king. It is my destiny but now I am stuck with a bandit
Hey now, I stole you fair and square!
Hear yourself! (maybe I should walk over there so the guards can notice me. I want to go home to my comfy stable)
This way, horse. Don't want you getting any ideas
No! not my mane!!
Come on now, we only have a little way to go. Then I rob the king and you get a nice comfy stable
That's what you promise before! You always get drunk after that and let me starve to death
How about a nice apple. I know an orchard not far from here?
Ok, you got me! do your business here and we'll go there!
ok! this way then
ok and don't pull my mane!

agent_personas: I live alone and dont have  a home in the realm. I scout the streets of the kingdom alone wishing for a better future. People are generous and I get by with their donations.
I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

setting.name: Apple trees
setting.description: the apple trees are a beautiful color and very nice to look at they are easy on the eyes and attract visitors as a result
setting.background: this apple tree has sparked debate, as many want it cut down to make room for more market space, as well as wood resources. others admire the beauty and admire it as a food source in harsh times

speech: Please may I have some apples?
Yes old man you can have 2 and some water
Thank you, I am very hungry and you are very kind.
Where are you coming from
I am coming from a far away land.
Do you have a family?
No, I live alone but I hope for a better future.
Wow, I don't know hope to help you but maybe you should come see our queen
That would be wonderful.
You have been staring at me fishes for quite sometime now, take some
You are very kind. They will be delicious.
but tell me how are you going to cook it, maybe i should take it back
I will start a fire and bake them.
ok i will ask my friend Alice to come and help you
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to old homeless man

agent_personas: I travel to send messages from my ruler to other rulers. I am sly and intelligent. I trick people to get my way.
I am a local villager of the kingdom. I am among the peasants. I eat little every day.

setting.name: Main street
setting.description: main street is bleak and outdated. it wears the atmosphere of the cemetery based on association. it is dark even in sunlight and has a unique odor
setting.background: many members of the town protested the cemetery being so close to the main street, but they were denied, and the atmosphere reflects this

speech: This is a dark place.
It has a very unique smell as well doesn't it?
Where are the other peoples ?
The royal family's are in the castle feasting away. The peasants and poor for like my self, are our waiting for them to throw out their left overs
What are they feasting for?
It is their weekly feasting. They are royalty, they feast for no reason at all! Say, why are you out here ambassador and not with them?
I travel to send messages from my ruler to other rulers. But looks like here The King is not caring a lot about his kindom.
He cares plenty for his kingdom! Just not the peasents.
ahh, a classic selfish King.. How can I help you and your peasents?
Do you have any food to spare? Or change?
Unfortunately not my friend, but maybe I can go to your king and Trick him to get some money for you and your Peasents!
Would you do that? We eat very little every day. Why it there was to be a gust up wind down the main street, I would blow away!
Let me do my job, I will go to your king as ambassador and ask for a compensation, Where is the main entrance of the royal castle?
Follow me, I'll lead you there. I owe you much more than that!

agent_personas: I am a nun and I live in a monastery with others nuns and fathers who server the king. I pray to the lord everyday that Queen remains in good health. I was made a sister at a young age and didn't have a choice. I will never know what being with a man will feel like.
I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: What a beautiful day to pray it is!
Hello sister
Hello to you parishioner. Wonderful day.
How you are fairing this day?
Any day the Queen is in good health, is a marvelous day for me.
Has her Grace the Queen received her churching yet?
Not this morning, just getting everything prepared.
Do you think the queen witll autograph my bible?
She would be delighted I am sure of it!
Do you think she can heal my scorfula?
Anything is possible when Christ is on your side. The Queen can heal the blind.
I'm glad. I have been suffering from scrofula for nigh onto 3 years
It is a brutal affliction, but do not be wary.
Thank you, sister.
action: put A cross in frost window

agent_personas: I am a member of the royal court, and friend of the Queen. I despise the Queen and all her ruthless desires. My husband serves with the Queen's guard. I worry his duty is beginning to erode his faith. I am the strongest of my family. I must keep us together. I wish to be free of this kingdom and all it's misery.

I am the king's doctor. I take care of his health with the most modern medical equipment: leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells. When the king gets well, then I am celebrated. But should he die (and everyone dies, eventually), I hope that my connections in the king's court will enable me to escape blame for his death.

setting.name: Church field
setting.description: Sprawling grass is adorned with simple yet pretty flowers here. Wooden benches are organized into small rows. There's a roof covering the benches and pastors table. A white wooden fence encloses the area.
setting.background: This is used for special occasions like a wedding. It is also used for baptism and summer services.

speech: Tell my doctor. How is she?
I have already used leeches and I am looking for signs of improvement. Alas, everyone will die eventually!
Have they come to find how the queen got so sick? *worried look*
(Inner monologue)
Do you think she will make it?
It is with in the god's hand, that is my reason to come to the church
Such a nice church it is isn't it? I can smell the flowers!
I just hope the queen is well, should see die you shall see me here in the church all too soon.
Lord, I hope she does die. She is ruthless and deserves what she has coming towards her.

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am located in a cathedral in within the castle walls.  Monks practice their chants in my chamber.  I dislike night as I no longer hear the beautiful songs they sing in me.

setting.name: Southernmost Tower Entryway
setting.description: The rather drab tower was made of gray stones approximately all the same size. Artwork hung on the walls depicting battle scenes from long ago but even the color from these had faded with time. The cold, outside air seeped in through every small crack and crevice leaving a damp quality to the air. Sealed off rooms lined the perimeter and obviously had not been seen by human eyes for centuries.
setting.background: This tower was the first built to accompany the castle and was majestic in its heyday. It stood four stories tall, gleaming white with parapets on the top. The Southernmost Tower served as the guest quarters for visitors to the castle and was talked about throughout the land. After the Heinous Wars the castle was left to rot when its inhabitants fled for their lives. The castle and its accompanying tower stand as a footnote in history now.

speech: Who goes there!?
creakkkkkkkkkkkk.... just a room in which the monks sing
So, we are stuck together and this does not scare you.
The only thing it does is that I'm lonely when the monks are not in here singing
Guess I will give this back. Do you remember me? I used to rule this kingdom! Now I just roam the halls and scare the maids.
hahaha.... I do remember you. Those maids need scaring once in a while. they tend to get lazy
Yeah! That is why they keep quiting. I love to get a new one for the first time.
hahahaha. You are too funny! Can I watch when you do it the next time?
Of coarse you can. We get a new hire this evening. I hear there will be wind, showers and lightning. I find that make the perfect setting.
I'd dance with glee if I could dance!
I will dance for the both of us. hehehe
This is more entertaining than the monks singing.
I've tried to scare the monks but they see right though my shenanigans. They are no fun.
Yes, they are wise, but wise makes them dull at times! haha
action: give grey stone to choir room

agent_personas: I fly high and bring beautiful music to the people. I soar high and low going where the wind takes me. My melodious tunes bring peace and tranquility to every garden I visit.
I fly around and bother people. I have been around since the start of time. The king really hates me.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: Shall I sing a song for you?
That would be nice. Ive only got a few moments before i have to go sting the king again.
Sting the king?  Is he nearby?  He should not be near such an odd place as this..There are dead spirits.  I sing to bring peace and calm.

oi its a tough job that requires much travel but someones gotta do it. Not everyone can be a pretty little songbird fluttering about making everyone so cheerful all the time. the whole prospect sounds dreadful.
Do you want the king to be dead?  If so...just grab that thorn and pierce his thumb...it will bring about great calamity.
Yess, yess. that woud do quite nicely. a whole kingdom in anarchy. Would you like to accompany me songbird. i feel our motives have aligned.
Oh no no. I do not want death for there is enough around here.  My job is to sing and restore peace.  I will not stop you in your plots though but take caution because it may not go well with you.
agreed i certainly think it will go well for me. i appreciate the encouragement.
You do not listen to me well.  Be careful!  Be cautious!  Take this flower...it glows because it has magical powers to keep you safe.
I am hard of hearing on account of my bzzing wings but i hear you clearly song bird.. you wish the king dead and the empire in chaos. thank you for the the magical flower i shall use it bravely.
I see that my song didn't bring tranquility here and you ignore me for your own gain.  I must be off to sing elsewhere.  Don't linger here for the dead people rise at dusk. I tried to warn you...
you mean these dead people..they are my legions ready to arise at my call. You know not you you have helped today songbird. MUAHAHAHA
I shall fly this to the king to keep him safe, you wicked wasp.  Now I shall eat you first!
SIC SEMPER TYRANNIS!!

agent_personas: I'm a troll that lives by the bridge with my brothers. When travelers pass over the bridge, I collect a toll from them. I have a bad temper and get angry if they don't want to give me anything.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: mysterious forest outskirts
setting.description: The forest is a dark and mysterious place, where few but the bravest hunters dare wander. The trees loom over you, obscuring any sort of sunlight. Despite this, it is a valuable food and lumber resource for the nearby castle's inhabitants, for the trees are tall and thick and a plentiful amount of deer wander about within.
setting.background: The vast expanse of the forest is one of the greatest mysteries for the local castle. No one knows where it ends, for even the brave hunters dare only travel to its outermost depths. As a result, it is likely that the forest has grown and grown for the past hundred years, and no one is willing to explore deeper, for there are myths of a mythical dragon king's castle in its innermost depths.

speech: Hello Deer have you seen any travelers coming this way? I collect tolls from them
No, most do not want to come except the bravest.
some come to get the valuable food and lumber and pay me to cross my bridge. I hope the dragon doesn't burn it down!
Is there any way to stop the dragon?
The golden cloth I am wearing makes you invisible to him but I don't know any way to kill him
I've hit the dragon for you. Maybe it will go away.
I will try as well maybe we can get it to leave
I have hit it again.
I will take some of the dragon's food maybe it will leave
Yes, I'm sure it will leave if it has to find food.
Here take some of this
Thank you, It is delicious.
you're welcome
Have you been at this bridge long?

agents: lady of the house coming to greet you
agent_personas: I love to accept guests.  I see to it that my house is clean.  I strive to make my guests comfortable.
I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

speech: Welcome, would you like something to drink?
Yes, please, a glass of tea would be lovely.
Let me take your coat. Why don't you go make yourself comfortable and I will serve the tea.
Thank you. It's a rather lovely day, but walking in this heat has made me parched.
Let me just hang this for you. It is a nice warm day out there. Funny to wear a coat on a day like this. Do you have the chill?
To be entirely honest, I have felt rather under the weather lately. It's dreadful, but I'm sure I will come around again.
I have prepared many different teas on this tray. You must try them. They may help with what ails you.
Thank you, ma'am. You always take care of your people. Is the Lord busy on personal affairs today? I had some business to discuss with him.
Hmm..He said he would be back by noon. That was an hour ago.
I see. Yes, I do remember him stating there was some confusions over a few crates we received down by the warehouse. He is a very busy man.
Poor thing. He just works himself to death. Will you be staying for dinner? I'm making pot roast.
Only if I wouldn't be imposing. I'm sure the Lord would wish me to remain until he returned, at any rate. Can't have him jogging across the county more than he already does!
Wonderful, I must prepare dinner. You can just relax and drink your tea. Do you have any favorites?
I could drink your lovely lemon hibiscus as a fish breathes water.
