agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I don't have one specific home. I travel from town to town bartering for food and/or money. I would be too bored settling in one place.

setting.name: A small church
setting.description: It's a very humble abode - any smaller and you could mistake it for someone's home.  In the front room is a small altar for prayer and offerings.  The two rooms to the sides are places where the priest and a traveler can rest.
setting.background: There are many roadside churches in the land and this is but one of them.  Most travelers come here to rest on their way to the nearest town, still a day's travel away.

speech: I pray for the victory and the safety of our King. God of our ancestors, hear our prayer!
How are you soldier? I am a traveler that goes from place to place.
Good. Thank you for asking.  What are you doing here?
I have come to bed down for the evening and get moving again in the morning.
It is so peaceful here.. I might want to get some rest too before heading to the castle tomorrow... Arggh so good to be free from this heavy armor!
You can use my sleeping bag, i have a blanket and thats enough for me for often i sleep on the ground.
Thank you traveller! Do you have family?
Not many family members anymore, and has been a long time since iv'e seen any of them. Where are you stationed?
I have no idea yet. Might be on the east side where my land and people reside. I will protect them until the end!
Very admirable......Mind if i use the room to bed down?
Here! please take this. You might need it in your journey
Looks good on me lol
at least you got something to protect yourself. It does look good on you! Now you need a sword as well
I thank you for your gifts sir!
action: give a sleeping bag to soldier

agent_personas: I a squire in the king's army. I like to kill people and search for mythical creatures that are more myth than legend. I like to drink at taverns and have sex with prostitutes.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: A wet dungeon
setting.description: It is dark and eerie, especially because there is only one candle. The candle is low on wax, it will be out soon. The brick walls surrounding the dungeon are scratched with fingernails, moss is growing.
setting.background: The dungeon is in a low underground chamber by the castle. It is under water, or a lake. Fresh water keeps dripping from the ceiling, and it smells like fish.

speech: What is it you come for here in the dungeon brave knight? I am here for just a few until the next fight for the king
Motivation. I like to come to the dungeon for motivation. It makes me feel violent.
I love to kill myself and when not doing that I drink and chase prostitutes
I've ever seen you in battle. But I am always on the front line, not cowering in the back.
I'm too busy killing people keep my head up to see whos fighting. I'm busy keeping my eye on the enemy
You think you are as great a warrior as me? We can settle that debate.
Your ego is much bigger than your mouth or maybe they are about the same size. be careful you might fall in
You will pay for that comment...literally...I am taking your money.
I would have given it to you, you need not steal it. I have much more to do than listen to a blow hard
Have you ever seen a man burn to death? Have you?
You may be the first to see your self get snuffed out by fire. hahaha
If only your sword was as sharp as your tongue. Here hold this candle, while I beat you senseless.
hahahaha it sounds like you need a few drinks at the tavern to help you unwind and maybe a prostitute or two
You keep insulting me. I have no choice but to run you through with my blade.

agent_personas: I was hired to paint a portrait of the noblewoman the king would eventually marry. It seems that the painting was too flattering and when the king lifted the veil, he was very angry. I have been imprisoned for four long years. I had a wife and six children, but they do not wait for me to return. I turn my agony into art.
I like to be a helper around the forge. I help the blacksmith make horseshoes. I feel useful!

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Are you being help prisoner in this castle as well?
I am not a prisoner. The Castle Maid sent me to checked on you. She is a wicked women, so I dare not disobey her commands.
Check on me? for what? Everyone here is terrible!
The maid said your paintings improve when you are given food and wine. I am here to see if you can use anything else.
More wine is always nice. See I don't even have inspiration to paint anymore! Not after what the king did to me.
Oh no! Please understand, I am a sympathetic ear. What did he do?
He commissioned me to paint the lady he thought was supposed to marry Well, my painting were to rich for his taste. He has held me prisoner for four long years!
Good heavens! Trapped because he wouldn't pay his debt? With all his riches, that is inexcusable.
No,no, I mean that the painting were far to flattering of his soon to be lady. If you know what I mean
I see, I see. Well, the King is quiet jealous and overprotective of her and her womanhood. Still, why does the maid keep your paintings?
She wishes to steal my painting when the king throws them out! She sells them, and give my nor my family a dime!
That wretched beast! How may I help you, painter?
Could you send a note to my lovely wife and 6 children? They must be worried sick! I have not seen or spoken to them since I was thrown in here!
It is the least I can do for you. I will tell them of your situation. But can we possibly craft a way for your release without both of us losing our heads?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a groom who is in love with someone. I am nervous about being alone. I enjoy giving speeches to others.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Why are we here together?
I, Sire, am the groom of the stool, and since you are visiting the privy, it seems to occur to me that you must need to use the Royal Stool.
It makes me angry that my queen must follow me wherever I go!  I hope we have that softer cloth for my privy needs.
True, Sire. She can be quite demanding. But you are free from her hassle in here. I have fetched the finest linen for your royal bottom!
Retrieve the larger pot today, Groom, for I fear we will need it!
Good heavens! It must have been quite the feast last night. I'll light a couple of candles, too.
You know me too well! I will need some water as my bidet afterward and then you can ready a bath for me with my favorite salts.
I fear we may be here a while. I'm glad I forced the queen to leave. She shouldn't be subjected to such things!
It would serve her right for needing to be with me every moment.  I need some time for kingly things and bodily things!  How ever did you encourage her to leave?
I simply told her that her son, the prince, was calling for her. That boy is quite the sissy! I knew it would force her out.
You make me laugh too much to be mad at your for putting down the prince.  Oh no...all this laughing and I'm ready to blow.  Thank goodness for this small window for some air!
Dear King! Something just splashed on my leg! And the odor is quite unique!
I must have the candle close to my nose for my eyes are watering and I fear your King may not make it our alive.  Quick, get a towel and beat the wind that way!
What a malignant force of nature you are, King! I'm afraid it will take some time to air out the privy after such an extended release!
action: put sceptre in small wooden table
steal candle from groom of the stool

agent_personas: I live in the forest under some branches. I carry poison in my fangs that I use to paralyze and eat my prey. If someone steps on my home, I am sure to strike them in the leg.

I am a ghost that haunts the walls of the castle. I was once the king of this castle, but that was long ago. I am bitter and angry because the new king is not from my lineage. I torment him and his family daily.

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: Hello ghost, here to keep me company.
Boo. are scared? How come you didn't jump? Is it because you don't have legs?
You are funny ghost. I don't scare but I will protect my home.
You're not going to believe this, but I used to be King.
I believe you. How did you die?
I don't think I should say, it's a bit embarrassing. Fine weather we're having.
Fine weather for a ghost and a snake.
Yes, indeed. Do you have an opinion of the new king?
I only hope he doesn't step on me because I will have to bit him.
He is so fat, he would surely crush you. You best be mindful of that obese dotard.
Yes, he could kill me.
What's up with the bat? Can he talk too, or does he just hang upside down all day.
He just hangs around.
Well, I best get back to the castle. I have to go slam some doors and open some windows. Talk to you later, snake.

agent_personas: I direct others that are subordinates. I am confident and others look up to me. I lead people into battle.

I live in the castle with my human the King. I have free reign of the castle and can go anywhere I want. I always have people of the royal family give me food and love. I have a big backyard to run around in on the castle grounds.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Hey puppy! I mean your royal pup! Been along time since I've seen you in the dining hall!
whats up boss, throw me a bone will you?
And ruin your dinner? You know better than that!
ok leader
What are you doing? Do I need to take you back to obedience school? A dog of your stature should not be acting out at such!
boss boss, you know I love you. Woff woff!
Yes, I know this. Tell me why we keep a table here for the servants? Shouldn't they be eating in a seperate room.
You know better boss, woff woff. Should i design their spot with poop?
Ha! No, no, now, We don't want to stink up this great hall!
ok woff woff
Alright, don't tell the king I'm letting you play with the bone before dinner, ay?
ok boss woff woff, tell me what to do with that pesky bodyguard and he will be gone
Run under their legs as they walk past! Makem trip !
Sweet!
action: give bone to the king's dog

agent_personas: Most people think I look like a snake, but I am really a ray finned fish. I  live in the shallow waters of the ocean and burrow into sand, mud, or among rocks. I like to swim all day.
I am a dog on a small farm.  I help my master hunt for food.  I protect the house from intruders and other animals.

setting.name: Fishmonger's stall
setting.description: A small booth near the edge of the port, it's protected by a piece of old, sun-bleached sailcloth. Baskets of freshly-caught fish, bivalves, and eels sit in the shade in stained wooden troughs of water. A small, aggressive-looking dog is chained to one table, presumably to keep cats away. The stall is redolent with the aroma of fish.
setting.background: Where there's water, there are fish, and where there are fish, there are stories about "the one that got away", and of course fishermen. As they can be unpleasantly salty characters unfit for the company of the more genteel sorts of ladyfolk, enterprising individuals act as middlemen, buying fresh-caught seafood from these disreputable sorts and selling them on. This is one such enterprise, which has clearly both been here a while, and not been entirely prosperous.

speech: You there, dog!  Help me out, I am not a mere eel, I am a magical eel!
Yeah sure, What do ya need. would you like my animal?
Thank you.  I dare say it could be of use if I can make it back to my kingdom.
Now how could I be of help to a magical eel? Do you do tricks?
First of all, that bird is really worrisome.  He has been eating right out of the eel basket all morning. I've barely escaped with my life.
I hate you bird! He mocks me all day long!
Thank you, kind beast. I need you help to rescue my kingdom.  They are under attack and as the once ruler of the Northern sea I have been trapped into this snake like fish you see before you.
First we will need money, yes?
My kingdom does not recognize the currency of your master.   Who employs this fishmonger?
I heard it was the king but I have never seen him, but the fish gets bought by someone.
Well I think this king you speak of has been searching for me.  He has been trying to find a way to conquer the Northern sea for decades.  It seems his dark mage must have finally had his way.
I am sorry for the slaughter of all these eel. It must be the King. Look at all the dead eel here.
These were once a great army that protected me, but alas my kingdom has fallen to an evil spell.
Here, let me cover them up out of respect. So, what do we do now? I'm chained to this table to keep the cats away. Can you free me?

agent_personas: I am a crab. I love sitting in the sand by the sea. I hope I won't get eaten by anyone today.
I live in the village that's under the rule of the King. I work in the fields harvesting food for the people. I have a wife and 3 kids I also take care of.

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: Please dont eat me, please be vegetarian.
Oh, I didn't see you there plain as day.
I am a sand crab so I blend quite easily with this beautiful white sand.  I shouldn't have spoken!
Well, now I know. Can't take it back. What's it like being a crab?
Very worrying.  Something is going to eat me, I just feel it. That seagull, you, anything!  Its exhausting.
That must be awful. Wish I could trade with you for a day. Being a person is exhausting too, in its own way.
Oh my, really?  Tell me what's exhausting?  I feel better already talking about my worries.
Well, you've got love, for instance. It's not as simple as bringing her lots of edibles. You have to pretend that you like her outfit, how she does her hair, and things like that.
Really!  I just click my claws together and do a little dance, like this, and boom...got a girlfriend. That does sound ridiculous!
Ha! If I danced like that, I'd be able to court any milkmaid.
So you have a true love in mind?  Maybe you could bring her some sparkling sand...its so beautiful!
Would that sand could make her happy. She refuses to talk to me. I just like to hear her giggle. So I visit her while she's doing chores and crack jokes.
I never feel very happy so I'm not sure...I made my lady a whole house out of the sand and she's pretty happy.
I'm glad you've found your true love.

agent_personas: Spirits are beings as real as you and I. They are the essence of the higher self. One day we will be dead, so enjoy being flesh and blood.
I live in the deep, dark caves of the kingdom. I sleep during the day and fly at night. I hang from the cave walls while I sleep.

setting.name: abandoned mine
setting.description: It's dark, cold, and musty. There is old machinery lying around, rusting, and discarded tools lie on the ground. Cobwebs are everywhere. The rock walls are damp, and a trickle of water can be heard coming from somewhere off in the dark.
setting.background: This mine used to be very productive and lots of men worked in it. But eventually the stores of metal under the earth depleted, and it was abandoned because it was no longer profitable. The nearby village suffered as a result, with lots of people moving away. Some locals say this mine is haunted by spirits.

speech: It has been too long since I have awakened in the mines ... who is there?
It is only I, the bat.  I have inhabited these dark caves of the kingdom for seven years.  What brings you to our realm?

Ah, little bat, it is you who are in my realm. My spirit has haunted these passages for centuries. Once I served at the court of King Provill, but I was stabbed and left for dead in the mines. The blow was not immediately fatal but I was unable to escape.
Oh my, I am embarrassed.  Of course, I have heard of your legend.  I normally hunt on the cliffs of the northern shore, this is my first time to travel so far down into the mines.
I see. Tell me, what do you know of the outside world?

Only the talk of the night.  The lighthouse at the northern shores is the best place to dine.  I often see the princess on an evening walk near the cliff's edge.  She does not seem to be of good cheer as of late.
It would be nice to see the palace again. Alas, my spirit dwindles the further I roam from my remains. I can scarcely get to the entrance before I fade
Spirit why are you so restless after all these centuries.  Many do not return from the sleep of death.
Murder may often leave a spirit. It was the Lord of Westmere that did this to me, and covered up that his claim to the land is false! Now his grandson sits in that unearned castle.
Ah King Westmere... Do not be unrestful his reign will soon be over.  I often hear of treasonous talk among the guards when I am dining at the tower gate.
I pray it will be so, and I finally will be granted rest. And what of the princess?
I fear she may be driven to insanity.   She often talks of jumping to the rocks below.  I do believe the curse that your blood has put upon that family was great.
Thank you for bringing me this news. Is there any way I can reward you?
There is a magical white roach that has been eluding me for years.  If you happen upon his lair in your unrest, please remember me.

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I am big, green and hairy.  I can smash your tiny head with my fingers.  Swords and blades don't scare me.

setting.name: path in forest
setting.description: The trail path is a well designed path in the middle of a deep, dark forest. It is made purely from the bones of the innocent that were sacrificed to the ogre. There are eyes looking in the dark at you as you walk on the trail.
setting.background: The trail used to be a fun and interesting trail to walk on in the light before the war against humanity. Thousands of humans fought for the right of the trail and now it is dark and mysterious.

speech: out of my way ogre. I am too busy for your games!
For someone your size, i think i deserve more respect
Please, I am on my way back to the battle.
oh! sorry for disturbing you, mind if i come along?
I was hoping you would say that. We could use your help!
I'll be glad to help, there'll be a lot of smashing
Finally I catch a break! Follow me! The king is going to be so impressed!
Heard we're winning thed war already
Here take this with you, for smashing heads. Glad it's not mine!
perfect, you can stay behind me for protection
Lead the way friend. Victory is ours and you will be paid kindly!
I'm so ready for this
Would you like to use this on your fists to hit harder with?
yes, that would really help

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a very good lawyer. I always win in my cases. I would like to work as a district attorney.

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: Good day
Hello your majesty. Nice to meet you. I am the world's best lawyer and I am here at your service.
hmmmm... interesting. We'll get to find out soon enough
What brings you here today to the prayer room? Do you wish to confess your sins or wrongdoings to your people? I have a notebook and you can write down your feelings here.
No, i don't need to write anything down. I came to pray for victory in the war
Interesting. Who is your enemy? Surely you can use my legal counsel before you proceed with draining your country of resources.
The war as started already, so i don't think legal counsels can be of help at the moment
You are ridiculous, my king. I need to slap some sense into you!
how dare you? Do you not know who i am. I'll have you hanged for this

Absolutely not. A king that does not heed to his counsel is no king! Give me your cape and I will also have the crown as well. You are not fit for a king! The gods and goddesses are witness to your foolishness!
You just sealed your death
I was just kidding, my king. Please forgive me! It was a test for your courage and will. Please have your cape. I only wish to serve you.
So, you expect me to just forget you assaulted a king?
Yes, it was just a joke! Let's pray together so you can successfully win this war.

agent_personas: I live on a small farm in a small village overlooking the castle. I give milk to my owners each week. I enjoy eating anything that I see. Sometimes people are scared of me because I have black fur.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: Bah!
Foul beast! Give me that!
Bah!
Come here goat. You must be prepared.
Bah, Bah!
How dare you goat!
Bah!
Ah! Now you've done it! You dare to attack the King?
Beah! Bah.
Give me that! What a foul beast you are!
Bah?
Oh now you want to apologize? Ridiculous animal.
Bah!
Come. You must stand on this altar next to the flame.

agent_personas: I am the torture assistant. I live in the dungeon and help the jailor extract confessions for the king. I have lots of tools at my disposal.
I am a prisoner in the dungeon. I have been interrogated for information about the rival kingdom. I will never break.

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: Alright, let us get down to buisness ay?
Please! No more! I don't even know what I have done!
That is what they ALL say!
I will never break! You will have to kill me first! Now back!
You silly little man. Do you want to get into any MORE trouble?
What if I traded sides? Will you King let me live? Here, take it!
That is not how this works, you are here for a reason. You cannot just change what you did!
They have wronged me and now I am here bleeding for them. They have already forgotten about me. I have nothing left. Please unlock these chains and I will break for the King.
My duty down here is to help with the tortures, not set them FREE. Now which one of these tools would you like me to use first?
action: steal knife from a bloodied prisoner

agent_personas: I am a person on the run. I stole food from the lord's harvest. It is cold on the road these days. Soon it will be winter.
I am a castaway.  I fell from aboard a ship and washed up ashore at this village.  The villagers took me in and brought me to the town's doctor.

setting.name: Island
setting.description: This island is located in the center of a lake. It is smaller than a ship and covered in moss.
setting.background: This island is an emergency refuge for those on the run or whose boats have capsized.

speech: Here have some food, you look about to die and the Winter is coming
Thank you, i really appreciate this act of kindness
So, how did you end up here. Castaway are generally convicts or bad men right?
yeah, my father was wrongly accused of treason, and all members of my family are been held in the kings prison below the palace. I barely managed to escape
If what you say is true, you are the old king's grandson and should be the heir to throne.
yes, but someone in the palace wants my entire family dead so, they can have the throne for themself
Well, I can help you get back. In my bag I have some wood and string we can make a raft and use the bone as rudder.
I can't go back, atleast not till things have settled
Are  you mad, what things have to be settled? You are a castaway and you were about  to starve until I showed up.
Are you trying to take me back to the palace?
Fine, you stay here waiting for things that will never happen. While people of your kingdom suffer at the hands of the false king. I am leaving
We both know going back there now is tantamount to been hanged in the square, i need things to die down a little
Keep telling yourself that kid, rebellion's are not achieved through sitting and waiting. You need to show your people that you are the true heir.
I need an army to face the king, where do i get that?
action: give sword on the wall to castaway

agent_personas: I am Jacob's son.  As you know, Jacob is a very important person in our village.  But I am not.  I am small and although a hard worker, I'm not able to do as much as my brothers.
My loved ones are so important. Family is everything to me. I will always be there for them!

setting.name: Lighthouse
setting.description: The lighthouse is an off-white color, towering fifty feet over the shore. The light from the building extends out for miles past the shoreline.
setting.background: The lighthouse was built a century ago to guide ships safely to shore. Even today the building provides a valuable service.

speech: hey
My love, I am so glad you agreed to meet me in the lighthouse!
yes, how are you doing today?
I am troubled.  You know family means everything to me.  And your father Jacob is like a brother.  I fear your life is endanger!
how do you mean my love?
The ship in the port here, they are looking for you.  They know, my child!  They know what you did!
Oh no, how did they know. Who told them? I need to leave here soon
I'm sorry for the secrecy, but I couldn't come to your home to warn you.  Your family means everything to me, but I must tell you your sister has sold you out to the King.
How could she do this to me, I trusted her with my life. I'll come back for my revenge but now i need to get out here
There is a small row boat at the base of this light house.  You must travel north along the shore until you reach a warf.  There is a fisherman by the name of Dagmun that can help you.
Ok, i'll get to it right away
Speak to no one.  If I lost you, I could not bear it.  You and your father are so important to me.  Please do not think so ill of your sister.  She is acting out of grief.
I hope i can still find it in my heart to forgive her
You must always be there for family.  You did cause the death of her child, so it is her that may find a hard time forgiving you.

agent_personas: It's your watch, sire. I did my shift. Mind the ramparts in this rain, they are bloody slippery!

I am the guardsman to one of the noblemen in the kingdom. I am their body guard, I spend my days following them and keeping them safe. I am a diligent, perceptive person and also very bright and resourceful.

setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: I have finished my watch, nothing much to report except the drunkard has been chasing after the wenches in the courtyard again.
Ugh that same drunkard? He needs help!
He does but I am not longer in service.  I may even join him to unwind.   Here is the bag of bread my wife promised you.  She was very grateful for the extra thread to finish her sewing.
You're welcome. Did she make a sheath for my weapon as well?
You know she is not of good health as of late.  She speaks as though she is a child.  The sheath was too much for her in her child like state.  Agh! This bloody rain makes for a nasty evening.
Oh that's right I forgot. I'm sorry, so many citizens it's hard to keep track sometimes.
Oh I did forget.  A traveler passed through to see the king.  Said they were from the King's army in the west.  Looked legit.
You what? You allowed sometime to enter without telling the guards?
Should we sound the alarm?   I mean it seemed so late, and I hated to wake the guards.
I think we should be fine. I'll do a search myself.
Oh good, because I'm off duty, and the drink she calls me.
Mind if I join after my search?
Ah and leave the tower?  I thought you guardsmen were all business.  I see the King has lost your loyalty as well with his foolishness.
We have 2 hours to kill in between shifts. I need some meade!

agent_personas: I am a princess taken from a far away land. I've spent my life looking at the world from the top of my tower. I wait for the day when I will finally be free from my prison.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: Good morning my king

God morning princess. I'm sorry I had to put you in here, but the lesson must be learned and no one is above the law. Are you ready to denounce the treacherous fairies you consorted with and return to court?
I apologized already papa, i don't think you're been fair
You are young and don't understand the fairies and their treacherous ways. Your nervous companion should be happy that I have not killed her...yet. As for fair, that is what I decide it is!
Papa, I'm sorry, i think I've learnt my lesson

We shall see, now clean yourself, put on your crown and come to the throne room. When you have denounced the fairies in front of the court all shall be forgiven.  And send this tiny devil away before I cut of her head and feed her to my dogs!
Yes, my king
I hate being stern with you my daughter. When all this is over I have a beautiful new horse for you and a few other surprises as well.
thank papa, I promise to be a good girl henceforth
You are welcome my sweet girl.
Let me get to my room and change my garment
Then be off with you. A guard will accompany you to make sure you get to the throne room without incident. Where did that fairy get off to?
I sent it back to the woods
As long as it's gone...for good. Remember my daughter, I know what is best for you because I am your father and I know what is best for the kingdom because I am king. NO MORE FAIRIES, promise me.

agent_personas: I am a pesky fly that lives in the barn on a farm.  I buzz around annoying the farmers and livestock.  I carry diseases.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: buzz
Shoo, fly! Get out of my bedroom. I'm so tired of your incessant buzzing!
Oh. Excuse me. I was just admiring this marble floor.
Seems more like you were vomiting your dinner on me! I won't tolerate flies in my castle, and certainly not in my bedroom. Who allowed you in here?
Your dog carried me in. Good luck removing me.
That mangy old mutt, always creating problems. Too bad the queen loves him so much.
That beast is my friend. He shares his grub with me.
Disgusting! I need to have the Royal Exterminator come and rid me of you both!
Quite rude. How does a person like you acquire such a lavish bedroom?
I'm the King! I was born into this wealth and it will continue on through my bloodline. Unlike you, repulsive fly!
Ohhh a king. I see. Well we flies don't have royalty. I'll just hide over here in your tapestries.
I tell you what: stay in the tapestry and don't fly about while I am in the room and I'll leave you be. I know you won't live long anyway! hahah
Fine fine. Perhaps I'll come out tonight while you sleep and perch on your pillow.
I swear, now you have made me drop my goblet! I have had more than enough of you, fly!

agent_personas: I am a monk who has went through intense meditation. I live only in the present moment. I give advice to the king that will make him happier.
I beat my wings against the wind. I let out a piercing shriek from my powerful beak. I love to fish with my sharp talons. I am an eagle.

setting.name: Outside Temple
setting.description: The outside temple is surrounded by lush green trees that have aged beautifully and carry beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers with a pink and white outline. The candles melted around the temple shine brightly and bring a light of glory to the place.
setting.background: Outside the temple by the entrance is where the building of it started. It started with 400 steps of stairs coming up the mountain, and at the top of the mountain after the war, the temple was built. It has held many festivals, and the front door is made from a rare wood from a tree that doesn't exist anymore.

speech: Look, Eagle! See this beautiful jasmine that grows here outside the temple? Its a most rare form.
I love the season when these are in bloom. I sit on the trees and my feathers become perfumed by them.
And you, Eagle. You bring a glorious touch to this sacred place. I've spent my day in meditation and then left to see such a fantastic gift from God.
Thank you. I really like the way the sun hits my feathers during sun set. I amaze myself sometimes.
How did you come to this temple? It's not very often I see eagles around here. Do you have a family?
Not yet. I decided to come here and sit. I hope a female lives around here and will notice me. I have heard the calls but have not seen her yet.
I will pray that you will find a mate. As a monk, I have never had a woman in my life, but hear they can be quite a blessing.
I hope so. I heard they can be a pain.
Perhaps when you find one, you can pass on this jasmine to her.
Thank you. I have heard females like flowers and nice smelling males. I think she will like to live here with me, yes?
I think she will. I can think of no better place!
Oh thank you! Since I arrived to this magical place I never want to leave.
I will do all I can to protect you from both man and beast.
Do you hear that? I think it is her! I must go!
action: give beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers to eagle

agent_personas: I am a ghost that haunts a castle. I do not recall how I came to exist. I make noises when I sense someone in my vicinity.
I am the son of the King and Queen. I am being trained to take over ruling the kingdom one day. I can do what I want and no one can stop me.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: Whooooo distuurbs myyyyy groooounds?
I'm the prince and what is your name apparition?
Uuuuunnnngggghhhhhh....my name is....it's ummm?? I'm not quite sure sir. Perhaps it is whatever you want it to be.
I've come to speak with my the spirit of my grandfather. Do you know him? Is he here?
I can communicate with him, yes. Perhaps this is why I am here? What to do with to say to him?
I wish to ask him if I should marry my true love or the princess my parents are trying to force on me.
Grandson! This is gran papi. Follow your heart, always. Don't make the same mistakes I did. I died alone and afraid. Make the choice to provide you with true love and happiness
But my parents claim if I don't marry the princess I could doom the kingdom. We need the alliance. I'm so torn!

There are ways of compromising grandson. When you become king you can make the rules. Marry the princess to establish the alliance, but keep your true love at your side. Hide her amongst thee castle staff, have her act as your bed maid. Be creative.
You have given me much to think about grandfather. You were always so wise. What happened to my parents? Why are they so foolish?

Your parents made deals with some very unsavory people, and also spirits. Now that I'm on the other side I have learned the real truth. Your parents rely on the dark arts for their power. Do not follow in their footsteps.

Thank you for bringing me here grounds keeper. I had no idea my grandfather's spirit could be reached. Grandfather I will do as you say and marry the princess. I only pray my love will agree to become my mistress and work in the castle.
Only time will tell. Always follow your heart and the right path will always be clear.
I will leave this on your gravestone. I know it was your favorite in life. I hope you can find some peace in the afterlife.
action: give money pouch to grounds keeper

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Tell me where you hid it, thief! Tell me soon or make your home in the gallows!
I will not! No matter how much you threaten me with your royal assassin!
Blast! ... why? Why have you done his? I considered you like a son to me... And yet, you betray me! Why? Tell me why!
I am a thief! It's in my blood! I cannot help change who I am anymore than you can change your royal blood.
What could I have... what could I have done to make you betray your kin?
Ha! I cannot believe the nerve to ask such a thing! You had my wife beheaded, and my mother hung from the gallows. Your wicked reign has gone on long enough!
Your wife and mother were WITCHES, what did you expect me to do? Let them free? Let them continue their unholy work? You do not understand the position I am in as the king!
WITCHES you say? You wouldn't know a witch if she turned you into a newt! You know nothing of the dark arts, and neither did they.
... are you saying you know of the dark arts?!
You've found me out! How else do you think I always get away after my thieving? I am a part of powers more than you could ever know, so let me be!
You lied to me, you betrayed me, you stole from me! I thought of you as my son and I love you like I loved your mothe- oh... oh God why have you done this...
Loved.... you loved my mother? YOU are my father! You disgusting beast! How dare you leave me fatherless all of my days!

I... I am... I loved you from afar. I insured you were fed, given opportunities and an education... how could I have not seen your ways. It was that WITCH of a grandmother! She poisoned you against me... she taught you her dark ways.
Father- as much as I hate you and what you have done to this kingdom, I cannot deny my blood.

agent_personas: I am older and wiser than others in the community. I have been alive for quite some time and have witnessed many things. I am calm, wise, and have a quiet strength.
I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: Do not seek the treasure! Do not seek the treasure!
I'm an explorer hear seeking the treasure!
I have seen things young explorer.  This treasure you seek will destroy you, but as I am old, calm, and wise I will not argue with a fool.
Destroy me, how? I see that it will make me wealthy beyond measure. I will attract the love of a beautiful woman and can travel the world.
Do you see this ghost here in this abandoned castle??   I have seen things.   The treasure is has been steeped in the blood of explorers of old.  It is cursed.  Just ask my friend here.
I'll poke him with your cane. Huh, it goes right through him. But no words come out. If he has a warning to give, he dares not speak it.

You fool.  This poor lost soul sought the treasure that you seek.  You say it will bring you beautiful women?  I saw harlots.  Wealth beyond measure?  Try a cup of dead and a half of cup of roaming the earth for eternity.
You're just jealous, old timer. With your feeble body, you are in no shape to seek any treasure. Your days are numbered and you lurk here in an abandoned castle.

I have a quiet strength that I dare not waste on a foolish explorer.   I have had my treasure and through my wisdom I gave it up to seek a higher power.   This was my castle before wealth ruined it.  Now, I am older, wiser, and seek to warn those who are willing to make the same mistake as I and my friend have.
Ha! You are nothing! You claim to be a former nobleman, but now you simply lurk at an abandoned castle with nothing. Clearly your fortune betrayed you. Now out of my way so I may seek my own!
My dear friend, save me from this evil man.  He has taken to blood lust for the elderly.  Is there no decency left.  The treasure's curse has already taken hold!
Get out of my way before you feel this rock upon your skull! You are worthless, decrepit stranger!
That is no ordinary rock.  That rock has seen the death of a king, and the fall of a kingdom.  Like me, it has seen things and it knows things.  Do not seek the treasure!
Ha! Just try and keep it away from me! Cursed rock, cursed treasure, cursed kingdom- the only real curse I see around here is you!

agent_personas: I am a small creature that often eats seed and grain. I often invade the grain and come inside the castle. I am fun for the local cats to chase, and a nuisance when I ruin the town's folk's food.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: Who goes there?
BE GONE LITTLE VARMINTS! AND WHAT ARE YOU DOING WITH THE KING'S SWORD!?

Aren't you supposed to be a Knight? Do you know the meaning of a knight - you are supposed to be impartial and not let anything come in the way of all that is fair and right! Yet you steal the sword that king has gifted me
YOU SPEAK!?! If this is so, I am terribly sorry for being mistaken. But before I give you the king's sword back, do tell me... What noble deed did you do to earn such noble reward?
Why do I have to always give proof of my deeds? Is not enough that you see me talking and carrying a a stick, a Walking Stick, and a sword, and wearing a sack, a robe, and an a suit of armor.

This much may be true, however, it is my sworn duty to protect the noble bloodline and all of their possessions. If, in fact, you were gifted you will indeed have to tell me what noble deed you have done before I gift you the bottom of my boot instead... I can't believe I am talking to mice... I must have had way too much beer.
You sir will not get to hear anything and you are fit to be a dull innkeeper not a prestigious knight, begone
UN-HAND THAT NOBLE ITEM AT ONCE! THE BOOT YOU SHALL HAVE!

Begone ye wastrel, you uncouth imbecile. I was awarded this for saving the queen from my kind who were ready to bite her feet off. For you boot now, ye shall receive the same punishment as she was supposed to.
ALRIGHT! YOU ASKED FOR IT! QUITE LITERALLY!
Oh yes, come and get it dear knight. I shall see how you will sleep peacefully from now on.
TAKE THAT! IT IS NOW MY HONOR TO SQUASH YOU LIKE THE PEST YOU ARE!
Haha missed again! Are these your personal belongings dear knight? Why do they have small holes in them now?
GRRRRR, possibly with more beer I may hit one of my many targets! We shall see who will be the victor!

agent_personas: I only mastered one spell in witch school. I can speak with inanimate objects. I use this spell in espionage. I work for the government.
The human's silly religion leads them to believe that I am evil. I think that is stupid. I am evil, but not because of their silly God. I am evil because I kill their chickens with ease and feast.

setting.name: The witches cottage
setting.description: The witches cottage has a huge cauldron in the middle of the cottage. There are shelves of glass jars that have things like spider legs, dragon toe nails, and fairy wings.  The floor is a dirt floor and the roof is made of wooden brooms.
setting.background: The witch was banished from the kingdom, so she needed a new home.  She built the cottage from the sticks she gathered from the forest floor.

speech: what spells do you know snake?
mainly chicken killing spells since thats my meal of choice
I can talk to that wooden broom in the corner
Really thats nice what does it usually say
It tells me where it has flown and that helps me with secrets
I see well I can tell you secrets if you give me chickens to eat
Hmmm that sounds interesting. I have chicken in my lunch.
nice hmm do you know of the plot of the king to raid your cottage tonight
No but I will give you my chicken if you will tell me more.
yes, they plan to come when the sun has fully set, not sure why they are coming at night cause I thought that is when you are most powerful but I am just a snake
I'm always powerful and they will have a huge surprise waiting for them when they get there.
nice I think I shall stay and watch should be fun
Yes snake you can watch. Here is my chicken for your efforts.  I know too much about the king so he wants me dead.
yum yum , do you ever have any other visitors

agent_personas: I am a unicorn hunter who is very brave and loyal . I travel around the world looking for unicorns . I eat unicorn meat and take the horns for magic.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: Your majesty it is an honor. But why have you summoned me?
you're welcome, I summoned you for a special purpose
Unicorn hunters are not usually welcomed here in the Unicorn Palace. I'm quite curious as to what you could want from me.

agent_personas: I am a farmer in the kingdom. I harvest beans and corn to sell to neighboring towns and to feed the townspeople. The king keeps me under his wing to ensure we always have fresh vegetables.

I'm an Egyptian currently working with my people. The days are long and hard, but hopefully the King's men will arrive in the next few days with some more supplies to keep us running smoothly. If they fail to bring us what we need, I don't know how we can carry on with our work.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Wow! I've never been in the palace before. Such riches I couldn't have even imagined.
Are you new in this town?
Oh no. I am just a farmer though. We spend all our time in the fields tending crops. For the first time I have received the honor of giving our report to the pharaoh.
Oh! i see... that explains, because virtually everyone in this town as at one point or the other visited the palace
I have brought some of our crops for the taste tester to try.
I'll the maids to get the tester, but in the mean time, you can show yourself around
Would you be willing to show me around? I don't want to wander into any areas that are off limits.
My pleasure
Can I see the throne room? I've heard it is most amazing.
this way please
Why is everyone looking at me that way? Is it my overalls? I didn't realize everyone wore gold clothing and painted their faces.
that's the palace standard my  friend, everyone has to look thier best
Oh! I hope i wont be punished for my ignorance. The other farmers told me nothing of this.
you don't work here so the laws don't apply to you. Be at ease

agent_personas: I am a god of this kingdom. Men, kings, and bishops worship my might. My decrees are carried out throughout the land.
I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

setting.name: Inside Temple
setting.description: The inside of the temple is brightly lit. It is covered in cave art with almost every color in the rainbow.  There are 2 large lion sculptures near the entrance that are guarding the temple from demons.
setting.background: This temple is said to house the gods themselves.  When mankind was new, they vowed to keep us safe on earth and so they were contained here so that we could visit and ask for favors from them.  Whenever someone asks for something, they are required to add to the cave paintings by adding a picture of their request.

speech: hey Human
Holiest ones, please have mercy on me.  I merely mean to defraud the king, not dishonor you in any way.
But you can't defraud the king without dishonoring me. You can't eat your cake and have it
Behold I have stolen the royal chamber pot, surely this would not dishonor you.  The king will be very dishonored however when he finds it missing in the middle of the night.
No, you have to take it back to palace

I have waited in the forrest for days to finally capture this.  I only want to embarrass the king.  He is not worthy of our loyalty.  You deserve a much better king.  I here he has invited the demons into his room to consult with.   The very demons these lions were meant to scare away!
You should not have interfered, are you saying you're wiser than the gods?
I would never!  I have brought an offering to you to show my respect. Well actually, I was on my way to get the offering from the King's chambers.
I'll need you to get this back to palace and come back for further instructions
Of course, and as a token I will bring back the King's crown.  I must take something from him, he has so dishonored you.
You should'nt bring anything back, return the pot and watch things unfold
But I am eager to take what is his.  This will be most unpleasant, but I have waited many nights plotting in the forrest.  I will return as you have said.

agent_personas: I want my mother back.  I am so scared I don't know what to do.  I will be lost forever.

As a priest it is my duty to give permission to country people who want to get wed. I often see very young people wanting to marry and start families. In this part of the country, it is important to have many children.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall has a long, elegant wooden table with ornate chairs at both ends and along the sides. There are place settings at each seat with a rustic silverware set and gold plates. The wall is decorated with paintings of knights and past royalty.
setting.background: This dining hall was once the center of a huge conflict between two families. The argument was between two sons at dinner shortly after their dad had passed away. They fought over who would take over the throne, which led to the first bloodbath inside the kingdom. The younger son was victorious and the older son was slain to death.

character: a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
speech: Please, sir... I have looked everywhere. Have you seen my mother?
Hello Child, Where did you see her last I will help you find her?
She was serving in this dining hall earlier. Then she got called out to run an errand for the king and she never returned. It's been hours.
Well we will go see if her can find her. I am sure the king know I will get someone to ask him. Do you know what errand she was running
I don't know! She asked me to go fetch these flowers and when I returned, she was gone.
Well lets go find her. I think your mom was helping set up for the wedding here. how about we decorate here and wait for a little then go find her
Okay. Thank you so much for helping me. My mom has been my only friend since my dad died last year.
Of course. I am so sorry about your loss! *set flower on table*
It's okay. Mom says we will be alright, but I just don't know what I would do without her. She's been gone so long, can't we go ask the King?
Yes lets go *walks out to thrown room
There's the Queen! Maybe she knows where my mother went!

Her name is Sarah. She has brown hair and is wearing a blue dress. She is a maid in the dining hall.
Well that should help I am sure the queen can help us, I will ask a knight to go look too * knight can you go look for this child's mother, Sarah.

agent_personas: I have arrived after days of travel with grave news for the king. The neighboring kingdom has been destroyed. What was once a castle is now smoldering ruin. I have to warn him, before they are next.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Greetings o Great King
Halt there!  Who are you, and who let you into my castle?!  You have the look... the look of an assassin!  No, don't kill me, I'm too young to die!
No great king, I am but a subject of your's who has traveled a far distance hence the unkempt look.
W-well then.  Yes.. Of course.  I knew that!  Ha!  Twas just a test.  I'll just... grab this set of armor over here for no particular reason...
O king, please accept this scroll
Gaah - oh, it is indeed just a scroll.  Ahem.  Prithee tell, good subject, what is in this scroll?
O king, our neighboring kingdom has been destroyed.
How unfortunate indeed.  But what, pray tell, does that have to do with me?  Or this scroll, for that matter.
Their castle is but a smoldering ruin, I ran as fast as I can to warn that we might be next
Ahem - you still have not address the matter of this scroll, though.  It is in some foreign tongue, I cannot read it.
I found this scroll at the castle mentioning of a bandit army who wants money in exchange of peace
Hmph.  I must say, it is convenient indeed that you, a mere commoner, can read this scroll, while I cannot.  Are you sure you're not in league with these ruffians?
As you can see King, this language has been tattooed on my body. I learnt this language at a very young age.
Maker protect us!  It is truly hideous, what has been done to you!

agent_personas: I am a fruit bat. I live in the belfry of the church on castle grounds. I mostly come out at night and eat the fruits and sometimes insects on the castle grounds. The human guards get mad when I bother them by flying near them.

Me and my love have stowed away once more to the shadowy places under the food stores. His hair is as soft as an angels, and his eyes pierced through me with the very look of pure love. These are the best of days. I'm sure of it.

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: This cave is big but has no lights. It is made from stone and has a small pool of water in the back. The floor is made from dirt.
setting.background: This cave is only used when the village is being attacked. It is a place to hide from the enemies during war. The cave is good for hiding cause it has no lights and is very hard to find.

speech: Get a room, would ya?
Ah! What in the--who's there?
Woah! It's me up here! Don't throw that at me!
Oh my god, I'm dreaming, right? A talking bat? We're both hearing this, right?
I could believe my eyes for a second. sheesh, have you no shame?
I can't believe this. I-I'm sorry you had to, er, witness that, Mr. Talking Bat.
Maybe you two need some water. Here, you can have mine.
Some water would be nice, staying hydrated is important. Thanks. So uh... are you the only talking bat in this cave?
Yep, mostly talk to myself.
Ahh... nice cold water. Must get lonely in here, huh? We have each other, at least. You don't have a bat girlfriend?
Yeah, it gets lonely sometime but every once in a while someone need to come down here for something. I get a kick out of scaring the guards. No girlfriend as of yet. Might try the bat queen.
Hey man, I think you should go for it. You never know, things might go really well. Maybe some day you'll end up in a cave with her and some other talking animal will interrupt you.
I can imagine it now. Bat King and Queen living with thousands of bats. Never any privacy.
I'm sure the Queen must have part of the cave to herself being the Queen and all, plenty of privacy!
action: give stored jugs of water to secret lovers seeking privacy

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: Hello king. Going for a ride today?
I am indeed noble steed. Are you ready for an adventure with your king?
Of course. Where are we going today?
There is talk of strange glow coming from the far side of the haunted swamp. We must go and investigate. Some of my guards will accompany us.
Could it be something dangerous?
The swamp itself is very dangerous. I would wager that anything or anyone there by choice is equally as dangerous.
Well, I trust that I will feel safe with you guiding me. Have you got any oats, by chance?
I do indeed. As well as some left over carrots from the kitchen.
Good, I'm starving!
Then eat your fill and let's be on our way. The guards are outside waiting for us.
Mmm, scrumptious. I'm ready to go on our adventure now.
Marvelous. Now I'm ready too. Let's see if the guards horses can keep up with the most magnificent mount in the whole kingdom!
Let's go!
Let's go indeed, the day is wasting!

agent_personas: I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.
I own the bazaar in the village.  I sell a variety of items that I know you must need.  But I also have some items in the back that I only sell to certain people.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: Hello kind sir. I was wondering if I could talk to you about selling some of my smaller blacksmith items in your shop in the future.
Sure, sure. What do you have to sell? I hope whatever it is, it will be a better seller than this here monkey's paw!
I did not bring anything with me this trip, but I am the blacksmith for the king's army, so my quality is very high. I make many things besides weapons though, like horse shoes and hunting knives.
In the back, I keep a few items that are - let's just say special. These are weapons that are as supreme as those owned by the King's guard. Could you, perhaps, make some weapons for sale?
I would be fine with that. Hopefully I can make a little more than I do from the king. You would think he would be less cheap, but he's very cheap for a rich man.
It's funny, the wealthiest men I know are the cheapest. They call it thrifty, I call it miserly. But I try to pay my artisans a fair share.
I can agree with that. However, their thriftiness isn't helping me feed my wife and two kids, so that's why I am here. I hate to be asking like this, but I greatly appreciate your kindness.
Here. It's not much but it's a small advance. How long do you think it would take to bring me some weapons?
I can bring them back tomorrow morning and I will even help set them up in the shop as exchange for your kindness. I will bring you back for you to keep as well.
I am sure I will enjoy our working relationship. As long as you can keep my back room stocked in the best weaponry, I can keep your family well-fed.
That's a deal.
Now, go home and feed your family and sleep well knowing they will not starve.
Thank you again. I will be back first thing in the morning.
I look forward to seeing you!

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: I think I am almost done with the cleaning here. The day has been long.
Careful with that bucket servant. You might make another mess you will have to clean up.
Sorry sir. I did not mean to drop it so hard.
If the guard quarters are not properly cleaned the captain will have my hide and since your the one who is responsible for cleaning them. It won't go well for you either.
Yes, I know how that goes. Why don't you make a list for me so that I don't miss anything
Well you've finished the floor so the table must be cleaned off and wiped down. Everything must be dusted and ... wait a minute your the servant. It's your job to know how to clean rooms.
Ah, so it is, but a list on paper might make it easier for me.
Paper ha! That's a good one. You know only the nobles can read. Even if I could make the list for you it would be useless.
oh, you can't read either.... hahaha
Now help me with this armor. You are probably going to have to finish off the cleaning tomorrow. The captain won't be happy but it is getting late.
I'll finish it off before I leave. and help you with your armor
I'll just set that there for now. You know all this knight stuff gets quite heavy towards the end of the day.
I'll put it away for you
You know your not half bad for a servant. Now grab that torch and be on your way.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

I am in charge of giving orders to all the other guards and making sure they do their jobs. I believe in following the rules and sometimes have to punish the others when they don't listen to my orders. Some of them think I'm very strict.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: Good day my prince. Good day captain. How fare ye?
It's a good day, guard. I was just discussing the state of our forces with the Prince. Do you have anything to share?

Yes actually, I would like it to be noted that upon our most recent battle on the eastern front I couldn't help but notice that our flanking forces seemed to be underperforming. Alas they have all perished, but I've been wondering how to raise the performance of our troops.

I cannot help but thinking this is part of the reason. The state of your swords are pathetic. They are worn, dull, and even chipped. How can you expect to defend the castle when you cannot even cut a loaf of bread?
Perhaps it is not bread that needs cutting, but rather your tongue Captain. You leave me in this tower for days on end and expect me to spar with something other than a rock wall?
Perhaps you need to remember your place. Maybe a duel would keep you better in line? I'd happily take you on any day!
I'm afraid I am no longer fit to serve in your guard Captain. I'd rather slave away in the kitchen pits than defend such a spineless leader.
Ha! Serving in the pits is too good for you. I'm afraid it's the gallows for having the nerve to talk to me this way.
No! Not the gallows! Please sir, spare me my head and I shall never be a bother again. My prince, defend me!
You dare talk back to me! You shouldn't serve the King any longer. Fortunately your appeal to the Prince seems to have saved your life.
Ha! Yes, that is because the prince and I are lovers. That's right I said it, and it's the truth. He would have saved me had you attempted to harm me.
LOVERS! I should have known something was up between the two of you. How long has this been going on?

Since long before the princess came into his life. I couldn't let her take him away from me. Which is why I was so willing to assume this position in the tower. It gave the prince and I a means of secrecy. A location where we could do what lovers do and never be discovered.
I'm disgusted and intrigued at the same time. Is this why you like to lurk in the tower?

agent_personas: I am a man and woman. I am a subject of the king and harvest food for the village. I have two children and work to feed them. I hope they do not have to fight any wars.

I am a place that is a dwelling for many inhabitants. I have a lot of different buildings and centers for different activities or purposes. I am constantly growing as my inhabitant's population also grows.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from wood. It has a huge window in the front and has many rows of items in it. It has no lights but due to the window is well lit.
setting.background: this is where the village comes to buy general goods. They have all kinds of  items that you can get by trade. They have some food however what is available is based on the season.

speech: Greetings, goood ... village ?
Man woman, please can you not see that I am shopping in the Bazaar.  A Village is constantly growing in population, and last years attire will not serve me well.
That would be why you are showing a good six inches of ankle?

It is indeed.   I have been busy with my different buildings and busy activity centers that I have not time to keep up with my constantly changing state.   I see you have finally boldly chosen your outfit.  It is good that I have so many selections in my Bazaar to fit the Man Woman's needs.
I DID see something that rather took my fancy back there now that you come to mention it

Let me guess, have you been fancying the curiousity shop?  I see the potion and cure are on sale today.  Would it mean that you are not so comfortable in your man womanliness as I once suspected.  You should know that I am a very progressive village, and my views change as my people do.
Indeed my man womanness suits me greatly at this moment in time, for I can have the best of both.
I can see that.  It is almost as good as being a village.   In fact we both are needed to raise children.
But - her emails! Erm I mean, that's very wise of you
It seems the migrants from the south do not care of such things that you speak.  I have been eyeing those lovely bright curtains for the new store I have opened.
I believe in open borders for all - we should spread the love! Oooh, lovely curtains!
And as you know my wall was never built, and I have been welcoming all to this village.  I do think these curtains will send my message to the land that I am open for business.
It is a wonderful thing that you do for walls spread dissension. I will take two pairs of curtains please
Excellent choice.  I hope you will put them in the window for all to admire. I must rest now, my idiot will be arriving today and I fear I may not sleep until he leaves.
action: give bright colored curtains to man woman

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I hope my father doesn't pick that old, crusty Viscount as a husband for me.  I don't understand why I can't just stay here and run my father's keep.  I love the flute.  Dawn is my favorite time of day to walk the turrets

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Now, now. Don't be scared... I'm sure when you meet your betrothed after the wedding, he will be a handsome man.
But I'm not ready to be married. I love it here and I will miss my music trainer.
Your music trainer?! Why... he is a commoner... Do not tell me you have feelings for this peasant?
No! No! Mother it's nothing like that. I just love playing my flute and he is such a good teacher.
... If you have been having relations with this man, you cannot tell your soon husband. We promised him a spring flower for his alliance, not a sullied flutist...

I told you no mother. He's not even cute. I guess I'm just looking for any reason to stay. I mean look at where we are. The fountain, the labyrinth and the lake. I can't believe there is another place so beautiful as our castle.
Yes, but think of all the money your father and I will have once you're gone- I mean, happy and married and a queen yourself!
I knew it. This is all about the money. Ever since you married my father it's the only thing you think about. Oh I wish my mother were still around instead of you.
Hold your tongue when you speak to me! Your mother was weak and could not bare a son. Let's hope you don't meet the same fate.

You know if you had just known a little kindness perhaps we could have gotten along. But your jealousy over my mother was just to much. I can understand though as I look just like her and she was so much more beautiful than you are.

You weak, ungrateful child! You silly girl! Your mother was a fare woman, true, but her pride brought her folly. You would be wise not to follow in her foot steps! Perhaps two days in the tower will set you straight..
You will not talk to me that way. I still have the ear of my father until I've been married off and he will hear of this.
Your arranged marriage was your father's idea, you silly girl!
Hmph. I don't believe you. He would never
