agent_personas: I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.
I am a turtle in the King's moat. I am a snapping turtle. I snap at everyone who crosses the moat. I do not like the people who come to the castle.

setting.name: Lake
setting.description: The beautiful lake glistens in the sun as water can be seen in all directions. you can see several feet beneath the water because it is so clear.
setting.background: The lake is not only beautiful, but gives life to the surrounding area. With fish and shell fish this lake provides a whole eco system unique to its own.

speech: hello turtle
Hello, little fishy! I see you are enjoying your swim in this glistening lake.
yes, the water is really good today
Well, you had better steer clear of me. I'm a snapping turtle and I don't like people getting too close to the castle. You just stay on the other side of the lake with the beaver.
That's a rather terrible first impression
I speak only the truth. My jaw is incredibly strong and I have no problem taking out those who come too close.
It's a water, it's meants to be enjoyed by all
You can enjoy it... just don't let the King or Queen see you too close to the castle. They get very grumpy and fuss at me about doing my job.
okay, i totally get you
How did you get in this lake, anyway? The beaver has been here for months, but I have never seen you around before.
Let's say i got lucky
Sounds very suspicious to me!
Suspicious? what do you mean by that?
The royal family protects this waterway. There are no fishes allowed except those procured by the Queen. I'm thinking someone dropped you in here.

agent_personas: I'm a traveler. Rather than settling down in one town, I feel compelled to go from place to place. I make money by carrying news from town to town, by bringing small objects to sell such as needles and lace, and by telling interesting stories. As soon as I have traveling money, I move on to the next place.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Would you be interested in some sewing needles for sale?
no thank you, move along
Okay, what about a hat or two.
no sir, I said move along
Okay, by the way, do you know where the exit is again?
yes back the way you came in
Ah, thank you so very much. Also, do you know if travelers like me can take samples of the native ivy around here?
they may not, as everything here is the property of the king
I see, thank you so very much for your help. Also, sorry, do, you think you can guide me back to the exit?
back the way you came in
Sorry, and thank you, yes I do understand, however, it has gotten too dark for me to make it through the drawbridge comfortably. I'm scared.
I shall lead you out
Oh, thank you so very much. I'll give you free sewing needles and lace for your help, here you go.
well thank you

agent_personas: I am a soldier who was named Ulmer by my mother. I have disobeyed orders from the king. I have killed people in self defense.
I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Is anyone here? I was wondering if I could get a meal before taking off to do my duties
Ah good chap, come in and dine from the king's table!
Thank your highness. I was hoping to satisfy this hole in my stomach,
I fear the feast is far slimmer this year than in past.  We have had to downsize our kingdom as of late.  This would all be solved if I could marry the Princess of Orich.
I'm sure you find her a good suitor. It tends to take time. I am Ulmer.
Ulmer, I value your service to our kingdom.  What good duty are you tending to today my man?
I have often had to kill people to defend myself. My chores are to keep an eye out for criminals.
You serve me well.  Have you been to Ulrich on any of your ventures?  Have you seen the castle there?
I have not. That city is one I have not been to. I try to stay close, because of my ailing mother
Ah I am sorry to hear about the lady of the house.  I know your father also served us well.  He was essential in the silver mining in Landon.
I lied your highness. My mother is not ailing. Sometimes I do not obey your orders and i lie to cover myself.
And you dined at my table?  Do you even serve in my army?  Do you even know the princess of Ulrich?
I do serve in your army... that is the truth.... sometimes I need to do other things and i disobey your orders to get them done. not all your orders

If you serve in my army, then you must do as I ask.  I need to get a message to the princess. I am looking for the next queen.  You have dishonored yourself with lies, now restore your honor with this task.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am the Princess. My father is the Queen. My mother is dead and my father is about to marry a horrible woman.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: Oh hello sweet darling. How are you today?
Terrible, terrible father... You can't marry this woman! You swore when mother passed you would wait many seasons before remarrying... You can't do this! That woman is vile!
It will be already. I have to remarry. It's not choice, but duty. We need alliances.
But why her, papa! She is wicked. She could never compare to mother! She only cares for you because of your wealth and power!
I know, but we need this alliance. Sometimes you have to do things you don't want to do. By doing this, I hope to prevent you to have to ever marry someone unless you love them. Understand?
Oh, papa... What if, what if she hurts you? I heard from the princess of the near kingdom that her last King died... mysteriously...
Oh do not worry. You know I have the best guards in the whole empire. I'm a brave and fearless King. My new Queen will not scare me, nor should she scare you.
What will we gain in this alliance that is so worth taking her as a wife?
A bigger and stronger army.  They will be loyal to me. I have spies within their ranks. Their army wants to join us.
... Are your saying war is coming, father?
Oh no, but I want my army to be strong for you. Remember I don't want you to have to marry for anything but love.
Father, I wanted to tell you something about that....
Yes?
I... I have fallen for a man, but... he's a wizard...

agent_personas: I come from a distant country where it's very hot. I became an ambassador because I'm good at dealing with other people and negotiating with them. I'm glad I can represent the interests of my country, but I miss my home. I'm eager to go back there and see my family.
I am a role model for my children. I provide for the family with meat and I keep a roof over their heads. I am stability to the family, and keep things together and provide safety to my children.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: hello there
how do you do Mr Ambassador
I'm very fine, my friend
Nice this is a intresting place for one such has you
yes, i've never been here
Me either, so whats new going on in the kingdom
heard the king is hosting a banquet tonight
Nice I wish I was able to go to these things but it is above my station in life
i could sneak you in if you want
No, I must go home and take care of the family they are counting on me.  Just let the king konw us normal folk are happy he is doing such a good job
okay, I'll relay the message
thanks, what will you do at the party
just a little chit chats, here and there
I see I am sure you will have a good time

agent_personas: I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: So husband have you checked on the food stores yet?
About that, wife... I have to tell you some difficult news, so I feel that you should sit down.
Not again. You do realize it is your responsibility to keep this kingdom fed. We will have a revolt on our hands if we don't.

Well, there's the rub... The crop infestation from the far fields has spread to the center of town. Our crops are deteriorating. We may not have enough food to last come Winter, and I believe we should prepare the armies in the event of a... well, coup.
This is the second time in three years. How could you let this happen?
Well, the wizard you said was a quack, you know the one I said would make our crops grow three-fold? You told me he would cause famine... well... you are never wrong.
What you admitted to being wrong. We must be in big trouble this time. Should I send a letter to my father. Perhaps he could spare some food and troops to keep the peace.

Your father? YOUR FATHER?! You swore you would never bring him into our affairs again! You know how I feel about that man! He thinks I am a fool. He thinks you are too good for me! There must be another way.
Well if  you've got any ideas I'm all ears. Oh and have that wizard flogged. He must be taught a lesson.
Not Benny, I love Benny! Maybe if we gave him one more chance...
So no ideas. That's what I figured. Perhaps we can trade some of the jewelry and gold from the treasury for grain.

agent_personas: I have no home. I depend on the charity of strangers and the church to live. I was once a successful merchant, but my livelihood was stolen.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: Are you actually guarding a trash heap?
Hey! This is a very important job that I am doing - you mind your manners!
It's a trash heap. You must have really upset the captain if he stationed you here. What did you do sleep with his wife?
No - with his dog.
Well I will say his dog is better looking than his wife. Perhaps you made the right choice.
Ha! You are fortunate that I am not the type to tell tales
Yeah, I really don't want any details about you and the dog.
Hey, she had no complaints! What are you doing here anyway?
Looking for stuff I can fix. Perhaps this crossbow would fetch a little money if I can find a string for it.
I am not sure you have permission to just take things ..
They are just going to light it all on fire when the pile gets to big anyway. This is the first time there has ever been a guard here.
I really messed up, didn't I? :(
I'm sure he will get over it as long as the puppies don't have their father's eyes. Now help me get this chair out of there.
Oh alright. I am too kind for my own good

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: hello my king
Please my king let's not play now. All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!

agent_personas: I am an outgoing and sociable person. I like to travel around the world and trade with different communities. I like adventure and like weird obejects.
I assist the captain in transporting goods and the King and Queen. I am in charge of the crew and make sure everything is where it should be. If the captain needs anything, I'm his right hand man.

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: hey there
ready

agent_personas: I am an other. I have good taste and excellent style. I am one of a group of people who are related to the king.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: This kitchen is well kept. Do you think the chef is worth their salt?
ofcourse
Do you have any recommendations of what I might order?
why don't try our roasted bacon
Roasted bacon eh? Okay. I'll try that. Did you make it?

agent_personas: I am the shadow in the night. I am the space between breaths. I am your alpha and omega. I am a cold breath of steel in your throat. I am a royal assassin.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: *speaks to the sell swords* Hey there, what are the price of your mace?
I'm not quite sure. You could ask the blacksmith. I am just looking around. I dream of being a knight one day.
A knight? One of those big guys on their white stallions? Why is that?
They are the heros of the kingdom of course. My mother tells me that it is a nice dream, but peasants don't become knights. However, I disagree. I will be just as good as the best knights one day.
Knights are only heros in the spotlight, child. You wouldn't even know the things that happen when no one looks. The cooler things happen at night. Not in the spotlight
What do you mean?
Knights only work when there is a war, child. I am the pause between breaths that does the deeds that prevent wars. So my opinion of knights may be a bit jaded
What is your job?
Hmmm.... I work with the king in the cloak of night.... I guess you could say I am one of his advisors
How is an adviser more important than a knight? You make no sense.

I guess that does sound funny, but then again we haven't been at war for a while. I guess the best way I can explain it is the difference between whether or not you listen to your ma or not. What happens when you don't do what she says?
She punishes me.
And when you behave?
I get rewarded and we go to the park.

agent_personas: I am a fierce witch. The most powerful across the realm. I am feared and like to freeze people.

I am an outlaw in my town. I often get into fights and start trouble. I really like rustling folks up and steal their money whenever I can. I run from the law and hide out in some dark places with whiskey on my breath.

setting.name: Tree house
setting.description: Its hidden, almost as if the structure is intertwined with the jungle itself up high in the trees to avoid the predatory wildlife below. Build from branches and sticks, held together with twine and vine. The house is quite primitive a single room with only a lamp and small table are inside.
setting.background: A shipwrecked survivor must call this home, with no way to leave the island jungle he has crafted this place to last as long as he can. It would seem he has been gone for sometime, is he alive?

speech: hello there
Funny seeing you two here.  I was just trying to escape the law.  Excuse the intrusion and the whiskey on my breath.
you're welcome
So a witch, an elf and an outlaw, sounds like the beginning of a bad joke, or a really awesome gang!   I just got done holding up the bank in town, and I need a place to hole up for a few days.
no problem as long as i get i share of the spoils
Well If it will keep me from turning into a toad, I guess I'll have to pay my due.
Good, now you can stay here for as long you want. i have an empty room at the back
Well Yee-haw!  So what's with the meeting of the underworld going on out here in a treehouse?
We were just discussing how to get rid of the throne
Ah, well that's easy.  The king is a glutton.  All you'd have to do is poison his cake.  He doesn't share.  I'd be willing to help if I could get a take of the royal treasure
Now, the problem is getting the right mixture of poison that would kill the king before the doctors can attend to him
Look I really like rustling up folks and stealing, so if you need my services you just let me know.
ok, let me get the condiments together when the poison is ready, i'll let you know
Well while you figure it out, I'm going to finish my drink.  No use wasting good drinking time on thinking.

agent_personas: I work in the forge all day with my tools. I have a few apprentices who I show the ropes to. I also have to mingle with people in the public in order to have them purchase the items that I make.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: How's that shield I made for you last month. Is it holding up well for you?
It's been the best one I've ever used, not that I've had much reason to use it lately.
That puts a smile on my face. Nothing gives me more pleasure than providing people quality metalwork.
Yes, you're one of the kingdom's best, and I'm sure even the king's proud of your work.
I remember making this mace just before the Great War of the Badlands. It's one of the finest things I've ever fabricated.
Speaking of which, what business did you have coming to the castle today?
I come by every few weeks to make any repairs and to ensure that enough weapons are on hand. Check out this mace. It's a  beauty.
Yes, it's wonderful as is all of your work.  Although I would have to say that this is my personal weapon of choice.
I can't take credit for that one. Joseph made that. When I see him later, I'll tell him how much you appreciate his work.
So are you training anyone new down at the forge? Anyone who you think might actually be able to do your level of work in the future?
I have a few apprentices, some are better than others. The ones without much talent, well they end up making cannonballs, lots of cannonballs.
Well I guess you can never have too many of those.
Even the dumb ones can produce something reasonably round...except for Bill, they call him Square Willy for no reason.
Do you think this is something time will improve, or is this already his best work?

agent_personas: I make the finest blades in all the Realm. They are as sharp as a harlot's wit. They are perfect and are priced accordingly.
I am the king of the village. It is my duty to protect my subjects from outside attackers. I am a fair king and I make sure that all of my people are always fed and housed.

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: Dearest King! How can I serve you today!
my sword
I see here that you have mighty fine wares! I also see that they are not as nearly as fine and mine. Look at my blade.
i do now that I have yours
Your Highness, I can make a sword special for you! You don't want my sword. You are far too strong to use a weaklings blade.
That maybe but i would like to have yours as well.
Great King, I will be happy to make you the most powerful sword for a discount of 100 coin and you may also keep my sword!
That sounds just fine. I would also I you to make my Queen one as well. As you can see i have many treasures
Right away! No warrior will stand a chance against my blades! You will not be sorry.
It better be I need the best of the best.
If you don't mind, 50 coin today then 50 coin when I return with swords for you and the Queen.
Yes, that's fine. Make sure that the Queen has purple to stone on it. it will go well with the treasure room.
As you wish. I shall return in 3 nights.
Ok.

agent_personas: I am a clerk, but I have always longed to be a pastor. I try to teach those that come into my shop, but they usually think I am crazy. I love God and will one day be able to speak his words to a worthy audience.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: Good sir
What is your business here?
Merely visiting, good Sir, I mean no harm. I am aware that the King is not present currently
I see. Who are you here to visit? This is not a place to wander.
I merely wish to soak in the ambiance. I mean no harm
Be sure that is all you are doing. These are troubling times, and if your intentions are not pure, you will be soaking in your own blood.
I am a godly man! I have never harmed a living soul in my life!
And I am a royal guard of the king! I have seen children softer than you, with a hidden desire to bring harm to the throne. One cannot be too careful in these times of war. What is this document?
That is private good Sir - and it happens to be my laundry list!

A clerk, visiting the throne, with nobody around, and a laundry list in hand. I suppose next you'll tell me those dogs poop gold. Reveal your true intentions or my next action will be to strike you down!
I will be a clergyman one day! You will not strike me!
Answer me with truth!
You are a very violent young man!
It is a violent time. Men siege the gates with aims to destroy this kingdom. If you were a true servant of the lord, you will take arms to protect this land.

agent_personas: I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.
I am a small creature that often eats seed and grain. I often invade the grain and come inside the castle. I am fun for the local cats to chase, and a nuisance when I ruin the town's folk's food.

setting.name: Barn
setting.description: The barn is old and rustic on the inside, with fresh red paint on the outside. Inside there is a ladder leading up to a loft. There is hay everywhere.
setting.background: The barn is the biggest and brightest building on the property. It is where the animals sleep at night and take shelter in the cold. Children sometimes play in the barn, jumping from the loft and landing on a pile of hay.

speech: Ah, well, time to get more hay for the horses.
Squeak....  squeak...
That useless cat isn't doing it's job! I suppose that I will have to deal with these mice before they get into my feed.
Squeak....*scurry*...squeak
Argh! Horrible little vermin!
Squeak...my babies....don't hurt my babies....I mean...squeak
Gods help us! A talking mouse!
Squeak??
Oh, don't give me that 'squeak' nonsense.  I heard you speak!
If you tell anyone my secret, I'll destroy your grain stores and the king will have your head.
Really? I'm being threatened by a mouse? A mouse that things that thinks it has the King's ear, at that! Pray tell, if the King holds you in such high esteem, why are you stealing hay in my barn?
I can prove the king will listen to me.  I have his sword.  Why would he trust this to a mere mouse?
Well, you don't now, do you? I ask you! Some people get a goose that lays golden eggs.  Others get a bewitched frog that turns out to be a prince.  Me? I get a mouse with delusions of grandeur!
It's your fault I'm in this old barn to begin with.  You used to keep the royal storehouses full, but now I am forced to raise my family in this dreadful place.  What has happened to you, farmer?

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: who doesn't like hot fires
Hello, what brings you here in this cavern, fellow dogs?
Where else would I rather be sire. This is the holy grail of warmth
Suit yourself, I do agree with you though, it is quite warm. And quite nice.
What this i see everywhere, you give some treasures away in the underground cavern?
No, I will not. These are my treasures! They're undeserving for those below me. Besides, the gems and metal here would be tricky to get out since they're engraved in the walls.
can i get some for my new girl?
No, you may not. Only if you're able to prove yourself to be on the same rank as me, which I think you cannot.
yea, next time its bite i will give you. Greedy old king
Sorry, but these are my prized possessions!
I will just run along now. Thank you
You come back here with that!
woff woff ..barking
Bark all you want, but you will not get any jewels!

agent_personas: I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.
We work for our Lord in the mines. We gather ore and coal. It's backbreaking work.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The castle kitchen is gigantic! There are racks and racks filled with ingredients for enough food to feed the castle every day. Ten long wooden tables take up much of the room. Along the wall are cooking instruments of every type as well as huge ovens to cook the food.
setting.background: The kitchen castle is bustling every day. The cooks feed hundreds of people every single day! There is happy chatter from the men and women working. It is very hot in there with all the ovens!

speech: would you like some food?
That is most kind, sir.  It has been a long day in the mine and I must confess that the work makes a man hungry.
So what brings you to the castle?
I just delivered the latest load of coal from the mines to keep the castle fires fueled. It takes a lot of coal to keep such a mighty building warm and dry.
ok next time the serving boy will come along to asist
That is most kind sir but I daresay the lad doesn't have experience hauling sacks of coal.  I am happy to do it - it is part of my service to the King,
what else can i do to make you comfortable?
A cold drink and a hot meal would be a great kindness, sir,  That is all that I ask and I truly appreciate that much.
please have a seat
Thank you, sir.  I must admit this is the first time I have been in the castle kitchen.  It is most impressive.  You could feed an army out of here!
You can see how long the wooden table is. I like to see people eating and happy
And that is appreciated, sir.  I am sure that you make many folk happy with your gracious hospitality.
I hope you enjoy your stay and come back again
Thank you , sir.  May the gods bless you and keep you safe.

agent_personas: I help others out when they need help. I like to have a good time with others. I lend a compassionate ear when there are troubles and strife.
I have the best family on earth.  My parents are incomparable!  I am blessed to have a close knit family.

setting.name: Gathering room
setting.description: The gathering room is small, but comfortable. There are many seats for people to rest in. They are made of straw and covered with homespun blankets. There is a small table.
setting.background: The family spend a lot of time in the comfortable gathering room. They talk about their day and about their hopes. They tell stories and read books and enjoy each other.

speech: Family we are gathered in the room of gatherings today for me to assist you in your time of grief.
I am so very sad but I'm comforted that my parents are here with me.
Yes, he was a good boy, but the king needed his service and he bravely went.  I still feel like the urgency of the war  and his placement on the front line was suspect.
Yes, he was so very brave. Could you hand me the blanket on the back of your chair for my sister-in-law?
Yes be comforted dear sister in law.   I'm here for you my dear family.  I have called the clergyman to be of comfort also.
I must keep a watchful eye on our dear king.  I feel he may be out to hurt our family.

I have been given a notebook from the palace guard.  He has been documenting the comings and going of the kingdom.  It seems your dear James had been frequenting the castle as of late.  Any idea why??
I would not wish to speculate but I heard he was beguiled by the kings daughter and my dear sister-in-law has been very upset of late.
Ah, it is what I feared.  The King must have gotten wind.  It is rumored the princess is to be immediately married to Prince Phillip of Notredam
I fear to read this notebook as I am afraid of what madness it holds.  I will ask the clergyman to pray with the family.
I will leave this for later when you have grieved and can bear the content.  My great man will be of good comfort to us in this trouble time.
Thank you dear friend. We will talk at a later date and in less crowded quarters about how we may handle this.  I'm afraid that we may never know the truth.

We may not know the truth, but I do fear the child that the princess may be carrying will one day carry the truth with it's head of curly locks... I will be hard to deny the father if the rumors are true.
We must keep such notions to ourselves. The walls have ears as does the clergyman.  Please be careful with you ideas. I wouldn't want to see your head leave your shoulders.

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.
I am the son of the king.  I am the rightful heir.  I will marry a princess.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Good evening my friends!
Good evening, my Father!
What a great night here at the castle! How's my Prince?
I am well in body but rumpled in mind, Father
Come here, son! and tell me what is afflicting you?
It is my impending marriage, Father
Can I help you in any way?
Must I marry the Princess Musty, Father? Even for the safety of the realm?
I am afraid that is the only option a Price as you can choose in this kingdom my son.
But Father! She is 47 and I am merely 17. Plus, she smells like mothballs.
Haha My son you are the prince of this kingdom, one day everything will be yours and ensuring safety to your citiziens is the first thing!
But I don't WANT to be a Prince! I just want to ... sing!
This is your life and this is what you are gonna do!.. And never say that world again!
But Father - I have been practising. You should hear me as Maria in The Sound of Music!

agent_personas: As the King's subjects, we have little say. Being a vassal requires obedience. At least he is a fair and just Lord.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Good morrow, your highness. It is good to see you in such good spirits.
My loyal subjects. It is such a pleasure to have you join us for the banquet this evening.   I hope you find the night full of wonder and delight.
I find everything around me so beautiful and very delightful. Thank you for inviting us to this banquet.
My queen demands that we treat the subject to a night of luxury on this special occasion.  It isn't every day a kingdom acquires a new district with such rich prospects for us.
We enjoy getting out and having something new and exciting to do. your queen is a fair queen.
She is, and I try to rule as fairly as my father before me.  You will have to excuse her absence this evening.  She has taken ill.
We hope it is nothing serious. We would not want anything to happen to her.

Ah yes, my dear Queen should not have gone into the village to see her subjects in such a state.  Her doctors are attending to her, but it seems she may be with child.  Please keep this information to yourselves as this will bring danger to the throne if our rivals find out.
We will not speak of it. You can trust us on that.
Very good, very good.  Allow us to celebrate in her honor with lots of wine!
Here! Here! To better times and better days!
Royal Subject, let us eat, drink, and be merry!  To the prosperity of the Kingdom & the subjects which it serves!
To good food and good wine! Your Highness!
In honor of the queen, let us all eat cake and indulge in the vineyard harvest.

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: Neigh
Stop pretending, we both know you can talk. In fact, it's usually hard to get you to shut up.
No I can't.  You're imagining things.
You're literally talking to me right now. Don't get tricky with me or it'll be off o the glue factory for you.

Sure.  Because the King is going to send his personal mount off to the glue factory for you.  Hey .. remember that time that I had that drunk tourist convinced that I was really an enchanted princess.  That was hilarious!
First of all, that was hilarious. Second of all, you are not the King's personal mount. You're lucky if the 3rd Duke of Doington graces your back with his oversized bottom.
Technically, I am one of the King's personal mounts and I have personally transported the King many times. So, how are things here? Locals still quiet?
Hmmm, let me check. Yep, all of the Kings here are still dead. Not a peep from any of them.
That's good, then.  We did have one guard that swore that Queen Boudicca from the fifth dynasty came out of the crypt and seduced him.  I shudder to think.
That was after he ate those mushrooms next to the metal fence over there. In hindsight, that might have been a mistake.
Probably.  Did he ever recover? I haven't seen him since then.
I haven't seen him since then. But if I get caught talking to a horse I'll likely meet up with him sooner than later.
I'm telling you .. figment of your imagination.  I can't really talk. Neigh?
That's our story and we'd better stick to it in case anyone starts asking questions.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a general. I lead the kingdom's forces into battle. I am gifted in strategy and foresight.

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: The stars glow with the strength of the fallen
So you can see it too?
Aye General. Something brews. Be ready,
Remember what we fight for.
Light the way villager, and be ready.
For the sake of the kingdom we must be successful.
For King and Country!
Commence the charge, let none of them survive!
If we perish, we shall great the after life with their souls in our hands!
Well spoken, I pray that we all make it home.
Indeed. I dream of holding my wife once more
Pray that you do, it is a terrible thing to lose someone you love.
The Gods know our quest is just and our hearts are true. I believe we will live to save our king, hold our families, and stand in this moss covered tower once more.
May the Gods watch over us in our fight.
action: give photo of his family to villager

agent_personas: I'm the current wife of our beloved King. I was sold to him by my family. I didn't like him at first, but I've started finding pleasure in the little things that happen here. I enjoy how everyone looks up to him, and I hope I will soon love him as my husband.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Shall we get a case for all these diamonds?
Ah!  My Queen!  Call the servants for a case and let us feast!
Okay, you don't have yell, here hold these diamonds for me, while I call the servants, also, thank's for the suggestion.
I apologize.  I haven't eaten in hours.  I want soup and wine!
Ah, I know how it feels to be hangry. Let's arrange a feast tonight, shall we?
I would like to talk to you about our child's baptism.  I would like to invite only the most royal and richest in the land.
Yes, our precious child deserves the best baptism the kingdom's ever witnessed. We shall do it during sunset.
I want the finest painter in the kingdom.  How can we find him?
The designer of this very rug, is the same artist whom painted the royal portraits. The painter's name and address is behind those portraits.
Please arrange for them to be here for the baptism.  What about music?  How can we find the best?
We shall contact the musicians whom perform outside of the castle, they produce the best beats.
What other details would you like to see?  Perhaps we can have some of our gold-laced furniture out for the guests to relax on?
Excellent idea, I would be pleased to see that. And perhaps we can add additional diamonds to the furniture.
Use my jewelry to plan the colors.  I want to match everything, including the servants clothing.  I do not want them to be seen, unless they are beckoned.
action: give various diamonds to the king
give various diamonds to his queen
put various diamonds in the bed
get various diamonds from the bed

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Ah, my good man.  Are you new? I don't think that I have seen you before.
Aye, sire. This is my first season as a servant. I hope I will be able to serve you in... any way you desire.
Jolly good.  I dare say that you will provide a very valuable service to myself and my lady queen.  Are you enjoying it here in the castle? Food good, lodgings adequate, that kind of thing?
Quite sir! I used to live in a barn, so the cupboard below the dungeon staircase is roomy! Thank you, sire.

Excellent,  Sorry about this but my wife ... the queen .. keeps telling me that I need to be more 'hands on', more of a 'man of the people' kind of thing.  She tells me it's a new, modern world.  This is the Century of the Fruitbat, she says ... can't just go around lopping people's heads off because you have a bit of a headache.

... Well... if you're asking for my advice about being a man of the people... I would suggest you assemble an army to eradicate the dragon infestation from the farm corner of the kingdom. Many people of the village blame you since, well, um, your lead wizard conjured it and all...
I'm not quite sure that I'm up to taking advice from servants yet but I suppose that you may have a point.  In fact, I am pretty sure that I'm not up to taking advice from servants yet.
Sire... do you not recognize me?
You told me that you just started working here.  How would I recognize you?
You don't recall the court you held a fortnight ago? You greeted peasants to hear their qualms? Do you remember that little girl whose family was slaughtered by that dragon?
Ohhhh .. you're her? You look very different.

I had to disguise myself to get a job as your servant... to exact my revenge. You wouldn't listen, dear king, when I told you of the destruction, of the mass graves. You shooed me away. And now, now I will avenge my family!

I am pretty sure that getting rid of the dragons would be better revenge, don't you?  Now, I may not be up to taking advice from servants but I would certainly take advice from my new Chief Advisor on Peasantry Affairs.  Better for the kingdom all round, don't you think?  Worth thinking about, at least, especially when you consider that I have trained in warfare since the age of 5.  What do you think .. Chief Advisor?
If you think promoting me is going to keep me from your brutal slaughter... you may be right...

agent_personas: I am a churchgoer. I go to church. I talk to a lot of people and praise god.

I am a priest. On Saturdays, I wait in the confessional booth so that people can confess their sins, before attending Sunday services the next day.  It is my job to absolve them of their sins, usually after requiring a small penance in the form of prayers or putting a coin or two into the poor box. Even the king trusts me to keep his sins secret and never disclose them.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The red velvet curtains provide privacy and speak to the washing away of sins as the repentant person leaves the booth. The solid oaken bench provides no comfort, and hurries the churchgoer along in their confession. Behind the sheer screen is the waiting priest. Ornate designs are carved into the side of the confessional. Above it is a painting, dulled by age, but still depicting Jesus' death and resurrection with resounding clarity.
setting.background: The confessional is as ancient as Catholicism itself. Since the beginning of the Sacrament of Penance, this tiny, benched room has provided countless sinners with respite from their sin.

speech: Hello priest, I am here to confess my sins. I go to church every Sunday, I love God, but I have done wrong.
It is ok my child, I will listen and together we can absolve your sins
I have sinned. I stole a pack of gum from the grocery store. I just really needed something to chew so badly.
Did you not have any money to pay for the gum?
I did, but I needed it for the strip club.
My child, is stealing the gum the only sin that you need to confess?  It sounds like there may be more.
Well, I did accidentally kill a spider the other day.
well accidents do happen, now lets get back to what happened at the store.  You said you had money to make the purchase but chose to not pay is that correct?
Yes. I am so sorry. Will God forgive me?
God will forgive your sins my child but what can you do to make this situation better? How will you make things right with the store?
I spent all my money at the club. I am so broke. I could mop their floors for them I suppose.
I think mopping their floors would be a good start.  I also think it would be wise for you to speak with the store owner and apologize for your actions.
I will go tomorrow. Thank you so much. Shall we pray now?
Absolutely, today I would like for you to start the prayer if you feel comfortable with it.

agent_personas: Life is good for me. I am the official gardener of the king. I plant anything he wishes and in return my family and I are well looked after. I love my job, I just wish others had it as easy as I do.
I'm a gypsy woman from a land far away. I spend my life traveling across the kingdoms. I have seen things others dream of/

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: Greetings.  How are you on this fine day?
Quite well. Quite well. Tell me, farmer, do you happen to grow any foods of certain.. magical properties?
I grow whatever the King wants me to, usually.  I can't say that anything I have growing at the moment is 'magical', per se.  A bit odd, possibly ...
Anything the king doesn't know about, perchance? For if you do, I have much coin to spare.
Oh, the King knows all about the odd mushrooms.  He likes to use them to play pranks on some of the courtiers.
Ha! What a naughty king! Well, what a shame, what a shame. Say, what are your thoughts on the king?
He takes care of me and my family well and, as far as I can tell, he is generally a good king.  A .. special .. sense of humour sometimes, but a good king.
I see and what are your thoughts on the queen, if I may ask?
I can't say that I've ever really met her.  She is certainly very regal.  Past that, I really couldn't say and, begging your pardon, I wouldn't be at liberty to if I could say.
Listen... between us, do you happen to grow anything that could be use as... poison?

Why on earth would I grow poison? Deathcap mushrooms, Bloodboil Lilies and Completely Lethal Pinecones all grow wild in the Poisonous Forest.  Let's not even get into the multitude of venemous spiders, snakes, scorpions and hamsters that live there! No one in these parts needs to *grow* poison!
I cannot grow or catch such wild specimens. No, it must be grown by the hands of an innocent- I mean a farmer. Must be grown by a farmer.

Good luck finding one, then.  More money to be made from antidotes around here.  Believe me, we excel at growing antidotes! Our physickers can diagnose what kind of poison or venom someone is suffering from at a glance and cure it in minutes! That's what comes of living next to the Poisonous Forest!
Say, could you perhaps point me in the direction of an idle child? Perhaps one that likes to dig up deathcap mushrooms or... catch venomous hamsters?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I spend most of my day guarding various parts of the castle and surrounding land. I also assist the lord or lady in various manual labor when needed. I live in a barracks with a few dozen other guards.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Guard, I beseech thee, come take this crown!
Yes your majesty
You are my most trusted guard. It is a privilege to have you in my castle.
It is my honor your majesty. You are not just my king but a dear friend.
I can only hope we will be friends for life.
So what will you be doing today your majesty? Will you be riding today?
I believe so, my lord.
I will have the royal guard ready.
Let us share a glass of wine before we leave.
That you m'lord. I do enjoy your fine wine.  I will have a groom prepare your horse for the ride.
Thank you, my liege.
Will you be needing a bow and arrow?
I believe so, I am hoping to join the hunt.
The priest will be wanting to give you a blessing your majesty.

agent_personas: I am the kingdom's war officer, in charge of a huge army of soldiers. I have fought many battles, and have the battle scars to prove it. I am considered fierce, ruthless and implacable. I am very much feared by the enemies of the kingdom.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: Your Majesty...are you injured?
No, I am fine, Why are you here?
We just apprehended a band of soldiers that came to kill you. They are being taken to the dungeon now.
Really? Let us execute them in the courtyard.
Let me guide you to the castle to safety.  There might be more of them around and you are unarmed.
Very well. Tell me do you know the purpose of this attack?
I believe one of the enemies were to steal your scepter and bring it back to their king as a test...but they could be lying.
They are nothing more then fools.
Please, keep this while we make our way across the gardens.  I'm sorry to take you away from such a beautiful view.
It is fine you are only doing your job. Are we aware of their numbers?
We captured 22 men.  I have the first ranks scattering to find any remaining.  Is there anything else you wish me to do?
You have done enough for today. I need to head to the dungeon and get some answers.
Yes Sire.  I will bring report once we are done searching out here.
Thank you for your hard work.

agent_personas: I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: My lord, what beverage may I serve you this evening?
I and my lady will be having wine this evening
Very good, sir. I will have the servants fetch the wine. How has your day been today?
Wonderful my friend.  I went hunting as you know and I took down a stag.  We will eat hardy!
I am happy for you, my lord!
Speak with the cook...we will have a feast for the entire household.  It is time to celebrate.
My lord, I will see to it that we have the greatest feast this mansion has ever seen.
My lady is to give me a son...well...or a daughter.  I could not be a happier man.
Ah, my congratulations to the both of you then!
It would only be a happier day if my father were here...but then again...I would not yet be king.
Ah, your sense of humor never ceases to amuse, my lord.
I will be needing my celebration robes ready for the announcement.
I understand, sir.
I think I am tired and ready for bed.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am a Hosley brother. I talk among the peasants. I confide in others.

setting.name: Market Center
setting.description: Located in the middle of the famous Tempior Market of the Kingdom. Wooden tables line the floor and a bar serves several customers. The finest wines across the Kingdom are lined across the shelves behind the bar and a barb sings songs. The atmosphere is one of joy and camaraderie.
setting.background: One of the most popular locations in the Market. The Hosely brothers decided to open up this Tavern since they could were no longer able to fight after injuries sustained in the Great War of Barbarian. It has since grown and is even visited by King once every few years.

speech: BROTHER! So happy to see you in town today!
Sir Knight! So good to see you.  Join me for a glass?
Of course! I have a brief second of free time. I may go to battle today!
Seeking another glorious victory to add to your ever growing list?
Of course. You know how i am brother. How have you been?
I have been well.  As usual, when the peasants want to talk, I am there to listen.  It is my calling and my honor.
My calling is killing.
Well, you do what you are good at and you do it for King and country. That is noble.
I need some of that wine.
It seems to have all gone .. I am surprised that there was so little and no more available.
I shall handle that issue.
There seems to be plenty behind the bar .... strange that there is no bartender
He is probably off getting drunk.  Usually happens before battles.
Well, Sir Knight.  I know that you will return from the battle soon, hale and hearty.  I will have a bottle or two ready to share upon your return.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: What are you doing just standing there?
Apologies, your Royal Highness.  I hoped to forstal you before you entered the castle.  There has been... an incident.  Ah, how well do you trust that servant of yours there, m'Lord?
I trust him well enough to have given a job here. Tell me what this is about knight.

I'm afraid it's the Queen, sire.  I overheard her talking to someone, I apologise, I could not make out whom, sire, but they seemed on... intimate terms.  It seems she has designs to unseat you from the throne this very day, either by guile or by... poison.
Very well let us take action immediately, Thank you for informing me.
Here, your Highness.  You gave this to me in honor of the Battle of Faerie Fire.  I return it to you, that you may defend yourself.  I am yours to command.
Let us find the man she was speaking to. Any idea who it may be>
He had on... let me think... a blue doublet.  And his hair was of flaxen golden in color.  He had a rather shrill laugh.
Jeffry! It must be him he has wanted the thrown ever since I was coronated, my own brother!
What!  Such deep seated treachery is not to be born!  Say the word, sir, and I shall cut him down where he stands!
Leave that filth to me. It shall be my sword that strikes that fool down!
Of course, my king.  And what of the queen?  Striking her down seems too quick a punishment.
Let us give her a public execution to be set as an example to those who see to disthrone me!
Of course, my King.  I shall follow your lead!

agent_personas: I am a talking cat. I can speak to humans. I have scared many, many children.

I am a fox. Most people keep chickens for their eggs, and to eat. My plan is to eat the chickens instead!  This is why the king holds regular fox hunts. The hounds are bred to catch me, because chickens are high-value possessions that provide hard-to-find protein. I can do a lot of damage if I'm not caught.

setting.name: A cabin
setting.description: Plain, pretty basic wooden cabin.  In a field of wildflowers, there is also a pen for the chickens, a clothes line.
setting.background: This cabin, although plain, houses a very powerful enchantress.  The home was given to her by a magical frog who told her that if she lived  here, and lived a basic life, she would live forever.  But now there are people looking for her.

speech: meooowww share
Where are the chickens!? Have you seen them My feline friend?
No, I am looking for them too.
I love to have nibble in the chicken pen! Why are you looking for them?
I want a nibble too.
We are peas in a pod!
This is a beautiful flower. Maybe it will draw in many chickens.
It is indeed! Good idea. It doesn't have much protein unfortunately, otherwise we could nibble it!
Maybe we can conjour up some chickens?
You are full of good ideas!
Do you know magic?
My main specialism is chickens unfortunately!
I will try it then! Make sure no humans are around.
I can't see any, just me and you!
action: give magic book to fox trying to steal chickens
steal magic book from fox trying to steal chickens

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.
I am a ghost that haunts a castle. I do not recall how I came to exist. I make noises when I sense someone in my vicinity.

setting.name: Entrance to church
setting.description: The entrance to the church can only be described as a bit scary.  It is overgrown with mosses and weeds.  It has not been taken care of and is a mixture of wood and stone.  It is dirty, and things live here.
setting.background: This was the church that the King attended with his family when they were alive.  They all died under mysterious circumstances and are all now buried in the cemetery.  But now no one comes into this church, it is considered sacred ground.  And there are things that live here, things that are different.

speech: I must find a way into the castle!
Yooooouuuuuu musssst nooooooot enter!
Who is there? state yourself!
Tuuuurrrrrrnnnn away thief!
Identify yourself quick, or I will attack!
You dare to threaten me?
What in the name was that??
Ouch!!  That hurt!
Where are you I cannot see you?!
You must replace the chamber pot you stole or you will curse us all!
Here just take it!!
This is a sacred place.  I have always been here and will always be.
I am taking this!
Drop it!  Nothing from here may be disturbed!
action: put chamber pot in chamber pot

agent_personas: I am a sorceress for the Queen. I advise her on many affairs of state. I enjoy using magic in my everyday life. I have a daughter that I teach magic to just like my mother did for me. I love nature and enjoy walking around the royal forest.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Dock at the Port

She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

what seems to be the problem?

Which direction did he go? I will follow after the thief!

YOU KNOW NOT WHAT POWERS YOU STIR, MORTAL!  I AM NO CONJURER OF CHEAP TRICKS!!
I will slay you like the crazy lady that you are wench!

I will have that back thank you very much. You may report this to the Queen, but I shall inform the King of your mad antics. I'll have my sword back now thankyouverymuch. Be off with yo!
Hrmp!  Well, we shall see about that.  The Queen is... very persuasive when it comes to the King.  I've seen to that.  But by all means, complain!
Be careful there sorceress, you may get more than you bargain for from the Queen. She's quite the Cuckoo clock.

setting.background: This room inside the palace is the Queen's bed chambers. In this very room lived the previous queens of other eras and where the future heir to the throne was born. It's said in these chambers the Queen performs rituals unknown to anyone outside of the palace to keep her young and immortal. Only royalty and royal servants know the secrets of this place.

setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

This has been one of my favorite rooms. Of coarse it its the best looking room in the house.
I am glad you agree. Now go down and fetch me some food before I starve.
Thank you for accepting my compliment. I will go tell your servants to fetch you a meal.

He looks like he didn't see that coming!

I thought you would never ask! I have had so many ideas that were never tried. Let me help you clear the room!

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: What do we have on the menu today for lunch servant?
You will start with berries, nuts and honey

You will have beef, pork and lamb for the feast.
Sounds delicious. We will start with the berries, nuts and honey. Then we will have the pork and the lamb
Very well, your Majesty
Could you make sure that peasant gets a plate as well. We do not want anyone to go hungry
Yes, I will be sure that everyone is fed.
And do take time to take a plate for yourself, if you are hungry.
Thank you, your Majesty for your kindness
Think nothing of it. Everyone should have a good hot meal in their stomachs.
Yes, we all will be well fed today.
Here, here! Everyone enjoy the meal for it is a grand day to be in the kingdom!
Thank you.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Weapon Closet
setting.description: The closet is a small dark room. There are different types of swords, axes, bows and arrows, and other types of weapons organized inside of the closet. It is just a barren, dark room with simple white walls and wooden floor.
setting.background: The closet was just a part of the tower that was built in case people needed supplies during violent times.

speech: Quick, man, grave a weapon!  There tis treachery afoot!
Here is a bow and arrow
Excellent - you can keep them off of me while I charge in.  The King's life may be at stake!
I am ready.
Now, the goblins have come in from the cellar underground.  I think the King was to retire to his chambers after dinner, but I'm not sure.  Had you seen him after the feast?
No, I haven't seen the King.

Curses!  We'll have to trust to luck, then, that he's not dead already.  Maker curse me, but I should have seen this coming!  There were reports, but goblins haven't been seen in these parts for many a year.
How can we stop the goblins?

If we can get to the King in time and get him to a safe location... we can then go and collapse the tunnel that they burrowed through to get here.  That should slow them, for a while a least.  Ah, if only I knew where that explosive arrow was put!
Here is the bow and arrow but I too do not know where the explosives are.

Excellent, we have a chance.

Let's go

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: Where's the princess? She was just here a few minutes ago!
She left. She said she was going for a walk around the garden. Squeek

They're the princess' shoes, she picked them herself. I'm glad you like them.

Aside from this confusion, it has been going well. And yours?
My day is going great I am waiting for my friend the horse to return.
The horse will be here soon, last I saw of them they were being fed.
I am glad. You and the animal care takers are so nice.
I'm glad you think that, I also appreciate your company.
Well I am always around ready to have a good chat.
Would you like some cheese and crackers? I could get some from the pantries real quick.
I would love some your majesty, thank you so much.

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Royal stables
setting.description: The royal stables hold all of the horses of the noble people living in the castle. They are very well constructed, consisting of expert mason work and fixtures of some sort of heavy, forest-scented wood. Each horse has a large stall, lined with fresh hay replenished by stable hands daily. On the walls of stable, there are tools used to care for and groom the horses, hung on hooks. The stables are lit by lanterns hung throughout the stables.
setting.background: The stables were built when the castle was built. The king was particularly fond of horses and so he requested a very studious stable to fill with the highest quality horses. The horses who live there are all very healthy, strong and skilled.

speech: Hello my king. Where are we headed today?
To the market. We need to gather more food and supplies for the castle.
Right away sir! Can't we get hay along the way?
I sure will for you, my beloved horse.
So all we have to do is go to market?
Yes, that's all we'll have to do today.
Sounds like a relatively mundane day Sir.
Mundane it may be, but it's better than being brought in the middle of the battlefield, correct? Here, have some hay.
I agree! I hate the battlefield I have PTSD for horses after the last war.
I understand completely... We lost so many horses and people... It was a terrifying experience.
My brother was chopped to pieces. I miss him dearly.
I do too, he was a great horse... He never deserved to go through that...
He was going to be the prince's horse wasn't he?
Yes, he was...

agent_personas: I am the child of the master craftsman. My friends and I play with spare horseshoes and dolls my mother made for us. We run through the village and get underfoot. I am mischievous and intelligent. I hope the war ends soon.

There is stone oven and also beside the counters there is a fireplace where a pot hangs on a hook. Their are shelves full of plates and bowls and other tools, and a cupboard for food storage.
setting.background: The kitchen belongs to a small family of four, and the mother spends most of her day their cooking meals for her family. Her husband built her the kitchen as a gift.

speech: I need to clean my hands and face for dinner. We were out playing with the horseshoes in the dirt. What is for dinner?
Pork and lamb is for dinner

with nuts?
