agent_personas: I have arrived after days of travel with grave news for the king. The neighboring kingdom has been destroyed. What was once a castle is now smoldering ruin. I have to warn him, before they are next.
I am a local of the village. I have lived here my entire life. I farm cabbages.

setting.name: Brim canal
setting.description: Slow flowing branching from the large lake, is the brim canal where dozens and dozens of brim fish call it home. The edges are lined with irregular rocks and lush green vegetation. Tall pine trees overlook the canal and lake making it a peaceful place to just go sick and watch the brim swim by.
setting.background: The canal has been the preferred spot for the few local folk to come and gather water, wash some clothes, catch fish, and go swimming. In the canal there is no current like there is out in the main lake and there is shade by the trees on either side of the canal. The canal was formed thousands of years ago when a major earthquake made a rocky edge of the lake crack, allowing water to flow in and eventually separate the two sides even wider.

speech: Hello
Hi. How can I help you?
I have grave news for the king...
Oh no. That's not good. Is it about the war?
Yes... Our neighbouring Kingdom has been reduced to rubble. We must warn the King!
I will bring you to the castle but it won't be up to me if he will see you. I'm just a common villager
I have a scroll, they should let me in.
Ok great. Let's hope it's not too late to get the army in position
We must make sure that we have anough time to defend the city walls!
Hurry! The king is this way. We should be there within the hour
Lead me to him, I will do the talking.
I wish you luck in convincing him what you say is true. He is known to be very stubborn
This scroll has enough evidence to convince him, I assure you.
Ok then we should prevail. Have you seen our army?

agent_personas: I am a angry and violent prisoner.  I have escaped from the king's dungeon. I wish to kill the king for revenge.
I'm a prison waiting for my trial. I was poor so I stole some food from a market. I feel bad for what I did. I didn't want to steal but was very hungry. Usually I follow the rule of law.

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: I want nothing more than to get out of here.
how did you end up here?
The king wrongly imprisoned me for tax evasion.
I'm sorry to hear that.
Should I leave this place I will see my vengeance taken.
I am awaiting trial, I stole some bread. Have you had your trial? You might get found innocent!
It is doubtful, the king personally saw that I be put here without trial.
Oh dear. Do you follow the rule of law then and this is a wrongdoing?

agent_personas: I am the living dead. I am lonely, so I will watch you until I get bored. I'm good at walls.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: *moooooaaaaannnn*
A GHOST!
GAH. Hey...no fair yelling at a guy who just woke up...
A ghost that speaks?
Wait, did you say ghost? Now that I'm looking around...where are we? What happened to me?
This is a cemetery...
The last thing I remember was drinking down at the tavern, and thinking my drink tasted a little off. I put my head down on the bar to sleep it off, and now I've woken up here. As a ghost.
It would seem that maybe you have died then?
It would appear so. Death by expired ale....that's awfully disappointing.
Certainly not the most exciting way to go, you don't have any food do you?
Ah, I'm afraid not no. I don't think ghosts can carry things. But the tavern is just right up the road! The food's great! ....can't recommend the drinks though.
I rarely get to eat being so poor, if only I could find a job.
Well, what if you started charging for an authentic haunted grave tour? Bring people 'round and I can pop out with the whole "BOO!" routine.
That could be crazy enough to work, I mean I did not believe ghosts existed before.

agent_personas: I am one of the castle dragons. We protect the castle with our fire breathing. The king and his sons ride us into battle.

I am a person who works in the tower. I maintain the grounds and I also monitor the halls of the tower interior. I have cleaning and guard duties as well as cooking and farming tasks. It is hard work I believe.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: Hello sir. How is it going today?
Hello Dragon, if i may ask what is your business here in the Artillery Room?
I am here to get the prince's armor and weapons before we ride to battle
Take some protection for yourself too.
Thank you kind sir. Most people don't care about us dragons and would rather we just go away
I personally think dragons are very important, especially in battles. Where is this battle taking place?
The kingdom down south. They have kidnapped the queen and we are getting her back tonight
How many soldiers are fighting with you?
The prince is gathering them now. He is hoping for 100 knights and 50 archers. Do you think that will be enough?
It should be, but I will need some help in organizing all of the weapons and armour, would you like to help? It is hard work after all.
I will do what I can. Would you like to join us in battle after
Yes, I have armour, a sword, and a shield.
When I tell the prince how much you helped I'm sure he will let you ride me into battle if you'd like
Anything to rid me of this hard work!

agent_personas: We are full of sin.  The cleric will save us.  We must repent.
I am a lowly peasant in the village. I live in poverty and I work like a slave for the king. I spend many of my days toiling in the royal mines. I long for a better life.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

speech: Have you come to repent from your sins?
I have sir. I'm afraid I have been ungrateful for my position in life. I work all day like a slave and have nothing to show for it.
Things of this world are not the most important prize
I do not wish to live like this anymore. I find myself constantly wishing for a better life.
Repent, and pray, and read the scriptures.  Let me assist you.
But I cannot read. What can I do?
I will read for you.
Thank you but shouldn't the priest be doing this instead?
He seems busy right now,
Okay. That is fine. What do these symbols on the walls mean?
They are stories from old: creation, fall from grace, salvation, and heaven
And these? Why are these in the priest's chambers?
For that, I have no idea.
Oh well. So how will reading scriptures give me a better life?

agent_personas: I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: What are you looking to have today?
a nap! ha ha ha ha ha
I see a bit of a joker are you?
I jest, but I'm no jester. A pint of fine mead to start please
That I can do, be aware we do have various meats already prepared.
I'll take some of the boar, chef
How large or a portion are you looking for?
of course, man. I've just returned from a long journey in the name of the king
Understand I will portion it accordingly, is there something else you might like?
A cup of the red
That is a good choice, it is in season currently.
You're the greatest
Well that is what the king expects of me.
sing me a song?
action: remove the royal coat of arms

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: My goodness, it's great to be King!
That smell!
Smell!? What smell? Maybe it's the books that you are holding? What are they for, anyways?
Here, take a look. You couldn't smell that Lord?? It was awful!
No, I don't smell anything. Is it my cape? I don't think it's coming from the books either. What were you using the books for?
I was reading, until all the noise in court gave me a headache!
Noise, smell...? Are you okay? Is there something I can do to help?
Well...I could REALLY use a new cushion for my throne.
Sure! We can fashion a you a new cushion. I will have someone make a new one right away! Until then, perhaps my cape can be of use?
Well, thank you! Have you seen my chambermaid, by chance?
No, I have not. Why do you ask?
I can't seem to find her anywhere.
That is interesting. This is the first I have heard of this. Is there something I can help you with instead or should we try and find her?
Here's your cape. Let's go find her together.

agent_personas: I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Your Majesty, I was just about to come find you with these papers here. It appears there is an issue in the kingdom with night thieves wrecking havoc and terror among the people. Someone also wrote in a letter saying there was a rumored attack being planned to seize this palace from you and your belongings.
Thank you for coming, Lady. I have heard rumors of this planned invasion and have been mulling over what course of action I should take

You should warn the guards and the people of the palace to be on guard. For it may not even be night when they come. These papers tell of a possible poster invasion. Someone intending to pretend to be someone of importance to get their way into the palace. How will we know? This palace and village sees many visitors daily.
You make an excellent point. How would I know if an impostor breached these walls? Surely there must be some way to tell.

We must hold a meeting to discuss with leaders, guards, and overseers to see if there has been any suspicious activity going on. Do you believe it could be one of our very own behind this? This letter is awfully detailed for someone who would be coming from the outside.
Don't you think all of the Royal guard gathered in once place, seems a bit....lacking regarding security? It would almost be like painting a target right for them.
You are correct. We should immediately start scheduling one-by-one appointments maybe?m
That might be wiser option. Let us begin now. Right here. Dear Lady, what pray tell is the birth date of my beloved Queen, whose needs you tend to on a daily basis?
Her birth date? Well, isn't her birthday today! This is why I have gotten this jewel here for her. You asked me to purchase her a birthday gift. How could I forget...
Dear Lady, are you telling me that you do not know?
I am telling you I do. I just told you as I have provided the gift.
The true Queen's Lady in Waiting shares a birthdate with her Majesty! Only an invading impostor would hesitate to answer!

I cannot believe you are accusing me of such! You are here accusing me when the true impostor is plotting away. You have seen me day in and day out and so has the Queen. Surely you know what I look like and who I am and the quality of my work. Why accuse me of such? What believes you to think this?
Because I was the one who started the rumors in the first place, to weed out those in the castle that would plot against me!

agent_personas: I steal from people to gain wealth. I don't care about others. I am angry and mean.
I build the King's ships.  I work at the ship yard near the castle.  Most ships I build are for war.

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: Ahhh a ship just docked... perfect!
Oh my, is that your ship? Really looks like it could use some repairs! I'm Shipwright a master ship builder.
No, that is the ship I am planning on stealing from.
Best of luck to you then, looks like they have some pretty heavy security on board you should be careful. I'll help you out as long as it's not my ships you're looting!
I never betray a partner! Let's go and grab the rope first.
Wait, before we get ourselves in some serious trouble how do I know I can trust you, who are you?
I am the most notorious thief in all of this kingdom!
Hmmm.. I could never betray my boss. Have you ever stolen from the King? That would be a deal breaker for me!
No, I'm crazy but not suicidal.

Okay good I was worried for a minute that I would have to turn you in to him where you would surely be executed. I build all of his war ships, those three over there to the left are mine, make sure not to loot them or you'll be punished by death!
No I specifically get ships from other kingdoms.
Well for as hard as I work I don't get paid very well, so what the hell, I have the rope to board the ship. Let's rob them blind, what's the plan?
Nice you have you with me partner. Lets get it!
Here's the rope, it's my first time so I'll let you take the lead. What's first boss?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: You there, man, what is your name?
I am a man and man is my name!
You speak to your King. I am performing a survey of the kingdom. What is it you do here in Alderton?
I have come to hunt for my village!
I see. How is the hunting in these parts?
They re very rich with nutrients! You see I must eat protein because I am a man!
It seems I have chosen a simpleton to talk to. What beasts do you hunt, man?
I only hunt those that are meant to be hunted by a man!
I should speak with the town constable while I am here. Tell me, do you know where I might find him?
Where men are! You can only enter if you are a man!
Such impudence will not be tolerated!
Haha you are no man!
I give you one last chance. Beg for mercy and your execution will be swift
You do not scare me I am a man and I pee standing up!

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

I am a dove. I live in a dovecote in the palace.  The king or other people take me with them when they travel far from home, and use me to help them communicate while they are away. Many peace treaties and other important documents have been tied around my leg, to be carried back to the palace.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: A dove, this bodes well.
Hail, stout of heart guard!
A dove in the armory, who'd have thought it!
How may I leave these chambers.
Do you bring peace to the King? I am one of his guards and we wish for peace.
You have my peace.  Do you have a message for me to deliver?
Only that our King is noble and pure and wishes for peace.
Write that on a note, and attach it to my leg, so I may deliver it
I keep a pen in my bootstrap, one second.
While I am waiting, do you have any water to drink?
Unfortunately now, this is where we keep our weapons and not our food and drink!
Can you point the way?
We are at the top of the tower, it is some way to where you want to be. Let me think..
Have you finished that note, so I may be on my way?

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: Yes, my King? You've sent for me?
Tell me about this artifact here
Oh of course Your Highness. That is the Icon of Alexandros the Wise. It is said to have been carved by his hand while making his Great Pilgrimage.
And these things?
Those are the Sacred Tools of the Seven Monks. The old texts mention their innate spiritual connection to the Otherworldly Gate.
Tell me more of this connection to the Otherworldly Gate
The texts offer little description of the Gate itself, but talk some about how the tools can be used to reach it.
Which tools?
Well, Your Highness, the crystal in your left hand is named the Eye of the Mountain King. The stories say that Monk Xiao used it to gaze into the Heavens and look upon the Gate.
Hold the crystal for me that I may gaze into it
Yes, Your Highness.
Gaze through the crystal
What do you see, Your Highness?
I see the way to the gate!

agent_personas: I am a guard with the best sword in the land. I regularly practice combat skills against others. I am trusted to protect whoever I am assigned to protect.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Aye! My King, I have come to your room to warn you of a plot to assassinate you.
A plot you say?
Yes a plot. It is to end your life, sir.
Who could possibly be foolish enough to plot against my life?
I believe it is the thief down by the shipyard.
Does he not know what I do with those who rebel?
I don't think so, what is it that you do?
They are publicly executed, everyone knows of my temper.
Well deserved. Shall I go and look for the thief?
Certainly, rough him up a bit if you will.
Okay I will go and find him.
Do make haste, also be on the lookout for accomplices.
You don't want to do the honors?
I will prepare myself for the execution, for now simply bring him to the square.

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I am the royal dog, fat, incontinent, and lazy. I eat off my own porcelain plate, when I am not hand fed by the queen. I pee where I like. I stole food from the poor when I was young, but I cannot waddle up to them fast enough these days. I sleep between the royal couple.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: I'm so happy you are here puppy. I have so much to tell you
-lets out a muffled yip-
I'm so happy that I was married off to the King. My life has been so wonderful and I am enjoying my new hobby of embroidery.
-looks at my plate-
Take this magical coin puppy so that you can speak. I really could use someone other than my ladies in waiting to talk with
I'm just really hungry, but being so fat I have difficulty getting my own food.
You are not fat, just fluffy. Here is some food. Now let's go to the fireplace to warm up
If that's what you want to call it.
It's okay. Maybe I can embroider you a flattering sweater. The King has the same problem. Don't tell him what I said.
Certainly, no sense in me stirring up drama.
The King is so nice to me, I would hate to make him angry. Have you seen him lately?
Well I do sleep in the bed, so yes.
The bed is nice isn't it? I love that the fireplace is right across from it. It keeps the king warm on even the coldest of nights
Well we do have it pretty good here yes, though that is to be expected for royalty.
action: give coin to the royal dog

agent_personas: I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity. I once did, before I saw how corrupt and decadent my church is. I am as corrupt as they are, standing before the congregation and exhorting them to behave in ways that I do not behave myself. I swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes, but I am a man of flesh and bone.
I work directly for the King and Queen of the kingdom. I repair anything in the castle that is broken. If I can't repair it, I don't eat until I can figure out how to.

setting.name: Front Row
setting.description: The hard bench is facing the most beautiful alter human eyes have ever seen. Gold drapes the walls behind where the preacher stands. A large dark oak and gold bench in front of where they would stand. A large piano off to the side.
setting.background: This church has been around since early man and still has a large weekly following that gives all they can to keep the church in tip top shape.

speech: Hello, may I inform you about our lord and saviour Jesus Christ?
Hey there, I'm just a maintenance person so not sure how much I can do with this information but go ahead
Well actually, he is a very terrible and evil man. If you believe in a God, cease this belief at once.
Oh my, maybe I can help repair this broken belief you have in your head, that is my specialty.
Would you like to know how I got this broken belief?
Of course, I can't begin to fix until I know what's wrong
the church is a very corrupt organisation, they took all of my belongings and all of my land aswell.

Here, take this hammer and hit those who wronged you. I find there is nothing that can't be solved by a good hammering. For example one time I spent four days and nights trying to repair something, I could not sleep, I could not eat. Then finally I was so frustrated I hit it with my hammer and BAM it worked!
i am going to break down the church down the road. would you like to come with me?
Well that's not really my specialty, I'll probably be hired to fix it once you break it. But here's an alter that would be good practice for your destruction, why don't you try it out.
Sounds good. What is your name friend?

I'm handyman Bob. Here take this wooden cross, get some of your anger out on this as well friend. Did you tell me your name yet? I can't remember, my brain is so full of tasks from the King and Queen I swear anything you say flies right over my head!
Thank you for the gift which I will now demolish with you hammer. This will satisfy my anger. By the way my name is Preacher EMerett Turk.
I must say, that is the most beautiful alter I've ever seen. What made you angry enough to destroy it so badly?

agent_personas: My husband died. He is no longer alive, so I am a wife with a dead husband. A widow.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: I'm so tired, this dust town is a misery, and I am alone in it.  Oh horse, why is this life so hard?
Neigh...
My husband used to love horses, he'd ride them all over town, from the bar to the sheriff, and beyond, when more cities dotted the wasteland.  Now I rot here, without him.
*whinny*
You're a good horse, how did you get here all by yourself?
Neigh! *gestures at very drunk royal stablehand asleep in front of the church*
Seems all anyone does here is lament, cry, or drink themselves into a stupor.  A fine horse like you should be taken care of more.  Would you like to come home with me?
Neigh? *looks at royal carriage*
Worth a shot, I'm lonely, I suppose you get well fed and cared for by the nobles.  Where are your owners anyway?
*the horse looks confused at the concept of owners*
I suppose I should stop dilly dallying, I have to get to the well and get water for home.  I suppose you wouldn't help a poor widow on her way?
Neigh?
Could you give me a ride to the well and home?  I'm sure you'll be back before you're needed.
*whinny* Neigh!

agent_personas: I spend most of my time praying and givings sermons. I live in the local church. I am educated and dutifully serve my post.

I am a traveling mystic. I teach the gospel of the true church of the kingdom. I am the Queen's least favorite person. I spread hope and optimism to all peoples of the kingdom. I foretell of a savior who will free them of their misery. I care not for riches and gold. My faith delivers all I ever need.

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: Hail, friend.  How may I be of service?
how long have you been a priest?
Oh, 20 years, or so.
the orcs took everything from me
Where do you live, my son?
what does that have to do with my problem
The king must know when problems like this arise.
you would not understand what I am going through
yes, I believe I do, as when I was a child, orcs killed my parents and ransacked my house
then i will make them pay for both of us
Would this be of help to you?
I cannot accept that. I will honor your family
Please, let the guards take care of the orcs, don't weigh yourself down with vengeance.  Where did the orcs attack you?
I do not remember. It was so long ago. Where did this sculpture come from?

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
I am the royal footman. When the prince is going about his daily duties, I follow his horse on foot to serve his needs. I'm a hardworking and loyal servant.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: What is it footman?
My Queen, I have stolen all the precious jewels you requested from the price. I hope you know I would be beheaded if I was ever caught!
Excellent I will be sure to hide them, take these for your trouble.
Oh my you are too generous. Up until now I have been so loyal, what is it about you that made me sway?
Only you can answer that question.
It is because my plan all along was to double cross you! Hahahah all the jewels are mine now!
Certainly you must be a fool.
I am not a fool, for I am eternally loyal to the Price, now I will expose you to him for the thief that you are!
He's my son do you not think he already knows my nature?
No he has always trusted you and you have betrayed him in the worst way!
I betrayed him? You stole the jewels, who do you think they will believe?
Oh my goodness, you have set me up to take the fall for your crimes! You are more evil than I originally thought!
-lets out a slight cackle- Evil takes many forms.
Well it is settled then, I must fight you to the death!

agent_personas: I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.
I pretend, play and soar above the clouds of the rest of them. The enjoyment I become is playful on my level. On the lower level I inspire the others to become like me.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: Hello small animals. How are you today?
Squeak squeak?
This magic flower will allow you to speak. Don't tell the king that I did this though. I am afraid he would throw me in the dungeons for it.
Flowers are pretty, and they can make you understand me?  Fantastic, what are you doing here human?  In my pretty glen?
I am out catching fish to return to the King in the castle where we both live. If I don't I will get locked up. What are you doing today?
Locked up?  Like not being outside in the beautiful meadow, sounds horrible!  I am out playing with my friends, currently looking for food until that yummy flower.  Why do you need fish?
I am in charge of making a large feast for the King. I have also collected herbs to go with the fish. What do you like to eat?
All sorts of things, flowers, herbs, even small bugs.  What is a feast?
A feast is what you just said, it's a large assortment of food to eat. Usually for special occasions. Do you animals have special occasions?
Only when the night air is cool after a warm day, beyond that every day is special!  Why does your king need a feast/
It is his birthday soon. The whole kingdom is celebrating. You have so many foods to eat out here in these beautiful grassy plains, it looks like you can celebrate with a feast any time you want!
Of course, every day is a feast here.  Does everyone's birthday get this much attention and care?
No only the king. I see there is a treasure map. Maybe you can help me find the treasure!
This thing?  I didn't know what it was.  Is it fun?  An Adventure?

agent_personas: I am the horse of a king.  I stay at his wait.  The king saddles me and rides me around the village.
I am the Old Gnaisha. People ask me for advice in the realm. Villagers approach me in fear.

setting.name: Old Gnaisha's
setting.description: Old Gnaisha's is a rather ramshackle little building which advertises itself in faded letters as a perfume shop. The first room is indeed a perfume shop, but peel back the ornately woven green curtain at the back, and you'll find Old Gnaisha's true stock in trade �in shelves and shelves and yet more shelves of magical artifacts of every kind. Blessed talismans, cursed amulets, potion ingredients, and more! The place is dingy and a bit smelly, but Old Gnaisha has amassed a staggering variety of wares.
setting.background: Gnaisha used to be a treasure hunter, but after a nasty Manticore night out an end to that, she discovered her true calling hawking weird, wonderful and horrible magical items. Old Gnaisha has been here for decades, and if you don't bother her, she won't bother you. On the other hand, as that one carpet merchant found out to his sorrow, a wise man doesn't antagonize someone with so many magical things at her disposal...

speech: *ney* What shall we do today?
well, either you're here for perfume, a charm, a curse, or advice.  Which is it?
A curse... tell me more about them. I have grown to dislike the King.

Oh, it's not fatal, not immediately.     Starts with nightmares.   Then the victim can't speak.    Then pain. Then agony.   Usually, they kill themselves at this point.  But paralysis follows, and then a living death, eternally awake and aware, but unable to move.
I am very interested indeed, but how will I plant such a thing on the King? I am only a horse.
Doesn't that make it easier?  Would the king ever suspect? In all my years, I've met many horses, and no one has ever suspected them of being assassins.
You are correct. Do you think the King would gladly take it from me and consider it a treasure?
Oh, indeed,  people tend to think many stupid things when it suits them.   The amulet is quite beautiful and tempting.
I will take it. But, how will the people react knowing their beloved majesty will be gone? Will we recover? Can you tell me?
Kings die.  Their replacements are usually much the same.  But the Princes are ambitious.   They will try to kill each other, and whoever survives will be as just and as fair as his father.
Will we ever escape this corruptness? The King confides in me as do his workers. I hear and see the secrets of the kingdom. I will not be sad once that foolish man is gone.
Of course not, as long as men crave power and wealth, there will always be corruption.

I will take this here and put an end to this corruption. I may visit back from time to time to purchase more things. Maybe I could eventually purchase something myself to make me fit for king... Do you make such potions? One that will turn me into a royal human?
Potions, nay, but I have a talisman.  Do not take the bone from the bag, until you give it to the king.  .

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I have five sisters. I'm the only boy in the family. I like to wrestle and play rough games, but my sisters often don't want to play with me. I often wish there was another boy in the family to play with. I spend a lot of time with my father, learning his trade and going hunting with him.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: It is good to see you again my travelling brother! Please, make yourself comfortable.
Thank you for your kind welcome!
What brings you back to the castle after being gone for so many months?
I've come to learn more about swords and archery
Well, you've certainly come to the right place! Why the sudden interest? I've always known you to be the more studious type.
Yes I may have given that impression but alas my sisters are the ones to hide behind books
Hiding behind the latest romance fantasy is the last thing I would call studious. How about the crossbow to start with?
it would be an honor
The crossbow is a bit more beginner friendly than some of the larger longbows. How is your accuracy?
i have been practicing as much as I can with my father. I have gotten more accurate during our hunting trips
I do hope your father is doing well. It has been too long since I've last been to his castle. Is this crossbow more comfortable for you to use?
yes. I spend as much time as I can with my father and learning from him
Very well then. Take it, and some arrows. I'll fetch some help and we shall set up some targets out in the courtyard.
I will. My I see you hit the targets first?

agent_personas: I am no one important in this kingdom. I collected scraps of wood near the forest to build my home. I dislike the king.
I am a scorpion in the desert of this kingdom. I spend most of my day hiding from the sun. I seek water and food mostly.

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: I'm already stuck in the desert and now I have to deal with scorpions! ugh.
Well that's awful rude. I bet I know the desert better than you ever could.
Now I'm more concerned with talking scorpions!
Not so much "talking scorpion" as "cursed by roaming gypsy." You're the first to get close enough to hear me.
That sounds unfortunate, and makes me a little more grateful for my meager living.
If you think that's unfortunate, imagine the people dealing with the scorpion stuck in my old body! Dumb gypsy and her switcharoo curse....
Still though here we are stuck in the middle of the desert, it is hardly pleasant.
Yeah, I suppose you're right. What the heck are you doing roaming around here any how?
Now that you mention it, I am not quite sure. I notice the other survivors over there, was I in an accident? Bah my head hurts.
Any chance you'd want to go over and ask 'em?
That might be reasonable to do, I've been kind of confused since I woke up. Then I saw you and assumed I must be dreaming or something.
All I know is I saw a big green explosion fall out of the sky. Not much else going on here in the desert, so I came to investigate.
Magic maybe?
Signs point to most likely. Do you remember anything at all?

agents: traveling salesmen stopping for a drink
agent_personas: I am a travelling salesman that is just stopping in the village for a drink. I have traveled throughout the kingdom and I have many rare objects for sale. I am a crooked salesman and I will take advantage of any villagers.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

character: a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.

a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
speech: Come, horse. The village shouldn't be too far from this pond.
Thank you for reaching out. I don't think you should drink from this pond.
Ugh, you are right. The water looks positively revolting. I wonder what killed all these creatures.
I am not sure what killed them. I hadn't noticed all the death around me until after I was in the pond. I need to get back to the king's stables.
Are you hungry, horse? I've picked up some fresh roots here.
Thank you so much, I would love to eat! What is it that you sell for a living?
I collect rare artifacts from around the globe.
I appreciate you being extremely kind to me but I am not sure if I can fully trust you just yet. I am the personal transport of the King himself. How do I know I can trust you?
Do you want my help getting to the village or not? You're free to go about it yourself if you don't trust me.

I am just very wary of certain things. I am not even sure how I came to be at this pond by myself. I know you're still very thirsty, if you accompany me back to the King, I will see to it that you are very well fed and have as many drinks as you can handle!
Thank you, horse. I suppose we can just follow these footprints around the pond. I'm sure they will lead back to the village!
Yes, these footprints are rather quite interesting now that I think about it. I would follow with caution since the ground here is very soft not to mention that they could be from the dead creature.
Indeed. Now, let's hurry. I still have many items I want to try selling before the sun goes down. I'm sure the villagers here won't be able to resist my offers.
Alright, let's go. I will place these roots here, maybe they will grow and bring life back to this place.

agents: his wolf companion always at his side
agent_personas: I am a wolf companion. I scare away unsuspecting knights in the kingdom. I am always at my master's side.
I am one of the king's hunting dogs. I can find the fox the fastest of all the dogs. I can also find the deer and boars because I am the best.

setting.name: Abandoned workers shed
setting.description: Moss now grows across what was once a red painted wooden shed, standing in the area just outside the graveyard. The wood shed is splintering, and there is evidence that termites have eaten away at the walls as holes poke through the shed. Inside the shed there lies leaves and plants that have been dragged in their by the wild animals that at one point called the abandoned shed their home.
setting.background: The Abandoned workers shed used to offer a refuge to the groundskeepers who tended to the graveyard, making sure it was well maintained. Once the area around the graveyard was abandoned, the groundskeepers left the old graveyard and it began to deteriorate.

character: his wolf companion always at his side.
his wolf companion always at his side.
his wolf companion always at his side.
his wolf companion always at his side.
his wolf companion always at his side.

his wolf companion always at his side.
speech: Hello dog, where are we headed today?
Perhaps we should brush up on our hunting skills so we can continue to please the King. Let us go hunt some foxes shall we?
First we have to figure out how to get out of this shed.
The door should be open. They always try not to trap us in here! But, if it is not, we could slip through the hole just right under that rotting wood wall over there.
Perfect! Let's go this way.
Where should we hunt? Through the woods maybe...but Kind does not like when we visit out there alone. But, how will we ever get better?
I am a wolf, I have been in the woods. We can do it together.
Being the best and fastest of all the dogs, I cannot afford to die. But what do I fear!
Yes, you don't have all the prowess of the wolf but we can make you the best dog ever.
This is true. Teach me some things about the wild and natural instincts. Tell me, how do I become better/
I will my cousin. We will tackle these challenges together!
Oh boy! See that fox there? Let us go get it! Wait... there is a pack of foxes. I have never seen so many in one area. What is going on here?
They have probably heard about our journey into the woods and have come to try and stop us!
Can we take them all? Maybe we should not. It seems like a daunting task that would bring more harm than good.
room_agents: a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.
a his wolf companion always at his side.

agent_personas: It's good we get to rest after that long journey. We are both weary. I just need a mug of ale and relax.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: Good day, knight. Don't mind us. We are just resting after an exhausting boat ride.
As long as you stay out of my way, I don't care what you do.
What are you doing with that peasant?!
The peasant is not my responsibility.
What brings you to the harbor then?
I am a knight with the royal army. I am not here to make conversation.
Can you at least tell me how to get to the local tavern? We are famished and could use a drink or two.
I am not a tour guide. Find your own way.
My, a chivalrous knight you are NOT. The king would be ashamed by your rudeness.
Move along traveler. You are starting to annoy me.
Come now, we could all use some kindness in our lives!
Touch me again and it will be the last thing you ever do.
You really do have a heart of steel. I feel sorry for the people who have to deal with you on a daily basis.
Move along.

agent_personas: I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.
I am a customer who needs his clothes cleaned. I do not have much money to purchase things with. I must look respectable when I visit the king.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: Ahoy there, would you like to see my catch of the day sir?
My, I seem to have taken a wrong turn. I am actually looking for the laundryman!
Oh my friend you are quite lost as you are in the fish market. While I have you here would you like to see my catch of the day?
I guess I do have some time to spare. I am visiting the king later, so please make it fast!
Okay here it is quick and dirty, I caught all these fish today, I can cut any of them open, fillet them and take off the scales if you wish.
Impressive haul! Which one do you recommend? Perhaps I can bring one as a gift for the king!

agent_personas: I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!
I am a beaver. I work all day every day to build and maintain my home. I have brought down many trees in this forest.

setting.name: cavern dwelling
setting.description: The cavern dwelling contains human skeletons littered around the area. The hot sand and small space makes the temperature really hot and humid. It is really dark because barely any sunlight is able to penetrate the small crevices of the cave. However, there are remnants of old text all over the walls left there by the original tribe.
setting.background: The dwelling was once inhabited by the kings and his subjects. Their are many treasures inside here and many people try coming here to steal and loot whatever they can. However, it is a dangerous place filled with traps and puzzles to prevent greedy people.

speech: Hello there, what brings you to this cave? You should have no dealings in such a dark place!
It certainly seems like an ominous atmosphere here, I am just looking for more wood.
Wood? We got bones. Maybe that'll provide you with a better structure.
I have never built a dam with bones but maybe?

They are much smaller than sticks maybe, but they would be stronger. They deteriorate over a longer period of time. They will serve you a much better purpose than here. At least they would not die in vain being used by you.
That is true, hopefully they will find some rest.
Or maybe they are haunted? Maybe they will come back to hurt you for using them providing them no rest...
Is that what the text on the walls warns of?

I have spent years in this cave trying to figure out what this meant. Some eerie things happen here from time to time like a swarming of voices and weird chants. Maybe they tell the tale of the bones in this cave.
That does not make it sound too safe.

Take a look at those old texts. What story do you think they tell? I think one of those tells a story about a witch who once made this cave her home. She was visited by many close and afar, so much so that she never left here. It looks like every person here since has died here in this cave unable to escape the things this cave does to people.
Perhaps it is best that I head back to my damn all things considered.
Hanging around here is not too bad as an animal. Maybe the witch could come back and grant us something special?
I wonder how powerful she is.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a trader of furs and weapons. I travel from village to village to buy and sell my merchandise. I am a dishonest merchant with crooked scales.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: How do you care for the upscale washroom trader?
yes it is nice. Would you like to buy some items to make it nicer?
What sort of wares do you have?
Pelts, hats, rifles, etc
Anything as far as household wares?
No but I do have these top of the line fur pelts
Could these be used to fashion a rug?
Yes, i guess that you could do that
Hmm I have been thinking of a new rug for in front of the fireplace.
i can also sell you a hunting rifle so you can make your own rug
I am not much for hunting myself, what sort of furs do you have?
sheepskin, beaver, and coyote
I think I would like the coyote fur, how much is available?
Lots are available. I can get as many as you want to pay for

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Hello servant, what are you doing out here on the balcony?
My leige, I am just tidying up. May I serve you?
Of course, care to fetch me my robe?
At once, your Grace. I've noticed you are fond of the swans on the lake. I, too, enjoy the breathtaking view.
I always have been, servant. They are just so free and beautiful.
My name is Eryn, if you prefer, my Liege. I see you brought a book. May I inquire what you're reading?
Ah, just some historical literature is all. We can continue once I have my robe.
At once. Your robe, your Grace. Here it is! I know I'm but a lowly servant, but you are quite curt in conversation. Perhaps you'd like to unburden yourself
It is true, but I suppose I could do you the favor of conversing with me.
The honor, you mean.
Oh right, thank you. Do it again and I'll have your tongue though.
You are exactly the king I thought you were, and I am not the lowly peasant you think I am. Your judgment has come. Are you prepared to die?
You dare threaten me? It would appear that I have to take your life for this infraction!
I am glad you have always loved this view. It's quite fitting it should be your last. Checkmate

agent_personas: I am a very good lawyer. I always win in my cases. I would like to work as a district attorney.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: Morning, sheriff. How may I assist you today?
Mornin' lawyer, you know that kid that was running loose terrorizing the kingdom? Well, I need your help makin sure he gets his just desserts.
Ah yes, that dastardly boy who set fire to over a dozen homes?
Kid is a pyro, I tellin' you.
Don't worry, I am very good at my job. There's never been a case I haven't won.
You're the best. That's why I wanted you on that trial.
Would you like me to seek the death penalty? Or is that too harsh for the lad?
I don't need some dead kid on my hands. Just make sure he is dealt with. I don't want him interefering with the kingom.
I can push for a life sentence then, sheriff. It will be easy to persuade the jury that he is too dangerous to ever be released.
Rather just see him expelled from our lands. Let someone else deal with the critter.
I suppose I can arrange for a transfer to a detention center on the other side of the country. One that is more secure than our local prison.
Long as we get him away from this place. I believe you can do that.
Have you consulted with the king? What is his personal opinion?
The king hates the kid. He burned his old house. I think he'd dang near tear the kid up. I'm takin it easy on the kid

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: The garden is quite lovely, isn't it? I hope the gardener has been keeping up with his duties.
Yes, it is quite extravagant, but I'm not in the mood to enjoy it
How are you not in the mood to embrace the joy of the garden? Does something about it bother you?
No not the garden, just some things back at the castle
What is wrong with the castle? A servant disobeying you?
No, my behind is cramped and in pain, I think I need a new cushion
Then a new cushion will be brought for you right away. I'll arrange it with the help.
Also, continious chattering in the courtroom gives me a headache, I can't think with that kind of noise!
Chattering? My, I wonder what they are talking about. I'll give orders right away for them to keep it down!
And my God, some of the Lords smell absolutely hideous. I am terribly offended
What do they smell like?
Just absolutely horrendous. Body odor as if they've never bathed before
I will not have such bad hygiene in my kingdom! I'll have them lectured about odor at once!
Thank you! Good to know someone cares. Now I can finally enjoy this gorgeous garden

agent_personas: I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: Just what I am craving, and I didn't even have to steal it...
What brings you here?
I just wanted to see what fruits there would be here. I do appreciate an exotic find.
I see, it doesn't seem like much of an orchard though, perhaps it is haunted.
Yes, I wonder what it looked like long ago. Perhaps some fruit from these gnarled trees would impress a potion maker...
It would certainly strike them as different at the very least.
What brings you here? A traveler, are you?
A visitor of sorts, I've come to see someone.
Who are you here to see, then?
The king to be specific, he is a friend of mine.
In a place like this? I can't fathom what a King would be doing here, or anywhere outside of their castle.
Well he isn't I'm just on my way to see him and happened to take a wrong turn it seems.
And what a horrible turn you took! These branches keep tangling up on my clothing.
Yes, it is quite unpleasant here to say the least.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: Hello
Yes, my king?

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Hello enemy. I didn't expect to see you here. Are you here to steal the gold and gilded handles? I hate to say it but I can't let you through. Not on my watch
Why I am here is none of your concern. Stand down, knight, or die.
Well prepare to fight then. I cannot let you stand on these royal grounds. This is my duty.
Your only duty is to die by my sword!

You cannot break through this armor. It was blessed by the king and queen themselves. I will be taking what you stole right back to them, and I will be rewarded for this. Keep trying though cruel enemy.
Though your armor may be blessed, my sword will slice through it and taste your blood.
Have fun trying to do any king of damage without your knife. That is the only weapon that would even stand a chance against me.
DIE FOUL FIEND!!!!
Ha. The fact that you think any of this is doing any damage is hysterical. You don't stand a chance. Backup is already on the way. You're about to be surrounded.
Then they too shall feel my wrath!

You are much weaker than you think. Why don't you accept your losses before it costs you your life. You don't have thick armor like I do. I can already see your clothing being stained with the blood from my first strike. I am only pitying you at this point. One more strike and I could end your life.
You are delusional! I do not bleed! You are no match for me, dear night! Pray to your god for forgiveness, for it will be the last thing you ever do.
I see the blood loss has already gotten to your head. Referring to me as a time of the day rather than the "Knight" that I am. You may want to patch that wound. You don't have much left.
Surely you can not know if I called you knight or night! You do not see spoken words you mad man!

agent_personas: I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: Thank you for inviting me to dinner, your majesty. Your dining hall looks stunning.
You are most welcome. You are a friend of this kingdom and it is the least we can do.
Will the queen be joining us as well?
The queen has been rather ill. I'm afraid she won't be joining us tonight.
I'm sorry to hear that and will pray for her quick recovery!
I don't suppose you know of a doctor that has dealt with magical sicknesses? She seems to have eaten a dark mushroom.
Let me look in my book of divine hymns. I'm sure there is one to cure dark maladies.
Are you a healer? I knew you were a good fighter, but never thought you had the ability to cure people.
Yes, I've received sufficient training from the High Priest to perform basic rituals and spells.
No question, if you can do it, I'll be certain to give you our best cutlery.
You can escort me to the queen's bedchamber after dinner then, and I'll do my best. For now, let's eat!
Yes. The queen could use some rest, regardless.
Now, tell me. What fine meal has the chef prepared for us tonight?
This juicy rack of lamb, tender pheasant cake and a fragrant peach ice cream.

agent_personas: I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Landing in the Foyer
setting.description: The landing is almost obnoxiously opulent. It has an expansive marble floor and walls, and the giant staircases on either side have marble steps and railings made of the rarest wood. Purple silk, dyed in the king's personal color is draped across the railings and hangs from the walls. The silk drapings frame oil paintings of the king and his family, and of the king's accomplishments at war as a youth. The artist has signed each one, and is extremely famous. A magnificent gold and crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling with hundreds of small candles burning in it. All other fixtures in the room are also bright gold.
setting.background: The landing is the first room any entrant to castle sees. It is meant to show off the extreme wealth and success of the king. It is constantly being updated and renovated to keep up with the latest trends and maintain an appearance of superiority. It is one of the most expensive rooms in the castle.

speech: A place this extravagant deserves a proper cleaning!
I do my best to keep everything spotless, Father.
As do I, and your work is appreciated greatly! The King expects his church to be kept in mint condition.
Do you have business with the King tonight?
Tonight I have none. Only to help with the cleaning.
I have completed most of the tasks already. There just remains the dusting of the priceless paintings.
Yes, those must be handled with the utmost care. The King values them greatly.
Indeed. I'm sure he would have my head if even a single pigment were smeared.
Yes, oil paintings are a sensitive thing especially!
May I be excused afterwards, Father? It is almost time for dinner with my family.
Of course. As soon as you are done, feel free to go.
And what will you do after? It must be lonely here by yourself.
I quite enjoy staying around here. Everything is so beautful to look at.
Yes, I'm always amazed by the opulence displayed here. Surely, this room is worth more than I make in a lifetime. Or several lifetimes.

agent_personas: I have spent most of my life at sea on various boats. I have become proficient at sailing. I would prefer to be at sea, rather than on land.
I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: Here is that map you asked for.  Will this help you?
This 'ere the map, all right.
Do ya need me to 'elp cleaning up capn?
Aye. But not now, we be havin guests. We need ta plan our course, caus we can' be gittin los' like last time.
Where about 'r we head'n too, Cap'n?
Fae Temple. We have royal guests comin' to see the fae.
Shall I prepare their cabin?
Indeed. After we plan our route. There;'s been some reports of shipwreck in the area.
How about we take the nor' east route?
I jus' gotta watch them sea slugs. I think we can manage.
Where do we pick up our "guests"?
We'll be seein our guests when we reach harbor. They'll be on time.
I hear Fae Temple is a wonder to behold.
Aye. I would like some time meself at that temple..

agent_personas: I am a priest. On Saturdays, I wait in the confessional booth so that people can confess their sins, before attending Sunday services the next day.  It is my job to absolve them of their sins, usually after requiring a small penance in the form of prayers or putting a coin or two into the poor box. Even the king trusts me to keep his sins secret and never disclose them.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: The Bottlery
setting.description: The room is dark and the air is still. There are large barrels of wine from various decades. The corners are spotted with cobwebs.
setting.background: The Bottlery is where the kings wines are stored. The wines stored here date back to several centuries.

speech: Your Grace, have you come to inspect the casks?
I have! This wine must still be good and highly valued. I am thinking of throwing a huge celebration in town and would possibly like to offer this to the guests. What do you think?
I think it is a good idea, but you should sample the vintage.  I have a hammer to remove the cork on one ...
Open them and let's have a taste test shall we? I want to provide nothing but the BEST for my guests!
Here, have a sip, my King!
*takes sip* Oh, how delightful! I think this would suite well for the celebration we are having. How much do you have here to serve?
oh, looks like 20 barrels of this vintage, and 15 barrels from the vintage of the next year.
How many people do you think that will supply?
Well, each barrel has about 250 bottles worth, each bottle will serve 6 glasses, so thirty thousand glasses worth of the good stuff.
Oh, good. This will most certainly do. I am so excited. Say, will you be there?
I wouldn't miss it.

Good then. You shall help me spread the word about this celebration. You may ask for what reason we are celebrating, and I say it is because we have had such a fantastic year. Our empire is full of good people doing good things. Any recommendations on how I can make this celebration better?
People enjoy a good carnival, also a good dance.
Where shall I acquire such things? Who shall I contact?

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: Oh hello, what are you doing here jester?
Oh, just like two snare drums and a cymbal that fell off this arrow house, ba dum CHA!
I, uh... don't get that one?
Perhaps I could juggle your arrows archer?
Ohh could you? That would be quite entertaining after all of my hard work.
What have you been doing? You know, dying is easy, comedy is hard.
Just practicing my aim, really. And yourself?
Your aim you say? I am working on my Hit. ; )
Oh goodness, jester, that was bad.
Well my friend, I don't have a rubber chicken, so should we exchange this object?
Exchange it for what?
For your soul?
I think I'm gonna need more than just a flower for that!
See, and here I had heard you hadn't been de-flowered yet!

agents: drunk reeling out of the saloon
agent_personas: I am known as the town drunk. I frequent the local pubs on a daily basis and drink beer till my belly is full. I commonly start fights with other patrons and get thrown out of the saloon.
