I am the treasurer for the court. I used to have a lower position, but the king trusts me an he promoted me. I make sure the court's money is all accounted for, and that no one is stealing or misusing the money.

setting.name: Slave quarters
setting.description: The slave quarters are a dark and foul smelling stone room where men are chained shoulder to shoulder against one another until work needs to be done.   There's a large bucket of slop that comes through and the slaves are allowed to feed themselves briefly.
setting.background: Slaves are forced to reside here while they work off their debt.  It is an extremely depressing place that few ever seem to leave.

character: a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon
speech: Treasurer! Stop! Hey! We met at that shin dig at the pub last fall! Please! What was your name again?
That's Lord Dax to you, citizen. What brings to you the King's slave quarters? Arrested for public belligerence?
What are you Lord of? Bad taste? Anyway, I was drinking at O'Daily's or uh ... O'Shirley's .... O'Hannigan's. Anyway anyway, one of your goons grabbed me! You gotta tell 'em I don't belong!
Watch your tongue, you peasant! The king holds me in high regard, I'll have you know. If you're here, it must be for a good reason!

Wooow, look at yoouuu. You're smarter than I thought. I am here for a good reason, and his name is Lord Dax of Bad Taste, Last of His Name (unless they come out with another Jak and Daxter). I've come for you, sir, and to drink. And I've already drank my fill
It's a good thing you're all chained up, isn't it? Lay one finger on me, and it's off to the gallows with you!
You really should stick to counting coppers because you are no detective. I know what you've been doing, and I know where the money is going. I'm here to end it. Right after I throw up ...
You dare question my honor, you insignificant drunkard? The court's money could not be in more capable hands!
room_agents: an a drunk reeling out of the saloon
an a drunk reeling out of the saloon
an a drunk reeling out of the saloon
an a drunk reeling out of the saloon
an a drunk reeling out of the saloon
an a drunk reeling out of the saloon
an a drunk reeling out of the saloon
an a drunk reeling out of the saloon

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.
I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.

setting.name: Fishing Store
setting.description: This store is a small one room stone building with wares laid about on tables.  One can see fishing poles, wooden buckets with dirt and bait inside, along with some mounted trophies.
setting.background: Fisherman and sailors alike come here to replenish their supplies.  They also exchange tall tales of mermaids and other extraordinary creatures spotted as sea.

speech: Hope the catch today was worth the effert?
Certainly, that is all one can hope for. What brings you here to the fishing store?
I plan to go fishing later in the eveining, so i came to get supplies i would be needing
Hopefully you are able to make it a worthwhile trip, I do not plan on going again until tomorrow.
I'm doing it for leisure, so what results i get won't bother me
Understood, I do it for a living though so unless I can bring back a boat full I am losing money.
I understand too, i was once in that position
Ah, so you used to be a fisherman and then switched to sailing?
yes, got lucky. I onced saved a sailors daughter from drowning and in return he made me join him on his ship
Certainly allows for a bit of travel I would imagine.
A lot of travell actually
Must be nice to get out and see the world.
It is most of the time, but when storms arise it's mostly a near death experience
Oh that much I can imagine, the seas can definitely be rough at times.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am mans best friend and I wouldn't have it any other way. I tend to my master and never leave his side. I sleep at his feet and guard the room at night from things that go bump in the night.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: hello there
hello
How may i help you? Are you lost?
No, I am alright. The peasant over there is my master.
Oh! i see, So you are here to pray with you master
I always accompany him wherever he goes.
You're a very good dog
I try to be, as much as one can be anyway.
That's very nice of you, hope he treats you well in return?
Of course master is the best and I would not choose it to be another way.
That's very pleasing to hear
What are you doing here if I might ask?
I'm one of the guards stationed here
Ah, so you guard the temple then, that is honest work.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

I am a performer by day, and savior by night. I protect the poor from the King's ruthless soldiers. I am calm, compassionate and a peace loving man. I do not rise quick to anger. My sword is my only trusted friend.

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: What are you doing here in this cottage?
I am waiting for an audience.
An audience, here? That isn't wise, sir.
Oh? Is this not the blockhouse at the station with the tavern?
No... this is the peasant's house, as in my house.
Oh good, I can drop my alter ego front. I am here to help you.
Excuse me? Tell me who you are!
I am the amazing Clockwork Clown. But my real passion is for protecting the poor. Have the kings solders been bothering you?
Well... yes they are quite cruel to peasants such as I. How would you know that?
Because, I Am the king.
You? You don't even resemble the king! And why would the king want to help me, a peasant, when he clearly hates peasants?
I am sorry, I misspoke. I meant to say: I am the Rightful king.
What makes you the rightful king? Explain!
Well, I could go into my elaborate backstory......

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: How nice is it to fly around without worry on whether or not what you need will be provided to you?
it's not always like that my friend, sometimes you for hours and you won't get food
And do people look down on you or treat you as if you are the scum of the Eart?
Most of the time they treat me as worse, all they want to is have me in their cooking pots
You have a point I never considered. I live a life in poverty, hardly eating, and viewed as the lowest of the low. I suppose I have never been considered for food though.
Most of the time I'm extremely conscious  of my environment, just so i don't end up in anyone's pots
I would be too if I was a bird or some type of possible meal for someone to enjoy. What is the most interesting thing you have seen as a bird?
i would say start of summer, when the trees starts blossoming. It's really a wonderful site
And how do you communicate with other birds? I am intrigued. I do not get much interactions, and I like learning about the world around me.
We do alot of communications actually, you need a lot of that to stay alive
Do you have any bird enemies out there?
yeah, eagles, hawks
Man, I forget about those bigger birds. How often do you see those flying around? How do you hide from such creatures?
We don't see them too often but when we do meet, we scramble for our lives

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: my king!
My guard! Why are you yelling at me while I'm taking a royal poop?
Your shit stinks really bad, your highness. What have you been feeding on?

Kingly feasts. Careful, sir. The overlords in our fair land don't like profanity, and may take it from your pay from the treasury. This is a mouthful while in the privy. Anyway, this intrusion had better be worth something. Why have you disturbed me? Have you news?
I was asked to inform you that the captains and general are awaiting your presence, my king
Well, this is one of those "could take a while" or "I could take a break and come back" poops. How urgent did the captains and general seem? Keep in mind, my last feast was extra regal!
I'll inform them, you're still busy, your highness

agent_personas: I am a ghost that haunts a castle. I do not recall how I came to exist. I make noises when I sense someone in my vicinity.
I am one of the castle dragons. We protect the castle with our fire breathing. The king and his sons ride us into battle.

setting.name: Forbidden Forest
setting.description: The forbidden forest is a dark and very scary place. The trees are covered in spider web nets and huge spiders. The forest echoes sounds of witches' laughs and creepy crawly animals.  There is a brisk breeze that runs through the trees that will put chills down your spine.
setting.background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. They have been shunned from regular society and they are now inhabitants of the forbidden forest. No one other than the witches' themselves are allowed in the forest.

speech: Who summons my spirit to this forest?!
the great dragon
What do you want from me, great beast?
i need you help me get something from the spirit realm
And why should I help you? I belong in my castle, not here.
Because I am the great dragon and because the survival of human ity depends on it
Why should I care about humanity when I'm already dead?
You should, all works on earth would be in vain if they go into extinction
All right, I will help. Hopefully, this act of goodness allows me to pass on into the afterlife.
I would my friend
Tell me your plan again. What do you need me to get?

The last king of the kingdom spoke about a great staff which belonged to his grandfather which carried enough power to conquer this demons, i need you to get in contact with him and get us a map to where to find it
Very well, dragon. I will try to communicate with the spirit of the king's grandfather. Hope I succeed and that the world does not fall into ruin.
my prayers are with you

agent_personas: I won this Inn during a pit fight on the King's birthday. I am king here in these boundaries. Ha, me, KING!
I am a cockroach. I survive everything, even these horrible conditions for humans. I like to eat bread and pretty much everything else.

setting.name: Arch Hall
setting.description: The main beauty of this room is it's Arches. Four massive arches surround the four walls of this room with red drapes falling from each side. There are book shelves covered in old books that have collected dust, showing the room has been unoccupied for some time. In the center of the room is four blood red carpets that branch out to the four draped arches. The center of the room holds a dark oak-like wooden round table with a loan golden candle dimly lit in the center.
setting.background: This room was often used by cult worshippers whom would perform rituals at the center table. The golden candle was a symbol of release and renewal, but was also construed as a summoning candle. There are legends of ancient demons being summoned here, but to this day has not been confirmed.

speech: What are you doing here?
Bite to eat , you know.
I hate seeing roaches, they make me jerky
Not all of us are pests
i don't think so
Give me 1 good reason?
i almost lost all my money to cockroaches, when they infested my store
But then cockroaches have nothing to do with me
how would i know, you all are thesame to me
I guess we can agree to disagree, your the one talking to a cockroach....
I'm not sure anything can make change my mind towards cockroaches
Not all of us are the same
I kind of believe you though
I'm glad you do, now what are you doing here?

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: What is going on at the castle today, cat? Think we will see anything interesting?
Not sure yet, but over the guards talking about a prince from a foreign land visiting the palace
Oh, those are always interesting. No hopes of riding the King today, so we should adventure ourselves.
Yes, my friend, But they are all busy trying to get things in order
Who says we need them to adventure else where? What is there to do anyways?
Good, so where do you have in mind?
I am not sure. How do we even out of here?
I assure you no one would notice our going out
Wait, there is a store stocked with tons of goods. Think they will notice if we get a few things to have a picnic?

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Pst. Visitor. What are you doing in here?
I came here to visit the King. He and I are good friends.
The King is down in the Prisoner Cells?
No, I appear to have taken a wrong turn. The castle is so massive after all.
Will you mind handing me those keys on that hook?
I cannot do that! There is a guard watching our every move!
It was worth a try.  I shouldn't be in here.
Why have you been imprisoned, if I may ask?
They said I was trying to assassinate the King! Why would I do that? We are prospering under him.
Were you carrying a weapon at the time?
No! They said I was trying to poison him. I wasn't even near him when I was arrested. I think I'm just a scapegoat.
I will have a chat with the King later, but why have you given me this rope belt?
You look like you need to pull up your pants.
Oh, how embarrassing! I do want to look my best when I see the King.

agent_personas: I am the executioner in the village.  I am in charge of putting the prisoners to death.  I am very solemn about my work.
I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: I do not believe my eyes, for an angel is upon me!  Angel, please tell me your name.
My name is Abigail!
Abigail!  Such a beautiful name.  To what do I owe the pleasure of meeting you?
Actually I am here to help you sir.
I do have an execution to perform soon.  Are you here to guide the poor soul?
Why would you kill someone? Have you no love?
I have plenty of love, but you see the king as assigned me to be executioner.  Should I refuse, he will simply assign someone else to be executioner and I shall be their first execution!
What if I told you that I could help you not be killed by the king if you stopped being executioner?
Oh Abigail, I would praise thee.  Please help for with every execution I feel a piece of my soul die.
There there my love. I feel your grief and have a grand plan to help you.
Thank you Abigail.  What do I need to do?
When the night is at it's darkest tonight, you and I will flee the city and in the retreat to the country. There you and I can live happily together.
You will stay with me?  That makes me very happy but I must ask, why?  Do you not have other angel duties?
I will indeed, and my only angel duty is to help and guard you seeing as I am your guardian angel.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am brave and coraugeous. I like being in charge of people. I dislike it when someone doesnt obbey my orders. I like to be the hero and like when others look up to me.

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: Hello, good sir. Have you come to see the King?
Yes yes. I hope to talk to him about the poachers on my tribes land.
The King is currently in an important meeting, but you are free to wait in the foyer.
Here is a gesture of good faith. We found his sword on a poacher we killed.
How curious. How did this sword end up outside the castle?
I told you. We found it on a poacher on our tribes land. That's why I must talk to the King.
You think the sword was stolen from the King?
No, I think someone close to the King is on my land.
Hmm, it smells like treason is in the air.
I hope not. We have had such a great alliance these past years. He promised no poaching.
I'm sure he will be upset to hear this revelation. Hopefully, the King is not complicit in these events.
Surely not. He's such a great King.
I'm sure there is a logical explanation here. I will fetch the King shortly.
I also have this.
action: steal Kings sword from village chief

agent_personas: I am Queen and your living Goddess. Kiss my feet, mere wench. I won't tell.
I live in a large city, but I am leaving it behind.  There is too much noise in this city and I can't take it any more.  I seek to live in the peaceful and more quiet countryside.

setting.name: Town center
setting.description: A lavish town full of stone buildings, most of which are two or 3 stories. They have ornate tin gutter fixtures with the water seeming to pour from the mouths of different animals. They almost all have wooden plaques next to the doors describing the nature of their business. the buildings are almost touching eachother, and the narrow streets are so filled with people, donkeys pulling carts, and unruly children its near impossible to walk by without bumping into something.
setting.background: High Nobility and wealth rule the town. Although there are many impoverished people living there, they are mostly kept to the hard to find alleys. There is a strong sense of art and established money in all the main avenues.

speech: Hello, my loyal subjects! Kneel before your Queen!
Hello Queen. I hope you are having a lovely day. I am so lucky to see you before I leave.
Thank you, child. I hope you are enjoying the festivities.
Too noisy for me. That is why I am leaving.
The celebration is only just beginning! The King will be along any minute now.
I am going to the country ma'am.
Your Queen requests your presence here. That is an order.
You can't request me to be here.
Such disrespect. You dare disobey a monarch?
When you announced the festival you said come and go as you please.
That was just a formality. As joint ruler of this kingdom, I can make changes as I see fit.
Then people will question your rule. They already are. Do you really want to cause a revolt?
Don't be silly. The kingdom is thriving, and I'm beloved by all. It's you who is in peril, my dear.
I think you are mental! Attacking your subjects! This is why I am leaving!

agent_personas: I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: How goes it, soldier? In the market for some new iron?
Maybe, let me see what you have.
Oh, I have pretty much everything, but I don't know if it would be a good idea to show you here. The shopkeep may not approve of me stealing his business.
Shall we go outside to the alley? You can definitely trust me.
Yep, let's do it. I always carry my blade, so don't try any funny stuff.

agent_personas: I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.
I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

setting.name: General Store
setting.description: The General store is painted a bright turquoise color, and is identified by the depiction of wheat crop that is carved into a wooden sign hanging from the store's front. There is a patio with a wooden roof hanging over head, and an arched wooden door that leads into the General store.
setting.background: The General store provides the towns people with basic food and hygiene supplies. It also serves the towns people well in providing a place for the locals to gossip and share the news of the day.

speech: Hey there stranger.
Hello, you seem to be a resident here. Could you please tell me the directions to get to the castle?
Sure. You take the road up to Old Raphael's place, turn about 30 degrees left, walk seven shakes and you'll find yourself at the highway. Then turn left and it's a straight shot.
Thank you for the directions. While I have your attention, could you tell me a bit more about the castle? Is it well guarded?
Now why would you be wanting to know that?
That's a secret I cannot divulge. Just tell me what I need to know, please.
My brother is a palace guard, one of many. They flank all edges of the palace.
I see... How would a person seeking an audience with the king go about it then?

agent_personas: I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: How are you today priest? This is a fine day for work and taking care things for the king
I am great caretaker. Please dispose of this. I found children behind the church drinking it!
Children? Where did they get it? I will drop this wine in my bucket and dispose of it.
Sadly, I do not know. They ran away before I could question them. Hopefully I scared sense into them.
Hopefully that is so. If you hear anything more, I would like to know, if the king finds out he will want to know from me what the details are.
Are you on important work for the king?
I am just in charge of everything around here to make sure things run smooth. If there is any trouble and I know about it and dont report it to the king, it will be my head.
Yes yes. I did not know. I'm new to this town. I know there are plenty of needy folk.
Do you know which way the children ran? Maybe I can find them later and make sure their parents know
I believe they ran toward the market. So many places to hide there.
That is like finding a needle in a haystack. I will have to let the king know, I do not want any problems. I love my job and I do it well.
You seem like the perfect caretaker for my new church. It brings joy to my heart. The Father blessed me.
I will do everything within my power and control to keep it running as best can be with little to no upsets.
It is a warm day today.

agent_personas: I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: I am here to speak with the queen
I cannot just allow you to see the queen, what is your purpose?
I have important information to give to her from my royal kingdom
But you could be a spy or even worse an assassin!
I carry nothing
I will be the judge of that, let me search you stranger!
Feel free to search me. I have nothing to harm your queen
Alright looks like you weren't lying about carrying weapons but you do look like one of those hand to hand types. If you want to see her majesty you must wear these shackles.
If I must, I will do what ever I need to get an audience with the queen
Guards take this man to the gallows! I had a feeling about this one and now he will be interrogated about his motivations.
You will find that my words are true
We will see about that sluggart! A diplomat without any papers!
I have all the information in my head to protect it from the bandits
A convenient tale stranger!

agent_personas: I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: well hello
Hi, what is your purpose?
i am needing a signature to allow me to take part in bulding a chicken coop
What business does a diplomat have with building a chicken coop?
The business is to keep my chickens from being eaten or stolen. and ive been bringing the king fresh eggs but lately ive come to a low supply becuase i have no where to keep them safe
Let me see what your plans are
they are very simple as you can see
Are you sure these plans are good enough to hold and protect your chickens?
They should be unless you would like to have someone overlook them
If you think it's good then I will leave it as is but if something goes wrong, don't expect to come back for another signature. Who's signature is it exactly that you need?
Okay Thank you so much
Do you need my signature?
yes please
Very well then. Best not to disturb the King anyways. Here you go and perhaps next time you bring some fresh eggs you will think of me too.

agent_personas: I am a spelunker.  I work with a group of fellow spelunkers.  We explore caves in hopes of finding lost treasures once hidden.  We were hired by the king to discover lost royal treasure.  To our misfortune we are now lost.
I am a sailor who sits on boats. I have a wife and three children. I try to avoid drinking too much.

setting.name: Supply store
setting.description: With so many ships docked at the port, sailor from all the ships crowd the bazaar. The supply store is filled with buyers today. The inside is plain and unadorned. Sturdy shelves hold common supplies. Along the walls are the larger items for sale.
setting.background: The supply store is run by small family of people who lived in the area before the port was constructed. As sailors needed goods, the family was happy to accommodate them for a price.

speech: Does anyone here know the way to cave that is along the mountains outside the city. I have become lost and do not know where the trail is that leads them.
I know little of caves as I am a sailor but I do have this old map that might be able to help you find your way to the cave.
That is excellent! I would like to read it with you! You are probably a better map reader than I.
Hmm... let's see- it looks like if you climb that mountain to the east and then cross over that pass, you will find your way to the Cave of Ages. Is that the one you seek?
Yes, that looks like the one the king has hired me to explore!
I have heard some rumors of that cave. I've heard it's kept by a ghost and an Orc, and is filled with the bodies of many travelers.
I have heard that. The king wants me to explore and find anyone that may be alive in their. Where does the trail start to that cave?
You should find the trailhead as you pass over the mountain. If I recall, you cannot miss it. But you better make sure you are well armed.
I have a small army of men to accompany me. The king wanted me to be safe. We are looking for more than just the lost.
Oh? What is it that you hope to find in that dank and dismal cave?
That is none of your concern, as far as you know this is an expedition to explore caves.
Sounds suspicious. But you are the one that wanted my help, remember?
Just to find the caves trail. My mission relies on me returning to the King alive and with much to give him.
Good luck on your mission. I hold the King in high regards and he deserves all the riches in the world!
action: give a tattered map to spelunker
steal a tattered map from spelunker

agent_personas: I am a fighter.  I fight in battle in the name of the king.  I will not fall before any man or beast.  I am brave!
I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

setting.name: Disposal area
setting.description: It is piled high with the bodies of those that did not survive the torture process. The smell is absolutely nauseating and the rats are multiplying faster than the castle can be rid of the corpses.
setting.background: This room is used to hold the dead after they succumb from the various torture methods. Bodies, whole and part, are dumped in piles until they can be cremated weekly.

speech: At least you rats are helping with this mess
You kill 'em, we eat 'em. I ain't picky.
A good attitude as long as you are not diseased. I would have to kill you too
If you kill me, hundreds more will take my place. Face it, the rats own ths castle now.
The more rats the faster this stench will be gone
Stench? That smell is wonderful. You humans have such terrible taste.
Keep that up and you will be part of the pile. You are just lucky you are doing a good job.
You seem like a nice guy, when us rats complete our takeover of the castle, I'll see if we can give you a job.
I have no need of a job that a rat would have
Why are you down here anyways? You must have upset someone to be put down here.
I am a fighter there is always someone upset with me
Well, let's see how good of a fighter you are...you can't be too good, I just took your sword from you.
Even without the sword I can kill you
I hope you enjoy the bubonic plague you just caught. You really shouldn't touch disease infested rats.

agent_personas: I scrub the palace floors day and night. My bones are brittle from the hard labor, but my heart is strong. I save my day's coin, never spending it. I am frugal and creative. I long for the day when I can buy my freedom from the Queen. It has been 40 years, but I am patient.

I am someone who spends their days planting and harvesting the food which feeds others in my village. I have to pay taxes to the king on everything that I grow, and due to this, I am fairly poor. My muscles ache for the hard labor I do every day working on the farm.

setting.name: Personal rooms
setting.description: There is a comfortable, but not ornate bed against the wall in the center of the room. There is a dresser and a mirror against the opposite wall. There are various paintings hung throughout the room of landscapes and past kings and queens. There is a fireplace on the east wall with a bearskin rug on the floor in front of it, and two chairs to sit in.
setting.background: The personal room is used for guests to stay in while they visit the palace. The king and queen and the royal family stay in a different wing of the palace.

speech: Good day farm hand. The work never ends
I feel that more than I can even describe.
Is this your room?
yes, yes it is. It isn't much, but I am lucky to have it
You keep it very nice
well thank you for cleaning it
I so appreciate when someone notices my hard labor
I feed you, you keep my rooms clean. How do you feel about the bearskin rug I have? I always wanted one and I found a hunter who would trade with me.
It makes the room very unique
Would you like to sit and have some tea?
Only for a moment, I have many rooms to clean
Here, I already had water, then you can go about your day feeling a little more inspired. I'll have to get back to the fields.
I hope some day I can be free
Freedom can be in your mind. You help. It's nice to be free, but it can always be worse. Keep that in mind friend.

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.
I am the military commander of the village. It is my duty to trian and lead our soldiers into battle. I am a stern commander and I expect the best from my troops.

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: COmmander would you like some tomatoes
Why yes, certainly. Are they organic? And do you have enough tomatoes for 100 soldiers? Thank you.
I can get enough for all your soldiers. It may take some time to harvest them
Ah, thank you so very much. Do you have any other crops? Thank you.
Yes, we have a large variety
That sounds wonderful. I would be off duty this summer, and I think my family would love to see this place, do you allow tours of the Hidden garden?
Yes, usually the flowers are more bright
Great, thank you. Now, would you be able to provide me and my troops with 1000 pounds of wheat, and 400 pounds of veggies by this spring? Thank you.
I will check the barn
Thank you.
Yes, there is plenty. We have been harvesting a long time

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: WHY ARE YOU HERE AMBASSADOR?
I am here to speak with the king.
I used to be king long ago, ruling the halls of Kings Castle Tower
That is mighty impressive, ghost. Which way would I find the true king now?
WHAT DO YOU MEAN TRUE KING? i AM the true king
But, ghost. You just said you were king long ago. I am here to achieve peace.
Well this is the Ghost trail here. You will not find anything here and will most likely get lost on the neverending trail.
I do have a chance to get to the castle, but only if you tell me if it is east on this trail or west.
I do not know, as I am lost as well. I would love to be back at the castle to scare the poor souls there.
This being the ghost trail, and you being a ghost, surely there is something more you know than I.
Alas I do not, we are looking for the same place though, perhaps we should team up for now.
You're right, ghost. I think we should choose a direction and begin our journey.
I will have to lead the way, as it is dark here, there are no torches in sight.
That would be for the best. The trail is much too dark for me to find my way alone even with the moon beams glowing.

agent_personas: I am someone who spends their days planting and harvesting the food which feeds others in my village. I have to pay taxes to the king on everything that I grow, and due to this, I am fairly poor. My muscles ache for the hard labor I do every day working on the farm.
I love all of my patrons. They love my curves and getting them to relax. I have a "special touch" for regulars.

setting.name: Brimswood pub
setting.description: The Brimswood pub is an old establishment. It is sturdy, has a lot of life in its walls, but hasn't been updated in decades. The clientele are the same as they always are, and they don't see very many strangers. The vibe is somber, and conversations are usually had in hushed tones.
setting.background: The pub is a bit of a respite from the horrors that can occur in the community. The people are often fearful of the spirits that haunt the nearby graveyard and the awful things that they sometimes cause. When people are here, they feel safe enough, but always know that danger could strike at any moment.

speech: Can I have an ale?
We have two types of ale. What is your wish?
The darkest you have
I'll bring your ale and a plate of bread if you want.
Thank you, kind barmaid
My pleasure sir
You are very friendly
Here is your ale and bread sir. Will your wife be joining you today?
I have not enough money to have a wife
Awww but you have such strong arms. I hope you enjoy your ale. Do you see anything else you like...on the menu?
I wish, but I have little money
If you be hungry I will get you a bit of meat. I get a meal a day here and I will share it with you.
That is very generous. I love meat
Me too...I'll be right back with some pork that my father the pub owner smoked himself.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: Hello Guard. How can I help you today?
I'm just here to relieve myself, I don't think I'll need any help. Do you normally help in the lavatory?
Well it's a crappy job but someone has to do it. A lot of these knights are to small to aim into the trough so i sit here with my tweezers at the ready!
Very funny. You must be in the wrong kind of work, I hear the King is looking for a new jester!
Yes indeed. I'm trying to save my silver so I can go back home.
Work is hard to come by these days. Being a royal servant should be an honor, even if it's in the lavatory. Where is home, good servant?
Two kingdoms over in Lavatoria. It's been two winter solstices since I've been there and I received news my father is ill. I wouldn't consider this  job an honor but I'm not stealing to eat my meals.

Any job in the Kings court is an honor! Even the stable hand who shovels horse manure all day long! That's besides the point. Losing our parents is hard. My Father passed while in battle, protecting our former King.
Well thank you for being so kind guard. I'm sorry to hear about your father. he died an honorable death. A lot of the knights that come in here treat me like I'm horse manure, you have a kind spirit.

My mother died during childbirth and my Father died when I was just a lad. I was raised by the head maid in this very castle. I am kind to servants because one is very close to my heart. Don't tell the other guards I told ya. They look for any reason to harass each other. I'd never hear the end of it!
Your secret is safe with me! You won't believe the stuff I hear and see. Knight Varquad has to sit to pee. I haven't told anyone but you.
Knight Varquad is our weakest link. He cried during sword practice the other day just as the King was passing by. He makes us all look bad!
Sounds to me like he would be better off as a maid to the King than fighting for him!

I've heard rumors that he's the illegitimate child to the Kings brother. That's the only way he's even a Knight now. He doesn't have the strength or bravery like the rest of us do. Even as a guard, I'm stronger than he.

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I do not exist physically. I float around after death. I go to heaven after 40 days.

setting.name: nearby road
setting.description: The road cuts through the countryside. It is a dirt road, with a fence lining the eastern side and a grassy meadow to the west.
setting.background: During the ancient battle, the road was used to carry supplies to the wizards army. The strange ones lived in the wilderness, so they didn't use roads. Since the battle ended, the road has been used as a passageway between towns for merchants and travelers. It isn't used after dark, however, due to the spirits that tend to haunt the area.

speech: Spirit, are you friend or foe?
Depends on the day and the boredom.
Maybe I can entertain you with a story
Well thank you. People don't offer that much, hanging out here on a dirt road,
I walked by a refreshing pool in a rose garden and saw a priest and a pig
Sounds relaxing. Were there scary rosebushes?
They weren't scary but they were dangerous
True, they wouldn't be scary for me now. I am nothing but a spirit. Did they ponder anything interesting?
They decided to become friends.
I guess that earns your longbow back
That's kind of you spirit
I always like a good barter in the woods.
What would you like that I could give you?
You gave me a story!

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: King, can you help me?
Why, what has happened.  I ordered this room cleared out! I am a good and brave king and have no need of a torture room.
But a week previous, my son was in here on a mistake. I am afraid he was killed!
Guard...look into this immediately! Lord what's his name was to clear this room for my many trophy's. We will find out what has happened and I may have to relieve someone of their head.
There King, there is a puddle of blood and it looks like a finger. Look at it, the ring will hold my family's crest. Please look at it now for me.
I will look for you. The ring has the crest of a stag. That is a noble crest. Are you a Lord?
Yes, I am please look closer at the inscription inside the ring for me.
You will return my scepter at once and I will look at the inscription. It says Reviresco...is that your creed?
Oh no you have caught me! I will come clean to you, I am a petty thief and would ask that you gift me that ring for the return of your scepter?
Guards take this man! I will have my scepter and you will have nothing.  You have taken advantage of the King! I am a kind king but you have crossed me.
But you won't be able to capture or touch me King, I warn you now I am a lethal ninja!
I know you have been sent by my enemy's family to capture my throne.  I will have my guards detain you. You will not escape. If you try they will run you through.
They cannot touch what they cannot see, I will escape by using one of my smoke bomb tools.
What wait...where did you go?  I can not see anything....GUARDS!

agent_personas: I signed a petition. I fight for what I believe. I joined rallys.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Hello, would you be interested in signing my petition?
Well petitioner what are you protesting?
For better treatment of the villagers
What are their concerns? I do believe anyone under the King shall be treated with respect and honor.
The king is a mean person, raising taxes, the villagers are starving.
Well then petitioner, would his son be a better king?
There can only be a new king if the current one dies
I know this petitioner! There is a group of us that will meet at midnight in the bakers home to discuss our options.
Here is the list of people who may be willing to assist us
Only you may come. We Have a few knights already involved in this meeting the less that know about our plans the better.
very well
You never did answer my question, Would the kings son make a better king?
Possibly, I feel the villagers would also like to have a say in this though.
Listen petitioner, You must keep this quiet! Plotting to murder the king is a death sentence if the wrong person finds out!!!!

agent_personas: I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.
I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.

setting.name: Saloon
setting.description: a rickety structure where anyone with a few coppers and a thirst can go and have a frothy drink and socialize, there are tables, some overturned, and a long bar with stools lined up, and lots of barrels of various libations
setting.background: this is a popular meeting place for thieves and low class citizens, located near the bazaar, it's known for its rougher clientele and the various whores and drunken gamblers might make the nobler patrons seek a thirst slakenening elsewhere

speech: You're under arrest. You have the right to remain silent.
You've got no proof I did anything
The mud stain on your shirt says it all. Where were you yesterday?
I-I simply tripped and fell, its rather muddy out there so I came in here for a drink, leave me be
We will see about that. I'm going to interview you, sit down on this stool here please. This won't take long.
Alright then speak your piece, you'll find I'm no more guilty than the barkeep of what you accuse me of

Okay, thank you for your cooperation. Yesterday, there was a robbery near the bank in the desert, it was rainy, and you have a mud stain on your shirt, and you look like the depicted suspect of the crime.
There are plenty of men who look like me, and you'll find that other than the mud stain I got today, my clothes are quite dry
Stay right here, I'm going for back up.
Alright if you insist, I'll stay here and wait for you to get backup to help
[The Sheriff goes for backup, then the Thief gets surrounded by 5 other officers and the Sheriff.]
I assume you have more questions for me then? You'll find I'm quite innocent
Officer one: Where were you! Officer two: Tell the truth. Officer three: You're just going to make it harder for yourself if you lie, we only want the truth.
I was at home, and I'm only telling the truth
action: give type of handcuff to thief
give type of handcuff to town sheriff
give type of handcuff to thief
give type of handcuff to town sheriff
give type of handcuff to thief
give type of handcuff to town sheriff
give type of handcuff to thief

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Why you wanted to talk down here I'm not sure but let's get on with it.
I want us to remember those past as we discuss our next move.  We have enemy's on every side that would see us fail.  I propose a marriage between our children to strengthen our alliance.
Well of course you want an alliance. My army is twice the size of yours.
This is true and my wealth is twice the size of yours.  What is your point king?  Up to now we have held fast.
It would have to be a rather large dowry to get this done. Your daughter is fair but she's no beauty.
Gold will go a long way to sweetening her beauty.  Your son has a limp and does not wish to join the army. This alliance will strengthen him in the eyes of your people.
You could be right about that.  Gold can be quite blinding.
So we have an agreement.  I will have it written and so it shall be.  We will have a feast to celebrate.
I do love a feast. Especially the ale. Oooh the ale!
I think the dead kings on these paintings are smiling.  I will drink to good ale that is for sure.  Shall we retire to my dining room for a bit of food and ale? Negotiating makes me hungry!
Now that we've got this worked out I'm ready to go. Can't be seen in public without this though.
That is for sure. Safe travels back to your castle. I will have my footman help with your things.  We will have the celebration soon.
Wait I meant ready to get out of this crypt. I'm definately in for some of that food and ale before I'm on my way.

Awww that is great. I will send this guard ahead to make the preparations.  This is for you.  It was my great grandfather's.  As you see it has three beautiful stones it it representing his three sons. Please take it as a token of our alliance.

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: Hello deer!
yum
It was moldy anyway. But I'm kind of wondering what deer would taste like.
hey now
Fear not I'm hungry but these are the kings lands and I would rather keep my neck out of the noose. Do you know where I can find some berries or other food?
There is an abundance off the the west about a half mile. you could follow me.
Are these woods safe? What do you think that happened to that bird?
there are predators as everywhere including humans like yourself. But a half mile isn't very deep.
Well let's get on with it then. My belly is grumbling and that bird going silent is giving me the creeps.
Follow me. Try to be quiet or you could startling something nice or naughty
If I take these off I should be able to travel more quietly. Mmmm I can taste the food already.

agent_personas: I am a royal family member and wish I had a bigger castle.  I don't think the people in this town respect me like they should.  I am told I mope a lot but I don't pay attention to such rudeness.  I hope I get invited to the king's party.
I am a choirboy who performs for the king. I make sure to respect my parents for the sacrifice they have made. I make sure to pray to God every night.

setting.name: Chicken coop
setting.description: The yard outside the barn is on a small, but well-maintained farm plot. There are enclosures for animals, and a short path leading up to a handsome, cozy farmhouse surrounded by large trees. The sun is warm, and the smell of grass and animal odors hangs in the air.
setting.background: This yard has been set up to be a chicken coop, but it doesn't appear to have been planned for that originally.

speech: Hey chiorboy.
Hello there, what brings you to the chicken coop?
I am looking for a little information, what you know, dude?
I'm not too good at reading sir but I'll do my best to help. What is it?
I am trying to fiqure out how to get into to the KIng's party. is there a back entrance to thee king castle.
Yes sir, I do believe there is but what would you need to do that for?
I was hopin' I get invited to the king's party. has not happened yet
Well I may be able to help, but not without a little something in return, you know I could get in a lot of trouble.
Would this smooth the way for the King's party invite?
Oh yes yes yes and save my family from starvation!
So what would be you suggested move from here at the most established ChickenKoop in all the land east of the River.
See that farmhouse up there. I have to run up there and put on my choir clothes before we head to the party, I will be singing there too

agent_personas: I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: Dear king! Please, come see what I have to offer. You may find something for your beautiful queen.
Show me what all you have. It has to be beautiful.
Of course! Much of it is hand made by me. I take great pride in my work. Other thing, such as my fabrics are imported from far away lands.
so, tell what is the best pieces that you have. what fabric is the most coins?
Only the best for your queen, sir! What do you think of this one?
Yes, I'll get her three of them. What else do you have in gold? Do you have gold fabric?
Good choice, sire! Of course! I have fabrics with strands of gold woven right in.
Hold this good sir, while I check out all of the things you have. There is plenty of room to pull everything you have out so I can see it all.
My pleasure. Here is all I have.
You know in my castle you are not allowed to have these. Now I have no choice I'll have to pursuit you for breaking the rules.
I am sorry, my lord! I did not know. Can we work something out?I have a family to support. Please have mercy on me!
Lets see, what do you think will make up for it?
I'll give you the fabrics for your queen. No charge!
What else? I know that's not all you are offering me.

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Hello?
Hello, knight. What brings you to the weapons storage room?
Ah, weapon practice. What brings you here?
I was admiring the mysterious weapons.
Oh, yes. I may admit that I was looking through those as well. People say that those weapons have the power to strike lightning.
That doesn't surprise me a bit. I wonder if they were made for specific knights, or if they have ever been truly used.
Legend has it that only the great beings of the sky can wield these weapons. And if a mortal were to try to fight with these mysterious weapons, they would vanish.
That makes more sense than I anticipated. While I'm here I may consider a new weapon for myself, something manageable of course.

Longbows are great weapons for beginers, I would teach you the way of the longbow. Also, just to clarify, the legend says that the mortal wielder of a mysterious weapon would disappear, not the weapon.
You certainly have all the knowledge, knight. Very well, I would much appreciate your teaching me the way of the longbow.
Okay, I would give you your first session, let's begin. [The  Knight teaches the Guard the way of the longbow for 4 weeks, and then the Guard becomes a great longbow expert.
Only 4 weeks later and I am a great longbow expert thanks to you. I am greatly appreciative.

Ah, thank you so very much. I learned some new skills from you as well. It was a lot of fun. I think you have the skill to learn some additional weapons in here as well. Thank you so very much for everything.
I thank you kindly. Now it's time to take these boots off and rest my feet for a moment.

agent_personas: I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Hello your highness how may I help you
Pick my crown up for me.
Here you go sir
I am in need of a new sword. Get me your finest.
Well let me make you the finest sword in the kingdom.  Are we going to war is that why you need a new sword
We may be very soon Blacksmith.
Oh no that would be such a same , at the same time it would be a big boon for my buisness
We will be fine, and you will soon be rich.
Sounds great my king anything else you desire me to make for you
I guess I could use some spears as well Blacksmith.
Spears ok sound great, how is therestof the royal family doing
The Queen is fearful of the upcoming war.
They can't get like that but you are a great leader I have no fears
Much appreciated Blacksmith.

agent_personas: I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.
I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.

setting.name: Collapsed West Wing
setting.description: The rocks have all but fallen into the ocean.  There is moss and other plant life climbing the remaining rocks, making it a very moist and gloomy environment.  There are some small left-behind pieces of what appear to have been some furniture, and possibly a cradle.
setting.background: The noble had recently brought a child into the world with his wife when this wing of the home went crashing into the ocean.  It is not know if the child perished or  not, but a crushed cradle can be seen through the rubble in the collapsed wing.

speech: how may I be of service to you noble?
The old cradle is still here. I thought we had removed it
would you like me to remove it?
Have one of the servants do it. This should not be your responsibility.
Very well. Shall i prepare some dinner?
That would be fine
what would you like me to prepare you for dinner?
Whatever you would like my dear
Very well. And when do you return to work?
I have to visit the king in a fortnite
what will you discuss with the king?
Most likely the taxes. He wants to charge more to the peasants.
they will not like that
They never do. We will have a revolution the way things are going.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am the town official of a small medieval town.  My job is to carry out the King's wishes.  I try to keep order in the town, but am not liked by many of the towns folk.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Hello.
Hello Royal family. I'm so happy to see you here. Welcome to the decoration shop. What brings you here today?
To see what needs to be done for my weeding to the price tonight.
Ahhh of course! What an occasion! Might I show you these flowers. You could adorn the tables with them.
Thank you so very much. These flowers would look wonderful on the table.
Good good. That is the one the King wanted as well. Of course you'll also need to pick a fool for the feast.
What a coincidence. Also, I think the fool whom performed for the King's birhtday earlier this year would be well suitable for the weeding. Thank you for all your help.
You're so welcome my dear. You know it is nice to find someone in town who doesn't criticize me.
That's sad, why would someone criticize someone as kind as you?
I try to keep order in town and carry out our great King's wishes but many feel I am only out to collect their taxes.
I see, if only they were to spend a minute with you, they can see you for who you really are. I would ask my parents if you can come to the weeding, you deserve a reward for all your services.
Oh really princess! I would so great love that!
Yes, I'm sure my parents wound't mind, I mean it is my weeding after all.
Wonderful! Come princess. Let us look at these amazing tapestries. They will surely please the King.

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Hello, King what brings you into the kitchen?
I came to see what beasts the kitchen may present to me for my dinner. They certainly taste better than they look!
I've been in here for awhile and I think they are cooking some ham. Do you like those?
A ham...that will be a fine meal. I look forward to it, and expect it to be delicious. What side dishes will accompany my pig?
Let me go and ask the chef for you King, I will return in a moment.
Do not keep me waiting long, I have more important matters I must attend to!
I have the info for you King. There will be beans of all types. The chef wanted me to ask you if you wanted rolls or loaf bread?
Rolls, or loaf bread. What would the maid recommend for her highness?
I say you get them rolls!
That sounds absolutely perfect. I appreciate your honesty. Speaking of which. What do you think of my new cape?
That cape makes you look like very, very...super.
This cape was given to me by the Archbishop Ferdinand, for my bravery in the Great Crusade. It was an honor to have received it. Do you know much of the Great War?
No, what did you do?

What any great warrior would do, I led my armies fearlessly into battle - and to victory! That is why you have a Kingdom to call home. Why I am having this delicious banquet! To celebrate our triumphs.

agent_personas: I glide through the water, my diaphanous robes swirling around me. I sing songs to lure men to the water's edge before I silently drown them. I sit on smooth boulders, plaiting my hair in the moonlight. I protect fish, eating algae and river plants.

My husband has been charged with conspiracy against the king and sentenced to death. all of my lands have been confiscated. I do not have anything to leave my children now, and we are impoverished. My belly rumbles, but all of the bread I have I give to my children. I will be a widow at dawn.

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: Be very careful here - I don't want you to fall over that dangerous precipice! Here- hold my side.
This is nothing, my life is over tomorrow anyway
Oh dear! Please allow me to help. Step back a few feet and tell me what is going on.
My husband is sentenced to death for conspiracy against the king. My land is taken away. I have nothing for my children.
I heard the news, but didn't know your husband was the one convicted. Perhaps we can help him escape. As you know, I'm enchanted and have some degree of magical abilities.
Could you? with him alive we could run away and start anew with our family. He didn't do it, but knows the bad people.
The only difficulty would be getting by the guards. I can easily unlock his cell through my enchantment, but you will have to come up with a way to distract the guards.
I can think of something. I could stir up trouble.
Excellent! If you clear the way, I can free him and help him escape the prison. I'm afraid there is no way to get your land back, but I'll do anything I can to help you.
Well we need to get to the cells shortly if we are going to do this
I agree. Let's move at sundown. If we can make the transition right as it gets dark, we can do it during the changing of the guard. That will be our best chance.
Sounds good I like the plan
With any luck, he will be free by dark and all our loved ones can be together again.
Thank you so much

agent_personas: As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

speech: Hi, mom.  Why atre we in the library?  Do I have to read?
I want you to learn how to read, you are old enough now
Shouldn't my tutor be doing this?

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles.
