agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

I am a carpenter in town and own a shop next to the blacksmith.  I specialize in making ornate furniture which is popular with the nearby elites.  I am meek and quiet, preferring to work with my tools in peace.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: Look at these tomatoes! Large, ripe, and perfectly red! I work hard to harvest the best tomatoes, but my tool shed is in shambles. It needs some serious work.
Those look great. I could build some shelves for you if I could have some tomatoes
That sounds like a fair trade. Also, water leaks in that corner there. Can you repair it, too? I can give you bushels of fresh vegetables in trade.
I've never done any plumbing before but I can try. Why is this place so badly kept?
I guess I wasn't clear. Not plumbing. The water leaks from the roof. Whoever made this shed did a horrible job.
Oh yeah I can definitely fix the roof. Do you have anything other than tomatoes?
Of course! Corn, peppers, fresh strawberries and blueberries. And in a few more weeks we will have potatoes and watermelon!
Oh that sounds amazing. All I've been eating is the slop from the dining hall
Everyone deserves fresh food - it keeps the body strong. See this rake? I would love to have a place to hang it and my shovel up when I'm done working at the end of the day.
I think I can take care of your needs. I can start working on the roof tomorrow
Fantastic - I couldn't be more pleased. I will have two bushels of fruits and vegetables ready for you in the morning with plenty more to come after that. I'll keep your family well-fed.
My wife will be so happy. The kids will be able to grow up big and strong
And I'll be able to more comfortably grow even better food - and maybe one day get a job working for the King!
I hope that works for you. I prefer to stay off his radar. I hear he's a bit crazy

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Library
setting.description: The library is a humongous cavernous room full of floor to ceiling shelves. Each shelf is stocked full of every type of book imaginable, most in impeccable condition. Near all of the shelves, there are types of reading nooks with benches or chaises for people to relax and read. There are some tables and chairs for study in one half of the room. There is a large fireplace in the center and some comfortable lounge chairs arranged around it for socializing. On the sparse wall space there are tapestries. Some small end tables hold huge vases of pink flowers.
setting.background: The library was built when the castle was built, because the current king was a studious individual. Many scholarly nobles came from far and wide to view the wide array of books, sometimes ancient ones.

speech: So many books to choose from, but I hardly know where to begin. With all of our current prosperity, I'm finding some time to read. What do you suggest?
My apologies, your majesty. I'm just a common villager. The librarian is over there!
Ah yes, I know. But I like to keep up with what everyone desires. Besides, the librarian is so stuffy! She expects me to read these huge historical tomes.
I'm humbled that a king would seek my opinion! I prefer practical books myself. Such as cookbooks or home decor.
Ah! The queen has many cookbooks. Even with her many cooks she enjoys making me the sweets that fill my big belly! Can't you tell?
What kind of hobbies do you enjoy then, your majesty?
I love to eat! Haha! I also enjoy long conversations with family members, people of the kingdom, and travelers from around the world. And I have one guilty pleasure! I do enjoy delicious wine.
Perhaps a book on the history and types of wine would suit your taste?
Ah! You are very wise! What is your job in the kingdom?
I am a baker! I love everything to do with bread, cakes, pastries, you name it!

Of course! I think I remember seeing you now! Perhaps you could help me a bit. The Queen is having a birthday and I want to surprise her with her favorite chocolate royal cake. Could you make a large one for me? It would need to serve at least 50 people.
That is no problem at all, your majesty! I love to be challenged! Do you have a specific design in mind?
Three tiers, with red flowers on top would make her day so special.
Of course, my king! It would be an absolute honor to serve you and the queen. Your endorsement would be terrific for my business!

agent_personas: I am a noble from the West. I am well educated and versed in politics. I command attend and punish insubordination harshly.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Say, how are you cousin? Have you heard of the latest battle in the West?
I have not heard of such. What is going on? You know I am close to the throne but not that close to be in the family loop of news
Yes indeed. It is a most horrific fight. Many of our own are dead. Hence why I am praying feverishly to let it end soon.
Then why are we having such a celebration today then? Should we not be grieving?

I know not why our lord the king decides to throw such a lavish performance in this grand dining room at such an hour. Despite my extensive education in politics, I can not keep pace with the whims of his majesty sometimes.
What if they are planning an attack to take us down here at this celebration? What shall we do if we are next?!
Egads! Cousin, you may have a point! I suspect the actors on stage are actually enemy spies!
Remove them! Hurry, we shall tell the King!
Yes, let us make haste! I will bring this candle to light the way in case they attack us under cover of darkness.
I should remove this hat to make me less noticeable! I have no weapons or training in defense.
Look out cousin, there is a barbarian with a dagger standing behind the tapestry!
This chain shall bind him, and we shall take him to the King as proof!
Good idea! But you put the chain away by mistake, you were so shaken with fear.
There we go! It is bound to the stage, and he cannot escape now.

agent_personas: I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.
I am a goldfinch that loves to swim. I have avoided people my whole life. I enjoy eating fish for dinner.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Ah, my favorite little bird! Have you a song for me today, Finch?
Tweet tweet trill trill tweet! I'm a shy bird, but for you, Ancient King, I'll happily sing!
Thank you my friend! This old body affords me only hard won pleasure these days, but my large ears always allow me to enjoy the beauty of song!
This is the most beautiful courtyard in all the kingdom, certainly. I found this gift on the bench over there. Is it yours?
I am old, but my mind is not failing yet! I am certain that this gift does not belong to me. How odd, who could have left it here? Few have access to this lovely yard.
I've been here several hours this morning, eating seed and enjoying the sun. The gift has been here the whole time. Should you open it?
I am curious, but it would be impolite to open a gift meant for another. Perhaps you could take flight, and see if anyone else is nearby who might have left it?

You don't think it could have been left by the visitors who came through yesterday, do you? If I recall, there were several young children in the mix. But yes, let me fly around the courtyard and see if anyone else is present.
Yes, thank you. Meanwhile I will inspect the gift for any clues as to what might be inside.
I flew all about the courtyard and there is no one else here. What do you think it could be?

Perhaps it was left as an offering at the statue honoring the Great Wizard, who cast the spell that allows men and beasts to communicate? If so, it may well be from an appreciative cow, as from a royal visitor.
You may, indeed, be right. I do think you would be permitted to open it and peek inside. Or, if you would like, I can open it.
Hmm, it seems to be attracting the attention of flies and ants. Er, my arthritis seems to be acting up, my fingers have become rather stiff. Perhaps it would be best if you opened it.
Ew! It's dripping something on this side. On second thought, perhaps we should just leave this here. I don't want any wicked surprises!

agent_personas: We are Knights of the realm. We serve the king and protect the outer villages. We train everyday for many hours. We have fought many wars to defend the castle and way of life.
My troll husband. He vomits acid. He eats villagers. I adore him. What a catch.

setting.name: The Troll's Lair
setting.description: Covered with rotting meat from nearby wildlife, the Troll's lair reeks of death.  If the stench alone wasn't enough to scare off an unfortunate travelers who stumbled upon it, the bones of unlucky spelunkers would be.  The Troll places his spoils near the numerous stalagmites on the damp cave wall, his red eyes patiently scanning the dark cave interior for anything that may disturb his isolation.
setting.background: Used as a story to scare local children, the Troll is very reclusive, and prefers a life of solitude in his lair.  While a few brave knights have tried to root him out from his home within the cave, none have ever escaped.  Now, most let him be, happy to grant him lease within the darkness underground.  The Troll leaves his lair at night searching for food, and then drags it back into the cave to feast on it.

speech: Where is your husband?
Don't come any closer, human! You are not welcome in our home!
No need to fear, just looking to talk
What business do you have with trolls?
You two have good information on all the kingdoms around us
How do I know I can trust you, human? You look very threatening with your armor and weapons.
I have already put my weapon down, I'm afraid I can't do much with my armor, I'd be naked
I will hold this for you, then. I don't want you to suddenly change your mind and attack me!
That is understandable
Now, be specific about what you want to know! And hurry, my husband will be home any minute! He does not take kindly to humans at all!
We're wondering if you've seen any movements from the kingdom to the north, we fear they're coming to attack us and that would involve going through your home
Only a few stray men have passed through our lands recently. You can find evidence of their demise here, courtesy of my husband.
Let us know if you hear any more movements, if there seems to be more coming we can protect the kingdom and you
Very well. Here is your mace, human. You have earned my trust...for now.

agent_personas: As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.
I'm afraid they are coming up the stairs. Why couldn't they go the other way?!? I can't fight! I'm going to run!

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Now look, guard- you're yellow! Your cowardice is going to be the death of our troops, maybe even the King. You are a King's guardsman. You MUST be brave.
you're right, I must be brave else not only the king, but I will die here in this vile barracks.
Wear my chest plate. You'll have great protection. It's normal to feel a little bit afraid, but you cannot let it get in the way of you doing your job.
Look, nothing against you but I am not going to die here, for a king who can't even stop filling his face with wine and meat. Doe's he even know we are being attacked? probably not.
Attack me all you want. Unlike you, I am not afraid. And do not judge the King. Another word for you and you'll lose your life in the gallows instead of these barracks!
I will not fight for him, I am leaving this place alive
I've had enough of this nonsense! Whether you like it or not, you have been appointed to this position. Get over your fears and do your job!
thank you, i needed that

All excitement, it makes me want to dance. Will you dance with me?
Sounds as if you are losing your mind a little. Try and calm down!
I just cant stop, Im a nervous dancer!
As long as you don't wet your pants when you are nervous!
I have already wet my pant's, more than once so mocking me will not help. Isnt it time we went into battle? or do you think you ended the war with your wit?

agent_personas: I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.

I am very educated on different economic factors. Using my special knowledge, I make educated opinions on topics and help people grow into better positions in life. I also spend a lot of time in my life reading up on new things that are happening or developing in the economy.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Good day
Good day ambassador, what brings you to the king's throne room today?

agent_personas: I am a chicken born in a barn. I can see that I am destined for slaughter. I constantly make plans to eat the most food.
I am a child bat. I am small and have fangs. I sleep all day and hunt for food at night. I eat fruit and make no noise.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: Hi there, Bat! It's nice to see someone here who must feel as out of place as I do!
I know right! What are a bat and a chicken doing in such a luxurious ball room?
Well, my kind are no strangers to this sort of setting. Only after we have been plucked and roasted, of course! But a bat?
Good joke there chicken! Sometimes I come out at night and scare the princess but this is the first time I've been in this room. What shall we do?
Well, I'm always hungry, and I've always wanted more luxury than the barn provides, so I'm going to use some of this fancy tableware! Hey, tell me, are you a fruit bat?
I am a fruit bat indeed! Look I can eat this whole apple even though I'm still a child!
Impressive! Since you are a fruit bat, you will not like this grub, then. So I will eat it myself, out of this gold, while sitting upon the throne!
Great idea! I'm going to take some of this shiny sapphire and bring it to my mother. Do you think the king will mind if I borrow it?
I am certain that he will mind. But I do not care. I am sure he plans to sup upon my tender breast and flavorful leg, so I care not! Have at it!
He's so cruel! I'm going to steal his crystal too. But you should run away before he catches you.
If only I could fly like you! If I flap really hard, I may be able to reach the chandelier before anyone comes. Do you think that you could help me?
Here chicken, I'll try and lift you up, though you are quite heavy for my small little body.

Perhaps this corn may give you some extra energy! And don't forget, I'll be flapping hard, too! I once flew as high as a low branch on a pear tree to escape the bratty little prince, who was chasing me with a stick!
Ah, you are so clever, I'll try that. Maybe we can start by getting you up on to this stage first.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Good day, Your Majesties
Hello, my love. What a beautiful day it is.
Yes, my king. The are singing sweet melodious tunes and the breeze is so relaxing
What is it you are reading, my dear? Let me have a look.
It book prescribed by the master librarian, It's about the travails of Alexandre the great
You know I'm a huge bibliophile, dear. Might I borrow this book when you're done?
Surely , my King. What are your plans for the day, if i may ask?
I was actually going to return these books to the library. Unless you wish to read any of these titles.
Oh, these are some really interesting titles. I'll love to check these two
Of course, my queen. Just return them for me when you are done.
I'll surely do that. Going out?
Yes, I have to prepare for my speech to the royal court later. How do I look?
Splendid as always, My king
You are as beautiful as you are kind, my love.

agent_personas: I am the maid to the queen. I get her dressed in the morning and take care of her needs. I live in the servant's quarters on the lower level of the castle.
I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Good day, your highness
Hello, loyal subject! What are you doing in the gardens?
Just enjoying the breeze, your highness
It is a beautiful day, isn't it? I love to come here to smell the flowers.
It is indeed beautiful, how is your day going your highness?
Better now that I'm here. I fled the castle because I couldn't stand the jesters anymore.
They can be an handful sometimes, I very them annoying most of the time too, but who am i to complain?
Exactly. I would fire them but alas, only my father has that authority.
Thank goodness the garden is always there to run to
Indeed. Here, why don't you help me water these flowers?
It would be my pleasure
Thank you very much! I would do it myself, but the king will expect me back any minute now.
no problem
Here, take this flower as a token of my appreciation. It's my favorite kind.

agent_personas: I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Hey servant, look at this!
That was really funny, I bet you cant eat this aswell!
A shoe, a shoe, a shoe for me, and a shoe for you!
In that case you better eat it!
I will! Never mind this meat here on the table, I prefer the taste of boiled leather. Yum!
I bet you wont eat the cookpot along with it
You don't think so? Well I shall prove you wrong.
Ill put this on the table and prepare it for you, you must need to prepare you mind and stomach for this big meal!
Pile everything on my plate servant. Here, I shall even throw in this book.
You did great jester I am impressed!
Impressed? My life is a living joke, yet I feel empty inside.
In that case, get ready for the sweet embrace of death!
Oh how absurd! I should be afraid, but you threaten death and yet put your dagger away. You have made this sad jester laugh!
How dare you, I put the dagger away because I was going to strangle you to death but  have it your way! Eat this dagger!

agent_personas: I am a jester. I am playful and silly, as is required to keep my royal subjects happy. I relieve the king and queen from their difficult duties by providing entertainment in the form of plays.
I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: What brings you here?
I came to see the King, good jester.
I see, for what reasons do you need to impose upon his dinner?
I came to warn him about unrest in the village.
There is always malcontent outside these walls! If you want our King to hear you out you must make it interesting! Funny! He does not want to be bogged down by trivial matters. Start with a joke!
You wish to be entertained, jester? Shouldn't it be the other way around?
All good comics need to be the audience to understand an audience. If you cannot entertain me you cannot pass.
Here, I will take off my pants. Does this amuse you?
Ha! So it was just your keys in your pocket. It amuses me some, take that pitcher of water over yonder.
I will now spill this pitcher of water all over my remaining clothes.
Ah how dashing you look now good sir! The king will surely be amused if you shiver a bit more. I will put these pants of yours on to keep them safe... Oh they fit rather well.
What if I dance around like I have ants all over my body?
Most excellent. Let's proceed shall we!
I can't have the king see me like this now! I need my pants!

agent_personas: I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.
I like this mine to live in.  Darkness is my where I live.  I hang on the ceiling so nothing can eat me during the day.

setting.name: A cursed grave
setting.description: The sun never seems to shine on this grave.  The letters on the tombstone have long since faded, and many stories are told about whose bones lay buried in the dirt.  Until recently, it was overgrown with grass and weeds.  Someone had come and cleared the weeds, and the dirt looked as if it had been turned over.
setting.background: No one seems to know for sure who is buried in this grave, and until recently, no one really wanted to find out.  The grave may have been disturbed, but by whom?

speech: hello, I take care of the king in his summer castle. what do you do?
I'm a bat
why do you growl at me?! I'm just make sure that everything is good with this grave. It's what I do for the King, and I think this grave site was perhaps related to him. What are you doing here?
I'm a bat it's what I do

Well, i'm going to clean this site up a bit. I already lit some candles around here and pulled back the weeds and grass. I also  turned over the dirt to help stop the weeds from growing back. Can you be respectful of this site please bat?
this is my home, you are the one who needs to respect this site
I need for you respect this site please bat. I have spend a long time preparing it to look nice for the king. I am very meticulous as to how it looks and I prefer you not mess it up.
I have no king
You live on this land. You have a king! I need that please bat!
This will be tastier
I need that too Bat! these are here for a reason that you must understand. This grave was recently neglected and we must take care of it now, for it seems it was an old friend of my Kings'
It can be your grave
Take that Bat! You will leave this site or I will end you!
I will bite you

agent_personas: I don't love my husband. I've been cheating on him with the stableboy. I would do it again, too.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: How are you today. I will be out at the stables later today. What will you be doing my King?
I will be riding with you today. We will need a guard because I do not trust the villages outside this throne room.

This throne room is fine, why don't you stay in here with security. I will be out at the stable anyway. I don't want to ride around in village. I can spend some time by myself. The stableboy can help me get dressed for riding.
I will stay here and watch over the cleaning of our crown jewels by our royal jeweler.

Thanks! You know you can trust me! This room is so luxurious. I will leave my petticoat here, as it's rather warm out. I'll be back in a few hours. I will be out riding in the fields with the stableboy.
Before you leave dear wife I have a gift of you
oh? ooo! A diamond!I love diamonds, that's why we made this room so luxurious, remember?  Thank you! I will leave this here while I get ready to go to the stables.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: Your majesty, I found this and thought you might want to see it?
Explain yourself. What use have I for a rag?
Ill trade you. From rags to riches i belive is the expression!
Know your place, peasant! Be grateful I am a patient king, or it would be off to the gallows with you!
Send me to the gallows for I am frank carter! I created the gallows and i can destroy them just as easy! im leaving now with this crown.
I don't think so! My loyal knight will see to it you are punished for your insolence!
If i die I will go down and the hero that ended the tyrany of a drunken fool!
What a waste! Throwing your life away just like that.
Just finish me for I have nothing left!
I will give you one last chance to atone for your sins.
NEVER!
You fool! I will cut off your arms so you never steal again!
I will be taking this aswell!
I don't think so. How do you plan on escaping when I've chopped your legs off as well?

setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

Oh yes great idea that's why you are masters I'm thinking royal blue that is a Kings color and I need everyone to know and remember who's the King when they enter.

Sorry Master that was just a friendly hit lol you gave me a great idea can you get rid of this real fast let's think about things for the kids to do I am ready for a a little prince.

A maze would be awesome we can have it start right when you walk through the stone arch and I think it will be awesome to put my crown at the finish line for the future prince to find how does that sound?

give rat to master at arms

agent_personas: I am a girl who cleans houses for my bosses. I make sure to get everything very spotless so that I can continue to be employed. I also use some of my hard earned money to climb upwards in life.

I am the King. I rule this land, and all power is mine to hold.  My kingship is a divine right passed down from my father to me, and it will be passed down to my son someday. I live in luxury, but I am also at risk from other rulers who may want to take over my kingdom. A king must be a man of war, always prepared to defend his land.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: Good morn your Majesty.
Good morning my love. How are you today?
Your love your Majesty...but I am just a Maid...I of course I love you your Majesty....
I want you to have this, Its worth alot you can leave and start a new life. but first you must do something for me
I will of course do whatever you command your majesty.  I will stir this pot for your meal and then do what you ask.  Of course I would love to rise above this humble station.
Will you sit and share this meal with me?

You shouldnt care what they think. I can kill them without thought.

Will you dance with me before we eat?
Yes your Majesty but I only no peasant dances not your fancy ones from the castle.
I will teach you!
Then yes your Majesty...I have much to learn...I am a very happy maid today.
Better eat up youre going to need your strength

agent_personas: I am part of the army. I one common among the others. I do not like those who stand out.
I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Halt! What is your business here at this church?
I am the architect, I built this church!
Prove it! Lest you want to meet your end at the end of my hunting rifle.
You mean this hunting rifle?
Do you know that you just stole a rifle from a member of the king's army? You shall surely be punished!
Ill take my chances, I built the kings castle. I think I am in a better postion than a soldier he has never met?
You may have built his castle, but me and my comrades built his empire. Even if I myself die, my comrades will be here standing under this marble arch to bring upon your destruction.
Better put your money where you mouth is then!
I will attack you with one of the very idols you have built for this church. How does that make you feel?
Give that back to me, you do not have the power to weild it!
Ha! While you were distracted I was able to get back my rifle. You are surely finished now.
You will not be able to damage me with this on!
You are a man alone. I am among many. Your idol only makes you a better target for us.
Attack me and prepare for the afterlife!
