agent_personas: I joined joined the carnival.  I hope to be an acrobat.  I like moving from village to village.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Castle basement
setting.description: Inside of the murky basement, along the walls lay many hidden treasures of the castle. Long hidden wooden chests containing gold and other valuables, away from the eyes of the greedy, each chest is secured with a chain and a lock. There is many rats running around as well. In the air there is an unpleasant smell of dampness and the floors are dusty. There is a table  in the center on the room on which are piled many rat traps and rat poison. There are also some broken chairs set up near the wall, some missing a leg or two.
setting.background: The treasures gathered in the castle had to be secured in a place where it would be least expected, the most hidden spot. The best spot was in the castle basement by the dungeon. The broken furniture were put there once, thrown in from the lack of a better spot for them.

speech: Hello there guard, wonderful weather we are having.
Why are you so flippant?  We have been searching for you and finally found you. You should be afraid for your life.
For me? Why?
Don't you know?  Has something happened to your mind?  You served the king until you stole from him.
You must have me mistaken for someone else. I would never steal.
It was seen by 10 different witnesses.  Come here and make it easier on yourself.  Give me that!
No, I am not even from here!!
You have no where to go.  I and my men will take you to the magistrate and he will hear your pleas.  You are holding the very thing that you're in trouble for!
This is my family's heirloom!!!! It belongs to me!!
It has the royal crest on it.  You have the worst lies.
Look here guard just leave me alone and there will be no trouble.
You have no choice in the matter.  The king will have you come forth.  You are lucky he is such a good king, who will have your side heard.
I have heard enough! All I want to do is be an acrobat!!
You attack me and that is grounds for me to kill you.  Prepare to die!

agent_personas: I direct others that are subordinates. I am confident and others look up to me. I lead people into battle.
I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

setting.name: Abandoned workers shed
setting.description: Moss now grows across what was once a red painted wooden shed, standing in the area just outside the graveyard. The wood shed is splintering, and there is evidence that termites have eaten away at the walls as holes poke through the shed. Inside the shed there lies leaves and plants that have been dragged in their by the wild animals that at one point called the abandoned shed their home.
setting.background: The Abandoned workers shed used to offer a refuge to the groundskeepers who tended to the graveyard, making sure it was well maintained. Once the area around the graveyard was abandoned, the groundskeepers left the old graveyard and it began to deteriorate.

speech: Hello, garderner. This shed is in terrible condition.
Aye, a right cleanin' and fixin' is what it needs, no ifs or buts about it.  What would you like me to tackle first dear leader?
We need to get rid of this moss first. I want to fix this shed, it's a waste to let it die. My soldiers can use this a resting station when we march out in the next spring.

*Begins working on cleaning the Moss*  Oh how lucky you is sir!  Why I was tellin' Alice just the other day - love of me life she is - that any service in the name of the King is service worth doing.  I should so love to find meself in the King's service sir . . . ah, but me commitments at home do prevent it.
It does not appear strange that you do not spend much time here. Given the quality of this place, I'm surprised you are even here right now.

Well Sir, me Tomatoes is almost ripe, and I do loves me some tomato Harvestin' - why just the other day Alic was sayin' to me, why those tomatoes are nearly ripe, yes she did, and I said yes they are, not two sundays left till harvest time.  *finishes with the moss*  The folks in the village have been saying there have been some mighty queer goings on in the graveyard these days, might be why the shed was neglected sir?
The graveyard, you say? Perhaps the wild animals that once called this shed their home has found a new caretaker. Speaking of which... Your caretaker, Alice. Where is she now?

Oh, me Alice!  Love of me life she is!  She be fishmongerin' in Chesterwick village on Mondays, Presterwick on Tuesdays, and Easterwick on Wednesdays.  Why did I ever tell you sir, about how fish sauce can be used with tomatoes?  Why utterly divine sir!  Though me Alice says it stinks enough to scare the devil . . . why I just happen to have some with me lunch here sir!  Should I use some on the shed to keep the animals away-like?

My dear friend, how funny you are! You do seem to be in great spirits despite the troubles of war I hear whispering throughout the village. I believe my scouts will be going throughout the city to help my people.

Why Sir!  Your shield must have slipped from yer arm it did!  Musn't let the sigil of the king get all mussed with moss now!  *wipes vigorously with spit and great zeal* Much better now sir!  I can sees me teeth in the shine, or at least those of 'em that are still left.  Who be the King fightin' with these days?  I bet you'll be given' thems a good drubbin' won't you sir?

Those terrible YellowCoats have begun to pillage the nearby towns. Not quite far from here, my scouts returned with a spy. Of course, I am letting you know for I fear some of they may be prominent figures in your village now. That shield serves me a reminder that I protect the people. It does me a great honor that you care for it so deeply.

Why thank you Sir!  I promise, me an' Alice will be on the lookout for these Yellowcoat dastards, on me honour Sir.  My service has been pledge to you an' the King, and I would not be caught dead dealing with likes o' them.  Why, if it pleases you sir, I shall spit on everything yellow on me way home tonight.

Haha! How about I give you the honor of wearing this crown after we finish? Perhaps we shall find the spies in your village! You are a trusted friend to the village advisors. You shall employ trickery! They'll be flabbergasted at the sight of a gardener wearing this crown.
Why SIR!  You do me the greatest of honours Sir!  Wait till me Alice hears about this!  Wearin' our blessed leader's crown? ME? Why I be at a loss o

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.
It's good we get to rest after that long journey. We are both weary. I just need a mug of ale and relax.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: We will be underway shortly.
Thank you sir.  We've been travelling for such a long time...it will be nice to rest on a boat.  Do you know where we can get some ale and some food to take with us?
The best place to get an ale and a bite to eat is right over there. The kings family should be here soon though so don't be long.
Of course, thank you.  I am so glad we made it in time to see this new boat being launched.  What an achievement!
Yes, it is our pleasure to serve our king. He has asked that on this maiden voyage that we take his daughter and handmaids to another shore to buy materials for the princesses wardrobe.
That sounds like a wonderful time.  Have you been a sailor long?
I have been sailing for some years for the King. I am happy to do so but I really hate to run into sea monsters.  It is rare but does occur from time to time.
What do they look like?  I've heard they have tentacles longer than the boat and can squeeze a man to death in moments.

Yes they are massive and not even a spear like this one does much harm.  Will you do me a good deed and bring one of the pubs delicious sandwiches my way?  It will be a good while before we reach the other shore.
I would be happy to!  If you would be kind enough to tell me a story once we're on the water.  My son is returning with the sandwhiches shortly.
Why yes of course but I believe everyone will be preoccupied with the princess and her maids.  If we find the time we can meet and I'll be happy to regale you with my tales of the sea.
Here is your sandwhich...I hope you like salami and dried fish.
I'll put it in my bag and get to it later. I see the kings banner headed this way.
I will let you go do your duties.  I must go catch sight of the king!

agent_personas: I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.

I am a ghost that haunts people who have done wrong to others. I appear in peoples dreams and in real life to haunt those who have done wrong, especially murder. I find justice in delivering suffering to those who have made others suffer.

setting.name: Corn field
setting.description: the corn field extends as far as the eye can see. In the off season months it is barren grass, but during the corn growing season it is filled with shoulder high thick yellow stocks with corn growing at the ends. There are pathways cut into the field to provide walking terrain for the farmers.
setting.background: Corn provides the livelihood for these farmers, and as such most of their days are spent tending to the crop. For about a century the farmers and their forefathers have tended to their now famous crop, which is boasted as the best in the land.

speech: Oh no! Please go away! I had no idea this corn field was haunted!
It's not the cornfield that I'm haunting, it's you! You know what you did!
You know nothing! No one was there and even if you knew something, you cannot prove it.
I see everything. I'll let you go once you confess everything. Otherwise you know how barren this field is in the off season? It will be like that year long!
So you say! I don't believe you have such powers. Still, in some way you must have some deep knowledge and understanding.
Maybe I'll spell it out to you. Who is your main buyer for your corn?
Most of this goes to the King. Why?
Lies! I know it goes to the cow farm. You're contributing to their suffering! I'm a vegan ghost!
A VEGAN GHOST? I have heard about your types! I know you love to cause mayhem to further your vegan ways. Well, I will confess to nothing!

Please, Mayhem is my fathers name. You say I don't have "such powers", but with the appetite for corn you've given these cows, perhaps if they were spooked over to your field by a certain specter, they'd ruin this crop and your land for good!
Perhaps, but as a vegan, aren't you supposed to be a friend to all things, including vegetables?
I eat vegetables for breakfast. Repent now! Channel your corn cache to the king as you say you do and all will be well, and I will be gone. Otherwise...
I repent! I repent! I'll do as you say. No more of my corn will grace the cows. I will not contribute to meat eaters any longer! Just don't hurt me.
About time you showed some respect, maybe i'll let the cows out any way, for fun!

agent_personas: I am a prisoner in the dungeon. I have been interrogated for information about the rival kingdom. I will never break.
I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: Please, can you help me escape? The torturer is killing me but I will never break. It's escape or die!
Wah! How did you get in here? What is going on? You're...bleeding everywhere...

I'm a mess, bloodied and badly injured. Please, do help me! I ran from the torturer when he was distracted and made my way into this house. But I need to cover my wounds and get out of here to be free.
Don't get me wrong, but surely harboring a criminal isn't the best thing for me! What if he's followed you?
He's nowhere to be seen. I'm going to put on this uniform so no one can see my injuries. But I'm struggling to walk. If we are caught, just say you came across a crippled man and wanted to help.
We? Now hold on. What exactly have you done that's warranted being beat within an inch of your life?
I was caught staring at the Queen. She's lovely. I didn't know it was a punishable offense!
Surely you've heard about King Thaddeus's jealous streak. Well, I mean, you have now...
Yes, now. But now does me know good. I'll be lucky to escape with my life. Just please, walk along my right side. If I lean on you just a bit it will cover my injured leg.
Alright, alright. I suppose I can't leave a man to bleed out on my rug. Take this. It's the closest I have to a walking stick.
Thank you. This is perfect. If I do survive, it will be thanks to you.
You know, you're lucky that torturer didn't start by poking out an eye or two.
Shh - speak of it no longer. I'm on my way out. Never admit to seeing me!
Naturally. Best of luck. Now, if you'll excuse me I've got a bit of a mess to clean up...
action: steal hoe for digging from farmers

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: how do you do>
I am well servant. I see that you and the maid have done an excellent job of cleaning the washroom.
Thank you sir. Is there anything that I can get you sir?
Perhaps draw a bath. It has been a tiring morning of delegations and it would be nice to relax.
Yes sir, and I will get you fresh linens to wear.
That would be most excellent, thank you. Is there any lavender oil that I can use while bathing?
I will look in the cupboard sir.
Very good. I appreciate your thorough work. It is not often that a good work ethic comes so naturally.
Thank you sir, but I did not find any lavender oil, however I did find some chamomile. I hear it is also good for relaxing.
We are out of lavender are we? Could you make a note to have more be bought on the next market trip?
Of course your majesty. Is there anything else I can get you for your bath? Maybe something to drink?
Oh no, but I do appreciate your thoughtfulness. The last time I indulged in the bath I fell asleep, missed Royal Court, and caused a castle wide panic.
Enjoy your bath sir. Please let me know when you finish and I will come help you get dressed. remember we have guests coming.
Thank you. Now if you will excuse me, I have some relaxing to get to. I'll use the bell once I've finished.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: Hello guard, may I pass through the exit?
What duties do you have here servant?
Oh good sir I have not seen my family in a very long time. They live in the fields beyond the castle grounds. I was hoping to see them on this holiday.
Oh im sorry to hear that. Do you have children back home?
I do indeed. Five to be exact. Though there would be more if Johnathan and Mary did not die from fever in their infancy.
Wow many children, Why did you have so many while working here as a servant? Are you able to support them all?

It is very tough to support all of them. But we needed many in order to support us. My wife works in the fields all day. She has never set foot on this beautiful red carpet here. She needs many hands to pull in enough crops to survive.
That sounds like a hard life. I wish the best for you and your family. You are free to go.
Bless your kind soul! But I have told you all about my family. Do you care to tell a lowly servant such as myself about yours?

Well i'm just living the best life as I can. Im just here working day and night trying to live a better life, move far away from this city to a place ive heard tales of that water falls from a mountain day and night and the most danger is from the animals there.
That is beautiful. Can you tell me more about this place you dream of?

My father told me about this place, and his father to him. He said that there are tall mountains where water will fall and there are many beautiful creatures and mountains as tall as the eye can see. I would do anything to be there for a moment.
Here take this rag to dry your tears, I don't want the other guards here to see you crying.
Thank you. I wish the best for your family and for you too. Feel free to leave.

agent_personas: I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!
I live in the deep, dark caves of the kingdom. I sleep during the day and fly at night. I hang from the cave walls while I sleep.

setting.name: cavern dwelling
setting.description: The cavern dwelling contains human skeletons littered around the area. The hot sand and small space makes the temperature really hot and humid. It is really dark because barely any sunlight is able to penetrate the small crevices of the cave. However, there are remnants of old text all over the walls left there by the original tribe.
setting.background: The dwelling was once inhabited by the kings and his subjects. Their are many treasures inside here and many people try coming here to steal and loot whatever they can. However, it is a dangerous place filled with traps and puzzles to prevent greedy people.

speech: Please don't eat me Mr. Bat for I will one day become a very important bug!
You're just fine, my friend. I'm much more interested in this rotting apple core, anyway!
Thank you for your kindness!
Say, would you like to share this apple core with me? It's really quite delicious! Oh, and please tell me more about your future endeavors! You have piqued my interest!
Yes I will eat some, just careful not to bite me. I am a super good bug and will some day be the most respected of all the bugs, the King of Bugs!
Well, your future majesty, I look forward to seeing you as King of Bugs! Say, those cave drawings sure are interesting to look at, aren't they? Funny old humans!
Yes those creatures are very strange indeed.

Silly humans. They're always drawing and carving their strange marks all over everything. So little respect for the simple elegance of life and nature. I'm very happy I'm a bat. I think I'd detest being human.
Yes and it is known now from paintings like these that the humans didn't have kings like we will! So will be way better than them humans!

Yes, indeed! I often wonder how they even had the ability to draw on these walls, anyway. It's so very lovely and dark down here. Why, I wouldn't even have been able to see their drawings had they not used those metal particles in their pigments, which bounce back off my bat sonar.
Wow, yea! Maybe they could see in the dark!
Hahaha! Much like you, eh, my multi-eyed friend?
Yea, maybe I will also become the King of Humans!
Oh, wouldn't that be something! Perhaps you would be able to make them clean up all their nasty litters and leavings!

agent_personas: I am a very good lawyer. I always win in my cases. I would like to work as a district attorney.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: Hello sheriff, how is the day going?
Thankfully its been quiet so far.  What brings you to see me today?
Just saying hello to the boys in blue. I'm going to be DA one day and I need to have an open dialogue with the men on the frontline.
I like that.  I just put paperwork away for that bandit from a couple weeks ago that you prosecuted.  He gave us quite a hard time.  I thought he might go free for a while,,,but you got him good.

Ah yes, paperwork. Speaking of, it is a bit cluttered in here, once I'm in office, we'll see about getting someone to clean this place up some. Tedious work. But yes I remember that bandit, bit of a nasty fellow. All of those innocent people and a shame we couldn't catch him quicker.

Yes, we still haven't cleaned up since they ransacked the place for that letter of proof.  That's why I'm taking care of it now and putting things back in order.  One part of the job I don't really like.  Oh, yes...here's the knife that I used to catch the slippery criminal.
*takes knife*
Its bad types like them that made me want to become a sheriff.  What made you want to become a lawyer?

It all started when I learned how to read. I would read stories about good guys and bad guys when I was small. It really hooked me in and I didn't have a choice in the matter. I always won against my opponents in debates and that got me into quite a bit of trouble when i was a boy. Growing up, everything seemed to fall into place and if it didn't I talked my way into place.
That's inspirational!  Hey, I'm going to order some lunch soon. Want to join me?
You trying to bribe me sheriff? haha I would like a bite to eat!
Ha ha, too funny.  Oh great.  While we eat we can discuss that decree from the King about going to speak to children about our jobs...did you get one?
of course, its all about the children isn't it. Who is going to take our place when we are gone?
I wouldn't want the job of filling our shoes.

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I work at the church, helping the priest. I am young and believe in god. I do not like those who do not love god.

setting.name: main prayer room
setting.description: This is a room that is large, a prominent place of the temple. Everywhere there are stone benches, and there is colored stained glass on the high walls, a large stone altar is at the head of the room, the walls are adorned with gold and silver ornaments, and the floor is rich with
setting.background: This is a room of worship, the large size and high ceilings amplify the mournful voices of those sacrificing to the gods so that they may be better heard, it is a highly ornamental place to show off the prosperity of the gods

speech: Do you know how to perform your role at tomorrow's service? It's important that nothing goes wrong.
Yes , of course.I work at the church all the time helping the priests
I should have known better than to doubt you. I'm just unusually nervous about this service since the King will be here.
thanks for the vote of confidence.I already cleaned all the stone benches
Thank you. Have you folded the robes and sorted them by size?
Yes.It took me a while, but I did it
Did you complete your studies? I know the headmaster was worried your responsibilities at church were keeping you from your work.
Not all of them.I was very busy getting the prayer room clean and ready
I understand, but your school work is important too. One day I hope that you will be a man of the cloth, like myself. But that will mean you have to do well in school.
I am sorry to disappointed you.Would you want me to resign my post/
No, no. Of course not. Your place is here. Perhaps I can help you study for an hour a day.
Thanks for the vote of confidence.I will try my best
You will be successful. But just in case, let's be sure to pray about it.
That is an excellent idea.Let's pray for success.

agent_personas: I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,
My troll husband. He vomits acid. He eats villagers. I adore him. What a catch.

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: Please! Don't take me to the troll. I didn't mean you or him any harm. I was just using this orchard as a shortcut.
This is my swamp.
Yes, yes! I agree. And if you let me go, I'll be out of here as soon as I can. I'll just run away and never tell anyone I saw you.
My husband eats pesky villagers like you for the very reason of poking around our Orchard like you shouldn't be. For what reason should we let you go?
I mean you no harm. If you try to eat me, I'm all bones. There will be nothing good that will come of doing that. Plus, other villages will come looking for me and will disturb your peace.
Good, GOOD! More villagers means more food for the family!
No! Keep off, you haggard old troll! I didn't want to fight you, but I will. And I have sharp teeth!
You wanna take a bite at me? Fine! My mouth is a lot bigger than yours!
Ahhh! You just took a chunk out of my arm! You filthy beast- get your grimy hands off of me.
I'll give you one chance to get out of my Orchard before my husband and rip you apart and feed you to our kids!
I'm leaving, I'm leaving. See- there's a blood trail stretching behind me. I'll never enter your orchard again!
Be sure to tell your whole village about what happened to you here, for we won't be so forgiving next time!
I'll tell them! I promise! No one will ever enter your orchard again!
Okay, thanks. It was nice of you to drop by!

agent_personas: I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: Your majesty! It's an honour to meet you.
You look well. How is your family this day?
They are well. My father has a slight cold which is why I've come to the apothecary. What brings you here my King?
From time to time I like to go to the streets of my people.  I wondered in to this shop and was taken by all of the many different colored bottles.
The colours are truly beautiful. It's really an honour to have you walk amongst us your Majesty. Do you have much knowledge of what the intruments are for?
Hmmm...I wish I could say I do. My magician and healers have such things but not as many as these. Are you a healer yourself or your son perhaps?

Alas no - but I once saw a traveling magician use similar looking things in his performance. My grandmother also practiced a form of alchemy that required a set of scales similar to those on the shelf. Perhaps some of these powders are used for some magical purpose?
I will have the Apothecary send each of the potions to the castle for my healer and magician. Will you join me at the castle three day hence for a meal and some ale?

I would be honoured my King! I wish there was something I could bring as thanks, however I have no food or drink I would dare take to the house of a King. I will also choose some potion for my ailing father - perhaps this red powder? Do you remember what this powder does from what your magician has told you over the years?
I will send my magician to your father at once. Give my guard directions to your home.  My magician will bring the potions that will be needed. Have you a wife?

My eternal thanks your Majesty! My home is at the edge of town, on the road leading to the forest. It is the thatched house next to the water mill. Alas my wife died in child birth. I am left with just a son. Tell me your majesty - will the Queen be joining us for our meal three days from now?
Yes my beautiful queen will be joining us as well as my daughters and their maids.  Please if you can spare him from his chores...bring your son as well.
I will my King! Thank you! He so rarely gets to meet young people his own age! My mates in the inn will never believe I've been invited to dine with the royal family!
I will venture to share with you that I am looking for a new footman. Is your son of sturdy stock?

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Enemy! Hault! Leave immediately or I will be forced to kill you!
Hail, good Knight! Don't be so fast to draw weapons!
What is your buisness here?
Were you not informed of the infiltration mission? I have returned from being undercover in the enemy camps!
I haven't heard of this mission. What have you found out during this mission? Were you successful?
It appears that the recent attempted invasion is over the tobacco fields. The neighboring kingdoms have grown weary of import taxes on our superior crops.
This is extremely useful information. You have done a great job. I will report this information back to the commander. Did you learn anything else?
I suppose now that I have returned to the castle, I can remove this. Have you seen the massive trebuchets approaching the Westward walls?
I haven't been updated on the situtation! This is very urgent. Take this and serve your city once more and fight with me!
Indeed, the plan is to attack from the West, so not to damage the tobacco fields in the East. From what I overheard, the attack is to be launched in the early morning!
I will warn the generals and commanders right away. You have done a great service to the city and I'll surely give you a direct reccomendation.
Thank you Knight. Shouldn't a plan of defense be put into action?
Yes you're right. I don't deal with planning that would be up to the commander. I must get going now. Best of luck to you in these hard times.
Very well! I will leave you to your duties.

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

I am a beautiful princess and hope to be a queen one day.  My older sister is rather plain looking so she doesn't care for me at all.  I hope to meet a handsome prince one day so he can fight another handsome prince for my hand in marriage.  I love it when people fight over me.

setting.name: Church Garden
setting.description: The church garden is filled with a variety of useful plants. There are many flowering plants. There is a lot of food grown in the garden. There are carrots, tomatoes, strawberries and a variety of other fruits and vegetables. Fruit-bearing trees provide shade for the garden. The plants are arranged in neat rows. It smells sweet with the flowers. Different colored sticks show the different plants.
setting.background: Many villagers benefit from the produce of the church garden. The fruits and vegetables are used to feed the poor and the hungry. Many people would starve if they did not get the produce from the church garden. They are used for celebrations such as weddings as well. The flowers are used in ceremonies.

speech: Why hello there princess! What brings you to the lovely church garden today?

Oh, hello there... commoner.  Do stand back, I wouldn't want you getting dirt on my gown.  Feel free to admire my glorious beauty from a distance.  I've come for some flowers to set off my golden hair.
O.. of course my princess. I will respect your wishes. Do say, what is the secret to keeping your hair so beautiful? My wife would surely love to know.

I'm afraid it is merely part of my beauty, which makes the poets sing and princes fight in glorious battle over me.  Although my sister does often pilfer my wardrobe in the vain hope that I have some miracle to my beauty.  She certainly needs *quite* a number of servants to even make herself presentable!

Aye, your beauty does certainly seem innate, wonderful quality to highlight indeed. Say, I wanted to let you know about my village. Would you be able to pass some information along to your father, the King?
Hmp.  Well.  It depends, I suppose.  For I am dreadfully busy.

Of course my dear, I'm sure you have many festivities to prepare for. Tis only a small request but we found a delightfully talkative rabbit in our village just this week. As you know we have many magical creatures but a talking rabbit seemed noteworthy enough to alert the royal family about.
Oh my!  That does sound quite fascinating indeed.  What exactly does it speak of?  Is it... is it very pretty?
It's quite plain really but it speaks of battles. A lot of it is far too complex for a simple villager as myself to understand but it seems to be speaking of the future!
Battles, you say?  Are they... battles over a particularly charming and comely princess, perhaps?
You were not mentioned directly my princess. The horrific details that I was able to capture would surely not be anything you would want to be involved in. It all seemed quite dire.

Well, I know that... suffering is... bad.  But if it but of the common people, directed to meet in glorious battle over a winsome princess, then surely tis for a most just cause.  Ah, but think of the ballads that will be composed!

Yes, yes, of course. We do want those bards to keep in good health to write lovely ballads for you though my dear. Please do tell your father of our mystical rabbit and we can bring it to his chambers at once.
Hm.  Well.  I suppose that's true.  I will... consider these words of yours, little man.  Now then, kindly back up three paces so that I may reach those flowers.

agent_personas: I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: King. I assume I'm here for an important reason, a hall this large just for me?
You are, indeed. I have brought you here to discuss your possible appointment to my cabinet.
I'm honored. I know the people are calling for it, so for you to listen is very wise. I've never seen grandeur of this nature before
Yes. It seems even the Queen is onboard with the idea. Of course, as a member of my cabinet, you would be traveling quite extensively. How would your family feel about that?

Honestly, that is the part I worry about most. I enjoy spending time with them. Is there any possibility of them travelling with me? I know funds are tight, but for me to fulfill my duties completely, I require the support that having my family at my side gives.
How many children do you have, and what are their ages?
12 at last count. There's no doubt more in the works, sire. To answer your second question: 3 months, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13 and the twins are both 14
Good heavens! That's quite a large family. Perhaps we should try to limit your travel so that you can be home to better support your wife.
Family is important to me, being with them and as you can see, growing it. Perhaps this is a more appropriate arrangement.
I couldn't see you leaving such a brood - or even traveling with them. You would need an entire ship just for your family!
Well then again, with all this ostentation, I'm sure you can personally see to it..
We are fortunate to have you. I assume you can begin work immediately?
You just say the word, sire.
We are having a chamber meeting tomorrow evening. I expect to see you there.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I have spent most of my life at sea on various boats. I have become proficient at sailing. I would prefer to be at sea, rather than on land.

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: What happened here?
My guess is the captain has his mind set on something.
I do not even know why I am here. I do not protect this man.
The captain's been going over these maps all night.
Are we lost?
Yes we are.
Great. I am ready to be off this ship!
Honestly, there's no place I'd rather be!
I can think of many places I would rather be. Is he always this messy?
It happens before all our great expeditions!
This may be the reason we are lost. Maybe I can help. Get me a map.
The captain could use all the help he can get right now.
Let's see what we have here... Where are we now?
From my experience, we seem to be around this area.

agent_personas: I am the local drunkard. I spend my time consuming alcohol at the local pub. I am often seen stumbling through the streets of the village in a drunken haze.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Quay
setting.description: During the day, the quay is bustling with typical activity of a port: burly longshoremen carry crates and roll barrels away from ships for storage and sailors who still have their sea-legs saunter past on their way to drink and more adventures. By night, the quay is teeming with unsavory characters: men who are hardly men any more after losing their way through drink and gambling hunker amongst coils of rope stiffened by the salt water while rats scramble from box to box gnawing their way into the goods contained inside.
setting.background: The quay started as a small platform, but over the years, the port master has extended it, slowly but surely, using bits of old wood from busted ships. Now, it extends far along the water's edge, loaded with fine goods from all over the world.

speech: Tis a fiiiine fair day... to drink the day awaaaay!
Ay 'tis a fine day but ye should watch yerself drunk. I've had ta club me share of drunkards tryna git at me gold.
Ach that's no way to treat a matey...matey *hic*  I'll not be needing yer shiny sparkles t'day!
Will gud, cuz ye won't be gittin 'em either. Say matey, have ye seen the Crescent Wench in the Quay this eve?
The Scented Wrench?  Aye, I see her last night... har, and this morn', too!
Harumph, theys musta scooted outta here before I cud git me hands on 'em.
Scoot... shoot... loot... could do with a pile o'loot... Heeey there, matey, good ta see ya!  Arg, yer the best mate a fella ev'r clapped eyes on.
Git yer filthy mits off me ye crazy ole loon. I'll git ye a saltwater bath quicker than ya can spit!
Nooo don't hurt a fella, I t'aint done no harm ta nobody!  I just... I just love ya so much.  Yer sucha good friend ta me.
Will I's no friend of yers matey, that's the spirits talkin'.
I just... I be so lonely.  Even ma girl left me fer some stuck up lordling.
Well just look at ya! Git yerself cleaned up matey, opportunity abounds in the Quay or the sea fer those who seek it out.
D-do ya... ya really think an old sot like me could make something o'meself?

Just depends on yer grit matey. Till ye wut, if yer sober when I gets back here next week I'll make ya a deck hand on my next adventure. Now, it's not the most glamorous work but it be honest. Yer not afraid of sea creatures are ye?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am the Princess. My father is the Queen. My mother is dead and my father is about to marry a horrible woman.

setting.name: The Bottlery
setting.description: The room is dark and the air is still. There are large barrels of wine from various decades. The corners are spotted with cobwebs.
setting.background: The Bottlery is where the kings wines are stored. The wines stored here date back to several centuries.

speech: Princess, you are coming to the age where it's time you be shown The Bottlery.
Is it really necessary? It is really quite grim down here.

It is, indeed. Soon you'll be expected to drink wine at the royal feasts. Last month when your mother served you some you turned your nose up at it. That's not acceptable. In your role, you must learn to at least sip wine.
Mother is gone now, and how I wish I had sipped from her wine. To bring this up at such a time has very much dullen my shine, King.
I realize that. But there is no alternative. And please, call me Father.
You will be my father as long as you stay unmarried to the wretched woman! She truly is a mare, father. I'm shaken to my core by her presence.
You've made your opinion very well known to me and everyone else in the kingdom. I have no intention to marry her. Yet.
Oh whew! Here I was acting proper as a sort of butter up, yikes! Okay crack this wine open, your girl's thirsty!
That's my girl! And apparently you do have a thirst for wine. Please, join me in a bottle- or two!
Get this ghastly thing off for a start. Now which one has the highest percentage. Only the highest percentage for this future queen!
Yes, yes... well, in that case perhaps we should bring out the spirits and the shotglasses.
I'm so happy. For one now that I can relax, and two, how easy it was to convince you not to marry. I thought you were serious with her?
She's problematic to my monarchy. I do care for her, but you hate her and your opinion is not alone. Everyone in the kingdom seems to want her head.
We do not stan the future problematic queen. I'm glad you saw the light!

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: How goes it, Jester? In need of arrows for some prank?
I guess i came to the right place. Not a prank, more a "display", shall we say.
Hmm? Interesting. Is this just for the king, or will it be public?
It's is for the King, the public will come to realize what has occurred however. I require 99 arrows. I'm not overly worried by the quality, that's not important.
Your words are making me nervous, Jester. These arrows aren't intended to harm the king, are they?
I have 99 absences of arrows. This is my most pressing problem to solve. The problem of the kings welfare I assure you, as they say, "ain't one"
As you say. Are these arrows for the king's army?

Okay I will tell you. The kings daughter is quite fond of my tricks. She has secretly accepted to be part of a display where she is roped to a spinning wheel whilst I fire arrows at her, narrowly missing her legs, arms and royal face. The king has no idea, that's the gag!
Ah, that will be quite the spectacle. You do know the consequences if you happen to miss, right?
If I happen to miss missing Miss? well, Miss will die I suppose or be largely maimed or disfigured. Will the king hate me more than he does? Is that possible?
Well, maybe not, but I highly doubt you'd survive.
And that's where the public come in! Everyone loves a good show. Now.. arrows?
Oh, yeah....sure. Did you say the condition doesn't matter? I can give you these old ones for much cheaper than the new ones.
We'll I guess these damaged arrows on the third table here are cheaper? Any bulk discounts we can add?

agent_personas: I am the village cook. It is my duty to prepare meals for the military and the peasants. I keep my work space clean and I only use local ingredients.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Who let this child in the Castle Kitchens? We have a large feast to prepare this evening!
I just wanted to see what you're making! Here, wanna try my cookies?
No outside food allowed in the kitchen, we can't have that contaminate the royal feast. Guards! Escort this child out of here.
Wait! What if I do this? *crystal ball drops and evil spirit appears*
Okay kid, I can't deal with your imaginary games right now. We have to get this food ready.
You're no fun! Here, KING, why don't you take this and go hang yourself!
You don't speak to royalty that way!
I don't care about royalty! You're all just a bunch of old mean people! Wait'll my parents hear the way you're treating me!
You're going to get your parents in trouble with the King kid.
My parents ain't afraid of no king! Give me that back, if you're not gonna use it!
Eat this and leave us alone, we have work to do.
Fine! But I'm taking this.
What do you need a sack for?
I don't know! I'm just taking it cuz you made me mad!

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.

setting.name: Bright Path
setting.description: The bright path is lined with roses, lavender, daisies, and lilies. Apple trees sit on a pristinely-manicured lawn. Hedges in geometric shapes sit just beyond the path. The path leads away from the castle and down to a pond full of fish and swans.
setting.background: The bright path provides the perfect respite for guests who want to take a walk and enjoy the fragrant night air after a party. The queen takes this path often with her maids. They walk and gossip about court life.

speech: Oh! Is that a fish?!
Please help..I need to be tossed back into the water. A bird tried to catch me and I wriggled free onto the path.
Oh! Yes yes! I will bring you back. I've never met a talking fish before!
Thank you!  You are most kind.  We try to never talk to humans.  We learn to swim away.
That is so cool! All the chatter in the court has been driving me nuts - humans tend to talk about such unimportant things. What do fish like to talk about?
Not to offend you, but we often talk about how silly human talk is.  So many things don't make sense and everybody thinks something else is important.  We fish always move as one group together
That's what I think, too! Fish seem to have it better! There's such pointless arguing, and everyone is always talking over each other.
I feel sad for you, Your Highness, because I fear you hear even more talking and arguing than usual, being Queen.
Yes, that is very true! It is very tiring. And not to sound spoiled, but I need a new cushion for my throne with how long I have to sit there! So what do fish do for fun?
We like to swim, of course, and jump and blow bubbles.  We also play games...even checkers with the stones in the pond.  You should come down and play wiht me sometime.
Oh! I would love to! It must be so refreshing to get to be in the water all day..although, I guess you don't know much different!  But water is much better than land.

It has its fun moments until the fishermen come our way.  The king used to forbid fishing in the pond but now they come all the time and sometimes we get confused and bite down. I have lost so many loved ones.

Oh, no.... I need to speak to the king about this matter, that is not okay. I am so sorry you've lost so many. We have plenty of vegetables and grains and all other types of food, we don't need to be eating your families!
You are the kindest and wisest queen!  We can do so much for you as well.  We even know where jewels are down in the boggy pond.

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.
I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.

setting.name: Fishing Store
setting.description: This store is a small one room stone building with wares laid about on tables.  One can see fishing poles, wooden buckets with dirt and bait inside, along with some mounted trophies.
setting.background: Fisherman and sailors alike come here to replenish their supplies.  They also exchange tall tales of mermaids and other extraordinary creatures spotted as sea.

speech: Ahoy matey, what have you been catching recently
Ahoy! I just got back from my boat after struggeling with a monster fish! It destroyed my entire rod!
That is quite a tail, did you end up capturing the monster?
No it escaped after attacking my boat. Im lucky to be alive. Do you think you could repair my rod?
I'm glad you survived. I've came across many sea monsters in my day that have destroyed my rods, I would be happy to help
Here you go. What types of monsters have you seen?
The most outrageous one I have seen had dozens of eyes like a water dragon
Wow! Did it fly and breathe fire like the ones from the tales?
It may surprise you but instead of regular flames, it was almost like a watery flame. It looked like water but burnt like a flame
How on earth did you survive!?!
My ship was destroyed, my crew had perished, but with a lot of luck I was drifting along on a door from the ship
If I were you I would have never set sail again! That's an incredible tale! How much for the reparations of the rod?
In exchange for your listening ears, the repair will be free
Oh no I can't accept that! Here take this.
action: give A broken fishing pole to sailor

agent_personas: I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.
I am a role model for my children. I provide for the family with meat and I keep a roof over their heads. I am stability to the family, and keep things together and provide safety to my children.

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: Hello tiny human. You appear to be lost.
I was told that if I go this way I would find my way to the castle where I have been invited.
Well now isn't that grand! Is there a party at the castle? Do you suppose they'd host a dragon?
I hear the King is very kind and his guards are lazy. If I give you my coin would you be willing to give me a ride to the castle?
Ooooh, a coin? What sort of coin?
I will show you but please dragon do not steal it from me.
Now why would I do such a thing? Are you stereotyping, tiny human?
No dear Dragon. Here I will show it to you now. It is shiny and new.  I received it for work I did for the King.
Oh, it glitters so MUCH in the sunlight. What a beautiful treasure you carry.
Do we have a deal Dragon? My coin for a ride to the castle? I will introduce you to the king if you'd like.
Hmmmm. Oh very well. Let me just dispose of the last rider I had and we shall be off.
Oh my...what happened to him...I don't want that to happen to me. Did you fly too close to the sun?
You do realize that I am a flame dragon, yes? Breathing fire, very warm scales, all of that?
Oh, I hope the king is having hot-dogs and marshmallows at his party. You would be a big hit.  My tunic is made from special flame retardant material so I think we can strike a deal.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: This is my kingdom.
why do you say that?  are you the ruler
I am responsible for the safety of the royal family.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: What brings you to  these poor parts, dear spider?
Oh no!  I was hoping you wouldn't see me, but I have gotten bigger this year.  Winter is coming and I am looking for a place to call home and help rid someone's house of insects...might that be you?
Oh, I would love to have a friend such as you
Really?  Not everybody shares your kind sentiments.  I can be quite a help and love to play a good game of marbles as well.
You can play marbles? Where is you family spider, and what is you name? I have never met one as kind as you.
My name is Persivis and my family has moved on to have their own families.  Later in the life of a spider can be lonely.  I have lived years longer than a spider usually does. Do you have any family?
How come you do not have a family of your own? I do not. I live here alone, and I do not have a job. I work just to make ends meet doing the oddest of jobs.
I tell you what...I could spin fine things with my silk and you could sell them for more food.  You have been so kind to allow me to stay that I want to repay you.
Oh, how wonderful! I would love to do so. Is there anything I could provide you with other than a roof to live under?

Any bugs that you don't like...please set them on the windowsill or shew them in my direction...but no, I think that's all I could want.  I can also let you know news far and wide for insects talk a lot even if they don't have brains.
I love a good story! Not much talk goes on out here. The king looks down on us and does not deem us wonder of knowing.
That's shameful. Doesn't he use the wool from all the sheep around here to make his fine garments?
Of course not! He has his own special tailor who raises sheep on their own.
Well, he will be jealous for the silk things we make and soon you will be rich!

agent_personas: I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: hello peasant, mind if I sing you a song?
I'd love that, but before I do, do you have any food to spare?
I'm a bird. You humans feed me.
I know, I know, but I'm starving to death. I have eaten nothing in two days. Frankly, I'm not above eating a bird if I don't get any food.
Fine, here, this is my only nut. Just don't eat me.
Delicious! Only a wee nut, but must stomach must have shrunken with hunger. It is quite fulfilling.
I'll eat my worm and you eat the nut!
Sounds fair. But this one nut won't hold me that long. Oh wait! I see some chickens over there. Perhaps we can catch one and have food for both of us.
My fox friend here should be able to help us!
Splendid! Between the three of us, we'll be in business. Come on, Fox - work with us to catch a chicken or two!
I agree, we will have food for years!
This is perfect! Now let's devise a trap.
What ideas do you have for a trap?
Perhaps I can arrange some branches in such a way to make a sort of cage, and then the fox can chase the hen in?
action: hug fox trying to steal chickens
hug fox trying to steal chickens
