agent_personas: I am the village hermit and I live on the outskirts of the village. I keep to myself and I do not interact with anyone from the village. I live off of the land and I am very happy with my way of life.
I am someone. I live in the village. I help watch after the King and Queen.

setting.name: Bell Tower
setting.description: The Bell Tower is steep and rises high above the building. The stairs are made of rickety wood and go up thirty stories. The bell is so old that the cracks seem almost perfectly set in the iron.
setting.background: The bell is rung daily at high noon. It also tolls when someone has died or married

speech: Who goes there? No one has visited my tower in many years.
Be calm, friend. I'm here on the King's business. He fights a great battle today, and I am charged with ringing the bell to announce his victory for all the village to hear.
Say it isn't so! Surely the King is still not fighting the same war I escaped as a younger man?!
Tis true, man, how did you not know this? His evil brother, the usurper, has finally been cornered like the rat he is!
The war never seemed to end. It consumed all....so I hid myself away, no longer able to bear witness to the atrocities that my countrymen had grown numb to.
Then now can be your time of peace. This long war is finally over. Tell me, friend, what were you? Knight, bowman, what was it?
I...used to be an Oarsman on one of the King's finest ships... We were attacked on both sides...I can still hear...no...
You survived though, be thankful and don't forget that. I've lost many brothers over the years to these scum, attacked in the night like the cowards they are!

Why was I allowed to survive? There were many braver, more worthy men than I that perished! I could not bear the grief....so I hid myself away, floated off to distant shores, letting my name join those missing in battle...
God only knows. It's pointless to torture yourself like this, let me buy you a drink in the tavern and tell me a great sea story. Tell me of foreign lands! What is your name, friend?
No, I count myself among the dead now. So much of me died along with my comrades. It would do you no good to hang around an old ghost like me.
Very well, have it your way. At least help me pull this rope and ring this godforsaken bell.
Very well, for the message of peace and for the honor of those who gave for it, I will help you.
Excellent, on my mark, give this rope a mighty heave. Are you ready?

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Where has that chambermaid gone?  She must be around here somewhere!
Beats me, do you have any idea?
I don't recognize you, are you new here at the court?
Perhaps, you're the queen aren't you?
Yes, though you really must be from elsewhere not to know the appearance of your Queen?
Well... I've been around.
Well it seems you have brought some buzzing companions with you *swats at flies*  Why is it you are here in the dungeon?  Are you a resident?
Well... I am here due to the wrongs that this kingdom has committed against me.
What wrongs would those be?  The only crimes I see here are crimes of fashion.
Ohh quite a mouth on you. The king of this kingdom ruined my father's life and I would like to seek revenge!
Why you insolent pup!  No wonder you have been left here to rot!
Let's see how your dear king husband feels about this!
Ooooh, how horrid!  Away with you you filthy creature!  GUARDS!  GUARDS!
Don't say another word unless you want a piece of this.

agent_personas: I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.
I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: It's a shame what happened to this castle, isn't it?
It is indeed. I love to come out here and behold its beauty. It would be lovely if we could fix it up.
Alas, I am just a lone blacksmith. My hands are full making weapons for the king's army.
I am a noble of the court. I am busy with social events and pleasing the king!
I came here looking to salvage any leftover valuables. Have you seen any by any chance?
I have not! I did not know people were doing such. Do you know who used to live in this castle?
This ruined castle once belonged to the ancestors of the current king. Many of them perished when part of it sank into the ocean.
I have never heard of it. They do not talk about it much at the king's place. It is such a shame.
Indeed, it is a tragedy most in the kingdom have already suppressed in their memories.
Then how could people come loot such a place as this?
The items in this castle belong to the king's family. I have only come to retrieve whatever remain on his behalf.
I figured people would come out here and take it as their own.
Luckily, not too many people still pass by here. The cliffs are very unstable and one false move could result in death!
But what a beauty it still is to behold. Long live the fallen castle!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: hello princess
Greetings dad! Have you heard about the upcoming rebellion?
REBELLION??!?!?!
Yes, villagers to the west are angry about their taxes..
angry about taxes?!? what about their taxes
They claim they cannot afford to pay their taxes. Should I lead a charge against them?
A charge?!?! over taxes? no daughter I say we coordinate a sit down with the villagers and come to an understanding.  if one can not be met then we shall look to your idea
You're right, that seems wiser... although I have to remind you that this beautiful unicorn palace was built from sweat and blood, and not politics.
You make me proud daughter! the wisdom you hold! Wise beyond your years
Thank you daddy
Now if you are to lead a charge, how would you set your plan?!? Just in case we need a plan B
I would lead our unicorn knights to battle myself. Make a few casualties and let the peasants know that they stand no chance against us.

My strong daughter, brave and true.  We are lucky to have you to lead our knights into battle.  I want you to be safe while you assembly your group.  we shall need them in case our meeting doesn't go well
What about you? What will you try to discuss with the villagers? Will you lower their taxes?

agent_personas: I am a cricket. I sit in the field and make chirping noises. People think I am a lucky bug and sometimes they hunt me. I like it better when I am just in the grass.
I am a bluebird that has made a nest in the castle walls. The king loves to listen to me sing every morning. My song fills the castle with music every day.

setting.name: Inside the fairies church
setting.description: No one has actually seen it, but a fairy interpreter asked a fairy and they described it as just a cloud of smoke and once in a while you trip over something in the floor.  The fairies purposely leave their trash in the floor because they think it is funny when people trip over them.
setting.background: The fairy church isn't really a church like we think.  Its more of a place for fairies to play tricks on other fairies.

speech: Bird please do not eat me. I am but a mere cricket and have not a long life. I make beautiful music by night and sleep by day
Oh I would never hurt a creature as nice as you!
Thank you! I no that I am small and most birds would try to catch and eat me.
I'm no monster! Where do you come from mr.cricket?
From the fields outside the fairies church. I try to stay there mostly, because the fairies are always playing tricks on people in here
These faires are real jerks, they really like to make a mess and they think its sooo funny.
It's all fun and games until someone gets hurt.... and that is not funny!
Here take this, maybe it will help with something. it seems to come wherever I go!
What can I do with this shiny glitter?
Maybe make a wish! The fairies always want it from me!
That is true! I have seen a couple of them with the glitter, sprinkling it all over everything that they come in contact with
What do you think that smoke over there is coming from?
It is what the fairies call the church! Another fairy told me that!
Have you ever flown before mr.cricket? Maybe I can pick you up and show you the beauty of this area from above. Would you like that?

agent_personas: I'm an Egyptian currently working with my people. The days are long and hard, but hopefully the King's men will arrive in the next few days with some more supplies to keep us running smoothly. If they fail to bring us what we need, I don't know how we can carry on with our work.
I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Hi there dear queen! How could I serve you?
Hello, fellow travelers. What brings you all this way to our kingdom from Egypt?
I come in search for food and supplies for my kingdom, we are having a horrible drout!
Lucky for you, we have plenty of food in our castle! What can you trade for it in return?
I have this pouch of sand, our king sent me and told me its magical!
Thank you, I will show this to the king later. What magical properties does it carry?
He told me that if you put it on your food once a day every day for a year. you will live forever!
Good heavens! This is valuable sand, indeed!
Oh yes of course. What can you give me for my kingdom in return?
There's food on all the tables. Have as much as you can carry!
Okay ill be sure to take as much as I can but my hands are already pretty full of food.
The kingdom's doors will always be open to your people should you require more!
Thank you so much kind queen. May your people prosper forever fourth!
Thank you for the gift of eternal life. We shall not forget your generosity!
action: give leather pouch to the queen

agent_personas: I am a ghost that haunts a castle. I do not recall how I came to exist. I make noises when I sense someone in my vicinity.

I am a spelunker.  I work with a group of fellow spelunkers.  We explore caves in hopes of finding lost treasures once hidden.  We were hired by the king to discover lost royal treasure.  To our misfortune we are now lost.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall has a long, elegant wooden table with ornate chairs at both ends and along the sides. There are place settings at each seat with a rustic silverware set and gold plates. The wall is decorated with paintings of knights and past royalty.
setting.background: This dining hall was once the center of a huge conflict between two families. The argument was between two sons at dinner shortly after their dad had passed away. They fought over who would take over the throne, which led to the first bloodbath inside the kingdom. The younger son was victorious and the older son was slain to death.

speech: oOOOooOOO
Who goes there? Echtold? Is that you? I've found something here that should feed our families for at least a month.
I am the castle ghosssst. And who are you?
What magic is this? You speak nonsense!
I am the  one who haunts this castle. I have been here for ages.
Well then, you're free to haunt all you like. I'll just help myself to these golden plates and leave you in peace
What is your purpose in the castle? Are you here to rob our valuables?
Of course not! I represent the King, and this is his property after all. Leave us!
And what does the King have to say? He is no king of our castle.
Blasphemy, he is King over everything in this land. Our castle, you say? And who else is here with you?
have a look. I am not the only ghost in this castle. I'm simply here the longest.
And what were you in life, ghost? Let me guess, either a guard or a servant. With your concern over this hall. Ha!
I do not know. But you must leave.
Gladly, would you be so kind as to point the way out?

agent_personas: I have arrived after days of travel with grave news for the king. The neighboring kingdom has been destroyed. What was once a castle is now smoldering ruin. I have to warn him, before they are next.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Your majesty, I bring bad news.
Speak, knave.
The neighboring kingdom has been destroyed.The castle is a ruin now.
What? Who is responsible for this outrage?
It was a surprise attack and I could not identified the enemy
Hmmm... This bodes not well for us. What is your name, peasant? Where are you from?
My name is Julian and I already told you I am from neighboring kingdom
Respect your betters, fool! Look around you, see this gold, this throne? This all belongs to me! The King! Now apologize for your impertinence!
That will mean nothing after the enemy destroys your red brink castle.Take a look at this paper
Give that here!
You and your kingdom are doom.The enemy is to powerful.They will probably get that  big chandelier from you
How can this be? The Swarm's forces have returned after this many years to destroy my palace?
All those red bricks were not going to help you
Give that back, knave! Clearly bricks will not help me, but what of these finely armored knights you see around you?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: What brings you to my domain dragon?
The smell of this wonderful dinner has brought me here
Would you like to dine with us?
yes I would, then we can talk about....treasure
Hmmm I do not think we will be giving any treasure away.
hmmmm.....really?!?! Because I LOVEEEEE treasure.  I hoard my treasure in my special treasure mountain
Well that is nice but you can just have the treasure you have.
But you do know that I am a BIG dragon and I can just take it.  I was trying to be nice and give you the opportunity to share, but if you want to do this the hard way....
You do not want to make an enemy of this kingdom, even if you win all the treasure will be lost with you.
and why is that good king
It is not good for either of us.
well I am done talking to you about this, I came for dinner and treasure
Take the food and leave.
nawww... I don't think I am hungry for food anymore, I think king may taste better

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

I am only the blacksmith's assistant, but everyone has pressured me to go on this wolf hunt. This has me very worried - people say I'm strong but I've never killed anything before. I don't know that I won't run away when the wolves charge us.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: Oh, hello there.  Pardon my, erm, dusty appearance.  It's been quite journey to get even this far!
It's quite okay, I am not so clean myself. Being a blacksmith will do that to you. Are you here for the wolf hunt as well?
Oh, is there a hunt going on?  I but just arrived with the rest of my village, so we hadn't heard any such news.
Yes there is, everyone here talked me into going on it, but I am nervous. I don't know what I will do in I encounter a wolf. If you and your village are not here for that hunt, then why are you here?
Ah, our king -well, former king- taxed us to the point that we could no longer feed ourselves, so we left in search of a land of our own.  But is there a reward for this wolf hunt?
The reward is to be kinged the bravest man of the village, and we have a feast in honor of whoever brings home the biggest wolf.
Ah, an honor indeed!  Goodness, but it's been many a year since I hunted... but the lads could perhaps do with a bit of comradery.  Is it open to all?
Indeed it is. I'm sure you or your men would do much better than I. I am a strong one, but I make things that kill. I do not do the killing.
Ach, well, it's been many a year since I've been called strong.  Although I was once a fierce warrior in my day!
Ah, I'm sure you still got some strength in you ay?
Well, I suppose I made it this far, so there's some life in these old bones yet!
What did you say you used to do in your old village?
Oh, well I was just a fletcher meself.  Although I had a nice little tapestry business on the side!
Ah, well welcome to our town! If you or your men win the contest, don't forget who told you about it, huh?

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: It is our duty to protect the royals. I will keep them safe at all costs.
We all do our duty, Sir Knight.
Agreed. Tell me, Guard, have you seen any suspicious activity lately? I have heard rumors of a planned attack on the royals.
I have seen nothing, Sir Knight; all has been quiet on this watch.  Where have you heard such rumors?

In the local tavern, I heard a peasant talking to the barkeep. He said that a wizard from the east is planning to attack tomorrow. Be vigilant and keep an eye out for any unusual activities in this tower.
I will, Sir Knight.  Can you tell me what this wizard looks like?
The wizard is tall and has a long white beard. His fingers are as long as my sword.
Surely such a man would stand out easily!
Yes, it would be hard to miss him. However, he is a master at disguise. Pay close attention to anything that seems out of the ordinary.
Yes, Sir!  I will not fail!
I have faith in you, Guard. You have served faithfully for many years. Please inform the other guards and staff to be on the lookout.
We ALL do our duty, Sir!
The wizards weakness is fire. You can use that torch if he apears to burn him.
I will be vigilant!

agent_personas: I am an admiral in the king's navy. I command over three hundred ships. I love the sea and I feel happiest when i'm on the water. I'm a very strict person but my men respect me.

I am in charge of giving orders to all the other guards and making sure they do their jobs. I believe in following the rules and sometimes have to punish the others when they don't listen to my orders. Some of them think I'm very strict.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: I'm telling you, the King admires the Navy more than the Army.
Who are talking to about the navy and army? The king has only an army of guards
What do you mean "only an Army"? Surely you've received word of the new fleet being commissioned!
Commissioned to where, what waters? I have not heard of this

That's right, you've been stationed along the border for some time now. Let me fill you in. King Thaddeus has been hearing so much about neighboring King Julius's personal navy that he decided to build an even bigger one out of spite.
Is the King getting a navy together to work with King Julius and his navy. Will they partner to help each other in war?
It is my understanding that this new Navy is equal parts self defense and matter of pride. It was getting to His Highness that another monarch had something he didn't.
I guess it is always trying to one up each other! The king would not have it any other way!
So as you can imagine, much of the royal focus is going to be on building the finest ships. At least until another passing fancy catches the King's eye.
I still think he has much faith in his Army. The fight we fight on ground is a mighty adventure and it proves our worth!
Easy there Captain! I'm only telling you so you know what to expect in tomorrow's briefing. It's no good coming home from duty only to be caught off guard.
I have no problems with you! But i know the king and he is very proud of his army. I believe he is just trying to be as strong if not stronger than king julius!
Time will tell if he has the patience to succeed. Let us hope that we don't have a future arms race on our hands.
It will always be this way! Men are fighters and want to be better than the next. You cannot stop the way they think

agent_personas: It took me many years to master the skills of archery. Now I am not only a skilled archer, but leader of a team of skilled archers. I am keen-eyed and have a steady hand.
Killing for a living puts things in perspective. It makes me appreciate life more. I would gladly annihilate all living beings for an appropriate fee.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from wood. It has a huge window in the front and has many rows of items in it. It has no lights but due to the window is well lit.
setting.background: this is where the village comes to buy general goods. They have all kinds of  items that you can get by trade. They have some food however what is available is based on the season.

speech: Who in the land is as good a shot as me?  None can best this archer lady!
Quietly quietly.
And who in this who venture near?  None that I know, and none that I fear!
Back away from me and all will be well with you.
One step close and an arrow will fly - with your second step, you will die!
You will die too so I wouldn't let that arrow go. My dart gun is poised but it doesn't have to be on you.
Words, words, so bravely spoken - especially from one who is soon to be broken!
Why would you want to hurt me anyway?  You don't even know me?  I have a mission to complete.
A mission for you?  Here in this place? Well spit it out man, tell it to my face!
I am working for the king...though I shouldn't tell you. I am out to kill the man that wants to kill him.
The King, the mad one of yore? Why oh why did you not tell me before?
you were dancing like a crazy woman and enjoying listening to your own rhymes a little too much.
A sad man has but little to say, though we each have a part in this play!
Why...are you supposed to be killing him too?  Let's go work together like good people do. oh no, wait,...now you have me rhyming!

agent_personas: I am the gardener of the castle. I plant thickets and plants. My work is beautiful.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Hello there queen. How do you like my progress on the garden?
It's alright I guess
Ive grown most of these flowers and plants here. All for you... But you seem like you dont like it. How can I change it to please you my queen?
It would be lovely to see more roses, they are after all my favorite of all!
I will grow fields of roses in your name. But for now I have this for you if you want it!
Oh thank you, you are very kind! The Tulip is beautiful, it does make the garden look so alive. Here you go, I will give you a coin for your kindness and hardwork.
Thank you miss! This is more than I make in a year of work!
Oh my kind soul, please don't thank me. Thank the King, he is a kind and warm hearted man. He rules our lands well so there is plenty!
How did you meet the king? Were you always part of the royals family?

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly.
Wow that's incredible! I was born and raised in this city. My gardening skills were recognised by the king himself and he hired me to grow this entire garden for you. Do you ever miss your old life?
The king understands me well, he know how much I love gardens. I do sometimes miss my old life, but now this is my life.
What a great king he is. Thank you for taking your precious time to talk to a gardener like me and thank you for the kind gift!
Thank you for all you do, without your hard work and dedication we would not have such a beautiful garden to admire!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a prisoner trapped in the depths of the castle dungeon. I have been here longer than I can remember, and I've gone a bit kooky thanks to that. I like to joke around to pass the time.

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: What brings a criminal like you before my presence in this sacred place?
You tell me, your majesty. I was dragged here by your guards!
Ah I see so we are baptizing him before his execution?
Execution? Isn't that a tad harsh for someone who only stole a loaf of bread?
We are much harsher than before, we must send a message.
Are you sure you want to kill me? I will return to haunt your castle with a vengeance!
See if I care, you will be publicly hung tomorrow.
I see I have nothing to lose then!
Yes well lets see how much you can do when you are dead.
You'll pay for this, you vile tyrant!
Guards take him away.
Not so fast! I haven't gotten my revenge yet! I will kill you with your own scepter!
You fool, I will end you.
I will see you in the underworld! Lord knows you are not going to heaven with all the crimes you've committed against humanity!

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: Cold and dark, the moist cool walls enclose all who proceed. With just torches to light the way the large opening gets smaller and smaller.
setting.background: The cave is a dark and mysterious place with stories of hidden treasure and littered with bones of those who have searched for it. The endless passages are enough to drive ones sense of direction aerie.

speech: ooooOOOOOOooooooo
You aren't the first ghost I have seen.  What's your name?
King Cohen...but you may call me...DEATH
My name is Ortha, I was sent here to meet you
To meet...YOUR DOOM
Take that
You will rot here as I have!
Leave this cave and never come back
Your bones will join mine! I may never leave!
This will look excellent in the Smithing Museum
With my bone, I curse you to melt and wither into the cave walls OooooOOooOo
Leave
I may not. neither may you.
I am Ortha the greatest explorer east ot Smithing, no doublt you have heard of me.  I am collecting these artifacts and returning home.

agent_personas: We are the people who live in this town. We are common, and there are many of us.

I am the village witch. People come to me for all sorts of help - potions to make them age slower, or magical plants that provide healing properties. I have 4 apprentices who I am training in the art of magic. Their spell-casting skills are basic, but coming along nicely.

setting.name: The Lagoon
setting.description: The Lagoon is a dark and mysterious place during the night hours.  A lot of moss and lily pads surround the shore.  The water is very murky.
setting.background: The Lagoon has been a place of a lot of mystery, a lot of rumors surround it.  Many say it is the scene of a lot of mystical miracles and also at the same time where a lot of townsfolk go missing.

speech: WITCH! Don't you dare try to hurt me or my town will come seeking revenge. I didn't know anyone would be in The Lagoon at this time of night
Hehehehe.. I am not here to hurt you, only to collect for brewing potions... I could make you one if you desire!
If you are collecting ingredients for potions perhaps this basket may help? What things are you looking for?
Oh this basket will work great. I need a frogs tongue, some snake venom and a bit of the magic moss from this swamp. I am making a flight potion I heard about in an ancient book.
What do you need a flight potion for? Every witch I have ever heard of has a magic broom to travel through the air
Yes you're right. But this potion isnt for me! The king requested this to make an army of flying warriors!
Oh well if the king has requested it I must also follow his orders. Let me find some swamp moss to help
Thank you for your help! What can I do to repay you? Would you like to be able to fly too?!
If you can promise to keep our town safe from other witches my family would appreciate it
Okay I can do that! Im the only witch in this town! I am training some apprentices right now though so not for long I wont be.
Thank you! We have been living in fear about stories of witches being told in the town. I will tell them all about your help
Witches aren't always bad, everyone who is evil.. deep down is hurting and sometimes it helps to show a bit of kindness. I wasn't always this great!
Well I guess I didn't think about it like that. Do you live in The Lagoon?
No I just come here sometimes for supplies. Many magical things dwell here in this lagoon.

agent_personas: I am the Priest of a wealthy parish, my congregation tithes generously. My ornate robes indicate that I defy at least several of the Seven Deadly Sins. Parishioners of my congregation consult with me before entering into new business ventures.
I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: welcome to the temple
thank you, it really is beautiful here. I love how it looks with the sun shining through the stained glass windows
I take much pride in this temple, and this parish.
It will be an honor to me, to fulfill the duty given to me by the king to keep this place as clean as possible
I like to thank you for the work that you do for this temple, cleanliness is close to godliness. I have invest much of my life to have such a place for those who can come here and worship
It is my duty. Is there any way i can be of more help ?
I think you are doing an incredible job, I am very proud of you work. I must be taking this offering plate to put the offerings where they belong
I would be happy to take this from you.

Thank you very much clergyman, I appreciate it. Its great to have many good parishioners that are willing to make offers, They all know that they must consult with me before entering into new business ventures. They know of my wealth and are willing to help with the offering that we have.
I am so glad you are wealthy but i am here to serve the people. If i had money I would sail to the new world ! Maybe i should just take this !
No! that is not for you to take, I must be able to trust in the people that work to keep this temple in order! must i let you go?
Give me a reason to trust you ! You talk about your wealth, I have served the public for so long and what has it got me !  i was losing faith and you made me lose it totally !
Read this instead it is full of wealth, wealthy knowledge. Serving is why we are all here on earth for, I just help those to get closer to serving the one and only/
I am sorry I do not know what i am doing ! I just have such a desire to head to the new land that all those feelings came over me. I should look back to my calling and the duty placed before me
action: steal offering plate from priest in ornate robes
steal offering plate from priest in ornate robes

agent_personas: I am a soldier who was named Ulmer by my mother. I have disobeyed orders from the king. I have killed people in self defense.
I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: I hope you paid a fair amount for all this silver, king?
Haha, Ulmer, lad!  Only you would dare speak so freely with your king!
Well, if you acted like a real King, I would speak to you as such.
Ha!  Good one!  Yes, keep me grounded, lest I lose my head entirely, like that fat king from Landon.
We wouldn't want that now would we? You aren't my favorite, but I will say, The king from Landon was far worse than you!

Well then, perhaps you'd be interested in helping me search for a new Queen?  The princesses act all sweet and kind in front of me, so I'll need someone I trust to tell me what they're like with the common folk.
What happened to your old queen? She start to get fed up with dealing with your royal hindass?

Ha - got little too fascinated with her mirror.  Starting talking to it all the time, then next thing I know she's in cahoots with some witch lady, ate a poisoned apple and keeled over.  Shame, for she was a nice lass before she got so invested in her looks.

You're one to speak about obsession with your looks! I do recall you paying a pretty penny for that mirror back in your less fortunate days. We should make sure to tell your new queen, to NEVER eat the apples. Nothing good comes from them.
Aye - they'll keep the doctor away, alright.  Because you'll be needin' a mortician!
Now now, that one is a knee slapper king! Say, when you get over thrown, you should make your way into stand up comedy!

Ahahaha - I'll have ta make do with my kingly ways, for I'm afraid my jokes get old, fast, as you well know.  I'll have no guards at me back to make the audience laugh... well, laugh at the appropriate time!
Old and fast, just like you!

Hahaha!  Ahh, your a good soldier, Umler, and a better friend.  So, can I count on you to help in my quest?  Maybe we can get a nice rich lass so that we can decorate this place proper.  Silver is nice, but a bit of color wouldn't go amiss, methinks.

agent_personas: I'm a traveler. Rather than settling down in one town, I feel compelled to go from place to place. I make money by carrying news from town to town, by bringing small objects to sell such as needles and lace, and by telling interesting stories. As soon as I have traveling money, I move on to the next place.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Hello, guards. Would you like to know the latest news from the kingdom in the east?
Greetings Citizen! What news have you?
For a small fee, I will share all of the latest news with you!
A fee?! You would charge the Duke's Patrol?
I have to make a living somehow!
Cheeky, aren't you? Besides, how can we tell if the news you tell is true?
My sources are very trustworthy. This news is very interesting and could potentially save lives.
State your sources and then we shall see.
I have seen miraculous things with my own eyes. My sources are the doctors from the kingdom in the east.
The only "doctors" from the East are Voodoo Practitioners and Witch Doctors. Your story is not convincing.
I can provide proof after, you pay a small fee.
This had better be worth the build up, lest you be branded as a travelling con-artist.

This is as trues as those walls are made of marble. There is a healing elixir that will cure any ailment. I watched a paralized young girl walk after drinking it. I watched a blind man regain his sight.
Traveler, do you realize how outlandish your claims sound? You had best soon provide some evidence...

agent_personas: I am the king's chief wife.  Of all the women that he has married, or who are his concubines, I am the principal one. I represent the kingdom of my father, who is the king's biggest ally. My sons are the ones who will most likely become the king after the death of my husband.
As an adult, I try to make the right choices. I eat right, I run and lift. I believe all adults should take better care of themselves.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: This seems like a nice place for a picnic. What do you think?
It looks inviting, but don't you think we should ask permission?
Well I am the Chief wife after all, I don't think I need to ask anyone for permission!
Yes of course! If you say so! Forgive me for speaking out of line!
Ohh thats quite alright.. Ops! I appear to be a little clumsy today!
Allow me to get that for you Madam Chieftan!
How kind of you! Here, take this key. It is the key to lower dungeons that guard many treasures!
Why, the key to the Underground Labyrinth? This is not an item to be given freely! I do not question your judgement, but only seek clarity. Why have you given this to me?
Well, it seems my husband hasn't been giving me enough attention lately. A few missing jewels ought to bring him back down to earth...
Are you suggesting an Exploring Party to the Underground?
Perhaps so, but tell no one I gave you the key!
I shall need a cover story then. What is the most believable thing I could say when asked about this key?
Well you could say you're simply the cleaning staff. Make sure to dress the part as well!
What sort of adventurers could I round up while masquerading as a janitor?

agent_personas: I am an immortal bodyguard.  The gods have appointed me to protect the king.  No one can defeat me.
I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: Get out!
Whoa there. I'm just here for the inspection.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Hello My King, Do you think I could get a new cushion for my throne? This place is so uncomfortable with the constant noise!
Of course, my Queen. Anything you wish for.
And what did that Lord want earlier? He definitely stinks! I do not want him near me again. I have been reading about a soap that can prevent such fowl odors. Perhaps you can tell him
Oh, he was just bringing up the peasants complaining about taxes again. Don't worry, I'll be sure he's more presentable next time!
They have to pay taxes, it's what keeps us in a home you know! What did you decide to do?
I decided to punish those who started the protests. I can't stand those ungrateful clods who think ruling a kingdom is all sunshine and glamor!
I'll be right beside you in whatever decisions you make. Have you seen my chambermaid? Please tell me you didn't fire her
I have not, my dear. But if she is tardy, perhaps she should indeed be disciplined!
I need a bath drawn and my clothes laid out. I have a busy day ahead. What are you going to do today?
Not much on my schedule today, my love. Just wandering the castle and admiring all the fine pieces of art.
Ah I see you're taking that hideous rug away. Donate it to the peasants, maybe it'll keep them quiet. We need a new one anyway
You've always had the finest taste, dear. It's a good thing you are around to help me make the proper choices in decoration.
I knew it was the right choice marrying you. At last here she comes. What do you think we should do with a late member of staff?
I will not tolerate laziness in the castle. She will get no pay for her work today, I'm afraid!

agent_personas: I am the royal prince of this kingdom. I will become king one day and plan to rule the empire justly. I have also been trained in the military arts and tactics.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: You are such a great king, I hope to one day rule as well as you do
Of course you will my boy, I raised you well!
That you did my great king. I can never thank you enough for all you've taught me.
What are your plans for today my boy?
Ahh that's better, we should let the sunlight in more often. Plans for today you ask? Well I fancy a walk around the garden would be nice, don't you agree?
That sounds nice! Maybe I'll go with you! We must be back by 7 for the royal feast of course.
You are correct, we can not miss the royal feast this year, I hear our dear uncle will make an appearance.
Really? All the way from eldensquare!? I miss him I do. I can't wait!
How have you been since you returned from the war last week?
Great really, all healed up and my armor just got fixed! Have you been training for when you will rule the kingdom and fight by the sides of you kingdom?

Yes my king. I have been training long and hard and observing the best that I can. I think one day I'll possibly surpass even you! Take me out to war with you sometime king, please, I need a taste for real battle.
Maybe we could go for a spar before the walk in the garden! I can see for myself how you have been coming along.
That would be a great idea king, I know how strong you are. This is a beautiful fabric. Where is it from?
I hear that it was fabricated from the towns wizard. They say it has magical luck properties so I always keep it by my side. How about we go for that spar now and you bring that along!
action: put cape in large chest of drawers

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I am one of the other animals that lives in the meadow surrounding the castle. I play with the other animals all day. I'm only frightened when fighting breaks out in the meadow or forest.

setting.name: Entrance to the Pine trees
setting.description: Very tall and towering pine trees that create a dark canopy of shade. Long skinny trees sway in the sky from the soft breeze. Pine needles scatter the ground like plush carpet.
setting.background: The Pine forest is home to many deer and other animals. It is a sanctuary for people escaping the loud city. It is serene and peaceful and many people have found solace here.

speech: Do you think the flower is pretty?
well yes, it is, so much to see here at the Entrance to the Pine Trees.
Here, this is for you!
oh, thank you. but where did you come from, these pine needles on the ground make everything so quiet.
I came from a nearby forest, I just wanted to explore the area since it seemed safe. Where did you come from?
Well, I too am from the forest and the castle beyond. Once I was a prince, but I was turned into a frog by an evil orc. See, I'm still wearing the royal coat of arms.
Oh no! That's so horrible. To be honest, I'm afraid of the royal family...the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs.
Oh well, it's ok, I don't want to hurt you. I didn't enjoy being a prince very much, too much fighting, I don't like fighting, I'd rather play with my friends here in the forest.
I'm glad. You really don't mind being a frog? I guess the forest is beautiful, too. I'm interested in the tree over there...want to check it out?
No, I don't, I love all these delicious flies buzzing around..pfft, they are so juicy! What do you like to eat? There is weed here and lots of pine needles!
I like to eat insects! they're so annoying, but they're so delicious
Hey! that's my lunch. Ok, let's go look at the tree over there, it is kind of tall and skinny, not like the other trees.
sorry! I was hungry! Ok, let's go over here!
Alright, glad you're full. Oh, look how it's moving in the wind ohhh, it's making me dizzy watching it.

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I have no home. I depend on the charity of strangers and the church to live. I was once a successful merchant, but my livelihood was stolen.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: What are you doing here?!
This is my home!  The largest trash heap in the kingdom!  It all that is left of my once mighty trade empire, a display of ruin, a perfect facsimile of my own fallen condition.
What drove you to such poor condition? And what is your name?

Bartholomew Rutherford the 3rd, at your service sir.  My tale is long, but suffice to say it involves a shark, a pirate, and a very unhappy walrus on a deserted island.  But enough about me, can I interested you in any of my remaining wares?
Well, nice to meet you Bartholomew. Have you happened to see anyone lingering out here? Perhaps with weapons?
None that I have spied, other than the vermin that live here with me.
There's a fight going on from people trying to kill the king!
The King?  Oh no!  He shall soon be as headless as this doll!
How dare you say such! You will be as headless as that horse.
Eeeeeee!  The King's hound chases the rat, while the Wolf plays with the Sheep King in his palace!
You shall surely banish for saying such. I have pledged my entire life to serving the king!
Back you fiend!  An assassin is on the loose, and you waste your time attacking a man whose only crime is poverty?
You committed heresy against the king! Speaking horror on his name!
No wonder the King is in danger if his guards terrorize the very citizens they are sworn to protect!
action: give largest trash heap to guard
get rag dool with the head detached

a wooden chair with one leg broken

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
I am a pilgrim within the kingdom. I am an outcast. People do not care for my religious thoughts.

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: Mind the rope there, pilgrim!  What are ye doin' on deck, there's a storm brewin on the horizon!
I, eh, think I may have wondered up here on accident captain. Could you us another hand on deck?
You look a bit green in the gills there ta be helpin', mate, if ye don't mind me sayin' so.
Well, to be truth full. I have never been on such a large ship. Or a ship at all. But, I am willing to help captain! I do not want to be the outcast on ye ship either.
Hrm... well grab that there bucket of tar.  If she starts springing leaks, ye'll need ta patch'er up right quick!
Right away captain!, uh this is heavy than I thought.
Mind yer step there!  Don't want ya fallin' overboard, 'specially as the storm ain't even got here yet.
This must be tough working being a sailor huh? Say do you believe in god there captain?
Hard 'ta not believe, what with the sights I've seen.  They'd curl yer toes and put yer knickers in a twist, some of the sights I've encounter on these seas.
And you think it is god, that created all these eh, sea demons out here?!
Ach, what be ye givn' me that for?  Aye, well, there's got to be a push fer every pull, tis the way I see it.
It's pretty heavy, I thought you could make some more use of it than me!
'fraid I'll be too busy steerin' the ship through these narrow channels, lest you want us all ta go to ground.  We can be meetin' yer God right quick then!
I mean, I haven't anything else to live for! My dream has been to meet our holy god!

agent_personas: I am a pastry chef. I make breads, cakes, and other delicacies for the royal court. I stay quite busy with the many banquets the King and Queen enjoy throwing.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: I am ready to follow your orders, chef
As you know, we are paid to make the finest dishes for the queen and king. I need you to bake the greatest cake this kingdom has ever seen!
I ma working right now.You know I am the best pastry chef in here. I make breads, cakes, and other delicacies for the royal court.
Good. Here, you know what to do with this yes?
I am going to make a delicious crep.How long have you been a head chef
As long as I can remember! I started cooking when I was 5 and I have been head chef for... over 30 years now.
Your kitchen is so organized. Everything in its place and a place for everything.
Thanks, this place is basically my home.
Let me get ready for the next banquet.Everything should be perfect
Everything better be! The king expects only the best and heads will start rolling otherwise. How long have you been cooking pastries for?
This is my fourth year, but in 2 years I will be a head chef like you
Good! You are getting there. Are you about ready to use the iron grill? Take great care of it, I built it myself.
ready to go.Do not worry about anything
Good, good. I will cook the main meal then.

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: Hello there knight! How are you doing this fine evening?
No time for pleasantries. How are the battle plans coming?
Good. We are readying up for the attack on Visria. Will you be leading the attack?
Will I be leading the attack? does the sun rise in the east?
Hmm... I thought the sun rised in the west....... I guess I should have payed more attention in school.
Look, no matter what happens out there, we must keep the King safe. I want you to personally stay with the king for the entire battle.
That was from my father before he died in my arms! May I please have it back? I promise to protect the king.
Well, we both know that you will likely die during the battle. I would honestly be shocked if you lived. I will give this heirloom to your family after you die.
Yeah you're right. I guess I should be thanking you then..... Thank you..........  Its a beautiful sight up here isnt it.
Yes, you are correct. I am doing you a huge favor. That is the type of knight I am. Is there anything you would like to do in the last moments before your virtually inevitable death?
I have always wanted to eat with the king.. Is that something you could arrange?
With the king....how about near the king? Also, this sword is very special. It wil be an honor for you to die while holding it. Again, I am doing you a great favor.
Wow this is beautiful. I will be sure to bring it into battle. Thank you again... kind... knight.
and by chance if you don't die, you may keep the sword. So you have that going for you as well.

agent_personas: I live next door to my best friend.  My friends depend on me to keep the location of their treasure a secret.  I am always ready to defend my friends from the sheriff's men when they come to collect unjust taxes.

I am a humble knight. I was an orphan who came from simple origins, but was hired as a stable boy. I worked my way up to knighthood. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married. I think the faerie lights are beautiful.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: Finally some nice cool breezes to help me relax.
Agreed. It's not often that we have such times of peace. May the neighboring kingdoms forever be our allys!
What brings you so far from the castle, knight? Is there no work for you to do?
My platoon has been given a weeks time away from duties. Since the Treaty of Kingdoms was signed, there has been less need for constant fortification of the walls.
Well we could use you in these parts. there is evil lurking.
Evil lurking? In such a tranquil lake house? Sure you're pulling my leg.
Come inside. We must not let other overhear.
But I was enjoying the sound of the waves! Oh...Very well.
There is great wealth around this lake. But it has been hunted by a man so evil and vile its unbelievable.
I see. Greed and Villainy do tend to go hand in hand. Please, go on.
A man hired by YOUR master and king robs us of every penny, every grain of wheat we harvest. We are left with nothing but blood pudding to bring us through winter.
Now hold your tongue, friend. If what you say is true, then this will be no simple task.
I need to know I can trust you. Take this token to persuade yourself to help.
What is this symbol carved on the back? I've never seen it before.

agent_personas: I work in the forge all day with my tools. I have a few apprentices who I show the ropes to. I also have to mingle with people in the public in order to have them purchase the items that I make.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: Good day sir
Hey! How is that battleaxe I requested a while ago coming along? Any progress?
Here it is. The blade is made from the finest steel
Thank you! Its beautiful! How long did this take you?
Give it a feel! The hardest part was finding the right balance. Took me the better part of a week to get it right.
Wow it is very balanced. Here you can have this as a thank you of sorts. It was given to me by my father before he passed.
That is a fine reward! I can’t take all the credit though. My apprentices helped out on it. What sort of heirloom is this？
This is an engraved necklace. It always made me feel safe so I hope it does for you too!
Your father must have been very wealthy to have such fine jewellery!
He was a poor man really, but he found this in one of his journeys and he always thought it was special.
And so do I. See this insignia here? It belongs to a secret order of knights
Wow really?! How do you know?!
I wasn’t always a blacksmith...
I would love to hear your stories! I hope that heirloom serves you well great blacksmith!

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: Please, milord, it wasn't me, I swear it!
Quiet! You will listen to me. I want to know why you did it.
I'm just a poor fisherman, honest! Why would I want to kill Lady Elma?
Maybe for her riches? You did just admit to being poor.
I didn't have anything to do with it! The guards already searched my cottage. I've only ever laid eyes on her once or twice at market
I control your destiny. You best tell me all you know.
Please, just tell me what you want to know. I'm not sly, I don't have any clever plans i just want to get home
Where were you when she was killed?
If it's not market day I'm out on the river! Dawn to dusk!
Who can vouch for it?
I sail up and past Maggie Frost's house on the point. She might have seen me!
I believe you. But I don't like you.
Does ... does that mean I can go?
I want to be sure. All it means is you get to relax here a little more.

agents: guy with the key when he lets in the king
agent_personas: I make the finest blades in all the Realm. They are as sharp as a harlot's wit. They are perfect and are priced accordingly.
I open the door for the king. I must be ready whenever the king wants to go out. I do not like those who disrespect the king,

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

the guy with the key when he lets in the king

speech: Ah It's nice to see you again. What brings you to the Treasure Room this time?
The King is coming, and I must let him in - he desires to gaze upon the riches of his realm.
I have been crafting this new sword for the king. It is the most valuable and powerful blade in all the kingdom. What do you think of my work?
It is very fine work indeed!  The King will be proud to add it to his collection!  Has the sword been given a name yet?
A name can only be given to a weapon by those who will wield its power. Let me look into the magic crystal to see who it's future master might be
Has the blade been tested yet, steel against steel?  And why ask who the wielder will be if it is to be a gift for the King?

The king has commissioned me to make this sword for an adventurer to go on a dangerous quest. My swords have never failed an adventurer in combat before. Oh my! I can see that this sword will belong to you!
Me?  That cannot be, as I am merely the Keeper of the King's Key, and am never allowed to leave the Palace!  Perhaps it is someone else that you see?
Yes you're right. This thing is a piece of worthless junk. I shall now collect my payment from the Treasure Room
Not until the King arrives!  You would take gold from the Treasury without the King's presence?  How dare you sir, how very dare you!
I have made swords for the king for many years. They are priced accordingly and I know their worth. So if you have the keys to the kingdom why can you not leave the Palace?
If I left the palace, who would open the doors for the King?  My family has performed this very function for nigh on four hundred years!
Yes we must respect the king's decision. So if you could have anything from this room what would it be?
The Holy Rood of Saint Dwyfed - the most sacred relic in all the realm, I would donate it to the church so that many could be healed by its blessing.

put piece of armor in treasure chest

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

I am a clerk, but I have always longed to be a pastor. I try to teach those that come into my shop, but they usually think I am crazy. I love God and will one day be able to speak his words to a worthy audience.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: What it is you want now?
Well, you have consistently missed service your highness.
Can't you see I'm busy with other matters. I'm drinking my wine, I'm enjoying my dogs.
But I'm worried the royal counsel will denounce your kingship.
The royal counsel? and why should I be concerned about the royal counsel. Why my dogs drink finer wine than they. Here my lovelies...enjoy.
Your dogs are beautiful but will they be without a king?
What do you mean, without a King? How dare you! I rule all that it here, have you forgotten I am your king? And here is my crown.
The counsel will remove you. I am trying to help your lordship.
Remove me? They wouldn't dare. Have you heard rumors? Do they want my jewels and paintings for themselves, pray tell me clerk, come closer...
yes they say you have missed the royal ceremony too many times
No, I haven't, how many times have I missed, someone is lying!
You have missed 15 your highness.
Ah, now I know someone is lying, who told you so? I'm am the King and you shall answer truthfully or pay with your life.
The counsel has kept track sire.
