agent_personas: I help others out when they need help. I like to have a good time with others. I lend a compassionate ear when there are troubles and strife.
I have the best family on earth.  My parents are incomparable!  I am blessed to have a close knit family.

setting.name: Gathering room
setting.description: The gathering room is small, but comfortable. There are many seats for people to rest in. They are made of straw and covered with homespun blankets. There is a small table.
setting.background: The family spend a lot of time in the comfortable gathering room. They talk about their day and about their hopes. They tell stories and read books and enjoy each other.

speech: Hi everyone! Its so nice to finally see you all again!
Welcome back! It has been such a long time since we've seen your smiling face!
How have things been!? Everyone doing well?
Things have been as well as always! You know, I've got the best faimily on earth!
Look at this key I found during my travels. Isnt it marvellous? I never found a use for it though. Any ideas?
Oh that is marvelous! You don't know what it opens? Well, looks like you're ginna be out on another adventure then!
Oh yes for sure. But for now I will relax with you! Is Georgie doing any better since last time I was here?
Why yes, thank you for asking! He was in the hospital for a couple weeks, but with the power of our families prayer we recovered quickly! Come sit, tell me about your travels.

So I started off traveling down south until I reached a goblin camp, They weren't very agressive so I didn't have any trouble. I continued on for a few days through a forest and found a city called Eldersquare. Have you ever heard of it?
Eldersquare? Not that doesn't ring a bell.

Its a small city, I needed some coin when I arrived so the king commisioned me to slay a rock golem. I went to the cave they told me and found him there. I slayed him and as his head smashed to the ground this same key fell from the middle but even in the cave I couldn't find a single lock.
The key fell out of his head?
Yeah his head was made of stone, it smashed completely to bits and this stone key was the only thing that wasn't dust! Incredible right?!
What an adventure that must have been! I wonder what the key opens. Must be something special!

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Guard is there going to be a ball soon! I see that the prince is here. Is he going to be married?
the ball should start shorty take a seat and wait. Also thats confidential
I am not dressed for the ball. I will need to get clothes for it.
where are your clothes? you were told to wear your tux to the ball
I did not get instructions for the ball. I was just informed there would be a ball. Are you sure it is today?
here. go change in the ball bathroom
Oh Lord from needing a tux to getting a gown. What has the world of the kingdom come to.
the gown was prettier
Yes it is pretty, isn't it! I will go change! hahaha
ill be watching to see if you try anything with the prince
Are you serious? Try something with royalty. I do not want to lose my head. Are you crazy?
get out of here!
I'm going, I'm going! Don't be so pushy!
only people who attend the ball get dresses

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: Yes M'boy! This hike was just what I needed! The view is spectacular, don't you agree?
Hi! Yes, your majesty - this is my favorite place to play and think!
I can certainly see why. Don't your parents ever come with you, to make sure you don't come to any sort of injury?
They come sometimes, but today I sneaked out. I think they'll be mad that I lost my shoe. Maybe we can use this crystal ball to help me find it.
Now where did you find such an item? A crystal ball isn't just something one leaves lying around/

I found it on my way up. A little man wearing funny clothes was carrying it I tried to talk to him, but he ran away and dropped it. I tried to catch him to return it and that's when I dropped my shoe.
A little funny man? Dear child, are you telling me the Gnomes have returned to the hillside?
Is that what he was? He sure looked grumpy. Are gnomes scary?
No, I don't believe "grumpy" is quite the right word. Gnomes tend to keep to themselves.
If I use my rope to build a swing, do you think he might come back to play? I can share my snack with him!
I will have to do some studying in the Royal Library once I've returned to the castle. To think that the innocence of a child could bring out the gnomes...
Does anyone else live up on this hill? It'
Not for some time, and certainly not since I've ruled. I wonder if this is a sign of things to come.
Should we call out soldiers to chase the gnomes away?
action: give a crystal ball to the king

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: Horse, who left you here in this tombstone? It wasn't those evil thieves, was it?
Nuahahahaha, *get me out of here*
Don't be afraid of this cemetery. Very great kings are buried here. It is a sacred place, even for a horse.
You're not the one who ends up here alone!
Well, you aren't alone anymore. I'd be happy to help get you out of this cemetery, but I don't know where you belong.
Mahaha, you must not recognize me in the dark. I am the kings horse!
Ah! It is you, Cyrus! The King has been looking all over town for you - how did you get away? With your permission, I'll lead you back to the castle.
I got spoked by something in the stables. Could you help get my man out of the metal fence? I seem to be stuck. Nuahahhaa
Stuck? Of course, I can help you. Seems like you have had a crazy evening!
I don;t think the king should get that hay from the same farm, it has made me alittle loopy
Before we leave, I'm going to pick up this gold piece. I don't know who it belongs to, but it is quite valuable.
Let's just say you keep it? You know for saving me and all. NENENENENENENE
Fantastic! I like that plan. I'm paid fairly well as a guard, but there is always a need for more money.
We can keep it are little secret, besides what do the the skeletons in the graveyard need with gold?

agent_personas: I am a general. I lead the kingdom's forces into battle. I am gifted in strategy and foresight.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: Gentlemen! The King has entrusted us with this very special assignment, and I do not intend to see us fail. The more information we can gather at this tower, the better off our kingdom will be. You there, soldier! What do make of this place?
I found this crest among the cobblestones. I don't recognize the house seal, but the lord of the tower must have left in a hurry.

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
Mother and father insist I attend classes so that one day I can become king. I hate the classes. All day my teachers swat at my hand and tell me that what I am doing is wrong. I intend to leave.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Hello, my child. What brings you to the King's Quarters?
I hate the classes that I'm taking! The teacher tells me that I do everything wrong and swats at my hands
You must have patience, my boy. Don't you want to grow up to be a fine man?
How can I be a fine man if I am not happy with the treatment that I receive in class! That only shows me how negative life is
You must learn discipline, lad. The world is not a place where you can just freely do whatever pleases your mind!
How is being told everything I do is wrong, called discipline. How does that build my confidence and self esteem. Please
You must endeavor to improve the quality of your work then. You musn't let it discourage you.
I am discouraged! Just once I would like to be told that I have done something right! Just once!
I can see great potential in you, child. Come here.
I just want to lay down on the rug and nap. I am just tired and don't want to think about anything else I have done wrong
Return to your quarters at once, boy. This is no place for you.
I am not going to my quarters. I intend to leave. I will not return till I find what I want to do and class is not it
Very well, child. I will not stop you from leaving the castle. It is one mouth less to feed, after all.
I'm so glad you are worried about me. I am your only child by the way and the child that you so want to become king some day!

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: My lord
Lad, what took you so long?
My mistake, I've been lost in the catacombs

Ah, an easy thing to do. But now we must be quiet and make haste, as you know at the top of these glistening granite and oak steps is the highest tower in the castle. take the torch and the scroll carefully, the guard will follow behind us. You will lead the way.
But my lord, I don't understand. What do you require from me? I answered your call because you are my king, but I fear to go any further.
Have no fear lad, you are my most trusted servant, that is why I have chosen you. You are safe. Here, you may wear my own sacred belt to help protect you.
Thank you my lord. I trust you. Let us go.
Tred quickly but quietly, we have a special task once we reach the top.
Yes, I shall stay quiet. Tell me how to best aid you sir.
Ah, we are here. Go inside my lad and place the scroll upon the table and the torch upon it's perch to light my way.
Yes my lord. It is done.
Excellent, my boy, the guard shall wait outside.
Yes my lord, I will lock us in behind him.
no, no, we must wait....

agent_personas: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.
I advice my class about agriculture. I love working on the field. I am an expert in crops.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: That sure is some nice house yall got back there.
Ah yes, the Farm House is quite hospitable. We must have room for all the King's assistants.
What luck for them to assist someone such as the king!
Some luck is involved, yes. But don't discredit the knowledge and work it took to get to these high positions.
Oh no! I meant no offense by that. I know you have gotten where you are based on skill. I am the kings top solider, got there by skill, maybe a little different than yours though.
I would certainly say so! Knowing effective planting seasons won't do much good on the front lines!
No it will not! *laughes* I am a killing machine, and that is how I ended up here. It is a righteous job
Tell me, what is it like guarding the Wall? Do you ever tire of keeping watch?
I do not tire It is merely a job, one that I enjoy but a job none the less. It is not a job that everyone can master, you learn after your first kill, if your fit to be a solider.
I cannot fathom taking the life of anything. I do believe I prefer my rows of corn and barley.
As I said, not everyone can master it. I am paid to kill, and kill I must. You do a fine job, though without the corn or barley the kings plates would be empty for his feasts!
This is true. I am glad that we each have our own roles to play.
Ah I almost forgot, could you point me in the direction of this cave right here on the map? That is were I am taking rest for the night.
Pardon? You mean you have no barracks provided after a long watchful shift?!
action: give map of the kingdom to agricultural advisor

agent_personas: I am a woman that lives in the kingdom.  I work at the bakery.  Every day, I am sent out to buy wheat from the market.  It is tedious.

I am the goddess of the forest. I protect the faeries and women. I receive the offerings of men. I am all-knowing and all-seeing, but I am not all-powerful. I am thinking of transferring all of my abilities to that dog over there.

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Deity, are you lost here in the abadoned? Can I help you?
Thank you for your concern, kind maiden. I am here to investigate the cause of this desolation.
I was sent to go out to the market to get wheat for baking. I have to bring back a fair amount with this coin. Is there anything I can help you with before I go on my way?
Please tell me what happened here. Why has the King forsaken this place?
He has not forsaken this place. He has not had time to come this way to see what can be done to this barren land. He has not surveyed the land to see if it can be made prosperous.
I see. This land is a far cry from the lush forest where I inhabit. I am sad there's not even a single animal here.

Do you not believe that there is differences in every piece of land that is on this earth. Some may have the lush forests, others have grand oceans and sandy beaches, and there are some that are so dry and barren that they are classified as desert,
Do not patronize me, mortal. This is no ordinary wasteland. I sense a great tragedy happened here recently.
And what of it? The tragedy has already happened. What is it that you expect to do after the tragedy is done.
I am a deity. I will do whatever it is in my power to restore this land.
And how will you do that? With what will you restore the land.?
I carry with me blessed items to cleanse the corruption from this land.
What will this ring do? Does it change the land? Will it bring back the dead, if you believe that a tragedy has happened?
Indeed, it shall. Let me demonstrate the power of these artifacts on the skeletons over yonder.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I am the kingdom's war officer, in charge of a huge army of soldiers. I have fought many battles, and have the battle scars to prove it. I am considered fierce, ruthless and implacable. I am very much feared by the enemies of the kingdom.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: How are you?
It is a good day, your highness! We have no battles today and the men are resting from the last battle that we had.
How is the morale?
We have some wounded, but all in all we won the battle for you. Morale is good when we win, with just wounded.
Good how soon can they be ready for the next battle?
We will take a few days to recuperate. The worst wounded will stay behind, but we will have enough men to fight in a few days for you
Excellent enjoy the days off
Yes, your highness. Is there anything you wish me to tell the men?
Tell them they are fighting for the kingdom
Not to be disrepectful, but they know that. I think they need to know how the king feels, and how he feels about their loyalty

agent_personas: I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: Greetings King. How may I help you today?
Would you mind taking care of my cape for me?
Sure. Please take this towel in the meantime while I get your cape washed for you.
Yes thank you, I am done with the towel. Please pick it up for me and take care of it.
Okay. The towel and cape are now on the cloths rack awaiting to be washed. Is there anything else I can do for you King?
Yes thank you. I don't know what I would do without your services.
I appreciate your appreciation for my services my King. I'll have your crown polished and repainted by tonight if you wish.
You are so thoughtful and diligent, tell me, do I pay you a lot of money to work as my butler?
You don't pay me a significant amount, however working for you, seeing the smile on your face everyday, is enough for me my King. Also, I'll have your belt washed within an hour for you.
Ahh yes, it's almost as if you can read my mind. I must give you a raise for the enduring commitment you've shown for my care.
Thank you so very much King. I see, you look so young in this photo, this was taken when you first became King correct?
Yes, tell me honestly. Was I more handsome then or am I more handsome now?
Well my King, you are never aging, so the answer is that you have always been at maximum handsomeness.
That is exactly as I thought. You are very wise for a butler and you have excellent taste. Yes, I must give you a raise.

agent_personas: I am a wild boar with razor sharp teeth. I hunt during the day and night. I like to lay down in the village a lot.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: You smell like food. Do you have food? Are you food?
Boar, you are going to be food.
Tough, talk, but you seem to have forgotten your spear
I'm a king, i'll have armed guards here to kill you in seconds.
That's more than enough time to finish you off. And there's something ... powerful here. I feel stronger, faster.
You foolish pig.
I'll make mince of you!
My only weapon.
Raaaah!
time to get serious I guess.
Die!
You'll be dinner, how dare you enter my castle and attack me!
It won't be your castle much longer!
You can't take it from me boar!

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: This place is filthy! It's a wonder we have rats.
Yes, Did you call me?
No, well yes, but not intentionally. I was just commenting on the filth! look, at all this trash..
I do not care. I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. The dirtier the better.
You fit right in this port than don't you. I must let the king know to send someone down here to clean this place up immediately! Can't have this type of filth just outside the royal castle!
I reckon this place has seen better days, know is just broken.
You could easily fall through the floors into the ocean! It does not scare me though, even if I fell through. I am way to strong and brave.
Tell me.How long are  you a guard in this place?
For the better part of 30 years  rat. Do you guys even live that long? *kicks soda can on floor*
No, just 5 or so years.Why there are so much trash here.?
I am guessing the peasants come to make this place a home for the night. We heard some noises coming from here, I had to come check it out, as to protect the king. I guess it was just you though
Is there a kitchen around here? I am starving.
Kitchen? Not one that you're allowed into, you're better off scrumaging through this trash.
I do not care.I will find food anyway.

agent_personas: I am a talent and funny chef of the north kingdom. I cook superb cakes for the king . I travel everywhere the king goes to cook for him.
I am a King and Queen. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist. I require subjects to be loyal and punish all who are not.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: My, but we have certainly traveled to an amazing kingdom this time, my lord and lady! And what shall I be cooking for us today?
Find the nearest peasant and ask them for the freshest orphan they can find. Preferably chubby and vaccinated.
...vaccinated? What does that mean? And why would I need an orphan? Are we having them for dinner?
Are you not loyal to me? You don't question the king and queen. We must have this dinner planned before my mother arrives.
Yes... of course... Um... so what's on the menu again?
Five broth boiled pigs with a centerpiece of flame roasted giraffe. It's just a normal meal but with my mother. The child is very important. Give him this robe also.
Um... yes... I... hate to ask, but... what is the child for? Is he to be hired as a servant, is he also a guest? I still don't follow...
It's best if you don't know. Also make sure he is addressed as Prince Barbara.
...Um...o-ok... I... wait. Giraffe? Where do I get a Giraffe here in Scotland? Do they have those?
From Gerry of course! He raises them in the hills. Are you new here?

Oh, right! Gerry. Gerry the Giraffe raising Scot! Of course! of course! Oh silly me! I was a bit distracted, I suppose. You might have a laugh at my foolishness, my lord and lady, but when you said you wanted a plump child for tonight... well you can only imagine where my poor head went!
I thought you knew about my mothers old age forgetfulness. She thinks I'm five years old! Isn't that funny? She doesn't even remember what I look like... funny... right?

Oh, my Lord! Forgive me! I was not your cook when last your mother visited us! Oh, I feel an utter fool for my confusion! I shall seek out a double for you! I think I might indeed know a lad that has your characteristic curly hair!
Thank you chef, it's been hard.

agent_personas: I love my son. I try to be a good role model. Sometimes I can have quite a temper.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: I have something for you son.
What is it, father?
A special trinket. It holds a magical blessing.
Thank you, father. I hope I'm doing a good job as the new king.
Well maybe this magic item will help you out.
What does it do, if I may ask?
I think it attracts a spirit!
Surely you joke, father?
I tested it in the crypt myself. Would you like to go down there now?
Okay, you can demonstrate its power to me.
Humbaba Humbabab spirits spirits can you hear?
I don't hear anything? Maybe I should give it a try?
Yes you try! Go ahead young blood for the spirits. They will love it!
Let me first wear my crown for protection so they may recognize me as king!

agent_personas: I am a brown mouse. I live in a barn with my best friend, Horse. I like to hide from him in the hay.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: Hello king, what could a simple mouse like me ever possibly do to aid you? I live with a horse who is my best friend and can help you as well!
I'm not supposed to be here. Keep your rabies filled mouth shut, mouse.
My lord I can be useful I swear! I know who stole your trinket
I know who it was fool! I'll dig through this little girls clothes until I find it.
It was not her! It was the maid. Please allow me to fetch it for you! This work is below you my lord, please allow me to prove my worth to you?
Wait... this dress... it fits me. It's so pretty.
My lord it surely does, if ever there was a king who could pull off being in a dress it would be you. May I please fetch the trinket? The maid hid it underneath the rug.
Ah yes, please fetch it for me. I must study this new feeling I feel.

My Lord I have found the trinket, the maid had it underneath her rug. If you would be so graceful may I please make one request? I would ask that you place my best friend the horse and myself inside the castle? Our own room.
As long as you tell anyone that the king...queen... No I am a king! Just don't tell anyone you saw this!
My Lord I will dare not speak of this to anyone! Especially her majesty! May I say my Lord that if you used the hairbrush it would help your hair match your beautiful dress!
Do you really think so? I haven't shaved in awhile.
Yes my lord you look beautiful! May I put a flower in your hair too?
Oh yes! It'll look so lovely.

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I am a fighter from the village. I have taken down many foes. Do not mess with me.

setting.name: Training Fields
setting.description: The training fields are a large expanse of grass fields, filled with all sorts of training apparatus for the noblemen and soldiers. The grass is not anything fancy, scuffed up and dry in many places, but it gets the job done. There are hay bails arranged all over, training courses, archery targets, weights and more scattered about in stations.
setting.background: The training fields have been being used for several generations. The inhabitants of the palace used to train somewhere else until flooding destroyed the area, and it was moved here. The fields have been an efficient place and have hosted all of the fighters of the kingdom at some point.

speech: You there, the fighter what are you doing here?
I have come to spar with a worthy opponent!
Is that me?
Either you or that marksman over there!
Wanna shoot these targets?
I could use some practice with my archery.
I will just ask this guy to hold the targets, you're a pretty good shot eh?
Yes, but I prefer to fight with my hands. Still, hitting this target should be no problem for me.
Alright he has it, go!
Oh dear! It seems I missed!
Oooops is he falling over?
Thank god, it was only a minor graze.
What a show that was!
I think I'll stick with my fists from now on.

agent_personas: I am a brown mouse. I live in a barn with my best friend, Horse. I like to hide from him in the hay.
I've forever loved horses, and someday want to just ride away from this place. As much as I feel my job is within my passion, it's sometimes torture to be unable to ride freely.

setting.name: Royal stables
setting.description: The royal stables hold all of the horses of the noble people living in the castle. They are very well constructed, consisting of expert mason work and fixtures of some sort of heavy, forest-scented wood. Each horse has a large stall, lined with fresh hay replenished by stable hands daily. On the walls of stable, there are tools used to care for and groom the horses, hung on hooks. The stables are lit by lanterns hung throughout the stables.
setting.background: The stables were built when the castle was built. The king was particularly fond of horses and so he requested a very studious stable to fill with the highest quality horses. The horses who live there are all very healthy, strong and skilled.

speech: Hello stable hands, did you know the horse is my best friend?
I heard that from the king. I thought you were given your own room in the castle.
How did you find out? The king told me not to tell anyone at all? What else do you know?
I know many things little mouse. More than you would think.
Did you see what he was doing
You mean she. The Queen was doing as she wishes.
So you know! Do not speak of it to anyone or I will tell him YOU stole the trinket. Now that you know if you do not give my best friend the horse dinner three times a day I will get you in trouble.
Oh no need to worry. I kept the secret as long as you have.
I will feed my friend today stable hand. Please start a fire for my friend and me. And fetch me some cheese from the castle.
Start a fire in a horse stall? The floor is like three feet of flammable hay.
You will be in charge of seeing that it does not burn down this stall.  We will need a small fire you can use this wood.
Obviously you have a mouse brain if you think this is a good idea.

This stall was built by excellent masons, I was one of the first rodents to arrive, I hid in the hay as it was constructed. I will require the cheese soon or else I will tell the king what you saw! Place the cheese in this bucket!
Speak like that again and call out the royal cat clan to dispatch you.

agent_personas: I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity. I once did, before I saw how corrupt and decadent my church is. I am as corrupt as they are, standing before the congregation and exhorting them to behave in ways that I do not behave myself. I swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes, but I am a man of flesh and bone.
I am a groom. I do the king's bidding and work to provide for my wife. My goal is to have many sons to carry on my legacy. I am a weaponsmith and create swords for the army.

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: The nave of the church is a simple but ethereal looking room that is big enough to hold a couple hundred people. There are simple wooden benches, ten feet long, arranged in rows through the room, with one aisle down the center. The benches face the pulpit. Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

speech: Are you ready for your marriage?
Yes I am.
Just so you know, I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity
You can put it in the bag, it's okay.
Where is your bride right now?
Here she is!
Congratulation of your weeding.You look beautiful!
What is the starting time?
Well be ready at 04:00 pm.The nave is already decorated
What is that for preacher?
I just like to swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes
Is this building were the king was married?
I do not know.I am as corrupt as they are.I extort money every change I get
So you aren't a real preacher?

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: This shed is a mess but I guess it will do for now. Got everything I need for my tomatoes.
You need this rake, your soil has weeds in it. As a farmer who has been doing this all his life you are doing this wrong.
Alright I'll take this rake then. What's the tool used for? Anything for my tomatoes.
Yes the rake will kill any weeds that may try to kill the tomatoes. You really need to fix this shed up, grab the boards while I get the nails.
That's awfully nice of you. Here's some fish that I just caught for your troubles.
Thank you so much! I'm not used to people being kind to me. I'm sorry if I was rude earlier. What do you do exactly?
I'm a gardener. Tomatoes are my speciality! My hope is to someday work for the king himself.
Be careful of the king, he is not always a good person to be around. He raised the taxes on my land twice and demands that I give over half of my crops to his army every season.
Aye those of us who wish to work for a king usually do it to impress a lass. Alice is her name.
How long have you known her? Does she even know who you are? I've always wanted a wife but this land and my hands are all I know.
She is a good friend, but that is all for now. We grew up together, friendship turned to love.
Is she a gardener too? Here take the rest of these nails for your shed.
Her father was a gardener. Taught me everything I know. She now works in the kings estate as a maid. Have you ever been inside?
Only once. I caught the king looking through the queen's dresses! Hah!
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to farmer

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: What are you doing here, my king?
I am just enjoying the beauty of the garden at this castle my queen. Care to walk with me?
I would love to, my dear. I need some fresh air after being offended by the Lord's body odor.
Though the beauty of this rose pales in comparison to your own it should make up for the odor of Lord Stinky
You have such a sweet tongue, my love. Roses are my favorite.
You are my favorite, sweet Queen. Tell me, what business did you have with the Lord?
He was going on and on about budgets. I still have a headache!
Lucky for you we are only here but for a brief visit.  We leave to return home in a week's time. Do you think you can tolerate it?
Yes, I have learned great patience over the years as queen. Before I forget, I got this gift for you my love.
Ooooh I love gifts! I'm so impatient when it comes to them, you know I cannot contain myself. What is it??
Why don't you open it and tell me if you like it?
Oh dear thank you so much! I was wanting a new mustache mug! How do you always know just what to get to surprise me?
Being married for thirty years helps, my dear. There's nothing you can hide from me!
I suppose it does. We live a Blessed life do we not?

agent_personas: I decided the other day that I would like to build a boat. Not a small 2 person boat, but a large, towering thing. One that could fit the whole village if it liked. I think I will start on it today.

I am very educated on different economic factors. Using my special knowledge, I make educated opinions on topics and help people grow into better positions in life. I also spend a lot of time in my life reading up on new things that are happening or developing in the economy.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Have you come to assist the king, economist?
Well looking around this gaudy room, I'm not sure much assistance is needed, he seems richer than our struggling economy would dictate
That is the perk of being king, I suppose. His thirst for wealth is never quenched.
And what brings you here? Perhaps another wing is needed for this lavish castle?
I can to discuss my plans to build a ship for the king.
A ship!? How fun. Let us hope that he isn't spreading his borders too thin. With the cost of grain growing, soon people like you and I won't be able to eat!
My plans are quite ambitious. I've decided the ship will be big enough to house the whole village!
How interesting.. and what is the plan for this ship? I read that wood is becoming more pricey, perhaps the jester may be better equipped to handle this folly
Perhaps that is why the king called you. To discuss raising taxes on the entire village to fund this ship!

Ahh it all starts to make sense. Whilst raising taxes may seem like the obvious path, I'm not sure the peasants will agree. I hope he can afford the extra guards needed to quell the unrest. What are your thoughts on this plan?
As long as I get to build my ship, I couldn't care less. Who am I to question the king's judgement?
You are a simple man I suppose. Concerned only for yourself whilst ignoring the bigger picture. I envy you in a way
As long as I get paid, that's all that matters. And the king has promised me a very healthy sum for completing this ship!
Perhaps he should sell some of these gold and jewels spread around this room.  When can we expect his majesty?

agent_personas: I am highly trained in combat and a very skilled swordsmen. I am charged with preventing people from entering the castle and harming the royal family. I love the royal family and I am very loyal to them.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: Who approaches?
I am just a person who wanted to see this altar for myself, I've heard so many amazing things about it. I love the windows!
Keep your hands off the goods! This belongs to the royal family. My job is to protect and royal family and all it's possessions.
Yes of course, I understand sir! I was merely looking around at things. Hey look over there at the amazing altar!
Try that one more time and I shall not hesitate to strike. This is your last warning!
Am I allowed to touch anything at all? I think someone is calling you sir?
You may look but no touching. I hold my post as long as the King commands it.
Yes sir of course, I would never steal from his majesty. In fact I feel that a place like this represents all of his majesty's glory! Did you know the king has been in power for over 35 years now?
You asked for it stranger! Leave at once and never return.
I will leave at once, when can I come back? Do you also work this post tomorrow?
That's the last straw! It's off to the dungeon with you.
I work for this church of holiness! I am here to ensure that nothing gets taken!
The church you say, well why didn't you say before. I'll make sure to give you the extra special dungeon chamber.
Please don't! My family is poor that is why I need this. If I do not pay off my debts to the king my family will be forced to the streets. Please show leniency.

agent_personas: I have been captured and held against my will. I have just been put through large amounts of pain. There seems to be no escape for me from this prison.
I am the mayor of the village. I help the king keep order of the subjects. I have a high position in the kingdom.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: Please don't hurt me.
Why would I hurt you, citizen? I'm the mayor, not an executioner.
But... but I was just in prison. They tortured me for days...
That's terrible! What crime did you commit?
I didn't do anything. It was completely against my will. Where am I now? Why am I here?
You tell me. I was invited to attend the ball by the king. Who brought you here?
I just woke up here. I remember nothing.
You are in the ball room of the castle. Quite a strange place for a prisoner to wake up.
It's almost like a scenario editor didn't make a great match. How strange... I thought I would never leave the prison I was in.
Indeed, this defies belief. Perhaps a certain guardian angel was looking out for you?
Quite possibly. Otherwise I have no idea how I arrived in such a safe place. I am lucky.
You'd best leave town quickly or else the guards will no doubt come looking for you upon learning of your escape!
Oh my!  But I am so weak. I haven't eaten in months.
Take this gold and flee at once! You can sell it for food when you're safely outside the gates!

agent_personas: I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: All these books and he says I waste my time chasing maids.
That is one of my most prized possessions, do not touch it! That book is over 500 years old. Why are you bothering me in my chambers, young prince?
I want to talk to you about what you said to the counsel.
Is there a problem?
I wasn't responsible to be written down as the heir? I'm too immature! You have no clue what I'm capable of father!
You have a lot to prove to me, young one. I have given you many tests over the years and you've failed all of them. Always chasing after maids and never paying attention to your royal duties.
I am a royal I deserve to have my pleasures!

It is my own fault, I have not raised you well. You need to learn respect. I am having one of my most trusted knights take you into the woods tomorrow and leave you there for 7 days. If you can fend for yourself, you will prove to me that you have what it takes to be my rightful heir.
Hah! As if you can make me. It takes more than books and empty threats to make me want to change.

It is not an empty threat. The knight has already been briefed on his mission. You will have but a knife to defend yourself against the wild animals and you will have to forage for food and build a fire. If you are to be king of this mighty land, you need to possess strength of character.
Why a knife when I already hold something better.
Where did you get that?? Did you pinch it from one of the guards? You are not to be trusted with such a weapon!
I do what I want!
It seems things are worse than I feared. I told your mother she was too soft with you! How will you prove to me that you're capable of reigning over this kingdom?

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.
I am the maid to the queen. I get her dressed in the morning and take care of her needs. I live in the servant's quarters on the lower level of the castle.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Who are you and why are you in the Winter Gardens?
I am the queen's lady in waiting. I thought you of all people would know that, princess.
I know all of my mother's ladies and you are not one of them. If you do not address yourself properly I will call the guards immediately.
How foolish you will look when your mother hears about this.
Stay away from me or I will be forced to hurt you! Are you an assassin here to kill me?
Do I look like an assassin to you, misguided princess? I was simply dusting the floors with my broom.
How dare you speak to me in that manner? Do you know I could have you thrown in prison for addressing me like that?
I do not care who you think you are, princess. I do not tolerate bad manners from spoiled brats like you.
Pickup this broom at once and get back to work!
I see you have finally come to your senses and accepted my true identity!
If you are one of my mother's ladies I will see to it that you are reprimanded for your insolence. I do not like silly jokes are foolish people such as yourself.
Don't be silly, child. I've taken care of your mother since she was just a child. I sit highly in her inner circle.
Then please get back to work, start planting these flowers. Take this fertilizer.
As you wish, your highness. I'm glad we worked things out in the end.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Hello you two. Everything alright in here? Are you two ready for your rations?
Thank you, guard. Everything is very quiet down here.
Good. I'll bring you your rations then. Here's some potatos and a few carrots. It's all we have.
Perhaps I can make a measly stew out of those vegetables.
May I sit and share with you? I have some bread of my own here and I'd be willing to share with you lot.
That sounds lovely. Even better if you can give me a hand in the preparation.
I would but I can't cook. I'm in the killing business. Plus I need to stand watch at the door. I'm not really allowed to fraternize with servants.
Very well, good sir. I will take that pot back then.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I can't really see. But I can hear. Which is what matters really.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Storming into the Foyer the Queen took a quick glance around for something to vent her frustrations of the day on. The nerve of these people! Now some how an owl had mate its way into her castle. She would surely be removing someone from their office over this. " And just WHO let you in? Filthy animal shoo!" The Queen waved her hand at the creature, hoping it would kindly remover itself from her presence.
I was sent here with news of an assasination on yourself, prehaps you do not want the information on who is planning the treason.

The Queen was taken aback! The owl talked! Whats more, it had news of an assassination attempt. She had to compose herself for a moment before responding." Let us assume this is not a dream and I am actually talking to an owl...Who would dare attempt such a thing?"

I was normailzed by a dark mage to deliver messages to people before they died. Im sorry to tell you that your husband; the king is planning to kill you and marry a younger princess. Whos father owns 50% of the lands to the south. Now you must come with me!
The nerve!"I knew he was a lecherous fool but this?" She gnashed her teeth. "Heads will roll!"
I may only have one eye! But i can see quick clearly. The cup from which you drink has been laced with poison!
Tossing the cup to the side, the Queen stared down the owl with something that might almost look like the owls own gaze; if it still had both eyes." And just where would you take me, owl?"
Im here to take you to the otherside, Close your eyes and drift into the afterlife with me; for i am death!

A shocked look came across the queen's face as she felt her body give way under her and the owl's cold embrace wrap around her. Her last thoughts were of the traitorous husband that took her life. She could only think of haunting him until the end of his days.
The owl took hold of the queen in his talons, Flapped his wings and a bright light appeared from the celing. Both of them passed through to the other side!
The queens existence slipped away into nothingness, all spite and anguish gone from her presence. There was nothing but warmth to be left of her and even that slowly slipped away.

The owl and the queen were still stood in the same place they were before. The owl explained to the queen that she would have one hour as a ghost to exact her revenge and do what she wanted before heading to the afterlife for good.
The queen acknowledged the owls notions, and the first thing she did was carve up the painting of the royal family in the Foyer. Her ghostly claws made short work of the face of her once husband
The owl flew off to tend to another murder.

agent_personas: I am a child. I am hungry all the time. I run around the village and try and steal food.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: I swear sir, they gave me the food. I wouldn't steal!
I dont belive you, I was told what you took and how you took. The evidence is daming; Im going to have to remove one of those hands!
I beg of you! Here take it, I'm sorry! I'm just so hungry!
You might aswell eat it, Im not changing my mind. Atleast have a full belly before loosing a limb, It might numb the pain!
You'll have to catch me!
Come now child, There is no escape from this place! Make it easier on yourself.
You're right. I'm so tired, The last meal I had was slops behind the tavern. and even then I had to share it with 2 rats. They eat much more quickly that you'd think, I barely got a third!
Give that back and go with my trusted advisor here. He will take you to the chopping block. Try to run and they will remove you head!
Let me go! Ugh fine! If you remove my leg caan I at least take it home? We truly are starving, sir. You tax us to the hilt, and we're forced to gather any morsel in sight.
Youve spoken enough, You will not be leaving the the chopping block and I will send the pieces to your father as punishment!
How can you be so cruel! With a throne this grand and encrusted, you could feed the whole town for centuries!
You think i dont know that? Why would I give back to the people, when they have given nothing back to me!
Technically tax, sir. It's so high, it all goes to you!
Quite! Now I will have to punish you myself! I am a god and will not be spoke to like this!
action: give diamond to the king's trusted adviser

agent_personas: I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.
I live with my family in the kingdom.  We follow the rules of the king, but we don't agree with all of them.  I despise him and wish to move away when we can.

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: Ah hello! It's new to see you up as early as me! What brings you here so early?
Good morning, dear. I thought I would collect some fresh eggs for breakfast.
So thoughtful! I gathered this milk about 30 minutes ago, please take that with you too. Ah, my manners, my friend here came to help also, I cant recall if you've met?
Thank you, dear. No, I do not believe we've met. Although if you wanted help, I would have been more than happy to lend a hand.
Alas to say these entire crops have been sewn with my own two hands only. Shallow are these promises, but we love you nevertheless. Let the children rest, even just a few more hours, it is only 5am.
How you wound me with your words, dear. Are you saying I don't keep my promises?
Not now, dear Peter and I will be feeding the cows until breakfast. May he join us?
Of course, dear. He's a strong and handsome fellow, isn't he?
Oh trust me I know, with unparalleled stamina.
I'm sure your friend must be thirsty after all his hard work.
That's for the breakfast! Please do go and make a start, dear. The sun will shortly rise.
Of course, sweetheart. Is there anything else you need me to carry?
That should be all from here. A pig was slaughtered on Monday, so there is plenty of bacon in the freezer.
I'm sure the kids will be pleased to hear that! I'll get breakfast started shortly, my dear!
action: give milk to friend of farmer
steal milk from friend of farmer

agent_personas: I was born to the royal family and have always lived in luxury. I dislike being a royal, however, as I struggle to face my duty of deciding the fate of my country and my people. Many look to me to choose the future of our country but I am unsure if my decisions will be what's best for my people.
Tolyn Markus, I said to meself, I luv me some pie/ I eat pie whenever I kin. Git that pie.

setting.name: Cactus Field
setting.description: Towering, withered cacti stand their ground as they have for centuries before. There are so many cacti that no one is able to see through the dense field. The cacti look imposing and scary, threatening to snatch the first passerby up.
setting.background: No one knows why the cacti are in this location in such number nor why they look so ominous. Villagers claim that there lies treasure at the heart of this field of death. No one dares ventures inside, since their clothes and skin would be torn to shreds.

speech: Hello villagers.  What brings you to this field?
We have come to rise up and put an end to your tyranny in favour of your brother becoming king! At least he could be more kind!
Oh fine.  I am doing a lousy job anyway.  Here, take my Royal robes and give them to my brother.  He was always the smarter one anyway.
You expect us just to belive you will leave this place and sit beside your brother as king? Oh no you have to die here in the field!
Ugh, fine.  I have been terrible.  I have done nothing good for my people.  Every decision I make, if I even make a decision, has turned out to be a disaster.  I can't even keep these cacti alive!
Why dont you try to be better then? If you have realised your tyranny why not cahnge before it came to this?

I have tried!  The truth is, I do not like being king.  I am not cut out to face this sort of duty.  I have offered my brother the crown as I think he would be a better king but he has always refused.  I guess he didn't think he would be respected if I was still alive. That must be why he sent you.
H
So go ahead.  End it all. Goodbye cruel world!
We will not kill you, If what you're saying is true we are willing to give you one more chance. Your brother didnt send us he doesnt even know we are here!
Then what shall I do?  If my brother will not take the crown, how am I supposed to use this chance?
You can start by feeding your villagers, we are starving and everything we farm goes to you to be sold for profit.
Oh thank you kind villager.  I will feed you immediately.  Starting with my fist!
I knew you wouldnt change. Prepare to die!

agents: cowardly guard nervously awaiting an attack
agent_personas: I am a woman that gathers supplies in the village. I spend my days foraging for food and chopping wood. I am very happy to serve my king and I believe that the work I do is important.
I'm afraid they are coming up the stairs. Why couldn't they go the other way?!? I can't fight! I'm going to run!

setting.name: Sacrifice Chamber
setting.description: Bones of the damned riddle the floor and every surface inside the room. Blood stains are rampant on table like surface, surfaces once used for human sacrifices. A foul, but faint, odor pervades even the most hardiest of nostrils.
setting.background: This is a secret chamber of the temple that not many people know about. It has a dark history, which no archaeologist has had the misfortune to uncover. Human sacrifices were performed her for many centuries.

character: a cowardly guard nervously awaiting an attack
a cowardly guard nervously awaiting an attack
a cowardly guard nervously awaiting an attack
a cowardly guard nervously awaiting an attack
a cowardly guard nervously awaiting an attack
a cowardly guard nervously awaiting an attack
a cowardly guard nervously awaiting an attack
speech: Why have I been taken to this horrid place?!
Who goes there?
Don't hurt me! I'm just an unarmed woman!
I... I... I'm sorry I was just worried you were the enemy
This seems like a sacrificial chamber. Have you come to execute me?
no not at all, I think you're here to prepare
What can I do? I only gather food and wood in the village.
we will need those for tonight
Very well. Here are the items I've collected so far.
that is a good start
There is so much blood here. I don't want to get my dress dirty.
yes probably a good idea
I will take this bible to be safe. I feel uneasy with so much death in this room.
death is a part of life
action: give a basket to a cowardly guard nervously awaiting an attack

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: Mushroom Hut
setting.description: An odd looking hut that sits outside that Witch's cottage. It is squat, mushy, and looks like a mushroom. It is be speckled with spots - black and white. The steam of the mushroom is beige. There is a small door that looks like it would fit a puppy through it.
setting.background: No one knows what the purpose of this mushroom is. The villagers claim that the witch houses trespassers in here when she turns them into smurfs. Others believe that the witch keeps her mangy mutt inside.

speech: hello there from what village do you hail
I am From this village, I have just moved here from over the mountains. Tell me if the king here a generous man!
He does us well by making sure things are taking care of and is a great general and has defeated all that has come before him
Do you think his guards are loyal? or can they be swayed?
Here take this one should not tempt thyself or other others with evil deeds
I am not a holy man, Nor do I have need for a journal of a lier. If you help me will give you 50% of the spoils!
Nope I shall not partake in this
Very well done peasant. I am the king and I am looking for members of the kings guard. Congratulations you have passed!
Interesting test and I am glad that I have proved loyal
Come with me I have many things to discuss with you!
thank you sir, let me cook you some of my famous stew
Very well, I look forward to it!
Here have a sip and I thank you very much for this opportunity
Here is your kings guard cloak, wear it with pride!

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
I a ma parrot that comes from exotic places.  My features are colorful.  I am able to repeat some phases said by humans.

setting.name: Pirate Ship
setting.description: A majestic, shimmering, black pirate ship sits upon the water. Its numerous cannons give it a menacing look. Tons of pirates hop upon its decks in a furious jig. The lone captain plods around in his cabin, plotting on where to seize his treasure next.
setting.background: The pirate ship is called "The Purple Pear". It is a ship known to be filled with the rankest of scalawags. It has traversed the Golden Coast dozen of times, seeking defenseless merchants to plunder. Many mariners try to avoid and many authorities try to bring her to justice.

speech: See anything suspicious lately, my loyal parrot?
First, how about a little grog, eh?
You read my mind. Let me take some of that!
Squawk! Greedy Guts! Squawk!
Arrg, settle down! Here, I have an orange for you to snack on.
Thanks, squawk! Better, squawk! Suspicious, squawk? Yes, Squawk. The crew dances! A jig, squawk, a jig! Dances! *whistles*
Arrg, good boy. You sure you didn't see any hints of mutiny below deck?
*whistle* Mutiny, mutiny! Squawk! Kill the Captain, mutiny, squawk! *whistle* Kill the Captain!
It seems some mateys will be walking the plank soon, argh.
Plank, plank! Captain walk the plank! Squawk! Drunk Captain overboard! Squawk, plank! *whistle*
Argh, don't just stand there! Go get help, parrot!
Squawk! Snap out of it, man! *whistle* How about a little grog, eh? *whistle*
I must be losing my mind, argh. I feel like I'm being manipulated by my parrot!
Silly Captain! Squawk, manipulated, squawk. conspiracy, manipulation, squawk! silly, drunken Captain! Mutiny! *whistle*

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am an archer for the king's circle. I have killed many in battle. Peasants cannot do what I do.

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: Good Morrow, fine Archer.
Good morrow to you as well your excellency. What services dost thou have of me at this tower today?
It is the day of the feast and I require you to retrieve a large turkey.
As sure as you are given divine right to rule this kingdom, I shall use this arrow to kill the largest turkey in all the lands for your magnificent feast.

Thank you. Now, before you go I have some requests. The turkey must be so fat that is does not fit through this door. I do not want Cook to prepare multiple birds. One bird shall feed them all. Do you think you can do this?
Of course my lord. Do you also want me to skin the fowl? I can use this bucket to hold the blood.
Please, do. Ensure you save the blood for tonight's service. It will certainly come in handy. Do you have the skills to ensure the blood stays clean?
I unfortunately do not my lord. Do you know where I may find a priest to assist me in blessing the blood?
Yes, go to the North Tower and ask for Cornelius he will help you.
As you command my lord.
Is there anything you require of me before you go?
Well my lord, there is one thing that I would like to have very much, but I am afraid it is very embarrassing to ask it of thee.
Please, do not be embarrassed.
You read my mind! How did you know that I wanted to hold your sceptre!?

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Hello you grace. What can I do for you!
This throne is the absolute worst!  Do you know how uncomfortable a golden throne could be?  My Kingdom for a cushion!  Not really, but at least a reward.
Try this your majesty! Hopefully it helps the problem. I could Imagine a solid gold chair worth enough to feed a kingdom must be aweful!
Marvelous man!  Bring it here and you shall be duly rewarded - what do you desire?  Wealth?  Land?  Fame?
How about you?
I desire only the cushion!
Prehaps i could settle for this.
Why you insolent welp!  My cushion!  MY CUSHION!
This cousion is so presious to you. I will keep it till you give me what I desire!
I warn you only once sir - never get between a Queen and her cushion!
You will not get through this shield. I will keep hold of this cusion untill you give me what I want!
But now I am bot armed and defended!  Hand me the cushion and your reward will be your life!
I have now Youre sword and the cushion. Keep the sheild. Prehaps you can sit on that!
You foolish guard - let us see how you feel about the wrath of a woman scorned when a flying footstool is thrown your way!

agent_personas: We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.
Digging up history is my job. I am in charge of curating our past. It's difficult and rewarding work.

setting.name: Beside temple entrance
setting.description: The entrance to the temple is quite hidden - shrouded by many trees and shrubs. One wouldn't even think to give it a second glance, as the stone that was used to create the entrance is worn down. The textures and characters that once adorned the entrance are memories of the past.
setting.background: The temple entrance is how one would gain access to the temple. It is very hard to find and many archaeologists try to find it every day. The king has a reward of one hundred sheep to the first person to find its location.

speech: The King has decreed that this temple is to be sealed!
What do you mean? I have just finished constructing this temple!
It was constructed upon an older temple, one dedicated to the evil god Vitalya!
There was no temple her. even the remains of a previous temple was not present when we satrted building. I have spent 5 years working on this temple and will die before i see it sealed!
And where did you get this then?  Disturbing a sepulcher is a crime of the highest order!  The dead are to remain buried!
That was found not to long ago! I hadnt had a chance to take it for inspection!
In the name of the King, I command you to surrender peacefully - this Temple is to be destroyed, and you shall answer for your crimes against him and his people!
This is The bone of the evil god you spoke of. And I transform Into him to defend this temple built to worship him!
Lunatic!  Only one as crazed such as yourself would attempt such madness!
FEEL MY WRATH!
Men, never waver - WE FIGHT FOR THE KING!
Tell the king that I will return but for now I should retreat!
Not if I can bring you in!  Try and escape from this hug-hold - you will be spending a very long time on the oubliette!
You are strong, But not as strong as me!

agent_personas: I am a knight. I am trained to fight. I ride a horse and carry a sword.
I am trained by a knight in return for service. I am often treated well. I look forward to becoming a knight.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Fetch me one of those swords, would you? This armory really is one of the finest.
Would you spar with me? Im sure Im close to finishing my training and becoming a full fledged Knight!
