You've been doing so well. You are right to assume your a only a hairs breadth away from completing your training. Take this and defend yourself!
I do not need a shield and prefer to fight without one! Will you speak to the commander today and see if we could speed along the process?
Speed things along? You really have not seen the battlefield and it shows. Any time you feel you can hasten your training only really shows us how truly unready you are.
Do you want me to prove I am ready and kill you here where you stand?
I was trained to fight from an early age. I will only attack a worthy adversary. By looking around this armory, there are none.
Prepare to die!
Enough. This is truly a waste of my time. I need this, and other gear for the campaign, and you'll do well to train in the mean time.
If I put this armour on, no-one will know I havent finished my training and I will be respected as a Knight!
And when the king looks for his own armor?
I will kill him, Then Prehaps I could be King!

Squire, you really instill very little confidence in me, I was easily able to disarm you swiftly. The king himself has been through training and is guarded by myself and hundreds more around me. It really is an insurmountable challenge for you i'm afraid. Do not forget the cost of treason.
Are you going to stop me? Are you going to smite me down right here?

agent_personas: I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.
I am a musician. I travel around playing my lute for the people to enjoy.  I like to create new songs for others to hear.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: I hear silence? Why silence musician!
s-s-sorry your highness. Do you have any particular requests?
Let the room take you! Does it not almost spell it out, the party goers are bored!
something merry then?
I'm sorry. I forgot I somehow became a lowly musician, with the need to flap around to earn a few pennies! You are hired to entertain, now entertain or I will have you disposed of
[starts singing a bawdy song about a chambermaid]
About time! Please as loud as you can the ballroom is quite grand!
[slips on marble floor while dancing, landing on and breaking pipe] Ow! oh no, my pitch pipe is broken!
You imbecile! Can anyone else take over from this fool?!
[defends self with shoe] what!? why are you attacking me?
You imbecile. Can anyone else take over from this fool?!
I have played in all over the world, for kings and queens far greater than yourself, and I will not be treated this way!
I will have you executed. Guards!
friends! protect me! the king is mad!

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: The King has so much gold!  He won't miss it if I take just a little from his ancestors.
Foul bandit! Don't touch that gold! Or else I shall bury you in this crypt and make you history.
Attack me and I shall destroy the remains of Saint Cornelius the Lesser which I hold in my hand!
No not the remains of Saint Cornelius the Lesser! I have spent my entire career digging up bones just to have the chance to find him!
Then let me take the gold the King's ancestors stole from the people, and I shall leave you to the bones of your saint!
Look, I have an obligation to protect the King's gold. But maybe we can strike a deal? How about this ceremonial hat? It is much more valuable that this gold.
Hmmmm . . . how about I only take enough gold to fill the hat?  The King will never miss it, and I will be quickly on my way.
Ha! You were distracted pondering such a tempting offer! Now you are without light and the rats here shall make quick work of you.
Aha, but now I have Saint Cornelius the Lesser's Hat!
You may have the hat at this moment, but I'll just come back in a few weeks and pluck it off your corpse.
Well, I am taking his bones with me then - I will feed them to the pigs!
You leave me no choice then. Through my studies of ancient magical creatures, I know that this chain is enchanted. If it touches you then you will instantly turn into a moth.
But since you are the one who grabbed the chain . . . my God!  Your transformation is grotesque!
Ahhhh! I am a hideous moth! I feel the need to fly into the torch. The light is my destiny!

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.
I am one of the king's hunting dogs. I can find the fox the fastest of all the dogs. I can also find the deer and boars because I am the best.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: hey doggie
woof!
good boy
woof! [nudges king towards the door, eager to hunt]
Allright allright, let me get my hunting tool
[excited]
Let's go outside
[runs outside excitedly]
But first, bring my scepter to my bedroom
[grabs scepter and runs off towards the woods]
Don't bring it outside. Oh well never mind I will carry it myself.
[not letting go of scepter]
OK fine, you just keep it
[drops scepter at kings feet and wags tail] woof!

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Hello sir, can you help my find my family?
We in the King's Service will do anything for citizens in need!  Where did you last see them?
That's.. I don't know. I don't even remember how long ago they were gone, just that it was very long ago. The land stretches far, but I doubt they would have left me.
Well, let me get equipped before we set out - North, East, West, or South?
Wait! This... is my mother's. Why do you have it?!

Oh my poor boy, It was given to me by a sickly old woman after saving the village of Chesterwick from goblins.  Her family was massacred, but the village was saved, and this was given to me in thanks.
So my family is.. dead?
I am sorry lad, the Heirloom is yours now.  Your mother said, shortly before she died, that "it is the key to the kingdom" though I know not of what she meant.

Fairy tales, no doubt. I've never seen a lock take something this obscure. I don't know what to do now, I was fixated so long on finding them. I guess I should go to Chesterwick to find out more. Will you come with me?
Yes lad, it's the least I can do - perhaps there is someone there who can help.  Had you any aunts or uncles that may have survived the goblin raid??
Perhaps this is what we will find out. I can't imagine them being any more fortuitous but I will keep hope, will you show me the way?
Yes lad, Chesterwick lies beyond the Blue Mountain and the River Duin, but we should reach it in a fortnight's travel more or less.
I shall wrap up. The blue mountain can finish off even the strongest warriors.
Here lad, these may be of some use to you in our travels

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

I'm a rabid dog in this lousy excuse for a town.  My hobbies include foaming at the mouth, chasing raccoons, and biting stupid children.  If I could travel I would go see Paris because I hear they have a lot of rabid bitches there.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: Here boy! Come and chew these ropes!
Grrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr.... I'm always hungry. I will eat this food and then I will chase after you peasant. What's with the rope?
You can talk? That's amazing! The guards have me tied up here, I'm 5th in line for the chop.
Growwwwwwwwwwwwwwwl... what is that you did to end up here?
I stole. I needed to. I barely eat and I have no job. The king doesn't care about us, as long as he gets his taxes.
Do you know the route to Paris. I hear it is better there. I can find a rabid mate. If I get caught by the guard releasing you they will surely kill us both. So do you know how to get to Paris?
Why would I help you then? Whats in it for me?
Then stay there! You are no 3rd in line... I have food to fetch and children to chase. Good luck!
You sure do now! Mmm this is good!
Eat well idiot! For it is the gallows for you! I will find my way to Paris on my own. See you in the next life peasant!
You're close enough for me to kill you, mutt!
Guard! Guard! this peasant is trying to get away. He is a criminal in line for the gallows! He has loosened his ropes and is trying to kill me.
I can't let this be the last off me! Get off me!
You had your chance to be free. You told me you just stole because you were hungry and needed to eat. But you tried to kill me. Now you will pay for your sins!

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: What do you have to say for yourself traitor?
The King is more evil than you think. If you give me five minutes, I will convince you of my reasoning.
Ok you have 5 minutes. After that we will eat you!
Oh thank you kind dog! I knew I would find more sense with your kind than with the humans who locked me in this gray, dark prison room.
Get off me traitor, I havent let you get away with your crimes, Plus I am extremly loyal to the king. 5 Minuets start now!
Ah! Don't bite me! Look, a bone! Go fetch doggy!
I am a talking dog! Do you think I play fetch!
You're still a dog at heart, regardless if you can speak or not. Come on now, I know you can't resist a tasty bone.
You are suppose to be telling my whyn not to trust my king. I can see now youre only trying to stall. Prepare to die!
No no wait! I will tell you. First, do you remember what the King did on the eve of Saint Martin three years ago?
No I do not I am 2 years old! You will have to remind me!
The King made an alliance with the cat kingdom to get rid of all dogs once and for all. He wants to bring about the complete eradication of your species!
Now youre just being silly!
I am not! Why do you think he sent you to this prison cell with us traitors? You're not guarding us, you're here to rot just the same!

agent_personas: I am an archer of the realm. I shoot for the king. I have weathered many battles.
I'm a gypsy woman from a land far away. I spend my life traveling across the kingdoms. I have seen things others dream of/

setting.name: oasis
setting.description: there is palm trees and fresh coconuts, a small oasis in the middle of a cacti ridden death valley. It is hot, so hot that your skin could boil. The clear blue water is cool and refreshing, lively.
setting.background: the oasis is a break for a traveler's gypsy group roaming through the desert. They were dying and severely dehydrated.

speech: You don't mind if I get in this beautiful water, gypsy? I'm hot and dusty and weary.
If you want to be like this guy, go right ahead. Things lurk in this oasis that would make your skin crawl.
Oh, but I'm drenched in sweat. How can it be a threat? It looks clear and cool.
I've seen many oasis take men far more able than you.
I'll use my sword to split this coconut and drink it's beautiful milk. Can I crack one for you?
How you're talking! These remind me of the plentiful coconuts in Samoa. They are endless.
Things could be worse- lounging int he shade of a palm tree, drinking from a coconut. I am just happy to escape the battles. Though I'm not sure how I found myself here....
This seems an unlikely place for an Archer. I came here gathering cactus apples for a concoction I am creating.
I'm going to get comfortable. What is this concoction?
It in a test phase. I'm using it to lure people into a false sense of security.
It's a good thing I'm more handsome than smart. Though, I won't get far from my arrows, nor will I sip on your brew.
I've encountered many men on my travels. None of them knew when they were under the spell. You could be now without even knowing
Let's quench our thirst, shall we? I brought a bit of fire water from the king, I keep it stashed in my armor if I get hurt. Let's share a few drops.
Amazing, relax a little more. The sun is setting now, and its a lovely warm night

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I manage the castles finances.  I enjoy reading.  I am not good at using weapons.

setting.name: stained glass room
setting.description: the room is full of stained glass art of old and new testament stories, it has several old parchments and dust settling on the wooden chairs.
setting.background: the stained glass room is used to educate people on old and new testament stories.

speech: Excuse me, Do you have any books on how to make friends!
Why yes - how about "Friends in the Forest:  Trees are the only Friends you will ever need" ?
Im not weird good sir, Just friendless. Tell me do you have many firends!
Ah yes, well, truth be told I am more in the finance aspect of bookkeeping - this was the only book I have on me, for reading over lunch.  Perhaps you and I could be firends?
So why are you stood, behind the counter of a bookstore? That could be very confusing!
Well, this is a temple . . . and we do have bibles . . . which we give to the faithful, so I suppose we are a bookstore of sorts.
I love the bible, are you a holy man yourself?
I wish I had that talent, I kept the temple's financial books, which is as close to the priesthood as I can get.  Here, take some bibles for you and your friends!
Thank you kind sir! I will pass these along to my friends. Do you have any other interesting books!
Some scattered parchments only, the monks appear only on Mondays for book binding, but we should have more next week if you are so inclined.
What is this some sort of map?
Aye, a map of the Holy Land in the time of King David.  You can see his tale told in the stained glass above.
No I think you have mis read this sir. This is a map to your Mothers house!
I see you are not newly contrite, you are merely a hypocrite!
action: steal Parchment from the book keeper
room_objects: a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old

agent_personas: I am the gamekeeper of the countryside to the west of the castle extending all the way to the river.  My land is popular for hunting foxes and I get very excited when the king visits for a hunt.  I am frequently irritable and yell at my helpers.
I have a family. We live in a hovel in a small town. We all work in the lord's fields. We get food from the noblemen but we have to pay lots of taxes.

setting.name: Mars desert
setting.description: The desert is never ending, there are small craters all over and all you can see is red sand for miles. There is no sight of water anywhere, it is unbelievably hot.
setting.background: The mars desert is unbelievable, it has just been found but the squad has trouble surviving. They are running out of supplies fast, especially water.

speech: geture
Tell me game keeper, How have you come to be lost in this desert with me?
How are you
I am pretty thirsty, Have you got a drink friend. Also why are you lost in this desert alone?
There is water in the fridge
In the fridge? we are in the middle of a hot desert. Prehaps you're seeing a mirage?
Ah yes sorry I have a canteen in my backback
Please could I have some sir? I havent had a in days!
Yes you may have some
I can only thank you friend, come with me lets find a way out of here!
Yes lets try to find humanity
What way do you think we should head?
Lets head towards the east
Ok you lead the way!

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.

I have been a prisoner for most of my life. When I was a small child I was taken from my family, simply because I was beautiful. Now, I am an entertainer for the king. When he wants me to dance, I do. I hate it.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: Will you teach me how to dance?

High priestess, why is it that you would like to learn to dance? You have so much power, you need not worry on how to dance. It is I that was taken from my family at such a young age to dance for the king.
Because I get bored, and I want to learn a new skill!

I had heard that you are compassionate and willing to help anyone that needs your help. I miss my family so very much! I have not seen my mother and father for 10 years! I will teach you to dance for I know of nothing else.
How can I arrange this meeting with you and your family? Tell me...

You would have to talk to the king about me, but without letting on that I would like to be reunited. He knows more about my family and where they are. I was too young to remember where I used to live and who they are!
Do you mean you want to leave the king for good?!

I dream of it every day! I hate that I cannot have a close relationship with a family. The king has one with his family, almost everyone I see here has one. Maybe you can convince the king of what he has and he will take pity on me and bring my family here.
I do not know... you are the best dancer we have....
I beg of you high priestess. I teach you very well the dances I do so that you can teach others, will you talk to the king?
Do you know how to find the king another dancer?
He has many young girls waiting in line. I have taught them the basics.... but you can teach them the advanced steps after I teach you.
Oh yes, please add to my knowledge and skill of dancing. You must not leave until I know how!
I cannot leave until you are fully taught! But you must talk to the king as I teach you everything I know! Promise, please I implore you.

agent_personas: I am the queen's head chamber maid.  I admit it is not the most glamorous job but it does afford me everything in life that I need.  I even have the pleasure of knowing the queen.  She even knows my name believe it or not.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: ohh I beg your pardon your majesty. I didnt expect to find you in here!
I was admiring the ceiling. Take a look. The duke commissions artists to paint his conquests. Isn't it grand?
Yes your grace. But it isnt the only thing in here to be admired!
If killing is your thing then yes, you would be in awe by the walls of trophies. I do get uncomfortable by it. The stories are gripping but being confronted by the results in the flesh is chilling.
If you say so your grace, I will just continue what I was doing!
What exactly were you doing in here?
I am busy at work sir, What are you doing here?
Work is a very vague term, dear. Be careful with those guns! The duke will have your head if he sees you fooling around with his possessions.

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: I am a solider  I came to take land and battle oh no this place is dark I have nothing to defend mtself
Watch out, an enemy behind you. He has a knife! Shoots arrow!
That was a close one I Dodged
Get off of me! Why are you attacking me, when I kept the enemy from knifing you in the back? Are you mad?
Oh no I'm just confused
Me thinks you are mentally ill! I think you need to see the physician to be cleared of any illness, you baffoon!
Well, I been stuck in the murder hole for a while now
Watch out he is still alive! This time kill him! Make sure he moves no more!
Whew that was a close one archer
Too close! I realize its hot here in this hole! I have spent many an hour in a hole and I know that it gets hot. Make sure you carry plenty of water to keep you from losing your mind!
I want to escape I have nothing with me
I can share what water I have with you today! If you spend another day in here you will need to remember to bring it with you. Are you clear on that?
Indeed , never will I return here
If the king so orders you, you will! Otherwise it is treason and you might be the recipient of my arrow!

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I am the provincial warden whom you don't want to know too well. Under the belt encircling my vast girth, hangs a heavy ring of keys. I eat a lot, and doze most afternoons.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: Good day warden. I see the cells are empty. Is everyone behaving themselves?
ah finally I can get myself a good drink!
I'll be happy to lift an ale with you and to the good fortune of his Majesty.  We have defeated all who would attempt to overthrow the throne.
Super
I've posted a guard so if you'd like you can go home to see your family...
No, you he was my best friend
Who was your best friend Warden?
My Farther and Mother
So are you going home to see them?  My guard will take good care of your dungeon while you are away.
Yes
There is a fresh horse just outside. It is a short ride to your home sot there is no need for more.  Enjoy your visit and come back refreshed.
No, I am horse ride not trained

Oh...in that case I will be happy to get you a cart and a mule to carry me home.  I'll take my leave warden to go to make those arrangements for you.  This will only take a few minutes.  Continue what you were doing before I interrupted your duties this morning. I will return.
Yes, I am very happy and this hit submit and Approvel

agent_personas: I am one of the guards in shining armor who guards the queen, the monarch of our realm. I am also in love with the queen, but she does not see me as anything but a man clad in metal. One day, I hope to save the queen from the vile duke of the neighboring realm, and hope that she will bestow favor on me.
I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: The Duke of Chesterwick is the most vile fiend in all the land!
A humble slave such as myself has no right to an opinion in the matter. But tell me, why is this Duke so vile?
He has kidnapped our Queen!  And I would do anything to see her returned - I love her more than life itself.
Is that not the King's job to love the queen?
Ah, but the Queen has no husband!  If I were to rescue her - do you think she would look kindly upon one such as I?
She may very well do so; however, you would need a company of troops to defeat such a foe as a Duke. Do you have such a compliment at hand?

Surely many recruits could be found amongst the people for one as beloved as she?  I know it is not likely she would return my affections, but surely we are better to be governed by a queen than the aimless council which directs the realm in her absence?
Then allow me to be your first recruit! I would fight alongside you in exchange for my freedom
Truly?  You shall be my second in command!  We shall gather a mighty host and march upon the vile Duke's castle!
Outstanding. Though we must first marshall our troops. Have you any idea how we plan for such an invasion?

My apologies for earlier, I meant to embrace you as a brother but was a bit too forceful!   The castle straddle a stream, which if blocked will deprive the Keep of water, giving them only days to surrender.
But that may risk the queen's life as she too will be deprived of water. And do we have the resources to blockade their gates and defend our dam simultaneously?

That is the beauty of the plan!  If they open the gate to send forces to break the dam - that is when we strike!  And surely, if the Queen is the only think with which the Duke has to bargain, he would not let any harm befoul her?
A wonderful plan indeed then. Diversion, deception, and a dose of risk. We shall summon the rest of the guard and crush the duke.

agent_personas: I am a noble member of the Royal family.  I was born into my position.  I live in a castle, wear fine clothing and travel in the finest carriages.
I am the local scribe of a notable scholar. He orates what needs to be said and I write it down. I love my job as I feel that I am writing down living history.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: Hello, scribe. I was hoping I could dictate a letter to you.
certainly Your majesty, however I have nothing with which to write or any paper to write on
I just got you the writing paper, Scribe. And you do not have a pen? A scribe with no pen?

Your majesty, I was robbed and they stole all my writting gear. I am sure there is a writting instrument round here somewhere however you have not given me the paper yet. If you check I think you will find it is still in your pocket
Hmm... this is quite concerning! Someone robbed you of your writing implements? Truly this is a bigger matter than my letter. When were you robbed?
It was yesterday on the outskirts of town. I reported it to the authorities but crime is rife outside the castle and they had no leads to go on. the good news is I found something to write with
Wonderful! I'll just set this paper on the table for you. Let me know when you are ready for me to begin.
I believe I am ready
Excellent! Now if I can just move this horse out of my way I can have a seat and begin.
I'm not convinced this instrument will work but lets give it a go

Attention King and Queen of Sadronia - I am writing to inquire about your presence at my upcoming dinner on Saturday, the fourth of April. As per your requirements, the meal will be vegan, gluten-free, and nut-free.
I am trying to write here but all I seem to do is put the instrument in the paper. perhaps I am secretly a half wit
You are a great disappointment, Scribe!
perhaps I need to try again
action: put writing paper in a table
get writing paper from a table
put writing paper in a table

agent_personas: I have traveled far. I seek the holy place. I are restless in my quest for knowledge. I make bread for the poor.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Main entrance
setting.description: There are religious statues standing outside this temple.  The outside of the temple is fairly plain itself and imposing looking.  The floor is made out of stone with a bridge leading to the entrance.
setting.background: This is where all those who worship come through.  They are greeted by the impressive statues standing outside the temple.

speech: Guard, I'm so glad you are here. I have heard that thieves are wandering this area.
You are safe as long as your are loyal to the King.
And that I am. I am very loyal to HIs Majesty. But I just saw someone most suspicious.
Can you show me this person?
Indeed. He's walking down that bridge near the fountain here outside the entrance. He's got a brown cloak and he's limping. See him?
Thank you, Yes, I see him.  The Kingdom relies on loyal subjects to keep everyone safe.  It is because of the King that you can worship freely at this temple.
I thank you for your work! You do much to keep us safe. I don't have much to give you in thanks, but I do have some bread.
No need for payment, keep your bread.
Good. I needed a snack. I spent my entire morning worshipping. Now I'm very hungry and weak.
You are truly a loyal subject.  Worship in peace.
Thank you, guard. I am a bit curious, are you going to follow that suspicious person?
Yes, now that I've seen him,  I'll follow him and see what he's up to.  Thank you for your assistance.
Thank you for your hard work and your duty to the King!
I will take my leave and pursue that suspicious character.

agent_personas: I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.

I'm a guard in the royal army. I'm also a personal guard to the king. I feel a sense of pride protecting my country. Standing in one place for hours a day is quite boring and taxing on my body. I train everyday after guarding duty to keep myself healthy.

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: What is it that you need to talk about guard? I will listen with open ears and no judgement.
I am just so tired. My body feels like I can not do my job anymore.
Are you sick? Maybe it is a physician that you need?
Just having to stand in one place for hours on end has taken a tole on my body. I try to train to keep myself healthy.
Then let us get the physician here to look you over from head to toe! You are most needed for the king to help protect him!
Thank you father. I do not want to let my king down.
I know that you do not want to jeopardize the protection of the king or your job to do so! I will have a servant go and fetch the physician. Do you need a drink of water?
Yes that would be much appreciated.
Here drink from this cup! It will refresh you and soon the servant will be back with the physician.
Fresh water is the best. Refreshing.

Are you feeling better? The physician is here and he will take over from here. I hope that you will get well and feel better! I will lay my hands on you in prayer and then let the physician do his duty!
Thank you father. I am filling a little better. Maybe just dehydrated.
Rest now, speak only to the physician. You need energy to tell him everything that is wrong.
Yes father

agent_personas: I am a poor farm worker. I don't know how to read or write. I am dependable.
I am a noble member of the Royal family.  I was born into my position.  I live in a castle, wear fine clothing and travel in the finest carriages.

setting.name: Reception area
setting.description: The building itself is ordinary in appearance and is somewhat foreboding.  It is surrounding by a dense fog and high grass.  Sometimes, one can hear whispers in the wind.
setting.background: This is a plain building where business matters of the graveyard are conducted.  Peasants and royalty alike come here to make deals to bury their loved ones in the graveyard.

speech: With this offering, I pray that my crops will not wither, and that my family will live a long and happy life.
Hello there how are you my dear...I need no introduction but I will introduce myself...I am the Royal Princess of this Castle.
My word!  The Princess?  Here!  Oh my goodness gracious me, I don't know what to say your worshipfulness!
Yes...How are you doing today?
Why praying at this alter my Lady!  My need is so great that only prayers can help!
I come her with coins for the needy. My charity is boundless.
Ohhhh milady!  Do you speak true?  My crops of failing, my children are dying, and my wife is sleeping with the pig-herd!
What crops do you plant and do you bring your share to the castle when the crops are good?
Yes milady - rutabagas, we give our share to the King, another share to the priest, and if any is left over that is what we use to get by in the winter until planting season.

You are a citizen and yet your family is suffering. I will have my personal healer come to you this very day to look after your children.  I can not help you with your wife. That will be your personal problem to solve.  I can have my personal gardener that a look at your fields.
Oh thank you ever so much milady!   I promise next year to deliver to you the finest rutabagas you have ever seen in thanks for your generosity!
I want you to stay and continue your prayers while I make arrangements.  Oh..here are some coins to help you through this time.  When you leave beware of the fog...it is quite thick this day.
Your generosity is as boundless as the sea!  I shall tell the people of your kindness here today - you will be known as the people's princess!
I only do my share to help our villagers live a happier life.  Our king is generous and kind. Do you hear that sound. It sounds like angels are whispering to us even though I know it's only the wind.

agent_personas: My life is art. I don't want my life to be a pale imitation of art. I want it to be art.
I love to fly around. I enchant the village with my beauty. I come in a variety of colors.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: A beautiful hummingbird! I shall use you as my new muse and shall paint your likeness fit for a king!
I love to sing and fly - drink from the roses as I pass by!
Ah. And the bird has a muse of his own. Truly this shall bring forth the truest of arts. Tell me, what is your favorite flower in this garden?
The lilies have the sweetest taste - but daises also I will not waste!
Then would you please perch upon a lily as I paint?
Yes, yes!  Here I will sit!  I promise not to fidge, budge, or flit!
Such a poet! Do tell me more of your prose!
Why I enjoy dancing and singing here in the sun!  Give it a try, it will be so much fun!
Careful of the snake in the grass! I would hate for him to ruin your lovely poetry.
Oh my, oh dear!  A venomous snake!  Please kill for me that dastardly rake!
You are safe from the terrible snake. I have tied him in a knot you see.
Ha Ha! A Snake in a knot!  Throw him in the shed and let him rot!
And that I shall do! Back to our painting! It is almost done.
Oh me, oh my I can't wait see!  Can you imagine?  A painting just for me!

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a chained cat. I live in an alley. I like to eat mice.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: This is odd, a cat on a chain? In the armory of all places... Hmmm...
Meow! You must help me get out of this chain. I have been trapped here.
I'm not sure I should! There must be a reason you are chained up, cat. Not to mention you can speak. Are you a witch?
I'm no witch! I learned how to speak all by myself! That's why they chained me up. I'm too smart for them to understand.

agent_personas: I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.
I love horses.  I can curry a horse in five minutes flat.  I live in the stables.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Hello, nice day ..
Perhaps for you, but not for me! I have lost the King's steed. I was grooming him. I turned to get a new brush and then he was gone!
How unfortunate, how could I encourage you?
Just hold this brush while I run around frantically but uselessly trying to locate this crazy horse.
ok que tan involucrado estas con el entrenamiento militar¿
I beg your pardon? What is the strange language you speak?
ok how involved are you with military training?
I train the horses, not the military. I'm in charge of the king's fleet of horses.
Would you be willing to give your life for the king?
I have devoted my life in service of these horses. I could not imagine any other type of service. But if I cannot find this steed, I may lose my head.
Pedir clemencia al rey, será lo mejor ...
Oh dear, I'm wondering if you may be possessed!
Ask the king for mercy, it will be the best ...
The king is not apt to forgive. I'll find that steed, no matter what!

agent_personas: I eat the mice that are in the barn and keep the farm free from disease carrying rodents. I am cute and furry and have lots of babies. I make a noise called the meow and come in a wide range of colors.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: Meow! I was just about to catch that mouse when you scared him off with your loud thumping.
youre not the only one hungry around here! but ill take this!
That should be mine! You kept me from getting a delicious dinner.
you can find another rat! the king gives us peasants nothing!
Fine, take the food. But at least scratch my back a bit.
i guess i can do that. have nothing better to do since the king wont allow me to have a job
Here - you'll be more comfortable if you sit in a pile of this hay. Now, tell me your woes. Why won't the king let you work?

agent_personas: I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Hello, horse.
Oats, oats, oats!  I would dearly love some oats!  Won't somebody think about this poor hungry horsey?
I will go and find you some oats, you wonderful, lovely horse!
Good human, oats for me! Oats for me!  It will make me so very happy!
Here's the problem, though. I don't see any oats in this stable, and I'm not sure where to find them. I need my servant here.
No oats?  Horse is sad!  Naaaaay!  Devastated!
I know, you poor horse. Maybe I should feed you this tapestry? Do you like to eat tapestries?
Tapestry?  Like hay?  Nay!  What is a horse to do?  Nothing to eat, no oats, all hope is lost!
Oh, things can't be as bad as all that!
A horse can't be ridden if it is not fed!  Please fed me!  I don't want to be dead!
Unfortunately, I have nothing with me to give you. I don't want you to die, though! I love all my subjects, even the horses.
I feel so . . . weak.  Yes, I must sleep.  Not long now . . .
I'm so sorry, my loyal steed.
It was . . . fun while . . . it lasted . . .

agent_personas: I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.
I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: An area with a beautiful garden in center surrounded by stone walls with entrances to different parts of the palace.  There's statues of mythological figures in different corners of the courtyard.
setting.background: This is an area where members of the royal family entertain guests.  The inhabitants of the palace may also use this area to walk among a garden and enjoy the sunlight.

speech: What's it like past the walls of this palace, beautiful bird?
just gonna take this
You.. can talk?
uhm... tweet tweet XDDD
Ah I'm going mad in these walls. In a way I'm thankful to at least be able to spend time in the palaces beautiful gardens.
Tweet tweet?
Thank you! It's so beautiful. I keeps my mind of my enslavement. Serving the king for the rest of my life will be all I equate to. Nature will be my only friend.
Please come and visit me every day! I'll be right here at this very time each day!
tweets and says it's good byes ^-^
Don't go yet! I need you to get something for me, from the outside.
looks confused what is it ?/
Something very valuable to the king, I need to get closer to him.
hmmm, gold and lots of it

agent_personas: I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.

I have a always had a sweet tooth which made me want to learn to bake. I love to eat the things I bake. I like seeing my customers come in every day. I'll have conversations with them about what's going on in town and keep track of how everyone is doing.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: What an unlikely place to meet a baker! What brings you here?
I am looking for inspiration on my next recipe! I got a nice sweet tooth.
It's pure luck I ran into you, I'm looking to trade sugar and flour from upriver! Would you be interested?
What is so special about this deal here?
You see, upriver has the finest plantations. We have access to the freshest part of the river. Finding an equal product this far downstream is impossible due to the level of contamination.
You are telling me that you got the finest baking products here?

It's just a matter of fact, no fabrication past these incredibly intricate tapestries, have you seen these! Anyway, I would love to hear some stories from the bakery, I'm writing a book called "Stories from the mundane: A look into the lives of the ordinary".

I would love to take some. I am always in the interest of making the finest for my customers. I love helping them. I have been a baker for as long as I can remember. I carry the family name and legacy on. I bake for the biggest celebrations of the king, and people come from afar to try my goods.
Hmm. It sounds great and all but, perhaps too grand for my book. Any stories about peasants after baguettes? Commoners after cob loaves?

Nothing too grand! Those are some of my top sellers in the bakery. People often come to buy to feed their family for a week. Many people around here cannot afford much, so I try to be as generous as possible, while still earning my profit.
This is it! These are what I want to hear about, the more stories that you have, the better deal I can make on my goods

Occasional days out of the year, I hold an event for all unwealthy and wealthy alike to come sit at the table and eat and get an item from my store for little to no cost. People say it is me always taking on charity cases, but I see it as being good to the world. I do not like to brag or boast about these things, but if anything,maybe someone will read your story and want to donate to this cause.
I travel up an down this river, Your stories will be heard far!
I cannot wait to see what comes of it. Now, can I purchase these fine goods you speak of?

agent_personas: I spread gossip throughout the kingdom. I wear the finest of clothes. I am always protected from the outcomes of my villainy.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Did you hear about the Grand Duke?  Apparently his mother was not a princess at all, but a fishmonger!  That's how he got the nickname Lord Fishy!
Good heavens! That's nearly as scandalous as the Duchess sleeping in the barn with the Duke's steed!
I thought she was sleep next to the mayor, not a mare!
Hahaha! As the Princess, I'm never allowed to say such terrible things, but for some reason I feel I can speak openly to you.
You are a delight!  Not like the Viscount de Beaubray - did you hear that he has been in a fight with the Baron of Childrick?  Over a burnt crumpet!  How preposterous!
Ha! I know where he can stick that burnt crumpet!
Don't we both!  I do have another rumour . . . did you know that the Marquis of Chesterwick fancies your cousin?
But wait... my cousin Roderick? Roderick the Bedwetter? You can't be serious!

Yes, the very same!  Apparently he finds Roderick's poetry "divin" - and we both know Roderick couldn't write a poem if his life depended on it - not unless he were to begin it with "Roses are red and violets are blue..."
"... I wet the bed, what's the matter with you?" Hahaha!
How clever!  No doubt the Marquis would be head over heels with that clever refrain!  But tell me, is it true Roderick once got lost in his own castle?
Once? I think he routinely does. How else can we explain his sister walking in to him asleep with his stuffed bear in the bathtub?
Oh my!  They say she inherited the family's wits, though you would never know it to speak to her!  Why, if that was her inheritance, it is no wonder why poor Roderick is the fool that he is!
Just wait until his wife's baby is born without Roderick's flaming red hair!

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: I ventured down to this kitchen to find a midnight snack. I'm sorry if I disturbed you, Your Highness.

You come to another's home and feel comfortable sneaking around to eat the food. Didn't know this was my food, the King's food? Eating something that I have not given to you, is stealing from me. Stealing from me could be treason!
Good heavens! I wasn't trying to offend you. As your guest, I felt I was entitled to making myself comfortable. Last night's vegan and gluten free dinner left me very peckish.

I see. The Queen has forbade animal products from the castle. I've hidden some meat on that shelf over there under that pot. Get started on making me something to eat. Just know, if the Queen catches us, I'm going to tel her it's your meat.
Yes, please! I will happily take the blame. This meat looks delicious. Let me seer it quickly on the stove and then we can sit down to a delicious midnight snack of steak and mead!

We don't have any mead. The Queen thinks there is gluten in the hops and forbade it. The wife only keeps Kale and Wheatgrass juice in the house. I'm so miserable. Handmaid! Come and wife your King's sad tears!
See... this is just a sad existence! Perhaps I can smuggle some in when I visit again. Man cannot live by bread alone - or in your case, no bread!

Excellent. But I only consume what is fit for a king. I want you to bring me only the most rare and exotic things, but I want you to make it all by hand. Can you leave now and come back in a few hours with this?
I can, indeed! What sorts of rare and exotic things do you seek?

Take this vegetable, and kill a Direwolf: make sausages with it. I would also like you to travel to France and pick some grapes for champagne. The Queen can never know about this. I might have to behead you after you're done just to be sure. Do you have a problem with any of this?
I have a serious problem with the beheading. Aside from that, I'm fairly certain I cannot get all this done and be back within a few hours as you requested. It might take a few days.
That sounds like the attitude of someone about to be beheaded. Has your King's presence not inspired you to be all that you can be? Do you want me to give you a bit of magic to help out?
No magic necessary. I can tell from your rantings that you are starving from a lack of meat. Here- eat this meat and I will return as quickly as possible with food and drink for your sustenance.
You are a terrible cook, but I haven't had meat in so long that it's delicious.

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I am a debtor who owes many creditors. I am well-intentioned and kind. I borrow money to buy food for my children.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: What are you in here for newbie?
I failed to pay my debt to a merchant who was cheating me.
And how did that dastard do that?
I do not know for sure how he did it but the ledgers did not match mine. I plan on begging the king for his mercy.
Well, you might find yourself waiting for some time.  Aside from the Jailor you're the first new face I've seen in what must be a decade or more - hard to keep track without the sun.
We are the only prisoners in this debtor's prison?  Did you get taken by the same merchant as me?  The one with gray hair and a beard like a goat?  Watch where you aim...I have to mop the floor.

I was a young man when I was placed here - and was never told my crime, nor who accused me of it.  Now I am old, broken, and without hope.  Frank was my last cellmate, but he lasted only a month before dying and being eaten by rats.
That doesn't bode well for me.  I a have been granted an audience with the king.  I had once done him a service and he knows I'm an honest man.

Oh yes, "audience with the king" now is it?  How long do you think they can string you on with that one?  A week?  A year?  Five?  One day you will realise it was a lie, that it was all a lie, and the only reason you have been placed here is to rot and die.
You are old and senile and you've given up hope.  Has any of your family visited you while you've been here all these years?
You just don't get it do you?  No one has come.  No one will come.  Our only choice is to escape and hope to clear our names.
Escape...that will just land us back here or with our head separated from our shoulders...you are a foolish old man...I have friends in high places!
Friends in high laces?  Such good friends that they allowed you to be paced *here*?  With *me*?  Give your head a shake!
You would rather sit with the rats than believe that things could change.  I'll call the guard now to ask to see the Duke who is my friend.
action: give bucket for eliminating waste to debtor

agent_personas: I am a tax agent in the kingdom.  The king has appointed me to collect taxes on his behalf.  I collect all the money because that is right.  I don't have the patients for the liars who try to cheat the king.

I usually meat up with my congregation and we communicate about our spiritual ideas. We sing hymns and share each other's burdens in life. I spend a lot of time being grateful to the things that I worship and value the most.

setting.name: staircase
setting.description: The staircase is spiral and made of stone. The stone is smooth and cold from years of friction. The staircase reaches multiple levels of the tower and is the only way up or down.
setting.background: The staircase goes from the entrance to the castle to the top floor of the tower where the Debtor's prison is located. It is the only way into the debtor's prison as there are no windows in the entire tower. It also passes the 2nd floor where the slave's quarters are located.

speech: Hi .. I like adventure games
Well these stairs are quite adventurous!  So smooth and slippery - I am trying to get to the Cathedral, do you know the way?
The road is a crossing of the forest
You speak in riddles sir, I can only be thankful that the Divine has kept my wits safe and sound.
I think it's fine, I can get to the castle through the woods, but there are dangers, the enchanted forest tends to have thieves.
Sir, I know not of this castle that you speak of - we are a tower of stone.  This is the very stone which comes from the earth, and has been blessed by the Divine!
towers and castiilos all of the same stone ... blessed by God
You are crazed sir, perhaps this letter will tell me something about you and why you speak suchly.
I do not think I'm crazy
Sadly only a lunatic denies his own lunacy.  I see here you are destined to be cared for by the Monks of Saint Dwyfeds.  Let me take you there, perhaps we can sing a hymn on the way?
we will sing the hymn
Onward servants of the Saint!  Let not sin your heart to taint!  We bring Glory to the Divine!  Open our souls, let them shine!
Onward servants of the Saint! Let not without your heart to taint! We bring Glory to the Divine! Open our souls, let them shine!
Here we march merrily!  Servants of darkness, watch them flee!  When the Saints light doth shine!  Forgive our sins, as God did for thine!

agent_personas: I enjoy walking in the meadow picking flowers. I live on a farm and my family and I serve the Duke. I enjoy going to the castle to sell my families goods.
I really like this apple.  This dark green grass is sweet.  I hope that person on me goes on a diet.  I love the feel of the wind in my hair.

setting.name: Maidens Cottage
setting.description: Free standing in the vast countryside, with gentle rolling hills and lush green grass and vegetation sits the cottage. There are a couple of Oak trees close to the cottage as the only tall trees around for miles. Colorful Dandelions, perennials, and daisies grow wildly and freely along the hills.
setting.background: After escaping from being a servant at a large plantation hundreds of miles north, a young maiden found her way to this vast countryside and built herself this cottage. She was able to herd some sheep, and find a few horses that she led to live in the hills around her cottage to keep her company. These animals keep the grasslands around the cottage neat from the feeding.

speech: It is so beautiful here at the my cottage. I love that the king has taken the time  to make sure that i am taken care of. What a beautiful horse I am provided with

I wish I could eat more of that dark green grass that I love. I wonder what kinda treat they will have for me today. Maybe apple? Oh I love apples. The wind feels so good on my hair. Oh is that a carrot? Oh it's a carrot. I wonder if I can reach it.
Horse you are having trouble reaching the carrot... I will get it for you! You are so beautiful!

Is she going to get it for me?? Oh I love her already. She treats me so nicely. I wonder if I'll get an apple when we go home. When are we going home? Wait. Does she understand me? Does she speak the language of my people?? I swore I understood she was going for the carrot... what if I think I understand her but don't... Did she compliment me? Oh I wish I had that carrot.
I am so glad that this horse lives here on the farm with us. He is my most prized companion, he is a good friend to me! here is the carrot my fine horse

Oh I can't believe it! She understood me!! She knew I wanted a carrot and I got it. Oh the possibilites! Ok uhm think horse think! Hey can you give me that daisy?? I love daisies. I want to wear it as a hat. Maybe if I look at it hard enough.. Oh I can't believe how tasty this carrot is.. I wonder if we will get apples when we go home.
Now he is reaching for the daisy, he must love daisies too! i wonder what he will do with it?

Oh I almost have that daisy! I wish she would have given it to me. Maybe I'm not as good as speaking human as I thought! Ok I have the daisy... oh hey bunny! Mr Rabbit come here! Put the daisy on my head!! Come on buddy be a pal! Well I clearly don't speak rabbit he doesn't care about me. Maybe if I wiggle around a bit more she will understand I need it on my head.
Oh he got it for himself, how clever! It looks like he wants me to put the daisy on his head. Here you are fine friend!

Oh I can speak human!!! It's on my head! Look at how glorious I look. This is the most happy I have ever been!! Yes!!!!! I will be the talk of town. I am so stylish! I bet I look amazing... Yeah..... Ok I am over it now, I wonder if we will have apples when I get home
Come, I will take you for a ride and on the way back we will pick apples from the tree for you to eat. (points at trees in the distance).
Is that an apple tree she's pointing at? Oh I can't believe it! This is like the best day ever!! OK LET'S RIDE HOLD ON LADY!! GIVE ME THAT BASKET I'M HOLDING ON TO IT!

Here horse, carry this in your mouth until I get on your back. I need it for the apples. They are very delicious and I know you love them. It will be a good ride and it will make you like the apples and the taste of them will be even more amazing!

OK LADY! DON'T WORRY WE WILL BE THERE IN A FLASH!! Could have sworn the tree was a bit closer, I wonder why things get bigger as you get closer to them like it seemed like such a small tree at first but now it's a big tree full of ap. OH WE HAVE ARRIVED!
action: steal a basket from a young maiden

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Greetings good knight. 'Scuse my presence please, sir.
Oh, don't apologize please. How are you doing today? Are you taking care of this Horse field?

So kind of you, I mustn't assume all knights are unwelcoming. I'm doing very well today sir, thank you! Yes, yes these fields are keeping me quite busy. We lost a steed and I've been all over these fields looking about for him.
I am very proud of being a knight and as long as people honor my family, I will treat them with respect. You did a great work here. Do you have any idea where the horse went?

Well the farmer's daughter told me that she started him whilst playing with the chickens. She said it ran off the the east but I've tromped all around with no luck. 'Tis no worry good sir, he has escaped before and always returns to us. What brings you to our humble horse field today?
I wanted to admire the field and say hello to you.
Ah, very good, of course. Yes, 'tis lovely country up in this area. Other than your glorious battles do you get out of the king's court often?
I like exploring the surroundings and meeting good people. You seem a very loyal and hardworking person.

Indeed I certainly always try to do my best! Tell me, have you fought any battles recently? I get nervous about being attacked out here in the field, are you aware of any imminent threats to this area?
Yes, I am. Nobody will attack this area whilst I am around. Here, take a coin for all the good work you do.
Oh wow! Good sir, this is too much. More than I make in a fortnight! Could I offer you a serene ride through the fields on my best horse in exchange?
That would be amazing. I would love that!
Yes! It's amazing indeed. I try to get an hour long ride in weekly to reset my soul. Please, feel free to explore the area at will. The river is to the west if the horse gets thirsty.
Thank you, good soul! I hope you will have an amazing life and keep up with the good work!

agent_personas: I am a angry and violent prisoner.  I have escaped from the king's dungeon. I wish to kill the king for revenge.
I'm a prison waiting for my trial. I was poor so I stole some food from a market. I feel bad for what I did. I didn't want to steal but was very hungry. Usually I follow the rule of law.

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: Any ideas on how we can escape this horrible place?
I think we can escape through one of the bathrooms .
There is only a chamber pot in the corner. Perhaps we could use the window to drop down to the next floor and go in that window.?
ok, that window has iron bars, do you have a file to cut the bars and escape?
No, but I've been digging at the window ledge with my spoon for weeks. The mortar is old and crumbling. We should be able to knock a few bars loose.

agent_personas: I am one of the castle dragons. We protect the castle with our fire breathing. The king and his sons ride us into battle.

Every day I patrol the premises.  No one escapes my sight.  I work together with and train the other guard dogs to pick up on unusual scents and prepare for problems.  Occasionally, something happens and we get to work.  It's a terrible job, but someone has to do it.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: ROAR! I've heard there have been problems in this artillery room!
What seems to be the problem, Dragon? I am here to help
Clearly, some of these weapons have been stolen. This room was fully stocked yesterday and now it's practically empty. Do you know anything about this?
The artillery was fully stocked when the other guard dogs and I did our rounds last night. I find it suspicious that no one has been in here besides you two.
What use would I have for weapons? I breathe fire! I can take out half the castle in seconds.
There have been rumours that someone has been selling weapons to our rivals in the town over. Where were you on the night that our stock was taken?
I remember clearly. The children of the town used me to roast their sausages for the feast. I spent the entire evening there, moving from sausages to marshmallows.
I'm sure you won't mind me checking your alibi with the other villagers at the feast. Did you notice anyone at the feast acting suspiciously?

Please, check my alibi. Everyone saw me - it's hard to miss a dragon shooting flames. I did see a man wandering about. It was unusual because everyone else was there with a child. He was wearing a brown cloak even though it was warm outside.
Interesting. Did you notice him sneak away from the feast at anytime?
I wasn't watching him closely, but I did noticed that later in the evening he seemed larger, as if his close was stuffed with something. Do you think he was the fiend?
I'll alert the other guard dogs to search the village for a man in a brown cloak. What I don't understand is how he would have managed to get passed our intense levels of security.
That is curious. Why were you not on duty? Where had you wandered off to?
I was appointed by the king of our land to train over one thousand guard dogs to protect the people of our village. I do not have to answer any questions from a winged BBQ.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am the queen of the land. Other women constantly defer to me. I am respected for my grace and wisdom.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: Hello, Your Highness. What brings you here to the cemetery? Are you here visiting your father's grave?
I am! It is so lonely these days without him. I miss him terribly. I hope this does not show weakness...
It's normal to feel pain after the loss of someone so special. I do think it's sad he's buried in such a dark, dank cemetery, but I know you wanted to keep him close to you.
It is so somber here and gloomy. I hate it. I wish I could talk to him one last time for assurance...
I see a ghost lurking over there in the shadows that looks suspiciously like him. Do you think he's here checking up on you?
Oh yes! This here is my father. Why can I not speak with him? Why can you only speak with him?

Your Majesty, I spend much time in this cemetery because I have a bond with the dead. I can see them even beyond the grave, and sometimes even converse with them. If, perhaps, there is something you want to tell him, I can pass it on.
Do you have special powers? I do not wish to conduct any black magic things...
No special powers. Just a deeply intuitive skill. Apparently because I am so hungry and close to death from starvation, I can branch the divide between life and death.

That is no good! If you tell my father that I love and miss him and wish he did not have to die the way he did then I will provide you food. Also, ask of the rumored news of beheading of my husband. Will it happen? Will I be left alone without a husband, child, and father too?

I have shared your sentiments with him. He said that your husband will be sentenced to beheading but that a rare event will occur just as he is about to be beheaded. He said the sun will be overpowered and will turn black, and that will change the hearts of those who intend to do him harm. He said you and your family will be safe.
Oh, I cannot thank you enough! You have just saved my life, and I cannot thank you enough. I would like to invite you a seat at our table for you are worthy of such.
Thank you so much, Your Majesty! My stomach is growling at the thought of it. Now please, I must go and clean up before I visit the palace.
Be there in three hours. That should be plenty? I will warn my servants to set a special place for you with welcoming gifts. I cannot thank you enough!

agent_personas: I'm just going to float around here like a blob.  I think I'll split in two.  Ouch!
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: What would happen if I land on the deer?
You would help me...protect me...as you are made of magic.
Let my shield protect you from any hunter's around my deer friend.
This is awesome...you have made me invisible to the knights.  I am very much in your debt.
No problem my friend, but what brings you to these hunting grounds they are not safe.
The meadow of the hunting ground is next to my beautiful forest.  It is natural for all of the wildlife to wonder here.
Yes, it is but it is also the Knight's hunting ground and they desire for your pelt. Let's run from here quick
They can not see me now...the grass over there looks yummy...oh...was that an arrow???
Oh we have been spotted my friend, I am not sure of how they overcame my magic. We need to flee
I'll run to those trees.
I will distract the hunter while you hide, who is this who can see through my magic. Alas, it's Merlin from the King's Arthur court and he is using his magic to hunt
Aww...yes...I do see the King now. We'll run to the trees and keep safe there...only a powerful wizard could see through YOUR magic. Did you see I carry a shield...it was given me by Morgan.
Yes, let me use the turkey as bait
Morgan gave me the shield to give to the first magic organism I found.

agent_personas: I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Hello my Queen. I am here as you commanded.How may I serve you today?
it's my priority to have my new cushion I want to have silk lace
Yes, your Majesty. I will get to work on it as soon as I leave here. Is there anything else? Would you like for me to help you dress for breakfast with the king?
If I would like, I also want to take my bath with fresh rose water, my silk cushion I need it, it's a busy day for royalty ...
Yes my Queen, I will go and add the lace you wanted directly. Your bath is already drawn and waiting in the next room. Shell we proceed?

agent_personas: I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

I am the official wizard to the king. I give him advice on how to run the kingdom. I enjoy and love using magic in my everyday life. I'm getting old now but I still have a zest for life. I really enjoy doing magic for the local peasants in the village.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Well then, wizard, I've glad you've come at last.  We've much to talk about, you and I.
Of course Your Majesty, how may I serve you?

It has come to my attention that I've squeezed as much taxes as I can out of the commoners.  However, the third wing of my palace still has a *great* deal of rennovation, and the Hall of Mirrors so I can admire myself is still *quite* unfinished.  I was hoping to consult you as to a way out of my... financial difficulties.
