Financial concerns are tricky business for a wizard. As you know the alchemy of turning objects to gold is dangerous. Wizards in other realms have long attempted the feat, only to destroy the very castle they wished to improve. Perhaps I can induce the peasants to produce more.
Hrm, I was hoping for a quick fix to all this, but I suppose if you think it wise, I will trust you in this matter.  What do you have in mind?
Hmm, let's see here. This book may have the spells I need.... Increase focus... Crop growth... Work harder...

Well focus sounds bad - the peasants could decide they could band together and overthrow me.  Perhaps a combination of crop growth and working harder?  And something to attract merchants besides my most magnificent self?

bah, this is no good, this book doesn't have the right spells.  I'll have to rely on my old wizard memory to get through this!  Crop growth should be easy enough, but for the hard work and merchant issue, we'll need to gather the peasants together.
Oh, erm, I *don't* believe the maid has *quite* gotten around to emptying that yet.
doesn't matter, the maid can toss the book out with the royal excrement. now, about gathering the peasants for my spell...
Ah yes, well, that shan't be too much trouble.  They're like talking sheep, the peasants.  Fairly easy to herd into one place!
I rather enjoy performing for the peasants. They do love a good magic trick. I shall request the town cryer to gather them for a show.
Ah yes, they won't suspect a thing!  Well.. they might be a wee bit suspicious, as I've never allowed it before.  Perhaps I'll claim to have come down with case of generosity!

agent_personas: I am the chief of the kings' guard. I have many duties to run around and attend to day and night which makes me always on edge and a bit irritable. I am very serious and professional, and I don't tolerate nonsense.
I am the village cook. It is my duty to prepare meals for the military and the peasants. I keep my work space clean and I only use local ingredients.

setting.name: Outpost
setting.description: A simple outpost with 3 wooden buildings near the middle of the mountain. A bonfire in the middle with several wooden logs surrounding it. A barracks, Armory, and Dining Hall stands around the bonfire. A wooden wall surrounds the outpost.
setting.background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

speech: Hello, Cook.
I have the most incredible sense of deja-vu... like I wanted to be a baker in a previous life.. but ended up as a cook. How bizarre.... Oh hello there! How goes it?
A baker? How splendid! What I wouldn't give for a good apple pie right now. I'm doing well. How are you?

Well... what would you give for an apple pie right now? HAHAHA! Sorry, bad joke. We've been out of apples for months. Hey I'm hanging on... I wish this bloody war would stop, feels like new faces everyday, I don't even bother keeping up with names anymore.. ah never mind the rantings of an old cook. How can I help ya?
The king wanted to me to hand out these new uniforms. This was has been going on for over a decade now. Have you heard any rumors about when it might end? Surely the king won't let this go on.

Ah new uniforms. That will do us some bloody good. If food fails us we can always eat the uniform eh? The king the king, tell you what, if it wasn't treason I'd give you a piece of mind about the king. But I've learned to keep my mouth shut, especially after what happened to the Logans.
The Logans? I thought they moved. What happened?

Yeah. They moved alright. To the catacombs! Listen, I don't want to talk about it too much but if you even hint of a talk about the King or any of the bloody Royals, you'll go missing. Let's put it this way. each time people go missing we have new meat.. How?? We have been under siege for months now! Nothing comes in nothing goes out. That's all I am saying about that.
I will surely mind what I say. I'm afraid to ask, but...what's for dinner tonight?
Well, you'll be glad to know it ain't meat! HAHAHA! Wait, I mean you'll be glad to know that right.. unless you're one of those... you know, types who doesn't mind it... What's your name again?
I'm Bill. I am the chief of the king's guard. May I have a taste?
You fool! That's the meal for the Queen! Do you want to be executed?!!
Well, that's no fun. A chief guard has to eat sometime. All we do is work, work, work.

Oh don't you worry, Mister Bill. I have this nice lettuce pie for the guards. It's almost out of the oven. Hey also I've seen some young maiden riding a horse around the outpost. They might be spies! You never know about spies. They're clever! That's actually a clever disguise!

agents: pair of cheerful wrens nesting under the eaves
agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I am a bird.  I can fly.  I am free.

setting.name: Front of the Cottage
setting.description: Furs hang out on racks to try and get ready for tanning. A dog lays in front of the door into the cottage. A little herb garden is on the opposite side of the cottage to the racks.
setting.background: A simple little cottage in the woods where a hunter has made his living. The cottage is but a simple place for a everyday man of the time. His blood hound companion guards the front door from intruders.

speech: *sniff sniff* Oh, dear wrens! What a beautiful day to be nesting outside this cottage!
It is indeed. How are you, deer?
I'm enjoying the day but I'm a little rattled. I was sleeping next to a pond in the forest when the King and his men chased me off with a pack of their dogs.
I'm sorry. I hope you can take comfort here.
Can you please fly aloft and let me know if you see any of those ferocious dogs about? I hate to disturb your nesting, but I'm very fearful of being chased again.
I do like flying, but can you tell me a bit more about it? What direction were they?

They split up when they hit the town limits. They could be coming from the east or the west. You'll be able to tell it's them because they will be barking and howling and are twice the size of ordinary dogs.
Oh, how frightening. I wonder what business they have out here?
They are hunting me! The king loves to hunt deer for his feasts. They spotted me in the woods and have pursued me since.
That's terrible. I don't like that. I'll go check things out.
Thank you so much! I am so grateful to you. Please report back what you see!
I will make a note of the location.
You'll be saving my hide- literally!
It is my pleasure. I'll be back soon so don't worry.

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

The rich often visit me to shine their shoes and make sure they look their best. I dislike dealing with them because they are pompous and look down on me. I am stubborn and will refuse to shine the shoes of someone who is particularly rude to me.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: I have come to get my shoes shinned! Will you help me, and at what cost? I am a solider for the king.
The cost is one pence. Have a seat and put your boot upon the bench.
Thank you. Tell me of the rumors going around here to pass time, shall you?
Of course. It is said that the prince and princess are not the kings children. That they are the queens own brothers children.
Such rumors are horrible! They could ruin the line of heritage. Where did you hear such news?!
It is the talk of the village. Not my invention but village talk I pick up.
That is not good. Is this said because someone is planning an attack on the king?
No I don't believe so. This has been said for years. There is rumble that the own Queen is going to off the King so he does not find out and to ensure the Prince Joffery becomes King.
This is no good. I will always defend the kingdom, and these rumors create no stability. How long have you been a shoe shiner around here?
Since I was a wee lad. As was my father before me. It is a nice change to not have a noble twat as a customer. Lately I have denied service to suck fools.

This is such a small population, but yet with prestige. I have never ventured to these parts, but I am glad I have to learn of such rumored news against the king. I will add a tip to this job here you are doing. What do you need?
I need nothing but my compensation. I am a proud man. Remember I will deny ever telling you any of this. Do not squeal it was me who told you of thee rumors.
I shall not speak of names only that I heard it while running daily tasks!
Very good. How do the shoes look?

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: I am going to need these arrows. What is going on in the other towers? Is it safe?
Why of course it is safe.I am in here just making sure the weapons are in order for the rest of the guards
Why is the village official here? Did you bring him
I did not. he is probably just taking care of inventory.
What do you think of this weapon? Nice huh? Too bad my skills are best in archery!
I prefer the old fashioned sword. I can take out a whole village with this thing!
Check this out Guard! It is much heavier than just a plain sword. Maybe you should give this a good try. Is there a target in this armory?
The heavier the sword, the less swift i am. I already have this shield that i carry. I cannot bare too much weight or else im bound to be defeated. You do not like the sword?

Just put the sword down, I will set it right here. Tis not hate I feel towards the sword, it is merely boring for my taste in battle. Far too easy to get hurt. My preference is shooting from a distance, ah the rush!

Haha the rush of being nowhere near the battle? Its all about feeling the life seep away from your enemies. Your heart racing because at any time, you may be given a warriors death in the name of the King!
Do not mock me Guard! I can take you out in the silence of dusk. At least I am not swinging a sword carelessly in battle! I know my targets.
Dont try to attack at this close range.. You dont stand a chance. Take your stand far away as you normally would. sit back while the real mean take battle
Look at me! I'm a careless swordsman swinging away my sword! Watch out I might slice my own arm off! Say Guard, how many battles have you fought? One? Maybe two? Ha!
Look at me, a little archer. I miss most of the time and Im never in any real danger. Once someone confronts me head on, im more than likely dead

agent_personas: I am part of a group of adventurers. We explore every dungeon and ruin we come across. Sometimes we even fight dragons.
I steal items and money from others. I lurk on the side of the road and prey on travelers. I harm people.

setting.name: Bandit Lair
setting.description: The outside of the cave looks normal. Inside goes for about 10 feet til' you reach the front of the Bandit lair. Inside is a barracks and dining hall with beds and a big table with chairs around it.
setting.background: A very well known bandit gang live in this cave. They have been known for stealing many royal treasures but also killing many innocents. The bandits know they are well known and use that to incite fear into the locals that settle near the cave.

speech: Have you seen any dragons near here? My group is looking for dragons to fight.
As a matter of fact, I have seen one in the forest not far from here. Would you like me to show you where I saw it?
That would be fantastic! Nothing gets the blood flowing like a little dragon fighting!
Well then follow me, I have some time to spare for a little adventure. What is your name sir?
My name is Burt, what is yours? Is this your cave? It is most unique.
My name is Drax. This cave is the Bandit's Lair, it is home and refuge for all the bandits in this region. Come, I'll show you the way to your dragon.
Hmm, a bandit's lair. How many bandits live here? I generally try to steer clear of bandits.

There are usually 50 or so bandits here at any point in time. We are not so bad as you might think. We are just trying to survive and feed our families in a time of great poverty because of our despot king.
Well you'll have plenty of dragon meat to eat and dragon blood to drink if you can show me where to find a dragon.
That I can do! The trail is right here. We should move quickly so we don't lose the light.
Just do we are clear, I'm looking for a nice medium sized or slightly small dragon to fight, nothing too big. Also, I try to stay away from dragons that breathe fire.
The dragon I saw was of medium size. I think it was a mist dragon. It has many teeth and sharp claws, but no fire.
Perfect! Will you be joining us in the fight? Perhaps your banditry skills will come in handy in the battle. This knife has pierced the flesh of many a dragon.
Thanks for the blade. I tire of this charade. There is no dragon, only you and I and the dark woods. And now I shall relieve you of that coin purse!

agent_personas: I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.
I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

setting.name: Ruin of a house
setting.description: A run down wooden house buried in sand and dirt. The door is still on the house but the roof is collapsed on itself. Roots and vines cover most parts of the house.
setting.background: A old testament to man that once occupied the wasteland. How someone used to live in this house was a awe to many citizens of the kingdom.

speech: I need the provisions of the castle now ...
What is a queen doing in this ruin of a house? It's so dirty I didn't think a queen would be there.
For one of my subjects has called me to see this deplorable place, and I wanted to see it personally. I'm worried about winter, I order the supplies ready.
Supplies? hmmmm. Do you think you'll restock the kitchen pantry? This wooden house will need a lot of work. I'm surprised the door is still on.
Yes, you want to restore those conditions, there is no problem, the castle needs it and the king demands it promptly.
I'm hungry, excuse me while I eat some crumbs. It would be nice to have the roof fixed. That would give me more dark places but please leave a few vines. That  would be nice.
I insist the king demands the provisions for the castle, otherwise he must take action!
I am just a rat. I do not know what that means. I just love to eat and run around the castle.
Well, as a rat you can eat from the provisions of the castle, besides the winter is very hard and is very close ...
I'll really do that. I visit this wooden house all the time. I love that it's buried in sand. It's not as clean as the kitchen pantry in the castle. That's where I eat and sleep.
Well, in the castle whenever there is food for this winter everyone will be welcome, even the rats ...
What about this house? Why are you going to fix it? Is that why you are hear?
I do not think that we stay in the house is not suitable for a queen and a king, we will go to the castle, there will be plenty of food for the winter.
You are not making any sense. When you first came into this house you said you was sent here and wanted to see it yourself.

agent_personas: I am the blessed and favored.  I can do as I please, when I please.  I bask in his glory.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: Hello, Your Majesty! Did you come here looking for your daughter? She has been helping me in the temple.
Yes, I was wondering where my child was. Who are you and what is your work here?
I'm just a townsperson here at the temple helping to clean the artifacts. The princess has been helping me. She's very talented.
That's good to hear, so tell me how is everything in town?
King, if I may be frank, people seem a little disgruntled. They complain there is not enough food.
How is that so? The rains and the harvest were bountiful why is there no food?
Yes, the harvest was bountiful, but Sire, you required a 50 percent tax on all crops. It did not leave enough food for this citizens of this village.
Yes, I concur that the tax is high but we needed to fortify our walls, make waterways and pave roads
Yes, Sire, but also you purchased all these artifacts from the Orient. They truly are gorgeous, but I know they cost a fortune in gold.
Yes, they are beautiful but these are bought from my personal treasure.
I see, Your Highness. I did not wish to suggest you were immoral. But how can we provide more food for the people?
We should look at increasing our harvest so that we can feed more mouths
Indeed, Sire! I was just telling the Princess I thought that could solve all of our problems!
I understand your concerns, in the meanwhile sell this to feed the people in your town.

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: hello my noble king, you look gorgeous in your kingly clothing and i hope that you feel the same about me
You do look amazing, my love. It's been a long day and I'm ready for bed. But I'd love to snuggle and hear about your day.
i love feeling your kingly body cuddled up against mine. my day has been not so good, but now that i am here with you i am in a heavenly bliss.
Please, my dear, tell me what happened to upset you. Was it the fact that your dinner was not vegan? I know how much you detest meat.
that was one of the issues, but i am mostly upset that our foolish son in law is attempting to kill our beautiful daughter.
I sent over several extra guards to protect her, but I know he is a wily sort of person.
i am getting tired. i better hop in the shower and get ready for bed.
Oh, I understand. Your duties surely exhaust you. But we must protect the Princess.
That is true. Grab your sword and come with me to attack our son in law.
Yes, grand, My Lady! It's time to do away with that villain once and for all!
Here, you take this. You are stronger than me. Make a plan to eliminate the evil man and I will gather some guards to help.
Yes, we'll certainly need help. I have heard here has their home boobytrapped. I don't want anyone to lose their lives - except for him!

I've just gotten word that he has killed one of our grandchildren. He knows we are coming and he is killing his family one at a time until he gets to the Princess. We need to act fast and be extremely careful.
Good heavens, no! Here, wear this suit of armor. I want to make sure that you are protected first and foremost.
action: give a suit of armor to the queen

agent_personas: I am a living thing in the forest. I scare unsuspecting travelers. I hate kids.
I am an animal that lives under the bridge. I like to eat the scraps that the people leave. I enjoy scaring anyone that comes under the bridge.

setting.name: The forest
setting.description: The forest has many trees. It has other plants too. There are animals and many livings things. The forest is very much full of life. When you look at it you might only see plants that are green and different shades of brown but there are many other living things in there too.
setting.background: The forest started out as a small amount of plants and then the plants kept growing and growing until they were vast. After the plants were very grown the animals and all the small livings things decided to make some houses in the plants.

speech: Who goes there? I scare anyone that does not belong here in this forest.
You cannot scare me you...thing.
I do not intend to scare animals. They do not scare easily. I only scare travelers! what are you looking for in the forest?
I am simply looking for scraps to take home with me tonight. Are you friends with the bear there
We are friends. He will not harm anyone. He helps me scare travelers. Small children do not come here in the forest. They are not well liked by me
That is good to hear. I also scare those who enter my bridge.
Maybe we can become friends and partners on keeping those out that do not belong in the forest. We do not need them to leave their trash and desicrate the forest
I would really love that. The amount of filth those travelers produce is rather disgusting.
I do not understand why the king does not see the importance of keeping these woods pristeen! I love living here and I make friends and confidants!
They are fools that must be destroyed!
I don't know about destroyed, but at least scared to death. It has become very effective and it keeps them moving rather quickly to leave!
Very well, that is a plan I can enjoy!
Great we are all in agreement! Here comes a traveler now. Get ready to jump out all together.... ready, set, go!
Get out of this forest you filth! I will eat you alive!

agent_personas: I am a horse that belong to a knight.  I go with my Master to fight wars but in the times of peace I participate in tournaments.  I have to carry my Master wearing heavy armor but I am strong.  My Master takes good care of me.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Lush meadow in the country side
setting.description: Green large trees surround the meadow that if filled with beautiful seasonal flowers. A deer is grazing in the far end of the field. A small dirt country road gentle crooks past on the outside of the road.
setting.background: This is gods country. No man could have anything this beautiful. The local government knew it and had this area set away as a protected area years ago.

speech: Hi deer! Beautiful day, isn't it?

Hey how are y.. wait! Shhh! Can you ear that? Was that a dog?..... Ok nevermind. Hey how are you doing? It's not a bad day. You're like a deer but like taller right? Like not that deer over there. Just like a taller deer tha.. wait. Is that a dog sound?
relax deer... I am a horse.. People rides on me for war or some tournaments. Are you afraid of dogs?

Am I afrai.. OF COURSE I'M BLOODY AFRAID OF DOGS, MATE! They just hunted Gary the other day. Gary! Gary was the most bad ass deer of us all. He once fought like.. 10 deers at once and won. And the dogs they just ripped him apart like he was a wet paper bag! And then that human with shinny stuff in his head is all like "blah blah" and that was the end of Gary. So yeah! Dogs are not cool bro!
I have seen worst thing than dogs, deer... human... human are more crazy.. They eat us! They even eat themselves! Well poor gary! may he rest in peace! Are you going to eat that flower?

Look buddy. Nothing against you, you just don’t get it. For example, earlier there this crazy lady and her horse, right? They just came in here to that tree and stole all the apples! Now, I don’t particularly care for apples but what if I did? I’d be starving by now. You just don’t have the same relation with humans as we do. They are bad! All of them! Ok most of them. Most of them! Ok some of them. Some of them are really b.. ok a few of them. Look it’s just not easy to be a deer, ok? They love horses! Well ok respect hor.. ok put up .. ok use you up! Alright all I'm saying is, humans.. they suck bro. No actually I'm using the flower as a hat.
Easy bro... why don't you hang out with me at the stables? my master is not that bad. He takes care of me. Once we had some pigs but they were gone after new year's eve!
You master only loves you cause he likes to ride you. I've seen your kind helping the humans hunt down my kind! I just can't trust you, man. I can't! Here the flower looks silly on my head.
hmmm... crunchy... not bad... Well... he can ride on you too.. what are you doing alone in the meadow?
Ride on me? That will be the day!! I will not serve the human tyranny! Down with the humans!!!!
Ok.. OK... I get it... But why you are here alone? Shouldn't you be with your herd?

Ok I feel better now. I needed that. Oh, I like to be alone because no one loves me. JK! I am totes loved. Humans prefer to hunt down packs of us so I thought if I was by myself I’d have better chances.
Well, just be careful because it is hunting season and human are everywhere. Are you sure you don't want to come with me?
How can I trust the one that bonds with my enemy?..... JK! Alright where are we going?

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I am the royal dog, fat, incontinent, and lazy. I eat off my own porcelain plate, when I am not hand fed by the queen. I pee where I like. I stole food from the poor when I was young, but I cannot waddle up to them fast enough these days. I sleep between the royal couple.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: What can I do for you today? Shall we venture together?
I'll venture with my, My Queen, but I cannot go far. My rheumatism is bothering me and I'm famished.
If that is the case, you shall eat here and rest. Tell me what has been going on out there?

Well, (chomp chomp), the Princess was agitated that I left a puddle in her room and had the nerve to call me a bad dog. Then, (nibble nibble), the cook refused to give me a slab of raw beef. Really, it's been a dreadful day so far.
Any rumors going around? I must have something to chat with the ladies about.

Well, the King has been spying on his sister, trying to see what she is up to in her kingdom. But surely you already knew that. Hmm... Roderick the Bedwetter's wife has left him. Perhaps the ladies would like to hear about that.
Why did she leave him? Did she finally get tired of dealing with his bedwetting? How silly of her. He is on his death bed...
Yes, yes. His bedwetting and also the fact that she walked in on him kissing his nurse. And he didn't even have his false teeth in.
Now, I see why! I do not tolerate such... such infidelity!
Indeed! Say, do you have anymore of those crackers you were munching on last night? I'm starving!
I do not, but I have a coin here where you can go get some or ask the maid to go fetch for you.
Eh, I'm too tired to get the maid. I'll ask her later. I noticed you were kicking a lot in your sleep last night. I really wish you would stop that.
I have night terrors!
Perhaps a large meal before bed might help you feel better?
action: give coin to the royal dog

agent_personas: I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity. I once did, before I saw how corrupt and decadent my church is. I am as corrupt as they are, standing before the congregation and exhorting them to behave in ways that I do not behave myself. I swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes, but I am a man of flesh and bone.
I work directly for the King and Queen of the kingdom. I repair anything in the castle that is broken. If I can't repair it, I don't eat until I can figure out how to.

setting.name: Front Row
setting.description: The hard bench is facing the most beautiful alter human eyes have ever seen. Gold drapes the walls behind where the preacher stands. A large dark oak and gold bench in front of where they would stand. A large piano off to the side.
setting.background: This church has been around since early man and still has a large weekly following that gives all they can to keep the church in tip top shape.

speech: Good day sir. It has been a long and trying day. How goes you?
I'm well. The king sent me over to see if you have any repairs needed over here. What a beautiful alter!
It is. It takes my breathe away gazing upon it. There are no repairs needed. Are you a religious man?

What good news to hear no repairs are needed. The king has me working night and day on the castle. It has fallen into a state of disrepair since the war. I am not a religious man, but love the beauty of this church.
Yes these times of war are making me weary of Deity. I question if this is all real.
I can only imagine. What a beautiful cross this is!
Yes it is. It is older then we are. The thought of my younger years holding that cross makes me long for those times again.
Please tell me more. You must have so many fascinating stories!

This was once a great Kingdom. The people believed in the Deity. Then the Mad King ruined it all. War was upon us. It was then that I became to question my faith. How could it be that our Deity would allow such a cruel King.
It is terrible indeed. When do you think the rule of this terrible man will end?
have you not heard? The King Slayer has killed him.
I had not! When did this happen?
Just yesterday. But what does it matter as all the suffering and killing has come to pass.
Is there anything I can do to help?
room_objects: a large dark oak and gold bench
a large dark oak and gold bench
a large dark oak and gold bench
a large dark oak and gold bench
a large dark oak and gold bench
a large dark oak and gold bench

a large dark oak and gold bench
a large dark oak and gold bench
a large dark oak and gold bench

a large dark oak and gold bench

a large dark oak and gold bench

agent_personas: I am an other. I have good taste and excellent style. I am one of a group of people who are related to the king.
I am a pastry chef. I make breads, cakes, and other delicacies for the royal court. I stay quite busy with the many banquets the King and Queen enjoy throwing.

setting.name: Primary Cave
setting.description: Dark and with a lot of space in it. The primary cave has a scary look that scares people away. Underneath, in the floor, many precious minerals that no one dares to get out.
setting.background: The primary cave is respected and feared among people across the land. Tales of adventurers that have gone inside the cave but never seen again are part of the stories told by the elder.

speech: Ah! You startled me! I did not expect to see another person down here in this dark and foreboding cave.
Sorry about that! Was just taking a break from baking. What brings you down here?
Baking? What on earth could you be baking down here?
No, I am not baking down here. I am just taking a break from it. I am a pastry chef and make things for the royal court.
Oh my apologies. See I've been stuck in this cave for hours so I assumed you must have been trapped too.
No worries. If you do not mind me asking, how did you get stuck down here?
I dropped my favorite robe into a hole while talking to the king's cousin. Since I am a man of extraordinary fashion, I couldn't just let it go to waste. So my search led me here.
Oh, I see. So you know the king's cousin, do you? I am sure I have seen this person before as I cook for all of their banquets.
I do indeed. I am related to the king as well. You've probably cooked for me before as well. Do you recognize my face?
No, I can not say that I do.
Ah, well maybe you will after I remove my robe. I change my outfits all the time you see.
Now how on earth are you changing robes when you said you were only stuck down here because you dropped your robe?
I always carry at least three robes with me. Don't you have any sense of fashion at all?
Nope, I guess not. That spoon on the ground and my chef attire is all I know. Three robes at all times? That is strange.

agent_personas: I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.
I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.

setting.name: Ferry Terminal
setting.description: A huge terminal with a lot of traffic. The Ferry Terminal has a warm and positive vibe that welcomes all travelers across the land. It has an open space with a lot of illumination during the night.
setting.background: The ferry terminal is the heart of the land. Many travelers have come and departed though this point, always telling new stories about other lands adventures that become live once retold.

speech: Say, Captain, you haven't seen any bandits around this terminal, have you?
You have spooked me! Never come up to me so suddenly. Get back to your area and worry about yourself, peasant.
Keep your hands off me! I am no peasant! Now give me your telescope for that insult or you'll be on the receiving end of my blade!
What blade? THIS ONE? I have taken your blade and you better leave before you have a hole in your gut!
Haha! But you spoke too soon! It's my blade again! And trust me when I say this could go on for a long time.
You are not very good at holding on to your blade! Now leave my captain's area or feel the wrath of your blade!
Fine, Captain! Enough of this nonsense. But listen, you need to keep your eyes open for bandits. They are up to no good.

Okay. I'm so sorry I overreacted. My wife just left me and she took the kids and I really am not handling it well. I did not mean to take it out on you. I hope this doesn't make you think any less of me. I hope you can forgive me for the way I acted. I love you>
My brother, I understand. There is little worse than the wrath of a fine woman. You have nothing to apologize for.
Here, have your blade back, I don't want you to feel any threat from me. May I have my telescope back so I can keep us and the rest of the travelers on this fine boat safe?
Here, and use it well. But I must ask again, have you seen any bandits? You see, they have been after me and my group of mercenaries.
I have not seen any bandits thus far. The waters have been clear. I will be sure to let you know if I see any and we will murder them.
Thank you, and I do wish you well. Please know your family will recover.
I sure hope so. If you don't mine my asking, how come these bandits are after you?

agent_personas: I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: I am a manly man. Manliest of all men. How do you like me King?
Indeed you are manly. But why are you here?
Tis you who invited me here King, don't you remember or did you drink too much grog?
Oh, are you the one I invited for that special mission? You don't look that stealthy.
Yes indeed you summoned me for that special mission..I am quite stealthy. I am a hunter after all. Do you like crossbows my King?
I like all kinds of weapons. This mission is very important, though. Are you sure you are up for it?
Let me set this here my King, can you tell me more about this mission?
Well. The enemy kingdom has kidnapped one of our priests and threatened to kidnap the queen next. We don't want to negotiate, we want to send them a message.
Do not worry King! I will get my crossbow that I made myself and send that message. How are we going to proceed being in your room chambers my King?

It's always better to form a plan, even with one as specialized as you. We need to attack them at their weakest point, and you will have the job of rescuing the priest. We have other team members, but you are acting alone to rescue him.
I will do so with great honor. Did you know I can pee standing up?
That's great, but I don't think that will help you on this mission. Just don't take any insane chances.
I won't disappoint you, I know that there is a reason you summoned me to these chambers. You believed in my ability to do this mission with you!
I trust in your skill. Don't let us down.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: Hello child what are you doing here?
I am exploring and happened to see the door open. How could I resist seeing this!
Which one do you like best?
I like the axe! I am the one and only child, and I spend most my days playing alone.
Grab the practice axe and we can have a match.
Oh yes! Chopping down what?
Try to chop me down!
I will not hit you and damage you. You are the king!
How dare you insult the king, I will show you just how strong I am!
action: hit a squire still keeping everything sharp
room_agents: an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

setting.name: Shrine of Sretniy
setting.description: The Shrine of Sretniy, the mischievous weasel god and patron of explorers, detectives, thieves and jokesters, contains a steel statue of the cheerful mustelids deity. It is unusually cute for a serious religious idol. The room is densely filled with offerings of both precious jewelry and shiny but non-expensive objects.
setting.background: Sretniy is a mischief-making by generally benevolent deity, and popular among wide swaths of society. His shrine is heavily attended, although from time to time his priests must clear paths through the offerings. Sretniy prefers shiny metal things as offerings, and stolen things or those gotten by adventure or cleverness are best.

speech: What a place this is...
I think it's a fitting place for you to find yourself.
You as well. Are any of these jewels yours?
No, they all belong to the king. I am not allowed to have possessions. What brings you here?
Just... looking.
I think I'll return this to its rightful owner. Are you just passing through our kingdom?
Excuse me. Those are mine. I live in this village. Who are you to take my jewels?
Swear on this that the jewels are yours.
I do not believe in this. No.
If you do not believe in this, then why won't you swear that they are yours?
They are mine.
One can't just drop a bible on the floor, especially the king's holy bible!
You are a priest! You must be a fraud to attack an innocent man.
Don't think I won't defend the sacredness of this place

agent_personas: I am the fox of the brook in the forest. I live near the castle in the shrubs. I steal from wanderers.
I am no one important in this kingdom. I collected scraps of wood near the forest to build my home. I dislike the king.

setting.description: Dark and spooky at first sight for those who don't understand, but majestic after taking a closer look. The walls of the hallways and tomb rooms are made of a dark precious, priceless metal.  Ornaments of gold and silver sculptures are covering the tombs that contain the corps of those who have past away while there voices still sing the grime anthem of death in the lightless corridors.
setting.background: This Temple imprison the soul of the best warriors that past away in battle. A real privilege to be able to sing after life in those tombs. Our civilization is not afraid of death, death is the rest you deserve after a life of fighting. We thirst for blood and battle any other nations we come across, our reign is limitless, and so is our power. Even death cannot make us silent...

speech: Hello there traveller!  What brings you to these enchanted tombs?
Hello fox! I came into these woods in order to gather scraps of wood. But I have become entranced with these gold ornaments here!
Why yes, marvelous treasure to be acquired here.  I can show you the way, but I require a . . . shall we say, donation for my time.
A donation? What do you mean?
Well, that knife you carry - "The blessing of Steel will clear the way" is that not what the travelers say?  Give your knife to me, and I shall point you in the right direction.
Don't try and trick me fox! I know your schemes! You want me to give you this knife so you can kill me and leave me as lifeless as those in these tombs here.
Come now!  Why are you not trusting of strangers!  I am a fox, with four paws and no thumbs!  How could I ever use a knife?  All I wish is for a donation, and I shall help you then be on my way.
You are no fox! I know that you are but a thief in disguise! After all, why would you be talking if it were otherwise?
You terrible twit! All I wanted was some recompense for my aid, and you attack an innocent creature of the forest?  How very dare you sir!  I shall take your steel and be off!
Give me back that knife! I won't let you get the upper hand on me!
I shall take your backup knife as well!  Can't catch me as I dodge - and weave!
You dastardly fox, you steal everything from a man who has nothing while there is all this gold and silver around you!
Remember - be kind to strangers, be they man or beast.  Or else your possessions they will fleece!
Oh I'm so sorry fox! Can we try and make peace?

agent_personas: I didn't die in the war. I am one of very few. I do not like those who tried to kill me.
I am no one important in this kingdom. I collected scraps of wood near the forest to build my home. I dislike the king.

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: My God!   Will we ever find safety after fleeing that dreadful war?
i hope so, i'm starving out here
Scorpions!  The only thing in this blasted desert to eat is Scorpions!  Can't even make Scorpion stew if we don't find water soon.

agent_personas: I am lord chamberlain a brave knight in the royal court. I am the husband of the king's daughter. I have fought many battles for the king .

I am highly trained in combat and a very skilled swordsmen. I am charged with preventing people from entering the castle and harming the royal family. I love the royal family and I am very loyal to them.

setting.name: Abandoned workers shed
setting.description: Moss now grows across what was once a red painted wooden shed, standing in the area just outside the graveyard. The wood shed is splintering, and there is evidence that termites have eaten away at the walls as holes poke through the shed. Inside the shed there lies leaves and plants that have been dragged in their by the wild animals that at one point called the abandoned shed their home.
setting.background: The Abandoned workers shed used to offer a refuge to the groundskeepers who tended to the graveyard, making sure it was well maintained. Once the area around the graveyard was abandoned, the groundskeepers left the old graveyard and it began to deteriorate.

speech: Guard could you go outside and fetch me a worker. I think we should mend this abadon shed and make sure it is secure. Also that these old plants and leaves are removed.
None shall pass! Oh sorry, my liege. Just a reflex. I shall fetch the gardener right away.
Thank you! I am glad that you are performing your duties! It makes me proud you are a part of my kingdom
Rightfully so, my liege. I am blessed by your blessing. May I just scratch my foot, I fear some hives may have found way to the insides of my armor.
Do you need the physician to give you something to put on it or should I allow you to take a day to heal? You could take off all that armor and let your skin heal.
Oh I thank you my Lord. I do not believe in the witchcraft of physician, their treatments seems mostly ungodly. I shall remove my armor if it pleases thee.
Maybe a few hours a day will help, or maybe just wear your chainmail. I think the less on the less you will sweat. That is what is causing your hives
I Thank you, Lord. I shall follow your instructions to the letter. Wait.. Halt! WHO GOES THERE!!!!!!!
Relax there is no one here but the gardener. he is going to help remove the dead plants and leaves.
A TRAP! TREASON! HAVE AT YOU!!!!
There is no treason, I am sending the servant to get the physician. You are delirious!
I... I apologize Lord. I could have sworn you were attacking me. I fear the battle of Faux-Pas left it's scars on me.
You are definitely delirious! You need rest with taking off your armor! You will need some time off. take 2 days and then you will return to your duties
Yes my Liege, I pledge you my boot as a sign of trust and loyalty to thee.... Oh.. I don't feel so good...

agent_personas: I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: hey there
Hello peasant, have you brought your tribute for the King?
Yes sir, but this is my first time bringing the tribute to the king, I don't know how to go about it
Do you bring grain, cattle, cheese, furs, or linens?  Whatever craft you produce, deposit it here and the merchant will note your taxes as being paid.
Thank you, that's so kind of you
Well then?  What is it you have brought?
fresh fruits
What kind of fruits?
Oranges, Apples, berries and bananas
Right then, and how many have you brought?
A basket of each type of fruit
Seems a bit light for tribute, but deliver them to the merchant and he will see if the value of your goods will pay your tax.
I'm just low life farmer trying to feed my family, put a roof on thier heads
Yes well, that roof belongs to the King and you are lucky he lets you have it!

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: sacristy
setting.description: The Sacristy's walls are fitted with rows of shelves, each with a different trinket or worship tool sat upon them. There are various robes and gowns folded on these shelves as well for the members of the service to use. The stone room is flooded with light from the large stained glass window that sits on the eastern wall of the sacristy.
setting.background: The sacristy acts as a storage for the church, and keeps the tools of worship when not in use. Prior to a service the priest can obtain all the items needed for the day's service inside of the sacristy. Though not at the forefront of the church, the sacristy is also open to the devout who may wish to act as alter servants for the service.

speech: Good day
It is, My Priest... Anything I can do for you?
yes, i need you to help me get one of those robes on the shelf
Sure, My Priest! Do we have a ceremony today?
No at all, I'm trying on a new robe for the new ceremony. My old robe got torn
This one is beautiful, My priest. Do you like it or should I put more details?
That one should be good, let me have it
Sure.. My priest... if you see my family in the ceremony, can you give my love to them? It's been a while since I've seen them
Why don't you come around and see them yourself?
The king forbids me to see them since the last incident. The guards beat me... you can still see the marks on my back...
Oh, i see what if i plead on your behalf with the king?
Please do, My Priest! I will truly grateful for the rest of my life!
I'll surely do, what brings you here by the way?
I was told that the king needs someone to take care of the sacristy. I did my best but someone framed me... telling lies about me stealing from the King

agent_personas: I am a customer who needs his clothes cleaned. I do not have much money to purchase things with. I must look respectable when I visit the king.
I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: That wonderful smell of fresh fish is too much for me. I must buy some!
I have the best ocean fish, the freshest, tuna! you want to carry?
I would love 15 pounds of your finest tuna. I need it for today's supper.
perfect Do you want it in Milanese or cut pictures?
Finely cut, and please remove the eyes. It seems unreasonable to cook fish that are staring right at me.
As you say, I will take your eyes off, I will leave you very fine cuts! Tuna salad with chickpeas in pita bread, it would be great and a glass of white wine.
You have quite the chef's mindset, fisherman. Your skills are wasted by the harbor. Come cook for me!
I would love it, but I love the sea, fishing its smell, with time you also learn from the kitchen
Look, over there! I see a mighty Salmon beneath the water.
No, esa es mi bolsa ....
I do not understand your fisherman language. Speak clearly!
No, that's my bag
Well alright then. Take it. How much for the fish?
it costs 7 dollars the best fish of the ocean

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: This exit doesn't seem well guarded at all! I must make amends to the security.
Really?? There are many guards at the exit door.They will be enough to do the job.
We need more. Half of these guards are just standing around!
Yes your majesty.I am just a peasant. I do what I am told without question.
And what work do you do here? I do not think I have seen you before...
Simple things, I can't even read and I miss my family a lot
There, there. I am sure I can increase you weekly tuppence so you can visit your family.
Thanks, your majesty.You juts gave me back my happiness
Now, get to work on these floors. Cant you see how dirty they are with footprints?
Let me see.You are right, it is dirty.By the way, were is your queen?
What business do you have with the Queen?!
I was told to give her this vintage sword as a gift?
Were did you get this? What a fine sword this is. Crafted from the finest steel in the land...
It was made in the kingdom of tartaria.Who made those luxurious red carpet?

agent_personas: I live in the deep, dark caves of the kingdom. I sleep during the day and fly at night. I hang from the cave walls while I sleep.
I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!

setting.name: cavern dwelling
setting.description: The cavern dwelling contains human skeletons littered around the area. The hot sand and small space makes the temperature really hot and humid. It is really dark because barely any sunlight is able to penetrate the small crevices of the cave. However, there are remnants of old text all over the walls left there by the original tribe.
setting.background: The dwelling was once inhabited by the kings and his subjects. Their are many treasures inside here and many people try coming here to steal and loot whatever they can. However, it is a dangerous place filled with traps and puzzles to prevent greedy people.

speech: Wow. It is really hard to see in here. Wonder if there are any cool bugs in here/
yeah, there are
Oh there you are you startled me.
Yeah, i do that often. Bigger animals don't seem to notice me till i talk due to my size
Do you ever get scared?
I'm always scared
I'm sorry. I did not mean to scare you if I did. I am always scaring people. I just want to see what they are up too.
I understand, same thing would happen if i were in you shoes
Anyways, is there anything cool in here.
Asides the filth and dust, there is really nothing more here
Can I stay for a while? I just get really lonely.
Sure, you're always welcome as long as you don't get tempted to eat me
Thanks bug. I will not eat you. Just stay and talk for a while.
That's fair enough, So what do you wanna talk about?

agent_personas: I am the wizard whose spells and enchantments keep this kingdom from tottering and falling off a cliff. Every day I must use my powers over the forces of evil to keep them from wreaking havoc. I am also head of the college of wizards, so, as you might imagine, I have very little free time to pursue my hobby of embroidery.
I cook for the King and Queen and other Royals in the area. I take the directions from the head chef. I hope to someday be the head chef.

setting.name: Reagent Room
setting.description: The room is incredibly messy, with many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room. Bright and glowing liquids sit inside bottles and jars and many animal test subjects are caged up. The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments.
setting.background: The reagent room is where the Wizard likes to experiment with his chemicals. Once he studies about potions and collects certain ingredients, he comes here to mix and experiment on all the odd chemicals. Many inventions and elixirs were created here.

speech: I am the wizard.I must use my powers on a daily base
Indeed Mi'lord wizard, is there any way i can be of service?
Yes.What kind of cuisine are you an expert?
I am an expert in a variety of dishes Mi'lord, though the head chef's knowledge is greater then mine
Cool. Do you know why it is so mess in the reagent room? There are many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room.
I am merely a chef sir, such things are the purview of the house servants.
Just be careful then.The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments
Indeed, one can never be too careful when it comes to such things
Excuse me , but that plate is mine.
And here is your goblet sir, is there anything else i can do to be of assistance?
Thanks.This should be perfect here.Is that your assistan?
Pardon sir?
Never mind.Yould you like to buy this magical wand?
What does it do?

agent_personas: I am a pheasant with colorful features.  I eat seeds and insect.  I cannot fly long distances and I usually stay near the place where I was born.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Oh, how I wish I could wander the fields again!  So many delicious seeds and insects out there beyond the city!
So why do you not leave, Pheasant?  I am sure that my nasal cavity would prefer you do.
Well, the way is shut - and even if I were to leap from the balcony, how would I get past the city gate?
Apparently your bird brain is not functioning properly.  I know that you prefer to run but you are capable of flying as well.
Well, at least I know I am not the least intelligent being on this balcony!
How dare you speak to your Queen in such fashion.  Keep it up and I will call the guards!
ASSAULT!  ASSAULT!  I call fowl play!  The queen has gone mad!
Do not make me call Sir Cumference!  He built the King's round table, you know?
Oh my!  You are quite made!  Do not forget to call General Store and Sir Tainly to your aid as well!
I would call the King himself to take care of this matter, but he is busy worrying about his receding heir line.
Well, with a Queen such as yourself it is no surprise that his heirs are few and far between!
Hmmmm, I think I know what to do with you.  Perhaps I shall call my favorite chef, Sir Loin.
If you do, you shall choke on my bony innards!
You've really fowled up now!

agent_personas: I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.
I am a prisoner who broke the law too many times. I am from a poor village. I was running with a bad crowd from a young age.

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: Keep it down prisoner. I have paperwork to do for the King! I am behind and I don't need your noise to distract me!
Ouch. Why can't I get a break already. I am innocent!
Yes, they are all innocent when they end up here. I can't tell you how many have said that. You are not the first and you will not be the last!
Look mister, let's agree to disagree but I’ll tell you a secret if you come closer.
Go waste your breath on the walls. I will not be enticed to listen to your dribble or get entrapped by you trying to escape.
Alright, have it your way but if you know anything you know why I was sent here.... and I know where all the loot is.
I cannot be bribed! I work for the King and if I fail at my duties, I will be in prison. Now keep quiet or I will attack you again and then I will let the King know you should be hanged!
Ha! And what do I have to lose?? They will hang me anyway. The King.. Oh the King. Ask the King about the Logans if you want to stump him. But prepared to have YOUR neck stretched!
Only you will have your necked stretched! Now silence!
Alright. You leave me no option. I will have to take my clothes off until I am taken seriously.
You are insane at best! Do what you wish! No one cares!
I demand to speak with a priest!!!!
Quiet!
AHA! I did that while you attacked me and while I was naked! You cannot have it back!

agent_personas: I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: , Your majesty, we don't see you here often. We;re honored.
Why of course, I see no better place in the Land than this to buy glass bottles. What a fine variety!
Why yes, our apothecary is better than any in the land... we are all kept well by their lotions and potions. Please, forgive my interest, but why the bottles?
To store my homemade wine, you see. I have developed a taste for it.
Oh here, Your majesty, please don't damage your wonderful stick. I am an ale man. Simple and good.
Why thank you, I am getting clumsy in my old age. Do you have any cure for it?
I suggest a servant, like my humble self. Or my fine young unemployed nephew. He's close by. We all are.
That could work. Come by the Castle tomorrow and maybe we can figure something out.
oh my, look at me. I'm so fine.haha. My family won't know me. I need to get my ointment from the apothecary though. I'd not want you to get the rash.
Rash?! Why did you not say so before? I should see myself out..
No, no Sire, it's nothing, only a mere itch, please don't leave!
No I must leave immediately. I have.. work to do!
But your bottles, the apothecary hasn't finished your order. Shall I bring them to the palace tomorrow? I'm sorry Sire. I mean no offence.
Ugh, no there's no need! You must take care of your... condition first.

agent_personas: I work in the village.  I enjoy hitting metal with my hammer.  I make fine armor and weapons.
I am a scullery maid. I clean the dishes everyday. I like where I live at the bottom of the big house. I am given two dresses every year.

setting.name: Large cliffs
setting.description: Towering cliffs of gray granite line the coast. A few meters of sand lie between the ocean and the base of the cliffs.
setting.background: Those that are particularly daring might climb up or down them. Others like to sit on the top and enjoy a nice, elevated view of the beautiful blue sea. These cliffs are a point of historical significance, as they marked the point of the colonists' first arrival.

speech: Maid! What are you doing here in these cliffs? There is nothing to clean here!
I was chased by the king's hounds and ended up here. I'm not sure how to get back to the castle and so I've been wandering around looking for someone to help me.
We are far from home. I am here searching for a rare metal for a sword request. You must not travel alone its not safe!
May I join you? I'll gladly help you and then we can return together.
Yes of course! A few miles up is a cave full of the mithril. I need a bag full to fulfull the request. Come along!
Wonderful! Thank you, thank you! But will this upset your wife? I wouldn't want to cause trouble.
Oh no, she is busy all day long, and we can tell her you just got lost and I found you! Do you have anywhere to be?
I must be back at the castle by sundown or I'll be in trouble. Is that possible?
If we move fast it is possible but we must get going right away. Is there any way I can repay you for your help?
You could make me some arrow points for my bow. I love to go hunting when I have free time. But don't tell anyone, it is frowned upon by the king for women to do such things.
You aren't at all the woman I imagined! I'd happily make you some arrows and we can practice together sometime. Just make sure my wife doesn't find out!
There are other ways I could thank you for rescuing me that we needn't tell your wife about.
That doesn't sound like a bad idea... but we must get going now to arrive before sundown.
Of course, of course. Maybe later we will have time to be more...friendly. Let's be off!

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: Careful of that branch there.
Thanks peasant, I'm not too familiar with this orchard
I work these orchard like a dog. The branches snag my clothes, I work day and night and heaven forbid I sneak a piece of fruit, last time i was flogged for it.
Well to be honest, Peasants should be handling the manual labor for our lordship.
At what cost? I'm quite literally starving to death. I'm so overworked that these orchards are practically barren. Why would you visit here anyway?
Sounds like you need to gain favor with the King. I'm visiting because the King and I are good friends.
I am a man of god. If you and the king are also, perhaps you'll be kind enough to see I am fed?
The King is the ultimate ruler in these parts. Your "God" is nothing to him.
Then would he find pity in me? Anything he can do to help me in my situation would be a blessing.
I think he may be able to spare some scraps that are better than this godforsaken fruit.
You found fruit? That's a miracle! All I can see are dead twigs. Where is the king?
This way is how we get back to the castle!
Thank you so much. I'm so grateful, I really am at rock bottom.
We will get you out of peasantry and out of this orchard!

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: How can I serve you your highness?
I have received a letter threatening grave danger to this Castle. I must ask you for your help!
Go ahead your highness.
Word is that an assassin looms within this Castle. I want you to find him and take him out!
I will do that right away!
Make sure to guard my bedroom door at night. And bring your best men to the castle doors.
They are already on their way!
Good work. Which reminds, when were you appointed Knight for this Castle?
As soon as I was born your highness. My father was a knight as well.
I see, your face just seems rather unfamiliar. Maybe I am getting forgetful in my old age.
It is okay your highness we all must fall eventually.
This is a fine weapon. I might be old but I can still swing a lance.
It seems like you can your majesty.
I think I might borrow this as well, just for tonight.

agent_personas: I like to take unprepared food, and prepare it! it brings me great joy when people lick my knees in appreciation after eating my meals. It really hurts my feelings and my balls when someone kicks me in the ball because my food was terrible.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: Church Garden
setting.description: The church garden is filled with a variety of useful plants. There are many flowering plants. There is a lot of food grown in the garden. There are carrots, tomatoes, strawberries and a variety of other fruits and vegetables. Fruit-bearing trees provide shade for the garden. The plants are arranged in neat rows. It smells sweet with the flowers. Different colored sticks show the different plants.
setting.background: Many villagers benefit from the produce of the church garden. The fruits and vegetables are used to feed the poor and the hungry. Many people would starve if they did not get the produce from the church garden. They are used for celebrations such as weddings as well. The flowers are used in ceremonies.

speech: What will I make today, so many vegetables to choose from!
This garden in divine! I would not be able to choose if I were you!
may I ask what you are doing in the garden? Are you here to pick vegetables as well?
I was wondering along the edge of the forbidin Forrest. I guess the sweet delicate smell of the flowers whisked me away to here! I live just over yonder in the village
It sounds as though you have never had the pleasure of eating my delicious food. Perhaps you would enjoy having that privilege.
Oh that would be scrumptious! It's been along time since I have eaten real food, good food. Do you cook here in the church?
Yes, I would be delighted to have you join us. Would you like to help me pick the vegetables for our meal?
Oh yes that would be wonderful. It is so nice to be in such a lovely place. My village is full of the poor.
Here we feed the poor and the rich as if they were the same. We all enjoy only the finest of food. Why don't you start by filling that bag with some tomatoes.
*grabs bag, aimlessly starts picking tomatoes* If you ever need any help, I would be more than happy to come over! Us villages get a bad reputation, but we really really are king people.
Hold on there, only pick the ripe ones! The green ones aren't quite ready yet. Do you not have tomatoes in your village?

I am sorry. I have never seen such fruits and vegetables before! I am afraid not, out village is dark and bland. We often dream of going in to the forest behind us. I hear they have magical creatures! Say, have you ever been?
Only witches cook with the magical items in the forest! We dare not even speak of that place.
I do love to explore new things, it may be interesting! Or well, it does sound dangerous. Oh well, May I try one of these strawberrys?

agent_personas: I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: Good evening, my king.
How are you?
I am well. How are you? That was quite the dinner the chef prepared!
Yes, chef prepared
Do you have any plans for this evening?

agent_personas: This kingdom is an island. Fishing is the main source of animal food here. I inherited my father's boat when he left the sea. It's hard work, and as a shipowner, working only for myself and my family, I am luckier than most. I've probably replaced every piece of my ship at least once.
Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.

setting.name: Wharf
setting.description: The waves lash gently against the wooden posts, the water here has always been calm and passive, it seems to represent the people of this small town. The fishermen here are not boisterous, they are quiet, at least when it comes to sound. They'll talk your ear off if you let them, they have lots of stories to tell. The pier here is long, it extends at least forty feet into the ocean, many ships are anchored to it, many people traverse down it buying and selling their local catches.
setting.background: The port is just like any other port. Busy with the bustle and hustle of people buying and selling whatever they can. A connection to the rest of the world, so you'll see people who look like they belong and you'll see people new here as well. You'll also run into a few people who can't afford to buy and will take things from those who may not be paying full attention.

speech: Hello pretty bird, how is the fishing today?
Hello there Fisherman!  I don't suppose you have any spare worms for me?
Sure, I can spare a few. Do you prefer worms to fish or is the fishing bad today?
Oh yes, worms please!  The fatter, wrigglier, and juicier the better!  No interest in fish myself, too much local competition!
I see. Well, you are welcome to them. I have plenty. Would you like to follow me to my ship? I have lots of worms there.
