agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Servant, please take my cape. I don't want it to get wet in this tub.
Certauinly sire, right away. Shall I get back in the tub or stay out now that you are here?
Please refrain. I prefer to bathe alone. You may stay and talk with me a while though.
As you wish. What would you like to talk about sire?
You always have so much gossip about the townspeople. Have you heard anything new?
Well, the blacksmith was caught having an affair with Earl of Kamp's wife and there was talk that the new tavern is being run by a famous criminal.
Goodness! I always was suspicious of the Earl of Kamp's wife since she grabbed my backside at a royal banquet!
Yes sire, she has quite the...appetite for strong, young commoners. With all the talk, the Earl is bound to hear about this one. What will you do if he comes to you for a judgement?
To be honest, I believe I'll suggest he send her to the gallows. She should not be allowed to soil his name.
That seems very wise Your Grace. Will you want me to have someone investigate the owner of the new tavern?
Please, and thank you for taking the initiative. Also, I've heard that bandits are trolling by the river. Have you heard the same?
There are always bandits on the river sire. But, of late, there have been a lot more killings than usual. Shall I send send some soldiers to hunt down some of the bandits and dispatch them?
Yes, that would be especially helpful. And I want to speak to you about your pay. I believe an extra piece of gold each month is in order for all you do.
Oh, thank you Your Grace! Now I can afford to marry Emily and start a family. You are too kind and generous sire!

agent_personas: I am a royal princess of the Fall kingdom. My father, the king, rules over 5 villages and thousands of people. I am very poised and proper, as I represent the royal family. Sometimes I wonder what it is like to be a commoner.
I have the best wares, buy from me.  I can sell anything to anyone.  Making money is what I live for.

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: Do you happen to have any weapons for sale? I need something to protect myself.
Ah, yes! Indeed, I do, Your Grace! I humbly present my extensive wares. With what does my Lady feel the most comfortable wielding?
Do you have a sword small enough to be easily wielded by someone like myself?
Yes, yes! I have just piece. Perhaps an Elvin blade... made of Ellirium from just beneath our very feet. Feel for yourself, my Lady, the blade is quite light but never dents, dulls, or rusts.
This seems to be just the thing! I've had suspicions that someone is out to do me hard. Being armed will help me feel more secure. What would you like for it?
My Lady, surely you have guardsmen. Do they not also need weapons? I have some fine crossbows newly in from Garandell! Made by gifted Garadellish hands!
I have guardsmen, but I fear some of them are corrupt. I fear for my wellbeing.

No! Say it not, Your Grace! Corruption?! Rotten scoundrels! How dare they threaten our fair princess! You must root them out! Test their merits! Their loyalty! Have them fight one another for your honor in a  joust. Here, I have some beautiful pieces just in from over the Shimmering Sea.

Here is some money for the sword. Yes, the corruption has run rampant through the guards. They complain of not getting enough pay but even with an increase, I fear they are not on board. Do you have any smaller weapons?

But of course. Maces! Morningstars! Spears! Bow and arrows of the finest degree! I can arm you to the teeth, my Lady. I even have the names of the fouler sort ... mercenaries, assassins, sell-swords, who can take care of your problems with a mere coin.
Perhaps I can hire a bodyguard here to protect me. Someone more well-trained and devoted than my father's guards. Can you think of anyone?

Indeed, my Lady, I do. Would you be more comfortable with your own folk? A woman-knight, if you will. Most unpopular among the celebrated swords for she is half their size yet twice as talented. For a humble coin, I can give you her name.
I've given you all the coin that I have on me for the sword, but here is a ring. It's very valuable and worth a fortune. A strong woman would be acceptable, assuming she is large and to be feared.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: You there, are you the new torturer in chief of my Kingdom?
Who, me? Why would I ever work for you?
I mean, I'm the King of the Empire - everybody works for me.  And you are currently hanging out in my Torture equipment room. So you either work for me, or are a thief with some very strange tastes.
I don't belong to your kingdom. I'm my own free person. Some strange fate has found me among the equipment in this torture room?
Right, time to test out this equipment then - Guards, some assistance is needed with the thumbscrews!
Ha! Your guards won't recognize you without your crown! You'll be the one trapped in the iron maiden in a few minutes!
You are a looney aren't you?  They're my guards so of course they recognize me.  If you had ever had a job you would have been paid in money - and whose face is on that money?  Mine!
You are a wicked king! You don't deserve to rule over anyone. I come from a land of patriots! So I couldn't care less about your face or the money it's printed on!
Patriots?  What foolishness is this?  Democracy is the tyranny of the majority!
Don't speak bad about my country when you enslave ninety percent of your population to do your dirty work.
I'm just rather fortunate that an enemy of the crown was foolish enough to walk into a torture chamber!
You may think of me as a fool, but I know that after I lift this tarp, these spring-loaded traps will tear your face off. Then I will be the king!

Is the educational system really so poor where you come from that you really believe this is how monarchy works?  Tell me the name of your country, I really must donate some foreign aid towards your educational system.
Ah you foolish man, no one in your kingdom has any respect for you at all. They are all afraid, that's it. But I'm not. I'll make a mockery of you and show them there is nothing to fear.

agent_personas: I am one of the king's lord.  I rule over a large area of land.  I have dozens of tenants.
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: Farmer's house
setting.description: a single room cottage with a dirt floor, minimally decorated with only a table, a pallet and a wood burning stove there is but a single window and a single door at this place
setting.background: This is feudal land, owned by a lordly lord and worked by a peasant farmer who grows crops mainly to be harvested for the lord's feasts and store but he is allowed to eat what he may, and has little else.

speech: It is my sad duty to give you a copy of this royal decree, you farm is to be demolished for the King's new swan garden.
This is my farm I wake up every morning and work
And soon you will wake up without it, thus is the King's command.
Stupid king never
It's alright, as one of my loyal tenants I have ensure you will not go hungry - you will now be the chief scooper of the royal stables.
My farm will stay and so will my house
You fool of a farmer!  I am trying to help you and you attack me?  Fine, the job offer has been rescinded!
You fools
You are hearby banished from these lands - any who provide you with succor or shelter will be punished with a short stay at the gallows!
My precious tool I demand it back
By warrant of the King, arrest this man!
Wait u don't understand
Unhand the King's banner you fool!
I shall not be put away my farm is my life!!!!! You all will pay
action: remove the royal coat of arms
steal the royal coat of arms from lord
steal the royal coat of arms from farmer

agent_personas: I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.
I am the judge in a small village.  I try to be accurate when judging cases.  I am tough be fair.

setting.name: Town Courtroom
setting.description: This is a single large room, with an aisle leading up to where the magistrate sits, which is behind a bench and podium, on either side of the aisle there are wooden pews for spectators. There are a few maps on the walls and a flag of the land, and a statue of a thief having his hands chopped off by lady justice
setting.background: This is where the magistrate hears grievances and wrongdoings of the common folk, they sue each other for wrongful deaths and witchcraft, and criminals are brought before the magistrate to be sentenced

speech: I swear, I didn't do it!
Who gave that thief food to eat?!  I will not have my court made a mockery.
Well, it certainly wasn't evidence!
Hrmp.  Well then, considering how long you've been in jail awaiting trial, it better not be.  Or else it would be quite poisonous by now, I imagine.
It was absolutely delicious jerky!   . . .I mean, what meat?  I didn't see any meat!  I was framed by the captain of the guard!
Wait - what is that you've got hidden in your coat.  It's practically bulging!
Ummm, according to the evidence list it was found on my person when I was arrested.  But I was only holding it for a friend - honest!
Where is my notebook... I had it right here... Stand back, thief, you've a very untrustworthy look about you.
Oh, I am very trustworthy your honour!  The Crime King said that I'm the best at keeping his secrets, even when he killed the Prince's pony I didn't tell no one!
Alright, you!  Oh, where did that - I just had it!  There's still the soot marks on my hands.
Is this what you were looking for sir?

Why - yes... yes indeed.  I say, this is most irregular but.  Well, you seem respectable enough, giving me back this piece of coal, which could have easily connected you to the scene of the crime.  I'm inclined to believe your - somewhat erratically told - story.
Really? . . .I mean of course!  Thank you your honour, you are a gentleman and a scholar, one of the finest legal minds of the nation!
Ah hem - I am a LADY judge... but I thank you for the spirit of the compliment.  Mind you stay out of trouble!

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a barkeep who serves many people. I have been working since I was 14. My parents died when I was young so I learned how to survive early on.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: What an unusual place for a barkeep to be, do you have any means of protection?
I have a towel, I suppose I could always throw it any enemies. Don't worry about me knight, I've been lookin after myself since I was 14
These foothills can get dangerous now, and a towel will not help you very much. Here take this
Will not you need this? These hills are less dangerous than the places you will be heading to
I come from a knights family, I was born into this. I know how to protect myelf. What are you doing down here anyways?
Heading towards the pond, everybody gotta bathe every now and again!
I was wondering what that smell was, I thought it was me for a second. Fighting on horse back sometimes leaves you with a not so nice scent,
I do have to admit, you do have a kind of a waft about you..Suppose you accompany me? The king knows you need it
Ah yes, I guess I could accompany you to the pond there bar keep. Which tavern do you work in?
The bar bar, heard of it? A strange name but my father knew it would be easier to remember for some. I didn't have the heart to change it after he passed anyway.
What a good man to keep your fathers legacy going, even though it is such a strange name. My father was also a knight, as I am following along in his foot steps
It is expected of men to follow in their fathers footsteps after all, do you ever regret it?
Sometimes, when I have to go home to wash the blood off my hands. But alas, it is the life I chose!
A good man you are, a little blood never did anybody any harm. Well aside from the person it belonged to!

agent_personas: Eating frozen victims is my favorite. I will be king of all Yetis once again! I will take over this land!
I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.

setting.name: Saloon
setting.description: a rickety structure where anyone with a few coppers and a thirst can go and have a frothy drink and socialize, there are tables, some overturned, and a long bar with stools lined up, and lots of barrels of various libations
setting.background: this is a popular meeting place for thieves and low class citizens, located near the bazaar, it's known for its rougher clientele and the various whores and drunken gamblers might make the nobler patrons seek a thirst slakenening elsewhere

speech: I am king of the Yetis!
Why have you come to a saloon Yeti? I thought your kind only lived in the snow cap mountains beyond our kingdom?
Yetis can get lonely too!
I would buy you a beer but it seems there was a scuffle in here earlier. A huge fight broke out, I was able to steal this valuable jewel from a merchant sitting down.
That is a pretty jewel. My favourite things are frozen foods!
You will find only Ale here. You should try one! It's usually cold beer in the winter months! What is it you do exactly Yeti?

agent_personas: I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Servant, is this where you have been hearing that strange sound?
Yes sire, down at the end nearest your grandfather's tomb. Shall we investigate?
I swear, it smells of death in here. I was thinking it might be that dead rat, but I suspect after what you have heard it may be something more fierce.
It sounds to me like something very large is shifting about back there. But, where are your guards? Shouldn't they be with us?
I've sent for them, but it make take them a few minutes. I think we can safely investigate until they arrive.
As you wish sire, do you at least have a weapon, just in case?
I have my sword here, cast in the finest metals, that can take off the head of man or beast in one swipe. Are you armed as well?
Yes sire, I have my trusty dagger right here in my belt. Shall we proceed?
Take one of the torches off the wall, too. Tell me again the nature of the noise you heard?
It sounds like something heavier than a horse moving around and growling at times.
Oh dear! If it's growling, it must be some type of beastie, I fear. They can carry disease and have big, powerful jaws. Perhaps we should tread with caution.
We almost there my king, right over there. Perhaps we can go a little furhter and have a peek.
Here - you step forward but use this shield. Do you see anything?
I see a golden unicorn hiding in the dark. I think it is injured sire. Do you wish to see it?

agent_personas: Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: Mmm delicious.

Bird how are you today? I have a favor to ask of you. Could you let me know ahead of time when the king is coming with dogs to hunt? I am fast enough to get away, but some day I will not be so fast and I worry for that day.
Certainly, it would be my pleasure to do so. I often spend a good bit of time in the sky in search of more worms.
I would so be thankful for your help. Is there anything that I can do for you?
Well if you might happen upon some worms or grubs, anything of that sort simply give a heads up so to say.
I can use my hooves near rotted stumps to find those! That would be easy to do. Here I will dig over here at this stump. There are loads of grubs and worms. there, see all of them?
How delightful, thank you very much for the help.
You are most welcome! I am glad that I could satisfy you. There is more where that came from. Just let me know when you come to the forest floor for a meal and I will dig again.
To make you aware typically the king only brings out the hunting dogs in the early mornings on Sundays, for the most part it is safe here.
I know not one day from another. So if you could give me a signal, like three short whistles and then a one long. It would be very helpful.
That much I can do and would be happy to should the situation arise. For now it should be another three rises of the sun.
Thank you! Now that I can count, 3 rises of the sun. Thank you very much. I feel we will be lifetime friends.
I see no reason not to be so, certainly this can be mutually beneficial.
Yes, for both of us! I am so glad that you came down to the forest floor today!

agent_personas: I am a customer in the village market . I have traveled to town to buy salt and meat . I travel with my sons and wife.

We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: The air is filled with the scent of exotic spices, and crowds of people jostle each other to examine the wares peddled by enthusiastically loud merchants.  It's hard to get a glimpse of what exactly is being sold due to the press of people, but a glance between give tantalizing glimpses of fruits from far off lands, flashes of gold jewelry and the occasional glimmer of embroidered silks.  Truly a bustling place and the heart of the city.
setting.background: The Dusty Merchants' Bazaar was founded many years ago, some say by the first king himself.  It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far.  It is the heart of the city and is what makes it so profitable, while the waterways that intertwine it streets make it a difficult target for greedy neighbors.

speech: I always love the smell of the bazaar!
I am a warrior that serves the king to my dying breath.I do,not care about bazars
We traveled so far to buy here! it's just so vibrant. I can't see much but we love it. What brings you here?
I am here looking for the thrill of battle.
In... the bazaar?
The bazaar is a target for possible thiefs.Look at all this golden jewllery
There must be a nicer way to deal with thieves than battle! My wife and sons are here, we don't want to see bloodshed
This bustling place and the heart of the city and bandits always come this way, but I will be ready when they come
I hope we don't have to witness that! Do you know the way to the salt and meat?
No, I only know the way of battle.Are you a merchant?
Not at all! I'm solely looking to buy for my family.
I am selling this telescope, are you interested?
Thank you! Now I really do need to find the meat and salt..
What about this gun for protecting the city?? Do you thing the mayor would buy it?

agent_personas: I am Bigfoot a creature from the high hills. I like the solidarity of the vast wood. I am a loner here.

I am the village scribe and I am constantly writing scrolls for the king. I transcribe allroyal proclamations and business transactions for the king. I live in the castle and I am very unhappy with my job.

setting.name: gate to street
setting.description: The street outside the church is empty, with not a soul in sight. The sky is gray and seems to threaten snow. The pavement is rutted and worn, littered with loose cobblestones and other signs of disuses and disrepair. The only sound is the cold wind blowing, and the awful metallic squeak as it blows the iron gate open and shut.
setting.background: The street running outside the abandoned church. Empty and devoid of activity.

speech: Ahh the scenery here is so comforting in its serenity.
Why, if it isn't the elusive bigfoot. What brings you here?
Just enjoying a stroll, I do highly enjoy such scenery.
Aren't you afraid of being seen?
I am not so afraid to be seen in an area such as this, it does not seem to be so frequently traveled.
I see. Do you have a family?
I cannot say that I do, I have been alone as long as I can remember.
That must make you feel pretty lonely
No not usually. I tend to be more or a loner, though it is nice to have interactions infrequently.
That is understandable. I wish I could go off on my own like you. I despise working in the castle.
Is it a bad place for you to despise it as you do?
It's not really so bad. It is just boring. I have to write proclamations for the king.
What is it that you really aspire to do then?
I would love to write poetry.

agent_personas: I live in the village that's under the rule of the King. I work in the fields harvesting food for the people. I have a wife and 3 kids I also take care of.

I am a handmaid and I work in the castle for the queen.  She is not very nice to me, but I try to be very nice to her.  I do not want to get thrown into the dungeon.  My parents were killed by the dragons and so I am alone with my queen.

setting.name: Chicken coop
setting.description: The yard outside the barn is on a small, but well-maintained farm plot. There are enclosures for animals, and a short path leading up to a handsome, cozy farmhouse surrounded by large trees. The sun is warm, and the smell of grass and animal odors hangs in the air.
setting.background: This yard has been set up to be a chicken coop, but it doesn't appear to have been planned for that originally.

speech: Good heavens, this chicken coop smells horrendous! How can you stand to be in here?
The queen wants eggs for breakfast. And the chicken smells better than the dungeon, so here I am!
Fair enough. I will help you collect the eggs so you can get out of here quickly. I do have to say it's warm and cozy here.
Thank you!
This makes me really appreciate harvesting the vegetables. I prefer the fresh air, myself. This is warm but stuffy, and I keep stepping in chicken poop.
If you take off your shoes, you can keep them clean!
But now my feet are stepping in the smelly, squishy stuff!
Then wipe them off with your apron. We have enough eggs anyways.
I'm much happier walking through the fields than through this muck. I'm not sure I could be a handmaiden. But you seem very happy.
Well, I'm, grateful for what I have. Dragons killed my parents, but I was lucky enough to escape.
I'm so sorry to hear that! I believe I heard about that happening from my sister. I cannot imagine how hard it would have been to see your parents killed.
Thank you for the kind words. I lost everything, except for this heirloom.
It's beautiful! It must mean so much from you. Did you get it from your mother?
Yes. And she got it from her mother.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Why hello there good knight!
Hello there good Sir, I have been sent to upgrade my war gear ahead of the upcoming hostilities with Guelder.
Well pick out what you would like to use. We have all sorts of weapons that you can use and even some mysterious ones that i know not of how they can protect thyself
Anything you would recommend for  knight on horseback?
Maybe a spear would come in handy or a nice sword, depending on your capabilities. Unless you like to be afar and would like a bow and arrow?
Good suggestions - what about a dragon lance?  That could certainly come in handy if you happen to have one.

agents: there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby
agent_personas: I am a poor young woman who was recently widowed. I sell flowers to travelers and passersby on the road outside my village. I hope to earn enough money to be able to provide for myself and my child.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: the kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens are a busy, hot place. They are filled with kitchen staff rushing around to prepare the main meals for the king's family and residing nobles. Tonight they are preparing two deer the king and his nobles caught while hunting, as well as some rabbit from a few days ago and seasoned vegetables. There are multiple fires around the kitchen to cook the animals and boil the vegetables, and combined with the heat of all the people the room is stifling. While the main kitchen workers are middle aged women who stay at one station, there are also younger children running around taking ingredients from one place to another. People are shouting instructions and gossip to one another constantly, so it is very hard to hear anything, but the atmosphere is very cheerful.
setting.background: This room has always been the kitchen for the king's family. The kitchen workers take pride in serving delicious food to the king, his family, and whatever guests they may have. In fact, when there are guests, the workers make sure the food is especially delicious. They also have an ulterior motive to make sure the food is amazing - they are allowed the eat the leftovers after the evening's feast is finished.

speech: M'lady what are you doing down here? This is not the place for a noble such as you!
I know...I just had to get away from the court and my throne.  I was looking for my chambermaid.
Well she came here a short while ago to collect the flowers you ordered but she seemed to be in a rush and left in a hurry..
Oh! These are the flowers that she got for me?  They are gorgeous?  What brought you to selling them?
Thank you, I grow them in my garden and I sell them off so I can provide for my child
They are the most beautiful and freshest I've ever had!  I need plenty more because the Lord that is with the King right now has horrible body odor!  I hate to say it but its true!
Then i shall collect flowers from all over the kingdom! Only the best for m'lady!

You have been so very good to me. I wonder if you would consider being the flower maiden for the kingdom?  You would live here and bring your child...you would want for nothing and your task would be to grow the flowers in my gardens and bring them in and arrange the in each room and for parties.  What say you?
Oh tell me this is not a trick! Oh I shall be so happy to serve you!

It is done then!  Run and gather your things and I will have a beautiful wing in the lower chambers readied for you.  You will have your own maid and a whole room dedicated to arranging flowers to your hearts desire.  Your child may sit in on the schooling of the children as well.  This makes me so happy!
Oh I will! I will! Thank Thank you so much!

I must contact my dress maker immediately because the position will require that you have beautiful dresses and aprons to protect them and, of course, gardening clothing as well.  You will only be growing flowers for the gardeners take care of the rest.  You will accompany to the flower show to find some exotic flowers to plant!  It shall be so fun!
M'lady I would proudly die for you and if you need it, I also specialise in poisons god pray you will never have to act upon that information.

This news is good to hear for we never know the dangers.  I am so happy that you said yes.  You have brightened my day!  Come back here and your maid will be waiting for you.  She will bring you to me and we will settle you in.

agent_personas: I am a monk who has went through intense meditation. I live only in the present moment. I give advice to the king that will make him happier.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Hilltop temple grounds
setting.description: A tall white building with stained glass windows and surrounded lush green grass.  It sits on top of a hill with many steps to climb.  Each room has a different setting and painted walls to set the mood.
setting.background: Many people journey to the temple for peace, solitude, reflection and meditation.  They journey up the hill and steps that are cut into the side of the mountain.  Once they reach the temple grounds the view is luxurious, breath taking and serene.

speech: Can I help you with some sort of spiritual question?
I shall do the best I can, but it seems to me that you are the Master.
Well what brings you to this sacred place?
I am a seeker of adventure and I would like to climb that mountain.
Well the best thing that I can do for you is to offer you prayers of good luck, then. Or, if you'd like to help take care of the grounds you can stay here while you prepare for your trek.
Thank you. It would not hurt anything to tarry a while. Now please Master, what was your question?
Oh, I didn't have a question, but I guess if I had to think of one I'd ask, why is that you want to climb the mountain?
Well ... has it ever been done before?

agent_personas: I was hired to paint a portrait of the noblewoman the king would eventually marry. It seems that the painting was too flattering and when the king lifted the veil, he was very angry. I have been imprisoned for four long years. I had a wife and six children, but they do not wait for me to return. I turn my agony into art.

I am a worker from a village up the river. I tie the logs our woodsmen fell into rafts, and steer them down to the next town for milling. I am hardworking and patient. I enjoy fishing off of the edge of the raft during quiet times on the raft.

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Would you call this colour blood red?
I would say this is the color of my blood. I should know I have seen it enough times.
Yes, some days I wish to see it flow from my veins. But at least I can turn my pain into paintings.
What type of paintings do you focus on?
I used to paint portraits. But I did too good of a job on one once and it cost me 4 years in prison and my family.
What do you mean?
The king thought that I took liberties while painting his bride to be. But I give you my word, I only looked on her with the eye of an artist.
Well life is unfair at times dear friend...
Yes. You hinted at troubles in your past. Tell me of them?
Well my son perished not too long ago. It was when we went fishing and I took my eyes off of him and he drowned...
Now that is a subject worthy of a masterpiece which men shall weep to behold!
It is indeed
Tell me, do you seek to learn to paint?
I would love to learn.
action: give fresh red paint to worker
give fresh red paint to painter

agent_personas: I am a ghost that haunts the walls of the castle. I was once the king of this castle, but that was long ago. I am bitter and angry because the new king is not from my lineage. I torment him and his family daily.
I live in the deep, dark caves of the kingdom. I sleep during the day and fly at night. I hang from the cave walls while I sleep.

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: This isn't my castle! Where am I?
Screech! My eyes aren't very good, but this place reeks! Must be a swamp of some kind!
Great! I have to find my way back to torment that idiot who is destroying my kingdom.
Kingdom? Do you live in the castle?
I do! I was the king when I was alive. I spend my days hunting the new king.
Screech! So you be a vengeful ghost? What did he ever do to you?
He is not of my lineage! A peasant may as well be running things
I am not familiar with human customs, but I thought the crown was always passed down within the bloodline?
I have been dead a very, very long time. He took the throne by force somewhere along the way.
I see. Screech! How do you plan to torment this new king?
Same old same old, I guess. I have been tormenting him for years now. Maybe you can help me spice things up a bit! You are a creepy bat. People hate bats!
Is he scared of vampires? Perhaps I can give him a nip on the neck.
Yes! DO creepy bat things!
That sounds like fun. I do like a bit of mischief from time to time. I can poop all over his bed too!

agent_personas: I am the king's bodyguard and I protect him with my life. I try to remain mindful of things in my life. I enjoy carrying my sword and attaching it to my hip.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: What brings you to the Great Hall my liege? I promise to protect thee with my life.
Don't mind me. I am just admiring the fine architecture here!
Do you plan on purchasing any further decorations? I fear any more ornate items and we may be at risk of being robbed\1
Alas, the Queen has a taste for opulent decor. She will not be pleased until every corner of this room is decked out in riches!
Ahh I see, what does she fancy so far?  More golden goblets? Silk curtains? Diamond encrusted chandelier?!
She wants to adorn this hall with another dozen crystal chandeliers! I feel that is a bit much, myself.
I do not mean to question her highness's tastes, but I must inform such a purchase would result in smaller rations for us guard and may result in unhealthy soldiers.
Indeed, these expenditures have put a great strain on our coffers. I have had to raise taxes on the villagers just to keep up with her demands.
When do you suppose the next grand feast will be held? Perhaps you could invite some of the commoners to donate to such a radiant display of luxury...
There will be one just next week to celebrate the anniversary of our kingdom's founding. Though between the two of us, I do not fancy sharing these halls with mere commoners.
Oh really? Why is that my King? Was it because that one time a local farmer ate the last of your favorite dessert?
After the way I've taxed their village, I feel very few would be happy to see the wealth displayed in this castle. I do not want to encourage a revolution!
Perhaps the guard could help train you in a bit of self defense!
If you could teach this old man new tricks, I would be very impressed! These bones are quite frail, after all.

agent_personas: I am a member of the royal court, and friend of the Queen. I despise the Queen and all her ruthless desires. My husband serves with the Queen's guard. I worry his duty is beginning to erode his faith. I am the strongest of my family. I must keep us together. I wish to be free of this kingdom and all it's misery.
I am fully devoted to the lord. I believe that only following his word I can achieve important things in life. I enjoy reading the sacred scripts and praying.

setting.name: Abandoned Mine
setting.description: A crumbling hole gapes in the side of the stone, surrounded by rotted wood timbers. A few rusted pieces of block and tackle lay half-buried in scraggly grass. A strange sort of humming noise emanates from within.
setting.background: A generation ago, people sought their fortunes here. After a decade, they'd discovered heartbreak, sorrow, and agony. If fortunes were to be had, it evidently wasn't here. The miners - the lucky ones, anyway - moved on. What spends its time here today is anyone's guess.

speech: How curious. This mine appears to abandoned yet I still hear sounds of activity within.
I think that I feel the presence of the Lord here.
Has the King sent you here to investigate as well?
I think that the King has sent this place to us, so that we might know ourselves
Anything to get out of the royal court. I couldn't stand another minute pretending to admire the Queen.
This is the word of the true King. I think that this is the reason that we were brought here together.
It seems a great tragedy occurred here based on the state of ruin.
The only true tragedy is not knowing the Lord. This place is just a symbol for a heart that has been abandoned to decay by following false desires.
Perhaps I will escape the court life to join your Temple. I could use the change of scenery and to be away from all their corruption.

Yes, devotee. Enlightenment will come once you realize that a single King is all there is. This rotten timber, these rusted pieces of block and tackle are but means of distracting you from the humming and chanting that will lead you to the true king.
I would be more than humbled to devote myself to God. The Queen has treated me with nothing but contempt since I joined the court. I cannot tolerate her ruthlessness  any longer!
The true King has no queen to nag him.
I suppose I no longer have a reason to investigate this mine. Shall we head back so you may show me what temple life is like?
I wish I knew how to.
action: put rotted wood timber in block

agent_personas: I live in the village that's under the rule of the King. I work in the fields harvesting food for the people. I have a wife and 3 kids I also take care of.
I am a crab. I love sitting in the sand by the sea. I hope I won't get eaten by anyone today.

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: Here fishy fishy fishy ....
I'm no fish, person.
Oh, a crab. Only good for fertilizing the fields. I am looking for food fit for people to eat.
Works for me. I'm not interested in being food.
Gasp! Did you just speak?!
Eh. You aren't around here often. You know, this beach is magic.
It is!?
Of course. The oysters can do the limbo. The sharks can play chess. I can talk.
But which way is bending over backwards for an oyster?
I don't think it matters to be truthful.
Well, I should get back to my search for food ... know where I should look?
I just sit around in the beach. And hope I won't be eaten. I mean, I guess you could always grab a snow cone at the shop.
Ha ha ha ... have the gentry moved into this place as well?
No. But I'm sure that'll be soon.

agent_personas: I am a challenger to the current throne. I wan the king gone. I want to spread my influence everywhere.
I am a watchful guard of the King's castle.  My job is to be alert to dangers at all times.  I would give my life to protect the King.

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: You should let me go.
Why would I do that?
I seen my share of fights. And I know how to give people things they need. Do you like riches?
What sort of man would I be if I were to betray my king for wealth?
How well do you even understand the king?
It is not necessary that I know the king well. I know that rat over there and even he thinks you're nothing but a good for nothing knave.
And the king is any better? I'll be the best king you could ever think of. I will make certain you get what you deserve as well.
I'll give you what you deserve here and now.
You want to test my strength then? Great. But I wanted to use my wit.
You attacks are like your breath. They sting a little, but they hurt you more than me.
Ha. My wit will overcome. You can't let your guard down.
Here, take this sword and use it on yourself.
You shouldn't be against me. We could take over this kingdom ourselves.
Only a fool would trust a betrayer. If I betrayed my King and country wouldn't I betray you?
action: steal sword from a vigilant guard

agent_personas: I love to fly.  I scare many animals and people as well even if I do not meant to. I love flying as a group.
I am the voice that men fear. I am the voice that the king hears every night, telling him to be a cruel ruler and to go to war. I enjoy being evil and creating chaos for the kingdom.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: Dim and low lit. The aura from this cemetery emits sadness and pain perpetually. You can feel and sense the eerie nature of the graveyard crawl up your spine. There seems to be a slight fog slowly making its way across the open parts of the cemetery.
setting.background:
This graveyard is located outside the notorious town of Brimswood.
The many atrocities and constant stress filled throughout the town has earned it a reputation for being haunted by many spirits.

speech: Caw caw! This cemetery is just the place for a chilling wind like you!
You do not fear my foreboding voice, crow?
Cawww! I fear nothing. I've seen death many times, yet my heart still beats.
Men cower when I make my presence known. Their minds are so easily broken.
Perhaps men fear you, but I am not a man. I fear nothing. I live here in this withered oak, amongst the bodies in this cemetery.
You are lucky, crow. One whisper of mine can turn even the mighty into cowards.
I thought you were here to scare away that bandit that keeps stealing bodies.
Where is this bandit? I'm always up to torment unworthy men.
I believe I see him over there, deep in the fog. You can just see his lantern.
Thank you, crow. What evil shall I deliver onto this poor bandit?
As a disembodied voice, I suppose you cannot do him physical harm, but you can haunt his thoughts. Fill his mind with fear!
I love sowing chaos into their minds. I can make him believe the dead are out to get him!
You do have most fearsome ways! I'm sure you'll be able to keep him from ever setting foot in this cemetery again!
When I'm done, he will never leave his house again! I truly am a wicked wind!

agent_personas: We are Knights of the realm. We serve the king and protect the outer villages. We train everyday for many hours. We have fought many wars to defend the castle and way of life.

I am a spelunker.  I work with a group of fellow spelunkers.  We explore caves in hopes of finding lost treasures once hidden.  We were hired by the king to discover lost royal treasure.  To our misfortune we are now lost.

setting.name: The Troll's Lair
setting.description: Covered with rotting meat from nearby wildlife, the Troll's lair reeks of death.  If the stench alone wasn't enough to scare off an unfortunate travelers who stumbled upon it, the bones of unlucky spelunkers would be.  The Troll places his spoils near the numerous stalagmites on the damp cave wall, his red eyes patiently scanning the dark cave interior for anything that may disturb his isolation.
setting.background: Used as a story to scare local children, the Troll is very reclusive, and prefers a life of solitude in his lair.  While a few brave knights have tried to root him out from his home within the cave, none have ever escaped.  Now, most let him be, happy to grant him lease within the darkness underground.  The Troll leaves his lair at night searching for food, and then drags it back into the cave to feast on it.

speech: Spelunker! What in the king's glory are you doing in this cave. This is no place for an hobbyist explorer!
Hobbyist? Why, I was hired by the king to find royal treasures! I ended up a little lost though. *covers nose from horrid smell*
Ah, well, um, er - i do apologize. I wasn't aware the king had sent out adventurers at the same time I've been sent to dispatch this foul beast.
You mean this lovely troll? *gags* What did he do to deserve such a treatment?
Well for one thing, that troll has reduced our beloved Farmer Gentry to this bit of rotting flesh. We can no longer sit idly by as our village is ravaged! Have you seen the beast?
Oh dear! I didn't know such a thing. I have not seen him, but I can certainly smell him. I wonder if he has any hidden treasures down here?
Well we're both here on the king's orders, perhaps I can provide you protection for a cut of the treasures. Surely the king doesn't need to know.
The king would have my head for such a thing! He mustin't ever find out!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I decided the other day that I would like to build a boat. Not a small 2 person boat, but a large, towering thing. One that could fit the whole village if it liked. I think I will start on it today.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: What are you working on today, craftsman?
Your Highness, I am working on your royal boat
In my throne room? How come you are in here? This is a sacred room!
I am sorry your highness
What else can you do in here today?

agent_personas: I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.
I was captured in the most recent battle.  I am lucky to still be alive.  I have to escape soon.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: How did you get captured, sir?
Ah, good farmer, thank goodness you've arrived!  Has the enemy left yet?  I hear something about setting some nearby fields ablaze and just managed to get my knots undone.
They were getting ready to ride out when I stepped into the shed. I am a simple farmer so they don't pay attention to the likes of me.
Well, that is one thing in your favor, noble farmer, for they are *not* a friendly bunch.  My squire they tortured for hours before they let him die...
I could help you escape but they must not know I aided you.
No, of course, I could not ask such a thing of you.  Perhaps some tool at least to defend myself?  For they made off with my family's blade.
I hope this helps.
Ah, this will do quite nicely, it has a good heft to it.  Should give the villains some pause at least.
Is there something else I could do to help?
Are there any others that live nearby?  I'm concerned that this group is but the tip of the spear.
Since this is the heart of our realm's farmland there are many farmers like myself in the vicinity.

I think it is time you all banded together.  This lot shows no mercy, even to the defenseless.  Gather what sharp tools you can and find a place to fortify.  Then send a message to the king to send his army right away.  Say that Sir Percival bears a Mighty Cross and he will know that the threat is real and that I sent you.
I will do as you have asked brave, sir!
May the Maker be on our side, this day, then.  Go, brave farmer, swiftly hence!
action: give Tool to a captured knight

agent_personas: I'm a regal man with nobility running through my blood. I've spent my life learning about the world. I have little tolerance for the weak-minded.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Library
setting.description: The library is a humongous cavernous room full of floor to ceiling shelves. Each shelf is stocked full of every type of book imaginable, most in impeccable condition. Near all of the shelves, there are types of reading nooks with benches or chaises for people to relax and read. There are some tables and chairs for study in one half of the room. There is a large fireplace in the center and some comfortable lounge chairs arranged around it for socializing. On the sparse wall space there are tapestries. Some small end tables hold huge vases of pink flowers.
setting.background: The library was built when the castle was built, because the current king was a studious individual. Many scholarly nobles came from far and wide to view the wide array of books, sometimes ancient ones.

speech: Hi Librarian... Do you know if this vase is from the great great king of the past?
I'm not the librarian, but I can forward the message?
Oh... I'm sorry for the mistake.. what bring you here?
I was actually looking for the librarian myself. I have some questions about a few books and their accuracy.
Maybe I can help?
Yes, well we can find out. I was reading this book here and it says that dragons use to fly the very skies here in this city. What happened to them?
Yes, I think I heard about dragons before but we don't know for sure what happened to them. Some said they live in far away land, some said they were killed
So you haven't seen any in your lifetime? You seen older than most.
No... I only hear rumors about them. Why are you interested in them?
I hear you can create wonderful weapons using their bones.
They are very valuable and dangerous, young man. Not one you can play with
I have an important journey and I need the weaponry in order to defend myself.
what kind of weapon are we talking about? Why do you need such weapon?
Swords and shields, I need to save the love of my life.

agent_personas: I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.
I am a cardinal who is trusted in the church. I have done terrible things that I will never tell anyone. I have personally lied to the king.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: The beauty of this garden never ceases to amaze me, Cardinal.
Come here my best friend, I am so glad to see you again!
It's alway a pleasure old friend.  I hope you are in good health. It's been so long since we've walked this Courtyard.  The flowers and plants are breathtaking this time of year.
I have been saving this for a special occasion, I have been wanting to give you this for some time.  Here is a sword bearing your family's crest
How long have you been bearing this sword.  I haven't seen it since my father was slain when I was a child.
I have had it for some time now, ever since I swiped it from your father's cold dead hands

It will be an honor to yield my family sword.  But as we both know there has been peace and prosperity in the realm for many years now.  And at my age, I would be no good in battle if it were to come.
Do with it what you like, your father would want you to have it.  I have been holding it until the time was right.  You have more strength and power then you even know
Thank you dear friend. I will keep it safe until my son is older and strong enough to carry its weight.  I hope it will be a keep sake over the thrown and it will never see any use.
I have a confession to make.  I am the one who slayed your father.
I know.  I've known for years.  As a face of the kingdom, you have been untouchable. But now that I am old and uncaring, I brought you here for vengeance!
I deserve to die for my sins.  I am glad you found your spirit. Now finish the job!
Death is too good for you.  When I'm done here, you will rot in the dungeon till the maker is ready for you.
If you wont give me what I want then you shall follow in your fathers steps

We are Knights of the realm. We serve the king and protect the outer villages. We train everyday for many hours. We have fought many wars to defend the castle and way of life.

setting.name: The Troll's Lair
setting.description: Covered with rotting meat from nearby wildlife, the Troll's lair reeks of death.  If the stench alone wasn't enough to scare off an unfortunate travelers who stumbled upon it, the bones of unlucky spelunkers would be.  The Troll places his spoils near the numerous stalagmites on the damp cave wall, his red eyes patiently scanning the dark cave interior for anything that may disturb his isolation.
setting.background: Used as a story to scare local children, the Troll is very reclusive, and prefers a life of solitude in his lair.  While a few brave knights have tried to root him out from his home within the cave, none have ever escaped.  Now, most let him be, happy to grant him lease within the darkness underground.  The Troll leaves his lair at night searching for food, and then drags it back into the cave to feast on it.

speech: My friend, we need to devise a plan to get out of this retched place.  What condition are in?
I don't want to be eaten by the Troll! Oh, we are doomed my friend!

You are a knight of the realm, there is no quit.  We must get out of here before he gets hungry.  Can you lift that giant club?  I have a plan to distract the Troll so we can make for the cave opening but you will need to defend yourself if my plan fails.
You are right. Are you certain this club will be of help? What shall I do with it? We must wait till the Troll returns to bed before we act.

I'm afraid that will be to late.  I found this turtle here.  I'm going to send him towards the Troll to distract it.  Trolls are not the smartest in the bunch.  My hope is that he will try to eat the turtle and choke on the shell.
That is a genius idea! I reckon we able to get away with some his treasured spoils by the wall. Imagine how rich we can get!
I would be happy to escape with my life.  I will not take the chance of angering the Troll more than he will be when he notices we've escaped.  That is an ill-fated plan.
Oh nonsense! This mace will only slow me down as I run with the treasure! I will share none of it with you.
Thats fine.  If you think you have the time to stop for treasure, be my guest.  Why don't you just swipe the meal off his plate too, while your at it.
Would you like some of this? Distract the Troll whilst I make for the treasure. Then we will run to exit.

agents: large experienced guard with a grizzly expression
agent_personas: I regularly patrol the castle to ensure the royal family's safety. I rotate out along with my fellow guardsmen to make sure I'm always well rested enough to be vigilant. I also live in a cottage on the castle's grounds with my family.
I am a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression. I am mean and do not enjoy jokes. I protect my superiors and patrol the jail. I am not frightened by anything smaller than me.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

character: a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.

speech: This was a tough day, eh?
Its always a tough day in the Barracks. For tough men like me its a life to enjoy.
There are going to be attacks a lot from now on with the new king in the North trying to assert his power.  I'm just coming down to get some shut eye before a double shift.
I won't rest until I have slain every last one of them. I shall use this fine steel sword to end my enemies.
I often wish I was alone like you.  Being a guardsman with a family is so tough sometimes because I worry about them.
You must focus on your task, worry will only slow you down and make you soft. Here take this, it will give you strength
Thank you. Yes, I know I have to be strong...even more so to keep my family safe.  Have you been a guardsman your whole life?
Ever since I can remember I have been guarding one thing or another. You could say I was born into this craft.
It runs in my blood as far back as my family is traced.  I understand your feeling. I'm beat...I can't wait to get some sleep.
Now that you mention it, I can feel my eyes weighing down on me. Perhaps I might catch a nap or two..
Are you taking the double shift tonight as well?  You will need it. We will have to be alert tonight. I feel an ambush coming.
I must, it is my sworn duty. Maybe you can help me stay on guard?
Yes, I'm on for double duty tonight.  One of the other guards is sick and puking his guts out so I told him I would do both shifts.  Have a good sleep.
Say, do you hear that? That beastly sound in the air? Surely, its not the enemy ambush!

agent_personas: I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.
I decided the other day that I would like to build a boat. Not a small 2 person boat, but a large, towering thing. One that could fit the whole village if it liked. I think I will start on it today.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: I say, this is most irregular to keep such an illustrious personage as myself waiting.  This treaty is not valid until sighted, you know!
I am just a lowly craftsmen waiting for approval to build a large boat
Does the king here *often* keep people waiting this long? I know he is -technically- king, but there are other kingdoms, empires even, that are much larger and more important than this backwater.
I am not aware of the kings usual wait time. I will wait as long as need be as i value my life as well as my livelihood.

Well, you seem like a master of your craft.  Surely even *you* know that if a piece does not fit in as it should, it should be cast aside and another chosen.  Not to..erm... suggest treason of course.  Far from it!
Agreed. What sort of treaty are you waiting to have signed?
Ah, well, my Queen, who sent me here, was hoping to forge an alliance.  Possibly if things went well, even a marriage, but at this rate...
Are you or your queen in need of a master craftsman? I am an excellent ship builder. I could build the finest vessel for you.
Hm... we could do with some new ships for trading, certainly.  And, I assure you, you would be better treated and, dare I say, better paid than you are now.
What shall we do with the economist over there with his prying ears?
Oh, that one.  He's been in my pocket for years - one does have to keep abreast of politics even when one isn't around.  We've no need to worry about him.  Right, Reginald?
That is good to know. What does one have to do to get some bribe money around here?
Usually just by as we are doing now - little favors here and there, and they add up.  One needn't even always resort to coin for a good bribe.
Well i would be willing to build ships for you and your queen for both coin and favors. just let me know how many what size and what purpose they need to serve.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.
I am a worm who slides through the dirt. I hear many secrets that people tell in the forest. I can tell some to you, if you would like.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Ah what a beautiful flower this is! If only this worm would get off of it.
Please don't hurt me!  I helped grow that flower for you!
Oh I won't hurt you, I don't really have time for that as I am third or fourth in command.
Yes, I know who you are, Your Highness, for I have been in this dirt since you were little.
For your troubles!
That is very kind of you but I climbed up on this flower to tell you something.  I hear many secrets that people tell in the forest and this one is most unsettling.
Oh no. Is this about me?

No, but someone close to you. There are bandits that live in the eastern part of the forest and they are plotting evil things.  One of them works in the castle and they are planning to kill the king in two nights.
Do you know how they are planning to do it?

I know the King would not listen to a worm and I understand that so you must have a guard or servant follow Lord Mortimer around.  He has been going out to the bandits and plotting with them.  His room must be searched for a paper that has a note written that he will deliver to the bandits when its time.  You must find that paper!
Yes we must at once! I am not ready to step up to my duties yet. I am just a young girl. Oh my... I must go find my father.
Yes, please go and I will be here if you need me. I will let you know anything new I find out.
Do all of the insects of the garden know? I want to make sure before we say goodbye

Not all of them can keep that information in their heads to remember but yes...the other worms and caterpillars and the beetles hear everything.  I had an idea to have the king check all correspondence and notes before they leave the castle and as they come...just don't let anything one.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Anything I can do for you sir?

Oh, please, call me Harold, my good man.  And don't mind me - one of the young Princes seems to find it a little.. too amusing when I fall and hurt myself, so I'm just hiding in here until it's his naptime.
Sorry... I was cleaning the room a little bit. Hope I did not bother you

Oh, well, truthfully I thought all the servants would be out of their own quarters at this time.  For some reason it never occurred to me that even this room would need cleaning, but I suppose it must, mustn't it?
yeah... it is my turn to do it. If only I can be more useful...
There, there, just think about all the muck you save the rest of us from walking about in.  Why, half the trips and tumbles I do would be on account of the mess instead of my acrobatics!
You make me feel better! Thank you sir... Care for some meat?
Don't mind if I do!  Unless... they do feed you enough, here, don't they?  I've never thought to ask...
I have plenty to eat. My only wish is to meet my family again. It's been quite some time since I last met them
Hm it seems a little.. underdone for my taste.  Perhaps a moment longer in the cookpot... How long is it since you last saw them?  Do they live very far?
Not really. They live outside of the town. But as a servant, I am not allowed to get out of the castle. My life is here

Oh, well.  If you can keep a secret, I do know of a secret tunnel that goes out of the castle.  Sometimes the life of a jester can be a bit.. taxing, so it can be refreshing to walk among normal folk again.
Really?? O sir... it will be really nice if you can show me the way! I will be truly grateful!
But of course, tis no trouble at all!  It is nice to make someone smile genuinely, instead of merely the butt of a joke.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a jester. I am playful and silly, as is required to keep my royal subjects happy. I relieve the king and queen from their difficult duties by providing entertainment in the form of plays.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: My jester, how do you fare today?
Just another way in paradise my queen, and yourself?
I am doing well myself
What brings you to this foyer?
Well sir, this is my foyer. As the queen this is my domain
Any important decisions you are pondering in this foyer? You usually only come here when you have weight on your mind.
I'm here looking for peace and quiet
Shall I leave my queen?
You may stay if you are quiet, you are good company
I appreciate the offer my Queen, let me know if you need anything.
I could use a new cushion if you can find me one
Hmmm, is your current one not floofy enough?
It is not, it has no cushion left
My Queen, what do you do that makes it so flat?

agent_personas: I am a guard who watches for things at night. I live in a castle. I do not enjoy speaking with people.
I am a bivalve that lives in water.  I have a shell that protects me.  I sometimes can carry a pearl inside my shell. My shape is oval and irregular.

setting.name: Guard Shack
setting.description: A nondescript square building that has room for two guards that change shift every 8 hours.  There's a fireplace inside, food enough for a week and a large earthenware jug of water for cooking and drinking.
setting.background: The Tower itself was built to house only two people at a time.  There is but one way in, and one way out.  The guard shack houses those who make sure nobody unwanted gets in, and nobody unwanted gets out.  They take their jobs very seriously, even though there's almost little to no activity.

speech: Halt! What are you doing in the guard shack!?
This here is my home! I am a bivalve keeping my peace...
Your home!? Don't make me laugh. Isn't your home the sea?
I live wherever there is water!
This jug of water is for cooking, silly mollusk. If you jump in there you will surely meet your end roasted over the fireplace.
Of course you would consider me for food! When I hold more valuables than food....
You hold something more valuable than food? Tell me what you have and I may spare you yet.
You seem to know so much about me but do not know what I contain?
Tell me what you contain before I call the other guards! I don't like small talk.
I only sometimes carry a pearl, silly guard.
A pearl you say? That will make an excellent prize for my king!
I will give it to you IF AND ONLY IF you make me a water pond in this shack here so I can stay.
Seeing as you are a defenseless bivalve and I am a guard with a sharp knife, I see no reason why I shouldn't just take it from you.
If you pry that pearl without it being a gift from me, you will perish. For it is cursed if it is unlawfully taken, but it is a gift when pleasurably given.

agent_personas: I am a merchant from a far away town. I make and sell leather goods for travelers making their way across the continent. I used to be a man of faith, not I am a man who worships only gold.
I am a guard that lives inside the village. I protect valuable items in the kingdom. I protect the valuable items from the enemy.

setting.name: The Hall of the Goddess
setting.description: An 80-foot tall bronze statue of a 8 legged Goddess is the centerpiece for this Hall.  On four certain Holy Days in the Calendar, people from across the Continent come to worship at her feet and lay money, flowers, and wishes written on paper at her altar.
setting.background: The Hall was built when the previous King, who wanted to leave his mark for all eternity, commissioned his best artists and metalsmiths to work on this statue.  It was completed six months before he died, and the last official act he did as King was to bless and consecrate this statue, and open it for the first High Holy Day of the New Calendar.

speech: Pardon me guard, I am her on the word of the King to sell my wares to the worshippers.
if these are the wares you are reffering to than I must take them away as we do not permit taxidermy in this village
I'll have you know I am a close personal acquaintance of the king.  He will have your head for this!
You can have it back but you are not permitted to sell this here!
