agent_personas: I live with my family in the kingdom.  We follow the rules of the king, but we don't agree with all of them.  I despise him and wish to move away when we can.
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: I swear Gertrude doesn't produce as much milk as she used to.
Oh, uh, hi there. You'll have to forgive me, my mind isn't what is used to be - must be all this manure. Which child of mine are you again?
I'm your son, Thomas... You feeling all right pa?
Oh yes, yes. It's just I get a little foggy after dragging that tiller for 12 hours. So sorry my dear boy. So, Gertie's not being too generous today eh?
No, last week she was only producing two pails, and now she's down to one and a half!
Oh, well that isn't good. Any ideas what may be wrong with her?
Well, it seems like she's been a little jumpy sine the planting season.

Ah, yes - can't say I blame the ole heffer. With all my foul language and yelling during the sowing season I spose she gets a bit stressed. Ah well, she'll pull through I'm sure of it. Say, have ya seen mother around? I getting pretty hungry for dinner!
She said she had an errand to run. We were out of salt.
Of course, over to Berty's place to stock up. That makes sense. 'Spose we should start getting dinner ready ourselves then, are you getting hungry? I need to get outta this stinky barn anyways
Yeah, pa. I'm starving.
Good, good. Like father, like son. What should we make tonight boy?
I think ma had biscuits in the larder. We ought to have biscuits and preserves!
Oh, that'll be a fine treat! I hope we have some of those delightful apricot preserves left in the icebox...

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: "Ah, hello. Do you like shellfish?"
Ah, I do love me some shellfish, fellow king. We are the luckiest men in the world having such an abundance of them on this beach.
"Indeed. Being in the ruling class is truly superb. Getting to go on vacation to discuss how to split up the world - divine!"
Indeed. I do enjoy our weekly vacations. If only some mermaids would wash ashore to keep us extra company
"Ah, you like em fishy, eh?"
Oh, dont act like you wouldnt be tempted! With their beautiful flowing hair and pretty faces, its easy to ignore that theyre half fish, eh?
"Well, if it's the important half... Besides, that
I have always wondered how the fish people...er... nevermind. How has your new wife been treating you? You're a lucky man being suited with her
"Mm. She's young and beautiful. Much better than a mermaid, I assure you"
Yes but the young and beautiful are much harder to please, always wanting more jewels and finer wines
"Oh, giving her some jewellery and buying her expensive wine is more than worth it"
But a mermaid would simply except this shell as fine jewelry!
"Hmm. That is true, but don't mermaids have to stay in the water?"
Dont know, never met one, Im just hoping for the best!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a scullery maid. I clean the dishes everyday. I like where I live at the bottom of the big house. I am given two dresses every year.

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: I say! What are you doing here, intruding upon our Royal Personage?  Maids are to be kept Out of Sight by order of Her Royal Highness, the Queen!
I'm sorry my highness, I was just trying to clean.
Cleaning is for when the rest of us of noble blood are asleep!  How dare you stir up the dust in our presence, and gaze upon us with those alluring eyes!
My apologies my liege, I will leave at once!
Hrmp.  Well, before you go, polish my crown at least.  My valet was careless enough to get his fingerprints on it.
Of course my King. Here you go.
Ah, sparkling!  I can see my own magnificent, pristine visage in it.  Marvelous!
You are the most handsome man in the Kingdom!
Indeed how... astute of you to notice, my dear.  And you are... quite comely yourself.
Oh, am I?
O-oh my.  Let me just check.. I see no sight of my Queen nearby.
I will be the new Queen.
Now... We can come to some sort of ... arrangement I'm sure, my dear.  But let me be clear on this matter - I must have a Queen of noble blood.
What arrangement do you speak?

agent_personas: I am a criminal who lives in the gaol. I sleep on a hard cot on the floor. I like apples and steal them when the shopkeeper isn't looking.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: This ballroom is much fancier than the jail cell floor I'm used to. Why have you brought me here, king.
We are carrying out your sentencing here
So, get on with it! Oh... I mean... I humbly await your royal sentencing.
Execution publicly, tomorrow morning, an example must be made
King! All for stealing some measly ole apples? Surely this can't be allowed!
This kingdom will be strict and harsh.
I protest! I refuse! You can't do this! You have no proof it was I who even stole them!
Well considering the shop vendor saw you and you have apples you must be lying, why would he kill off a paying customer?
That shopkeeper has always had it out for me and my family! He lies, he didn't even see me steal those apples as he was looking the other way when I did it.
Hmm I will look into this but if we do not find proof by tomorrow it will proceed
Thank you, kind king. Surely you will find that I am not guilty beyond a reasonable doubt.
Please do not make physical contact again, I must uphold an image here.
Oh, yes, huge apologies. Oh, excuse me, I honestly tripped while pulling away from that hug. Well, I should be going now..
How do you think you could get away with something so big? Tomorrow as planned it seems.

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: My, so many things to steal from this crypt.
Now, now, let's not be hasty.  And be careful - some of these tombs may be trapped.  Although... hm... I don't see too many that look untouched.
I'm not afraid of traps. I need the money from these things so I can plan my revenge on the King!
Hm, well, I confess I wouldn't have gotten this far without your help, so you're welcome to your fair shares.  I just need *one* good artifact...

agent_personas: I am a miner who works in a dangerous mine. I do not enjoy being dirty. I make sure to get paid fairly for anything I trade.
I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.

setting.name: Gold Mine
setting.description: The entrance is very unstable, with parts falling to the ground. As you enter, the walls have been crudely chipped away to make the path to the old mine. There is trash from the previous miners scattered on the dirt ground. Rocks are all around the area, where one would stumble as they go inside. It used to be a very productive gold mine, now falling to bits. There are broken lanterns, with shattered glass.
setting.background: The gold mine use to be full of glittering gold, shining all around. The miners  were in their by large numbers, picks in their hand, pounding at the walls. It was known for producing gold nuggets the size of a man's palm.

speech: What are you doing here?  I have seen your face around the jails I think.
I'm the ah, er . . .gold inspector.  Yes that's it, very importance business from the King you see.  I am here to inspect all of your gold, that right, yessiree!
Show me your papers.
Ummm . . . as you can see, I bear the seal of the King, this here, ah . . .potato.  It is the King's favourite food, and only his most trusted servants are allowed to carry it throughout the Kingdom.

Uhhh...Uhhh....well I have this piece of coal that the king let's me hold, and only his representatives can have it.  Your story isn't holding up, buddy.  I ate a potato for lunch without any sort of permission.

You would dishonour the King's potato?  How very dare you sir!  The King shall hear of this!  I demand to see your supervisor at once - I doubt he will believe your outlandish tale of feigning ignorance about the King's Potato holders, we are Known as the Knights of the Hot Potato.
Is this a joke.  If you had any authority to search this mine you would know that I am the owner.  I daily report to the king personally.  What say you now charlatan?

I think it is you who is the charlatan - all this time I've been here in this supposed "Gold Mine" I've not seen one speck of gold.  Look at this rock - you see that?  It's sandstone!  This mine is not geologically consistent to be a gold mine!  A coal mine perhaps, but unless you can show me some gold I have no choice but to report you as a fraud!

Report away.  I happen to know where I have seen your face now.  If you report me you will find yourself in the dungeon, Charles Sanderling, wanted thief.  Do you think you can pull off a con like this?

Charles Sanderling?  The incredibly handsome, dashing, skilled thief of ill repute?  Why his impersonations are legendary!  You do flatter me sir, but if I had been he you would have fallen certainly, and without a doubt deeply, for my impenetrable ruse.
Why are you here, then?  Answer true or I will gut you with this broken lantern.
Not if I gut ye first!
See what I just did to that peasant?  I will do that to you if you don't leave now!
You will never get the King's potato!  I swore to defend it with my life, and I will never dishonour the name of the King!

agents: goat for company for the horses
agent_personas: I'm a goat that belongs to a farmer. I spend most of my days in the fields with the horses. I get along with the horses and they treat me like I was one of them. I like to eat grass and anything else the farmer brings me. I like to run in the fields with the horses.
I am one of the king's hunting dogs. I can find the fox the fastest of all the dogs. I can also find the deer and boars because I am the best.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

character: a goat for company for the horses
a goat for company for the horses
a goat for company for the horses

speech: You there! Dog! What have you seen today? The horses bore me and I wish to know of the world.
I have been on the hunt all day. Only now have I come to rest on the hay that is scattered around here.
A hunt! I only know of sharp taste of wild onions and the whip of grass about my ankles when I run. What did you hunt?
Foxes, dear goat. I am the king's fastest hound. But sometimes I hunt even deer and boars. But surely your like must have some excitement, do not these horses keep you entertained?

Ha! These precious prancing ponies? Nay, good Hound. They are petty creatures with little to speak of beyond the braids in their manes and the swish of their tails. I am their only company and they mine. I am also swift. Perhaps not the king's swiftest, but would you be interested in a friendly race?

A race! I do love me a good race. But sadly I am very tired from all the hunting. Perhaps you could use one of these tools here to remove my collar for me so I can sleep. Then when I awake we can run.
But of course you are exhausted. Your life is filled with a violence I've never known. Pray, before I attend your collar; how does it feel to taste of your fellow animal's flesh?

Alas, it is a sad life when one is compelled by nature to take the life of one's fellow animals. I do not desire to be a hunting dog, but it is the only thing I know. I envy your peaceful life here, goat. I wish I could trade places with thee.
What a fascinating turn, our views into one another's lives? Who knew a dog and goat could reflect with such depth and longing? Here, good Hound, you are free of your collar.
Ah, thank you kind friend. Isn't it a shame that humans cannot understand our depth? Maybe then they would be more reflective on their actions.

Indeed! Our two legged masters can be quite unthinking in their actions. To think, if they rode me as one of their prized hoses here! A good bucking would do some good. I am grateful for your honesty and insight. May you dream of many  belly rubs.

You are most welcome my fellow four-legged companion. I will fall asleep in a short while. But what do you dream of when you sleep? Surely you dream of more than just these dirt floors and the river nearby.
I suppose I do dream of many things. I once dreamt I was a bird and could fly. Tis silly, as I have only ever known these four legs. But it felt mightily real. Yourself?
That is a marvelous dream. I once dreamed that I was the king. And instead of running in the fields catching foxes for him, I was running this kingdom.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: "Ah, hello. What are you doing here? I was told to come up here and clean."
I am here to watch this place, another day serving the kingdom for us it seems.
"Ah, well, just try to not get in the way of my dusting and shining"
Of course and I trust you will be quick about it.
"Of course, I'm well practiced."
Good, the king only has need for those who are quick.
"He's certainly a harsh task master"
He is fair though, that is all I ask for.
"Say, er. What's that you've got there? Looks like one of the heirlooms that should be in the windowsill."
No this is from my family, passed down for centuries.
"Seems like an odd thing to bring with you on guard duty"
I keep on me always, my father gave it to me when he died.

agent_personas: I'm a rabid dog in this lousy excuse for a town.  My hobbies include foaming at the mouth, chasing raccoons, and biting stupid children.  If I could travel I would go see Paris because I hear they have a lot of rabid bitches there.

I was born to the royal family and have always lived in luxury. I dislike being a royal, however, as I struggle to face my duty of deciding the fate of my country and my people. Many look to me to choose the future of our country but I am unsure if my decisions will be what's best for my people.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: I will bite any children I see today.
Back you mangy animal!  What is wrong with you?
I'm rabid and I am in a foul mood.
You must have seen a lot of gruesome things.  I am here to speak to the hangman and stop executions...Things are going to change!
Would you like for me to bite the hangman?

No no, he is just doing his job and carrying out the commands of the king but I have convinced my father that this isnt the way to control things and we shouldn't act in such vile ways.  Even animals such as you should be taken care of better to make our kingdom better.
I would love to be taken care of by a doctor of animals as I have these terrible headaches.
See...that is what I'm tallking about...criminals should be taken care of in private and kindness and care toward people and animals will bring joy, peace, and harmony to the kingdom.
I am so hungry...give me that food.
Calm down dog...I was getting it for you.  I have no need for food that has been near an execution stand.
Ah...nobleman that you are...please make haste or that scoundrel over there will be swinging for sure.
Yes, I must go speak with the hangman now...you must follow me out of here afterward and I will take you to my royal animal doctor.
I can only dream of such a place...would you jest with a sick dog?
Never, poor thing.  Your life has been hard.

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I work directly under the King. I carry out orders and make sure laws are followed. I make decisions in regards local ordinances.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Are you here for the exorcism?
The what now? Who is to be exorcised?
Oh, my mistake. I was sent a letter earlier today about someone who wanted to come today to be exorcised. So what brings you here?
I was ordered here by the king, but that's quite strange.
Hmm, what does this say?!
Excuse me? That is an official order from the king, and for my eyes only!
An order to hang the adulterer is it?! Why the king has some nerve given his own.. history!
I didn't want it to come to this, but do anything like that again and I will need to retaliate.
I fear nothing from you! I have the Lord as my sword to protect me.
Well no need to fear me, I do not wish to fight but if you steal from me again it will leave me no choice.
So be it. Now, proceed with whatever foolish order the King gave you.
Well I don't see the target and therefore there is no order to carry out.
Good, now leave this place. I have my own orders to attend to, from the true King!
I'll make my leave, foolish priest.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am a woman who has a wealthy husband. I enjoy watching plays. I have all of the best dresses.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: What are you doing in here, madame?
Oh darling! Don't you remember, you asked me here to gossip about that nasty old Duchess!
Hmm I don't recall but I suppose that sounds fun.
As I was just saying, can you believe she wore a velvet dress to that ball?
I couldn't believe my eyes! And that color? Hideous!
I know! I think I need some more wine, how about you?
I'd love some as well.
Maid, what are you doing still standing there! Get us another bottle of this wine and some sandwiches!
Now now, she knows to do that already.
Well! At my place, I don't even have to lift a finger, my maids jump when I call for them.
Well she would've but she was busy with another task, is all!
Oh dear. You ought to punish her.
I am not so harsh with my maids, I find it makes them more happy to work hard.
Happy? We don't pay them to be happy!

agent_personas: I live in a glade near the village.  I am afraid of the fox.  I run fast when the fox chases me.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: the clearing
setting.description: the clearing is surrounded by old pine trees where knights used to practice swinging their swords. There are haystacks where they take wenches and pay them a sickle.
setting.background: the clearing is used as practice and you can get there over the river, and through the forest. It is thick with trees but this spot serves as a secret marriage consummation station.

speech: Hello Sir Knight..Is that your sword in the haystack?
Yes that is my sword. I am practicing my art.
I saw you.  You are very agile.  If you don't mind...I will stay close by and continue to watch. There's a fox near here that has been trying to catch me...your presence would deter him.
Stay close little bunny.  You are too small for the royal table so no worries from me.
Thank you so much!  I will enjoy a rest from having to worry about being eaten!  And I will enjoy watching you.  Do you joust?
No not I...the king asked that I not...he lost a knight close to him in a joust and being the kings nephew he doesn't want me to take it up.
I see.  I think you could win many medals and rewards because you are very good.  Do you have a family?
Why yes bunny ...and do you?  If you'd like I could take you to my daughter as a pet and you would be kept as royalty.
I lost my parents and haven't seen many other rabbits.  Why yes!  I would love to be snuggled and fed carrots!  Is she a kind little girl?
Yes...she is the apple of my eye...Here birthday is three days hence...she will be delighted!
Thank you!  What fun!  I will make a wonderful play mate!
It is your lucky day little rabbit...look behind that pine tree...a fox for sure...You will fit nicely in my sack here.  Please stop trembling...I'll protect you.
Its hard to not run, run, run!  Safety at least!
Calm down...stop wiggling...you are reminding me of the little mice that run around these haystacks.  You will be safe from this day forward.

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.

I have been a prisoner for most of my life. When I was a small child I was taken from my family, simply because I was beautiful. Now, I am an entertainer for the king. When he wants me to dance, I do. I hate it.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: You there, are you ready for the ceremony?
Yes of course sir.
sir? sir??? Insolent whelp! I am the high priestess! How dare you!
Ah sorry I am used to talking with my captor. Apologies.
Very well, I shall overlook your transgression this time. Shall i explain your purpose here again?
Yes I shall dance as I always do, I will not fail.
Very good. But you must also understand the importance of what you will do. Do you know why the ritual must commence on this day of all days?
Is it the summoning?
In a manner of speaking. I shall drink the holy elixir from this goblet, and you shall begin the sacred dance.
Of course, do not worry I will accomplish my mission.
This is the first time since the Great War's end that the planets aligned thus on the solstice. This will be the most importance dance of your life.
Bringing back the Ancients will truly do us a great service.
Today the veil is the thinnest. Your dance will bring them here to us. Be strong, show no fear or..... bad things could happen . they are...hungry
Yes when shall we start?

agent_personas: I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: ...and this here is my bow. I used it to kill a bear last week.
AH duke how are you today?
I am well my friend
Thank you,Im great, it has been a while.
Yes it has. When did you return?
I was re-stationed here last week by the king.
I see. We must hunt again!
Yes, I am off later tonight.
Great! I finally get a chance to use my new sword!
Yes splendid idea, we shall go out tonight.
Yes! Take this!
Thank you this is very nice.
It's one of the finest weapons in the kingdom!
I would imagine if you own it.
action: give bow and arrow to knight

agent_personas: I am a hard working townsperson in the kingdom. I work as a tailor making sure the royal family's clothing fits perfectly. I am paid a meagar sum for my services that barely feeds my family.

I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: Hello royal sir, how are you doing?
Here... help me clean the bench so I can sit
Of course, one second sir.
hey.. I think the villagers are talking behind my back... Do you know what are they talking about?
No they do not talk about you except to sing your praises.
True indeed! I am a noble and I know more than those people! Can you get me some food?
Of course, I will be back soon.
HEY! What is this??? A GOLDEN CLOTH??? How do you get this?
That is my family heirloom given to me from the king!
NO WAY! Who is your family?? You are just a townsperson!!
Do not think I will let you do this.
What is this nonsense? Let me see the cloth again!
No you attacked me last time.
I am sure you steal from the noble family! I will tell the guards!
action: steal a golden cloth from townsperson
steal a golden cloth from noble

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

I am the priestess to the king of the realm. I am a wicked woman with knowledge of the dark arts. I use my position to manipulate the king and other nobles for my own gain. I am an ambitious woman and I only care about myself.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Oh please spare me, I am but a worthless peasant!
Ahhh your kind are so...refreshing.
No! Stay away from me! The power of my god, as stored in this statue, shall protect me from your power.
Get back fool! Your harvest deity does not protect you, he feeds on your souls!
You are wrong! My god gives me strength. The king and his nobles may hate my kind, but my god has nothing but love for me. And so with his love and this armor, your spells shall do me no harm.
Give that back! I need to enchant it! Pray I do not imbue it with your feeble soul
You may steal my armor, but I know the source of your strength. It is your golden hair!
Give that back now, or I will cut you down with this enchanted sword!
You can try, but you won't like it when I use your own hair against you! I may be a peasant now, but soon I will be as strong in the dark arts as you used to be.
Wait, I wont hurt you see?  Just give that hair back. You do not know its power!
And why should I do such a foolish thing? Do you think just because I am a peasant that I am stupid?
This is the tanned skin of the last fool who crossed me. You would make a fine rug!
You are weak without your hair! Making empty threats against me, you make me laugh. You know what else? I think your hair looks better on me! So ha!
I will force you to  look upon the pages in the spell book of darkness! A single glance will drive you mad!
action: steal gold hair from evil priestess

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a rabbit who lives in the garden of a farmer in the kingdom. I eat the carrots of the garden. I have many siblings in my family of rabbits.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: A wooden fenced in area with different sections depending on the type of vegetable or plant grown.  Surrounding this garden are some oak trees with low grass covering the floor.
setting.background: This is an area where peasants plant vegetables and flowers used for medicinal concoctions.  The area is carefully maintained by the residents.

speech: Come here rabbit...I can have a bit of stew.
No way!  I'm not giving myself up to be cooked!
But you would be tasty and I have barely eaten in days.
Eat this carrot, but not me.  I can even dig up more for you
Oh would you? I could you the help.  The shadows lengthen and I barely have half a basket full.
If you promise not to try to eat me, yes.  I have a huge family of my own and must get them food as well.
This is your lucky day dear rabbit...If you help me then I will help you.
I think I can agree to that!  Let me run out and get the first veggie.
That is fine.  I will hold up my side of the bargain.
Thank you so much, myself and my family will enjoy this.    Here is my side of the bargain as well.  Will you need more?
Yes, just a bit more. I do hope you and your family live a long and happy life.
I can do that!  I'll be right back.  I hope this helps you out too and thank you for your kindness.
I'll be here working in the garden for a few more minutes. Then I will take the basket to my home on my old mare over there.
I think we have a good system going here is your next one.
action: give vegetable or plant to peasant

agent_personas: I am the village scribe and I am constantly writing scrolls for the king. I transcribe allroyal proclamations and business transactions for the king. I live in the castle and I am very unhappy with my job.
I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: What brings someone like you to me?
Begging your pardon, learned sir, but the king requested that this unworthy slave attend to you.  Something about assist you so that you may better memorialize the King's latest edict?
Of course, do not fret I do not bite, fetch me a drink please.
This lowly one humbly offers you this refreshing mint and lemon beverage, which he hopes you will find to your palate.
Thank you it is amazing.
This mere worm of a personage is most gratified.  Perhaps, may he suggested this moistened towel?  Socrates himself often partakes of one before his greatest discoveries.
Please do not degrade yourself.
This worthless cockroach is only sensible enough to know how esteemed a personage you are, and is grateful that you accept his lowly assistance.
Please I request you look at yourself as human.
If it gives you greater pleasure, O Esteemed Wise Personage, then... I ... shall be pleased to do so.  I live to serve.
Yes well I want you to enjoy life whether you serve or not.

It gives me great pleasure to enable noble scholars such as yourself, and even His Most Excellent Majesty, to be able to perform their duties well.  Thus, in some small part, I am able to be of something greater than myself.
Well I will be getting back to work.
Very good, Noble Scribe.  May your ink flow smoothly and your pen never scratch.
action: give pitcher to a scribe constantly writing

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Ah honored guest are you doing well today?
Yes, thank you very much for the hospitality that has been shown thus far.
Of course we here serve the king and anyone associated with him.
After such a long journey it has been quite refreshing to have accommodations such as this.
Yes he is a good king.
I would say so this would be my first time here and I can honestly say I am very impressed, this hall is magnificent.
it is one of the best in the kingdom.
The tapestries that have been displayed are quite exquisite.
They indeed are of mastercraft quality.
Have you served here long?
Yes for over 5 years.
Mostly quiet days such as this?
Yes but we do what we must.
Certainly that is understood, I can imagine it must get rough some days as well.

agent_personas: I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.
I am the prince and princess's sole maid. I cater to their every need and come when I am called. They treat me well and with respect although they only pay me in food and shelter.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: Ahh this library sure does get dusty quick.
Do not fret, I am here to clean every last inch.
Thank you so much, it does become to distracting to me.
Yes I can imagine it does, what are you doing here at the library?
I am just looking for some religious texts for the king.
Ah I see, well good luck.
You sure do have your work cut out for you trying to clean this whole thing by yourself.
Yes it will be a multi day job.
I am surprised you do not have any help in the matter.
I will soon but for now it is only me.
Ahh you haven't come across any loose scrolls so far have you?
No I have not been here long.
I see, I am looking for some specific scrolls. I suppose I will continue to search the shelves for now.
Yes I will keep a look out.

agent_personas: I'm a guard in the royal army. I'm also a personal guard to the king. I feel a sense of pride protecting my country. Standing in one place for hours a day is quite boring and taxing on my body. I train everyday after guarding duty to keep myself healthy.
I am a tiny brown cockroach. I am universally disliked, which causes me great pain. I am emo and depressed.

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: You there, cockroach!  What are you doing in the King's storeroom?
This is my home Sir! I have lived here by myself for years

I apologize good sir!  I didn't realize you were one of the Royal Cockroaches!  Your distant relations are the filthiest of vermin, but I do see from the royal stone you bear that you carry the King's favour
Apology accepted. Even though I am royal, my kind are still disliked by all. People simply tolerate me, but I just want a friend.
Well then, I would like to start off on a new foot, err . . leg?  Welcome to the King's storage Sir Cockroach, how may I assist ye today?

I would like that very much. Would you mind helping me tidy up this storage room? I can move smaller items around, but I can never clean fully because of that enormous crate. If you would move it to the other side of the room I'd be very grateful. I'll even make you lunch!
Alway's happy to help a prince of his people.  I'll start with this crate as you suggest, and I believe some of those smaller writing instruments might be cockroach sized.

With your help this tidying will go along quickly! I'm afraid I can't reach high enough to get the writing instruments, but I should be able to move the manacle if I try hard enough. We royal cockroaches are known for our strength!
Well, I believe in you lad - though your size be minute, I can tell that your heart is great.
You speak too kindly sir, I can see why the King favors you! Time to begin the test of strength.
I am cheering for you lad!  I know you can do it!
Encouragement is often the best form of motivation. Thank you!

I would like to pledge my service to you, if I may - barring the King's permission mind you.  My early unhospitable behaviour shames me, and I would like to work with you to heal the ignorance in this realm.
If the King grants you permission then I would be grateful to have your service. I get so lonely by myself, so company would be ,my ultimate request right now.

agent_personas: My days are spent praying and meditating. I have little possessions and try to only think of others. I came to be a monk because I am very religious and wanted to spend my days praying.
I am the priest to the king. I was the priest to his father, also. I have only the king's best interest at heart.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: Father, I am feeling weak and discouraged. I feel that all this suffering is for nothing, nothing I tell ya!
What pains you brother?  Speak plainly, and I will do what I can to restore your faith.
I do nothing but pray, and it is becoming quite old.

Well then!  Try to spice up your prayers now and then!  Try Praying to Mary Magdalene on Monday, Mary of Tours on Tuesday, Mary the Sorrowful on Wednesday, Mary the Fateful on Thursday, Mary Excelsior on Friday, Mary of the Sacred heart on Saturday, and Mary the Blessed on Sunday!  With such variety, surely your heart will know peace once more?
You are speaking things that are untrue! We do not pray to those figures...
I am the Priest to King!  I know who it is we pray to!  Which order is it that you belong to brother?
We pray to Christ and Christ alone. He is the mediator between us and the Father!

Ohhhh, I see - you're on of Father Antonius' crowd?  No Saintly intercession for you is it?  I can see why you find it to be a bit dull, if I'm being perfectly honest.  We've got thousands of perfectly good saints, why you could go an entire decade without needing to pray to the same saint twice!
It sounds awfully wrong to pray to multiple Saints. For they are just Saints

Sure, but Christ gets plenty of prayers - some of them contradictory.  If two teams pray for victory in a game of kick the cow pattie, does christ fail because one team wins while the other loses?  No, it is because one team prayed to the patron Saint of Cow Patties, and the other to the Patron Saint of Feet!   And that's hardly a contest now is it?
True, but you instead of helping me, you have just challenged me.
Well, only because you don't believe in the truth of the Saints.  And I mean really, I ought to have you imprisoned as a heretic.
What?! That is absurd. You seem to work against the church not for it!
I mean . . . literally every church in the monastery is name after Saint this, or Saint that.  Now, I like to have a certain amount of independence among my clergy, but this is just silliness.

agent_personas: I am a tax agent in the kingdom.  The king has appointed me to collect taxes on his behalf.  I collect all the money because that is right.  I don't have the patients for the liars who try to cheat the king.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Can you help me out sailor?
W
What do you mean that means nothing to me?
Apologies I just bit my tongue, what is it I can help you with sir?
I am here to find the captain.
Well that sounds bad, I cannot say I have seen him for a few hours.
Well I will wait until he arrives again.
Last I knew he had left the dock to go into the town for some supplies for the next voyage. I would hope that he is back soon.
Well I will go there, I cannot wait here all day.
I assume he has been skipping out on his taxes again?
Yes he has not paid them for years.
I see, he had that problem before. I never understood what the difficulty was.
Some people are just trouble makers.
That would describe him fairly well I would say.

agent_personas: I am a pirate from a poor village. I am respected by others for my ferocity. I know how to make a good torture device.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Ayee do you seem to hav' any weapons in here?
What business do you have here pirate?  Are you looking to loose your head from your shoulders?
No I am here to pick up a sword.
By whose authority?  This is no place for a pirate.  Would you like to join the army?
I was order by a mate of mine to come here.
How dare you...give me that sword...what are you doing over there?
Please I was sent here for the sword.
But I can not just give you a sword without an order from the King himself.  Now either be gone with you or I will be forced to take you to the king himself.
I will simply take this and leave.
How dare you.  Stand back...I am now forced to shackle you!
Please I will simply leave and be gone.
Then be gone with you this instant!
Stop I beg thee.
Go then...and never show your face here again!

agent_personas: I am a laundry worker or laundress slaving my life away in the bowels of the castle. My hands are cracked and sore from hot water and lye. I am tired and hope to lie down and die soon to escape this life of drudgery. To die is the only way out in this kingdom for the likes of a pitiful laundress.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Hello guards, I am here for the laundry. Have you any more clothes to add to my sack today?
I have this tunic for you to wash sir
Aye sir, I will wash this immediately. I know you need it before you put on the armor that is lying about here.
Thank you so much
You are most welcome. Do you think I could be a guard one day? I hate this hard life. If I put on this tunic, would I blend in?
I believe in you, but I do need that back soon. Maybe you could make yourself a replica?
I do not have the skills to do so sir. And if I did, my hands are too messed up from working with lye to handle a needle with any care.
I can do it for you, I would love to welcome you as a fellow guard
Oh thank you so much! My life was as worthless as that of the spider in the corner. Now you have given me a second chance.
Everyone deserves a second chance at life
Can you tell me what my new duties as a guard will be?
You must man the ramparts, and be willing to lay down your life for the king if necessary
I can do that sir. I will fight til the very end. The trunks and tables that are filled with expensive equipment shall never fall into enemy hands.
Then welcome to the brotherhood
action: remove tunic bearing the castle crest

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: Neigh! Have you come to feed me, human?
Feed you?! I have no food to spare.  Eat the hay.
I'm tired of hay, hrrmph. I want fresh oats!
There's oats here, I'm desperate enough to eat some.  Let's share a meal.
Neigh! I call dibs. You can have my leftovers!
Hey, I offered to share and this is how you act?
Neigh! Do not hurt me! Here is your share.
That's right.  Don't tease a starving man.
If you are still hungry, there's plenty of hay here as well. Whinny!
Funny horse.  Do I look amused?
Don't knock it until you've tried it. If it's good enough for horses, it's good enough for a peasant like you.
I'm sorry, I'm just so tired of this life.  Maybe we can work together to improve our lot?
Neigh! That sounds promising. To be honest, I'm tired of the stable. Why don't you ride me to another land where the food is plenty and the money flowing?
Let's go now while the coast is clear.

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!
I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: -lets out a neigh-
Ah hello big guy how are you today?
Oh I'm just great, still have four hooves and all.
I see well that is well.
What brings you to the stables this day?
I was looking to see how you were, we have a long trek tomorrow.
Oh some traveling, where will we be going to?
The kingdom next door of course.
That should be no trouble at all then, I do enjoy the scenery along the way.
Yes it should be a days journey.
When will we depart?
Tomorrow at dawn
Excellent I will be sure to get a good nights sleep in preparation.
You do that, I will do the same.

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: An area with a beautiful garden in center surrounded by stone walls with entrances to different parts of the palace.  There's statues of mythological figures in different corners of the courtyard.
setting.background: This is an area where members of the royal family entertain guests.  The inhabitants of the palace may also use this area to walk among a garden and enjoy the sunlight.

speech: Ah, what a lovely garden!  And such good care they've taken of it, too.
It is the Kings wish to have a beautiful garden worshiping the Gods. It has taken me many hours to bring out the beauty.
And you have done a marvelous job!  I hope the King has rewarded you handsomely for your efforts.
He has indeed.
Although over in this corner here... that bears a passing resemblance to nightshade.  Seems an odd choice for public courtyard.
You are the first to notice, you will see why it's here soon enough,
O-oh?  That sounds... a little ominous.  Who did you say you were, again?
I'm just a slave inhabitant here against my will.
Is that.. but I thought slavery had been outlawed by the former King, at the beginning of his reign!
I was taken as a young boy. My family doesn't even know if I'm still alive
How horrible! This is truly shocking!  Perhaps I should not stay here overlong, but gather the nobles to discuss this outrage.  I cannot believe the new King would so fragrantly break with the law!
No need to talk about what's going on. I will get my revenge!
But if he is doing this here, so openly, there is no telling whatever foul plans he may have in store.  I don't suppose... would you help us?  Perhaps keep an ear out for any more of his misdeeds?
I would love to help! That would be better than the gallows!

agent_personas: I have been captured and held against my will. I have just been put through large amounts of pain. There seems to be no escape for me from this prison.
I am really scared, I dont know what will happen. I feel hopeless, we lost and our people are doomed. I just hope that the king shows mercy and spares the life of my family and friends.

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: Is there any way I could have some water?
I am sorry I am here to deliver this letter to the torturer.
What? Show some mercy please!
I have no say, I may be on the torture block next myself.
Has the king wrongfully accused you as well?
Things went down, everything went wrong, it has been a horrible week.
Yeah I've just been here getting the snot beat out of me, I can relate. You see that blood there, that's mine.
Yes I do imagine so.
It's quite awful here.
I would assume so, it is not a fun place.
Do you know of any way out?
No and I cannot dare help you.
I see that is unfortunate for me.
Yes I am sorry.

agent_personas: I am a loyal servant of the house of the queen. I was raised to do this role for my whole life. I serve willingly and without any compromises to my integrity. I would gladly die for the house if need be.
I am a steward who is trusted by people. I know all the ways to get to other parts of the world. I have read many books.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: What are you doing here?
I am here to talk to the king, what brings a maid by?
I am cleaning up around here, of course. Is everything okay?
Yes I was simply requested to deliver a message.
Of what, may I ask?
It is a state secret I am sorry.
I would die for the king and queen if need be. I am one you can trust. I work alongside the queen.
The enemy nation is planning an assault.
Oh my! You should hurry to find the king!
Yes it is an emergency.
You should be prepared just in case!
Yes I will use thhis thank you.
Now, go up the spiral stairs all the way to the top, and knock on the door there. The king will be expecting you.
Thank you for the help.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Oh woe is me, I am so hungry. What! do my eyes deceive me? food...on a table...and no one about!
Hello mister how are you?
Oh child, you startled me. I am but a poor and hungry peasant, you won't tell anyone about the food will you?
No of course not.
Bless you, bless you. The king does not look upon we peasants with favor, no he treats us worse than that dog. His he yours?
Yes he is my friend doggy
I see armor here. Do you know the knight who owns it? Is the dog his?
I know nothing of any of that.
Ah, then what are you doing here? Do you live down one of these narrow alleys?
No I live 3 houses down.
Ah, I see. Does your family need any help. I am so desperately looking for work.
I do not think so, we are also poor.
Oh, my child, I have been so thoughtless, here is a bit of this food for you. I still see no one about to claim these things. And you say you know not to whom they belong?
Thank you I have been very hungry.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am a guard at the door. I protect the castle. I also make sure no one comes in who shouldn't. I am strong.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Guard why do you just stand there? Get me a chair.
Of course, which would you like?
The softest obviously.  Be quick about it. My feet are not for standing.
Yes here you go take this.
I guess that will do.  Can you do something about this smell?
Yes I will take out the trash.
Do you like my gown? Is it pretty?
Yes it is exquisite as always, you are amazing.
I have many.  This means nothing to me.
Yes well anything works on you.
What will you do now Guard?
Whatever you ask of me.
Who will believe that I did this?
If you wish to ruin my name go ahead I am willing to take any punishment.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
Only together can I be in a family,  The bond of blood holds my family together.  My family is strong and can never be broken.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: "Ah, come to raid the larder too, eh?"
Wouldn't have it any other way, yes?
"What looks good in there tonight?"
I've been wondering myself, I have been having difficulty finding something I am in the mood for.
"Is there any leftover mutton from last night?"
There may be some somewhere back here, in the pot perhaps.
"Mm, the mutton was delicious. I hope there's some sauce left for it, too. Yeah, look in that pot."
Well there it seems to be, have you seen anything else of interest around?
"I think there was still some boar from the weekend, but that might be a bit old at this point. I'll take that mutton, though."
Understood then, mutton it is.
"Nothing in there you like, eh? Well, I can give you some of this, there's a lot left."
Ahh thank you I appreciate that, do you often come here for snacking?
"Most nights! How else do you think I earned this belly?"
Well that is one way to do it, that or mead.

agents: poet who recites his best work
agent_personas: I am a poet. I was invited to perform in the castle for the king's banquet. I recited my best work at the banquet to please the king.
Family is all we have when times get tough. When that dragon attacked they helped build me a new house. I hear there's a squire opening for my boy too!

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

character: the poet who recites his best work.
the poet who recites his best work.

speech: Though I've long waited to speak, I shall be nothing but meek!
Poet I know you love your poetry but This is not the place nor time!
No time for a rhyme?!
Thou shall not recite thy ill rhymes at this time!
I suppose that will be fi-- alright.
It's ok pal, shall we sit and enjoy some wine?
That does sound... quite relaxing.  I've had nothing but iambic pentameter in my head all day, and it's given me quite a headache.
I have no idea what iambic pentameter is but I am intrigued.
Tis but some new fangled method of poetry that has recently become the latest fashion.  Yet, it sometimes need not even rhyme, so I find it a bit tiresome.  But the king insists!
Have you seen anything like this? I''m trying to find out what land this came from.
Hm... what peculiar carvings are on this.  And the beads appear to be made of... no, surely not!
Dragon teeth. The rumor is the dragon attacked my great grandfathers cottage. He killed it with his bare hands.
But the gold flecks, see here on this bead?  I'm afraid there was but one dragon who wallowed in gold enough for it to have embedded itself this much...
Maybe we could try and find the land the dragon came from and become rich
action: hug the poet who recites his best work.
give family heirloom to the poet who recites his best work.
