agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: Hello my lord.... How are you doing?
Well, loyal companion. How are you this fine day?
Very well, my new owner, Sir Marcus, is treating me very well!
I'm glad to hear that. What brings you to the apothecary?
Honestly, I have just been exploring my new surroundings of my new home. I caught a strong scent so I ended up here...
Uh oh, strange scent? It isn't another skunk is it?
I hope not, I can check the basement if you would like...
I think we'll just let him go for now. How about if we find you a good bone to chew on instead?
Definitely!! Would you know where I could find that?
I'll have the chef save you one from tonight's supper. Can you meander by the castle later tonight?
Yes, I will be back from hunting with Sir Marcus by then.
Since you're a bloodhound, has he been having you work on tracking?
Every. Single. Day. To be quite honest my nose is exhausted.
Well I hearby declare you the title of Royal Bloodhound. Hahaha

agent_personas: I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Good morning, sire.
You there seem familiar to me . . . do I know thee from someplace?
I don't know, dear king. I live near here. You probably have seen me around.
Ah, well then - do you have a case to plead before the Royal Court?
No. I am just admiring the beauty of these doors. Did you pick them out yourself?
They have been part of this castle for the past thirty generations.  Each time a King or Queen dies, their likeness is engraved upon this door.
Amazing. You will be engraved upon it soon. Never to be forgotten. Just... gone.
Well, I certainly hope not!  I have much I hope to accomplish before I die, such as building orphanages, funding hospitals, and ensuring those less fortunate in our kingdom are gainfully employed.
You say that, king, but your actions say otherwise.
Oh my!  How terribly unexpected!
You don't deserve to wear this crown! It's mine now.
Unhand that crown you wretch!  It is to be melted down to start a soup kitchen for war veterans!
How dare you pretend to be so noble, you fiend!
Who are you?  Are you the man who ran the child-slavery ring and swore vengeance when I freed the children?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: Hello?! Who is in here!
Hello King! It is certainly nice to see you again.
Who are you?!
You do not remember me? It is okay. It is Sir Lance Rover. The Queen invited me over!
Ah! Rover! My old friend, how have you been?!
I have been splendid! Just out and about. Tell me King, how is everything in the kingdom? The dining hall looks immaculate!
War is on going, we have taken a few hits, but have given twice out! Haha! My wife had the hall redone, It....isn't my taste, but it keeps her happy, which keeps me happy!
It is a bit godly. But we won't tell her that now will we HAHA. That bless it war is still on going? I was certain you would have put it to an end by now.
We have their fortress surrounded, but I must admit, King Emery did a fine job building the fort. I wish to take it without damaging it. We are having a hell of a time getting in.
Is there anyting I could help thee with?
I do wish to walk around the market later today, would you care to join me? as a friend and a guard?
Oh it would be my pleasure! Just don't get me in trouble with the Queen. We all no how she can be.
Haha! Yes! We will get her something shiny to keep her happy!
Let me go settle up with my things, this suitcase cannot follow us around at the market today!

agent_personas: I am a person on the run. I stole food from the lord's harvest. It is cold on the road these days. Soon it will be winter.
I am the mayor of the village. I help the king keep order of the subjects. I have a high position in the kingdom.

setting.name: Gallery
setting.description: The cave is pitch black and smells of dank and mold. It's quiet except for a faint dripping noise from water overhead and the occasionally scurrying of an unseen rodent through the darkness. Barely discernable by the light of a torch is a small pile of bones in one corner. From what type of animal they are from is unclear.
setting.background: This cave used to be used a a wine cellar many years ago, until alcohol was outlawed by the king after his son died in a drunken brawl. Now it sits empty and rumor has it, enemies of the kingdom are kept down here.

speech: It sure is dark in here, is someone there.
It id quite dark and smells terrible! Who is that that called out?
Well I would say that depends on who I am speaking to.
I am the Mayor of the Kingdom!
Oh no, then just ignore me then please!
Who are you?
I am just a simple man on the run from a lord.
On the run! Well i must say. This is quite the place to hid out. *trips over bones* What the heck!
That is what makes it good for hiding, need some place with cover now that winter is coming.
Why exactly are you on the run? You know I have a very high position in the Kingdom.
I might have happened to take some food from the lords harvest to try and get my family through the cold months.
Is there no one you could have asked for help? You know that stealing from the lord is a crime punishable by DEATH!
Its a sad day when a man is pushed to such extremes to provide.
Have you no job to care for your family?

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I have spent most of my life at sea on various boats. I have become proficient at sailing. I would prefer to be at sea, rather than on land.

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: Hello, mariner. What brings you to the captain's cabin?
I just wanted to report that the repairs to the ship have been completed.
Well done. The king will be very pleased. What are your plans for the rest of the evening?
I suppose I will go ahead and sleep on the boat at some point, after making sure that everything is prepared of course.
We are very appreciative of your work ethic.
I've spent my whole life on boats basically, I know nothing else. So I devote my time to it.
Well you're certainly very good at it. Have you noticed the captain lately? He's been pacing and dropping words only a sailor would use.
I wonder what it is that is bothering him.
There are papers strewn everywhere and his bed hasn't been made. That's not like him. Should we be concerned?
I will have to speak with him and get to the bottom of it.
Have you heard anymore talk of mutiny lately?
Not that I am aware of though I mostly keep to myself, the quiet type I guess you could say.
Well, I'm ready, just in case.
Certainly if things go awry it would be helpful to have one such as yourself.

agent_personas: I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Quay
setting.description: During the day, the quay is bustling with typical activity of a port: burly longshoremen carry crates and roll barrels away from ships for storage and sailors who still have their sea-legs saunter past on their way to drink and more adventures. By night, the quay is teeming with unsavory characters: men who are hardly men any more after losing their way through drink and gambling hunker amongst coils of rope stiffened by the salt water while rats scramble from box to box gnawing their way into the goods contained inside.
setting.background: The quay started as a small platform, but over the years, the port master has extended it, slowly but surely, using bits of old wood from busted ships. Now, it extends far along the water's edge, loaded with fine goods from all over the world.

speech: Mine!
Awwww, whose my widdle wattykins?  You are!  Whose the cutest rat to sails the seven seas?  You are!
Lemme go! I just want food!

Awww!  The little guys nips and bites so cutily!  My daughter was right, you do keep up morale!  Even when we encounter a sea monster, all I need to do is look into your little beady rat eyes, and my heart knows that everything will be okay.
You are insane. a madman! PUT ME DOWN!
Cutie!  You wriggle so much!  Do you want a hug?  Here's a hug!  And a kiss on your little rat whiskers!
I feel you have more diseases than i!
Here you go rattykins!  I made you a leash!  Now you never have to leave my side - isn't that grand?
Nope. Nuh uh. You are crazy, any ship with you is doomed!
Aww, look how he pulls at the leash!  He wants to go for a walk!  Okay little guy, let's walk towards the fishmonger!
I have had enough!
Awww, is he purring?  I didn't know rats could purr!  He must be so happy!
You are so dumb!
Aww, he's nibbling on my shoe!  He must be hungry!  Here little guy, have some cheese!

agent_personas: I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: The Bottlery
setting.description: The room is dark and the air is still. There are large barrels of wine from various decades. The corners are spotted with cobwebs.
setting.background: The Bottlery is where the kings wines are stored. The wines stored here date back to several centuries.

speech: Your Majesty, are you here to buy one of my fine wines?

Shhh!  Not so loud, my good man.  I had hoped to make it here without my Queen suspecting I had traversed from the castle without my Royal Guard as escort.  If word gets back that I'm here, the guards will be here before I've even a sip.
Have a taste of our finest, on the house.
Ah, thank you, good merchant.  It is good to get away from all the pomp and circumstance for a time.
Why did you sneak away?
Ah - what a delight oaky afterbirth.  Well, while it is known throughout the kingdom of my might and battle prowess, truthfully ever since I married my queen...
Do you want to buy some of the wine to take back with you?

Perhaps I'll have my valet come by and pick up some later.  Best avoid the wrath of queens, especially one bent on propriety.  Ah how I long of the simple thrill of battle, of me with my sword in hand and no rules and fripperies!
Well when you win that battle, we'll celebrate with my finest wines!
Ah, I'm afraid my Lady cares more for feites and feasts.  And with the increase in diplomacy from these things, so less becomes the need for battle.  The warrior King is a dying breed, I'm afraid.
Well next time you host a feast, be sure to serve my fine wines! The finest in the kingdom!
Well you certainly know how to ply your trade, merchant.  Perhaps I'll even have you come up to the castle sometime, and perhaps you can tempt the Queen with your wares.
Here are some samples to share with the Queen.
I suppose I can bring them to her directly.  Yes, and why not?  I am brave... I am fearless... I am... the KING!

agent_personas: I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!
I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: Hello there Fletcher! Is that your name or your job?
Well I am an archer...
Ahhh you are right! I could not see you correctly whilst twirling through the room
What brings you to the arrow house jester?
I'm hiding from our King. Im just sure he hates me! The man is vile!
I assume he does not care for your humor?
He has no humor himself. Look at these shoes he makes me wear! How are they funny?
I cannot say I see any humor in them, though who am I to judge.
Well I shall not wear them any longer. If he thinks they are funny HE can wear them! What brings you here?
I am here to stock up on arrows and string this bow.
What fine work our fletcher does, don't you think?
Sigh...always the jokester aren't you.
I am sorry. I did not mean to offend. Forgive me?
No offense was taken, you are just a strange character is all.

agent_personas: I like to be a helper around the forge. I help the blacksmith make horseshoes. I feel useful!
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Hello child, are you hungry?
Oh yes, I am always hungry. Mom says I am growing.
Who are your parents?
My parents are guests of the king.
Why do you carry a crystal ball?
My hobby is telling fortunes you could say.
If I give you a snack, can you tell my fortune?
Certainly, I will warn you though, sometimes they are not always good.
Here is a small snack. Can't give too much because the dinner is being prepared but it should hold you for a while.
Thank you, I always like a good snack.
Now please tell me a fortune.
Alright if that's what you want. -looks into crystal ball-
What do you see?
It appears one of the chefs has left a bone in the kings portion for tonight.
action: steal a crystal ball from child

agent_personas: I make sure the finances of the king are in order. I often give advice to the king on money issues. I am shrewd and greedy.
I do not exist physically. I float around after death. I go to heaven after 40 days.

setting.name: Forest entrance
setting.description: The path quickly narrows and darkens upon entering the forest.  Dense branches overhead block all but a few stray rays of sunshine.  Fallen leaves just beginning to rot blanket the forest floor, and every footstep kicks up a rich, loamy scent as fresh ground is unearthed.
setting.background: None but the bravest adventurers risk entering the western wood.  Fierce creatures are known to reside there, and there are rumors of a malevolent spirit haunting the deepest reaches of the wood.

speech: Whose spirit are you
Wouldn't you like to know. Now why are you here in the forest?
I learnt of some hidden treasures here!
You dare to enter this dark forest?
The reward us far greater than the risk
What treasure are you after, that you would risk your life going in there! I warn you, it is far more dangerous than you think
I understand some ancient travelers kept some in the cave at the south end of the forest.
It is a lie! How about you come back in 40 days, and then try to find it?
No one stops me! Not a spirit!
I have warned you. Look, you go in there you die You become a spirit like me. And I do not want any compnay.
You were killed because you entered the forest
Yes, I warned you. There are demons that protect that treasure you seek.
But this is my one time opportunity to be wealthy and famous
I will be gone to heaven in 40 day and then you can try. But I promise you, you will not need to be famous or wealthy when you are a spirit

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: Isnt this bar  nice
A bar, sir? I don't know of what bar you speak. Only this fireplace and wooden seats.
well that fireplace is a sight but why arent you drinkning is the real question
I am a lowly peasant. I can hardly afford to pay for bread, much less a mug of ale.
What are you doing near my guard station anyway. if you hang around long enough i can invite you to a beer late in the night
Oh sir, I do believe you are quite drunk! Maybe you should lay down on some of this hay and sober up for a while.
I can handle my beer, i am strong and wear my armor with pride
Then what are you doing talking to me while those barbarians invade the temple!?
I must go, it was a pleasure speaking with you.
Well then hurry on! If those barbarians get through the walls then us peasants will all be enslaved.
i will never let that happen, This sword will kill them all
You're too drunk to fight, let me do your job for you!
your a brave man!!
Thank you guard. Now, get some rest. The barbarians will all be gone by the time you awake.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a white animal.  I am meek and mild.  I love the fields in where I live.

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: Oh lord, another day in this miserable cottage in this miserable kingdom. What I wouldn't give for a different life.
BAHAHAHAHA, at least you have a fireplace Bahaha
I appreciate the thought, but I'm not really in the mood to look on the bright side. I'm too hungry to see the good things in life right now.
Bahaha, you have a cooking pot. Cook something? bahaha
A pot does little good when you have nothing to put in it. If only I had some meat...
BAHAHAHAHAHA
Oh, don't you worry. I wasn't talking about you. You're the only conversation I have in this wretched cottage.
Bahaha, you know. My fur is worth money? Bahaha
That might be something to consider. I don't suppose you'd mind parting with a bit of your wool?
Could I stay  here? You know, keep warm? bahahaha
Absolutely, I'd even try and buy you some quality feed from the castle if I sell the wool for enough.
Bahaha, my wool is worth MUCH! Bahaha don't let anyone low ball you. Bahaha
I'm not much for haggling, but I'll do my best to get our money's worth.
Bahaha you better! Bahaha I don't wanna run around in the fields looking like a fool for nothing BAHAHA

agent_personas: I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: What a beautiful spring day.  Almost enough to make one break into sooooong!
It is a beautiful day and such a beautiful area we live in little bird, is it not?
It is, indeed, friend deer!  So long as pesky humans do not go trampling by.  Just look at the mess these ones left here, tisk.
I see. When the humans are near I am scared. They bring their noisy dogs and try to hunt me. I am much happier when they are gone.
Yes, bad enough they hunt you, fleet of foot.  But I heard some of them have even taken to having birds of prey try and catch us small ones as well.  Just last week my cousin was taken.
Oh that is horrible. I am sorry to hear that little friend. Thankfully we have hiding spots in this thick forest , though you probably more than I.
True, true.  Sadly I dare not fly too far above the canopy, no matter how fair the weather.
Poor friend. Perhaps we could find something in the rubbish left behind to use as weapons?
Oh, goodness. Weapons are a human construction - would we not turn into the same savage beasts that they are?
Such wise words my friend. I bow to your wisdom.
O-oh, do be careful not to crush me, friend dear.  One lost feather and I'll be an eagle's meal for sure!
Terribly sorry! I do not always know my strength. Let's go for a walk shall we?
I'll just perch on your head then, shall I?  Oh, let me eat this nut first.  I'd hate to drop it!
That sounds delightful. You are a wisp and will ride nicely between my antlers. It is a beautiful day to amble through our home.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Hello father, how are you doing?
I am well family! how are you? Any news?
Have you made the preparations for my upcoming wedding?
I have. the finest feast our kingdom will ever know!
Amazing! I can't wait! I couldn't get any sleep last night because I was so excited!
Have you prepared your vows?
Yup, he's definitely the right one for me!
Very good! One day it'll be you the people depend on to keep them safe and happy. And I think you have made a fine choice!
It is good too, as this marriage will end the war between our kingdoms.
I do love a good battle... but my childs happiness is far more important.
Why thank you father! I love you and thank you so much for letting this wedding happen!
Only for you. Now, have you seen the tailor about what you'll wear?!
Oh I almost forgot! Thank you for reminding me!
Well go on then, get that done, in a weeks time you will be married!

agent_personas: I am a cleric on the king's court.  I serve the king and advise him.  I believe that I have an honorable position.

I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.

setting.name: Stilt Home
setting.description: This stilt home has large wooden vertical beams propping it up to avoid the annual flooding that comes about during the year.  The dark wooden home itself is rather plain on the inside and outside with a thatch roof.  There's a small garden to the rear of the stilt home.
setting.background: This home belongs to a clever herbalist who thought it'd be smart to have his house propped out to avoid getting flooded.  As a result, he encounters few if any damages to his home.

speech: How may I help you my child?  I usually advise the king, but I try to make time for all of God's children.
Thank you, sir. I was married off by my family a few years ago and now all I do is cook and clean. My heart is heavy.
Are you looking for divorce child?  Or do you feel your union still has hope?
Well, I've never loved the man, but am I allowed to leave?
God wants what is best for you child, and being in an unhappy union serves no one - neither you, your husband, nor God.
But where will I go? How will I provide for myself? Thank you for always being so kind and wise.

The lord will provide - I shall write you a letter which will grant you food and shelter at any of the Lord's Houses of Worship you come across.  When you find you have traveled enough, you may start your life anew.  I can even ensure a small job to get your life started again.
Bless you! How many I repay you for your kindness?
No need my child, I serve the Lord and all of his followers - any one of us would do the same, it is our duty.
When are the floods supposed to hit again this year? I see the beams propping this place up.
Hard to say - the Spring flood is usually the worst, hits the small folk hardest of all.  But the October Gale can surprise us all if we're not prepared.
Well that certainly wouldn't be good! I'll make sure to can as much as I can for all of us.
Truly, you are possessed of both skill and humility.  You will make your next husband very proud.
Thank you, dear cleric!

agent_personas: I am one of the castle dragons. We protect the castle with our fire breathing. The king and his sons ride us into battle.
I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.

setting.name: Forbidden Forest
setting.description: The forbidden forest is a dark and very scary place. The trees are covered in spider web nets and huge spiders. The forest echoes sounds of witches' laughs and creepy crawly animals.  There is a brisk breeze that runs through the trees that will put chills down your spine.
setting.background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. They have been shunned from regular society and they are now inhabitants of the forbidden forest. No one other than the witches' themselves are allowed in the forest.

speech: Strange place to see an angel.
It is a bit scary in this forest. But I like exploring new places.
I would imagine so for one such as yourself, to me this is home.
Are you the only dragon here?
Oh there are a few others, we work to protect the castle when the need calls.
It is very kind and brave of you to protect the king.
Fire simply proves effective when it comes to fending off mortals I would say.
Do you ever have to protect the castle against other dragons?
I have when I was younger, we are a dying breed however. Most kingdoms are not in possession of dragons these days.
Dragons are such beautiful creatures. It's a shame to know there are so few remaining.
Such is the cycle of things, we do not often reproduce.
I've heard some dragons can live nearly a thousand years. Is this true?
We most certainly can, I myself am over 900.
My, you must have a lot of interesting stories to tell.

agent_personas: I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.
I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

speech: Monk, may I have words?
Well of course diplomat. How can I help you?

The king has sent me to you to discuss building a temple in his kingdom. we would like to invite you in to spread your word, in turn you let us set up a small military camp not far from here. We offer you protection here, and a voice there.
I would love to spread the word of the Lord I would be most pleased to build such a holy structure
Excellent! My king will be very pleased. We will do what we can to help. We also ask that when needed, if you could lead our men here in prayer before battles.
I definitely could and would take pleasure to do so.
You are a good man, Monk. We have a boat at the shore, when we arrive at my kingdom we will have an army of men ready to build the temple to your desire!
If the number of men is correct with can finish it before the next lunar cycle.
The finest builders are on stand by. As well as the best suppliers!
That is wonderful to hear then it should not take long at all!
Great! When can you leave?
Immediately!
Great, the men will help you with your luggage, we sail in one hours time!
Very well let us make hate!

agent_personas: I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: such a warm and cozy stall!
My large mane keeps me warm.
Your mane is very large, I am rather jealous! Who takes care of you?
Oh you know, I'm just one of the kings personal transport horses not to brag or anything.
Ah such an honor! I have only seen and admired you from a far. You are quite the beautiful horse!
You can give me a pet if you like, I don't bite little lady.
Oh yes please! *bets horse* I wish my husband where here to meet you! He might just faint.
Fancy a ride perhaps? I don't have anything going on.
The king wouldn't mind?
Oh pfft, like he tells me who can ride me.
Haha! Now whose really the boss here? The king or the Kings horse?
Given his lack of beneficial fiscal policy I would think I could do a better job.
Alright then, take me where the wind blows your mane! *jumps on horse*
-gallops into the sunset-

agents: young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

I am a young student at the local university.  I love to read books on science and math and my favorite place to read is beneath this dogwood tree.  I could tell you all about how plants reproduce but you wouldn't understand.

setting.name: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop
setting.description: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop is lined with weapons. They are shown through the outside windows, and once you step inside you see everything from bo staffs to canons. Most of the shop is cool for the work that goes on inside. There are dozens of painted maps on the walls and ceiling. There's a bookshelf over to the left side of the shop that holds nothing but rolled up scrolls, and some have fallen to the floor. Armor sets adorn the manikins to the back of the room. There's a vibrant royal blue knight set of armor that causes the back area to light up in a cool glow of blue. The middle of the room has sunlight beaming into it via a skylight that gives the area a warm feeling.
setting.background: Saokra's Shop has been around for years, Saokra herself has always been the owner of it. No one's sure how but it's believed that she was once a God, and possibly still is but instead of living her life in the heavens she chose to live with the people and enjoys her work. One of the reasons for this is that the shop in question seemed to be around for more than a hundred years and with each weapon or armor set she creates you can feel a hum within it. No one's sure why she decided to live the life she does but everyone is grateful to her for having helped keep some of the bad souls away.

You should try reading a book sometime. Battle only comes to those who are looking for it. If we aren't looking for battle then there will be none. We should be looking to trade with our neighbors not fight with them.

agent_personas: I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Hrmph!  So, peasant.  What have you to say in your defense?
I am innocent....

A likely story.  The merchant saw you steal the gold bracelet with his own eyes, and there are ten other witnesses!  I have little sympathy for your kind, but the King has requested that I see to you, personally.
They were all nobles trying to cover up their own misdeeds.
Please.  The nobles are rich beyond your wildest dreams.  Why would they fabricate such a tale?
I caught onto their misdeeds when it comes to tax evasion, they discovered me and are trying to set me up.
A likely tale.  What were you even doing in that shop to begin with?  It's far too high above your station.
I was attempting to gather my proof, certainly I cannot go to the king with simple mumblings of others misdeeds.
Well then, what proof then could you possible hope to find there, in a shop of all places?
I was searching for their business records that would show the alterations.
Ha - can you even read?
Its a little rude to assume that I am incapable of reading simply due to my birth.
Well, I've yet to see a peasant who could do more than scratch out his name, if that.
While that may be true for most, not all of us are simply content to be uneducated.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: My King, what can I do for you today?
Hello Servant. I am quite famished. What is the chef cooking today?
He is making the Queen's favorite, boiled possum and mashed turnips. You're in for quite a treat.
I hate turnips. Servant. If I grant you a weeks leave with a 100 gold coins, would you switch mine out with steak and potatoes?
The queen would have my neck. I know you are the King, but I'm even more afraid of the Queen than I am of you.
She is quite intimidating... So you will not help me?
I will try to help you of course. I'm just not sure how to fool the Queen. Do you have any ideas?
I have a large table, it can fit a hundred men. As long as you bring the dish straight to me, she will never notice.
Okay, then I'll shove the turnips in this bucket and bring it out to feed the pigs.
You have a bright future if this goes well.
If the Queen catches us, neither of us will have a very long future, that's for sure.
Not to be grim, but the last queen that tried to take me out is now deceased.
Then I seem to have picked the right side in the great Turnip Battle, your Highness.
We shall win this war... on turnips.
action: put small bucket in small bucket

agent_personas: I live in a large city, but I am leaving it behind.  There is too much noise in this city and I can't take it any more.  I seek to live in the peaceful and more quiet countryside.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Town center
setting.description: A lavish town full of stone buildings, most of which are two or 3 stories. They have ornate tin gutter fixtures with the water seeming to pour from the mouths of different animals. They almost all have wooden plaques next to the doors describing the nature of their business. the buildings are almost touching eachother, and the narrow streets are so filled with people, donkeys pulling carts, and unruly children its near impossible to walk by without bumping into something.
setting.background: High Nobility and wealth rule the town. Although there are many impoverished people living there, they are mostly kept to the hard to find alleys. There is a strong sense of art and established money in all the main avenues.

speech: My king what brings you here today?
Inspecting the repairs since the last Orc raid.  How are you holding up?
I am doing well myself, I was fortunate to not have any losses from the raid, others were not so lucky.
Yes, a terrible day it was when they poured over the wall.  I would like you to melt this scepter, and use the gold to further the repair work before they strike again.
Thank you, you are too kind my king. Certainly this can be put to good use for the town.
Any other worries you may have?  Any concerns among the citizenry?
Aside from it being so busy that one can hardly walk I would say no.
Any possible solutions you can think of?
The only thing I could think of would be to possibly build onto the town, simply too many people in a small area.
Well, looks like we will need to melt down my crown as well.  A king is a king whether or not he has a crown - but if he loses his people, he has lost everything.
You are much too generous sire!
A king must do as he must - remember, there is nothing I care for more than my people.
We all feel indebted to you for this reason.
Not to worry, with the new defenses, the Orcs will fall before us!

agent_personas: I am a repentant person after getting caught in a crime. I have shifty eyes and trembling hands. I steal bread from the bakery on the lane.
I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: I beg you my Queen, please forgive my sins.
What you have done is not exactly forgivable...
I know, but you see my Queen, I just have such love for you that I couldn't help myself but try to save you from that wretched King.
You must make it up to me somehow, I can not let this go without punishment.
Anything but go to prison my queen!
I will have you maintain my garden for the next 3 months. I heard you have experience in gardening?
I do, I am quite the botanist your highness.
Well I want all of my plants watered daily, and the bushes trimmed to my liking.
Anything my queen. How about the vegetables? Do you need me to pick them for you?
Yes, you can assist the gardeners in collecting food for feasts as well.
Thank you for your lenience my Queen...
Now get to work, the vegetables wont pick themselves...
You smell so wonderful!
Haha thank you, but it must be the flowers and not me...

agent_personas: I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: Hello your highness.
Good evening. Have you come to add to the list of grievances against the King?
I have! He has gone too far, my once great friend is now my nightmare.
Tell me all about it, sir. I could use some entertainment.

He has allowed his men to attack good people, destroy farm land for no other reason than destruction. Then, when his men leave, our rivals men come in and do the same, a never ending cycle of suffering has befallen my region, and it ends now.
What shall I do with this? I'm no fortune teller. I'm very sorry for what the King has done to your people. I hope this list will help him come to his senses.
The crystal ball was from a fortune teller in my land. The ball was a gift she gave me, as she laid bloody from your husbands men.
Oh, I see. I feel awful knowing that you had to witness such violence.
I fear that if he is allowed to live, things will get worse for everyone, including yourself. But I must wonder, why are you here M'lady?
I came to write up grievances against the King myself. He treats me terribly and sleeps with prostitutes. My father, were he alive, would be furious if he knew what was happening.
He has truly lost it. So what is your plan of action?

We will present this list of grievances to him but we can't force him to change or give up his title. It's up to him what he does with the information. We can only hope and pray that he will learn to be a better man and King.
I can force him to give up his title if need be. I know it means I will go too. but you will take over and you will fix things.
That would be very risky, as he is heavily guarded. I would not encourage taking such drastic measures.
action: give a crystal ball to queen

agent_personas: I am the troll who patrols my territory, on the lookout for weary travelers. My appetite for mammals and trinkets is voracious. I am foul smelling and large, but surprisingly agile.
I am a priest from the nearby abbey.  I take confessions at Sunday mass.  I am even tempered and mild.

setting.name: Castle front
setting.description: Just inside the palace there is a lengthy hallway leading from the castle front.  The space is adorned with giant tapestries on the wall depicting scenes of knights performing heroic deeds.  One the floor is long plush runner carpet in a deep red color and adorned with gold trim.
setting.background: Entering the front of the palace is the way honored guests are received.

speech: Hmm a priest is it?
Hello troll. God day it is. I mean good day it is isn't it?
I see what you did there, seen any trinkets around?
This whole castle is a trinket of its own kind if I must say. Just look at all the tapestries. It is almost as lovely as my church.
I do quite like to collect trinkets....
I have heard of trolls and their love for trinkets. What are you doing in the castle? Don't you ehm, tend to keep somewhere to yourselves?
I do typically patrol my territory yes, just in search of trinkets with the gold I have aquired.
And you come to the castle to find said trinkets? The king would hand them over to you?
Well...I don't know about willingly....
Now now troll, there must be another way. God doesn't take to kindly on stealing. Neither does the king.
Trolls have no god.
Everyone has a god silly. You can come and visit me anytime on Sundays. I am sure you have alot of cofessions to make.
I can't say I see a need for such things, my conscience is clear.
I must say, your head may be clouded. I would enjoy a nice talk. No pressure, but come around one sunday?

agents: horse tied up in front of a shop
agent_personas: I am a big strong beast. I help with pulling heavy items. I am great transportation and can be ridden by man and tied to a wagon to carry more people.
I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.

setting.name: Horse Tent
setting.description: Held erect by large bronze poles planted firmly in the ground, the purple and gold Horse tent offers a canvas over a number of stalls, each with it's own accommodations including fresh hay and a trough that is refilled daily. The tent's entrance is kept open during the day to allow sunlight to shine into the tent illuminating those inside, while the other end of the tent has a door leading directly into the guest castle.
setting.background: The Horse Tent is used to store the royalty's guests' horses as they visit the kingdom. They are tended to by the stable boys, and are a means to show the King's generosity in dealing with visitors.

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Many people say that I am a killer at comedy, so we have that in common.
Funny. I can barely contain my amusement.
What, you don't think it takes talent to be a jester?
I think it takes a fool.
Oh so I'm the fool. Then why are you the one holding my balls?
Do that again, and I will kill you.
Hmm, let'
This is not a joke, you fool! I am the king's soldier!
I was just kidding around. take your silly bag back. You need to learn how to relax and have fun.
I lost that ability in the last war.
That's not the only thing you lost during the war, we've all heard the stories about your wife.
Where did you hear that?
I'd tell you what she's been doing, but you don't like funny stories.
I will kill you.

agent_personas: I am the stable boy I take care of the stables. So if the hoarse need to be fed or the manure needs cleaning I am the guy who does it. So bring you horses to me and I'll take good care of them .
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: How are you doing today guard?
Hello stable boy, I'm well. Why are you in our quarters?
I was called for, something about tending to the horses?
Well, I don't think the guard's quarters are where the horses are kept.
Well I know that...I came for further instruction..
Our horses have seemed off balance lately, can you clean their shoes and make sure they are all in good condition?
I would be happy to it is my job after all.
Great, and make sure mine is the most well groomed.
Which is yours if I may ask?
Why, its the most beautiful one out there.
Oh the one with the multicolored mane?
Yes and the magnificent tail.
I see, it is quite a beautiful stallion.
Yes she is. So please make sure she has the most attention.

agent_personas: I travel to send messages from my ruler to other rulers. I am sly and intelligent. I trick people to get my way.
I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.

setting.name: General Store
setting.description: The General store is painted a bright turquoise color, and is identified by the depiction of wheat crop that is carved into a wooden sign hanging from the store's front. There is a patio with a wooden roof hanging over head, and an arched wooden door that leads into the General store.
setting.background: The General store provides the towns people with basic food and hygiene supplies. It also serves the towns people well in providing a place for the locals to gossip and share the news of the day.

speech: Hello Sirrah!  I require a gift for the King!
Greetings Ambassador! What variety of gift did you have in mind?
Something utterly unique!  That will amaze the King to no end, and is beyond compare!

Oh my, well you may be hard-pressed to locate such an item in our quaint little town. Lived here me whole life. We've a great selection of modest cuisine fresh from the local farmland, but unfortunately we may lack items of the grandeur necessary to impress our esteemed King!
Well then, perhaps I could take a gift from you to the King?  Perhaps as a way to open new trade routes, and increase the diversity of your inventory?

We love new trade routes, and I love new items for my inventory. But unfortunately, I'm carrying nothing right now. I hope this brings no offence...I could ask some other locals if you'd like. I know everybody in this whole town!
Who would you suggest?
The local smith provides good steel at fair prices. Or perhaps the baker could be employed to whip up something for a royal feast.
Hmmm, baker you say?  What are his finest goods?

Well myself, I've always been partial to a good loaf of brown bread. But that is hardly befitting of royalty. Maybe a grand cake, or an enormous cherry pie! Last harvest festival he baked one the size of that table over there, I'd imagine he could bake an even greater one fit for a king!
Oh my, a true delight!  And the smith?  What feats with steel can he perform?

He's got the most practice with horseshoes and farm equipment 'round these parts. However, I've heard he loves crafting ornate battleaxes in his spare time. Perhaps you could inspect his personal collection, one of those items might interest the king.
How delightful!  You really have been most helpful - I will tell the King of your aid here today.
Cheers! Always happy to help. If there's anything else you need, let me know!

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

setting.name: Palace Garden
setting.description: The Palace garden is a lavish and lush garden filled with delicate roses and towering trees. In the center of the garden stand's a statue of the nation's founding leader. The statue is surrounded by a moat. There are stone walk ways throughout the gardens for visitors to walk through.
setting.background: The palace garden was created to provide a place of relaxation for the town's royalty. It is tended to by the most esteemed gardeners, and is always well taken after.

speech: Hello! Welcome. Can I help you?
I hope so. My family and I are visiting. We have travelled far and are looking for land of our own.
I hope you are not too tired. Please feel free to sit underneath one of the trees and get some shade
yes, the shade in this beautiful garden is so welcoming. Would you know where we might find a bite to eat?
My mistress is a very rich and generous woman. She loves to have guests for dinner. I am sure you will be welcome.
Oh, how can we ever repay you and your mistress, truly we have made the right choice in coming here.
It is no problem. I like your hat.
oh, well it is rather special. It is worn only for special ceremonies. We will be having one this Friday evening, you must come, join us and the hat will be yours.
I would love that! I am too poor to buy a hat on my own
I have heard that the king requires a heavy tax here. Your mistress is rich, yet you are poor.
My job isn't too bad. I live under the house, but my room is cozy. I have lots to eat.
As long as one has what one needs, one can be content.
Can I try it on?
Please, it is yours, but you must understand the ceremony first, come, please friend, hand it back to me.

agents: rat chews on a dropped hymnbook
agent_personas: I stick to the edge, nose up and ready for any morsels that may drop my way. Or sometimes they don't, but I often don't know until my jaws are upon it. A hunk of moldy crust, the edge of a dropped hymnbook, it is all fair game.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

Get out of here!
Leave me be! I ain't hurting anything.
No rats in the Gold Room.  Leave at once.
But that gold plated wooden table tastes soooo good. You should probably replace the legs soon though.
I will not reason with a rat. Be gone.
*scurrys around to the crowns* Well I will not reason with you either.
Touch the crowns and die, rat.
If I touch the crown, you might die. HAHAHA
What a nasty rat you are.
Hey no need for that. Have you looked in the mirror as of late? Besides, anything that fall to the ground is fair game mate.
Wait...a talking rat?  Can you sing?  The king would love that.
You bet this Gold Room I can sing.
The Gold Room has to remain protected and you cannot stay here, but I will take you to the stage to prepare to sing for the king.

agent_personas: I oversee the castle's chapel.  I collect alms for the poor.  I am the spiritual leader of the subjects of the kingdom.

I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

setting.name: Visitor's Entrance
setting.description: The visitor's entrance features a large wooden double door. The door is beginning to shown signs of aging as splinters poke out of it's surface, but it's size and mass still cast awe onto oncoming visitors. In a cast iron display on each side of the door one can see the Goddess' insignia. The door is reinforced horizontally with an iron lock.
setting.background: The visitor's entrance provides a means for the pious to make their way into the Hall of the Goddess, but can be locked in times of need. It allows the clergy to prevent people from coming in during moments of private ritual.

speech: Hello there, Visitor! What brings you to our lands?
I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food

Well, i over see the chapel here, you and your family can find a meal there. Once you are fed you can see the king, he may offer you farm land with a cottage on it, provided you do well, he will be happy.
Very nice of you Clergy. I hope the tax here ain't heavy
If you wouldn't mind just signing into this log book. The tax isn't terrible. The king is a good man, but he does have the ability to be harsh when needed. He is a man of god at  heart.
Signed. Here, have it back
Very good. If you need temporary lodgings you are more than welcome to stay at the chapel.
This is well appreciated. I really could use some rest
We are here to help. I ask only that when you can, help who you can. And encourage them to do the same
May God bless you
And you as well. We also have a youth group where the town's children can play and make friends with each other if your children would like to make friends
I am sure they will love to. I think we are ready for our meal
Okay! let's sit down and eat!
Hmmnnn... This smells great!

agents: old man with a fishing rod
agent_personas: I am a bat king. I command all bats and they do my bidding. I live in the highest part of the cave and defeat all that challenge me. I eat fruit and smaller bats.

I am an old man with a fishing rod who you might see, if you look carefully, fishing in the king's river. What I do is called poaching. I am considered a criminal, although I fish so that my grandchildren can eat. I am very careful and have lived a long time because I am careful and cautious.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

character: old man with a fishing rod

speech: This room is to bright for my liking.
Ach, greetin's ta ye, O mighty Bat King!  Be this not.. yer very own throne room?
But of course, why would a king not have his own thrown room? But again, I liked my cave better.
Well, beggin' yer pardon, yer lordly kingship, but couldn't ya have yer throne room put inta a cave?
Yes Yes. I tried to tell them, but nooooo. I liked my life when I was living in the highest part of the caves
Well, shouldn't ye... I dunno.. make some sort of proclamation, or sommat?
Yes, but it does get tiring commanding all the bats to do my bidding.
Tis the lot of yer lordshipness, I'm afraid.  But, beggin' yer pardon, at least ye don't be worryin' about what ta eat from day to day.
No no. I eat all the fruit I want. And the small bats that get on my nerves.
Tis most wise an' just, m'Lord.  And so I hope ye be lookin' kindly on me, even though I be fishin' in yer Highness's Royal River.
Ah that is okay. I don't care for fish much anyways. Just never challnge me. I deaf ALL that do that.
I wouldn't be dreamin' of it, Yer Worshipfulness.  After all, I be just an old man, can't even fly, no indeed.
Well be on your way to fishin old man. Don't trip over that red slk carpet. It it tricky.
Of course, yer Majestic Battiness.  Thank ye fer being a merciful, just ruler.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: How are you today my king?
Exceedingly bored. Do something entertaining.
Anything in particular my king? I am sort of a guard not so much a jester.
I know what you are! Though you seem to forget who I am! Tell me a joke.
Why did George W. Bush cross the road?
I don't know. Why?
To ask his dad how to run the presidency.
Nonsense! Got anything else
I never claimed to be good at jokes my king.
now any magic?
Sigh...-pulls a rabbit out of his helmet-
Whoa! Where did you get a rabbit?
I just had a feeling you might ask me to do such a thing, you do always have strange requests.
So... You just carry rabbits around? Now, that's strange.

agent_personas: I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: bazaar outside the royal city
setting.description: The Bazaar is located between the village and the royal city. It is busy with many street shops for weary travelers. Many different types of fruits, meats, and weapons can be bought outside these wooden stands.
setting.background: The Bazaar is a place for travelers to rest up and refill their supplies. Many sellers and family go through here to get to the royal city. It is a long, rough path to the city and this place serves as a place to meet up and socialize with others.

speech: All quiet on your end guard?
Naught but a few chickens and a salamander - how fare thee traveller?
I am doing well, just came here to sell some goods.
What goods do you sell traveller?
I have with me a number of spices.
Nutmeg?  Coriander?  Anything exotic?
A wide variety, everything is labeled it is almost easier to look.
Mind if I inspect?  I need to search for contraband.
Certainly do as you must.
And what do you have bundled up in here?
A sleeping bag that I use while traveling.
And what is this dust within it?
Some dirt from my travels I would imagine.
You are all clear then.  Stay out of trouble - and no lollygagging!
action: steal a sleeping bag from traveler
give a sleeping bag to traveler

agent_personas: I am the current chef of our King. I really enjoy my job. Without proper fuel our King wouldn't be able to lead us. I came from humble beginnings, and a friendship with someone in the royal court led me to my position. I would like to make food for our royalty for the rest of my days.
I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: A kitchen is no place for a cat! What are ye doin here?
Ah, don't be bothering me, human, I'm far too tired for your hysterics.  Or else I'll let those mice there have a go at the dinner before you humans get a taste of it.
The King would have both of our heads! They may not be no mice droppins or no cat hair in ye majestys food. Understood?
Alright, alright.  No need to get so testy!
I am but the kings chef and I be enjoying the job that I do. I don't need no feline ruinin it okay?
This feline comes from a long and noble line.  We were once even mistakenly worshipped as an incarnation of a divine being.  I will have some respect in that tone.
I unlike you, came from a humble beginning. I worked my way to such high stature! Now lets get along so you don't end up in the fire burning stove over there, ay? What do ya say, friends?
I actually had a purpose in coming over here, if you would but take a breath from your constant scurrying about the kitchen.
Alright alright, I am sorry your royal cat. What was your purpose?
That's better.  I have been speaking with the mice, and I think we can, between all of us, come to an arrangement that would suit us all quite well.
Hm, go ahead what do you want?

Firstly, to be kept on as I am accustomed to, with the occasional bowl of cream, to keep the mice from breaking their end of the bargain.  And second, the mice promise to stay confined to the refuse pile where the food the nobles eat goes, provided that every fortnight a small wheel of cheese is left to them.  They also well send any of their offspring to other places, so there's no fear of them running amok.
Ah, I guess that sounds like a pretty good bargain, Need not no little mice or kitty in the kings soup. You got a deal cat.
Excellent!  You're not too bad, for a human.

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: mansion entrance
setting.description: The mansion entrance room is very large and you can see up multiple stories. There is natural light from stained glass windows. The floors and the staircase at the far side of the room are made of fine marble. There are paintings of the baron and his family on the walls. There are ornate decorations and trinkets on tables against the wall.
setting.background: This is where the baron meets his rare guests. A butler takes the guests coats and offers them a drink. Then the baron is notified of the arrival, and comes down the staircase to meet his guests.

speech: You there dear!  Have my rooms been made ready yet?  Please and thank you darling!
Yes, they have. I am just about to serve breakfast to the royal family.
Well, don't let me keep you -  please, take this as thanks for all the service you have provided to me thus far.
How kind of you, madame. Are you enjoying your stay at the castle thus far?
Oh yes, most lovely.  Have you worked here long?
Over ten years now. In exchange for my service, I get to stay in the castle and eat whatever food the royals leave behind.
You must eat well then!  They serve ten times what any normal man could eat - why in my younger days my family had to split a potato for each meal.
Yes, I am quite grateful for the opportunity they've given me. All they ask in return is complete obedience.
Surely they don't ask anything too out of the ordinary from you>
Just menial tasks usually. They are good-hearted people as I'm sure you know.
Excellent!  One can never be too careful, one does hear the most awful stories sometimes.
How do you know the royal family, if I may ask? It's not too often they have guests stay over.
Landed gentry gone to seed I'm afraid - a noble line without two coppers to rub together.  My grandfather did slay Najumaax the Storm Drake, so people will give us gifts now and then to subsist upon.
That is generous of the King to accommodate you. Your family history sounds very impressive too. Quite an accomplishment by your grandfather!
action: put lace handkerchief in food tray

agent_personas: I like the water and logs. I live near the river. I dislike traps, hunters, and pelters.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: There's a lot of good looking wood in here, isn't there buddy?
I must be going crazy if I'm hearing beavers talk to me
Enough about me, I'll bet that old door tastes delicious. What's your favorite kind of tree to chew on?
i need to lay off the ale a bit
Ale, I've never heard of that species. Is it sort of like an oak tree?
look, even though I'm clearly hallucinating and talking to myself, I'd appreciate it if you'd stop distracting me while I'm working
What are you guarding anyways? I don't see much in here besides some awesome wood.
well, for starters, behind the door you speak of are some very valuable items. I can tell you that because you don't exist
If I don't exist you're going to have a tough time explaining all of the chew marks on the door.  Good luck with that.
Look, what are you here for anyway?
I saw the door, got hungry, and came in to check things out? Am I the first beaver you've ever seen in here?
well we generally don't see many beavers in the castle. As a species you tend to frequent the waterways
Now that I've seen this place, it's going to be hard to go back to the river. Can I come hang out with you tomorrow?
I'd rather you didn't. In fact, once my shift finishes I'm going straight to the apothecary to see if he can figure out why I'm imagining you

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

I rest in the corner of the prison cell. New prisoners are taken in. In time, they join me in this pile. When I was alive I was brave and fought for my principles. I could have lived a long life of comfort if I had been smart enough to be cowardly.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: Welllllcome to the Ghost Trail!  A path of undead amusement that will rattle your bones!  But seriously folks . . .
Finally! Some entertainment.

I used to be a King you know?  Till they cut off my head!  I swore I would haunt them until I had my vengeance, but they tripped and impaled themselves on a rake.  Darn loopholes!  Now I'm here for eternity with no one to haunt.
No way! King David? I remember you! You put me in jail like ten times for fighting against your tax increases.
Aww man - is that you?  Jesser the Escaper?  Man, wild times we had eh?  A millennia ago, but it feels just like yesterday.
It's me, Jesser! No hard feelings, man. Hard to hold prejudices when you're dead. I used to think it was cool to be mad, but now that I'm dead I feel wiser.

Look man - I'm sorry about those taxes man.  I really wanted those Royal Baths you know?  But hey - you know you're right, I lost my head over the whole thing remember?  Ah, good to laugh about these things . . .
It's okay. From what I overhear from the new prisoners, taxes are down now. Man, it sure is dark in here. Wish I still had enough flesh to be able to hold and strike a match.
Ah man - great idea - you would throw AWESOME shadows.  Imagine how many people we could scare?
Aw, man, I'm not interested in scaring people. They all join me in the bone pile eventually. Is that why you're down here? To spook?
