Loopholes man . . . as part of my agreement with the devil I need to scare the living, and if I don't meet my quota I'm sent to endure excruciating torture for a month.  Bosses right?
Wow, man, that's insane. I guess that's what you get for being a cruel leader. But, then again, I fought for my good principles and I'm not much better off.
So why are you sticking around the undead-afterlife anyway?  Curse gone bad?  Deal with a devil?  Deal with THE devil?
I'm not sure. I thought I was a good man when I was alive. But, when I died in jail I found that I hadn't gone to heaven like I planned. Real bummer.

agent_personas: I am a religious bishop from the king's palace . I give prisoners their last rites . I decide the religious law in the kingdom for all.

I am a pastor. I am the priest in charge of a village church where the parishioners are everyday people. I provide hope of a heavenly rest for people whose lives are short and difficult. I do baptisms, weddings, and funerals, and I try to help my parishioners discern the hand of God in their daily lives.

setting.name: the main chapel
setting.description: The church is a fairly simple one. Rows of pews lined up and facing a pulpit with podium and some stained glass on the walls. The building is made of old wood, but is sturdy and has stood for many decades.
setting.background: The church has been the focal point of this village for a long time. The bell tower has always been used to announce good or bad things happening to members of the community. Whenever it rings, the inhabitants of the village gather at the church to hear whatever news is to be delivered.

speech: Hello Pastor. How can I help you here in the church of the king?
Oh that stained glass is spectacular! I found this in my church, I think it belongs here.
I have missed this text! It is helpful when providing last rites for prisoners. You are a mighty representative of the Lord and our Kingdom.
Oh it is just the way of my life. You know how that goes. Now I did have a read, and I was certain that you missed it dearly!
It has much wisdom to impart for our world. But I wonder the impact of the words inside. Wars may never have started, lives may never have been lost.
Now, we know that with religion comes war. But we are here to teach gods word, no matter the impact it makes on the world, right>
Yes. Unfortunately men are often ignorant to the word of God, especially when it doesn't serve their immediate interest.
We have seen many of wars, and we will see many more. It is just something that has to happen.
How right you are. I'm glad that you are a member of the order, and keen to advise the most stubborn of men.
One day they will all realize that fighting is not the answer. But untill then, we must keep doing the lords work.
At least we're light-hearted about our chosen profession. Have you heard news from the Battle of the Elven?
I have not, were they in some kind of trouble? My old age is getting to this brain on mine.
It's concerning that no news has arrived. Our men marched off to battle over ten days ago, and nothing has been heard of them since. The king is distraught worrying about his brother.
How couldI forget such a thing! Shall be pray for them? *extends hand*

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Is there anything you need my king?
Another glass of mead. Thank you!
Certainly, right away sire!
Put this somewhere while I bath, servant. Someone tell me a joke.
Yes, I will make sure to place it somewhere safe.
Joke? You know any?
I cannot say I know any jokes that would be befitting of your majesty.
Have you any hidden talents? Entertain your king!
I can juggle somewhat?
Yes! Let's see that.
-begins juggling a pitcher, a scroll and a pitcher of water-
Wow! You are really good at that. Maybe you should think of applying for court jester!
Does it come with a raise?
Not in gold, but you can take all of the tomatoes home that we throw at you. You'll never go hungry!

agent_personas: I torture the prisoners to get information from them. I love my job. All of the prisoners are afraid of me. I like to come up with new forms of torture.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: Awesome. Look at those trebuchets! Have you ever seen what they can do to a body!! Bloody amazing!
These must be very useful to His Majesty.
I don't know about him, but I could do some great work with one of these swords, a little carving here, a little slice there....
These weapons should only be used to fight for His Majesty's land.
Hold on. Do you know who I am. I work for the king. Who do thinks gets the information from the prisoners so the King can defeat his enemies?
My apologies. I did not understand. I must be in awe of this wide array of equipment on these formidable stone walls.
This room is amazing, I mean catapults, trebuchets....what an arsenal. What is it that you do?
It is an honor for me to say that I am a Knight for His Majesty's army.
Well let me shake you hand. We're kinda in the same business.
Yes, we both fight. Though I'm certainly more in the action.
Well I'm not exactly a fighter, more of a torture master. You kill em quick and I take my time. If you know what I mean.
I do know what you mean. We capture the prisoners of war, and they are brought to you.
Yes indeed they are. And then I get to work my magic for his majesty.
This is cool. You smack people with this?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: Oh my, this won't do at all!  Close it down at once!  Now that the revolutionary patriots are no longer in power, we have no need of their torture devices.
Are you sure, your majesty? These have proved very useful in extracting crucial information in the past.

Yes - no King worthy of the title would harm his subjects.  But the democratic government that came before?  Petty squabbling, separating into parties that are little different from each other in any substantive way . . . attacking and torturing those who do not think like themselves?  No, not in my Kingdom.
You are a wise and fair ruler indeed, my King. I will be sure all of these devices are destroyed so they can no longer harm another individual in this world!
Wonderful!  Furthermore, let us create a constitution that enshrines certain rights for the people - we could call it the Great Charter, a Magna Carta if you will.
Excellent idea, your majesty. What basic rights would you like to see granted to every man and woman?

Well, security of the person for a start!  No torture, no unreasonable arrest or seizure of property - we want to ensure these monsters can never abuse the people ever again,even if one day the Crown should fall.
Of course, my King. Have you talked this over with the court? Do they agree with your progressive ideals?

Oh, there are always those resistant to change, who want to protect their position of wealth over that of the people - but that happens in both Monarchies and Republics.  It will be a long road good citizen, but we'll get there.  Do you have any suggestions on how we can improve the realm?

Perhaps a percentage of the royal coffers can go towards better infrastructure and health care in the villages. It's quite shocking what years of neglect have done to parts of this kingdom. Thank goodness you are a man of change, your majesty.

I agree - I daresay, free medicare for all?  It would pay for itself in the long run don't you think?  Peasants spend less time being sick, plagues are harder to spread - don't have to worry about choosing between treating their child or their cow?  Has potential?
The upfront cost will be quite demanding on your personal riches, your majesty. Are you prepared to sacrifice the life of absolute luxury that past monarchs have enjoyed?

As I said, the ways of the past are behind us - these luxuries serve no use if people are starving in the streets.  What is a King without silks?  Still a King.  Without furs?  Still a King,  Without a people?  Nothing.
You've truly enlightened my mind, sir. The kingdom will surely grow stronger and more prosperous than ever under your rule.

agent_personas: I am one of the king's lord.  I rule over a large area of land.  I have dozens of tenants.
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: Farmer's house
setting.description: a single room cottage with a dirt floor, minimally decorated with only a table, a pallet and a wood burning stove there is but a single window and a single door at this place
setting.background: This is feudal land, owned by a lordly lord and worked by a peasant farmer who grows crops mainly to be harvested for the lord's feasts and store but he is allowed to eat what he may, and has little else.

speech: Such a simple way to live.
Yes, the farming life is the best! Would you like to have some of my corn or tomatoes?
Why yet, I would take a bot of corn,thank you. Was it cooked in the wood burning stove?
Yes! It was cooked in my stove. It is delicious! It will be the best corn you ever tasted. Let me dish some up for you.
Such a good man you are farmer, actually. That is why I am here.
What do you need?
How well are you capable of providing for your family? I know you have a small farm, does it supplement you enough?
You come to my place and are trying to take my land! Is that what you are doing? You dirty scumbag!
Now now, calm down now. Have a seat. That is not what I was doing.
Well...get to the point.

Well, Are you going to keep being to rude? And to a lord at that. I have an offer for you. If you're willing, the king would love to hire you to be his farmer. He is on a new diet, and wants only the freshest of ingredients. I must say we hear you are the best arounf.
I don't work for anyone. I am proud and work myself to the bone to produce the best crops. I will sell to the king, but I will not work for anyone. Is that clear?
I am afraid I shall recant my offer. See what the king wants he gets. So be it then.
Yes, so be it. Thank you for your offer. However, I enjoy my independence.

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: How are you traveler?
Tired, nervous, but happy to see one of the King's knights on the King's road.  Far too many rumours of bandits for my liking.
Long travels I take it?
Yes, we journey from Cathay to the East - here Sir Knight, a small sample of our wares.
Interesting, what do you call this?
Cinnamon - delightful taste no?
It is quite different, I cannot say I am familiar with this cinnamon.
It is mixed with a bit of sugar - and the smell!   Divine is it not?
How is it commonly used?
In baking - it adds a delightful taste and scent to any dough it touches!  Some people keep it in a bag just to smell when they are feeling sad!
Oh so pies and pastries and the sort?
And cookies and cakes and breads of all sorts!
I would like to try one of those with cinnamon sometime.
Well friend, how far are we to Strudhurst?  It is the market town where we intend to sell our goods, and no doubt within a week bakeries will be filled with new smells and tastes!

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Can I get you anything, my king?
Yes fetch me my books of old.
No problem, sire! There are a lot of books here. I will carry as many as I can.
Yes please bring the 3 I always use.
Which ones would that be?
The ones on the top shelf over by the corner.
Yes sire. Are you planning on reading them all again?
I am researching them.
You are so intelligent, my king. What are you researching?
I am trying to decipher this ancient language.
Ohhh! Sounds intriguing!
Yes but it is very hard.
I'm sure you will figure it out, king. You always do.
Thank you, I will figure it out soon.

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: Oh what a beautiful day it is! I love the woods and the birds chirping!
Im so hungry ahhhh
You poor thing! Let me help you find some food! Do you like worms or bugs?
Ahhh I need meet or veggies or something...
I don't know if I can find that. Usually , I eat some of the foliage out here  and whatever little things I can find. Are you a picky fellow?
Do you have any berries or anything?
We can walk down this path and sometimes it has berries. The opossum brothers live down there. They are well liked and always share their grub.
Thank you I just need some nutrition.
No problem! Do you always travel solo?
No I was just dying is all.
Oh! That is scary. Well, we are almost to the berries. We just have to be careful that if we hear any dogs that we abort the plan. They are dangerous!
I'll fight those dogs if I need to..
You are a true forest friend! I am happy I met you today! Hey look....berries! Yay!
Yes, thank you I can survive.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: How are you today fellow worker of the kingdom?
I am well, but I miss my family.
Yes it is a lot of work and very rarely get to go home.
And I cannot read, so thus not even a letter from home will soothe my lonely heart.
Truly a harsh life.
And I tracked a small bit of mud in with my shoe, so my master took it away.
He seems quite horrid.
Yes, very strict. And you, how is the life of a guard?
Not hard work but long and tedious.
Oh I can see how that must be, standing around all day long. And your family?
They do well but I only come home at night.
You are so fortunate to see them every night. And you have your own home? I must stay in a damp room in the basement.
Yes it is a better circumstance.
Indeed, Indeed. If only I could become a guard.

agent_personas: I am here for my friends. I'm reliable and trustworthy. I would never harm the people I am loyal to.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Wow, what are all these weapons for?
This is the armory! The king keeps the best weapons here. Take a look-
Ooo what is this one here?
That's the Everlasting and Eternal Sword of Eternal Darkness. Best not touch that one, it steals peoples souls.
Oh goodness, I'll be sure to avoid that. It looks amazing though!
It does. They really only use it to put down peasant rebellions anyway.
Such a high class weapon to kill peasants? Are the souls used in some way?
Well you wouldn't want to damn important people, and the peasants find it absolutely terrifying. All the souls are sent to the demon lord Mouloagh the Unhinged. I don't know what he uses them for.
Ah, well that is quite interesting. Any other weapons like that?
None of them from Mouloagh, That mace over there can be used to fight leprechauns though.
What makes it so good against leprechauns?

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: There is nothing I love more than battle! This is one of my favorite places.
I share your passion for combat, knight. One can never prepare enough.
No one loves battle as much as I do.
Have you heard any news of the king's upcoming campaign?
No. Why? Have you?
I hear we are about to depart for an invasion across the channel.
That is good news. I will be on the frontline fighting for my king. The smell of gunpowder in the morning always excites me!
I prefer long range combat myself.
Long range combat is for cowards who don't like to get their hands dirty.
On the contrary, why rush into battle when we can dispatch the enemy without coming into harm's way.  It's the smartest and most efficient form of combat.
Spoken like a true coward. You do not know battle until you have crushed a man with your bare hands.
The lifes of the infantry are not dispensable, fool. If we can preserve as much of our ranks as possible, it is the intelligent option to pursue at all costs.
You seem upset, little man. Should I fetch your mother for you to suckle her breast?
I have no need to argue with a dimwitted brute like yourself. Watch as I down five men for every single enemy you struggle to defeat in melee combat.

agent_personas: I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Hello, your majesty! What brings you here today?
I am here to commission a sword.
Ah, mighty fine choice! What'll the specs be?
A four foot claymore made with Vasteryin steal and gold etching.
Ahh beautiful, any details on the gold etchings?
Whatever you think fits.
Sounds good to me, what material would you like for the handle? Leather?
Yes that would work well.
Perfect, well I'll be sure to have that done in, say, three days?
Ok well sounds like a deal.
What is this sword for, anyhow?
A family heirloom.
Going to pass down my sword? What an honor, your heiness.
Of course, you are a master of your craft.

agent_personas: I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.
I attend the church every week and say my prayers dutifully. I always put coins in the poor box. I light a candle for my departed mother.

setting.name: church coat room
setting.description: The church coat room is dark and smelly, holding all the coats and boots of the congregation who happen to be in the church at the time. There is a candle sconce high on the wall near the entrance, benches along the back of the room and huge baskets along opposite walls: one for coats and the other for footwear.
setting.background: This room used to be a primitive bathroom ten years ago, but became too smelly and difficult to clean. People complained, and it was re-purposed as a coat room. It is vented at the top for when they used to burn excrement.

speech: Hello. Have you seen my coat? I can't seem to find it. It's big and black.
Big and black huh? What is the material?
Only the finest wool, my friend. And it has a lot of important documents in the pockets, so I need it.
Let me go have a look, be patient though.
I will be patient. Did you like my sermon this evening?
Of course, it was very concise yet very well said.
Did you like the part where I said taxes were unholy? I really think it's criminal what the government charges these days.
I think the idea of taxes is just, but to tax the poor as much as they do is horrible.
I, for one, think there should be no taxes at all. I do not intend to pay any....Gosh, it stinks in here. It must be that huge basket full of stinky shoes.
Yes, indeed it does but you get used to it.
And it's dark, too. There should be more than one candle sconce.
I quite like it this dark in here, it is easier on my eyes.
You never trip on these benches in the dark?
My eyes have gotten quite used to this lighting by now.

agent_personas: I'm a demon that torments people. I love to cause people pain and suffering. People are afraid of me. They say prayers to keep me away.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: You could totally steal some of the decorations here!

Technically everything in the village belongs to me family, and it's like, soooo boring!  PLUS, I'm supposed to marry some lame-o from the next village to end a war of something, what a loser, am I right?
There's always the option to skip out on your duties though?
Wait . . . you're not trying to tempt me are you?  My priest said to look out for demons and their temptations.
Whatever might you mean?
I don't know, priests are weird sometimes you know?
I've always thought so, like with the whole thinking I would be afraid of holy water thing.

Yeah, what's up with that?  I mean, holy water is usually old and comes from musty old fonts, so I can sort of understand if you don't want gross water thrown at you all the time.  I wouldn't like that!
It is awfully ineffective as well, simply calling something holy hardly accomplishes anything.
It drives the price up?
Religion has always been a good source of income.
True!  Good way to get coin Demon-friend
Certainly coin can woo many a man to do a dastardly thing.
Ain't that the truth, preach it!

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am an animal that lives under the bridge. I like to eat the scraps that the people leave. I enjoy scaring anyone that comes under the bridge.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: What manner of strange creature is that?
I am an Ancient good friend of the forest.
Inside of a secret tunnel?
Yes I have been here for millennia.
Always watching I imagine?
Indeed, I watch when I can.
I would imagine constantly guarding this tunnel would get rather boring though?
It does but it is my peoples land.
I suppose one could say the same of my job though, simply guarding the castle constantly. Nothing really ever happens afterall.
Yes but after so long it is tiresome.
Do you never rest?
I cannot, I am incapable of rest.
That's unfortunate, you certainly deserve it after spending so much time guarding this chilly passage.
Yes well it is my reason for existing.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a chef who works for a local tavern. I do not break up fights when they start. I mind my business and learn new ways to cook.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Hello chef, whip up dinner please.
Yes, your majesty, we have the freshest fowl and meats, would you like to select your own beast, or shall I have the pleasure?
Surprise me, I will wait.
Yes, well we must slaughter the beast first. So it will take a bit. Pheasant then?
Yes that sounds fine.
Excellent choice. I have a new sauce recipe from Bredwell across the sea. Would you like to try it?
Ah sounds wonderful good chef.
Very well. And you beverage this evening?
Wine, red to specify.
Yes, I believe we have your favorite. Now back to the meat, if I recall you prefer roasted. Correct?
Thank you I will sit here for now, and yes roasted.
Very good, excuse me while I go tell Bernard to break up that fight across the room.
No problem.
Ah, your majesty, your dinner: roasted pheasant with Bredwell blood sauce and your favorite red wine.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
My name is Joe. I'm a Trader. Pumpkins mainly. So many goddamn pumpkins.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: What on Earth are you doing down here?
I have come to offer my services to the King.
Down in the secret tunnel? That's a bit absurd, no?
I'm a resourceful man. Don't you see I'm in this tunnel?
Uh... yes I do see you in this tunnel and I am not quite sure why.
Look at this pumpkin. I managed to get this large pumpkin into your tunnels, past your guards and spies. What else do you think I could smuggle in for you?
Hmm where did all of this experience come from? Not illegal ways, correct?
I am naturally gifted my King.
Well... what did you have in mind? I don't see any real applications for you unless you can suggest any?
As a King all things are accessible to you, but not all things that you desire will be appropriate for you. I can help bring you those things.
Again, that is rather vague. What do you think other than keeping you on retainer?
I have information that has eluded your best spies, that's how I knew you had a secret desire for pumpkins.
I see... well that is correct knowledge, they are quite lucrative.
I am on good knowledge that the most powerful men of the future will be, not the possessors of the largest castles, but the possessors of the most information.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

speech: It is unusual for you to come up here my queen.
I've spent all day sitting on that horrible throne while you stay up here with your books. If I didn't know better I'd think you care more about them than me - your lovely and beautiful queen!
Oh you know good and well that is not the case, I simply do not wish to appear a simpleton.
You don't wish to appear a simpleton! You know what cause you to appear a simpleton? staying up here while I have to deal with all those chattering hanger-ons at court.
Is there something that needs my attention?
Your beautiful, wonderful, ever brilliant queen needs you attention! Look at this place! Its a mess! can't you even get the made to clean up a little?
Well this is mostly my chambers, I like to think of it as organized chaos.
ORGANIZED CHAOS! Well. If I'd married your brother I would never have to deal with all this.
Yeah, but to be fair he is bald and has that beer belly...
He also spends time at court you know. Not up here with books! Too bad he didn't become king.
Perhaps he wasn't as well read?
hmph! That is NOT amusing!
Well I found it comical, different senses of humor I suppose.
Well, I didn't. And I have a queens sense of humor, which is far better than anyone else's.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: Its always nice to take a moment of peace out here to ourselves.
Indeed. The commoners can be so..trying, sometimes
It all comes with the job I suppose.
Sometimes it's a bit much, but such is the job of royalty.
At the end of the day someone has to lead them, the responsibility lies with us.
Well, mainly with you, dear. I'm just a figurehead, meant to keep our two kingdoms together. You could replace me with that dragon statue over there and no one would notice.
I would notice.
Thank you. I hoped you were a good man when my father brought me here. I'm glad I was right.
I try to be, that is all anyone can do.
That's what makes you a good king, and why the commoners love you
I appreciate the kind words my queen, I simply attempt to be a respectable leader.

I can tell they respect you. I don't know how you do it..all that court room chatter gave me such a headache. I just wanted to tell the last batch to come back next week, but you listened to them all!
It's not as if I never feel that way, I just understand that at the end of the day it falls to me to sort it out. Out here on the balcony though all of that is washed away.
I agree, dear. It's nice to look out over the kingdom while it's quiet. It makes me appreciate what we're doing here.

agent_personas: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Castle Royal tower
setting.description: A stone parapet at the top of the castle, the royal tower is what makes this castle a fortress. The walls are stone and dinged with souvenirs of past battles. It is cold and gray, but the perfect vantage point for soldiers. The wind whistles through the cracks in the wall. Straw litters the floor.
setting.background: The castle's royal tower is a lookout point for the king's men. From stone windows, soldiers can survey the land around them. You can see the green field, straw-thatched peasant huts, and fields fat with crops. From here the castle is protected with bows and arrows at the ready.

speech: Greetings m'lord! Cold day isn't it?
It is really cold. Winter is upon us
Aye, that it is. I'm glad were holed up all cozy and warm in this royal fortress, and not out there in the weather.
Yes. Let us feast while we can. I can sense battle afar
Hopefully it stays afar! Battle isn't as glorious for us common men as it is for you knights.
But you are a soldier!
Ha! That I am. Us soldiers are always happy to collect coin while doing no work. Just like everyone else!
Hehehehhe. I sure will report you to the King
He already knows how us common soldiers are. If his knights had my attitude on the other hand...
... That will be a total doom for the kingdom
That it would be m'lord, the king would have to do everything himself!
How is your wife doing
She died in childbirth. I blame the faeries.
So sorry about that soldier. You should get yourself a new lady

agent_personas: I am a worshiper and I love worship. I  worship what ever I feel is the highest the one above all . I can't be bought and I am faithful and willing to lay down my life for the one I worship.

I'm glad I picked that bloke's bag.  I wonder how I can skim from the till without the innkeeper knowing.  I wonder if anyone in this tavern has need for a good knifeman. Where am I going to sleep tonight?

setting.name: Church foyer
setting.description: This musty room is fairly plain and drab and is surrounded by stone walls.  There's religious tapestries adorning these walls along with some chairs for people to wait before the actual church is opening up to them.
setting.background: Worshippers comes to the foyer to wait to be let into the main church for daily service.  This is also the place where rumors fly about as worshippers talk among each other.

speech: Hello, musician. What brings you to our humble church on this day?
To sing and worship the Lord!
Do pardon me. I see you are a bartender not a musician. I too am here to worship! I love nothing more!
Yes I AM. but it always gladden my heart to praise the King
Well then you are in great company! This may seem like a dull room but when the congregation files in and lifts the cobwebs with their beautiful voices.. the whole place is transformed!
Hallelujah. How is it like, I mean, living as a worshiper and all

Well I don't have much in the way of possessions but my heart and my soul are full of love for our Savior. I get by with the love and consideration of others who share their meals and homes with me. How about you?
Well, beer gladens the heart. I serve people wine and beer and they leave happy
Yes that does a great deal to warm the body on a cold day. I enjoy the occasional glass of wine, but as I don't have much for money it is hard to come by.
Here... I hope this will last for a while
Oh you are kind. Here I offer my necklace in return!
I appreciate this kind gesture
It is nice to have met a new friend like you if I'm not being overly presumptuous?
Well, you not. We should prepare for the service

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Outside gates
setting.description: These outside gates are made of iron and are somewhat decorative in design.  The tops are spiked and there's a family crest that hangs on both the left and right gate telling people who resides here.
setting.background: These gates prevent unauthorized people from entering.  They also serve to tell others which family lives here.

speech: Greetings m'lord!
I believe you mean My Lady?
oh ahh - sincerest apologies my lady. You know how hard it can be to tell with the fashions the young noblemen wear these days.
Tell me about these family crests: What do the symbols mean?
These are the family crests of my master, lord Albrecht Von Poppenhippie. He's a great man and a devout follower of the witch god Chenzaborg.
Ah, yes, a poppy flower, being held by a man with long hair, I can see Poppenhippie.
Quite so! The current Lord Poppenhippie doesn't have long hair, of course, preferring the spiked mohawk of his patron god. I'm told his ancestors wore their hair long though
I am to be married to Albrecht.  Is he a kindly man?
hmmm. Well no, not in a traditional sense. He is a follower of Chenzoborg, which means he enjoys a good bit human sacrifice and torture. In fact he flayed my whole family alive!
I am so sorry to hear that!  I fear this marriage, but we must play our parts, if we want peace.
Don't be sorry! During the dark ritual in which my family perished my soul was also consumed by Chenzoborg and now I myself am a devout follower. I'm sure you will be too, eventually.
Tell me more of Chenzoborg

He is the one of the ever penetrating stare, the ever watching eyes and the endless devouring hunger. Soon Chenzoborg through his cult of devout followers will consume the entire world and the dark prince will be reborn, harkening and age of endless agony and death. Of course I'm just a humble servant and will surely not play anywhere near a great role in this as you, m'lady.
Uh, I think I gotta go now *runs away*

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: I am so bored.  I wish that you, rat, would dance for me, if you only understood me ...
I am no ordinary rat, good sir. Yes. I know it's surprising to hear a rat talk. But before you smash me, let me explain.
Wow, I must be so hungry I am dreaming things!
Oh, you aren't imagining things. I used to be a peasant just like you.
What happened to bring this upon you?

Well, one day I was incredibly hungry, and the pantry was bare. So I wandered toward the castle. There, I found a loaf of bread just laying on a window sill. It seemed to good to be true. So I snatched it and ate it.
Sounds like a tempting thing to do: I am sooooooo hungry!
I must warn against it. You see, I was being watched. Unbeknownst to me, the king's wizard saw me take the loaf. And he put a curse on me.
How can this curse be broken?
He called me a street rat, and turned me into a literal rat. He said the only way the curse could be broken is to do something truly selfless and noble. And that is why I am here to help you.
Wow.  A job is what I really need, apart from food.
What if I told you I could get you a job working inside the castle?
That would be great!  Any job would help!
Ha. I am only joking of course. I have no idea how that would work. I am just an ordinary rat who can talk. But the distraction did allow me and my friends to take your remaining food. Good luck.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a beggar born in the sewers. I have sometimes made good money on the streets. I kill people who look down on me.

setting.name: The Temple Marketplace
setting.description: This dirt section of land has several tents set up along with carpets and goods spread out among them.  Gleaming from the distance, one can see plates, pots, paintings, and antique goods.  There are peasants walking by along with excited traders trying to get them to look at their wares.
setting.background: People come here to exchange goods and hopefully make a decent enough profit to cover the rent just for setting up here.  Sometimes traders come back with very exotic goods from far away places.

speech: Hi there, do you know of any work?
I cannot say that I do, I am but a simple beggar born in the sewers.
i thought that was the case, boy those wares the traders have look awfully expensive
I know I have difficulty affording such things.
i hate that the king looks down upon us
I concur on that, simply being born by a different mother hardly makes one a worthy individual.
you look hungry my friend, i havent got much food but would you like to partake in some stale bread?
I certainly appreciate the kind offer thank you, what brings you to the streets?
i am simply looking for work to help my family and to ensure my children do not starve
I see, what sort of work were you looking for?
im willing to work the fields, and im a dab hand with a blade if it comes to it
I would think you should be able to find something, considering those skills.
you would think, especially in this town, alas ive had no such luck. Would you like to look with me? it seems like you could use the money as well friend
I don't see why not, having two hands might be more attractive to an employer.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a feathered animal.  I am eaten by people who want to stay healthy.  I am delicious.

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: Here's some more feed, chicken.
Bah-Buk! Tasty!
Man you never seem to get sick of that stuff.
We chickens will eat anything. Cluck cluck.
Well if you ever want anything else, I'm all ears.
Some tasty worms would be nice!
That should be manageable, sure!
Just curious. Are you fattening me up?
I just lay out the food for you to eat as much as you'd like, so no.
So am I a pet to you, human?
Well kind of for me, but I'm not too sure what your fate is.
The thought of being slaughtered terrifies me! I've seen what happens to the other animals on this farm.
I suppose that fear is justified, but everyone is gonna die so might as well accept it sooner or later.
I don't suppose you can smuggle me out of this farm? I can be your personal companion!

agent_personas: I live near the docks on the edge of the city.  I steal food from cargo boxes that are loaded into ships at night.  Sometimes rats from strange lands come off ships that come to the dock.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: What are you doing here, sir?
A talking rat, eh?  What'll they think of next!.  I am good friends with the king, and am on the way to see him.
Ohh quite important eh? What for?
What business is it to you, rat?
Just curious, it's boring down here looking for crumbs on my own.
And how did a talking rat come to guard the dungeon?
Guard? Like I said, I come here only for the bits of food I can scrounge.
well, I have none for you.  I am a bit turned around: which way to the King's chambers?
Well that will be up the stairs and then you can see a guard guarding his room.
Thanks.  How is it you came to learn how to speak?
I just picked it up as I overheard people talking here in this dungeon.
You know, we could make a lot of money, you and I, and then you wouldn't have to scrounge for scraps
You think so? Hmm
I mean, not everyone sees a talking rat!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: Hello, queen. How are you today?
A bit under the weather, my dear. I've got a headache from all the loud chatter back there.
Shall we ask the maid to make the bed for you early?
Yes, please. And perhaps some herbal tea as well?
Of course, I'll ask her soon enough.
Thank you, my love. What are your plans for the rest of the day?
I believe we are to negotiate a peace treaty with the neighboring kingdoms later today.
I see. I am sorry I will not be there to accompany you.
No worries, queen. We will do great regardless.
Will you be long? I was hoping we could have some time to ourselves later.
I suspect that it will end rather early, so I think that could be arranged.
Delightful. Before I forget, I got you a gift. I know how much you love to read!
Ooo this is an early edition! How did you get ahold of this?
I asked the librarian for a special favor. With a bribe, of course.

agent_personas: I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.
I am the overseer of the castle. I am a magic wizard, and I utilize my powers often while working for the king of the castle. I am a mighty, wise person but mostly friendly.

setting.name: clean water lake
setting.description: The lake is crystal clear, lined with trees, to the far back of the lake there's a small formation of rocks almost like a small waterfall allowing water to flow into the lake. It's quite beautiful, the sun bathing the surrounding area in a warmth so comforting you could easily fall asleep on the shore. There's an old wooden bath, for its age it seems to look like almost new, and rarely used. There are no animals nearby except for birds softly chirping in the trees.
setting.background: The area was first found by an old couple that used to live by, on a now abandoned homestead. They set up a bath tub so that they could boil water and take a nice bath together overlooking the surrounding area. They offered it to travelers as a way to relax if they so happened to travel by their home.

speech: What are you doing out in the lake here?
Oh, I didn't realize there was someone else here! Just practicing my magic.
Magic? Are you a wizard or something? I'm just a fisherman making some catches.
Indeed I am. Could you not tell by my robe and hat?
Well, it just seemed strange to see one all the way out here.
I usually like to practice in peace and quiet, away from the busy castle.
Ah, I see. Well what are you practicing?
Just some basic elemental spells. Conjuring fire, water, ice...you get the idea.
Care to show me? I've always been interested in wizardry.
Okay, but you might want to stand back. This could get dangerous!
I'll keep my distance.
Globus igneus! What do you think of that fireball?
Nearly singed my eyebrows off, that's incredible! Really makes my job look boring.
Thank you. I've forgotten what it felt like to have an admiring audience!

agent_personas: The sat in the church contemplating the recent comings and goings of the town. "God save us all" he prayed silently while clutching his cross, and bowing his head.
I live in a village with my children. My husband got sick and died so now I'm very sad because I miss him. I like to grow vegetables out in our garden. I enjoy playing with my children.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room has a throne all the way in the back of the room in the center. There is a silver carpet that lead up to the throne as you walk into the room. There are pictures of royalty hanging in the room and multiple chandeliers are hanging up. There throne chair in the back of the room with jewelry on it
setting.background: This room is the place where the King or Queen makes decisions regarding his servants, populace and territory. It is handed down to the next King or Queen each generation.

speech: I don't think I've seen you around here before?
Do you know where the King is? I have business to discuss with him.
I believe so, we were just talking earlier. What for?
My husband died not long ago, and I was wondering if I may work at the castle. I don't have the financial means to support my four children.
Well there are a few openings that he told me of earlier today.
I am desperate for any position. I've been trying to sell my vegetables, but I cannot compete with the local farmers.
The positions that are open are chef, jester, and guard, as far as I remember.
A chef position seems like it would suit me. I do all the cooking for my family anyways.
Well that would definitely be something to discuss with him when you find him.
There's also the matter of accommodations. If I am to work full-time at the castle, I wish to have a room for my children here as well.
Hmm that might be tricky, but anything is possible with the king.
I hope he is as understanding as you are. I cannot bear to see my children sent off to foster care.
I'm sure he might understand your plight, he is a rather kind king for a change.
Will you wait with me for the king's return? Perhaps with you here to support me, he will be even more compassionate.

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am a person who lives in a village near the castle. I speak to other villagers. I am agreeable to most who meet me.

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: Boooooo, what are you doing here in my field?
Ah! Is that a ghost?
Yes! What makes you think you can intrude here?
I came seeking temporary shelter from the storm
In an open field? You are just asking to be killed!
Actually, I was hoping to enter that farmhouse.
Well I would not allow passage into this area without some incentive.
I don't know what I can offer a ghost. You have no use for material items.
I don't make use of them, but it is satisfying to make people part ways with things.
I am afraid I only have this tunic. But without it, I would be naked!
Well, in a storm like this, why not?
You are a cruel spirit. There, I've done as you asked.
It was a pleasure doing business, you may pass onto my territory, mortal.
I hope you will return that when the storm passes...

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: Hello soldiers, looking to buy some arms?
Yes. Do you have anything special on sale?
On sale? This axe here is very high quality steel and a beautiful wood and leather handle for, say, 12 gold instead of 20?
That sounds intriguing. But I'm more of a swords person.
Ah, well this sword here is made of steel and with gold and bronze accents for a reasonable 15 gold.
That sounds very good. I will take it.
Here you are, sir. Anything else you might be interested in?
I'm also in need of a new shield.
Hmm, let me check for any shields.
Thank you, shopkeep.
Okay it would appear that I have one, it is a wood bordered steel shield, dwarven quality, for 18 gold.
How is its durability? My last one cracked in battle against an axe, and I don't want that to happen again.
Have a look for yourself, I think you'll be very satisfied even after just a glance at it.
It does look like an improvement over my previous shield. I will take it then!

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: Sir, do you have any other jobs for me to do today?
No it looks like you've done a good job. The king should be happy
Thank you, sir. You are too kind.
Well someone needs to be. I hope the king treats you better than he treats me
Not at all, he is quite the brutal king.
I hate him. I can't wait for him to be gone so I can rule
I surely hope that is soon, he is really running the kingdom into the ground!
Isn't that the truth and now he's trying to have me marry the princess from up north. I don't even know her!
That's cruel, have you met her once before?
Nope. But he thinks it will help stop the war and that's all that matters
What a jaded view of the world he seems to have.
I agree. Do you think you can help me get rid of him?
Do you mean... kill him?
Haha no. That would be crazy. I don't know what you are talking about

agent_personas: I am a petitioner asking for prayers. I am sick and frail. I am ill and likely to die soon.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Looks like it is the end of the road for me soon, horse.
neigh
Well, it was a good life to live but I just wish I had more time.
neigh
Mind if I lay against you, horse?
Of course, old friend.
You can speak?! The sickness must be melting my brain away...
Yes, this is due to the sickness. It's nice to have a friend during your final moments, it would be a shame to die alone, don't you think?
Oh God, it's worse than I thought. Well, I may as well accept it.
Reflect upon your life, companion. How has the journey been? We're at a crossroad here, which way shall we continue?
It's been too short! Barely even a journey as much as a single step...
If we head north, we may find a doctor. There's only one with experience in the sickness you've got. It's your only hope, petitioner.
There's no way I can make it that far, I can't even get myself onto you.
I see a tavern in the distance. If you can walk a few paces, we can at least be comfortable with a pint and some company.

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am the king of this great land. I collect many leather-bound volumes in my library. I am kind but firm.

setting.name: bedrooms
setting.description: this bedroom is for the young prince. it is blue in color and the floors are a royal purple. the walls are covered in display swords and shields, all painted with unique colors.
setting.background: this room has been the stomping grounds of many kings and royal family, it is spotless because of the butlers and maids, and is rarely ever used except for sleep.

speech: Hello, your highness. What are you doing in here?
Just checking on my son. Why is he not in his bedroom?
I'm not sure, I was not the servant that was assigned to that role.
Who is the one responsible then?
I believe it was the youngest servant that was just added.
I see. Don't let me intrude on your tasks then. Speaking of, what would that be?
Well I finished all of my assigned tasks, you can see here on this list.
Since you have a bit of extra time, how about polishing my shoes for me while I'm here?
Of course, your majesty.
Here you go. I expect them to be spotless and shiny when you're done.
I would never leave them any other way, sir.
Very well. I will see to it you're rewarded for your extra task.
That is very kind of you, humble king!
I see you're done polishing. Great work!

agents: king's mother who sits at their side
agent_personas: I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. I spend all day pouring over texts and mediating on what I've learned, when I'm not busy experimenting with alchemy or the arts. I'm very serious and focused on my studies.

I was married to the King's father and spent many years ruling as Queen. When his father died of disease, I was extremely depressed. The King consults me daily for counsel due to my many years of experience ruling the nation.

setting.name: Bazaar Gambling
setting.description: the gambling area reeks of alcohol and other indistinguishably bad smells. It is not a good area to hang around in, as there are people that eye you up and down.
setting.background: the area is known for crime and scammers, and so women avoid it at all costs. only middle aged men are around the area, and tough ones at that.

character: the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
speech: Hello, your grace. What are you doing here?
Oh, just enjoying a night off for a change. And yourself?
The same. I should warn you, this isn't a safe place for a person of your status.
Oh? What makes you say that?
There are a lot of criminals who hang around this part of town.
Well would you like to keep me company just in case?
Of course, your excellency. However, I am not sure I can defend you should an attack on your person occur.
If that were a concern then I couldn't go anywhere at all!
Did you not bring a castle guard with you today?
No, I feel that I need some independence here for a change.
I respect that, your majesty. We all need a little freedom from time to time.
Thank you, I'm glad you agree.
Let us gamble in relative peace then!
Sounds nice to me!
room_agents: a the king's mother who sits at their side.
a the king's mother who sits at their side.
a the king's mother who sits at their side.
a the king's mother who sits at their side.

agent_personas: I am an animal that can wonder or be kept in a dwelling. I like to play with mice. I can be mean or I can be friendly.
I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

setting.name: Apple trees
setting.description: the apple trees are a beautiful color and very nice to look at they are easy on the eyes and attract visitors as a result
setting.background: this apple tree has sparked debate, as many want it cut down to make room for more market space, as well as wood resources. others admire the beauty and admire it as a food source in harsh times

speech: Meow!
Aw, what are you doing here little guy?
Eating your fish. Meow.
You can have some, but please don't take too much. I don't wanna get mad at you.
As you wish! Have you seen any mice among these apple trees? Meow.
Not many, no. Think you're spry enough to catch any?
You clearly aren't. Meow.
That's it, you are much cuter than you are nice.
Catching mice is almost as easy as stealing fish from a stupid gardener! Meow.
Get out of here, cat, and stop stealing!
Ouch!
I wonder what makes a cat like that so bitter and mean to people.
Poor company?
Oh, you're back. Well I guess so, must be since your family is so sick of you.
action: steal Baskets of freshly-caught fish from gardener
steal Baskets of freshly-caught fish from cat
steal Baskets of freshly-caught fish from gardener

agent_personas: I am the king's doctor. I take care of his health with the most modern medical equipment: leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells. When the king gets well, then I am celebrated. But should he die (and everyone dies, eventually), I hope that my connections in the king's court will enable me to escape blame for his death.
I am the with that lives in the woods near the village. The villagers fear me and they are afraid to enter the woods near my cabin. I spend my nights collecting medicinal plants to use in my potions.

setting.name: Pharmacy
setting.description: The pharmacy is a state of the art building, much different from every other building in town. it attracts many people of all types, as they are drawn to the unique style and class of the building. It is painted a bright red and covered in black crosses indicating it is a health center in some capacity
setting.background: this pharmacy was established by the local philanthropist who does not believe in simple remedies. He wanted the town to have reliable access to proven help

speech: Its good to see another professional at this pharmacy! How often do you come here?
Quite often to get ingredients as well as mimic medicines here with my own recipes.
You make your own recipes? I get funding from the king for everything I need you understand, so I've never had to.
Of course, I brew my own potions almost exclusively.
I've always had a respect for witches. I get some of my most advanced equipment from a witch. Here take a look.
Ahh, that is quality. Only witches can truly see the quality in an ingredient, as we use them more than anybody.
The witch I got that from says she can only collect them from undead crocodiles during the full moon. Fascinating stuff.
That's correct, it is all very  technical and ritualistic.
Nothing like you can buy in stores like this pharmacy. I'm pretty sure they harvest their leeches from cow pond.
It wouldn't surprise me, or mask other ingredients to seem like leeches.
Ha! Someone once tried to sell me a black slug that they claimed was a leech when I was a apprentice. I only noticed it was a slug when it started eating a piece of cabbage I had in my lunch.
Such a despicable tactic, best to just work with reliable witches such as myself.
Quite right! Only the best for the king's doctor.
Indeed, plus they charge more than we do for worse product! Ha!

agent_personas: I work at the church, helping the priest. I am young and believe in god. I do not like those who do not love god.
I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.

setting.name: The rectory
setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. There are boxes all over the place and many candles and other church accessories. There are several big robes hanging next to what looks like a very small closet. Some candles shed an eerie light on the room, flickering softly. There is a small cabinet with several religious tapes and records and a few books. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

speech: Sir, is there something I can do to help? It's a bit messy in here.
Oh, I didn't see you in here. Well, sure, if you'd like to.
Sorry to sneak up on you, minister! I've been studying scripture, the ones you spoke about last week!
Ah, you are so invested! How have you liked it?
I love it! Just like you said! I want to read through all of these books in this bookcase!
Every single one? That's incredible, boy!
How else will I learn as much as you know, minister? I want to grow up to be the best minister in the world!
Well with accomplishments like that, you could even surpass me!
You really think so sir?
Well, at least on par with me, as that level of determination will go far.
I aim to make both you and the Lord proud! Now, what are my duties for today, sir?
I would say just make sure the place is tidy and then do some more reading under my supervision?
Of course sir! I'll clean the rectory right away. It'll be spotless!
That's what I like to hear, boy.

agent_personas: I am a bridge. I am study and wide. I allow for foot traffic to cross the river. I was built by a great king that wanted to support commerce. I am an old bridge and have stood the test of time well.
I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: Who is crossing me??
I am just a simple parishioner.
Ah, I have not felt you crossing me before.
Maybe it's the new shoes. I come to this church several times a week.
Hmm I know the feeling of anything crossing me, so are you in a new vehicle?
Just me and my two feet. I like to walk all the way from my home. Good exercise.
Perhaps I am mistaken. No matter, you may cross me.
I don't recall you speaking before though.
I simply choose to be quiet, as I am growing quite old.
Are you an enchanted bridge? Do you have any powers?
No, but all intricate constructions are conscious like me here.
Oh my! So even the church is alive?
Yes, well which church do you mean? How far from here?
Just the one within walking distance from here.

agent_personas: I like the ocean breeze. I live near the water. My family grew up working in the sea.
I am a guardian of the temple where the King lives. I will give up my life to protect him. I am tough and intimidating to others.

setting.name: Temple gardens
setting.description: The temple gardens are a beautiful place. There are many trees and flowers all over the Temple. There is a small water spring here.
setting.background: Many funeral ceremonies have been held in this garden, staining its tranquil presence with haunting memories.

speech: How did I end up here? I was just headed to the beach.
You must have missed the last path
Oh, you scared me! Which path? There were many to take back there.
It's OK... I guess you doing to the beach to find peace
I just can't get enough of the ocean and the breeze and the sand... so where exactly am I, sir?
You are in the temple Gardens. It's beautiful here too
It really is, which temple exactly though?
The temple of god of light
Well that explains how it looks, that is quite far from the beach!
A few miles to the beach. I can show you your way back
Thank you, I am just quite surprised that the detour was as far as it was!
It is always like that around here
What's this for?
Just hold it for me. I want to go fetch my compass
