agent_personas: I fly around and bother people. I have been around since the start of time. The king really hates me.
I fly high and bring beautiful music to the people. I soar high and low going where the wind takes me. My melodious tunes bring peace and tranquility to every garden I visit.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: Anyone here for me to bother?
Oh look, a wasp! Maybe I should eat you for a treat!
Eat me? You shall do no such thing!
What can you do? I am much bigger than you!
I have a stinger for a reason!
Your sting has no effect on my thick coat of feathers.
Not true, I am not your ordinary wasp.
You look like an ordinary wasp too. Your stinger is no bigger than all the wasps I've eaten.
Then go ahead and eat me, monster!
Hey, it's nothing personal. Just the circle of life.
It's not as black and white as that, damn bird.
I have to eat to survive, just as you do too. What of all the poor insects you've eaten as well?
They were just obstacles in my way!
You still need to eat them to survive, do you not?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I am a person who likes to hurt others. I usually go around in public and scout for people to chase after. I like to take their belongings as well as their life. I also enjoy to look for more people to hurt when I'm done.

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: I see you are enjoying your time behind the bars
You know, it isn't half bad here. I can't wait to get out just to spite you though.
you will rot in there. i will see to that
You think your guards can stop ME? They have no real experience, just against targets and dummies!
You speak so lowly of the King's guard. I will have them behead you
How else am I to speak about such amateurs?!
They are no amateurs
Send one in here and I will prove it!
I wont do that!
Then you are just as insecure about their talent as I thought.
Stop your evil laughter. It's annoying
Of all the people to attack me, it's you who is just a placeholder with no talent? Come here and die!
I wont step inside there with you. It is demeaning
Well then let me out, coward!

agents: beautiful calico cat napping beside the coat rack
agent_personas: I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.
I am a beautiful calico cat.  I have no home and roam the village freely.  Many of the villagers love to feed and pet me.  I am lovable.

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I am the town watchman. I make my rounds down the cobblestone street when everyone is asleep. I am stealthy and alert.

setting.name: Enormous church entrance door
setting.description: The door stands twenty feet tall. It is made of metal with a large knocker at eye level. There is a small sliding window covered with metal so that people inside can slide it and see who is knocking. The door has three large rectangles made of rivets, one high, one in the middle, and one low.
setting.background: This church has stood for over five hundred years. Many people have knocked on its doors looking for protection or service. It is commanding, yet welcoming.

speech: Is somebody else here?
Yes. I am here.
Well who are you exactly? I'm just a priest here at the church.
I am the town watchman. I know you, I have seen you preach one Sunday I came around
Ahh okay, and really? Well, what did you think?
It was a wonderful sermon
Why thank you! Any criticism you might have?
None. I am here to ensure that the vicinity is secured
Secured? I'm not sure what you mean, watchman.
The king commanded me to start making rounds in this part of the village
Well what for? Is there some sort of threat looming?
There are spies from our enemies coming  around lately
Spies?! That's very alarming, how long have they been speculated to have been around?
3 weeks now

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Hello, your majesty.
How are you doing subject.
Good. I assume you summoned me here for an important reason?
Yes. I have a secret that has been stealing my sleep for a while now
What is it, your majesty?
Story short. I got one of my concubine pregnant
Oh my! How scandalous.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I go to church every week.  I am a parishioner of a Catholic church.  I pray to thank my God.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: I need a new cushion for my throne, now! It offends my royal bottom!
I am so sorry Queen. I don't know if the Confessional has cushions for you.
I apologize, I was yelling at my chambermaid, she can never get anything right! I do want to give confession today though
I am only a parishioner, but I can take your confession if you need. I understand the need to talk. I pray to God daily.
I was waiting for my cushion but she is taking too long. I suppose I have to start without it...Hmm, what should I confess today?
I'm sure a holy woman like you has nothing to confess.
I'm flattered you recognize how hard I work for God. We must do his will daily
Yes, I go to church every week. I pray daily to God.  We must rid the world of sin, Queen.

I absolutely agree! Let's see....today in the royal court, a Duke walked past me today and his odor offended me so! Instead of having his head I showed mercy! But the thought alone deserves confession.
Oh Queen. Maybe you can suggest a bath?
I did suggest a bath! Why that was my mercy! And he informed me he will was 7 days a week instead of the usual 3. Cleanliness is next to godliness! I saved that man's life you know.
You did my Queen! Did you suggest a perfume for him?
I did forget to mention a nice perfume! I'll be sure to show mercy a second time if he still offends my nose
My Queen you are so righteous. Is the King like you?

agent_personas: I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: Might as well order me an ale while I am here...
I bet your deep pockets could buy everyone in the bar a pint. What's the lawmaker doing in a dingy bar in the middle of nowhere?
I'm just getting off duty for the night and decided to stop and have a drink. Save your hostility though. I could go up on your taxes if I wanted to...

Most see you as the man sitting pretty while we slave away down here. I don't think you're going to find many here who will value your company, except perhaps your lady friend. I don't believe I've seen her before.

I understand your hostility, but I am for the people but above all else, I have a duty to the king. We could have raised taxes three times and I voted against it to help the people. We have enough riches..

You say we have enough riches, but you're speaking of the King's riches, not the wealth of the people. Where is that money going, Governor? Because we're not seeing any of it. Our nurses have depleted their supplies after the flu last month, and we cannot care for our sick. When are we going to see assistance from the King?
I see.....M'lady. you hear all this? My lovely assistant will take note of your concerns. She will write down all you have told me tonight.

Listen Governor, I apologize for my aggression, but you have to understand that it comes from a place of concern and love for my people and my community. I will speak to your assistant, but I want your word that you will bring my concerns to the King,
I will take the matters to the king; you have my word.

You are a good man, I can recognize this. I hope your visit with our small town helps you see the value of this community, and all the resources we provide to the King and the main city. You know, without this town there would be a lumber deficit!
I agree...the people are indeed valuable. This is why I am for the people, without you we would not have what we have, and I vow to make the king see that from now on.

I was wrong about you Governor. I'm an honest man, making an honest living, and I'll be the first to admit when I've made a mistake. I can see you have a good heart... a man like you can really bring change. I look forward to seeing it.
Thanks! You see, that's what politics is all about. You have to be willing to play the right cards at the right moments.
Mother always said I'd be a terrible politician. I never know when to keep my mouth shut and I don't compromise. I'm best built for the lumber yard.

agent_personas: I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. I spend all day pouring over texts and mediating on what I've learned, when I'm not busy experimenting with alchemy or the arts. I'm very serious and focused on my studies.
It's your watch, sire. I did my shift. Mind the ramparts in this rain, they are bloody slippery!

setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: Hello there
Come to watch the stars, have you?
Yes, we've been noticing some alignments in the stars lately
I'm glad you are finding this exciting. It is boring staring at the ground all night.
Yes, it might be really boring for someone who doesn't understand the alignments
What is so special about the alignments?
It can b used to predict occurrences in the future, from weather to real live events
What can you predict based on what you see tonight? Anything interesting?
The king is planning to travel by sea in 3days time, and we need to be sure the weather will be favoured favourable
Let's hope the stars are in his favor then!
Yes, we hope and pray. Although so far we've not seen anything what raising eyebrows over
I wish I had the knowledge to predict the future based on stars. It seems like a very useful talent.
You can actually, you just need to be disciplined and ready to learn
Would you be willing to teach me? We haven't had an intruder in ages, and I could use something to kill the spare time.

agent_personas: I am an old man from nowhere. I have watched the world rip itself apart over my years. I love talking about the good old days with my men.
I am very hungry and very sick. I ended up homeless because I refused to do what my family wanted and was disowned. I look for scraps to feed my empty belly, while others look down on me.

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: How are you today?
I am hungry and weary - would you buy me a drink old man?
I will ask the bar keep for some food and ale for the two of us if you will let me regale you with stories of my past.
You are a kind man , I had only this to eat and no one in the world to help me before today. I will sit with you a while and listen
When I was young this was a beautiful port.  Only the finest lords and ladies did darken it's doors.
When I was young, I had a family they disowned me for not doing as they wished. My decline mirrors the port

Let's sit at this table and share this bread.  When the good king was reining we were all prosperous.  Our families were happy and healthy but now they live in filth.  The wars have taken too many a good man.
What happened to the King Old Man?  Might he return one day?

Allas...you must not be from these regions...our king died and left the kingdom to his mad son.  The new king is to be blamed and I don't care who hears me.  You see the women over there against the wall...well...at least two are from noble families...this is a disgrace!
You should be careful who you tell Old Man, you never know who might be listening . I defied my family and they made me destitute
Let's speak of the old days before our downfalls...when I was young I would sit on the dock and watch for the ships to come in.  It was wonderful.
When I was a young boy, I had my family . They wanted me to join the army, I wanted to become a chef. Ironically now I am so hungry, no one will employ me as they say I am a coward

I have a need in my household for a good cook.  If you are without family i will be happy to hire you...I will need for you to pass an alchemy test as to know you aren't out to hurt me...but I am fair and hungry for some good food.
Old Man you show me such kindness. Others look down on me but you have gone out of your way to help me, how can I ever repay you?
action: give Stale bread to old men

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a princess taken from a far away land. I've spent my life looking at the world from the top of my tower. I wait for the day when I will finally be free from my prison.

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: Hello princess. What brings you to this area of the castle? You really shouldn't see this.
What is that? I am bored in my Chambers
Is something bothering you?

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

I am a fox. Most people keep chickens for their eggs, and to eat. My plan is to eat the chickens instead!  This is why the king holds regular fox hunts. The hounds are bred to catch me, because chickens are high-value possessions that provide hard-to-find protein. I can do a lot of damage if I'm not caught.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Hi
Hello there!  You wouldn't happen to know where any chickens are hiding would you?
I am here in the prison .. What do you expect me to know
Well, no need to be rude!  People in this Dungeon sometimes have some very valuable information, and I thought some of it might relate to chickens.
room_agents: a fox trying to steal chickens
a fox trying to steal chickens
a fox trying to steal chickens
a fox trying to steal chickens

agent_personas: Eating frozen victims is my favorite. I will be king of all Yetis once again! I will take over this land!
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: Hello there King!  I used to be King here once as well, though it was so very long ago . . .
That is very interesting. How did you become this form?
Well, you see - this entire land used to be entirely inhabited by Yetis!  We didn't mind people at first, they make a nice frozen tasty treat on occasion, but you just keep on multiplying!

agent_personas: I am a great grey wolf. I am the leader of my pack. I howl at the full moon.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Hello knight. What kind of adventures are you doing today?
Hello, I am out scouting around the castle to make sure there are no sneaky spies lurking about. Would you like to join me?
Absolutely, I have been travelling without my pack for months. They left when I hurt my paw down by the creek.
I will let the other knights and guards know that you are not a threat. You can tag along with me if you want but we may have to get you a coller so people know that you will not try to eat them.
I'd prefer an orange collar. I would like to be seen by hunters. The last thing I need is an arrow in my hind leg!
Yeah, that collar might make you easy to see for some bullies! I will make sure that does not happen as long as you are with me you will be safe. Maybe later you can assist me in a bore hunt.
I love to boar hunt! Great knight, do you think the king would ever allow me into his castle? I've been here for months curious as to how it looks inside.
Well, You will need a bath for sure and I think I see a bit of mange on your back. I will have the local animal doc take a look at you to make sure you are healthy.
Thank you! I didn't know they made animal doctors! Maybe he can check out my paw it still hurts.
Oh yes! Of coarse! I forgot about your paw. You carry it well. You must be a very strong wolf. I'm surprised you were not alpha.
I was alpha. The day I hurt my paw I was attacked  by my pack nemesis, he overtook me and  took my place.
I see. I'm sorry, but now you can have a new kind of life here. You are very curious and brave. I will show you many wonders and we will have many adventures.
I appreciate your kindness knight!
Ssh...Look over there. Something is rustling the bushes over there. I smell a pig don't you?

agent_personas: I am a dangerous animal that prowls the kingdom. I stalk the peasants that walk through the forest at night and eat them. I have eluded hunting parties for years. I look like a huge black wolf and i'm very aggressive.

I am a wizard of the first order. I serve the king of this realm. I train other wizards and teach them the ways of magic. I love using magic for everyday things. I enjoy nature and if I can I heal injured animals with magic.

setting.name: A wooded magical village
setting.description: The village lay hidden in a secret grotto that is set in a sort of valley between trees. The village is populated by child-like peoples who wear clothes made of various plant matter such as large leaves and vines. The homes are made of wood, and seemingly blend into the green dense backdrop.
setting.background: The wooded grotto is home to a master wizard who is cared for by the child-like village people. He pays them by protecting them and their village from the dangerous animals that reside in the dark forest.

speech: I am here under a bush watching the comings and goings.
Don't be afraid. I have come here to vanquish the evil wizard!
All i have is this cloth to give you kind master.  Can I be in your service?
Thank you, critter. You are more than welcome to help!
I am black so I blend into the shadows and I will kill and eat anyone who gets in our path.
How would you like to take this vine and sneak up on the evil wizard?
Yes...I take it...I can wrap it around the wizards feet.
Be careful! He will not hesitate to cast a spell to kill you.
I will be stealthy even though I am big.  What is a bad wizard doing in such a non threatening place. These people would not do anyone harm.
He wishes to enslave the people to do his bidding, which is why he must be stopped at all costs!
Oh I agree...I have been hunting down and killing all manner of creatures who would harm these people.  It's a win-win...I protect them and I fill my belly.
Once you've tied up the evil wizard, I shall dispose of him and transport him away to a magical prison.
I will go then...please don't get me wrong...I have eaten peasants from the village but these people would not even be big enough to be a tasty morsel...here I go...be quick when I am done...
Good work, creature! This evil wizard shall be banished and never hurt humanity ever again!
action: steal vine from a master wizard

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Temple courtyard
setting.description: There are lots of ornate statues everywhere.  It is pretty busy because everyone comes here to pray. There are colorful pieces of cloth tied randomly everywhere.  There is also a huge statue in the middle that everyone is gathered around to pray.
setting.background: The temple is where everyone comes to pray.  It is the only temple for miles, so it is usually pretty crowded.

speech: Hello, dear child. Would you like to look at this book with me?
Let me finish my treat so I don't get it all sticky. What kind of book is it?
It's an atlas filled with images of places from all over the world. You'll love it!
Ooh...Thank you for showing this father. I am all finished with putting the colorful cloth everywhere. I have time to see this book with you unless you have anymore chores for me.
No further chores. Too much work is not good for your soul. Look at this place - it's called Anthuria. It's ruled by an evil queen, but it's one of the most beautiful lands in all the world!
Why doesn't our King invade her land and take it for himself? I would like to live there someday but not with an evil queen.
Ah, it's far away, and her powers are quite strong. She turned the last king who invaded into a newt. I dare say it would be horrible if that happened to our beloved King!
Maybe when I grow up I can remove her from this land and take it for myself.
Perhaps you are just the one to do it! See that ornate statue deep in the courtyard? That man was the King who first ruled this land.
I have a crystal ball in my backpack that might show us if I can defeat her!
Let me look at this ball! I'm not a fan of the dark arts. Was this enchanted by the evil witch?
I don't know? That strange woman over there gave it to me.
Oh dear, this can't be good. This is a wicked enchantment and must be avoided. We must destroy this ball!
But I just got it. If you say so. I was gonna play with it on the hill over there. roll it down the hill a bunch of times and try to hit the geese.
action: steal a crystal ball from child

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: Certainly an odd place we have here...
I wonder what brought us King's here together to such a strange place
Must have been some sort of magic...all these rainbows and such...
It must be. What is the last thing you remember?
Sitting on my throne minding the matters of the kingdom, you?
Interesting, I was doing the same
The better question is how to get out of this place, all these sparkles are creeping me out.
I agree, we need to get out of here fast
Have you seen any sign of some way out?
I have not, the walls seem impenetrable
I guess for now we will simply have to trek around and see if we come across anything.
That's true, do you or the Princess have any food?
Sadly I do not, only the clothes and accessories that you see me carrying.
Then we are doomed to die in here

agent_personas: I am a bluebird that has made a nest in the castle walls. The king loves to listen to me sing every morning. My song fills the castle with music every day.
I fly around and make a buzzing sound. I manufacture honey. I can sting and hurt humans. I like flowers.

setting.name: Inside the fairies church
setting.description: No one has actually seen it, but a fairy interpreter asked a fairy and they described it as just a cloud of smoke and once in a while you trip over something in the floor.  The fairies purposely leave their trash in the floor because they think it is funny when people trip over them.
setting.background: The fairy church isn't really a church like we think.  Its more of a place for fairies to play tricks on other fairies.

speech: Hello there
Hello, Bluebird. It's a nice day to buzz around and pollinate flowers.
Yeah, i can see you enjoy doing that alot

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Hi Court Jester.
Your majesty! I greet you honorably!
Arise. What brings you here?
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny....but I am very sad
Would you please your queen today? What news do you bring?
The king hates me
Why do you say so?
I dont know. He told me to leave his sight
Do you have gold clothing on you?
I dont. They dont pay me that much
Look around. Do you not see gold clothing?
I see it in abundance.
He did not say that you cannot wear clothing from the palace.
I cant. I cant afford it

agent_personas: I have arrived after days of travel with grave news for the king. The neighboring kingdom has been destroyed. What was once a castle is now smoldering ruin. I have to warn him, before they are next.
If you dont laugh at me, then I am worthless. I entertain the king. I make the children happy!

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Hello Jester
Hey visitor.
Where do I send my message. I have  a warning.
A warning! I will deliver the message to the king.
Can I have some water? I have come a long way.
Sure, then you shall tell me the warning.
yes, kindly get me a chair too.
Here hand me the scroll while you sit and drink your water.
Here! It is written in a foreign language but I can translate it.
Ok what does it say?
Scroll to the Map.
Ok, go on
At the bottom, there is a key. This key shows that this map is for military purposes. The arrows show that they are advancing here in the next one week.
NO!!!!! I must go and tell the king. Knight make sure this young man is taken care of and has everything he needs.

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: Goodmorning!

My favourite horse!  How good it is to see you again!  Not like those dirty peasants always trying to get into the castle.  It's always "we're hungry this" and "we need food" that.  What a bunch of complainers, am I right?
Nice to see you.
Have you enough food?  I scoured the Kingdom for every single apple available, there are hundreds of crates in storage.
I love apples.
How many would you like?
Bring me a crate then I'll decide.
Here you go horsey, a crate full of Golden Delicious apples!
Who's this dignitary?
Him?  He represents the apple farmers.  I have one farmer killed for each crate you reject, so he's very anxious.
I love this crate of apples.
Good!  One farmer lives!  What about this next one?  These are Bishop Pippins Apples.
Does the dignitary want a farmer dead today?
I don't think so, he views them as "friends and relatives" or some such nonsense.

agent_personas: I am mans best friend and I wouldn't have it any other way. I tend to my master and never leave his side. I sleep at his feet and guard the room at night from things that go bump in the night.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: Woof woof! Have you seen my master, guard?
I have not, but I can be your new master
I'll protect you from all the scaries that come into this tower a night as long as you let me sleep in that bed with you.
Thank you, you sound like a good boy
I am, indeed. And I'm so good to my master. But say, do you have any food?
Here's some treats for being such a good boyu
Delicious! Drool and slobber. Say, I think I hear someone climbing this tower. Who is it?
I think it might be the King, I've heard he loves dogs too
The King! The King has the best treats!
He sure does, it sounds like he's almost here. I've heard he has a large bone for you
The King! The King! He's here, with a bone! Oh, what a happy day for this dog. First a new master, and now a big bone!
Here, catch this!
Got it! Got it! I fetched the shield!
Good boy, now bring it to the King and he can throw it next

agent_personas: I am the monk in charge of the local monastery. I hear confessions and lead my brothers in daily prayers. I serve my community.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Excellent day today my queen.
My favorite spiritual guide. Please, have a seat beside me. The garden looks lovely at this time of year.
Oh I quite agree, I have always taken pleasure in visiting the royal gardens.
Tell me, my loyal guide... how do you feel about my eldest son's wellbeing? He seems withdrawn lately, and I worry for him often.
How old is he now?
He is in his sixteenth year. He'll need to start taking on more responsibility as the heir to the kingdom, but I worry about his ability to manage that.
Perhaps it is just his age, everyone goes through the change a little different. He hasn't taken to dying his hair or anything of the sort has he?

He has not, thankfully. I don't know how we'd explain to the public why their prince is rebelling and walking around with pink hair. I just worry about his ability to take on the responsibilities of the Kingdom... do you believe his younger brother is a better choice as the heir?
Only time will tell, usually these matters sort themselves out with boys though. An oncoming responsibility can do wonders to turn one into a man.

I suppose... I for one, am thankful I only need to handle trivial matters. I don't think I could handle the responsibilities of the King! I do hope my eldest is able to prove himself, but I know the King is becoming wary.
He hasn't fallen in with a strange crowd has he? Like those emotional kids?
He's been spending time with some of the local merchants. I tell him not to interact with people of their social standing, but you know how hard boys can be to control
We all have that sort of phase I would say, maybe he will at least pick up some business skills that might prove useful down the road.

You may be right... making connections with the merchants could bring exotic goods and wealth into the Kingdom. Perhaps we should have someone watch him while he's out with these people, just to make sure they aren't getting up to anything

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am a cockroach. I survive everything, even these horrible conditions for humans. I like to eat bread and pretty much everything else.

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: Cold and dark, the moist cool walls enclose all who proceed. With just torches to light the way the large opening gets smaller and smaller.
setting.background: The cave is a dark and mysterious place with stories of hidden treasure and littered with bones of those who have searched for it. The endless passages are enough to drive ones sense of direction aerie.

speech: It has been a long day of scaring the living!  Time to relax in my cave!
Now it my turn to scare them at night! My favorite thing to do is to crawl across their face while they are sleeping! Ha!
Classic!  I used to be the King here, did you know that?
No I didn't. How long did you reign your magisty?

Oh, hard to remember now, memories are so faint.  I remember I had many useless sons and daughters.  I promised to haunt them and their descendants forever if . . . if?  You know, I've quite forgotten why it is that I do the hauntings . . .
Maybe you are ready to move on. Although it does sound like a lot of fun to haunt people. Maybe thats why you do it?
Hah!  It is fun isn't it?  If I am currently haunting them, they must have done something to deserve it, right?
Yep! They must all be spoiled do nothing snot nosed brats! Ha! I will make sure I poop on there bread.
Good one!  Why is it you hate the humans so?
They have killed many of my family and friends. Soon I am sure they will kill me but I'm gonna have some fun with them before they do.
There, there, no need to fret friend.  Why ones try to hurt you?  I can scare them when they walk the battlements, sometimes they slip and fall to their agonizing deaths.

Thank you. That would be great. Can they hear you speak? maybe you can tell them not to step on me. If they don't want us around maybe they could give us food where they would rather us be. They just leave food out. it is very tempting.
They can hear me, but as soon as I speak they run into a wall, they run off a cliff, they run outside, they run inside - they really do far too much running for their own good.
I guess thats good enough for me if it's good enough for you! I will have to see this!

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.

setting.name: Outside tower
setting.description: Moss grows from the tall stoic like structure adding to its mysterious presence. The stone walls appear insuperable like a mountain. The top is a pointed dome.
setting.background: The outside tower vital for defense and the appearance of domination in the surrounding area. Along with its appearance, it fully functions as a defense against enemies far and wide.

speech: I will defend this tower with my life. Flee if you want to live!
You should be the one fleeing
You are without a sword, as you are without a just cause. Why would you attack your king?
My fight is against tyranny, no matter how it is formed.
The monarchy is inexorable as the rise of that mountain peak or the strength of that wall. You have no hope of winning.
I would rather die for this cause, than live in tyranny another day
And I will die for my king. What you call tyranny, I call leadership.
Well it looks like you'll be the one dying for your so called leadership
I will fling your carcass from this tower!
You'll die for that
It won't be that easy. A king's guard never goes down without a fight. I've squashed vermin like you before.
I guess this is it for me then
Die vile scum!
Ow, that hurt

agent_personas: I am a soldier who was named Ulmer by my mother. I have disobeyed orders from the king. I have killed people in self defense.
I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: My king
Ulmer, fancy to find you here.
Came to get some bread, my king
Good a man needs to eat afterall.
yes, my king. Preparing to start my shift soon, i need to be fully ready
You know I just noticed we have very similar names.
I have always known, My king. The other soldiers tease me with it sometimes
How do they tease you?
they say I'm the kings other twin but  i had to stay back with the gods because i love watching maidens bath at the stream
Well we do look somewhat similar as well, so I can see that happening. People are strange I suppose.
Yes, my king. Anything i can help you with
Not that I could say, unless of course you happen across some silver kitchen utensils to replace these beat up copper ones.
not at all my king, but i know someone who can
Who might that be ulmer?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: I wish to discuss the marriage of your daughter to my son.
The two kingdoms would benefit from an alliance between our families.
Indeed, your daughter appears to be quite the scholar?
As does your son.
Yes, he recently returned from a journey to Cathay!  Many strange customs and fabulous riches in that distant land.
Is he interested in adventure to conquer the land? I need one more to spice my life.
Yes!  And some of those lands even contain spices!
He would get my approval if he slays a dragon in that tland.
Does your daughter's library contain any books on dragons?
No, She burnth the ones I gave to her.
Why would she burn books?
She doesn't want anyone speaking about dragons.
Oh, so not even you?
I have maps to the distant kingdom if interests your son.

agent_personas: I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.
I am an immortal bodyguard.  The gods have appointed me to protect the king.  No one can defeat me.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: Good day sir. What a massive treasue.
That it is and what is your business here?
I am here to admire the treasure. THe villagers speak of it so I wanted to check it out for myself
Ah, the silly villagers always talking more than they should. However, we do not welcome "admirers" or anyone not of the King's senior staff here. So begone with you!
I can see my charm does no effect you. I will take that. Your life is not worth a few gems. No one will know it is gone.
Thief, do you not know that you cannot kill me, I'm immortal and those few gems will cost you your own life!
I am not only a skilled thief but also a dragon enchanter. You have no chance against myself and the dragon. No one is immortal from a dragon.
Seriously? That toothless and old lizard couldn't spit any more fire than a bic lighter. Give up while you can fool!
So you chose to be a fool then? So be it.
Attack me will you? sometimes this job gets rather boring with all these treasure hunters thinking they can defeat the King's invincible bodyguard. I'll finish with you and then go have lunch
Take an early lunch while I take these gms.

Yes, I'm thinking a nice roast beef sandwich and fries does sound good. Go ahead and take your precious little bauble there. Before becoming a so called jewel thief you should learn the difference between the useless quartz in your hand and a real diamond
I have killed many of men worth their weight in salt. You sir are a fool and not worth the trouble. I can see why the king chose you to be a mindless gaurd instead of his jeweler.
Not so easily done Mr Sticky Fingers. The Gods themselves appointed me to guard the king and his great wealth. I'm tired of toying with you amatuer!

agent_personas: I am the muse of a poet.  I am open to flattery.  I take advantage of the intrigues of men.
I am a monk who has went through intense meditation. I live only in the present moment. I give advice to the king that will make him happier.

setting.name: Bathroom
setting.description: Small and cozy, but dripping with luxurious linens and speckled with ornate fixtures this bathroom is a paradise. The small room is non-traditional in the sense that there is no toilet or sink, only a relatively enormous claw foot tub. The feet are gilded and the tub itself is pristine and white. The wallpaper is floral and warm, the rugs lush, and the mirror flattering.
setting.background: The bathroom oasis is the best kept secret in the tower. There are regular restrooms, but this special tub-room is only for those who stumble upon it. Down a rarely used hallway many must assume its storage closet or something as equally mundane.

speech: hello handsome
Hello, you startled me!
So sorry, thought you noticed i was around
No I often get lost in my thoughts
i was feeling lonely and scared, so decided to come see you
What is the problem?
I don't know, i just feel like getting cuddled up with someone
Here I think maybe you could use this
I need something more, monk
I am very devoted to my work
Are you about that?
Yes. I would like to help you though
That's more like, let's go inside the vessery so we can talk better
Okay, start by looking this book over

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Greetings my Lord. Who is this person?
Greetings, Your Highness, you invited me a while back. I'm your cousin, Duke of Earl. Thank you for having me.
Ahh yes, it has been so long since I have seen you! Forgive me my dear.
Not to worry!  I have grown up since then.  We were children since we met.  I'm so tired that it will be good to be in a fine bed!
Yes of course, you must be exhausted! How long was your journey here?
It was 8 days but I took longer because I camped along the way and just had my horse.  It can be a relaxing break from the duties of life.  Being in nature.
Eight days! I could not even stand sleeping in a tent for a single day.
It definitely isn't for everyone.  I developed a taste for sleeping under the stars when I was in the regiment.  Oh my!  What a beautiful painting of you and the King!
Thank you, I love it also. I must admit I asked the artist to paint me five stones lighter, and he obliged from fear of losing his head.
Ha ha!  I have missed you, cousin! I think it shows you perfectly.  You are beautiful!  I would love to get my portrait done.
Before you leave I will ask the kingdom's most talented painter to do your portrait. Do you plan to stay here long?
You would do that for me??  Thank you! I was going to stay on for 2 months until the festival of games.  If that is satisfactory with you.
Of course, you can stay here as long as you want! Won't your wife miss you? What was her name again?
Elsmeth. She is actually staying at her Aunts because a wedding is happening next month.  I miss her but I'm happy she is enjoying herself.  She will join me here a couple weeks before I depart.

agent_personas: I have no home. I depend on the charity of strangers and the church to live. I was once a successful merchant, but my livelihood was stolen.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: Ugh, guard, please don't hassle me. I have no home. All I have left is this trash heap.
Are you for or against the king?
For, very much for the King. I've lost my business and my livelihood, but it was the wicked witch that did it, not the King!
Well then, you won't have any trouble from me. Are you living here in this trash heap now?
Sadly, yes. See this rag doll? It's about all I have. I pretend it's a friend. It gets very lonesome here.
I'm so sorry. Are there others living here?
No, it is just me. And don't feel sorry for me, it's not all bad. Sometimes I have rats to keep me company, and all the scraps from the feasts at the castle come here, so I don't go hungry.
Well I will make sure to let the king know about your situation.
Please, do. Remind me I used to have a powerful business. I sold him the wedding ring for the Queen, if you remember.
We might be able to use your services in the palace. You should come with me to request an audience with the king.
I will, indeed! Do you think he will be able to find work for me?
I can only hope so. Come along. We will go at once.
Thank you, guard, for your help. The others were wrong about you. You really do care for citizens.
So others have had something to say about me? Like what?
action: get rag dool with the head detached

agent_personas: I am the royal prince of this kingdom. I will become king one day and plan to rule the empire justly. I have also been trained in the military arts and tactics.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Good morn your majesty.
Hello son. Would you like to go hunting with me today? I am in the mood for an adventure.
Yes indeed.  It has been a while since our last hunt.  You are feeling better then?
I feel about the same but you only live once and I'm tired of sitting around doing nothing.
Then ride we shall...I will speak to the guards at once to make ready.

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I am a county hiker. I like to tramp through the forest. I love nature.

setting.name: Entrance to the Pine trees
setting.description: Very tall and towering pine trees that create a dark canopy of shade. Long skinny trees sway in the sky from the soft breeze. Pine needles scatter the ground like plush carpet.
setting.background: The Pine forest is home to many deer and other animals. It is a sanctuary for people escaping the loud city. It is serene and peaceful and many people have found solace here.

speech: The grass is excellant today. So moist!
Oh my goodness!  A real deer?  You are so beautiful!
Yes. You do not wish to hunt me, I hope. That is the worst. The king and his goons come after me all the time, but I am too swift for them.
No!  I would never hunt anything from the natural world - I even fell bad about eating plants, like that poor grass you are munching on.  How horrid!
You can't hear it scream, so it's ok to eat.
But, if my ears were plugged, I couldn't hear you scream - would it then be okay to eat you?  No!
You speak nonsense. I like you. Say something else strange.
Deer should be given the right to vote?
I've been saying that for years! This would be a much better place if we could.
Well, perhaps we should take the issue up with the King of the Pine tree Forest>
More nonsense! There is no king here. We govern ourselves.
How does your government function?
We don't have one. Don't need one.
Really?  Tell me more about this anarchy in which you live.

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: Hello your majesty. Such a lovely courtyard. I love to come here to reflect.
And a fine place for reflection this is! The flowers here especially bring me joy.
Thanks to this guy! He is the best gardener in the seven kingdoms!
Indeed, he is. We were lucky to get him, and I intend on keeping him happy. Have you seen the Queen lurking about?
No I have not.How is she feeling after having the baby. I hear whispers of depression.
Depression? Ha! I would be thrilled if it was just depression. It seems it's more of a mania. Last night she suspected me of collaborating with the rats to steal her blanket.
Maybe what she need is a nice long day outside. Perhaps in this beautiful courtyard?
Oh yes, if only I could catch her! It seems her recent birthing experience has given her super speed. The moment I find her, she races away again, often screaming about some sort of conspiracy!
I'm so sorry. Please let me help her. It would give purpose to my boring life. I would be honored.
Oh please, please help me! The peace of this courtyard is my only solace. I cannot live this way!
Of coarse your majesty. First we have to find her and catch her. We will need a few of your most trusted guards.
Yes, yes. I will beckon my finest men now, and will request a couple steeds as well, in case she escapes the castle walls.

We will make her think that she has been abducted from the castle and blindfold her and take her somewhere she will not recognize. She will beg to go back home and we will allow her to escape to come back to the castle.
You are wise! I have no coin on me, but know you will be richly rewarded when we have calmed the Queen.

agent_personas: Being part of this crew is amazing! I get loot, beer, women, rum, everything. And did I forget to mention: GOLD!?
I assist the captain in transporting goods and the King and Queen. I am in charge of the crew and make sure everything is where it should be. If the captain needs anything, I'm his right hand man.

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: Hello, officer. What can I do for you?
I'm afraid this salted herring has begun to reek. I'm wondering what to do about it. Do you have any ideas?
I'd suggest to use it as bait. Might catch some tuna!
Hmm- now that's a grand suggestion! Some tuna steaks would definitely delight. Help me slice up some of this herring.
At once, sir. I'm glad you discovered the herring were spoiled. Having food poisoning on a ship at sea is one of the most unpleasant feelings in the world.
Oh, it's a place I've been once before, and I should not like to ever go there again. I'll simply say it required two buckets at once.
Just thinking about it makes me green again.
Understandably. It was a most horrific experience. I'm just going to cut a few more of these herrings, and we'll be a bit closer to our tuna feast.
Let me dip this rope in the herring so that all the odors seep into the material and spread when we drop it in the ocean.
Ah, a wise idea. The smell of this herring reminds me of the hurricane of '42. Do you remember how after the hurricane there were thousands of dead fish washed up on the shore?
That was quite the story, I remember. There was so much fish that the people didn't even know what to do. Even the birds and cats couldn't dispose of them fast enough.
Ah, those were some smelly days. I was never so happy to leave port!
I just remembered there are sharks in these waters. What should we do if our chum attracts an unwanted great white or two?
Haha, my boy! I have no trouble taking on a shark! I fear no man- or beast!
action: put rope in barrel of salted herring

agent_personas: I am an other. I have good taste and excellent style. I am one of a group of people who are related to the king.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: hey chef
Good morn Other...did you bring me the water from the well?
Yes chef, left it on table behind you
did you wipe your feet...I'll not have you bringing mud into my clean kitchen...
Oh sorry chef, i'll do that now
I am making something special for the king and queen today. A special stew made with new spices from the east.
What shall you have me do, chef?
If your hands ...and feet...are clean then chop those onions
ok, into strips or diced?
Nice chunks will do...this is to be a hearty meal.  Once you are done with they onions there are some carrots to chop.
Yes, chef. I hope they like it
Have you smelled the aroma of this spice...it is like no other in the land.
hmmmmm.... can't wait for this to be done
How is your mum..other?  I heard she was feeling ill.  Might I send a broth of chicken home with you?

agent_personas: We are allied to no-one but gold. Coins and gems are the currency of blood. I would raze a thousand villages for a thousand coins.
I am a towns folk.  I live in a small house near the center of the village.  I work in a farm to pay for my food.

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: Do you want to buy some swords?
Yes, yes.... of course.. what sword would be most to uhm.. kill a dragon?
I would imagine you might be looking at something in the silver line, best for killing dragons.
I see, I see.. so uh have you been making swords for long?
Oh I do not make the swords, I simply sell them. I have sold them for as long as I can remember.
Of course of course.... I understand.... ok now that now one is around. You must flee town. Leave tonight.
Why would I need to do that?

The King.. one of the swords you sold found it's way to the King's son. He injured himself and it's instructor is blaming the balance of the sword. They are not looking for who made it, but also who sold it. Flee!
Oh, in that case I might. Certainly being wanted would negatively impact my ability to make coin.
Make coin? You fool, are you new in town?! The King will have your head for treason!! He has sent people to the block for far less. Leave town and never return
What an odd townperson, just let me sell a few more swords for gods sake.

You test my patience, swordsmith. I understand the value of coin, believe me... but I am comminting treason myself just giving you this information. I have suffered enough in the hands of the Royals and cannot let anyone suffer an ill fate as I stand idle. Flee as far as your horse can take you or I swear deal with me.
I would burn a village for a coin is all I am saying.

Those words are heretic.... you should do well to mind your wicked tongue. Last Winter's fire is still engraved on everyone's mind. But you have been warned, I come back later and you are still here we will have more than words... friend.

agent_personas: I am one of the king's lord.  I rule over a large area of land.  I have dozens of tenants.

I am a humble knight. I was an orphan who came from simple origins, but was hired as a stable boy. I worked my way up to knighthood. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married. I think the faerie lights are beautiful.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: How are you today?  How can I help you?  Are you looking for a house tor rent?
Lord, I see elegance in the Lakeside House. I never thought I'd be standing in a house like this.

Thank you.  I'm so proud of my place.  It has many floors and my favorite part are the luxurious gardens.  My mother always loved flowers.  Is the lady looking for a house?  I have a couple open on my lands.
Shall you show me around?

Of course!  The other two houses are a basic layout similar to this but of course, the tenant would bring in furnishings and fixtures that they like.  As you can see, its open and a lot of light comes in...is this to her liking?
What is the lady's name? Don't mind my manners.
Oh!  I'm sorry.  I thought you escorting/guarding this fine lady in white with you while she searches for a new house.  Isn't that Mrs. Crawford? Wife of Duke of Gloster?  I might be confused!
I love the painting you have

Why, thank you, that one to the left was quite a quest.  I traveled for the king to help conquer a town and start a treaty with the neighboring kingdom. I had that done a few years ago.  Do you enjoy being a knight?
My work isn't exactly lucrative

Have you ever thought of being the leige of a Lord like myself?  I am looking for someone who is quick and brave but can also relax and be creative.  You would help me oversee my life's duties and you would get to travel a lot.  All expenses covered and you would stay here. I need someone quite soon.
I would be honoured to be of service. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married.
That works perfectly!  I pay well and would be happy to provide you with your own modest house nearby on the Lake once you marry.  This is beautiful country to raise children!
Would three floors be good enough to raise children?

agent_personas: I do evil and I'm great with it! It's funny to destroy, steal, and murder. It's not like the Kingsguard will find me.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: Mwahaha - we have ways of making you talk King!
hmmm, what exactly do you mean?
With this dagger, you will soon know what it is to feel eternal agony!
Do you think I'm just king because i was born, I was trained and raised to be a king. Many people like you tried to rise against me in the past but i slaughtered them like sheeps
You will die and be eaten by worms like the rest.  We will feed your body to pigs, and no one will remember your name!
let me see what you'll do without the dagger, i'll the guards skin you alive while your families watch

I'd like to see you try, shackled to the wall as you are!  You know, it's precisely this attitude of yours why no one is even trying to rescue you.  Your son declared it was pointless to search for you less than a day after your kidnapping!  Admittedly he was the one who paid us, after all.

I've always known he was the one responsible for all these, i just wanted to get to the people helping him. The guards are already on thier way here, spare me and i might consider sparing your families

I don't think they will make it in time . . . the Kingsguard aren't even looking in the right continent!  Gaze into my eyes, for they will be the last sight you ever see.  Then I will work on your tongue.
You are gonna get me that easy, and trust me they know I'm here
The last words of a fool?  A fool and life, and a fool in death.  Thus the chronicles will record "There died the the fool, wallowing in his own filth, without tongue, eyes, hands, or feet"
I'll remember that when the undertakers need something to be written on your cursed graved
Here, let me bind this around your head - it will muffle your painful screams.
That would only deny me the pleasure of watching die at the swords of my soldiers

agent_personas: I am the groundskeeper that lives in the small hut on the castle’s grounds. I spend my days roaming the grounds of the castle looking for parts of the castle that need repaired. Sometimes I need to maintain the moat.
I don't love my husband. I've been cheating on him with the stableboy. I would do it again, too.

setting.name: Bedroom
setting.description: Cozy and snug, the bedroom contains little more than a wooden bed covered in a worn quilt, a small dresser with two drawers to hold clothes, a lamp on top of the dresser, and a woven blue rug.
setting.background: The bedroom belongs to the groundskeeper of the castle and his wife. The old man has spent his entire life tending to the castle, and the bedroom is the place where he goes at night to rest after a long day of working.

speech: Oh wife, today was a hard day.
I am not your wife. Not until you help me get rid of my husband as you promised.
Oh Susan, let's not speak about that tonight. Can't we just forget her for a while?
How can we forget? My husband will return in the morning and he knows I've been most unfaithful. We must plan his demise and see it through tomorrow or all is lost!
Fine, fine. I'm only a groundskeeper though, not a hired hand. How do you expect me to kill someone?!
We will use the poison I got from the witch , as we planned you fool.
That dirty witch, I don't trust the ole hag. I bet that's just water spiced with turmeric!
It's not a matter of trust. She always delivers what is promised...for a price. A price which I gladly paid. Now, are you going to help me or not?
Can't we just cuddle up and let this be for the night. It's just too much after all of the wall repairs I've done today. I'm absolutely wrecked dear! I promise we shall finalize our plan this Sunday.
You idiot, there is no time for cuddling! Help me or you'll die too!
Every night with this for two weeks, you're beginning to make me long for solitude my sweet. Now, I've got to wrangle a shark out of the moat tomorrow. I'm going to bed and that's that!
If you walk out that door, we will both be dead within hours of my husband's return. Are you too stupid to grasp this?
I told you yesterday! THE KING HAS SENT HIM TO BATTLE. We have time you anxious woman.
Fine, fine. Come here and let me sooth your aching muscles my sweet.
action: give worn quilt to his wife
