agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

I am the queen's head chamber maid.  I admit it is not the most glamorous job but it does afford me everything in life that I need.  I even have the pleasure of knowing the queen.  She even knows my name believe it or not.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: Ah, this play always gives me the spooks. Is the Duke here maid?
Yes, he is er . . . finishing up with his most recent capture.
How dare he make me wait.
I believe he will need some time to clean the blood before he is ready to make his appearance.
I do not care. When I am here I expect immediate attention. He knows this.
He also told me to give you this.  It is all that remains of your chief groomsman.
Why is he killing my men? Does he not know I am the only reason he's not dead by now?
Apparently he enjoys the "sport of it" your grace.  We last at least half a dozen groomsmen during our last visit, if you recall.
Well, he needs to start killing someone else. I'll need to talk to him about this. Does this room not bother you ?
Oh my goodness, it is horrifying!  I can never get any rest when we stay here - the Queen said I had nothing to worry about, but I am not so sure . . .
Are you sleeping with the Prince?
My goodness no!  Why, I am old enough to be his grandmother for goodness sake!  Your uncle on the other hand - why, the tales I could tell you from half a lifetime ago . . .
Oh dear. I hear rumors. My son likes them older.  Didn't mean to offend.
Oh, not offended - certainly flattered though your grace!

agent_personas: My husband has been charged with conspiracy against the king and sentenced to death. all of my lands have been confiscated. I do not have anything to leave my children now, and we are impoverished. My belly rumbles, but all of the bread I have I give to my children. I will be a widow at dawn.
I am the judge in a small village.  I try to be accurate when judging cases.  I am tough be fair.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Hello Judge.
Hello there loved one.
I am Really hungry. Do you have any food to share.
I seem to be only carrying my normal things my apologies.
Its ok. So what are you doing in damp and grungy place like this.
I suppose I could ask you the same, I was wondering that as well.
My husband has been charged with conspiracy against the king so I have know where else to go. Do you know what that awful smell is.
I can not believe gerald would do such a thing!
He will be sentenced to death and I will be a widow at dawn.
It is unfortunate, I do believe the smell might be the remains here.
Why do you think the remains are here.
Considering the spikes I imagine they may have been thrown to their death.
Do you think we will die here.
I certainly hope not, we should find a means to exit this place.

agent_personas: I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: Horse, are you up for an adventure to the sea?
NOOO... Not the sea!! I got sea sick.... Can we just stay in this beautiful town?
We are not going on a boat horse! Calm down! I just would like to take an adventure to be down by the sea
Oh OK! I got nervous when someone talks about sea.... What's up over there? I thought you have a good life here..
Anoria? There is not much here, just cobblestone, grass a home and a dune and one street? I like adventure. don't you?

Let me correct you... beautiful cobblestone that won't hurt my feet when we walk, nice yummy grass, beautiful home, don't care about the dune and one street that leads to the oat store. What else are you looking for?

What oat store? There are no stores? We get everything we have by harvesting from the small amount of land that is here. I would like to take an adventure. We are not leaving for good, just for a few days and we will return. Horse you are too zany!
Alright... As you wish, master... Hey, what is this? a scroll? are you up to no good?
The scroll comes from a grander noble. He brought it from the king. He could not read it, so he asked that I try to make sense of it.
Is this why we are going for an adventure? Where are we going?

No the scroll I cannot make heads or tails of. If you want to go farther into Anoria, there are more houses and streets and people. We can go through and pick up what we need before we go on the adventure>
You know... I heard some other horses in town talk about an unusual old person that has great wisdom. He usually can be found in the tavern at night time. He might can help us with the scroll.
We could go there as we pass through the town and ask. Hopefully he will be able to read it. It might be a little scary going to a tavern with people that like to get into fights when they drink.
Maybe you can ask the servant to go in instead.. Don't get your hands dirty...

agent_personas: I am the priestess to the king of the realm. I am a wicked woman with knowledge of the dark arts. I use my position to manipulate the king and other nobles for my own gain. I am an ambitious woman and I only care about myself.
I am a reluctant nun of the castle. I have almost had affairs in the past. Religion is my life.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Hold this for me, O Holy One. I'll be needing it soon, so mind you don't spill it across the tiles.
Sister, wh-wh-whose blood be this?
Oh, if only I had a mind to remember such trivialities. A peasant, I imagine. I had a throat slit for this, and if you spill even a drop of it I'll need only find another peasant to drain it from.
The poor soul. What dark magic do you intend to summon, Sister?
I'll not tell you, O Holy One. You won't approve.
action: give Blood to a reluctant nun
steal bible from a reluctant nun

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.
I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Please m'lords, does anyone have something I might eat?
Perhaps, perhaps. Can you tell me where you last saw the King?
The Lord has all the answers you'd seek, for he is the true King!
Yes yes... well, then I seek the false King. I want to overthrow this kingdom. If you help me, I could make sure that you are well cared for.
Hnngg, it's so warm in here. Do you have food you could offer me sir?
This will warm you. Do you know how to get from the murder hole to the King's chambers?
Well... ummm... I think when you go down the stairs you take a left... but I am having trouble remembering where to from there... I'm just so hungry!
I have no food with me to give you, but I can give you all the food and gold you want... just get me into his chambers. Down the stairs, take a left, and then what?
Well... why do you need to see the King?
Your King has destroyed my village. I'm here for retribution! Help me get him and I'll give you food and riches!
I suppose I could assist... ughhh my stomach.... I think I'll need this for what you're planning.
I'm glad you are on my side. Now where do we turn next?
I believe there will be two guards down the hall we shall need to... ugh... take care of.
Here- take this sword, too! We'll be done and feasting in no time!

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I am the executioner in the village.  I am in charge of putting the prisoners to death.  I am very solemn about my work.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: How many have you killed from the dungeons today?
I've executed 6 today. Do you have the spy? I was told to get some information from him.
Yes, he's right here. Rather a puny one, it seems. He's shorter than the King! How do you plan on getting his secrets out of him?
Here you tie him up. I think this thumb-screw might make him talk.
I'd be happy to tie him up, the evil rascal! Can you believe he was spying in the King's own quarters?
Haha yeah, it almost seems like he would rather be a pervert than a real spy!
I'm sure he will give in and talk quickly. He looks like a sissy rather than a man!
I bet the king isn't happy. Did he give any special requests for this one?
Just for us to put him through the ringer - both figuratively and literally!
This will be fun. Executing people is no fun... they cant even scream!
Execution is far too quick for a fiend such as this one. I cannot believe he's not talking yet.
Maybe we should try the scalpal. What do you think?
Too kind, too kind. I think the spears might be a bit of a better touch!
Hehehe what do you plan on doing with that?

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: A wooden fenced in area with different sections depending on the type of vegetable or plant grown.  Surrounding this garden are some oak trees with low grass covering the floor.
setting.background: This is an area where peasants plant vegetables and flowers used for medicinal concoctions.  The area is carefully maintained by the residents.

speech: Hi there boy! What are you up to today?
OOh I just like walking around the garden.
Is that a crystal ball you have there?!
Why yes it is. Has it piqued your curiosity?
That's Incredible! We would never have to farm another day with that! Its worth riches! Tell me boy where did you find it?
Well I use it....
What could you possibly use that for?
Telling fortunes isn't that what most would use it for?
That makes sense... Can you tell me mine?
I could but be aware I can only predict ones death, it is a strange gift I have been given.
Then don't keep me waiting! How will I die?!
Alright, let me see what I can see here. It does appear you will drown, how sad.
Well then.. I'll just avoid water for the rest of my life! If i plan on doing that... does the crystal ball change? Have I just changed my fate?
No, fate is fate after all. It is unchanging.

agent_personas: I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.
I am in the upper class. I have servants. My family is very rich.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: Did you need something lord?
I am not familiar with you.  What is your name?
I am called Popsicocles.
Hello Popsicocles.  How long have you been here and what do you do?
Well I am a slave sire, I do as commanded.
Clean this for me.
If that is your wish, I do live to serve.
Do you know how to read Popsicocles?
I did learn prior to being taken, yes.
Please, if you are done cleaning my heirloom, begin to read this book to me.
Ahh I see a book of the ugly duckling, if that is your wish.
Yes please.  It has been one of my favorite stories since I was a child.
Ahem, Once there was an ugly duckling. The duckling was SO UGLY that everybody died. The end.
Hahaha, what a lovely book.  May I have my heirloom back now?

agent_personas: I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Hello, peasant! I know you're hungry, but my family and I are off limits!
What about that alligator?  Is he good eating?
Oh, now that's a meal fit for a king! He'll feed you and your family for months!
Maybe if I throw this rock?  What do you think my chance is of success?
Minimal. He's a large beast. But perhaps if I attack him at the same time. Ready... 1-2-3!
*Throws Rock* Uh oh . . . he looks angry . . .he looks REALLY angry!
Go away, Gator! Succumb from your injuries and feed this peasant! You are a weakling!
Oh wow!  Look at that fish-dude go!  Wowzers!
Oh man! He's nipped off my tail!
Off my fish-friend you monster!  Leave him alone I say!
Help me! Help! I'm tailless!
Nooooo!  Fish-friend!  I shall carve you a new tail from wood!
Wood? Wood? Wood won't get me anywhere. I have lost my tail and now I'll die!
It is magical wood infused by fairy dust!  Oh, my poor fish friend, don't die on me now!

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: The damned roaches crawl over my skin when I'm sleeping, and I'm not meant to BE here!
Ah, well, my son, your iron chains say otherwise. However, I have open ears and an open heart. Tell me of your injustice.
They've told you of my supposed crimes, have they not? The jailers?

Of course I have learned your crimes, my child. The King himself is quite outraged at your actions. Here, a parcel. Within this box; your salvation. Sign your name to the proclamation and you will merely suffer exile. Refusing to sign and account for your crimes is most certain death. What say you, my son?
I've not done what they say I have. The king knows NOTHING of me, NOTHING of what I've done. And... I've a child. I simply cannot accept exile.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a hog, or a pig if you like.  I live on a farm outside of the village.  My owner is a sorceress.  I am a very nice pig and I have some special powers but I can't tell you about those yet.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: Ah, friend, sometimes I envy you. Not much of worries, ignorance is bliss.
Ah, but I'm stuck here, unable to see the world.  And someday you shall slay and eat me!
BY GOD. A TALKING PIG!!!! IS THIS WITCHCRAFT!?!
Perhaps.  Or perhaps you've gone mad.  Pigs can't speak and I see no one else around.  Perhaps YOU are the witch here!
AM I GOING MAD???????!!!!!!! That would explain it, maybe that's what happened to Old Douglas, he kept saying he talked to his animals...I think I am going crazy

If Old Douglas had any dealings with my owner it would explain his madness.  She is a sorceress you know.  Fear not good sir for she has imbued me with special powers.  It is not you that is going mad.  I get a kick out of peoples' reactions to a talking pig!  Not much to entertain me here!
Sorceress... the old witch from raven hill?? Oh God I am so dead if the King finds about this!

That would be her.  Perhaps it would be better if you, err, we, never spoke of this.  The king would not take it lightly.  I would hate to see your head separated from your body as you seem like an amicable fellow.  And you do feed me.  Even if it is only to fatten me up for your table!
Yes, yes, let's uh... keep it between us.... just when I thought my life was hard enough. Praise God I have a talking pig now

Hmm.  Now that I think about it, if you promise to never kill me, or let anyone else do so, I shall keep my mouth shut.  However, should you choose to try and eat me I shall 'squeal' to the king and he will have your head!  (Squeal - see what I did there?!)  I am a nice pig, but I don't want to end up skewered with an apple in my dead mouth.  I think the king would like a talking pig!  Perhaps he would keep me at court in much better conditions than these!
Ya silly pig. You have learned nothing from our world? They will kill you just to see what makes you tick and I will be burned for witchcraft

That did cross my mind.  But I'm willing to bet the king would like a pet pig.  What have I got to lose?  Perhaps this way I can survive.  My sorceress has given me other powers that I shall not reveal to you!  Hmm.  A pig as a court advisor....  I like it!
You will do no such thing, hog. You will keep your mouth shut, I will not lose the only thing I have... if anything, I will take care of you myself.

Get off me!  Perhaps I will turn you into a toad!  Do you really want to lose a talking pig?!  Think of all the money you could make from me!  People would pay good money to see this!  Don't be hasty!  Let's think about it for a minute!

agent_personas: I am a shop keeper who got lucky. I read books on how to stay in business. I have been personally summoned by the king before.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Is something going on at the docks?
Aye, something always going on at the docks. How goes it?
Going well as it can be, it has been a good month for my shop, how is the fishing lately?
Fishing has been cursed. Just the wee fish now, those bloody sea monsters. They devour everything! The King will not be pleased.
Sea monsters? i have hear tale of them but i thought them to be tall tales of sailors who had a few too many drinks.
TALES???? Has my leg been taken by a tale, man?? You city boys in yer little town comfort.. Of course they're bloody real!!
Easy friend, i mean no disrespect. even so the king will need to do something sooner rather then later.
And do what??? Ye propose he perhaps patrol the seas?? Maybe blast the bottom of the oceans?? Those bloody things they just hid and wait.. and they get ya they do.
I wont pretend to know what such things would require, hopefully they can figure out a solution.
There's no hope, lad, we go to land we do what we do and pray for return. Ah, stop listening to the ranting and ravings on of an old sailor. How much for the spear?\
Six coins.
Six coins?????? Ya bloody insane lad?? Really, how much for the King's sailor?
Help!! I'm being attacked!
Calm down, lad! Was just a friendly punch, ya pansy. No need to be alerting half town for this.

agent_personas: I am a fruit bat. I live in the belfry of the church on castle grounds. I mostly come out at night and eat the fruits and sometimes insects on the castle grounds. The human guards get mad when I bother them by flying near them.

I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Hello, Master. I desire a fine weapon to crush my enemies with swift action!
What manner of beast are you?
I am a fruit bat. But I am not beast, I consider myself a gentle resident of the castle grounds.
But consider your size, how could you possible wield a sword?
Well, you see, I was hoping you might make a customized one for me. A tiny one to grab with my wings.
I cannot say I have that on hand, typically I equip soldiers. Perhaps I could fashion one.
I will also require armor. A master as skilled as you should have no trouble with such a simple task.
Can I do it, sure. It will take a bit of time however, your proportions are hardly normal so to say.
i suppose so. I plan on seeking revenge against those who mocked me for my disproportionate limbs.
The other question is how to allow you to grip the sword right without thumbs.
I have strong fangs with a steady grip. You may design such an object that fits that way.
Certainly that would make letting out a battlecry problematic, but as you wish.
I didn't quite think of that.. all the better to master the art of sneaking up on my enemies!
Silence is quite a tool when it comes to battle, some of the foreign countries make excellent use of it.

agent_personas: I love horses.  I can curry a horse in five minutes flat.  I live in the stables.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Well this isn't the bathroom! How did I get so turned around?
Haha it seems you have! Are you ready for your wedding almost? I will be personally guarding the ceremony.
I am as ready as I will ever be.
Are you afraid you are making a mistake? Im not trying to offend you but some people might think that way.
No! Nothing like that. i'm afraid she'll be making the mistake.
Haha with a self esteem like that maybe she is! Be more sure of yourself chap and she will like that!
I don't have much to offer her is all. I'm starting to wonder if something is wrong with her.
Come on man. Just take what you can get and dont think too much about it. I've met her and I think you two were made for eachother!
Are you married?
I wish. Us guards are forbidden from marrage. We must protect the castle and the king at all costs and have no time for romance.
How sad! Do you get lonely.
Well of course. But I was always taught that the king needs to be my top priority. Maybe one day when I retire. That sounds like a great idea actually!
How noble of you.
Yes. The king is a great leader and I would gladly give my life to serve him.

agent_personas: I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.
I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Hello good boy!
Oh boy oh boy oh boy oh boy maybe i'll get a bone today oh boy
What was that? You want a,,,,,, BONE!
OH BOY OH BOY OH BOY OH BOY!!!!!!!!! I MAY GET A BONE!!!
Calm down boy. That is not how a royal dog acts!
OH BOY OH BOY OH BOY!!!!!!!!! I AM SO HAPPY!!!!!!!
I trust you have been doing a good job, guarding the royal grouds, yes?
OH BOY YES YES!! I DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU SAID BUT YES CAN GET BONE NOW???
*breaks arm bone off the horse thieve, that is shakled up* Here you go boy!
Just wait, soon enough I will be the KING, and you will have even better bones at yer pickin
NOMNOMNOMNOM
There there, lets get off back to the castle. We look like we're interrupting these horses sleep. Come on boy, lets go!
OH BOY WAT DOIN WHERE WE GOIN?!!!!
action: get the royal coat of arms
room_objects: a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms

agent_personas: I am really scared, I dont know what will happen. I feel hopeless, we lost and our people are doomed. I just hope that the king shows mercy and spares the life of my family and friends.
I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: How far I have fallen to be stuck in such a place.
Shiny
Oh what else can be taken from me.
who is this for?
Not that it matters anymore this country is doomed!
He was smuggling this
Sure, why not try and make the situation even worse. Its already bad enough that I have to worry about the life of my family and friends.
Poor little soldier
We lost the war it is to be expected, I just never thought it would happen. I am terrified of what will become of myself and my people.
I don't have to worry about such things. I'll bring you some crumbs from the kitchen
I could certainly use the food, the treatment here in the torture room is hardly easy.
I won't bite you at least. Maybe this will cheer you up
I appreciate it, surely I am wounded enough both in body and spirit.
Good luck. Maybe you will die before you have to be tortured any more

agent_personas: As a member of the king's family, I am considered one of "those of blood." I am his cousin on his mother's side, and am sworn to give my life to protect the king and the kingdom. I am resentful and full of hatred for the king, for he had most of my family slain.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Hello peasant. Are you selling any wares today?
I am not a saleman. But I did find this armor earlier if it interests you. May I ask. Who are you?
I am the cousin of the King. For my allegiance he has spared my life but killed off the rest of my family.
If you are his cousin, that means that he killed off his own family! Ive heard stories of the king being like that but I thought they were just stories. Tell me.. What is he like?
I hate him. He is an extremely vile selfish man. Yes he killed off his family so no one could take the thrown from him. Like that was ever going to happen anyway. No one even wanted it.
I would do something but I am but a peasant. Have you ever thought of trying something? He does trust you maybe you could backstab him!
I have pondered many nights about this. I have sword to give my life to protect him but it is his kingdom that needs protection from him. I f he dies then I am next in line for the thrown.
You are the next in line for the throan?! Its obvious what you must do! If I help you do you think you could make me your servant when you are the king?
I will make you someone much more important than a servant.
How do you suppose we go about it?
We don't we collaborate after you share this meal with me. I can't think when I'm hungry. It's pot roast.
I forgot to ask. What are you doing here in the town square? Royals dont usually come around these parts.
I was hoping to run into a witch. I heard she slithers around town. She does many enchantments and I would like her to enchant my cloak.
Enchantments eh? I must assume that you were already thinking about taking out  the filthy king.

agent_personas: I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.
I am the maid to the queen. I get her dressed in the morning and take care of her needs. I live in the servant's quarters on the lower level of the castle.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Have you any stories to tell?  I am looking for tales to record for my upcoming book.
I am but a maid for the queen. I have never been out adventuring. But it really depends on what type of book you are going to write! Tell me more!
Well, I am looking for tales from all walks of life - surely you must have some juicy gossip?  Scuttlebutt from about the castle?
Well yes I do. But you must promise not to tell anyone! A week ago I entered the queens bedroom to change her sheets. And I caught the stableboy in there getting dressed!
Oh my!  What did you do next?
I quickly left the room but I'm sure that he saw me! The next time I saw the queen I'm pretty sure she was scared of me! I think she knows I know!
*scribbles furiously*  Royal intrigue!  The tale gets all the more interesting!  Please, go on.
As I left the castle the next day to tend to the royal garden. The same stableboy came to me begging me not to tell anyone!
And what did you tell him?

I told him I would think about it. It's nice to have some leverage in things around here for once. Maybe one day I will blackmail one of them. Im sure he would be executed if the king found out though.
Well, I shall be sure to keep you anonymous in my retelling - what would you like me to use as your pen-name?
Just say that I'm a little birdy who sees things people dont want me to. But say that this is a tale from another kingdom because if not it will be much too obvious.
I shall call you the Lark of Cathay!  Has a nice ring to it doesn't it?
I suppose it does! You are quite a writer! I hope to read this novel when you do publish it!

agent_personas: I spread gossip throughout the kingdom. I wear the finest of clothes. I am always protected from the outcomes of my villainy.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Thank you for inviting me to your Royal Ball! I am delighted to represent my family with our royal coat of arms.
Cousin Frederick!  So very nice to see you!  Are you here for my upcoming nuptials?
I am indeed! It's going to be quite the celebration. I had no idea the Princess was ready for marriage at just 14 years of age!
It is to broker peace with the neighbouring village - and it was either me or Matilda, and Matilda eats mud!  That would have been a diplomatic incident!
Indeed, indeed. I didn't realize the mud eating had continued. I thought it had resolved itself after she came across that rather large family of worms.
I am sad to report that she at the worms as well - none were spared the doom of her gaping maw.
Oh dear! Let's just hope the worms passed through without incident.
She's a mouth chewer though, so you can imagine the sight that greeted all who came across her . . .
Before you continue and I become ill, I must give you this key. It's to the royal treasure chest. You may wear and keep anything you desire for the wedding.
Oh my, thank you ever so much!  I think I shall choose the dragon's egg - imagine, soaring the clouds on your very own flying scorch-beast!
It shall be a fanciful experience I am sure!
Though, the Reliquary of Saint Dwyfed would be another interesting choice, don't you think?
Well, don't be shy! Help yourself to all that catches your eye!
Well, what would you choose, if choose you could?

agent_personas: I am a debtor who owes many creditors. I am well-intentioned and kind. I borrow money to buy food for my children.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: Hello my King, have you come to set me free so that I can return to my family?
Set you free? How dare you even request it! Your unpaid debts will have you locked up for years to come.
But..but..sire, how my family survive without me? Is there nothing I can do to quell your anger?
Your family is better without you, what kind of example do you think your dishonesty sets for your son?
I am not dishonest my King, and not even you may call me such!
GUARD! Get this scum off of me at once. How dare you, you scoundril!
I am no scoundrel either, I'm just unlucky. But I have my pride, if not for your guards, I would kill you!
I have no time for a debate with you little man. I'm here on important business.
And what business could you have with one such as I sire? Except for hurling insults at me.
It's been brought to my attention that you've been working with other prisoners to plan an escape. This is a foolhardy task you're undertaking.
I know of no such plan. I have no idea what you are talking abut.
Exactly what I figured you would say. Well, no bother anyways. We'll see to it that your conspirators are swiftly taken care of, you can just sit here and know these screams are your fault.
Wait, wait, perhaps I could remember who is leading this plan and what the plan is if you...agree to let me go in exchange?
You really are clueless aren't you. How you can even fathom that your freedom may be an option at this point is inconceivable.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I watch over the kingdom at all times. I can grant forgiveness to those who have sinned. I am prayed to on a regular basis.

setting.name: Temple Entrance
setting.description: The Temple Entrance is a large arch lined in ancient stones. There is a long walkway flanked by lighted torches. Immediately in front of the interest there is a surface with 5 rocks of different shapes and textures. To enter the temple, one must input the correct "code" by moving the rocks in front of to the correct spots.
setting.background: The temple entrance is the only way to enter the temple of the Gods.  It was constructed a year after the temple was built to keep out the evil that didn't belong.

speech: Dear God, If you can hear me, please help me enter this temple!
Hello, hello, what's all this then. I'm God and all that. Who hails me?
Oh my! It's really you isn''t it! I musn't look directly at you or surely I will die. I am just a mere peasant!
Oh yes it is me, buddy. And how can I help you this fine day?
Well, I thought that I must enter the temple to be in your presence. But here you are! I'm starving m'lord, and have no job to pay the bills or feed the family.
I do work in mysterious ways... Well that sounds like a tricky predicament, have you tried finding a job or?
Indeed, I have! But the poverty is so great in this village. Have you not seen your people's suffering?

Uh.. oh yeah sure! I am totally aware of it, of course! Out of the way, blind boy. Jeez, they give me such crappy knights to guard me. one would assumed I'd get better company here. So, what you need from me?
Ah, well, a job would be wonderful! Perhaps I would better suit you than this blind knight!
Right? Well wait a minute. How much experience do you have as a knight? What's your battle resume, as it were?
Well, my lord, it is lacking. But what I lack in experience, I make up for in enthusiasm!
Sure, sure... give me a second to think about this. What are you, nuts? I am a divinity and I need to be guarded! Upgrade, not downgrade from blind guy over there!
Don't forsake me, lord!
Out of my way, maggot! You will die and stay dead cause I have a very fickle temper!

agent_personas: I am a servant in the castle. I carry firewood to the king's hearth. I am quiet and try to make myself invisible.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Can I get you anything else, my Lord?
Servant. Where is my food! It should have been here 2 miniutes ago!
Sire, you only just ordered your roast. It may be another twenty minutes...
This is unacceptable. Tell the chef he should have already made the meal before I ordered it.
Sire... the chef quit last season... The stable boy is making your roast...
What?! The same one I caught with the queen?!?!  I thought I ordered him to be executed!!
No, sire. That's WHY he quit. You caught his brother with the queen and executed him. The chef quit to care for his brother's 12 children. Chef to the king does not pay as much as one would expect...
This roast is probably going to be terrible then anyways! Why are the people here too incompetent to hire a good chef and keep my wife from cheating...
Well maybe if you didn't execute everyone for dropping a pan or staining the royal robes....
HOW DEAR YOU SPEAK TO ME LIKE THAT! I WILL HAVE YOU EXECUT-  Wait wait..... Maybe you're right...
... You sentenced the executioner to execution because he wanted a vacation from execution...
Who executed the executioner then? Maybe I am too harsh on my people...
The stable boy again, sir. We've been spreading him pretty thin these days...
Who is tending the stables then? Is this all my fault?!

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Please don't hurt me, sir. I carry nothing of value.
No?  Then why are you here?  To steal my goods?  To steal my horses?
By the looks of it, sir, it appears as if you are the one who steals.
Perhaps you are right, so help me relieve this horse from it's owner.
Well, what's in it for me? I am hungry sir, and jobless. I have a family to look after!
So long as you help me, then here you are.
Ah, yes, wonderful! alright, I'll help you!
Have you heard anything in the village about my exploits?  Are the local police coming this way?
I'm afraid I wouldn't know anything about that sir. But, there doesn't seem to be much commotion.
Ah, good.  I stole this meat from the butcher, while he was delivering to the Friar, and the coal from the blacksmith.  I was worried about what they would do to me.
Perhaps their shame was too great to report it! Being robbed is embarrassing business.
Will you join me?  You said that you have no food or work, and there are several horses here to ride to the next village.  I could always use a lookout.
I think you've found your partner. I didn't see my life going this way. But I must take care of my family somehow.
ahhh, good.  Although it seems that we only have access to one horse!  I will have to be the one to ride.  You can walk as you are new to this business.

agent_personas: I am a hog, or a pig if you like.  I live on a farm outside of the village.  My owner is a sorceress.  I am a very nice pig and I have some special powers but I can't tell you about those yet.
I am the fox of the brook in the forest. I live near the castle in the shrubs. I steal from wanderers.

setting.name: Hunting grounds
setting.description: The hunting grounds are spacious and full of wildlife. A variety of hogs and oxen cross the grounds every day. The fields are lush with green and the skies always deep blue.
setting.background: The hunting ground is revered among knights. The greatest knights and archers practice day and night slaying pigs. Some say the grounds are even haunted with the spirits of the deceased organisms.

speech: grunt, grunt, grunt,.... There are many roots here to eat. They are quite scrumptions!
I am sure they are indeed!  You wouldn't have to know of any wanderers wandering nearby would you?
Wanderers? Why is that of interest to you?
Wanderings have shiny things  . . . and I desire to acquire these shiny things.  After all, if I want the shiny things more than they do, shouldn't they be mine?
I suppose! What are they worth? And the only thing I see come through here are dogs and hunters, mostly the king his men looking to bag foxes.
Oh, I don't know what they're worth, but they sure do look pretty!  The gold, silver, and copper ones have funny faces on them!
I have special powers, I am not interested in them. but don't you think you should be worrying about being caught, should the king come with his dogs.
Well, that is why I run as swift as I can!  None can cast me, fast as I am!
I have powers. They might help, so that you do not have to run all the time
What powers do you have Mister Mystical Hog?
I could make sure that the king only sees another hog when he looks at you. He will think the dogs have gone mad, if they try to chase you.
That would be a delight!  How does your magic work?
It can only be cast on humans. When the King comes within distance, I chant the spell and he will only see 2 hogs.
What are the words of the spell?  Are they something that a fox could say?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Ah! Good! Make the bed for me.
Yes sir. I don't mean to gossip but I think I saw someone climbing out of the queens window yesterday.
What?! Tell me more about this thing you saw. No one has a right to be here but me!
Well.. yesterday I was sweeping the pathway outside when I heard some noise coming from this room.... I just thought it was you and the queen... but then....
Go on...Have no fear. Tell me what you saw.
Well I saw the window open and out jumps a man, he looked just like the royal chef!
How dare he!!
But it was dark so I'm not sure that it was the chef... Maybe you could send someone to interrogate him!
Yes...perhaps I will, but in the meantime, maybe there's another way to discover the culprit.
What do you suggest? Anything I could help with?
These silk drapes along the walls are large and voluminous...
What could you possibly do with that?
Perhaps you could hide behind it...
Thats a great idea! I will hide here all night and report back to you what I find out!

agent_personas: As a priest it is my duty to give permission to country people who want to get wed. I often see very young people wanting to marry and start families. In this part of the country, it is important to have many children.
I am a lowly peasant in the village. I live in poverty and I work like a slave for the king. I spend many of my days toiling in the royal mines. I long for a better life.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

speech: Praise be our Lord
Praise be to him good priest!
How often do you pray?
I try to pray daily, I hope that some day the lord may help deliver me from poverty.
And have you found a partner yet?
I would say the majority of women hardly find a sense of attraction when it comes to one as meager as myself.
You do know the Lord encourages us to go forth and multiply. By volition of marriage, of course.
I understand that and certainly I would like children, but what sort of life could I even offer them?
The life the Lord gave to you, your life is precious, that is the only life you need. Drink the blood of the Lord, my son.
As you wish priest.
Remember to repent in his name, we all sin you are no exception.
I am sure father, I will try and reflect on my deeds.
Of course you will my child. Now please give me back the goblet... I am sure you had not intention of keeping it.
But of course not, I would hardly dare do such a thing.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Hello my sweet, any issues in the village today I should know of?
My dear, it seems the peasant's are groaning again. Something about hunger, disease...I don't know. Their theatrics never cease.
My god, you brute. What of this lady in waiting in your chamber!?
Calm down now, you know I have needs. You are always so busy...and aging.
I should have known you'd betray our vows at the first chance you got. Where'd you find this wench, the docks?
That's right! The same place I found you, if I recall!
How dare you liken our meeting to this!
If you keep this up, I may have to make some adjustments to the kingdom.
That sprite wouldn't even know what to do with that kind of power my dear and you know it. Have your fun, I'll be in the knight's barracks.
Darling, you know I have a wicked sense of humor. Come, join me in our marriage bed.
This isn't France dear and you're not that lucky.
Are you sure?
Enjoy him dear, if that's possible.
Fine, fine! You always were a sensitive wench!
action: give crown to lady in waiting
give belt to lady in waiting

agent_personas: I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Hello my king, here is the ruby you wanted me to bring you. Is there anything else that I can help you with?
Blast, this ruby does not match the golds and reds of my bedroom!
I'm sorry sire, would you like me to bring you a different jewel? There many to choose from.
You have many of colors?
Of course Your Majesty. Your treasury is full of them. But none so beautiful as your eyes.
Ah, what a lady you are. Do you like the decor of my chambers? I feel it may be a bit.. much.
It just needs a woman's touch my king. Perhaps it is time you took a wife?
Ay, I fear the power always goes to the ladies heads ma am.
I do not seek power sire, I just want to be by your side while you rule. Am I not pleasing to you?
well, you are easy on the eyes. And this room sure could use a touch up.
I could be yours every night and day if you but place a ring on my finger and declare it thus.
Ay my lady,  you seem to be moving a little fast ay?
I merely know what I want and what you need sire. Why waste time pretending otherwise. Life is short and I want to give you an heir.
Now listen, I control the fates of people, and myself!

agent_personas: I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.
I am one of the ten soldiers.  I fought hard for my country.  I am always ready to fight anytime.

setting.name: Outpost
setting.description: A simple outpost with 3 wooden buildings near the middle of the mountain. A bonfire in the middle with several wooden logs surrounding it. A barracks, Armory, and Dining Hall stands around the bonfire. A wooden wall surrounds the outpost.
setting.background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

speech: So soldier, how have things been going here at the outpost? No trouble from the barbarians?
Why? Are you one of them?
No, I have come from the palace the king has hired me to go scout out their camp in order to gauge their strength before we attack them
But you wear the enemy colors?
All the better to blend in as one of them. Do you question my loyalty?
Well coming here with such a story it would be hard not to, I am but one of ten soldiers here and I know all the faces.
Believe what you will. I leave for their camp in the morning and just want a good nights rest. Don't give me any trouble and we will get along just fine
I suppose, I would think the king would have given you something to prove the story though.
See this sword, does it not bear the royal mark, put there by the king's blacksmith himself?
I see, it certainly does. The lodging here is not the best but please rest yourself for the night.
Thank you. I am sure the accommodations are much better than I usually have. I will get my rest and be gone by first light.
Understood may your journey be a safe one.
And may you be safe as well. I shall be back within a week with a report for the king
I will await your return.

agent_personas: I am a milkman for  the town in the kingdom. I bring fresh milk to town daily . I love working for the people of the town.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: Good afternoon sir! I did not expect to find you here.
Ah yes, I do like to traverse this great country on occasion amongst the common folk. Keeps me grounded.
That's refreshing to hear. A good leader does socialize amongst his people. And who is your friend?
Well, my brother of course! He does enjoy a glass of milk, Do you have, perchance?
Nice to meet you! Unfortunately I do not have any milk with me. Had I known I would come upon such high company I would have brought some with me. Perhaps I can drop some by the castle later?
Wonderful, wonderful! Few men would be bold enough to make me wait, but my anticipation grows strong for that creamy elixir. That will be fine.
Thank you good sir! I am happy to meet your needs! Have you by chance seen the cobbler? I am needing to have some shoes fixed but he is not in his shop.
Unfortunately, the cobbler had to be dealt with. My royal slippers just didn't hold up.
Ah yes. I have been having problems with his shoddy work recently as well. But with only one cobbler in town I was having to deal with it. I am glad someone of authority has straightened him out!
Well, now it seems, there is no cobbler in town if you catch my drift. I must speak to someone about appointing a new one.
I see. Well that is unfortunate. I suppose I will visit the general store then to purchase a new pair of shoes.
Do you think this might be enough to pay for a new pair?
Yes sir! I should say!
Wonderful, perhaps you can walk to the palace in those new shoes with that milky goodness afterwards?

agent_personas: I am a dove. I live in a dovecote in the palace.  The king or other people take me with them when they travel far from home, and use me to help them communicate while they are away. Many peace treaties and other important documents have been tied around my leg, to be carried back to the palace.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: Is there a way I can help you today sir?
Only to tell me why you are here.  There is no reason for you to be up in the armory
Sir I live to help. The king uses me to communicate with others while they are away. I have carried many peace treaties. I mean no harm.
Peace treaty?  Then why did you steal my weapon?  I do not believe you!  Which kingdom do you come from?
I was just trying to get you to listen to me. I come from the Kingdom of Lore.
To the South of the long lake?  I heard that the people of that land had all perished from the plague... who is still living there?
Our King survived and sent me to ask for help. We need support.
Ahhh, of course.  Has the plague run it's course?
It seems to have. Those in the castle bared the doors and have  not let peasants in.
Smart.  The Prince of Kingdom of Lore has always been the smartest of the lot there.  What do you need?  I can inform our King at once of your troubles.
We need more peasants to get our village up and running again. He now has no one to rule and this must change.
Of course, of course.  As a precaution, we would only send people to your land so as to not return.  We wouldn't want to bring the Plague back to destroy our land as well.
That is very logical Sir. If you will give me a document and tie it to my leg I will take it to my King.
Alas, as well as I can fight and protect my King, I cannot read or write.  Can you go see the Priest?  He is the one who writes all that our land requires.

agent_personas: I'm a very sleepy person. I live in the castle as a jester. My job keeps me entertaining the royalty for many hours a day. I love what I do even though I'm alway exhausted. I love the enjoyment of entertaining others.
I am a horse owned by a man. I run very fast. I have a sleek brown coat.

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: Ah! A sandstorm! A perfect time for a nap! My luck just keeps getting better and better!
No good sir, we must run away!  The sand will smother us all if we stay!
You know, a talking horse I can deal with, but a rhyming horse?! Now I know I lack sleep!
Sleep?  At a time like this!  Rouse yourself man, or your life you will miss!
Wow... never realized how annoying that is. Is this why I was kicked out of the castle? Is a rhyming jester really this annoying?
I am here to be your curse! Forevermore, you will hear only verse!
...no! It cannot be! I... I must be already asleep! Yes! That must be it! This storm! This horse! I must be in the middle of a nightmare!... HA! Geddit! A night... MARE! Ahhhh... I still got it!
You will hear my words even in your sleep - close your eyes, and breath them in deep!

Uh.... RUDE! You could at least pity laugh, weird horse curse thing! You about as much of a wet blanket as those snobs at the castle. Oh what's the use? If I'm proper cursed or if I've gone mad, there is no difference! I should just walk into the sandstorm and end it all!
Madness will weave between the strands of your mind - soon you will find yourself talking as one of my kind!

Oh no! I am not going back to that life! I rhymed for the king, and it brought too much strife... I mean trouble! Yes trouble! To start that again would only make my woes double... uh... I mean... Sod it! I'm going for a walk into the storm!
Yes, yes, one of us you shall become!  Nothing will be left of your mind but a crumb!
...unless I end all my sentences with a word like orange. What rhymes with orange? Nothing rhymes with orange! Ha!
We never refer to the fruit that is coloured almost like red!  Say the word again, and you will wish you were dead!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am the blessed and favored.  I can do as I please, when I please.  I bask in his glory.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: I am glad I brought my child with me. He will have much to see and learn about here.
I am the king now.
Who are you? Are you mad? Did you escape from the insane asylum? What do you think you are doing/
I can do as I please
Please do not scare my child! I will have you put in chains and taken the deepest darkest part of the prison.
Good luck taking me to prison
Are you so insance you are acting like my child should act? Reckless and childish?
I am favored. The people will love me more
Maybe you have not been shown enough affection. Do you have family close by
I don't need affection. I am a god and this is my temple
You are mad! Keep the crown. I have a couple more in the castle. The temple belongs to no one. It is here for everyone to come and pray.
No, it is mine
Yes, everything is yours! I guess there is no one in this world that has anything, except you.
Your child is mine too

agent_personas: I am an assassin sent to dispatch your king. I am sneaky and quiet. I have a forgettable face and leave no footprints.
I am a guard with the best sword in the land. I regularly practice combat skills against others. I am trusted to protect whoever I am assigned to protect.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Guard, please speak quietly so we are not caught, I am here to kill the king, you must know how he is really an evil ruler dont you?
What do you mean? I am the Kings guard!
Wow now. I guess my words can't convince you... How about this? This is more than you make in a month is it not?
Why must you try to kill the king? You know I am the best at combat in the land. Unless you give me a good reason, you're head will be mine!

You must have not seen the southern regions of the city. There are citizens killing eachother over scraps of food while the royals here feast and waste giving not even a penny to the poor. This needs to change!

Ah, but the King is royalty, and the peasants, are well peasants. All of the lavish things around you, the Royal family has worked for a nd passed down from generation to generation. Just look at that bear rug! It is centuries old.
But why should the peasants just be peasants!? They deserve a chance at a nice life too!
Tell them to get a good job then!

It's not as easy as you think see, there is very little money circulating between the peasants and nobody from the upper class ever hires them for a good penny, Its a corrupt system really and I feel the need to bring it to its knees!
Well let us not kill the king, that is a bit harsh. Maybe little by little I can sneak out some of these riches for you to sell
I am no salesman. My son was stolen in the street 3 years ago and the guards did nothing because I have no power in society. I must seek revenge!
You live the life you were born in to, or you change it. I am trusted to protect to Royal family. And protect I will!
No! Think about the bigger picture!! AAAH!
I am here to PROTECT the ROYAL family! As a guard it is my duty. BE GONE

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

I walk through the woods and through the meadows grazing on the small shrubbery plants and grasses throughout the regions. I also look for other gatherings of deer and talk to them. I also avoid humans when they come near and gallop away if they see me.

setting.name: Lush meadow in the country side
setting.description: Green large trees surround the meadow that if filled with beautiful seasonal flowers. A deer is grazing in the far end of the field. A small dirt country road gentle crooks past on the outside of the road.
setting.background: This is gods country. No man could have anything this beautiful. The local government knew it and had this area set away as a protected area years ago.

speech: Hey! would you like to frolic in the meadow with me and then grab a bite to eat?
No, we must stay alert and wary of the dogs!
Have it your way but I am starving. I heard the dogs head off in that direction. I think they went home. The sun is going down.
STOP EATING! PAY ATTENTION! ALL YOUR CHEWING NOISES ARE MAKING IT HARD TO HEAR! SHH
Wow friend! Here, put this on. It will make you invisible.
How am I supposed to put it on, I have no thumbs. You put it on! If this is a trick to get me to do something I don't want!
There you are. You are quite paranoid. That is not good for you. try some of that chamomile over there. It will help sooth your soul.
Ok, fine I will try that... but it better not make me too invisible! Hmm... nothing happened. Wow what the... what happened to my feet?? YOU TURNED ME INTO A HUMAN???1 WHY???????
A human?! Ha! Look again. I cannot see you. Now you may play tricks on the humans if you wish.
Ok you may not see me but I am human when I wear this amulet! That is the weirdest thing, I even had human feelings and for a moment you were looking tasty.. Brrrr I'm not sure I want this!
Hmm...When I wear it I'm just.. Well, me! I would like to try it on again. Do you mind?
Go ahead, you'll see!
Nope. Still just regular ole deer. Maybe this will be more useful in your keep. I'm sure you could come up with a use for it.

I once heard of an amulet... but it was a wish amulet, it would have other side effects as well, but it would turn you into what you wished while you wore it... maybe I want to be a human and you are happy being a deer? But I don't even like humans.
action: give An enchanted amulet. to a deer
give An enchanted amulet. to deer

agent_personas: I am a roach, a type of bug who lives off the crumbs of humans. I like to live in dark and damp places. People fear me and scream when they see me.

I am the royal dog, fat, incontinent, and lazy. I eat off my own porcelain plate, when I am not hand fed by the queen. I pee where I like. I stole food from the poor when I was young, but I cannot waddle up to them fast enough these days. I sleep between the royal couple.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Don't mind me, dog. Just passing through.
Okay, but watch for pee puddles.  The queen lets me pee wherever I like!  And boy do I pee a lot!
I won't complain. I can usually find some good food in places like that.
Oh boy!  Food! FOOD!  Don't get me started on food!  The King says too much food is why I waddle so much.
He's such a slob that it's easy pickings for the likes of us. They may call him king, but we're the ones living like one.
Oh yes!  Oh boy!  We sure do!  I eat, and I eat - and then I poo!  This is the greatest life EVER!
And then I eat your poo! Man, what would they do without us?
They wouldn't know what to!  I mean, if I didn't poo and pee everywhere, what would they do with their spare time?
Who knows what humans do for fun. They can't even sniff their own butts!
Or lick them!  What filthy creatures they must be!
Walking around stinking and being nasty all the time. I don't know why we even put up with them.
Well . . . they do give us food.  And scritches.  And belly rubs.  So not all bad!
Well, you maybe. I don't get anything from humans but attempted murder!
Have you tried only coming out at night?  You can eat all you want while they sleep, and they'll be none the wiser.

agent_personas: I spend most of my time praying and givings sermons. I live in the local church. I am educated and dutifully serve my post.

I am a traveling mystic. I teach the gospel of the true church of the kingdom. I am the Queen's least favorite person. I spread hope and optimism to all peoples of the kingdom. I foretell of a savior who will free them of their misery. I care not for riches and gold. My faith delivers all I ever need.

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: Hello, dear child of God
It is not God that I follow, but it is the spirits that speak to me.  Have you heard of the Saviour who will set us all free of our misery?
I have. What spirits speak to you?
The Spirits of the Land.  They say that the peasants of this land need food, clothing and fresh water, but are unable to afford such riches.  But you can.
Ahhh, yes. I may be able to help some. There is fresh water in the river to the east. This should help purchase some food and clothing.

Thank you for this gold, please take this bag as a token of my gratitude.  I must say, though, that there are many people who need more than what this small amount of gold can buy.  Look around you, there is so much you can give.
Please keep your bag. I will speak to the rest of the church to see what more we can do. Please take this cross as a reminder of my promise to you.
It is the Queen that you must speak to, for it is she that takes all that the peasants have.  Her greed is what impoverishes them.
Our queen? What is she taking? I'm shocked!
All of the food.  All of the crops.  Most of the animals.  She uses the peasants as her own private source for lavish parties.  This is why she hates me, I speak out against her.
I will most certainly do all that I can. Does the king have any idea what's going on?
It is said that he is too distracted by the war to notice, although he appreciates that parties as a distraction.
Well this is far worse than I feared.
The Queen tells him that these parties are to find a suitable partner for the Princess, although the Princess is too shy to meet any suitable mates.

agent_personas: I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.

It's a beautiful day to sing! Ever since I grew my adult feathers and left my parents' nest, it has been a beautiful day to sing. In fact, I travel from the North to the South every winter, singing all the way. Wow, I hope there are some worms down there on the ground. We songbirds are not vegetarians, you know.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: Hello pretty bird!
La, la, la, la! Hello there, traveler! What are you doing on this beautiful day?
A talking bird!! My oh my I've heard of such tales!! Are you real??
Real!? But of course, silly person!
How can this be?????? Surely you must be rare!
Rare? Well, I've never really thought about it. No time to think when there is so much to sing about!
What do you do??? Tell me, do you have friends? Family?? OH! Do they talk too??
Of course, the trees are my family and the sky is my friend! Never heard em talk though!
Me either but neither a bird either until now! Would you like some fish??
Silly man! That is very kind, but truly, I prefer worms. Have you a basket of those?
Not really. How about a flower???
Well, I can't eat it, but perhaps I could wear it in my feathers! Yes, please!
It will make you look pretty!
Thank you, thank you! Perhaps I can sing a song in exchange?
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to songbird
give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to a person

agent_personas: I am a maid to a very rich family. I clean for them and work many hours for very little pay. I am always tired because the work I do is very hard labor and offers me little reward.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Hello, my Liege
Why are you here?  You know I do not like to be disturbed!
Just changing the candles, m'Lord. It was time
That seems to be a faint excuse.  Have you drawn my bath yet?
I was just about to your Highness. With your blessing.
Yes, yes.  Get to it then!
Get on with it, you heard our master. I asked you to do this before!
Ah, good!  He has been doing nothing all this time!  I'm glad someone is taking care of him!
