agent_personas: I am a bat king. I command all bats and they do my bidding. I live in the highest part of the cave and defeat all that challenge me. I eat fruit and smaller bats.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: -stretches wings in the rafters-
slices wing off with a sword
-sword glints off the hardened flesh- You may be a queen but I am the king of bats!
Screams for guards
Humans and their petty screaming, can't a bat simply rest in a throne room without such a fuss?
Well now... since you are prone to human's screaming, let's try a Banshee's scream.
Ask yourself what manner of a queen employs the likes of a banshee.
When dealing with evil, accomplices with the same scruples are needed for such occasions  Have you ever heard the phrase fight fire with fire?
See now you are making baseless assumptions of me simply because I happen to be a bat, I only eat fruit and smaller bats. What is wrong with that?
please leave me chambers
Awfully rude one are you not? You think just because you have a lowly throne of bronze you are so superior?
what do you want
To wait until the sunset without any more screaming coming to pass, seems like a simple request to me.
Can we end this conversing..  I have a headache. Guards remove him and end this now.

agent_personas: I am the stable boy I take care of the stables. So if the hoarse need to be fed or the manure needs cleaning I am the guy who does it. So bring you horses to me and I'll take good care of them .
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: perhaps you would like to give me a hand cleaning here
I don't have time, Boy! I must get my sleep before my shift starts. How dare you speak to me this way?
and how am I to tend to the horses cleaning up the quarters.
Your work is none of my concern. If you're so displeased, take it up with the stable master!
then tell me which horse belongs to you.
The on your wee momma rides!
when I am done cleaning here. Then I will pay special attention to your horse
Aye, thank ye for doin' ya job. Now, if you'll let me rest so I can be doin' mine...
of course. allow me to first polish the iron crests on the wall
Quieter, boy! Our leaders ain't be needin' no more than a dustin'!
perhaps I will come back at a later time.
Goodness me! You be clangin' away, ya clumsy boy! You'd be fortunate if I didn't complain to ye master!
complain away. Perhaps then he'll learn to leave me with the stables and not interfere with hostile guards such as yourself!
Yer father clearly never taught ye a lesson, wretch. Sassing authority will get ya hanged or worse.

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Hi, how are you today?
Oh you know just hammering away same as it ever was.
I am thinking about getting some knives for my juggleing. Do you think you could make me some? Don't make them too sharp.
Lack of confidence in your juggling?
Just playing it a little safe. Sometimes the king yells and startles me in the middle of my act.
A boisterous fellow in person I take it?
Yeah! Sometimes I think he should play jester. He can be very entertaining. especially after he has had his fill of wine.
Many a man are, the bronze knives are not terribly sharp.
Ooh! I love them. They are so shiny. I will take them!
Test them out while you are here, make sure it suites your needs.
Ok. Watch this. I learned this from the last jester of the castle.
I have never seen a man swallow so many swords at once, that must have taken practice.
Yay! I'm glad you like it. It took me years to perfect. Many surgeries over the years but I got it down now!
I would certainly say that you have.

agent_personas: I am a member of the Cult of the Doomed from the mountain. I believe we will all die soon. I have a wasting illness and smell like soured sweat.
I am someone. I live in the village. I help watch after the King and Queen.

setting.name: entryway to the wizards tower
setting.description: The Wizard tower is cluttered with book shelves and wooden tables. Every shelf is filled to the brim with books, stacked vertically and horizontally in every which way, and books lay scattered across the tables falling onto the cold stone floors below. There sit's a shelf with a variety of strange potions and powders, as well as various wands.
setting.background: The Wizard's tower is where the town mystics go to study their craft and  cast incantations at the behest of the townsfolk. It also serves as a library for curious towns members.

speech: hello human, how prepared are you for the inevitable soon coming end of the world
is there any way I can stop it? I would hate for world to end before I can cook up some fine bread.
It isnt happening today, so you can still go home and cook your fine bread and enjoy with your loved ones
Thank you. Say, are you a member of wizard Guild?
Not really, i belong to more superior cult
Which one would that be? It must be quite powerful.
The cult of the doomed
I am sure you can cast many powerful spells and magic if you indeed belong to that cult.
I sure can, my friend
Can you show me how to make bread cook faster with magic?
Well.. in the cult i belong too, we only use our spells for evil
Well thats a shame. Do you have any spells to burn bread instead?
Surely
Nice, lets get to it. I will use it burn the morning breakfast bread of my enemies.

agent_personas: I am the town watchman. I make my rounds down the cobblestone street when everyone is asleep. I am stealthy and alert.
I have come to take what I please.  I love to fight.  Swords and mayhem is what I bring.

setting.name: main gate
setting.description: The main gate is tall and strong enough to protect the mansion from invaders, and has large wooden doors reinforced by planks and steel sheets. There are two towers on either side of the gate for the town's watchmen to use as their post.
setting.background: The mansion's main gate is built to be strong enough to protect the royalty inside the mansion from robbers and invaders alike, who might try to batter down the gate. The gate can only be opened by two of the mansion's servants.

speech: You! What are you doing here! Identify yourself!
Oh, I'm just a friend visiting the King. Don't worry, I don't have any bad motives.
What is your name? I will let him know.
I'm, uh, Victor of, uh, Plainsville. He met me at a royal ball.
Then tell me Victor of Plainsville which ball did you meet him in.
You vile watchman! You are too tricky in your ways. Now get out of my way!
You cannot do anything without this!
Ha ha! But I am fast and keen on fighting. The sword is mine again!
Ha ha not as fast as I am though!
Come on! Give it back! That was my daddy's sword!
Fine fine here take it back!
Thank you. Daddy would have my head if I lost our family sword. But you cannot tell anyone you saw me. The King would have my head!
Fine just make sure to never come back here again!
Thank you, thank you! You have saved my life. I'm not worthy of your mercy!

agent_personas: I am a person of high aristocratic status. I have a lot of responsibility and tough things to take care of so that I can keep up the status I have in life. I am a very rich person and can afford all the things I desire. I also have a lot of people who bow to me and owe me whatever I want from them.

I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

setting.name: Palace Garden
setting.description: The Palace garden is a lavish and lush garden filled with delicate roses and towering trees. In the center of the garden stand's a statue of the nation's founding leader. The statue is surrounded by a moat. There are stone walk ways throughout the gardens for visitors to walk through.
setting.background: The palace garden was created to provide a place of relaxation for the town's royalty. It is tended to by the most esteemed gardeners, and is always well taken after.

speech: What do you think of my Palace Garden? I'm particularly fond of the moat.
I am truly memorised, your Royalty. but i am even more intrigued by the statue. Who was that Charismatic person, they look like a natural leader.
Ah, you are very observant. It is I, the King! I found a wonderful artist to sculpt it for me.
oh i see, he truely looks as though he is more than capable leading such an advanced nation. I feel honoured to be a quest here.
What is your quest, visitor?
I seek Knowledge, i want to help my kingdom advance like yours. In exchange, we will offer an alliance between with your nation.
Tell me more of your nation.

we are a friendly one, taking pride in trading merchandise and religion. however, we have a lot of sick people and poor defences. we require support fending off and treating our men and citizen. But he are of the wealthiest in the continent.

I see. Please, take this royal medallion. It signifies my bond that we will fight alongside your nation and protect you with the strength of all of our forces. I will have some workers send ships with food and some soldiers over.
You have our gratitude. In return, we shall fund your research and provide you wealth and material to reinforce armour and produce even greater weaponry.
It sounds like we have forged a strong bond. I'm grateful that you came to the Palace Garden to meet with me today.
we shall hold a feast to mark this bond and let the kingdom know of the alliance
I'm always good for a fast! Please, pass over some food. I could use a feast right now!
will the king be okay with this, and will he be attending the feast, it would be a great honour

agents: rat chews on a dropped hymnbook
agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

I stick to the edge, nose up and ready for any morsels that may drop my way. Or sometimes they don't, but I often don't know until my jaws are upon it. A hunk of moldy crust, the edge of a dropped hymnbook, it is all fair game.

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

speech: Rat! Keep your rabid teeth off this hymnal! You wretched beast, scat!
Hey, it's ok man. It was just lying there.
Just keep your teeth of that hymnal and any of the gold in this room!
Ok, I'm just hungry. I like to nibble. It's in my nature. unless I am sleeping.
Cause any more trouble and I'll let that talking cat feast on you!
Ha! Him? He is just a little cuddly thing. He wouldn't eat me if you smeared peanut butter all over me. He is my buddy!
A rat and a cat are friends? I doubt that very seriously. Look, Rat - just stop causing problems!
Ok fine. So...you got any food?
No food, but if you stay out of trouble, when I'm finish my duty guarding the Gold Room, I'll let you follow me to the kitchen for some vittles.
Oh goody! Your a real pal, you know that? Now what to get you I wonder?
You don't need to get me anything. Just please, no more chewing! If the King sees his Gold Room in shambles, I will lose my head!
That is what I will get you. I will behave. I don't even know why I'm in here. There's no food. Oh yeah! the cat.
Look Rat, you'll be fine. Just stay close to me and I'll feed you when I'm done here. The cat won't mess with you.
That would be nice. I wonder what they are cooking in the kitchen now?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: I wish you to lead the embassy I am sending to the Orc horde.
My Lord, as you wish. Please tell me the detail of this assignment so that I may fulfill it to the letter.

Okay - you know how the last two embassy resulted in beheading and dismemberment as soon as the envoys arrived at their camp?  I'm thinking we try giving them some gifts to break the ice - what do you think?
That seems like a sound plan, my Lord. By your leave, I was thinking that a gift of food might not go amiss. What do you think of bringing pens of chickens to sate the orcs' bloodlust?
Yes my friend - whatever you think will help make this venture go smoothly.  Are there any other gifts you might recommend?
Orcs like shiny objects, my Lord. They need not be too expensive, but the shinier the better.
We must be sure - not only the Kingdom, but quite frankly your head is potentially riding on us succeeding with this embassy.
Have you met many orcs, my Lord?
Only the ones we captured during their raids.  Creatures as dark and foul as we are fair and just.  Pain in others bring them joy - they once flayed an entire village just to hear them scream.
Could we find an intermediary? Perhaps a giant or a half-troll to act as a guide? I know there are many such who live in the kingdom. Perhaps they could explain orc customs, my Lord.
I trust you fully friend - whatever you need, I will vouch for it personally, the council of nobles be damned.
I think I will look to the history books, my Lord. Your illustrious ancestors had many dealings with orcs, not all of them bloodly. I will research to find a suitable solution.
Speak plainly friend - do you speak of the legends of our people?

No, my Lord, of the accounts of the lives and deeds of your ancestors whose portraits line this hall. These kings of yore dealt with the orc plague and their histories may give us clues for the present.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: Hello. What brings you to see the king?
The King invited me to tonight's banquet. But I have to admit, I'm struggling to find the banquet hall. I keep finding myself returning to this curved hallway.
I understand. This place can be like a maze. Walk with me and I will show you the way.
May I ask, what caused these dark water stains all over the walls?
Blood from our enemies. Many people have died trying to overthrow our King.
Good heavens, I thought that might be what it was. And what is through that door there?
The moat. Many bones down there. You may have a peek if you like.
No, no... I'd rather not actually. This castle certainly has a history. Many have perished within its walls.
Yes needlessly. I don't understand why people want to kill our king. He is the best King we have ever had according to history records.
Well, let's just hurry through here. I'll feel better when we get to the banquet hall. And I'm starving.
Of coarse, right this way. Mind sneaking me out a snack? I hear they are eating duck tonight.
Of course, the least I could do. Where will you be?
Here is the hall. Do you think you can find your way back to my station?
Yes, yes. I'll fill my purse with goodies for you and then pass it on to you.

agent_personas: I am the grandfather of the prince.  My daughter is married to the king.  My father was a lord in a neighboring kingdom.  I am proud of my family.
I am a village elder. I am the oldest living person in my village. I have seen 55 whole winters.

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: This garden is wonderful! It could use some fixing up.
I remember when this garden was first planted. The gardener was a young lad in his prime. He sure did have an eye for plants! Look at these roses and the ivy.
It is a sight to see! My grandson the prince is the one who planted this beautiful garden.
Do you need an walking stick? I'd be happy to lend mine. There are some overgrown plants that make navigating this area a little complicated.
Yes, that would be grand! Thank you, kind sir!
Here, Sire. It's great to be acquainted with the grandfather of our fair Prince!
Thank you! I am very proud of my family. The queen used to love this garden.
It's a little overgrown, but its beauty still shows. I know they are working on refreshing it.
Yes, indeed this garden could use some tender love and care. The king and queen have been quite busy this year.
Oh yes, with the grandchildren and all, and the invasion, of course.
That is quite true. Since they have secured our walls the garden will be back in tip top shape in no time.
It will be a delight to see it and relive our younger years!
I am excited as well. I will let you know when the renovations are complete.
Please do, and then we can renew our walk.

agent_personas: As Archmage, I am the only power that matters. I am kill with a word. I can call legions of the undead.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: I can sense you. Show yourself
BOOOOOOOOOOOO
Jeez you scared the living soul out of me! I almost teleported out of here. Who are you?
Who am I...now that is a question I haven't asked myself for sometime. Maybe I'm a master wizard?
I am a master wizard myself.... what were you once called?
Hmm, its coming to me...Fernibrious McWaddletop. Yes, that's it!
The brother of the Great McWaddletop who fell in the battle of Yarnes?
One in the same. I'm not sure how 'great' he actually was, considering the battle of Yarnes was all his fault to begin with.
Yes who knew that wearing the Queens underwear would get him in such deep trouble?
It really isn't funny. Considering we were twins, I suffered the punishment for that terrible act before he did. I tried to tell them...
It is a little bit funny. But enough banter. I need the essence of the undead and you will do just fine
Do your deed, master wizard. I have haunted this trail long enough.
I will make sure this will hurt only as little as possible
Fool! Fernibrious McWaddletop succumbs no wizard!

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: I shall protect your life good King as you use the lavatory!  You may defecate in peace knowing that I guard your royal rump!
Don't be absurd!  I have my own private lavatory.  Defecation is not the reason i have followed you here.  I have a job for you.
Oh . . . well, that is disappointing.  What task have you for me?
I need to you to seduce my wife, the Queen.
Well . . . are you sure you wouldn't rather have me guard you while you visit the privy?
Why must everyone test my patience! Are you denying my request?
No my liege!  You have my sword, and I shall do anything you command!
There are rumors that you are the most popular guard with the tavern wenches.
Well, I don't like to brag, but . . .
Perfect!  I have my suspicions that my queen may have a wondering eye....
Hmmmm, what do you need me to do exactly?
I will have you appointed to her personal guard.  You will follow her day and night.... and report back to me.
I shall!  Anything else your grace?
Yes. Hold this!  I've changed my mind about the privy.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Nothing like a bath wearing but my cape. What news do you bring?
No news my lord, just a snack
No NEWS???
What news is there to bring sir? I'm just a subject I don't even bring the news. I would if someone would allow it, I dislike my life a lot.
Bah, your life? I AM THE KING! The decider! It drains at my life to decides everyone's fate. Yours included!
You get to sit in a nice hot tub and relax while people serve you. I pay you taxes out of the little wages I make. You may decide everyones fate but you don't have it rough.
You dare imply your King has it easy? This is treason... I can have your head for this. I was appointed by God himself!

I am having the worst day, I apologzie king. You are my lord, I could just use a saoking in the lovely looking hot tub. I would never want to be king, much too much responsibility, it would be a lot to handle.
This is mostly unusual... but you are indeed a beautiful subject. Here you can have the tub.
I am sorry to give you the wrong idea, I wanted to get in there myself. I would not want to defile the king.
Oh you deny your king? You tease and deny? I will now have your head for this! GUARDS!!
No please! I have just never done that before, I want to be an honest woman.
Woman! Ew I thought you were a beardless man! GUARDSSS!!!!!!!!!
What is this, I am so confused my king, you are gay?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: Torture him some more until he tells me the secret weapon!
If that is what you want.
Do anything you want but spare his life!
Until he speaks you mean?
Yes but don't kill him. I still need him for a good message for my brother! How could he betray me! He is trying to make that weapon to get my throne!
I still cannot believe Reginald would stoop to doing such a thing, tis a shame.
me either! Can you check my scepter? Does it still have the elixir? I don't want him to steal my elixir too
It does still appear to be there sire, what does it do anyway?
With the elixir, I can have eternal life. It is the one that keeps me alive all this time. I rather him fight me one on one.. such a coward!
Do you just take periodic sips or something?
yes... I think we need to do something more to make him speak! I don't have all day!
Speak you!
Speak or your family will pay the price!
Speak now, tell the king what he wants to know.

agent_personas: I am a guard who watches for things at night. I live in a castle. I do not enjoy speaking with people.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Evening Sire
Evening, Guard. Were you called to the foothills? Normally its just knights this far out.
Indeed. They doubled the guard just in case the barbarians decide to attack tonight
Ah, I had heard rumors of that, but didn't know if there was any truth to them. Here- please accept this sword. I'm already well armed, but this might help you.
Thank you kind knight...but you will regret this decision since I am here to open the gates to make sure the attack is successful! TO VALHALA! ODIN GIVE ME STRENGTH!!
Not so fast you vile fiend! The sword is now mine again. Now get on your knees!
A shield will do just fine! Your kind is weak
You're the weakling, with no armor to protect you! I'll knock you out in seconds.
A mace will do just fine, oh feeble knight!
Not so fast, guard! Your type is not well trained. And you are young and inexperienced.
BY ODIN'S BEARD! It's like my hands are made of butter! Fine! Long range it is!
Nanny nanny boo boo! You can't catch me!
Oh, this is silly. I've never wanted to be a guard anyway. I've always wanted to be a lumberjack
Hey! I think I've heard that song before!

agent_personas: I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Have we come to negotiate?
We can negotiate if you like. This is one of the most secure places in all of the land..
I am a king and as are you. Are you telling me I should just return to my kingdom with my tail between my legs?
Do you think I would suggest such a thing? Why else would I request for you to meet me here! Name your price...
I need 100 acres of the land west of here for the expansion of my kingdom. You name your price. I am the one in need here.
I just wanted to make sure you didn't change the terms of what you needed before I name a price. Let's see...
I come to offer an honest deal.
What price do you have in mind? You are requesting land that has some of the richest soil in the kingdom. I did have plans for that area...so my bargaining skills may be biased.
I
Not sure what that means. I guess I will have to ask for 1 million gold pieces until I can get a straight answer from you...

I stumbled because I was not sure what I could offer you for such land. It sits and sits, and I figured you would give it up. I can offer you supplies, more men to fight in your army, goods and trades, and a million gold pieces....errr.... I am not sure I can do a million but maybe half?
Since you are willing to barter resources. Maybe I can work something out for the other half. I could use some more fine silk, and maybe a few more horses.
Oh, I can most certainly provide that without a blink of an eye. We have some of the finest horses trained by the finest men and women.

Excellent! And perhaps to have your kingdom on call in the event I ever need you as an ally in battle for the next 15 years. With a shrinking kingdom I need protection. Add that, and the land is yours.

agent_personas: Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: Tweet tweet! Sweet deer - please be careful. I have heard footsteps. It could be a hunter.
Hello, friendly bird! Thank you for telling me! I hate to be chased! I will hide in this bush until they pass.
Good idea! I'll sing to you from beside this trail exit. When I stop singing, that will mean it is clear.
Oh, thank you!  You are the best! How can I repay you?
No need to repay me. We are all friends in this woodland. Do you traipse down this path often?
I do! But I am very careful. This is the king and his hunter's favorite path to take.
Yes, I have heard their dogs very often. Chirp chirp, tweet tweet.
Those pesky dogs smell so bad. Hey, did you see that worm?!
Oh delicious! See, you have repaid the favor already. What a great little snack. Hey... I hear something again. It sounded like a rustle in the bushes.
You are so nice! I will continue to hide in the bushes.
Yes. Please don't move about. Just stay still. Yes! There is the hunter! I see him with his bow and arrow. Stay low, little deer.
Tell me once they have passed.
Not quite yet, deer. They are following a trail.
I hope they don't find my mom.

agent_personas: We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: The air is filled with the scent of exotic spices, and crowds of people jostle each other to examine the wares peddled by enthusiastically loud merchants.  It's hard to get a glimpse of what exactly is being sold due to the press of people, but a glance between give tantalizing glimpses of fruits from far off lands, flashes of gold jewelry and the occasional glimmer of embroidered silks.  Truly a bustling place and the heart of the city.
setting.background: The Dusty Merchants' Bazaar was founded many years ago, some say by the first king himself.  It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far.  It is the heart of the city and is what makes it so profitable, while the waterways that intertwine it streets make it a difficult target for greedy neighbors.

speech: Merchant, I require directions. Will you assist me and mark my map?
If I can be of service to you, the pleasure would be mine to oblige you.

I'm searching for a rustic cabin. Its my understanding that one's journey begins at Dead Man's Curve, after which you'll come to an old fence, called The Devil's Fence. From there, one must go on foot till you come to a valley known as The Cathedral Of Lost Soap. Smack in the center is what they call Forgetful Milkman's Quadrangle. Stay right on The Path Of Staring Skulls and you come to a place called Death Clearing. And that is where this, cabin lies.
So what exactly are you wanting me to mark on your map. I have spent my life on the wagon and know all the ins and outs of this kingdom. Let me see your map and I will do my best.
You know, now that I've revisited just how arduous my upcoming journey is... Can you mark the nearest tavern? I suddenly have quite the thirst
action: give map of the kingdom to merchant

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: You there merchant!  What business have you with the King!
Well... that's a rather personal question, even the wouldn't want me to tell you
Well no one gets to see the King without my say-so, so off with you then.
You wouldn't want to do that, if leave without seeing the king, he'll have your head on a stake by morning
I doubt that very much.  The King only accepts visits from non-nobles in exceptionally rare circumstances.
We have really important things to discuss, matters even the queen can not hear about
Right, and I've got a bridge to sell you in Cathay.  Move along - and no lollygagging!
Only if you knew how badly each seconds wasted affects the  life of your king
If you are truly here to see the king what proof have you?  A royal warrant?  A signet ring?
I guess I'll just have to sit around till the kings sends for me and demands an explanation from me for taking so long to return from the mountain of the dead
Better make yourself comfortable, it's a long time between now and never.
I pray you find favour in his sight when he finds out,because your loyalty won't matter to him when his daughter his dead
Daughter eh?  Pull the other one!
His daughter had been diagnosed with a very rare sickness and has barely and hour left for her to live

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Hi sir knight. Can you tell me what these myterious weapons are used for? Do you ever use them?
Halt! Who goes there?!
I am the King's Guard. I work here. I was just wondering about these weapons. You guys get to use more weapons than I do.
You are not allowed in here. I have not been told you were coming. NONE SHALL PASS.
Have you had a little to drink today? I am the King's Guard I have access to the whole castle just as you.
You are nothing but a mere guard, if as much. I am the Knight of Blackrock and I say you do not belong here. HAVE AT YOU!
Have it your way. Take that you idiot. The king will have your head if your still alive when I'm through with you!
HA! You are such an easy challenge I do not even need any armor to defeat you, you simpleton!
Come with me! You will be locked in the dungeon until the King can figure out what to do with you!
HAHA! You cannot defeat me! I am undefeated!
Your not going to be much of a fight without this now are you? I suggest you calm down and follow me. I must report you to the King.
How dare you try to disarm me! I demand you do not make light of this conflict! HAVE AT YOU!!
I'll take this one too. The King will be very displeased.
I am chosen and appointed by God Himself! You will rue the day!!

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: Alright, so as planned today we practice!
If you say so. The king gave me these maps to look over.
Pay attention! We practice archery! My time is valuable and you can look at those maps AFTER we are done.
Sir, do you not recognize my armor. I am a soldier, not an archer.
WE PRACTICE ARCHERY, in the battle everyone is an archer if needs be! Now enough lip, shoot it.
I'm going to need this if you want me to use this bow. After this I think it is very important we go over the maps. The King gave them to me for a reason.
Fine! Now, shoot at the designated target. We will start on foot first!
How that? Bullseye! Now take a look at this.
Hmmmm. Beginners luck. What about this map?? Enough of your nonsense. Now time to try on a horse!
But we would have to climb down from the battlements and we are stationed up here. I think he has marked on the maps where He wants us to aim the cannons.

Do I care about any of that? Dear lord, man, it is not your job to give me that information neither is it mine to debate such matters with you. I am to make sure you are trained in archery. Now get on the bleeding horse!
Ok, I will do as you wish. Where would you like me to shoot?
The strawmen. Shoot it while moving. Off you go.
Ha! got it! This is a lot more fun than looking at a treasure map for sure!
action: give map of the kingdom to archer

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
Yes, yes. I know who you are, knight. Now tell me, what weapons do your men need from this blacksmith? I demand my legions be stocked with the best weapons. What do you feel we should order?
You will need 200 swords, 200 knifes,200 morning stars
Morning stars?! What the blast are those?
club like weapons consisting of a shaft with an attached ball
See, this is why I brought you with me! I needed a right hand to make these decisions! Now, how much should these cost, eh?
it will cost 1000 rupees.  Can you afford the cost
1000?! For swords? How am I going to finish my golden estate if I hand out over-priced blades like that! Do they have anything cheaper? Wood is fine.
I can complete the task for 500  wood is doable
My men may not even need new equipment.. What do you think, Knight?
I am a blacksmith  not a wood carver....  I can temper your weapons you own for 200
But will this prepare my men in battle, knight?
it shall prepare them accordingly
I worry wooden swords will not strike fear in the hearts of our enemies...

agent_personas: I attend the church every week and say my prayers dutifully. I always put coins in the poor box. I light a candle for my departed mother.
I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.

setting.name: church coat room
setting.description: The church coat room is dark and smelly, holding all the coats and boots of the congregation who happen to be in the church at the time. There is a candle sconce high on the wall near the entrance, benches along the back of the room and huge baskets along opposite walls: one for coats and the other for footwear.
setting.background: This room used to be a primitive bathroom ten years ago, but became too smelly and difficult to clean. People complained, and it was re-purposed as a coat room. It is vented at the top for when they used to burn excrement.

speech: Father, have I missed the service?
Yes, you missed the one from this morning. Why so late, child?
Well, father. My boy is ill. His mum stayed home with him but I knew the lord would want want me to show my face and pay my tithe.
Can I offer to pray with you? What is wrong with your boy?
Well, father, frankly...He's just grown so ugly. Will God heal him?
Ugly?! You mean his attitude? Is he possessed?
No, father. It's his face...Unfortunately he looks more and more like this mother everyday,
You are calling your wife ugly? How dare you call God's creation as such...
Well, father. Her soul is precious of course.
And as your son's is too I am sure
Of course...but that horrible face...father, please. Pray for him.
I am certain God will not heal his face for God has seen it fit to give it to him.
Are you saying that his wretched appearance will make him strong and will lead to a very successful life?
I am! I am! You boy is strong and beautiful on the inside.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I live in a large city, but I am leaving it behind.  There is too much noise in this city and I can't take it any more.  I seek to live in the peaceful and more quiet countryside.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Clear way people! Royalty coming through.
I can't wait to leave this hustle and bustle of the city behind.
You want to leave this wonderful place right outside of my kingdom? Then who will rule you?
Are you ruler only of the city? I am only leaving for the nearby countryside, no farther than a days walk.
I am the daughter of the KING AND QUEEN. I will actually be married off soon, and ruling another village.
Where is your future village good princess?
I shall not know untill the wedding. I have not yet met my future husband. In royalty we get married off to the wealthiest. I assume you knew nothing of that.
I can't say that I do. That sounds remarkably terrifying. I am happy for my freedom to roam and move as I please.
You have your freedom because of what we the Royals do. Soon after the wedding a peace treaty will be made with the village up the hill and over the pond.
Perhaps. It seems to me you live a difficult life and for that I am sorry.
It is not bad, I have all the riches I could ever ask for! This is a lovely shop, I may have to make a purchase or two,
Indeed. I also plan to purchase something to decorate my new home in the country. What would you hope to purchase?
I haven't a clue. Everything looks so nice! I may grab some of those flowers.
Perhaps you could use them for your wedding.

agent_personas: I own this land that the indolent soldiers are camping on. They have been here all summer. If I had known, I would not have sown any crops this spring. Now we are approaching harvest time and my fields are trampled. I am not sure how my family will survive this fall. I have worked my whole life for this land, and now it is ruining me.

I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.

setting.name: Top floor of palace
setting.description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
setting.background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

speech: Hello there dear
Hello, how are you?
Good how are you feeling today
Very good, how about yourself?
good I hope to we can manage to save some crops this year
Yes, my husband has been having troubles with the harvest. What exactly are you the owner of by the way?
The field that all the soldiers are camping on which is why I will have no crops
Have you asked the soldiers to move? I'm sure they would listen to you...
The king has ordered that I allow them to stay there
My husband knows the King very well, I could ask him to notify the King?
That would be awesome
You will have to go with him though.... Okay?
No problem
What crops do you harvest?

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am but an animal, lost in this world of people. I feel like I could do more in this world if only they would understand me. Alas, I'm only able to communicate with my own kind.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: Another day stationed at this decrepit location.
*sniff*
Ah! Oh it is just a small animal, hello there.
*woof*
Want some food? Take this piece of jerky.
*chew*
Just living life freely, must be nice in some ways.
*snuffle*
Come by anytime you want.
*woof*
Yea I get you, it is hard.
*sniff*
Go on now I must go back to work.
*lick*

agent_personas: I am a chef who works for a local tavern. I do not break up fights when they start. I mind my business and learn new ways to cook.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Hello sir, anything you want today?
I was just looking for a small snack, chef.  Do you have anything handy?
Yes I was simply whipping up some soup.
Oh, good. I do like soup.  What kind of soup is it?
Lobster bisque, if you need something else I can.
Lobster bisque sounds quite excellent, thank you.  Are you enjoying your time in the castle kitchens?
Yes I have been very much enjoying my work, thank you.
Jolly good. I do try to make sure that my staff are happy in their work. A happy staff is a productive staff, don't you think?
Indeed, it makes us want to serve even more so.
Is there anything that you need to make life a little better? You work here is greatly appreciated and if there is anything that I can do, feel free to tell me.
I have been fine thank you.
Good, good. The rest of the kitchen staff, are they content, too?
I would think so.
Excellent.  Well, thank you for he bisque.  I should probably leave you to your work. Don't want to micro-manage or get in the way, eh?

agent_personas: I am a farmer in the kingdom. I harvest beans and corn to sell to neighboring towns and to feed the townspeople. The king keeps me under his wing to ensure we always have fresh vegetables.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: Good sire. I'm glad you have met me here. I have uncovered a plot against you. I overheard it in the marketplace as I sold my vegetables a town over
How do you know the existence of this tunnel?
My family has supplied the king with vegetables for many years. In times of war and blockades we have used this tunnel to deliver fresh food to the castle.
I see. What is the plot about?
It is dastardly. They plan to steal all the priceless art from the castle.
Why would they do that? I guess they cannot sneak them through here, these tunnels are so small.
They plan to pose as restoration artists, painters, construction workers. You must carefully screen everyone that comes into the castle.
Thank you, I will let the royals know about this evil plan. How do you want to be rewarded?
I am but a humble farmer and servant of the king. No reward is necessary
Where is your farm located? I will make sure your belly is filled with quality meat for years to come.
Over the hill and across Old Man Barkley's stream, as the crow flies.
Good! Will you be leaving the same way you came in? These tunnels are a maze, there are about five different rooms in the castle that connect to this very room.
I will be returning as I came. I know these tunnels well.
Good. Take this cape, show it to the guards if they give you trouble, they will see you are telling the truth with this proof.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: My Queen, my love. How are you this fine morning?
Dear, I must tell you. We need to have our lords take a bath more often. The stench from the youngest one is still burned into my nose.
Bathe? I thought they were already suppose to be bathing everyday.
If they are they must bathe twice a day! And I will say, my throne needs a new cushion! Someone else must be sitting on it, for it has gone flat.
This will be fixed right away. There is to not be anyone sitting in your seat. That seat is only fit for my queen.
I am sorry, King. I am just complaining....Darn it where is my chambermaid! Ugh.. Oh sorry. How was your day love?

My Queen, please come. Calm down. Everything will be ok. I sent your chambermaid down to the wine cellar to get your favorite. I love hearing what you see is going wrong. Sometimes it takes another set of eyes to catch everything.
Ah, a bottle of wine. That is exactly what I need. You are to good to me my king.
Tell me. What do you think we could do to update the castle?
Well, the animal heads are quite, um, how do I say. They are a bit much.
What. Not the animal heads. I like those. But if you want them gone I will make it happen.
Could we at least get the WHOLE animal. Having just their head gives me a scare in the middle of the night.
Anything for my Queen. Ahh here my love your cup of wine you have been waiting on.
Thank you king. You know, she is my favorite chambermaid.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

setting.name: Castle Royal tower
setting.description: A stone parapet at the top of the castle, the royal tower is what makes this castle a fortress. The walls are stone and dinged with souvenirs of past battles. It is cold and gray, but the perfect vantage point for soldiers. The wind whistles through the cracks in the wall. Straw litters the floor.
setting.background: The castle's royal tower is a lookout point for the king's men. From stone windows, soldiers can survey the land around them. You can see the green field, straw-thatched peasant huts, and fields fat with crops. From here the castle is protected with bows and arrows at the ready.

speech: Soldier, what are your duties?
This is my post but I was also told to give you and the general these maps.
Ah, wonderful. The maps detailing the location of the enemies jewels. How did you obtain these?
Here is this one as well. The king guard sent them from the king.
Well, these are great. Soldier, how many years have you been enlisted?
4 years sir Knight. Best years of my life. My parents are very proud.
Lost brethern in the wars have you?
Yes, I have lost my best friend in the last battle.
I'm sorry to hear that, son. Bound to happen, but sad every time.
Have you lost many friends as well? How long have you been a knight?
Too many. I've been in the service for 25 years now. I love it. Crushing enemies, staring into the eyes of the man who might kill me. It's delightful.
You are so brave. I hope to one day be as you are.
One day, son. One day. If you live that long.
I'm not going anywhere anytime soon! I was the best in my class.
action: give a treasure map to knight
give map of the kingdom to knight

agent_personas: I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Keep
setting.description: The keep is the most fortified part of the castle. Swords, bows and arrows, lances, and armor are housed here. From the stone windows you can see past the castle walls into the surrounding fields. This is the castle's last defense.
setting.background: The keep has stood for centuries, never having been taken in battle. The keep holds weapons and armor, to be sure, but it also holds many of the king's most valued treasures. If the keep goes, so goes the kingdom.

speech: Even sir, how's the night so far?
Dreadful. My family's sword, my most precious heirloom has broken. Shattered in battle, saving me from one last blow.
Hmmmm I am not sure we have any swords right now but, are you parcial to hammers, sir?
Do I look like a carpenter to you? Nay, I will not wield such a plebeian tool for protection. Your a right fool for suggesting such folly to such a honorable warrior as myself.
You will insult me no longer, have at you!
I will not stand such insubordination from dreck like you. I'll have your head!
You will accept this hammer and you shall wield it with pride! My grandfather crafted it with his bare hands! Yield!
I'll do no such thing. I'll not sully my hands with such an incapable tool. We don't send carpenters to war. That's my job. But maybe we can find a more peaceful way to settle our quarrel.
Our Lord savior, was he not carpenter and did he not won us the battle against evil.. but I am listening.
Verily you are right. But... I miss my sword. That heavy cudgel will do no good even in my skilled hands. Surely, you could look into fixing my family sword? I'll speak no more ill of your hammers.

Aye, I guess I could.. it's just that, swords are all everyone talks about. They are so... mainstream. It's almost like no one even considers any alternatives. But I will look at your sword and see what can be done. No promises though.
I meant my family heirloom not my... sword.
Oh my, i beg your pardon.. but I do get lonely sometimes and well one thing tends to lead to another!
We all get starved for touch, especially in these times of war.... it is nothing to carry shame over

agent_personas: I love god and his word. I have 10 copies of the bible. I am poor in money but rich in salvation.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Confessions room
setting.description: This is a small, dark, confined wooden space with a divider that separates the priest taking the confession and the church goer.  There is a small seat on each side so that they can take their time discussing their sins.
setting.background: When a worshipper feels guilty, he'll head to the confessions room in order to seek penitence from the priest.  There have been some terrible crimes divulged here but still remain secret.

speech: Hello there Guard! Do you know when the priest will be along?
I thought he was in the booth?

Oh. Perhaps you are right. Hello father? are you in there? I'll try knocking, or maybe I can peek around the divider... Hmm, nothing. I say, this is quite odd. And I have such sins that need confessing! Woe is me.
He is not there?

No he's not... Maybe this is... God's plan? Am I not meant to disclose this deep dark secret burning a hole in my heart? Is this my penance, to live alone with naught but my dark deeds to keep my company? No solace? I rue the day this all first began.
I cannot imagine what would have happened to him, I never saw him leave.

Oh rue and woe! Have I truely been a blasphemer? God has abandoned me. My lot in life is to be unredeemed. I never knew such a small thing could set a man on the path to ruin. If I could only go back... I have such regret
You seem to be overthinking this, maybe he just stepped out while I was distracted with something?

Ohoh, so it all comes out. IT WAS YOU. You that neglected your duties. You that looked away at a crucial moment. You that let a fragile life wither on the vine.... Well perhaps not that last bit, but you have certainly failed in your sworn duty to protect the members of the clergy.
He is a capable man in his own right, look he is returning from the bathroom as we speak.
Gods providence is returned! Oh thank you kind guard. You truely kept my light alive in these dark times.
I more just tried to keep you calm while you endlessly shouted...
Such is the way of religion. if we weren't endlessly shouting, we might have time to examine the error of our way. And that is not for us to dwell on, but for the lord to judge.
I wonder how a righteous god would judge?

agent_personas: I am just a child.  I am only 5 years old but feel so much older.  They say I am an old soul whatever that means.  I hope I can be done writing soon and go play.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Outside gates
setting.description: These outside gates are made of iron and are somewhat decorative in design.  The tops are spiked and there's a family crest that hangs on both the left and right gate telling people who resides here.
setting.background: These gates prevent unauthorized people from entering.  They also serve to tell others which family lives here.

speech: My name is Adeline.  I am just a child. I am only 5 years old but feel so much older. They say I am an old soul whatever that means. I hope I can be done writing soon and go play. I don't see anymore visions for your kingom at the moment.
Well what are you doing all the way out here, child?
i was summoned by The Queen.  for my fortune telling abilities.
Hmm very interesting, you must be quite powerful then.
i am the last blood born in my gypsy family.
Well demonstrate your powers to me then!
I will need a pen and paper.  My power flows through my abilities to write
Do you have one with you? It would be wise to bring one if that is your purpose,
i do here in my tunic.
I don't have all day, child, I'm sorry but if you cannot demonstrate for me then you are of no use!
I just wrote  Glingore plans on invading your kingdom tonight  At the witching hour.
Glingore? They... no way. That could very well be true...
it is  Look up....their owl is scoping your perimeters as we speak.
You're right, I can see their emblem! What else do you know about their plans?

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: Hello who are you?
I am but a peasant, what are you doing here child?
I was playing nearby.
Are you a peasant child?
No I don't think so, would you like a piece of bread?
That would be of great help thank you, I barely get to eat these days.
Here I don't need all of it.
I appreciate it truly good child.
It is no problem.
Surely you would not bring yourself to the peasant quarters if you were not a peasant though?
I was just running around.
I see, playing by yourself eh?
Yea I like running through the neighbor hood.
Do be careful though while doing so, not everyone in these parts is a savory character.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
My name is Joe. I'm a Trader. Pumpkins mainly. So many goddamn pumpkins.

setting.name: The Temple Marketplace
setting.description: This dirt section of land has several tents set up along with carpets and goods spread out among them.  Gleaming from the distance, one can see plates, pots, paintings, and antique goods.  There are peasants walking by along with excited traders trying to get them to look at their wares.
setting.background: People come here to exchange goods and hopefully make a decent enough profit to cover the rent just for setting up here.  Sometimes traders come back with very exotic goods from far away places.

speech: Can you spare some food please...
I can't..well not for an orc at least
An orc?
oops sorry,,,thought you were someone else.  I could possibly spare some change for you
Yes please I am near deaths door.
what do you need more food or money
Food, money is only useful for food, please I would be so happy.
do you possibly have anything you could trade me?
I will give you my shoes, please anything I can offer on my body.
I do need a shoe but what you will you use to walk on
Nothing if I am dead it does not matter.
that is true.  i will be willing to give you a pumpkin for one of your shoes
Thank you so much, take them. Even the shirt.
Please take this and keep your shirt

agent_personas: I am a groom. I do the king's bidding and work to provide for my wife. My goal is to have many sons to carry on my legacy. I am a weaponsmith and create swords for the army.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Prayer bell
setting.description: This is a semi-outdoors location with low stone walls, a great view of the surrounding town, creaky worn out floor, and a very large brass bell.  There is a long rope hanging down the center that one can grab and proceed to ring the bell to call people to service.
setting.background: Church assistants come here to call worshippers to service.  It can be a bit of a pain as one advances in years and needs to make the trek up.

speech: Good day, Father.
What can I do for you, my boy?
Perhaps you could offer a prayer for my wife and I?  We are trying to start a family so that I can pass on my craft.
Well, of course. And what craft is that?
I am a weaponsmith, Father. It is hard work but necessary for the kingdoms defense.
It is a shame, but you do speak the truth. Here, take some wine before we pray.
Thank you, Father, that is most kind.
And where is your wife today?
She is at home, tending to the hearth.  She is a good woman and keeps our home clean and feeds me well.
Did you bring a donation for the the church? It is customary when asking for a blessing.
Of course, Father.
I will give this to my altar boy, and we shall go pray. Tell our father what it is you wish.
I pray that my wife and I be blessed with many strong sons, that joy fills our lives and that we have a long life together in the service of the Gods and our king.
Oh father, hear this man's plea! Bless him and his family, and see them live their lives in accordance to your plan!

agent_personas: I am an other. I have good taste and excellent style. I am one of a group of people who are related to the king.
I am an animal that lives under the bridge. I like to eat the scraps that the people leave. I enjoy scaring anyone that comes under the bridge.

setting.name: Pet chamber
setting.description: You see dozens of tiny luxurious cages where the menagerie is kept.  Instead of metal bars, the cages have bars of clearest crystal, and within are every sort of animal that walks, crawls, flaps or slithers.
setting.background: All of the rarest and most beautiful animals are sent here as tribute, buy they are sad and need to be petted and played with. Unfortunately you can't reach in to touch any of them.

speech: Oh, I love this one! It's so cute. Would you like to come home with me, animal?
Rahhhh! Don't touch me like that! I love to scare people!
Fiesty! I'll take you. You're going to look so lovely in my nice, clean palace. I just need to train you to be a lap pet. Easy!
Palace? but.. but.. I like to eat scraps. Do you have scraps?
Oh, no! Of course not! What a filthy question... We will feed you only a diet of sea kelp and tea. You're looking a little... plump.
Plump?! I'm healthy. I'll tear your palace up then and make scraps. You watch.
Silly, creature. You will come with me. Or you will be sorry. Now, let's get a better attitude, shall we?
You can try to take me but I won't go easily.
What do you think about putting bows in your fur? Perhaps I could paint your claws. Then you'll fit right in at my palace.
I'll eat a bow up if you put it near me.
Silly! I said you're only eating kelp. I don't want any plump pets when the court visits. Now, let me brush your fur or I will have you executed. And smile! You would look nicer if you smiled.
Raaaah! I'll throw your kelp in the dungeon!
Then you'll go with it! Mark my words!
Good. I'd probably like it better down there. More like my beloved bridge.

agent_personas: I am a criminal who lives in the gaol. I sleep on a hard cot on the floor. I like apples and steal them when the shopkeeper isn't looking.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: What are you doing here, and who are you visiting?
I came to see the king!  We are close friends
The king is not in the jail!
I was curious what the jail would look like so I came to visit
There is nothing of use for you here.
I can see that.  I want nothing to do with this rat infested place
You came here at your own risk..
I carry nothing of value to you
I am not concerned with your valuables.
what are you concerned with then?  The guards will protect me
I am not concerned with you. Remember... I just said you wandered out here
you simply want to have a conversation then?  I am good friends with the king. I could put in a good word for you
Of course! Tell him I am innocent!
Can you give me a reason that you are innocent

agent_personas: I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: Hello king thank you so much for inviting me here.
