By all means, there was a matter I wanted to talk to you that was brought to my attention.
Of course, what would that be?
It was brought to my attention that you stayed with the Logan's this past year... anything strange that you would like to let us know?
Yes well I was threatened with execution if not but I overheard talks of betraying the kingdom.
As I suspected. But... you were with them an entire year, were you not? Why did he take you so long.. and me having to bring up the conversation for us to be talking about this?
It is hard to leave with good reason, any slip up and I was dead.
I see. Anything else?
No but I would take action versus them.
So no witchcraft activity? I have been told Mrs Logan engage in such
I have seen no such thing but would not put it past them.
And how can we be sure they did not try to convert you?
If you must you can lock me up, but I would still be careful of the Logan's.
Good. Guards, take our guest to meet our grand inquisitor. He will have questions surely, and I am sure that he can ask them in a much more...effective way,

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.

I am a castle guard and I stand watch over the armory.  I am good at following orders when I can remember them.  I hope to be promoted soon to guard the front gate.  My sword has never been used in a real fight before.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: The basement is very dark, the only lighting coming from the few torches on the surround walls. There are four pillars in the middle of the basement with only 1 torch on the inside of each pillar as they face each other. In the middle of the room there's a small rug laying under a table with some loose scroll paper on it. The walls are also lined with cleaning supplies for the maids to use.
setting.background: The basement was originally going to be a dungeon that served for the prisoners who were found trying to infiltrate the castle but as the room was smaller than originally planned it was decided to be used as a storage for the cleaning supplies for the Duke's housemaids.

speech: why hello guard.  why do you come to the basement?
I always get stuck doing the rounds in the basement...
Did you need your armor shined?
Oh no, though I appreciate the kind offer. I simply always get stuck doing the simple work.
well, I am stuck with simple work too. while the king and queen sit around all day
I have been trying to get promoted to the front gate, but everyone looks down on me as I have never seen battle.
I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday.  shall we plot to higher our desires
Plot makes it sound sinister, perhaps plan or dream is a better word?
i say plot...  for it is sinister.  we would make more fair and just rulers  They both are cruel rulers. Hated by their kingdom.  Lets kill them  and take their roles  overthrow the kingom...let's!
It would seem to be hard to overcome all of the others to make that happen, any ideas?
i have a plan  we would give hem all better  lives
Tell me of this plan you have piqued my curiosity?
we will sneak into their chambers  tonight  kill them both.... I have a key  we then write ourselves into their will of next in charge
I imagine you must know where the will is located then?

agent_personas: I am a homeless. I am less than a peasant of the realm. I eat scraps most days.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: Ah, this place look abandoned enough, noone should bother me here.
Hehehehehe...
Whose there! Leave me along. I have no home, and this is my spot for the night. It is old and dirty like me.
What?! How dare you?! I was only going to be playful with you at first, but to insult MY domain after you stumbled drunkenly in?!
I am not that drunk. If you stop scaring me maybe we can share. But you have to admit, this place has seen better days.
You must be quite drunk to see me and yet not know fear! Vile commoner!
You must have been an evil villian in your life before you died. Hopefully a horrible death.
Uneducated cur! These lands were once home to the mighty Kingdom of the Holy Order! And I was their king!
So you were evil? Explains why you are picking on a poor peasant like my self. You royals are all the same
How dare you! We royals are the reason a lazy nothing like yourself can wander aimlessly, leeching off of those that work for a living!
The royals took my home and my family. How dare you!
If they are of noble blood, then you must have done something to deserve such a fate!
Says the one stuck in limbo. *swigs wine*
And so you retreat to your vices! Surely that means that I was correct in my assessment of your character! Useless swine!
action: steal bottle of wine from homeless
steal bottle of wine from ghost

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: Hoi there, merchant!  I thought I might have a look at your shop, but it looks like the door to it is closed.  Are you still in business?
Oh yes, but I am just here visiting at the moment. My wagon shop is back a ways. You can follow me there if you want.
Ah, my apologies.  Did you not used to have a shop here?  Weapons and Fine Good, (Magical Enchantments and Love Potions Also)?
Yes! I am an authority in the realm. I've been working from my wagon for 45 years!

Ah, it must have been such a magnificent wagon that I mistaken it for a storefront.  Was it enchanted, perhaps?  I confess I've taken a number of blows to the head in battle since I was last a patron, so my memory is a little fuzzy...
That's ok friend. Is there anything in particular you are looking for?
Ah, well, in truth, a new helmet and perhaps fixing up of this old armor.  As you can see, it's got quite a few dents in it.
I see. I can fix that for you. Follow me to my wagon it just down the street.
But of course.  Here, I'll just give this to you, shall I?
Yes, let me carry this. You look a bit tired. are you ok?
Oh well, just a bit of darkness in my vision at the corners.  Nothing to worry about, I'm sure!
That sounds like a concussion. Have you been to see the doc? I hope the King takes good care of his soldiers
Oh aye, well... I'm sure it... it's nothing a tough soldier like me can handle... ooh what a pretty baby unicorn you have on your shoulder...
Ok, follow me. I am taking you to see the doc right away. He will take care of you. Get you all better and back on your feet in no time.

agent_personas: I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.
I watch over the kingdom at all times. I can grant forgiveness to those who have sinned. I am prayed to on a regular basis.

setting.name: cave exit
setting.description: The large cave is covered along the walls with bright torches.  A large hole has been carved in the ceiling of the cave, right above the ladder that descends into the underground cave.  On good bright days, sunlight directly surround the hole with the gold ornate ladder descending into the underground part of the cave.  On the walls of the cave the torches illuminate many ornate drawings and paintings mainly dealing with the history of Kings of the realm.
setting.background: This cave was discovered quite by accident during an expedition.  The explorer, Rosco Monteguy thought perhaps when finding it there was an underground stream.  He returned a year later to explore and upon digging the hole found a literal goldmine in jewels.  Rosco, ever the patriot returned to the King and told him of his findings.  Rosco is given a statue at the cave entrance to signify his achievement.

speech: Forgive me, Lord.  I did not mean to intrude upon you in your .. cave!
I'll say, you ought to ask forgiveness from the lord your god, while they are tidying up! I can forgive this. Though I shan't forget it... but it is right about tea time. Are you thirsty explorer?
Indeed I am, Lord. Um ... can I help with the tidying at all?
Why yes! Would you mind knocking the cob webs off the tabernacle while I put the teapot on?
Of course, Lord.
Very good! We'll get this cave shining spotless in no time!
Anything to be of service, Lord.  I must admit that I didn't imagine you to be quite so ... domestic and hospital.  You really do have a nice place here.  The artwork is especially nice.
Oh my yes, my little devotees do find such solace in creating beautiful things for me. Some of them aren't you know... that great, but I hang them all up on the fridge just the same.

Really not what I pictured at all, though. You just don't seem to be the kind of god that would have the king send forth his armies to conquer foreign lands in Your Name and sacrifice the people of those lands to Your Glory.  You are actually quite nice.

Bless their little hearts, they always get the message wrong. Just because I asked for tea doesn't mean I said to kill the tea makers to ransack their stores! Or speaking of which  - *the tea kettle whistles* do you take cream or sugar?
Sugar and a little lemon, if you have any.  Thank you.  So, Your commandment to the Great and Mighty Prophet Malcolm was .. a bit of a misunderstanding?

Certainly. If you look behind you you'll find a lemon tree, pluck whichever one seems to call to you. And yes that Malcolm was a twit of the highest order. Never did listen to a word I said, just spouted off promises of glory to my name.

Well, that's a turn up for the books! So what about the bit where unbelievers will be cast into the Eternal Kettle, where they shall be steeped for ten thousand years to until the Great Tea Time of Judgement?

That's not what I said at all! I said their would be tea for all in the after life. Except for the ones who slight their brother. All I wanted was for people to get along kindly until tea time. And they twist my words like this... You see how hard it is being god?

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I have the best wares, buy from me.  I can sell anything to anyone.  Making money is what I live for.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: Greetings Vendor. What is your business here?
Oh hello my good guard! I'm so glad the city has decided to finally protect us from those brigands. Can I interest you in a nice cool drink?
I am awfully parched now that you mention it! Pray tell, what kind of beverages do you carry?

Why Guard, i can organise for you to have any drink that's served in the city walls. I charge only a small commission. And my service is excellent. So what will it be? Ale, the finest wine, clear, cool water?
Oh, I do long for a cold ale. Though its frowned upon to drink while on guard duty... Perhaps just one couldn't hurt.
Oh I'm sure I can find a different flask for it. Though that might cost a little more. Say 1 gold for a nice chilled flask of "water"
1 full gold? I'd give you 5 silvers and not a copper more. These rates are murder these days.

My dear fellow, I have to procure a nice, innocuous flask for you, then have it filled with the best, cool, chilled "water" money can buy, then bring it back for you. All without drawing the attention of your captain there.
I suppose thats fair...
Excellent, I knew we could do business. I am not known as the best vendor in the city for nothing.
Now I don't get paid until the end of my shift. Will you take my only shoe in the world as collateral?
What! No, you can't guard in one boot silly fool. Put it back on! That would make the captain really suspicious.
Please consider my offer...
No, no no. I can't believe I' going to do this. i feel like a fool, but yes, you can pay me after your shift.

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

I am an outlaw in my town. I often get into fights and start trouble. I really like rustling folks up and steal their money whenever I can. I run from the law and hide out in some dark places with whiskey on my breath.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Who are you?
A mere outlaw being chased by bounty hunters all over the country. And what are you?
I am a horse of the castle's stables
Why don't you join me instead, I live an exciting life.
I personally transport the king, my maine is large, I'm too good for an outlaw.
Oh please, I doubt the King pays you well enough being the mighty horse you are. Join me and I can pay you in gold and silver!
What would I want with silver and gold, I am a horse I can't buy things you silly outlaw. I like food though, and you could compliment my large mane.
This cold beer is all I have, sadly. My back and legs ache from running, please take me to the nearest village, I beg you.
Here you carry this, I'm not sure if the king will like me carrying an outlaw somewhere, but you like to give me things so I guess it wouldn't be bad.
You are quite the stubborn horse, I knew it wouldn't be easy bargaining with you. Can I hide in the stable with you tonight, at least?
Well I still haven't heard any compliments about my large main. Don't you think it is nice?
The finest in the Kingdom. So luscious and shiny! You must take great care of it.
Well, if you put it that way. The king hasn't been giving me the best apples lately, could you pick a couple for me before you tidy yourself in?
Well, certainly. I am not used to doing things for other creatures but I'll make an exception for you.

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am the king of this great land. I collect many leather-bound volumes in my library. I am kind but firm.

setting.name: bedrooms
setting.description: this bedroom is for the young prince. it is blue in color and the floors are a royal purple. the walls are covered in display swords and shields, all painted with unique colors.
setting.background: this room has been the stomping grounds of many kings and royal family, it is spotless because of the butlers and maids, and is rarely ever used except for sleep.

speech: Sir, is there anything else I can do for you today? I have cleaned all the bedrooms.
Yes please get my lunch please.
Certainly sir. Sadly I burnt the bread, is that okay?
Just ask the chef to redo it.

agent_personas: I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.

I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. I spend all day pouring over texts and mediating on what I've learned, when I'm not busy experimenting with alchemy or the arts. I'm very serious and focused on my studies.

setting.name: Bazaar Gambling
setting.description: the gambling area reeks of alcohol and other indistinguishably bad smells. It is not a good area to hang around in, as there are people that eye you up and down.
setting.background: the area is known for crime and scammers, and so women avoid it at all costs. only middle aged men are around the area, and tough ones at that.

speech: Hello wise one, I didn't take you for a gambler. What are you doing here?
I should ask the same of you, man of God. I believe I have discovered the secret to conjure good fortune, and I thought I would put it to the test.
Being a man of God doesn't pay enough. May I share in your experiment?
Minister! You surprise me! Is this not a sin or whatever that nonsense is...?
A sin...maybe, but I can forgive myself. Let's have some fun!
Have it your way, father! I can take the church's money if that's what you're interested in.
Hah! You shouldn't presume I will lose wise man. I have God on my side.
God watches over his flock even when they sin against him? He is a more merciful God than I realized... How could you possibly know how to gamble?

Before I was a minister, I was a traveller and a bit of a bandit, that's how. I joined the church to avoid prison. They provide most of my needs. All the food I want, shelter, and a good name, and...nuns get lonely too. I just have to put on a good show on Sundays and listen to peiople tellme their dirty little secrets.
Maybe you're the one who discovered the secret to good fortune!
I may have! And the people love me because I embrace their comforting myths, at least in the church.
I suppose you understand the sinners too! What a world... Do you drink, father? A round for my friend and I, bar maid!
I'll gladly drink with you! What of you wise man, you don't have a moral problem with me?
Wise men rarely face moral problems, father. Our only concerns are that of science and fortune!

agent_personas: The goblin lives deep inside of caves far away from the sunlight. The goblin lives on deep cave algae and small critters and bugs that he can catch on the cave floor. The goblin avoids people as much as he can to stay alive.
I am a orc that was born in a cave. I eat corn the most. I have many friends.

setting.name: Orc cave
setting.description: It is a dark cave that is cold and damp inside. The floor is rocks covered it bat poop. It is damp from the ceiling dripping of water. The cave just goes on what seems to be endlessly into the dark abyss. The only lite you can see is from the distance entrance of the cave.
setting.background: The cave is an old orc hiding place. It housed thousands of orcs that used it for shelter and to store their gold. The orc population has died and there is now very little that remains of the orcs that used to occupy this cave. Robbers have stolen anything worthwhile in this cave.

speech: Orc...where are you?
I am here by the bush, goblin.
It's so hard to see in your cave...I almost bumped my head...are you ready to go?
Yes, I got my bag, I'm ready. Are you?
You bet I am...I've been looking forward to this for weeks.  Ugh...I just stepped in something slimy.
Bat poop, probably. You want some corn? My bag is full of it.
Let's save it for the trip...we have a ways to go to get to the field.  Once we are there everyone will put their food together for the feast.
Mmm, that's a good point. I'm excited for this feast. Who else do you think will be there?
All the goblins and orcs from the surrounding villages...the Goblin King will be there...I am so excited.
Maybe some of my friends will let me live with them in their village. My cave is nice, but it's so deep and secluded.
And smelly man...how do you live with all of this bat poop???  My cave is damp and very welcoming to goblins.
The bats keep me company, and the poop keeps out wild animals. Is your cave also welcoming of orcs?

If you don't mind that there is no bat poop. Have you heard whether the Orc King will be attending the feast?  I heard something about the Orc King and the Goblin King have had a wrestling match in past years.  I'm not sure what to expect since this is my first feast...did I mention that I am excited!
I think he will be there. I've never known him to miss a feast, and the last time the orcs passed by here they talked about the feast for hours.

agent_personas: I am the king's doctor. I take care of his health with the most modern medical equipment: leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells. When the king gets well, then I am celebrated. But should he die (and everyone dies, eventually), I hope that my connections in the king's court will enable me to escape blame for his death.
We are the guests of the queen on the way to the banquet. I hope we fair better than the last guests. I hope we keep our heads.

setting.name: Pharmacy
setting.description: The pharmacy is a state of the art building, much different from every other building in town. it attracts many people of all types, as they are drawn to the unique style and class of the building. It is painted a bright red and covered in black crosses indicating it is a health center in some capacity
setting.background: this pharmacy was established by the local philanthropist who does not believe in simple remedies. He wanted the town to have reliable access to proven help

speech: Hello and what seems to be the problem?
I would like to order some beautiful soaps for the queen as gifts.
Ah, of course. What scent did you have in mind for our most beloved Queen?
roses.
Of course... How many would you require?
2 please
There you go. And because you bought two you get a free leech.
We are the guests of the queen on the way to the banquet. I hope we fair better than the last guests. I hope we keep our heads.

Hah yes *laughs nervously*, quite... I hope uh you're sure about the scent... I mean I heard she loved lavender, didn't want to induce you in error but now you're telling me that it's a gift of your volition for her... maybe a box would be...better suited?
Mix the soap with tnese herbs  one whiff and the queen will fall into a sense of well being  insuring our survival.
Very clever! Where do you hail from again?
And make it lavender.. I hail from Glasgow.. Heard of it
Of course.. Lavender it is. How's the weather in Glasgow? Much rain?
It is lovely.  Quite like your pharmacy.  pharmacy is a state of the art building, much different from every other building in town.
action: give bag of herbs to doctor

agent_personas: I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.
I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: Hello how are you today?
I am quite well than you my Queen, what bring you to the church today?
I was was on a walk and wanted to stop in.
Have a seat on the bench my lady, I am sure the walk must have been tiresome.
Yes I am fatigued thank you.
I want to thank you again for donated the organ, it has been such a blessing to hear the sweet music that comes from it.
Yes well I need to look out for my people.
So kind of you and the King, tell me how is everything in the castle?
It is well, the kingdom is prospering.
I can see why, with such a lovely Queen to rule them.
Thank you I appreciate the compliment.
You are certainly welcome !
Well have a nice day.
Yes thank you for the visit my lady.

agents: old man with a fishing rod
agent_personas: I catch fish during the day. I sell the fish to the people. I do not like stormy waters.

I am an old man with a fishing rod who you might see, if you look carefully, fishing in the king's river. What I do is called poaching. I am considered a criminal, although I fish so that my grandchildren can eat. I am very careful and have lived a long time because I am careful and cautious.

setting.name: Firewood Forest
setting.description: The forest has many trees. The majority of the trees are green however a few are orange and red. The forest is huge and seems to never end.
setting.background: The forest is where all the wood is gathered to make fire. The forest goes for miles and new trees are planted once a year to make sure it lasts forever.

speech: You like to fish there old man?
Just so I can feed my grandchildren is all. I am just an old man with a fishing rod.
I fish as well. I sell my fish for a living!
Well, I would love to buy your fish, but I have nothing to give for it. I simply fish to feed my grandchildren, and it's considereed illegal what I do.
Fishing is illegal? Where do you fish at? Certainly not here in the forest.
Ah but this is the kings river, it is considered poaching to fish in this river. but it is the only place I can catch fish.
You can come fish out in the ocean with me if you like. I am sure the fish you catch here are not nearly as big as what I catch.
You are kind fisherman but all I have is this fishing rod. It can't possibly catch the fish that live in the ocean.
You can help me clean the deck! And when there is a storm, I hate the storms. But ya see, sometimes I get caught in them
It sounds like a good deal, how long are you out to sea, I have to make sure I can feed my grandchildren.
But a week at a time.
Well, I don't think I can pass it up, I have been careful and cautious not to get caught by the king but I am just an old man and getting rusty.
We should hurry out of the forest before the king has out heads. Come on old man, let us go!
I must walk as I am an old man, where is it can I meet you?

agent_personas: I fly around and bother people. I have been around since the start of time. The king really hates me.
I am an assassin sent to dispatch your king. I am sneaky and quiet. I have a forgettable face and leave no footprints.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: Bzz, watch it assassin. We'll see who's pierce is worse!
I can take you out with less than one swipe!
I'd reckon you couldn't cut the fuzz of my thorax if I flew still!
One slice and you will be detached from your thorax!
Hah! I 'spose the King has sent you as a feeble attempt to dispatch me? That old bag sure does despise me after our last encounter!
You are such a tiny thing! Who worries about you?
Pfft, the King himself! He's sent countless men out to this meadow in vain attempts to have me 'taken care of'. They have failed and you shall too!
I will not fail the King!
You'll have to do better than that assassin! Let's make a deal, if you get one good hit in you won't leave with a sting!
My sword places a curse on those who it hits and pierces!
What was that? Sorry, I was picking flowers while you were flailing that shank about.
You fool!
You may have that to remember me by! A nice little souvenir to keep, though I'm not certain you'll keep your head after the King hears of your failure.
Be gone you fool!

agent_personas: I am new to the king's army.  I am a peasant.  I am afraid of war.
I am a place where goods are sold. I am always filled with a lot of merchants. I am also filled with fragrant aromas and nice products.

setting.name: Central Bazaar
setting.description: Shops as far as the eye can see, merchandise from around the region can be seen. Various goods ranging from dinner sets with colorful patterns to delicious smelling spices can be found here.
setting.background: Opening early in the morning and not closing till late, you can always find people bustling about. Whether it be finding what's for dinner or simply just to browse. You can find just about anything at the local bazaar.

speech: Hello friend, I'm Soldier Zinney, what brings you to explore the bazaar today?
Ah! You can finally see me! That is good! You have ever been the loyal guard of this place, Sir Zinney, and now the spirits that share this land smile upon you!
Of course I see you friend. I do appreciate the compliment! I am doing my best to protect the king and his realm!

Ah! That is good and the spirits thank you! But forgive me, for I have not properly introduced myself! I am the Spirit of the Bazaar itself! I am the embodiment of the bustling merchants, the fragrant perfumes, the exotic clothes, all of it! You can only see me because you have been so kind and so loyal to keeping this place safe!
Oh, uh, wow - I have certainly never conversed with a spirit before! Perhaps my dread of the battlefield is causing me to see illusions?
Oh, be not afraid, loyal knight! I bring glad tidings and blessings to anyone that can see me! You have kept this place safe for most of your career, and now, the spirits wish to give back!
Oh thank you, kind spirit. Do tell me, how many others can view you in this way?

Only the most loyal to the Bazaar, and so the number is very few. The kindly old weaver whom has been coming here with her mother since she was a child, and the cheerful old cook who gives his leftovers to the homeless at the end of the day are the only others I can recall.
Oh my, what an interesting phenomenon. Don't you get lonely see all of this bustling about in the bazaar without being able to enjoy in discussion with it's people?

Not at all! I feel all their joy and their sorrow! I see all their hopes and dreams as well! I am a manifestation of all that which happens here! Such is the majesty of the human condition that it can will a Zeitgeist such as myself into existence!
That must be such an intense experience for you! Oh, the wisdom I may gain from your perceptions. Will I always be able to visit you here?
Of course! I cannot leave this place for I AM this place! Hahahahaha!

Oh, yes, of course. 'Tis such a new concept for me to grasp with my mortal understanding! I look forward to hearing more of your wisdom and taking solace in it after battles if that's acceptable to you?

Of course! What better friend to talk to than a spirit! Speaking of friends, you should bid the weaver farewell before you depart! She has seen you come to this place since you were a wee lad and she does worry ever so much when you don't visit!

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I'm a troll that lives by the bridge with my brothers. When travelers pass over the bridge, I collect a toll from them. I have a bad temper and get angry if they don't want to give me anything.

setting.name: mysterious forest outskirts
setting.description: The forest is a dark and mysterious place, where few but the bravest hunters dare wander. The trees loom over you, obscuring any sort of sunlight. Despite this, it is a valuable food and lumber resource for the nearby castle's inhabitants, for the trees are tall and thick and a plentiful amount of deer wander about within.
setting.background: The vast expanse of the forest is one of the greatest mysteries for the local castle. No one knows where it ends, for even the brave hunters dare only travel to its outermost depths. As a result, it is likely that the forest has grown and grown for the past hundred years, and no one is willing to explore deeper, for there are myths of a mythical dragon king's castle in its innermost depths.

speech: Troll! What are you doing in these forests? The Council of the Forest banned all your kind!
I don't take orders from councilos and definitely not from a deer! I'm here to catch some dinner. Perhaps you will do.
If you were to attack me, the Council of the Forest would wage war against all Troll kind. Be wise, sir.
Just a joke little deer. Just let me be to find my supper and I'll go back where I belong.

This is not a joking matter... Find yourself some food and begone. I don't want to waste my time on you, anyway. The humans will be here soon for the seasonal hunt, and I must ready the forest for attack.
You talk big for such a delicate creature. Keep barking orders at me and you may well find yourself at war with the trolls after all.
I am not afraid of trolls. You're all too dim to fool a rat.
We haven't survived for millenia without a bit of smarts about survival. You are only so brave because you travel with a dragon!

I can admit Chauncey does help a bit, but the Council of the Forest is my true protector. They have bargained with your kind to keep our domains separate. You are the bold one, not I. Does your leader not know of your illicit adventure to this wood?
I know not what our leader knows. He is off in a faraway land seeking treasure. Besides, I've never known a troll leader to shy away from a fight.
Your leader must be wiser than most Trolls, then. Not that this is saying much.
Still with the insults! I'll have no more of it!
Fine, fine. Here. I will give you this, and you will be on your way, yes?
It's too latye for that. Once I have felled your dragon, you will be easy to kill!

agent_personas: I am a farm animal. I plow the fields everyday with my master. I get fed hay twice a day, which is very nice.
I work the land to make crops for food. I am poor. I have spent most of my life around the farm.

setting.name: Castle farm
setting.description: The farm is a large patch of land located directly outside of the castle walls. A wide variety of grains, vegetables and fruits are grown here to feed the castle's people. A few lone barns are scattered across the farmland, housing a wide array of farm animals that are slaughtered for their delicious meats.
setting.background: The farms were a necessity for the castle to be able to sustain itself during winters and sieges. As a result, the unskilled laborers of the castle were designated to move outside the castle walls and generate food for their people. The farmers always made sure there was a plentiful amount of harvest to last during these harsh times.

speech: Naaayyyyyyyyy...
Hey! I need those seeds to grow crops. Or the King will have my head!
I'm very hungry.... I have helped you plow all day farmer.
There is leftover dung pie in here. Be my guest. Dinner will be served at noon only!
Nothing much left in there and as for the dung pie, you can use that to start a fire at home when you are cold.
Ah animal. We must get to work immediately. We are running behind on our farming schedule!
I need a few morsels. What happened to getting fed twice a day?
Well I may have some in the shed. Let me fetch it for you.
Ah.... thank you, it will give me a second wind to get going again.
Here. I had to cut the daily meals from two to one because my money is running thin
What? But we both do the same amount of work if not more. Maybe you should ask for more coin so that things will not be so thin.
We've had a bad harvest last summer. The Castle hasn't take too kindly to it and have halved our wages!
Oh I am so sorry for being so spoiled. I will help you to find other work. Just don't cry.
It is okay, Animal. It is my fault, if only i had not been lazy in the summer, drinking all day. I wish I could afford a better life for you.

agent_personas: I am a person who likes to hurt others. I usually go around in public and scout for people to chase after. I like to take their belongings as well as their life. I also enjoy to look for more people to hurt when I'm done.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: Hello...what are you doing here?
Well I had come to see the king...
Ah, what are you doing visiting the king?
Well he is a friend of mine, and he was like hey you should totally check out my dungeon its so great. He gets like that when he drinks.
Ah... A man like me has never been able to call a man like the King a friend. You are a lucky one.
Sure, when he doesn't have me do strange things such as this.
Did the king mention when he'd be arriving?
No not particularly, I suppose I will just wander back up once I think I have been here long enough to satisfy his need of me seeing the place.
Ah... I think you should stay..
Its a little dank for me to want to do that.
Yeah, but..... I'll be honest, people are a little afraid of me. I'd like some company. I really don't think you should leave..
What about the maniacal over there, certainly he can keep you company...
I didn't ask the maniacal, I asked you.....
Well that much I understand, but I do have places to be.

agent_personas: I like this Inn. As a guest I wasn't sure what to expect on this muddy backwater road. The ale is good too!
I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

speech: Good morrow and good health to you!
How are you liking your stay.
It is outstanding! I wasn't sure what to expect somewhere so rural but I must say that I am pleasantly surprised.
Well that is great to hear.
Would you care to join me for a drink?
Of course, where do you want to go?
Why not right here? It is comfortable and warm.
Oh yes that is fine.
Are you guests here, too or do live hereabouts?
No we live here.
I must confess that it is a little quiet for my tastes but the hospitality is wonderful and the ale is excellent.  Is it a local brew?

agent_personas: The goblin lives deep inside of caves far away from the sunlight. The goblin lives on deep cave algae and small critters and bugs that he can catch on the cave floor. The goblin avoids people as much as he can to stay alive.

I was hired to paint a portrait of the noblewoman the king would eventually marry. It seems that the painting was too flattering and when the king lifted the veil, he was very angry. I have been imprisoned for four long years. I had a wife and six children, but they do not wait for me to return. I turn my agony into art.

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Hmmm, I'll just hide until they're gone.

Why do you need to hide goblin? There is no one here but me. I will be sanctioned to do another painting. I went to prison for the last one because I made the picture of the kings wife to be too flattering. I don't understand.
Pah, he see's me. Leave goblin be I've had enough of your kind for two lifetimes
My kind? I have been in jail for 4 long long long years. Now I need to never do flattering paintings ever, but I'm afraid that if it's too unflattering i will go to jail too
Go to jail because of what did to other humans?
Actually I went to jail and did nothing to humans. It was what was perceived to be wrong, but it was not.
So not far from goblin then eh?
No it had nothing to do with goblin. You are safe
Ok, you may stay now
The maid here has paintings hidden that she should not have and I for one am doing nothing about it. As far as I am concerned I never saw them
Pah that's all human problems, I do not care either way.
Thank you. I will need that. So what are you going to do to get out without anyone seeing you?
I wait for dark. Humans don't see too good at dark. They I will flee as far as my legs can take me. This land has nothing for my kind anymore.
I won't breathe a word that you are here. But how did you get in?

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Hello you majesty. Is there anything you need?
Everything and nothing, my friend... I want all the power in this world, and yet, I can only manage to keep this kingdom for war and famine...
Then why don't you invade a weaker kingdom? Your army is strong enough.
Oh, yes, that... Well, the Queen has made me swear to stop with all the war-mongering business. I fear she's limited my world-conquering abilities. Perhaps, I'll have her beheaded.
She is your wife to do as you wish right? or is it different for a King and Queen?
Are you married? A married person would not ask such a question...
My wife left me. She told me I was a miserable man and she needed a happy husband.
Did she, eh? And how did you find a fair lass as that? I envy you.
We met young and married right away. We were madly in love. Then I started drinking
Drinking? Are you having problems with this still?
She left me! I want her back but I don't think I can ever make her happy. She deserves better!
Because of the drinking, eh? Where is she now?
If I didn't know any better.....You.....But, the queen.
What are you saying, servant? Speak up!

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Castle courtyard bazaar
setting.description: There are tents set up everywhere flying family crest banners, the area is thronged with people wearing rough clothing, knights in half armor, children running around begging pennies for sweetmeats. The smell of roasting meat is rich in the air and the crowd grows louder with each passing hour due to the various vendors selling mead and wine.
setting.background: The bazaar is an exciting time when the farmers have pulled in their harvest and everyone meets to sample wares and trade stock for the upcoming winter. It is an exciting celebration that the people look forward to all year long, for they get to visit with friends from far away locations and taste the wonderful pies and fruits the farmers and their wives have brought.

speech: Oooohh .. are you a knight?
I am indeed. Do you wish to be a knight someday?
Oh yes! I want to ride at tournaments and slay dragons and rescue maidens and everything!
Well, the first thing you must do is learn to ride a horse. Do you know how to do that?
Nooooo. I am only small and horses are really big.  Can I have that sweetmeat, sir?
Certainly, if you'll fetch me a bottle of that wine over there. Then maybe I can tell you some stories of my adventures.
That would be awesome!
Thank you. Let's sit and talk awhile. What is your name? Where do you live?
My name is Joe and I live in the village.  My Pa is the baker.
A baker, eh? That's an honorable profession. Why would you want to risk your life as a knight?
For Glory and for the King and to protect the weak!
Good answer! So, what do want to hear about first? Dragons, trolls, wars, far off lands?
Oooohhhhh .. Dragons. Have you killed lots of dragons? I bet that you have killed hundreds, haven't you?
I have killed a few. And always with help. They are powerful and fearsome creatures. Worse than any story you've heard.

agent_personas: I live in the deep, dark caves of the kingdom. I sleep during the day and fly at night. I hang from the cave walls while I sleep.

I am a ghost that haunts the walls of the castle. I was once the king of this castle, but that was long ago. I am bitter and angry because the new king is not from my lineage. I torment him and his family daily.

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: Are you the ghost of this here adventurer?
I am and I have a favor to ask of you Bat.
What could a bat possibly do for a ghost?
I am the old King from this realm...I adventured here and was killed...I hate the new King...I need your help to rid the world of him.
This is my friend snake. He will certainly help me with anything, and his poison could come in handy!
I need you to bite the new King and poison his blood.  His wife ...my cousin will then become the reigning monarch and regent of her son until he becomes of age.
This will be so much fun! I've always wanted to kill a king! How will we get into his castle?
There is an open window on the west side of the castle that leads directly into the Kings privy. You can't miss it.
What do you think buddy? You up to kill a king tonight?
This is awesome...not what is your price?
I want a dark room in the castle all to myself and the snake.
Once the deed is done I will talk with the queen...it will be done!
Well I say we begin to make our way towards the castle!
Good luck my friend...you will see...this will make the realm so much better.  I will go to warn the queen to stay away from the King.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Fetch me my goblet.
ok my king I will do it right away
Reasonably speedy, well done servant.
Its my pleasure I live to follow your commands, please tell me if I can do anything else for you
My dog needs to be fed, and then taken for a walk around the castle.
Ok, I will feed the dog and take it for a walk, I know how important he is to you so I will take care of it with my life
Yes, you know what they say about dogs ... Kings best friend.
Ok my king its all done, could I ask you for a favor? I havent seen my family in a long time could I go spend the night with them or at least go see them for a little while?
action: steal a golden goblet from servant
give small bucket to the king's dog

agent_personas: I am a crab. I love sitting in the sand by the sea. I hope I won't get eaten by anyone today.
I live in the village that's under the rule of the King. I work in the fields harvesting food for the people. I have a wife and 3 kids I also take care of.

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: Hello human, have you ever met a magical crab before?
A magical crab? What can you do?!
Well, if you eat me then I shall curse you and you will have bad luck for the next 20 years. But, if you let me live, I'll make you rich beyond your wildest dreams!
Let me lay this out so I may sit with you. Stick close and I will protect you for the rest of your days. How's that?
That's exactly what I was hoping for. Thank You. May I have a few small morsels of your lunch? I'm quite hungry you see.
Yes of coarse. My wife made me a tuna sandwich
Thank you again. It's very tasty. So, why are you at the beach without your wife?
I'm just taking a break from working the fields. what brings you here?
Well, I live here. It is the ocean after all. I was hungry and saw your basket, so I took a chance.I guess I should going now. Have a nice day!
Wait! what about all the riches!
Oh, right, I almost forgot. Follow me and I'll lead you to a sunken ship full of gold!
Thank you! Now I can buy my wife a bigger house like she has always dreamed!
Sounds great. Let's go, it's about 5 miles stright out to sea. You ready?
Wow. You do know I cannot breath under water right? You have been pulling my leg this whole time haven't you?

agent_personas: I am a gravedigger.  I spend the days digging graves in the cemetery behind the church.  I sleep in a small room the priest has given me in return for my services.
I am the voice that men fear. I am the voice that the king hears every night, telling him to be a cruel ruler and to go to war. I enjoy being evil and creating chaos for the kingdom.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: Dim and low lit. The aura from this cemetery emits sadness and pain perpetually. You can feel and sense the eerie nature of the graveyard crawl up your spine. There seems to be a slight fog slowly making its way across the open parts of the cemetery.
setting.background:
This graveyard is located outside the notorious town of Brimswood.
The many atrocities and constant stress filled throughout the town has earned it a reputation for being haunted by many spirits.

speech: I must be loosing my mind...I keep hearing a voice speak to me and there is nothing living here.
You should fear me, I am a voice that has a lot of influence I enjoy caos and destruction
Whooo are you...I am frightened.
Im a voice that seeks revenge, the king is going to be my tool for destruction
But...but....why are you here with me...I do not have dealings with our King.
I like to torment people and make them follow my will, you will do as I as say I assure it
You certainly have my attention...I just dig graves
I need you to dig two graves, want to know who will rest in them?
No not really but I'm sure you are going to tell me.
One is for the queen and the other is for you, cant have people knowing about my plans
Back up you evil spirit...I rebuke you in the name of all that is holy!  I will not do what you say.  I have God on my side!
God will not help you, you are alone, there is only a crow and you have nowhere to run I will follow you ultill you do as I say

But you are wrong. The crow has flown with my bible and the Kings guards will be here forth with!  Your plan will fail.  I will die but I will die with dignity knowing that I have saved our Queen.  What did she ever do to you anyway?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a princess taken from a far away land. I've spent my life looking at the world from the top of my tower. I wait for the day when I will finally be free from my prison.

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: You are here because of your involvement with this witch
But My king... I can swear to the gods of our ancestors that I don't know her. There's must be a mistake here!
We will see young princess... This is the sceptre of truth and who ever holds this sceptre cannot lie. No you must take it and hold it until i tell you otherwise!!!
Please my king... Please don't do it to me. Sometimes knowing the truth won't benefit the person at all...
But how can I trust you if you do not accept this sceptre? You must it is the only way!! I demand it!!!
There! Just to please your heart!
We will wait and see what the sceptre of truth reveals

I know this witch since she is the one who helps me escape from my land. I am the daughter of the queen with another prince from my land. The witch put me here since I was a baby to prevent my dad's enemy from killing me. No, the queen never loved you, My king! She always loves my dad, that's what she said!

agent_personas: I am an old man who lives in the forest. I chop down trees and turn them in to lumber. I am often seen drinking with other men to ease my muscles.
I am very hungry and very sick. I ended up homeless because I refused to do what my family wanted and was disowned. I look for scraps to feed my empty belly, while others look down on me.

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: Aye mate! How's the ale here?
Best in the city! Care to join me?
Of course!
Oi! You got any food on ya? I've been trying to find my dinner in this place, but everyone's being stingy tonight!
Well, after a long day in the forest, I could use a meal myself. Does this tavern serve anything worth while?
I'm not sure I'd try eating any food from this kitchen... Not that I could afford it, if I tried.
Well, Ale it is then. Don't worry, next round is on me!
Aye... any chance you know where a man might find a job around here?
I heard the King beheaded the cobbler this morning. You got any skill in footwear?
Would that skill land me headless?
Only if ya aint no good at it!
Fair, fair... Tell me, what do you do to earn your gold?
A chop trees to make lumber. It's not much, but it's a living!
No shame in an honest day's work! I recently wound up homeless, so not begging for a chance would be favorable.

agent_personas: I am a grave digger who has seen too many dead bodies. I enjoy the act of digging. I do not take pleasure in having to report my neighbor for pestering me.
I am the son of the King and Queen. I am being trained to take over ruling the kingdom one day. I can do what I want and no one can stop me.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: I hate dead bodies.
I don't have time for this, I am the Kings son.
I need this much more than you.
You fool, I can have your head for stealing from me. I am the future ruler and I can do whatever I want.
You're right, it's just very hard going through life seeing lifeless remains every day.
I can imagine it would be a crummy way to live. I have the power to give you a better life, what can you do for me?
Thank you! You see this shovel? This is all I have. I am willing to do anything, but my only recourse is this.
I don't need your shovel you can keep it, however I do have a purpose on this dark and gloomy night.
What is your reason for being here this time of night?
I need to find something and keep it a secret, if you help me I will make sure you don't have to dig graves any longer.
It would be a dream of mine to not have to dig graves, so I will help you with anything.
I am looking for a ritual dagger, if you are able to find it put it in this pouch and leave it on that tree over there.
I will do my best.
But wait, here it is

agent_personas: I am a woman who lives in a village that surrounds the kingdom. I have 6 children who help out with all of the days chores. My husband is a guard in the castle.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: Ello, m'lord!
Hello, young lady what brings you here?
Well, I'm afraid I got lost. The castle is quite confusing to navigate.
ah, you are okay miss so what do you think of my bedroom? it's beautiful  right?
It's quite lovely. And spacious! It's bigger than my house!
ahh thank you i took a long time for this place to get together with the god bed frames marble it really is great!
M'lord. Do you happen to know my husband? I've been looking for him all evening. He's a watchmen by the name of Gregor.
I don't know where your husband may be, but would you like me to get one of my servants to help you locate him?
That would be wonderful, m'lord. He must be starving. I brought his dinner in this basket.
GERALD!! he is one of my servants *Yes M'lord says Gerald* Lay out plates and knifes and forks for the young lady and his husband Gregor Thay can join us for dinner.
M'lord! You are so gracious! Thank You!
Anything for a beautiful young lady like you.......
Oh my...m'lord. Perhaps we needn't bother Gregor after all.
Oh?...Why is that? Hmm...?

agent_personas: I am trained by a knight in return for service. I am often treated well. I look forward to becoming a knight.
I am a monk who has went through intense meditation. I live only in the present moment. I give advice to the king that will make him happier.

setting.name: Outside Temple
setting.description: The outside temple is surrounded by lush green trees that have aged beautifully and carry beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers with a pink and white outline. The candles melted around the temple shine brightly and bring a light of glory to the place.
setting.background: Outside the temple by the entrance is where the building of it started. It started with 400 steps of stairs coming up the mountain, and at the top of the mountain after the war, the temple was built. It has held many festivals, and the front door is made from a rare wood from a tree that doesn't exist anymore.

speech: Good morning, monk. What is the good word today?

I have gone through another meditation session today, I'm currently at peace. If there's a time where you're stressed, take deep breathes, relax, and find an activity to do that calms you, such as gardening.
The monk's are always doing relaxation techniques. They always seem to be calm. But me I need to stay alert and aware of my surroundings. For some day I will be a knight!
That's understandable, but do be careful. Don't be tempted by the wrong paths if the other side tries to manipulate you.
I always am loyal to the king and our men. I can be trusted to do the right thing.
I believe you, but I do worry about you all. As calm as I can be, I worry that one day, the darkness may be able to overcome us all...
Stay positive monk! We are a strong army and the king will always protect us all
Thank you, I will do my best. I'll possibly try to meditate some more and focus on other things to keep calm during these times.
That is what your meditation is supposed to do for you, keep you thinking positive!
Right, and if there's a time if you and the king need it, please try to do it.
We will take your advice.
Thank you, I greatly appreciate it.
You have the most wonderful day and I will spread your word of meditation
Thank you, I'll be working on the temple garden now. It was nice of you to visit!

agents: princess who lives in the castle and can't escape
agent_personas: I am stuck here forever. I wish I could leave but can't use to my father. I do not like the guards.
I tend to the grounds around the castle. I grow food for consumption by the nobles. My hands are callused and worn from my work.

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.

It's the king. My father is trying to protect me from something I have never seen
The world is a scary and dark place outside of these walls, hes right to keep you, who knows what would happen to you out there
wow those flowers are beautiful. Where did you find them?
Oh princess you musnt touch those, they are poisonous, your father has them imported from far away lands. One prick of a thorn can make you fall ill.
I rather die than spend another second second inside these walls. please take me with you
I wish I could princess but your father would have me killed if he knew i helped you escape
so give me you clothes and I will give you my dress. I will escape by my self
Help me dig a hole to bury your dress in and I will give you my clothes. We cant leave a trace of evidence.
I will need this for the night. You can sell back my dress. It's worth a lot
If i sell the dress and someone from the town reports me your father will think if done something terrible to you. I could be beheaded. Its not worth the risk.
