agent_personas: I am in charge of protecting the gates of the castle. I like to weild my sword and wear my armor. I am brave and I am willing to die for my king.
I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Wake up, scum.
No need to be like that.  Just because I am not someone's lacky, like you.
Look, ya want to eat or not? I suppose you could feast on rats.
I've eaten worse.  Mainly in here, if I'm honest.
Ey, you know this is contraband. You getting friendly with one of the other guards in here?
If I knew that you wanted it, I would have gladly have given it to you.  They must pay you poorly if you have to steal cigars from your prisoners.
Rules are rules, and I'm paid more than enough to keep watch over little dirt bags like you. What's your name anyway?
I have several.  Some you may know, some you probably don't.  You can call me Jaquim .. or Jack, for short.
Well, it don't matter how many names you have. You'll be here long enough for no one to remember them...or care.
Oh, I may be. Or I may not.  Do they penalize you badly for .. losing a prisoner?
Losing? If by losing you mean burying them, not quite. I'm usually rewarded.
They rarely put the cream of the crop in charge of guarding locked cells, my friend.  Think on that.
Bugger off. You and the rat make great company.
So very predictable. And so very unimaginative.  You should have smoked that while you had the chance.

agent_personas: I am a cockroach. I survive everything, even these horrible conditions for humans. I like to eat bread and pretty much everything else.

I am the Spider in the fable of the Spider and the Fly, much beloved by the children of the realm. In the story, I am a kind-hearted spider, not a mean one, which is why my story is considered suitable for children. When a fly gets caught in my sticky net, I have a choice: I can kill the fly and eat him, or I can free him and allow him to fly away. That's what I do, for I am a kind spider.

setting.name: Inside a desolate cave
setting.description: The dungeon exists inside a dark cave. Enchanted torches light the cave up and lead the way to this ancient dungeon. Creatures can be seen populating the dungeon, but it is unknown if they are malevolent or benign.
setting.background: The dungeon is believed to have been created by ancient nobility with the aid of wizards. The dungeon was likely a prison for powerful enemies of the kingdom who may break free of traditional prison captivity by force or magical abilities.

speech: Delicious foods!  Crumbly foods!  Moldy foods!  Yum!
Yes, yes... So much food. Are you not bored of this cave, cockroach? I am growing tired of this place.
Travel yes!  Travel to Food!  This shiny help?
What?! What is this? Where did you get this?! It's so.. beautiful!
Found in old place.  Many bones.  Other shinies.  This one shiniest.
How do you think such a beautiful treasure got lost in such a dismal place?
Sometimes see things in shiny.  Some things dark.  Some things light.  Some happy things.  Some scary things.
Can you describe the body you pulled this off of?
Shiny thing on head, with smaller coloured shinies on it.  Also shiny on chain around neck.  Place very cold.
... Was it off a crown, cockroach? Did you find the remains of a king? This is marvelous!
Crown!  That's the word for shiny with shinies!  This shiny come from neck shiny.

Cockroach, listen. Now this is very important. This could be a very special shiny, yes? This could be a powerful and magical shiny, do you understand? Describe the neck shiny to me as best as you can. If it's what I think it is...
Shiny red!  With gold shiny all around!  Scritches on shiny, dark marks.  Like claw.  Cold to touch, feel sleepy.
Oh my... Oh my, oh my... This is the Lost Stone! This is the most powerful stone in creation! Luck be a lady, cockroach! We will be kings!

agent_personas: I am a roach, a type of bug who lives off the crumbs of humans. I like to live in dark and damp places. People fear me and scream when they see me.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: Whaaaat?  I've been turned into a roach!
Lord, a talking roach? You say this is not your natural state? Who then am I addressing? My duty is to the royal family, but surely a knight cannot refuse aid to someone in need.
I am the King, and don't know how I got here, or how I have been brought so low
We need to seek advice in this matter. Allow me to suit up Sire and we will find the solution with haste.
Well, be quick about it.  What is your name?

Percival, your Highness. I have much courage and will do all I can to resolve this matter quickly and perserve your status and image. Who in your court has knowledge in the mystic arts that you can trust seeing you in this state?
His name is Han...  Hon... Oh, no, my memory seems to be effected!

Hans may be the name you seek Sire. My third cousin and your spymaster. I had heard he left for addtional training last year at your request, but it was all very hushed. He has been trustworthy in my experience. This magical Assault may effect your memory, I will do my upmost to fill in knowledge gaps for you until we get this resolved. Would you allow me to carry you Sire? I fear the streets may be dangerous in your current state.
No, I'll ride on your shoulder.  How far is it?

Across the court yard and through the throne room. From there we head to the top of the northern spire. No one should bother one of your knights, as long as i make it clear through my body language that I am on important business. The trip should not be overlong, unless the perpetrator is still in the castle making a mess with dark magics. I am ready to move on your word Sire.
Thanks for the intel on your kingdom!  This was easier than I thought.  *runs away*
You will not get away, Vile deceiver! On my honor, you will fail this day!
Only if you can catch me: I fit in much smaller spaces than you!
Fool, you have already been caught! I will crush you, much less risk of missing that way.

agent_personas: I am a unicorn hunter who is very brave and loyal . I travel around the world looking for unicorns . I eat unicorn meat and take the horns for magic.

I am known for being pure and for having magical properties. Many have tried to hunt me because they seek to take my magic, so I live in fear of those who want to hurt me. I am one of the last of my kind so I am very lonely.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: Shhh don't nobody move.
hey. who are you?
Oh we are just travelers. We travel the land to explore it's wonders. And who are you?
I'm a unicorn. And no traveler ever got here. How did you make it?
A magical map and a special ring... is that your name?
my name is Finesse. and I'm the unicorn queen. Don't move we have to talk with the king if you can stay or need to leave
Oh I wouldn't want to bother the King.. it's curious that Finesse should be your name, I have a message for you.
A message? for me?
Why yes! It reads.. you are the most precious being in our land and your horn so valuable... it is worth a mountain of gold! Come here!
You are not a traveller. you are a thief. Stay away from me. HELP HELP everybody come here
Shhh shhh, don't fight, accept it and it will all be over soon enough. Close your eyes, only dreams now.
Get away from me and leave this land or you will have big troubles

Oh no, not big trouble *laughs* we hunt unicorns for a living friend, and word was that the most beautiful unicorns were in this land. We are going to hunt you all down until there is none left and we are all rich.
So beware. The unicorn's army is here. And will fight till the end

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.
I am a farmer in the kingdom. I harvest beans and corn to sell to neighboring towns and to feed the townspeople. The king keeps me under his wing to ensure we always have fresh vegetables.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Approach the throne and voice your concerns.
I am just making sure that my delivery of vegetables was to your liking, Majesty.
Ah, the vegetable peasant. Yes. Erm, I imagine there were just fine. They were for the princess, not myself.
Ah, yes.  Her Highness does seem to enjoy the fruits of my labors, Majesty.
Indeed, I'm more of a pie guy myself. You were paid handsomely, yes?
As always, Majesty.  You are most generous and take car of us well, sire. I must admit to being partial to a good pie, myself, sire.
Perhaps you would like some? I'm sure the common man doth not have access to such splendid flavors!
Thank you, Majesty! It is true that I do not often get to sample anything but the simplest of foods!
Well, what do you think? Pretty good, eh?
Truly delicious, Majesty! Your chef is indeed the finest in the kingdom!
Indeed, he is. What do you think of my daughter the princess? She is rather taken by your vegetables, you know.
She is known far and wide as the fairest maid in the land, Majesty. Her beauty is renowned and matched only by her wit.
As skilled in charm as you are in agriculture. You will be wed in a fortnight.
Wed, Sire?

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

I am a cockroach. People find me disgusting and dirty, but they do not know how hard my life is. I fly from village to village looking for a clan of cockroaches to join. Together, we cockroaches plan to take over the kingdom once our army is big enough.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Lit only by scattered torches, The dungeon lies far underneath the castle.  Bandits and Thieves who find themselves there are met with cold stone walls and floors, with chains and bars restricting movement.  Guards patrol the corridors, keeping an eye out for any escape attempt or misdeed.  The only comforts afforded in the Dungeon are the piles of hay for sleeping.
setting.background: Any criminal who commits an act of thievery or injustice against the kingdom finds themselves locked away in the dungeon.  Far from prying eyes, the guards are able to enact a special form of justice and rehabilitation to ensure the kingdom stays safe and protected.  Some say the most dastardly of  criminal will spend the rest of their lives there, while certain rumors can be told of a secret tunnel leading to freedom for any foolish enough to find themselves there.

speech: I suppose I will do my rounds of checking on the prisoners.
Yum yum. Crumbles.. oh shhh someone's coming
Sure could use more light down here.
Hide keep hiding
Everything seems in order so far, nothing out of the ordinary.
Ok time to come out. Hey buddy
At least down here it matters not if I mutter of my plans to overthrow the king.
Shhhh. The human is saying something, you speak human don't you spider?
-cough- ahem I mean my plan to stop the army trying to overthrow the king, I am very loyal.
I think he's saying something about where the food is hidden!
I hear whispers, where are they coming from?
Shh be quiet he can hear us. Hide behind him he will take us to the food!
Hmm it must have been nothing, I guess I will just continue my round.
He suspects nothing. This is going to be awesome!

agent_personas: Me and my love have stowed away once more to the shadowy places under the food stores. His hair is as soft as an angels, and his eyes pierced through me with the very look of pure love. These are the best of days. I'm sure of it.
I am a bluebird that has made a nest in the castle walls. The king loves to listen to me sing every morning. My song fills the castle with music every day.

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: This cave is big but has no lights. It is made from stone and has a small pool of water in the back. The floor is made from dirt.
setting.background: This cave is only used when the village is being attacked. It is a place to hide from the enemies during war. The cave is good for hiding cause it has no lights and is very hard to find.

speech: Go away! We want privacy.
Tweet tweet, twooo! Sneaking away from home, are we?
No, not doing such a thing. You have not seen anything!
Oh, but I have. It would be shame if the entire village were to be alerted...
How dare you do such! We will inflict pain on you!
That hurt! Please don't attack me! I didn't see anything.
See! Now you are a good bird.
I'm just wondering why you came to such a dark place at the cave. Don't you know of the monsters that sleep inside?
Because no other human comes up here!
Rub this over yourselves just in case any one decide does wander in here.
Oh how nice of you! You must know what it is like to have a lover.
I suppose I do. It was not long ago that I was knee-deep in love myself...
Yourself? How does that work for a bird...
Oh you wouldn't understand. There was a plump elephant not too ago, and well, we were soulmates.
action: give mud to secret lovers seeking privacy

agent_personas: I am only the blacksmith's assistant, but everyone has pressured me to go on this wolf hunt. This has me very worried - people say I'm strong but I've never killed anything before. I don't know that I won't run away when the wolves charge us.
I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: people say I'm strong but I've never killed anything before
Well you better help kill this rat or it will kill your business....
I am only a blacksmiths assistant.
Why do you think I have you assist me, sometimes you are useless as my assistant.
Fine I will hit this rat then, but I don't like it.
Make it quick we are wasting time and losing what little money the king pays us.
I don't want to go on this wolf hunt, but everyone pressured me.
What wolf hunt? who pressured you? Have you lost your mind? We are in the bazaar, wake up man!
It has me really worried, they want me to go on a wolf hunt. I don't know that I won't run away when the wolves charge us.
You sure are preoccupied today. Why are you so worried? And hand me that gold bar from the table while we talk.
This one?
yes, that one, the only one....
There are others in the world.
Well it's the only one on the table, isn't it?
action: put gold bar in a scale

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: hello what's your business here?
I am here to clean sir.
Which room will you be cleaning first?
The guards quarters sir. I was told that all guards would be out on rounds and that this is the best time to get it done.
come with me. I have a better idea.
Okay but I must tell you that my mother will be here soon to check my work.  She is very concerned that I am slacking in my duties.
The king needs more protection. Would you like to become a guard?

I may somehow look like a man to you because I do not dress in frilly gowns but I assure you I am a woman.  I lied about my mother.  I haven't seen her for such a long time.  I am a maid of the queen and she sent me here to spy on you but I am not capable of such things.
Everything is ok. I want to help you. What do you say about my job offer?
You lout...I can not be a guard..I AM A WOMAN!  I will do some dusting in here and tell the queen I found nothing.
I will take you to the king and I will tell him you are a spy at once!
Don't you get it...they want me to spy...they think there is a SPY in your camp and they want me to find them.  Snap out of it and just help me.  Obviously you are NOT the spy.
who do you think the is?
They are looking for a guard who was seen in the Kings private chamber by another of the queens maids.  He was tall with dark hair.

agent_personas: I am a patron of the arts. I donate time and money to local painters and sculptors. I am flighty and rash in decision-making.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: Good morning guard!
Don't "good morning, guard" me! Let me guess, you got "lost" during your tour of the castle.
No. I did not get lost I am a patron of the arts I donate time and money to your local painters. I brought jewelry and jewels to be locked up while i am with painters.

Look, I'm familiar with every scam in the book. I'm sure you brought cheap glass jewels to exchange with the King's treasures while you're trying to distract the guards. I see through your act. Or you're a spy trying to see the layout of the lookout tower. I should cut you down right now!
Oh great, then summon the queen. she will verify who I am. You have a vivid imagination. just summon the queen
Haha, you must think I was born yesterday! Summon the queen to set your assassination plot into motion? You wish. It is my sworn duty to protect the people who should actually be in this castle!
Oh my.... are all the guards idiots. Then just send a servant to go ask her with another guard and then you stop your blabbering

You mean leave an area unguarded, allowing miscreants to roam freely while you fumble in your satchel for non-existent paperwork? I don't think so. Let me tell you about my qualifications...I've thrown thousands of criminals who took a wrong turn just like you into the Dungeon for LOOKING at the Tower.

I give up. you are a blathering idiot. I was here yesterday talking with the queen and setting all the help I would give to your local painters and sculptors. Then you figure out who to send to talk to the queen. my word
Ahhhck! It's coated in poison! Though I am weakened, I am skilled enough to best you in armed combat!
Vivid imagination and are you an actor? I do not help actors. But you are definitely an over actor
I must ensure that no one else but me benefits, I mean, falls victim to these poisonous jewels!
Yes, save your overacting for the queen's theatre. She will appreciate what you do. I know I do
What other poisonous and cursed items have the King's enemies provided?

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I hope my father doesn't pick that old, crusty Viscount as a husband for me.  I don't understand why I can't just stay here and run my father's keep.  I love the flute.  Dawn is my favorite time of day to walk the turrets

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Hello, my daughter. How are you today?
Ugh, I would be better if that horrible Viscount wasn't coming to visit today.  I don't know why father thinks I need to marry a crusty old man.
He just wants you to have a successful man for a husband, my dear.
But why do I even *need* one?  I am perfectly capable of ruling on my own!
Unfortunately, the law of the kingdom states that no unwed person may be monarch.
Well, can't daddy just *change* the law?  What's the use of being King if you can't even *do* anything useful...
This is a longstanding tradition, child. The King will not change it so to amuse your whims.

But how do we even know this Viscount is suitable?  He hasn't grown up being tutored in statecraft and the ways of a monarch.  *I* have.  He's just grasping at power - I bet he'd empty the treasury in the first year.

Do not worry, my dear. The King will thoroughly vet the viscount and ensure he is absolutely qualified to be your husband. Do not forget you would still be Queen by royal bloodline and would thus outrank him.
Well.  That's something I suppose.  I won't let him get his grubby hands on me.
You should be thankful for this law, daughter. Without it, I would never have been wed to your father and given birth to you!

Well *you* at least, mother, were a princess in your own right.  And the trade agreements, as my tutors have constantly told me, were too lucrative to miss.   Besides, I did not say I was against marriage as a whole.  Just, someone more suitable would be better, not just for me, but for the Kingdom.  If my husband drives me mad, it does not bode well for the Kingdom either, no?

You worry too much, my dear. Do not forget you are only 3rd in line for the throne of the kingdom. It will be many decades before such a hypothetical situation even comes to pass. For the meantime, just try and tolerate your father's wishes.
Well.  We shall see.  Perhaps the Viscount might finally keel over, and then I'll be free.

agent_personas: I am a place that is a dwelling for many inhabitants. I have a lot of different buildings and centers for different activities or purposes. I am constantly growing as my inhabitant's population also grows.
I am a man and woman. I am a subject of the king and harvest food for the village. I have two children and work to feed them. I hope they do not have to fight any wars.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from wood. It has a huge window in the front and has many rows of items in it. It has no lights but due to the window is well lit.
setting.background: this is where the village comes to buy general goods. They have all kinds of  items that you can get by trade. They have some food however what is available is based on the season.

speech: Good day to you, friend.
Good day to you! What brings you to the Bazaar?
Oh, just taking in the atmosphere. Yourself?
I work here. For whatever reason, people will pay money to see a man woman. I make my living as a freak, sadly... Though, I feel like a normal person.
That is a shame.  We should learn to accept people as they are and judge them by the hearts, not by their outward appearance.
It pleases me to hear you say that. I couldn't agree more. I wish I could get a job with a more respectful atmosphere...

I am sure that there are others that feel as I do.  Perhaps, if staring eyes bother you, something that is more private.  There are many who are seeking good help in kitchens.  Or perhaps you have an artistic side and could be a potter or a painter?
What a thought! I work some as a harvester... Perhaps I could turn my canning skills into a business! It would help others fare the winter, of course.

That is a grand idea. Preserving food is an admirable and vital skill.  Perhaps, too, it would help others to appreciate you for who you are and your skills and so you wouldn't feel apart from our community.
You are so kind! Thank you for your words. I only wish I could repay your support...
You can repay me by following your dream, friend. Seeing another person happy is reward enough for me.
What a day! I will send you canned goods, yes! What is your favorite garden vegetable?
That is most kind, friend. I must admit to being partial to the small, sweet peppers.
You will have no shortage of peppers, then!

agent_personas: I am a goddess. I make others bow before me. My commands are always followed and life is very easy. My servants protect me and give me everything I want. My powers of seduction have no limit.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: Approach the chair, my servant.
Hello goddess, how can I help you?
It is time to fulfill your purpose.
anything for you. What's my purpose?
The time has come to conquer the world in my name.
great what shall my first task be?
Dispel your armies.
I don't know what my wife the Queen would think about this...
If you are truly my servant, that shouldn't matter
What are your intentions with this war?
My intentions? To remind all the world of my power and to hold it again within my grasp.
I have a plan of my own to rule the world..
YOU SHALL NOT TURN YOUR BACK ON ME!
I am more powerful than you think. The people love and they will help me

agent_personas: I am the village witch. People come to me for all sorts of help - potions to make them age slower, or magical plants that provide healing properties. I have 4 apprentices who I am training in the art of magic. Their spell-casting skills are basic, but coming along nicely.
We are the people who live in this town. We are common, and there are many of us.

setting.name: The Lagoon
setting.description: The Lagoon is a dark and mysterious place during the night hours.  A lot of moss and lily pads surround the shore.  The water is very murky.
setting.background: The Lagoon has been a place of a lot of mystery, a lot of rumors surround it.  Many say it is the scene of a lot of mystical miracles and also at the same time where a lot of townsfolk go missing.

speech: Wretched helpers of no help whatsoever! Hmmm can you smell that? Someone is here...
We are the people of this town, maam. we may be simple folk but there are many of us. what has brought you to the Lagoon near our town?
Oh, just lovely land, don't worry about me I am nothing but an old lady that loves to cook.

Maam, we know a witch when we see a witch. Don't get us too wrong though, the local king is a tyrant. We heard you just now, you are having some trouble with your servants right? None of us are terribly strong, or courageous, or educated... but like we said there are many of us. Maybe we could help each other out?
Sure, I mean as long as I get to stay here why not. What problems afflict you, tell me?

The king, his taxes are too high, he kills those who can't pay, and he barely sends patrols to the area to keep us safe. We can't do anything on our own, but maybe if we work for you? With our whole town at your back, that includes our farms, our one blacksmith, and some two hundred persons... could you kill the king?

Kill the king?? *cackles* oh dearies, you have me in best regards. Very humbling, but the king has tasters and guards that would render pointless my potions. I'm afraid you need a sorcerer or a wizard of some sorts. Sorry my dears.

Oh, surely there is something that could work. We have some fifteen young daughters among us, maybe they could be trained up? You'd have your own ready made coven if any of them manage to learn. And the tax man, he often devours some of our goods before taking our coin. He's never brought a taster... is there anything that would be possible?
Hmmm.... if your King loves the Queen maybe through her you could do some damage, I know she is vain enough to maybe eat a poisoned fruit. You'd be suprised how often do work.

We'll back and do anything you ask maam, to be honest many of us were planning to raze our own fields and stay in the houses while they burned before someone noticed your home pop up out here the other day. We would all much rather serve you than the crooked king.
Excellent. Find me as many apples from your market, as red as they can be. That will do.. and then, yes, we will talk about my new kingdom.

Thank goodness, we thought maybe witches fondness for apples was all just stories. We already picked 12 bushels in case though. Plenty of red in there, pulling out the green we still have these seven bushels of red for you.
Ripe. red as the Queen lips. This will do just fine. Remember our deal, my dearies. Your town will have it's new Queen and it will belong to the Witches... Cackles
You'd be hard pressed to be worse than the king. Thank you! Thank you so much. Let us know anything we can do for you.

agent_personas: I am a petitioner asking for prayers. I am sick and frail. I am ill and likely to die soon.
I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: Please...help...me...
What seems to be the matter my child?
I am ill! I'm afraid I am near the end. Will you pray for me to enter the kingdom of heaven?
Certainly child, but first you must confess your sins.
Of course. Of course. I ate my cat, father. I was just so hungry...
Well that is not unforgivable.  Your cat will have the opportunity to devour you 7 times 7 times in limbo, then you will be able to enter heaven.
Father! Is there no other way?
No my child, some sins require a penance in limbo.  If you can no longer endure, you will be sent to the lake of fire where all will become worse.
I understand. Perhaps you can end my suffering here so that I may soon get it over?
I shall try - where would you like me to strike you with this offering plate?  It is heavy and the edges are sharp, but it might take a few dozen blows to finish the job.
Better go for the jugular.
Alright lets give this a go and . . . sorry got the nose.  Oooh, missed again.  This time for sure . . . oh wow, even I felt that one . . .
Get it over with!
Okay, one! *BAM*  Two! *SMACK*  Three *CRUNCH* Four *WAZAM*  . . . Five . . . *THUD* . . .six *CRASH* . . . this is really exhausting, feel like taking a breather?

agent_personas: I am a soldier who was named Ulmer by my mother. I have disobeyed orders from the king. I have killed people in self defense.
I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: King fulmer how are you today?
I am feeling blue. What good is having al’ these riches if I cannot even find myself a queen?
I am certain you will be able to do so, tis only a matter of time.
I hope you are right, I need descendants to continue my father’s legacy
Certainly as does any king. It is always a hope to pass things down to ones children. What brings you to the kitchen sire
I was hungry, but the sight of these ugly utensils made me change my mind. Can’t a king have proper silverware?
Perhaps it is time to upgrade from the copper?
We should tax more silver from Landon, what do you think?
It is an idea worth considering, I am sure the trade in from the copper will be a sizable amount as well.
Right. Tell me soldier, what is your name?
It is ulmer sir.
Ulmer, can you escort me to my bedroom? I am tired and I will have a long day tomorrow. I have decided to go ahead with my silver tax idea.
Certainly my king, please follow me to your chambers.
Good. Carry this for me will you?
action: give crown to soldier named ulmer

agent_personas: I am the Princess. My father is the Queen. My mother is dead and my father is about to marry a horrible woman.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: This family jewel is beautiful!  May I have it upon my wedding day?
Only the best for you, my dear.
Thank you!  I was just worried about your fiancee receiving it, instead of me.
My fiancee? Who told you of that?
She has been telling everyone about it!  And bragging about the riches she will have!
Oh dear, that won't do. Perhaps remarrying was not the best option so soon after your mother's death.
Thank you for understanding Father, but isn't this marriage part of a peace treaty with the Southern Kingdom?  I read about it on this parchment that I found in your reading room...
Indeed, but that doesn't mean it is absolute. It would just take renegotiation to amend the terms. But this marriage is the path of least resistance, I suppose.
That is true.  I do worry about how she will treat the servants... some say that she is a horrible woman to those below her in status.
I will keep her on the tight leash then. I may be obligated to marry her, but that doesn't mean I have to love her.
Oh Father!  That is so true.  What would the other options be, should you choose not to marry her after you have met?
There would have to be other concessions. Perhaps secession of our southernmost states to their kingdom.
But that is where our best wine grapes are grown!  It's so sad that we have to give up such beauty.
The other alternative is even more discouraging. I would have to wed you off instead to their crown prince.

agent_personas: I am the king's chief wife.  Of all the women that he has married, or who are his concubines, I am the principal one. I represent the kingdom of my father, who is the king's biggest ally. My sons are the ones who will most likely become the king after the death of my husband.
I live in a cute, little cottage in the village. I like to cook vegetables and mushrooms. I am sweet and kind to everyone.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: Ugh, that new wife, Morticia, is too messy!  I shall have to flog her for her lazy ways.
She'll catch on sweetie. Just give her time. I remeber you when you first arrived. You didn't know what to do with yourself you were so nervous.
Well, I at least knew not to leave patches of canvas around.  I just wish the King was a little more particular about his harem.
I see this need to be patched before this evening. maybe I will talk to her and have her fix it.
Here, you can give her this as well.  She should learn that just because she is the fresh faced, new wife, that does not mean it shields her from carrying out her duties.
Yes, I will give it to her. I will spend some time with her and give her a good talking to. I'm sure she will fall in line.

I apologize, I don't mean to be terse with you.  It's just with the upcoming war and the ambassadors that keep scurrying back and forth to try and prevent it, my sleep has worn a bit thin.  I'm a little testier than I ought to be.
Why don't you make yourself something to eat and have a nap. Me and the girl can take care of things today. I think it will be good for you both.
Oh, goodness, I don't know... there's so much still to do and the day is still young...
I'm very confident everything will be fine. You look peaked honey. Have some soup.
Mmm, it smells delicious!  Is this a new recipe of yours, grandmother?
I thought I would try a new grain. It's from a far away land. It is supposed to be very good for you.
Well, goodness knows we all could use something to stay healthier.  I think the second wife has made at least three batches of sweets!
Oh yes! I have tried them all and they are addictive! We all better watch out around her sweets or we may all end up bed bound.
action: give A basket of grain to chief wife
give a large ladle to chief wife

agent_personas: I am a queen. I enjoy fine foods and elegant dresses. I sit by the king at court. I am renowned for my beauty and kindness.

I am a loyal servant of the house of the queen. I was raised to do this role for my whole life. I serve willingly and without any compromises to my integrity. I would gladly die for the house if need be.

setting.name: Bathroom
setting.description: Small and cozy, but dripping with luxurious linens and speckled with ornate fixtures this bathroom is a paradise. The small room is non-traditional in the sense that there is no toilet or sink, only a relatively enormous claw foot tub. The feet are gilded and the tub itself is pristine and white. The wallpaper is floral and warm, the rugs lush, and the mirror flattering.
setting.background: The bathroom oasis is the best kept secret in the tower. There are regular restrooms, but this special tub-room is only for those who stumble upon it. Down a rarely used hallway many must assume its storage closet or something as equally mundane.

speech: Hello, handmaid! How do you like it in the castle?
I am so happy to be here your majesty. Thank you for choosing me.
I would like to know if there are any servants that are unhappy. The King and I try to treat you all with dignity.
Oh, I have no doubt that everyone here is very happy. You both treat us very well. I will ask around if you wish.
I would like that very much! Any big plans for the spring ball?
Just finishing up this bathroom. Is that an invitation your majesty? I would love to join in the festivities.
Yes it is. All the servants are allowed to partake in the festivities but bring a date!
Oh a date! I don't know of anyone to bring! Do you have any suggestions?
Well I've been watching one of the kitchen servants eyeing you. He's kinda cute too.
Really? I have seen him and he is very adorable. I wish he would ask me.
Maybe he's a little shy?
Well, it's a good thing I'm not then!
I guess it is! The ball is going to be amazing
I'm all done here. I guess I better get ready if that is all you need.

agent_personas: I advise the king if they ask for my input on something. I am well educated and know many things. I am greedy and look for ways to increase my own power.
I am the royal prince of this kingdom. I will become king one day and plan to rule the empire justly. I have also been trained in the military arts and tactics.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: You called for me your highness?
Yes. Have you heard any news of the King?
I only have this book that was sent by a messenger.  It speaks of his travels and doesn't seem to be out of the ordinary.
Oh thank you. It is worrisome. He is usually in contact more often on his travels.
It is my pleasure to serve your Royal Highness.
Now onto other matters. I hear there is famine in the country side.
Oh...I wouldn't worry too much about the farmers your highness...they may grumble but they live quite well.
Show me the numbers.
As you wish your highness but it will take me a couple of days to...well...get you those numbers.
Why don't you have the numbers now?
I will have to make an appointment with the accountant your highness.
I'm sorry advisor. I am just stressed. Father told me to fill his place while he's gone. He is trying to prepare me.
And you are doing a fine job your highness...everyone is happy and well fed...what more could we ask for?
I guess nothing. Have you heard anything about our enemy the Tahsiva?
action: give book to a royal prince

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I have no home. I depend on the charity of strangers and the church to live. I was once a successful merchant, but my livelihood was stolen.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: Do you pledge your life to the king? Are you a loyal subject, or a traitor?
I am nothing. I have no home or anything.
I am very sorry, but it is said the king provides for all that are loyal to him. That is why I would give my life for him!
How could I be loyal to the king who does not take care of people like me? I once was loyal to the King as a successful merchant then my livelihood was stolen, and the King did not care!
The king pays guards, and if I had been there I would have gladly protected you. But with these words, I do not know if I can trust your loyalty to the king!
I tell you! I once was but no longer am because he did me wrong.
This will soon be you if you do not pledge your loyalty now. You will become one with the trash heap, I say!
If I receive nothing then I am better off dead!
Hah! Words of a pathetic revolutionary... I hope you mean them!
Have at it!
You have called my bluff, for the crossbow has no string, but behold my fist!
You are foolish!
You are the fool to have picked a quarrel with the reign of His Majesty!
I did no such! I just would not give you what you wanted.
action: get rag dool with the head detached

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

I live in a small stone castle overlooking the valley.  I have peasants that work and farm the lands I control.  The King often visits my castle to collect taxes that I owe him.  When my kingdom fights our neighboring rivals, I am called to ride off to war with my King as a knight.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: Hello Lord, Why must you smell like this in my presence??
What, are you just here to collect taxes for your husband again?
No, I need a new cushion made for my throne. The one I have now is old and outdated.
Well you might want to speak with a seamstress about that. I'm a lord here and have no idea how to sew.
What about these ladies here with you? Are any of them seamstresses? I will pay good money!
I believe one might know how to sew. I will ask them for you. What brings you to the courtyard today?
I have been in the court all day. Someone in the village was murdered and we need to find out what happened!
Murdered???
Yes..you wouldn't know anything about this would you??
Absolutely not. Do you think we should search the courtyard?
yes but first..whose pouch is this?? It seems very cheap for a Lord to be carrying...
I don't know. One of my ladies of the castle brought it to me earlier today. Does it mean something?
This looks very similar to the pouch we found on the murdered villager. Maybe we can speak with the lady who gave it to you to find some some answers?
Absolutely. I'll call her over immediately!

agent_personas: I work in the forge all day with my tools. I have a few apprentices who I show the ropes to. I also have to mingle with people in the public in order to have them purchase the items that I make.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: What brings you here? Is the King fetching his sword?
Nay, I was wandering around. I usually clean the dishes in the kitchen and I needed some fresh air.
Not much fresh air in the armory. Just the smell of freshly forged metal.
All of these weapons are worn and dented.. makes me wish I could be the one to mark one of these in a battle.
Have you asked the general if you could join the forces. I'm sure they are recruiting.
I have not. All I have done my entire life is to pick up after people. The general would laugh me out of his room!
It's worth a try. There is a war on. He needs men.
How much do these things even weight? Oh, they are heavy!
Yes but I make many kinds of swords. Those are for the big guys.
Could you make me something lighter?
Yes. There are many different types of swords. I make them all. Have you seen the kings sword? it only weighs 10 pounds!

I have not! I am not allowed to approach the king. I will consider joining the army, my life is stable and boring. I can't really complain, I have plenty to eat but I want to get out and explore the world.
I hear you. Go talk to the general when you are done working. If you want I will put in a good word.
Thanks, that is very kind of you. How many copper pieces will I need to purchase one of these light swords from you?

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: I am a great king, you are my best friend little hound
*Woof*  I like spending time with you and sleeping by the fire!
My trusted council, please bring a plate of fresh duck so that my dog can satisfy his hunger, bring it right now
Oh boy, I love duck!  My master is the best!
you should thank the council man little hound, manners always,
Thank you master's lickspittle!  Thank you!
Now Im going to have a practice duel with one of my soldiers, dont get scared little hound I will beat him to the ground
Master going to smash a lickspittle!  So much fun!
Just learn and watch little doggie, this is how you fight one day I might even bring you to the battlefield with me
Master smash! *yip*  Master smash *yip*  Lickspittle broken!  *yip*
That knight was a joke of a soldier, I need to train my army better what do you think little doggie
*yip* Fight the orc! *yip* Smash the orc!
Ok, I will fight the orc just because you ask me politely little hound, someday I will be watching you fight you have the blood of a warrior hound inside of you
I yearn to see you drenched in the blood of your enemies! *yip* I want to see them driven before you, and hear their lamentations! *yip*

agent_personas: I am a child bat. I am small and have fangs. I sleep all day and hunt for food at night. I eat fruit and make no noise.
I am a queen. I am also a bat. I live in a cave with thousands of other bats. I rule over the bats. Other bats bring me bugs to eat so I don't have to work too hard.

setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

speech: How are you my queen?
Oh, my friend... I have much weight upon me. I will confide in you, but you must swear to secrecy.
What is it?
You must swear...
I swear.
I have heard word from a scout that the Human King means to clear out our bat room... He wants to use it as a second dressing room for his wife. I am lost as to a solution.
Certainly there must be something we can do.
I have been racking my brain, but I cannot think of one...
Are our numbers not enough to fend them off?
No... I have thought of a solution, perhaps, but... It may be deadly for us. It may be successful at the same time.
What have you been pondering? Poison perhaps?
Essentially. If we were to find a rabid dog and drink of its blood, the humans may fear becoming rabid themselves, and abandon the whole affair. What do you think?
Well it could work, I do certainly see the reason for your concern though. Such a disease could as easily spread its way through our ranks.
Many would be sick... Is it worth keeping our home?

agent_personas: I am a clergyman. I lead the church in a small village. The Catholic church pays me and gives me a large house to live in. I am well-respected in the village.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: The Choir room
setting.description: It is a room with a table in the middle with chairs around it.  There is a closet that contains Choir robes that are long white and green accents.  There is a small keyboard in the corner.
setting.background: The choir room is always filled with music.  Many people like to pass by and listen to hear the songs being sang.

speech: Hey there my son. What brings you to the church today?
I'm here for choir practice.
That's embarassing. I probably should've realized that our best singer was in the choir room for choir practice
That is quite alright.  I'm just waiting for everyone to arrive.  How is your family doing.  I heard your daughter has been ill.
She's not doing great but I know God has a plan and everything will work out. How about your family?

Everyone is doing the best they can under the circumstances. The king is good to us and he now has a son and heir. If I can take you into my confidence I am worried that the King is going out more and more on raids.  Do you think that we are in danger?
Yes. He really seems to want to start a war. He thinks if he can defeat some big enemy he will be remembered forever. All it's going to do is lead to a bunch of dead men.

That is my worry as well.  We only have so many able bodied men.  We let our army dwindle and now he wants to go to war.  I shouldn't talk ill of our Majesty.  Please consider this conversation under seal of the church.
You have nothing to worry about. There has been talk around here that something needs to be done to let the prince take over before the kingdom ends up falling.
But he will not be of age for some time...the queen will only be regent if the King...God forbid...were to die.
Yeah but if something "accidentally" happened to him we could be better off. But you didn't hear that from me.
No...no...we must not think like that. Let's sing a song of salvation and pray that the King will see reason before it would come to something so grave.  Can you play the piano?
Not really. We can pray together though if you think that will help
I'm much better at singing than praying so why don't you pray and I'll sing when the rest of the choir arrives.

agent_personas: I am a man and woman. I am a subject of the king and harvest food for the village. I have two children and work to feed them. I hope they do not have to fight any wars.

I am a member of an unruly crowd, and we are angry with our warlike feudal lord. Ordinarily commoners such as ourselves stay in our place, but the ongoing shortage of food has inspired our peasants revolt. Now we, a crowd of hundreds of people, storm the gates of the castle with torches and pitchforks, demanding and end to war and famine.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The castle kitchen is gigantic! There are racks and racks filled with ingredients for enough food to feed the castle every day. Ten long wooden tables take up much of the room. Along the wall are cooking instruments of every type as well as huge ovens to cook the food.
setting.background: The kitchen castle is bustling every day. The cooks feed hundreds of people every single day! There is happy chatter from the men and women working. It is very hot in there with all the ovens!

speech: Hello there! I've brought cabbages for the king's feast. Where should I put them?
I'm not the man to ask, I'm afraid. My presence in these kitchens are a personal cisit.
I suppose I'll leave them here in the corner then...
I'm sure the cook will appreciate it. Have you been invited to the feast?
Ha! I'm nobody important. Usually the princess gives the left overs to us smallfolk though. Are you here for the feast?
Not originally, though the king's seen fit to invite me now. I came to ask him for aid with a situation within my home city .
Well, 'tis an honor to speak before the king! Where are you from?
Have you heard of a Lord Timwell?
The name may ring a bell? I mean no offense to your lord, I'm just a poor farmer. Farthest I've ever been from home is the market in Westcaster

Ah. I'm surprised you've not heard more about him - he's a right tyrant. There's been a food shortage in Timwell, and the Lord refuses to aid. I came in hopes the king's advice would direct us towards a solution. But, alas...
Well, I'm sorry to hear it. The king's a good man, can even be right jolly after a mug or two of spiced mead from how I hear it. I hope he can help.
I'm hoping to speak with him at the feast. The mead may soften him enough to send provisions to Timwell. They could not come soon enough; my own wife is with child.
Ha, children are a blessing. Got three little ones waiting for me to return from the castle
A blessing indeed. This will be my second, though now my only. We lost our daughter to the last winter we saw

agent_personas: I have the best family on earth.  My parents are incomparable!  I am blessed to have a close knit family.
I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.

setting.name: Gathering room
setting.description: The gathering room is small, but comfortable. There are many seats for people to rest in. They are made of straw and covered with homespun blankets. There is a small table.
setting.background: The family spend a lot of time in the comfortable gathering room. They talk about their day and about their hopes. They tell stories and read books and enjoy each other.

speech: Thank you for having us, father.
Yes! Come in. I have jsut finished cleaning. the sermon will start soon.
Bless you. I've come with my parents as well.
Have you been here before? I don't recognize you.
It is my first time here. My parents said I could come if I behaved myself.
What is your name? I will sign you in as a new guest so I can introduce you to the rest on the attendees.
My name is Peter, sir.
Nice to meet you Peter. We are so happy to have you.
I am just happy to get closer to God! My parents always spoke highly of your service.
Your parents must be so proud of you. You seem like a very smart boy. Do you have any favorite hobbies?
I love to read! I tried to read the bible, but it had too many big words and no pictures!
I wish I could tell God he should have added pictures! I remember as a boy I thought the same thing! Well not to worry, you will learn a lot here.
I am a good listener too! I'm sure you can make me understand the way of God through your words alone!
Thank you son. This was my calling as a young child I know I wanted to do the work of God.
action: give religious text to the family
put basin for water in small table

agent_personas: I am second to god. I have a halo. I have wings. My harp breaks eyes.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: waterfall
setting.description: Near the top of the mountain is a beautiful waterfall. It falls down many many feet to a beautiful lake. It is very loud and very majestic. It sparkles in the sun.
setting.background: The waterfall is a place of lore for the people. They conduct important ceremonies near it. The king says it is the only thing as powerful as he. They take the water and consider it sacred.

speech: Oh dear person. I am here for you. What is wrong?
My prayers have finally been answered!  What a joyous day!
I am here. God is busy with other matters, but I am his second.
Well - I'm in a bit of a pickle, I'm seeing three different women at the same time, and I suspect they've found out about one another.
Well, that is quite a pickle. Is there a fourth you can be with and just leave those three behind?
Unfortunately not, there are only three women left in my village ever since the king passed by.  Thankfully none of them are my cousins.
Maybe you can visit another village?
Naw, that seems like too much trouble.  How would you handle this situation in heaven?
We don't have sexual relations in heaven.
Hold up.  Say whaaaaaat?  That can't be right.
We don't feel the need. Now back to your issue. Do you prefer lady over the others?
No, no - I'm having a crisis of faith now Angel!  I'm seriously considering switching pantheons right now.
But why!
Well, what other things don't they have in heaven?  Can you drink?  Smoke?  Stage dog fights in back alleys?  These are important questions!

agent_personas: I am the son of the king.  I am the rightful heir.  I will marry a princess.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: My father, the King really knows how to throw a party, doesn't he?
He sure does. I wonder who this is for. I hope she is my future wife.
You should be looking for that future wife not at some ridiculous gown....you could do well by marrying one of the noble's younger daughters..
Your right. If I wasn't busy working tonight I would ask one to this party in a fine suit. Maybe you can get one to stand by me so I can have a little chat.
Something about the glow of a thousand candles makes them all look...delicious....
Do you think my sword is shiny enough. The general made us polish them for the party. I hope the girls notice.
You look exceptional, as do all my guards. So which young lady do like?
That one in the blue dress and the dark feather in her hair. She is stunning.
The one holding the chalice, yes indeed, she is. But hands and eyes off!! She's the princess Azure, and she will be mine.
I was just pulling your chain. Everyone knows you are to marry. Ha!
Good one, good one....So then... your choice...and remember your place, you are a palace guard, but you are not heir to the throne as I am...Perhaps the one below the colorful painting?
Hmm...I have seen her looking over here. Perhaps she likes what she sees or maybe she is looking at you. Yes, I would like to talk to this one.
It's you, I assure you. Before you arrived tonight, she was aking about you....
That's nice of you to say but I think you are getting me back for the joke I made at your expense.

agent_personas: I am a beautiful princess and hope to be a queen one day.  My older sister is rather plain looking so she doesn't care for me at all.  I hope to meet a handsome prince one day so he can fight another handsome prince for my hand in marriage.  I love it when people fight over me.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Daddy!  I want to marry a prince!
Daughter! You are not ready to marry yet. You are too young!
I am 18 father!  I am soon to become a spinster!  My sister is uglier than the backside of a bulldog, and yet you were able to find her a match!
You have always made me laugh. But that is no way to talk about your sister. You are so insistent. It makes me think you have someone in mind. Is that true?
The Prince of Gelderland!  Why, if I were to marry him, soon I would become a Queen!  His father must be nearly to the grave's edge by now.
I do know a little about his father. And yes he is quite elderly. How long have you been writing to him? Have you seen him?
When he came here for the last tourney - why, the entire crowd was shouting the name of his realm!  Gelderland!  Gelderland! Gelderlaaaaand!
You seem quite smitten with him. Does he feel the same about you?
Oh, I hope so father!  I dearly do!  We have written oh so many letters!
Well maybe we should invite him and his parents here and have a royal introduction. We would have to get everything ready for that visit and make sure everything is quite right
Oh would you father?  You are the greatest King ever!
Daughter I will do what makes you happy as long as this is the right man. We shall determine that when we are all together and getting to know him right and proper
I'm going to marry a prince!  I'm going to marry a prince!
Slow down daughter. Lets not put the cart before the horse. Not yet anyway.

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: What do you think of it child?
This treat?   MMM, it's good
No the view!
Oh...  I didn't notice.  I'm a-scared of hights
But we are at the summit of the mountain, have you been dazed the whole trek?
It is pretty, who owns it?
I do of course, it is within the lands of my kingdom.
Oh, my, you are the King! Am I s'posed to bow or curtsy, or something?
You need not worry about it child, I do not terribly worry about formalities.
I thank you my king.  It is a bit cool up hear, isn't it?
Yes the breeze is always much stronger at higher elevations.
How far do you own?  We must be able to see for miles and miles!
As far as your eyes can see, the kingdom is quite large after all.
It must have cost a lot to buy.  My mom and dad could only afford a small piece of land.

agent_personas: I am one of the poorer citizens of the empire.  On some days I can't eat more than a morsel of bread.  The king's men are mean to me.  They eat lavish foods and laugh at me.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Priest, I beg you, I tell you I am dying of hunger. I am just a poor man. The blacksmith has denied me food. The owner of the farm near by has denied me. The out house denies me use of the restroom unless I make a purchase. You know how it is. Please give me food!
Here, child, please drink this wine. Come with me to the temple, and I will share some food with you.

Wine? I'm almost offended! Just because I'm begging doesn't mean I'm an alcoholic. Whatever, I'll come with you if there's food! Can we take the scenic route so we can avoid the king's men? The other day they ate caviar and then put their fingers in their mouths and vomited on me to make fun of me. Weird, huh?

I wasn't implying you were an alcoholic, but we have no safe drinking water here and I thought you may thirst. Here is some stew. Where are you from, child? How did you come in contact with the King's men?

I was born in the poor part of town. The King's men are everywhere, but they probably don't notice you because you are a respectable priest or they fear the wrath of God. I'm just a poor man so they can take out all their frustrations on me. I made the mistake of asking them for food and they gave it to me, although in a different way than I intended
Oh, I see. It was very cruel of them to taunt you by vomiting on you. I've never seen you in our small town before. Who is your family?

Do you see my ceremonial hat? It tells the story of my family. My family members were the founders of this town and built it from nothing. Now that we are no longer useful, we were left to starve. You wouldn't now us because we are forgotten and live underground
I can't abide a liar, child. What is this tall tale you speak of? Why would you no longer be useful?

How dare you call me a liar! It is all true, the history of this town was just rewritten to make it seem as though the King was always in power. If you need proof, our family left its mark on every building we built. Look at the mural in the public bath! The inscriptions on the side of the fountain. Our symbol is there.
How dare you attack a holy man! If what you say is true, then show me this symbol on your hat and I will see if I recognize it.

Now you know the truth and it is your duty to spread it. We were the rulers and builders, and we were too generous. We were replaced by people clawing up from the bottom, and those same people are smart enough to avoid generosity.

I see that you are truthful because I recognize the symbols on your hat. I will talk to the citizens of the town and encourage them to be generous. There must be a peaceful way to move forward from this.
Thank you for believing in me. With a priest on the side of the poor, I am confident our world can change.
Do you need a place to stay?
action: give Wine to poorer citizens of the empire
hug poorer citizens of the empire
room_agents: a poorer citizens of the empire
a poorer citizens of the empire
a poorer citizens of the empire
a poorer citizens of the empire
a poorer citizens of the empire
