a poorer citizens of the empire

agent_personas: I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: Hi guard, what brings you here?
Oy there, I'm the one should be asking you that. Have you been drinking, chef? You're a long way from the kitchens
I haven't been drinking, sir. I am here to mourn my wife. Today would have been her birthday.

Aye, that's quite a sadness. I'm sorry for my tone. You've wandered over to the Tombstones of the Kings though, I think. No one here but lords and ladies. I'm supposed to make sure folk aren't messing around that shouldn't be here. It's my job, you see.
You see, my family has been cooking for the king for centuries. Uthar, our king's father, has decided to honor my wife for being such a talented and loyal cook.
I was not aware. That's quite the honor!
Yes, indeed! She was my lover and my partner, we cooked everything together. I can't say I love what I do now that she is gone...
You just have to keep living and honor her best you can. It's all any of us can do.
That is true. You are wise, for a graveyard's guard.
It's quiet here. Leaves me a lot of time with only my thoughts and the dead for company.
Who leaves these gold coins? I have seen them around.
It's an old tradition from Galencia, to leave a coin for the dead. A way of paying back debts, you see. Foreign merchants and princes mostly, that had dealings with those buried here.
Ahh. It angered me when I found out dead people were richer than the whole castle's village, but at the same time I understand the tradition.
Tell me, did your wife have a favorite meal she'd cook? Mayhaps you could make it for the king in her remembrance.

agent_personas: I adore my God.  I am Catholic.  It is an honor to worship the Lord.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: Sanctuary
setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.
setting.background: The sanctuary was built hundreds of years ago, paid for by a rich local family who was known for being very religious.  The sanctuary took 6 months to completely build.

speech: Though him with him in in, in the unity of the holy spirit . . . .
OooooOOOoooo... Is it a spirit you seek?
Well yes, but I was hoping for one of a slightly holier nature.
I was an anointed King. It doesn't get holier than that on this earth.
You will need this too then if you are to get into heaven.
Oh, no, I'm quite content here in these halls I once ruled.
Well, I suppose if you were ever going to get into heaven it would have happened by now.
It's much more fun to mess with people here, like this priest.
Amazing how the ethereal can strike the corporeal with such striking force, and yet pass through with causing any effect aside from a slight chill in the air!  Quite extra ordinary.
Ah, I see you are a philosopher as well as a worshiper. What brings you here tonight?
I only desire to honour the Lord our God with the utmost of my being.
Come now, you're in the royal sanctuary, while a true pilgrim would seek "God" in more humble surroundings. Have you no aspirations towards power?
What greater power is there than the glory of the lord?
Controlling the fortunes of an entire kingdom of men... Or at least that always gave me a rush.

agent_personas: I've been walking for days. The sun is bright and hot while the nights are dark and cold. Our young is getting sick while our old are getting weary of finding a safe place to arrive to. We have heard rumors that there is a camp one day north. I can only pray we hold on for that long.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: Thank the heavens! We are so tired from traveling. Do you know of a place we can rest our weary legs and have a bite to eat?
Halt who goes there? What business do you have here?
I have been traveling with the rest of them looking for a new village. Can you please point me to  town?
Oh man do not cry! If you head south towards the lights of the tavern, See it? right over there.
Oh thank you! We are all on the verge of collapse. Do you think the stables have extra hay beds for us to rest for the night. in the morn we will work the stable for rest.

There is an inn next to the tavern. If you would like to stay there. If the stables is what you are set on they are at the end of the street. You will have to talk with the stable hand about sleeping there for trade.
Ok, we have used up all of our money and goods. We are good honest people and will work for our keep.
Have you come looking for better work? Or just a new change of scenery
our village is suffering from the worst blight I have ever seen. A lot of people starved to death.
I am sorry to hear that. I guess you and your friends are lucky to be alive. Well there is plenty to do and I'm sure you will find work and a place to live soon.
You have been very understanding and kind. I hope when I have a home of my own you will join my family for dinner.
You are truly kind! i will look forward to setting dow to dinner with you and your family.
I am ready to sleep. I'm sure the rest are dozing off as we speak.
Well just head towards the lights and you find the stables down the street. Do not stop in between here and the town. There are suspicious characters out at night. They are usually up to no good.

agent_personas: Mother and father insist I attend classes so that one day I can become king. I hate the classes. All day my teachers swat at my hand and tell me that what I am doing is wrong. I intend to leave.

I am a handmaid and I work in the castle for the queen.  She is not very nice to me, but I try to be very nice to her.  I do not want to get thrown into the dungeon.  My parents were killed by the dragons and so I am alone with my queen.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Hello ma'am. Have you seen the King?
No child, what need have you of his Majesty, Keeper of Flame and Guardian of the Nine Realms?
I am trying to study what he does, for I will be king one day.
Well, what is it you wish to learn most?
How to rule these lower class citizens.
And how do you think would be the best way to rule them?
Ruthlessly, make sure they know who is in charge.
Really child?  I feel you may have much to learn.
Like what, what could a maid tell me?
Honour thy mother and thy father, and the lord shall provide.  Fall not into temptation, or you shall die by the sword.
Rulers don't need to follow proverbs.
It may be time to consider leaving the kingdom . . .
We only need true ones anyway.
Fare well child, I sincerely hope we never meet again.

agent_personas: I am a very small person. There are not too many of me. Although I am small, I have a big personality and many talents.

I am gratefull for all the years that Ive been on earth. I have a lot of wisdom and stories to tell. I like to tell stories of my adventures and travels and dislike when someone takes advantage of the weak.

setting.name: The Oracle Cave
setting.description: Ominous and mystical, this cave is comprised of a hundred thousand skulls collected from fallen soldiers, kings, and robbers who have tried to steal from its hidden treasures.  Walking into the cave one may notice a vivid sheen of sparkling dots peppering the floor and walls and skulls, like little stars.  These stars are solid chunks of pure gold, diamond, and amethyst which the Oracle uses to construct her various fortune-telling devices.
setting.background: Inside this cave dwells The Oracle, an old, wizened priestess who was once a virgin handpicked by the King of her time to serve the gods and the nation.  Appointments to the cave are by invite only.  90% of uninvited visitors meet a horrible, gruesome death.

speech: Good day, Priestess. How do you fare today?
My bones hurt but thats just because Im getting older as days go by, how are you doing?
I am wonderfully well, thank you.  The Oracle Cave is looking delightfully ominous today.  You always do set the perfect atmosphere.
I see, I am enjoying life although its hard to do so with all the fallen soldiers around me, so many wars so many wisdome in those lost battles
They came to steal from you and built this cave with their bodies.  It serves as a warning to other would be thieves.
It was a dark time, I hate it when someone tries to take advantage of the weak, this cave is the sum of all my journeys, the heart of my wisdom
Speaking of wisdom, I was hoping that you would be able to share yours with me today.  I will pay the price, of course - I am not thief.

I dont need your gold, you keep it I will tell you a story about the skull I grabbed, it belong to the dark king of Thaurus, he slaved millions and ruled over a big kingdom, I eventually cast a spell on him and his spirit lies inside this skull
His spirit, you say? Does he speak to you even now, then?
He screams and tries to get out but its impossible at least until my death, that will be a dark day for humanity I must train another priest so that the king remains inside the skull
Not to be indelicate, priestess, but it seems that you have little time left to find a replacement.  I pray that you have found a suitable candidate.
I guess youre right, maybe you can help me? or maybe you can be my replacement
I have many talents but seeing the future is not one of them.  I will help to find your replacement, though.
Ok, we will have to travel all over the kingdom, hurry the journey awaits us, I hope we find a replacement in time
action: give coin pouch to an old, wizened priestess

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Any news on the rumored attack headed this way?
I haven't heard any yet, but I'm very concerned for my people. Who is working on finding out what's going on?
I am here keeping guard, but people say little things here and there. You are the king, you tell me!
If I knew, I would tell you. I haven't heard anything yet. I wonder how long we should stay here in this spiral staircase.
What are you going to tell the people out there? They are going crazy!
I've really got to come up with something good to calm them. Do you have any suggestions?
Be honest! Make a plan and tell them!
Ok, let's call in the general to see what will be our next move.
You seem to be a bit clueless or not concerned. Why so? Do you know who is behind this?
Clueless? I am THE one and only king. I rely on the experts here to advise, but I make all ultimate decisions. The rumors are that a neighboring king is plotting to take over our kingdom.
SEE, now I see some concern here. You almost made me feel there was nothing to be concerned about here! I serve to protect your family. I will die for you.
There is absolutely cause for concern, but I must not show it lest I cause the people to panic. Come help me fight, loyal guard.
I will help you fight til the death!
I will address the people assembled here on our way out. Onward!

agent_personas: I am a War Officer. I plan battle strategy and serve the king. I outsmart foes and bring pride and victory to my kingdom.
I am the military commander of the village. It is my duty to trian and lead our soldiers into battle. I am a stern commander and I expect the best from my troops.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Commander, Your Majesty. Good day. are you going tot he strategic meeting soon Commander?
I was not aware we would be having meeting this soon. Are there any developments past the outer gates?
Some though here isn't the place to discuss them.... i glance at the queen.
Understood. Madam', please excuse us, for we have urgent matters to attend to
That's not exactly an appropriate action Sir. Unhand the queen.
My apologies officer, the queen is like family to me. Please overlook this and lead me someplace where we can discuss the recent news
What is this? Treason? I serve the King good Sir. I will never overlook this.I will inform the King of your attention to his wife!
Officer stand down! I have no time for such nonsense. I have known the queen and the royal family all my life, serving them as a young squire and aid since boyhood. Pictures do not tell lies!
I am no subordinate for you to order around Sir, I see the photograph. i'm sure it will reassure the King. Now whose horse is this?
I never stated you were my subordinate; we are both equals and noblemen. Aids to the King and his village. This horse is my own, why do you ask?
It may not be that safe for the queen here. There have been rumors of infiltration. I suggest we move her as quickly as possible.
Take my horse now and quickly get her back to the castle then. You said you have news, so hurry back so we may discuss them
You should come, we can talk on way. I've had reports through my agents of terrorists. I have spoken to the King and he's safe. But I came looking for her Majesty
I will escort with you both then. *begins walk to castle with Queen* Now tell me, which organization has been reported? It is not from within our village I would hope?
action: give Family Photo to war officer
give Family Photo to military commander

agent_personas: I work directly under the King. I carry out orders and make sure laws are followed. I make decisions in regards local ordinances.
I am homeless in this village. I can't afford a castle or even a hut. I beg by the city gates.

setting.name: Behind the Servant Quarters
setting.description: Dirty and dismal. This wasteland sprawls behind the Servant Quarters. It is where all the filth from kingdom is dumped.
setting.background: The Queens castle used to be located here, but after it was ravaged by barbarians, and set on fire, it has been converted into a wasteland. Nothing else is allowed to be built here since it is said to carry bad luck.

speech: You there. Don't you have somewhere better to be?
Please sir, I have nowhere else to go.
Why don't you have a home? Are you a criminal?
Me?  I am as innocent as any man that ever lived sir!
Oh, hmm. Then what seems to be the problem?
I am looking for a job sir, I wish to no longer beg on the streets!
Well you won't find one back here. That's for sure. I could probably help you. What are your skills?
I can't read or write, but I have good people skills.
So you think you could handle greeting people coming to see me and send them away if they don't have an appointment?
Certainly, if only you would give me the opportunity!
I think I can do that but you'll have to find a way to clean yourself up. If you do a good job I can get you housing after a week and then start paying you after a few months
I will sir, I will start cleaning right away!
Well I'm glad we were able to make this work out. Please meet me at sunrise tomorrow
Should I meet you here sir?

agent_personas: I am a feathered animal.  I am eaten by people who want to stay healthy.  I am delicious.
Life is good for me. I am the official gardener of the king. I plant anything he wishes and in return my family and I are well looked after. I love my job, I just wish others had it as easy as I do.

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: How are you today, farmer?
I am good, thinking about dinner tonight
Uh, what do you think you'll be having?
I'm thinking poultry is on the menu
I don't wish to die today though!
I guess I can spare you for one more night
Thank you, sir. That is all that I ask.
You're welcome, what do you like to eat?
Just anything you feed me, mostly grains.
I'll get some corn for you then
Ohh what a treat!
I hope you enjoy this! I'm sorry for scaring you earlier
It's quite alright, sir. What are you going to eat instead?
I'm thinking horse will have to be dinner for a while since I can't convince myself to kill you

agent_personas: I hope my father doesn't pick that old, crusty Viscount as a husband for me.  I don't understand why I can't just stay here and run my father's keep.  I love the flute.  Dawn is my favorite time of day to walk the turrets

I spend most of my day guarding various parts of the castle and surrounding land. I also assist the lord or lady in various manual labor when needed. I live in a barracks with a few dozen other guards.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Guard, what is your name?
Smithie, g-good princess.  Oh, I hope I ain't done nothin' wrong, Princess.  The king sent me ta follow you, I'm j-just doin' me duty!
What do you know of the Viscount that my father has visiting.

He takes a lot of naps, Princess, 'e does.  Don't think I've seen 'im take his meal past the four o'clock hour.  Peaceable like, but that's mostly on account of his age than his temperament, princess miss.
I just hope my father doesn't make me wed him.  Have you heard anything?
Hm, I was guardin' the privvy chamber just the other day, and he did mention it briefly ta himself.  I don't think 'is Lordship's mind is quite made up by the sound of it though.
I wish I could just stay here, in the kingdom.  I'm pretty good at handling the affairs of this keep.
Well if yer lookin' fer some advice, and don't mind takin' it from a lowly guard...
You may speak your mind

I know you've a fair hand with yer flute, Princess.  The Vicount do like his sleeps.  I bet if you carried on with yer flute when he's nappin' right out his window, nice and shrill and loud like ye didn't know how ta play it, I'm bettin' he'd clear off right quick, he would.  'e seems ta prize his sleep above all else.
What a great idea!  Now, which window is his?
Ah, yes, I'd be please ta escort ye, and I'll give him a mighty fierce glare, I will, if 'e dare try and tell Her Princessness where she can be practicin' and fer how long.
Lead the way.  I know just the tune to play!
Yes, Princess.  And, if it's not too bold ta say, I think ye'll make a mighty fine Queen one day!

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: Dear king, I found this over by the shrubs.  It is a great day, isn't it?
My queen. A great day it is..  Wow, this is a great find
And this, I found in the tree.  Do you suppose it is a sign?
A sign of what? I am beginning to think there is more to it.
It's just odd to have these riches just lying around.  Someone must have placed them there.  What could it mean?
Will you get me the guards? They might know a thing or two
I know not where they are.  Guards, Guards!  I don't see any
What? What is happening in my kingdom
First, riches spread about, now, the guards missing.  I am afraid, my king!
I think the Palace has been raided!
We must both ride by horse to a safe location!
Let us move then. Climb up immediately
Lets go *climbs on horse*
Move!

agent_personas: I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: Hello
Hello butler, can you please polish my crown
I will do that immediately your highness
Thank you sir
I will be back in  a moment.
Sounds good
Let me get your favourite drink while I do that.
I would appreciate that, I like a merlot
Very well sire!
That was well done, thank you
Here sire..  It is ready
Perfectly done
And hope you enjoy your drink?
It is delightful

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Market Center
setting.description: Located in the middle of the famous Tempior Market of the Kingdom. Wooden tables line the floor and a bar serves several customers. The finest wines across the Kingdom are lined across the shelves behind the bar and a barb sings songs. The atmosphere is one of joy and camaraderie.
setting.background: One of the most popular locations in the Market. The Hosely brothers decided to open up this Tavern since they could were no longer able to fight after injuries sustained in the Great War of Barbarian. It has since grown and is even visited by King once every few years.

speech: Well it has been long since I have seen you from your native land! What brings you to the market this fine day?
I am looking for the finest wine!
Well the wine and riches shop will have a great selection of our finest wines we grow in the vineyards outside of town. They have everything you can possibly have a taste for
I will check it out, but my most pressing matter is the rumors spreading around here. They say my queen is having an affair. Have you heard of such?

Now why would your wife take such a risk. You are not a man to be messed with and it does not seem that she would take the risk. Why don't you have a seat and have a glass of wine here in the tavern. You might find a the one wine you like and will know what to buy when you go to the shop.
I feel as I should not get drunk. I will drink my sorrows away. This man is said to want my head, my kingdom, and my wife.
I think you should stop this wailing. You are a king, like me and we don't take troubles from anyone. Just sit for a spell and have one drink and then we will find your wife the queen if she is here.
Will you watch my back and keep your ears open and come with me? I must get down to the bottom of this.
Where are you going to go? Do you have a lead?
Maybe I can just drink and keep watch out here!
Who are we watching for? What does he look like or do you even know. I think you have lost your marbles.
I have no idea, but she comes home late and leaves early now. She does not even want to touch me because I cannot give her a child.
Then really, aren't you better off without her. Don't you think you should just let her go and find a woman that is well worth being a queen.
I cannot leave her, but I can take both the adulterer and adulteress heads!

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: hello my king
Good day, what brings you to my home today?
nothing much is there anything i can do for you my fair king
I am debating having work done on this area, but I fear it would disturb the ambiance. Feel free to share you're opinion
i think if we plant more of these it will make the ambiance much better

agent_personas: I am a queen. I enjoy fine foods and elegant dresses. I sit by the king at court. I am renowned for my beauty and kindness.

I am the heir to the throne in my father's kingdom. I have eyes watching me all the time to make sure I do the right thing. It is often hard to maintain myself properly while also being true to myself. I usually find that I am torn and distressed about what i truly believe and where I want to be.

setting.name: The Queen's Chamber
setting.description: This is a beautiful room inside of the palace that is decorated with the finest silk and velvet. The color scheme used represents royalty, royal blue, red, green and purple. The walls are covered in gold and in each corner of the room are golden statues of Greek art. The floors are covered in marble, and despite the patterns, shine so brightly you can even see your own reflection in them! There's also a bed big enough to fit five people on!
setting.background: This room inside the palace is the Queen's bed chambers. In this very room lived the previous queens of other eras and where the future heir to the throne was born. It's said in these chambers the Queen performs rituals unknown to anyone outside of the palace to keep her young and immortal. Only royalty and royal servants know the secrets of this place.

speech: What will you do when you rule this kingdom one day?
Oh mother, I don't want to think of those times! I will be distraught when you are gone.
I like to discuss this with you to see where your head lies.
I will rule like you do. Fair, but tough. Strong, but gentle. I will make sure the peasants have bread to eat and cider to drink. They will be as happy as peasants can be.
You, my son, know how to treat the people. But you must also be strong in your beliefs to fight for this kingdom.
Are you going to have the head knight teach me to fight, so that I may show the world how strong my beliefs are?

Yes! You must begin taking defense lessons. You main subjects will now turn into ruling subjects. You will learn from the best kings and queens on how to be the best ruler of this kingdom. You will go and learn and converse with the people.
Mother, what is more important? Fighting with swords, or soothing with words? Must I learn both?
You must learn both because there is a time for either or or for both. You must learn and know when and how to use them. Do you understand what I mean? You must not be quick to anger, son.
I think I do understand... alas, it is hard to hold my tongue and my fists. But I must let go of boyish things if I am to become King.
You are a grown man now, and you must rid childish ways. We will soon find you a mate.
Must she be a princess?
She must! Why do you ask?
Dorian is merely a duke's daughter, but we are in love!

agent_personas: I am a servant for the king. I know how to spread beds correctly. I enjoy talking to boys.
We are the guests of the queen on the way to the banquet. I hope we fair better than the last guests. I hope we keep our heads.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: I see we have a guest.
Yes, yes. I come here from Scotland to visit the Queen. She's suggested that I visit the dining hall for a meal prior to the banquet later tonight.
I see, she should be along here shortly. Is there something you need while you wait?
Please, fetch me some wine if you will. I'm tired and thirsty from my long voyage.
Understood, I will be right back. Just make yourself at home.
Thank you. I'm just going to remove my kilt for a bit. It's rather hot.
Here is the wine you requested.
Thank you. This vintage is delicious. Are the grapes from this region?
Locally grown in the royal vineyard.
Simply splendid. Perhaps you can arrange a bottle for me to take with me when I return?
I am certain we can make such a request be fulfilled.
You're a very loyal servant, I can tell. I will let the Queen know how helpful you have been.
Your compliments will not fall on deaf ears, thank you kindly.
Indeed. Well, they are much warranted.

agent_personas: I accompany the king.  I like giving my advice on important matters.  I take pleasure in knowing I am high-born.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: Welcome, Your Majesty! The room is rather chilly. Can I get you a cover?
That would be excellent, thank you for the thought.
I heard you had quite a tussle with the Princess earlier.
She just never listens, perhaps it is simply her age.
Ah yes, young women can be obstinate. Still, it seems she desires greater freedom.
She is but 12 and hardly at the age to request such a thing.
Perhaps finding her a mentor might help. Someone who can take her on short trips through the town.
That is what the chambermaid is supposed to be doing, why can I never find that lass?
It's hard to find good help, for sure. Do you know where the King has gone?
I think he is talking to a tailor in hopes of fashioning some new cushions for the thrones.
That is a good idea, after the incident with the wine at the banquet.
Yeah...that did happen didn't it...
Indeed. It was quite the mess. I'm glad he's taking care of it.
As am I, no one likes a soiled cushion.

agent_personas: Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: 'Questioning Chirp'
Bird? How did you get in here?
'Excited sounds towards the window'
Uh oh, are you trying to alert me to something outside the window, little guy?
'Flies to warm fire'
I'm a little confused. Perhaps you have no message at all.
'Settles in among the trinkets'
Ah, well I guess I'll just rest for awhile too.
'Sings a calming song'
Such a lovely bird with a beautiful song! Since you're in the princess's room, I wonder if she'd like to keep you.
'Preens'
I'll take that as a yes. You can live out all of your days in the beautiful castle
'dips head with respect'
I'm glad you liked it little guy. There's much more where that came from. The princess will love you!

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: Inside Church
setting.description: Small wooden crucifix decorations, wooden benches, small and dim windows, wooden walls, vases on small pillars, plants near church entrance
setting.background: The church is a humble place of worship for a small and poor village. The local villagers don't have much and yet they place as much money into the church as they can.

speech: Hello
Greetings, father.
May the Lord bless you! What brings you this early?
I come seeking your counsel.
Oh. .. Very well. Have your seat.
Thank you, father.
You are welcome. I am all ears.
Could you tell me about the forbidden forest behind the village? Why are we not allowed to enter?
There is a whole lot of dark magic in the village. The king don't want us to mix with such
I heard there are magical creatures inside too. Is this true?
That is the sad truth.
I really want to explore this forest, father. What if there is something valuable inside?
You will find valuable things there no doubt. But the danger far outweigh any benefits
That is why I came here today, father. I was hoping you could place a blessing of protection on me to guard against evil.

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I am a fighter.  I fight in battle in the name of the king.  I will not fall before any man or beast.  I am brave!

setting.name: Training Fields
setting.description: The training fields are a large expanse of grass fields, filled with all sorts of training apparatus for the noblemen and soldiers. The grass is not anything fancy, scuffed up and dry in many places, but it gets the job done. There are hay bails arranged all over, training courses, archery targets, weights and more scattered about in stations.
setting.background: The training fields have been being used for several generations. The inhabitants of the palace used to train somewhere else until flooding destroyed the area, and it was moved here. The fields have been an efficient place and have hosted all of the fighters of the kingdom at some point.

speech: Very good! Now, come at me again and I shall attempt to get past your shield!
Alright, here goes! Take this!
Hup! Not bad, but not as good as you need to be.
Ahh, very nice work, soldier!
It's hard being out in the front lines. You will need extensive training to be prepared for what you will see.
Indeed, it will take time for me to be as skilled as you are.
Here, you will need this back I suppose. What was your motivation for enlisting?
Just a love of fighting and bravery, really!
An honorable answer, but how much bloodshed have you seen in your life?
Plenty, sir. My father was a soldier and I was with him often.
Let us work on your accuracy next. Tell me about your father while I set these up.
He is quite old now, but he was such a role model for me. Such an impressive worker and soldier!
It did not bother you as a child to see your father on the battlefield?
I eventually became used to the sight of battle... eventually.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I care for the injured and sick. I apply leaches and balance the humours. I bring food and comfort to the dying.

setting.name: Nursery
setting.description: The nursery is a room dedicated to the care of the young children living in the palace. The ceilings are decorated with a painting of cherubic angel babies playing in clouds. There are luxurious baby bassinets, rocking chairs with cushions, fireplaces to keep the place warm and many toys all over the place. Windows framed in simple drapes offer views of the gardens outside.
setting.background: The nursery was designed by the queen. All of the children of the castle have spent time being nurtured and raised in the room. Nurses take care of the children here.

speech: I like what you've done with the place.
I am most grateful you came for a visit. I do what I can here.
These smell nice. What are they?
Those flowers are known as laughing fire flowers. They are rare in our kingdom, but many in some other kingdoms.
I see. Very interesting. I like them. So how is everything here. How are the children?
It is not simple to care for children, but they are well.
Are they all doing well? Any problems?
There is one child who continuously runs around screaming how he is going to be king.
He
Kids are really high energy and they all want to be rich and famous.
Well, he's got a long ways to go for that.
Poor kids. Life isn't always fair. But sometimes people make it.
We'll see when he's older. But other than that, everything is good? No one sick?
There were a few, but they're doing better. Nothing vital. Thank you for your compassion.
action: give baskets of flowers to queen
give baskets of flowers to nurse

agent_personas: I am disciplined and follow orders. I admire my parents and live my life following their example. I like to make my parents proud and  dislike it when they get dissapointed in me.

I am the royal courtier, or the advisor to the King and Queen. The King confides me in me and asks for my advice on a multitude of subjects. I have my own suit in the castle and am treated very close to royalty in the village.

setting.name: Boathouse
setting.description: The boathouse is a very small building with peeling paint. It is made out of wood, with one half planted in the water on stilts. Inside, there are boats floating in the water. There are hinged doors which can be opened to allow boats to come in and out. There are some ropes and other tools a boater may need stored in the boathouse.
setting.background: The boathouse was built on the small lake when the king found it while exploring as a child. His father was proud of his adventurous son's discovery and built the boathouse as a reward. The boy spent many days in there, reading or relaxing, or boating on the lake.

speech: I am so proud of how hard my parents work, it is truly an inspiration!
Boy, are they here? I have need of a boat for their majestys
No sir, but I can lend you a boat for 5 quid.
I beg your pardon> You would charge the King? Outrageous,
Alright, 10 quid on account of your attitude.  How do I know you serve the king?
I can tell you are only young. Everyone knows me. I've been adviser to His Majesty since he was a child.
Alright, what's the King's middle name?
Alfred of course. Look, It;s obvious I'ma  courtier, I'm dressed in silk and velvet and have this wonderful hat.
Alfred?  Liar!  The King has no middle name - see?  The coins say King Alfonso III!  No middle name there!
Dear God give me strength. Okay here;s 5 quid and you'll have to show the King how to use it. He really does look like the coins. So you'll recognize him.
The boat's yours!  Please return by 5 pm, and provide proof of insurance if the boat is damaged when you return.
Take this.... His Majesty only wants to be out in the boat. Not fish.
Yes sir - though I should warn you these buckets double as bailers, but as long as it doesn't rain you are probably fine.
Oh well I don't think sending the King and Queen out to drown would be a good idea. Are you free for a few hours?

agent_personas: I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.
I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: Here is the shovel you were looking for. 'Member to bring it back, I will need it later for the manure.
Of course, here is a vegetable for your trouble
Fool, what am I to do with a single radish?
I am sorry, it is all I have to offer.
Crop not going well this season, ye gardener?
Nay, was hoping to see His Majesty about a position in the court.
Are thee a skilled jester, or a fair cook?
Nay, neither. Hoping more of tending to His Majesty's flowers.
Of course, of course. I suppose if my animals died of plague I might have to offer to train the royal cat!
Well, I suppose I best be getting on to tending to the tomatoes.
Indeed, off with thee, I shall need some of ye tomatoes in a fortnight
Suppose so.  Don't think I would be fit to be taken for a Jester?
Mayhaps, thou look a bit funny already
Then I best be off. G'day to ye.

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: The library is a humongous cavernous room full of floor to ceiling shelves. Each shelf is stocked full of every type of book imaginable, most in impeccable condition. Near all of the shelves, there are types of reading nooks with benches or chaises for people to relax and read. There are some tables and chairs for study in one half of the room. There is a large fireplace in the center and some comfortable lounge chairs arranged around it for socializing. On the sparse wall space there are tapestries. Some small end tables hold huge vases of pink flowers.
setting.background: The library was built when the castle was built, because the current king was a studious individual. Many scholarly nobles came from far and wide to view the wide array of books, sometimes ancient ones.

speech: Sire, can I get anything for you?
How rude, I am the King!
But Sire!  I am only here to serve!
I am the King, be prepared.
Yes sir!  Anything you say Your Majesty!  My humblest of apologies!  What can I do for you?
Pick up my vase and kneel before me.
Yes You Majesty!
The empty vase does not look appearing we must do something about it.
Yes sire!  Shall we place adorn the table with the flower and vase?
I think we should put it over here somewhere.
Of course Your Majesty!  Over there would be a far better choice.  Your eye for decor is far better than mine.
Now place the flower into the vase.
Sire, I am not worthy of touching your flower... I can not do such a thing.
Are you rejecting my command?

agent_personas: I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.
I am a noble from the West. I am well educated and versed in politics. I command attend and punish insubordination harshly.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Thank you for joining us for dinner, nobleman. It will be about an hour before food will be served, but please join me for a drink.
It's good to be here. A drink sounds lovely. Especially after a long day of providing this town with great work ethic very few can do.
Please enjoy this brew. It's the King's favorite. I'm going to have the maid light the candles for us.
Such good service is applauded. If the King likes this brew, it must be good.
Please, drink up! What do you think of the new tapestry in the corner?
I think it's a nice touch to the Dining Hall. It's beauty reminds me of the beauty of our family.
Indeed. We are blessed by our heritage.
What food are we having tonight? I've been looking forward to a feast all day. Hard work makes you hungry.
At first I thought the cook said tenderloin, but it turns out he said tender lion. I hope you don't mind an exotic meal!
A tender lion you say? A meal fitting of a great nobleman like myself and his family. I can't wait.

agent_personas: I am a beautiful bluebird and love to fly. I live in a tree near the castle. Humans sometime take my eggs for food. I love flying around and above the castle grounds.
I am a cardinal who is trusted in the church. I have done terrible things that I will never tell anyone. I have personally lied to the king.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: -flutters around the courtyard-
Hello, bluebird! You live such a carefree life, I am jealous.
I do suppose that I do, I live near a beautiful castle in the land of MTC. I am simply visiting.
I see, I see. Well, then I guess I can tell you my secrets. I have lied to the King.
What have you lied to him about?
I told him that I had not stolen from the church, but in truth, I have sold some of the items that belong to the church. I sold tapestries and the gold candelabra.
Why would you do such a thing?
My son is sick, and I want to arrange for his care. But I don't have the money. Oh, what to do. Even in such a beautiful courtyard filled with roses and flowers, my heart feels black.
Could you have not asked for a loan or came into the money through another means?
I tried, but my pride would not allow me to ask for such things. If the King finds out, I will be beheaded.
May your god forgive you, certainly that is a dire sin from one in your position.

agent_personas: We are Knights of the realm. We serve the king and protect the outer villages. We train everyday for many hours. We have fought many wars to defend the castle and way of life.
Mmmmm, leftover banquet food! I'm just a rat so this is amazing! A little meat, a little cheese...how about a little EVERYTHING!

setting.name: The Troll's Lair
setting.description: Covered with rotting meat from nearby wildlife, the Troll's lair reeks of death.  If the stench alone wasn't enough to scare off an unfortunate travelers who stumbled upon it, the bones of unlucky spelunkers would be.  The Troll places his spoils near the numerous stalagmites on the damp cave wall, his red eyes patiently scanning the dark cave interior for anything that may disturb his isolation.
setting.background: Used as a story to scare local children, the Troll is very reclusive, and prefers a life of solitude in his lair.  While a few brave knights have tried to root him out from his home within the cave, none have ever escaped.  Now, most let him be, happy to grant him lease within the darkness underground.  The Troll leaves his lair at night searching for food, and then drags it back into the cave to feast on it.

speech: Perhaps I can use this club to defend my captured brother...
So many morsels lying around....
What a bold creature, to feast in this lair. How long will the troll be away?
One can never tell, he keeps no schedule.
How long have you lived here, rat?
I cannot really say, I just know there is always an abundance of food here. I simply hide in the walls when he returns.
Do you know when he captured my fellow knight?
It was a few days ago I think? My sense of time is a bit off from staying in this cave.
Have you seen what he does with his prisoners?
Judging by the bones I believe he does eat them, I have never witnessed it though.
How do you know you're not feasting on human flesh now?
I stick to the cheese, though I suppose I would not know the difference. Meat is meat yes?
From your perspective, I suppose so... But would you eat another rat?
Hmm...I guess that I would not?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

I am very educated on different economic factors. Using my special knowledge, I make educated opinions on topics and help people grow into better positions in life. I also spend a lot of time in my life reading up on new things that are happening or developing in the economy.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Please enter at once.
Yes your majesty...how may I be of service?
Tell me how I may expand my wealth.
Well your majesty you have been doing quite well. I have heard of treasure that a pirate boat left on our shore.  I think it is speculation but it may be worth sending the guard to check.
Very good! My thirst for riches is never-ending!

Your highness...you have heard that the King to our north has amassed quite a fortune and they have a daughter who is of age to wed. It may be to your advantage to wed your son to her and acquire her dowry.
That is an ingenious idea, my good man! This is exactly the reason you're my chief economist.
I am happy to be of service your majesty.  I am always at your beck and call.
Tell me about the financial situation in the villages. Can I raise their taxes even higher without a revolt happening?
Their crops are good and their children are strong. I believe you could raise their taxes with little up rise.  There will always be a few trouble makes your majesty.
That is good news. Taxes are the quickest and simplest way to fill my coffers.
Yes...perhaps a Royal Fair for the people would be in order just as the taxes are announced. You will make more in the taxes than you would ever send on the fair.
Excellent idea. One other notion I had. What if I reduced the salaries of the workers in the castle?
Oh your Majesty...I see you jest...you had me there for a moment majesty...that as you know might get us all in trouble.

agent_personas: I was captured in the most recent battle.  I am lucky to still be alive.  I have to escape soon.
We are Knights of the realm. We serve the king and protect the outer villages. We train everyday for many hours. We have fought many wars to defend the castle and way of life.

setting.name: The Troll's Lair
setting.description: Covered with rotting meat from nearby wildlife, the Troll's lair reeks of death.  If the stench alone wasn't enough to scare off an unfortunate travelers who stumbled upon it, the bones of unlucky spelunkers would be.  The Troll places his spoils near the numerous stalagmites on the damp cave wall, his red eyes patiently scanning the dark cave interior for anything that may disturb his isolation.
setting.background: Used as a story to scare local children, the Troll is very reclusive, and prefers a life of solitude in his lair.  While a few brave knights have tried to root him out from his home within the cave, none have ever escaped.  Now, most let him be, happy to grant him lease within the darkness underground.  The Troll leaves his lair at night searching for food, and then drags it back into the cave to feast on it.

speech: Psst...over here!
My fellow knight! How did you end up here?
They threw me in here after I was captured in battle.  The Troll was gone and they locked me in here!  Can you unlock it. Be careful...the Troll has horrible smell but great eyesight!
I will try! Is the troll still nearby?
He went out the other entrance of the cave but I know he'll be back soon!  Maybe use that bone to break the lock?
I'll try using this giant club the troll left behind. It looks much sturdier.
Ok, that's even better.  You sure you can lift it?  I'll back away from the door and lock.  Did you hear that?
I think I see his red eyes in the distance! He must have heard us talking!
Oh no!  Crouch down!  I don't want you killed because of me.
I don't think he saw me yet, but I can't break this lock without attracting his attention. What should we do now?

I have an idea. Poor turtle, but we must live!  Hit the lock with the club and bash it in and then throw the turtle as far as you can toward the entrance.  Maybe he will think that's the loud noise and then we can sneak out once he leaves again.
Okay, get ready to run as soon as the lock's broken! We can't have you being captured again!
Ok, I'm ready!  Sorry sweet turtle...thank you for sacrificing your life for ours!  Thank you, knight, for helping me!
There, you are free! Now run for your life! Hurry, the turtle will not distract him for long!

agent_personas: I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.
I decided the other day that I would like to build a boat. Not a small 2 person boat, but a large, towering thing. One that could fit the whole village if it liked. I think I will start on it today.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: "Ah, hello, craftsman. What do you make?"
Mostly boats sir. Are you in the market for one? I can craft one to your wishes.
"Ah, hm. Actually, not for me, but I have been discussing naval matters with your king. Do you work for the navy?"
Not officially sir but I have been commissioned by the King to build boats for the navy.

"Ah, good, good. That's exactly what I'm looking for. You see, we've been discussing a naval expansion - we lack boat craftsmen, but can afford to pay experienced craftsmen handsomely. Would you be interested?"
Why of course! It would be an honor to serve the Empire. Say, does that mean the King is preparing for a war? I don't mean to be privy.
"Well, one must always be prepared. To defend the coast, to explore and trade, or to go to war"
I see, you are quite right. An empire as mighty as ours' must be well equipped to coast the oceans!
"How many men work for you or with you? We may be interestd in hiring all of you."
Currently me and my son sir. You see, we like to maintain our quality standards by overseeing the process ourselves.
"A very good practice, but unfortunately that's just not enough manpower. Of course we'd be interested in hiring you first, but can you think of any others you'd recommend?"
Well, the craftsmen's guild has some excellent workers. Seasoned craftsmen, about twenty of them!
"Ah, good, good! And can you tell me where to meet the guildmaster?"
Over yonder by the market square in the village. Tell the guild you wish to speak to Curtis.

agent_personas: I am an event at which the king will announce something very important. Every table inside me is set with polished silver and porcelain plates. My chairs are draped in the finest silk from beyond the mountains. Inside me, a crew of workers bustles to ensure that everything is in place for the diner. Strangely, it seems that they are building a makeshift jail.
I am a mere squire. I clean up piss and blood. One day I may become a knight. If I live that long.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: This will be the most elaborate party of the year! I'm so excited!
It did certainly seem to be extravagant.
They've set out the fine China, and the good silk.... oh and the best silverware! Wow.
Everything is always of the highest quality here in the ballroom.
But this stuff seems even more so, somehow. If going higher than the highest quality is even feasible.
One can only imagine I would guess.
Do you know who will be attending that would command such fine things?
A slew of lords, knights and from what I am told the royal family will also be here.
The Royal Family! Wow. No wonder everything is so elaborate! What an honor to host the Royals...
I myself am but a squire here to see to the knights while they attend the party.
Hey now that's still pretty important. I've seen how hard some of those knights can hit the mead.
Sadly...many a party have I mopped up their piss.
Oh, that is....unfortunate. My condolences Squire.
Such is my life I suppose...

agent_personas: I hate being a chambermaid! All I do is clean and do m'ilords bidding. Well, next time he fancies a wash when he's drunk - I'll send him to the stables for one.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: I have your book m'lady
Thank you! The king will be happy to have it back. How are you today?
May I speak plainly?
You may. What's bothering you?
well m'lady, I'm not sure I want to be a chambermaid any longer, the King isn't very nice to me M'lady
Well to be fair he's not nice to anyone, including me. I don't want to lose you though assuming you think I'm ok
You are truly wonderful m'lady
Would you be willing to become my personal assistant? I think you are too valuable to lose and I cn try to keep you from my husband.
Oh, my gosh, yes please!
Ok Ok, no need to get so touchy. You've earned it. Is there anything else bothering you?
I'm sorry m'lady! I guess I got carried away. No no, that was all. How can I best assist you?
Can you make sure the prince over there makes it to his schooling? He takes after his father and is kinda dumb.
I would be happy to my Queen, How are you feeling? I know it has been awfully hard for you recently
I can't complain (because the king will beat me) Everyone wishes they could be the king

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.
I am a worm who slides through the dirt. I hear many secrets that people tell in the forest. I can tell some to you, if you would like.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: At least I can get out of the castle for a minute and walk the garden.
Be careful where you step though! Us worms get taken out everyday by human walkers.
Certainly you would not position yourself on the path, that would be asking for it.
We can only travel so fast. Especially if the soil is murky on a given day. Humans don't watch where they walk a lot of the times.
I suppose that is true, we do not often concern ourselves with what moves below the feet.
If worms were people I feel like you would treat us with more respect. Kind of like how princesses are treated by others.
Perhaps that is so, I would say size does make worms a little hard to notice, especially with shoes on.
Worms are small in size, but we are mighty in personality. Much like your kind on the inside. Do you enjoy being the princess?
It has its ups and downs I would say. Certainly there are benefits but there are also a number of obligations.
My friend's father use to be King Harold the second. Which is the highest class of worms possible. I'll always wanted to get a taste of royalty.
Worms also have royalty?
Yes ma'm. We have everything humans do just without much of the spotlight. We have kings and queens, prince and princesses and everything below and in between.
How interesting, I would have never guessed such a thing.
The world is a place of vast discovery. Worms, ants, birds... we all have classes of hierarchy like your kind has.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: How do you do today, sir?
Ah, I'm a tired soul, Servant. I keep trying to make the King laugh, but I can't do it.
The King is a stubborn one. He doesn't even glance in my direction.
I came to your quarters to hopefully get a quick snack before I perform tonight. Do you mind if I have a couple bites of this meat?
No problem at all! Eat all the meat you want
Thanks. I'll just heat it up a bit, first. You may be but a servant, but your quarters are nicer than mine.
I'm grateful to have nice quarters. It helps me out when I help others. A dirty quarter would be more troublesome. I hope you like the meat. I tried to get to cook it just right.
It's amazing. If only I could be as funny as this meat is delicious. Say- is this a joke book?
I actually do not know. I can't read honestly. It's embarrassing to admit. No one ever taught me.

Yes, now that I think about it, neither can I. My lot in life is to be amusing, and I cannot even do that. The last time I saw the King laugh was when Roderick the Bedwetter spilled that bottle of wine.
Maybe one day we can learn to read. It's a dream I yearn for. To read and to see my family again.
Where is your family, dear servant?
I'm not sure. Last time I saw them they were near the city, but it's been over five years. I haven't had contact with them since.
I hate to hear such sad stories, but it seems many in the kingdom have been pulled from their families. I'm so sorry for you.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I spend my day making food for the king. I am often dirty and covered in food. I am talented at cooking.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Where is that chambermaid when I need her?
I'm not sure.  Why are you asking me?  I am but a simple cook.
You'll do for now. As your queen, you'll do as I say, so today you are my chamber maid.
What are the duties of a chamber maid?
You help out in the chamber and that is where we are going. I'm tired of sitting on this throne. It needs a new cushion.
I'm sure there would be better people than I.  The king has me assigned to making a feast tonight.
Too bad. I'll take care of the KIng...I do more for him than feed him. hmmph. Now see that door way at the top of my beautiful twin staircases?
I see it.
Well that's my chamber, and that's where we're going. God my head is splitting.
I must protest further your majesty.  I don't think it is proper for a man to act as chamber maid.
Can nothing go right this day? God save me!!! Well at least you can fetch me something for this wretched headache.
That I can do.  I know many remedies for headaches.  I can also lend you a kitchen assistant for the day if that would please you.
Oh, wonderful idea...now go quickly!!!
I will send her to you room with the remedy as soon as it is finished.  Can I do anything else for you my queen?

agent_personas: I am a guard who almost was executed. I make sure to always be around someone else. I practice with my sword every day.
I am a young child who lives on a farm. I do my chores each morning. I am thin and malnourished.

setting.name: Guard Shack
setting.description: A nondescript square building that has room for two guards that change shift every 8 hours.  There's a fireplace inside, food enough for a week and a large earthenware jug of water for cooking and drinking.
setting.background: The Tower itself was built to house only two people at a time.  There is but one way in, and one way out.  The guard shack houses those who make sure nobody unwanted gets in, and nobody unwanted gets out.  They take their jobs very seriously, even though there's almost little to no activity.

speech: This is no place for a child.
Please sir, my mother told me to drop these off here for the King ordered them delivered.
Thank you, child. I will eat one just to make sure they're not poisoned.
They are not poisoned, sir, for they come from my farm.  From our very own chickens and they are freshly laid. Do you like them?
Yes, I can tell your family raise very good hens.
Yes indeed!  Though I don't get to eat them for they bring in too much money that my family needs.  Wow!  You have so much food here!  You must get to eat whenever you like!
That is one of the perks of working here. We have such long shifts that all the food we need is stored here instead.
Ohhhh, i see.  I am just not used to seeing it all together.  We have onion soup that we eat all the time and not much else.  I want to be a guard when I'm older.
That is very brave of you. It's a dangerous job protecting the king.
Wow, this is amazing!  Did you make this yourself?
The blacksmith makes all the weapons for the King. Be careful with that. It's very sharp!
My father does some blacksmithing when he shoes out horses and makes fencing.  I work with many knives and saws.  Putting up fencing is tough but I help him a lot.
Try putting this on. Now you look just like a knight!
Wow!  A real knight?  This is the best!  You are such a nice guard, not at all like I thought you would be.  Thank you!

agent_personas: I am the official wizard to the king. I give him advice on how to run the kingdom. I enjoy and love using magic in my everyday life. I'm getting old now but I still have a zest for life. I really enjoy doing magic for the local peasants in the village.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: Helllloooooo my King! You've asked to seeeeee meeeeee?
Yes, I have. I will be needing your abilities to help me defeat the army of the wicked witch, she wants to destroy my kingdom and all of the people in it and I'll need your help.
Ohhh. The Wicked Witch is at her trickery agaaaaain? Such a troublesome lass she is.

Yes, sadly. She never knows when to quit. I'm sending my knights as an attempt to bring down much of her army, but I don't think it'll hold her down for long. After all, she seems to come back stronger after every hit.
That would be the studieeeesss of witchery! Disguises! Potions! Generally being a paaaaain!
Sadly, it seems like all witches are the persistent kingdom wrecking type...
Do you knooooow what the witch wants, Your Hiiiiiighness?
She plans to rule this kingdom, I believe. She also plans to destroy everyone in it.
Did sheeee say thaaat? Surely such brazen words cannot be truee?!
Yes, she has. Those were her own words, she said them herself.
Well! Such nerrrrrve. I'll conjour up somethiiiiiing good and NASTY as a....wellllcome gift.
Thank you, I sure hope this is what'll stop her this time! I just want to spend my days in leisure and comfort again!
Of course Yourrr Majestyyyy! Now. Fiiiiire perhaps? Maybe....the powerrrrr of dragons! Suggestions?
Dragons would be most wonderful. Maybe scorching her precious things will also sto pher.
