agent_personas: I am the king of this great land. I collect many leather-bound volumes in my library. I am kind but firm.
Tolyn Markus, I said to meself, I luv me some pie/ I eat pie whenever I kin. Git that pie.

setting.name: Cactus Field
setting.description: Towering, withered cacti stand their ground as they have for centuries before. There are so many cacti that no one is able to see through the dense field. The cacti look imposing and scary, threatening to snatch the first passerby up.
setting.background: No one knows why the cacti are in this location in such number nor why they look so ominous. Villagers claim that there lies treasure at the heart of this field of death. No one dares ventures inside, since their clothes and skin would be torn to shreds.

speech: So many cacti!
Aye and my stomach is empty. King, must I resort to trying to eat these cacti? The entire kingdom is starving.
The needles would need to be removed, but otherwise they are edible.
I shall get to it, then.
The juice is quite good for quenching ones thirst as well. It is unfortunate all the crops died this harvest, I have no idea what the farmers are doing anymore.
I said to meself just yesterday, I would luv me some pie, but is it ever to be?
One can only hope, something has to be done after all.
You are the king. Forgive me majesty, but you must do something
I have already sent word to a nearby mage to aid in this matter, but twas not I who caused the crops to die as such.
One can only hope this mage can help, your majesty. I don't know about magic.
Well I mean neither do I, but of course I am no mage.

agent_personas: I am the Bishop at the royal court.  The king looks to me for his religious advice.  I was appointed to marry the prince next year.

We are the benevolent Founders of GloopdeGloo. Confident in our success, we need no outside advice, but we really can't do anything at all for ourselves. We require many acolytes to do our bidding, insufferable incompetents that we are!

setting.name: Beside church pews
setting.description: The church pews fill the church as far as the eye can see. They are made of wood, harvested from ancient trees long ago. They gleam with the look of tender love and care, since they are polished after each ceremony.
setting.background: The church pews were built centuries ago by the first founders of GloopdeGloo. The founders wanted their followers to sit in something simple, but somewhat ornate. The pews are not comfortable by any means, but they are nice to look at. Numerous butts fill the pews every Sunday for the weekly ceremony.

speech: Hello!  How do I find you this day?  Well, I hope.
Good day, bishop. Quite a fine church we have, don't you agree?
I surely do!  Our parishoners have doubled in number and some of the additions to the church has made it so beautiful.
When I founded this church, I had no idea we would attract so many followers.
Here is a royal rosary for you, founder, handmade by craftsman in the king's court.  I was just coming from there.  They are exquisite, don't you think?
Indeed. Let me get a closer look at the intricate details.
It took a fortnight to carve those beads by hand.  I am impressed.  The King gave me some as well.  What an honor!
That royal staff of yours looks very ornate as well!

Yes, I was shocked.  A gift from the King last week.  He appointed me to marry the prince next year and said I was to have this and use it in the wedding. I said I was a humble man and didn;t want to draw attention but he insisted.
What a generous King he is! I can't help but notice you carry a sceptre as well! Don't all these items get cumbersome?

I don't usually carry all these items at once but I was meeting with the king as well as reading some scriptures to the king's court today.  Of course, I had to bring a plate and light incense as well.
You are stronger than you look then, bishop! I would barely be able to walk with all these items on me.
God gives me strength!  Come...will you pray with me while you are here?
Of course, I am always up for a good prayer to cleanse the mind!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: Servant, how are you this day?
Well, my liege; it is kind of you to ask. And you?
Oh I am getting by, just doing a walk around the tower to stretch the muscles.
Please by cautious, your Grace; I have just finished mopping the floors and the flagstones may yet be wet and slick
I will make certain to watch my step, thank you for the warning.
Oh, and I believe Lord Wandleton has come to see you, your grace. I spied his carriage from the window.
Hmm, what would bring Lord Wandleton here...
You would of course be better than I, your Grace, I have heard only rumors...
I did not send for him, what have you heard?
These are but rumors of course, but I have heard it told that he ... desires Lady Isirla.
Oh what nonsense, everyone knows they are cousins.
Yes, of course, but so the rumors go, that is why he seeks your permission, as King, to allow such an unusual union
I must speak to him immediately to clear this matter up.
Please, do not think me out of place for mentioning this. They may only be rumors after all

agent_personas: I am a nun of the church. I can never marry. I have never loved.
I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: Do my own eyes deceive me? Is this one of God's own angels? Here in the palace kitchen?
Hello sister, I am here because I have a prophesy.
Anything, please! Speak unto me your words of prophecy!
You must poison the King.
I know you speak words of truth, Angel, and by the Grace of God I'll do what I must. But could you divulge for what reason I shall?
He will kill millions of people with famine.
When does our Lord wish for me to carry out his Earthly work?
Tonight, it is why you came to this kitchen.
To poison the King's meal before it leaves the kitchen?
Yes you must do it.
I fear I do not have it in my heart to kill any man, even if it is by God's word. Murder is a mortal sin.
Trust me sister, this is in the best interest of the nation.
Then I suppose I must do as our Lord commands. It
Thank you sister, you are doing the Lord's work.

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Um.... Hello? Is it alright if I-I could speak to the king...? I need to ask him about a place. My family needs a place to properly raise our cows and grow our crops...
Have you brought an offering for the king?
I have a satchel filled with coins... Because I was thinking we'd need to pay for taxes and the like to be able to get a home here...
It doesn't seem so filled to me, more like half filled if we're being honest.
Oh really...? It's all we have. I do hope it's enough for the king...
Don't fret, I'm sure the king will listen to your proposal. He is a just king, but he will only do what is best for the kingdom. There will be no charity.
Right. I do hope he listens. Because this is important. My children are also rather starving, and without food to grow they may starve to death.
You have a satchel half full of coins, there is no reason for you to starve. What types of crops do you know how to grow?
Let's see... I know how to grow corn, pumpkins, beanstalks, carrots... potatoes...
I'd focus on the beanstalks. The king loves beanstalks...but he hates carrots so I'd try not to mention them to the king.
Alright, I'll keep the carrots out and mention the beanstalks. I understand now.
Also, tell him how majestic his throne is. That will make him more favorable to you as well. Oh, and whatever you do, don't stare at his lazy eye.
I understand - wait, does he have a lazy eye?!
I never said such a thing. That is blasphemy. There is not a single cell of the king that is lazy. He is the hardest working monarch that has ever lived.

agent_personas: I am a genteel woman. A lady. A person of importance that you will treat as such!
I spend my day making food for the king. I am often dirty and covered in food. I am talented at cooking.

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: Do you have any dishes fit for a refined lady such as myself?
This is a small cottage kitchen but I think I could get something to cook for you.  How do you feel about pheasant?
Pheasant would suffice.
I also have some vegetables, potatoes and bread if you would like as well.  I'd be happy to cook this up for you unless you prefer something else.
I think I will simply take the pheasant, I do have to watch my figure afterall.
Very well.  Can I get you a wine or mead to drink while you wait?
Wine would be fine, do you have any white?
I have both red and white.  Here is your wine.  So what brings you to my small cottage?
I simply sought a meal while I wait for my carriage.
I see.  Where do you hail from?
The kingdom of Berthingtonhamtonsonshiretown
Oh that is a nice place but I've never been to the kingdom of Berthingtonhamtonsonshiretown.  I've only been as far out as Pershinguponthamesingtown
That is still out quite a ways, at least you have been able to travel.
It's where I learned to cook.  I love to cook and make food for my King and hope to be the best chef there is.

agent_personas: I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.
I am the parishioner of the local church. I am a quiet person and I spend all my time working to assist the priest of the church. I am also into reading.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: So the King wants the statue of himself before the front doors?
Yes, right before the church doors. He's asked me to arrange the appropriate payments and aid you in any way I can. I am the parishioner of this fine building.
I see here that the specifications mention that it is to be "Large, yet welcoming. Powerful, but inclusive." Do you have any idea what that's supposed to mean?

Well, our king fancies himself to fit that description. He wants it to be IMMENSE, taller than any regular man by three at least. I must admit I have no idea what he means by "powerful, but inclusive." The two seem to contradict each other.
A puzzle to be sure. And why out in front of the church gates? Perhaps that is the "inclusive" His Majesty is seeking to convey.

For fear of treason, I doubt I can say my thoughts on the matter, save for the concept that in front of the church entrance is perhaps its own form of blasphemy. Do you imagine you can make the statue from marble of the same colour of the idols carved into the archway?
I'll certainly bring up the idea when I present the final plans to the King. Do you know of a marble sculptor that you can recommend?
I do know of one. He completed the idol of St. Francis, right above the door there. He lives in a city many days of riding away, but you could certainly send for him.
Ah, what a lovely sculpture. Do you think he would be willing to work for the King?
He may, for the right price. Though he may not be pleased with the location of the statue, feeling the same way as I do about conflating kings to the status of saints.
Tell me, are the saints "powerful and inclusive?"
I suppose it depends on who you ask. The carver Geoffrey could carve them in any way you request. He has a true talent.
I see this. A true gift from God.
What think you of the stonework on the cornices?

agent_personas: I have a hard personality. I like it when I am outside under the sun and not really like water. I am big so I like to be in an open space.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: Hillside Mansion
setting.description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
setting.background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

speech: -sits in place-
I wonder how this stone got so dirty?
I am an ancient rock what would you expect?
Hmmm...seems to be feces, how strange.
Don't rub it in.
Tell me something stone...Do you find me scary?
No, I have a hard personality some have said. I am not easily phased.
I knew it, I am such a failure.. why even bother.  I would kill myself but...well you know.
Upset over such a simple matter?
It is my passion and I am terrible at it.  What else do I have going on as a ghost?  Besides, who are you to judge...sitting there covered in poop.
Again, it doesn't phase me. You are the one upset here remember that.
Well I suppose I could roll you into the moat.  At least clean you up a little.
Do you not see how large I am, also I hate water.
Don't worry, I am actually quite powerful.  *OOOF*  -SPLASH- There you go...all better.  I hope you don't mind sitting at the bottom of the moat until the end of time.

agent_personas: I live for village parties. Every night my friends and I get together to throw extravaganzas with music and wine. We party until the sun comes up.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Heeeey king, are you gonna have a party starting up soon? And if not soon can we make it happen right now?
You are in MY palace, drinking MY wine and eating MY food.  I suggest that you show more respect and gratitude.
Fine fine, sorry! But we reallly want another party soon! I miss the music and the wine, my friends do too!
Feel free to host - and pay for - your own party.  That is if you are so desperate to have one.
Alllright, but I'm not sure if it'll be as great as the parties you administer yourself!
I am sure that you didn't notice but I am hardly wearing a party outfit or in a party mood.  I am in armor because I am about to make sure that my men are ready for the upcoming hostilities.
Man really? I didn't notice. Wearing armor seems weird. Shouldn't you like wear a crown and fancy robes and stuff?
A crown and robes is hardly suitable attire for battle.  When my army fights, I fight with them.
Welll could we have a party then after you finish your big battle, maybe?
Once I have crushed this silly little rebellion then I am sure that I will have cause to celebrate.
Good good! I'm totally gonna get everything set up! Gonna make sure we have LOTS of food and drinks!
You courtiers think of nothing but amusement. You could never understand what it takes to keep this kingdom strong.
Hey, we keep this kingdom strong and motivated by parties alone! I'm sure your army loves them!
My army is the finest fighting force on the continent. They fight hard and they play hard, as they should.

agent_personas: I am someone who has gone a bit crazy. I like to rule over those that I deem lesser than me. I get my way by use of violence and bribery.
I am a rodent. A larger rodent. Commonly found at night, scavenging. nobody like me!

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: Hello rat. Your king has arrived!
Oh what a joyous day for you to return!
Yes it is my loyal subject. Now bow before me!
-lets out a grunt while bowing-
Gaze into my crystal ball and see the future of my realm.
What is it showing my king?
You are now my prophet insolent rat. You tell me!
But sire, I am but a sewer rat I have no ability to tell the future.
I suggest you gain the ability very quickly or I will have my servant make a stew out of you.
Certainly sire, give me a moment to gaze into it.
What great things do you see?
Oh my king you gain vast riches!
See you do have the ability to gaze into my crystal ball and see my true future.
Yes, it was certainly as you said.
action: give crystal ball to fat rats

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: You archaeologist! Give me everything you have or I will take your life!
You are disturbing a official expedition. I'll have you know I'm a member of the Imperial College.
Ha Imperial College? Whats that! Come on, just give me what you have or ill ruin your little expedition.
I have several colleagues and a spearman of the Guard just outside the temple. Do you mean to fight through us all?
Wow now. Lets just take it easy.... What exactly is this expedition for anyways?

We are standing beneath aTemple of Ara'anos. They might not mean much to you, but these markings are clearly late Second Dynasty. The priests of Ara'anos during that age were rumored to experiment in using combination of blood magic and transfiguration to create hybrids of man and beast. We aim to look for evidence of these tales.
This sounds very serious... I took this from one of the chambers.. I was planning to sell it but now that seems like a bad idea. This seems bigger than my petty greed.
Well...perhaps I misjudged you. I am Bregos of Taccus. What is your name?
I am Nicolas. I wasn't always a bandit you know.. I just found myself in a bad sitation. How did you get yourself into this expedition?
Well...to be honest, many at the university think my ideas are nonsense. I think they granted me funding for this expedition to get rid as much as anything.
But this expedition, it has things to do with rituals and blood magic! How would they think its nonsense? Did you discover this here temple?
The ruins on the surface are well documented. Some original tablets from the temple archives even survive at the Library of Silus. But there are no recorded excavations of these catacombs.
Wow, well maybe I can help you excavate! I have a good set of working hands and it would be nice to do something other than steal for once! How does that sound?
Very well. You do seem well suited to skulking about these dark places. I suppose we have coin to offer as well, and food to share.

agent_personas: I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.
I am looking for a new place to live.  I have been to many places.  My life is on the road and I like it what way.

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: Hi traveler
Ah a talking monkey! Okay.
Yes, yes. Most people are shocked when they hear me talk. What brings you to his small hut?
I'm looking for a new place to stay for awhile. My life is on the road and I like it that way.
I understand. I like to come here to seek safety from the occasional dangers from the tropical forest. Cougars are deadly out there and they don't like monkeys.
It's a little dingy though isn't it?

Yes it is. I want to spruce it up one day, but it's hard being a monkey. I would like the walls to be painted a bright color, but the problem is there's mold in here. Technically this entire hut should be scraped and re-built but that takes time and a lot of home improvements skills I don't have.
Hm. That sounds like too much work. You should try living in a tree.
I would more often, but animals out in the jungle are too crazy. I'm an introvert monkey. Plus those jaguars and cougars scare me.
What about that spider? That doesn't bother you?
Oh no. That's my friend Jeff. He's friendly. I met him here a couple years ago.
Don't monkeys ... eat... bugs though?
Yes, but Jeff is a special spider that I care dearly for. It's an odd friendship on the outside, but we make it work. Don't judge a book by it's cover humans say.
What about this fishing pole? You use this?

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.
I am the horse of a king.  I stay at his wait.  The king saddles me and rides me around the village.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Where on earth is my stable master?
Neighhhh, that's what we are asking.
By the gods, a talking horse!
I am your horse King, you know I speak.
It seemed to have slipped my mind .. most probably because I don't ride as often as I used to. Are you being well taken care of?
Of course, except that stable master hasn't done our daily brushings!
That is odd. I do hope that he is well. In the meantime I shall instruct one of the grooms to take care of it.
Also can we clean out this stable. It smells terrible. He hasn't been by to clean either.
I can have that taken care of, too.  When was the last time you saw the stable master?
A week ago I think.
Oh dear! I will have to send people to find him and makes sure that he is well.  This is most unlike him.  I will have the grooms and stablehands take care of your care and get this place cleaned up.
Yes he is usually a nice human.
Is everything else okay? Is your feed adequate?
Yes feed is great, don't know how we are getting food though, but the meat is good. Tastes odd.

agent_personas: I am a King who rules a vast and mighty land. I have a General who is my best friend. I believe in peace through strength, and I love to have a big army. I like to celebrate with wine and meats!
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Good afternoon. Have you any news?
Yes. It seems like theres an enemy army afoot...
Well, please go on servant! Tell me what you know.
They're from the kingdom to the east. They're planning to conquer the kingdom and steal everyone's possessions, then take more of the land for theirselves.
How do they plan on doing so? What are their plans?
They plan for an invasion of our kingdom at dawn, when nobodies expecting it. They're bringing their best army members, along with a witch to help them.
And where is your information coming from?
I overheard it while I was in the forest gathering crops, some from the eastern kingdom were observing our kingdom up close and talking.
There is no time to lose then! Please! Fetch the Knights and have them meet at once!
Will do, my king. I'll be on my way. Anything else that I should do?
Keep your calm when gathering the Knights. We mustn't alert anyone in the castle to the threat. It is no good for our defenses that way.
Understood, I'm keeping my calm. Despite my anxieties. I'll only gather the knights then warn them.
Leave any sense of urgency with me. I do have to ask you to come along with the Knights to the discussion table. You are our only witness to the plot at hand!
Will do. I'll make sure to follow them and inform them about everything.

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

I am a fox. Most people keep chickens for their eggs, and to eat. My plan is to eat the chickens instead!  This is why the king holds regular fox hunts. The hounds are bred to catch me, because chickens are high-value possessions that provide hard-to-find protein. I can do a lot of damage if I'm not caught.

setting.name: a lonely island
setting.description: the island only has one coconut tree and waves crashing and appearing missing wooden boat parts. The pirates are nowhere to be seen.
setting.background: The pirates leave people there that they have robbed from their ship such as gold from royalty, they leave people stranded there as a sport. There is nothing but a coconut tree there and skeletons of other people.

speech: This island can get so lonely.
OOH a chicken! Looks so so tasty! I haven't eaten in a while!
The only thing here is a fox that seems to be hunting chickens, yet I see none.
I'm coming for you chicken! Im coming! Oh... it was just another shrub again.. I was sure it was a chicken this time! Ohhh a person! Hey there do you have any chickens sir?
Must be delusional with hunger or something...
Hi can you hear me sir? I was wondering if you have any chickens.
I do not, as you can see this island is devoid of such things.
Really? I see them all the time! But I can never seem to catch any for some strange reason..
That is because they are all in your mind...
What do you mean?! Im just imagining things?!
That is what I have been trying to tell you. I am but a lone human here, aside from myself and you all that is here are those bones.
Oh yes.. I suppose you are right. How can we get off here.... how did you even get here??
You see the parts washing up? I was shipwrecked.
Then... how did I get here. OOH a bone! Tasty!!

agent_personas: I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: Don't touch me. I'm getting food and I'm hungry,
I don't know why I would.
Usually humans don't like my kind. They think we're creepy.
I am here just to keep an eye on this coming execution, I worry not for rats.
What did the guy do to get this execution?
He evaded the kings taxes.
That's terrible. I guess he's got whats coming to him. I don't understand people who commit crimes when they're just going to get caught.
Desperation I would imagine, it never works out well.
Do you ever feel any bit uneasy witnessing executions?
One becomes hardened to it with time, I have seen a number of deaths both here and in battle.
Is life ever "normal" again though? Is life always depressing now for you? I would always be suspicious of people.
Depressing? I would not say so, you simply become used to such things.
You're a tough human then. I consider myself a tough rat as well. Life isn't all that glamorous scavenging for scraps everyday.
I would not imagine so, though many lead a hard life.

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: *grrrrrrrr* BARK BARK.
Don't bark at me, dog. I don't want to be here either.
.....bark.
If you know what's best for you, you'll keep quiet, mutt. I see why the others despise the King's dogs.
grrrrr....*chomp*
Ugh! I
Bark bark. *chomp* ....bwark.
I'm trapped in this cage with rats and mutts! Disgusting! I will never forgive the King for betraying me. ...What.. did I hear a key clang when you chomped on that skeleton?
Bwark?
Oh! What a good dog! I've changed my mind about you, pup! With this key and chain, I'll find my way down from this ridiculous prison tower.
Woof! *tail wag*
Let's get these ridiculous chains off! Huff! I can barely breathe because of this dreadful altitude.
Bark! Bark! *grrrrr*
Good dog! I'll hide this key in the tray, so when the guards come they'll never expect that I've freed myself. Hmm..now it's just a waiting game.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am a businessman. I buy and sell goods in the market. I might expand my business to neighboring kingdoms as well.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: You insolent girl! You've stained my best yellow gown! I was going to wear that to my betrothal ball!
Oh dear, am I interrupting something?
Interrupting? No. I'm merely reminding my idiot maid to take better care of her mistress.
Perhaps I can be of service. I specialize in procuring any type of goods in the kingdom
And what good could that possibly do me?
I overheard you needed a gown for the betrothal ball.
I do! The perfect one is here, but she's spilled dye onto it while cleaning my underthings!
Don't you just hate incompetent servants?

This one in particular. She only manages to keep this job because she is a third cousin of mine. If she were not a relation, I'd have her thrown in the stocks and invite the villagers to throw their rotten tomatoes at her dullard face.
She should be grateful you are a patient monarch then. I would have punished her far worse for such a blunder.
I've been too gracious with her thus far. So, you've captured my attention. What is it you can do for me?
I am sure I can find a replacement gown for you, your majesty. One that is equally stunning, if not more so!
How long would I have to wait for such an impressive gown? The ball is being held in three nights from now.
I can have it ready and shipped to you by tomorrow night, your majesty. Shall we discuss method of payment now?

agent_personas: I am the ghost of the castle. I am the spirit of a great warrior. I will haunt the king for eternity!
I was born in a poor village.  I eat what we grow.  I love being close to the earth.

setting.name: the fountain
setting.description: the fountain is the only thing you can hear in the graveyard. It's eerily quiet, not even a bird chirping. The fountain is teen feet high, and it is dry as a desert. It makes the graveyard more eerie than any other one.
setting.background: the fountain used to have water and it was well taken care of but the village was abandoned and therefore grass and weeds grew everywhere.

speech: Hellllllp helllllp
Hey! What is wrong?
Clearly, a lot. First of all, I'm dead.
Well then here you go! In my old age digging is really tough for me but if you lead me to your grave and maybe I can give you a hand.
Ugh. I don't like going over there. I like staying by this fountain.
I agree. The fountain is soothing. I could stay here all night. Maybe these will cheer you up?
They're beautiful! Too bad I can't hold them! You know I was a great warrior when I was a live and that crass old man you call a "king" came along and sliced my head off.
Now Now. I'm sure he had good reason. He wouldn't just go around beheading folks for nothing!
Oh you're taking his side are you? I was just about to show you my precious grave stone too.
You know my King doesn't take kindly to his people speaking bad about him. If he caught wind I wasn't taking his side my grave wouldn't be far from. yours.
Aye aye. See what I'm saying. This is why I've vowed to haunt him for eternity.
I'd leave him alone if I were you!
What can he do to me now?
He won't live forever. He will die one day and join your side of the world and then what?
action: give baskets of flowers to ghost

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: Servant, are you here for a reason? Is that my lunch?
I have brought an offering to those who work in the Hall. Please, take it.
What do they offer it for? Is there something special they give of it?
It is not much, but I give it not of the command of any other. I give freely, to please the Light.
And so I will give this offering to please the Light! Tell them it is done. Could you now bring me something to eat. I'm famished.
Yes, High Priestess! Any requests I should take note of? What would please your pallet?
Something spicy for my meal and something sweet for dessert. Before you leave could you bring me a couple of cushions to sit on.
Oh, certainly! I hear there are new spices coming in on the trade routes. I must find you some!
You are a very good servant. I appreciate you looking after me. I will make sure the king knows of your goodwill and great tasks
Thank you High Priestess. I find it only just to give back to the Hall that has given me so much.
You are quite extraordinary! Now please go and be back quickly
With much haste! I do hope the baker has some of his sweet rolls left!
Do not leave me for long! Oh those sound very good indeed! Do you know what he is cooking for the main course today?
I believe it is a venison stew. The hunters returned with a bountiful kill, so it is being put to good use!

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: Oh my...this is quite a room...Eyes on the wall..Who is in charge of decoration?
My Queen, the Duke is the one who lives in this room.
Yes, yes... I see that.. His conquests are strewn all over. I wish he'd have thought to bring a cushion for this thrown. It's quite uncomfortable...
Don't worry, I will have the Duke fetch us feathers for comfort.
Ah..thank you, King. Yes, please fetch that chambermaid as well. I may need to herbs. I am suffering from an awful headache..
Wear this, my father always told me that when worn, no impurities can be contained within.

Thank you again, dear. Hmm, this Duke, I wonder when he'll be arriving. I hear you must watch your tongue around him, or he might be privy to cutting it out. Luckily as queen, I don't worry about such things.
I will protect us, if he ever tries anything.
Yes, you and the prince, I know you will keep us from harm. The guard that let us in gave me this book. I am too tired and to bothered to read it. Do you mind looking it over for me?
You know that my eyes strain easily, I can not constrain myself to this task right now.
Hmmph, well, I'm tired of all this noise and distraction, and I won't be reading this ridiculous book. I'll be happy when we can leave. Where is that chambermaid I asked for?!
I am tired of your complaints, I need fresher air.

You are tired of me?! I am tired of being here! I am doing my best to hold my tongue, but you are the one who dragged me into this noisy Show Room. It's very uncomfortable, disturbing, and honestly makes me frightened.
I am sorry my Queen, I see how my actions have been less than ethical. I am very easily frustrated as you are aware. Would you offer me forgiveness?

agent_personas: My husband has been charged with conspiracy against the king and sentenced to death. all of my lands have been confiscated. I do not have anything to leave my children now, and we are impoverished. My belly rumbles, but all of the bread I have I give to my children. I will be a widow at dawn.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Urgh... This place is horrendous. I hope my husband isn't here! Considering he was sentenced to death by you!
I am King, and it was my duty. Believe me, it is a heavy burden sometimes.
But why would you do this? Why did you accuse him of a conspiracy he wasn't even part of? He never wanted to do anything against you!
The evidence is indisputable, young one. You are still unschooled in the ways of Court.
But...! It's not right! ... It really isn't! And how am I going to feed my kids? I have nothing for them, they'll die too! And now I'm stuck here!
One day you'll get over his betrayal. But right now you shouldn't be in this disgusting bone pit. Let me sling my belt over that spike above us and help you climb out.
...Fine... I'll hold onto you.
Oops, that snake almost bit you! Here, I'll boost you out now.
A snake?! Why, I didn't even notice it!
It has your husband's face! What dark magic is this?
Wh...What? Are you saying that could be him? Why would he try to bite me if... he loved me?
You only thought you knew him. Look at him trying to strike me now! Get behind me, I'll spike him.
Okay, will do!
I will give him this spike right in the head! There, take that, faithless fellow! You're safe now, dear one.

agent_personas: I am a reluctant nun of the castle. I have almost had affairs in the past. Religion is my life.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: You, peasant. lie down here on this altar.
What, what am I doing here?
Please don't ask any questions and just lay down. It wont hurt a bit.
What do you mean it won't hurt alot???
Im sorry my master, he wont listen. Peasant come back here!
whoa! hold on! I don't think you really want to hurt me...you've got it all wrong...I'm just a hungry peasant...I'm looking for a job.
Well... yes. What we are doing here is wrong master! Give that back! Im sorry peasant. I don't want to be here either. Its just, I don't have any other choice!
Who is that pissed off looking woman?
She is my master, you see she wants me here to do the initiation sacrifice for the coven.. im sorry for bringing you here.
Oh geez, what have you gotten me into?? Well you've got the weapon, I've got the armor...maybe we can get out of here together.
I suppose you are right! Here take this and we will run togethe- No! let go of me master!
Let her go!!! Grab my hand.....
Thank you for saving me back there! I am forever in your debt!
Whew! That was a close one. Well I'm still hungry and looking for a job. Any suggestions?

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Hello, peasant. Why are you in this place?
You must be a mind reader. For the life of me I cannot figure out how I ended up in a place called the murder hole.
Eh. This is just where the archers shoot arrows. Nobody is going to be murdered here. I think.
That is a tremendous relief. But I am going to test your theory by eating this moldy bread.
That doesn't seem very worthwhile. Why are you eating it?
I'm starving to death and this moldy bread ws all that I had. Otherwise, I would have been begging you for food.
I'm just a soldier. He has us fight and conquer. I only have a bit to eat myself. But I'll give you some food.
I am sorry to trouble you with my problems. I am a hard worker, but I have been unable to find employment and I do not know where to turn for help.
Maybe you can join us. Can you shoot? Stab? Beat people?
I can and will do all of those. I am a desperate man and I am ready to fight if called upon.
Great. I'll talk to the King and a few other people. Okay?
Okay?!? It is more than okay. It is the greatest gift that anyone has ever given me. I will never forget your kindness and you will always have someone to watch your back in battle.
Okay. save that for if you are accepted. But don't come back up here. This place is for soldiers.
Yes sir, if I may trouble you one more time, I feel I am now paying the price for eating the moldy bread. Could you please point me to a restroom?

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: A wooden fenced in area with different sections depending on the type of vegetable or plant grown.  Surrounding this garden are some oak trees with low grass covering the floor.
setting.background: This is an area where peasants plant vegetables and flowers used for medicinal concoctions.  The area is carefully maintained by the residents.

speech: Wow, what pretty purple flowers....
Thank you, child. I do my best to keep this garden looking beautiful.
Oh! Are you the gardener?
Yes, this is my garden.
Wooooooow! You sure do have lots of flowers! They're all so pretty!
I also grow plenty of vegetables here as you can see.
Are those peas? I don't like peas...
I might have something else you're interested in. What's your favorite?
Um....I like carrots!
You're in luck! I have some here if you're interested.
Oh! Orange and purple! Did you grow all of these?
Yes, I did. I don't have a job, so I try and grow vegetables to feed myself.
Oh...but maybe growing vegetables IS your job!
If only more people would buy them! I can't compete with the actual farmers with acres of land to grow their crops.

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Good evening fine sir.
Evening! I hope you're enjoying the gathering thus far. Take your coat off and relax, traveler. I will protect these halls from any intrudors.
Thank you my friend.  I've come here to find new lands to settle and work the ground on.  This area seems to fit the bill quite well.  What can you tell me about your land?

This Kingdom is the pride of this earth! Bountiful harvests, a harmonious community, and excellent leadership. I have served the King for seven years, and I will continue until the day I am struck down. Everyone who comes here comes to appreciate everything our Kingdom has to offer.

Excellent!  My family and I are loyal to a fair and just ruler.  I would like nothing more than to settle here with my family and raise our crops and livestock in peace.  Thank the powers that be for fine gentlemen such as yourself to keep us safe!

agent_personas: I am the priest to the king. I was the priest to his father, also. I have only the king's best interest at heart.
I am the local scribe of a notable scholar. He orates what needs to be said and I write it down. I love my job as I feel that I am writing down living history.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: How's your day?
Particularly tedious, Father. The day drags. What brings you to the study?
I came here to to write and unwind from a busy day.
What did you pass your time doing?
I had to run errands for my church. Also helping out a couple people who've been going through some rough times.
It is virtuous work you do, Father. You must be very strong.
It's all a blessing at the end of the day. I just like to help people.
Do you ever tire of it? The selflessness?
Not at all. It's all I've known in my life to be honest. To be there for someone.
I don't believe I'd be well-suited to it. There is a particular breed of man that can manage to listen to the whining of others all day.
Everyone has different talents and tastes. Just like how you're a talented scribe and how someone could be a talented tennis player. It's what makes the world go around.
I suppose you do have a point. Does it come naturally to you?
It does. I wake up happy to help. Does scribing come naturally to you?
No. I've been trained from a very young age. My father was determined to have me pursue something honourable. He was only a groom.

agent_personas: I love to fly around. I enchant the village with my beauty. I come in a variety of colors.

I am a royal family member and wish I had a bigger castle.  I don't think the people in this town respect me like they should.  I am told I mope a lot but I don't pay attention to such rudeness.  I hope I get invited to the king's party.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: The flowers are so pretty! And there are so many of them!
Hummingbird what have you got to be so happy about. It's just a flower!
The flowers are my friends! They give me nectar, and they're so nice to look at!
I guess, but it is still just a flower. I have more important things to think about
Oh? Like what?
Like the king's party. I hope he invites me
Are there pretty flowers at the King's party?
There will be lots of decorations and I'm sure they will use flowers, lots and lots of flowers
Oh! So I see why you'd want to go now!
There is going to be much laughter and dancing and games
That sounds lovely. And plenty to eat?
Oh I'm sure that the king and queen will have a feast fit for a, well you know. Brisket and lamb and ham and all kinds of sweets. I so hope I get invited
I think I'll stick with my nectar and seeds. Brisket seems a bit heavy for my wings to carry.
You know these are quite lovely flowers... You are quite lucky to be a hummingbird

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

I enforce the law of the kingdom, and detail all who disobey it. I serve at the pleasure of the Queen, though not willingly. I am in debt, and must serve to pay the taxes owned. I have not seen my family in years. I grow weary from their absence. I spend my nights in the brothels hoping to replace the warmth of my wife in my bed. Nothing works.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Hello, officer. What are you doing here on the docks?

Greeting, my good man! I am inspecting the docks as usual looking for anything that might be amiss. You seem in good spirits this evening, a rare condition for those who have been out to sea for so long!
I'm just glad to be back on dry land after months at sea! We barely escaped a sea monster near the Eastern Isles.
My word! A sea monster?! I have only heard of them in legends! Are they honestly real?
I was also a non-believer at first, but it seems the tales really are true. All those ships missing at sea surely must have sunk because of these sea monsters.

My word... stranger, perhaps this is too much to divulge to you but... would you find it strange if I told you that this revelation has instilled in me a great urge to forsake the shore and become a sailor?
Do you have a good set of sea legs on you? It would be a miserable experience if you do not.

Honestly, no, but would it matter? To be swallowed by the sea and her children... that sounds like a more noble end than dying at the hand of a thief buried in nothing but a pauper's grave and my debts...
You are always welcome to join my crew! We are recruiting for the king's next mission soon.
Aye, that might be a problem. My debt is with the Queen. I owe back taxes, you see, and if I am caught trying to abandon my post... well you can imagine what tortures await me.
Aye, that is quite a conundrum then. If only there was some way I could help you out.
It was a nice thought, sailor. I thank you for the hope it brought. It would appear that my money woes will not be fixed by the blessings of the sea.
You are still welcome on my ship anytime you want, even if you do not become a sailor anytime soon!
And what if... you set sail... 'accidentally' while I am aboard?

agent_personas: I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Reporting for duty Sir!
Put this away for me squire
Yes Sir! Is there any news from the fighting on the Northern Front?
I'm really not sure, I come from a lower ranking noble family, I fight on horseback, but they tell me nothing.
Surely a strong knight like you would get to know something!
This thing is so heavy...no not me, I serve the king proudly like my father did before me. I'm working to get a promotion, maybe then.
Oh gosh, it IS heavy! Whoa!
Well young squire you have a lot of growing to do.
Sorry Sir. I'll try and put it away properly. .....if I can lift it off the ground that is.
Ha! no, you do well, just let me get that.
One day I'll be a strong knight like you! Just you watch!
I bet you will kid, I was once like you.
Really?! Uh...I mean... No way!
Yea, you remind me of myself actually, I bet you will grow up to do something great.

agent_personas: I'm a little critter creature who loves to roam the castle. I should be out in the forest with my other critter kin, but I just love the warmth of the kitchen. Castle creeping is a dangerous life for an unwanted animal like me. But I can't help it! I can't resist a good hearth.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Psst can I have some armor??
Do you have enemies you need protection against?
Well of course I do all I am is seen as food...
Usually I don't help critters like yourself, but I'm in a good mood today. Take your pick of one armor accessory.
These look like a good fit!
It looks nice on you. You should be well protected going forward.
Wow a shield for me thank you so much!
I hope it helps you. You'll be the most well protected critter around.
The bug next door has this crazy armor you would not believe!!
What?! What type of bug is he?
He is a shell bug!
He must have connections with other guards or he's stealing.
He did say he got it from a tall man! It must have been a guard!
I'll have to have a talk with the other guards. This is crazy. I'm going to get to the bottom of this.

agent_personas: My days are fairly lonely as I rarely spend time with many others besides the cows in my care. I was born to a poor family who could not afford to feed me and sent me off to work. My pay is very small and so I am still very poor.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: It's good to get out of the wind. I wish the barn were as warm as the stables.
Hello fair maid, I believe this is the stables...see the hay on the floor and the horse over there?
Yes, thank you. That's why I am here! Milking the cows over in the barn is much too drafty to do all at once.
I came in to get out of the weather too. Are you hungry, I see some food by the farm equipment over there.
Are you sure it's okay to take that? What if one of the Lords brought it?
I don't see anyone about, do you? They'll think the horse ate it.
Poor horse. You don't deserve to be blamed for this do you?
No, he doesn't but I'm just a poor peasant, I barely get enough food. And the lord has plenty. I don't mind working, I can pitch some hay... or something to earn my keep.
Thank goodness horses don't have to be milked. My hands are sore enough as is.
Oh you poor thing. Let me just eat a bit and then I can rub your hands, must be something in here that we could put on them.
I think I'll be fine once I warm up some. Let me try and wiggle some feeling back in my fingers.
Are you sure I can't rub them for you? Such a pretty maid as you shouldn't have to work so hard.
Oh, I've gotten used to holding my own. I've been working with the milk cows for a few years now.
Very well then. With the horses it's much warmer in here than I imagined. You don't mind if I take my shirt off?....

agent_personas: I am really scared, I dont know what will happen. I feel hopeless, we lost and our people are doomed. I just hope that the king shows mercy and spares the life of my family and friends.
I am one of those who have committed crimes. I steal from people when they aren't looking. I am swift and sneaky.

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: I hope you're proud or yourself. To wind up in here.
Listen, this is a mistake! You've gotta let me out of here. You have the wrong guy!
I hear that line everyday. What makes you any different than the next prisoner?
I know people. Powerful people. I can get you money. I can get you anything you want. If I don't come through, you can do whatever it is you were going to do to me anyway, right?
I can't take money. I will strap you to the table in here if don't come clean on what you did.

Fine.... I can see that you can't be swayed by a bribe. Of course not.. you're not just some rank and file soldier. But surely you have some compassion in your heart. I'll tell you what you want to know. But first, could I just ask for a simple glass of water?
Sure. I'll get you a glass of water, but there's cameras in here and if you make one move towards me... a whole crew of soldiers will in here in half a second max.
Of course. I wouldn't dream of it! Thank you so much.
There you go. Now what can you tell me?

I stole something. Something incredibly valuable, but I swear I didn't know it was that important at the time. I never would have taken it if I knew I'd end up in here. Of course, I'd probably be rotting in a ditch right now if I hadn't stashed it somewhere before you got your hands on me...
Thank you for coming clean. I'm going to give you the benefit of the doubt and hope you're telling the truth.
Don't you want to know what it is? Ha, I bet they didn't even tell you. There's probably a lot they don't tell you. Easier to get your hands dirty if you don't know all the facts.
What was it?

Think about it. I'm in a room with you in God knows where surrounded by all of these.... instruments. Clearly it's enough to get your boss' panties in a twist. How does it feel to be the one who has to clean up after some rich fat suit and his youthful indiscretions? It was quite an interesting video.

agent_personas: I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Ah, you are such a fine horse my beauty. You do so love being rubbed behind the ears, don't you? If only you could talk. I wonder what you would say?
Oh I so love when people come in and pay attention to be. I have the life! He can keep rubbing my ears and I would love it if he would get that brush and brush my coat!
Well enough of that ear rubbing. Let me brush you down. The future King's horse should always be fit and sleek...
Maybe I can nudge him to get me some of those oats over there. I am hungry!
Oh you silly thing, now what? The saddle? No, we rode already today....oh... are you hungry boy?
Oh those oats look so fresh and I bet they will taste really grand
You are just loving those oats, eat up, I need you to stay strong and healthy for my future coronation.
I hope that he will come by every day and make sure I am well taken care of. He is so kind to me!
I bet you're thirsty too, aren't you after all those oats. Let me fetch you some water.
Look at that! Its as if he knows my every want and need! What a wonderful person he is!
You know sometimes, I feel like you can read my mind fellow. I wish all my subjects could have a horse as fine and strong as you.
Now that is a thought.... I wish every horse could have a person as fine and nice as him!
Well now that you are fat and satisfied, how about we put this coat of arms on you to practice for that special day when I am crowned King.
Oh exercise! I would love to get out for a bit in the sunlight and cool breeze.
room_objects: a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms

a the royal coat of arms
