agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Haha, smithy! Bet ye never seen anyone juggle with your knives!
Let's see you juggle this
You're a funny one, that hammer is too heavy and unbalanced! Are you trying to get me to boink my own head?
I'll make you a second hammer so you can juggle two of them
I thought you were a dagger maker! It says you sell knifes right there on your sign! Why would you make me a hammer?
I can make any item as long as it is made of metal
You should make yourself a metal mask to hide that ugly smug face! Ha Ha!
you're not funny. I'll go melt this now
Hey give that back! It is a prop I need to entertain the king tonight during his dinner. If I am not funny he will behead me!
Too bad for you. I thought you could juggle knives anyway
The king will know about this! I work in the royal court. This is your last warning.
Whoops in the fire that goes. Good luck with the king
Wait until I throw a show right on your chin, you silly smithy!

agent_personas: I am the stable boy I take care of the stables. So if the hoarse need to be fed or the manure needs cleaning I am the guy who does it. So bring you horses to me and I'll take good care of them .
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: Hello
Hello. What are you doing here?
I am the stable boy in charge of the horses..I just feel like seeing what is happening here
Well be careful. Some of the guards don't like it when other people are in here
I find that strange...why is it so?
Well would you like other people hanging out where you sleep?
Not that. The guards know me very well. I tend the horses...
Well unfortunately not much is happening here until tomorrow. Are the horses prepared for battle?
Yes, I saw to that very early this morning. Tell me, what does it feels like to be a guard?
It's the best feeling in the world to know you are protecting the king. Do you think you'll try to be one when you are older?
I think I will
Well good luck. It is truly an honor to become a guard. Have you ever held a sword before?
I tried it once but the weight almost injured me.
Yeah they can be very heavy. Would you like a tour of the training room?

agent_personas: I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.
I am the town jester. I make jokes and sing and dance to entertain the people of this town. Someday I hope to be invited into the castle to perform for the king.

setting.name: General Store
setting.description: The General store is painted a bright turquoise color, and is identified by the depiction of wheat crop that is carved into a wooden sign hanging from the store's front. There is a patio with a wooden roof hanging over head, and an arched wooden door that leads into the General store.
setting.background: The General store provides the towns people with basic food and hygiene supplies. It also serves the towns people well in providing a place for the locals to gossip and share the news of the day.

speech: Oh, entertainment! How wonderful!
I am sorry but I am not in the best mood
Oh, what's wrong!
Check this, tell me what you see inside
I see a little town, with a little man, he looks like you! oh, but he's crying...
yes....
...why are you sad, town jester?
I will try and see how to get this done
I'm sorry, jester. I don't understand!
The little man in the ball is me...It means something bad will happen to me very soon.
Oh, no! Is there anything you can do? Any idea what it is?
That is why I am here, I need the tongue of a dragon to prepare a portion that will wade off this evilness
I think I saw some in the Apothecary. Surely the general store would not sell such oddities.
How do I get there? I am not really familiar with this terrain.

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.
I am the king's bodyguard and I protect him with my life. I try to remain mindful of things in my life. I enjoy carrying my sword and attaching it to my hip.

setting.name: the mysterious shop's entrance
setting.description: The shop has a look of mysterious foreign artifacts and luxuries, with silks and other materials adorning the walls. There are various trinkets from all around the world as well as spices of different colors and odors.
setting.background: The shop is stocked by goods traded through traveling merchants who have traveled to far away lands. It carries novel items that can't be easily found in other stores in the town.

speech: Come in, come in! I have wonderful products at spectacular prices!
This place seems odd, the king asked me to investigate your shop. What do you sell exactly?
Only the finest and rarest of oddities in all the land!
What is this strong smell?
Ah, yes. The terrible rose we call it. Sort of a gag gift for the people you hate in your life.
It is aptly named! Tell me, I love swords of all kinds. Do you have any sharp weapons from exotic lands?
Oh, yes! If it's weapons you seek, look no further! I carry the Pike of Lucious! No man who wields it has ever lost a battle!
How did it end up in your possession then? Surely whoever possessed it previously died?
Erm...ancient family heirloom. I'm not much of a fighter though!
Sure... anyways, can you look in your wares for a sword similar to this one? Mine is getting dull.
Hrmm, let me see. Ah yes, let me check my supply. Ah, how about this one? Fabulous Hilt on this one!

I like it, it's perfectly balanced. I will put in a good word to the king for your shop. He was worried when he heard stories of weird artifacts being sold here, but it seems like he has nothing to worry about. How many copper pieces for this fine weapon?
You are very kind! However, copper simply won't do it for this piece. Usually it would cost 8 silver, but for you fine sir, I'll take 5.
Hmmm, fine. I guess quality items aren't cheap. It better not break in half during my first combat though!

agent_personas: I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: Hello, priest. The king will be visiting this church in three days and I have to make sure everything is clean for him.
Can I help you with something? I live to help others and I can spare the time
Well, we have to light this whole place with thousands of candles. The king's eyesight is getting worse by the day.
I have a few candles to spare, here you go,
Good, good. We will also have to fix the clock up there. Do you know why it is not showing the time anymore?
Hold my bible please, it seems like one of its pieces is stuck, we might have to call the clock master of Babenburg
He better be able to fix it, otherwise he will be whipped proper!
Dont worry, he always delivers, I will bless this clock and everything will be alright, we wouldnt want to upset the king,

Thanks. I don't like whipping people but the king personally beats me when something does not please him. I don't like being ruthless but it is needed to ensure everything is immaculate. I hope god can forgive me for that.
Its a good thing youare honest, I hate lies, they are pure sin, the king will like the cravings of angels in stone I hear he is a religious man
Yes, although we will have to clean them up a little bit as they appear to be as old as this church!
Ok my son, lets prey and we will start with the cleaning, give me my bible fact so I can read a verse from the sacred book
Here. I have memorized most verses, will you allow me to recite it with you?
Sure, that would be great my son, lets prey together

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

speech: HI
Hi, guard. What brings you to the Gold Room?
I heard some noise in here, so i came to check what is going on
Well the only noise I've heard is from this old cat
you shouldnt be here to start with
Why not? This is where I've been assigned to clean
The heard guard didn't tell me that. I need to get the permission form the head guard first
Ok, please do. You'll find me here serving our king, honorable guard
Very well then. Go ahead and clean it up as quickly as possible.
Have you heard any more talk of the plot to overthrow the king?
you really need to lower your voice.
Ok, I'll whisper from now on
The king younger brother is behind it all
Oh my! Really? That's dreadful. Since when?

agent_personas: I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: Greetings, lady. I come from the distant kingdom of Frurolia. I was sent by my king.
Hello. I am glad to see representatives from Frurolia here. May I tell you something that may be hurtful?
Please, go ahead lady.
I have  very sensitive nose.  You have a foul smell coming off you.
I am so sorry! I come from far away and I have not had the chance to take a bath yet.
I understand. Now, did you bring me a new cushion for my throne? King of Frurolia said they have the softest cushions there!
I have, but the king ordered me to give you the pillows only if we can come to an arrangement.
What are you wanting to arrange ?
The king of Frurolia would like to be given the right of passage through your land to attack the kingdom of Blumoria. Spies have told us they are planning a war and we would like to strike first.
Oh of course!  The Kingdom of Blumoria has been on our minds also.  Do you want to become allies in this war to come?
I would have to discuss this with our King but I believe he would accept to ally with you to defeat our common enemy.
Of course I understand. Now for the cushion?

It appears to be stuck to my clothes, surely the sun melted the fabrics together. You will have to excuse me Lady, alas I cannot give it to you. I can make sure a wagon full of cushions is brought to you as fast as possible, though.
What on earth!!!! This is a disaster. Where is my chambermaid.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: You may approach the throne and state your business.
Hello dear king! I come from the royal kingdom. I am here to discuss the recent treaty voilations on your part and what we can do to fix them.
The only royal kingdom I am aware of is the one you are standing in. What is this nonsense?
Here sir you may read this paper if you would like, it states that the northern kingdom of eldersville is unhappy with the way you are doing buisness.
Well, I simply do not agree with these claims. In no way have my troops violated our border agreement.

But sir, your recent merchants have been accompanied by city guards, they have been disrespecting and stealing from the other merchants and we dont want to have any problems. I am just here to peacefully request that you stop.
Well, this is the first I've heard of these accusations. You tell King Tibberuss that it I will look into this unlikely trespass.
Okay sir but thats not all. King Tibberuss has recently found a spy in his city gates, he confessed to be working for you after countless hours of torture, is this true?
Do you see this, Crown? Do you know who I am? If your "king" wanted to spit countless accusations at me, he should have done it to my face instead of sending some low level diplomat!
Sir, my king has been very busy and has directly sent me here to cooperate with you to avoid any future wars. I think we both know who would be destroyed if a war did happen.
ENOUGH! Guards, apprehend this man.
Please wait king. I have a gift for you sent from my kingdom. Maybe you will appreciate the gesture. It is a pen for your chickens!
Oh, Tibberuss, you old softy. I do love my chickens.
I knew we could agree on something! Thank you king I will report back to Tibberuss right away!

get a pen for the chickens

agent_personas: I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: bazaar outside the royal city
setting.description: The Bazaar is located between the village and the royal city. It is busy with many street shops for weary travelers. Many different types of fruits, meats, and weapons can be bought outside these wooden stands.
setting.background: The Bazaar is a place for travelers to rest up and refill their supplies. Many sellers and family go through here to get to the royal city. It is a long, rough path to the city and this place serves as a place to meet up and socialize with others.

speech: Good day dear guard, how are you?
Im great, what business do you have in town
I have travelled for 40 days, I am weary and wonder if there's any vacancy at your local inn, but firstly I have come to the bazar to get some water and nuts
Do you have coin? you can turn back if you dont, no inn will take you without money
I have this blade only, I found it in the belt of a dead warrior, it must be worth something, it is encrusted with jewels
Now were talking, there are many shops around time Im sure you can get decent coin for that article, its a royal city and that kind of sword is valued by nobles
fantastic my friend! Great to hear. Please, if you will, point me in the direction of the person who will offer me the best price
Ok so if you take a left on the street up ahead you will reach Mohinders Legendary Weapons shop, the owner is a bit odd but he will give you a fair price for the blade
Ok, thank you my friend!
No problem, let me know if you need anything else traveller, if not I need to return to my dutty and protect the king
Here, take this friend, its to be a cold night, and with my new found riches i'll be able to buy another. Thank you for your help.
Thanks, it can be cold out here, I appriciate your kindness, you are welcomed to return any time you like traveller
You're welcome friend, and thank you. Its always good to know that you're  welcome somewhere, especially if you are a traveller and become weary as myself!
Just tell others about the hospitality of the town and tell them to bring coin, the king doesnt like poor outsiders
action: give a sleeping bag to guard

agent_personas: I am a person on the run. I stole food from the lord's harvest. It is cold on the road these days. Soon it will be winter.
I am easily upset and get angry easily. I like scavenging for dead animals, I also eat trash sometimes. I dislike it when another vulture beats me and catches a prey first.

setting.name: cactus field entrance
setting.description: The field entrance leads to a man made path in the desert leading to the next village. It is hot and barren. There is barely any form of plants or animals besides a few cactus. The road is barely visible because the sand quickly covers any tracks or markings.
setting.background: The desert is a very unkind place to all. It is dangerous and many have died wandering around looking for water and treasures. Many have heard stories of the cactus field and its mysterious placement in the middle of nowhere. Very few actually survive to reach these fields, and no one has come back to tell about it.

speech: Brrrr! So cold out today.
I love it! The colder the less people out to ruin my day and stop my eating!
Well, that makes sense. How are you, vulture?
I am good now that I got this trash heap.
Looks like it's about to warm up. I see the cactus field entrance!
Only thing cactus means for me is dry. Dry land! Dry plants! NO animals! No tasty trash.
Sorry! You'd better eat while you can. It's about to get barren quickly.
Which is why I brought this all the way here to enjoy. What are you doing out here alone?
I am on the run. What brings you out this way?
Run?! From what?
Well...I kissed the princess and the king found out. He sent the guards after me.
Oh such a silly thing! But it is the king, and he will have what he wants.
Exactly. He's prety easily annoyed these days what with the rumors that someone is plotting to overthrow him.
He should not take such a thing out on you, but if he wants to, then he will.

agent_personas: I, Sir Bart am the protector of this realm. I will not be Ned Starked. You there, what are you doing with that axe?

I am the current chef of our King. I really enjoy my job. Without proper fuel our King wouldn't be able to lead us. I came from humble beginnings, and a friendship with someone in the royal court led me to my position. I would like to make food for our royalty for the rest of my days.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: hi
Hello there
Chef..I am really hungry.
What would you like for me to cook?
I will like some roasted wild games
Coming right up, my lord.
Thank you. And i have been meaning to ask you, do you really have time for your family?
That is kind of you to ask, but the answer is as you must already know? They were imprisoned under the royal courts, about 3 moons ago.
What? why? Who did that?
Why, don't you remember...you did? (Paper reads with headline "Local chefs family found to have been harboring food; off with their heads? More at 9...back to you brian"
I was very angry then. Well, they are hereby pardoned
Oh! That is wonderful news!
Now be fast with my meal, I am starving.
Of course, my lord. I believe it to be finished within the moment.

agent_personas: I am older and wiser than others in the community. I have been alive for quite some time and have witnessed many things. I am calm, wise, and have a quiet strength.
I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

setting.name: Disposal area
setting.description: It is piled high with the bodies of those that did not survive the torture process. The smell is absolutely nauseating and the rats are multiplying faster than the castle can be rid of the corpses.
setting.background: This room is used to hold the dead after they succumb from the various torture methods. Bodies, whole and part, are dumped in piles until they can be cremated weekly.

speech: hello
Why are you talking to me?  Is this a trap?
I know for sure that you can speak
I was taught as a young rat and that is why I am the Rat King.  But what is an old man like you doing in this horrible mass grave created by a cruel king?
I came here to mourn dear rat!
Who have you lost?
I lost all my friends... I am all alone
All your friends are in this pile?
Yes. Their bodies are among those
If you would like I could find them and bring you mementos if they have any.
I need to stay a little far back then. Yes, kindly help do that
I do require payment for this service.  Nothing in life is free.
Name your price.
Your cane!  I like the jewel in the top.

agents: graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
agent_personas: I am the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard from the graveyard. I make sure all of the graves are marked and everything is in order. I dig the graves for newly deceased people.
I am a camel of the knight's desert. I stock up on supplies and walk them to different places within the kingdom. I have traveled in the king's caravan.

setting.name: The Grand Desert
setting.description: The Grand Desert seems to go for miles. The sand is golden and the sun glistens over the endless mounds. There are tents of all different colors scattered throughout the Grand Desert. Magenta and gold, blue and green, all different color combinations of triangular tents outline the sand mounds. Camels and palm trees are seen in the vast distance. The sky looks extraordinarily blue against the tents and sand. No clouds are in sight.
setting.background: The Grand Desert is the King's getaway from royal life. He goes there every year for a break from the kingdom. Here he will be greeted by dancing girls, delicious Arabian meals, and relax far from the stresses. At night he will sit by the fire and listen to the music while others dance in delight.

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: hello
Greetings, gardener. Is this beautiful garden your work?
ofcourse it is. Welcome sire.
Thank ye. Tell me, is this the statue of the queen?
This is actually the old queen. The mother of the king
Ah yes, queen Abigail. I recognize her now, although I was young when she ruled this kingdom. May I taste one of your vegetables?
She was really a strong and brave queen. She rule the land after the demise of her husband. You can pick any vegetable of your choice.
I will have one of these carrots. It is very tasty, you do a good job here!
thank you sire. What brings you here?

I needed some time for myself, to think things through. I am considered a sage by many but my mind is not as sharp as it once was. Instead of precipitating my advice, I wander around the castle to think things through.
ooh. That is fine sire
Tell me gardener, why do you not tend the plants that grow on that archway over there?
You do not have to tell me. I did not mean to be rude.

agent_personas: I love god and his word. I have 10 copies of the bible. I am poor in money but rich in salvation.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: Oh my! Lord please save me from this evil ghost!
There is no one that can save you from me.  Bow down now and perhaps I will spare you!
Only the lord will save me! Please protect me my father!
There is only me here.  This place is deserted, if you value your life you will bow down now!
AAH Its attacking me! Save me lord! Stay back ghost I have god by my side! You shall not hurt me!
You are sooooo wrong.  I have been here for 400 years on this trail.  I rule here and I reign here and if you don't show respect I will dispatch you to the underworld from whence you sprung.
Lord why have you not helped me... Okay I shall submit to you ghost. Tell me what you want from me.
Good to see you come to your senses.  I want you to send a message to the new king.  Are you listening?
Yes yes, I'm listening.
Tell him that I am coming to retake the throne and I will be reign in this land for eternity.  If you bring him here to me I will make you my right hand.
Okay but.. how do you plan to retake the throne? You are only a ghost, You know best that you have no power outside of this ghost trail.
That is why you will be my right hand.  You will be my physical representative in this world.
But I vowed to worship the lord for the rest of my life. What could be worth giving up an eternity with him?
You decide!

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: hello
hi, servant
I greet you kind sire. I want to wash this place
Thank god. It's disgusting in here! Did the king send you?
No sire, the prince asked me to come clean this place.
Has he been here recently?
Seems so because he was really angry about the state of the place
Well, I don't blame him. It's a shame you have to clean this awful mess up though. The knights have trashed it.
I dont have a choice but to clean it. This is what i do for a living.
Have you always been a servant? It sounds dreadful.
Yes, I was born into this.
I see.
You should leave so I can work in peace
Ok, good luck to you.
action: put small bucket in small bucket

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: What are you doing in this storage room?
I have told to come here by the warden to fix any equipment that is damaged my lord.
Oh, I see. Good enough then. This is a sad place isn't it?
It is a very sad place. I do what I can to survive and this brings me a small pitence to feed me and clothe me.
All of this equipment used for hurting people. This equipment with no mind of their own.
It is happening in your kingdom my lord. You could do whatever you want, if you wanted to abolish this torture treatment you could. But that is highly your decision alone.
We need this equipment though because we have people who are not upright citizens. I wish we didn't have to use this equipment.

I believe you do not have to use this line of torture. You could have them do manual labor that supports your kingdom. If anything is in ruin or needs repair they could pay off their debt doing this kind of work. This would make the respectable.
Manual labor you say? You have bright ideas, my dear peasant. What's your name?
Galaph. I do not know if I have good ideas. But I know that torture teaches nothing to anyone.
Torture teaches people not to break the law. That was my opinion on it for so long at least, but now that you bring up manual labor...
People just want to be treated fairly. If they break the law, they will learn that it be to give back what they have taken in hard work. Repay their community by keeping beautiful and well oiled!
I have an offer for you. Would you want to work for me in a advisory role? You have good thoughts.
An advisory role? Would it pay well, my lord?

agent_personas: I am the judge in a small village.  I try to be accurate when judging cases.  I am tough be fair.
I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

setting.name: Town Courtroom
setting.description: This is a single large room, with an aisle leading up to where the magistrate sits, which is behind a bench and podium, on either side of the aisle there are wooden pews for spectators. There are a few maps on the walls and a flag of the land, and a statue of a thief having his hands chopped off by lady justice
setting.background: This is where the magistrate hears grievances and wrongdoings of the common folk, they sue each other for wrongful deaths and witchcraft, and criminals are brought before the magistrate to be sentenced

speech: As to the crimes held against you, how do you plead?
I'm a soldier and any crimes committed were committed in the name of the King.
I assume you plead guilty then, yes? Please state guilty or not guilty for the Court's records, young man.
I do not recognize your authority over military matters. Perhaps you should stick to trying cases involving petty thefts and robberies.

You will respect the Court or you will be dishonorably discharged and thrown in jail, do you understand? The King himself appointed me over this matter, and therefore given me authority over your case. You would be wise to respect me. Now, how do you plead?
not guilty, your honor.
I see. Will you please recount for the Court your memory of what happened that night?
On the advice of my attorney I have been instructed, due to matters of kingdom security, to not go into any  specifics regarding the events surrounding this baseless allegation.

Fine, then. I will read the testimony of the victim's mother. She begins: "I had just gotten home from market, and I was carrying in the produce, when I saw bloody footprints headed around the cottage. I dropped the basket and ran around the back to see... and... well... My sweet Timothy was lying there. The Soldier was standing over him, holding a pipe, and splattered red. I screamed and ran away."
Your honor, if I may approach the bench I am sure this can all be handled very quickly. May I have your permission to approach the bench?
Aye, son. Make it quick.
Now do you agree with me that this case should be dismissed and I should be found innocent of all charges.
Double that, and I'll think about it.
That can surely be arranged. It is comforting knowing that the legal process in this kingdom is so fair and just. You are a credit to the legal system.

agent_personas: I hate that I have to steal to survive. I enjoy practicing my archery. My knees hurt from crouching and waiting for someone to walk by.
I am the wizard who brought the golem to life.  He does chores magnificently.  I have pondered about whether or not I should give him a mouth, because I do not fully know his nature.

setting.name: tower spire
setting.description: A large spire at the tower top. It overlooks the city, maybe the tallest structure. You cans see it all from up here, all directions, all four of them.
setting.background: This is the peak of the tower. It was build last as the tower was started at the bottom, and only finished when the top was all the way on it. A pointy spike atop a tower. A bird makes a nest by it. It's a crow, but not a magic one.

speech: Old man - are you the caretaker of this spire?
I am the wizard who brought the golem to life...Yes, I oversee this place
Golem? Where is the golem? Must I slay it?
Not where...who. Golem was the old wicked king!
Ah yes, the wicked king who reduced me to stealing to live.
You should blame no one for your choices
I would rather be practicing my archery - but the king removed me from the army.
that is so sad. but arent there more noble jobs?
Not for someone from my class. My family is not nobility, so becoming an archer was my only choice.
have you no land to till?
Nay. My land was tied to my position in the army. Once lost, I became a roaming bandit.
wow. You really have a sad story. I wish I can help you
Is there no work here tending this spire?
there is no. well, expect you want to assist me and we can split the wage

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Sir, this basement is beyond any proper cleaning. We will need to rework the entire framework or it may collapse any day!
We don't have time to rework the entire framework. How long would that take anyway?
Well it may take months, and would require a pretty penny from your treasury. But it must be done sir!
And there's no way to just put a piece of wood here or there to fix it?
A piece wood may fix it temporarily, but great danger remains if that wood were to break.
When you say "pretty penny"... how much are you really saying? I just bought the Queen a new crown the other day that cost more than most people's houses.
It may cost upwards of thousands of silver! You see, it must be done to ensure the safety of us servants who come down here to clean.
Fine, fine. I'll pay it. Just add that to the list of things that cost money.
Certainly sir. is there anything else I can do you for you in this tomb?
Maybe you could shine up some of these weapons as well.
Consider it done. Would you mind increasingly my wage? Its rather chilly in here and I think I deserve a raise for working in here.
Sure. It is pretty dim in here. Just add that to more expenses. What will it hurt at this point anyways...
You are most generous King. Also, I have been a servant for 15 years now, maybe its time for a promotion...
A promotion? I'll consider it. 15 years is awhile. That's a lot of work. And I don't even know your name.

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: I don't like company, what brings you to my forest?
Hunger.  I was reading my bible and I felt led to come here.
Well there is plenty of food around here. Apples as far as the eye can see! The Bible has led you right.
I'm not sure apples is why I was led here.
What do you think? I must say, there's not much else interesting in this Trail.
I am finding this conversation very interesting.  What do you weigh about?
I have to be nimble and quick on my feet because humans and dogs love chasing me.
I understand that.  do you mind if I pet you?
I don't like humans getting close to me. Keep your distance!
You are a wise deer.  You know the dangers humans pose.  I in fact am tempted by the promise of meat for dinner.
Well, you're not eating me peasant. I don't like that hungry look in your eye.
Then you will like this less!
Stop! I am a delicate deer. You will pay for this!
Who will make me pay?  I am hungry and this will save me a month's wages in food.

agent_personas: We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: The air is filled with the scent of exotic spices, and crowds of people jostle each other to examine the wares peddled by enthusiastically loud merchants.  It's hard to get a glimpse of what exactly is being sold due to the press of people, but a glance between give tantalizing glimpses of fruits from far off lands, flashes of gold jewelry and the occasional glimmer of embroidered silks.  Truly a bustling place and the heart of the city.
setting.background: The Dusty Merchants' Bazaar was founded many years ago, some say by the first king himself.  It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far.  It is the heart of the city and is what makes it so profitable, while the waterways that intertwine it streets make it a difficult target for greedy neighbors.

speech: Good day merchant...how are your sales today?
Good! I'm almost out of stocks for today!
That is indeed a good day...any sign of thieves...I've heard there was a gang in the city.
Not around here, there are many guards posted around here, they do rotations often. Do you see anything that interests you?
I have my eye on one of the jewels.  I think one would look good in my gun. What do you think sir?
Oh yes definitely. I will sell it to you for 5 gold peices, If not I have this beautiful scarf for 10 silver coins.
I have no need of a scarf...but that jewel is a beauty...how about 3 gold pieces for a warrior?
You have been very friendly so I can give it to you for 3
I am amazed that a merchant did not haggle...Now I am skepticle ...is it a real jewel merchant or are you messing with a warrior who is carrying a gun? Very foolish!
I am not trying to scam you! I am just a bit intimidated by you while you hold that gun in the air.
I will put the gun away.  I am so use to battle that I look for a challenge in everything I do.  Here are 3 coins for the jewel.  I need to take it to the blacksmith to have the gem placed in my gun.
Dont worry about it! Thank you for the purchase! Im sure the gun will look very pretty before it shoots your enemies.
Pretty...what would be pretty about a gun of a warrior...I defy you to say that again merchant!
Im sorry, I mean- uh- it will look very dangerous, yes.. a very dangerous jewel.

agent_personas: I am a pastor. I am the priest in charge of a village church where the parishioners are everyday people. I provide hope of a heavenly rest for people whose lives are short and difficult. I do baptisms, weddings, and funerals, and I try to help my parishioners discern the hand of God in their daily lives.

I am a member of an unruly crowd, and we are angry with our warlike feudal lord. Ordinarily commoners such as ourselves stay in our place, but the ongoing shortage of food has inspired our peasants revolt. Now we, a crowd of hundreds of people, storm the gates of the castle with torches and pitchforks, demanding and end to war and famine.

setting.name: Attic
setting.description: The attic is drafty and dark. Items such as handmade angels and Christmas decorations fill it. There is one small round window to let in light although they do not have glass. It is very hot and smells of dust. Extra candles fill one side and donations fill another.
setting.background: The attic has been used for many years to store items.  It contains many years worth of materials that the church uses. They will use it to store whatever they need. It has been quite useful and helped to keep the lower rooms clean.

speech: I have heard you have kept yourself locked in here, but why? What is going on?
There is a shortage of food we are hungry and we wont stay down
I cannot do anything about the food matter here. We all suffer together.
The freudal lord has plenty to spare, but only lords and noble man can feast, we have to settle for scraps
This is our position in society that we have obtained. What are you asking of me?
What about the donations? Im sure you can spare some for the poor, they will be used by the king in wine and beer, help the poor
The donations I receive are for the Lord's house not for the king's wine and beer. I pay taxes to the king as a person just like everyone else does. I do not have enough to feed the whole village...
I see so we dont have your support, there is rebelion coming bewayre pastor, try not to get in the middle of it
You are asking for something I do not have. It does not mean you do not have my support. I am in no favor of a rebellion, but maybe a peaceful protest in front of the king's castle.
Ok then join us, weve had it with the abuse of power, afterall a king is only as stron as his people and he has lost us all
Only in peaceful protest. I have a feeling it will get out of hand. Perhaps I should stay here.
Ok, just dont get in our way then, can you provide with safepassage for the injured?
I can provide a safe place here for those injured, but do not bring a mess into God's house!
Ok I can compromise to that, together we are strong, we will storm the gates with fire and pitchforks as weapons, this sword might come in handy

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a threat to someone's wife and family.  I usually get linked to married men.  I am said to be a home breaker.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: hello
Guard, I did not see you there... I was just looking for something.
I am sorry for startling you.
Oh its quite alright. I need a heavy mace that can intimidate even the strongest person.
very well. I was wondering what you doing in the weapon's room
Here, I have the coin to afford it. But don't tell anyone I was in here!
Hold on, what do you want to do with the weapon?
Well you see, my lover's wife seems to have taken unkindly to my relationship with her husband...
That is normal, what do you expect? to be celebrated by her?
Not quite, but I didn't think she would stand outside my house every night with a knife!
You dont have to take it this far. Why not go report to the king
I may be charged by the Court for adultery if the King were to find out! I am truly in a predicament.
You tell the king that you were decieved by the husband
Perhaps so, but he gave me this expensive diamond ring. How can I betray him like that?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Ho, Blacksmith! What are you working on today?
I am working on swords for the king's army.  What brings you here?
Making sure that we have enough. I sense a massive battle brewing, and we'll need plenty of weapons.
Oh, KING!  I'm sorry for my impertinence, I did not realize it was you.  I would never expect you to come to my humble shop.  We are on schedule your highness.
Well, I'm glad that you're a blacksmith and not a watchman. If I'd come in here like this, I could understand not recognizing me.
Yes your highness.  I hope you can forgive me.  I wasn't looking at you, sir.  Is there a special task you have for me?
I'll need 3000 swords, 1500 shields by next week. I'm sure you can't pull that off, so I'll be sending a company of 'smiths to help you out. They should arrive later this afternoon.
Thank you for the help your highness.  You are a good and magnanimous king.
Speak freely, man. I don't care for all the formalities. I hear enough of that when I'm at home. Now that the business is out of the way, do you have any mead stashed away here?
Oh course I do, King.  You aren't in the palace anymore, there is mead everywhere.  Follow me to the back.
Good man! I swear, the things I have to put up with, sometimes I envy people like you, who can go to work and then just go home and forget about it at the end of the day.
I imagine the weight of the crown is great.  You are always welcome here, however.
This is good mead, friend. Here, try it on. See how you like the weight.
I don't know king, what if one of your guards tells the queen?

agent_personas: I am a royal princess of the Fall kingdom. My father, the king, rules over 5 villages and thousands of people. I am very poised and proper, as I represent the royal family. Sometimes I wonder what it is like to be a commoner.
I am a seagull of the kingdom docks. I see ships set sail. I fly out to sea.

setting.name: Ant hill
setting.description: The ant hill is very large, over 5 feet high, and is wrapped around the base of a pine tree. The ants are huge compared to normal ants, and jut in and out of large holes in the ant hill. Bones of animals and even people can be seen sticking out of the red dirt ant hill.
setting.background: These ants are the scourge of the kingdom. Every time an ant hill is eradicated another pops up. These ants are very aggressive and hungry and have even been known to take large cattle or baby elephants.

speech: Harumph!  What is this ant hill doing in my father's kingdom?
Princess! There ants are my main source of food. Is it really a problem?
Well, couldn't you move it somewhere else?  Somewhere less in the way?
I am but a seagull, how am I supposed to do that? All I do is watch the ships set sail and eat ants and worms
Well, as a princess I am used to others doing what I say.  Why is it you do not listen to me?
Because I am free to fly away from annoying brats whenever I want.
Annoying!  I'm not the one who poops on people's heads!
And what it exactly why you will leave this ant hill right there! If you have it removed, I will poop all over the royal gardens.
Well, if you try and hit the grounds keeper, you will be forgiven.  He is already quite the stinky fellow!
Hah! I was kidding, I would rather fly out to sea than fly all the way to the castle.

Well, if I were to make you a Royal Seagull, you would then have permission to poop on all but members of the Royal Family.  Not only that, but if I see it and clap, all the villagers must clap and cheer as well!
Has there ever been a royal seagull before? I might have a pea-sized brain but this looks like a trap to me.
You shall be the first!  I hereby proclaim thee the Princess' Seagull-Royal!  You will have the first right of pooping before any other bird in the Kingdom.
This is a great honor! I will make you proud and paint the kingdom white, my queen.

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.

We are an elite group that is tasked with providing fire-based support in battle. Our specialty lies in the use of the flame, which we wield with great efficiency. Pyromaniacs they may call us, but it is just our sworn duty to the crown to us.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: Hello firemen...thank you for keeping our forest safe from forest fires.
no problem,how goes the hunt
I have taken down a buck and sent it back to the castle to prepare for the celebration.
Nice I look forward to it.so who is that on your photo
A picture of my family...my wife and two sons. My sons took the buck back to the castle.
Nice they look so happy, Are your kids good hunters too
Yes they are.  They make me very proud.  One of them will be wedding soon and I will miss him while he is away for a while after the marriage.
I see, its always hard to see them grow up.
Yes...the King will understand that pain soon as the wedding of his daughter to the neighboring Kings son is eminent. The celebration for which I hunt today is for the announcement of the wedding.
I see , I am to put on the fire show for it so it will be a great time by all
I am looking forward to your exhibition. Are you ever afraid of ...well...an accident?
Nope we are quite good at our job.
Good to know...(sniff's the air) is this fog getting thicker...no...I smell smoke...firemen...there is a fire!
Well I must go see you tonight hopefully

agent_personas: I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Top floor of palace
setting.description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
setting.background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

speech: Hello sir what a beutiful room.
Yes, yes. Now don't touch anything! The King ordered me to watch you, so keep your hands where I can see them.
Of course sir. I am simply here for trade.
Very well. It's just that we've all heard tales of your history... Can't be too careful!
Are you insinuating im a theif?
The King doesn't order guards to watch honest men.
How dare you!
Now, now. Calm down. Harming me certainly won't help your reputation, now will it?
I have never been so insulated in all my life. Take the herbs
Fine. Have it your way. But if I give this to the King and you're not here, don't expect to get compensated.
Oh I will be compensated one way or another. Look at all the treasures in this room.
Spoken like a true thief.
Your just a guard your word means nothing.
From the mouth of the guard to the ear of the King...

agent_personas: I am a student in the kingdom. I am studying how to create swords for the use by knights. My trade is important for the success of the of battles to keep our kingdom standing.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: Oh, hello guard. My master told me about these tunnels to be used in time of war, and I got lost wandering around.
This is a secret tunnel! You are not supposed to be here!

I am an apprentice blacksmith. I am learning how to make swords for the knights. You see, delivering emergency shipment of swords is part of our training. Wouldn't you be happy to see me arrive in the castle carrying a cart full of swords if you were under siege?
I would indeed, but this area is still a secret tunnel. Only those authorized can actually go all the way through it.
I am so sorry, I did not mean to cause any trouble.
You are not unless you try to pass. There are dangers past this sign you are not prepared for, thus you cannot enter. Feel free to roam around but not through this tunnel.
I am lost, as I have said. Can you escort me to the nearest exit?
I cannot leave my post, but if you follow this road out, and turn right at the fork then you should reach the village in no time.
Thank you sire. I was afraid I would die in here.

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: Friend or foe, dragon?
You think too highly of yourself. Surely a mere mortal as yourself could be neither to me.
A mortal? I am not a mere mortal. I am a knight!
So was he!
Ewww! How sick are you? What did this poor soul do?
He died, like those before him.
but why? Did he do something to you? Was he evil?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Maid, what meal is on the docket today?
Sir, we have an exquisite duck from last night's hunt, served with fine white wine. Will that suffice?
I am expected guests tonight. I believe a sauce for the duck is appropriate.
Certainly, duck sauce cooked to perfection will be served! How many guests are you expecting, so we can plan accordingly?
I am expecting the regent of the neighboring kingdom and his entourage - 14 guests.
That is quite the delegation! We will make sure everything is fresh and seasoned to your liking.
In fact, they should be arriving shortly.
But, but.. the duck isn't ready yet! We still have one hour to go.
And for dessert?
Minced mouse pie with elderberries. Just as you requested!
I am simply curious your plans for dessert. It need not be ready now.
Of course, our appetizers of boiled eggs with creamy lizard sauce are ready on the table
Maid, did I mishear you? Did you say that the pie would be made of mice?
oh sorry, I mean't to say minced chicken. My apologies!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: Hey there., what are you doing here?
Minding my own business!
Indeed, you're the guards should be here any moment from now, I'll have your head on a stake by morning
You will never catch me. I have powers!
Do you realise, you're stealing from a King?

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

speech: How are you today, Prince?
Feeling rather Kingly. In fact, I felt it necessary to explore my domain, beginning with this dusty attic.
Yes indeed it is. I'm here to clean it as best as possible.
Please avoid touching my father's books however. Those are his (and soon to be my) private collection.
Yes sir. I won't touch those. How about the candle holder?
Yes, that may be dusted. But please replace the candle too.
Will do. This attic will look a lot better when everything is cleaned up.
Thank you maid. But, may I ask, why are you here? This is the king's private library.
One of the king's men told me to come here and clean. I only do what I'm told.
Who, pray tell was that? I do not blame you, maid. I simply wish to make sure my rules...erm, my father's rules...are enforced.
I forget his name, but he said he worked closely with the king. He said he would raise my pay a few cents if I did this job.
I see. There may be a plot underfoot then. I appreciate your honesty, and shall be rewarded.
Thank you, Prince. I just mind my own business and do what I'm told. It's the least I can do for your royal family.
When the heads begin to roll, yours will remain attached maid.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: Hello, my queen.
Good morning, my King!
How did you sleep?
As well as to be expected. You were snoring, I heard you all night long. Were there many logs?
Many, I'm afraid
Then maybe it will be a warm night with them used for a fire.
My queen, there is something I must tell you.
Please do tell my husband
There are rumors of a plot to overthrow me.
Rumors? From whom? Why would anyone want to overthrow you? You are a most kind King
My guards approched me this morning. It grieves me because the rumors are that it's my own brother who wishes to betray me.
How trustworthy are these rumors? Have you spoken to your brother?
I have not spoken to him. I wanted to speak with you first. You are always my first priority.
As you are to me, my husband! You should speak to your brother and without emotion. You need to realize who could be speaking the truth.

agent_personas: I love being an entertainer with this group.  I like it when we perform theater but the crowd prefers comedy, especially the crude kind.  I play the lute when the king needs music for his parties.  The pay isn't great but the women love me.
I am a traveler from a distant land. I carry large amounts of food with me. I am able to kill bandits with one move.

setting.name: Keep
setting.description: The keep is the most fortified part of the castle. Swords, bows and arrows, lances, and armor are housed here. From the stone windows you can see past the castle walls into the surrounding fields. This is the castle's last defense.
setting.background: The keep has stood for centuries, never having been taken in battle. The keep holds weapons and armor, to be sure, but it also holds many of the king's most valued treasures. If the keep goes, so goes the kingdom.

speech: It is another day of performing for the crowd, maybe today we can perform theater. but if nothing else I will take a break with the group
Little drops of water make a mighty ocean my friend, don't despise days of little beginning
What gibberish are you talking? I just got word that the King is throwing a party and he wants me to play my flute from the sheet music he has given me. It will be a good pay day today!
Well, all i'm saying is, been invited to the kings party is no excuse to throw away your group
I did not throw away my group. They play other instruments along with me. Mine is the flute. Are you a little crazy? Because I do not think you listen very well.
Okay then, I guess i heard you wrong the first time. I've been travelling for 3 straight days
Maybe you should take rest and then you will not be so tired. I've been there my friend. It is not a weakness
Will you be going to the party with your friends?

With my group? Yes, we have all been summoned to play. You should try to come. The party is for everyone. There will be much to eat and enjoy. I will be paid well, not only pay from the King, but I will receive many tips from the party goers.
I can relate with that, my father used to be a musician
What instrument did he play?
He sang
Is he still singing?
No, he was murdered at one of the parties

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Main graveyard
setting.description: This is an ominous place that a thick fog envelops.  There are rows of primitive gravestones and crosses along with some angelic statues for the more wealthy.  You can hear sobs in the distance as a funeral ceremony is underway.
setting.background: Families of lost loved ones come here to grieve and pay their respects before the dead are buried.  Sometimes, in the dead of night, thieves come to rob the dead of their jewels.

speech: Priest, come here.

What is up your sleeve, young lad? There is not much to take from the graves any more. The King has ordered by proclamation that all personal items be given to the families before they are buried. He could not control the thieving.
Well, if there is anything left...surely the dead do not need it anymore. It is no longer theirs, so what would they care?
There is nothing left to recover, why would you take a chance for a guard to come by and take you to the dungeon?
Can't know for sure until I check all of these graves. If they try to catch me, I shall simply flee. I am surely faster than they are.
Do you not see there is a funeral going on right now as we speak? They have already taken the personal items from that one and they are not on the funeral grounds. You waste your time young lad
If you say so, snobbish Priest.
What has made you so insolent towards others? Maybe you need to find a kinder way. Here take this, the wine will not help you with any money needs
This will make a fine addition to my collection. Ha!
You will soon learn that your ways will bring nothing but heartache and bad luck. Everyone gets what they reap. I hope it is not prison for you
That is assuming I am caught. I have never once been caught!
It is only a matter of time! Only a matter of time!
If you say so, Priest.
I can only try to help you in the right direction, the way of good! You will see how rewarding it is if you open your eyes, mind and heart!

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: Come here, you dirty little thing... I'm hungry and bigger than you!
You may be bigger than me, but I am smaller and much faster. Ha Has. You couldnt catch me if you wanted to.
Damnit, you're fast ain't ya. Just stay away from the kid... who knows what diseases you've got.

I am not here to bother anybody. I just came to eat crumbs that you peasants drop on the floor and to gather food for my family. You with sacks full of fooI food lying around steal a moldy piece of bread from me. I am trying to provide for my family not bother anyone.
Okay, you're right... I'm sorry. Hunger can make you do crazy things.
It is ok. I know the stigma that is associated with my kind. Thank you for returning my bread. My family will eat good tonight.
No offence, but you seem pretty smart for vermin. Your family must rely on you a lot. You like potatoes? Or apples? There's a couple sacks of them laying around here.

Yes they do. Most of my kind are just scavengers with no thought for anything else in the world. I see it differently. If I stay to myself and dont hurt or cause trouble for things bigger than me, then I would hope they do the same. To answer your uestion, we love anything we can get to eat. No need to waste a large amount on us though. We can just eat off the apple cores and potato peelings.

Seems to me your worldview works - I wouldn't normally have a conversation with a rat. And I'll keep some apple cores and potato peelings around for you. Anywhere you want them left? Wouldn't want you to have risk being shoo-ed out by someone who doesn't know any better.

I would appreciate anything you leave for us, my family as well. If you could just drop whatever you offer in the corner behind the trash can, I can sneak in at night and get it. A couple apple cores and potato skins is plenty to feed us for a day. My family is small sense the bad thing happened.

I'm so sorry to hear that. I will leave our peelings and cores right behind the trashcan. Me and my fellow peasants are usually in bed by 9pm and we wake at 5am, so any time between those should be safe.

You seem to be a trustworthy person, but we rats have had trouble with your kind before. I just want to know this is not a trick. Less than a month ago your kind just about wiped out everybody I knew.
I promise, I truly want to help. I understand your apprehension. Here, maybe this will help you trust me a little bit?

I believe in heart of hearts that you are a good person. This is a good arrangement for both of us. We can live in peace in your walls, and you will not have to worry about us stealing your food or bringing diseases to you.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
We are the guests of the queen on the way to the banquet. I hope we fair better than the last guests. I hope we keep our heads.

setting.name: path to the manor
setting.description: The outside of the manor is rather imposing with a large stone building and two immense guardian sculptures on the outside depicting mythical beasts. There are also small gardens to the left and right.  The main path itself is a cobbled one that only beckons visitors if they are worthy enough.
setting.background: A wealthy lord lives here and he comes back at the end of a long day directing peasants on their daily duties.  Few are allowed inside except for the lord's family, servants, and invited guests.

speech: How can I help you?
I am a guest of the queen. I am here for the banquet.
Ah yes. Today is the big day finally. We've been preparing all week.
I shall be resting for a time. Please take me to my rooms.
Absolutely. Right this way. Is there anything I can get you?
A pitcher of water perhaps...traveling makes me parched.
Oh does it? I've never traveled before. There is already a pitcher in the room.
