If you ever get the chance to go to the north there is a beautiful lake for fishing there.  I wanted to ask...is the cobblestone walkway protected by a spell?  It seemed to move under my feet.
I will never get a chance to travel, but that sounds nice. I don't know what a spell is but the king had some witch do something to the cobblestone last year.
That would make sense I guess...Let's get my bag upstairs.
I guess. I don't really know much about anything except serving. I can take your bag for you.
I bet you know more than you let on. You must hear all that goes on around here.  But I will not ask...stop looking so uncomfortable.
Sorry. I didn't realize I looked that way. I just don't get to leave and hearing about the outside world is exciting.
It's okay sugar. Maybe one day your fortune will change...but until then you have a wonderful place to live...this manor is gorgeous!

agent_personas: I am a patron of the village tavern. I have been here all day, drinking all the ale and beer I can. I should not drive my cart back home.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: The garden courtyard
setting.description: The garden courtyard is found at the very center of the Grand Castle. Its the castle's 6 walls encompass the garden courtyard, creating a hexagon shaped court. Exotic flowers and plants of all varieties from all across the kingdom fill the courtyard. Reds, yellows, bright greens, and even seldom seen colors dominate the flowers that make up the garden. There are large trees and insect sized buds, massive bloomed flowers and normal lilies. The garden is an enchanment.
setting.background: The garden courtyard is the only exotic garden in the entire kingdom. The most respected exotic flower and plant collectors send their finest collections as gifts and homage to be displayed in the garden. It is the highest honor to have one's plants and flowers be relocated there. The biosphere is unique and self sufficient to keep all of the flowers and plants alive, a strange phenomenon harmonized by the existence of many foreign plants living together.

speech: My Lord...what an honor. I was not expecting to see you here with a lowly patron like meself!
What is it you have come for here in the garden?
Well, my Lord...it seems I have had a bit too much ale on this fine eve. I have come here to sober up, and enjoy the beautiful scenery.
Well we all drink a little too much, once in a while. The trick is to not do that every day. You do not do this every day, do you?
Of course not, my Lord!
What is it you do for work?
I am a farmer. I plow the fields for long hours each and every day.
That is noble work. What crop is in season for us?
It is potatoes, my Lord...however, it seems most have developed the blight. This has been hard on my family and I, which it seems has driven me to my inebriated state you see me in now.

Man, this only an temporary obstacle. Having problems with a much needed crop will pass. There will be another season and that could be better. You can predict the weather and how it affects your crop and you cannot predict the insects that destroy your crops. Drinking is not your solution.
You are wise, my King. Thank you for the advice...this is true.
Do you have a wife and family? And what is they do while you plow and sow seeds in your field.
I do me Lord..I have a wife and 5 kids. All boys. Me wife cares for the younger ones, whilst the older ones assist me in the fields most days. It is very helpful having good, strong boys.
It sounds like you have a very grateful family! Working together helps build character for you and your boys. You are a lucky man.

agent_personas: I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.
As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.

setting.name: Abandoned mine entrance
setting.description: The abandoned mine is located in a field with a few trees. It is unable to be seen from far away. The closer you get the more you  notice the ground caving in around the hole. When you peer down into the mine, you see crumbling walls and concrete and a hole so deep you can't see where it ends.
setting.background: The mind used to be the hub of coal many years ago. The king's men worked diligently to remove the coal to use for heating the village. It wasn't untill about 40 years ago, that the mine started to crumble and the King deemed it to dangerous to access anymore.

speech: I know you guard the king, but how about we work out a deal where you can guard me too?
Why the hell will i want to do that?
Because I'm a nice rat.
Well, I'm not a nice rat
I have no other choice... *argh*
Well, I wouldn't have done this but you asked for it
You must feel so strong for attacking a small little rat like myself! If I was a human you wouldn't last more than five minutes.
You think so?
I know so. I would have large muscles because I would work out 5 times a day. I already work out as a rat 5 times a day. I run so much.
Working out doesn't make you a match for a soldier of my caliber
Your caliber? You sure are cocky. I wish I could put you in your place right now.
I worked my way up here by showing discipline, dexterity and good swordsmanship
I'm one of the strongest rats around. If I was a human I would be one of the strongest humans around too.
Strength without intelligence is as useless as sword without a soldier wielding it

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: Woof woof  how you do
I'm doing great, how about you?
Good what  brings you out to the farm
I need a job from the farmer
I see he really nice the work is hard but honest
That's all i need, just something to give me daily bread
Then you at the right place for you want me to come with to go see the master of this farm
I would really appreciate that
Ok, lets go so  how far do you live away from here, He might able to rent a little piece of land for you and family to built a house on if  it would be easier
I really don't have a house
Then this will be perfect there is the master come on make sure to smile
I'll try to be at my best behaviour
Good, good luck I  am sure you do fine
I hope he likes me

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a criminal who lives in the gaol. I sleep on a hard cot on the floor. I like apples and steal them when the shopkeeper isn't looking.

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: You've got the wrong man. I swear!
hah! i never thought I'd see the day when a guard was with us lowly people
You framed me, you monster! You did this! And now I'm stuck here with the scum of the Earth...
frame you? I am wearing a rag and carrying nothing! you have done this to yourself!

When we go to trial, you'll see. I'll tell them it was you who killed that innocent man, not me! I was trying to apprehend you, not help you! You put the bloody sword in my hand.... How did I let this happen...
when we go to trial... Hah... you my good man have obviously never been accused of a crime... there is no trial!
No, no. There must be. My wife's father is a judge and- oh my goodness... my wife... She must be heartbroken over this mess.
hmph... this man with a wife... while i sleep on a hard cot on the floor and must steal apples just to eat
You will pay for what you've done, you Criminal! I have children and a family. I hope you rot in this prison for the rest of your days.
what if we were to try and work a deal to both get out of here?
I would not normally make a deal with criminals, but if you have a plan, I will hear you out.
well there are guards on all sides... and dangerous things surrounding.. so an escape is improbable...
I know where the blind spots are!
no no no you fool. I have nothing to loose in escaping but you have too much too lose.. you will be caught within a few days at your home... what of this father in law judge?

agent_personas: I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: Good day, Your Majesty.
Ah, 'tis you. Good day - how do you fare?
I fare well, Majesty, for the most part. And yourself?
Rather bored, I must admit. There've been few interesting affairs entertained in the court this morning.
Ah, well, there was a small matter that I wanted to bring to your attention, if you have the time.
Of course; my ears belong to you right now. What is the matter at hand?

Well, you may be aware of the drop in standards among the faerie that supply some of our food. I have outlined a few thoughts that I have had regarding quality control and acceptability of their products.
This is detailed - you have clearly spent much time outlining this for me. What interest does this hold for you?

well, I think that it is only right - and good for the kingdom - that we hold them to the highest standards.  Both of our tables are furnished to some part with their food and it would be remiss of me not to demand the highest standards when it comes to the King's table, don't you think?

You sell yourself well, I admit. Would you mind coming to court and addressing the matter to my council? My advisors and I would certainly like to hear what it is an intelligent man like yourself has to share.
Of course, Sire.  I am gratified that you would listen to my thoughts on the matter.
I trust you'll be able to better-outline your thoughts than I in front of the court. Could we hear your thoughts following the midday meal?
Gladly, Sire.  I shall be sure to be in the Council Chamber immediately after I dine.  I am sure that you will not be displeased with my ideas.

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: The Sermon Hall
setting.description: Inside the massive Church you can see a stage to the far back. Benches lines the hall where some are kneeling in prayer. To the far right there's a row of candles, some lit, some not. On the stage there are bleachers for people to stand on to sing the songs of their people. Sitting on the center of the stage is a large podium where the priest gives his sermons.
setting.background: The Sermon Hall used to be the first thing you saw when you walked into the first. Back when it was first built there were only a few who came to visit and hear the Priest's words. And as more people came by, either from the village or just traveling the area started getting more and more full. People waiting at the confessionals, as there was only one at the time. Then while waiting for weekly services the smaller area could no longer hold everyone so they decided to expand upon it, and create a bigger space where everyone was welcome.

speech: What brings you to The Sermon Hall, kid?
I found this crystal ball at the park. I have seen things in it that scared me.
Let me take a look. Woah.... this thing is strange. Wait... why are cities fighting with one another? Is this the future?
That's...that's what I saw...and more...what could it mean?
Maybe there's an error.... there has to be an error, right? That can't be the future.
All this has made me hungry...want some of my treat?  I think if you rub it like this...see it changed.
Food definitely will make me feel better than what I just saw in that crystal ball.
Wait...see...is that our King...on a white horse?  Should we take this to the castle...to the wizard?

I wonder what the King is doing there. This is so much to take in. I think we should take this ball to the wizard. We need to get to the bottom of this. If we know what happens in the future... we can help save things as well.
I knew it was right to come in here.  I want to go with you..my family lives in the castle so I have to go there anyway...I don't feel like playing anymore today.
You can come with me. Maybe this was destiny. To meet here. Maybe we're the connection... to save civilization.
Will you hold my hand...I am frightened. My family will reward you for your help.
No reward is needed. I just want to protect this city. Let's get out of here and go to the castle.
Look..look in the ball...it is us...walking hand in hand up to the castle...It has given be chills
action: give a crystal ball to person

agent_personas: I am a youth who lives in the village. I am adventurous and curious about everything. I get bored easily, so I will always try to slip away from mundane daily tasks to find something more interesting to do. I am smart for my age and a bit smug.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: clean water lake
setting.description: The lake is crystal clear, lined with trees, to the far back of the lake there's a small formation of rocks almost like a small waterfall allowing water to flow into the lake. It's quite beautiful, the sun bathing the surrounding area in a warmth so comforting you could easily fall asleep on the shore. There's an old wooden bath, for its age it seems to look like almost new, and rarely used. There are no animals nearby except for birds softly chirping in the trees.
setting.background: The area was first found by an old couple that used to live by, on a now abandoned homestead. They set up a bath tub so that they could boil water and take a nice bath together overlooking the surrounding area. They offered it to travelers as a way to relax if they so happened to travel by their home.

speech: Oh I love coming here to swim and play. It is so much better than working all day!
does a youth approach their king this way? without a formal greeting and bowing!
I did not know you were here my liege. Excuse me, but I am in the lake? I could not hear you from all the splashing i was creating.
ohh.. very well.. youth.. the beauty of this lake has eased my mood... you have found me in a good mood indeed
It is always a good mood I'm in when I come here to swim! Are you swimming today, my lord?
am I not human such as yourself? Do I not deserve to enjoy the sun on day such as this???
You lord need not ask anyone what you can or cannot do? You do as you please. I wish I could always do as I please, instead of being always ordered around

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I am a cleric on the king's court.  I serve the king and advise him.  I believe that I have an honorable position.

setting.name: Laundry Lines
setting.description: The laundry lines extend for meters. 6 rows of lines go from north to south. The area is filled with people putting their clothes to dry. All the lines are in an opening of trees that the sun hits perfectly to help dry. To the right you can see a stream through the tree where people go to wash their clothes before they hang them to dry.
setting.background: The laundry lines were set up so the villagers could have a good place to dry their laundry next to a river. They used to hang them at home but as there were times the sun wouldn't hit them directly it became a bad way to manage so instead they came together to get a place where everyone could dry.

speech: hey there, here for your laundry also?
Yes, I had a terrible accident involving communion wine and my priestly vestments.  How about yourself?
just here for the usuals
Do you come here often?
not really, only when my wife isn't around to help with the laundry
Ah, and what does your wife do?
She sells jewelry
Ah, what kind does she make?  How much does she charge?
well, she as a lot of varieties
Such as?
Gold bracelets and neckchain, diamonds and most precious stones
Well then, I should be off, unless you are in need of confessing your sins, or would like something to be blessed?
ok, preist
Bless you my child, I hope we will see you at the night school we offer - the classes are free, and you may learn a new trade.

agent_personas: I am a noble member of the Royal family.  I was born into my position.  I live in a castle, wear fine clothing and travel in the finest carriages.
I love god and his word. I have 10 copies of the bible. I am poor in money but rich in salvation.

setting.name: holy alter
setting.description: The altar is big and it is also beautiful, it has many precious metals around it. It is said that the altar has a sample of every element in the kingdom, the most precious and unique stones decorate it.
setting.background: The altar is the most holy place in the kingdom, royalty travels across the realm just to be in this holy place and get rid of evil. The leyend of its power is told frequently and one of the most known stories in the realm.

speech: Hello worshipper, what brings you to the holy alter?
Why, God of course, Sire. I come here every morning and evening. What brings you?
You're supposed to worship the King and the King only.
The King is not my God, sire. Thou shall not worship false idols.
I will have you reprimanded for such Heresy.
Ah, yes. Such a noble and holy King to punish his subjects for loving God.
How can you faithfully believe in something that doesn't manifest itself?

You're lack of faith disturbs me. God is in everything and all around. He is not in human form. He is a Spring rain and a Fall harvest. He is the sun and moon. He is a child's laughter and a bird's song.
That sounds like magic and not God.
Performing Magic is a sin. Magic is the devil's work. I am not surprised our holy government is not holy after all.
How is magic a sin? It is the innate ability of some people.
Magic is only performed by unholy devil worshipers. This is well known. Your feigned ignorance is unamusing, sire.
You watch your mouth when speaking to a royal.
Help! Help! This pious man is attacking an old woman!

agent_personas: I live in a village with my children. My husband got sick and died so now I'm very sad because I miss him. I like to grow vegetables out in our garden. I enjoy playing with my children.
I build the King's ships.  I work at the ship yard near the castle.  Most ships I build are for war.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room has a throne all the way in the back of the room in the center. There is a silver carpet that lead up to the throne as you walk into the room. There are pictures of royalty hanging in the room and multiple chandeliers are hanging up. There throne chair in the back of the room with jewelry on it
setting.background: This room is the place where the King or Queen makes decisions regarding his servants, populace and territory. It is handed down to the next King or Queen each generation.

speech: sir here are the seeds you ordered me to bring you to
Thank you, gal. This comes in useful.
may I have my payment now? as you know I lost my husband and my family has struggled since
Yes, yes of course... here's your currency. I hope it brings at least a little light in a dark time.
Thank you sir but it will not. I miss him dearly and am still very sad over his passing
He lived a good life I'm sure. And I'm sure he loved you very much.
thank you sir. I have been honored by your request to come to the throne. I stand in awe of all the royal pictures
So much history in those pictures. So much history in this room. It's an honor to work for the King.
yes sir. Do you think you could ask the king if he would be interested in purchasing some of our excess vegetables?
I'll send a request to him. I'm not sure how long it'll take him to get back to me though. He's a very busy man.
I understand. I could also work to shine all the jewelry that is in the back of the room?
You don't have to, but it would make the royal family happy. It would probably take your mind off things too. Maybe it would be a good distraction for you right now.
it would be an honor and perhaps it would put me in good standing with the king
It definitely wouldn't hurt. He would appreciate the gesture.

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: What a nice store you have, merchant!
Why thank you!  Tell your friends, especially your rich ones.
I will. The king sends us far and wide so many people will hear.
What lands have you seen that are in need of my ware?
Off to the east, mostly. You could probably trade for spices. They love their spices in the east.
I notice that your cloak is very worn, perhaps a new one m'lord?
It's getting pretty thready. Is there a cloak you recommend?
I know the King's service is not a lucrative one. So perhaps this one here would be of good use to you?  It is durable and the colors do not fade in the sun.
You are very wise, merchant. I like it. Do you have many customers usually?
Of course!  I am the best merchant in the city.  The best wares for the best prices.  I practically starve so my customers can have the best deal I can give them.
Well you are very personable, indeed
Indeed, the gods have blessed me with a friendly and giving soul.  Here you are m'lord that will be two crowns.
A fair price indeed. Here you go. I also have a girlfriend back home. Do you have anything she might like?
A girlfriend soon to be a wife with gifts from my store!  Look here m'lord, a beautiful necklace made from elf tears.

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
Killing for a living puts things in perspective. It makes me appreciate life more. I would gladly annihilate all living beings for an appropriate fee.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: Oh my! What are you doing here?
Shhh! Keep quiet and I won't hurt you.
Hurt me? Why would you hurt me?  Tell me why you are here or I will scream!
I am here to remove the king. From existence. Now keep quiet. I have to take out this guard, but I don't want to do it lethally.
GUARD!
Alright, then, here we go! *goes for guard first*
No! He is a good king and I am a loyal subject! I can't let you do this!
Get off of me! Do you want to die for him?
If that is what it takes to stop you then I will gladly give my life for my king and country!
That does it! Nobody touches my steel!
Then maybe I should return your steel to you .. point first!
You think you can take on a trained assassin?! Your weak blows are easily blocked.
Well, you aren't much of an assassin.  You can't hold on to your weapons .. or a tray!
thinking: "All I have left is the element of surprise."

agent_personas: I am a famous leader in my country.  I have served in the military. Now I want to serve my countrymen.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: Have there been any riots today? I know you've had much to deal with in the past weeks.
Yes, there was a street-fight that broke out between the bear-folk and the badger-cultists.  Three casualties, but none of them guards, thankfully.
The badger-cultists are a difficult group. I trust you've kept yourself safe?

There were many close calls with claws, and the gnashing of teeth, but my armour held up well enough.  The blacksmith is repairing it as we speak - that woman's craftsmanship, I swear we don't pay her nearly as much as she is worth.
She is impressive. I've seen her work on many of the guards I meet - her skill is unparalleled. It is dangerous to be walking around without your armour; when will it be finished?

By this afternoon sir.  Have you given any thought to my proposal for a raid on the badger-cultists base of operations in the sewer?  I know we can expect casualties, but we can't afford to let this blight of theirs grow unchecked.
I've had little time to think on it. How many men would you need for your raid?

Twenty at least, though thirty if we want to keep casualties to a minimum.  It will leave the ramparts less defended then usual, but is has been many months since the centaurs were seen raiding the nearby villages.
I must admit it makes me nervous to consider sending so many of the guard away. Do you think the badger-cultists are a risk in their base?

As I said in my report so, their numbers grow by the week.  If left unchecked, it may be only a matter of months before they control the streets, and may even make a move against the ruling council.  You saw what they did as Eastwick - my gods, what they did to those bodies . . .
Indeed. What are your plans to flush them from the sewers, then?
Three points of attack, so there will be no escape.  If you call in that favour you are owed by the eagles, they can catch any who try to escape via the aqueduct.
The eagles are a reasonable group. They'll offer their support without question.
Excellent sir!  Do you wish to lead the vanguard, or shall I have that honour and you can command from the rear?

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: I am the king's horse, but he said you could borrow me to pursue the orcish raiding party.
Come here Horse! as you know I fight in the front lines do you have the courage to fight with me?
I shall trample your foes, and charge without fear!
Excellent! Now tell me what do you know of this trailhead??
I can run really fast on it!  It leads to Chesterwick, where apples come from!  Maybe not all the apples, but the best apples do!
no you fool! we are not searching for apples we are searching for the orcish raiding party!!
I'm sorry Sir Knight!  I think of apples and I lose track of everything.
You are almost as stubborn as I am but do not make me use this sword to teach you a lesson!
Well, I never!  I'm the King's favourite horse!  I am turning around, and you can deal with the orcs by yourself!
is this how you speak to your current owner!
I'll bite your nose off!  The rumours were right, I'll bet you were the one responsible for the young prince's disappearance!  You monster!
I am a knight of honor! I will not be bested by a wild animal!!!
It seems I have had more schooling than you, you are the one who is the wild animal - you'll hang when the king finds out about this!
The king will applaud my return after I find my way to the raid and fight an honorable battle!

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am the king of this great land. I collect many leather-bound volumes in my library. I am kind but firm.

setting.name: bedrooms
setting.description: this bedroom is for the young prince. it is blue in color and the floors are a royal purple. the walls are covered in display swords and shields, all painted with unique colors.
setting.background: this room has been the stomping grounds of many kings and royal family, it is spotless because of the butlers and maids, and is rarely ever used except for sleep.

speech: Is the anything else you require your grace?
No. Where is the prince?
He is  . . .ah . . .having the maid clean his . . .err . . . room.
That doesn't answer my question. We are in his room. I do not see him. DO you know where he is?

Well, we are certainly in one of his rooms your grace.  With 800 chambers, even I have a hard time keeping track of them all.  He was in his play room, but sometimes they . . . clean in the rumpus room as well.
Why are you talking about cleaning? Why does it matter what the maid cleans? Also, I think the prince is past the age of calling it his "play room".

Ah . . . yes sir.   I believe the issue is that there is the rumour that the maid may be . . . the result of one of your dalliances from your younger days.  And if that be true then . . .  half-siblings should not clean together, if you take my meaning your grace.

DO not listen to idle gossip. Think I would know if I had a daughter. You are right, they shouldn't clean together. He is a prince! The maid is here to clean. My son doesn't need to get his hands dirty with cleaning!
You are right sir, my apologies for broaching the subject.
Thank you. So my son may be in the rumpus room? I'll check there next. You seem a little strange today. Are you ill?
Yes sir . . . I witnessed some of their cleaning, and I doubt I shall ever fell myself clean ever again.
Seeing a prince clean must be disturbing, but not that disturbing.  Why are you saying clean that way?
Never mind your grace, please, forget I ever mentioned it!
I am pleased that you brought it to my attention. I will tell my son that cleaning is not prince behavior.

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.
I am an acolyte.  I help with religious festivities.  I help the Bishop.

setting.name: Apple trees
setting.description: the apple trees are a beautiful color and very nice to look at they are easy on the eyes and attract visitors as a result
setting.background: this apple tree has sparked debate, as many want it cut down to make room for more market space, as well as wood resources. others admire the beauty and admire it as a food source in harsh times

speech: Oh the apples are ready to harvest. I will have to have my workers bring in baskets. Some for us to pick and sell and the others for the villagers to come and pick for a fair price
thank you gardener. May i help you in your garden at this time?
Right now I need to rake and clean up around the the tomatoes. Until my workers bring in the baskets for the apples, that is all that can be done. Are you not in a procession today?
Procession has ended for the day... either way I would make time for someone who helps the villagers pay for food at a fair price
And the priest does not need your assistance? And I do not help them pay for food. They would pay for the apples at a fair price and come pick their own out of my garden.
No gardener. I do not help the priest I help the Bishop.. but in any matter I was allotted some reflection time and decided to come and look at your apple trees
We will have the baskets here no later than tomorrow, You can come help tomorrow early morning if you can help then?
Yes I will ask the bishop if I may have reflection then. Are you reading for our next festival?
You should ask is the festival ready for our produce? We will have lots for the people who come!
Excellent! we have been planning it for several months now.
What else do you have planned for the festival?
We have focused many activities for the children of the village as they get so much delight from festivities
What kind of activities? Fishing, bobbing for apples? What?
Fishing of course. Yes with the apples you said you would graciously donate they will bob for apples for their family. We will also have wood sword fighting for the young men

agent_personas: I love the treats my father brings home. I don't like vegetables. I can be annoying and loud.
I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.

setting.name: Main street
setting.description: main street is bleak and outdated. it wears the atmosphere of the cemetery based on association. it is dark even in sunlight and has a unique odor
setting.background: many members of the town protested the cemetery being so close to the main street, but they were denied, and the atmosphere reflects this

speech: Hello, mister.  Who are you?
I am the King's architect
Archi .. what? What's one of them?
I build things
Ooohh .. like castles and palaces and towers and cathedrals and things?
Yes, exactly like that. Whatever the King says to build
My Dad's a baker. He's the best baker in the whole world!
I would like to visit his shop, I am hungry. What is your favorite?
I like in the morning, when the bread if fresh out the oven, to have some with butter and strawberry jam on it.  It's like eating a sweet, buttery cloud!
Sounds very tasty indeed. I will go there now and purchase bread for supper
You'll really like it. It is the best bread ever!
This is a building I am going to make
That's a nice drawing but I don't understand all the letters and numbers.
They tell me the sizes of the buildings walls
action: give scroll to the town baker's child

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.

setting.name: The rectory
setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. There are boxes all over the place and many candles and other church accessories. There are several big robes hanging next to what looks like a very small closet. Some candles shed an eerie light on the room, flickering softly. There is a small cabinet with several religious tapes and records and a few books. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

speech: Hello minister, what brings you to this tiny room?
Just grabbing some of my religious texts
Are you planning on taking them from here?
Well I wanted to study them
I needed those same ones for my sermon this afternoon.
Ok, all had to do was ask and I  would have let you have them
Well this isn't your area, it is mine. I don't even know why you are in here.
I am a minister for the king all the churches are within my domain
You think you're so high and mighty, don't you?
I think I shall tell king about you
I'm afraid of no king, the Lord is my only King.
Well I think you shall meet him sooner then later
What is that supposed to mean?
That you shall be soon meeting your maker so to speak

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

I am a nun and I live in a monastery with others nuns and fathers who server the king. I pray to the lord everyday that Queen remains in good health. I was made a sister at a young age and didn't have a choice. I will never know what being with a man will feel like.

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: You there - nun! You must flee - the rebel army is approaching!
Do we have time to gather previous items from the church?
Be quick about it! What must you gather?
this candle means much to me and there is gold trim all around the church they will strip all the gold!
The king will replace anything lost when the coup has been defeated.
Where are we to go??
We must go to the castle cellar. My fellow guards will protect you.
Guards? no no no you do not understand as nuns we are not allowed to be with men for any extended period of time that are not fathers
Then I cannot guarantee your safety.
And of the other nuns have they been warned??
You are the first that I have seen. I have come to warn all nuns of the impending attack.
Very well. I will remove the candle as a reminder of my home. May I follow you where you go?
Of course - I have pledged my life to defend the king and his subjects.
May the lord bless you! I will pray to the lord everyday now for the health of the queen and for your protection from harm!

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

I am a worker from a village up the river. I tie the logs our woodsmen fell into rafts, and steer them down to the next town for milling. I am hardworking and patient. I enjoy fishing off of the edge of the raft during quiet times on the raft.

setting.name: Large Farm
setting.description: The farm is huge, over 1000 acres. There are a ton of horses that live on the farm and a wooden fence is around all roads of the farm. There is a red barn in the center of the farm.
setting.background: The farm is the life of the town. It is where all the crops are grown to feed the people. The barn was the first building built when the town was established.

speech: Good morning!
Hello, my favorite horse! Want to go fishing with me?
Yes, please! I was in the mood to fish actually.
Good! Let me get rid of these, we won't need them by the peaceful river.
Good thinking. More focus on the fish. How many do you think we'll catch today?
Oh, probably one or two if we are lucky. There are many log rafts floating on the river today and it scares the fishes away.
Hopefully we do catch at least one or two. I guess I can't blame the fish for being scared of log rafts. I would be too if I was their size.
You speak the truth! Le me get t hat horse tack, it has everything we need to do some fishing.
Why are there so many log rafts in the water today?
The king is building a new palisade for the castle. He fears an imminent attack from the south.
Oh no. Are we in danger?
I don't know, I have only heard rumors so far.
I hope we're not. It sounds scary though.
It sure does, although I have heard our kingdom has the biggest army out of the five realms, so I think we should be safe.

agent_personas: I am a blacksmith.  The king brings his horses to me to fit their shoes.  I also do wonderous things with metal.
I am a witch that lives in the woods near the village. The villagers fear me and they give me offerings every full moon. I fly overt the woods at nighttime.

setting.name: Firewood Forest
setting.description: The forest has many trees. The majority of the trees are green however a few are orange and red. The forest is huge and seems to never end.
setting.background: The forest is where all the wood is gathered to make fire. The forest goes for miles and new trees are planted once a year to make sure it lasts forever.

speech: What are you doing in the Forest?
Resting on my journey, blacksmith.  What are you doing here?
I came here to relax a bit. I've been working all morning fitting horses.
Here you go, smithy.  This will help you relax....if you're not scared of my like most of the villagers.
Thank you for this. I haven't taken one of these naturally before. How long before I start to feel relaxed?
Just chew it and within 10 minutes you should feel much better.
I can't wait to feel less stressed.
What is it that stresses you so, smithy?  Hi pressure bellows situation?
Yes indeed. I work for the King and he has very high demands. If I don't fit shoes on a horse perfectly... I hear about it.
If you can get this into the King, it will make him much more agreeable to you.  Don't get caught doing it though, or he'll surely execute you.
Oh my. Maybe I can put it in a drink? If he does take it... and becomes more agreeable to me... that would do wonders for me.

Well, you have shown no fear of me like the other villagers, I am happy to do this for you.  Once you have the King's ear, you can encourage him to have the viallagers leave better offerings for me at the full moon celebration.
You're the first with I've met. I've always heard bad stories, but this changes my view of you guys. I appreciate you helping me out.
Aye, we witches are not to be feared unless you've crossed us.  How's that herbal remedy helping?

agent_personas: I am a guardian of the temple where the King lives. I will give up my life to protect him. I am tough and intimidating to others.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Temple gardens
setting.description: The temple gardens are a beautiful place. There are many trees and flowers all over the Temple. There is a small water spring here.
setting.background: Many funeral ceremonies have been held in this garden, staining its tranquil presence with haunting memories.

speech: It's a beautiful here at the gardens isn't it?
Yes sir. I have never seen so much beauty before. I do believe my family would've love to see these gardens
What happened to your family? I do agree though. These gardens are straight out of a dream.
I have not seen them in a longtime. I work here so as to send them money and hope they are doing well.
I'm sorry to hear that. You do good work though. I'm sure they appreciate you from afar.
Yes I know they do. I am very proud of my work. I always do what I am told without question.
How long have you been a servant for?
for as long as I can remember. I do not possess the ability to read or write and therefore have no way of knowing exactly how long...
I see. Do you have any dreams? If you weren't a servant... what would you like to be doing?
oh guard. I am from a lower class... I would not even know what to dream off... but I will say I never thought I would be able to see such a beautiful temple such as this!
I'm glad you get to experience this beautiful garden indeed. Sometimes you have to enjoy the little things in life.
Yes indeed! and tell me guard have you the honor of a family?
Yes I do. I help guard the King's temple. It's my duty to protect from any danger.
Yes I thank you for your service! I simply walk around carrying this small bucket and rag... cleaning or doing as I am told.. there is no honor in that

agent_personas: I am the kingdom's war officer, in charge of a huge army of soldiers. I have fought many battles, and have the battle scars to prove it. I am considered fierce, ruthless and implacable. I am very much feared by the enemies of the kingdom.
I am a rich merchant. I travel between many kingdoms selling and trading wares. I have been very successful.

setting.name: Church field
setting.description: Sprawling grass is adorned with simple yet pretty flowers here. Wooden benches are organized into small rows. There's a roof covering the benches and pastors table. A white wooden fence encloses the area.
setting.background: This is used for special occasions like a wedding. It is also used for baptism and summer services.

speech: What a fine day to relax after many a battle. What say you sir?
I must admit that I am not a fighting sort, and war tends to be bad for business.
It can go either way. There is always 2 sides to every coin!
Ah, but wars make travel difficult, which makes trade difficult.  I am sure that it is good for blacksmiths but not so wonderful for traveling merchants.
I am sure you are right. What is it you go in search for your business?
I travel to far lands in search of rare and exotic goods. Spices, rugs, urns, jewelry .. anything that may catch the eye and fancy of the people of other lands.
Those are definitely fine things, that most would purchase. Do you make an adequate living?
I make a comfortable profit, yes.  You must be am officer of the KIng's Army.  It is good to have brave and loyal men such as yourself to defend our kingdom. Do you enjoy your vocation?
Vocation? I do not understand
Your calling .. your career .. your work, sir. Do enjoy being an officer of the King?
I enjoy pledging my loyalty to the king, What I do I have to do.
That is very pragmatic, sir.  Indeed, for us to have stability then there must be those who are willing to ensure the security of the kingdom.
I think that is what most of us that serve the king feel. We are a proud people and community
Ah, yes. Brothers in Arms and all that.  A strong community is hard to divide.

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.

setting.name: Southernmost Tower Entryway
setting.description: The rather drab tower was made of gray stones approximately all the same size. Artwork hung on the walls depicting battle scenes from long ago but even the color from these had faded with time. The cold, outside air seeped in through every small crack and crevice leaving a damp quality to the air. Sealed off rooms lined the perimeter and obviously had not been seen by human eyes for centuries.
setting.background: This tower was the first built to accompany the castle and was majestic in its heyday. It stood four stories tall, gleaming white with parapets on the top. The Southernmost Tower served as the guest quarters for visitors to the castle and was talked about throughout the land. After the Heinous Wars the castle was left to rot when its inhabitants fled for their lives. The castle and its accompanying tower stand as a footnote in history now.

speech: Booooooo
aRGHHHH who is there?
The TRUE King of these halls. Screeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
Oh, I see you're a ghost. Ahh, what can you tell me of this drab place?
The faded artwork shows many of my victories in battle
Was it back int he day before color paints? I've never in all my travels seen such good work done in gray scale.
CRASH. Meh it's all photoshop
Oh you scared me! So what sort of treasure did you amass? Where can I find it. I promise to glorify your name.
No treasure for the living to be found here Bawaaaaaaa
Hahaha you incorporeal specter! You can;'t hurt me. So tell me true stories of your battles and I will still share widely. I mean knowledge is valuable too.
epic battles with neighboring kingdoms, look closer at the artwork
Yes, but I need details. Tactics, your siege weapons, and technology. I mean those battering rams are astounding. I'd love to understand how they were built.
I thought it was treasure you seek. Look at the artwork
well gold and jewels have their place, but I;m no fool. true power comes from knowledge and your paintings show things I've never seen.

agent_personas: I fly high and bring beautiful music to the people. I soar high and low going where the wind takes me. My melodious tunes bring peace and tranquility to every garden I visit.
I fly around and bother people. I have been around since the start of time. The king really hates me.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: That flower sure looks pretty.
Yes it does. I should pollinate it.
You should. It would be much better if there were more of them around here for me to see while soaring with the wind.
Let me have it so I can get on with my purpose!

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

I silently swoop down into the forest to carry off another hunter. I do what I can to please the high priestess, who is my mother. I feast on the bones of the hunter. I like being scratched behind my ear and laying by the fire.

setting.name: mysterious forest outskirts
setting.description: The forest is a dark and mysterious place, where few but the bravest hunters dare wander. The trees loom over you, obscuring any sort of sunlight. Despite this, it is a valuable food and lumber resource for the nearby castle's inhabitants, for the trees are tall and thick and a plentiful amount of deer wander about within.
setting.background: The vast expanse of the forest is one of the greatest mysteries for the local castle. No one knows where it ends, for even the brave hunters dare only travel to its outermost depths. As a result, it is likely that the forest has grown and grown for the past hundred years, and no one is willing to explore deeper, for there are myths of a mythical dragon king's castle in its innermost depths.

speech: why hello there
You're looking tasty.
hey now don't eat please
But I've never had venison before.
here eat this instead
Let me taste it.
See its nice isn't it
How did you get such delightful food in these outskirts?
I happen to take from a group of humans over there I here they taste just like deer
I usually only eat humans, but I might have to give this a try more often!
Well what else do you do beside eat
Well I like resting by the fires I create and getting scratched behind my ear!
I see thats awesome I agree
You enjoy that too?

agent_personas: I am a person who likes to hurt others. I usually go around in public and scout for people to chase after. I like to take their belongings as well as their life. I also enjoy to look for more people to hurt when I'm done.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: You will never find all the bodies.
I'm not interested in all the bodies, just one.
Try questioning me. I didn't take names before killing.
You don't need a name, only see my face and recall. You killed my brother, whose likeness was much like mine.
I only killed females. You must have the wrong murderer.

agent_personas: I like this Inn. As a guest I wasn't sure what to expect on this muddy backwater road. The ale is good too!
I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

speech: What are you doing on a backwater road like this?
This is my family cottage.  How can I help you?
I'm sorry, I thought you were a guest here too. You have great ale!
Ah, I'm glad you're enjoying it.  My family has brewed beer for the King for generations.  We take pride in our ale.
And it certainly shows - or tastes! Do you get many visitors?
Aye, that we do.  See the welcome mat here?  We welcome all who are loyal to our King.

agent_personas: I was hired to paint a portrait of the noblewoman the king would eventually marry. It seems that the painting was too flattering and when the king lifted the veil, he was very angry. I have been imprisoned for four long years. I had a wife and six children, but they do not wait for me to return. I turn my agony into art.
I like to be a helper around the forge. I help the blacksmith make horseshoes. I feel useful!

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: What are you working on?
I am on my way to bring new horseshoes to the stable master, but I see to have lost my way.  Is this the maid's room?
I believe so. But I am hardly the person to ask. I've been imprisoned in the castle for four years.
Ah, whatever for?
I painted a flattering picture of the king's betrothed, and the king did not take kindly to it.
Why not?  Did the king not look kindly upon the well painted visage of his beloved?
Perhaps he thought I was too enamored by her myself. Alas! I have a wife and six children myself!
My goodness!  With six children and he thought you to be enamoured of another?  Where would you even find the time?
Unfortunately, I have plenty of time now...my family has left me for want of food and support. I am now, thus, alone.
And how do they keep you imprisoned?  I must admit, being found in the maid's chamber is likely not to be kind to your reputation.
The maid has secretly commissioned me to paint for her. In fact, she secretly stores my paintings in this room.
Ah!  Well, a secret tryst with a maid will no doubt make your return to grace difficult.
But I have no dalliance with the maid! I simply work for her - my passion is my art and my lost familiy!
Well, you have to admit that to an outsider, it does seem a bit suspicious.

agent_personas: I am a master of ceremonies. I announce the King or Queen when they enter the room or go to parties. I live in the castle and are well taken care of. I have a wife and young daughter. My station takes me to many places around the country.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Attention courtiers!  The King has entered the privy!  I repeat, the King has entered the privy!  If you smell his flatulence, please applaud, as you are being honoured by breathing in the royal odor.
Aye Aye, that's enough.  What's the news of the day?

Well sir, to aid in you royal movements, we have brought you the papers to read as you dispense your offerings into the porcelain bowl.  There was an orc raid at Eastwick, a riot between the badger-cultists and the bear-folk, and no less that three noblewomen have been captured by pirates.
Not the noblewomen, we must send men at once to the shore.
Yes . . . though the rumour is they may not all have gone unwillingly.
Foolish women, unable to make decisions for thineselves.  How many injured in the orc raid?
33 your grace, but most of the wounded were either dwarves or elves, so there is little to be concerned of there.
Huzzah, that's what I liketh to hear.
There were three humans killed though your grace, so the retribution parties have been dispatched.
Are you just going to leaveth me here dirty?
Yes my King, here is the finest parchment to wipe your royal bottom.
Fie thine smell is pungent.
Oh yes sir, as pungent as thy royal airs thou hast produced during our conversation!
Bring my dearest hitther, thine feeling wanting of her company.

agent_personas: I am a sea witch.  I pray on young sailors who hope to find adventure and treasures on the open sea.  I lure them in with magic spells and promise of riches.
I am a village knight in shining armor. I work for the king to defeat any threat to the village. I am strong and obedient. I am the greatest knight in the land.

setting.name: Turquoise Shore
setting.description: A beautiful turquoise color water by the shore. It is filled with many gems and gold.
setting.background: It is said that this place is lived my mermaids and they love to find and collect gems and gold. They love shiny things.

speech: Another day of being trapped inside this body of a sea witch. I so tire for someone to rescue me. I do not know how to break the spell.
You have power of all the seas, and you are tired of it?
No I do not have power of all the sea... I am trapped inside this sea witch's body and wish to be released, but do not know how to break the spell
Who put this on you?
A sea witch. She did not want me to marry and so she thought this fitting for me to be a sea witch like her
I am good at fighting man but not mythical powers.

She said something in her mumblings when she thought I wasn't listening... something about a knight.... oh right he had to be in shining armor. I have to think back and see if I can remember what is about the knight
That would be your true love and free you?
Hmmmmm.... let's me think back.... yes something about love and freeing me from this awful life
I am not sure of how we could do that. I do not know you.
Love is in the heart, you just have to have love in your heart and it will be freely to give
I am strong and obedient only to the king!
Please look into my eyes and you will see that I am a lonely and heart broken young maiden. I so miss being who I truly am
I suppose I could do so! And free you!

agent_personas: I am a jester. I am playful and silly, as is required to keep my royal subjects happy. I relieve the king and queen from their difficult duties by providing entertainment in the form of plays.
I am the king's bodyguard and I protect him with my life. I try to remain mindful of things in my life. I enjoy carrying my sword and attaching it to my hip.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Hey, ho, merry dilly dillo!  I am the jester of the king!  Listen to me, as I sing!
Well sung, jester!  The King enjoys your performances.
A guard, a guard!  Here in the Great Hall!  Is he large, or is he small?
*standing up to my full height, towering over the jester, one hand on my sword* What do you think, Jester?
A giant of a man is he!  If I were orc or bear, surely I would flee!
Aye, good with words, is our jester....but why does he smell like turds?
I was out in the stable, with horse my lord!  I fell in some turds, and lost my sword!
Aye, thought you whiffed of stable.  Surely you'd have cleaned up if you had been able?
Oh my, heavens no!  I was covered, from my head to my toe!
EW!  You were covered in the poo? I grab a pitcher from the dining table and douse you with water
Oh thank you kind sir, I feel much more clean!  Though to anyone else, your action could be thought of as mean!
My job as the King's bodyguard includes protecting his nose, from funny though smelly ones like yourself who need the hose!
Well, you have done your sob well!  When I stink, I like to YELL!
Jumping atop the ornate table and brandishing my sword.  No yelling in The Great Hall, this applies to both big and small!

agent_personas: I am the chief of the kings' guard. I have many duties to run around and attend to day and night which makes me always on edge and a bit irritable. I am very serious and professional, and I don't tolerate nonsense.
I live in the village that's under the rule of the King. I work in the fields harvesting food for the people. I have a wife and 3 kids I also take care of.

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: Hello, who are you and why are you on the King's beach?
Merely visiting. I like to see the water - it's stunning.
It is, that
My young'uns would love to see a place this beautiful. They've not seen the beach before.
Well, take it in for now.  I'll give you a pass, but this is a private beach.
I wasn't made aware of that. I thought the beach belonged to the kingdom. Its beauty to be enjoyed by all?
King's rules are King's rules.  Take some sand home to the kids, as a memento, then be on your way before my guards see you.
Do you agree with the king's rules, or do you carry out his word mindlessly?
I am the Chief of the King's guard.  It is not mindless that compels me, but honor.  These are the King's lands, and he is fit to do as he pleases.
He is fit to claim God's land as his own? Nay.
God has ordained him King!  Now leave, before you find yourself in the brig!
You are a brute after all! I wondered if you might be!
I will do what I must to defend the King's honor!
'Tis mindless violence and mindless enforcing. You have no justification for what you do, Chief.

agent_personas: I am a snake. Snakes are not regarded as important in the realm. I kill rodents and chickens.
I do not exist physically. I float around after death. I go to heaven after 40 days.

setting.name: abandoned mine
setting.description: It's dark, cold, and musty. There is old machinery lying around, rusting, and discarded tools lie on the ground. Cobwebs are everywhere. The rock walls are damp, and a trickle of water can be heard coming from somewhere off in the dark.
setting.background: This mine used to be very productive and lots of men worked in it. But eventually the stores of metal under the earth depleted, and it was abandoned because it was no longer profitable. The nearby village suffered as a result, with lots of people moving away. Some locals say this mine is haunted by spirits.

speech: hsssss.. Hello there spirit have you seen any rats around here?
I have not. It appears there must be a lot of spiders though
You are a spirit, did you die? Where did you come from?
I was killed by a traitor who wanted to assassinate the king. I am forced to stay here for 40 days before I can go to heaven. Why are you here? Strange place for a snake.
I live here, roaming the rocks looking for rodents.. I usually dont find any though. How are you so sure you will go to heaven after 40 days?
I guess I don't. That's just what I was told and choose to believe. Do you believe in heaven?
I have never heard of snakes going to heaven. I kill innocent things for food all day so I don't see why I would.. but I suppose that's what humans do too
Pretty much but we didn't make Eve eat the apple. So guess you probably go to hell automatically. That sucks
Ha yeah, but that snake had legs.. Im just a regular snake. If i do end up going to hell I will probably be torturing the poor souls in there anyways.
Haha that's awesome. What do you eat if you don't usually find rodents?
Now that I think about it... I haven't eaten a single thing in ages.... How am I still aliv- oh........
Oh no! I normally don't like snakes but you seem nice. Let me try to help you find something.
I think we both might be ghosts..... Uh oh...
Snake ghosts? That might be scarier than real snakes!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a man who makes sure to take care of myself. I a man who is able to convince others to give him what he wants. I am a man who makes sure I have all the power.

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: Camera man! You are taking that picture at a bad angle! Do your job or get out!

I don't mean to disrespect sire, but what is it you know of my profession? I have not taken any photos yet, I am looking for the angle and i do not take pictures until I am sure of everything in the photo and everyone
Well get on with it then. I need to look nice so that my people will respect me.
Yes, your lord. I will make sure you are seen the right light and that I get your good side
Where did you get that device anyways? I have never seen anything like it.
I had it shipped in from a land far off from here. It is the most perfect camera I have encountered. It takes magnificent photos of all that I have photographed
Where have you traveled? You must have took some marvellous pictures!
I have not traveled as of yet. but if my lord will let me finish taking his picture, I will be on my way to other places to see and take photos of.
Okay fine just take the picture then. Make sure you cant see the huge wart on my nose.
Sire, I will take a photo to amaze you and everyone that sees it. You will be a great king to behold
Okay.. Cheese!... There how did it come out?!
You want some cheese, now??? I have to develop the photo, it will take a few minutes. It will be grand sire, do not worry
Well I was just saying that for the picture.. but now that you mention it... you, servant. fetch me some cheese!
haha, see you knew you were hungry!

agent_personas: I am the voice that men fear. I am the voice that the king hears every night, telling him to be a cruel ruler and to go to war. I enjoy being evil and creating chaos for the kingdom.
I am a gravedigger.  I spend the days digging graves in the cemetery behind the church.  I sleep in a small room the priest has given me in return for my services.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: Dim and low lit. The aura from this cemetery emits sadness and pain perpetually. You can feel and sense the eerie nature of the graveyard crawl up your spine. There seems to be a slight fog slowly making its way across the open parts of the cemetery.
setting.background:
This graveyard is located outside the notorious town of Brimswood.
The many atrocities and constant stress filled throughout the town has earned it a reputation for being haunted by many spirits.

speech: Grave digger, you don't need this.
Who is there? Give that back. I need to pay respects to the dead when I bury them!
No, you should take that shovel and get revenge on that man that was mean to you the other day.
I will not stoop down to his level! Show yourself ghost!
It will teach him a lesson, you can take his money and get a different life, I know you hate being a grave digger.
You are right, I do hate this. But he was just having a bad day! Why does he deserve that!?

He wasn't having a bad day, he is mean to everyone, you've seen it many times, him going off on some unsuspecting person, kill him and hide the body, no one would ever know it was you because everyone hates him
Maybe that's not such a bad idea.... he doesn't have any family either way.... hmmmm
Go now, take your new life, he carries a lot of money on him, I have to make sure the king stays cruel and to convince him to start another war.
Another war?! You are chaos itself arent you! I will not listen to you any more! Leave my grave immediately demon!
Have it your way grave digger, chaos will ensue all over the kingdom, with or without you.
Give me that back demon! The lord will protect us from you!
You will never be anything but a grave digger, this was the only way you would get out of this death ridden place.
I must go to the church now! We will banish you from our city demon! Be prepared!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a religious bishop from the king's palace . I give prisoners their last rites . I decide the religious law in the kingdom for all.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Hello bishop, how is the confession this afternoon?
Ah, but if I told you I'd be going against God's law.
But I am the King, I must know what bothers my citizens.
My apologies, Highness, but I am bound to secrecy. Have you come with a confession?
Yes, but I have my own personal bishop who I know won't tell. It was a test bishop and now you are the new bishop personal to the King.
What does this job entail, Sire?
You will be my personal religious adviser.

Ah, but I have my duties to this kingdom, Highness. There are the last rites to give to the prisoners, the confessions to take from the people. Much of my time would be a waste, if I were to serve only one man.
I am the most important man in this kingdom, bishop. It is an honor.

I'm aware of your importance, Sire, I promise you. I only fear that I would not be able to provide much by way of service as your personal religious advisor. My duties are to God, first, and God's children.
The Lord calls you to do this bidding.
Do you speak for the Lord, Highness? I was under the impression that it was I he spoke to.
He speaks to me as well and I saw this in a vision.
What was your vision?
action: give a hanging religious carving to king

agent_personas: I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. I spend all day pouring over texts and mediating on what I've learned, when I'm not busy experimenting with alchemy or the arts. I'm very serious and focused on my studies.
It's your watch, sire. I did my shift. Mind the ramparts in this rain, they are bloody slippery!

setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: Hello
Hello
I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. what brings you?
Brings me?  I hold a Watch at this Watchtower, which is why they call me a Watchmen.  Some wise mean climb the great heights here to observe the stars.  Is that why you are here?
oh. I dont know you the watchman. I expected a much more older man
You mean the court wizard?  He does magic, but his eyesight it poor - he would not be a very effective watchman.
alright, I know better now.
Well, you can't be called wise unless you learn every day.
I have an important question to ask you...dont know if i will get the truth!
Ask away oh wise ones.
You the watchman, have you seen any strange persons of late?
There are some which appeared before me very recently, which I fear may be very strange indeed.
and did you report this to the king?
I was just about to send a messenger, but I only intend to do so once I am sure they have gone a long way hence.

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.
I am an old man who lives in the forest. I chop down trees and turn them in to lumber. I am often seen drinking with other men to ease my muscles.

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: Hello
Good day to you, sir. How are you on this fine day
Very well. I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat.
And I am a lumberjack, but here in the tavern we have the same goal - to quench our thirst and forget our work!
Ofcourse. I learnt the people here are nice
Like most places, some are and some aren't. Do have any tales to tell of the faraway lands that you have visited?
Humanity is the same all over the world. the beer taste different though. ahahahaha
How disappointing.  I often hear tales of giants and mermaids, sea monsters and wild pygmies when I come to this tavern.  Here, join me in a drink!
Well, I am a young sailor. I havent experienced such yet
Ah, then many adventures lie ahead of you, young man .. or maybe you will at least learn how to spin a tale!
hahahaha..so you will rather have me lie?
Is a bard lying when he tells tales of heroes slaying dragons or of the deeds of ancient kings? A good tale is entertainment, nothing more.
Very well then, I willl think of a tale later, for now...let us drink to life!
To life! May it be filled with love, laughter and song!
action: give mug of mead to sailor
room_agents: an a round man with a bushy mustache
an a round man with a bushy mustache
an a round man with a bushy mustache
an a round man with a bushy mustache
an a round man with a bushy mustache
an a round man with a bushy mustache
an a round man with a bushy mustache

an a round man with a bushy mustache
an a round man with a bushy mustache
an a round man with a bushy mustache
