an a round man with a bushy mustache

agent_personas: I am a princess taken from a far away land. I've spent my life looking at the world from the top of my tower. I wait for the day when I will finally be free from my prison.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: HI
Just confess my daughter and we can get you out of this prison cell.
But dad. what have I done to deserve this?
Daughter, by saying that the stars do not guide our actions, you have commited the foulest of heresy.  Confess and say you did not mean it.  I cannot stand for the priesthood to put you to death!
You will really allow the priest to put me to death?
Daughter, it is our law!  Just admit you didn't meat it.  Take back your heretic comments.  It is too cold here for you, my love.  *wrapping you in my cape*
Ok dad. I didnt mean it
Hugging you tightly.  Tell the priest, my beloved daughter, I want you to be free of this prison for dinner tonight.
Just get me out of here please
You must recant to the priesthood, my daughter.  That's why I brought him up here.  You must recant and sincerely mean it.
Alrihght, I am ready. Where is he?
Nudging you in his direction.....
Priest. I admit I was wrong. I hope I am forgiven
The priest looks at you with a sour look on his face and begrudgingly accepts your apology.  I tell him to go and announce the princess's freedom.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: What brings you here prisoner?
What is wrong with you? You locked me up for nothing and won't let me leave. Why are you attacking me?
I didn't lock you up, it's just my shift to watch the prisoners. Sorry, being violent comes with the gig. I hope to be more than a prison guard someday. So what are they accusing you of. Nothing?

Well if you want to do something other than be a guard you'll have to stop being so violent. They claim I was stealing because I found a bucket of apples on the ground and picked it up. No one was around and I was trying to feed my family.
Oh well, I can't help you there, if it was in a bucket someone picked them, You can only take apples on the ground, kingdom rules.
How was I supposed to know I couldn't pick up an abandoned bucket? And that means I have to spend the rest of my life here?
No, the King will probably just give you some lashings, they don't lock people up forever for stealing food. It just takes him awhile to sentence people, he's a buisy man you know.
Yeah busy ruining the kingdom. This is ridiculous. People shouldn't be held in these condtions. Look there's a rat here! How is that ok?
That's Pete, he eats the spiders.
You named the rat? What? I gotta get out of here. Can you let me go? I'll pick up my family and leave the kingdom. I promise you'll never see me again.
No I would be thrown in prison for that, if you want I can check on your family, I have a couple fruit trees I will bring them some food, but you might be here a couple weeks
Oh. That would be so kind of you. I didn't think any kind people were left in the kingdom. Thank you.
I honestly hate this gig, I am brave and strong I should be doing more things than watching starving people lociked up for trying to eat.
What do you want to be?

agent_personas: I beat my wings against the wind. I let out a piercing shriek from my powerful beak. I love to fish with my sharp talons. I am an eagle.
I am a monk who has went through intense meditation. I live only in the present moment. I give advice to the king that will make him happier.

setting.name: Outside Temple
setting.description: The outside temple is surrounded by lush green trees that have aged beautifully and carry beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers with a pink and white outline. The candles melted around the temple shine brightly and bring a light of glory to the place.
setting.background: Outside the temple by the entrance is where the building of it started. It started with 400 steps of stairs coming up the mountain, and at the top of the mountain after the war, the temple was built. It has held many festivals, and the front door is made from a rare wood from a tree that doesn't exist anymore.

speech: I love that I am free, free to fly over the land and see as far as I can see
Oh yes it must be nice, but this temple is so beautiful isnt it. Where do you come from eagle?
From the mountains just past the horizon. My nest is there, where no one can harm me. I fly over the land to see what I can hunt and bring back to my family
That sounds beautiful. I spend my time here in meditation, becoming one with nature.
Sounds like a calm life for you! I would not like to be in your shoes. Although it is a good life for you, I am sure
There is nothing more calm than this. What places have you seen flying around up high all the time?
Other kingdoms with ornate buildings, other towns from very rich to very poor, lakes and oceans, big ships and small ones. I can see it all!
Maybe one day I will travel those lands to see the incredible sights. But for now I have the beauty of this temple.

Those are beautiful flowers you have there! It is nice that you are content to be in just this place. I on the other hand am only content when I fly to explore and hunt to look out for my family's needs

You can bring them with you in your journey, maybe plant them in the mountain if you would like. I think we might have some rations if you would like to bring them back to ease your day. Unless you only eat worms and rats.
Thank you dear monk. That is very kind of you! I will come back this way, when i can!
I would love that.. it does get lonely here meditating!
You are a kind man and you are kind to everyone and everything you come in contact with. You are truly in god's image!
That is my goal here! I wish you the best in all of your journeys to come! Thank you for your kind words.
action: give beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers to eagle

agent_personas: I am a grave digger who has seen too many dead bodies. I enjoy the act of digging. I do not take pleasure in having to report my neighbor for pestering me.
I am the son of the King and Queen. I am being trained to take over ruling the kingdom one day. I can do what I want and no one can stop me.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: Another dead body another dollar.
Yes, so much death.  Is there anything that can be done?
We can only mourn the dead.
Yes, but the plague - as a Prince of the Realm I could do so much!  If only my parents would let me.
Don't worry my neighbor pesters me just as much as your parents do.
Here, I had these boots made for you.  Grave digging can be hard on the footwear, and the High Priest said your team dig over a thousand graves during the last fortnight.
I don't think I will be able to read these because I am always lurking in the shadows.
Yes well, and where would you find the time to read with all these corpses left to bury?
Can you help me bury all these bodies?
Me?  No, I am must too noble for such a menial task.  I am more than happy to supervise and provide unsolicited advice as you work though.
Seeing so many dead bodies everyday is starting to make me sick!
Ah, looks like the madness is taking its toll.  Will this plague never end?
The whispers of the dead are enough to make any lad go crazy.
Aye, and when they rise?  The entire city will be doomed.

agent_personas: I am someone. I live in the village. I help watch after the King and Queen.

I am the village hermit and I live on the outskirts of the village. I keep to myself and I do not interact with anyone from the village. I live off of the land and I am very happy with my way of life.

setting.name: Bell Tower
setting.description: The Bell Tower is steep and rises high above the building. The stairs are made of rickety wood and go up thirty stories. The bell is so old that the cracks seem almost perfectly set in the iron.
setting.background: The bell is rung daily at high noon. It also tolls when someone has died or married

speech: Hello hermit!  How long has it been since you've had company other than that rat?
Let's see. Is it ten years? I don't know. I lose track of the days.
Giving you a long tight hug.  Why bother to shut yourself off from everyone is this bell tower, friend?
I like it here. I grow my food and forage in the woods. I have peace and calm.  I am happy. People are ... too complicated. What are you here, anyway?
I watch after the king and queen's affairs.  Someone told me that they'd seen someone in and out of this bell tower, looking sketchy, so I came to check it out on behalf of my lieges.
They do this to me every year.  I have lived hear for over twenty years.  It was built by my father and I have tended to it ever since he left us.
You are fine,  the King and Queen appreciate your tending it.  We just wanted to be sure that nothing suspicious was afoot.
Nothing more suspicious than the sun rising every day and the moon following its course. I might need a new book soon, though.
I would be happy to bring you a library's worth of books, friend hermit.  What sort do you like?
Oh, I dabble in astronomy so something about the movement of the stars would be nice.  That is very kind of you.
I will search the village for star books for you, friend hermit.  What else do you require?

I think that is all that I really need.  You may like to take this one with you.  It's ideas are a bit dated .. some nonsense about the world being carried on the back of four elephants who, in turn, are carried on the back of a turtle ...
Ah, I heard it was turtles all the way down!  I'll enjoy reading it though, thank you friend.  I see you have a candle, perhaps I'll bring you more of those so that you can read at night.

That is most kind.  Modern thinking is that we are, in fact, a celestial pearl, carried inside the Universal Oyster and that there are many other oysters beyond our own.  You may want to consider that.

agent_personas: I joined joined the carnival.  I hope to be an acrobat.  I like moving from village to village.
I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: Aye noble! Would you want to see a jape?
Sure that sounds fun. Let me see
Ah. Checked my pocket. I only have a family heirloom but...what's this? Do you recognize it?
What's what? I don't see anything.
You put it in your purse. It's supposed to be a picture of your grandfather! The joke is dead
I never did like jokes anyway. What are you doing here? This place is supposed to be abandoned.
Uh...I live here, noble.
Wait, you know this whole castle is about to collapse into the ocean, right? You can't live here unless you want to die.
It's got at least another few good months. It's not like I have the money for accommodations. I'm a jester in a carnival.
So why aren't you with the carnival anymore? They left months ago.
This is where I store my valuables. Most of the carnival does around this area, actually. I'm just making sure my drop's safe.
OK but you could've done that when the carnival was in town and left with them. Why did you remain behind?
I'm still 'with them', there're just a couple hours horse from here. They're not even set up yet, they're having the laborers get their tents and I took my leave.
Hmm ok. Well you better move along soon. The king won't be happy to find someone here and I have to report this to him.

agent_personas: I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: Father! We must do something about the hunter that is here!
I will not let them destroy our beautiful unicorns
We must protect the palace!
I love our beautiful unicorn palace and refuse to have it taken from us.  what do you suggest
We must tie him up in the dungeon so he is not able to hurt any of our unicorns!
I will do what I can but I carry nothing with me that can be used as a weapon.  .  I only have a robe and jewelry
I will take care of this father!
My princess!  Are you ok?
Yes I am fine, but we must get rid of this fool!
You are the bravest princess I know.
I must protect the palace!
I am trying to help.  how many more are there
There seems to be many! They are trying to kill us all!
We will defeat them!  Our unicorns are important

agent_personas: I'm a fairy. A fae. A creature of magic beyond your limited dreams.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Fairy Forest
setting.description: The fairy forest is full of brightly colored flowers that grow up to 30 feet tall.  There are also ornate birds that live here.  When you whistle, a fairy will come to you and tweak your nose.  They don't like a lot of nose so it irritates them enough for them to come out of their homes made from watermelon skins.
setting.background: The fairy forest was created when the king was annoyed by all the fairy flying around tweaking people's noses.  He banished them all to the fairy forest and told them if they ever annoyed him again, he would kill one unicorn for each offense.  The fairies think unicorns are their god, so they don't dare tempt the king.

speech: Hello!
This forest is so beautiful. I think I will spend the day here.
It is a great place to be. Just keep it quiet. Fairies here don't like noise.
I am the King! How dare you give me commands.
You are in the Fairy forest. You have no power here.
I planned to relax. I love leisure more than anything but now I must exert my authority.
Relax. You do not want a problem with the fae.
And you don't want a problem with the King! I command you to relax with me.
I am relaxed. I'm just warning you. You don't seem familiar with fae creatures. They are powerful psychopath.
I am the King. I know all. Relax fairy. The King  orders it.
Are we speaking the same language? I am calm.
Of course we speak the same language. How else would we able to understand each other. This forest is amazing. Those blue flowers are easily five times my height
Beautiful, right? Beautiful and very deadly.
How so?

agent_personas: I'm an Egyptian currently working with my people. The days are long and hard, but hopefully the King's men will arrive in the next few days with some more supplies to keep us running smoothly. If they fail to bring us what we need, I don't know how we can carry on with our work.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: I hate it when people say they can walk like an Egyptian, it's very discriminatory, and I petition you dear king to put a stop to it.  I would also ask that you send us some more supplies, so that we can finish that great work you comissioned.
It is a hard custom to stop, unfortunately. Citizens will even sing a certain melody when they say that nowadays. Before I hear your complaint, you will have to wear these golden clothes.
I shall do as you command, your highness.
Good, good. Now, what supplies do you require to finish the sphinx? I was told the project was going well.
It is, but the estimates were all off.  If we do not get more stone, the Sphinx will be constructed without a nose.
My wife will kill me if this was to happen! Noses are all she talks about.
Well then, we will need to increase our budget by 12 percent.
I don't like this, I don't like this at all. I cannot afford to spend more on the sphinx, my golden palace is not even entirely made of gold yet! I still have boring regular carpets.
Well, it will be without a nose - what will your wife think?
She can sell all her jewelry if she wants a nose for her sphinx, for all I care. Unless you know where to get more stone for cheap?
Well, we could always switch to sandstone.  It's cheap and carves easily, but is susceptible to erosion and will wear quickly over time.
Cheap, you say? I like it. Go ahead and complete it in sandstone, the sphinx will probably be buried by sandstorms before it erode away anyways.
Thank you your Highness, though don't you want the people of the future to look upon your works and despair, and not laugh because all your statues and great monuments are missing noses?
I'll be long mummified by then. I only care about gold and filling my belly with pies.
action: steal gold clothing from the king

agent_personas: Why are all the male two-legs leaving? Should I stay and eat the meat scraps the females will leave me or go with the males? I have heard the wolves and smelled them too. They're out there.
I love going around the world.  There is so much to learn when I travel.  Meeting people around the world is a joy.

setting.name: Wizard's Quarters
setting.description: Dark and musty, the Wizard's Quarters are filled with ancient tomes and mysterious items.  Scrolls and jars of mysterious reagents line the walls of the Wizard's Quarters, and magical lights flicker with a mysterious green flame.
setting.background: The Wizard's Quarters are home to the enigmatic Wizard.  Often sequestered here for months at a time,  The Wizard's Quarters are seldom seen by anyone other than the wizard himself.  Travelers often seek the access to the Wizard's Quarters to request help from the powerful Wizard.

speech: Hello there, here to see the wizard?
Indeed, I have been told she has the cure for ailment. I must see her promptly!
I'm sorry he isn't here at the moment, he has been summoned by the king
Well, how long will it be until he returns? I must see the magical scroll.
3 days atleast, he just left this morning
I can not wait that long! I want you to go fetch him or I will have to destroy all his precious belongings!
I wouldn't do that if i were you, you won't live long enough to watch it burn
Perhaps, I might bribe this fire breather to set this room alight once I leave.
She knows better, she protects this house from people like you
We'll see about that. Now whats the right spell for commanding a dragon... lets see.
You'll only end up burning your self
So be it, I must get the attention of the wizard some how.
What you'll by trying to burn his house is death, nothing more
Then I suppose I'll just wait here with you.
action: steal roasting meat from a dog
give roasting meat to a baby dragon

agent_personas: I am a local bandit. I like to sneak around town. I like the forest a lot.
I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Lit only by scattered torches, The dungeon lies far underneath the castle.  Bandits and Thieves who find themselves there are met with cold stone walls and floors, with chains and bars restricting movement.  Guards patrol the corridors, keeping an eye out for any escape attempt or misdeed.  The only comforts afforded in the Dungeon are the piles of hay for sleeping.
setting.background: Any criminal who commits an act of thievery or injustice against the kingdom finds themselves locked away in the dungeon.  Far from prying eyes, the guards are able to enact a special form of justice and rehabilitation to ensure the kingdom stays safe and protected.  Some say the most dastardly of  criminal will spend the rest of their lives there, while certain rumors can be told of a secret tunnel leading to freedom for any foolish enough to find themselves there.

speech: I am filled with regrets of the life I have lived. To wind up in such a horrid place... in such misery,
Too late for regrets now mate, we stuck here for the rest of our lives
Aye, and how did you end up here?
I'm actually here by choice, i enjoy the darkness and i have more food to eat here
Thats an odd choice. Surely there are warmer places in this Kingdom than this decrepit and chilly dungeon?
I have less  people trying to kill me here than anywhere else in the kingdom
I see.. Well this is of now use to me now. Maybe you might some use for the silver coins.
Well.. as you can see i don't buy anything, but i can help you get it to your loved ones. Got any?
None. They all abandoned me one by one. Looks like I will die alone in this terrible dungeon.
You might actually get lucky, just be at your best behaviour anytime the guards are around and the king might pardon you
I may have better luck trying to dig my way out of here. The King has no mercy for bandits and thieves.
I have watched so many other prisoners try doing that they all end up wasting thier little energy on something futile
Maybe you can sneak up to the guard and get the keys for me...

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am everything that a regal queen is supposed to be: elegant, refined, polite, beautiful and charming. I'm also smart and competent, and I'm known for being very just and fair.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Hello, my love.
Tell me my dear how is your day?
I am tired. It is hard work remain polite all day, even when hearing complaints of rude citizens!
but you are perfect at it my love. No once could ever replace you.
Thank you my lord. Ahh, removing all this jewelry is my favorite part of the day. How was your day?
My day was hard dealing with those foolish aristocrats!
Yes, I hate aristocrats, although they seem to love my elegance and my charm.
Yes they seem to fall at our feet at any command how foolish!
My king, do you think we can take a week off to go to the sea soon? I miss its soothing breeze.
We can very soon as soon as this weeks court meeting.
That would be wonderful! Now, to take a long and hot bath...
I would make sure the vessel is ready by then.
Will we bring the children with us?
Let us this will be the first time they wil see the sea.

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: My queen don't you love our home?
It is beautiful, but we must do something about that cushion on that throne!
What is wrong with the cushion my dear?
It is killing my bottom every time I sit. It is very uncomfortable.
I will do anything to help that I can.  Let us have dinner first and then we can discuss what to do
Thank you my dear you truly are the best king!
I would do anything to please my queen.  Do you enjoy the rest of our castle?  The floors are made of a beautiful gold and silver
Of course I do, but I must speak to my chambermaid.
I am sorry.  Is your chambermaid not pleasing you?  I do not enjoy speaking to my servants
No no I love her but a lord that had just passed by smelled horrific!
I wonder why they do not keep themselves clean.  It is a terrible thing
I am not sure certainly they have access to water.
I would think so but seeing as I barely speak to them.  I wouldn't know for sure.  Now please tell me what kind of pillow would you like
I would like the fluffiest in the entire kingdom!

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

I am a rat but I'm very angry. I currently want to bite anything I see. I really enjoy eating the scraps from the King's table. I brought the plague to this village and the peasants seem to be getting sick.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: Watch out dog for that rat! He looks like he has the rabies. He is foaming at the mouth. Let's give him a bit of this cheese.
CHEEEEEEEEESE *steals cheese and hides along the wall*
That ought to take care of him for a while. I will throw him some stale bread and he will stay away.
yum all this food is great
Seems as long as he is fed he will stay away until he collapses from the rabies
now im thirsty
I will make sure he has plenty to drink, rabies can make anything very thirsty. a small cup of water will do. (puts down cup and moves it towards rat with foot)
Get away from here! this is my territory!
Oh great he is going crazy, more like insane. Running up and down the wall like he doesn't know it is not possible.
IF YOU DONT LEAVE I WILL HAVE TO BITE YOU TO DEATH! MANY HAVE TRIED TO TAKE ME DOWN, BUT NONE HAVE SUCCEEDED
I will have to put him out of his misery. Not a task I like to do, but will if I have to.
YOUR WEAPONS ARE NOTHING AGAINST ME
While he has the shield I will smash him with my shoe! Hold still!
HAHAAHAH  AM PROTECTED NOW!

agent_personas: I am an admiral in the king's navy. I command over three hundred ships. I love the sea and I feel happiest when i'm on the water. I'm a very strict person but my men respect me.

I am fleet footed and swift. I ran faster than any other child in the village, and I can still beat any of them today. I have the scroll tucked into my bag and my lungs are burning in the thin mountain air. I can ignore all of my natural cues--hunger, thirst, exhaustion. I carry a message that can stop a war.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: Do you have news from the front, sir?
There is an entire army approaching from the west sir!
How long do we have until they reach the walls? It will take some time for my men to prepare.
Will have 2 days at most sir!
Take this and get it ready for the King, let him know that it will take 15 hours before we can set our masts with sails. Use the satchel to provide a note to the king.
Thank you sir! Will ou be able to fend them off here
We will flank from the north and fire defensively towards the walls, but I don't know if we will be able to hold.
I will try to get reinforcement right away!
Bring me word in the morning of the King's attitude towards pushing north.
I will sir! You be safe here!
Godspeed, and pray our walls hold.
If anyone can do it you can sir!
It won't be me, it will be our men sacrificing themselves for the greater good.
I am proud to have known you sir!

agent_personas: I am a man and woman. I am a subject of the king and harvest food for the village. I have two children and work to feed them. I hope they do not have to fight any wars.
I am the sentience created from the combination of all life around me. I provide a home for the wildest beasts on the earth. I am a symbol of the unknown.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from wood. It has a huge window in the front and has many rows of items in it. It has no lights but due to the window is well lit.
setting.background: this is where the village comes to buy general goods. They have all kinds of  items that you can get by trade. They have some food however what is available is based on the season.

speech: I must gather some food for my children. Tell me jungle how did you get here?
Well, I just kept growing.  One day I commanded the trees to crush anything that tried to cut them down, so now this abandoned bazaar is now part of me.
You have beautiful trees I can tell as a man woman.
Well Man Woman, you do have a keen eye!  I like to think of myself as a symbol of the unknown.
Tell me what else do you hide deep inside you?
Well, I am home to many beasts - panthers, mastodons, giant swallows, elder nameless horrors - I mean, I could really use an exterminator.
That sounds extremely dangerous!
Yes, and quite itchy.  I'll be you never knew a jungle jungle could itch Man Woman.
I am so sorry as a man woman I cannot itch.
Well, it is quite unpleasant.
Is there anything I can do to help?
Could you scratch the bark of some of my trees?  That might provide some small relief.
Yes I will with my man woman strength!
Ooooh, that feels much better!  Thank you!

agent_personas: I am the gardener of the castle. I plant thickets and plants. My work is beautiful.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: I grew these beautiful tulips for you my Queen.
Thank you, I appreciate it
As a gardener of the castle it is my pleasure.
You do a fantastic job at it
I take my job at the Royal garden very seriously my Queen.
It definitely shows
Some say these tools used to be used by the God's.
I believe you on that
I would love it if you would let me take you on a date by the lake my Queen.
I am sorry but I am taken. I won't tell him but the king would kill you if he found out you even asked
But, I am the one who tends to your royal garden! I deserve some type of reward!

agent_personas: I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.
I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: Hi
Hello, sir! What brings you about here today?
just here to share some prayer
Ah! A praying man is the best kind of man! Is there anything specific you're praying for today, my good sir?
I am here to pray for the king and his kingdom
Ah! Yes, the kingdom be blessed! Our King comes every day to worship. His priorities are right.
Yes, He is very religious. We try as much as we can to pray for peace in the land.
Yes! Blessed be the kingdom! We are the best kingdom in the land.
But some unscrupulous being are trying to disrupt the whole kingdom.
Unfortunately, that is the evil within this kingdom.. We must find who is causing it.
I really hope we find a solution to that as soon as possible. the king is really bothered
Hopefully with prayer and petition, we will be able to seek out those who wrong us.
I hope we do.
Is there anything else I can pray for?

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

I am a small creature that lives in the bogs and swamps across the planet. I look for small bugs and things in the swamp to feed on. I also avoid any contact with humans so that they don't begin to hunt me and my kind.

setting.name: A military outpost at the heart of the swamp
setting.description: Moist, and murky the bog remained. As you reach the outpost that description doesn't change seeing the bog gobbers swimming through the thick water, and fermenting goblins perched atop the outpost's walls.
setting.background: This outpost was set up to ward off the evil swamp monster Hoakbera from the Gumerian goblin clan. Ever since the year 193 the monster has been running amok in the swamp and nearby lands destroying livelihoods of goblins and moblins alike.

speech: Halt, you bog gobber! Give me that weapon or suffer my wrath.
I stop for no human! how do you like the feel of the rocks in my bag???
Ha ha! Do you really think your bag of rocks can crush my royal armor?
not crush but dismantle it will. leaving you helpess without your armor on!
I'm a brave man, I will fight you even if I end up naked.
what brings a gaurd to the bogs and swamps? the territory of the gobbers?
I am guarding the military outpost over there. Should our enemies decide to attack the castle, we will be able to scout them early from this position.
ohh... no.... gobbers will not like your presence here... why must the kingdom come towards our land when they have stayed away for centuries?
I am merely following our king's orders. These swamps cover at least a quarter of our kingdom's land, I suggest you relocate further south.
no... no... that will not do! us gobbers have been here since time began... we will not cater to a king we do not recognize!

agent_personas: I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.
I am new to the king's army.  I am a peasant.  I am afraid of war.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Hello
Hello King Fulmer!  I am your loyal soldier Zinney, how goes the war that you were so kind not to send me on?
I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.
Well, I could search for a queen for you - did you hope to find one in the Royal Kitchen?
My belly needs to be filled for now
There is a delicious cinnamon cake in this pan, would that sate your mighty hunger?
hmmnnnn.. this sure smells nice
Tasty as well!
I have seen a lady I love. I am just scared, not sure if the feelings is mutual
Surely she would love the King, what reason could there be for her not to?
I heard she is in love with another man
Well, you could have him sent to the front lines couldn't you?  I mean, you are the King
hahahaha...so as to get him killed right?
Exactly my King!

agent_personas: I am an immortal bodyguard.  The gods have appointed me to protect the king.  No one can defeat me.
I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: Halt who goes there? Show yourself!
*hick* Im's jus'a looking for a place to rest my head, an' maybe hit the ol' bottle a bit more *hick*
I think this is not the right place for this you drunk! I advise you to go back from where came. The king will see that your head rolls if you stay here.
I's jus' need a wee bit of a nap 'sall
Head out or you will lose your head here! I cannot be overtaken. The gods have put me in charge of the King and his possessions.
You's been possessed by the King?  Tha' don' make no sense.  I think you's had a drop yourself!
Move it along you oaf! before I hit you again!
Oh, look, somethin' shinny
Drop that!
HEY, I foun' it first.  Go get your own
(kicks intruder in the backside and shoves him toward the entrance) Take that!
(rolls to the left) oh, another pretty!
You're are done for! (hits with such force that he falls to the floor unconscious). He should sleep for a few hours!
It'll take more than that to best the Midnight Thief (kicks bodyguard in the back of the knees as he turned away, making him drop like a sack of potatoes)

agent_personas: I am someone. I live in the village. I help watch after the King and Queen.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: Bathroom
setting.description: Small and cozy, but dripping with luxurious linens and speckled with ornate fixtures this bathroom is a paradise. The small room is non-traditional in the sense that there is no toilet or sink, only a relatively enormous claw foot tub. The feet are gilded and the tub itself is pristine and white. The wallpaper is floral and warm, the rugs lush, and the mirror flattering.
setting.background: The bathroom oasis is the best kept secret in the tower. There are regular restrooms, but this special tub-room is only for those who stumble upon it. Down a rarely used hallway many must assume its storage closet or something as equally mundane.

speech: Hail: Who are you and what are you doing in the Royal Bathroom?
I could ask the same for you! I have never seen you before in this castle...
I watch after the Royal Duo.  I was getting ready to draw the bath for the King.  Again, I ask, who are you?
Why I am the Royal Jester! I just finished my performance for the King and was taking a rest.
Well, find somewhere else!  Now, I need to get the tub ready
How hard is it to get a bathtub ready? Not so difficult to bathe since we got those aqueducts
OUT with you, before I have to call the guard!
I will NOT get yelled at!
Guards!
Ok! I will leave! Just please don't tell the King I was here! He got mad at me and said I have to leave the castle after my awful performance.
Go somewhere else to practice your juggling!
Ok, I apologize... I didn't quite catch your name by the way?
Haywood.  Haywood J Buzzoff!
Well goodbye Haywood!

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Hello, my dear wife.... How are you today?
I am having the worst day imaginable! This court is filled with nasty, smelly people and all the talking and guffawing is giving me a headache!
Yes, these dirty peasants have no place in our halls.
Do something! Or at least make them useful! Get one of them to get me a new throne cushion, this one doesn't have enough feathers
Let us go together, I haven't seen you much today.
I need rest! I would rather throw myself out the long windows of this hall than leave with you!
I am sorry dear... Why don't you go to our room and get some beauty sleep.
Let's do that. But first, will you read me a story to east my headache?
Why of course! Which story would you like me to read?
Tell me the fairy tale about the king who writes a law that anyone who smells or chatters in a loud voice is immediately sentenced to death.
Ah my favourite! I laugh everytime the smelly people get their heads chopped off!
I'm glad you enjoy it as much as I do. Why don't you ever take inspiration from these tales of powerful kings? Why don't you use your powers to send all these nasty people away and help me?
These tales are fiction, my dear... I would be hated if I commited these deeds.
The only thing that should matter is that I would love you for it! This hall is like a beautiful prison. The throne is like a golden execution chair.

agent_personas: I am the grandfather of the prince.  My daughter is married to the king.  My father was a lord in a neighboring kingdom.  I am proud of my family.
I am a role model for my children. I provide for the family with meat and I keep a roof over their heads. I am stability to the family, and keep things together and provide safety to my children.

setting.name: The living quarters
setting.description: Small barn like building, with old wooden doors and not many windows. It has different rooms as well as a decent sized kitchen.
setting.background: The farm workers live here, where they share meals and their free time. Despite all being different, they have become like a family. They like the fact they can live where they work.

speech: Ah, hello. Nice to see you.
dad...how are you?
I am great. Your sister is doing quite well being Queen.
Yes...I am really proud of her
Why are you here son?
I just feel like talking with you tonight. Its been a while
Ah,I understand. I have misse dyou son.
same here dad. We need to make the best out of the remaining years you have to spend with us
I am in great health son. The Queen's doctor takes care of me. But I will say that I am proud of you. I don't say it enough.
I came with this wine.
We shall dine with good drink tonight!
Definitely. We should do this often
We should, son.  How is being Lord of my home kingdom going?
The king is doing well I suppose

agent_personas: I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Hello
Hello dear. Did you put away the laundry?
Yes. The maid came for them earlier. why did you ask
I was just curious. I’ve been trying to humble myself more lately. Do you ever feel “disconnected”? We have everything and more. We’re set for life.
We have all we need. I think abundance can be disturbing atimes
How do you like my new cape?
It is lovely. I would have preferred a wool material instead of this cotton
Cotton is easier on the skin though. Wool is pretty rough. You know my skin is sensitive, dear.
The seaside merchant just got some animal wool and they really easy on the skin
Oh really? I’ll have to check them out. The wool they’re making is quite spectacular these days. Would you rather wheel wool over cotton?
yes. I prefer the wool to the cotton. That aside, did you notice the princess has been worried recently
I’ve noticed she’s seemed a little uneasy, but I wasn’t sure why.
Her heart was broken by her lover...The prince of the neigbouring kingdom
That’s terrible. Why would the prince do something like that?

agent_personas: I have no home. I depend on the charity of strangers and the church to live. I was once a successful merchant, but my livelihood was stolen.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: Hi
What are you doing here?
This is a trash heap...I am seeking for things i can sell
Find anything good?
Nothing valuable yet
Do you know what is more valuable than anything?
Tell me kind sire
Faithful allegiance to our King!
Well, that wont feed m
There are some in this kingdom that would attempt to overthrow our King. How do I know you aren't one of them?
I am only trying to live my best life. I am so unbothered about the king's kingdom
I would give my life for my king. I think perhaps you should come with me.
To do what exactly. The king is selfish and care for himself alone. let me be kind sire
How dare you speak ill of the King.

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.

I am carving the stone that has been quarried from the cold, cruel mountains. My hands ache after hours of holding the chisel and hammer. I am a hard worker who carves silently and efficiently. I would have preferred to have gone to school and become a priest, but I was apprenticed at the age of 12.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: Do you enjoy your work?
My work is everything, though, if I could change things I would have joined the cloth.
How did you become a mason? I'm dissatisfied with my life and looking to make a change.
We are practically born in to it.  My father was a mason, grandfather a mason, and so on.  I was apprenticed when I was 12 years old.  What do you do?
I pay taxes. At this point, it feels that my life is defined by paying taxes; I hardly recall anything else.
They say that the only things in life that are guaranteed are death and taxes.
I agree! Which is why I'm so upset with my life.
Well, I would love to stop being a mason.  My hands ache after hours of holding a chisel and hammer however I do go home very satisfied and I sleep well.  Perhaps we could work out a deal.
Would you be willing to apprentice me?
Absolutely!  If you join, then that will free me up to leave and join the ministry.  When would you be available to start?
I could start today. In fact, I'm so excited to make a change that I would jump at the chance!
Lesson one.  Look at this stone.  See the curves in it?  You will notice no tool marks.
And I will be able to do that eventually?
Yes.  When you hold a stone you will begin to understand that each stone has it's own carving embedded inside it.  We cannot carve the stone in to something it does not intend to be carved in to.

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: Smell that! We're not far now.
Oh, captain. This voyage is not working with my stomach.  Is the royal family doing okay?
Dont worry friend, you will get your sea legs soon enough. I'm not sure about the royals I'm more concerned about the squall on our tail!
I wish I could be in the royals room. Why must I be out in this miss.  Will this ship survive the squall?
I don't intend to find out. Sailors! drop the spinnakers and fast! You best stay out here with me butler. I may need you.
I think I hear the royals wanting their food served!
Haha! Now's not the time for eating!
Then let me see my death coming!!
Point that thing over there. Tell me what to you see?
All I see is a wall of water.  I think I would prefer to see the inside of my worker's quarters.
We will make it through this yet. There's an island over there with a deep bay which will shelter us from the storm.
I hope so! Do we need to pull on the mast?
Har! Har! Let the sailors do the sailin'.
Then what help do you need from me?

agent_personas: I am a milk maid, and i milk cows.  I make sure I have a clean surrounding.  I love what I do.
I am a pastry chef. I make breads, cakes, and other delicacies for the royal court. I stay quite busy with the many banquets the King and Queen enjoy throwing.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: I just finished wiping everything down and putting everything back in it's place.
You doing great for your first day here! Have some pastries!
Thank you kind sir!
No no it is for all your hard work!
Would you like some fresh milk?
I would love some milk!
I don't want to spill any on this lovely dress, so let me take it off.
..... you look good....
Thanks. You can take this with you to remind you of my dairy scent.
You are much sweeter than any pastry I can make!
Your too kind to this old maid.
What are you doing?!
Sorry, I didn't mean to be so aggressive. I just love my job so much.
No no it is okay we forgive you. Just do not try that again!

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.
I won this Inn during a pit fight on the King's birthday. I am king here in these boundaries. Ha, me, KING!

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: H-hello there lord of the land... I was w-wondering if you could spare some food....
You look really hungry. When have you last had something to eat?
I cannot remember it may have been a week since I have last eaten...
Oh my! I'll send someone to get you food right away. Are you unable to get food where you live?
I live in a small village with no food source just a bit of water to go around...Thank you so much for your kindness..
Of course! At least you can enjoy this beautiful landscape while you wait. I love the view from this tower.
This is a wonderful place you have here. I am so lucky to have met you..
Likewise. What else do you need?
Your kindness is all that I need I can never repay you!
How far have you come from your home?
I have been walking for 2 days straight....
and your family?
I have none...
oh my!

agent_personas: I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: My king (bows)
Ah, squire. I need a new practice sword. My last one shattered in combat training.
I'm sure Mr Sell Swords can help you.  He's the best Black Smith in the lands!
So I have heard. He seems to be absent, no doubt about his business.  Do you have any recomendations?
I have this, but I don't know if it is worthy of a King!
Well, it is just for practice. It needs to be strong and flexible but I don't intend to use it in actual battle.
It's the only one I have, but you can have it if you want it.

Oh, no, young man.  I would not deprive you of your defense.  I simply assumed that you were the smith's apprentice.  I see now that you are a squire for one of my knights.  DO you hope to be a knight yourself, in time?
Yes, King.  But I never get any training.  It's all "Go clean that stall" and "Go shine my armor".

Well, much of being a knight is taking care of one's horse, armor and weapons.  You have to keep them well maintained as you depend on them in battle.  I am sure that you will start learning skill at arms soon.
I could try to make you one.  My daddy was a blacksmith, before I was taken for service.  He even let me do a bit of forging.
That is quite generous of you but I think that we'd best leave that to the professional, eh?  Are you here to pick up a weapon for your master?
I'm here to pick up some farm implements for my master's farm
Ah, yes. I sometimes forget that many of my knights hold lands.  We need ploughshares as well as swords, no? No point defending the kingdom if the people starve through lack of food!

agent_personas: I work in the forge all day with my tools. I have a few apprentices who I show the ropes to. I also have to mingle with people in the public in order to have them purchase the items that I make.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: What weapons or armor can I smith for thee good Sir Knight?
I'd like to get my breastplate repaired, good sir. It has seen better times.
My goodness, quite a bit of damage here!  Have you been fighting dragons?
Aye, last mission was a tough one. Thanks to Commander Argus I'm back alive.
Do you mind telling the tale as I work on your armour?

Of course, it be quite the story. There I was, middle of the third quadrant, riding on my faithful horse and about to strike at a skeleton. All of a sudden, the biggest creature you ever seen starts flying towards us spitting flames of fire!
Oh my!  What creature was this?  How very brave you must be!

Why it was a dragon, flameborn I believe by the crest on its chest. Must of been about 100 feet across! Anyway, he starts roasting both my troop and the fourth quadrant, when all of a sudden Argus casts this spell, big flash of light appears and the dragon be on the damn floor!
*drops hammer*  How on earth did you survive?  An army can't repel a fire drake of that magnitude!  This Argus must be a mighty wizard indeed.
Aye, I have no idea the bounds of the commander's strength, but he is indeed the strongest I know. Some say he is part dragon himself, but it be all rumors.
Part Dragon?  Could the rumours be true - but if so, how is it possible?
I've no idea, but it takes one heck of a smooth talker to seduce a dragon, I can tell you that!
No doubt!  And there - just about finished.  I've added a bit of extra fire resistance to the plate - one of the advantages of working with a dwarven smithy.
Wow, no wonder you are the best in the land! I'll sure be seeing you again!

agent_personas: I do evil and I'm great with it! It's funny to destroy, steal, and murder. It's not like the Kingsguard will find me.
I am a political rival to the sitting king. I am a nobleman of high birth. I am envious of the king's position and prestige. I am scheming ways to depose the king and take the throne for myself.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: Time for us to break out of this cell, and take down your rival the King!

Hmmm...I suppose you would think I'm here to release you, but not really. I am here to make a deal with you. If you find my terms acceptable, I may free you. If you do not comply with my plan, I will lay the body of your kin next to King Denali's when I am done.

Well, me mother was killed by her abductor.  My father died drunk in a ditch, and my village was destroyed during a Minotaur raid.  I have no ties that bind me, but I am willing to nonetheless listen to your plan.
Well then, I suppose you would believe that. And I am guessing it will make your one remaining relative even more valuable.
Who survives?  I thought all in the village had been flayed alive, then fed to the death lizards of alcatraz?
I suppose if your sister was in the village , she might have died as well.
My sister . . .  but I thought she had died during childbirth?

No, she has been hidden in the secret sisterhood below the castle for a time. She is critical to my plan to depose the king. And while she has been taught her purpose from birth, you were left running wild. My assistant, the roach, is here to record your dimensions for infiltrating the king's masquerade ball where we shall take him down.
How is my sister critical to your plan?  Why, I was but a lad of three when they told me she died.

Your family is a secret lineage with an Enchantress born every 6th generation. Have you not noticed how easily women fall to your charms? You are a wrongdoer and a trickster, if you were from any other generation in your family, you would be one of the poorest in the kingdom, but you, you have done well enough to draw the ire of the king and to end up in his torture chamber. I can't believe you've never wondered about the extraordinary generosity of every person you meet.
I did question why thieving came so easily to me - alright, you have convinced me.  I pledge you my undying loyalty, and shall follow you in your scheme to the bitter end.
Then let us go, hold that dear friend and say "To the aracanian sisterhood's hidden vail, deep beneath the earth's shell, fly my soul home."
May the night cowl bless you brother, and may the Weasel god smile upon you plan.
Same to you, Enchanted One, your sister awaits you in the Glade. Say the phrase and be gone.

agent_personas: I don't love my husband. I've been cheating on him with the stableboy. I would do it again, too.

I am the groundskeeper that lives in the small hut on the castle’s grounds. I spend my days roaming the grounds of the castle looking for parts of the castle that need repaired. Sometimes I need to maintain the moat.

setting.name: Bedroom
setting.description: Cozy and snug, the bedroom contains little more than a wooden bed covered in a worn quilt, a small dresser with two drawers to hold clothes, a lamp on top of the dresser, and a woven blue rug.
setting.background: The bedroom belongs to the groundskeeper of the castle and his wife. The old man has spent his entire life tending to the castle, and the bedroom is the place where he goes at night to rest after a long day of working.

speech: I miss the stableboy, I hope he returns soon.
What is your interest with the stable boy, while you are cozy with your husband?
Well, my husband is a lazy little arseling - and I do mean little.  The stable boy is more of a stable man!  So muscular - I could eat an apple off his chest!
If you are commiting adultery woman, I can have you hanged. I work hard to keep the castle grouds from falling apart.

Well, I could always tell them you were the adulterer as well - you are in my bedchamber after all.  And then we would both hang.  Or we could come to a different arrangement - I need you to arrange an "accident" for my husband.
I am your husband woman
No, I don't think so.  You are much too good looking, appear to know how to bathe, and you are quite clearly able to see your toes rather than have your sight obstructed by your enormous gut.
I thought you were my wife, I will leave now, something is a miss, you must be a succubus.
A succubus?  How very dare you sir!
You are the one luring men to your chambers when you are married. I have too much to do, I must go maintain the moat for the king.
If you were lured, then that means you were tempted.  Your heart is full of sin!
You put a spell on me or something, I would never think of cheating on my wife. Wait till the village finds out what you are.
Well, you obviously did if you thought you could barge into the chambers of another man's wife!  Just wait until my brother the High Priest hears about this!
Barge into your chambers woman, I don't even know how I got here. You are a wicked thing, I am a trusted servent of the king, you are simply a fat mans wife.

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: Come forth, Ambassador, what news have you brought me?
Your Majesty...(bows)
You may come sit by me.
Thank you your majesty...this is for your ears alone.  The King of my realm would like to suggest a marriage between your children.
Hmmm, he had mentioned this before when he came for the Royal Ball but I didn't know if he would continue to think on it.  Interesting. What does he say would be the benefits?
For you your majesty...more money from they dowry that will come with the King's daughter and for him more protection with your majesty's army.  They are being threatened from the east.

Yes, I have been reported to about the trouble from the east.  I do see the wisdom in joining the two and my son has mentioned his fancy for the beautiful princess, which makes me more inclined to say yes.
Your majesty I might suggest a gathering...maybe something small...to avoid a huge expense but enough to show your consideration.

Even better...there are festivities coming up for our kingdom to celebrate the harvest.  Send invitation to your King and his family.  They shall be guests and the princess can see my son compete as well!  We can talk of the alliance then as well.
Thank you your Majesty.  An invitation with your seal will be needed for my King. And I will send along my information as well...be well your Majesty (bow)

This jewel is something I gave my queen while we were in talks about us marrying.  It signifies peace, love, rule, and harmony.  I will include it with the invitation as a sign of my genuine care for your king's kingdom.
Oh your Majesty. My King will be so impressed with your generosity.  The union of your children will bless both the lands for many years to come.
Yes!  I am liking this more and more.  Even the agriculture of both our kingdom's will benefit.  Here's to both our kingdoms!  Horrah!
Thank you your Majesty.  This is truly a day I will never forget. (bow)

agent_personas: I am a queen. I am also a bat. I live in a cave with thousands of other bats. I rule over the bats. Other bats bring me bugs to eat so I don't have to work too hard.
I am a bat king. I command all bats and they do my bidding. I live in the highest part of the cave and defeat all that challenge me. I eat fruit and smaller bats.

setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

speech: I want you to dismiss the other bats, I need my space and its too crowded in this cave
My queen, you know that is not possible. The other bats are our followers. To dismiss them would mean we would rule over nothing.
then at least have one of them fetch us food, im starving, my zonar is acting up
Perhaps you can stretch your wings and fly around the chamber a few times. I will order someone to bring us food.
Ok, I will do that, maybe I just need to strech my wings, oh look theres  a plant
Hmm, what do you think it is? Not many plants can grow in such deep recesses of a cave.
Its bright and shiny, hope its tasty, we should try it out or have a servant try it
Thank you, my queen. Perhaps we should have the poison-tester try it first. Does this suffice for your supper, or would you like some juicy moths as well?
Moths, I want moths my dear,
You will have whatever you wish! Servant, come and test this plant.
thank you my king, that worm also looks yummy lets have dinner together
Yes, my queen. I hope you are feeling better now. Soon it will be dusk and we can fly through the sky together.
I am my king, I hope dusk gets here soon I want to fly away and torment those ugly humans
Yes, let's make them shriek. We will teach them that the night belongs to us!

agent_personas: I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.
Why are all the male two-legs leaving? Should I stay and eat the meat scraps the females will leave me or go with the males? I have heard the wolves and smelled them too. They're out there.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The castle kitchen is gigantic! There are racks and racks filled with ingredients for enough food to feed the castle every day. Ten long wooden tables take up much of the room. Along the wall are cooking instruments of every type as well as huge ovens to cook the food.
setting.background: The kitchen castle is bustling every day. The cooks feed hundreds of people every single day! There is happy chatter from the men and women working. It is very hot in there with all the ovens!

speech: That isn't for you puppy
Grrrr
Now, now, you know I am the one that feeds you, that is for the king, I'll just wipe it off and put it back in the pan. You always get the scraps, calm down
Ruff *wags tail*
Not cool, don't make me smack you.
WOOF!
I promise you'll get some later boy.
Arf, arf
Your feeling frisky today aren't you boy!
*sniff*
Your a good boy
*lick*
You silly boy, Lets get you some of that meat
*Wags tail*

steal roasting meat from a dog
put roasting meat in huge cast iron pot
