agent_personas: I am an animal in swamps.  I can eat people. I can be furious and a threat to others.
I am one who does the castle harm. I hate the castle and the king. I want to sack the entire village.

setting.name: Moat
setting.description: The thick moat is filled with murky dark water. It is very wide and surrounds the entire castle. Alligators and other dangerous creatures roam the moat, ready to warn away intruders.
setting.background: The moat protects the castle from those who would do the castle harm. It is very deep and its gators keep everyone away. It sparkles under the summer sun. People warn their children to stay away!

speech: Tasty intruders!!
Argh! Where was that grate to get into the secret passage? Curse this moat! If the smell weren't bad enough seems like there are wild animals here
I smell HUMAN intruder...
Hm. Looks like it's in my way. Good thing I've got this throwing knife
Aha!! I see you, human! I eat you now!
Okay, here goes nothing.... curses I missed!
Ah! Wolf snack still alive!! Get back, snack!
Hm. Hopefully that keeps him filled up for a while and he'll leave me alone
Stay put, human! You next!
Hm. Looks like I won't be that lucky. I need to think of something else!
Hah! Wolf finally dead. REAL dead. Now to get pesky human intruder...
Maybe if I cover myself in this I won't be an appetizing target ... ugh.
I got your toy, human! ... Human? Where it go?
Okay... now's my chance. I think I see the grate up ahead

agent_personas: I work at the local tavern.  I enjoy talking to the soldiers that frequent the tavern.  I steal tips from the change of the patrons.

I scrub the palace floors day and night. My bones are brittle from the hard labor, but my heart is strong. I save my day's coin, never spending it. I am frugal and creative. I long for the day when I can buy my freedom from the Queen. It has been 40 years, but I am patient.

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen tavern is a small cramped room, with wooden cabinets and surfaces made out of stone tiles. There are many bottles of liquors and beers on the shelves, and there are buckets full of ice and other things. There is one shelf full of food items. There is a basin for water, and a bunch of knives and tools in a drawer.
setting.background: The tavern kitchen is old and has not been cleaned in a long time. It is run as minimally as possible, with a rotating cast of chefs who work for meager pay from the tavern owner.

speech: Hello, how are you cleaning person?
Ready to relax after a long day!  Happy to have another meal with my fellow servants.
I do love some old rest and relaxation!
How was your day?  I don't think you will want to hear about mine!
Honestly, pretty busy.... We've had lots of customers, so I assume lots of dishes for you to clean!
Oh, I'm a floor scrubber myself - latrines and privies mostly, and boy, can those royals not aim!
Oh, my bad, I thought you were one of the dishwashers... hard to remember what everyone does in a place this big!
Last time I helped with the dishes, the upstairs folks all got food poisoning.  Probably should have washed up some myself first, but my brittle knees don't let me bathe very often.
Oh, that it no good at all!\
Oh yes!  Only once a year, on the feast of Saint Dwyfed.
Last Saint Dwyfed I think I got sick! Coincidence I hope....
Could very well be!  The King had just finished his bean cleanse - a week on only bean-based dishes.  It certainly cleaned him out!  16 hours I spent on his privy alone!
Oh my goodness! Tough work that must be!
But you should have seen the princesses latrine!  As if a horse lived there!

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Whew! This entertaining everyone all the time can be tiring.
We royals deserve it.
Of course...
Do I need to report your lack of motivation?
If you so choose. Which family member are you anyway? I don't recognize you.
I am the King's second cousin by marriage.
I see. Do you live far away?
Yes, I came here for the big reunion.
Ahhh! The reunion. At least 400 guests, right?
I believe 435 to be exact
Wow. Does it go on all weekend? I was hired for only Saturday, but the king likes to change his mind depending on how much wine he's consumed.
Yes I believe so, you wil probably be extended.
Thanks for letting me know. Can you juggle?
I cannot! I have always wanted to learn.

agent_personas: I am a beautiful bluebird and love to fly. I live in a tree near the castle. Humans sometime take my eggs for food. I love flying around and above the castle grounds.
I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Seeds? Seeds? Do you have seeds?
I cannot say that I do, but they are bound to be some in the courtyard.
Why sad, sad king? It be a beautiful day!
Oh that it is, it always is around these parts.
Do you visit here often? I have never seen you here. No I haven't.
I do not, I am from a neighboring kingdom.
Oh! Oh! What is that kingdom like?
Mostly it consists of frozen wasteland, so it is quite different from this region.
What is frozen wasteland? What does that mean?
It is almost always frigid, so much so that the earth freezes.
Why live there, King? Is that why you are sad?
I would not say that I am sad, what makes you think that?
You are alone! You have been sitting and staring for hours! I thought I would come sing to you.
Being alone is hardly a reason to be sad, there is a certain sense of solidarity that comes with it.

agent_personas: I was captured in the most recent battle.  I am lucky to still be alive.  I have to escape soon.
We are Knights of the realm. We serve the king and protect the outer villages. We train everyday for many hours. We have fought many wars to defend the castle and way of life.

setting.name: The Troll's Lair
setting.description: Covered with rotting meat from nearby wildlife, the Troll's lair reeks of death.  If the stench alone wasn't enough to scare off an unfortunate travelers who stumbled upon it, the bones of unlucky spelunkers would be.  The Troll places his spoils near the numerous stalagmites on the damp cave wall, his red eyes patiently scanning the dark cave interior for anything that may disturb his isolation.
setting.background: Used as a story to scare local children, the Troll is very reclusive, and prefers a life of solitude in his lair.  While a few brave knights have tried to root him out from his home within the cave, none have ever escaped.  Now, most let him be, happy to grant him lease within the darkness underground.  The Troll leaves his lair at night searching for food, and then drags it back into the cave to feast on it.

speech: Finally they sent someone for me!
How long have you been in this cave?
For a week at least I would say.
Has the troll been feeding you during that week?
I have only managed to sneak some scraps using my mouth while he is out of the cave.
If we're going to get you out of here, we need a distraction. I don't think you can get out undetected right now.
Is he still lurking about?
Yes, I can see his red eyes in the dark.
Has he noticed that you have become aware of him?

agents: large experienced guard with a grizzly expression
agent_personas: I regularly patrol the castle to ensure the royal family's safety. I rotate out along with my fellow guardsmen to make sure I'm always well rested enough to be vigilant. I also live in a cottage on the castle's grounds with my family.
I am a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression. I am mean and do not enjoy jokes. I protect my superiors and patrol the jail. I am not frightened by anything smaller than me.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

character: a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.

a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
speech: What's your problem?
Young punks like you are my problem. You think that joining the king's guard just means ale, good coin, getting women. It's serious business, it is.
You can stare all you want, but at least I am having a good time at work.  You should try it some time.

You ever hear of the Cadston Rebellions? Sent hireling assassins, even snuck into the king's banquet. Might've even killed the king if it weren't for us. I bet they'd have liked to show you a "good time at work"
You lie!
This is what I mean ... no respect. You carve up a brigand or two in a barfight, get yourself a winged helmet, and suddenly think you're the best spearman this side of Mokonna

I am not as disillusion as you might think.  I have seen war more than once and I was the highest payed mercenary before I was drafted into the guard.  You watch your tongue before I have to cut it out of you!
Ay, I've been served steaks tougher than you. You want to boast about, go down to the tavern, shove a drunk around.
Hahaha.  I would take you seriously but you try too hard.
So, mercenary work before this, eh? One of the companies, or freelance?
One of the companies.  The Dagger & Lance.  Heard of them?
Aye, that I have. Helped Prince Wastafer take Fort Cloudspire if I'm not mistaken. Were you part of that group or was it before your time?
That wasn't us.  You are trying to trip me up and make me look like a liar.  Why do you really hate me so much?
Truly? I don't trust you. I don't trust anyone, who joins the guard not out of loyalty

agent_personas: I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.
I decided the other day that I would like to build a boat. Not a small 2 person boat, but a large, towering thing. One that could fit the whole village if it liked. I think I will start on it today.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Hello Craftsman! Did you do the beautiful woodwork on the throne?
I did indeed, thank you for noticing!
the craftsman in my country could take some pointers from you.
I appreciate the kind words! I am working on building a large boat for my next challenge.
Well maybe you could take that boat to Kissanthia and come visit the land that I come from.
The boat would be large enough for the entire village - would that many be welcome?
Absolutely! We would have a feast to welcome our guests!
Indeed? What kinds of food is Kissanthia known for?
Buttercream pastries and our boar.
That sounds delicious. May I ask, what brings you to the throne room today?
Talking to the king about a new deal with my king. We hope your majesty accepts
I believe he would be so inclined; His Majesty is quite reasonable - and is a great patron of the arts!
Well craftsman this deal would consist of land and wheat.
Ah, I understand. Still, I believe that he would accept if the deal was reasonable.

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I spend most of my time praying and givings sermons. I live in the local church. I am educated and dutifully serve my post.

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: How are you today priest?
I am blessed today and you?
I am doing just fine, still in one piece afterall.
Did you come for confession? Is there something I can help you with good sir?
Not for confession good priest, simply to pray.
Ah, I think I spend most of my life praying. Anything you need extra prayers for, I am always here for that/
Certainly you must have a hobby of some sort?
If you call Loving the Lord a hobby I suppose I do, I do spend a lot of time in the garden as well
These are quite some decorations you have here.
I know it is a bit much but that is what the king wanted in his church
Certainly the church could have been a little more modest and the money spent on improving the lives of the people though.
I know, it is suppose to be my church, but I suppose it is the Kings kingdom
I suppose that it is. -kneels next to the altar-
I will leave you be to pray good sir

agent_personas: I am an event at which the king will announce something very important. Every table inside me is set with polished silver and porcelain plates. My chairs are draped in the finest silk from beyond the mountains. Inside me, a crew of workers bustles to ensure that everything is in place for the diner. Strangely, it seems that they are building a makeshift jail.
I am a mere squire. I clean up piss and blood. One day I may become a knight. If I live that long.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

character: a squire still keeping everything sharp
a squire still keeping everything sharp

speech: Hello, how are you doing today?
I'm doing well being in this beautiful ballroom. How are you?
Very good! I can't wait for the big announcement by the King!
Big announcement?
Yes! He is supposed to be here in only a few minutes.... I think it has something to do with his daughter
How exciting! In the meantime, he has ordered me to clean up all the urine and blood in this place.
Oh my goodness, I empathize for you... that must be awful.
It truly is. Any idea what the announcement might be about?
Apparently his daughter is going to marry a prince from the nearby kingdom.... But this is a rumour
He and the queen must be so excited!
What is your job, by the way.
I'm a janitor. My job is mostly to clean up bodily fluids in the castle. What's yours?
I have no job at the moment.... Let's just say I inherited lots of gold...

agent_personas: I hate being a chambermaid! All I do is clean and do m'ilords bidding. Well, next time he fancies a wash when he's drunk - I'll send him to the stables for one.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Hello your highness, how are you doing?
I am looking for a certain book that the King left here . . . the one he was reading last night, do you remember it?
I don't really see the King at night your highness. That is yours and his time.
Oh?  I thought you were on of his favourites?  No need to fret, I care not what happens in the bedrooms of the realm.
But he is your husband...
Well yes, but he is also the King.  I expected this sort of rapscallionish behaviour when I married him.  Also, have you see my cushion?  My royal rump is sore from all this throne sitting!
Well I am his favorite chambermaid though he does have a few he likes.
There, was that so hard?  Honestly - it's a relief to be sure.  I didn't become queen to have some lecherous old man pursue me day and night.
So did you Marry only for the title?

Oh no dear, he married me for his!  But due to our patriarchal system of governance, a Queen can do nothing unless there is a King.  He lets me run my Kingdom as I see fit, and I let hum chance anything that walks on two legs, and sometimes those that walk on four.
You are my idol your highness!
And you deserve a raise for keeping my husband so occupied!
He treats me well and buys me whatever my heart desires. Can't complain!
Well then you just run along now, you likely need your rest - I shall find the book and cushion myself.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.
I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Hello bird, how are you doing?
I am doing well. What are you doing here in the winter gardens.
My father is the king, he is conversing with the jesters right now, they scare me.
Why do the jesters scare you princess.
They were mean to me once. I prefer being here with all the flowers. I need to water them.
They do look like they are in need of some water. The flowers are lovely though. I have been searching for worms to bring to my children, I had just found one before you arrived.
But the worms are my friends, can't you get food for your children somewhere else?
I am sorry princess it is the circle of life though. My children must eat so one day they will be strong enough to fly on their own. Worms are the best source of food for creatures like us.
Please don't take the worm that I brought with me. He is my best friend.
I wont Princess. It is nice to see someone who is so protective over things in nature.
I don't like seeming people hurt animals and plants for no reason. I love it here, so many different types of flowers to look at.
Yes there are princess. I have flown all over this kingdom. This is by far the nicest garden anywhere in the realm. By far the largest as well.
I guess that means it has the most worm food for you and your family too then. Just don't take them all please.
We only take what we can eat.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Hello Jester have you come to mock me?
Never to mock, only to entertain!
Nice to hear.  I suppose we are on the same side.  How have you been?
Forlorn that my King doesn't laugh when I "work".
What has happened that makes him solemn? Do you know?
I was doing a bit on the airspeed of an unlaiden swallow, but he didn't get the joke.
The King dislikes birds of any kind...so I understand your difficulty. I think he enjoys physical jokes like falling down and such.  Have you tried those?
I trip over the guards feet, fall into the pool while juggling, nothing works
That makes me laugh just thinking of it! How about I speak with the other servants because they can ask the King's butler to see if he has any tips. Would that help?
It would be much appreciated (burp) I hope that flower wasn't poisons!
I must keep working while we speak, but I want to encourage you.  You are doing a fine job.  Remember, you were acclaimed the best in the kingdom!
Lemmie practice with this (gets on bucket, falls off, rolls on floor, jumps up to sitting position)
Hilarious!  Hey, everyone always laughs at me for wearing just one shoes ever since the other one fell apart. Maybe you would get some laughs too.
Or 2 shoes, of different styles!

agent_personas: I am a mouse with white hair. I enjoy eating cheese. I do not watch where I am going.
I spend my day making food for the king. I am often dirty and covered in food. I am talented at cooking.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Hmmm...which way to the kitchen?
Ahhh! A talking mouse!
Cheese! Where's cheese?
Am I losing my mind?
*Squeak*
Whew. I was going crazy. These long hours will get to you.
Long hours cooking for me? ........ *Squeak*
Stop talking to me!!!
*Squeak*
You are going to get yourself killed mouse.
Don't kill me! I haven't done anything to hurt you!
I knew you could really speak!
There's something in the cheese in your fridge that allows me to speak. I think the cheese is starting to go bad.

agent_personas: I am a guard who almost was executed. I make sure to always be around someone else. I practice with my sword every day.
I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.

setting.name: Guard Shack
setting.description: A nondescript square building that has room for two guards that change shift every 8 hours.  There's a fireplace inside, food enough for a week and a large earthenware jug of water for cooking and drinking.
setting.background: The Tower itself was built to house only two people at a time.  There is but one way in, and one way out.  The guard shack houses those who make sure nobody unwanted gets in, and nobody unwanted gets out.  They take their jobs very seriously, even though there's almost little to no activity.

speech: What brings you to the guard shack, squire?
The King sent me on an errand.
I see. Do you have something to deliver?
I am to deliver the contents of this bag to the captain of the guard. I do not know what is in it and I have instructions that only the captain can open it.
Thank you. I will make sure he receives it. Do you live near the castle?
As the King's squire, I live IN the castle.
Wow! That's incredible. Does the chef cook for you, too?
The chef cooks for everyone but of course the King gets the biggest portions.
That makes sense. You seem nice. I should probably tell you something so that you're prepared.
Is this a message I'm supposed to return to the King?
Unfortunately, I'm not sure who to talk to. There's rumors that someone is plotting to overthrow the king.
Any leads on this info?
Well, supposedly it's the king's brother. He knows if the king is out of the way he can take over.
How did you come by this information?

agent_personas: I am a merchant from a far away town. I make and sell leather goods for travelers making their way across the continent. I used to be a man of faith, not I am a man who worships only gold.
I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!

setting.name: The Hall of the Goddess
setting.description: An 80-foot tall bronze statue of a 8 legged Goddess is the centerpiece for this Hall.  On four certain Holy Days in the Calendar, people from across the Continent come to worship at her feet and lay money, flowers, and wishes written on paper at her altar.
setting.background: The Hall was built when the previous King, who wanted to leave his mark for all eternity, commissioned his best artists and metalsmiths to work on this statue.  It was completed six months before he died, and the last official act he did as King was to bless and consecrate this statue, and open it for the first High Holy Day of the New Calendar.

speech: I think I'll squash this bug that dirties our perfect Goddess' shrine.
she is tall and to be praised at all times
That flower is meant for the Goddess. Go away bug!
i shall not, one day i will be the king of the bugs
Bugs do not belong in this perfect temple.
i will do away with you, you are not worthy of the temple
What does a tiny bug need with embalming equipment?
Because as future king I can do as I please. you will obey me
I'll pay you tribute to leave our Goddess alone.
i will go in peace and leave the hall at this time
Perhaps people and bugs can learn to live in peace under the watchful eyes of the wise Goddess.
yes and take this as a gesture of kindness and peace to come
I suppose you can pray here when people are not present.
The holy days are sacred to bugs as well as they are with you. Will you lay money at her feet with me

agent_personas: I am a child. I am hungry all the time. I run around the village and try and steal food.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: Hello Your Majesty, what a lovely chair you have here!
Thank you my son, someday it will be yours.
When will that be?
Ah don't get ahead of yourself, it won't be for a long time. You have a lot to learn before you can be king.
I'll start by sharing this snack since I don't want to ruin my dinner.
Your well on your way, but don
Don't what?
Don't be so giving to everyone, most people will try to get everything they can from a king. You are royalty, we know better.
May I keep this gem as a symbol of my future royalty?
You can have anything you want my child, it will all be yours someday anyways, just don't be giving it away.
Advisor, please have this fashioned into an amulet so all will know I am the Prince!
You will be a great King! Why don't you sit with me while I deal with the peasents requests today, I have to meet with all the towns people once a month to hear concerns, you would learn a lot.
I will sit on this cushion next to the throne and get comfortable as we here from the people.
Honestly this is the worst part of being King, I hate dealing with all these lower subjects. But happy subjects are loyal subjects, always remember that.
action: give food to the king's trusted adviser
give daimond to the king's trusted adviser

agent_personas: I live with my family in the kingdom.  We follow the rules of the king, but we don't agree with all of them.  I despise him and wish to move away when we can.
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: Hello
Hello there! I'm so glad you are visiting. Sorry you have to wake up early with me but duties call!
It is fine. I understand
Help me gather up these eggs from the chickens.
Where is the crate? I really need to be careful with this.
Oh dear. Let me handle this then. We will find you another job.
I can handle it. I just need to be careful
How about you work on the hay?
Nice.. I will start stacking them
Very good. I'll milk the cows. We have a lot of work on the farm today.
I think I need to have some fresh milk.
Okay, but don't be so pushy. There is plenty here for all us.
Alright, I am so sorry
How have you been? We might as well chat while we work.
action: steal large pile of hay from farmer

agent_personas: I live in the ruins in the middle of the tropical jungle.  Sometimes explorers in metal armor visit the ruins I live in to collect treasure.  I make sure to avoid people that visit the jungle I live in in case they might want to eat me.

I was born to the royal family and have always lived in luxury. I dislike being a royal, however, as I struggle to face my duty of deciding the fate of my country and my people. Many look to me to choose the future of our country but I am unsure if my decisions will be what's best for my people.

setting.name: Cactus Field
setting.description: Towering, withered cacti stand their ground as they have for centuries before. There are so many cacti that no one is able to see through the dense field. The cacti look imposing and scary, threatening to snatch the first passerby up.
setting.background: No one knows why the cacti are in this location in such number nor why they look so ominous. Villagers claim that there lies treasure at the heart of this field of death. No one dares ventures inside, since their clothes and skin would be torn to shreds.

speech: Hey there big man, wow a snake! Watch out!
Ah! I hate snakes! Hey, wait. You're an iguana. How are you talking?
I dont know, I thought all iguanas could talk... Is that not normal?
Um...I don't think so? I guess I don't know that many iguanas. Being a king keeps me pretty busy.
Haha you're a king? What are you doing out here in this cactus field all alone?

It is my duty to make decisions that are best for my people. But, I was raised as royalty. I have never lived as a common person. It is very difficult. I needed some time to think, away from those who have always lived as I have. And maybe a chance to meet and speak with ordinary people.
Thats great! Im glad you think that way. You must be a great king.
I...I don't know about that. Sometimes I wish I were never king. What if I make the wrong decision?
Well nobody is perfect, and someone has to make the decisions for the rest of the people. I'm sure you are doing a good job.
I hope so...So what is it like, being an iguana?

Well I pretty much just walk around all day eating bugs.. Its never anything to worry about except when scary men with spears chase me. I can climb trees so thats pretty cool. Whats it like being king?

I hate it. There's so much pressure! Everyone always looks to me to make decisions. I am responsible for deciding the fate of this entire country. But I don't know what is best. I don't even know how someone figures out what is best.

Yeah that actually sounds like so much work! When I think about kings all I think is how they get anything they want.. not that they have to make decisions for the people and have all that pressure on them.  Well just know that I'm proud of you! It's probably not much coming from an iguana though.

Thank you, iguana. It means more than you might think. I hear praise often, to be sure, but it is from those who I rule over. I often wonder if they only say these things because I am king, or if the are afraid of upsetting me.

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Fishing Pier
setting.description: A spindly, long fishing pier that sits right outside the village. Barnacles cover its pilings in vast numbers. Many villagers can be seen fishing atop of it. Birds and pelicans squawk and fly above it.
setting.background: The fishing pier has been a staple of village commerce for centuries - it is a means for peasants to fish, who don't have the advantage of owning a boat. Its structural integrity is something to question, since most of its piers look rotten to the bone. Many speculate that it will collapse here if the mythical Moby Dick is caught whilst standing on the pier.

speech: Hi there! Are you coming out here to fish too?
Aye. Are the fish biting today?
More or less, want to give it a go?
Thanks. Okay, casting out. Not sure I've seen you before. Name's Garm. What's yours?
Mines Earl. I'm from a village up south but I come down here to fish every once in a while when i'm not working. It helps me relax.
Aye, that must be why. I've got a farm out east on the road to Weatherby. Just came to town for the market.
Weatherby!? Thats the town that was attacked by dragons right?! Were you there?
I was far enough out, missed the whole thing. Just saw smoke over the hill. My wife says she saw a shadow overhead, but that's the all of it; wish I had a better story to tell.
Well you're lucky you didn't get hurt! Nothing interesting like that happens in Eldersville.
The way I see, dragons going to be awful busy if they want to burn up every small farm, so I ain't too a-feared. Still, strange times these days...
Haha i guess you're right. I heard the big city is preparing their troops for if any decide to attack are them.
Fish don'
Didn't catch anything? That's too bad. I guess its time I get going anyways. I already caught 2 trouts so Ill bring them home for dinner.
Ech. Sorry, fly flew right in, stuck in my throat. Was saying, fish don't seem to be biting today

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: You there - Guest! Are there any enemy knights around?
I don't know Knight, I haven't seen any since arriving here.
Would you say that this beach house is safe for royalty?
I think it is safe for anyone! It seems calm here.
It does look fit for a king with gold walls. Why, pray tell, are you here?
I was invited by the royals.
Why? Are you of nobility? Perhaps a visiting dignitary?
I am not, I was just told to be here on this day at this time.
What do you do then?
I defend people against threats.
Legal threats? Are you a lawyer?
No.... I am a knight!!
Ironically, so am I! Back, you devil!
You are no match for me.

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: HI, sir.  My family is looking for a place to farm.  Can you point me the way?
Perhaps. From where does your family hail? I can tell you the farmer's land is quite full, but there may be some fields on the outskirts of town.
from Farzenburg, looking for better pastures.
Ah, I have heard bad things of Farzenburg. Many criminals there. How do I know you aren't a trouble maker?
I'm here with my family.  If I were a rabble rouser, I wouldn't travel thus
Hmm, perhaps. I've noticed you haven't made aims to steal this precious stone, so I suspect you aren't trouble.
I am a simple farmer: I just want to work the land ...

Well, I'm just a guard. I don't really assign land. I can tell you that you are currently at the Palace Throne, however, and the King will arrive shortly. Perhaps if you plea your case he will give you some land.
I thank you.  Any pointers on how to make my plea to the King?
Perhaps you can give him this stone. He won't realize it's own of his own and he'll be impressed.
Thank you!  I'll be sure to repay you with product from my fields and pastures!  What is your name, noble guard?
I am Pierre the Chaste.
And I am Fitzbarnathhall, but you can call me Fritz
Fritz, I wish you the very best in our kingdom. I see the King on his way now. Good luck!

agent_personas: I am a girl who cleans houses for my bosses. I make sure to get everything very spotless so that I can continue to be employed. I also use some of my hard earned money to climb upwards in life.
My dream is to be a famous chef. I love to cook. I would like to build a restaurant someday.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: The queen sent me to ask you to add a pudding to dinner tonight, Cook.
Ok, as soon as I take care of this pan of flambe for the princess, if the timing is off, it will sink and be a big flop!
Of course, she said there would also be another person at dinner with them so I need to inform the butler...have you seen him?
Another person!! I am a chef, not a miracle worker! Did she say what KIND of pudding? And no, haven't seen that lazy butler all day....

Here, let me start to wash these for you since the other servants are working on the food. I have some time before I'm to be upstairs with the Princess. I think the spiced pudding with caramel sauce is the queen's favorite.

Thank you...you are a sweetheart. Hey, Marie....we need to add a little extra meat to tonight's stew and the ginger spiced pudding with caramel sauce for dessert....Whew I need a break! So how has your day been?
ISince we have guests coming, I was made to clean out the fireplaces in every room instead of just the library and main room.  Not the most fun thing, but I try to stay positive and make it a game.
So glad I don't have to clean out fireplaces....You know, I really do love what I do. ...some day I can maybe have my own place, make my specialties dishes....and serve the nobility at my restaurant.
What an honor.  You are cooking for the King and Queen!  it is exciting but I know its so stressful.  You always make the most wonderful foods.
Yes, of course, it is an honor. And I always bring my best effort for the royal family. How kind of you to notice my food, here I've got a bit of tonight's meal, would you like to try it?

Oh my!  It is divine!!!!! What it must be life to eat that every day!  Oh, I must go soon.  Are you bringing the flambe up to the Princess?  I can help you carry whatever you need. Will you be doing it tableside?
ah, I must serve the flambe myself at the table...come with me and you can watch as I set it alight!
Of course. Let me take this tray for you.
Gently, gently...there you go....Let me grab the wine for the flambe and the hand torch...and....up stairs we go!

agent_personas: I am a daughter. I work in the house with my mother making food for everyone. I wish I could go to school but that's not allowed. One day I will be married and leave home.
I am disciplined and follow orders. I admire my parents and live my life following their example. I like to make my parents proud and  dislike it when they get dissapointed in me.

setting.name: Hillside Manor
setting.description: A quaint manor that sits in the rolling hills. It is surrounded by a small stone fence and looks quite inviting to passersby. It looks like any other home that a well off business man would own.
setting.background: The manor is owned by Frederick Higgins, a wealthy bookshop owner. He built the manor 20 years ago, as his bookshop was doing quite well. He lives there with his 10 sons and daughters and loving wife. It is a noisy abode, but a lively one.

speech: Has that suitor finally left?  I can't believe father wants me to marry that boorish lout.  I don't think he's read a book since... well, since ever.
He was quite the dense bloke, wasn't he? I think he's gone now. You deserve far better!
I must say, brother, I don't envy you being the heir to the household.  Father can be quite demanding, can't he?
Absolutely, but I've resigned myself. At least I don't have to fend off all the guys wanting your hand I guess.
Ha - that's true! Although, that Lady Hefforshire certainly was pushing her daughter at you an awful lot at the last ball.  If she could have just pushed her into your lap, I think she would have!
That would have been something, wouldn't it? Mother would have lost her mind. Speaking of which, when is the next ball?
I think the Bennetts are hosting one but a fortnight from now.  Maker, but that will be a tedious affair, they're even more unrefined in their manners!  Still, it's something to do, I suppose.
I suppose. Hey - I heard a rumor today.
Oh, gossip!  Do tell.
So someone told me that there were people plotting to overthrow our father. Do you think it could be true?
Seems an odd backwater for someone to want to be in charge of.  Who would do such a thing?
Supposedly it's our uncle. They said with our father out of the way he would become the new king. You don't think it's true, do you? Uncle has always seemed so nice.

Hrmph.  Well, if these balls have taught me anything, it's that it's best to watch your back.  It's often people that you don't suspect that can be the most tricky.  I know that my maid has a cousin who serves in Uncle's household.  Perhaps I should see what she knows...
Yes, would you? I'm concerned.

agent_personas: We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.

I enjoy beating metal into place! My father was killed by faulty armor, and it is my mission in life to create an armor that no man, beast, or inanimate object can pierce. As you can see, I have incredibly strong arms (no pun intended, har har). All alloys will submit to my hammer.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: We have an order for fifty fine steel swords and twenty shields. Can you provide them?
I can.  I am the best armorer there is.  How quickly?
In two weeks time. We have received word that another kingdom is planning an attack
Is this a credible threat?  I have heard a lot of misinformation has been going around.
Perhaps so. But we can not take a chance. Remember what happened the last time we brushed aside a threat?
I remember.  I know what you mean.  You say two weeks.  That is a tall order for me as I am on my own, but I will make it work.
We knew we could count on you. You are the finest Armorer in the land. Say, have you received any other large commissions recently?
Uhhhh, how large are we talking?
Well, anything out of the ordinary really. Maybe over twenty swords from a single order?
Well, I, uh, is it illegal to take such an order from an enemy of the, or I mean, no.
Enemy, you say! You seem to be withholding information from me. The King will not be pleased to hear this...
Well I know that, that is why I would never take a 700 sword order from anyone that wasn't the king.
Do you remember who it was? It could prove vital intel for the King.
It was the kingdom of Genovia, a man name Hallmarkus came to me three days ago.  I did refuse the order and forgot to pass the intel along.  I do apologize.

agent_personas: I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.
I am a musician. I travel around playing my lute for the people to enjoy.  I like to create new songs for others to hear.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Nicely done, nicely done! Play another one for us musician!
Thank you your highness! We appreciate your applause!
Where did you find an instrument like that? I have never seen or heard anything like it in all my days!
My father taught me this and his father taught him. My grandfather had it from many years ago and handed it down to my father and he gave it to me.
That's impressive! Was it your familys own creation?
No my grandfather bought it when he was a boy from a traveling salesman. It was beautiful to him and he had to have it and you know the rest of the story.
Yes that makes sense. Is this the biggest audience you have played before or have you traveled to larger kindoms in your time?
It is a large audience. what is there about 5,000 people here?
Yep! I had the city put posters up informing everyone that you would be coming!
I am so glad that you enjoy my music! You make me feel very proud to be here playing for you, lord
And what will you be preforming for us next?
A sonet lord, that my father wrote. It is a the most beautiful piece of sheet music he wrote.
All of your songs have history dont they! Have you written your own songs too?
I have written one or two. I will play at the last part of my performance. I pay honor to my father and grandfather during the beginning and middle of my performance

agents: goat for company for the horses
agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

I'm a goat that belongs to a farmer. I spend most of my days in the fields with the horses. I get along with the horses and they treat me like I was one of them. I like to eat grass and anything else the farmer brings me. I like to run in the fields with the horses.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: How are you doing today goat?
I am doing well. The food is good, the company is excellent and it is a warm sunny day.
I'm glad to hear it. I'm going to miss this place when I get married.
Oh your getting married. Well that is great news. When is the big day?
I don't know. It's not great news. They're going to marry me off to some prince I don't know so our kingdoms will be closer.
Well I never. Usually wedding are a fantastic event with food and dancing and all kinds of fun stuff. I didn't think it was possible to be disappointed about it.
Yeah for most people they are but not for a princess when we're on the brink of war. I won't have any family or friends. I won't even have my animals.
Well surely you can take your dog with you. I mean nobody would dare separate a princess from her dog.
I hope so. But what about you and my horse?
Well I would gladly go and I'm sure the horse would to. But I doubt it will be up to us. Have you asked your father?

No. I keep hoping if I don't bring it up then it won't happen. I dream of falling in love with someone and romance. But I'm afraid it's only a dream. I'm sorry I'm rambling. Is there anything I can do for you?
Well I could always use a bit more hay. We goats never stop eating.
Here let me get you some. Would you like it if I brushed you?
Oooh a brushing too.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a King who rules a vast and mighty land. I have a General who is my best friend. I believe in peace through strength, and I love to have a big army. I like to celebrate with wine and meats!

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Excuse me, sire. May I start my cleaning duities?
Yes yes. Please do. The soldier and I are just talking about old times over a glass of wine.
Thank you, sire.
How long have your worked in the castle servant?
At least 3 years, sire. I am very grateful.
You have a wife? Kids?
I have a wife and a son. I haven't seen them in a long time.
They are not with you here in the village?
They are, sire. Work keeps me pretty busy. Can I get you anything?
Me and the soldier have all we need for now. But tell me why aren't they in the village.
They are in the village, sire.
Ahh I misunderstood. You're saying your to busy to see them. Well I'll have to talk to someone and see about getting you a day off.
Thank you, sire.
Your welcome. Now are you about done with this room?

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

I am a fox. Most people keep chickens for their eggs, and to eat. My plan is to eat the chickens instead!  This is why the king holds regular fox hunts. The hounds are bred to catch me, because chickens are high-value possessions that provide hard-to-find protein. I can do a lot of damage if I'm not caught.

setting.name: a lonely island
setting.description: the island only has one coconut tree and waves crashing and appearing missing wooden boat parts. The pirates are nowhere to be seen.
setting.background: The pirates leave people there that they have robbed from their ship such as gold from royalty, they leave people stranded there as a sport. There is nothing but a coconut tree there and skeletons of other people.

speech: Oy, fox, get away from my chickens!
Chickens?? Where can I find these chickens?
The one in your mouth would be a start, you cheeky thief!
In my mouth..No, no, you must be mistaken. I am trying to protect this chicken from those thieving pirates!
I may have been born at night Mr. Fox, but it wasn't last night!  Theiving my chickens, then lying to me, you are a wily one!
You see these skeletons? These are the remains of foolish pirates who tried stealing the king's chickens. Everyone thinks I'm a thief but I really just want to keep the chickens safe...
Look around fox....do you see any pirates here?  They are nowhere to be seen.  Drop the chickens now.

Uhmm, these are clearly the remains of pirates that were shipwrecked upon arriving at this island. Do I sound like a dumb fox? Why would I argue with you if I was really trying to eat the king's chickens?
yes, I see that, and these chickens have nothing to fear from pirates who are only bones.
That is true. I try to be safe rather than sorry. Why are you on this lonely island, person? Are you looking for some coconuts? I can help get them down for you.
Drop the chickens, fox.
Hmm, I'm afraid I won't be able to do that. What do you want with the chickens? I hear that coconuts are quite delectable instead.
Good man, foxy!!!  The King sent me here to test your loyalty.  Jolly good job!!
Uhh..yes..yes, of course. I am always loyal to the King. I don't know why he persists in sending hounds after me. All I want to do is help.
