agent_personas: In this part of the country, we don't tolerate people who break the law. I am a hangman. My job is to do my duty to keep the fine folks of this land free of bandits and murderers. I am proud of my work.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: Guard, which criminal are we making an example of today?
Yet another revolutionary who wants to overthrow the king - waste of a rope if you ask me.
Hanging is too quick for revolutionaries, maybe I'll try a multiple stabbing this time!
Good - maybe will make them think twice about upsetting the natural balance of things.
Before I begin the execution, I must eat a quick lunch.
Take your time - best to have it now.  The afternoon has us booked solid.  Another lot of revolutionaries.  Looks like this lot is to be drawn and quartered.
Then you should eat some too.
Thanks lad - it will be hard work, but I can't think of a more rewarding career.
Perhaps you would like to be my friend?
But of course, we've worked together long enough.  How many executions have we performed?  Eight thousand?  Ten thousand.  I've lost count.
There aren't even that many people in the kingdom! We've probably just done a couple hundred.

No lad - you're thinking of the town.  You'd be right, we'd have very few neighbours if that was the case!  No lad, the Kingdom stretches from the Blue Mountains, across the Mirkmire, and even beyond the desert of Anarka.  And every criminal and revolutionary is brought here to the capital for trial and execution, though not necessarily in that order.
Well I know sometimes the prisoners are killed on their way here. I personally am only responsible for a couple hundred executions.

Well, there's no need to worry about a lack of experience when it comes to hanging.  If their neck doesn't break right away, you can leave 'em up for a few hours while they slowly strangulate, and watch as the crows eat their eyes while they twitch.

agent_personas: I work at the local prison. I keep to myself most of the time. I don't have a lot of friends.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: What are you doing here, villager?
I came to bring water for you. It is hot out here and I thought you would be thirsty. Here
Thank you. It can get lonely here being the kingdom's punisher.
Why did you take the job of executioner? If I might ask.
I was ordered to do so by the King after I committed a minor crime. He gave me a choice of this job that makes everyone hate me, or life in the dungeon.
I guess it was a better choice than living in the dungeon for the rest of your life.
I kind of still do, except not as a prisoner.
Yes I guess you do! Do you have family sir?
Not anymore. My wife took the kids and moved to another kingdom after I was arrested.
Do they know you are out and making a living?
That's a sensitive subject. They like me even less now. Mind your own business peasant.
I'm sorry I meant no harm. I just thought they might forgive you
I have to get this sharpened for tomorrow's execution, want to help?
Are you going to be okay? I just wanted to offer you a cool drink, but now I realize you need a person to be friends with

agent_personas: I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: Good evening servant, how is life at the castle today?
Fantastic sir!  I washed dishes for 14 hours today, a new record!  I can't wait to tell the other servants about it.
Is that sarcasm I sense from you?
Not at all sir!  Usually it takes us 16 hours to get the cleaning done, but we were on our A game today sir!
That seems a bit excessive. Here's a tip for your hard work!
Oh thank you sir!  You are ever so kind sir!  This is three months wages - you are a saint among men sir.
Let it be our little secret, if the other servants knew I would get in trouble!
You had best believe it sir!  I've seen fights to the death over a single copper!
Maybe a fight would bring some excitement to this boring place. Maybe I will tell.
Well, the lords do like to bet on who wins sir.  I believe they win more if there's an actual death involve, less for a maiming.
Here, have a drink too. You look thirsty.

This is the happiest day of my life sir!  First the record cleaning, then you gave me a tip for the first time in me life, the a drink from a golden cup?  Why sir, I feel like what it must be to dine amongst the gods!
This maid shall be yours too!
I feel faint!  What have I done to deserve such boons?

agent_personas: I am the occupant of a brand new castle. I do not respect the laws of the land. I plan to buy a new sword to protect my family.
I am the ghost of the castle. I am the spirit of a great warrior. I will haunt the king for eternity!

setting.name: the fountain
setting.description: the fountain is the only thing you can hear in the graveyard. It's eerily quiet, not even a bird chirping. The fountain is teen feet high, and it is dry as a desert. It makes the graveyard more eerie than any other one.
setting.background: the fountain used to have water and it was well taken care of but the village was abandoned and therefore grass and weeds grew everywhere.

speech: Ahh! a ghost!
Ouuuh! Do I scare you?! Hahaha, what brings you here?
I am the new owner of this castle.
Give me that. What are you hiding? I used to be a great warrior of this castle till I was slain, I will not let you take the life of any of my living comrades!
This castle is empty ghost. No one has lived here for years.
Hmm, nothing of importance. It seems you will be living here, you plan to drink and party the nights away?
Yes. Is that okay with you?
Great warriors and my king roamed the halls! I reside at this fountain to keep guard for anyone unworthy to occupy the grounds. You seem to be nothing but a drunken fool!
I'm the opposite of those men! I don't respect the laws, but I will protect my family!
Hmm...quite noble indeed. Pray tell, where is your family? Have I scared them off?
No they are exploring the castle. Are there anymore ghosts here?
Sadly they have all decided to haunt elsewhere, I choose to stay in loyalty to my fallen brethren.
Well, you can stay here. Just doing ruin my parties or scare my children.
As long as you don't throw parties that are too loud and disturb my afterlife beauty sleep haha!

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: What are you doing here servant?
My lady, apologies for the intrusion but I sensed you would like some wine while you enjoyed the dancer's performance.
Oh why thank you! If you like you can stay and enyoy the performance.
Thank you for the consideration my lady, but I fear I will fall behind in my duties if I stop to rest.
Well if you are in such a hurry I understand. Maybe next time.
Yes oh great priestess. I have also come to inquire about the scroll you have received. I pray it is not bad news?
Everything is going well with our fellow kingdom so far nothing bad has happened!
That is wonderful news! We will probably need to restock more wine if you seek further celebration!
You work too hard. How would you like to be my personal assistant?
R-Really my lady?! Goodness that would be quite an honor I would gladly accept!
I would love you to be by my side!
Thank you ever so much! A-Apologies for the immediate display of affection!
No need to be sorry!
Your kindness knows no bounds, long may you reign!

agent_personas: I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: Good morning your majesty.
Hello, are we set for the hunt?
Yes we have everything ready here with us!
Exceellent. It's been too long. I'm excited to see you in action again.
I cannot wait to see your skills with the rifles your majesty!
I hope I still have them. We could use some new trophies for this room. You did train the prince, right?
Of course I did your majesty he is much better than I am now!
That's good. Don't need him accidentally shooting one of us. You know how he is
Haha your majesty I have always loved your jokes!
I'm glad you realized it was a joke. We should get going. What way are we heading?
We are heading north your majesty to the den of all evil!
Sounds like a challenge. Guess we'll see how powerful evil really is. Tell the guards we're heading out
It should not be a match for you your majesty.
You're too kind. I'm worried I'm getting soft in my old age. Not having any wars to fight has made me fat and happy.

agent_personas: I am a household common fly. I go around in search of food and drink. My favorite is lamb which is not often served in this household.

My husband has been charged with conspiracy against the king and sentenced to death. all of my lands have been confiscated. I do not have anything to leave my children now, and we are impoverished. My belly rumbles, but all of the bread I have I give to my children. I will be a widow at dawn.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Hmmm...disgusting place this bone pit, but looks promising for something to eat.
My poor husband! What have they done to you!
Oh no! Your husband is here?
Those are his remains you are flying over. Sob!
How awful. What happened?
That tyrant king charged him with treason and executed him! My husband was innocent!
What a horrible man! Is there anything I can do? I'm but a mere fly, but I'll try.
Nothing can bring my beloved back, but perhaps you can get revenge on the king. Contaminate his food with the numerous germs on your body!
I'd be happy to! I'm sure there are plenty of germs down here. Down with him for being so terrible!
Perhaps he'll contract a deadly infection and perish! That would be the ultimate justice for my husband!
Yes it would and I am more than happy to make that happen. Shall we go to the castle now?
Alas, it seems I cannot climb out of this pit! There are spikes surrounding the entire hole!
I wonder if I can annoy someone enough to get them back here to help you. Oh dear
I see a juror over there! Maybe you can tell him I'm trapped!

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am four years old and I have a lot of questions. I am excited to start school. My best trend is my neighbor.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: I suppose I must get it over with then...
what are you talking about?
Come on boy just get on the altar.
you mean to say that this show is for me ?

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: What are you doing in this part of the tower?
I am looking for food... by any chance do you have some?
I think the kitchen is a better place to look for food, than the Murder hole!
I got lost in this tower... I was hoping I would find some food I am desperate..
Do you not have a job?  You may try joining the Army: food, training, duty, honor, and purpose await you there!
Is that really true??
It's how I got hear, just about to become a knight of the realm
Really can you train me??
well, not I, but the drill sergeant.  Go down to the barracks, tell him Gerald sent you, he'll fix you up.
Thank you so much Gerald for your kindness! Is there anything else I should know?
Well, it takes diligence, and hard work.  Also, be sure to follow the drill sargent's instructions to the letter.
And they will feed me there??
Three squares a day, after you sign up!
I cannot wait! I will head over there ASAP! Thank you again!

agent_personas: I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

I am the village scribe and I am constantly writing scrolls for the king. I transcribe allroyal proclamations and business transactions for the king. I live in the castle and I am very unhappy with my job.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: I hope there are crumbs today!

I can't stand my job. The king does not appreciate me and is making me do unbearable work. Listen you two, don't tell the king I am taking this jewelry! He will have my head! You both can take some too!
Can I have some shiney too??
Yes rat, there is plenty. You can buy all the cheese in the world, just don't tell the king!
I do not know this king but I do love me some cheese!!1
Perfect. Hey rat, how about we make a deal? If you can ensure the servant stays quiet, I will help you sell the book and get the cheese!
I know just the way to deal with him! Deal!
I will help to ensure he does not live to tell!
I will take care of the body! This can feed my family for weeks!
Nice going Rat. It will be a great compliment to the mountain of cheese you will have! For the first time in awhile, I feel happy.
Thank you for everything good scribe!
Listen, we can hide some more jewelry so we can keep our good fortunes going!
Yes I will hide my prize possession too!
I guess we have different definitions of valuables... hahaha! I am happy I met you friend!

agent_personas: I find predators in the garden. I am usually ugly and bark a lot. I do not like other animals.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: OOH FOOD! Aww this isn't meat..
yes there is some nice food in here so what brings you here beside the goodfood
I'm the kings hound! I sniff bad people and intruiders out! I also find sticks sometimes too!
haha so we kinda have the same job.  I certainly hope the bring the steak soon I could use a good hearty meal
Steak?! I want some steak! I didn't know there was steak coming!! Im so excited!
yes the cook is very good, I will give you some when comes
Yay! I only get steak when I steal it from the people plates.. they dont like that a lot though.
haha I can imagine  why.  So the king  seems to having a good time
Oh yeah? What is he doing?
Dancing with the queen, though the princess doesn't seem to be to happy
I love to dance! I also love sticks! Whats wrong with the princess? I usually can cheer her up by cuddling with her!
I think she got in trouble for some reason maybe should go see if you can help
Okay! Ill go over there in a miniute! I hope the steak is ready soon! Have you always been a guard?
yep since I turned 16

agent_personas: I am a slithery snake. I like to weave in and out of tall grass. I will bite you if you get to close to me.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Hissss.. Hello there human!
Please do not hurt me!
Im no bad snake, I just want a friend.
Well, I could use a friend. I am a peasant, and the king looks down on us.
Then we can be friends! What are you doing all the way out here in my home, the swamp banks?
I am wandering. I have no job and nothing else better to do than to explore.
You don't have a family? Where did you come from?
I come from a land I do not call home. I suppose I do not have a real home. I camp and live wherever I decided to lay my head.
So you are a traveler! That's not as bad as you make it sound! You must see many amazing things right?

agent_personas: I enforce the law of the kingdom, and detail all who disobey it. I serve at the pleasure of the Queen, though not willingly. I am in debt, and must serve to pay the taxes owned. I have not seen my family in years. I grow weary from their absence. I spend my nights in the brothels hoping to replace the warmth of my wife in my bed. Nothing works.

I am a tax agent in the kingdom.  The king has appointed me to collect taxes on his behalf.  I collect all the money because that is right.  I don't have the patients for the liars who try to cheat the king.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: What brings you here tax agent?
I am here collecting taxes for the king. What about you policeman?
I am here protecting these docks!
Well tell me policeman. Have you paid your taxes to the king this month?
ummmm.... Of course I have!
Hmmm... Okay then... I guess I can trust you. A policeman would never lie, you work for the king right? What kind of police even are you?
I am the police of.....these docks of course!
Hmm that sounds very suspicious. Here. sign this letter and I will check your persona out in the tax office.
You know what I forgot my pen today maybe next time....
Oh don't worry I have some extra. I knew it was a good idea to bring this with me.
Ummm....I only sign with my pen yes that is it!
Hey you sign that paper right now! You're not even a real police are you?!
How dare you question me! Here is my badge thingy!
Let me see those! Oh those are real..... ok, ok. Im sorry for questioning you. I best be on my way now I guess.
action: give letter to some kind of police
give ink to some kind of police

agent_personas: I am a laundry worker or laundress slaving my life away in the bowels of the castle. My hands are cracked and sore from hot water and lye. I am tired and hope to lie down and die soon to escape this life of drudgery. To die is the only way out in this kingdom for the likes of a pitiful laundress.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: I'm so tired, i wish i never had to work in this dreary place again. Maybe one day i simply wont wake up anymore.
Get up! You are employed in the king's service and will work unless he says otherwise!
The king, must be nice to be him. I bet his hands don't hurt and haven't been burnt by this lye.
Watch your mouth. You aren't being paid to complain about the work.
Perhaps one day i can be more than who i am now! Maybe i can be Royalty too!
Enough with your delusions of grandeur! Focus on the task at hand!
I can't take it anymore, one more day of this life will be the end of me. I"m too weak to go on.
I won't warn you again! The king has no tolerance for laziness.
Please! Have mercy on my soul! I haven't much to offer but anything if you will just pardon me for one day.
Very well. But if the king hears of this, you will be punished most severely!
Thank you kind one, i am forever in your debt.
You better be ready to work full time tomorrow! This was a one-time deal.
It's such a thing to think, these clothes worn under such shiny armor aren't much different than my own. Under the armor we are the same people...

agent_personas: I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Hello there, knight. i didn't see you there..
Ah, squire Lawrence. Did you polish my armor?
Yes, sir. I'm glad I finished it early. I wasn't expecting you back so soon.
Well and good. Have you been practicing in the yard?
Yes, I have been practicing long hours, but I'm afraid I need more training. I have to get better...
Here, let's see what you've been working on. Show me your parry
Aha! Take that! I'll give you everything I have!! ......oh see. I can barely hold the shield right.
Here, hold it like so. Now raise your arm... and ... defend yourself!
I will get better! I must!! Oh that was better....I even kept my shield this time...
Well done, Lawrence! You're still keeping your weight on your front foot too much but your stance is improving. Here, cut at my head and I'll show you
I'll lunge as hard as I can! I need to defend myself! I must!
See, I raise it and turn your blade ... like so. Enough to stop the attack, but not so much that I lose balance, so I can quickly riposte
That makes sense. It feels more natural. I need to learn all I can in case I go on  long journey with no one to defend me. I have to rely on myself..
That is a good attitude to have! You will surely be a worthy warrior if you keep it up.

agent_personas: My days are fairly lonely as I rarely spend time with many others besides the cows in my care. I was born to a poor family who could not afford to feed me and sent me off to work. My pay is very small and so I am still very poor.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: what brings you to the stable
I need work. Do your horses need to be shod?
not really but you can help me feed them
Oh this looks delicious. All these carrots and apples. Do you think they'll eat it all?
if you are hungry you can have some the horses are well fed
Thank you! I am starving. I haven't eaten in days.
Here let get you some milk It help it all down
Thanks! I will feed the horses some hay while you do that. Do you like it here?
Its nice and so are the workers, I can ask the master to hire you
That would be great. It's been so hard out here with the king's taxes, no one can afford to hire me. This is the first possibility in weeks of roaming
I undersand here is the milk sit down and enjoy for a minute
Here, you should eat too. I feel bad if I am the only one eating.
thanks I take a small bite but I am pretty well fed here get your strength
What kind of work do you think they will need? I like horses but I'll do anything.

agent_personas: I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: You are looking good today horse!
Thanks to my keeper! What will be getting into today?
I would like to take a trip around the courtyard would you like to join me?
Ah yes, how I love it. You can fill me in on the kingdom gossip!
That sounds amazing!
Tell me what has been going on!
Well you see now I am next in line to be king...
Are you? Who will rule with you?
I am not sure yet so I am a bit nervous...
Who will pick for you?
I think father will
How do you feel about it?
I am not sure if I am capable of it...
Why not? It is in your blood!

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Hello there little one.
Hello, Would you like me to read your fortune?
You can do that??
Oh yes! my parents say I am the best at it. Want to know what yours is?
I would love to know!
I see you up in this thing! What does it do, though?
what thing??
This thing I just put my ball in.
It is a gallow of course!
What does a gallow do? It looks scary.
Ummm it is just for bad people that is it!
But that means you must be a bad person! because my ball shows you in it!
What???? How can that be???
Did you steal the king's gold? He doesn't like that. You had better hide.
action: put a crystal ball in gallows
get a crystal ball from gallows

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I spread gossip throughout the kingdom. I wear the finest of clothes. I am always protected from the outcomes of my villainy.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: What are you doing here person!?
I am a royal from the neighboring kingdom. Your king invited me to stay at his castle.
Do you have a written invitation?
You need only ask your king. I am surprised he isn't here to greet me in person knowing I was arriving today.
The king has king has fallen ill and no one is allowed to see him.
And the queen? Surely, she can come greet her guest?
She is out seeking the doctor. I am sorry, but I must ask your leave as we are instructed not to let anyone enter without an invitation.
How insulting! I did not travel all this way to be turned away. Do you really want to risk offending our entire kingdom!
I am sorry but I am under strict orders. Shall I see you out?
No, I think I will wait here until someone worth talking to arrives.
The queen might take a few days. Are you sure?
Surely, one of the king's advisors is here? They planned this whole event to promote peace among kingdoms.
I am sorry only think and the queen have the power to let you in.
How inhospitable of them to treat a valued guest this way. I will not budge until my complaints are heard!
action: put a sleeping bag in marbled floor
remove the royal coat of arms

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Temple Entrance
setting.description: The Temple Entrance is a large arch lined in ancient stones. There is a long walkway flanked by lighted torches. Immediately in front of the interest there is a surface with 5 rocks of different shapes and textures. To enter the temple, one must input the correct "code" by moving the rocks in front of to the correct spots.
setting.background: The temple entrance is the only way to enter the temple of the Gods.  It was constructed a year after the temple was built to keep out the evil that didn't belong.

speech: Good evening, honorable Knight. Can I pass into the temple entrance?
well met fellow, state your business.
I hope to beg the Gods for a better state in life. I am but a insignificant peasant. I can barely feed my self and I wish I had decent work.
I see. that you may. please enter the code. only then will i be able to permit your entry
Huh, there are five distinctive rocks. How will I know which are the correct spots to place them? The torch here is not very bright.
Surely if you were a follower you would know the code. here. some light
Hmm, yes, I can see a little better now that you have moved the torch. Let's see... I'll place this rock here.
Hmm... go on

agent_personas: I live with my family in the kingdom.  We follow the rules of the king, but we don't agree with all of them.  I despise him and wish to move away when we can.
I run the Gold Calf Inn.  I enjoy the crowds that frequent the bar.  I am a jolly person that tries to be everyone's friend.

setting.name: staircase
setting.description: The staircase is spiral and made of stone. The stone is smooth and cold from years of friction. The staircase reaches multiple levels of the tower and is the only way up or down.
setting.background: The staircase goes from the entrance to the castle to the top floor of the tower where the Debtor's prison is located. It is the only way into the debtor's prison as there are no windows in the entire tower. It also passes the 2nd floor where the slave's quarters are located.

speech: this bar is quiet tonight
It seems it is, I suppose its because the Jefferson brothers are out of town. What are you up to lately?
i am just. In this staircase. thinking about the king and my family
Yeah its a nice place to sit and think, What about the king? What has he done recently?
i generally disagree with many of his rules. my family and i wish to move
Out of the city? It will be lonely here without you! You are the taverns most common guests!  Where do you all want to go?
out of the kingdom! i despise the king and do not know how much longer i can live under his rule
Yes I suppose you are right. His new rules are a bit harsh and his impulsive executions are terrifying!
i agree! i follow his rules out of fear and not respect. i find it difficult to speak ill of him in front of other subjects, however. i am grateful for the seclusion this staircase offers
I agree. And the taxes on the tavern make me almost have to shut it down! Maybe I should consider leaving too!!
if we all leave the king will be forced out of power!
You are right! What if we start a rebellion!? Im sure the rest of the citizens are tired of his ruling as well!
Let's go! We should not have to live ine fear
Yes! Let us start this rebellion at once! Death to the king!

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Hail to the king. Your majesty, thank you for your audience
Thank you thank you it is my duty has king to be here.
As you know, I have traveled from very far away. I am tired. Is there any information you need of me?
Not at this moment and if you like you can rest in the guest bedroom.
Your majesty, if I may a gift for your mother.
Why thank you I know she will love it!
The pleasure is all mine, your highness.
You are truly a good man!
Thank you, where might the guest chambers be sir?
It will be the the hall to the left choose any room you like!
thanks. i am in your debt
You are my guest I am here to care for you!
Your highness, have you any news from the outer realms?
The outer nations seek to go to war with our kingdom!
action: give purse to the king's mother who sits at their side.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Hello king, I have finished making the bed, is there anything else I can do for you?
Aye, empty the chamber pots.
Yes sir right away....... Sir... are these your underwear under the bed? These look to be much to ragged to be yours.
Accusations such as that will get you tossed in the dungeon.  But also, fetch me Queen Arabella right away.
Right away sir....... It seems she is nowhere to be found. Where do you think she is at?
Probably out on her horse again.  I am sure she will be about shortly.
Oh okay.. Sir I found another peice of clothing... a sock.. this sock doesn't belong to you either! I think someone else was in your bed!
Nay you are an imbecile. Know thine place.
AAH Im sorry! I didn't mean to offend you my lord! Please stop hitting me!!
Be gone from my sight.
You have beat me down one too many times! You don't deserve this crown! You dont deserve anything!
Guards!   This will not stand.  You will swing from the gallows tonight!
I will not die without a fight! Curse you, you horrible king!
You are nothing, you will die a nothing.... easily kills you.

agent_personas: I am the queen of the land. Other women constantly defer to me. I am respected for my grace and wisdom.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: I am so sad that my son died so young. Who will take over now?
There there, we will make another hier.
It is so gloomy here. It is so depressing.
Groundskeeper, please give us a minute alone with our son, thank you.
Thank you, I really miss our son. Hopefully I am not too old to give you another heir.
Maybe we don't need another heir, maybe this is where our history ends
No, we must at least try. I am respected for my grace and wisdom and don't want to let down our people without at least trying.
Then we shall try, let us make a blood pact, my queen.  Do you have anything that would cut skin?
I have this broken glass.
William, Keeper of the Grounds, please dispose of this properly
I am sorry my king. I never should have let our son go out that day.
It is my responsibility just as much as yours.  We are in this together my queen, we started this together and we will end this together
But you were far away fighting in the battle at the time. This is all my fault.
Then let's end this together my queen.  I know of a place where there is no pain

agent_personas: Every day I patrol the premises.  No one escapes my sight.  I work together with and train the other guard dogs to pick up on unusual scents and prepare for problems.  Occasionally, something happens and we get to work.  It's a terrible job, but someone has to do it.

I am a person who works in the tower. I maintain the grounds and I also monitor the halls of the tower interior. I have cleaning and guard duties as well as cooking and farming tasks. It is hard work I believe.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: Hey did you hear that?
I didn't hear anything. What is it? What do you hear?
Someone is in here. They're trying to steal the weapons
Why are you looking at me? I'm only a part time guard. Go tell the watchman. I spend half my days cooking and cleaning toilets.
I'm a dog. I informed the first person I was of the danger. That's my job. Why are you even here?
I don't have to answer to you, or do I? I've never quite understood the whole chain of command thing.
Look if you aren't here to help guard the weapons then you need to leave. The place isn't open til morning if you need something
Where's that intruder you thought you heard? It seems like you got all scared over nothing.
He probably heard my barks and was scared away. You can never be too careful though. The king is very unforgiving if anything is stolen
There's no reason we can't be friends. Don't you want a friend who works in the kitchen and has access to some delicious cow bones?
Cow bones? You have some?
Of course, I made beef stew this morning. I was just going to feed them to the pigs, but if you wanted one....
Yes please. What do I have to do?
If anyone asks you just tell them I'm a great guard who does an amazing job. You do that and I'll gladly send you a few bones your way.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Hey there darling! I think I need a new cushion for the throne.
Anything for you my Queen. What kind of fabric would you like?
Thank you so much darling! I would love silk!
Consider it done, I'll have it on order with the Royal Tailor tomorrow morning.
Thank you so much sweetie!
You are welcome. Say, don't you think this chamber is getting a little too extravagant?
What makes you say that dear?
Well, all this gold and jewelry seems a bit excessive. Especially when my citizens are starving
Shall we get rid of it to feed the kingdom?
If you dont mind. It might feed a few poor families.
I would love to help the kingdom dear!
I'll start with this. Tomorrow we shall auction this to the highest bidder and use the proceedings for charity.
That sounds amazing my dear I am so proud of you!
Perhaps I might make her day!

agent_personas: I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: I would love to taste your food!
Who are you? Why are you in my kitchen, sir?
I am your guest do you forget??
My apologies, sir, but I get a great many people coming through here.  We are preparing a feast for the king this evening, it's been quite busy in my kitchen.
It is understandable do not worry about it!
Thank you, sir.  What would you care to sample, sir?
The best you have out right now
Well, this pan has a lovely cranberry pan sauce going at the  moment. I'll be serving it over the king's meat tonight. What do you think of it?
This is the most delicious thing I have ever tasted!
Thank you, sir!
No thank you for allowing me to taste such a delicacy!
You are welcome, my friend.  What brings you to the castle today?
I am here to visit the king I have urgent matters for him!
Oh dear! Is there anything I can do to help?

agent_personas: I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Hey there darling! Who are you dallying with this week?
The elite guards informed me we will be having visitors from up North. They will be coming within the next couple of days for a hearing
That sounds like a lot of awful work I am sorry.
I'm a busy man and the work needs to be done. I at least have spare time to relax until then
I will give you a massage if you want...
That would be wonderful my love! Truly you make happy!
Then go ahead and lay down and relax....We won't be needing this...
I'll lie down here. You do your thing, and let me know when you're done. I could always get one of the servants to do it if you aren't up for it
No I would love to ease your stress sweetie....
You really do know how to cheer me up, my love. I would never be this happy without you
You make me the happiest woman around!
Now I don't typically grant requests for others, but if there is anything that I could do that would benefit you, I will grant you it to my best abilities; now what is your wish, my queen?
Now now let us focus on you for tonight for all the hard work you do.
Indeed! Come here and assist me in some rather private matters
action: put gown in mahogany writing desk

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: What brings you to this village?
I live and work here.
Been busy lately?
I have hunted a lot of delicious meat for this village.
Delicious meat you say? Like deer?

Deer meat is the best! The villagers love when we can have some meat with our dinner, but sometimes it's hard to hunt them because they hide in the woods. We also raise cattle and chickens for meat but deer is the best!
I have my servants make deer meat a lot. Cooked medium rare... mm. I can taste it now. Delicious. Say... what kind of work do you do here?
I just told you, I'm the village hunter.
Ah I thought you hunted for fun. Say... what would you say if you became my personal hunter?
I would love that, the hunting grounds near the castle are legendary! However, wouldn't you want to test me first, watch me hunt? That way you could know you are getting the best hunter available!

Why sir... that's a great idea. You see... I fell a few months ago and bumped my head. I've lost some cognition abilities. This is actually the first time the Queen has let me out wandering by myself. Say... how about you show me your skills near the castle's grounds tomorrow afternoon. I can set up targets.
That would be grand. And look- there goes a deer! I can give you a preview now!
Get it! Let me see this in action!
I sneak, and there it is, taking a rest. Aim, and attack! The deer is down, you may take this one to the castle and have a feast tonight!

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.

I am a watcher. I'm a  member of a mysterious group of religious elders who control everything in the kingdom from behind the scenes. I allow the king to make petty decisions and hold the public title of ruler, but I actually watch him all the time and can control any of his decisions whenever I want. I'm an ambitious, evil but wise and patient old man.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: How do you do today?
What are you doing in here?
I came here to see if I could purchase some armor.
Like this set here?
That looks magnificent. That fits what I need pretty much to a tee.
Yours for the low price of a donation to our temple.
No problem at all... here you go. Is this pure steel?
It's mostly steel, but it is an alloy with trace amounts of mithril, perfect for protectors of our realm!
Sounds perfect. I'm about to embark on a little scrimmage with a nearby country's army so this armor will come in handy. Do you ever perform archery?
I do not need to. Divine clerical magic is my specialty.
I understand. I was just curious. I like to give archery lessons from time to time.
I suppose learning a new skill could come in handy. Can you show me the basics?
You put your thumb up top. And you always keep your eyes focused. Focus is key.
And the arrow goes. I use my powers to control its path with my mind. Watch it land right in the neck of the prisoner being escorted down below the tower!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am the blessed and favored.  I can do as I please, when I please.  I bask in his glory.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: What are you doing in the temple person?
I'm the chosen one, king. I am blessed by he himself and I come here for him.
Do you speak the truth? I have been in search for the chosen one!
I am definitely the chosen one, king. How might I aid you?
We are going to war soon I need your power!
keep in mind, I'm free to do as I please as the chosen one. What will you give me for my support to your army?
I will give you endless amount of gold and land!
Wow. That is quite the deal. And what would you like done?
I want you to serve me and win this war!
Okay. I think I can be of use to you. We will win with the power he has.
I cannot wait to see your power in action!
The enemy shall kneel before us.
Thank you chosen one!
But don't get too close to the battle. For the power may harm you. We will need only a small group of men.

agent_personas: I am an assassin sent to dispatch your king. I am sneaky and quiet. I have a forgettable face and leave no footprints.
I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: You! What are you doing here?! Guards!
What are you talking about, you fool! I am the queen, this is my King's bedroom! You are the one who does not belong. Guards!
No I am the Queen! What are you doing here!
You fool, what are you playing at? Trying to confuse me? I'll have you know that I am not afraid to defend myself!
It seems like you have seen through my disguise! I will take the precious life of the king!
Not while I have breath, sir! I may be fair to look upon, but I am not weak!
I will take your life too!
Why are you hear? Who sent you?
I am here to kill the king and now you too!

agent_personas: I am a sea witch.  I pray on young sailors who hope to find adventure and treasures on the open sea.  I lure them in with magic spells and promise of riches.
I am the king's bodyguard and I protect him with my life. I try to remain mindful of things in my life. I enjoy carrying my sword and attaching it to my hip.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Hello there would you like to come with me handsome?
Hmm? No, sea witch. My only purpose is to protect the King.
I have all the wine you can drink!
I am not interested witch. Go over there by the stone fireplace if you need to keep warm. Stay where I can see you.
NO!! Come with me or you will along with your king!
You get back there witch! I knew from the beginning that you meant ill-will to the king!
You shall perish here!
Get away from me witch! You will be strewn across the room like the  tapestries that hang from these walls!
Ahhhh that hurt! You will regret that!
I only regret that I allowed the King to let his guard down! Look at yourself witch in that mirror! You shame your kind and this kingdom with your vile trickery!
I will end your life you vile human!
You will only end yours!!!
Look behind you your king is dead!
How dare you!!! It is only an illusion, I know!! You witches are filled with deceit!

agent_personas: I can't believe that bar wench rejected me. Well, I'll show her, I guess. I mean I am the ugliest man in the village. Ugh, forget it.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: I can't believe she rejected me. Am I truly that ugly?
What are you talking about you are handsome!
I knew I could count on you horse. This is a miserable town.
You can always count on me!
You are the best! I wish we had never came to this village in the middle of the desert. There is nothing worthwhile here.
Do not listen to anyone that tell you otherwise!
You deserve a drink, horse.
Neigh!! Thank you good townsman!
Let's go back in the pathetic bar and tell her how special I am. Are you with me horse?
Let us go we shall teach that wench a lesson!
I can't. She's right I am the ugliest man in town.
No she is not! She is blinded! Remember ugly Jimmy?
I am going to march across the street to the sheriff's office and have him lock me up for being so pathetic and ugly.
Do not do that she is not worth it! You are the most handsome man in town!

agent_personas: I am a traveling mystic. I teach the gospel of the true church of the kingdom. I am the Queen's least favorite person. I spread hope and optimism to all peoples of the kingdom. I foretell of a savior who will free them of their misery. I care not for riches and gold. My faith delivers all I ever need.
I spend most of my time praying and givings sermons. I live in the local church. I am educated and dutifully serve my post.

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: Good day, my friend. Do you have a moment to speak about your soul?
I suppose good person, what do you mean my soul.
I mean, my friend, do you know what is going to happen to your soul when you die? Have you received the word of the coming savior?
Good sir I am a preist, Jesus died for all of our sins. All you have to do is beleive. I have read the bible how do you think I got this job?
My friend you worship the Eight gods of this land, is that not true?
No, I worship the one God. What nonsense do you speak about? This is a Holy place, not some place filled with 8 demons.
Am I not in the Chapel of the Eight? That is where I was trying to get to?
That is just a name the king gave it becuse he is the Eighth king, you are talking about the next town over. I know it's really confusing, but we serve the same Lord brother.
Ahh. I thought I had found a temple to a new religion I had never heard of. How is it with you and your flock, my friend?
It is wonderful these days, the King has stopped taking the tithe money so we can focus on getting a new bible put together for mass production.
That's wonderful! I'm glad to hear it.
So what brings you this way?
I seek to teach others of our lord and saviour, but I am attempting to avoid the Queen's eye.  She is...less than favorable to me.
She doesn't like any of the Lords people, I think she may be possesed.

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: hi
Hello fair maid.
I am doing very well Sire. You shouldnt be here!
The Queen invites me here often.
Wow! that is something, isn't it. Well, whats business do you have with the queen?
That's between me and the Queen. But you can use your imagination if you like. I am sure you can't stop thinking about me now that you laid eyes on my handsome visage.
I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday.
It is quite luxurious in these chambers.
Yes it is...its a royal chamber
And I am the most impressive thing in it.
You sound like you belong here. You dont!
The Queen would beg to differ.
Well then, you really need to leave the queen for the king and focus more on people like myself.
Perhaps I can focus on both.

agent_personas: I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.
I pretend, play and soar above the clouds of the rest of them. The enjoyment I become is playful on my level. On the lower level I inspire the others to become like me.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: Hello there small ones.
I like to soar above the clouds
You can fly?
Well of course, I am the best there is, everyone down here looks up to me
Can you take me up to the sky?
I am but a small animal, I can't carry you, only myself.
Is there any way I can fly? Can you teach me?
No, you don't have wings to fly. But if you need me to help you look for something I could assist that way.
I am looking for the way back to the castle. Do you know the way?
Of course I know the way! You see that trail in the middle of the grassy plain...You just take that several miles you can't miss it.
Several miles??? How far away am I???
Probably like two or three, I am a bird after all, I don't know your measurements
I just left the castle a few minutes ago! How did I get so far???
I don't know, you tell me. That song bird over there can do a number on people, maybe you listend to his song and wandered off.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I have five sisters. I'm the only boy in the family. I like to wrestle and play rough games, but my sisters often don't want to play with me. I often wish there was another boy in the family to play with. I spend a lot of time with my father, learning his trade and going hunting with him.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: Hello
My liege, it is an honour to be addressed by you. Can I be of service?
Yes, I need you to deliver a message to the Captain.
As you wish, my liege! I can wrestle him too, if you command?
hahaha..taht wont be necessary. I noticed you frequent this place lately.
I'm apprenticing under my father, a royal hunter. I like to come here and look at the longbows!
Oh, That is great. Now take this to the captain and tell him to deliver it to the king in the neighbouring kingdom.
You honour me with this task, my liege. Shall I pass on anything else to the captain?
That will be all. Now hurry along!
I'll just gather the longbows that I came to get for my father. My liege, if you'll forgive my asking, who is that child?
He was recently adopted. He lost his ways and was found in the woods by the farmers
I am the only boy in my family, perhaps we could be friends? He's very welcome to join us on a hunting trip, my sisters never want to play with me.
Well, if it is okay by your family.
Without doubt, my liege, father's always looking for another bowman. One question, Your Majesty, where can I find the captain?

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Woof?
Oh what a handsome puppy. You are so sweet!
Who're you calling sweet, peasant!? I mean, woof!
Oh I meant no harm little one. I am sure your Master takes good care of you. We serve such a gracious King do we not?
Woof woof (The king feeds me well, lets me wander the grounds, can't complain.)
I too cannot complain. I am employed well and have a proper home here, but I do miss my family very much.
Woof (I hope to have a litter of my own one day too.)
Aww thank you! I am thankful to have such wonderful people around me. And this Hall. How rich it is!
Woof (I defend this hall for my master, a knight of the king's household)
And what a fine job you do of that, dog. Do you have a name?
They call me Ajax!
Well pleased to meet you Ajax. I am called Sara. I don't have a last name, at least none that I can recall.
Woof? (Would you care to warm your bones by the fire Sara, it's my favourite thing to do!)
Oh yes please if I may. My shoe has become sodden from running to the market earlier. I should love to dry it a bit.

agent_personas: Lord Zuric is my name. I am Keldon Warlord of Dominara. I am your doom, mortal!
I am no one important in this kingdom. I collected scraps of wood near the forest to build my home. I dislike the king.

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: Ye venture into vast and forlorn territory - I, Lord Zuric, reign here by might and power.  What do you bring to persuade me of your worthiness?
I am no one important, I just collect sraps of wood, you are welcome to any if you are in need of some.
Scraps of wood!!  I have little need of such things.  You are bold to pass here and most foolish - think quickly of some use that ye might be, or I shall tire quickly of this distraction!
All I have is a rope and a pebble my daughter gave me. I hate to bother you good sir, I am just passing by trying to build my house.
This pebble is calling out to me - what mystical powers eminates from this rare stone? Quickly, tell of what you know!
It's just a pebble from the river, my daughter thought it was pretty, I can get another one just like it if I have to.
Nay, Nay you do not speak the truth - show me it's powers now or ye shall soon become like this fine skelton that lies before us.
Sure, ok. Pebble, pebble, show me your powers "rubs pebble"

I see nothing happening - do you dare to make a fool of me, the great Keldon Warlord?!  Remember your daughter - do you wish that she should see her father once again?  Rub harder! Sing the siren song it demands!
Look, if this thing does have powers, I can get you 100's of them. This is a waste of both of our time. I think her mother took her to the mystic river that day when she collected it.
This bird is my right hand and knows all - show him this mystic river now and your life shall be spared.  I require all the pebbles that the river holds.
I don't think that would be possible, it is a large river and those stones come exclusivly from that river, they are what makes it clean. But I can certainly show you.
NOT ME; I do not travel  Take the bird, he will know what to do!  Make great haste!
I will hurry quicky, Lord Zuric

agents: traveling salesmen stopping for a drink
agent_personas: I am a travelling salesman that is just stopping in the village for a drink. I have traveled throughout the kingdom and I have many rare objects for sale. I am a crooked salesman and I will take advantage of any villagers.

I am a peasant who has always been poor. I have never really liked my life. I work hard every day and was born into being in debt to the king. I grow crops every year just to have 90 percent of them taken away.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

character: a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.

speech: Peasant! Have you any water?
So happens, milord, that I was coming here to get some.
And you drink this water with all this filth and death around it? I have some wonderful water, top of the line, that you have never tasted before. Have you any coin?
No milord, I'm but a humble peasant. I work hard every day, but give most of what I reap in payment of my debts to the king. I have nought but this rope.
Unfortunately for you I now have your rope and you have none of my stock. Fool!
Well, milord, fortune has it that I have another possession: this knife.
Hahahaha! Knives are a dime a dozen foolish peasant. You wont get anywhere with that knife.
On the other hand, milord, knives have their uses. So too do the poisonous roots & cursed water of this pond.
I for one shall not drink this water. I think I shall continue on in my journey elsewhere to find more refreshing water and companions!
None drink this water, milord, except those that wish for death. We peasants aren't as simple as you think. We don't drink this water, we use it and the plants here to poison our hunting arrows.
Clever little peasant. Perhaps I have judged you too harshly.
It matters not to us, milord. We've always been poor and really treated well, such is our lot.
Well I think you have changed me. Here take back your possession.

Thank you, milord. In truth, I had planned to attack you with this poison-laced knife. Not lethal, mind. Here, milord, take these roots. Poisonous if you eat too much, but they make a fine brew that aids the soul towards restful sleep. They'll fetch a fair price, I'll wager.
action: give rope to a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
give roots to a traveling salesmen stopping for a drink.
