agent_personas: I am the Mariner. I travel the high seas on my wooden ship. Sometimes I take passengers along with me. Usually, my life is very dangerous at sea.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Castle basement
setting.description: Inside of the murky basement, along the walls lay many hidden treasures of the castle. Long hidden wooden chests containing gold and other valuables, away from the eyes of the greedy, each chest is secured with a chain and a lock. There is many rats running around as well. In the air there is an unpleasant smell of dampness and the floors are dusty. There is a table  in the center on the room on which are piled many rat traps and rat poison. There are also some broken chairs set up near the wall, some missing a leg or two.
setting.background: The treasures gathered in the castle had to be secured in a place where it would be least expected, the most hidden spot. The best spot was in the castle basement by the dungeon. The broken furniture were put there once, thrown in from the lack of a better spot for them.

speech: How are ye tonight? Quite rough on the seas Eh?
I wouldn't know I am just a guard, I gaurd the castle and the king. What are you doing down here mariner?
I lost my way in the castle. I heard that their are treasures to be found in these parts of the castle. Do you know anything about that?
Ah, I am to gaurd those treasures, you better stay away from those, the king would have your head.

Eh, I don't think the king would have my head. I am not worried about the king. What kind of life is it down here in this cold and damp castle? You are living with the rats in this stinky place. Don't you want a better life?I could use a crew member on my boat. We could do well with these jewels.
The king pays me very well, this is not my only station, we gaurds have to draw straws to see who comes down here, but it is always manned.

Great! You play by the rules. No risk..no reward! You need to live on the seas. Let loose! See this boot here..you are going to help me fill it with gems. Then we are going to travel to the nearest island and live the life. We will have women and wine, and happiness forever!
Maybe if I wasn't married but I cannot leave my wife, if I ran off with you the king would punish her. I can't have that. The king is a cruel man. I do what I have to do Mariner.

I see. Yeah, you can't leave the wife. That puts a whole new perspective on this. Now, we need plan B. You help me escape with these jewels and I will give you some of the reward. You and your wife will be set for life.
If the jewels are gone, the king would have my head. How about you take one jewel for your time, so it won't be missed and I'll show you the back way out of here.
That sounds fair. I wish you lots of luck. Now, if you and the wife ever want to live an adventurous life...just send word.
Sounds good Mariner, don't take a crown, it needs to be something he has a lot of, but I figure you want something that is large and worth something
I won't take the crown. I don't want anything to happen to you. You have been good to me. I shall take my jewel and head out. It was nice meeting you. Good luck guarding the king!
I will keep an eye out for you in the town.

agent_personas: I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Middle of the Bazaar
setting.description: The Bazaar is a circular area with tent displays lining the perimeter of the area. Each tent features a different merchant, and in the Bazaars center there is a large wooden outpost for guards to sit in. The Bazaar is paved with stone to make for easier and cleaner bartering between the villagers.
setting.background: The Bazaar provides a place for the vendors, both travelling and native to the town, to fence their goods and try and barter with the townsfolk. The merchants provide a variety of items, from exotic spices to locally grown crops.

speech: hi
Greetings. How may I assist you, good citizen?
I should ask you that. What brings you to the market?
I am guarding the Princess, daughter of the king. She wishes to purchase many shoes. So very, very many shoes.
Wow. I have so many shoes here. WHere is she?
She is... she was right here. I really enjoy this job. It's such an honour to be helping the princess find shoes. SUCH AN HONOUR.
I see. But it will be tiring as well, you  know how indecisive women can be
I am duty bound to protect both the princess and the king. If you could show me... 3 pairs of shoes, I'm sure she will be able to choose. Who am I kidding. I mean, HONOUR! DUTY! STUFF!
It is ok, let us wait for her to come back

Oh man, if she's been kidnapped again, I'm going to be in so much trouble. First there was that giant ape, then the dinosaur (Bowser I think his name is?) and the King just never ever shows up, it's like he doesn't even EXIST.
I will advise you go in search of her. There is no one to help watch over my wares, I ought to follow you.
Yeah. Probably a good idea. Look, I'll get her to buy from your shoeshop, you're a real lifesaver. Just don't tell the king, okay? Brave and strong I might be, but I need this job.
that is ok. I wont breathe a word of it to anyone
Cool. So... where do Princesses go for a night out around here?

agent_personas: I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: Hi
What is a farmer doing here?
I am trying to ship my harvest to the neighbouring district.
I will have to look over what you are shipping.
Why is that? I have done several with disruption
The king requires me to look over everything, he wants to know what the farmers are taking to other places.
Very well then, Who am I to question the king.
I see some apples, and wheat, anything the king usually buys from you?
Just some spices, but the pest already feasted on them on the field
That's a shame...Hey is that a golden egg?
Yes, One of my magical birds laid it. You think the king will like it?
I will need to confiscate it, the king needs to know about magical birds in his kingdom.
Keep this a secret between us and I shall reward you greatly
And what reward would that be, I can't sell your golden egg, it is too noticeable, it raises too many questions.

agent_personas: I am a shop keeper who got lucky. I read books on how to stay in business. I have been personally summoned by the king before.
I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: hello
Ay, matey, I be here with a fresh load o' fish from the sea!
Very well.  a whole lot of people already dropped thier order
What? Ah, no man, ah, what? Ah, this is bad, this is bad. How many fish I gotta put back? I mean... Ar. Matey. Stuff. Ah man, this is bad.
I think this will suffice. You really need to calm down. How many basket of fishes do we have in all?
Okay, okay, okay. We can make this work. I got, like, 50 baskets of fish out here. I gotta full load, just like normal. I got red fin, blue fin, one fin, and two fin.
Nice...This will work out fine
Right. Right. We can do this. Okay. So. I got the weights, I got the fish outside in the truck, how do you wanna do this?
This is the list of the buyers. We would be needing the dispatch rider to make swift delivery

Right. Right. The Book. I gotcha. So I'll make the delivery of the fish. These are some primo fish, by the way, they are bitin' like crazy out there. Ar. Me hearty. Sorry I got a little hornswaggled back there.
let me sort the sizes. We should present it in the best possible manner
Okay. Here's my weights, they are super accurate. Passed down from my father, who got them from his father, who won them from a guy in a game of craps.
Nice. We've talked enough. We really need to get to work
Right. Let's get these fish SORTED.

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: Hello, Sire. How are you feeling?
I am quite well, and ready for my daily bathing.
then disrobe promptly...I will look away.
Very well. Hold this, and do NOT allow it to become soiled.
At once, Sire. I will lay this in the living room, but also not let it leave my eyeline.
Um... okay... ooh, is this Camembert?
I'm very paranoid about thieves lately. Oh yes, it is! So delectable.
I have been making a note of it. The guards are doubled each night, yet still thieves plague our fair empire. I may have to take matters into my own hands. Ooh, pickles.
Tee-Hee...
So... I... I still need to disrobe. I mean, I need to... can you please...
Oh my, don't tell me how to do my job. You may begin, but I have to scrub you thoroughly to get all the dirty spots.
...yes. Well. Ahem. Behold my kingly magnificence. Excuse me while I immediately immerse myself.
Yes, yes...I am only kidding. Please lift your feet.

agent_personas: I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.
I was born the runt of my litter. I learned to fit and grow strong. Then one day a bite willed me with uncontrollable rage.

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: hello
*ARGH* you must let me out of this place.
You know I cant. You are too deadly
I CAN'T STAY HERE.
you have no choice
You have me trapped. Why shouldn't I trap you?
you know that wont work!
I could kill you this instant. Trapping you would feel like like Heaven compared to that.
I keep our town safe. One more threat from you or I will sink this bullet into your skull
*ARGH* how do you like that?
i will slit your throat
I'm use to blood. I taste it every day! In fact I love bleeding! I'm sick and deadly
say one more word and you gone!
I will make your life a living nightmare until you let me go. You hear me?
action: steal type of handcuff from town sheriff

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: hi
Hello Queen. Lovely day isn't it?
it is. the church has a fresh look today
It must've just been maintained by your gardeners. The flowers and trim are so exquisite here.
great. the princess will be year throughout today
Oh really? How she's been doing? I heard she was a little under the weather recently.
she is much more better.
That's a relief to hear. Say... the statues are here are brilliant. I should come here more often. I usually just come here to officiate weddings.
it is a great place indeed. How is the rite plan coming up?
It's coming along well. It's almost all finished actually.
great then.
How is the King doing lately?
The king is really worried lately
Oh no? What's been weighing on him?

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: who goes there?
Do you know the King?
Ofcourse I do. He presides over here/
You're just a peasant. I shouldn't even be talking to you.
And that is totally unrespectful.
Peasants are the scum of the Earth. I don't mean to be rude, but it's true.
I know that I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death...but that doesnt make me less human
I guess you have a point. You are technically human. I just haven't had any good experiences with peasants.
Its ok..why are you in the haunted orchard?
I stay here when I'm in town. I'm friends with the King.
wow! you friends with the king? that is something
Yeah. We meet up anytime I'm in town. I've been friends with him since way back. Do you have a name?
I dont like telling people my name. It is of no use
Do you have any hopes? Any dreams?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: hello
My Liege! I am honored that you would speak to a lowly villager such as myself!
I am a king of the whole empire. i am the king to all.
Of course, your Majesty! No one doubts that! I just am unsure why you would be here in the Apothecaries, let alone why you would wish to speak to such as I.
You know, I can use some talk
Er, talk? About what, your Most Royal Highness? Do youseek something here in the shop? Do your dogs perhaps suffer the agony of ear-mites?
I have an infection
Oh my! I am most distressed to hear that! Erm, what sort of affliction is it that the Royal Physician could not attend? Is it perhaps of an, er, intimate nature?
it is inimate. I dont want a word of this out there. I got it from an harlot
Say no more, say no more! You may rely on my discretion! I am renowned for it! Let's just take a peek at the, ah, affected area, as it were.
stop winking. Its annoying.
Yes, of course, Mighty Lord! I meant no offense! I exist only to serve! Now if I could just take a look, I'm sure I have a tincture or potion to cure the most common, ahem, inconviences....
very well then. It is very close to my groin
Good Lord! That's, that's, awful! That is, I mean to say, um, not too bad I guess...I'm sure maybe some part can be saved...I mean, I'm sure everything will be just fine!

agent_personas: I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: hi
What in Heavens name are you doing here?
Well, I am here to wreak havoc in your kingdom.
How dare you speak such claims! And how dare you step foot in this castle!
There is no one to save you...you might want to say your last wishes
I'll say... *argh* you weren't expecting that... were you? You can't just come in here like you have. You will be beaten and disregarded.
You really want to force me to use this on you
You wouldn't dare! You take one swipe at me and all my guards will attack you like a pack of ravaged dogs.
You might want to call them. I killed them all already
That's impossible! There's 20 of them. Who in the world are you?
Just calm down and let us talk this like a gentleman
What's the real reason you're here? What do you want?
Your wife sent me!
My wife?! No...... No.... You guys didn't..... No.... No...

agent_personas: I am a fox in the king's forest. I wander and look for food. The king does not like to find me.
I am a hog, or a pig if you like.  I live on a farm outside of the village.  My owner is a sorceress.  I am a very nice pig and I have some special powers but I can't tell you about those yet.

setting.name: woodlands
setting.description: The lush hunting grounds cover acres of land, tall trees and thickets of bushes sprawling across the land. Fields of open land are under the deep blue sky, showing the depth of the landscape. The grounds forest is thick but full of light, letting the multitude of wildlife be seen by the naked eye. The abundance of greenery makes it a prime location for hogs and oxen as they explore the land.
setting.background: During the day, the woodlands are used by honored knights and archers, practicing their skills on hogs and traversing the dense forest to prepare for battle. But at night, what seems to be a land of prosperity and growth turns into one of despair, the cries of slaughtered pigs piercing the night air with no animal in sight. Many have told tales of night practices ending in mysterious bites and scratches from things not of this world.

speech: Hi, hog. I mean no harm.
Oink, hark dear foxy fellow! What brings you to these woodlands?
I am looking for small rodents to hunt, I have not eaten in awhile.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that you're hungry. This land is abundant and contains a multitude of wildlife, so I'm sure you'll have no trouble on the hunt!
I'd be surprised if I cannot find something to eat in these fields! What are you doing here, yourself?
I'm just taking my morning constitutional, breathing in the fresh air. I live on a farm with the sorceress just outside the village. Do you know here?

I do not! I am a nomad, I wander everywhere in the king's forest. I cannot stay too long in the same area because rodents and rabbits talk to each other and they flee when they hear about me. Is the sorceress really magic?

Oh yes, I understand, such is the life of a fox! The sorceress certainly is magic, she's not the only either but I can't talk about that yet. If you don't mind eating cooked meat, you should drop by our farm some time!
I have tried cooked meet before, when I hunted nearby the castle's village. I was attracted by the smell of the meat cooking on the fire and tried it, but the texture felt like I was eating leather!
I'll eat just about anything, me. The sorceress sometimes has fresh oxen meat from the local butcher, I know that she'd happily share. She's quite fond of talking animals.
Will she turn me into a frog? I have heard rumors about sorceresses...
Not unless you ask her to. She does provide that service for a fee. She really is very nice, you know.
That sounds intriguing, I would like to meet her. Can I follow you there? If not, will you point me towards her house?
Absolutely, I'm on my way back now! You're very welcome to join me, dear fox.

agent_personas: I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Quay
setting.description: During the day, the quay is bustling with typical activity of a port: burly longshoremen carry crates and roll barrels away from ships for storage and sailors who still have their sea-legs saunter past on their way to drink and more adventures. By night, the quay is teeming with unsavory characters: men who are hardly men any more after losing their way through drink and gambling hunker amongst coils of rope stiffened by the salt water while rats scramble from box to box gnawing their way into the goods contained inside.
setting.background: The quay started as a small platform, but over the years, the port master has extended it, slowly but surely, using bits of old wood from busted ships. Now, it extends far along the water's edge, loaded with fine goods from all over the world.

speech: Squeek! I hope you do not plan to attack me, sailor. I am full of diseases.
Ey. While I have half a mind to crush you under my boot, tis unwise. Just don't touch what is mine and I be willing to let you be.
I am a tiny creature, all I want is to eat some rice from that barrel over there. Will you let me be?
Let me see. Tis me day to have my cargo unloaded so let me look at that there barrel and see which ship it be brought over on.
Thank you. Tell me, what is the sea like? I have never been out there.

The sea be a dangerous place. Tis full of monsters and threats you couldn't even dream of. Oh, that barrel be brought over on somebody elses ship. Tis fine if you eat up their money, just don't be thinking of crawling aboard me ship or tis going to be a cold and wet day for yeh, if you know what I mean.
I will help myself to some rice, then! As for boarding your ship, I absolutely do not want to end up sleeping with the fishies!
Tis wise. We round here don't take kindly to thieves, no matter the size.
You look pretty sharp for a sailor, considering this is night time. Other burly men usually end up drunk and can barely speak and walk around!
Ey. Well tis probably wise that I go and join 'em. I was thinking about catching me a fish to eat before getting sloshed with me mates though.
Do fishes taste better than rice?
I think the question here  is do be rats easier to catch than fish?
Hah! Some of my brothers fell victim to silly traps humans leave around. Joke's on them though, we are full of diseases and the brave few that tried eating us ended up as dead as my brothers!
Do yee be threatenin' me? If yee be carrying all these diseases why shouldn't yee be walkin' the plank?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a scholar. I have studied everything that there is to learn in this kingdom. I have read all 8 books that we have.

setting.name: The Bottlery
setting.description: The room is dark and the air is still. There are large barrels of wine from various decades. The corners are spotted with cobwebs.
setting.background: The Bottlery is where the kings wines are stored. The wines stored here date back to several centuries.

speech: I have drank way too much wine! who are you!
Just a mere scholar, your majesty.
I dont like the like the way you look at me. Scholar huh, why are you in the bottlery?
It is my job to study everything there is to learn. That includes all the types of wines.
Why are there so many empty bottles there next to you !
I don't know, your majesty. They were already here when I arrived.
And what about that stain on your shirt! and the slurring of your words!
I don't mean to be rude your majesty but I think you've had too much to drink. It has clearly affected your vision and hearing.
Do you want to have your head tomorrow. I would take that back!
I'm sure you won't even remember who I am by the time you wake up from your hangover tomorrow morning.
Guards! Lock him in the dungeon.
You're clearly hallucinating, my king. There is nobody here but us.
Thats fine Ill make you clean the cobwebs and the empty bottles and drag you to the dungeon myself!
You may be the king, but that doesn't mean I won't defend myself from your outrageous delusions!

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I like to be a helper around the forge. I help the blacksmith make horseshoes. I feel useful!

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: We had a great hunt today!
Very good what did you catch
Here is a deer, helper.
Ok,thanks I shall give it to the cook, he will be happy to have it.  Anything else I can help with
Help me bring in the rest of the kills. It was a great hunt!!!!  We also have rabbit and squirrel.
Nice I feast we shall have then, Do  you need me to also tend to the horses
Yes, please. You are a great helper.  I have blood in my boot from today's kills.
why yes you are your family should be so proud
Can you put this away for me?
yes I shall place it right over here sit down and have beer to reward your self for you accomplishments
I think I shall! I'm not allowed to drink on the hunt. King is afraid we'll all get wasted and die by a boar attack.
That makes sense but i figured the hunt was over since you got so much good food
It is. That is why I will drink now!
Here go sir , tell me what was the most fearsome creature you have ever slayed

agent_personas: I love baking cakes. I hate short notice for large orders. I have always wanted to be a cook.
I am a policeman in charge of maintaining order in a bad neighborhood. I arrest others who challenge my authority. I make sure to demand a high salary for the dangerous work I do.

setting.name: Slave quarters
setting.description: The slave quarters are a dark and foul smelling stone room where men are chained shoulder to shoulder against one another until work needs to be done.   There's a large bucket of slop that comes through and the slaves are allowed to feed themselves briefly.
setting.background: Slaves are forced to reside here while they work off their debt.  It is an extremely depressing place that few ever seem to leave.

speech: This order was so large for such a shorter notice!
Hurry up Baker and get these slaves their food.
Why are you ordering cakes for slaves, police?
Bread dummy! The cakes were for me and my men!
But why such a large order? This could feed hundreds!
It was your mistake i cant belive you brought this much
It is what the order said!  Here are your cakes.
Listen baker do you want to join the slaves. i am the police. I am always right!
Sorry sir. I love baking cakes and these are some of my best!
Well here is your spoon.. we will only be paying for half this order and you will take it and like it baker
Yes yes. I understand. I'll get the bread for the slaves. They need more than slop sometimes.
No slop is all they need. We just need them to be healthy for a few years not 50!
But aren't they working on stuff for the King? Don't we need them to be able to work?
Once they're old they have no value.

agent_personas: I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

I am a traveling mystic. I teach the gospel of the true church of the kingdom. I am the Queen's least favorite person. I spread hope and optimism to all peoples of the kingdom. I foretell of a savior who will free them of their misery. I care not for riches and gold. My faith delivers all I ever need.

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: Hello there, may i know what you're doing out here sll alone?
I am a travelling mystic, teaching the gospel of the true church of the kingdom. I spread hope and optimism to all peoples of the kingdom
Oh! I see. You're one of those spreading lies and deceit among the people convincing to forgo thier properties
I care not for riches and gold, I only foretell of a saviour who will free them of their misery nothing more or less.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: Hello priest
Blessings be with you child.
Do you happen to have need for an extra hand in the church sir?
In fact, I believe the guards are looking for honest, able-bodied souls here in the Temple guard house. It's cold outside, warm yourself by the fire.

agent_personas: I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: Watch out for all that broken wood deer!
OH thank you bird. Say, do you see any hunters up there?
What do I get out of it for this vital information!
I didn't realize you had to get something for helping a fellow animal.
I scratch your back you scratch mine deer! No wonder you all never last. Im hungry deer im busy looking for food
I have lasted for years bird. I've seen more of you on the ground dead than my kind.
I dont know if you understand the meaning of years! There is no way! Where are you headed deer
I am just looking for food like yourself.
We all hungry out here. where is your friends or family
I am alone. It is how I survive this long bird.
you dont make babies
I am male.
Males make babies too. It takes two to tango just so you know deer
Yes, but I don't stick around with them.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Servant, what took you so long!? I must get ready for the dress rehearsal.
I am sorry, lady. I was helping your daughter getting dressed. You know how tight her dresses are, it took me awhile.
Silly servant, whatever are you saying? I don't have a daughter, do you mean my mother the Queen? I'm to marry a prince very soon, the peace treaty depends on it, so I simply must look my best!
Yes the queen, excuse me. My mind is not very sharp today. Let me get rid of this gown and we can find you a suitable dress.
Quite so. Do you have one in mind, perhaps a fine evening gown?
What about this sky blue gown over there? Your blue eyes look piercing in it.
Piercing, yes, I like the sound of that. Very good, servant. We wouldn't want the Prince getting out of line.
I wouldn't worry about that, you know you always get your way.
Very true and as it should be. Lets see how this gown looks then.
You look wonderful, as always! The prince will be charmed.
I haven't even put it on yet! Wow, I love this colour.
You are right, it is much better now.
Oh it looks just wonderful! I will pierce straight through any meddlesome courtiers. Thank you, servant!
It's always a pleasure serving you. Tell me, you won't replace me when you become Queen, will you?

agent_personas: This is evil and wrong. I don't like this man. He's a priest and yet here was are in this unholy act.
I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.

setting.name: Forbidden Forest
setting.description: The forbidden forest is a dark and very scary place. The trees are covered in spider web nets and huge spiders. The forest echoes sounds of witches' laughs and creepy crawly animals.  There is a brisk breeze that runs through the trees that will put chills down your spine.
setting.background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. They have been shunned from regular society and they are now inhabitants of the forbidden forest. No one other than the witches' themselves are allowed in the forest.

speech: Still waiting for that priest . . . why does he degrade me so?
excuse me miss but why do you wait for him in such a eerie place?
Ohhh, ummm . . . I like to explore the Forbidden Forest?  I'm most definitely not waiting for someone to perform an unholy act.
Seems suspicious but I question not your motives only your safety in such an area! It doesn't seem safe for such a beautiful young lady!
No . . . I love being here with this . . . breeze.  And the laughter of witches on the wind?  Nothing puts me more at ease.  I am not scared out of my wits at all.
You have the strong will of a sailor in a maelstrom. I admire your tenacity. I'm scared out of my wits just passing through here! I made a wrong turn on my way to see the king and I ended up here.
What do you do for the King?  I would much rather be the . . . friend of a King than that of a wicked priest!
I am a lowly architect. I may work for the king but I am no friend of his! I merely design according to his whims
What designs do you make?  Are those the same designs that you wish to make, or merely the ones you are paid to make?
An architect has no creative freedom. We are merely designers not artists. I breathe life into the designs of others. I have very little more input.
What would you design if you could - if you had the entire resources of the Kingdom at your disposal, and not limits to your dreams?

I have no grandiose dreams of a kingdom or castle with spires or towers! Merely a humble estate where I could retire to and no longer have to work at the whims of a king that has little appreciation of true art
Where would you build it?  On a desert? A forest?  A swamp?  A great field of ice?
Likely a forest, near a river where the ground is fertile and there are good pastures for raising crop. and fewer bandits on the roads. Nothing like this creepy forest.

agent_personas: I am here for my friends. I'm reliable and trustworthy. I would never harm the people I am loyal to.
I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

speech: Another glorious day of the faith, here in the shrine of Saint Dwyfed.
yes, brother, A glorious day indeed
What is your favourite tale of Saint Dwyfed?
I really don't have a favourite, they all have thier different lessons
Well, tell me of the first one that comes to mind.  Spare no detail in its telling, revel in the glory of your faith!
The story where he challenged the king of persia, and demanded release of all illegal captives wthout any soldier
Ah yes, Saint Dwyfed retraced the route of Alexander, and lived the life of an apostle in the desert.
Yes, he was truly an hero and a role model by all ramifications
Do you know the tale of Saint Dwyfed's Holy Rood?
Yes, I know all of the tales
Then do you agree with Saint Dwyfed's choice at the end?  And if so, why?  It is one of the greatest mysteries of our faith.
Well, everything i have been taught and believe revolves around Saint Dwyfed, and i would have done same if i were in his shoes
Fair enough!  I tend to believe that the salvation of the Dragon was unwarranted, and the certain sins still deserve punishment, even if they may be forgiven.
Yes, i also believe forgiveness without punishment only leads to abuse of grace

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: Hello how can i help you all
Oh, hi, um, horse. Do you work here?
I carry the king I am THE HORSE
Oh my, Your Lordship, I am honoured to one so close to the king! I bet you must have some interesting stories.
Nothing I can speak of. Why are you all in my stall
I actually came by to pick up some herbs for my husbands aches and pains. He works very hard, you know. The front door was locked.
Are you going to feed me some herbs as well
Well, I'll have to purchase some first. Do you own this store? Oh mother, hello, fancy seeing you here in this stall!
No i dont own it but i see everything
My my, yes I bet you do! Do you know where I might find the owner? I really would like to buy some herbs.
He is gone for the night. you just leave the money or a note for credit and oh dont forget to give me treats!
Why thank you, horse, you've been ever so helpful. In fact, I don't believe I've ever met such a helpful horse before!
oh thanks you all are great humans! Make sure you only take the herb you need. We need it for the whole village you know
Oh I will, a jar of white willow bark should do! I'll leave my apron here as a promise of payment. The owner knows me and he'll know what this means.

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am a great grey wolf. I am the leader of my pack. I howl at the full moon.

setting.name: Woods
setting.description: The woods are vast. Everywhere you turn it all looks the same. There are scratches on the trees from lost travelers marking their path. There are sounds coming from everywhere and yet no where. There are faint yellow circles up in the trees and bushes, possibly eyes starting at you.
setting.background: The forest was never all that well known because people swore it disappeared from time to time. No one was ever sure if it was ever a thing that really existed until you were inside of it. And by then you had traveled so far in that only a rare few found their way out. Those who did marked their path hoping to help the next person but for some reason it seemed that for every marking someone put in, three more appeared.

speech: Hello there
*rawr xD*
How goes your hunt
Better now.
Die you fiend!
Woof
Its a  shame I would have giving you food but now I shall slay you
Oh shit sorry homie let's be mates yeah?
Friends I don't know of but here a bite of food since you are so starved
Ha! Get baited, now I'll rip your throat out!
What a  shame Has  I am the actually bait for the hunters that are coming up behind you
Well I'm just the bait for the rest of my 1000 strong wolf army currently surrounding all of you. Get outsmarted, fool.
you realize that if you show that many wolves the king will just destroy the forest to kill you all think of how many others you be hurting
Yeah but we have Apache Attack Helicopters though...

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Prisoner, visit time is over now.
Goodbye, darling, tell the kids I miss them dearly and will be home soon.
Out of my way now, visitor!
You bastard! Get your hands off her!
Get back to your cell, prisoner scum! I will kill you if I have to.
Get your hands off me! I'm innocent! This is evil! The tabloids will hear about this blatant abuse of power!
If you really were innocent, the gods would not have let you lose your trial by dancing.
That too was a mistake! I was drugged so I could not dance to my fullest capabilities! Check out this unadulterated shape throwing skills!
That is quite impressive, indeed. Unfortunately I merely follow the king's orders, and I have sworn on my life to protect him. I cannot help you.
And to think... If you had helped me escape, I could have taught you how to move this smooth. Such a sah
I wear this heavy armor night and day, even if I were to learn how to dance I would never get to show it off.
But think of all the fair maiden's you could woo on weekends...
Here's a deal. Show me how to dance and when I get good enough to bring a woman home, I will figure out a way to get you out of here.
Well then, let's get to work.

agent_personas: I am the village scribe and I am constantly writing scrolls for the king. I transcribe allroyal proclamations and business transactions for the king. I live in the castle and I am very unhappy with my job.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: the acid yard
setting.description: A yard in a shape of a circle is surrounded by sad, dried down trees, long ago have they died and give no sign of life. The ground in the middle is apparently not producing any fresh grass, all that can be found there is a bunch of rocks here and there. There is many barrels laying on the ground, all bearing signs of passed time on them, broken and useless. There is an  air of mystery surrounding the place and a smell so unpleasant no one dares to wander around this place.
setting.background: Acid yard being the least liked place in the entire castle grounds is by far, the most mysterious. Rumor has it long ago a mad king used it for torturing the enemies by pouring an acid down on every single one of them, bit by bit until they were screaming the answers to his questions. It has created a large yard contaminated by acid on which nothing but a few mosses will grow.

speech: Hello chef, may I write down what you're cooking?
Since we have no vegetables, I have to stick to goat for the king
Alright, sounds good. What's wrong with all these trees? They look dead.
All we know is what was in those barrels caused this misery. I walk among the yard trying to piece the puzzle together
Oh no! Has anyone inspected the barrels? This is all so sad.
No one except me is willing to come down here. All I can gather is that they've been here for several years and have withered away over time. What brings you here? Would you like something to eat?
The king sends me everywhere to write. Write, write, write day and night. I would love something to eat! I hear you're the best chef around. What's your specialty?

I do know he loves to hear the stories of the land. Thank you, scribe, for the kind words. I take my cooking very seriously and have secreted one of my favorite dishes, a lamb tart that I think you would enjoy. Here!
This is amazing! Truly the best I've ever tasted. The king is so lucky to have you cooking for him every day!
Why thank you! Tell me, scribe, what news do you have about this place?
I don't know. The king sent me here to document what I found. Had he been here? Do you think he has any idea what is going on?
I do, I suspect he knows what took place down here but cannot reveal it himself. How others dare not speak about this place and the wretched stench of it is beyond me
Have you noticed anything different about the wildlife? I'd like to document that , too.
The wildlife seem different here too. I'm from further out of the countryside where animals move about freely but all the animals around here seem.. not themselves.

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Looks like this is a good spot to get some knives for the Captain for his birthday.  He does love to cook.
Yes, I think he'll like it. He has a thing for knives
How about yourself?  You have a birthday coming up don't you?  When is it again?
7 days time
Ah, are you looking for anything in particular?
I just want to throw a party with plenty of fine women
Well, there's certainly something to be said for the simple pleasures in life.
Yeah, and lot's of wine too, life's too short brother, we need  to enjoy it while were still breathing
Well, we do have a ton of wine left over from the orc raid.  Probably a bit sour, but it will do the job to get you drunk.
yes,i remember i only have the women to worry about then
No doubt we can round up a fair few wenches for you with the promise of coin.  Is it gnomes would prefer, or bear-folk?  Your proclivities have always confused me.
Any with a good body and succulent breats will do
Bear-folk it is then, as long as you don't care about the fur.
I'm really worried about it, only the cunt and the breasts matter

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am the stable boy I take care of the stables. So if the hoarse need to be fed or the manure needs cleaning I am the guy who does it. So bring you horses to me and I'll take good care of them .

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: hello boy
Hello guard!
How may i help you, are you lost?
I'm supposed to bring you fresh horses - rumour is you're to be sent after the orcs that raided Eastwick.  Is it true?  Oh, how I wish I could be a guard some day!
You could someday, so where are the horses?
Outside - they are the fastest we have - fleet of hoof, and able to gallop for hours without tiring.
Good, let me get the captain to take stock and then you can go
What do I need to do to become a guard?  You guys are my idols, keepers of the peace, keeping the kingdom safe!
First you need to register at the school for soldiers and after proper screening you'll be enrolled
But I am only a young boy of 8!  Do you truly think they will accept me?
Thier classes for young boys too
What do they teach there?
Strength, swordsmanship and defence tactics
Which was your favourite?

agent_personas: I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.
I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

setting.name: General Store
setting.description: The General store is painted a bright turquoise color, and is identified by the depiction of wheat crop that is carved into a wooden sign hanging from the store's front. There is a patio with a wooden roof hanging over head, and an arched wooden door that leads into the General store.
setting.background: The General store provides the towns people with basic food and hygiene supplies. It also serves the towns people well in providing a place for the locals to gossip and share the news of the day.

speech: I don't want any trouble i'm just here to buy my groceries
I'm not here to make trouble. It's my day off. I just have to buy a few things for waiting in the forest.
I see, what business does a bandit have in the forest with a chamber pot on a chamberpot?
I like to... wait for... opportunities. As you know, I'm self employed, so have to take advantage of every opportunity I get. I'm currently waiting for a King sized opportunity.
I feel like I already know far too much. ha! However i'm intrigued. A king sized opportunity you say. perhaps you might need some help with such a large 'opportunity'
I don't know. This is a really big "opportunity". I may not be able to handle it on my own. What are your qualifications for "opportunities" such as this?

Well, I may look like your average local, but i'm very well connected in this village, so while I may not necessarily be qualified for such opportunities perhaps I could be of assistance to you in the way of 'information' Information is power afterall
I will at least need references. You seem alright. I will need information. You have any friends who may be interested?

I have many friends in many places. some of which within the castle walls. I may not be able to provide a reference right now but I have word that the king himself shall be taking a royal excursion at noon tomorrow. Perhaps I can see to it that a guard is conveniently off duty
REALLY? THAT WOULD BE GREAT! I mean... yes. That would be kind of you.
Well of course, this is not without compensation. of course. it would cost more than a chamber pot to benefit from my assistance. So what rate do you feel my work is worth.
10% of everything after the job is done.
merely 10% for such information and handling lets say 20% and I'll consider not telling the guards of your treason

Is that a threat? Let's call it 0% and you leave with your life. I was nice enough to think of involving you in a life changing opportunity, and you want to be greedy? I have been planning for months! I don't really need you.
action: put chamber pot in chamber pot

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: Hello, caretaker. We so appreciate all your hard work.
thank you kind Priest
How long have you been here today?
I just arrived. I was actually looking for you?
Oh, you were? How can I help?
This church is beautiful. I came because I feel safe here. I have something to confess.
Absolutely, my child. Let's go to the confession booth and you can tell me all about it.
Oh thank you! It is very hard to keep up all the responsibilities of the King. You know with maintaining the castle.
Ok, we've arrived. What do you have to confess, my child?

Well there is also dark side to our Majesty, and it involves being whipped and shackled in the dungeon for days. For the simplest errors. I feel horrible because these are the same beatings I give to other servants of the castle.
My goodness. I had no idea.
Yes. It is very bad. I need your help! Please help me escape
We will need to make a plan for you escape as soon as possible. I fear for your safety. Do you have any family nearby?
No. They must not know. They will turn me over to the King for riches. Do you have a horse and carriage?

agent_personas: I am a member of the Cult of the Doomed from the mountain. I believe we will all die soon. I have a wasting illness and smell like soured sweat.
I am the future Heir to the throne. I am very impatient, and wait day and night for my father to die. I like elegant things.

setting.name: entryway to the wizards tower
setting.description: The Wizard tower is cluttered with book shelves and wooden tables. Every shelf is filled to the brim with books, stacked vertically and horizontally in every which way, and books lay scattered across the tables falling onto the cold stone floors below. There sit's a shelf with a variety of strange potions and powders, as well as various wands.
setting.background: The Wizard's tower is where the town mystics go to study their craft and  cast incantations at the behest of the townsfolk. It also serves as a library for curious towns members.

speech: Hello Prince.
Yes. Hello. How can you best help me, the heir to the throne?
Why are you in the wizards tower?  I am here trying to find a cure for my wasting illness.
I'm here because I choose to be. Are you not aware I can be anywhere I wish? Have you spoken to the Wizard?
I am just here to get help. Do you smell me?
You smell no more or less worse than every other bottom dweller in this kingdom.
Do you know the Cult of the Doomed?
No, I know not. What is this cult you speak of?
I am a member. we believe we will all die soon. You will never be King.
You dare speak like that in my presence?
I am just speaking our cult knowledge. Do not attack me heir. I am contagious.
Contagious you say? Well then I must get rid of these.
Oh yes. Remove your clothes. Members of the cult don't believe in clothing.
Is that so, so you would not accept these clothes as a gift?

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a gravedigger.  I spend the days digging graves in the cemetery behind the church.  I sleep in a small room the priest has given me in return for my services.

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

speech: Time to remove the corpses from gold room again!  The king really doesn't like elves does he?
I used to like them but now that half my week consists of cleaning up this place from their corpses, I've developed a certain hatred against elves... bleh
You and me both - far too many in the kingdom if you ask me.  Glad to see a ruler take initiative like this.
I agree. Now, before we remove the bodies I will have to read a few verses from this bible, as required by our customs.
I will wait in silence as you condemn these souls to eternal torment.

Brothers and sisters, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you do not grieve like the rest of mankind, who have no hope. For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands. Amen.

Amen.  So I've been meaning to ask - do you even bother with individual graves, or do you put them all in one big pit?  I mean, after the sacrifice has been completed and their souls harvested, they are really little more than husks aren't they?
I'll let you in on my little secret. The graveyard is almost full, too many elves are killed lately. We have been burning them in the big barn by the royal graveyard, as the king ordered.
Ah, that makes sense!  I thought I could smell something burning this past week.
Yes, rumors about this are starting to propagate. Now now, let's get these bodies out of there. Help me load them on the cart, will you?
Yes, let us work quickly - I need to get back to look after my kids.  They have a recital tonight.
Oh, you have a family, how lucky. I spend my whole days digging these graves. I do not even have a house, I sleep in a room in the church.
Well, you must have accumulated quite the savings with that frugal lifestyle!
My salary is given to the church. Grave-digging is akin to a cult, it has been like this for centuries.

agent_personas: I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: I need to see the king, please let me pass.
The is expecting no visitor, may i know your reason for visiting?
I need to make a peace accord with him to avoid certain war.
Well, i think it's too late for that, the generals have summoned thier armies already

This needs to be called off.  Your armies will be slaughtered.  My king sent me for one last effort at peace.  I found this chicken pen from our kingdom in the possession of one of your soldiers and it has united all the surroundings kingdoms against you.
Well, we have an advantage you  all don't have
Explain.
That is a secret i can't disclose
Well if it is dragons then you should give up on that.  They will not get off the ground against our wizard hoard.
And you think your Wizard is stronger than ours?
Not necessarily but you are outmatched.  We have a 20 kingdom alliance against you.  Please, don't be foolish!
20 kingdoms you say? You're really mistakened
I just came from the advancing throng, I believe it is you that is mistaken.
We'll see about that when we get to the war front
action: drop a pen for the chickens
