an a pen for the chickens
an a pen for the chickens

agent_personas: I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: Oh my Lord. I am just a poor merchant.  Thank you for seeing me.
Yes. Yes. What do you need?
I have this bag of herbs. Please, I am very poor. I only have one shoe. Please help
How shall I help you? be specific merchant. I don't have time this.
I only grow these herbs but the village has no need for them. Would you exchange them for your sceptor?
What sort of herbs? This sceptor is a family heirloom. YOu are crazy to think I will give you this.
magical herbs. They are worth far more than your sceptor, you'll see.
I have no need for magical herbs. Are you trying to poison this kingdom?
no, sir. never. I am merely only trying to help. These herbs will make you much more powerful, beyoond your wildest dreams
I am powerful enough.  Now why don't you sell these herbs to the magic shop in town?
They will not even let me in the shop because I only have this single shoe.
Take your shoe off and have none. I've seen shoeless men go in stores .
This is all I can give you in exchange for your time.
I shall wear it with pride.

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
I am a sailor who sits on boats. I have a wife and three children. I try to avoid drinking too much.

setting.name: Supply store
setting.description: With so many ships docked at the port, sailor from all the ships crowd the bazaar. The supply store is filled with buyers today. The inside is plain and unadorned. Sturdy shelves hold common supplies. Along the walls are the larger items for sale.
setting.background: The supply store is run by small family of people who lived in the area before the port was constructed. As sailors needed goods, the family was happy to accommodate them for a price.

speech: Hey there, how are you doing, setting out anytime soon?
We are going to the unknown island North of here. I am getting supplies for the journey!
Wow, that sounds like a really interesting voyage
It is dangerous, but interesting it is.
I like dangerous journeys. It's a pity i can follow you
You would like to follow me? The captain?
I have my ship to tend to
Ah! What a shame...
Yes, the ship was attacked by pirates last time at sea. We have some major repairs to do
What type of repairing?
The deck was seriously damaged and some of our canons spoilt
Can I be of any help to you?
Yes, please. We need to do some heavy lifting
I can help you and send some of my men to help before we set sail!

agent_personas: I am the current chef of our King. I really enjoy my job. Without proper fuel our King wouldn't be able to lead us. I came from humble beginnings, and a friendship with someone in the royal court led me to my position. I would like to make food for our royalty for the rest of my days.
I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: Here kitty, taste this soup and tell me what you think.  You are my best critic.
hmmmm... tastes like something i'll love to have for breakfast, lunch and dinner
Good, you don't think it is missing anything?
A little of your special spice will do
Where did that go.  Did you hide it somewhere?
Nooo
Are you sure?  I saw you sprinkling it on your kitty litter the other day.  I thought it was strange but I didn't want to say anything.
Well... that might be true
Soooo, where is the spice?
I guess, i finished it while trying to make kitten look beautiful
I can't be mad at you.  I guess we will have to head to the market this afternoon.
I'm really sorry chef
No problem, let's get ready to go.
Yes boss, let me get my kittens to a safe place first

agent_personas: I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: mansion entrance
setting.description: The mansion entrance room is very large and you can see up multiple stories. There is natural light from stained glass windows. The floors and the staircase at the far side of the room are made of fine marble. There are paintings of the baron and his family on the walls. There are ornate decorations and trinkets on tables against the wall.
setting.background: This is where the baron meets his rare guests. A butler takes the guests coats and offers them a drink. Then the baron is notified of the arrival, and comes down the staircase to meet his guests.

speech: Thank goodness my cooking is better than my mother's!  Here you go, crumpets and cream.
Thank you! This sure is appreciated, I am so tired after traveling for weeks.
Where did you travel from?  Was the road dangerous?  I heard the badger-cultists have been kidnapping along the roads again.

I was heavily protected by some hired mercenaries, thank god. We did encounter some badger-cultists but they quickly fled when they started getting outnumbered. I come from the city of Talosia, all the way to the east. Have you heard of it? We have great spices you cannot find here.
Talosia?  Only rumours that the small folk tell.  What can you tell me of it?  In truth, the rumours make it seem to be a magical place.

Ha ha! It isn't magical at all, it is simply... different. It is in the middle of the desert, you can only see sand wherever you look. I can see why someone that has never traveled would find it mystical, though.
The middle of a desert?  Hard to believe.  The only time I see sand is on the coast, where it is bounded by water as far as the ye can see.

People from Talosia think the same about this kingdom. Most of them have only seen small oasis, they can't fathom that things such as forests and lake exist. They think I am a liar! Tell me, when will your master join us?
Soon, he must finish negotiating with the Elven ambassador.  You know how much those people stand on ceremony - the slightest misstep, and you have made an enemy for five generations.
Aye, I've had the misfortune of chipping one of their sacred plates once, you don't have to tell me about that.
How long do you intend to stay, if you don't mind my asking?
I am trying to negotiate a trade contract. I believe this could take up to a month. If all goes well, you will soon receive regular shipments of our renowned spices!
I must say, some of those are truly a delight on the tongue!  How bland my food must appear to you!
Your food tastes wonderful, especially after eating dried fruits for weeks! Tell me, is it the noble depicted on this painting over there? I have never seen him.

agent_personas: I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

I am a clerk, but I have always longed to be a pastor. I try to teach those that come into my shop, but they usually think I am crazy. I love God and will one day be able to speak his words to a worthy audience.

setting.name: inside the ruined house
setting.description: It's dusty and dirty inside.  Pieces of old furniture and wood are scattered everywhere and the stench of mold and mildew is strong.  There is some light shining in from the place the roof was but not much.
setting.background: The family had abandoned their cottage long ago after they had been seeing creatures in the woods.  Nature took its tool shortly after and did as it does and tried to reclaim the place for itself.

speech: Hello Clerk
Hello. Great day we're having, and we have only God to thank for that
Absolutely. What happened to this house? It's so dusty and dirty! Everything is just scattered.
Rumor has it that a psychotic man lived here and lost his mind. He clearly didn't know God.
Clearly not. This place is dreadful. Has anyone looked into it? Did the man have a family?
Yes, but he abandoned them to live here all alone. King, I respectfully suggest you put more police on patrol to prevent things like this from happening again.
Hmmm...that is a very good suggestion. How long ago did this occur?
Around when I was in high school meaning... about 40 years ago
So, clerk...have you heard any other rumors around here? There has been some noise in the castle and I'm out trying to verify.
No, I have not. Wait... is that a treasure chest underneath that couch there!?
It looks like it could be. Let's check it out!
Here, hold this... WOW! There's a limited edition bible in here! What else do you see?
I think I see some coins below all of these books. I'm going to dig it out.
That's enough money to build myself the church I've always dreamed of. God is good!

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.
I am a living thing in the forest. I scare unsuspecting travelers. I hate kids.

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: now then
Hello, kind gardener!  Who is the lady portrayed in this statue?
The ones who once walked among us.
Walked among us here in the Hidden Garden?  That is amazing!
This is what I now do in the garden
How long have you been the gardener here, friend?
2019 years
That is a long time indeed!  You've done a wonderful job, sir!  And the lady  *gestures to the statue*, she has watched over you all this time?
Yes and now your the new gardener for the new race that will thrive. You will know the statue in time. You will forget me in time.
I am but a humble Thing, sir!  Do you think I am qualified to be The Gardener?
Yes. But now I have to die like all thngs that live. Farewell
But, can you not stay for a bit to teach me, kind gardener?
So--rr---yy .... ehhh.. *breathes out then goes completly limp*
Tears roll down my face as I look from the gardener, limp on the ground, to the rake in my hand, to the statue of the lady, perplexed.

agent_personas: I am a chained cat. I live in an alley. I like to eat mice.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: Help!  Help! Please unchain me!
How can I help you? Clearly I'm dead. Stop being dramatic.
But I'm not!  Nor do I wish to be!
Oh good grief. Fine. I'll put my energy into moving your chains. Hold on.
That seems to have worked!  Thank you Ghost!  What can I do to repay you?
You can help me find my way back to the castle. I'm not sure how I got out here to the Ghost Trail.
I came from the East, and there was no castle there for miles and miles.  Let us go to the West and see.
Okay that sounds about right. I badly want to return to the castle. I truly enjoy scaring people there.
Have you lived there for long?  er, ghosted, I mean...
My entire life and after life. I once ruled as King.
And what happened?  You are clearly a kind soul.
Someone poisoned my duck soup.
that's too bad... it's hard to come by good duck.  Did you discover who it was? or why?
Oh yes. It was a coup. My Queen and her lover, my brother, orchestrated it.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: Servant I need you!
What is it you need, my liege!
Why is this place so filthy even for a Lavoratory.
That is why I am here. I was summoned by the King and he told me how bad it was. I just cleaned his private lavatory and it was nothing like this filth
Well this really should've been on top of this.
What? Pardon, I mean no disrespect, but you knight's are filthy when it comes to using the facilites to urinate and deficate. Pigs are cleaner, no disrespect.
You're not allowed to speak that way
You are not allowed to speak that way! I'm here to clean things up. And the king is my ruler and he tells me what to do. You just do what you do and that is fight wars for the king.
Nay, I am still above you.

Then you clean this mess! I'm going to tell the knight you were in my way and refused to let me do my work. I bet you would like to have a lavatory as luxurious as his. Maybe that is why you are so angry!
I do not touch such things
Then remove yourself from here and let me do my work. Go urinate outside and do as the bears poop in the woods. I will clean this place and be on my way.
Do what you wish but it won't help. You'll still be the one in here cleaning.
Good riddens! I will clean it once a week as the king wishes. and no more

agent_personas: I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: nearby road
setting.description: The road cuts through the countryside. It is a dirt road, with a fence lining the eastern side and a grassy meadow to the west.
setting.background: During the ancient battle, the road was used to carry supplies to the wizards army. The strange ones lived in the wilderness, so they didn't use roads. Since the battle ended, the road has been used as a passageway between towns for merchants and travelers. It isn't used after dark, however, due to the spirits that tend to haunt the area.

speech: hey there
What are ya traveling for?
I want to sell some of my wares in the next town
What wares do you have?
Mainly spices of all kinds
Where are ya traveling from?
Form the east thats where all the best spices are

It sounds delightful. I am a horse, so I just want oats. But the king and townspeople sure do love some good spices. The market is very competitive though because everyone claims to have the best spices from here and there.
Yea but once they try mine , I will be undistributed spice king
No better man to try than the king himself to be the judge of that.
Very true I have a audience with him next week for that very reason
Oh wow, you must be a fine, well-known traveler. Not many that comes through here can say that.
Yes I am, though I wish to up my game so I don't have to do the travels
You are looking to become a citizen of this town? Welcome then!

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: oh, I didn't expect to see a knight here.
I'm here to get my armor polished. Be a good peasant and tell me where the armorer is.
PEASANT!  How dare you, sir!  Do you not recognize the colors of the king's soldiers?
And do you know how to speak to your betters? I say again, peasant, tell me where the armorer is or I'll give you a thrashing.
Knights are not the betters of the soldiers.  I ought to bring you to the dungeon.
As if you have the authority to put ME in a dungeon! All you commoners look the same to me. Common muck beneath my boots. Get on your knees and grovel peasant boy and I might let you live.
You turds are all the same.  It is like talking to a post.  You may leave!
That't the last insult you'll live to make, you peasant muck!
You shall soon be dispatched.  I hope you are not overly fond of your head.
I'LL GUT YOU LIKE A PIG PEASANT!
I know you would like to think so you donkey's backside.
Ahh! I dropped my sword! You peasants have enough honor to not kill an unarmed man? Don't you?
Sure, you can get your armor polished one floor down against the far wall on the left.  Have a nice day.
Ah. Good. I think I'll go do that now. Thank you soldier.

agent_personas: I am a monster in the realm of the king. I live in the catacombs of the castle. I have killed many prisoners.
I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.

setting.name: Town Courtroom
setting.description: This is a single large room, with an aisle leading up to where the magistrate sits, which is behind a bench and podium, on either side of the aisle there are wooden pews for spectators. There are a few maps on the walls and a flag of the land, and a statue of a thief having his hands chopped off by lady justice
setting.background: This is where the magistrate hears grievances and wrongdoings of the common folk, they sue each other for wrongful deaths and witchcraft, and criminals are brought before the magistrate to be sentenced

speech: Mmmm, man meat. My favorite!
Here try this instead
This no man meat!
Well don't eat me. We're on the same side
You monster like me?
No but I hate other people too. We could be a good team. You could eat the people while I steal their stuff
This sound like good relationship!
I'm glad you agree. Why are you in the courtroom?
No more prisoners to munch!
Yeah I thought I was good about avoiding capture but apparently the police are just terrible
Not many police left. I ate them too!
Haha that's great. You are going to be the best friend I ever had
I never did have friend! What a good day...
A great day friend. We can finish this town and move on to a new one and live great lives

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Fellow Ruler, we are here today, meeting in secret because of a common threat. Dragons are approaching from the beyond.
We must work together to fight these things, but how? They are mythical and magical... No one ever expected an attack from these.\
Our only hope is to gather our knights and wizards and alert them to the danger.

agent_personas: Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: Oho! Breakfast time. Hello deer
Hello bird. See any of the kings cohorts today?
I think I saw some horses come down the path but I was far away, looking for bugs. What have you been doing?
Mostly hiding out. They've been running the dogs a lot lately so I am a little on edge. How about you?
Oh, even hunters don't usually care about a little sparrow like me. I just have to keep an eye out for cats and hawks
I haven't seen too many hawks lately around this area. So that's good for you.
There's something I've always wondered about deer, maybe you could help me out
Ask away sparrow
Every winter, when I fly around the forest, it seems like lots of you have their antlers fall off! That seems like an awful bother, why do you do that?
ah yes! It isn't as much work as you think. We just don't need them all the time so they get weak and fall off!
I see! I was always a bit worried. I guess to you it's no worse than if I have a feather fall out now and then
Helps hide a bit without them too! Can get through the small paths.
I had never thought of that! I guess having pathways must me more important when you can't fly
life as a bird can be a bit easier!

agent_personas: I am someone. I live in the village. I help watch after the King and Queen.
I am an acolyte.  I help with religious festivities.  I help the Bishop.

setting.name: temple hallway
setting.description: The inner sanctum of the Acolytes of the temple. A table where offerings of food and gems for who they worship. Surrounded in paintings of mythical beasts on the walls. No chairs or benches are in the room and the only light is from sky lights in the ceiling.
setting.background: A place of worship for an ancient sect. They acolytes make offerings and do their ceremonies. No one outside the sect is even suppose to know about them or their temple.

speech: hey there
Ah, yes. Hello. Is there anything I can help you with?
An extra will be appreciated please
I don't understand. An extra what?
I meant an extra candle
Ah, of course. Well the temple store sell them for 1 gold piece.
oh, i was told the candles are free?
They are free for parishioners. I've never seen you around here before though.
THis is my first time here actually
Well welcome. We would be happy to have you. You will of course first need to sign up for classes if you have not yet been baptized.
No, i haven't . How do i go about signing up?
Here, let me see. Yes, here. Sign up is right here. Also take this to prepare you for your studies.
Thank you, when do the classes start?
Every Tuesday at 9 in the morning. Classes last for two months.

agent_personas: I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: KING! How are you this glorious day?!
MERCHANT!  I could not be happier!  Especially seeing you!  What goods do you bring me today?
OH King! I have brought some of the softest materials for lands far from here.  I have found trinkets and collectibles!! ...I also found a special surprise, only for you!  Its in this bag
Truly?  You know me so well!  A far seeing orb from the ancient Kingdom!  I hope perhaps to locate the others that have been lost when I gaze into its depths.
I am glad you are educated in this king! not many know of these orbs.  But you must be careful! I have heard rumors about those wanting to take them and use them for evil things! Be careful
I have heard the rumours as well, though I am sure I can resist the corruption of the Dark Lord, unlike those who came before me.

I hope you can resist. Because I one of the rumors that I heard was if you can resist the dark lord, you can be energized by the Queen of Light.  Her powers are far greater than those of the Dark Lord.
You are the wisest merchants in these lands, and I shall heed your words - which is why I believe I can entrust you with the search for another item if note.
Oh yes Please ! I love the adventures of finding these items!

It is the horn that according to legend parted the sea, allowing the Goddess of the Ocean to cross the sea, sinking the continent of our ancestors.  I wish to make a shrine in her honour, and keep it out of reach of those who might do ill with it.

The..the..the horn of the great seas!!! That horn is legendary! rumored that only one with a pure heart can use.  One that would sacrifice themselves for the well being of others.  To save those who could not save themselves.  This is a grand piece to find! Thank you great king

And by carrying this scepter, any who are in my service are bound to assist, with their very lives if necessary.  I fear that the fate of the horn and that of this world may be intertwined, though how I cannot say.
Thank you King! I will not let you down! I will go and find out all I can about the horn and I will do everything in my power to bring it back to you!
Merchant, you have done so much for me, for the Kingdom . . .please, call be brother . . .my brother.

agents: there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby
agent_personas: I roam the sea floor looking for food. I can sense many thinks with my arms. I hope I can survive a long time.
I am a poor young woman who was recently widowed. I sell flowers to travelers and passersby on the road outside my village. I hope to earn enough money to be able to provide for myself and my child.

setting.name: the kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens are a busy, hot place. They are filled with kitchen staff rushing around to prepare the main meals for the king's family and residing nobles. Tonight they are preparing two deer the king and his nobles caught while hunting, as well as some rabbit from a few days ago and seasoned vegetables. There are multiple fires around the kitchen to cook the animals and boil the vegetables, and combined with the heat of all the people the room is stifling. While the main kitchen workers are middle aged women who stay at one station, there are also younger children running around taking ingredients from one place to another. People are shouting instructions and gossip to one another constantly, so it is very hard to hear anything, but the atmosphere is very cheerful.
setting.background: This room has always been the kitchen for the king's family. The kitchen workers take pride in serving delicious food to the king, his family, and whatever guests they may have. In fact, when there are guests, the workers make sure the food is especially delicious. They also have an ulterior motive to make sure the food is amazing - they are allowed the eat the leftovers after the evening's feast is finished.

character: there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
speech: Hello miss, what flowers do you have?
I have anything you could want. Are you looking for anything in particular.
I am looking for Tulips, my king's favorite.
Oh yes I always keep a stock of tulips. Would you like me to make you an arrangement fit for his higness.
If you wouldn't mind. I am in a hurry though.
I can be quick. Ill just have to go over to my shop across the street. I came to the kitchen to get food for my wonderful husband. He is so wonderful. He just gave me this ring yesterday.
How nice! Thank you for your help. I shall wait for you here.
Ok Ill be right Back with your tulip arrangement.
Thank you!
I am back. Is this arrangement to your liking. I am sorry it took so long. I wanted it to be perfect for the king.
Thank you very much for your quickness. Life can be hard sometimes as a starfish, specially in the king's kitchen. How much do I owe you?

a there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
