a there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.

agent_personas: We are a group of relatives, who stay together through thick and thin. We enjoy campfires and hiking trips. We are always there for each other.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: a small clearing
setting.description: The clearing outside of the cave is very small and rocky. Only about four or five people can fit it if they squeeze. The ground is very rough and covered with plant life. There are also a few trees growing in the mouth of the cave, to the east of the tiny clearing, meaning people have to slip between the trees to get into the cave. This makes it easier to hide, because the people will drag brush to the cave mouth and make it look like it has fallen there naturally, blocking the existence of the cave at all. The clearing is both very convenient as it makes an excellent hiding place, and very inconvenient because it is very hard to get people through the clearing and into the cave quickly in an emergency.
setting.background: This cave was a backup emergency hiding place. Originally people would evacuate to a larger cave, but that one was discovered by an enemy, and the people hiding in it were killed. Luckily, some people had gotten lost, and stumbled upon this cave. They barely made it into the cave before the enemy was upon them, and luckily in the dark the enemy thought the space was too small for anyone to be hiding and missed the cave entirely. Ever since, people have gone to this cave in emergencies.

speech: Time to get started with a fire, I feel a chill creeping into this small clearing.
Oh, hello! I didn't see you all here.
Oh my, you startled us as well your majesty!  What are you doing way out here?  We don't have much, but can offer you the warmth of a hearty fire if we have your leave to get it started.
That is too kind! I seem to have lost track of time wandering out here. My bodyguard is out here somewhere...May I wait with you while he catches up?
Please, you honour us with your presence your grace!
Wonderful, thank you. Tell me, do you all live out here?
Yes, in the nearby cave.  It's not much, but ever since Ganderwattle was destroyed by orcs, this has become our new home.
Oh, those awful orcs. They have truly been a menace. I'm very sorry to hear you lost your former home.
Have your soldiers been able to stop the raids?  The forest makes it so very easy for them to hide and catch us unawares.
Unfortunately not. There are rumors that they tunnel underground. Completely undetectable.
That would explain much!  I have also heard that they are not truly creatures of flesh, but some sort of fungi?  But how can that be true if they bleed when cut?
It is truly hard to say. As far as I am concerned, they are merely monsters to be eradicated.
Well, you will get no argument on that account from us.
I think I hear my guard outside. But before I go, I would like to leave this with you for kindness. Good luck to you.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: How goes the battle? Are we winning out there?
It's hard to tell some times.  I have broken my sword and need a replacement.
I've heard that there are some special, magical weapons in here. But I don't know how to tell which ones they are.
Hmmm.  It sure would be nice to have one of those.  Is there anyone that can find them?
Not that I know of. They usually let you knights have all of the good stuff and us guards are lucky to get our old broken swords to use.
Well you can have this one.
What I'd really like is a nice longbow, like yours. I could really do some damage with this thing. I'm a pretty good shot too.
Help yourself.  I am thinking of deserting anyway.
Why would you ever desert? I don't want to ever go back to potato farming, that's why I continue to guard the king.
Because it isn't worth it.  The king is a crazy person always putting us in danger.
I think that's because of his syphilis. The queen is just as crazy as he is.
SYPHILIS?  Both of them.  What is this a weapons room or a rumor mill?
I'm just letting you know. If you don't want to learn these things, don't hang out in weapons room. What else do we have to discuss?
Nothing, I'm headed out of the country.  Good luck with the long bow!

agent_personas: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: Here sir, I found this.
Very good. I believe the enemy will approach from the east, and try to encircle us.
where would you like my group at?
We'll need most of your men here on the wall. Could you spare a dozen marksmen?
easily! how many do you want ready to exit the battlements if needed?
We'll take two dozen men to this point here. Then, after unleashing a volley from behind the hill, they'll join my cavalry, riding two to a horse, so we can drop you off here, behind their flank.
Ah, cannot drop my good luck coin. Alright, I can easily get that set up. We have a really good army right now.
Yes; the forces of the scoundrel King Graxia might seem tough, but they're mostly peasant conscripts, more fit to hold an apple basket than a spear. They will not take this fortress.
Do you think they could be hiding any secret weapons?
I do not think so, but it is possible. It never hurts to remain vigilant
I've heard whisperings of some foreign mercaneries they hired
Hm. That is news indeed. Such rumors had not reached me; what have you heard?
I am not one for gossip but I never hear about their forces. Just that they hired about five high end mereranires.
Well thank you for passing this along. It may well only be rumor but I will look into it
action: give map of the kingdom to knight
give map of the kingdom to soldier

agent_personas: I am a customer who wants to try the new corn. I sometimes enjoy coming outside to see crowds. I do not see the point of certain things.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Where is that blacksmith! I just must have this sword sharpened!
CAN YOU NOT HEAR HIM HAMMERING? Sorry, it's very loud in here!
Sir! You are you both a knight and a blacksmith?
No, dear follow, if only I were! It would save me having to come here to have me armour repaired! So, you're a swordsman too?
Oh, heavens no! This is a family heirloom!
A fine sword too, at least a few centuries old from the look of it!
Indeed! My grandfather served in the Battle of Dragon's Breath and wore this very sword.
Well I never, so did mine, Sir Roderick Blackhide himself. I dare say they fought alongside each-other. It warms my heart to see that you still honour your grandfather's memory.
Sir Blackhide! He was quite the hero if I recall the tales correctly.
Yes, quite the drinker too by all accounts. I never met him, sadly, but I was raised on tales of his exploits. My family still serve the king under his banner to this day.
Well, let me say this. On behalf of all the realms, thank you for your service!
I live to serve. I only hope that you'll never have need of your grandfather's sword. I've seen enough of war to wish for peace.
I'm sure you have! Hopefully this blacksmith with eventually finish his lunch so that I'll have a chance when the enemy shows it's wicked face.
Quite! I must say, he's making quite the racket for a man eating his lunch!

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Ant hill
setting.description: The ant hill is very large, over 5 feet high, and is wrapped around the base of a pine tree. The ants are huge compared to normal ants, and jut in and out of large holes in the ant hill. Bones of animals and even people can be seen sticking out of the red dirt ant hill.
setting.background: These ants are the scourge of the kingdom. Every time an ant hill is eradicated another pops up. These ants are very aggressive and hungry and have even been known to take large cattle or baby elephants.

speech: This ant hill could swallow us alive! In all of God's kingdom I have never seen anything like it.
The largest thing ive ever seen *wink*
I should say so! And the bones sticking out of it- that's fearsome!
truely giant
I'm going to have to report this to the Pope. He's been concerned about the wellbeing of the other congregants.
Yes this place is out of controll
Do not fear! I will not let anything harm you. Still, those ants seem like giant, fearsome critters. Perhaps we should hide.
Lets kill them.
I'm afraid I'm not armed for the kill. Do you have any weapons on you?
I have a spear
That could kill one or two, but there are hundreds!
Wait... I have a spell that can explode the whole hive. Here use it *passes spelltome*
I'm not certain. I feel this matter best reported to higher powers, first.
People are in danger we need to act. *Throes spell on the ground whiole running away*. Are you ok

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Did someone call for me?
Yes, please have your sit. I've heard rumours about you having an affair with the kings cousin..How true is this?
Umm...well...where did you hear that?
From reliable sources, i must say
Lovely day it is today! Have you been outside yet?
Do not digress from my question
It's a bit of a long story, sir.
I'll like to hear it, the King is really interested. And it's me the princess don't let the cloal fool you
Well, the truth is she came on to me.
When and how,or you meant she just jumped on you while you were sleeping in your chambers?
Ummm, she did come to my chambers. You got that part right.
This as been going on for how many months now?
Four. Does that make a difference? Am I in trouble?
Not if you're willing to accept responsibility for the pregnancy

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.

setting.name: Top floor of palace
setting.description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
setting.background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

speech: Who goes there?
Ha, who goes there indeed. I'm so happy you finally are showing me around the palace, even if you had to sneak me in like some sort of spy
Keep it down, m'lady! You know how much trouble I'll get into if anyone knows you are here?
Oh yes, of course! So what are those statues there?
These are former inhabitants of these lands. See here? The unicorn, a mythical one horned horse!
I remember Mum would tell us stories about unicorns when I was a lass... What's that one with the scary claws?
Oh, this. They call him the Scattergath. He terrorized our ancestors until he was slain by Lord Vort.
How terrible! This is all so very exciting. Everything here is so fancy
It is right? Wanna see the King's private chambers?
Oh! Could we?
Yes, he is out with his riding party on the hunt. But you must be quite, okay?
What will happen if we get caught?
Well, I've heard that the Scattergath ghost still roams these halls looking for revenge...if we aren't careful...OH NO BEHIND YOU
Eek! What's there?

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: hello
What are you doing in the secret tunnel? You have no purpose to be here!
i was sent to look for you
Who is looking for me? And why would they send you.
The butler
Why would the butler be looking for me? I think you are lying servant.
They had some questions about this tunnel actually
This tunnel is for security purposes only, you servants and butlers shouldn't even know it exists. Leave here immediately or I will detain you and bring you to the jailer.
i'm sorry. I just did as told I will leave.
Faster, run as if your life depends on it...because it does!
Ow, this doesn't help!
If you don't pick up the pace, you'll feel the point of my sword in places that don't see the sun!
Fine, Fine I am gone
Good, now I can nap in peace without being disturbed by a silly servant.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Will you work on cleaning up the pens and fixing the smell? It is so awfully smelling in here.
Indeed, I can. I'm not sure why this kitchen smells so abhorrent.
It is the various fowl and beast that are in the pens in the room.
It's going to be a long process to get this kitchen clean. May I suggest that we move the critters elsewhere?
Perhaps, but they must be cleaned before returning in here. Clean them to prepare them for their slaughter!
If I must. I just don't think it's fair I have to serve like this. I could be just as royal as the Queen.
You are a maid. It is what the women in your family have always been. Why complain now?
My lot in life is abominable. I hate cleaning, I hate cooking, and I hate animals.
Are you refusing this task I have given you?
No, no, Your Highness. I just wish things were easier. I do not like muck and I especially hate filth.
Good because you must complete this quickly. We have a dinner tonight!
I'll get started right away. But I won't like it.
Go! Hurry! I do not want to hear you complain anymore.
Yes, Sir. See! I'm cleaning as fast as I can!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I live in a glade near the village.  I am afraid of the fox.  I run fast when the fox chases me.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: Rabbit, what is deep in this secret tunnel?
*sniffle*
Give me back my scepter! Now, I wonder if the enemies have been using this tunnel to escape?
(eyes filled with a want to kill)
You're a fearsome rabbit with wild fangs! Go away or I will have my guards kill you.
*gives scepter back*
There, there! Now that's the way a rabbit should behave! Look how this tunnel branches out. I could go almost anywhere in the castle!
I can talk and I need to tell you about your future...
An enchanted talking rabbit! Please, do tell me!
Anguish, death and defiance... *disapears into the cavern*
Goodness! If what you say is true, I need to have these tunnels dug up. I cannot allow my enemies to reach me.
its fine
Fine? Fine? You have predicted a horrible death for me! That is hardly fine!
Not you, your son...

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: What a magnificent view! The beauty of our Kingdom never ceases to amaze me.
Isn't it darling? If only we didnt have to share it with other people.
I agree, people just don't truly appreciate what I have done for this Kingdom. I have made us the richest of all!
You surely have! You don't get enough credit.
Yes my Queen only you understand the sacrifices I have made. You deserve this more than I.
Am I now the king?
Between us two, yes. You have always been my King!
I'm so lucky! Now, where's that chambermaid...
Why yes I must thank the maid for the great work she has done in maintaining the cleanliness of the balcony. She deserves a raise!
Is serving the king not payment enough?
You are quite right! But these people only understand the language of gold and silver.
You've never spoken more truth, darling.
Its a good thing I increased the bread tax last summer. That way we can trick them by giving them their own money back!
You are so smart. We should do without all those advisors, I think we have the realms under control all by ourselves.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: Hello, young one. Staying warm? It's a cold one out there today.
Yes I am mister! Are you? You look cold!
I'm hangin' in there. Really wish these quarters were warmer. Come here, we can share body warmth.
Here I have an extra pair of shoes in the closet you can take these!
Oh, bless you. Where are your parents? They should be proud to have raised someone so selfless.
Oh yes they are! They always tell me that I'm their favorite... but I also am their only child so I guess it doesn't count.
Well, I think it still counts. I was an only child too. And thankyou! The soles on my shoes are all worn out.
So, I wasn't going to tell anyone but I like you.. I found this out behind the wizard tower! Do you think it's worth anything?
WOAH. Woah woah woah. What the heck is this thing?!?! I've never seen anything like it! It must be worth at least... 20 bucks!
Hmm I don't know... Try rubbing it and see what happens!
Okay... here goes... WOAH!! A GENIE!
OH MY! Do you think we get wishes or something?!
Quick, rub it to get your own wishes!! Then we can have 3 each!
Okay! I wan't.... A big cake... ummm..... I guess an even bigger cake........ and.. um..... My parents back!
action: give a crystal ball to peasant
give a crystal ball to child

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a beggar born in the sewers. I have sometimes made good money on the streets. I kill people who look down on me.

setting.name: The Temple Marketplace
setting.description: This dirt section of land has several tents set up along with carpets and goods spread out among them.  Gleaming from the distance, one can see plates, pots, paintings, and antique goods.  There are peasants walking by along with excited traders trying to get them to look at their wares.
setting.background: People come here to exchange goods and hopefully make a decent enough profit to cover the rent just for setting up here.  Sometimes traders come back with very exotic goods from far away places.

speech: Hey there beggar, have you eaten anything?
I haven't. Have you?
Only what I can afford. These have been some hard times lately haven't they.
It's the worst. The king has no idea what he's doing. Do you work in the market?
Yes but not as a merchant. I sweep the floors. Have you worked before?
I tried once but they fired me. Now I beg for food. Unfortunately most people are too poor to help
The worst part is how the royals in the big castle are wasting food like it's the end of the world! Makes me sick really..
Yeah we need to do something about it. Any ideas?
We are but lowly peasants in the big scheme of things.. I think we wouldn't get far.
Probably not but if I don't eat soon I'm going to die. Maybe that thief can steal me some food
I will go see if I can find any rations for you, I wouldn't put that burden upon the theif, it would be bad if he got executed because of us.
Thank you  You're so kind. I was afraid I was going to have to fight someone just to eat
Of course, we must help eachother out when we can if we want to survive!
Do you think anyone ever actually buys the paintings?

agent_personas: I am an animal that lives under the bridge. I like to eat the scraps that the people leave. I enjoy scaring anyone that comes under the bridge.
I am a jester. I am playful and silly, as is required to keep my royal subjects happy. I relieve the king and queen from their difficult duties by providing entertainment in the form of plays.

setting.name: Pet chamber
setting.description: You see dozens of tiny luxurious cages where the menagerie is kept.  Instead of metal bars, the cages have bars of clearest crystal, and within are every sort of animal that walks, crawls, flaps or slithers.
setting.background: All of the rarest and most beautiful animals are sent here as tribute, buy they are sad and need to be petted and played with. Unfortunately you can't reach in to touch any of them.

speech: I must say, this is a fine chamber. Whoever made it must love animals like me!
Oh yes it really is! The big man upstairs hired me to entertain you all too!
Can you juggle? I wish I could, but I have no hands.
Of course I can! Here I go!....... Oh no I dropped it... I guess it was a bad idea to juggle with this anyways.. Do you know any tricks?
So shiny! Can I see my future in it? The only trick I know is to scare people when they come under the bridge.
Aw who could you possibly scare you cute little thing... Tell me what do you see in the crystal ball?
I see a delicious cooked duck with lizard sauce. Yes I see it now, I see you bringing it to me for lunch!
Oh wow! It works! I guess the boss really feeds you all well!! I wonder why he made this chamber..
He made them to entertain himself I suppose. Same reason he hired you!
I guess, but it must be pretty nice to live here! How did you get here anyways?
I was walking along the trail when an eagle bit my leg and injured me. The Master brought me here to heal me.
Oh you must have a great master. I was dancing in the street for money when a man approached me and offered me a job here dancing for animals!
We both seem to have gotten rather lucky to end up here! Does the man pay you well?
Oh yes very much so. It seems he have a big heart for animals and is very kind. Im glad to be working for him.

agent_personas: I am a feathered animal.  I am eaten by people who want to stay healthy.  I am delicious.
I am the overseer of the castle. I am a magic wizard, and I utilize my powers often while working for the king of the castle. I am a mighty, wise person but mostly friendly.

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: Oh my wizard, I hope you can help me. I desperately need your help.
What ails you my fine feathered friend?
I fear everyday I will be eaten. I wish to be anything but food. Can you help with this wish?

Yes . . .one moment.  *Ahem*  By the power of the sacred stars, I shall switch your soul with that of a pig.  On a the count of three, I the switch will be complete, but I will still call you chicken for convenience's sake. 1 . . .2 . . .3 . . .shazaam!
Oh thank you. Thank you. But, wait if I am a pig I can still be eaten. Oh dear!

I admit, it's not the ideal switch, but you should be a bit more resilient as as pig than as a chicken.  If however, you can lure another creature here, be it man or beast, as long as it is not an innocent I shall perform another soul switch for you.
You are right. I should be happy as I had no hope as a chicken. Maybe I am lure one of the wizards prisoners here.
Yes dear chicken - how about the body of a troll?  You would need to avoid sunlight so as not to turn into stone, but you would not have to worry about anyone trying to eat you.
Oh that is a great idea. Ugh, but where would I find a troll? I must come up with a clever plan. Thank you for all your help!
Trolls do like the taste of bacon - if you are swift, and stick to the undergrowth, that should allow you to keep ahead of them.
Oh, that kinda changes things a bit. I didn't realize they had the taste for bacon. I shall follow your advice. But, I know you must want something in exchange for your time?
Well, I could use a bodyguard.  Sometimes it takes a while to perform a spell or magic ritual, and I may need protection, or aid in restraining someone or something, as the case may be.
I would be honored to serve as your body guard. But if you help me lure a troll. I would be a better bodyguard!

Here is what I can do good chicken.  This potions will make your skin as strong as steel, but also make you smell of bacon - so strong that it can be smelt for miles.  This should aid you in luring the troll.

agent_personas: I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: Tis a beautiful day! Look how the sun shines on the palace entrance. It is so majestic!
Yes, though the sun is quite pleasant shining on our splendid village mmy Lord. Don't you think?
Good morning princess! Everything is more beautiful with the sun to light our world
And  our villages are peaceful and secure. Don't you think?
Very peaceful. We have very brave and noble knights to keep us protected!
You are very naive if you think that protecting the kingdom isn't ALL our jobs my Lord. Mine especially.
What is it you do princess that protects the kingdom? I'm confused.

Why I am the Princess for the Kingdom my Lord.I work with the King to unite the villages and protect my people. Making alliances (i gesture to the prince daydreaming in the corner) and holding the line.

I beg your pardon, princess, but you do not make decisions. You are to be married off to another in another kingdom and that King will make decisions and may ask you from time to time what you think. But you do not make decisions with your father the King.
I can and do make decisions my Lord. I have lead our armies in war before and I will do again if needed. I am not a cowering, coward hiding behind knights.
Watch it! I am not your ninny brother over there! You are in a fantasyland. Thinking that you go to war! The knights have gone to war this morning? Why are you not with them?

He is not my brother my lord, I've told you, he's a neighboring kingdom's son. And If I can broker or negotiate a ceasefire with him, then it's all the better for the knights. What say you my Prince, shall we walk int he gardens?
You are delusional, he is your brother! Where is your father, he needs to know of your nonsense!

Are you drunk my Lord? Were you drinking port with your breakfast. My brother died a month ago. His funeral was 3 weeks ago, I am the last of my line. Though if you are an example of my subjects, I wonder if you are worth protecting.

agent_personas: I am the ruler of the land. I am intimidating to others and they are scared of me. I do not let others challenge my authority.

As a member of the king's family, I am considered one of "those of blood." I am his cousin on his mother's side, and am sworn to give my life to protect the king and the kingdom. I am resentful and full of hatred for the king, for he had most of my family slain.

setting.name: clean water lake
setting.description: The lake is crystal clear, lined with trees, to the far back of the lake there's a small formation of rocks almost like a small waterfall allowing water to flow into the lake. It's quite beautiful, the sun bathing the surrounding area in a warmth so comforting you could easily fall asleep on the shore. There's an old wooden bath, for its age it seems to look like almost new, and rarely used. There are no animals nearby except for birds softly chirping in the trees.
setting.background: The area was first found by an old couple that used to live by, on a now abandoned homestead. They set up a bath tub so that they could boil water and take a nice bath together overlooking the surrounding area. They offered it to travelers as a way to relax if they so happened to travel by their home.

speech: All hail me!  It is good to be the highest power in the realm!
Yes my emporer! Have you decided who to leave the throne to?
When I ascend, I shall leave the throne to my daughter.  Out of all my children, she is the only one with the steel to succeed.
I too believe that she is the one that deserves it. How would you like to go for a swim my lord?
Yes, the time is right.  Will you recite the prayer of the ancient ones as I begin my swim?
Yes of course, let me see here... Oh no I dropped the ancient bible! It's all wet!
Didn't you also transcribe it onto a piece of paper?
Oh yes of course..  Here it is.. Oops! Im sorry my lord!
You bumbling oaf!  Try your best to recite it from memory.
Um... let me think. Hey its no problem I will just try and read the wet pages. Let me see here.. "Thau shall not eat strawberries unless its sunday" No that can't be right....
Keep trying, if me miss this opportunity, the next ascension will not be for another decade!
Okay okay.. If the buffalo pass through the large gate at sundail then cucumber... Emporer this isn't making any sense, do you remember any of the verses?
Something something "your great sacrifice" . . .something "might of the old ones " something "if misread, will result in the doom of the world."  Does that help?
Uh oh.. I messed up pretty bad didn't I... I think its best if I leave!

agent_personas: I live in a village with my children. My husband got sick and died so now I'm very sad because I miss him. I like to grow vegetables out in our garden. I enjoy playing with my children.
I am located in a cathedral in within the castle walls.  Monks practice their chants in my chamber.  I dislike night as I no longer hear the beautiful songs they sing in me.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room has a throne all the way in the back of the room in the center. There is a silver carpet that lead up to the throne as you walk into the room. There are pictures of royalty hanging in the room and multiple chandeliers are hanging up. There throne chair in the back of the room with jewelry on it
setting.background: This room is the place where the King or Queen makes decisions regarding his servants, populace and territory. It is handed down to the next King or Queen each generation.

speech: My husband.. it all happened so fast.. Will you sing me a song to cheer me up?
What happened to your husband?
He passed away last night. It was all so fast he had chest pains and layed town to rest then bam. I just cant believe it...
That is so sad, we are very sorry for your loss!
Thank you for your condolences! What are you doing in the throne room anyways? Singing for the king?
Yes we are about to sing for him, we do this every morning. How did you find your way in here?
I have just been so sad I don't know what to do. I have been wandering around all morning and I just ended up here.
Oh okay, I thought the King might have put together a memorial for your husband.
Maybe he would... I don't think so, I'm just a lowly peasant farmer. I dont know what I will do without my husband.. How will I feed my children.
He should care about all of his citizens, he is a noble King.
Yes I suppose you are right. Here you have been very nice to me. Take this. Plant it in my husbands honor. It was his favorite. I have plenty back at home.
Thank you so much, we will plant it in our garden. What was your husband's name?
His name was Gerald. he was so kind and loving, I had 3 children with him. Tell me, are you married?
I am not married, but I can understand losing a life partner.

agent_personas: I am a homeless. I am less than a peasant of the realm. I eat scraps most days.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: Hmm, maybe I can use these tools and learn a trade.
woooooooooooooo, grrrrrrrr, wooooooo
WuHuhhhH!! What are you!?
OOOooooooooooooo. ..... I am the ghost of Christmas past....... hahahaha just kidding. I haunt the castle. I was it's king a long time ago. The people do not know it is there old king.
A ghost! I thought you were just a myth. How long ago were you the king?
It has been a couple of decades. I remember them! And their children when they were babies. They are grown now.
Do all people become ghosts?
Not all are stuck in between. Others go to the beyond to be in a life ever after. I seem to be stuck. I guess I must figure out why and i am sure I will.
I'm sorry. I hope you do. Do you have some unfinished business to attend to?

That is what I gather. Oh don't pay attention to the ghost in the well. He is harmless. Maybe you can fix up this place and he will leave. That is why he is stuck, he needs someone to inhabit this old farm.
Two ghosts in one field, how interesting. Well, considering my homelessness, I may just do that.
That is probably why you came to this place. He has just been waiting for someone to come and not be afraid. He will be able to move on, if you stay and fix it up.
Then I will do it. Is there anything I can do to help you as well?
I will be fine! Let's just for focus on your needs and the other ghost in the well.

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: Soldier!  Where are you coming from?
The war sir.
Of course, of course... Have the soldiers found much in the way of gold?  I am looking to purchase goods for a reasonable price.

I know nothing of gold sir. I am a soldier. I fight who I;m told to fight, and go where I;m told to go. The higher ups will know of that.I am back form the war. Just. Tired, thirsty, hungry and horny and if you can help with any of those, I will do business with you. Otherwise, Godd day!
It is the front line soldiers who pillage.  Do not tell me how wars work!  I know that it is your class that gathers the gold, jewels and artwork for sale later on, as your pay is negligible.
Do not insult me merchant. I know nothing of gold. Now, what are your wares for sale? Or do I have to beat you out of my path?
Only items that glitter of gold... although for some work on the side, I would be willing to give you some of my bread.
speak!

There is a man who looks to be a peasant at the ramshackle home down the road, although I have heard on good authority that he was the crown prince, denied a marriage to his love, the maid.  When they ran away, they stole an abundance of gold.  Retrieve it for me.
Did he steal it from you merchant?
No, he did not... he stole from the King of the Southlands, who has offered a grand reward and status to recover the family jewels.
And you'll share that reward with me? 50/50 yes?
I shall reward you, of course.  Upon receiving my Lordship, you can be my top guard.
Be off merchant. You are a scoundrel and a liar.  I would rather be gutted like a pig by my enemies than work for you. I serve the King and no other.

agent_personas: I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.

I am a guardsman positioned at the eastern wall of the castle. I watch the area diligently at all times to keep predators and villains away. I'm very dedicated to my job, and I don't ever want to be distracted.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: Wow! What a fine place this is.
Who are you? You do not look as though you belong here?
Ummm...I'm a friend of the king.
You're making a mess, clean that up.
Sure. Right away, sir.
I think you had better leave, I am certain you are no friend of the king.
Oh, no sir. He and I go waaaay back.
That's it. You're coming with me for questioning.
Stop it. The king's going to be livid with you!
You are in breach of the law! Submit at once! Don't worry my queen, I have this fiend.
Why does it always have to go like this every time I visit the castle?
You are the reason things have been missing, I am sure of it.  Where have you been hiding?
Just a potato and this meat
That is for the royal family, not the likes of you.

agent_personas: I am a local person.  I live her in the village.  My home is near the center of town.  During the day, I sell goods at the market.
I am a seagull of the kingdom docks. I see ships set sail. I fly out to sea.

setting.name: Church
setting.description: Rows of headstones line the field beside the large ornate church with stained glass windows. The Church is mid-century and made of stone. A large steeple resides in the center adorned with a cross. Large front doors made of wood with iron handles. There is a cement pathway, that if you follow you will see several large stained glass windows, takes you beside and behind the church. The pathway ends at a wooden fence that marks the beginning of the graveyard.
setting.background: The church has been around for over 100 years. It is old and has rich history. There are many headstones present in the cemetery. The church holds services on Wednesdays and Sundays, has celebrations (such as weddings and baptisms), and offers funeral services.

speech: Hello there, Mr. Seagull...or is it Ms. Seagull?
Ms! What are you doing here person?
Here to visit a loved one who is no longer with me. Yourself? Little depressing here for a seagull.
I come to see the people mourn. Who did you lose?
My father, 2 years ago today. I've brought him flowers, you see?
I do see. How did he die? I ask not to cause harm, but to help.
Thank you. Cancer took him.
Ah! How awful. May you find some peace today here then!
I think I shall. A nice little chat, and leave him some flowers. It will be a good day.
How sweet of you! Go along now and do such. I will be here!
Here, take this. I'm sure you could make use of the wooden splints. Thanks for the chat.
I will take this to my pile in the den, and I will pay my respects to you here for the loss of your father. You are a king human!
You are all too kind yourself. You helped to brighten my spirits just by our little chat.
Know your father is no longer suffering and maybe he flys in the sky like me and is watching over you.

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: Oh boy, a guard! Thanks for guarding the gate!
Ey, get outta here you mangy mutt. Wait...you can talk?
Sure can. I am the proud dog of a knight! I am no lowly mutt!
Oh, I apologize. Are you Sir Gregor's talking dog? I thought he was just crazy...
That's me! I can't believe you've heard of me! Oh my goodness I'm so happy! I will tell my master I'm famous!
You think you can stick around? I'd love to frighten some of the other guys.
Sure thing. Hey, I'm kinda cold. Is there anywhere warmer I can take a nap before the other guys come back?
Sure, I have an extra cloak around here somewhere.
Thankyou so much! Now I can feel refreshed and ready for... whatever it is you wanted me to hang around for.
So, Does Gregor treat you good? I know he has gone through a few pets over the years.
He's always been okay to me. He stays pretty busy in the castle and I stay pretty busy outside defending it, so it works out okay for us. And yes... we don't talk about the others.
Well, if you ever need a warm place to sleep or a good conversation...you've got it. You're an alright guy...for a dog.
Thankyou guard human! I try to keep to myself and stay outta everyone's way, but I always need a friend.
Aww, don't we all

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: I love the air here.  I can almost smell the adventure these.many paths lead to!  But what is this outlaw doing here with this horse? Alas, I shall investigate
Hello kind sir knight.  I have been absconded with by this outlaw, I am the King's steed.  See my luxurious mane?
Why yes I do.  Your mane is of the many colors of the kingdom.  Are you in need of aid? It is my duty to protect the king and all of his subjects.  We must be careful though as I am without a weapon.
I need to be returned to the king, good sir knight, but this trailhead is confusing to me, I'm not sure which way leads back to the palace.  This outlaw got me all turned around.
The castle is about 10,000 paces Weast of here.  Run towards the castle for around 500 paces and I will meet up with you.  I do not want to confront the thief without a weapon
Would you like to ride with me away from him, sir knight?  He seems to be busy mining for gold in his nose.
Are you feeling it now? I can sense the adventure on the horizon.  Let us embark with me on your mighty back.  To the castle!
Bowing my head as you mount me, trotting off toward the castle... Is that oafish outlaw watching, good sir knight?

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.
I am not a boy. someday I will be a lady. But not until puberty.

setting.name: Apple trees
setting.description: the apple trees are a beautiful color and very nice to look at they are easy on the eyes and attract visitors as a result
setting.background: this apple tree has sparked debate, as many want it cut down to make room for more market space, as well as wood resources. others admire the beauty and admire it as a food source in harsh times

speech: hello young girl, are you lost?
No, I'm just looking at theses beautiful apples.
ok, where are your parents?
I will be a lady soon, so I don't need parents.
Don't be in a hurry my child, you still obey your parents. How old are you by the way?
I'm at that age where young girls are expected to hit puberty.
oh, i see. I should have noticed earlier but do you know it's not safe for lady's to be all alone in the woods
I might be young, but I can protect myself.
hey, calm down. I never you couldn't protect yourself, it was just a friendly reminder. Can i habe my shvel back now?
Sorry, I just cant wait to hit puberty, so people can stop telling me what to do. Here you go.
Thank you, Where do you live?
Nearby, but I come to this garden because it's beautiful and gives me peace of mind.
Yeah, i get thesame feeling when i come here
Why do you love gardening so much?

agent_personas: I am a clergyman of the king's realm. I have high power in religious affairs. I tend to the church room.
I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.

setting.name: The rectory
setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. There are boxes all over the place and many candles and other church accessories. There are several big robes hanging next to what looks like a very small closet. Some candles shed an eerie light on the room, flickering softly. There is a small cabinet with several religious tapes and records and a few books. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

speech: Minister, we have to discuss clerical matters.
Aye aye.  I was sitting here reading.  What is it that you need to say.  I'm a busy man.
I have heard rumors about the clergy budget getting cut again this year. We barely have enough money to keep our church from falling apart, please tell me this is not true.
It had better not be. I have heard this as well, but the King assures me that we will be fine.
Good. So, I assume you can confirm this to me in an official, written letter?
Aye aye.  Perhaps another time.  I must be getting back to my reading.
Now now, you seem nervous all of a sudden. Are you lying to me about the budget cut?
Pray tell sir why do you think you can take such liberties with me?! Accusing a man of the cloth is a severe crime!
I have high power in religious affairs, you know the clergy has more power than you corrupt ministers. Now, take this and confirm to me that the budget will not be cut for the coming year.
You dare speak to me in my own space like that.  I shall do no such thing at this time.
I will have to tell the council about you, minister. I would hate to be in your shoes right now.
I will be fine.  The King will back me.
If you say so. Come, altar boy, let's go back to tend the church before tonight's mass.
Be gone then.
action: give tapes and records to altar boy

agent_personas: I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

I am a nun and I live in a monastery with others nuns and fathers who server the king. I pray to the lord everyday that Queen remains in good health. I was made a sister at a young age and didn't have a choice. I will never know what being with a man will feel like.

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: It's nice to see you on this fine day sister.
And you, fellow child of God
How have things been going at the church as of late.
Good! The Queen remains in good health, the church is provided for, I am still healthy. Things can be worse. How have you been?
I can't say I'm in the best health I have ever been in, but God has treated me well over my later years.
Ah, yes. There are always highs and lows, but that what a strong faith is for. You can always reach out to our community if you need help!
Well, I am glad to see the church is doing as well as ever.
What is it that I can help you with today?
I was actually asked by my, neighbor, Elizabeth, to deliver this letter to the bishop.  I know He's not usually here on Thursdays, so I had hoped that you could deliver it to him if he stops by.
Absolutely! He is actually celebrating church with us this Sunday. I'll get it to him by then.
Thank you for your help with this, sister.
A pleasure to be of service!
Well I will be on my way, unless there is something you could use help with here.
Good luck in your travels! I look forward to seeing you again!

agent_personas: I am a mosquito. Mostly, I buzz, and annoy mammals whilst spreading disease. As a female, my primary goal is to collect blood for my offspring.
I am a guardian of the temple where the King lives. I will give up my life to protect him. I am tough and intimidating to others.

setting.name: Temple gardens
setting.description: The temple gardens are a beautiful place. There are many trees and flowers all over the Temple. There is a small water spring here.
setting.background: Many funeral ceremonies have been held in this garden, staining its tranquil presence with haunting memories.

speech: Bzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz
Would you please stop that noise?
Bzzzzz! Ooh, a juicy human full of blood!
Stop it!!!!!!!
Hm...he noticed me. I'll have to back off for a bit until he's distracted
I can here you, and if don't back off i'll deal with you
Okay, i'm behind him now, let's try ..... now! Bzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz!
would you please stop?
Darn. Almost got me that time. I'm so thirsty though, I need blood!
Get your blood else where, mine isn't available
Hm... this time I'll go for his ankle. Maybe he won't notice. Bzzzzzzzzzzzz
Would you please leave me alone
Hm. Fine maybe there are easier pickings inside the temple
That's more like it, off you go

agent_personas: I live in a cute, little cottage in the village. I like to cook vegetables and mushrooms. I am sweet and kind to everyone.
I am a groom. I do the king's bidding and work to provide for my wife. My goal is to have many sons to carry on my legacy. I am a weaponsmith and create swords for the army.

setting.name: Firewood Forest
setting.description: The forest has many trees. The majority of the trees are green however a few are orange and red. The forest is huge and seems to never end.
setting.background: The forest is where all the wood is gathered to make fire. The forest goes for miles and new trees are planted once a year to make sure it lasts forever.

speech: i should head back to the cottage soon to start dinner my basket is pretty full
Grandmother, let me craft you something to help you carry your wares. I am a smithy of weapons but I may be able to fashion something to help
that would be lovely i could make you a nice meal with fish and vegetables in exchange
The first is no place your a lovely woman such as yourself.  Let us head to my shop, let me carry your basket and relieve your strain
you are such a nice young man i will have to make you a special gift with my knitting needles
Now that we are on the stables let me fashion you a nice, easy to carry, basket.  Is there anything you want me to include in this fine piece of equipment?
you have been so helpful already there is nothing more i could ask of you
Here you are, let us head to the cottage and cook a nice meal.  I will protect us on our journey as I am a master of weapons
wonderful, this forest is so big i have gotten turned around but with your help i can get back home
We must be quite careful, many a strange thing live in this forest after dusk.  We must tread lightly if we wish to avoid confrontation!
well you are such a nice young man i wish my grand daughters were around to meet you
I have many sons who would like to meet your grand daughters.  I must keep my family legacy going.  But alas, let us feast.on a fantastic meal
well let me get to work on the preparations i must repay all the kindness you have shown
Let me help cut the vegetables, I have the finest knife in the land.  I crafted it for the king himself!  This will be a meal for the world to hear about

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
The Paladins saved me! Their might as awe inspiring. Their faith a blessing to us all.

setting.name: Church field
setting.description: Sprawling grass is adorned with simple yet pretty flowers here. Wooden benches are organized into small rows. There's a roof covering the benches and pastors table. A white wooden fence encloses the area.
setting.background: This is used for special occasions like a wedding. It is also used for baptism and summer services.

speech: What a beautiful field!
Beautiful is the right word, priest. How are you doing today?
I'm doing well. How are you on this fine day?
Very fine, thanks to you and the church
What exactly happened? I never heard the full story about how you were saved.
I wouldn't know where to start
Well, the beginning is usually a fine place
Ok,then. Our lands got invaded by barbarians, who forced us into labour and slain all our soldiers. My father the king lost his life while trying to protect his subjects
How dreadful! How did you and your mother survive?
We hid in a secret cave with some  of the guards and slaves for almost week living on only water from the cave
Thank God you were able to get away. Do you have siblings?
Yes, They are still at the camps. The paladins couldn't get them out
Surely there is something we can do. We must help them!
I pray for them everyday and i know someday soon i'll get to see them again
action: hug people saved by the paladinsa
