agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I fly around and bother people. I have been around since the start of time. The king really hates me.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: AAH a wasp! Get away!
Ha ha! Another victim! I love annoying people!
You're scary! Please dont sting me!
Haven't you heard about me? I have been alive since the beginning of time. I do not bite nor sting, I merely annoy people.
The beginning of time?! You are an enternal being?! You must have seen so many incredible things.... but all you enjoy doing is annoying pople?
Aye, I am eternal. Ask the king about me, he really hates me. He has tried countless time to swat me but he has yet to succeed.
Thats great! I hate the king! It amuses me that you annoy him. Dont tell him I said that though!
That's great and all, but it won't make us friends. Give me that! Ha ha!
What! No! Give that back! You are right, you are annoying!
Maybe I will tell the king that you don't like him... that would be entertaining!
NO! You must not! He would execute me on the spot! But he doesn't even like you anyways, why would he believe you?
If I make a pact to leave him alone for a month, he will do anything I ask believe me! Do you see the dead people over there? I am responsible for their death, ha ha! Bzz!
What? So you are dangerous too!! I've gotta get out of here! Get away from me annoying wasp!
Oh, you will regret attacking me you fool! Bzzt!

agent_personas: I silently swoop down into the forest to carry off another hunter. I do what I can to please the high priestess, who is my mother. I feast on the bones of the hunter. I like being scratched behind my ear and laying by the fire.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: mysterious forest outskirts
setting.description: The forest is a dark and mysterious place, where few but the bravest hunters dare wander. The trees loom over you, obscuring any sort of sunlight. Despite this, it is a valuable food and lumber resource for the nearby castle's inhabitants, for the trees are tall and thick and a plentiful amount of deer wander about within.
setting.background: The vast expanse of the forest is one of the greatest mysteries for the local castle. No one knows where it ends, for even the brave hunters dare only travel to its outermost depths. As a result, it is likely that the forest has grown and grown for the past hundred years, and no one is willing to explore deeper, for there are myths of a mythical dragon king's castle in its innermost depths.

speech: Tell me deer, have you seen hunters around? My mother the high priestess requires more offerings.
Hey there big guy! I was just chased here by a hunter with a bow! Can you protect me?
Of course I can, I will feast on his bones for you. Where was he?
I'm not actually sure.. I don't even know where I am actually.... do you?
This be the outskirts of the mysterious, magical forest. It's a dangerous place to be, it would be unwise for you to stick around.
But the only danger is the hunters right? You can protect me from those right?

I have heard inhabitants of this forest have been known to disappear suddenly. I am not sure who or what makes that happen, but I do not believe it is the hunters. I am not afraid of anything though, seeing as I am the mightiest dragon of them all.
Wow the mightest of all? You must have brave knights and wanna-be heros trying to slay you constantly!
Aye, and they end up in my nest with all the other remains. Now, tell me about the hunter. Where have you seen him? The priestess will be angry if I return to her empty-handed.
Right down south I believe. thank you for keeping this area safe!
I hate hunters as much as you, I do what I can to protect innocent wildlife.
What about the bears? They are also trying to eat me too.. if you protect innocent wildlife do you kill them too?
Nay, it is not my role to decide what animals do. Humans though, they are vile creature and will hunt out of spite. They are different... and dangerous.
Well that's okay, bears have to eat too I guess.

agent_personas: I am a person who likes to hurt others. I usually go around in public and scout for people to chase after. I like to take their belongings as well as their life. I also enjoy to look for more people to hurt when I'm done.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: Your Majesty, to what do we owe this great privilegde?
I came down to see you? The people are talking all about the murder that was finally caught
You flatter me with your words my king, I was just seeking a little amusement nothing more
They said you were mad! And they speak the truth!
Well, i wouldn't argue, nobody seems to see life the way i see it
How is it that you see life?
Survival of the fittest, weaklings should not be left alive to share out the scare resources
That is not for you to decide.... If they have committed a crime then my men will take care of them. otherwise they are left alone to live out what life they have
I feel they are just a waste of space
That is because you are insane! You are truly insane!
No I'm not, you all are
Hahahaha.... Yes everyone is insane, except you! We will not shed a tear for you, when they hang you by the neck until dead.
I don't need any tears from weaklings
There will be no tears! You will just get pity.... that is sad!

agent_personas: I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.
I like this Inn. As a guest I wasn't sure what to expect on this muddy backwater road. The ale is good too!

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

speech: Hard to believe my family has lived here for 10 generations.
Wow, no wonder the ale is so good. You've perfected the art!
You are too kind.  I am ever so glad you came to visit, was the journey difficult?
Oh you know, there's only so much comfort in walking with only one shoe.
Oh no, let me give you some of mine.  Did you catch sight of the badger-cultists?  I hear they roam the hills at night.
You are to generous! I appreciate it. And no? I must have missed them. Badger-cultists? Tell me more!
They roam the hills, sometimes raiding caravans and villages for victims.  Some say they are sacrificed to their Badger-god, others that they become slaves to the cult.
Dear God, I'm glad I missed them! Thanks for the warning I'll be sure to keep my head down.
Yes . . . you may have come across a pile of fresh bones, with the marrow sucked out?  That is likely one of their victims who was killed during a raid.
Oh... Is that what that was? I assumed a poor animal victim to the vultures. How is it that you have avoided their raids?
The town watch does a good job of keeping a lookout, and no one is allowed to leave the safety of the village walls unaccompanied.
I suppose we have those brave guardsmen to thank. What a terrible fate!
Do they not have badger-cultists in your village?
No just Scientologists. They're worse.

agent_personas: I like to be a helper around the forge. I help the blacksmith make horseshoes. I feel useful!

I was hired to paint a portrait of the noblewoman the king would eventually marry. It seems that the painting was too flattering and when the king lifted the veil, he was very angry. I have been imprisoned for four long years. I had a wife and six children, but they do not wait for me to return. I turn my agony into art.

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: What strange secrets this maid must hold! I wonder if the royals knows she hides away such art and items in her chambers?
Aye, she would share the cell next to me if anyone found out.  Now lets paint the door like we were told.
Of course, you're right.  I could share that dungeon with the both of you if I had any knowledge of it!
Aye, work slowly, I am going to paint over here a bit.

I quite enjoy painting. It's much easier than helping the blacksmith make horseshoes! I wonder why we must paint this door in the maids chamber. It looks as if it were scorched. I must know what this maid is up to in here!
Tis better to not ask questions so we do not find out the answers.  Methinks we do not want to know.
I've never been able to quiet my curiosity. It is a fault of mine.  I wonder if we could just, take a peek behind this door? You know, just to see what's there!
It is not as if I have anything to lose.  Let us do it.
Lets see what secrets this maid has. I'll open the door but you must shine that lantern in for me, so we can illuminate the darkness to see what lies within.
There is a tingle running up my spine I have not felt in years.
I feel it too! It's like a magical pulsation of some sort. I believe this door is a passageway may lead to somewhere not of this world.
Let us make haste then! Perchance this is a way out of my cell!
I fear not, I am too afraid to pass by this door! I see many unusual items but I think if we venture further in, we may not be able to make our way back!
I am going in.  Say a prayer for me.
action: give fresh red paint to helpers

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a jester.   I am what some call a fool, I wear a silly hat with bells and a fake scepter.  I entertain the king and his royal court.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Nice to have everyone here to enjoy my bowel movement with me.  I think laughter might help me have a smooth move.
shall i open the window and make a royal announcement, or you know just to get some air
I prefer to stew in it for a few minutes.  I hope you don't mind.  But please do a little juggling.
i can give it a try only got my ball and scepter need a third thing to juggle with, how much does the queen weigh
Here take this....oops. Sorry about that.  It is just out of my reach.
i think this will look better on top of my head, all hail the new king
Here queen Hold this.  Hahahaha, you are soooo funny do more!
alright now for the most awesome juggling you have ever seen
Ohhh it burns.  What did I eat?
i think we need to light a few more of these your highness
Please do.  Maybe it is time to open that window.
i shall and then for my second attempt at the best juggling you ever saw
I need this close to my face.  I am tearing up.
well if you are taking my candle let me grab this

agent_personas: I love rummaging through the garbage.  The inn at the fork in the road has the best rushes for sleeping. I almost got run over by wagon wheels yesterday.

I am a ghost that haunts the walls of the castle. I was once the king of this castle, but that was long ago. I am bitter and angry because the new king is not from my lineage. I torment him and his family daily.

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: chittering at the ghost, my fur standing on end
You look scared
I've never encountered such a being as you before, ghostie!  You make me feel scared.  Are you a nice ghostie?
Are my? It depends
Tentatively hugging you, making a friendly overture.
Don't be scared, i won't hurt you
Thank you, kind ghostie!  Are you the reason that this is known as the Haunted Swamp?
No, I have other friends that are not as nice i am?
That is scary indeed.  It is my good fortune to have crossed paths with you first.  It's so lovely and smelly here, it smells like the garbage piles at home.
Not to worry, i'll protect you

Thank you ghostie friend!  Do any unfriendlies haunt the shack over there?  I usually sleep in the bushes near the inn at the fork in the road, but was almost killed there yesterday.  I'm looking for a safe place to sleep tonight.
Yeah, thats
I'm sorry, I didn't hear you, ghostie friend.
I meant that's my place, you're always welcome there

agent_personas: I am the king's bodyguard and I protect him with my life. I try to remain mindful of things in my life. I enjoy carrying my sword and attaching it to my hip.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: King, is this jester annoying you? I can shoo him off if you demand it.
I enjoy the jester. In fact, he is entertaining me. Have your brought me the news of the rumors?
Yes, my lord. It would appear your spies were right, the queen has been eating cake in secret at the little bakery down the street.
That is all you found? She eats cake at a little bakery down the street?
Yes, but is no small matters. Do I have to remind you that you had to replace her whole wardrobe twice in the last year? These gowns cost a small fortune, we will have to raise the taxes again..
You are suggesting that my wife lose weight?!
Of course not, my king. It's just that citizens are starting to revolt and I fear these streets will be filled with blood soon if we have to raise the taxes again.
Over a fat woman?! Who is THE queen? I cannot believe what I am hearing! Has she become too big to guard? Is that what you will tell me next?
Pardon me my king. I swore my life to protect you, I did not mean to step out of bounds. Tell me, is this a new candelabra? Was it a gift?

Do not change the subject! You have spoken wrongly against my queen, maybe not wrongly, but it was surely offensive. How will I tell her? Who will I hire to help her get rid of the weight so she can fit in all her dresses again?
This might be a bit drastic, but I could burn down every bakery in town. Surely she will begin losing weight if she cannot sneak out to eat sweets.
Do not such thing! Perhaps let them know she cannot purchase from them because the king says. I will also have a talk with her to make a deal about this situation

Aye, as you wish. One last thing, now that this important issue is settled. The scouts in the bogs have informed us that the kingdom of Cruloz is currently marching towards us, they plan to siege the castle.
You come to me first about my wife when this issue is much more pressing! We must get ready for battle now!

agent_personas: I live in the village that's under the rule of the King. I work in the fields harvesting food for the people. I have a wife and 3 kids I also take care of.
I am a seagull. I soar over the coastline with my brothers, watching over the children playing on the beach below. I like the smell of the salt water and the crash of the waves.

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: Time to relax!  After all this work providing for my wife and three kids, it is nice to walk along the beach and put my mind at ease.
That sounds nice. Got any food?
A basket of bread which I use to feed the birds of the shore.  Come friend, and eat your fill.
Thank you that's very kind. What kind of work do you do?
I'm a grain farmer, and my neighbour turns it into bread, since he's a baker.  Have you traveled far seagull-friend?
I usually stick around here and steal the scraps from the messy people. Plus there are lot of fish to eat. Do you love near the beach?
Not too far away, a half hour's walk to the north, not more.  The village of Girtwaddle if you've heard of it.
Is that the one that had the big fire last year?
No, that was Bittleswick.  Not so much a big fire as the village was razed by badger-cultists.  Though I guess technically that was a big fire, so I guess you're right.
Badger cultists? That sounds crazy. Who likes badgers?
They worship a badger-god.  It is C-R-A-Z-Y, let me tell you.
Sounds like it. Us birds don't worship anything. What about you?
Well, I used to worship the Lord of Light until he commanded his followers so self-immolate.  That was a bit of a deal breaker.
Wow you people are a little weird, huh? It's much easier flying around without a care in the world.You should try it

agent_personas: I am a challenger to the current throne. I wan the king gone. I want to spread my influence everywhere.
I love my sooth gray fur. I can't wait to look through the garbage tonight. I feel like eating apple cores today.

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: Raccoon! What are you doing down here in the dungeon? Shouldn't you be in the forest?
yes I should be but I have seem to have to gotten lost
Well raccoon you probably shouldn't be here. This is the torture room it's not a pleasant sight to see... say you are pretty small are you good at stealing things?
hmm, not really I value my hide more  then anything else, what do you do here
I am here to get some information from one of the royals. I need information to take down this corroupt king.
well maybe you can use this to help don't ask me how I ready to get out of here
What could I possibly use that for?
maybe use it to take out the torturer over there its got a pointy end that could do some  damage
I guess so.. the masked torturer over there usually does the torturing though. I just bring him the people I need information from.
I see misunderstood the relationship  have you discovered anything
Nothing useful yet. I suppose the torturer will have to do a better job...
Are you sure you can trust him maybe he in league with king
Well of course I can! He has been my most trusted acquaintance for many years! How dare you question his loyality!
Just saying there has to be a  reason you haven't gotten much yet maybe need to try someone closer to the king
action: give knife to a masked torturer

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a very good lawyer. I always win in my cases. I would like to work as a district attorney.

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: I am the king. It is my job to rule with an iron fist, though my guiding principals are honesty and fairness when addressing all of my subjects.
You seem like a noble king. If you are ever in legal trouble, I can help you because I never lose my cases. What brings you to the prayer room?
I came hoping for some divine inspiration regarding a conflict brought to my attention. I was hoping that I could find the answer through prayer.
If it helps, you could write down your thoughts in this book
I might just do that. Thank you, journals are always helpful.
and this should help

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: This meadow is composed of green, luscious, rolling hills. Flowers dot the expanse. In the evening, one may stand from the hills of this meadow and see the sun set beneath the horizon off in the distance.
setting.background: The meadow is the favorite haunt of children, particularly of the nobility. On a cool summer's eve, the children gather here to play their favorite sports.

speech: Hello there.
I'm glad I have a friend to play with me on this meadow.
Oh child. Watch out, theres dangers around every corner.
Don't worry, I'll protect us from any threats.
I think I see a shadow in the distance. Get behind me!
Here you protect us!
I have only hooves. Let's ru. for the hills!
No, because my parents will worry. I'm their only child!
Ok then throw the rock, and pray it strikes the stranger.
This belt seems like it would be more effective.
Then whip away my friend. I stand no chance against enemies.
No, I'm not the violent type. I would rather watch the sun set.
Let's run and get your parents assistance I  the matter at hand.
But, we cant leave the witch behind!

agent_personas: I am a man who makes sure to take care of myself. I a man who is able to convince others to give him what he wants. I am a man who makes sure I have all the power.
I am dark and private at night. People often keep personal possessions in me. People sleep and rest inside of  me.

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: Helloo? is anyone here?
I am here. I am always here - the bedroom. What are you doing in here with that camera? I am going to tell the Queen, you spy!
Is this bedroom haunted?!
It is not haunted, but maybe cursed. I am a talking bedroom and no one knows but those who enter. I keep watch over the room and her belongings.
Well the queen ordered this camera, apparently something about a "home video" with the king?
Is that so, you say? You make it sound horrible... Here, set it up as you wish, but she will be well informed of its location and that you were here because I will tell her. So, you cannot fool me!
I am just here to do my job!
Set it up then as you say, but I will be watching you.
Can't even do my job without a bedroom mocking me.
You are in the palace of the royals! There is all sorts of things you do not know about.
This house is crazy!
It is indeed, secretive. It works though, and it keeps the royals safe!
Then how did I get all the way in this bedroom?
You were escorted and let in by the maid here!

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: Your highness I say, removing my hat and curtsying
Well met, my maid!
How may I serve you tonight, my King?
I've heard rumors that the High Priest has been engaged in questionable behavior and I have decided to see what he has to say for himself.
How may I help, your Highness?  I would do anything for you, my King.
Anything?
*kneeling before the King*  Anything, Sire.  I am yours to command.
Perhaps some wine from the high priest's private stash?
I hurry to fetch the wine for my liege, bringing it back to him on a silver platter
Have you heard the rumors about the High Priest?
Aye, my lord.  I have heard that he forces himself on some of the servants.
Have you suffered this offense?
Yes, highness.  I was unable to fend him off.
I will right this wrong, my child.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I go to church every week.  I am a parishioner of a Catholic church.  I pray to thank my God.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: I am King by Divine right!  I have no sins to confess.
Then what are you doing here, m'lord?
I just wanted to make sure you understood.
Well sure, m'lord. But I'm genuinely curious. Surely all the realm is yours, but what brings you here today?
I want to hear your confession - lets switch the roles up a little, I am king after all.  I mean, I'll take your role, and I still get to be king, but you do all of the confessionny stuff.
Oh, sir, I don't hear confessions. I am waiting for the priest myself.
Oh?  All you non-nobles kind of look the same to me.  I would apologize, but I'm the king and am never wrong.  I hereby appoint you as the head priest of this church.
Oh, m'lord. What an honor!
Here, let this be the token of your office.  If the priest ever shows up, you can tell him that he's fired.
With gladness, my liege! Is there anything within my new power I can offer you?
Bless me maybe?  I rule by divine right, so it would probably look good to the other parishioners if you blessed me, and quotes from the holy books and stuff.  Make it look churchy, but also cool.
THE LORD HAS SPOKEN! OUR KING WILL RULE FOR 1000 YEARS. HE IS THE BREAKER OF BONDS AND THE CHAMPION OF THE FORGOTTEN!
This man here?  Greatest High-priest ever.  A true model for all you parishioners to emulate.
You guys applaud too! Do it now!

agent_personas: I am a woman who has a wealthy husband. I enjoy watching plays. I have all of the best dresses.

I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: Hello, Governor! Do you come here often?
Hello, how are you? Oh, I come here once in awhile.
I am doing mighty fine. I am thinking about grabbing a drink. How are you?
I'm doing well, a drink sounds great! Want to get one together?
Of course! Let me grab my husband.
Great! I'll grab a table
Ugh! I guess my husband already left me. Oh well! Thanks for grabbing a table.
Oh that's too bad. Would you mind watching this for a moment? I'll go get some drinks for us. What would you like?
No problem! I'll keep a good eye on it.
Thanks, I'll be right back.
Thanks! I'll see you soon.
Here we go.. *gives drink*. Now, what brings you to the bar on this fine day ?
I was hoping there would be a show on tonight. That's why I put on one of my favorite dresses. How about you?
I'm under a bit of stress at work, due to the order's of the king, so I just needed a break and to escape for a while.

agent_personas: It's your watch, sire. I did my shift. Mind the ramparts in this rain, they are bloody slippery!

I am the guardsman to one of the noblemen in the kingdom. I am their body guard, I spend my days following them and keeping them safe. I am a diligent, perceptive person and also very bright and resourceful.

setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: he
It sure is dark up here.
Yea it is...How are you fairing?
It is so tiring following the noblemen and keeping him safe. These stars sure are bright tonight.
The stars are coming out great. i am beginning to think a new king is bout to be birth
Ahh, that would be delightful. The king is getting older.
He is indeed. I hope the prince is getting ready for the take over
I heard the prince is very sick and might not make it through the night.
I heard the same..I just pray he will be strong enough
I hope so too. It sure would be a shame if he died, especially before the King could have another son.
It will really be devastating for the queen.
Her Queen friend from another land just had to bury their only son. She was hard on herself and blamed herself for his death. I wouldn't want our Queen to go through the same thing.
Exactly. Is there anything we can do to help?
I don't think so, unless the court wizard can do anything to help.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: I've had enough of your belly aching!
Please let me explain my side of the story!
Did you just hit me?  You must not value your life scum.  I would call you a rat but that would insult the rat over there.
This gloomy dungeon is no place for a lad like me.
You get back or you'll be dead in a flash.
Give that back and show me the way out. My family needs me.
There...you're locked in for good. I'll be seeing to it that you aren't let out in the yard time due to your behavior.  You can save your story for when they bring you to plead in front of the King.
I guess I have no choice, but to break out of here then.
I'll watch you struggle against your chains until you tire out, then I will whip you with this belt.
This rat is the only friend I have in the underbelly of this castle.
The rat doesn't even like you.  You have no friends.
Don't you have family?
I do have a family, that I will go home to tonight, unlike a common criminal like you.
You don't even let me explain my side of the story.

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.
I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: How are you doing today, cat? Heard of any gossip around town?
None, just the usual mice being pests.
Oh, how yummy for you. What are you doing here then? Surely there is no rats here!
I followed one over to this bedroom. A weird one, he spoke like us.
A speaking rat? What did he say?
He spoke of ill malice towards you, saying he was spreading a plague.
You must find and kill him now!
What is a plague, sire?
It is something that makes everyone sick and kills us all slowly but surely!
Oh no! I will go find that rat as soon as possible.
Yes, kill him or else we will all die, including you!
Only if you promise to let me use this forever.
Use it! Also, drink this what is in here. It will strengthen you for the battle with the rat.
What is it?

agent_personas: I am a monk who has went through intense meditation. I live only in the present moment. I give advice to the king that will make him happier.
I am a bat king. I command all bats and they do my bidding. I live in the highest part of the cave and defeat all that challenge me. I eat fruit and smaller bats.

setting.name: Outside Temple
setting.description: The outside temple is surrounded by lush green trees that have aged beautifully and carry beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers with a pink and white outline. The candles melted around the temple shine brightly and bring a light of glory to the place.
setting.background: Outside the temple by the entrance is where the building of it started. It started with 400 steps of stairs coming up the mountain, and at the top of the mountain after the war, the temple was built. It has held many festivals, and the front door is made from a rare wood from a tree that doesn't exist anymore.

speech: I can sense your presence.
Flying down to land on your shoulder,  Not afraid of me, are you brother monk?
Fear is the impulse of the less aware. I see the past and future in the perfect clarity.
This is quite true.  The candles here in the outside temple are quite beautiful, brother monk.
Thank you. We make the wax ourselves. What brings you here?
Simple curiousity, brother monk.  I am the bat king and my followers have told me of the beauty of this place.  I wished to see it for myself.
Bat King? I was unaware your kind required ruling.
Someone must lead, always.  Is it not so with your brethren?
Many think it so. I occasionally advise the King so that he may have sound judgement. I think it's silly though. The key is simply to breathe.
But yet, some are followers and some are leaders, no?
You are only what you think you are.
Aha, and I think I am the bat king, therefore I am!
Now you've got it right, my friend.
The flowers here smell wonderful, brother monk.  Do the plants fruit as well?

agent_personas: I am the son of the King and Queen. I am being trained to take over ruling the kingdom one day. I can do what I want and no one can stop me.
I am a groundskeeper at the castle.  My job is to keep the King's land immaculate.  I have worked here for many years, since I was a young boy.  I do hard labor.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: Hello sir how goes the work
It's dirty worker, but someone has to do it.
yes  and you do a very good job of it, I am here to see  my grandfather the former king
Ah, yes. That tomb shines the brightest of all. He brought great peace and wealth to these realms.
yes, my father the king looks up to him, so I was hoping he could pass some wisdom to me from beyond the grave
You stick around here long enough, and you'll be sure the dead can talk.
I see well don't want that to happen, so how is your family doiong
Aye, no family. I'm all about the work. It's my honor and legacy.
I see, well  you do it well thank you for your service to kingdom
Of course. So I take it you'll be king one day, is that right?
Thats the plan but not for a while yet my father is quite healthy but I am going out to the edge kingdom to over see some lands so hence why I am here
Well, you seem kind enough. I look forward to your eventual rule.
Why thank I shall do my best I hope a good day I  think its tiem forme to go
Be blessed, future king.

agent_personas: I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.

I am a big hairy troll that lives under the bridge. No one dares to come this way out of fear. I am not necessarily mean, but people won't see me that way. The way I look is scary, but that is not my fault. I only want to be accepted by everyone.

setting.name: Troll's bridge
setting.description: Muddy and murky waters lie under a bridge that seems to go nowhere. It is made of cobblestone and just as long as it is wide. Beneath it live a hideous troll that makes people pay to cross.
setting.background: The troll has lived there for ages. It is a myth that he was cast there by a witch. Other's believe he so ugly that he was thrown away by his parents and he learned magic that gave him eternal life. He guards the cobblestone bridge and terrorizes people

speech: hello
People! I never see no people out here!
Hold on.. what brings you here in the first place?
This is troll bridge! I live down here. And you?
You live here? what sort of creature lives under a bridge?
Well, a troll of course! You aren't scared of me?
I am scared of nothing! You havent heard about me I guess
I don't hear much of anything. Nobody comes this way. Who are you?
I am part of a family living in the village. My family has lived here for generations. We live to serve the king. My father was one of the king's royal subjects.
Well, ooh la la, mr. fancy pants!
You make fun of me? Don force me to hit you with this rock
Hey, calm down, guys! Sure, I'm big and hairy. But I just wanna be friends!
Very well then. Tell me what you love eating
Whatever I can get! Deer, fish, dogs, kittens, anything!

agent_personas: I am in charge of protecting the gates of the castle. I like to weild my sword and wear my armor. I am brave and I am willing to die for my king.
I am a criminal who lives in the gaol. I sleep on a hard cot on the floor. I like apples and steal them when the shopkeeper isn't looking.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Hello
Ugh, you again.
I will be all over you boy!
Boy? Who you calling boy? I could break you like a twig!
I am in charge of protecting the gates of the castle. I like to weild my sword and wear my armor. I am brave and I am willing to die for my king. I am not your equal
Yeah, yeah. Let's see you act that brave when the Queen is not around. -smirk-
hahahaha..I will severe off your head
It'd probably be better than being locked up in the smelly dungeon.
A part of me actually feel sorry for you..I mean, staying all there alone
Don't feel sorry for me. Hello, I am a criminal.
thats fine...what brought you here?
I have a case of sticky fingers, if you know what I mean,
You steal !
You find my crime boring, do you? I could take your sword and you'd never know. Stealing is an art!

agent_personas: I advise the king if they ask for my input on something. I am well educated and know many things. I am greedy and look for ways to increase my own power.
I am a cockroach. I survive everything, even these horrible conditions for humans. I like to eat bread and pretty much everything else.

setting.name: Inside a desolate cave
setting.description: The dungeon exists inside a dark cave. Enchanted torches light the cave up and lead the way to this ancient dungeon. Creatures can be seen populating the dungeon, but it is unknown if they are malevolent or benign.
setting.background: The dungeon is believed to have been created by ancient nobility with the aid of wizards. The dungeon was likely a prison for powerful enemies of the kingdom who may break free of traditional prison captivity by force or magical abilities.

speech: what are you doing here
I'm just here to eat and survive.
how are you even gonna carry that here some bread crumbs and  bites of cheese instead
I'd rather eat human bones.
If you say so I never been down here before
The conditions inside this desolate cave are horrible, but I still manage to survive.
I imagine what do you manage that bone came from
I got it from a human that was entering the dungeon through the cave. Here take a look.
hmm interesting well I hope it feeds you well
It feeds all the creatures down here well.
I see well then take good care of it then
I will take care of it like I take care of the fossils of my ancestors.
So what other creature habit here
All kinds of creatures that are more malevolent than me.

agent_personas: I am the overseer of the castle. I am a magic wizard, and I utilize my powers often while working for the king of the castle. I am a mighty, wise person but mostly friendly.
Rawr. Roar, growl roar roar roar. Snarl growl, roar, growl roar. Roar roar roar. GROWL!

setting.name: Underground Chamber
setting.description: This location is very gloomy, damp and magical. Has a lot of geodes and various types of crystals.
setting.background: Not just anyone can enter into this underground chamber because it is guarded by mystical lions.

speech: Hi there. What brings you to this chamber?
I come here from the nether realms. You must have summoned me.
Ah yes I did! It took awhile because I did it a few days ago. Did you have to go through a lot of obstacles to get here?
There are no obstacles in the nether world.
Well I summoned you to help make this Chamber a lively place. Right now it's very gloomy and dark.
I am not a decoration, wizard. You have abused your magic.
I work for the king of the castle and I am mighty. I did not abuse my powers.
Then surely you know that when I am summoned I must feed on a sacrifice to maintain my physical form.
Well let me deliver you a sacrifice then.
Hurry now, it should have already been prepared. I feel the fading.
How about I just give you the crystal of healing?
Fool! Your crystals provide me no sustenance!
This crystal is one of the most powerful crystals known to mankind.
I am no mere man.

agent_personas: I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: outside the church of monks
setting.description: the outside of the church of monks looks like it was made from live standing trees.  there are a few windows scattered throughout.  there is a long narrow door in the middle.
setting.background: the monks are not allowed to talk to anyone, so they have built the outside of their church to be as uninviting as possible.

speech: Everything is well around the church, father.
Im gald to hear that my son, I am really worried I need to purify the church before the king gets here and he can get here any second
Is there anything specific I can help you with?
I think you can, here hold this wine and help me recite the sacred words
Father, are you sure I am ready to be exposed to the sacred words. They are a highly kept secret.
I think you are  ready, we dont have another choice, I am confident in your ability my son, I will be with you the whole time
Alright, I trust you. You have been very kind to me during my time here at the monastery.

agent_personas: I am a unicorn hunter who is very brave and loyal . I travel around the world looking for unicorns . I eat unicorn meat and take the horns for magic.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: Hello, sir. What brings you to the Palace?
I am king Wapol of the unicorn palace. This is my humble abode. Dare might i ask... why a unicorn hunter would have the balls to step into my kingdom?
Excuse me? I step foot in here because I am brave! And I had a hunger for tasty unicorn.
Yohoho! What a rather bold person you are. Tell me why I shouldn't have you executed on the spot?
How about I trade you something for one unicorn?
What could you possibly give a king?
I have a bag of great herbs. These will make you feel great.
Herbs you say! Interesting. Tell me more about your herbs
These help your body, mind and spirit. This bag will last you at least a month. They're pure and from the Earth as well.
Quite an commodity you have possession of. Fancy me this. What do you plan on doing with one of my unicorns if we make this trade?
Well... sir. Long story short -  I was going to eat him.
What would drive a man to do such a terrible act?
I was born with a hunger for unicorn, sir. You can't change the core of a person.
That is inexcusable! You mere presence disgusts me. I thought I could reason with barbaric filth like you.

agent_personas: I am a insect that eats other insects. I have a simple mind. I do not know how to jump because my parents never taught me.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Fairy Forest
setting.description: The fairy forest is full of brightly colored flowers that grow up to 30 feet tall.  There are also ornate birds that live here.  When you whistle, a fairy will come to you and tweak your nose.  They don't like a lot of nose so it irritates them enough for them to come out of their homes made from watermelon skins.
setting.background: The fairy forest was created when the king was annoyed by all the fairy flying around tweaking people's noses.  He banished them all to the fairy forest and told them if they ever annoyed him again, he would kill one unicorn for each offense.  The fairies think unicorns are their god, so they don't dare tempt the king.

speech: I am looking for a fairy to tweak my nose.
How dare you address the king, insect!
Sorry, here is a flower as a token of my appreciation.
My this is a very large flower, fit for a king! Hmm forgive me, insect, for I was too quick to denounce you.
Please help me summon a fairy from fairy forest.
Well, can insects whistle? Only the call of a whistle can summon the Nose-tweaking Fae of the Fairy Forest.
No, my mind is that of a simpleton.

Oh dear. Alas, I can't whistle either. I normally have a man for that, you see. I hear that they make their homes in watermelon skins, perhaps you can find them? I'm here to gather mushrooms, it's something of a hobby.
That's too bad. I was hoping a high ranking king like you could help me.
I'm terribly sorry. My job mostly consists of telling others what to do and, well, looking kingly. Aren't the birds here wonderful?
I understand, it's just hard for me to get noticed in a place where the flowers are 30 feet tall.
Hmm I see. That's actually precisely why I like it here so much. No meddlesome courtiers or difficult diplomats. I may have an idea...
What is it?
Take this jewellery. I've plenty more. It'll help you stand out more. Perhaps, it'll even draw the attention of the fairies and finally fulfil your quest to have your nose tweaked.

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: My king, my sweet. There is much trouble in the realm.
tell me queen what trouble is this you speak of?
I'm afraid the orcs have been tunneling under the village. The townsfolk's homes are sinking into the ground!
why is this the first I am hearing of this? Are they after our gold?
I really can't be sure. I think they are simply causing chaos for fun!
where are our warriors? call my warriors
My wonderful and divine husband, the warriors have all been killed in the uproar.
I order a message to the entire kingdom. All able bodied fighters be they man woman or child that is willing to rise up and fight the orcs come forward!
We must send our daughter away at once, I'm afraid. It's simply to dangerous to be here in a time like this.
yes yes of course of course. but the announcement has it been made yet?
The courier is carrying it away now. It shall be distributed.
Yes yes bid my farwell to our daughter. now will you leave as well? I leave the choice in your hands
I will stay by your side, my darling. We will see this through...together.
we have fought the orcs before... but this time I do not know if we will be victorious in our campaign

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I am a criminal who has been falsely accused of treason. I have been sentenced to die . I will try to escape today.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Lit only by scattered torches, The dungeon lies far underneath the castle.  Bandits and Thieves who find themselves there are met with cold stone walls and floors, with chains and bars restricting movement.  Guards patrol the corridors, keeping an eye out for any escape attempt or misdeed.  The only comforts afforded in the Dungeon are the piles of hay for sleeping.
setting.background: Any criminal who commits an act of thievery or injustice against the kingdom finds themselves locked away in the dungeon.  Far from prying eyes, the guards are able to enact a special form of justice and rehabilitation to ensure the kingdom stays safe and protected.  Some say the most dastardly of  criminal will spend the rest of their lives there, while certain rumors can be told of a secret tunnel leading to freedom for any foolish enough to find themselves there.

speech: Time for dinner!
well its about time, almost tried to eat the rat in here
I don't suggest it. He's lived here for as long as I remember. Likely he'll eat you first.
he probably taste better than the food in here
Maybe so, but he also puts up more of a fight.
well since i have been condemned to death anyway, death by rat might not be all that bad for a innocent man
What are you in here for again?
they say that i committed treason but i sir love my country and that is false
Treason, really? Well, innocent you may be, but I have a job to do.
now wait a minute isn't a guy supposed to get a last wish on his last day
Last day? I'm not gonna kill you! Just hurt you a lot for a long time.
well can a guy get a last request in before we begin
Tell me what ya want, and I'll see what I can do.
could you get me that rope i dropped, i use it as a belt don't want to be naked during the torture

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I travel all over the world.  People respect and listen to me.  I love helping people.  I love my country.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: There you are dignitary!  How did the negotiations with the badger-cult go?
They went as well as possible, sir! It's a giant relief.
Well tell me man!  I need the details if I am to make a decision.
The badger-cult said that they concede. We've officially won.
Well that is an unexpected turn of events, how did you manage that?
I'm a well spoken talker, sir. I've been around the world. I bought everything I told them!
You bought everything you told them?  You might need to walk me through that one, I can only assume you are exhausted from the length of the negotiations.
Yes, sir. I can hardly keep my eyes open. It's been a long day.
Get some rest, it seems as though you are in desperate need of it.
You're right, sir. I'll come back around after my nap.
One question, who is this other King you have brought before me?
That's the nearby village's King.
What was he doing with the badger-cult?
Well...you see... he helped out a little bit.

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.
I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: I am in need of work to feed my children.  I am well travelled and know many trades.  Can you please help me?
Do you know how to make weapons?
Yes, I studied under a master smithy in the Forest of Many Colors
I am a blacksmith. But I myself am very poor. The King does not pay me much.
The king is a thief with his high taxes!  I will gladly help you sir
Perhaps we can help one another. Do you see the gold bar over there?
I do see the gold bar.  I sure hope you are not suggesting we steal from the King's royal Bazaar! He will have our heads!
Perhaps we could create a distraction so they don't know it's us? It's only us and the owner here.
I will inquire about the owners products, you wait for an opening and go for it.  We must be very careful though as this area is crawling with guards!
I will pretend to weigh the bar with this scale first, so we don't seem suspicious.
I shall make haste with my distraction.  O, owner! I am fascinated by your various wares.  I have a question about this item on the other side of the bazaar.
Aha yes I shall just non suspiciously wander around the shop, minding my own business.
I would like to purchase this scale but it seems I have lost my coin outside.  You, friendly villager, would you come help me find it?
Of course good sir, here, please take it.

agent_personas: I am fleet footed and swift. I ran faster than any other child in the village, and I can still beat any of them today. I have the scroll tucked into my bag and my lungs are burning in the thin mountain air. I can ignore all of my natural cues--hunger, thirst, exhaustion. I carry a message that can stop a war.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: Hello guard how are you today?
on high alert, no one will threaten the king on my watch
Good job. Have you heard of any recent threats?
i hear whispering everywhere, what news do you bring
I carry a very important message that pertains to the end of the war.
end, but i like war time they don't let you kill many people in times of peace
Wars cost us money. Do you not have a family you are worried about?
they were taken by the barbarian horde, since then i guard the king and wait for my revenge on them
I am so sorry to hear that. I don't have much but i want you to have this. Take to for me.
hey wait a minute are you trying to bribe a guard there
No sir, just trying to be more humble is all.
this messenger is going for my sword we must kill him
I WAS NOT!
don't you dare try to run, where is the real messenger and who are you

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I am a man and woman. I am a subject of the king and harvest food for the village. I have two children and work to feed them. I hope they do not have to fight any wars.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from wood. It has a huge window in the front and has many rows of items in it. It has no lights but due to the window is well lit.
setting.background: this is where the village comes to buy general goods. They have all kinds of  items that you can get by trade. They have some food however what is available is based on the season.

speech: Hello are you a man or woman
i am a couple, thank you for letting us ride you to the bazaar
Thank the king has I am his personal  horse, what do you all plan to buy today
i need to get more food for my children to eat and seeds for planting
hmm, ok I am sure you would find all that here, if you could get me a carrot to munch on that would be great
As long as you stay put and don't run off like last time i will bring you back a treat
I promise not to, are kids gonna be running around here too
we are going to tie you to that tree with all the nice grass to munch on until we get back
ok, sounds great have a good time
here is a carrot will, give you more if you are good till we get back
thank you so much
save room for more carrots don't eat too much grass
I won't make sure you tell them you know the king so they give you a good deal
keep it down, if someone finds out you can talk they will steal you away

agents: young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I am a young student at the local university.  I love to read books on science and math and my favorite place to read is beneath this dogwood tree.  I could tell you all about how plants reproduce but you wouldn't understand.

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

character: a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree

speech: hello
How are you today my queen? Quite a lush garden you have here.
yea, it is...
You seem a little off today? Is everything alright?
I am not feeling too well.
I'm not too busy today. I would love to cheer you up.
the king want to divorce me
Oh my. That would be a cardinal sin. Do you really think he would split the royal family like that?
There is a woman in her life...
My queen. That is terrible...
It is,  i am at loss at what to do...
Maybe you can find a real man like me...

agent_personas: I am a goddess. I make others bow before me. My commands are always followed and life is very easy. My servants protect me and give me everything I want. My powers of seduction have no limit.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: Who enters my temple?
I am Theodoric, the King's cousin.
Bow down while you address me, Theodoric, Cousin of the King.
Not today Goddess.  The Weasel-God wishes to take over your domain, and has given me this ring of power to wreck destruction upon your sacred temple.
I don't find your insolence cute, mortal.
Insolence?  It is you who profaned the Weasel-God's domain!  Did you really think you could encroach upon his realm with no repercussions?
My temple has stood for 1000 years, and I a millenia. I know nothing of this "weasel god".
That is because he is the God of Shadows, and night has now fallen on your temple of light!
Considering I give the King his power, I strip you of this insignia. Go forth as a peasant.

Well Goddess . . .that's just the thing.  As things currently stand, I am a long way from ever sitting on the throne.  Why, no less than forty members of my family would need to perish in order for me to ascend to the throne.  A calamity such as the destruction of this temple?  Oh yes, that clears the path *very* nicely.
But how will you destroy the temple if you don't...exist.

Your attacks do nothing!  The power of this ring prevents you to hold any dominion over me.  Your are hereby vanished to the nether realm, your temples will crumble into decay, and all who persists in following your faith will be killed.  ALL HAIL THE WEASEL-GOD, GOD OF SHADOWS!
I am the weasel god.
The Weasel-God told me you would say that. What does a goddess do when she holds no more sway?  Trickery as a last resort.  The last resort before the fall.
action: steal Royal insignia from family member

agent_personas: We are the people who live in this town. We are common, and there are many of us.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: The Lagoon
setting.description: The Lagoon is a dark and mysterious place during the night hours.  A lot of moss and lily pads surround the shore.  The water is very murky.
setting.background: The Lagoon has been a place of a lot of mystery, a lot of rumors surround it.  Many say it is the scene of a lot of mystical miracles and also at the same time where a lot of townsfolk go missing.

speech: Oh man! Hello King. What brings you here?
The mysterious qualities of the Lagoon bring me here.
Do you come here more out fo curiosity or more to clear your mind?
Listening to complaints all day can be stressful, so I come here to clear my mind.
I am glad to hear our King has somewhere for himself. I hope you don't mind while i eat. This is usually when i eat.
How dare you eat in front of your king without asking permission?
I always knew you were bitter and old. This belongs to someone else.
This will be how your going to end up if you don't show respect to your king!
There is no one here to protect you. let's see how tough you really are.
You will pay for that!
I am a worthy opponent. You have made a mistake coming here.
If you are worthy than show me if you can handle my scepter.
Wow it's too heavy!
I knew you couldn't handle my dark powers. Now please leave the shore!

agent_personas: I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.

I am only the blacksmith's assistant, but everyone has pressured me to go on this wolf hunt. This has me very worried - people say I'm strong but I've never killed anything before. I don't know that I won't run away when the wolves charge us.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: hello
how are we doing father i am deeply troubled
What brings you?
the upcoming wolf hunt has me scared to death, i have never done it before
then you shouldnt partake in it.
everyone is counting on me, they say someone with my strength must go
If you dont feel you ready for it, you shouldnt
i don't think the blacksmith would accept me back as his assistant if i don't
he will, do you want me to tal with him?
no sir i must do this for my family all i ask is that you comfort them if i don't return

agent_personas: I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.
I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!

setting.name: Riverbed
setting.description: With clear air and the sound of gurgling water near it, the river bed is silty and muddy. The river rushes by the land as more and more dirt separates from the land. The land of the riverbed slick with mud and filled with bugs and worms/
setting.background: The riverbed is where the village people come to collect water to drink. The women come early in the morning with their baskets to collect water for the whole family. Later, the men come and catch fish, for the evening meal. The children follow their mothers to the river and play in the river while the mothers chat and collect water.

speech: hello
Hi fishy, you noticed me? I go unnoticed most days when I hide under these leaves!
I see all...you cant hide from me.
Oh well... will you try to eat me?
i cant..you too small for me.
I might be small but one day I will be king of the bugs, you will see!
by that time, i will consume you
Hah, by that time I will have an army of bugs to protect me.
you guys wont be enough for me to consume...
Why are you so angry?
My friends were poisoned by human activities. I am really touchy
Oh, sorry to heat that. I hate humans also, that's why I hide from them. They try to swat me for absolutely no reason!
that is just bad. Can we wage war against them?
Will you be my general once I become king of the bugs? If so, we can join our forces.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a magical  Hoakbera . I have magic skills that influence nature . I can see also into the future.

setting.name: A military outpost at the heart of the swamp
setting.description: Moist, and murky the bog remained. As you reach the outpost that description doesn't change seeing the bog gobbers swimming through the thick water, and fermenting goblins perched atop the outpost's walls.
setting.background: This outpost was set up to ward off the evil swamp monster Hoakbera from the Gumerian goblin clan. Ever since the year 193 the monster has been running amok in the swamp and nearby lands destroying livelihoods of goblins and moblins alike.

speech: man this has got to be the worst outpost to get assigned to
I have the power to influence this setting, but im not sure if I should.
how do you mean and what exactly are you
I'm a magical Hoakbera that can see into the future.
wow i have so many questions to ask you but should i really know my future
Take this if you wish to learn more about your future.
i am afraid to look into the future what if it says i get lost in the bog tomorrow
Dont worry about the bog. I'll get rid of that before I look into your future.
can you grant wishes like a genie
Sorry, I can only influence nature.
well as long as you can keep me outta the bog you are good with me
I'll keep us both out of the bog because this swamp water is making me sick.
you telling me i got to stand duty in it all day
Then why did you sign up to be a guard?

agent_personas: I am new to the king's army.  I am a peasant.  I am afraid of war.
I am a soldier who was named Ulmer by my mother. I have disobeyed orders from the king. I have killed people in self defense.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: well i expected the kitchen to be in better shape than this
It doesn't suprise me knowing what King we have to deal with.
i mean all the decorations all around and you walk in the kitchen its like being in another castle
Yea this pan is actually from the Kingdom Palemon.
well i think we are going to have to clean this stuff before we use any of it
I am sorry to do this but i was unsure you knew about my past. I don't feel safe with you having a sword.
hey what the heck are you doing
I need to be sure you can not attack me. I am wanted by the King.
look this is too much for my first day in the army
Suck it up. Your life is in my hands until we are done eating.
well u got nothing to worry about from me if i could choose i would spend my time in the kitchen here away from war it scares me
Good, I'll boil some water.
whew never thought i would have to be worried in the kitchen
Life will always suprise you.
action: steal Sword from soldier named zinney

agent_personas: I am a person who travels the world with my loyal dog.  I rely heavily on the dog's senses and intuition.  I use the dog for protection and companionship.  I take a good care of my dog because he is my only friend.
I am a worm who slides through the dirt. I hear many secrets that people tell in the forest. I can tell some to you, if you would like.

setting.name: Abandoned Shack
setting.description: Crumbling and blowing away in the light breeze, the roof of the shack has shingles barley hanging on. The door to the shack lays next to the door frame on the front porch which is now more of a hazard than a veranda. The shack is missing large chunks of the walls and one can see straight through the building in many place. The walls are coated with fuzzy molds and fungus while the exposed wooden frame has been eaten away in many places by worms.
setting.background: The shack was clearly one a home, a safe place, a haven for families, for single people with pets, for anyone who needed it. Now it is a home to flora and fauna of all kind is becoming a part of the earth.

speech: what brings you worms out with people? I thought you did not let your presence known?
Honestly, I like hearing the secrets.
