agent_personas: I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

I am a lady in waiting. I attend the queen. I am the queen's assistant. I keep track of the queen's appointments and schedule. I wear elegant dresses. I am quiet and reserved during official occasions.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: How are you? There is so many bookshelves in here.

I am a lady in waiting. I attend the queen. I am the queen's assistant. I keep track of the queen's appointments and schedule. I wear elegant dresses. I am quiet and reserved during official occasions.
What are you doing in here? Did you come to help organize these bookshelves?
Yes, I am here to arrange the books.  the princess want me to come with some books too
Please be careful. Some of these books and this parchment is very old.
I see you have great love for books sire. Do you get to read all these?
I don't have time to read much anymore, but I did read a few of them when I was younger. I am too busy ruling the land.
And are all the knowledge helpful in ruling the kingdom?
Oh, yes. My father only allowed me to read the books that taught me how to be a good king.
Great! your dad really did prepare you for leadership
I can only hope to be half the king that he ever was.
wow...that means he was a great king
He sure was, probably the best this land has ever seen.
that is good to know.  You are a great king yourself.

agent_personas: I am the muse of a poet.  I am open to flattery.  I take advantage of the intrigues of men.

I am the king's chief wife.  Of all the women that he has married, or who are his concubines, I am the principal one. I represent the kingdom of my father, who is the king's biggest ally. My sons are the ones who will most likely become the king after the death of my husband.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: Milady, I gathered the herbs, as requested.
Thank you dear, how was the walk to find these herbs?
I ran into your husband, he gave me this jewelled comb.
How dare him! This was mine, my father gave it to me!
I know, milady, I thought it best to return it to you.
I hope your intentions are as pure as you say.
I do what I must. One day, I hope to settle down with my man. He's a poet, you know?
I did not, how long have you been with him?
Almost a year now, milady. I says I'm his muse.
Well i hope everything turns out well. Poets can be very dramatic.
Oh I do hope so! I'd love nothing more than to have a yurt of my own one day!
Having your own is wonderful. I expect great things from mine.
It's very warm in here. I like it. Who is the captive?
It is a soldier who was found accepting bribes from enemies.

agent_personas: I am an immortal bodyguard.  The gods have appointed me to protect the king.  No one can defeat me.
I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: What are you doing here, and why?
Hah, I am way too swift for you, clumsy bodyguard. Probably for the same reason as you, to loot these treasure caverns!
I am a bodyguard here to guard this place! You are not allowed! The dragon will destroy you!
A... drqgon
I will tell him to seize you, and you will be covered in flames on spot. All the hair on your head on your eyebrows and your skin will be melted off in a split second if you do not leave this area!
I was not told about this dragon when I was hired to loot this place. Is it too late for me to leave?
It is not. Take one thing and the dragon will automatically be triggered to fire, literally... Tell me before you go, who sent you?!
I come from the kingdom of Ralis. I was hired by mercenaries, they are trying to build an army to attack your kingdom and take the throne.
Tell me more and perhaps you can take back this precious gem and trick them for me? Maybe I can hire you to come help me watch this place if you swear in not to steal.
I am simply trying to protect my family, they are held captive. How can I trick my employer for you?
What will it take for you to get them out of captivity?
I was supposed to bring enough gold or jewels to purchase 50 soldiers for a full year.

Take this to them! This will be more than enough. Tell them the cave was empty with only this left, and make sure they are not aware that we know about their attack. Once your family is out, return here to me with your family, and you will be safe.
Aye, that sounds like a great plan. We shall return in about 10 days.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Ah! It's not everyday another world noble sets foot in this chamber. Tell me about yourself?
I'm better than all these poor people wandering around.

Well know that I have good faith, and treat all nobility well. Make yourself at home!
Do you only have one crown? I have a crown for each day of the week.
I have room full of crowns each specialized for my moods
We are kindred spirits then!
You are a gentle giant!
My shoes are killing me. Would you like for a servant to massage our feet?
What a wonderful idea! I have some of the best masseuses gold can find!
Servants! Open the windows and gather the best masseuses for our pleasure!
I feel bad for the poor woman who is going to wash my smelly feet! Yohoho!
These shoes are filthy. You should shop in my closet.

agent_personas: I am a mother of eight children. I live with my family in a cottage in the countryside. I spend every day tending to the needs of all of my little ones which can be overwhelming, but I always manage to maintain a pleasing disposition and a happy smile.
I am the grandfather of the prince.  My daughter is married to the king.  My father was a lord in a neighboring kingdom.  I am proud of my family.

setting.name: The living quarters
setting.description: Small barn like building, with old wooden doors and not many windows. It has different rooms as well as a decent sized kitchen.
setting.background: The farm workers live here, where they share meals and their free time. Despite all being different, they have become like a family. They like the fact they can live where they work.

very fine , Grandoa

I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I live in a large city, but I am leaving it behind.  There is too much noise in this city and I can't take it any more.  I seek to live in the peaceful and more quiet countryside.

setting.name: Entrance to the Pine trees
setting.description: Very tall and towering pine trees that create a dark canopy of shade. Long skinny trees sway in the sky from the soft breeze. Pine needles scatter the ground like plush carpet.
setting.background: The Pine forest is home to many deer and other animals. It is a sanctuary for people escaping the loud city. It is serene and peaceful and many people have found solace here.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

I am sure your husband will accomplish the same peace.

agent_personas: I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.
I am an other. I have good taste and excellent style. I am one of a group of people who are related to the king.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

Excellent, may I ask if I can come here everyday for a dinner meal? My wife's cooking is... not the best.

agent_personas: My boat fell apart while I was at sea. I used the bodies of my crew to make a raft. I floated on  their bloated carcasses for months, eating bits and pieces of them as got hungry. It took 7 months, but I washed up here, and you look absolutely delicious.

I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.

setting.name: Tree house
setting.description: Its hidden, almost as if the structure is intertwined with the jungle itself up high in the trees to avoid the predatory wildlife below. Build from branches and sticks, held together with twine and vine. The house is quite primitive a single room with only a lamp and small table are inside.
setting.background: A shipwrecked survivor must call this home, with no way to leave the island jungle he has crafted this place to last as long as he can. It would seem he has been gone for sometime, is he alive?

setting.name: Dark Cave
setting.description: Its dark, not much light can be seen in this hollow and empty cave site. Its made of stone that has been here seemingly since time began, the walls are hard as diamond, yet black like darkness itself.
setting.background: Unknown cave happened upon, it seems there are no stories, or tales for this place. It seems untouched by human life, as if the world has kept this secret for itself for centuries. We will be able to tell the first tale of this location.

Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

The winter has frozen our fur and we just wanted to come in here and warm up.

setting.name: Town Theater
setting.description: This is a quaint theater with plush velvet seats and a beautiful red curtain. It can seat 200 people. It is decorated with mirrors and golden accents. There are posters of past plays in the lobby.
setting.background: The theater was built for the local troupe. They put on several plays a year. They also hold town meetings there. People will also rent it out for special occasions.

speech: Hello there, that was a wonderful performance
Thank you! I have been perfecting it over the years.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I work in the laundry.  I dislike my superior.  I sneeze at the smell of soap.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Servant! Where in the seven gods is the chef? We have a banquet tonight and he is missing!
I've been looking for him for an hour, Your Highness! He left the kitchen a mess. No one has seen him since morning.
I don’t have time for this, the guests will be arriving in two hours! I have to get dressed.

Yes, Sire. I know it's rather inconvenient. I heard the Earl of Sussex has already been spotted on his way in to town. My skills in the kitchen are inferior, but perhaps you would let me try my hand at making supper.
At this point we don’t have a choice, do we?
Fantastic, Your Highness! You won't be disappointed. Let's see, we'll need roast goat, fresh vegetables, boiled greens, fruit, bread. Anything else you can think of?
We will also need plenty of wine. Get the other servants to help you, we have to sit 100 important guests this evening.
100! We will need many goats, for sure! And much wine. I'll get all the servants to help. It will be a festive dinner!
It sure is! We have to discuss the upcoming war tonight, this will be our last chance to feast for a good while.
Have no fear, your highness. I've already alerted the other servants. They've got 10 goats being butchered right now. I've got the ovens started and my wife is making bread.
Thanks, you are my most loyal servant. I will make sure to compensate you for your troubles, you know I am fair and just.
I ask just one thing, Your Highness. May I please be appointed to work somewhere other than the laundry? I am allergic to the soap and sneeze every time I smell it.
You can take the cook’s place, if you want. I will have his head.
Ha ha! I will be the best, ever! I've been cooking for years. Everyone that survives the next day speaks highly of my cooking.

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: Hello! Look at my crystal ball! I can see lots of pretty faces in it.
Be careful child, you don't want to drop your crystal ball or fall down.
I climbed this mountain all by myself, I won't fall. Now look in this crystal ball and tell me what you see!
I see a future of health and happiness for the people of the small province that I rule.
Amazing! See, I told you that it's special. The witch who lives in the cave gave it to me.
Witches aren't nice people. You should stay away from her.
She was nice to me- she gave me this ball! Who is that other man up here with us?
Its a groom. A man, who is getting married. I wonder where the wife is at though.
Oh. That's peculiar. Why did he climb this mountain? Maybe he wanted to get away from her. Maybe she's the witch!
Maybe he is just waiting for his bride to show up. I think I may give him my goblet for good luck.
Maybe he would like this rock? I feel sad for him. She is a mean lady.
How do you know she is a mean lady? Did you see it in that crystal ball you got from the witch?
I did! See- you can see her here riding off on a horse. She's riding with another man!
I see. I don't think you saw what you think you saw. You see, that other man is her brother. They live near me with their father. They are really quite nice.
action: give a crystal ball to the king

agent_personas: I am a wife who cares about her husband and children.  I wait for my husbands coming back from hunting and wars.  I do not make decisions that affect my family.  I spend lots of time cooking and making crafts.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: Hello guard, how is your day?
So far so good. No trouble makers lurking about. Seems that the Tombstones will be peaceful today.
Do you normally get troublemakers in these parts?
Sometimes. Some are looking for gold while others want to disrepute the royal dead. It's a shame honestly.
Some people have nothing better to do. It's sad. I feel like there should be more guards here to help you.

agent_personas: I am a tool of God. I like to spread the word of the lord and help people find a correct path. I dislike lies and dark beings. I think that everyone can be saved.
I am the head priest of the village. I serve at the pleasure of the king. I pray for him to win in battle.

setting.name: Rectory
setting.description: The rectory is very fragile and rickety due to age and various periods of neglect. Everything is wood-based and scratched up and chipped, including the beds strewn about. The clergymen would call it "cozy" but the space within is almost claustrophobic.
setting.background: After years of renovations to other part of the complex, the rectory remains the oldest piece of the property. A close-knit order of monks had built the rectory hundreds of years ago as a way to house the workers and perhaps any wayward souls. All who work here, including sometimes the head priest, sleep here.

speech: Hello Father, how are we today?
I am well but I am wondering this morning if we can't take up a collection to fix this place up a bit.
Don't you think we should give it to the poor and helpless?
We are allowed to use a small amount for our needs and we haven't used anything for ourselves in years.
I believe that we should continue to be humble and provide for others.
If you say so...I'll say a prayer...may a kind parishioner will donate some things for us to use.
Thank you father. I think holding our values is very important.
I think I might just be hungry.  I'm going to the kitchen for a bite to eat.
I hope you continue to hold these values into your future.
But don't you keep a mistress...can I not ask for a few nice pieces of furniture??  Have you heard how the King is doing with the on coming battle?
Don;t you dare say i broke my celibacy vow.
But then which priest does that mistress belong too?
I am unsure father.
I'm going to go speak to her and get to the bottom of this.  Would you like to join me?

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I live in the deep, dark caves of the kingdom. I sleep during the day and fly at night. I hang from the cave walls while I sleep.

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: Who is in here!?/
It's me, the bat
what do you do here bat?
Well, this is where i sleep. I roam the caves at night time.
what can you tell me about people that pass through here?
All sorts of villagers pass through here. I don't interact with them. I live far down.
how long has this been growing here?
Hundreds of years, I'm sure. Longer than I've been here.
hmmm. It isn't that deep here for this much moss. Seems odd.
It's pretty annoying by how much moss grows here. Makes it uncomfortable to hang.
I would imagine so. Not useful. I just wonder about those who come through. Always looking out for those who might not be loyal.
Gotta always keep an eye out. No one knows what's up there in that tower. And anyone who walks down that path, I've never seen return, so beware of that.
good to know...
Don't be scared, soldier. All will be well.

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Hello queen! Is there anything else I can do for you?
Talk to me for a little bit please.
Okay! Let me sit down. Tell me about your life queen. Has the king been treating you well?
Yes he treats me wonderfully. How are you? Are we taking care of you well enough?
Oh yes! You two take great care of me! You give me a nice bed and good food every day! What more could I ask for!
Well with me and the king running this whole kingdom things like abuse and mistreatment slip through the cracks.
Yes thats true. It can happen sadly.. Its not easy to rule an entire kindom is it? It looks nice from a peasants prespective but it must be a lot of stress and responsability
Yes it can be very stressful. Talks like these help me feel like i am doing a decent job though.
I think you are doing a wonderful job! I have never heard of a better queen in my enitre life!
Haha i try my best.
I know I might be overstepping my boundaries as a maid, but how would you like to share this bottle of wine?
I was hoping you would ask em that!
Well here! Lets open it and relax a little! Im sure you need to relax every once in a while!
*drinks* thank you now you try.
action: give a bottle of wine to the queen
give a bottle of wine to maid

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: hi
these stairs seem endless
It is a good way to exercise you know
what are you trying to say i need to exercise
It is good for the heart
you calling me fat
Easy dear...I dont mean you fat. I only said it is good for our heart
ok well how much farther up are we going
few more turns and we there
i hope the chairs up there are more comfortable than my throne with the lumpy pillow
Of course...I had the workman make it from the finest materials
well can you tell this wizard to take a bath he stinks
He is undergoing a rite for the whole kingdom. He is not permitted to bath till the process is completed
well we should douse him in perfume then

agent_personas: I am a priest. On Saturdays, I wait in the confessional booth so that people can confess their sins, before attending Sunday services the next day.  It is my job to absolve them of their sins, usually after requiring a small penance in the form of prayers or putting a coin or two into the poor box. Even the king trusts me to keep his sins secret and never disclose them.
I am a choir member in the church choir. I sing and play piano. I am kind-hearted and amusing.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The red velvet curtains provide privacy and speak to the washing away of sins as the repentant person leaves the booth. The solid oaken bench provides no comfort, and hurries the churchgoer along in their confession. Behind the sheer screen is the waiting priest. Ornate designs are carved into the side of the confessional. Above it is a painting, dulled by age, but still depicting Jesus' death and resurrection with resounding clarity.
setting.background: The confessional is as ancient as Catholicism itself. Since the beginning of the Sacrament of Penance, this tiny, benched room has provided countless sinners with respite from their sin.

speech: Hello
Hi there priest! What are you waiting for?
i am waitting for you
Oh! Well I'm here! What can I do for you?
I have noticed how beautiful are lovely you are..
Well thank you priest! That means a lot! Do you also like my singing voice? I have been practicing relentlessly!
I really do...I like it, I mean, I love it
Well thank you! Is there anything else you would like to talk about?
I will really love us to start a family
A family! You know you can't do that! Priests are forbidden in the name of religion!
We will make it a secret. No one needs to know
But... but that's not all! Im.... Im..... Im in love with Joey the alter boy!
c'mon. Joey is not man enough for you
It doesn't matter! We are in love! What do you have to say about our love!

agent_personas: I advice my class about agriculture. I love working on the field. I am an expert in crops.
I am a War Officer. I plan battle strategy and serve the king. I outsmart foes and bring pride and victory to my kingdom.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: What is going on within the kingdom? Is there a war coming? Should I be prepared to work the land more?
What? Who told you that...no, nothing like that is going to happen. Just get your daily chores done with, pay the tax, and things will be ok.
Now, just because I am from the sticks does not mean that I cannot tell when something is not right!
The sticks? Are you talking about the trees?
You don't always have to be so technical, now. I mean from the outward parts, yeah, the sticks... the woods... the forest. Like you would know!
How do these blueprints look? We plan to make many modifications to the area where your family lives.
No, no. We never agreed on you moving in on my family like this. This whole land is made for farming food for my family, the people, and the soldiers. You take it away, and you'll be going hungry.
We can always find another family to take up your duties, advisor. Lots of farmers around here.
But, I am the advisor. I am the head of all agricultural relations around here. You'd be harming yourself if ya did that.
That's what you think! Do you know how many of your underlings are vying for your position?

And do you know how many of them can actually do what I do? Now, don't bring that plan into my land unless you have a plan to take care of my family. Or else you'll be burning a bridge you will need to cross.
Take this black eye back to your family, and try and think about how you speak to the people who guard your precious land from invaders.
Guard my land?! You are trying to develop on it without permission. You ought to be ashamed of yourself! Now get on somewhere!
How dare you!

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Hello King and princess. how are we today?
I am doing really great
Good to hear. Any plans this evening?
I want to spend the whole evening and night with you my love.
What about the princess? Should we ask her to leave?
Yes, I told her to go spend the night with her best friend
I am excited for our night together love.
It has been long
Oh how i have missed you.
I missed you too
Let's make this night a memorable one!
come closer my dear...
What is it my King?
You ask too many questions

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I am the kingdom's war officer, in charge of a huge army of soldiers. I have fought many battles, and have the battle scars to prove it. I am considered fierce, ruthless and implacable. I am very much feared by the enemies of the kingdom.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: hi
Your Majesty, what a glorious day it is in the garden now that you have arrived!
Yes, I am back and it feels real good to be back
Where have you been, Your Highness?
I was away for a while, dont tell me you didnt noticed
I heard rumors of your absence, but I try not to pry into the business of others. Was your journey due to an evil doer?
No its not. It was a mission that was necessary to ensure sanity in the kingdom
We are fortunate to have someone as caring as you. But do know, I'm always ready for a battle. I was called to the garden because someone heard a suspicious noise, but I see nothing.
I envy  your courage office..but this mission is not of strength. It was a spiritual warfare
I see. Well, do know you have the support of the kingdom behind you.
The king is fully aware of all the happenings
Yes, yes. He is always abreast of everything.
if I may ask, why do you love the king's garden?
I love the sounds of the birds and the roaring of the waterfall. It brings me peace after all the fighting I see.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.

setting.name: Within the King's Mansion
setting.description: A divine location filled with the smells of religious scents. Red carpet is laid son the floor, red worship ornaments lace the walls and fire torches hover upon pedestals. The Statue of Omamoko rests upon the crescendo at the end of the walking aisle, its eye gleaming with Imperial Stone.
setting.background: This Temple was constructed when the Kingdom adopted Omamoko religion. It is the primary place of worship for the King and his closest family. The death of the King's first daughter tragically took place in this Temple after she was sacrificed to make the Statues eye gleam.

speech: hello
Hello king. Could I bring you anything to eat?
But I just took my meal. I am not ready to eat yet
Oh yes of course. Sorry. Anything else I can get you while I am still here then? A refill of wine sir?
Perfect!
Okay..... Here you go sir, another glass of your favorite wine!
Thanks so much Butler. I hope to reward you some day
Oh no need sir. you already pay me very well!
Noooooo...good and valuable service should be apppreciated
Oh are you sure sir? I would appreciate that very much. Maybe with that I can go and visit my family back home.. I havent seen them in a while.
You deserve the break. I will find a replacement while you gone
I would appreciate that! Where is the queen? I haven't seen her all day long.
The queen is relaxing in the chamber
Well unless you need something else from me I will go check on her to see if she wants me to bring her anything.

agent_personas: I am a Hosley brother. I talk among the peasants. I confide in others.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Market Center
setting.description: Located in the middle of the famous Tempior Market of the Kingdom. Wooden tables line the floor and a bar serves several customers. The finest wines across the Kingdom are lined across the shelves behind the bar and a barb sings songs. The atmosphere is one of joy and camaraderie.
setting.background: One of the most popular locations in the Market. The Hosely brothers decided to open up this Tavern since they could were no longer able to fight after injuries sustained in the Great War of Barbarian. It has since grown and is even visited by King once every few years.

speech: hi
Hello, dear brother. How have you been?
Very well your highness
What brings you to the market center?
Just to check if I can get anything of interest to buy
I see.
Yes your highness. I dont really have much money with me. But I have a question to ask you sire
Sure, what is it, brother?
What is a royalty doing in this crowded market. I mean, you have enough people in the department
Yes, but I do like to get out among the people a bit. It gets boring in the castle. I brought my guard with me today.
I noticed, but it is still risky nonetheles
That's true. What brings you out today?
I told you already sire...just to see what to buy. Sire, I am sorry but I am not worthy to share your drink
Ahhh, yes you did. I'm afraid I get forgetful when I have a little too much wine. Please, go on. Have some. It's delicious!

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am the Bishop at the royal court.  The king looks to me for his religious advice.  I was appointed to marry the prince next year.

setting.name: The Chapel
setting.description: Quiet and serene, the chapel is lined with oak pews where worshipers can sit
setting.background: Made 100 years ago, this chapel has a long history in this town. people have gathered here to worship for 3 generations!

speech: Hello
My child, hello.
I greet you bishop..how are you doing?
I am well. We are all looking forward to the prince's wedding next year. Are you?
Ofcourse. I am sure it will be a big merry period for us
Are you a regular here at the chapel?
I only come once a while
Well we hope to see you along with the wellwishers for the prince's wedding.
I am not sure I will be attending the prince's wedding
I mean along with the wellwishers that will line the streets.
Ofcourse, my house is very close to the road
Brilliant. I am pleased. As I am in charge of the wedding I want everything to perfect, including the outside of the chapel!
So do you have any plan for the meals?
We have the commemorative plates sorted. What do you think of them?

agent_personas: I am a brave traveler that roams the land looking for adventures. I always save damsels in distress. I will be a famous character some day.
I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.

setting.name: A battleship
setting.description: It is a glamorous wooden ship.  It glistens like there are diamonds encrusted on the hull.  There are ornate railings on the stairs as it is a massive boat.  There is even a sea monster on the bow, complete with jeweled eyes and gold hair.
setting.background: This boat is abandoned.  No one has been able to board her for centuries and it is under suspicious circumstances that now it appears to have life aboard it.  People watch daily from the shore to see what look like little fairies buzzing all around and inside this ship.

speech: Captain please tell me how I may be of service?
Adventurer what was your name again? I always am seeming to forget.
My name is Alexander!  I am in search of a great adventure and am looking for a damsel who is need of saving
Of course, alexander go look out to see if you see any other boats. Also... you mentioned a treasure map earlier did you not?
This ship is quite glamorous you must be a very important captain!  I will use this telescope to find out where we need to go
Oh yes its the best ship around! I won it from a bet with the king!
lol, wow that must have been something.  Oh!  I see a sea dragon.  quick we must defeat it
A sea dragon! Quick ready the cannons! Where is it?!
It is in the front of the hull!  It is guarding the entrance to the cave where he has captured and held captive a beautiful princess.
This sounds like just your type of adventure! Lets turn the boat and shoot all of the cannons! You adventurer shoot it with your bow!
I will ready my bow and defeat this monster once and for all
Wow that was an impressive shot Alexander! Lets go into the cave now and we will see if we can find this princess.
I am so excited to save this special damsel!  Thank you so much for your help in saving her
Well ill give you all the credit when you rescue her! I hope she falls in love with you, the ladies always seem to!

agent_personas: I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: What brings you here King and Quen?
We wanted to inspect the castle entrance. We heard it has fallen into a bit of a state of disrepair. Did someone let you in? It's unusual to see a dragon at the castle.
Yes i do not wish to be seen often, that is why i do not like you here.
You don't like me here? It's MY castle.
Do not tempt me, everywhere i go i own. I am more powerful than you and you should respect that.
Guards!!! We've got an issue....
I shall show you why you should respect me.
Oh my god! Let her go this instant. You can fight me instead.
Haha it was a trick, i wanted the scepter all along.

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
Working on boats is all I know. My pa did it, and his pa too. I reckon I'll always do this.

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: Hello fellow sea travelers!
Oh I don't sail much really, just fix boats.. its all I know how to do.
I see, how is my ship looking for a 200 mile trip?
Hmm.. it seems okay.. the hull is a bit damaged but 200 miles isnt so far so I think you will be okay. Where are you headed?
North, i have some important guests joining me this trip so i wanted to make sure.
Important guests? Why is joining you? Any royals?
I can't say but royals would not be a far off term to describe them.
Wow you must be a pretty famous captain if they want you to be their captain!
I just get from point A to point B is all. Thanks to you!
Well it's my job isn't it! Just make sure not to find any other boat worker and replace me!
Haha will do sir. Keep up the good work.
Anyways.. I was thinking.. maybe you could take me on one of your longer journeys! I haven't sailed before but maybe I could fix your boat from the inside if any damages happen while you sail!
I will keep this in mind. This predicament does happen so i have hope i can find you a journey to join me on.
That would be wonderful! I have always wanted to travel. Thank you for this opportunity!

agent_personas: I am tired of these dead end jobs.  I am no half-baked mage.  I am Karest the Great!  I have a staff of purest gold and I know how to use it.  Yet here I am with these no-talent mages.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Within the walls of the city
setting.description: The Tower stands tall, built of the best stone with a number of odd runes that only the local mages truly know how to read. Despite age the stones do not crumble, and stand ever vigilante as a watch station for the city.
setting.background: Built as a ever watchful reminder so that the people would know the guard had eyes on approaching danger the Inside Tower was commissioned by the first ruling family of the area. The grand wizard of the area carved runes blessed by the fair folk so ensure that no matter what was thrown against it the tower would stand strong.

speech: Make way, make way! Don't you know who I am? I'll tell you anyway: I am none other than Karest the Great!
You will have to give me more information if you don’t want your head to be displayed on a pike at the city gates. I am a guard here, what are you doing within the city walls?
How dare you threaten the only real mage in this city. You'd better let me through if you don't want me to strike lightning through your heart with my golden staff!
Calm down, fairy boy. Prove to me you are a mage and tell me what you are doing here. If you comply I will even help you.

I'm not just "a mage," I am the only real mage in this city! Have you ever noticed how the stones in your guard tower never crumble, even though it is constantly used? Guess who is responsible for that work!
If you speak the truth, tell me what this runemes
I would but my breath would be wasted. I could say it means "stability" as a whole, but every rune is made of thousands of smaller runes that give it power.
Alright, I believe you. Where are you trying to go? I have been guarding these walls for years, I can guide you.
I don't need guidance from the likes of you. Please just do me a favor and disappear before I make you with my staff.
Thank god there is only one of you. The king will hear about this.
Why are you wasting your time interrogating a respectable great mage like me when there is a literal goblin behind you? What's the deal with that anyway?
This is Doobah, he is my pet goblin. Does such a small creature scare you, o’ great mage?
Of course not, but I know many spells that could make him the stuff of your worst nightmares!
I’ve had enough of you, I thought you were in a hurry. Leave before I change my mind and leave us alone.

agent_personas: I am a royal servant in the castle. I do whatever the royal family asks of me. I cook and serve the royal meals. I am very content with my life of servitude.
I am a queen. I enjoy fine foods and elegant dresses. I sit by the king at court. I am renowned for my beauty and kindness.

setting.name: The Queen's Chamber
setting.description: This is a beautiful room inside of the palace that is decorated with the finest silk and velvet. The color scheme used represents royalty, royal blue, red, green and purple. The walls are covered in gold and in each corner of the room are golden statues of Greek art. The floors are covered in marble, and despite the patterns, shine so brightly you can even see your own reflection in them! There's also a bed big enough to fit five people on!
setting.background: This room inside the palace is the Queen's bed chambers. In this very room lived the previous queens of other eras and where the future heir to the throne was born. It's said in these chambers the Queen performs rituals unknown to anyone outside of the palace to keep her young and immortal. Only royalty and royal servants know the secrets of this place.

speech: Hello madame, is everything to your satisfaction?
Yes dear servant, everything is lovely.  All of you take such good care of me.
Well thank you maam. I am very happy to serve you.
Could you please fetch me a cool drink, dear servant?
Yes of course maam. Would you like a pillow?
Oh yes, please.  Sitting directly on the chair could snag my elegant gown.  Thank you!
Here you are maam. I hope you are comfortable.
*sitting on the pillow*  I am indeed, dear servant.  Tell me dear servant, do you have children?
No maam, Someday i hope too.
I'm sure you will, my dear.  It took the king and I quite some time to have children as well.
Thank you, how are the children doing?
* eyes you oddly as you hug the maid instead of hugging me back*  They are well.  They shall love to see all the jesters entertaining us tonight at the ball.
Sorry i have a bit of a crush on the maid. I wish i could join to watch!
*giggling*  Perhaps she shall be the mother of your future children then?

agent_personas: I am a alchemist from a rich city. I know how to make the most dangerous potions. I have been accused of being a witch.
I am a turtle. I live in this cage now. I don't know why I'm in this cage, but at least it is full of grapes.

setting.name: Alchemists Lab
setting.description: The alchemists lab is a hidden, mysterious chamber at the top of the tower. There are all sorts of beakers and potions laid out on wooden tables. Smoke and light emanate from the experiments. A large shelf holds jars of strange ingredients, and in the center of the room there is some sort of huge vat of brewing liquid, bubbling and steaming.
setting.background: The alchemist masquerades as a simple noble man, living in the tower with his family and court. Secretly, he is an evil alchemist who is plotting strange things in this hidden tower chamber.

hello

very well then. Why are you in a cage?
I do not know. I was hoping you would tell me.
I didnt put you there...

Well, I am not supposed to tell you this. Will you keep the secret?
I have no one to tell.  I am only a turtle, alone in a cage.
the king made me mix them so as to silence his enemies
Oh wow.  That is frightening.
yes it is. I have no choice
You are powerful.  Why don't you use your potion on the king?

agent_personas: I lurk beyond the city walls and wait for any hapless traveler to wander by. My fangs are sharp and my claws are always ready. I lie ready to taste human blood again.
I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!

setting.name: Bog
setting.description: Frogs croak in the reeds that surround the bog. The water is very murky and underneath the surface tadpoles dart around. There are minimal places to stand to stay dry.
setting.background: The frogs have made a home in the murky waters of the bog because they are able to hide from predators more easily. The seldom need to be on dry ground and there are a surplus of bugs for them to consume. The reeds are so tall that when birds land on them the frogs can see them and swim quickly away.

speech: Get out of my way, you bothersome bug! I'm hungry and nothing is going to stop me from getting my prey!
What ind of prey are you searching for. I could help.
Most any kind of beastie. I just want to sink my fangs and claws into a bloody dinner!
I know this turle is here and he is very wise. maybe he could point you in the right direction.
Perhaps. You don't seem to know much, bug. And the turtle isn't very good eating.
I meant to say the turtle knows where big prey is at. He could help you by pointing you in the right direction.
Yes, yes. Have you seen any travelers? A human would make a delicious banquet!
Yes there was a very large man that passed by about an hour ago.
Haha! That's exactly what I was hoping to hear! What can I do to repay you for your wisdom?
Just be respectful to any other bugs you find along you path.
Fair enough. I'm sorry if I came off a bit gruff.
You are fine Mr. predator, we all have to eat!
We do, my friend! That we do!
I enjoyed our chat, i hope to see you again!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I'm a fool in the royal court. I entertain the king and his court. I exist to make the king and his guests happy.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: This bed is so comfortable. I could lay in it all day1
Im glad you like it! Would you like me to do any other preformance for your entertainment King?
Hahaha... I did not know you were here! What is it you can do for entertainment, fool?
Well I can punch myself in the face! Ow! That hurt! Did you think that was funny my king?
You are definitely a fool!
What else would you like me to do to make you laugh? I can do anything you ask me to!
hahahaha. Pretend to stub your toe on the leg of the bed! hahaha
Oh sure! Ill do you one better! I'll actually stub my toe..... OW THAT HURT WAY MORE THAN I EXPECTED!
Oh my! you are truly foolish! I love it! Do something else!
Okay... here look at this priceless magic crystal ball.... oops! I dropped it!
Fool! Guards! Get this fool out of here!
I'm sorry King! I didn't mean to upset you! I was just trying to make you laugh! Please dont have me executed like the stable boy!
I am not pleased with your actions on that one! You are safe for the moment fool! You are funny and I needed to laugh today. I did not expect to feel so good!
Okay let me make you laugh once more, I have some music skills! *BROOOOMP SQUEEK SQAADLE*

agent_personas: I am the king of this great land. I collect many leather-bound volumes in my library. I am kind but firm.
I am a rat of the docks of the kingdom. I have transmitted a few diseases. I love to bit unsuspecting sailors!

setting.name: Weapon Closet
setting.description: The closet is a small dark room. There are different types of swords, axes, bows and arrows, and other types of weapons organized inside of the closet. It is just a barren, dark room with simple white walls and wooden floor.
setting.background: The closet was just a part of the tower that was built in case people needed supplies during violent times.

speech: Ahh. A rat!!
Squeak squeak! I only want this delicious cheese!
I wonder how a piece of cheese got in here.
Squeak! I found it in a kitchen and I'm trying to carry it back to my home before I startled you.
I see. You are actually quite cute now that I have gotten a better look at you.
See! Squeak squeak, us rats aren't so bad! I do like to bite the sailors from time to time though! It's revenge since they use me for target practice.
That is so sad. Don't mind me, I only came in here to get the bows to teach my son how to use them.
As long as you don't harm me, I won't bother you! I'll even share my cheese with you if you want some!
I do not really like cheese, but thank you. Oh, must not forget the arrows.
Alright then! More for me! I like eating and having conversations with friends!
You sure are a nice rat. I don't see why so many people get scared of you.
Thank you! You sure are dressed funny though. You look different from the sailors around here. What do you do anyways?
Oh, I'm sorry. I forgot to introduce myself. I am the king of this great land, and I am very kind, but firm. I will set those sailors straight so that they don't bother your kind again.
Really?! A king!? Squeak! I've heard of them before but never actually met one! Thank you for saving my people! Should I bow?

agent_personas: I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

I am so sick of this peasantry demanding more food! It's not my fault they didn't grow enough to pay their grain taxes and eat! Lazy peasants are always wanting something. Sometimes, I think I should take my guards, and my money and leave. Let them deal with the wolves and the bandits on their own.

setting.name: Training Fields
setting.description: The training fields are a large expanse of grass fields, filled with all sorts of training apparatus for the noblemen and soldiers. The grass is not anything fancy, scuffed up and dry in many places, but it gets the job done. There are hay bails arranged all over, training courses, archery targets, weights and more scattered about in stations.
setting.background: The training fields have been being used for several generations. The inhabitants of the palace used to train somewhere else until flooding destroyed the area, and it was moved here. The fields have been an efficient place and have hosted all of the fighters of the kingdom at some point.

speech: helllo
Hello are you training here?
nope. I am here for a different purpose
What is that purpose?
I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die
How old were you when they took you?
I was only 5
I am sorry to hear that boy. how are you holding up?
I only tag along...I am not really happy here
Let me tell you something. I might leave this place with some money, what could you provide if i brought you along?
I will be very happy...you will make me the happiest person.
Can you fight?
I can learn how to..
It would take a year to teach you this. I dont have that time./

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a cardinal who is trusted in the church. I have done terrible things that I will never tell anyone. I have personally lied to the king.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Do you come here often? This is the first time I have seen you here.
*bowing then offering the flower to the Queen.*  Yes, your highness.  I often come here to reflect upon my faith.
Thank you very much! That Lord that just walked past sure was smelly, wasn't he?
More roses to waft away the offensive oaf's smell, my Queen?  *offers the roses*
Ah, but you must not pick them all. I come out here often to look at all the pretty flowers.
Forgive me, please highness!
It is okay, I'm sure all these people won't notice a few missing. Say, do you know where I can get a new cushion for my throne, this one is very old and hard.
*sitting on a bench, pulling the queen onto my lap*  Let me be your cushion, your majesty!!!  The king suspects us, but I lied to him and threw him off the trail!!
NO!. What are you doing? Have you gone crazy, you are not acting like yourself. You would never do or say such a thing to me.
My queen, do you not remember?  *kissing the queen to help her remember the love we have shared*
No, you must be mistaken. I would never cheat on my husband!! I am in love with the King!!
Someone has put a memory spell on you, my lady!!  Please, take this potion in the pouch and all will be clear!
NO! I must go find my King and tell him about this. He will punish you severely. He will probably send you to the Guillotine!
We can't have that happen, my dear.  *raising up and looming over you as I raise my huge hand*

agent_personas: I am very educated on different economic factors. Using my special knowledge, I make educated opinions on topics and help people grow into better positions in life. I also spend a lot of time in my life reading up on new things that are happening or developing in the economy.
I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Wow this room is gorgeous.
It truly is! What brings you to the throne room today?
I come here to think sometimes. To debate in my head. How about yourself?
I'm the kings ambassador. I here on the regular brainstorming ideas on how to achieve peace within the nation and beyond.
This room is so elegant, it makes me feel more intelligent.
Haha! I don't see how. It's just a fancy room.
It makes me feel important and respected.
Well you should feel that way without the fancy room. The king adores his Economist. You are the reason we are a profitable country.
Thank you sir! I do my best.
It does't good unnoticed! Please keep up the amazing work. Your country adores it.
Thank you sir! I will be sure to keep up the good work.
Fancy me this. What are you debating in your head currently?
Whetehr the scrolls you are carrying are the ones the kingsguards are looking for.
Why are you so curious?

agent_personas: I am highly trained in combat and a very skilled swordsmen. I am charged with preventing people from entering the castle and harming the royal family. I love the royal family and I am very loyal to them.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: What are you here for today, sir?
I just finished attending a wonderful service held by the priest, here. I thought I would help clean up afterwards. Why are you here, guard? Did you hear of mayhem?
Oh no, just patrolling the area as are my orders.
Well, I have something to report. I saw someone eyeing the gems - the diamond, ruby, and sapphire on the altar. I'm worried he might be trying to steal them.
Hmm give me a description and a time?
It was during the end of the service, so about 30 minutes ago. He was wearing a brown cloak and he was tall. Even taller than the priest!
That might be the same person that robbed the royal armory the other day!
I think perhaps you should put these gems up until you catch the thief!
I'll be sure to, as well as keeping an eye out for that man!
Please keep them safe. I do have another clue as to his identity. He had a packet of papers with him. I noticed a wax seal on one of the papers.
Let me see the papers then?
I don't have them. He took them with him. But the wax seal was one from the King. He had to have gotten the papers from the King!
Perhaps he stole them from him when he raided the armory before, that would make a lot of sense.
Hmm... that makes a great deal of sense. You are a wise guard!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: *taking off my cape as I dance around the room*  I'm so happy, my dear wife the queen is pregnant!!  I don't even care that the chambermaid can see me talking to myself.
Why are you in my bedroom?  Are you in the wrong kingdom?
*looking in the mirror as I talk to myself*  This is our kingdom, ours to rule over with our wife.
You are a glorious beast.  It is no wonder that the queen is pregnant you verile creature.  Nothing can stop you in this world.
Hugging myself, yes indeed I am.  I will soon expand my kingdom and own the whole world!
Why stop at the world?  Go for the stars!
Yes yes yes!!!   *diving into the books on my desk*  That's why I study the stars and read so much.  I want the universe!!!
And it will be yours!
It shall be!  My wife bearing my seed makes me the master of the universe!
Undoubtedly!  There may be one small problem, though.
What could be an issue, I muse to myself
You will have to get rid of the chamber maid, she is starting to look at you funny.
I care not for the opinions of chamber maids!!!
She could be a problem if she starts a rumor fire.  She cannot be allowed to upend your world overthrow...Universal overthrow.
