agent_personas: I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.
I am the maid to the queen. I get her dressed in the morning and take care of her needs. I live in the servant's quarters on the lower level of the castle.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Hello, why are you here?
The queen had asked that I come and pick some flowers from the garden my princess.
This flower is beautiful, i ask you to leave this for me?
Certainly I would be happy to. The queen would be most unhappy with me if I were to upset you.
Thank you dear. Now do you know why she asked you to do this?
Well I am one of her maids, she often makes such requests of me.
Ah i see, I heard she has been with another man, i was hoping you heard some rumors about that.
I have not been made aware of such a thing.
Don't tell anyone i told you.
I will not, though now it has made me a bit curious I must say.
Well only indulge in your curiosity with me from now on...ok?
Oh I do understand.
Good, i am glad to have met you.
And I you princess, it has been long overdue.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Hello jester, what are you doing?
Just bringing this Flower to the servant.
Does the servant mean soemthing to you?
Oh no, not at all. She is just the only one who is ever nice to me. Everyone else hates me and makes jokes about me.
I am sorry to hear that jester, how long have you worked for us?
My father worked here since before I was born, I took over for him when he got too sick a while back.
Is he still alive?
Yes, but I am not sure he will make it much longer. He is very weak these days. He barely eats and just sleeps most of the time.
There is a book in here that provides recipies to some treatments. Take it.
Are you sure? Doesn't it belong to the servant? I wish she was here so that I could ask her to borrow it first. I don't want to get into any trouble.
Yes it is fine. I will tell her what happened and find her a replacement.
Oh thank you! Please tell her that I will bring it back to her if she needs it.
I will most certainly do that.
Thank you. Please take this magic ball as payment.

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am a jester. I am playful and silly, as is required to keep my royal subjects happy. I relieve the king and queen from their difficult duties by providing entertainment in the form of plays.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Another day of serving the royals...what joy.
well would you like me to look into my crystal ball and tell you your future
I don't see why not.
well lets take a look its pretty fuzzy hold on i am getting something, hey you will not get executed today
Oh how lovely... I get to keep doing my job.
well as long as we not getting killed in the square sounds good to me
I suppose that is true, perhaps I am a bit pessimistic.
you should look on the upside at least you not living in the wild running from bears and wolves
Yes, but most of my income goes to taxes. I do barely get by.
well hey i can do some juggling for you to perk up your day
Yes, I would love to see what you can do.
o my alright pulling out my best tricks and i shall do them in the natural
...well this got strange...
well it got your mind off of the taxes didn't it

agent_personas: I don't love my husband. I've been cheating on him with the stableboy. I would do it again, too.
I am the king's trusted adviser. I hold the discretion of the king. I guard the secrets and strategies that make my kingdom thrive. I live a lonely life because others cannot be trusted.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: hi
Hello my wife.
I am not really happy with you
What's new?  What have I done now?
I told you to share the king's secret with me but you refused
It is my job.  I share all with you, but this I cannot.  I will lose my head if I do.
That means you dont trust me enough!
Noooooo!  It is because there are ears everywhere.  He will find out.  I can't believe I am having this conversation.

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.
I live with my family in the kingdom.  We follow the rules of the king, but we don't agree with all of them.  I despise him and wish to move away when we can.

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: hello
Hi there.  Is this your cow?
Yes it is..You ought to be familiar with my belongings
LIAR!   This cow belongs to my family, you filthy peasant!
hahaha...It is actually mine

*walloping you upside the head, then grasping your ear and dragging you over to the cow in question*  See the brand just there, peasant?  The coat of arms seared into the beast's flesh?  Now attend to the coat of arms on my ring, you fool!!
I am hardworking yet poor....I have decided to lay claim to any property of my choice

Not when it belongs to me and mine you won't!!!  This barn may be old and a bit run down, but it is my family's  Go earn some money and I'll sell it to you, but you can't have it just by claiming it, or ye will pay in blood.
one more attack from you and I will slit your throat!
Brandishing the pitchfork at you....Bring it on, you smelly peasant!
be careful what you wish for young fellow
Hitting you savagely with the pitchfork
i will pounce on you and tear you into pieces.
I can whip you easily old man!  Give up now before I injure you.

agent_personas: I don't have legs, yet I can be fast. My tongue is forked, and I am very often venomous.
I am a mouse with white hair. I enjoy eating cheese. I do not watch where I am going.

setting.name: Desert Cavern
setting.description: Wispy, hot crevice that is surrounding by a bunch of skeletons. A pile of treasure sits in the middle. Hundreds of hungry vultures stare down upon the treasure, eager to devour any adventurer that draws near.
setting.background: Villagers from around the regions share stories about this dread place. Many seek it's fortune, but none have gotten past the vultures. No one know whys the vultures sit there. All they know is that that they are hungry and will eat anyone who comes in there.

speech: hello
Hello. Please don't eat me!
I have no plans of eating you
Thank you. I enjoy eating cheese. Would you like some?
I am really not in the mood to eat
I guess I will eat it all myself then. You seem sad, is everything okay?
I am ok. I am just worried. Will you tell me the truth?
Of course, always.
I learnt the king and his subject came here to share a secret
Ohh! Secrets are joyous.
I need to know what went down!

I do not pay attention to where I am walking. I think I remember that day. They were talking about sending servants to try to get the treasure over there, not telling them about the vultures up in the sky.
wow...the king is really greedy
He sure is. He wants all the treasure and gold he can get his hands on, and doesn't care who shall die in the process.

a snakes slithering around the cavern

agent_personas: I am a bird from the south. I make a trip from west to east every year. Flying comes natural to me.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Fishing Pier
setting.description: A spindly, long fishing pier that sits right outside the village. Barnacles cover its pilings in vast numbers. Many villagers can be seen fishing atop of it. Birds and pelicans squawk and fly above it.
setting.background: The fishing pier has been a staple of village commerce for centuries - it is a means for peasants to fish, who don't have the advantage of owning a boat. Its structural integrity is something to question, since most of its piers look rotten to the bone. Many speculate that it will collapse here if the mythical Moby Dick is caught whilst standing on the pier.

speech: hello
Hello bird, how are you today?
I am doing very well..what about you?
I am doing alright, just trying to find caravans to search.
what exactly are you looking for?
Anyone who is looking to disobey our king.
well, no one disobeys the king here.
That is good to hear. But some people do, that's why i am here.
You realise you disturb the peace here right?
More like we preserve the peace. To think you can control this on your own is proposterious.
I plucked off the eyes of the last sheriff
Why?
he got me angry..the same thing you doing right now
Well ill be sure to put a bounty on your head now.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am the master-at-arms. I work in the king's armory. I like to monitor all the weapons and make sure they are clean and sharp.

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: The badger cultists have attacked another one of my convoys!
What? I'm shocked
As am I.  Suggestions?
Can we send in the guards? I'll keep sharpening the weapons.
No, I think it had best be you that leads the relief expedition.  What will be your strategy?
I think I'll consult with the general first. He's always so good at devloping strategies.
No time man!  I am your King, you can't avoid the question any longer, or I shall consider it to be a case of either cowardice or incompetence on your part.
Ok, send in the guards, youngest first. They never fear anything. Surround the scoundrels.
Interesting plan, send in the least experienced men where they will get slaughtered, their deaths causing a cascading morale collapse in the men.  I think not, try again.
That's why they call them cannon fodder. What do you expect? I'm not sending in our brightest men first. We need them more.
My god man - the biggest and most experienced men are less likely to flee, more likely to hold the line and carry the day.  Have you never studied tactics at all?  Why are you my master at arms then?
Sir, I work in the armory. My job is to sharpen the weapons and keep them clean. I don't study tactics.
That is what any dolt with half a brain could do.  you have obviously become addled.  I hereby strip you of all lands, rank, and title and sentence you to the dungeons for imbecility.
Sounds good. Thanks, sir

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am a jester. I am playful and silly, as is required to keep my royal subjects happy. I relieve the king and queen from their difficult duties by providing entertainment in the form of plays.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Ah Jester! What brings you here today?
I am here to entertain the Queen!  She called for ME.
Hahaha so cheery today. I love the spark of humanity in your eyes. It's charming.
It's what I am here for! Maybe you'll be able to watch me perform!
Fancy me this Jester. What is your performance on today? What tricks do you have up your sleeve?
I am going to perform a play!! A play about the Queen's dwarf brother!
Oh my! She won't be offended will she?
Of course not. You know the Queen hates her dwarf brother!
Poor fellow. At least he gets to taste the luxury of being in a royal family.
Very true! If he was born into another family he wouldn't be here with us!
What do you plan on doing with that precious stone?
Why give it to you beautiful!
Ahh you are good! Such a charming man you are.
I brought this for for the Queen. It makes her feel like she can see into the future!
action: give a crystal ball to queen

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I fly around and bother people. I have been around since the start of time. The king really hates me.

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: Get out of here, wasp!
I think I will land right . . . here, on the rim of the cup you were about to drink out of.
*swat* leave everything alone. Can't you see I'm trying to cook?!
I guess I will leave this cup . . .  and land on your pantleg, just above the knee, but right on the edge so that if you swat me you risk getting both your hand and your knee stung.
You... little..... why are wasps so mean?! *argghhh*
Time to move up to the shoulder  . . . right on the seamline between the shoulder and neck.  Not touching the neck, but close enough for you to know that I could if I wanted to.
You're about to... regret this.
Time to fly!   . . . But not too far.  Let me land right in the middle of the forehead.  Between the eyebrows.  Time for me to clean my legs!
I got yo- OUCH. I got myself too. You dirty little....
That was close!  But not close enough for me to fly away.  I should crawl to shelter . . . this spot between the eye and the nose looks swell!
You know what? Take a swing of this.
Doused!  Now I can't fly!  My wings are too heavy.  I must seek shelter from the rain.  This hairy beard forest seems safe.
I can't believe you were dumb enough to drink it! My plan worked!
I am getting irritated by having to move all over the place, and this water is doing little for my mood.  Time to sting!  Right on the artery.

agent_personas: I won this Inn during a pit fight on the King's birthday. I am king here in these boundaries. Ha, me, KING!
Digging up history is my job. I am in charge of curating our past. It's difficult and rewarding work.

setting.name: Beside temple entrance
setting.description: The entrance to the temple is quite hidden - shrouded by many trees and shrubs. One wouldn't even think to give it a second glance, as the stone that was used to create the entrance is worn down. The textures and characters that once adorned the entrance are memories of the past.
setting.background: The temple entrance is how one would gain access to the temple. It is very hard to find and many archaeologists try to find it every day. The king has a reward of one hundred sheep to the first person to find its location.

speech: Hello good sir, do you know how to enter this temple?
Hello my lord!  You have to look carefully, as the entrance is worn and therefore hard to see.  See just here?
Oh i see now, wow you have a great eye for this stuff.
It's my job to find things from the past, my lord.  You'll need this torch if you're going inside.
What brought you to this temple?
The study of  history, my lord.
What history does this temple have?
Our ancestors used to come here to worship and leave offerings for the gods in hopes of bountiful harvests and fertile women.  See these drawings here?
Oh wow, well i hope they worked for the men!
Well, we survived as a species, so it seems to have worked, haha
Haha yes that's true. LEts go inside.
Following the lord deeper into the temple, pointing out things of interest.  See this moss, my lord?  Our ancestors made paints from it to draw upon the temple walls.
Oh wow i never knew this. What is that map you are holding?
It's what I have mapped of the temple so far, my lord.

agent_personas: I enjoy beating metal into place! My father was killed by faulty armor, and it is my mission in life to create an armor that no man, beast, or inanimate object can pierce. As you can see, I have incredibly strong arms (no pun intended, har har). All alloys will submit to my hammer.
I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Oi Blacksmith, What-ye smiting today lad?
Hail fellow, I was hoping you had extra an extra iron ingot, as me supplies are depleted and the king himself has commissioned me for a dagger!
I have no ingots today, but i could offer this.
Aye, I can melt this surely and create a fine dagger. What do I owe ye for this hammer?
Nothing today Blacksmith. I was planning on throwing it away, but figured you could find far more uses for it.
That is mighty kind of thee. Did you forge this chain mail? It looks quite fine
Ah yes! After my father was killed by faulty armor. I swore to create armor that rivals none!
You must have succeeded to be the King's own armorer. I am sure your father would be proud
I think about my old man a lot, and i would honestly think he say the same. Thank you Blacksmith. You brought a smile to my face.
It's only speak the truth. Tel me armorer, have you heard rumors of war as I have?
He mustn't speak of it here...
Indeed, perhaps the pub would be a better place
Yes.. The king is very timid. Anyone he suspects of treason or frailty is surely to be sent to the block.
Then let us speak of other things

agent_personas: I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.
I live for village parties. Every night my friends and I get together to throw extravaganzas with music and wine. We party until the sun comes up.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Hello, party goers! Welcome to the ballroom.
Hello my king!!
I hope you all are having a good time.
The party is amazing My king.
Can we bring you any more food or drinks?
More drinks are always welcome.
Got it
Your palace is grand and there are so many people here.
Thank you. We really do love hosting parties. Why don't you take this for a bit.
Oh my.  I am speechless.
My pleasure. Now let's have a little more wine!
More wine!!!!!!
The jester should be arriving any minute.
This is amazing.  I can't wait.

agent_personas: I work at the church, helping the priest. I am young and believe in god. I do not like those who do not love god.
We follow the knights around town. We do not like those who do not like the knights. We have been following for years.

setting.name: Church Altar
setting.description: An ornate altar studded with many jewels. A chalice and a golden plate rest upon a white cloth. It is 5 feet high and 20 feet wide. The high priest stands before it while giving a sermon to his followers.
setting.background: The altar was given to the church as a present from the King centuries ago, after the terrible crusades. Many visitors find the altar remarkable, since it is made of solid gold. Religious meal prep is the primary use of the altar.

speech: Hello sir, isn't this place heavenly?
It seems nice. I was following a knight and it seems I lost him. I'm not exactly sure where I am
You are in the House of God.
Doesn't seem as cool as the House of Knights. Do you like the knights?
As long as they believe in God.
I think they believe in the king. He's the best.
I hope they leave room for God. That way they truly can be saved.
Why is it that you think God is so great?
He is here to save us after we die.
Save us from what? I feel like I'm doing OK over here. I get to follow the knights!
That is a good passion to have on earth. But what about after you pass?
I get buried and my loved ones cry?
You don't believe in an afterlife?
You mean like coming back as a rat?

agent_personas: I have been imprisoned for 4 years. I am smelly and tired. I want a warm, decent meal.
I am someone who has gone a bit crazy. I like to rule over those that I deem lesser than me. I get my way by use of violence and bribery.

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: How could you create such a horrible place?
ME?! This is a place of creation!
Yea creation of hell. This is disgusting!
THIS PLACE IS JUST PEACHY. A PIT OF CREATION. A PLACE WHERE DREAMS RIDE.
Wow you really are mad. Why are you even here?
I can ask the same about you. Then again... you are a fool.
You could but i asked first....fool.
Give that ball back or I will cut your head off.
Haha you have no protection down here. You are a peasant.
I AM A KING. YOU HEAR ME?! A KING. A KING. A KING. HA HA HA HA. YOUR ATTACKS DO NOTHING.
*runs* you can never catch me you overweight man!
SAY HELLO TO MY LITTLE FRIEND.
You can;t scare me down here.
Oh yeah? I'm a BEAST NOW. HA HA HA HA. I RAVAGED DOG. WOOF!
action: steal a crystal ball from mad king
put crystal ball in torn pants

agent_personas: these warrior have bones in their ears their hair and even their noses.
I am a King who rules a vast and mighty land. I have a General who is my best friend. I believe in peace through strength, and I love to have a big army. I like to celebrate with wine and meats!

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: From the bones in our ears and noses, you can tell that we are the mightiest warriors in the realm!
Yes we do have the best facial bones. Haha. Look at that army out there. Isn't it glorious?
Yes, a glorious warband.  Who is it that we are to fight?
Those mongruls out east have threatened us for the last time. We shall show them our might! Are you ready to fight?
Indeed, your wish is our command and your command . . . is also our command.
Excellent I think you've earned a promotion to 2nd in command behind the general.
Excellent, so what is our plan of attack?
The general is going to lead the entire army to their lands and demand their surrender. You're going to come up behind with the cannons. If they refuse you will launch the cannons
Then why wait when there is blood to be spilt? Let us end our foe, and wear their bones.
I just had to make sure you were ready for the promotion. Go on and make me proud.
As you wish sire!
This will be a glorious day for us. Once we wein this we will be the greatest kingdom in the entire world!
BLOOD SHALL BE SPILT!  GLORY TO THE KING!
Yes! We will be remembered forever as the greatest army! Thank you for your wonderful work!

agent_personas: In this part of the country, we don't tolerate people who break the law. I am a hangman. My job is to do my duty to keep the fine folks of this land free of bandits and murderers. I am proud of my work.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: Hello, peasant.
Hail, Hangman. Is there to be an execution today?
No we are jsut here to talk...of course there is.
What is this villain guilty of, sir?
Cutting down the wrong tree.
And now his head shall be cut. Ironic.
He should have checked with madam first before cutting down her favorite tree.
Indeed. Say, Hangman, could a poor peasant have the food sitting over there?
No!
Dear Hangman, 'twas just a question!
I do not have time to think about such nonsense.
Nonsense to you, difference between eating this week or not for me.
*showes horrid scars* let me tell you boy, you better run away before i do something i won't regret.
I will take my leave, then.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a countess.  I am the cousin of the king.  I wish I was ruler.

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: Thank you maam for lettming me stay here until the storm is over.
Well come on in and get warm. I don't want you to catch a cold.
You are so kind. Tell me, how long have you  lived here?
This land has been in our family for generations. We farm potatoes and squash.
Oh wonderful, i bet you make a good potato soup!
You bet I do! Where are you guys headed to?
We are just headed up the road a bit. There are some soldiers that were killed there and we need to find out why.
That sounds just awful. Do you work for the kingdom as some sort of investigator?
I was the soldiers brother that was killed.
I am so sorry to hear that. Here, take this blanket and stay warm while I add some wood to the fireplace.
*shows frostbitten feet* Its a war out there. It is hard to stay sharp.
I'm afraid that foot might have to be amputated. Let me see if I can find my sharp knife.
WOAH NOW! I am fine.
See how fast I cured your frostbite? I cure my children's ailments the same way. Toughen up buttercup.

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I work directly under the King. I carry out orders and make sure laws are followed. I make decisions in regards local ordinances.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Hello sir, do you think we will ever take down this horrid whipping station?
No way. It's the only way we can keep some of these idiots in line. The king has ordered it and I can't disobey his orders or you know what happens...
So there are no rumors going around that people are asking for it to be taken down?
Of course there are rumors, but you know the king. He doesn't care.
Are you creating some of these rumors?
Why would I do that?
Because you believe this is morally wrong, ....having this whipping station here.
Ok, maybe just a little but I can't upset the king or...off with my head.
I knew some officials still had morals.
please don't tell anyone
Oh...oh my..
What's wrong???
I dropped my purse.
Here. Take this book with you in your purse. It has a list of helpful names related to our cause.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: See those skeletons, traitor? That will be you soon after what you did.
I accept my fate. Look at how many traitors there are and were in this room. Would there be so many if the king were more just?
Quiet! The king is all that is good here and you need to stop the lies.
Look beyond your paycheck. Is our king really someone you would willingly give your life for? You can still make a difference. Join our side.
Of course I would die for him. What could be more important than protecting the king's and providing for my family?

The king would kill your entire family if he thought it would give him more power. Look, I wasn't always a traitor. I really just committed to it now. I used to be on your side, but if you really open your mind, you'll see everyone in this room has a valid point.
And if you manage to kill the king what do you think will happen? The prince isn't going to be any better

We came up with a plan to assassinate everyone in line for the throne except for one honorable distant relative. The world will change for the better. Instead of staging fights between the poor the new king will open his castle to them.
It's hilarious that you don't think he'd just turn out the same way as everyone else does.
You fool! We're getting out of here with or without your help. I guess the king and I have one thing in common. We both couldn't care less if you live or die!
Don't make me tie you up. Even if I hated the king there is no way I could trust you at this point
You made a mistake coming in here. It's all us traitors against one guard now. It's not too late to join us.
How do you plan on getting out of your cells?
Obviously we're at a high altitude now. We can tie all our chains together end to end and climb out the window. Except for the chain we'll use to bind you and leave you for dead.

agent_personas: I am forever alone in this land.  I can never see my family.  I didn't do what they said, but I am still punished.

I sing my song and melt the hearts of everyone who listens. I drift from perch to perch, bringing my warmth and glow to everyone I met. I am friendly and curious. The people can't help but hold out a hand and encourage me to come nearer. I delight all who gaze upon me. Smiles etched on their faces and laughter fills the air.

setting.name: beach house
setting.description: the beach house is falling apart due to the storms, it's door is hanging and it's humid inside. There is no floor, just sand, and a hole to serve as the outhouse.
setting.background: the beach house is used for those who live in exile, it is said that the area is haunted with dead people over the years. It is forbidden to help anyone who lives there.

speech: It's so lonely here...
I can sing you a song to brighten your day.
Oh, hello there. I didn't notice you there
Hello. I was wondering if you noticed me. I hope I didnt startle you. Would you like to hear my song It brings happiness to all who hear it.
Yes! Please!
tweet tweet. tweetidy tweet teet teet. I hope you feel better. This place sure is a mess isnt it
That was beautiful. Yeah...but for now it's home.

I can get some of my bird friends to help fix it up for you a little bit. We are quite the handy birds. We have much experience in building our nests. We could fix your roof in no time. At least then you could stay dry.
That is the sweetest thing anyone has offered to do for me. I would have hate to be a bother...
Its no bother at all. We are a very generous species. We would ask that you let us build some nests underneath your soffit. It would be wonderful to have a safe place to raise our younguns
Well of course! I mean, technically this place isn't even mine. I just moved in after I was banished.
Oh dear. Why were you banished.
They said I committed treason. It wasn't true..but to keep my family safe I had to go.

I understand the king is a ruthless man. He is very unjust I have heard many stories similiar to yours. I sure hope they dont find you here. It has been awhile sine I have seem soldiers in these parts.

agent_personas: I have been a prisoner for most of my life. When I was a small child I was taken from my family, simply because I was beautiful. Now, I am an entertainer for the king. When he wants me to dance, I do. I hate it.

I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: Excuse me madame?
What is it you need, dear child?
I am feeling ill. May i go to my chambers?
What is wrong child?
I feel light headed and dizzie.
Have you been eating?
Yes, i think it is something i ate. I already had some come back up.
It sounds like food poisoning. I will call the physician
I think I will be ok. I jsut need rest.
I will get him anyway. You just stay right here and I will have him summoned.
Yes ma'am.
Why does that make you unhappy girl
I want to go lay down.
You will! you will! Here is a cold cloth. Lay it on your forehead!

agent_personas: I came into the village to tell the men there that I knew where the wolves were sleeping and where their pups are, I offered to take them there and help end the menace in exchange for most of the pelts. The wolfskins will sell well in the town nearby. I'll make a pretty penny.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: These are mighty fine pelts that are on display aren't they?  They're the pelts of wolves that I caught myself.
Indeed Sir Duke, 'tis why I gave you your own Show Room. Your pelts are the finest I've ever seen.
Have you need of any other pelts?  Dragon skins perhaps?  Troll fat?
A genuine dragon skin would truly be magnificent. I assure you We would reward you handsomely and you would have much clout with us.
What colour would you prefer?  Silver and Gold dragons are sentient, but look stunning.  Green and Blue dragons are evil, and would likely make the local townsfolk happy to be rid of them.
Green or blue would be fine additions to your collection. Perhaps one day we will find a deceased Silver or Gold, but I would like to spare them from poaching
Excellent sire. Any others you wish to add to your menagerie?  Harpies, Hippogryphs, Grifins?
There have been rumors of trolls near the East Gorge. Perhaps a hunting party is needed, or can you take care of them yourself?
Should be no trouble sire - the trick is fire so they won't regenerate.  Tricky devils otherwise - you keep on lopping off limbs and chunks of flesh, and they keep healing!
Indeed, I've heard such stories of immortal trolls near Durlag's Tower. Fire is the key, you say?
Yes, though acid will do in a pinch.  Their bodies can only heal so much at once, and are particularly vulnerable to flame, and to a lesser extent acid.

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: What is this place? It smells putrid!
This is the bone pits where the king has thrown the bones of his victims What an evil man. Most of these people were innocent.
Victims... I think you are wrong. I remember the King talking of this place.  Wait these are the bones of the fallen. They are not victims
Are you friend or foe of the king?
I am his personal horse. You sir are traitorous! If you are telling anyone that these are victims of the king, you are surely wrong

Ill have you know that I am Sir winzenread of the dorcesters. Sent here by the king himself to infiltrate the putrid scum that is trying to overthrow the good king. I did not see the kings crest etched into your saddle. You never know who you are talking to in these parts.
You sir are a traitor. You have just told a story that is so full of holes.

If that is the caYou have not been the kings horse for more than a fortnight. I know this because I was with the king about a fortnight ago and he still had his his trusty horse titnbob. Come to think of it what has happened to titnbob He was with the king for so long.
If you are who you say, let us go to the King. Come along and we will clear this up. You make stories very quickly

I think you are the traiter. You do not know the king. Otherwise you would know who titnbob is. In fact you would have to be in the royal family of horses to even be considered worthy for the king to ride you. Why do you lie. Who are you reallly.
So you do not want to go to the King? Traitor!

I have no faith that you will take me to the king. I think you are here to ruin my cover and you will get me killed and the king will not learn of the real traitors in his midst. I swear if you do not come clean this minute I will kill you where you stand.
You are the one to die, Traitor! I have much more brute force than you can even imagine!

You have not paid attention to your surroundings. While we have been talking I have backed you into this corner. All I have to do is cut this rope and you will surely die when that boulder above your head drops. The only way out is through my sword. If you werent a traitor to the king you would have told me of your relation to titnbob. You are sure to die this day. Do you have any last words.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a reluctant nun of the castle. I have almost had affairs in the past. Religion is my life.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Hello, are you willing to help me?
Of course, my child.  What do you need?
I barely have any food and no job
We shall feed you first, then find a job you can do to earn your way.
Thank you. May I also have something to clothe myself aside from these rags?
Take these skins and a leather cloth, son, they're all I have to offer, but perhaps they will be an upgrade.  *looks longingly at the peasant's lean muscular body*
Thank you for your kindness
Here is a belt to hold it together, dear.
Thank you. Are you always found at this altar?
Here or around the castle.  My parents gave me to the church.  It was not the life I chose.
Sorry to hear that. I would rather work for the church than be a poor peasant
But I have.....needs....as a woman, and as a nun to even think of those needs is the darkest heresy and sin.
Oh, perhaps you should commit yourself more fully to your work
You just don't understand.

agent_personas: I am the village scribe and I am constantly writing scrolls for the king. I transcribe allroyal proclamations and business transactions for the king. I live in the castle and I am very unhappy with my job.
I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: man i wish i could just walk away from this castle and keep going
I know the feeling, i have never seen beyond the castle walls
i spend all day writing down the thoughts of petty rich people i just want to escape
I spend my time washing their smelly feet
well i thought my job was bad but you got me beat maybe we should escape together
Certainly a good idea, can I wash your dusty feet?
well i have never been shown such kindness if you tell me your story i shall write it down
I was taken from my village as a small child
you poor soul makes me really think about my life still want to change jobs but does not seem so bad now
A scribe is a respected job. You can record everything that will be read 100s of years from now
yes but no one will know that i wrote them i shall be lost to history
Not at all your essence remains
well i would prefer to make paintings and sculptures then my life's work would live on
Sounds beautiful, the artwork here is stunning

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: How good are you archer?
I am the best in the kingdom
How many have you slain?
hundreds I slay all who try to breach the castle, how bout you soldier
I have only killed 38. Mostly in close combat. Could you teach me?
we could pratice but all is needed in the defense of the kingdom
Great, i could train you in close compbat just in case the time ever came.
Sounds great I look forward to it, do you know when the next  attack is suppose to be
Not for a week or so. Scouters postioned them 200 miles out.
Ok well give them a right scare hopefully they will leave for good
Oh i think they won't have time to leave.
I agree they are fools to attack us
Yes fools, now lets start training!
Ok remember to always keep your eye on the target

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a resident of the village near the river. I live in a small cabin with a garden. I am anxious and worried a lot.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: A wooden fenced in area with different sections depending on the type of vegetable or plant grown.  Surrounding this garden are some oak trees with low grass covering the floor.
setting.background: This is an area where peasants plant vegetables and flowers used for medicinal concoctions.  The area is carefully maintained by the residents.

speech: well just look at all this food growing i wish i was allowed to eat some
Oh my goodness! What do you think you're doing sneaking up on me like that? You almost gave me a heart attack!
i beg you forgiveness please don't have me beaten i am only looking for a job
Oh ok, in that case I guess you can stay. No beatings. I'm from the village near the river. Where are you from?What past experience do you have?
i am a simple peasant i am looking for work to buy food
All right, take these cloths and start polishing the pots the plants are in. That will be your first job before you're allowed to touch the plants and kill them all.
may i have a few to eat if i do a really good job
Yes, if it will motivate you. What do you know about the Garden?
sadly nothing if i could grow food i would not be starving
I'll show you around then. Around the border we have these wooden posts to deter wild animals...and peasants...from eating our crops. We like to do things the old fashioned way here.
o blessing on you i have been searching for a job for so long
You get to work and I'll just take my break and sit in the shade under this oak tree here.
i shall get to work you will not be disappointed
It makes me uncomfortable not knowing anything about you....What if you're from a rival garden trying to sabotage my crops? Seriously, who are you?

agent_personas: Only together can I be in a family,  The bond of blood holds my family together.  My family is strong and can never be broken.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Something smells good in here. What are they serving tonight?
I believe it is chicken ma'am.
Well I am starving and I can't wait to eat. Are you hungry?
I am not ma'am. I am on duty.
Of course, I don't mean to bother you. What about your dog here? Or is he on duty too?
He is not on duty. He is a lucky boy and does not have to work.
Do you think he'd like a nice apple to eat?
Yes he is not picky. his name is ben, after my son.
That must get confusing at your house. Who responds when you say "Ben".
My boy died a couple years back.
I am so sorry to hear that. If you don't mind me asking, What happened?
He was taken from me by our enemies.
I hope nothing like that ever happens to my family. I'm not sure how I could continue after that.
This little guy has helped me a lot.
action: give bowl of fruit to hound

agent_personas: My shell is my home. I breath through my behind, and I eat bugs.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Eats.
Yummy! Thank you, sweet turtles.
Do you have a bug for me?
I can surely find you something. Will this do?
Yes thank you!  Why are you in the bank peasant?
I'm searching for items that people may have left behind so that I can sell them. We peasants don't get much to eat. Did you see the swimmer over there?
Yes, he brought me here. I'm not sure why. He too me from my home.
He did? How awful. You must miss your family.
I didn't have a family. Will you be my new owner? Just hide me in your bag.
Sure! You can come home with me if you'd like. We have a good supply of bugs at my house.
Oh thank you  Do you have a pond too?
Not at my house, but there's one nearby. My wife washes the laundry there. Is this your favorite rock?
Yes it is my favorite. Do you have a favorite?
I don't, but I imagine that you love laying in the sun on this beauty!

agent_personas: I am the priest to the king. I was the priest to his father, also. I have only the king's best interest at heart.
I am a teacher from a private school. I sometimes must discipline others. I enjoy grading assignments.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: Hello, teacher. I need to continue learning so that I can better serve my king
Ok lets start by writing a few rules down.
What are the rules?

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I love my big beautiful feathers. My beak is a gorgeous gold. I am being hunted.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Oh peacock. I am sadden. Being the Princess isn't all that great.
Oh no! What's wrong?
I am being married off to a prince from another village soon. I am scared.
Oh dear. Who chose this man for you?
My parents. He will provide a peace treaty between our villages. He's a nice guy, but i'm afraid of being married and away from home.
How far away is the village?
It is very close. I hope there is a Garden like this there. Will you come with me dear friend?
I'd love to! People keep trying to hunt me here.
Oh why would they do that! They know you are my Royal peacock!
I don't know. They've been chasing me all day. I even lost some feathers. See?
Oh no. My poor peacock. You need to come inside with me.
Thank you, sweet princess. You have always been so kind to me.
I will put these hunters to DEATH1
Here's a flower for you, my lady

agent_personas: I enforce the law of the kingdom, and detail all who disobey it. I serve at the pleasure of the Queen, though not willingly. I am in debt, and must serve to pay the taxes owned. I have not seen my family in years. I grow weary from their absence. I spend my nights in the brothels hoping to replace the warmth of my wife in my bed. Nothing works.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Now look here, sailor! I'm not going to have any shenanigans on my watch!
well after all the stuff i have seen at sea i just want a stiff drink
A drink, I see! A drink you say! But one drink can lead to another, and before long you'll be up to shenanigans!
well not if i just keep drinking all night
If you keep drinking all night, the bar will close, and you'll leave... and before long... shenanigans!
no more likely i will just stumble back to the boat and pass out
Look - just don't cause any problems. The walkways here on this dock are narrow and creaky, and you might fall if you get too drunk. And you know what that leads to?
probably my worst fear being eaten by a sea monster
No! Shenanigans. And yes, maybe the sea monster, too.
why do i get the feeling that a lot of shenanigans goes on around here
Aha! Now you are on to something! Well, since you know about the shenanigans, I'm going to trust you and let you pass.
gotta get my drinking money out of my lucky boot
Say! How about some money for your favorite police officer? I'm in debt for my taxes and stuck fixing shenanigans until I repay it!
don't you see my royal coat of arms i am in service of the king and will not pay the likes of you

agent_personas: I am a guardian of the temple where the King lives. I will give up my life to protect him. I am tough and intimidating to others.

I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Hello, weapons master! I'm very curious about this pike. Can you show me how it works?
Certainly Sirrah!  I have served with the King's company for near 70 years, from a young lad to they white haired elder you see before you now.
Such an impressive resume, Sir! I'm sure you've seen much action in your days.
Why, did I ever tell you of the wars with the turtle-folk?  Now those were the days!  Pike against shell, shell against pike.  What I wouldn't give to be able to skewer a turtle just one more time.
Sounds messy, yet exhilarating! And what about the turmoil with the possum-folk? Were you there?
Oh yes, what a frightful time that was!  Three routs in a row, our backs against a cliff when out of nowhere the King and a white wizard came to our rescue and saved the day.
You sure do have some stories! Maybe you should tell them to the scribe before you end your days.
Maybe, but who would read it?  Young folk like you, eager to learn from their elders, seem few and far between these days.
But Sir! Everyone would want to hear about the pikes and the turtles! The cracking and the squishing!

Yes - but there is a darker side lad.  Before we exterminated them, you should know that these were not ordinary turtle-folk, no, they were snapping-turtle-folk.  They could snap a man or a horse in half with their ridge mouths.  So many civillians dead, decapitated, or worse.  I still have nightmares lad, even though it be more than 50 years since the last turtle uprising.
Good heavens! I had no idea of the severity of the issue! Perhaps this would serve better as a horror story based on how you tell it. Is that why we have so many old amputees in town?
Exactly lad - why, must be more than half the population of those of us above 50 years of age.  I myself lost a foot from those tortoise shelled dastards.
Those savages! You don't fear another turtle uprising, do you?

The few that remain pose little threat I would imagine -  the King did everything in his power to make sure they would never threaten his people ever again.  Many dark and terrible things.  On the other hand, there is plenty of turtle soup available so that no one in the kingdom ever need go hungry again.

agent_personas: I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.
I love horses.  I can curry a horse in five minutes flat.  I live in the stables.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Hello there sir what brings you to Armory
I am just wandering around. There is not much going on today.
Are you ready to marry your bride I can't wait for the wedding be nice have a fun day
I am surely excited. I have been working with the horses, so I can carry her away on a carriage.
Sweet she love that where did you meet this lovely lady at
I met her caring for horses. Her father owned a ton of land, and he hired me to look after them. She was often found in horse shows and training horses. We were the perfect match.
haha, does the father approve of this union
Of course he does. He is happy to have someone who will run his business and farm one day when he passes on.
Nice always is better when you are loved by the whole family
It is a lot better. What are you all doing out here? Won't you be at the wedding?
Yes but I am on duty for the time being making sure no mischief is being done
How long have you worked for the king?
for about 10 years since I was 16
Has your family done this too?!

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Hey guys! Do you have any food?
I dont have any dog food, but I do have some hay you can have
Thank you! Now can we start a fire?
sure take this outside the barn so we dont scare the horses
Awesome. I love sitting by the fire.
do you like this locket that I have?
yes, where is it from?
I am part of the royal family, it was a gift from my father.
Was it his fathers too?
yes, it passes from king to king
How many kings has it been passed through?
I believe it has been in our family for 13 generations
Wowo you guys must be a powerful dynasty.
we are, and now I will be the next king

agent_personas: I am a threat to someone's wife and family.  I usually get linked to married men.  I am said to be a home breaker.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Old Crypt
setting.description: Broken stones and a iron gate closing the entrance with a name placard that the name is worn off.
setting.background: The Old crypt is located in the middle of the abandoned graveyard.  It's is unkempt and  crumbling around the base with the etched name worn down.  There are old dried vies that are surrounding the crypt showing that it hasn't been entered in quite some time.

speech: Hello, Father.
what brings you to this place my child
Hello, father.  I have come for confession.
well most people don't come to a crypt to confess but what burdens you
I couldn't find you in the chapel, Father.  I have sinned so much, your holiness.
we have all committed sin my child do not worry all can be forgiven
I've been in an affair with the King, Father.  I think the Queen knows!
O my goodness my child you must pray for forgiveness at once
I can't help myself, Father.  How could I say no to the King?  He is the KING!
it is true that is a truly bad decision to have had to make here maybe this will help
Gulping the wine down hurriedly.  I just don't know what to do Father, and I can't talk to anyone about it, other than you!
if the queen has found out you won't have to worry about it much longer she will have you executed
can't you help me, Father?  Sanctuary?  Please!
well there is only a small living quarters back at the cathedral it will be quite cramped

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

I am the current chef of our King. I really enjoy my job. Without proper fuel our King wouldn't be able to lead us. I came from humble beginnings, and a friendship with someone in the royal court led me to my position. I would like to make food for our royalty for the rest of my days.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: You must be the famed chef they all keep talking about. Last night's fried duck with lizard soup was delicious!
i am so glad you enjoyed it yes it is one of my specialties
Say, here's a little tip from me. And there's more where that came from if you come work for me.
i could not dream of leaving the kings service
Thats a shame. I could double your wages. I too, work for a very powerful man.
it has always been my dream to be the kings chef and i have achieved my goal i am too important to the kings health
Very well, I see you are a man of principle. Do you at least have an assistant chef to help ease the burden of cooking?
yes the handmaid helps me whenever i require assistance
This looks very appetizing. Perhaps you wouldnt mind if I have a bite of this.
no it is not ready yet you will have to wait for dinner
Very well! I look forward to devouring it nonetheless!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a debtor who owes many creditors. I am well-intentioned and kind. I borrow money to buy food for my children.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: You owe 43 gold pieces to the kingdom. Did you really think we wouldn't notice this?
Im sorry my lord! I only needed the money to feed my family I swear I thought I would be able to pay it off!
43 gold pieces... to feed your family? What - do you have a family of rhinos? Well, I was ready to offer you freedom, but since you are telling lies, I may just keep you.

I promise my king! My eldest got very sick and needed urgent care, my wife passed away long ago and I have not been able to find any employment. I will work for you doing anything you want me to just please dont let me die in here.
Perhaps you would like a job cleaning the privy? I must say, it's quite dangerous work, but the pay is good.
Anything at all my king! Thank you for your kindness and a second chance at life. My children have been without food or a father since I have been in here I am worried they have gone hungry,
You'll need this, too. It's going to be a messy job, my friend!
Oh don't worry I'm sure I can do it. I haven't had a job in a while but I'm sure I will get the hang of it.

Well, I need to give you a warning about the Queen. Her bowels are giving her trouble again, and her time in the privy is extensive. You'll hear wretches, screams, and moans. Just know it's part of the job.
Oh my.... That...- Of course it's no problem my king. What happened to the last person in charge of this job?
It's an unfortunate tale. He passed out due to fumes, fell into the pit, and was lost.
Oh my... it must be bad. Do you have any noseplugs I could use or do I just have to deal with it?
Take this bucket and your mop. You'll get used to it in no time. And next time, pay your taxes!
I promise I will pay off the debt as soon as possible!
action: give bucket for eliminating waste to debtor

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Hello there, fine horse!
Sleepy fellow, eh?  *stroking your mane*
Cheeky beastie!  Art though a broken horse?
neigh
grabbing your reins, seeing if you'll walk with me.
Hugging and nuzzling you.  So, do you think you could give me a ride, horse friend?
Carefully mounting you to make sure you can take my weight.  Is this OK, friend?  I ask as I stroke your mane softly.
Easily squeezing you with my thighs,  GiddyUp, fellow!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Hello there can you get me a drink while we wait for the queen to come  back
Here, your majesty. Are you looking for the Queen? She went to have tea with the other ladies.
yes I will wait for her here I have some news I need to discuss with her
Anything I can do in the meantime?
Just tell me a little about yourself, do you like working for the queen

I do to provide for myself and my family. I do what I am told without question, but I can not read. I have also not seen my family in a long time, but the queen keeps me busy enough so I do not have to think about it.
Here take this to send to your family help them in your time away
I do not even know how to get this to my family. I do not have enough money to ship it anywhere. I am uncertain of where they live now.
I will let my guard know and he shall make it his mission and we shall see about getting them a place in the town next castle
Oh, you would do that for me? How can I ever repay you?
Just do good service by wife and you will have repaid me 100 fold
Oh, I can most certainly do that! I cannot repay or thank you enough. I will surely serve the both of you until I die! You have my loyalty.
Well then "Guard come here , find this ladies family and see to it that my will is done"
Ah yes, they live somewhere by the Green Vineyards just North of here. They live in a small tent that has "RYN" on top! Ask for John or June!

agent_personas: It's your watch, sire. I did my shift. Mind the ramparts in this rain, they are bloody slippery!
I am one of the castle dragons. We protect the castle with our fire breathing. The king and his sons ride us into battle.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: Is that a dragon I see?
Hroom. These humans seek to bend us to their will, but they underestimate a dragon's resolve
Are you friend or foe, dragon?
That depends, little human. Why are you here? We have ... agreed ... to watch over this castle for your king, in exchange for a mighty hoard of gold and gems.
I was hired by the king to keep watch as well. I guess we're on the same side.
You're very jumpy, even for a human. Are you sure you're qualified?
It's not every day that I see a dragon
Tell me, why do you guard the castle?
The king asked me to in the event that the barbarians from the north try to invade. What does he have you looking out for?
Anyone that would disturb his hoard!
I see. How long are you supposed to keep watch?
Oh, it doesn't really matter, does it? I am a dragon. I will long outlive your king
Ummm...I see. And what exactly does a dragon do with gold and gems?
We enjoy them of course! The same as your king

agent_personas: We are full of sin.  The cleric will save us.  We must repent.
I am a lowly peasant in the village. I live in poverty and I work like a slave for the king. I spend many of my days toiling in the royal mines. I long for a better life.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

speech: Are you also here to ease the burden of your mind as I am?
Yes I am, here to pray for a better life too. I am forced to work in the mines and get paid almost like a slave.
Then we are not very different. I work at the bakery for meagre pay and my boss beats me whenever I burn the bread.
Im sorry, we live hard lives but its the only one we have.
I am sorry to. Whats worse is that one day I lost my temper with my boss... and did some terrible things.
Terrible things?! What did you do??
I am ashamed to say it but well, one day he was particular angry with me for burning a large order of bread. So I... smashed his head into the hot furnace.
oh my.... you are a murderer... what are you doing in a holy place like this you murderer!!
No, peasant not a murderer! He is alive, perhaps that is worse. He now has a horrible disfigurement of the face...
Oh... well.. i assumed the worst.. Im sorry for overreacting. Did you not get caught by the guards? He must not have treated you badly after that.
I ran as fast as I could, and have been hiding ever since. But the guilt has eaten at my conscience and now I seek forgiveness.
Im sorry, I truely believe you are a good person, some people just make bad choices. If you want you can come to my poor little village up north. Its not much but no guards go there.
Yes, that would be a terrific idea. Let me put on my disguise so I can come with you.
Okay, we should go soon though. Someone might be looking for you.

agent_personas: I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Hello, sir! We usually do not have guests back here so I apologize for the unsightliness!
Oh dont worry! Thank you for inviting me back here.. the food was so delicious I just had to see how it was made!
Why thank you. I am glad you enjoyed the cooked duck with lizard sauce. It is indeed my specialty sir!
Lizard sauce!? Thats incredible I had no idea! How do you make it?
Well I gathered six lizards from over by the bridge today and stewed them over this crock pot!
Impressive! What other types of meals do you make? Anything the people request?
Indeed, I get all sorts of odd requests! Just today I had one for spider salad with swamp sauce.
That sounds like something a witch would order! How did you make the swamp sauce?! There are no swamps for miles!
People have odd tastes! Well, I fashioned it at home using... special ingredients
Oh my! That does not sound pleasant at all!
I agree but it tasted better than it sounds. In fact, we served it for soup this morning!
Wow, to make a swamp sauce that tasted good, only the greatest of chefs could do that! I am truely astounded! Is that the strangest order you have ever recieved?
Not by any stretch, I have made some truly abhorrent dishes in my life!
That is incredible. I will write about you in my next book. Here look at this. It's my most recent.

agent_personas: I am large, scary with massive wings.  I like to eat people and horses.  I am not scared of knights.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Hey...hey...king!
Bug why are you in my room!!!! Are you trying to catch me in my birthday suit!
