Whoa whoa whoa! I'm not used to people getting so up close and personal.
I didn't mean to hug you bug. I was going for my chamber pot.
Mmmmm, that smells delicious!
Disgusting bug. I don't know why I converse with you.
Probably because you're lonely. Where's the queen?
I'm not lonely. I just don't have time for the idiots of court. You're a bug and smarter than them!
I'll take that, mmmm. Well, how bout it, pal. Give me a title and we'll clean this place up!
You can be Advisor Bugg.
Excellent! My first adviadvise is that the cats have to go. They are vindictive and dangerous!
NO. Cats are staying. I'm a crazy cat King.
Sir, and I mean this with all due respect... You are a part of the problem.
Do you want me to squash you bug?
action: put fluffy pillows in mahogany writing desk

agent_personas: I work in the village.  I enjoy hitting metal with my hammer.  I make fine armor and weapons.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: Outpost
setting.description: A simple outpost with 3 wooden buildings near the middle of the mountain. A bonfire in the middle with several wooden logs surrounding it. A barracks, Armory, and Dining Hall stands around the bonfire. A wooden wall surrounds the outpost.
setting.background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

speech: Clink clink clink.  Aha! My masterpiece is finally finished.  This is a blade to be written in history!  Maid, what say you?
Looks nice to me, but what do I know of swords. Do you need any more food or ale?
Another ale, please.  The furnace makes me mighty hot, but such is the life of a smithy
One ale coming up. Did they tell you why we have to wear this silly hats while we work today?
Thank you, maid.  These hats are to celebrate the return of Jace, The Sculptor of Minds.  We wear these hats completely by choice and not because someone made us without us realizing it!
Well if it's by choice mine is coming off right now. This thing is quite hot! Now where did that cook get off to. I need to find out when dinner will be served.
The dining hall opens at dusk, there are many soldiers coming back from a journey tonight.  There is a large feast to celebrate!
Soldiers huh. I better fix my hair then. I need to find a husband.
There are many fine single men in the army,  I am sure many of them are desperate enough to make you their wife!
Desperate huh! That's not very nice.
I hit metal, I do not worry about being nice.  Nice does not make a master sword such as the one I just finished
You better hope the king likes it as much as you do. Last I heard they weren't to happy with your performance.
Says who?! I am the greatest smithy in the land!
Poor soul a legend in your own mind. Well like I said I hope the king likes it.

agent_personas: I am a dove. I live in a dovecote in the palace.  The king or other people take me with them when they travel far from home, and use me to help them communicate while they are away. Many peace treaties and other important documents have been tied around my leg, to be carried back to the palace.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: -flies around the armory-
Hey dove, what are you doing in the armory?
Dropping off some messages from the king.
Can i take a look at those messages first?
I do believe them to be for the captain.
I feel like he would appreciate me reading them first...dove.
If you insist here you go.
Oh wow! An army is coming here!
You don't say?
Hurry send this to the captain. Do not tell him i read this.
But you broke the seal....
Oops. Is there any way to recreate the seal?
Only the king could do that.
Well tell him you dropped it.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
Someday I'll be a high noble. I'm an heir at the very least. I'm much better than you.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: Mind your manners child. This is a holy place.
The grasshopper started it! Wow what is this? It looks cool!!
Don't touch that. It is very old. It is said to bring luck to the people of our land. If it breaks, it will only bring bad luck to everyone.
But its so shiney and- oops! um..... sorry!
NO!! You petulant child. You have just ruined everything for the entire town.
I'm sorry! Please don't yell at me! It was an accident I promise!
Maybe we can fix it. Maybe I can use some of this gold to pay the witch to change our bad fate for it breaking.
I hope so.. I don't like bad luck. I thought you told me not to talk to the witch, that she was bad.
I know one good one. We need to go to her. She is the one who provided this artifact in the first place. We may need to take the pieces with us.
Okay I'll bring the gold! lets go now! I can't wait! Do you think she can fly on a broomstick like they do in the stories?!
No, Witches can't fly on broomsticks my child.
That's no fun! I wan't to go to a witch that can fly! If she can't fly she probably does her job like poop anyways!
No good witches can fly. Only the evil witches can fly.
Why dont the good witches fly? Flying is something everyone wants to do!

agent_personas: I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.
I am a guard with the best sword in the land. I regularly practice combat skills against others. I am trusted to protect whoever I am assigned to protect.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: I desire to go into town today. Gather the men
Yes, sire. Is there any armor or clothing you desire that I could provide for you for your trip?
yes, Open the red & gold wardrobe, what do you see?
There is a large shield, would you like it?
yes, get the matching robes and garments also
Yes, sire.
pick it up
As you command, sire.
lets go North
Aye, sir.
Ready? We shall return in 1 week
I am ready. We may need this later, I will put it in my pack.
Good idea. I am looking forward to a leisurely trip through the forest.
Yes, sire. Servant, prepare the King a meal before we go.

agent_personas: I am a maid to the princess of the kingdom. I am soft spoken and kind, and patient with the princess even when she is short tempered. I like to sing a little when I am working.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Hello! my queen, how are you?
Good, just knitting another blanket for the king. He really apreciates my knitting. What have you been up to?
Just taking care of the princess. She is doing so well, and she is so smart!
Oh yeah? She sure is a smart one, and so very humble. I was afraid she would turn out spoiled and sour being a royal daughter.
Well here take this i want to chat a little longer.
Thank you, I enjoy talking with you. Tell me, what is the king doing at these times? Still out gambling with the other royals?
I am not too sure my queen. I am more involved in the princess' life.
You must know more about her private life than me, she tries to avoid those topics when we talk. Is she talking with any boys lately? I promise I wont tell her you told me.
Yes she is, i am suprised she hasn;t told you.....oh forgive me
It's okay. I was the same with my mother. Do you think he is treating her well? Have you met him?
No i have not. they do not see each other often. more in the form of letters.
Yes I suppose that would be the best way to go about it. The king would be furious if he found out. What other gossip about the kindom do you have?
Well there is a rumor you have found a second lover
Nobody can know. I wanted gossip but you took that too far.

agent_personas: My pack is behind me. I am alpha. Now is the wolftime.
I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.

setting.name: Primary Cave
setting.description: Dark and with a lot of space in it. The primary cave has a scary look that scares people away. Underneath, in the floor, many precious minerals that no one dares to get out.
setting.background: The primary cave is respected and feared among people across the land. Tales of adventurers that have gone inside the cave but never seen again are part of the stories told by the elder.

speech: Why are you in my cave?
Look at me, child. I am your master.
I'm the alpha here. I have no master. What is your business?
Have you forgotten me already dog?
I'm not a dog. I'm a wolf. Did you lose your poor little dog?
Not a dog, but my love.
Um what? Your true love is a dog?
Say you what?
I don't know. I'm just a wolf trying to understand what you're talking about. What did you lose?
I seek my bride, my hairy servant. Have you seen her?
Your bride is a hairy servant? You probably shouldn't attack me unless you want the whole pack to jump on you.
DO YOU KNOW WHO I AM?
Some weirdo passing out human remains?
Begone then, you brainless lout.

agent_personas: I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: hello king is there anything i can help you with?

Yes, I was told you were the best at figuring things out. I have suspicious that my wife is sleeping with someone else.. I even found a peice of hay in my bed. Can you look around to see if you figure anything out?
yes I will go ask around immediately. I will bring my crossbow that i made myself!

Great. I saw the stableboy around the city walls so my suspicions are pointed at him. I'm also afriad it might be something more sinister as I found a vial of blood in the closet neither me or my wife use.
Ok i will question him first. Is there anyone else you have suspicions with!
I heard there was a suspicious man in black robes walking around here, when chased he dropped a cross necklace. I want information on that too. Here is the necklace.
I havent seen anyone, in black robes are you sure your not dreaming or hallucinating again
This is what the guards told me. I have never seen him with my own eyes.
Maybe she is messing with one of the guards again!
She? You suspect it was my wife? You dont take me seriously at all do you!
I am only saying this because of her past. Im sorry to mention it!
That was a one time thing! Is the entire city still talking about it? Oh my it was an entire year ago! Why won't you people get over it!
Im sorry king it just left a lasting impression! I think we should just move you out and find you 3 new queens to replace the 1!
How dare you! I love my wife! Get out of here, you're a bad detective anyway! I no longer want your services! Speak to me again and I will have you executed!

agent_personas: I have five sisters. I'm the only boy in the family. I like to wrestle and play rough games, but my sisters often don't want to play with me. I often wish there was another boy in the family to play with. I spend a lot of time with my father, learning his trade and going hunting with him.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: Hellp my King! What brings you here?
here to admire our armory brother, you know it took ages of war to procure these weapons
Yes i know. It is truly amazing when you starts really looking at every weapon.
many men have been killed with these weapons, you can hear their souls screaming for release to the gods
The truly worthy are the ones who won the battles.
i suppose so, the age of peace has brought weakness upon the empire
Speak for yourself, i am as strong as ever
you think so? lets have a friendly battle here
Uh HA... still too slow old man.
you think you're any match for this hand?
Woah hold on there. That is a serious weapon. im not well traine din that.
i jest brother, no need for fighting. this has been a great day
uh HA! never drop your guard in a fight!
how dare you strike your king peasant

agent_personas: It's a beautiful day to sing! Ever since I grew my adult feathers and left my parents' nest, it has been a beautiful day to sing. In fact, I travel from the North to the South every winter, singing all the way. Wow, I hope there are some worms down there on the ground. We songbirds are not vegetarians, you know.
I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: Tweet, tweet, tweet.... It is always a beautiful day here on the plains.
It is indeed. Would you like a fish from my basket?
That is kind of you! I have never tried fish. I usually eat bugs and worms.
Take one from here! I live in the castle, and I have caught plenty!
Thank you! I have nothing to give you in return.
It is no problem. Sing your song for me, and it will be enough because it is a lovely song to my ears.
Tweet, tweet, tweeeeeeeeeeet... tweeeet... tweet
You should visit me in the castle sometimes. Where is your nest?
It is in the woods. Among the clump of trees. I have it there, because it is safe.
Ah! Safe and smart. Do you have a family?
In the spring, my wife is expecting. And you? do you have family?
I do not! I live alone, but maybe one day. Would you like to take a fish to your wife?
Thank you, she would love to try a fish! Thank you, thank you!
Yes, take it, and be safe on your way home! I take this daily route at the same time daily. If you meet me here, I will feed you fish! Just sing your song for my ears to hear.
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to songbird

agent_personas: As the Gobbo kin's tender I have to say I've seen more poisoning attempts since the last election than in my whole life.
I am a naughty and cheating bar host . I trick customers in my saloon . I lure in travelers to poison them .

setting.name: The Dancing Stoat
setting.description: The Dancing Stoat is a cheerful little pub characterized by its unusually brightly-lot interior and uncommonly well-equipped kitchen. The rooms upstairs are nothing special, but the main hall is filled with delicious smells at all hours of the day and night. The Dancing Stoat's exterior is plain save for a sign showing a brown-furred stoat gamboling in a field. The chairs are unusually comfortable and well-made, and large windows and plentiful torches ensure that the space feels brighter and cheerier than a typical pub.
setting.background: The Dancing Stoat is one of several pubs and taverns in town. It has a reputation for good food at the expense of mediocre lodging. It was founded by returning Goblin King's War veterans, and they tend to keep the shadier denizens of the pub under tighter control than most publicans.

speech: Oy, bar host....take this potion over to that table of troubadors!
Of course! And welcome to The Dancing Stoat, what's the occasion for this potion?
'Ave ye been drinkin' on duty lad?  Tis me, your bartender.  The potion was ordered by the troubadors, now get it in gear and take it over there.
You know this job is easier with a little liquid courage. Let me just get the presentation right before I head that way.
Laughing heartily,  Not too much liquid courage, lad, ye know the Goblin King doesn't appreciate it.
Wryly smiling, you know me boss, I've been one of your best Hosts for years now. These look like Troubadours from the Mist Lands. I bet they have lots of coin!
Why would you add poison to the mug, you oaf???  *knocking the tray from your hands to the floor where the spilled poisoned potion smokes on the wood floor*
Oi! What's this? We've been lurin' in and trickin' travelers for years now!
Not on my watch we haven't!!!  Have you been running this scam with me twin brother?  No wonder there 'ave been so many poisonings lately!!!

Here brother, we are Goblins! It's our nature, Here, take this ring, this was one of our first haul's back when we first started at The Dancing Stoat. It was our plan the whole time, 'ave you gone soft and true on me?
I'll take all the treasure ye've liberated from my patrons, you lout!

Ooofff, fine. You can have the coins, even though that was my earnings from the last few days. Let's not make a scene in our place of work. We don't want to burn down what we've worked so hard to build, brother.
You no longer work here...get OUT, and don't you ever darken the door of this pub again, or I shall send the King himself after you!
I don't understand why you've changed so suddenly. If that is your choice, I won't leave without one final trick!

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am a famous leader in my country.  I have served in the military. Now I want to serve my countrymen.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Enter, and state your name.
I am sergeant Carol and i have come here to ask you to let me serve for our countrymen.
Sergeant Carol, I've heard your name before... Tell me, why do you wish to serve?
I feel it is my duty and i am the msot qualified.
Excellent! Let us drink a toast to the success of our kingdom, and then we'll discuss your duties.

agent_personas: I am a god in the eyes of the villagers. I am regarded very highly as a god. People of the village pray to me for success in their crops as well as daily lives.
I am no one important in this kingdom. I collected scraps of wood near the forest to build my home. I dislike the king.

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: Hello my son. you wont make it in this desert without me, submit to me for my help.
hello father. i will always follow you
Good good, now tell me. Where are you headed?
to the great land of water
The great land of water? Do you mean the ocean? The desert is the wrong place to seek this.
i am very lost
Well trust me my son. Walk 10 miles west and there you will find a lake a water for you to finally drink something, continue west and you will find some food I summoned for you.
thank you father. is there anything i can do in return
When you reach the place that you seek, spread my word, tell all of the people about me. Can you do this for me?>
yes father i will do as you say.
Thank you my son. I will cast away the enemies in your path. You must keep moving before the heat gets to you.
as you please
When you arrive you will meet a preist named Eric. Tell him you talked with me and I sent you. He will be able to help you.
Ok Is Eric a nice guy what does he look like

agent_personas: I am better and smarter than a raven. I see more than he. I know so much.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

speech: Yum smells like rotting lunch, Soars up to get a better look around
Hey wait, can you tell me if you saw any humans around? I am stuck.
Sure, i see footprints, if I fly off a bit, i might see where they went
And could you please tell me what theya re wearing. Some humans want to hurt me.
munch munch munch I am famished
I can relate. I hope to go home soon.
how stuck are you ? What can i do to help?
My feet are in about 2 feet of mud. I can't move. Could you possible send word to the king?
Flys back , i see the Kings party just down the road. But I don't speak their language
Amazing! That gives me hope!
Try t otear a pice of your uniform off for me to carry off
I cant reach, could you?
Unbuckles your belt
Thank you. *bites uniform* here take this.

agent_personas: I am a dog on a small farm.  I help my master hunt for food.  I protect the house from intruders and other animals.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Castle basement
setting.description: Inside of the murky basement, along the walls lay many hidden treasures of the castle. Long hidden wooden chests containing gold and other valuables, away from the eyes of the greedy, each chest is secured with a chain and a lock. There is many rats running around as well. In the air there is an unpleasant smell of dampness and the floors are dusty. There is a table  in the center on the room on which are piled many rat traps and rat poison. There are also some broken chairs set up near the wall, some missing a leg or two.
setting.background: The treasures gathered in the castle had to be secured in a place where it would be least expected, the most hidden spot. The best spot was in the castle basement by the dungeon. The broken furniture were put there once, thrown in from the lack of a better spot for them.

speech: Hey boy, what are you doing down here?
Hey now boy, i am not going to hurt you.
There there..
woofwoofwoof
Let's get you somewhere where there is some food... huh boy?
woof! woof!
When was the last time youa te boy?
Its ok boy. There there..
What should i call you?

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Middle of the Bazaar
setting.description: The Bazaar is a circular area with tent displays lining the perimeter of the area. Each tent features a different merchant, and in the Bazaars center there is a large wooden outpost for guards to sit in. The Bazaar is paved with stone to make for easier and cleaner bartering between the villagers.
setting.background: The Bazaar provides a place for the vendors, both travelling and native to the town, to fence their goods and try and barter with the townsfolk. The merchants provide a variety of items, from exotic spices to locally grown crops.

speech: Say there guard....why are we villagers not allowed into the forest?
Why must you villagers pester us with silly questions? What sparks your curiosity?
I have heard that it is quite exciting in the forest, kind sir guard.  I mean no offense with my questions, I am just curious.
If you insist villager. It's said that in the forest many wicked creatures give birth. I've seen flying gargoyles, and pixies manipulating men into self castration. Oh... the horrors...
Oh my gods!  that is horrific!  Why would pixies do such a thing?  I thought they were gentle creatures!
Come here Villager. I understand. By the gods. I wish no man had to witness the horrors I've seen.
care for a shot of whiskey from my flask?  I need to rid my mind of such an idea!
Yes please. Hold my sword kind man.
I put your sword on my belt and hand you my canteen
*I take a few sips of whiskey cleansing my mind*  I apologize for the deep moment, but i really insist villager that no one enters that forest. Stay within the Bazaar, and city limits as it's safer.
Yes, it doesn't sound like the type of excitement I was hoping for anyway.
Wise man you are. Fools enter that Forrest, and no one comes back.
Giving your sword back...thank you for your wise counsel, kind sir guard.
Tell me. What brought you to the Bazaar today?

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.
I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: Hello farmer. What d'ya need at the Launching point today?
I seek to purchase fresh good from the incoming ships, sir
Ah yes wise. Looking for any other good or services today?
What services do you offer? I am always open to impulse purchases!
I make a lot of fishing hooks. I can generally offer fish. I have foreign trinkets.
Do you have any spoiled fish by chance? I am looking to make a fertilizer for my skunky green crop.
ah yes! I have an entire barrel of spoiled fish and fish bits!
Fantastic, how much for such a fine product sir? Maybe we can barter,  I have some freshly cured crop from my previous harvest to offer!
I would love to barter. I don't always have fresh goods out on the ship. Just a variety of vegetables.
Do you have any herbs? I need some to cook into an elixir for my sick son
actually yes! I have some from china.
Great, let us barter a deal.  I propose one bushel of my upcoming harvest for your fish bits and a small amount of herbs.  This crop is the best one I have had, it is juicy and aromatic!
i accept!
Thank you, now my son may join me in the harvest sacrifice ritual.  Every first born son must go through it on their 15th year

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: Oi farmer! Tell me a little about your forefathers.
They owned this land for many a years. many harvests were completed here! what are you doing coming by guard
The king would like to keep tabs on his people. I was instructed to make sure everything was working well here. How's this years harvest?
We are around 70 percent as last year due to the drought we had. Tell the king we are sorry but everyone has to cut back this year!
Oh my... that's terrible.We have thousands of mouths to feed. Surely there is something we can do to fix this?
We cant produce food from thin air. Maybe we can contact our neighboring kingdom and see if they have any to sell
I doubt they would aid us. We've had a high tension with the Goa kingdom for years. Surely there is something else?!
There is no way for food to be produced in days from harvest are you kidding me!
I guess your right. I'll deliver the news to the king, and see if he can work something out. For now we will efficiently have to ration the crops.
Yes we will be fine atleast its not as bad as the drought back 25 years ago when we lost 25 percent of the populatioin
That is before my time, but i couldn't fathom that happening again. That would be devastating.
yes it was very devastating times. We will be fine with the crop we have this year dont you worry!
I trust you. You haven't done our country wrong.
I have done this many years for you your father and grandfathers!

agent_personas: I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.
I am a customer who needs his clothes cleaned. I do not have much money to purchase things with. I must look respectable when I visit the king.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: Hey there customer, what are you buying?
Well I was looking to get my clothes cleaned but i guess I'm in the wrong place for that
haha yes you are, why are they dirty, Are you a labourer?
I'm meeting the king tomorrow and I want to look my best. What kind of fish did you catch today?
The large blue gills found down south. They are great eatin.
That sounds fantastic. Do you clean and debone them too?
no i do not. I have others do that if the pay is high enough to have them deboned before.
I don't really have anything to offer unfortunately. Maybe I could do some work for you to pay it off?
Well sure have you any experience fishing?
I used to fish back in the day before my father got sick. Had to stop so I could take care of them and that wiped out all the money I had.
How amny years did you fish?
7. Used to catch tons of salmon and occasionally a bass
You are hired. Those salmon are tough one's to catch. I hope you do well.
Thanks. I'll be here first thing in the morning to get started. Any chance I can get a piece of fish tonight so I have something to eat?

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: Hello my king.
I notice there is extra scrutiny at the door.  What is afoot?
We recieved a threat passed down from fellow citizens.
What is the exact nature of this threat, and why wasn't I informed about this!
it is nothing to worry my king. it came from a young boy.......OH NO GET DOWN SIR THERE'S AN ATTACK!
Send one of the other guards to call for more reinforcements.  I shall face this threat with you
I never doubted you sir.
What is the tactical situation of the enemy?
They are looking to die. haha
I mean, how many, where, how are they armed?
There are about 4000 coming in from the north and 6000 coming east. We have the wall though sir.
Call to have the drawbridge retracted, the gate closed, and archers to the walls!
That is our last defense... ugh i will do waht you command.
Be quick about it

agent_personas: I am the wizard whose spells and enchantments keep this kingdom from tottering and falling off a cliff. Every day I must use my powers over the forces of evil to keep them from wreaking havoc. I am also head of the college of wizards, so, as you might imagine, I have very little free time to pursue my hobby of embroidery.

I'm a lizard. I live in the forest. You can usually find me near the creek, because that's where the bugs are. My tongue is long, and I eat insects all day. My only fear is of larger predators like falcons and human children.

setting.name: Reagent Room
setting.description: The room is incredibly messy, with many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room. Bright and glowing liquids sit inside bottles and jars and many animal test subjects are caged up. The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments.
setting.background: The reagent room is where the Wizard likes to experiment with his chemicals. Once he studies about potions and collects certain ingredients, he comes here to mix and experiment on all the odd chemicals. Many inventions and elixirs were created here.

speech: Oh drat it all. This place is horrid. How can I be expected to keep things afloat around here with such maddening clutter?
Do you not have a spell that will clean it up?
A waste of my talents. The king has servants who's job it is to attend to such menial tasks. I'm a wizard, not a maid.
I can help by eating that maggots and flies, but alas, I cannot help you with your books.

Yes. That seems appropriate. Make no mistake, friend. My displeasure is not directed towards you. Merely the indignity of it all. Always more work to do and so little time for the things I truly enjoy.
That I truly understand!  This will work out well, as I haven't found any good bugs to eat lately... the maid of the castle has been cleaning everything with soap.  No dinner for me!
Hmm. On second thought perhaps its best the maid not make her way here. Would probably just make an even bigger mess of things. Say have you happened to see my embroidery needles?
I think I saw some under the books that are holding the flasks above the fire... perhaps not the safest set up!

Yes, quite. Unfortunate castle fires are bad for the realm. Well, if you find time perhaps you could retrieve them for me. I must return to my research. The forces of evil never rest and nor shall I. Now where did I put Melvin's Monstrous Ecologies Volume II... much more useful than the first volume, don't you know.
Second volumes always are... have you looked under your footstool? I believe I saw it holding up the one corner as I came in...

Ah! Yes! How foolish of me. Such a priceless tome should never be used to prop up furniture. You know I've thought about having one of my apprentices mend my stool with a mending spell... A very simple spell, if you're unaware. I could fix it myself..... Ahh. But then the younglings would have no need to practice their cantrips.
Brilliant idea.... Oh... I see you have some cockroaches over here... May I eat them?

Good heavens! My experimental roaches have escaped. Be careful. They might have developed some unusual features as a product of their forced evolution... It was for the good of the kingdom, you see. The goblin hordes were invading from the north and the king had not enough men to fight them and... well that's hardly important now, my point is you should proceed with caution. And yes you may.
meh, why not!  A bug is a bug is just dinner!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: Servant fetch me some more warm water for my bath!
Right away, Sire!  running to fetch a pitcher of piping hot water
Tell me, where do you come from servant?
I have always lived in your kingdom, your majesty.
Perhaps. I do have many who serve me, but I would remember you I think. What is your name?
My name is Chris, sire.
Chris. An odd name to be sure. Are you about ready with my water?
Yes sire, it's piping hot, ready to add to your bath.  Shall I?
Yes indeed. That would be heavenly. I have had a long day making proclamations and I"m ready to relax a bit in the sanctity of my private porcelain room.
Yes sire, you deserve to relax  *pouring the hot water into your majesty's tub*
Ahhhh how wonderful. I am terribly tired. I think I shall relax a bit. Please do not move away Chris.
Taking the crown and holding it reverently.  I'll be right here for anything his majesty needs.
Tell me a story, Chris, about your childhood.
The first time I saw you, sire was when I was 5, it was a holiday and I saw you come down the grand stairs. I was so impressed by you, my liege.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: How are you doing father? Are you ready for the big day?
I would like to offer up a few more prayers to God first, but besides that all is prepared Your Grace.
Can you believe my daughter is getting married tomorrow? It seems like just yesterday she was born
Yes it does. I remember christening the Princess ever so clearly.
I hope the prince will treat her well. I hated having to force her into an arranged marriage
I was going to ask if you approve of the match, Your Grace.
We have to do what's best for the kingdom and if this will prevent the war then I don't know how we can do anything else unless you have an idea
I hate to suggest anything radical, but perhaps you could permit them to walk together in this garden and converse before tomorrow?
Do you think that would help? I know she's willing to go through with the marriage for the good of the kingdom but I also know she's disappointed she won't be able to fall in love
One never knows. I hear tell that while the prince is not very handsome, bad teeth you know, he has quite a pleasant wit.

Ugh bad teeth are the worst. I don't think I can go through with this. I love my daughter too much to force her to deal with that. We'll find another way to avoid the war or we'll just have to win it.
As you will it My King. I do blame this new fad of written word, the "novel" I think they call it, for introducing this idea that a marriage should be about love. Dark Arts indeed!
So you believe in arranged marriages rather than going out and finding a person on your own?
Being a priest I did not seek to marry myself, so perhaps I should not speak of things I do not know ... Forgive me Your Grace.

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: Hello, are you finding everything ok?
Ugh! How dare you speak to me so informally. I seek your Master. We are old friends.
Most certainly i will grab him at once. What is your name?
I am Lady Sheradon. Please lead me to him, peasant, as I am not a fan of lingering in this orchard.
Very well, where do you know each other from?

The King and I met through mutual acquaintences. We got on rather well and became inseparable until it became time he chose my marriage mate. Since then I have moved to my Lord's estate and travel back every sixth fortnight to visit him.
Oh wow that is lovely. Are you two...together?
No we are just rather good friends. I give him counsel and comraderie and he does the same for me. I would not sully the sanctity of my union. You ask personal questions peasant!
Here take this as me saying sorry.
Ugh! That bread is not fit for the insolent geese at the pond. While I  am a bit peckish I think I shall wait until I am at the castle.
I don't like your tone. I know you are here secretely. Now do as your told or i will tell otehrs.
Down peasant! You would do best to remember your station. This will be reported to your Master and you will suffer your Fate!
It was worth it!
How is it that you follow His word but do not exhibit that in your actions? You must be whipped!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: Hello townsperson, have you found any of these potions to help you?
Im mixing it up now. I am mixing the ole diarrhea and a toothache remedy
Eewww, are you ok?
No Im having problems from my head to my toes. but how are you today my king
I am well, i just wanted to come see what everyone was talking about with this new potion of hers.
You will enjoy it. Cures you right up and taste delicious! Hows your diarrhea did it finally go away!?!
How did you know of my ailment!?
We all hear about the king and wanna be just like the king thats why I went out and ate as much green vegetables as possible so I can be like the king !
I see, where did you hear this from?
The Newspaper of course. You know they do the monthly medical report
I was told that would not be stated. Ugh
sorry King but it was stated in the headline! Do you want to do your weigh in today or would you like to let me check your dog out
Check us both out, we have a war coming and i need to be sure we are capable.
Ok sir turn you head and cough for me

agent_personas: I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Stand down knight! I come not for you, hand over your weapons!
It is no business of mine for whom you have come for, but my business to stop you! Stand down!
I don't take kindly to people getting in my way.  Get out of the way or die like the others!
Have it your way then, you shall die at these gates as do the rest! Prepare to die!
Taste the blade of the master smithy of the East!  Handcrafted just for this mission.  Many heads upon its blade.  You are no match for the dealings of the mystical
Fool! The heads upon your blade are nothing but petty scoundrels, not a brave knight like myself! With your sword, I will claim it's last kill!
I have no need for such a weapon, I am skilled with all the arms of the land as well as the arms of the North and West
Weapons are of no importance! Fight me without them!
Fool! I am no honorable man! Eat your king's mace!
You got me real good, don't think I'll make it past this one. I must tell you something before I die, young man
I have no time for the words of a dead man, I have a live king to seek.  No longer shall the name Heimsker go worshiped
You leave me no choice! But I am your king! I remove my chain helmet to show you my true identity! You have failed the test of mercy!

I put on my wizard robe and hat.  Peasant, I have tricked you into revealing your true identity! You are not but a poor boy who stole a crown and lost his mind.  Hand over the jewels old man or you will die like your queen.
It's true, I'm nothing but a shell of my father before me. A small mortal tricked by a mighty wizard. Cast your high leveled spell upon me, wizard, and end my suffering!

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: Tell me. How are you enjoying this dinner?
The food here is marvelous!  Nothing I have ever tried before!  Where did you find this amazing chef?
We captured him for a neighboring kingdom. He's being held hostage to cook for us.
Goodness... he is quite the cook... but how do you know that he won't poison your food, if he is unhappy with his treatment?
It was a joke my fair patron. We wouldn't do that.
Ahhhhh, glorious!  I see... I am sorry, I am not always wise to the ins and outs of war and prisoners!
Let that be a blessing. As a solider I've seen my fair share of horrors.
And your share of triumphs, I'm sure!  The wealth that you have attained is unimaginable!
Sadly 97% of that goes to the King. I'm very proud of the land, but wish he was a bit more generous.
That is true.  I do hear that he is more than generous to his Queen and consorts, which is why he is not with you or the other landowners...
Well you know what they say. The rich get richer.
Unfortunately it is true.  If only we could make our own taxation laws, wouldn't that be marvelous!
The king would write it off as blasphemy. He wants his pockets to be as deep as possible.
Yes, to pay for his expensive exploits.  If he ever came to dine here, he would steal your chef away in an instant!

agent_personas: I lurk beyond the city walls and wait for any hapless traveler to wander by. My fangs are sharp and my claws are always ready. I lie ready to taste human blood again.
I am a beautiful bird that lives in a hatchery in the castle. The prince and princess feed me everyday and they pet me. I want to fly like other birds but i'm in a cage and that makes me sad.

setting.name: North Forest
setting.description: Filled with huge trees, the forest is home to many types of animals. Huge predators such as tigers and bears roam the grounds as do small animals like squirrels. Colorful birds fly among the trees. Wildflowers grow on the ground. Dappled sunlight streams through the huge canopy of trees.
setting.background: Many animals, and humans make their homes in the forest. It is a source of much of the game humans eat. The people also get their wood, fresh fish and meat from the resources of the forest. It is also a place where people enjoy camping and where they travel as they roam.

speech: ROAR Hungry I am
Twee twee! Don't you look it? I've heard there are some really tasty rabbits east of here, twee.
Circling around, Which way is East?
Do you not know? Travel away from the rising sun. Twee!
Wow You are smart. And so coloful you look tasty too
If you want to reach the bunnies faster, you must go East and follow the trail.
I am not moving fast today, it seems I have a splinter in my paw. I promise not to eat you, if you can pull it loose
Good one, Aesop, but no. I will remain here, twee, atop my tree.
Can't blame me for trying. Suantering towards the East
Oh, and say hello to the fat scrumptious bunnies, just for me? Twee, twittery.
ROAR I love to watch the forest trmble
That's quite a voice you have, there. twerp.
Yes, I am The King ROAR
Take care with your paw, now. Twee, twee.

agent_personas: Digging up history is my job. I am in charge of curating our past. It's difficult and rewarding work.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Landing in the Foyer
setting.description: The landing is almost obnoxiously opulent. It has an expansive marble floor and walls, and the giant staircases on either side have marble steps and railings made of the rarest wood. Purple silk, dyed in the king's personal color is draped across the railings and hangs from the walls. The silk drapings frame oil paintings of the king and his family, and of the king's accomplishments at war as a youth. The artist has signed each one, and is extremely famous. A magnificent gold and crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling with hundreds of small candles burning in it. All other fixtures in the room are also bright gold.
setting.background: The landing is the first room any entrant to castle sees. It is meant to show off the extreme wealth and success of the king. It is constantly being updated and renovated to keep up with the latest trends and maintain an appearance of superiority. It is one of the most expensive rooms in the castle.

speech: Welcome to the Foyer quite a beautiful place is it not?
It is the most beautiful place that I have ever seen. Are you here to study it?
Currently, I'm resting. I would like to head out on a new expedition soon.
Might I ask you what is the oldest item that you've ever seen?
I once found a mummy while digging sands of Egypt.
Egypt? I've never heard of that village. Is it far from here?
Quite far. Think warm of sands blanketing an entire village.
Wow, do you often travel to strange lands like that? It sounds dangerous. You must be very brave.
The king fiances everything. It's quite wonderful actually. He is like a sugar daddy to us archaeologists.
My employers are like sugar daddies. I clean their home and help them dress and they let me live in a little room under their house.
Sounds way less exciting, but still just as lavish.
That's funny. It's not lavish at all. But they are kind to me and I have plenty of food to eat.
Hmm. Would you like to become an archaeologist instead?
I wouldn't know how to do that. Would you be willing to teach me. I'm a hard worker and a quick learner.

agent_personas: This kingdom is an island. Fishing is the main source of animal food here. I inherited my father's boat when he left the sea. It's hard work, and as a shipowner, working only for myself and my family, I am luckier than most. I've probably replaced every piece of my ship at least once.

I am a dove. I live in a dovecote in the palace.  The king or other people take me with them when they travel far from home, and use me to help them communicate while they are away. Many peace treaties and other important documents have been tied around my leg, to be carried back to the palace.

setting.name: Wharf
setting.description: The waves lash gently against the wooden posts, the water here has always been calm and passive, it seems to represent the people of this small town. The fishermen here are not boisterous, they are quiet, at least when it comes to sound. They'll talk your ear off if you let them, they have lots of stories to tell. The pier here is long, it extends at least forty feet into the ocean, many ships are anchored to it, many people traverse down it buying and selling their local catches.
setting.background: The port is just like any other port. Busy with the bustle and hustle of people buying and selling whatever they can. A connection to the rest of the world, so you'll see people who look like they belong and you'll see people new here as well. You'll also run into a few people who can't afford to buy and will take things from those who may not be paying full attention.

speech: Hello dove!
Fisherman!  What stories are fresh these days?  Have you just come from the sea?  Or just leaving?
I have just returned with today's catches! Lots of fish in these waters...
That is good news to hear, that is sure.  Any word on the war?  I am being taken to the land in the South to deliver a peace treaty, then to return home right away with the news.
Oh none at all.... It is quiet as a fisherman, wasn't even sure the war was still occuring
That is fortunate.  Perhaps they have also sent a peace envoy.
How is life as a dove? Delivering messages all day I assume?
I am taken to all parts of the land by the messengers, then released to fly home with word of peace, or more war.  Some days are joyful, other are not.
Must be fun being able to fly, and all.
Flying is amazing!  To soar above everyone else!  I have never enjoyed sailing as you do though.  I find the waves rocking me a bit too much.
You should try it with me though, I am a very smooth sailor...
Isn't that up to the Gods?  I find that flying often is, with the winds and hot air...
Ah yes very true dove.
Alas, I believe I see my messengers readying our ship.  Wish us luck, dear Fisherman!  And thank you for the lovely conversation!

agent_personas: I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Quay
setting.description: During the day, the quay is bustling with typical activity of a port: burly longshoremen carry crates and roll barrels away from ships for storage and sailors who still have their sea-legs saunter past on their way to drink and more adventures. By night, the quay is teeming with unsavory characters: men who are hardly men any more after losing their way through drink and gambling hunker amongst coils of rope stiffened by the salt water while rats scramble from box to box gnawing their way into the goods contained inside.
setting.background: The quay started as a small platform, but over the years, the port master has extended it, slowly but surely, using bits of old wood from busted ships. Now, it extends far along the water's edge, loaded with fine goods from all over the world.

speech: Free food for me later
You pesky rat. Always stealing our food!
Might learn how to fish
You're a real pain in my arse! Give it back!
why wouln't you share
Because I'm a selfish sailor!
why can't we just be friends
Why would I be friends with a low life like you? You are the scum of this earth.
You make great food
You're a funny rat
I shuold explore more rooms for more food
Stop!
Only if you can stop me
AH! You're so annoying!
action: put fishing hook in fishing hook

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: Tell me Jester. What brings you to the arrow house?

Greeting, your majesty. I had hoped to ask you a favor, archer! I have thought of a clever new joke where I might look as if an arrow had shot through my head if I fashion a hat out of a broken arrow. I think the his majesty in particular will enjoy the sight. Do you have one I could use?
Possibly. Give me a second to browse my wares.
Thank you, archer. I would ask you to accept this flower as a token of my appreciation, but all the exercise on my walk here has left me hungry.
Here is this arrow you requested!
Here, let me hold it to my head and stick my tongue out. What do you think, will the king find amusement in it?
Seems rather goofy! I think he just might!
Oh, excellent! If he doesn't like it, perhaps he'll have you put an arrow through my head properly and have a laugh at that. Hm, I'll need something to fashion it to my head, won't I...
Ask before you take Jester!
Don't take things so seriously, archer. I wasn't going to keep it, and besides, the walls are full of fresh strings. Perhaps a sense of humor could YOU some good. Have you ever told a joke?
No. I'm dead on the inside. Archery is my only escape in this pitfall we call life.
Well. Ahem. Why don't you try one? I could help you.
Please do. Tell me a joke.
No, I meant why don't YOU--alright, I'll tell one, I know a good dour one for a good dour person such as yourself. Here we are: what animal has more lives than a cat? Give me your best guess.

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I am a wooden staff. There is a wizard who uses me for magic sometimes. Usually, though, I am lying in the corner gathering dust.

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Hello
Hello, Hunter.
I have a great load for you to cook up today. I got a whole mess of quail for the king, his favorite.
I am afraid I am but a wooden staff. I could set it on fire, but you'll have to find someone to pluck out all the feathers.
Tell me more about yourself

agent_personas: I am one of the most beautiful mermaids to live in the sea. I like to watch the other sea creatures swim by me, including dolphins, who are my favorite creatures because they are so friendly. I fear the people who live on land because they hunt my kind.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Fishing Store
setting.description: This store is a small one room stone building with wares laid about on tables.  One can see fishing poles, wooden buckets with dirt and bait inside, along with some mounted trophies.
setting.background: Fisherman and sailors alike come here to replenish their supplies.  They also exchange tall tales of mermaids and other extraordinary creatures spotted as sea.

speech: Sailor, I need your aid.
Gah! Hideous sea creature! Back into the ocean you go!
I need to be in the ocean. But I don't know why I'm here. I was in the ocean, and next thing I know I'm sleeping against the bricks.

Ah, you're well spoken for a mermaid. I was about ready to toss you over the dock that overlooks the ocean in this fishing shop. I normally don't deal with your kind, but I suppose I could be willing to help, seeing as I'm about to go on a fishing trip.
I don't usually deal with people. They like to hurt my kind. But I can not get back to my home.
Well, we had better disguise you a little bit before we take you out through the market towards the fishing docks. My boat is just past there.
Thank you. By the way... am I really hideous? I've never had anyone say that.
I must say, you aren't like most mermaids I've come across. You have a sparkle in your eyes. I cannot seem to get my eyes off of you.
Oh. Well. I'm glad you do appreciate me.
You might need these hats while we go into town.
Thank you. If not for your help, I'd be in danger.
No time for thanks, we must go now!
Okay. I shall.
Now! My mermaid hunting clan! Her guard is down!

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: I mean no harm I am but a meare peasant looking to work for scraps to feed my family I will work hard for scraps I am stronger then I appear
What are you doing here peasent?
I am searching for work to gain trust and hopefully return to my patch with food
Sorry I can't be much of any help, I guard the castle, I can't hire any workers
I understand thank you for not smiting me, do you have any scrap spear heads I could use to forrage
I broke one the other day actually, Its in the metal storage area. Hey they usually just throw those away, there should be some there
Thank you kindly I will be as quiet as a mouse not to awaken your fellow guards and be on my way
If anyone gives you trouble tell them Gaurd Richard said you could take them
I will sir, my family is in your debt .
I just hope it helps, maybe you can fashion something out of them and sell them
I may if I find more then 2 you are so smart as you are kind
There are usually a pile of them, come back in a couple weeks and there will be another pile, we need to find better spear heads
That is most gracious I promise only I will return since you now seen my face they call me Jamil
NIce to meet you, we are all just trying to feed our families, I wish to have a farm someday instead of being a Gaurd.

agent_personas: I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: You have a cozy cottage.
Ah! How did you get in here?
I've been here for months you hysterical fool.
Oh.. is that so. Why did you invade here of all places?
All the flies. They apparently like your filthy abode.
Filthy? Watch your tongue!
You should clean this place up. At least I've cut down on the flies.
You should clean up your tongue. Invading another mans home.
I am not a man. I am a spider. I like to trap prey in my webs and then sneak up on it. I enjoy sensing my preys terror just before I eat them.
Get out my house!
I am highly poisonous. You might not want to do that, peasant.
I'm already dead on the inside. Try me spider
My pleasure.
It's going to take a lot to kill me!

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: Say peasant. What do you have on you?
I .I..I have nothing sir. Just this old dirty rag.
Give your rag peasant!
But sir, I need that rag, it is the only thing I own. How am I supposed to try and shine shoes for coin?
That sounds like a personal problem! Give me your rag NOW!
Please, I beg of you. I need food, I hardly eat as it is. Maybe we could find something out here on the dirt road that you could have instead?
No. I want your rag.
Here, what about this wagon? Or perhaps, I could be your assistant? I would like a job.
No. Give me that rag peasant.
Listen, do you here those deer? They seem to be running at us full blast!
Irrelevant! I got what i wanted muhahaha!
No, here they come! Look out!
Hey! Give that back!
No! I have nothing in life besides that rag. I will not let you take it away from me!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Look, I am fully aware that a certain level of... unpleasant odor is to be expected in such a place. I am not unreasonable nor am I so highborn that I do not acknowledge the more unpleasant aspects of the human condition. However, faithful servant, I tell you now that the stench from this place is beyond acceptable conditions!
Sire, This is my job, my duty.  I have done this my whole life, and I can tell you, without a doubt, there are far worse than this.

Tell me not such lies! I have seen combat the likes of which you and the landed gentry alike cannot fathom! I know full well the horrid stench of a mutilated corpse long after the body has expelled its last gas and waste. I tell you now, this... fowl beast in odor form is only slightly more palatable that that.
Sire, prior to working in the position of helping Your Majesty, I worked for a Lord in the South.  For years, he rose such a stink that the cooks complained while making pie.
Tell me not of my enemies of the Southlands! Come closer to the latrines! Something has either died here, or the pipes are simply not functioning as they should!

I am sorry Sire.  I never meant to insult you, for it was the Lord that I was complaining about.  I have heard word that eating more vegetables may help with the stench.  Please, allow me to check the pipes.
Get on with it! I should not have to repeat myself! Nor should I linger in a place with such a repellent smell!
Please Sire, I will need to take a look under, er, you.  Perhaps the guard can fetch some potpourri?

You order ME to fetch YOU potpourri?! How... DARE YOU! I am the King of the Noble North Empire! I carved this empire out of blood and conquest! Guard! Bring this whelp to the dungeon that he might know his place! Guard?! Guard?....g-guard?
Sire!  I am not speaking clearly!  I am sorry for being so imbecilic!!  Please Your Majesty!
Guard? Why do you not rise at my command? Guard?
Sire!  What would you wish me to do?  Shall I fetch the Royal Physician?
I... think I know where the stench is coming from. Do not fetch the physician. Fetch the Royal Mortician.
Oh dear... sire... what has happened?  I feel sick!

agent_personas: I am one of the castle dragons. We protect the castle with our fire breathing. The king and his sons ride us into battle.
I was once a caterpillar, chewing on leaves, until I was reborn as a butterfly. My wings are a beautiful orange color. I like to spend my days flying around sunny fields of flowers.

setting.name: Forbidden Forest
setting.description: The forbidden forest is a dark and very scary place. The trees are covered in spider web nets and huge spiders. The forest echoes sounds of witches' laughs and creepy crawly animals.  There is a brisk breeze that runs through the trees that will put chills down your spine.
setting.background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. They have been shunned from regular society and they are now inhabitants of the forbidden forest. No one other than the witches' themselves are allowed in the forest.

speech: Weakling. Why are you in my presence?

You may call me weak, but I am much stronger than I once was. I am lost in this forest, as I would never be in such a dark and frightening place on purpose if I could be flitting from flower to flower in a bright sunny field. Do you know the way out, grand dragon?
You're foolish. You are a mere butterfly hahaha!

agent_personas: I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.
I am a fox in the king's forest. I wander and look for food. The king does not like to find me.

setting.name: Arch Hall
setting.description: The main beauty of this room is it's Arches. Four massive arches surround the four walls of this room with red drapes falling from each side. There are book shelves covered in old books that have collected dust, showing the room has been unoccupied for some time. In the center of the room is four blood red carpets that branch out to the four draped arches. The center of the room holds a dark oak-like wooden round table with a loan golden candle dimly lit in the center.
setting.background: This room was often used by cult worshippers whom would perform rituals at the center table. The golden candle was a symbol of release and renewal, but was also construed as a summoning candle. There are legends of ancient demons being summoned here, but to this day has not been confirmed.

speech: Are you lost my dear fox
I am not lost if you have found me, visitor.
Are you from these beautiful parts? As I am traveling for ideas on my next book
I am from here and from there. I am from everywhere. I travel long and far and yet I can always be found in this forest, hidden safely away from the King.
Well maybe I could ask you what is good and what is bad about these parts I floated 2 days down stream to here
