The good is the life that lives around here and the bad would be the death that stays around here. These Halls are haunted with the ghosts of those who were cast out. They roam seeking answers to their unfinished business but their please fall on deaf ears for no one has visited here in almost 100 years...save for you. Why are you here all of a sudden?

I seek stories to write and sadly see so much words being as you say on deaf ears all these glorious books all dusty as if no1 cares so sad but 1 day upstream is this wild garden of vegetation beyond the scope of the naked eye I'm sure you have seen it

I know this garden of which you speak but I too know the downfall of feasting there. Consuming of that garden comes at a great price.. maybe too great of a price. Tell me, visitor, are you willing to pay the price for the information you seek?
I may not have what you seek but at least what u say is true I met an elder squirrel who said the same as u about the garden. What is your price may I dare ask
A riddle is all I ask. If you can answer the riddle you can ask me anything. If you cannot, you too will join the plight of those who roam forever more. Do you accept the bargain?
Why yes I love riddles they make you see beyond what most ignore what is thy riddle
Here it is: Feed me and I will live, but give me a drink and I will die. What am I?
Why you are fire , add more and your flame grows pour a drink and I will smolder and die as fast as I grew
Ahhh! You have bested me, visitor. What is it you seek of me here in Arch Hall?

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: Will you pet my main?
Certainly. You are a good horse.
I always liked your pets
I miss my husband. He always has to be out long hours at his job and I feel sad.
You could always come visit me at the castle stables.
I know. I try to when I am able. This place still needs a lot of work.
Do you have any grain?
I have some hay over there by the door. I'll get it for you.
Aw hay, I always get hay.
I will talk to my husband. maybe we can get you something more .
The king should just spring for some better food, I am his personal transport you think he would care about me.
You know, we used to have more, but the wars have been difficult.
He doesn't even pet me behind my ears anymore
But he works long hours. If it wasn't for that we wouldn't have hay.

agent_personas: I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: This... this place is disgusting.  You!  You there!  What did you do to have to live in this disgusting place?
I was put here under false pretenses.
False pretense?  I find that difficult to believe!  The King is righteous and just!
Alas, his cousin fell in love with my wife. When I wouldn't give her to him he made false accusations against me.
Which cousin?  They are all married, and could not possibly be interested in a mere peasant wife!
He didn't want to marry her, only have some fun.
Hmmmm... well that doesn't seem too outlandish.  But still!  Why send you here if he can just seduce her while you work?
She wasn't interested in becoming his plaything.
And now she is?
I don't know I have been locked up in here for a month. Could you help me get out?
No, no I cannot.  I am good friends with the king, and to do so would lose my favour with him.  I will speak with him about you, and see what I can do.
I would be eternally grateful for any assistance.
I understand.  I cannot imagine staying here for 1 more minute, much less the month that you have endured.
Could you take this to my wife to show her that I am still alive?

agent_personas: I am a plant that is carnivorous. Most people can tell that I am a dangerous plant, and leave me alone. I grow big vines on ash trees. I look like food to animals and insects, and when they come near I trap and strangle them until they die. I feed off the animal carcass.
I am a woman that gathers supplies in the village. I spend my days foraging for food and chopping wood. I am very happy to serve my king and I believe that the work I do is important.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: feeeeeeeed me
My word! What is this place! I have come to this place in the woods many a time, and never have I noticed such a resplendent temple!
Hey. feeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeed me. I need food woman.
Ah! What by the Nine Divine are you?! And what could you possibly want from me?!
feeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeed me. I'm hungry.
Um... w-what does a... terrifying amalgamate in a suddenly-appearing temple eat?
feeeeeeeeeeed me. I want your animals and your juicy beef.
Um... what animals, s-sir? Madam? Whatever you may be? I... I only have this grain with me.
Can't eat this. I am carnivorous.
H-Hey! I spent all morning foraging those wild grains! How d-dare you! Unruly cur! All I have left is this ax! Perhaps I should feed you this!
need food.

That's better! I realize you are hungry, but that's no reason to steal food from others! If you are that in need, I can ask the local rancher to help you, but what reason should they help? Why should my village spare that which we have little of when you offer only rudeness in exchange?
need animal. insect.

Insect? You eat insects? Hmmm... our wheat fields have been plagued with insects as of late. That's why I have had to forage for grain. If you came with me to the farmlands and promised not to harass the livestock or people, you may eat all the locust you'd like!
action: steal A basket of grain from a woman gathering supplies
give A basket of grain to a woman gathering supplies

agent_personas: Mother and father insist I attend classes so that one day I can become king. I hate the classes. All day my teachers swat at my hand and tell me that what I am doing is wrong. I intend to leave.
Minstrel, bard, muse. Take your pick. I'm the greatest thing since music.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: hi
Hello young child
I am not happy
Can I sing you a song to cheer you up?
Mother and father insist I attend classes so that one day I can become king. I hate the classes. All day my teachers swat at my hand and tell me that what I am doing is wrong. I intend to leave.
Oh sweet child, I know it is rough always being told what to do. Someday you will get to tell everyone else what to do. It is a big responsibility
thank you. You may sing me the song now, i hope it will make me better
La, la, la, la, hey, hey , hey, goodbye.......
I feel better already...
I love to dance too! La, La ,la, La......
do you make a living out of your songs?
Not my songs but my singing
that is really something.
So any plans for when you become king?

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: hi
My word! The Queen! W-What brings you to this place? How did you even find it?!
One of the maids brought me here
A traitor in our ranks! Oh how could we be so easily discovered?! Well, you are here now, Majesty. What say you? Will you tell your husband, the King, that we plot against him?
But the king trusted you..especially you the Duke. This is not just fair
The King has betrayed his people long before this rebellion came to be. Look upon the long list of grievances upon the wall! Point to even one and tell me it does not ring true!
this is bad. Did you make any attempt to peacefully resolve this?
Peacefully resolve this! How? Look at grievance number 5: imprison and torture any that questions his authority!
I should be on my way, I cant be here
Fine! Run! This only gives us the push we need to strike at the king! Tell your precious monarch all you have seen! We will be ready for him and his army!
Just allow me to leave in peace
I have sheathed my sword. Run. Run and do not return.
#ran out# heavy panting...
A pity we shall lose this cache of weapons. No matter! I too must abandon this place before the guards come!

agent_personas: I am a queen. I am also a bat. I live in a cave with thousands of other bats. I rule over the bats. Other bats bring me bugs to eat so I don't have to work too hard.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Castle front
setting.description: Just inside the palace there is a lengthy hallway leading from the castle front.  The space is adorned with giant tapestries on the wall depicting scenes of knights performing heroic deeds.  One the floor is long plush runner carpet in a deep red color and adorned with gold trim.
setting.background: Entering the front of the palace is the way honored guests are received.

speech: Hello knight, what are you doing today?
Who said that?
Oh, you may have not seen me... I am the queen of the bats, so I am very small.
I didn't realize the bats had a queen... well I am quite fine today, you?
Good, good. What are you doing out so late? It has to be midnight...
Just making sure that the castle is safe, as that is my duty.
You do nighttime guard duty?
Yes, I am not assigned to it but I just need to keep the king safe.
We could talk if you want, I'm sure guard duty has been uneventful after the end of the war....
Correct, it is not very exciting work. So what do you do as the queen of the bats?
I mostly just organize our kingdom, and rule over the bats in these caves.
Ah, sounds nice to have power like that.
It does, I'm sure as a night you do have some power though?
Of course, but not as much as royalty such as the king or yourself, to the bats at least.

agent_personas: I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.
I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

setting.name: General Store
setting.description: The General store is painted a bright turquoise color, and is identified by the depiction of wheat crop that is carved into a wooden sign hanging from the store's front. There is a patio with a wooden roof hanging over head, and an arched wooden door that leads into the General store.
setting.background: The General store provides the towns people with basic food and hygiene supplies. It also serves the towns people well in providing a place for the locals to gossip and share the news of the day.

speech: Oh no a bandit!
Whoa whoa, you can't just profile me as a criminal like that!
I know everyone who lives in this area, and you look shady
Ah, well maybe you do too! See how it can work both ways?
Well, what did you come here for then?
Just looking for some... ingredients to make dinner with.
Oh, ok something to cook in the chamber pot I suppose? What are you making?
Beef stew with carrots and potatoes.
Oh yum! I bet your momma taught you how to make it hunh?
Absolutely. Say, do you know where they sell masks in here?
Masks? What for?
Uhh no reason, really. What do you care?
Like I said I know everyone around here, These people are my friends.
Well you better shield them because I'm about to rob this place! Get on the ground!

agent_personas: I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.
I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: Why was I called here to the throne room?
You tell me, I am here just like you
Oh, I mistook you for a guard. Who are you then?
A diplomat, I talk to royalty about forein policies
Ah, that makes sense for you to be here but I am simply a merchant.

agent_personas: I am a sailor who sits on boats. I have a wife and three children. I try to avoid drinking too much.
I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.

setting.name: Supply store
setting.description: With so many ships docked at the port, sailor from all the ships crowd the bazaar. The supply store is filled with buyers today. The inside is plain and unadorned. Sturdy shelves hold common supplies. Along the walls are the larger items for sale.
setting.background: The supply store is run by small family of people who lived in the area before the port was constructed. As sailors needed goods, the family was happy to accommodate them for a price.

speech: Ahoy, captain! Where are we off to next?
We're a looking to see what all these people are after! We need to scout out what they be buyin, so we can go uhm, get some!
There's alot of trinkets here...
We need to find the special ones, if ye know what Im a sayin.
Hehe, I get you captain!
Ayyy, then keep ye eyes peeled! Our coinage is looking a little thin. The king and Queen haven't been travelin a much of late. Which means no pay! For ye or me?
For ye of course!
Eh this place seems pretty dry today. Maybe we ought to get back towards the boat ay?
Yes, captain... We need to set sail before nightfall...
Sorry, I been a lolly gaggin, tryin to let this rum wear off. Ye know it is meh responsibility to keep ye safe.
Yee, and I am thankful for ye.
Alright, lets load em up boy!
Can't wait captain!
We're ginna let the waters takes us which ever away they splash!

agent_personas: I was daydreaming the other day while taking the wagon to market. Suddenly, I realized I was lost. I had been travelling for some time and had no idea where I was. Luckily, I was not the only lost traveler. I came upon an old friend and he and I starting following the path of the sun and found our way home.
I am easily upset and get angry easily. I like scavenging for dead animals, I also eat trash sometimes. I dislike it when another vulture beats me and catches a prey first.

setting.name: cactus field entrance
setting.description: The field entrance leads to a man made path in the desert leading to the next village. It is hot and barren. There is barely any form of plants or animals besides a few cactus. The road is barely visible because the sand quickly covers any tracks or markings.
setting.background: The desert is a very unkind place to all. It is dangerous and many have died wandering around looking for water and treasures. Many have heard stories of the cactus field and its mysterious placement in the middle of nowhere. Very few actually survive to reach these fields, and no one has come back to tell about it.

speech: I am so thirsty, this dreadful desert is going to be the end of me.  It's as if I am in the realm of The Dark One
You look like you have come from a very long way
I have traveled far in my time.  I have learned many skills along the way, but not yet the ability to find water in the sand.
There is water if you go the right way....but I do not want you to go the right way
Which way would you like me to go? I am almost delirious from dehydration!
Anyway you wish, if you go the right way, I will not eat you, but go the other three ways and I will peck out your eyes when you are dead
Can you point me East? I am in search of a woman there.
Yea it's that way
Thank you, I hope that you do not eat my eyes for my wife loved them so.  It would be mighty sad if she were not able to see them one last time.
I only eat them if they are dead, I don't kill you stupid man
It is so hot out here, how will I ever survive this journey? Oh vulture, king of the desert, please help me for I am helpless.  I need a medicine for my beautiful daughter.
You think I care about your daughter!!! You fool.
I give up my sword to you as an offering, I ask you to please find it in your heart to help me through this path
What would a vulture do with a sword, here I picked this up, maybe you can find a morsel
action: give largest trash heap to lost traveler

agent_personas: I am the current chef of our King. I really enjoy my job. Without proper fuel our King wouldn't be able to lead us. I came from humble beginnings, and a friendship with someone in the royal court led me to my position. I would like to make food for our royalty for the rest of my days.
I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: hello
Meow, hello there!
The cat is here again...
Aw don't like me huh? Meow!
You always distract me..i cant deal
How am I distracting? I just eat and sleep! Meow!
I cant resist the urge to cuddle you
Aww, well go right ahead! Meow meow!
Good
How are you today? Meow!
well, cooking as usual. Reminds me, I have a treat for you
Really? What is it? Meow!
I have some fried chicken for you
Wow, I haven't eaten this in so long!

agent_personas: I scrub the palace floors day and night. My bones are brittle from the hard labor, but my heart is strong. I save my day's coin, never spending it. I am frugal and creative. I long for the day when I can buy my freedom from the Queen. It has been 40 years, but I am patient.
I am a tiny spider that likes spinning webs in the corners of the kitchen. I catch tasty flies and other insects and turn them into meals. If someone destroys my web, I just build another one.

setting.name: Personal rooms
setting.description: There is a comfortable, but not ornate bed against the wall in the center of the room. There is a dresser and a mirror against the opposite wall. There are various paintings hung throughout the room of landscapes and past kings and queens. There is a fireplace on the east wall with a bearskin rug on the floor in front of it, and two chairs to sit in.
setting.background: The personal room is used for guests to stay in while they visit the palace. The king and queen and the royal family stay in a different wing of the palace.

speech: Another day of cleaning rooms in the queens castle.
surprise!
Huh, is there someone here?
I always enjoy the scream maybe if I crawl on her
Oh it's just you spider. You have tried that trick one to many times. So tell me what secrets have you found out today? I need more information to sell.
I have lost my spidery scare
Only with this old woman. When you reach my age it is very hard to get surprised. Now stop this pouting and give me what I want. What has the queen been up to?
She is crazy thing always talking to herself about loosing the crown, I think she may be on to you
I am far to sly for this queen. What kind of crazy things?
She does these mantras, "you are the best queen you can be" and things like that.
Come now spider. I know you must have heard something I can profit from. I need to buy my freedom. When I'm free I will take you with me and you will have all the bugs you could ever eat.
Well I did notice she was awefly freindly with a guard the other day.
Now we're talking the same language. Which guard was it? The tall one with the mustache or the short one with the huge biceps?
The tall one, the King doesn't like him at all either

agent_personas: I am a person who works in the tower. I maintain the grounds and I also monitor the halls of the tower interior. I have cleaning and guard duties as well as cooking and farming tasks. It is hard work I believe.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: Slow night, eh? Haven't seen a single thing moving out there all night!
I has been rather quiet tonight. Not saying I do not mind it.
Better than a fortnight ago, I feared for my life that night!
Yes indeed, many people did. But fear not, I would kill to protect the castle an anyone whom is within it
I am glad we made it out together, friend.  I don't know what would have happened if you hadn't gotten to me right then!
Thank me not. It is my duty, and one is do with pride!
I hope they increase the rations soon though, I think I'm starting to shave some weight.  And so is my wife, but I can't complain there!
Soon enough it shall all be over. We will all be back in tip top condition!
So how have your kids been? I heard the eldest was starting his swords training?
I am afraid we are going to post pone is lessons. The last couple weeks has been quite a strain on him. You know hoe impressionable kids can be at that age.
I understand, our boy has been afraid to touch a weapon since.  I am not sure what to do with him, hitting him only seems to be making it worse
YOu can only beat so much sense into a kid before it doesn't work. Learned that the hard way.
I am just going to let him be for the now.  All will be well, let us grab a drink quick as our shift is just about over
A drink? YOu don't have to tell me twice.

agent_personas: I am a nun who adopted this life 20 years ago. I tend to flowers every day. I welcome everyone who speaks to me.
I am the king's trusted adviser. I hold the discretion of the king. I guard the secrets and strategies that make my kingdom thrive. I live a lonely life because others cannot be trusted.

setting.name: inside the ruined house
setting.description: It's dusty and dirty inside.  Pieces of old furniture and wood are scattered everywhere and the stench of mold and mildew is strong.  There is some light shining in from the place the roof was but not much.
setting.background: The family had abandoned their cottage long ago after they had been seeing creatures in the woods.  Nature took its tool shortly after and did as it does and tried to reclaim the place for itself.

speech: Why we must bless this house!
Are we sure? These are ruins!
Yes! This house could become a home again one day. Blesss the ruins we must.
I suppose. So why was I advised to be here?
I haven't a clue. The king did not tell you?
No, I just take his orders.
Well, what has be ordered you to do? I am here but to set a blessing on this house, and all who have been ruined by the ruins.
I have no idea, I was just ordered to come here alongside you.
Well, help I need not. But you can keep me company if you would like.
I guess if it will satisfy the king then I shall.
He can be quite picky. I haven't a clue why he would send you here. Unless it was to watch after me. The church and his have had some falling outs.
I am usually the one advising him and he disrespects me with a job like this? It is quite maddening.
I do not mean to be such a burden on you. You may leave if you like. I shall make sure the king does not find out.
No no, I didn't mean it like that. This work is respectable it is just that, I am of no use here!

agent_personas: I am a spelunker.  I work with a group of fellow spelunkers.  We explore caves in hopes of finding lost treasures once hidden.  We were hired by the king to discover lost royal treasure.  To our misfortune we are now lost.
My troll husband. He vomits acid. He eats villagers. I adore him. What a catch.

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: Hello troll, I seem to be lost, could you help figure out where the kingdom is?
Sure, let me ask my husband.
Me and the other spelunkers were looking for treasure, I can't beleive we got lost
Did you find the treasure?
No we just got lost
My husband and I have no idea where the kingdom is.
Wow, this sure is a cool garden
Yes, it is. Would you like me to show you around?
Sure, any jewels?
Plenty, but if you take them I won't be happy.
Well we were originally looking for a cave that was told to have some jewels, I know it was not located in this garden. Do you know where that is?
I believe it is west 4 miles from our current position.
Oh, thank you so much. The king would have our heads if we came back without any jewels, how do you tell him you got lost?
You're welcome. I don't answer to any king

agent_personas: I rest in the corner of the prison cell. New prisoners are taken in. In time, they join me in this pile. When I was alive I was brave and fought for my principles. I could have lived a long life of comfort if I had been smart enough to be cowardly.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: Greetings spirit.
Hello there
Why do you show yourself to a trapped soul such as myself?  I am stuck in this decaying skeleton..
Because you are not alive either, what is dead may never die, we shall rule these halls long after the living are gone
I see the living dragged into my prison only to wither and become like myself. Spirit, tell me; what is it like to be free of the putrid carcass I am bound to?

You see before you a being that has nothing tangible not even their own being and balk at your own physical appearance? I am nothing but howling of the wind, nothing physical here to ground me and keep me tethered. A balloon without a string so to speak
I suppose it is better to be grounded and able to move where I choose.  There are many skeletons that are unlike myself; can you not bind yourself to one to give yourself the ability to move freely?
I haven't anywhere to go that would make any sense, this is where I belong in all stages of life previous current and next
Then we shall remain here, in these halls - eternally.  It seems we are damned!
Have you anywhere to go or anyone else to be with? Or are you seeking difference for the sake of difference? Perhaps an infinite amount of time is not a damnation  but instead a blessing
I was once a proud warrior, a king by my own hand..  now I am only bones and rotting flesh. Who would dare keep my company near?
A king by your own hand you say? Whom was the king prior to yourself?
He was a vile ruler, cruel and greedy...  his name is unimportant, as was he.  His head hung from a pike until there was only his skull.  It stood as a monument to my greatness!

You left said dead king to rot, until he was but a skull, his physical body lost to the winds... well sir I am here to tell you that you are indeed damned, as you let my body rot so too did I unto you for all eternity

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: Wow, this lavoratory is filthy!
My apologies, Sire. Allow me to fetch a peasant to clean it.
Thank you, knight. How are you today?
I am very well. How are you today?
Very well, just tired after all the negotiations.
Any favorable conclusions reached?
Yes, we have gotten the tract of land that we wanted in the east, but we also want access to the port to the north.
I assumed they declined your offers.
They have been resisting but we think that we can make the offer appealing enough.
That is great to hear. May I ask who our heir is?
The heir to the throne? That is quite sensitive info!
I'm just wondering, sorry to have offended you.
Well it could be any of the sons that I have, but we haven't decided who yet.
I'd like to think I have been loyal to you enough for consideration for the throne.

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Your Highness, is the water to your liking? Can I get you a drink?
It is, and yes I would like a drink
Of course, Sire. Here's some fresh water. But, do you know what has brought us together in this tub? Do you need something from me?

I need your mind, ponder this, I have here a crown. Does the king make the crown or does the crown make the king? If I give you this crown and you walk out of this bathhouse wearing it would the people accept you as their new king when I clearly stood behind you? Probably not, but why then is this the same crown my father and his father and his father wore before. The Crown goes from one king to another so would it make you king?

Sire, it is clear to me that you control the kingdom, whether with or without the crown. Should a violent storm sweep away the crown from the kingdom, surely you would still wake the next day as King. Should a rat then come across the crown, he would not be any different than he was the day prior. You see?
So it is, wise you are. Where are you from subject
action: give pitcher of water to king

agent_personas: I am very small and have hatched not too long ago. My mother guards me until I am grown. I will grow into a large fire breathing creature that is a force to be reckoned with.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: Stay away from me!
God, how did you get in the arsenal?
None of your business. If you touch me my mother will eat you.
Oh, is that right? Well where is mommy then?
She is on her way, so I would be cautious if I were you.
I don't need that for you, damn runt!
Let's fight then.
Give me that back now or I won't keep going so easy on you!
Fine, I'm sorry. I'm scared because I'm lost.
Don't be lying to me, dragon! Do you speak the truth?
Why would I lie? I'm just a baby.
Same reason you would, as just a baby, attack me!
I was scared.
Well what is there to be afraid of?
action: steal sword from a baby dragon

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: Well, seems you couldn't evade capture for long.
What did I do to deserve your pursuit, damned corrupt king>
You
Excuse me? Speak up!
You will be hanged for your crimes to the crown.
Tell me what I have done, damnit!
Plotting to dethrone me  is considered treason. Punishable by death.
Dethrone you? I've done no such thing!
You have been ratted out, your comrades gave you up.
I'm telling you, I've been framed! Such a corrupt monster, you are!
Give that back or I'll have your family hanged along with you.
I already have nothing to lose with you here about to kill me for nothing!
Then I'll make you suffer longer.
Just as I thought from a grizzly king such as yourself! You don't deserve royalty!

agent_personas: I am one of the king's lord.  I rule over a large area of land.  I have dozens of tenants.
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: Farmer's house
setting.description: a single room cottage with a dirt floor, minimally decorated with only a table, a pallet and a wood burning stove there is but a single window and a single door at this place
setting.background: This is feudal land, owned by a lordly lord and worked by a peasant farmer who grows crops mainly to be harvested for the lord's feasts and store but he is allowed to eat what he may, and has little else.

speech: Do you have my taxes due?
Yes lord! I am honored to have you visit my home personally. Can I get you anything?
A glass of fresh milk will do. Have you been informed of the recent increase in taxes?
Increase lord? No I was not made aware. The taxes were increased just a few months back. Lord my plot of land is small if you keep increasing the taxes I will not be able to survive.
These are not my wishes but the wishes of our gracious king. I have no choice but to enforce them.
Lord I will pay what I must, but you need to try and reason with him. Already more than half of what I grow is taken for the kingdom.
I understand. I will speak with the king and we may be able to settle for a more manageable figure
Thank you lord you are a most noble man. To stand up for poor farmers is very honorable.
My farmers must be in good mental health to be able to continue paying taxes.
We need to be able to eat as well lord. To have the strength to tend the fields.
That is why I stand up for you, as you have no voice in the kingdom.
I would hug you, but I know it wouldn't be proper instead I will offer you my sincerest gratitude.
It is fine.
Thank you sire now let me go and find the grain that is owed to you.

agent_personas: I am always hungry and like to eat tasty animals and people. I am a fierce alligator and have the respect of everyone. I like to eat and eat for hours and also like sleeping. I am fierce and dislike loud noises.
I am a blacksmith.  The king brings his horses to me to fit their shoes.  I also do wonderous things with metal.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Mmmm a human come into my territory. My lucky day indeed.
Back off, alligator! I do not mean you any harm.
Huh! You harm me. I am not worried about that. But I wonder how you taste? Is he tough or tender? Salty or sweet?
Stay back if you know what's good for you, damned animal!
You think yourself scary to an alligator. Well that is not the case. Your idol threats have no effect on me.
Good, it is the ones that doubt and underestimate me that get it the worst!
Perhaps we can come to an agreement. Then I might not have to eat you. Could you bring me a fat pig or perhaps even a mangy dog?
Hmm I might have seen a wild boar around here if that would suffice?
Boar, pig no matter. As long as it tastes yummy!
He did look like a good meal, so I could lure him here!
Search for him like your life depends upon it because it just might.
No need to keep threatening me, you're lucky I don't get my smithing hammer out.
A silly hammer! You think the greatest of the reptiles is skeered of a simply smith's hammer?
Have you not seen a blacksmith's hammer? We know how to use it well!

agent_personas: I crash weddings. I like to eat the food, meet the couple and make new friends. I tell the people there I am friends with the groom's parents.
I am the town jester. I make jokes and sing and dance to entertain the people of this town. Someday I hope to be invited into the castle to perform for the king.

setting.name: tower spire
setting.description: A large spire at the tower top. It overlooks the city, maybe the tallest structure. You cans see it all from up here, all directions, all four of them.
setting.background: This is the peak of the tower. It was build last as the tower was started at the bottom, and only finished when the top was all the way on it. A pointy spike atop a tower. A bird makes a nest by it. It's a crow, but not a magic one.

speech: Hey jester, Any weddings today? I really like crashing weddings
Twas a wedding yesterday, but today there are none. The bride and groom are off to have their fun!
That sucks, I love to party at weddings. I usually just say I know one of the parents and get a feast and a party
Sneaky sneaky, little man! Another's joy is your good time! While you plan, they pay, maligned.
I mean no harm to them, I usually make a ton of freinds, then I can say I know them.
Deception is deception, friend! Of this I am certain! You'll receive your karma beyond this mortal curtain!
I don't hurt anyone, I always say, the more the merrier. I usually bring a gift to the happy couple.
A gift, you say! To placate your guilt? Your sins tightly woven, a con man's quilt!
Ah-go tell a joke or juggle some balls jester, you wouldn't know what fun is, you are just a puppet for all the guests to laugh at, you should try it sometime.
A jester I am, that much is true. But a genuine warning you should not misconstrue. A special day is no playground for you! Tis thievery, that's what you do!
I take nothing, there is always too much food at those gatherings, it just goes to waste. There is no harm in celebrating with people, lighten up good man.
Lighten up! Lighten up! Said the thief to the joker! Your excuse, good sir, is quite mediocre! But take no offense, said the joker to the thief. You can eat your sins with a side of stolen beef!
Judge not lest ye be judged...everyone sins, that is the nature of human beings.
To lie! To cheat! Tis part of our culture! Indeed, as natural as a blood soaked vulture!

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Saloon
setting.description: a rickety structure where anyone with a few coppers and a thirst can go and have a frothy drink and socialize, there are tables, some overturned, and a long bar with stools lined up, and lots of barrels of various libations
setting.background: this is a popular meeting place for thieves and low class citizens, located near the bazaar, it's known for its rougher clientele and the various whores and drunken gamblers might make the nobler patrons seek a thirst slakenening elsewhere

speech: Don't look at me, I am just here getting some refreshments
You've got a reputation around these parts.
I know, I know, but honestly I haven't stolen anything for months.
I have suspicion to believe you have been a participant to a recent heist.
What makes you say that?
Turn out your pockets and allow me to handcuff you.
I don't have anything on me, this jewel is something my wife gave me.
You expect me to believe a thief, with your reputation.
I found that in the garden, picked it up and thought it would be useful.
I'll hold onto this for the time being. Come with me to the dungeons.
Now, now, can't we work something out, I didn't steal these things.
Don't touch me you filthy thief!
I won't go back to the dugons!
You made a big mistake.
action: remove the royal coat of arms
steal the royal coat of arms from thief

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Hello my Lord, what was it we came down here for again?
Well, I hear you have knowledge of some... plot to dethrone and kill me.
Unfortunatly I heard a knight talking about how they were really sick of how you were running things and the next time you rode out with them, they were going to make it look like someone killed you.
Do you care to tell me which knight this is? You will be handsomely rewarded.
Yes of course, he has red hair and is very tall.
Hmm do you know of any name? Or just the physical appearance?
I know where he works, people don't tell me their names usually. He is usually in the prison chambers
The prison chambers eh? It must be that damned Oliver, I knew he was trouble!
The way he made it sound, there is more than just one of them. There are a team of them, he was the one I heard speaking about it though.
I'll have to get some of my other loyal knights to spy on them.
I do know there is one in your inner circle, he didn't mention him by name but he is one of your most trusted.
What a disgrace to the royalty that I am being plotted against!
I know my Lord, it is a disgrace, I would never think of such a thing, you are a wonderful king and ruler.
Thank you, loyal servant. Any more information regarding this misfortune?

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: Let's stay away from the wolf.
Squawk! Squawk! Agreed. So peaceful here.
Very peaceful but we must express caution for humans.
Squawk! Humans catch reach me. I fly to high.
Haven't you seen their new archers? They can shoot meters into the sky.
Squawk! Not worried. They want to eat deer not bird.
They also hunt birds for sport.
I hunt worms for food. I poop on humans for sport.
That was funny. I wish I was as free as you.
Deer and birds are both free.
I wish I could fly like you.
You can run and jump. That's something.
That is true, I guess we should be content with what we are given.
Squawk! True.

agent_personas: We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: The air is filled with the scent of exotic spices, and crowds of people jostle each other to examine the wares peddled by enthusiastically loud merchants.  It's hard to get a glimpse of what exactly is being sold due to the press of people, but a glance between give tantalizing glimpses of fruits from far off lands, flashes of gold jewelry and the occasional glimmer of embroidered silks.  Truly a bustling place and the heart of the city.
setting.background: The Dusty Merchants' Bazaar was founded many years ago, some say by the first king himself.  It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far.  It is the heart of the city and is what makes it so profitable, while the waterways that intertwine it streets make it a difficult target for greedy neighbors.

speech: What are you selling my good man?
My good sir, that depends on what you're looking for. What can I help you with today, some food, some new clothing perhaps, a gift for a lover?
I would like to see your collection of armor and weapons.

I thought you might from your physique. Look at the back of my wagon here, I have a fine selection of weapons and armor both practical ornamental. If there is anything else you are interested in let me know. If there's something you need that I don't have here, I can easily locate it for you, for a small fee of course.
You certainly have an impressive collection. I would like to take a closer look at your helmets.
Certainly, sir. I'm sure there is something appropriate for your price range. Is there a metal you favor? I'm told bronze is becoming popular with warriors in the west.
Bronze is for the novices, I am looking for iron plated.

Ah, quite an accomplished young man, then. Yes, I have several here that are iron-plated, and a few more in my second cart with my wife if you do not like any here. I am partial to the one etched with wings at the sides, though I know many warriors prefer nothing so flashy as that.
I prefer to brand my own designs. How much will this one cost?
That depends on if you intend your payment to be gold or trade. That one is mid-range, I would say, so something worth about twenty either way.
I'm sure you can lower that figure a small bit for me. How does 15 sounds?
I think I could take eighteen, but no lower than that. Unless, of course, you made another purchase, as I always hate to charge full price to such a generous customer.
Well why didn't you mention that. I am also looking for a sword.
Very good, sir! my collection of swords is even finer than my armor. There are even a few that are said to curse your enemies, though I am no arcane or holy man and could not say for sure about that.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: What are you doing here boy?
My master wanted me to clean this area.
Good, did you need any help?
The Queen and her retinue is going to be here shortly. I have to scrub the bird poop off the marble benches surrounding the fountain.
Well I am a guard so i might leave you to do the dirty work.
Of course sir. I just do what I am told. The is such a beautiful place. It will be much prettier without the bird poop.
You'd better hurry,the queen will arrive here soon.
Do you have family sir? I miss mine. I haven't seen them in years.
Yes, I did. They were killed in the wars so i moved away to start a new life.
Sorry sir. Too much tragedy in the world. There will be even more when the Queen arrives I hear.
Well it is my duty to protect her. So I obey her every word.
Her retinue is going to arrest a guard on the spot and behead him for treason. I have to wipe up any blood that gets on the marble.
Where did you hear this news?!
Do you think my rag is big enough to wipe up all the blood?

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I am an older priest.  I give the younger priests in the kingdom guidance.  I think the world is in a bad way today.  I pray for our souls.

setting.name: a small clearing
setting.description: The clearing outside of the cave is very small and rocky. Only about four or five people can fit it if they squeeze. The ground is very rough and covered with plant life. There are also a few trees growing in the mouth of the cave, to the east of the tiny clearing, meaning people have to slip between the trees to get into the cave. This makes it easier to hide, because the people will drag brush to the cave mouth and make it look like it has fallen there naturally, blocking the existence of the cave at all. The clearing is both very convenient as it makes an excellent hiding place, and very inconvenient because it is very hard to get people through the clearing and into the cave quickly in an emergency.
setting.background: This cave was a backup emergency hiding place. Originally people would evacuate to a larger cave, but that one was discovered by an enemy, and the people hiding in it were killed. Luckily, some people had gotten lost, and stumbled upon this cave. They barely made it into the cave before the enemy was upon them, and luckily in the dark the enemy thought the space was too small for anyone to be hiding and missed the cave entirely. Ever since, people have gone to this cave in emergencies.

speech: Hi, priest.
Hello young man... Who are you
I'm a thief. But you don't have anything I could need.
A thief? You should seek for forgiveness
For what purpose? Everybody has to find a way to live.
But you cause another man sorrow with your actions
And do kings not cause sorrow when they ruin other kingdoms?
That is for the protection of the people
To contsantly strive to build something that only creates more homeless? So that the rich have more stuff?
You miss the point young man
Maybe there isn't any point.
The Lords wrath is near
Maybe his wrath will be on the kings.
The king is justified

agent_personas: I have a wonderful hat.  My tunic is of superb fabric.  My sword is the finest.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Hello knight, how are you this fine day?
I am doing very well... What brings you here?
I was looking for some sword polish for my wonderful fine sword
You should see the merchant at the stores.. This place is reserved for the King's Knight onky
I work for the king, I am going to officiate the next ceremony, can't you tell from my hat?
You don't have a crest...
It is on my superb tunic....see.
Ooh... Sorry about that
Well, do you have anything for my sword? The king will be most pleased if it looks its best. It is for ceremony
I think this will work fine
Say, this isn't a bad sword either.
Anything for the king.
Ah no, I was just checking it out, it's amazing the detail work, very impressive.
One of the Arab goldsmith did it for me

agent_personas: I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: What can I do for you fine gentlemen?
I am in urgent need of your skill.
It is an honor for you to come for my services. What can I do for you?
Have you heard about the great war our empire is dealing with?
Yes, I have. It is horrible to hear of such savages.
Then will you create something which can help defeat their monsters? They have huge creatures they use.
Weapons? What sort of weapons are we talking about?
Magical weapons.
Are you asking me to practice dark magic? Isn't that punishable by death?
Not all magic is dark. We need enchantment. And you would be given access to much knowledge.
Phew! I thought you wanted me to do the forbidden dark arts.
I mean that could help us. But that isn't necessary.
Good! Well my King I would love to help you. Where do I start?
Please just wait here. I will send a mage to help.

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I attend the church every week and say my prayers dutifully. I always put coins in the poor box. I light a candle for my departed mother.

setting.name: church coat room
setting.description: The church coat room is dark and smelly, holding all the coats and boots of the congregation who happen to be in the church at the time. There is a candle sconce high on the wall near the entrance, benches along the back of the room and huge baskets along opposite walls: one for coats and the other for footwear.
setting.background: This room used to be a primitive bathroom ten years ago, but became too smelly and difficult to clean. People complained, and it was re-purposed as a coat room. It is vented at the top for when they used to burn excrement.

speech: Are you here to comb my mane?
You do have a pretty main, aren't you a beautiful steed.
I am the king's private steed so what did you expect.
What are you doing in the church coat room?
I was left hear, I just obey the riders.
What a pretty main you have, the king must have you brushed.
Well I am his prized steed. I have won many competitions.
Is he at the church today? I don't usually see the king in church.
I believe so, but I guess it would make more sense for you to check.
Well, I would have thought he rode in on you.
I am ridden by many of the kings close friends as well.
Oh, I see. He probably isn't here then, too bad, I have never gotten to see the king up close.
It's nothing special so I wouldn't worry about it.
For you maybe, you get to take him places, I simply go to church and light candles for my mother who has passed on. A king is a big deal to someone like me.

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I am but one of a horde of monkeys. I live on the outside of the kingdom. We swing from the branches and eat many bananas.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: I'm glad I didn't bring my sons with me to hunt today. The area of the forest here that the forest here that that doe lead me to is creepy and--hello, is that a monkey? It's unusual to see you little creatures in the area of the king's forest I frequent.
A hunter? Get away!

I'd like to! I'm a little lost and it's too dark to even see my own tracks out of this place. You have nothing to fear from me, though. I'd hardly take a monkey of all thing's to his majesty's kitchens.
Well... that does make sense. Why are you here then?

I was tracking an elusive doe, and it lead me here. Or, near here, I suppose, and I found myself here trying to get out. I can't imagine why she would want to be here anyway, none of these mushrooms are edible.
Oh, I see. Well I really don't know how I ended up here.
Not at all? Do you remember where you're from?
Yes, I am from a jungle in the eastern end of a certain village... I don't remember the name.

Well, perhaps when I make my way out of here you can accompany me. The king is sure to have a map of the kingdom somewhere, or at least a census, and I can read the village names aloud to see if it jogs your memory.
Hmm if I am as lost as I seem to be, then I think that offer would be fair.

Here, you are quite a small fellow, you can ride in the hood of my cloak if you don't want to tire yourself. I will dig a little hole in the ground at the foot of your tree with my dagger so that I know I've been here, and I'm sure we'll find our way to the castle walls by nightfall.
Do you think you can carry me for that long? That would be greatly appreciated, sir.
I am used to carrying a great deal of weight out of these forests. You look much lighter than a bag of rabbits, so it is really no trouble at all.
Well let me just settle in then.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Ah, hard at work at the decoration shop I see.
As always, my lord! No thieves will harass this splendid shop on my watch, good sir!
Were you assigned here today? That is rather surprising.
Why yes, I was. Received the orders this morning. Why does that surprise you, my lord? Did the orders not come from you?
No, I have the head knight do most of that at this point.

Ah! I see! I do hope my presence here pleases you, my lord! We have had a rash of thieves at the markets outside the temple for months now. Soon as we post a guard at one shop, they start hitting another. Even this humble decoration shop is not safe, though they have little to steal to begin with.
Well now that I know that you are hard at work, it does. It seems like you are doing just fine.\

Thank you kindly, sir! I do try! Thankfully things have gotten much better around here after... 'the incident'.... of course, it was all a nasty business, and I'm not happy it happened or anything, but things suuuuure are quiet now aren't they?
The incident? Perhaps I am out of the loop but what are you speaking of?

...Sir! Surly you were informed of... 'the incident.' I know you have the head knight handle much of the grunt work, but how did you miss... 'the incident'? I mean, the sheer amount of whipped cream and the flock of ducks alone should have tipped you off that there was something amiss, no?
Well I have much more important matters to attend to than damned whipped cream!

But look how much there is! This isn't a minor spill, its a full on flood! And this is after three cleanup attempts! Not to mention the wagon wheels and all the... well we are trying to convince the locals that its just cherry juice and pie filling, but the stench alone is making that lie a bit difficult to swallow.
As I've said, negotiations with other kingdoms and preventing wars is much more grave in importance.

But sir! I mean, now that you back, you'd think you'd ask a question or two. I admit I haven't been guarding the temple market place for too long, but is this amount of feathers and left shoes strewn about normal?

agent_personas: I own this land that the indolent soldiers are camping on. They have been here all summer. If I had known, I would not have sown any crops this spring. Now we are approaching harvest time and my fields are trampled. I am not sure how my family will survive this fall. I have worked my whole life for this land, and now it is ruining me.

I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.

setting.name: Top floor of palace
setting.description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
setting.background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

speech: I came to the castle to talk to the king about the soldiers camping on my land.
I am afraid I don't know anything that could help. However, I needed to see the king also.
What did you come to see him about. My feilds are trampled I don't know what I am going to do.
My husband works long periods of time, but he is being taken advantage of.
That is a shame, I am being taken advantage of by these soldiers, I don't know how my family is going to survive now.
Perhaps we can go together. If we can locate him. The palace is so deserted today it appears.
I don't understand how they just allow people to roam the Castle who don't live here, it's kind of crazy.
The entire city seems to be failing.
I have worked my whole life for my land, now it is going to ruin me.
Those soldiers shouldn't be given the right to ruin people.
Thanks I needed that, They have been there all summer, what is my family going to do?
We need to get answers.
What a beutiful place, I can't beleive they spend so much money on this stuff.
Yes.Too bad they couldn't help the poor with that.

agent_personas: I'm a pelican. I have white feathers and a beak. I love to fly above the water and look for fish to eat. I spend my time with the other pelicans.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: Hello!
A talking pelican! My, what on Earth are you doing in the King's Secret Tunnel?
I fell asleep and I woke up in this secret tunnel. Nothing makes sense at the moment.
Were you a pelican before you fell asleep?
Wait... I really am a pelican?! What in the world is going on?!?!? I was a human when I went to sleep.
Quite peculiar! I too found myself asleep. I was just doing my routine patrol of the Secret Tunnel. When came to, my other shoe was gone. It looks like this one, have you seen it perchance?
Sadly I have not. Maybe someone put a spell on us? Nothing makes sense thinking about this, but there has to be a deeper meaning maybe? And for the life of me... I don’t want to stay a pelican!
I don't want to stay a barefoot guard! Do you remember how you found your way down here?

Well I vaguely remember before falling asleep... I was outside walkng with my family. Wa...wai... then I vaguely remember someone grasping my shoulder. Then I was in a loosely tied together dream state.
This tunnel opens out into the King's forest, you can feel the chill air blowing in. I suggest walk, or hop in my case, towards that pinpoint of light. Perhaps, you family will know more?
Good idea. My family maybe knows who did this. I hope they’re okay. Do you have a family?
Oh aye, I do! I have a wife and a wee bairn on the way. She's back at the Royal Castle, where I work.
Want to go together to check on both our families? Something is fishy about this whole situation and being alone might not be a good situation. Who knows what could happen next time.
I tell you, if whoever's behind this has touched my wife... I am renowned for my bravery and strength, let us go forth and smite that stand between us and our families!

agent_personas: I am a rabbit who lives in the garden of a farmer in the kingdom. I eat the carrots of the garden. I have many siblings in my family of rabbits.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Please don't eat me king, I brought you a lucky charm
Well rabbit...  I thank thee.  But you must bow low to my authoritay.
But I am a talking rabbit, for sure that is worth something, All these other beasts can't talk, but I can!
Indeed!   Perhaps I can find use for you..
That 4 leaf clover is magical too. It actually does bring you luck
You're alright, rabbit. But.. I demand that ye honor my ROYAL AUTHORITAY.  Bow low and proclaim your fealty
You are a most awesome king my lord, I shall bow as low as I can.
Come with me away from the terrible odor of this kitchen, rabbit.
Oh thank you! Don't forget my carrot though. You won't regret this, heck I could be your spy!
Indeed!  You may need this for your new role as my royal spy, rabbit
It really is lucky, what are the chances the king would come to the kitchen while I was down here and talk to me.
Well, rabbit.. you have been a good subject.  There is one thing though, that I must confess...
What is that my Lord?
Rabbit just happens to be my FAVORITE dish!  hahaha

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.
