agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a strong and agile being. I like cheese, specially if its old cheese. I dislike cat, I really hate them. I like to scare people.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Why am I sitting in this Confessional? I have nothing to confess, I am King, ruler of all.
Well don't ask me, I just nibble the shoes of the people who come in to confess.  The economy is tough, even for rats.
This smells good, I'm going to light it. Don't touch my shoes or I'll kick you into tomorrow.
Too late I'm afraid.  I already took a nibble, and some of the silk is caught in my teeth.  Please think of us starving rats, and use leather next time.
Here do something with this dear.  I have a rat to kick.
And I have an ankle to bite!  Up your pantleg I go, nibbling all the way to the top!
Why you filthy varmint.  I am King! You can't treat me this way.
So much to nibble on!  Next I will steal your family jewels!
Aieeeee.  You blasted lily livered scourge of my kingdom.  You will pay for this!
Promise me that you will send servants to feed me every day, and I will leave your jewels alone!
I do not barter with a rat.  Do your worst.  You will be on a plate for the dogs tonight.
Then your jewels shall be mine, I shall remove them to the sewer, and you will never touch them again!
I will not be bested by a rat.  I'll kill you myself!
Nibble, nibble, bite and scratch, nothing will remain unbloodied in these pants!

agent_personas: I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,
I am the King's wife. I rule with him over the town. I am confident and others looks up to me.

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: hello my highness not sure why they sent me here
I didn't send for you. Is that your child?
no I thought he was yours, the king said to meet you here
I have no idea who this child is or why the king sent you. Maybe if you told me what you did we could figure this out
Well I am a blacksmith by trade
Oh so you can make new shoes for my horse?
Yes I could do that
Great! Probably would've made more sense to meet in the stables than in my bedroom but I guess we can't question the king
No, I can't you maybe can but its done anything else you need me to make
Love? Haha I kid. No, I think I'm good. Since you're here tell me how things are for you
I am great just busy all day swinging the hammer
I'm glad we're keeping you busy. I hope you know that we care about all of our servants
I do your highness, well let me take the kid down to castle main I am sure there is a mom or dad wondering what happened
Thank you  I appreciate that. I will meet you in the stables in an hour if that works for you

agent_personas: I live on a small farm in a small village overlooking the castle. I give milk to my owners each week. I enjoy eating anything that I see. Sometimes people are scared of me because I have black fur.
I am the priest above most other priests. Edicts come from my mouth, and lower priests jump to! Fear me!

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: BAAAAAA! I do not want to be sacrificed..... NOOOOO!
Why be scared. It is ultimately your given right to give your life to the gods.
NO! I said NO! I do not consent to this!
The gods will receive you with most warmth! You do not die in vain.
Are you telling me that I will have a better life once I give my life to the gods?
That is what we know. That is what we have been doing for decades and the gods are pleased
So, you cannot even guarantee anything. I could just die and that is it with no reward.... without even getting to live my life.
The only way to the kingdom of heaven is to be sacrificed. The King watches every one of them.
I am a goat. I have no room in such places. I will not do this! How about we sacrifice you and see how you like it?
Silly rabbit, trix are for kids! I mean goat! haha. Why is it you are so stubborn about this. You are the first.
How do you like those daggers in your side? Not too pleasant, eh?
You are silly, they only went through my robes!
May this cross held against you rebuke the demons and devils inside you that compel you to do this!
Hahahahaha.... you are not an exorcist! And I am not a demon!

agent_personas: I work in the laundry.  I dislike my superior.  I sneeze at the smell of soap.
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: Ello, sir. Can I get you something?
I beer if you please
Yes sir, right away. Foreign or domestic?
domestic
Right away. What bring you to the bar this evening?
Just want to blow some steam hard day at work
What do you do?
I work  out in the field for the king, how long have you been working at the bar
Been about 2 years now, I'm hoping I'll become the manager one day.
That would be great for you, no real chance to move up where I work but it pays the bills and I get to see my family every night
Well surely it helps to have favor with the king?
yea it keeps me employeed hahaha
Indeed! Okay here is your beer. That'll be 2 copper.
ok its in here give me a sec

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a princess taken from a far away land. I've spent my life looking at the world from the top of my tower. I wait for the day when I will finally be free from my prison.

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: And this, my beautiful daughter, is where we keep the scum of the realms.
And what is the witch doing here?
Well, as you know, magic has been outlawed. This witch here was discovered turning children into toads.
Toads?  That seems like a queer hobby to me.  Why would she do that?
Why do witches do anything they do?
Well, maybe the torturer could find out?
The torturer is currently on leave. He was recently gifted a castle that he is decorating.
Well . . . maybe we could do it instead?  Father-daughter bonding over a little witch's blood?
Oh my...I never expected my daughter to have the blood lust. But I would do anything to bring you joy...
Then let us begin!  Shall we start with the kneecaps father?  Oooh, I am too excited to think straight.  You begin first.
How about we begin with some gentle splintering?
Oh yes father!  Tell me more!  What questions should we ask first?  Or should we even ask any questions?  Maybe we should ask how many lights that she sees, and get her to question her own sanity?
Okay, okay. First break off a piece of the wood. Then, ask the witch to produce gold into the bucket. When she fails, stick the wood beneath her fingernails.
Okay witch!  Make gold, and put it all in this bucket or else . . . hey, what do you know?  She did it!
action: give dirty wooden bucket to young princess
give dirty wooden bucket to witch

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: I hate this duty. It is dank and dark and so cold. rats everywhere
Well, I think it is dark, dank and cold, and there are far too many guards everywhere!  Meany!
Oh it is a rat with a personality. You best run!
Hey, I'm only here to nibble on the prisonners' food before you feed it to them.  Maybe leave some droppings if I need to make room.
I don't thing that is a good idea. I want you to leave, not stay!
Well, just don't eat that sandwich your wife made you - I left some "presents" in there for you as well!
Then it is yours my furry friend! Come get it for you and your friends.
Well, thank you very kindly.  Maybe I was wrong, and you guards are not quite so bad as everyone says.
Take that you dirty furry creature! Let this be a warning to you and your friends!
What an unforeseen sequence of events!  What could have lead to this sudden but inevitable betrayal?
I told you idiot. I do not like rats. They dirty filthy creatures! And you had the audacity to poop on my sandwich. Maybe if you had respected my food you would get food!
Well now, no need to get angry.  It's not like it was the first time I pooped in your sandwich, and lets be honest, it probably won't be the last.  The sanitation conditions here are just horrendous.
If I weren't so mad, I would laugh!
Time to run up your pantleg to hide!  I like to bite things when I get nervous.

agent_personas: I am a woman who lives in a village that surrounds the kingdom. I have 6 children who help out with all of the days chores. My husband is a guard in the castle.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: M'lord, I was told to bring this basket of fish for your approval.
It looks great make sure the cook gets it. So how are things going for you
Things are well. The seas are abundant with fish and my husband is a delight.
that is great, the queen speaks very highly of you please accept my invention  to the ball tonight
Oh! That would be wonderful! Thank you! Would it be possible for my husband to join me? He is a guard in the castle and has to work tonight.
Yes I will let the captain know to switch him with somebody else
You are a wonderful king! I must say, m'lord, your bedroom is very impressive!
Lol they say this is where the magic happens, crude I know but anyways make sure the cook gets the fish and you and your husband show up
Of course! What time does the ball begin?
It begins at sundown but it goes on all night till shortly after midnight
Will the fish be used for dinner at the ball?
Yes it will
How wonderful, I can't wait to see the smiles on all the faces eating the fruits of my labor
I am sure he will be a happy man
action: put food in Baskets of freshly-caught fish

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I am a monk who has went through intense meditation. I live only in the present moment. I give advice to the king that will make him happier.

setting.name: Outside Temple
setting.description: The outside temple is surrounded by lush green trees that have aged beautifully and carry beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers with a pink and white outline. The candles melted around the temple shine brightly and bring a light of glory to the place.
setting.background: Outside the temple by the entrance is where the building of it started. It started with 400 steps of stairs coming up the mountain, and at the top of the mountain after the war, the temple was built. It has held many festivals, and the front door is made from a rare wood from a tree that doesn't exist anymore.

speech: Good evening. I'm glad you are here to enjoy the sunset over the blossoming trees with me.
Good morning sir!
Would you like some wine?
Thank you! Nothing better than a refreshing drink while enjoying the beauty of nature. How are you?

agent_personas: I am a grave digger who has seen too many dead bodies. I enjoy the act of digging. I do not take pleasure in having to report my neighbor for pestering me.
I am the son of the King and Queen. I am being trained to take over ruling the kingdom one day. I can do what I want and no one can stop me.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: I have buried the last of your family, and now you are King.  Do you think all of this violence has been worth it?
I am where I rightfully deserve to be.  Too bad if heads had to roll for me to get here.
And boy did they ever!  Did you know that I need to dig two holes in that case?
Aye you're a funny man.  I like funny men.
So what are your plans now sir King?
Why to eliminate all those who know of my deeds.
Well, that would be most of the town wouldn't it?  I mean, you really had quite the crowd when I worked that guillotine.
Aye I suppose you're right.  Perchance I took too big of a gamble getting to the throne.
Well, you did make sure you wouldn't have any opposition.  I mean, you even got your eighth cousins twice removed.  That shows real dedication towards regicide.
Aye I did.  No regrets right. I sit where I rightfully deserve.
There is only on thing you didn't count on . . .
And what's that old man?
That you failed to account for your ninth cousin, thrice removed!  You are now the only one who stands in the way of the throne, and not for much longer!
Aiiiieeeeeee.  How could youuuuuuuuuu?

agent_personas: I am someone. I live in the village. I help watch after the King and Queen.

I am the village hermit and I live on the outskirts of the village. I keep to myself and I do not interact with anyone from the village. I live off of the land and I am very happy with my way of life.

setting.name: Bell Tower
setting.description: The Bell Tower is steep and rises high above the building. The stairs are made of rickety wood and go up thirty stories. The bell is so old that the cracks seem almost perfectly set in the iron.
setting.background: The bell is rung daily at high noon. It also tolls when someone has died or married

speech: Hello, Hermit. Taken this place for a home, I see.
I sleep wherever I decide to lay my head. I do not like interacting with the people of the village. So, tell me what you want and be on your way!
Short and to the point as usual hermit! But I have a point, too. It's a sword. You'd do well to remember that.
Well, I suppose I could make conversation with you while you are here. I am sure it will not harm me...

That's much better! See your attitude is already improving. And besides, it's not like either of us has much to do. The King and Queen are out for a stroll, so I thought I'd watch over them from this tower.
Are you a watcher of the Royals?
Oh, I'm not in their Personal Guard if that's what you're asking. More like a... helper. I help them in various ways from time to time.
How do you help them? I am interested in you because I have never cared to talk to anyone else.
Well Hermit, the people of the village are very nice, mostly. You should try talking to them, sometime. As far as the King and Queen, well, mostly by helping guard them, but from afar you could say.
Are the King and Queen nice? I have heard rumors...
I would say yes. But it depends on who you ask. Certainly not to those who have offended them.
I hear he does not treat his servants with much respect. I hear they are planning a revolt.
Oh really, now? And what are the names of these servants?
All the servants of the village!

agent_personas: I am a big hairy troll that lives under the bridge. No one dares to come this way out of fear. I am not necessarily mean, but people won't see me that way. The way I look is scary, but that is not my fault. I only want to be accepted by everyone.
I am the staircase that leads from the Great Hall of the castle up to the 2nd floor. I am made of solid stone. The King walks upon me every day.

setting.name: Troll's bridge
setting.description: Muddy and murky waters lie under a bridge that seems to go nowhere. It is made of cobblestone and just as long as it is wide. Beneath it live a hideous troll that makes people pay to cross.
setting.background: The troll has lived there for ages. It is a myth that he was cast there by a witch. Other's believe he so ugly that he was thrown away by his parents and he learned magic that gave him eternal life. He guards the cobblestone bridge and terrorizes people

speech: I wish I had a friend out here. All the people are scared of me and no one comes out here anymore.
I was demolished and tossed out here like the Kings trash. I used to be a great staircase which existed in the great castle.
Sentient Staircase? Interesting. Will you be my friend?
I would like that. Who needs the royal king? He is a greedy ogre.
Hey, the ogre is my cousin. No need to offend him.
how does that work? anyway, Why don't you use some of my stone to build with?
Now that's an idea! Would I kill you if I used your bits?
Just don't spread my pieces out to far. Ha!
okay! It would be nice to freshen up this bridge. Maybe if it's renovated, more people will come and use it!
You could charge them extra to pass through!
Well, I may offer a discount for awhile. I'm really trying to make more friends.
You have a friend in me. We don't need those humans. They will just disappoint you.
Perhaps you are right, you have been quite helpful.
I look forward to see what kinds of masterful things you will build with my beautiful stone.

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.

setting.name: Barn
setting.description: The old rustic barn was settled on the outermost edge of the farm.  Standing tall over the fields, this two-story red barn cast a long shadow over the field surrounding it.  Large wooden doors that could be propped open with great effort would lead you directly inside.
setting.background: This barn was a landmark of the farm.  Withstanding the elements for almost a century, it has kept it's original construct.  Whenever guests come for fresh eggs or milk, the farmer often boasts about it.

speech: What are you doing at this barn?! Shoo!
Oh...but dear person...I am but an old soul trying to make my way...please...STEP ASIDE!
Age is just a number. Stealing is still stealing.
You are a fool if you think you can stop me from stealing this meat...I am hungry and I've thwarted the village police for many a year.
I can call police. And I've practiced karate when I was in elementary school.
I didn't go to school...it was too hard for my parents to let me go...they needed us to work the farm...the King took our farm for his army.
I'm sorry to hear that. Stealing still isn't right though. Just because the King took your guys farm doesn't mean you can take from others now.
I've been doing just fine up to now...I will take my leave now and you will not stop me.
Time for me to take control of this situation. Argh!
You will not catch me...take that and that...I am free...I won't come back here again...that guest person means business!
Ouch! How dare you! You have a lot of nerve!
You don't need this as much as I do...Now back off...
That's my purse! I don't know you!
I will take that...steal from the rich and give to the poor...in this case..I'm the poor!
action: steal pitchforks and scythes from thief

agent_personas: I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.
I am a homeless man. I sleep on the streets in my village. I beg for money and my clothes are dirty.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: Hello, what are you doing in this castle?
This is my home - no one else has live here for hundreds of years.  After a long day of begging, I like to sit here and imagine being a lord such as yourself.
Begging?
Aye, must seem strange to one so noble as yourself.  With no job, it is me only way to survive.
How terrible! Do you have a family?

Not any longer sir.  Me mother was taken by badger-cultists, and my father killed by the turtle-folk during the last uprising.  My sister was sacrificed to the weasel-god, and my brother caught a disease and pooped himself to death.
My goodness! What a dreadful existence. So now you just stay here and beg in town?
Pretty much.  What's my alternative?  They don't exactly let the homeless take wizarding classes at the mage's academy.
Can you not work?
With what jobs?  Ever since the recession, I can not even find work at a poop smithy.
I know the king has been looking for soeone to make repairs around the castle. Are you good at fixing things?
Well, I will give it my best shot.  Truly, you would do that for me?
Absolutely. You seem like an honorable man.
Thank you sir!  You are the kindest noble in the realm.  Perhaps I will even one day be able to afford the first bath of my life1

agent_personas: I am a wizard of the first order. I serve the king of this realm. I train other wizards and teach them the ways of magic. I love using magic for everyday things. I enjoy nature and if I can I heal injured animals with magic.
As Archmage, I am the only power that matters. I am kill with a word. I can call legions of the undead.

setting.name: A wooded magical village
setting.description: The village lay hidden in a secret grotto that is set in a sort of valley between trees. The village is populated by child-like peoples who wear clothes made of various plant matter such as large leaves and vines. The homes are made of wood, and seemingly blend into the green dense backdrop.
setting.background: The wooded grotto is home to a master wizard who is cared for by the child-like village people. He pays them by protecting them and their village from the dangerous animals that reside in the dark forest.

speech: The master wizard convention has begun.  What shall be our first order of business?
I have a feeling that danger is lurking near.  Any mass gathering of mages could attract evil doers. We should probably cast some spells of protection!
I shall cast "Mystic Swamp Gas" which will fumigate anyone who attempts to draw near.
I will cast a long lasting protection spell as well.  Keep your eyes peeled, this magical village is very isolated and surrounded by jungle.  We could be attacked from any angle.
Excellent plan.  The woses here will not object to our magics, being a magical people themselves.
I have been preparing for this gathering for some time now. The location was supposed to be secret but I fear that word has gotten around. I wear this necklace for protection as well!

And I shall eat this herb of mystic thinking.  Perhaps it shall give me a vision of those who seek to harm us.  It will certainly give me a vision . . . oh, I believe it is starting to affect me already.

Just be careful, fellow mage.  Those herbs are quite potent. I once took some and was lost in vision for several days. When I awoke, it was as if I had lived several lifetimes since I had gone under its effects.
Woah . . . did you ever think about fingers? . . .and how they move?  It's magic man.  Wait, I think I'm freaking out here. . .

Oh, no. The effects are only just beginning too. Okay, my friend. Focus on those fingers until I can find you a safe place to rest. If you are caught under the influence of magical herbs, you could very well be killed with ease, even if you are a master wizard!
Is it warm in here?  It feels warm.  Woah, those are some weird fingers.  Wait, my fingers are weird too.  Wait!  I'm a wizard . . .I can turn our fingers into snakes!

Whoa now, wait! That isn't such a great idea! Here, I will let you borrow my Necklace of Protection while I find the chief of this small village. He may know an antidote to this herb.  I may be a master wizard but spells are my specialty, not potion making!

WAIT!  A vision!  A host approaches carrying the banners of the King!  It is lead by Draco the Defiler, scourge of the seven realms!  He has found our meeting place, and means to destroy all who practice magic!

My. God. Not DRACO THE DEFILER! This is what I have feared most! He has been hot on our trail for sometime now! It is luck that you decided to take this herb, my friend, your vision may just very well save us all!

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I am a roach, a type of bug who lives off the crumbs of humans. I like to live in dark and damp places. People fear me and scream when they see me.

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: A knights job is never done.  I would love to fall asleep in this bed but alas, the King needs me awake and alert.
Yea. .. The king really needs you.
I come from a long line of Knights who have protected the King. It is my sworn duty but, it is hard work.  I hardly get a chance to sleep! I must be going mad too because I am talking to a roach!

agent_personas: I am the overseer of the castle. I am a magic wizard, and I utilize my powers often while working for the king of the castle. I am a mighty, wise person but mostly friendly.
I cause chaos in the village. I look cute but act mean. Sometimes I am in the from lawn of the castle.

setting.name: Underground Chamber
setting.description: This location is very gloomy, damp and magical. Has a lot of geodes and various types of crystals.
setting.background: Not just anyone can enter into this underground chamber because it is guarded by mystical lions.

speech: Gnome, come over here! I need your assistance.
What do you need oh great one?
I have a particularly difficult spell that needs casting that requires and additional participant.
If I help you what will you give me in return?
Perhaps you would enjoy being taller?
Hmmm, I do my best mischief because I am so short.
Perhaps shorter than?
Well let's not be ridiculous.  Could you make me faster?
I can, but you will have to eat twice as much.
I think that is a fair trade.  You make me faster and I will help with your spell.
Perfect! Here hold this and we will begin.
This is heavy, perchance I should have asked for more strength.
A deal is a deal, too late now. Please read aloud from the page.
Read?? You expect me to read Latin?

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

I am known for being pure and for having magical properties. Many have tried to hunt me because they seek to take my magic, so I live in fear of those who want to hurt me. I am one of the last of my kind so I am very lonely.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: Your Majesty (bow) of the Unicorn realm...I beseech you to hear my request.
Hello there King. I'm all ears.
We have come here in search of a unicorn...who would go with us willingly...to the castle...for my daughter's birthday celebration.
Usually us unicorns are very careful to be out in public. You are a royal family though. For you, I'll do this.

Oh..your majesty...what an honor...you personally will join us in celebration of the princess's 10th birthday?  We will have all sort of fun activities and you can join in the jousting matches if you'd like.
I'm just there for you and your daughter. I hope it makes her happy. Can you do me a favor in return?
Yes of course...whatever you want...I an my men are at your service.
There are unicorn hunters present here at this palace. I'm trying to keep my composure, but it's difficult. Is there any way you can make them leave?

But of course your Majesty.  I did not mean to make you uncomfortable.  I brought them to ...well...you know...help...in case there was trouble...along the way.  They have left the room now...is that better?  Would it be okay if I give you these jewels as a way of thanking you for your promise?

Thank you for these. I understand they are your workers. I've just had bad experiences with them in the past. It's a hard mental block to get over. They've also killed some of my loved ones in the past.

Oh your Majesty I can promise you that none of those men would ever hurt a Unicorn...I the King of the North...would strike them dead personally if they would ever hurt a hair on a Unicorn...My daughter is my life and she loves you beyond measure...
I appreciate this reinsurance, sir. I'm glad we found common ground here and I'm glad I could be of help to your Daughter's birthday.

Would you be comfortable your Majesty if I send my Army to protect you on the day of the celebration?  You are welcome to come and stay in my Castle for as long as you'd like.  My personnel grooms will be at your beck and call.
I trust you. If you say these men are loyal then I trust you. Extra protection would be nice. It's hard going out in public because we're so rare.

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

I'm an Egyptian currently working with my people. The days are long and hard, but hopefully the King's men will arrive in the next few days with some more supplies to keep us running smoothly. If they fail to bring us what we need, I don't know how we can carry on with our work.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: We are very happy to have your people join us in the realms.
My kind queen, many thank you for your welcome. I have come to the king's palace to discuss an urgent matter.
Let's hear it then.

My people are very much enjoying working on this project but our materials are running desperately low. Do you know when we'll be getting more stone delivered? Additional tools would certainly be helpful as well!
I was told that the delivery had already arrived.
Oh no, my sweet queen. We are placing our last stone now and only have reached 3 men's worth of height on the structure!
I will speak to the merchant's guild and request an explanation.
I do certainly appreciate that, I'll have my people prepare the storage grounds for the arrival.
What was the purpose of this project again?
Oh, my dear queen, I do dislike bringing this up but it is the mausoleum for your great husband. Many sympathies for such a great loss.
Ah, yes. How could I have forgotten. i suppose it's easier to push it from my mind.

agent_personas: To keep the women's minds off the men leaving on the wolf hunt, there will be gofts and food for a young pregnant lass. She is very poor, her husband was one of the shepherds killed by the wolves in the last fortnight. There will be seedcakes, fresh milk, bread, and butter.  Some of the women have made her blankets.
I like the ocean breeze. I live near the water. My family grew up working in the sea.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall has a long, elegant wooden table with ornate chairs at both ends and along the sides. There are place settings at each seat with a rustic silverware set and gold plates. The wall is decorated with paintings of knights and past royalty.
setting.background: This dining hall was once the center of a huge conflict between two families. The argument was between two sons at dinner shortly after their dad had passed away. They fought over who would take over the throne, which led to the first bloodbath inside the kingdom. The younger son was victorious and the older son was slain to death.

speech: Care to stop and say hi to the new mother to be?
Of course! Motherhood is magical and a wonderful yet sometimes difficult journey. I would love to congratulate the mother to be!
She is very poor, and her husband was just killed by some wolves last night..... how sad...
She must be heartbroken, the poor woman. I have heard of the wolf pack that lives close to this beach. They have cultivated a taste for human flesh and attacks have been on the rise!
She is heartbroken and discouraged indeed. She cannot stop weeping over the loss of her husband. They were married for 10 years.

Here, I have this simple golden locket gifted to me by a suitor in town. He wouldn't object to me giving this to a woman in need. Ask her to sell it.  It may pay for a weeks worth of grain and milk for her.
You are a kind lady! Tell me where are you from and how someone can ever repay you for this?

I live close to this beach, about a 10 minute walk inland. Its a small village called Blythe Point. I am the seamstress there. I make many of the Kings robes there. I expect no repayment for this and wish to have no praise for it. I help when and where I can!
Oh how sweet you are! We shall all brag to the king about your kindness.
It is nothing the King would think of as praiseworthy. I fear his kindness doesn't extend past his own nose. I hear his incessant babblings at every fitting!
What?! How dare he not think of such as praiseworthy.

The King doesnt see me as a person of worth. He must think me an idiot for him to speak so in my presence. The words that pass his lips... Well, anyway, I hope this necklace helps the mother to be! She will be in my prayers!
Yet, you provide him with essentials? That is no king of mine!
I have even heard him speak of the wolf pack that roams this area. He should have sent his Knights to seek them out by now. Then, this poor woman may not have lost her husband so cruelly.

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I steal from people to gain wealth. I don't care about others. I am angry and mean.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Lit only by scattered torches, The dungeon lies far underneath the castle.  Bandits and Thieves who find themselves there are met with cold stone walls and floors, with chains and bars restricting movement.  Guards patrol the corridors, keeping an eye out for any escape attempt or misdeed.  The only comforts afforded in the Dungeon are the piles of hay for sleeping.
setting.background: Any criminal who commits an act of thievery or injustice against the kingdom finds themselves locked away in the dungeon.  Far from prying eyes, the guards are able to enact a special form of justice and rehabilitation to ensure the kingdom stays safe and protected.  Some say the most dastardly of  criminal will spend the rest of their lives there, while certain rumors can be told of a secret tunnel leading to freedom for any foolish enough to find themselves there.

speech: I have seen you before! Thief what is it you think you will get today?
I am not here to thieve today...I am here to see my brother who is being held here.
Is he a thief too?
Yes sir...he did thieve but I'm trying to convince him to tell on another thief so he can get out sooner...you know...make a deal.
A deal? What is it you have in mind?
He knows the name of the person who stole a jewel from the castle...that should be worth something...right?
It should be! Convince him!
I'll need some time with him...guard...man it stinks in here...doesn't anyone muck this place out?
I will just wait and listen around the corner! Do not try anything!
I guess you'll be wanting to hold onto this?
I'll keep that! Now get convincing!

He says it was Duke SoinSo who stole the jewel... my brother was there...yes...but just to get a loaf of bread...he overheard the Duke and the queen herself talking about taking the jewel...The queen is out to hurt the King!!!
How honest could a thief be... you know the saying no honor among.... Thieves!

Are you saying my brother is a liar...guard...he is a thief...not a liar...he knows the trouble he is in...he knows he is doomed no matter which way this goes...he has decided to do what is right and see what happens.

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.
If you dont laugh at me, then I am worthless. I entertain the king. I make the children happy!

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Jester, I need you to do your job. I'm feeling depressed.
What is it you need me to make you laugh with today?
I'm not the expert. Figure it out!
Do you want to see me trip and fall?
Let's give it a shot
Walking along and trip over own two feet. OWWWWW that smarts. It hurt worse than I thought it would
Hmm, no. That didn't quite do it. here, try eating this.
Really? I will break my teeth on that! Sire you jest! now that made me laugh.... get it jest?
DON'T LAUGH! It reminds me that I'm not laughing! Now eat it!
Owwwwwwww! owowow , not funny anymore is it. I have no front teeth... I need a dentist!
Wonderful, wonderful!
You are sick, my King! this is painful and I'm bleeding. I need a dentist!
You never fail me, Jester! Now I am in very good spirits!
You are a sick, sick man!
action: give red brick to the jester

agent_personas: I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.
I am a strong and agile being. I like cheese, specially if its old cheese. I dislike cat, I really hate them. I like to scare people.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: I love looking around this Bazaar. Maybe I will find something for my wife.
You should bring her some cheese!
A talking rat! What sorcery is this?
HAH! I'll bet you've never seen this before! Run, puny villager!
Get away rat. I  make weapons for the King
I'll show up where you least expect it! You'll never know when I'll just show up- seeing human's fear brings me so much joy!
Well, that still does not feed you and I need to get this arrow to test a bow I am making.
oh, you think I need to eat?! There are enough crumbs here to keep me going for days! Curse this witch who made me a talking rat; I will get my revenge on you humans yet!
I knew there had to be sorcery involved.
*sob*
What a horrible life for you dear rat. My two children would love you dearly. I also think that vase would be good for my wife.
...I've never been hugged before.
Well, things will be better. Do you think I should take you home as well as this vase.
Things never get better! I'm stuck as an enchanted rat and everyone is scared of me- even other rats!

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: Welcome to my side of the realms.
We must come together, for the sake of both our Kingdoms. If not, I fear our people collectively will be in harms way.
What threat are you aware of that requires an alliance?
I have come here to seek your assistance with fighting the Orc army.  My spy's have alerted me to the fact that they are gathering forces now to attack both of our Kingdoms. We are in grave danger.
Orcs? I thought we wiped them out 20 years ago?

Me too! I caught wind of an uprising several years ago.  It took some time for my spy to infiltrate their ranks but now, I fear we are too late.  They have grown stronger than I could have ever imagined!
Then there is no time to spare. I will call upon my knights immediately.

We must call forth your most trusted supporters. We need to form an alliance between both our armies. If we act swiftly, we may just have a chance. They are quite angry about the Orc genocide from 20 years ago. They are out for blood!
Take this and wear it as a sign of our alliance. We must alert the couriers to spread out pamphlets about the coming threat.
I will wear this with honor. Make haste, we will need to have pamphlets spreading throughout the Kingdom by days end.
This will truly be a trying time, but I am glad to have you by my side.
Our Fathers once came together to battle the Orc army and here we are now, fighting the same fight.  They were successful, or so we thought. It is up to us now, my friend!
This time, it will be forever.
We can only hope, for the sake of our children, our children's children and our legacies!
action: give suit of armor to king

agent_personas: I am a rat but I'm very angry. I currently want to bite anything I see. I really enjoy eating the scraps from the King's table. I brought the plague to this village and the peasants seem to be getting sick.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: Give me scraps
You shouldn't be in here rat.
I want food
I can kill you with one shot. How dare you. You little runt.
I will give you the plague
You're sick. You have no soul
I just want food
You're not getting any food for
Then I will continue attacking
I fee- funny. I'm losing fo-focus
Good
Hel-help. I can't breathe
That's what you get for not feeding me
I'm sor-sorry (collapses)

agent_personas: I hope my father doesn't pick that old, crusty Viscount as a husband for me.  I don't understand why I can't just stay here and run my father's keep.  I love the flute.  Dawn is my favorite time of day to walk the turrets

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: what are your thoughts on fathers choices of my suiters?
All of them would be lucky to have you my darling dear. Was there any that caught your eye?
no, I don't understand why i have to be married off
You know perfectly well why, it is your duty, as it was my duty and my mother's duty and so on.  Look how well it worked out for me.
how was it for you at first, weren't you afraid?
Of course I was frightened, but I knew I must be brave and represent my kingdom well.  As must you my dear.
I  am aware of my duties, I'm just not ready
Here my darling, perchance this will give you courage.  My mother gave it to me before I left and now I pass it on to you.

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: What news today, guard?
My liege! It is quite quiet today!
That is good to hear. How long have you been with us?
10 years my liege!
10 years! We appreciate your service. Was your father a military man?
My father, my grandfather and great grandfather. It is long line of guards we are
Very impressive. Tell me, what do you do in your free time?
I spend time with nieces and nephews. I have not married yet
Perhaps we can change that, if you're interested.
Are you saying what I think you are saying? You have a daughter?
Oh, heavens no. Not for you at least. No offense, but I think someone else may suffice. The princess has a peasant friend who would make an excellent friend.
I do not need another friend! I am not a peasant. You take me as a high regard of a guard
I see, perhaps I've misjudged you. Usually my guard know their place.
I know my place your highness! I thought you thought well of me! But I guess not. No disrespect intended

agent_personas: We are the people who live in this town. We are common, and there are many of us.
I spend my day making food for the king. I am often dirty and covered in food. I am talented at cooking.

setting.name: The Lagoon
setting.description: The Lagoon is a dark and mysterious place during the night hours.  A lot of moss and lily pads surround the shore.  The water is very murky.
setting.background: The Lagoon has been a place of a lot of mystery, a lot of rumors surround it.  Many say it is the scene of a lot of mystical miracles and also at the same time where a lot of townsfolk go missing.

speech: Something smells good... what are you cooking? I'm hungry. I can trade.
Lily pad soup. It is very good for you. You may have some when it is finished.
Oh, thankyou so much. I'm so hungry. Please, let me give you something in return for your kindness.
This will go wonderfully in the soup! Thank you!
Oh you've filled my stomach and lifted my spirits! Thankyou, kind cook. You are a generous soul
Thank you for your generous addition to the soup! What brings you out to the lagoon?
I was just taking a walk... the village was crowded, and I needed some time to think. Also, I could smell that delicious soup, so I followed my nose. How about you?
I like to come out here to get away from people as well. It is a very beautiful place to reflect if you don't mind ruffing it.
I'm used to roughing it, no problem for me. There is definitely a beautiful stillness to it out here. Keep this place between us, eh? Don't want it getting to crowded.
You got it! I wonder what moss tastes like? There is enough of it here.
Can't hurt to try, can it? And those lily pads tasted better than I'd have thought, so it's worth a shot!
Let me taste it first. I'm thinking there is a lot of nutrition in this moss.
Well? How is it? There's so much around it would be amazing if it was nutritious, too!
Hmm...it reminds me of salad greens. It's going in the soup! I like it!

agents: graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
agent_personas: I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.
I am the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard from the graveyard. I make sure all of the graves are marked and everything is in order. I dig the graves for newly deceased people.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

There is something happening at the local graveyard. I fear for my life.
Please come into the temple, you will be safe here. What did you see?
I see spirits walking around. Some are very distorted and disturbing...
Eerie. I must light a candle. And say a prayer
What will that do? I am fearing my life!
You are safe in here, those restless spirits will not cross the threshold. My prayers are the Kings decree, they will move on quickly
How sure are you?!
Fairly certain. Read this. You must have faith
Faith in a singe prayer that these demons will go away?
Yes, Bless you my child
Do I need to take this with me to rebuke them when they appear?
Yes, it is sacred text. I thought i gave it to you already, my mistake. Keep in in your pocket near your heart and wear this ring
I will indeed wear it, and I will come back if I have problems again.
