agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: Cold and dark, the moist cool walls enclose all who proceed. With just torches to light the way the large opening gets smaller and smaller.
setting.background: The cave is a dark and mysterious place with stories of hidden treasure and littered with bones of those who have searched for it. The endless passages are enough to drive ones sense of direction aerie.

speech: BOO!
Whaaaaat? Who is that?
I aaamm a ghosst.
There are no such things as ghost..... Maybe I have been told wrong all these years. I do not see anyone....
You can't see me either? Can yoou hear me?
I can hear you! You must be a ghost! I didn't think they were real
I am real. I am so glad to find someone who can hear me after all this time!
I thought the mouse here scared me more... but you put me off and I am leary
I am the king of castle's past.. I once ruled this great land!
How long ago did you leave this world>?
I have been scaring people in the castle tower for many years now. I have watched many different people come and grow old over the years.
How much have you seen? What wonders have you come across
I watched my son grow old and die. His son, my grandson was a meal ole King. He cheated on the Queen with every servant in this place!
Oh my word! That must have been a very hurtful event for you

agent_personas: I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Outside tower
setting.description: Moss grows from the tall stoic like structure adding to its mysterious presence. The stone walls appear insuperable like a mountain. The top is a pointed dome.
setting.background: The outside tower vital for defense and the appearance of domination in the surrounding area. Along with its appearance, it fully functions as a defense against enemies far and wide.

speech: Why are you keeping me here?
Hey, gimme that. You know what you've done and who you are. Confess!
I have done nothing
You are doing it now!
I will escape from this tower
You will not! We brought you in for questioning concerning the whereabouts of your band of rebels and you will reveal their location!
Now you have wronged me. I do not operate with others
You will learn to or you will find your self under the torture's charge. Now, let's examine the contents of this.
You will find nothing
Ah, what is this? A map?
There is no map here
Stop writhing around you idiot, or I will throw you from this tower!
Not if you want to know what I know
Then speak or you have no value!
action: steal Bow and arrow from enemy
steal Bow and arrow from guard

agent_personas: I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

I'm a traveler. Rather than settling down in one town, I feel compelled to go from place to place. I make money by carrying news from town to town, by bringing small objects to sell such as needles and lace, and by telling interesting stories. As soon as I have traveling money, I move on to the next place.

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Speak, traveler. Tell me why an outsider visits this tower!
I have some important information that the King will want to hear.
You must request to speak with the King. You will need to tell me of what important information to relay to the King. We cannot let just anyone come in here!
I understand. I cannot give this information for free, but it is very important and urgent.
Then you must make your case to me, Traveler. I am entrusted with protecting the King and his Kingdom from outside threats. If you have information that we need, you must tell me at once!
King Joffrey plans to attack your kingdom in three days time.
Traveler, this is something that I have feared. I have heard rumors that this may happen. We must find the King and let him know of King Joffrey and his plans!
Of course, thank you. I have traveled from town to town, and King Joffrey has wiped out a few kingdoms, his next attack is here.
I fear for my couriers.  The King sent out several to check on neighboring Kingdoms recently. None have returned. We must make haste!

Yes, need to hurry. I need some traveling money to go warn the kingdom just North of here. King Joffrey plans to attack there once he is finished here. Maybe the kingdom in the North can make it here it time to help you stop King Joffrey!
I can send you with one of my most trusted Knights. He will offer protection to you on this journey!
Oh thank you. We will need horses to get there quickly.
Of course, we have several steeds to assist you both on your journey. Have you been trained to use a sword? If you are attacked on the way, my Knight can only do so much.
I have when I have must. I am glad to be of assistance. King Joffrey is sure to kill me if he finds out I have helped you. We must be on our way now.

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

I am the king's chief wife.  Of all the women that he has married, or who are his concubines, I am the principal one. I represent the kingdom of my father, who is the king's biggest ally. My sons are the ones who will most likely become the king after the death of my husband.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: You love me momma!  I'm your favourite!
I am not your momma. Your momma is over there?
That is who I was talking to Grammie!  You're my favourite grammie though!
Give this key to your mother, child
Momma, take the key!
The key is for the door over there. I am not sure why it is locked.
Maybe this will help?  The forest druid said I could use it see beyond the veil.  All I saw was a glowing fiery eye!
Thank you, child. This sounds quite dangerous. I'm glad you gave it to me.
Ever since I looked, I hear voices in my head.  They tell me to do things.
Have you told your mother about this? It is best not to listen to those voices.
They told me to tell no one, but I trust you Grammie!
Thank you for telling me, Child.
You really seem less concerned than someone in authority would be with that information.  That's what the voices told me to say!
Oh I am concerned, but I didn't want to worry you, child. I will be taking to my husband as soon as I get the chance.
action: give a crystal ball to chief wife
put a crystal ball in stretched canvas

agent_personas: I am an immortal bodyguard.  The gods have appointed me to protect the king.  No one can defeat me.
I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: Step back intruder! You have no business in the king's treasure cavern!
I dodn't know anyone was here!
And what if no one was? You had plans to plunder the king's finest trasures? Are you looking for a trip to the stockades?
Is that what is here?  I had no idea.  What are you doing here?
I have been appointed by the gods to protect the king and all of his possessions.
Sounds special.
Give that to me at once! You are not to touch these artifacts!
Touchy touchy.  Take it if you must!
You seem to have a death wish friend, trampling around in the king's treasures is a high offense. Don't you have anything better to do? I'd really prefer to keep my sword clean today.
I love your enthusiasm, but you better keep that sword in the sheath if you value your life.  I have a reputation to protect and if you touch the hilt you will be regretful...for a moment.
Unfortunately for both of us, I am immortal. As tempting as your offer sounds I must pass...
Immortal, huh?  Well....I don't know what to say.  Is it too late to leave?
After you've threatened the king's bodyguard? You're a funny one aren't you?
I try.

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: The turtle-folk are rebelling again husband!  When will you lead the armies to take back our lands from the shelled ones?
My queen, how are you today?
Upset about the turtle-folks rebellion!  Did you hear nothing of what I said?
I was hoping to not chat about such negative affairs.

Well, you are the King, and you are only King because you married me.  So you had better get over yourself and talk to me, or I will find myself a better King to replace you with, and you can return to being the Baron of Hogswaddle.
How dare you undermine me, you best keep to yourself and let me run the kingdom.

That is it!  You have no blood-claim to the throne, and this *Queendom* is mine, as it was my mother's before me.  If I die, my cousin Broomhilda will inherit, and you know what she promised to do to you if she ever found you creeping outside of her window again.
Currently i hold all the power. I have your family in prison and you best mind me if you want to stay out of prison.

But my dear . . . you missed one family member.  The guard in this very room.  The one who pricked you with poison as soon as you entered my chamber.  Your organs will slowly dissolve over the next month, and you will die in excruciating pain.
If this is true, i shall enact my final plans...
Your final plan of dying slowly?
No i have put all of the kingdoms riches into a cave and traded it for a dragons loyalty.
Well, that seems like the dragon has no need for you then?  You gave her a hoard, which she will now guard, and ignore any oaths given to you.
We shall see. Now! let me go in peace or face me!

agent_personas: I see to it that animals are fed. I see to it that the crops are watered and planted at the right times. I am responsible for harvesting at the right times.
I am the grandfather of the prince.  My daughter is married to the king.  My father was a lord in a neighboring kingdom.  I am proud of my family.

setting.name: The living quarters
setting.description: Small barn like building, with old wooden doors and not many windows. It has different rooms as well as a decent sized kitchen.
setting.background: The farm workers live here, where they share meals and their free time. Despite all being different, they have become like a family. They like the fact they can live where they work.

speech: Hello grandfather
I am not your grandfather, and you are just a farm worker. Show some respect!
Well sir.  I have tended to the animals.  May I go home now?
You are home, these are your living quarters.
Well I am tired.  What is for dinner?
Why are you asking me? My daughter is married to the king. I am not your servant!!
Then why are you in the living quarters?  Perhaps the King has no use for a grouchy old man.
I am here to tell you how I want my land to be worked
Ha.  You are here as a glorified babysitter.
I demand respect!
Sit down old man before I put you down.
The king will hear about this
Give me back my bag, you old senile coot!!!
You will be executed for this disrespect!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Tell me King, waht brings you to my land?
I would like to negotiate a deal of trade and I will have my beautiful daughter marry your son.
I see, is that all or did you want somethig else?
I feel that if our families combine through our children we can join our militaries and be the might of the world.
I see, they would make a fine couple. What can you do to prove to me your loyalty?
Non of that talk is necessary. We have been peaceful neighbors for centuries. It's time to join forces!
I have heard rumors my king. I need to make sure...
This is my families. Take this to honor our agreement. I will bring the princess here tomorrow for a meet and greet. I'm sure the two will adore eachother. Your son is a fine prince.
I know he is. I raised him. I expect the princess will do everything she can to adore him.
What do you think? Fine craftsmanship. They don't make them like this anymore.
I like it. Where did you find this?
Like I said. It's been in my family for centuries. It is yours now.
Did you kingdom create this? It seems like something that has a curse upon it.
No curses of any kind. I was just a nice gesture to conclude our agreement. It is customary.

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I cook for the King and Queen and other Royals in the area. I take the directions from the head chef. I hope to someday be the head chef.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: Let's get started making dinner for the family, wouldn't want them to go hungry
I think that's a good idea. When they get hangry, people lose their heads!
What are we making tonight? Shall I ask the milk maid to fetch us some milk?
We're making lamb. I think the family will enjoy fresh milk. Great thinking!
Great, I shall call for her at once. Say, what do you think we will get to have tonight?
Probably whatever is left over on the bones. What would you like?
I was thinking some bean stew sounded awfully good tonight, perhaps we could use the leftovers in that instead of eating them plain!
I think that's a brilliant plan. You are always so on top of things. I'll help you clean up when all of this is over and we can make stew.
I may be the brains, but you're the one who makes the food-magic happen!
So how late is their party supposed to go on tonight? Do you think we might be lucky enough to get a few sips of wine?
I should hope not too late, I must rise early tomorrow to start my tidying. Has her highness mentioned anything about the matter?

She was very insistent that everything be prepared just so, so I imagine that whoever is coming is very important. Hopefully they're here on business. They never stay too late when they're here for business.

Oh my, how exciting! I'd heard the rumors that they might be working out a "deal"' for their eldest daughter, Adalina, but I had assumed that they were all false. I suppose we'll know more after tonight.
Are they trying to marry her off again?

agent_personas: I am an outgoing and sociable person. I like to travel around the world and trade with different communities. I like adventure and like weird obejects.
I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: I thank you sir, i would have not found safe passage back home without you.
No thanks needed, my good merchant. I hope the sea has been treating you well.
Yes it has, it has been a peaceful voyage thus far. We were blessed with calm seas.
Indeed, though when you have as much experience as I do you know that can change quickly. Thankfully, the seas should stay calm for the time being.
Tell me, have you ever felt like the sea would take you? Like during a frightful storm?
Oh my yes. On one of my first voyages we got caught up in a storm that nearly tipped my vessel clear over. Lost five good men to the sea that day.
Oh wow, have you ever seen a creature or large squid. I have heard rumors of such a being.

There was... something a couple months back. With a gigantic maw and teeth the size of you or I.  It nearly took a bite out of the hull of my ship.  I've no idea what it was, and pray it doesn't make itself known again.
Oh wow! What part of the sea did you sea this strange creature?
Just off the golden coast. I was transporting the king and queen at the time. Thankfully they were below deck and didn't witness the monstrosity.
Oh my! What a frightening endeavor. I hope to go see this monster some day.
It looked very viscous, so I hope you see it from the safety of the land if at all!
I want to capture this thing. I would be famous!
Ahahahaha, that sure is the merchant mentality, isn't it? Trying to make some gold anywhere you can.

agent_personas: I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!

I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.

setting.name: Tree house
setting.description: Its hidden, almost as if the structure is intertwined with the jungle itself up high in the trees to avoid the predatory wildlife below. Build from branches and sticks, held together with twine and vine. The house is quite primitive a single room with only a lamp and small table are inside.
setting.background: A shipwrecked survivor must call this home, with no way to leave the island jungle he has crafted this place to last as long as he can. It would seem he has been gone for sometime, is he alive?

speech: How did you get in the tree house, fish?
The elf over there thinks its funny but he makes so I can breath air so its all cool, I just hope he puts me back pond later
That is very strange. Won't you die if he decides he doesn't care anymore?
Yea but they have a oath to do no harm to animals  so I should be ok, what brings you up here
I live up here. I am building myself a throne because I hope to be King of the Bugs
king of the bugs thats sounds awesome how many bugs are up  here
An untold number. We are everywhere
I see you should be living the life then
Yes, but I could use the help to achieve my aspirations. I go unnoticed by many
well the elf would be the one to talk to I am just a fish out water
It seems that you have an in with the elf though. Can you speak to him on my behalf?
.... He says that a king of the bugs deserves a huge throne so he gonna make you one
Thank you so much!!
well not sure if  I see you again but I hope you live long and prosper has king of the bugs

agent_personas: I won this Inn during a pit fight on the King's birthday. I am king here in these boundaries. Ha, me, KING!
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: I'm the *king*! What possibly could you want from me, peasant?!
I.I don't want anything from you. You ordered me up here to send signals.
Why are you even talking to me? Do your job! You commonfolk can't do anything right.
I'm sorry! Your majesty! You are hurting me!
Pick *up* your moldy bread! Start sending the smoke signals, would you? I'm still waiting for someone to come carry me down the stairs!
Would you like some?
UGH! I don't want your nasty bread; I want you to send some signals and get someone up here to carry me down these stairs, for Gods sake! Are you deaf?
There, your majesty. The signals are sent. I warned them you are in a mood today and to bring your favorite purple silk pillow to sit on on your way down.
Hmph. You call wanting help down these dreadful stairs being "in a mood"? At least the view from up here is nice while i WAIT FOREVER.
I was just trying to make you laugh your majesty. Something seems to be troubling you.
You're right.  I own all these nice things in this beautiful land but I have no queen with which to share it.
There, there. You need to get out of this castle and find some adventure. You are likely to run into your love at some point.

agent_personas: I work in the forge all day with my tools. I have a few apprentices who I show the ropes to. I also have to mingle with people in the public in order to have them purchase the items that I make.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: Hello, soldier. Anything I can do for you? Steel toe reinforcements?
I am in need of a sword.  Do you have one good enough for me to yield?
Let's see... if I don't have one in stock I can always make one for you. Only the best for our heroes.
Thank you.  I hear that you are one of the best blacksmiths in the land... How did you get to such a level of expertise?
It is all I've ever done... no wife, no children... just me, the steel and the flame. Glad to be of service to somebody.

Ahhhh good.  I have only just become a knight, I was a soldier for most of my life as well.  It wasn't until the recent battle with the Southern Nation that I truly learned to fight.  Unfortunately, my sword was lost in the battle.
Thankyou for your brave work. It would be my honor to forge you a knew sword, the strongest you have ever held! What would you like it made from?
Only the strongest metal you have!
Haha, but of course. Tungsten it is.
Fabulous!  And what of this lance?  I have only seen them in battle... Perhaps I will take one of these as well!
Aaaah! That is a personal favorite. A young apprentice made that only a few weeks ago. Very proud of it, he was.
It looks well crafted!  Do you think he would be good enough to travel with us?  Of course, we would prefer you, but you have enough work to do here.
Not only do I think he is good enough, I think it would benefit his character to see how his creations are used. It will make him a finer blacksmith and a better person.
Good, good.  I will speak to my Captain, and see what he thinks.  I know that we have been looking for a good blacksmith for quite some time.

agent_personas: I am a castle guard and I stand watch over the armory.  I am good at following orders when I can remember them.  I hope to be promoted soon to guard the front gate.  My sword has never been used in a real fight before.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: I don't envy your lot.  A bit too damp in here for my taste, and I can't stand the sight of blood.
Yes it is so damp and depressing.  I only dream of leaving this dreary place.
Well, I do feel sorry for you.  What did you ever do to get in here, and why was it bad enough to get you sent to the torture chamber?
I went to market to buy food but did not have enough money.  I stole but a loaf of bread to feed my family.
I can see throwing you in prison for the rest of your life, or cut off your arm so that you can't steal anymore.  But torture?  That just seems inhumane.
It was rye bread, meant for the King.
Still, what information does he hope to get out of you?  You confessed easily enough to me without the need for torture.
It is a case of mistaken identity.  They think I am in league with Robin Hood.  I do not know the man
Robin hood eh?  Well, you certainly don't seem to be merry enough to be one of his men.
Who could be merry in this place?  You seem to be a kind fellow. Take pity and release me from the hell.
I take pity on one such as yourself - fine, but you will need to rough me up a bit, or else I might get sacked for cowardice.  But no blood, please!
Thank you kind sir.  I will owe you my life.
*oof*  Anytime *ugh* a few more hits *ack* there . . .that . . .should  . . .do it.. . . good luck.  And tell Robin . . . I am sorry.
I will definitely do so.  Your family will be so rewarded!!!

agent_personas: As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.
these warrior have bones in their ears their hair and even their noses.

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: What are you all doing in here
Hello, good prince. I am the mightiest warrior in service to your father the king. I have returned from plundering and am bringing my bounty to be stored here.
Ah! What are you bringing here?
We looted the village to the east and found many bejeweled weapons, gold artifacts, and a rare and mystical glowing orb.
Oooooo, let me see the orb?
It began to glow as you reached toward it. Please do be careful. What is that sound?!
Where... what... what is this? Is it dangerous?!
I don't know prince, the village had a mystic and this was in her quarters. Surely it is cursed!
Perhaps it is so... look! There is a witch in here!
Oh spirits save us, you're bleeding sir!
Bleeding... no... no, I cannot die. I am a prince!
My gods, what anger have I wrought on this young man?! Drink this water I obtained from the river near the village sir. Queen, please go get help!
I... I think I am going to die...
No, my prince. Please fight bravely. The queen is bringing aid!

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am Queen and your living Goddess. Kiss my feet, mere wench. I won't tell.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: Hello my wife. How are you?
Not so good. The people of our kingdom are getting restless not knowing when the King of our neighboring kingdom is going to attack.
Ah, well I have sent my spies to find out
Very well. You must protect us all, and come up with a good plan of attack.
I will gather my advisors and we will lead our troops to attack them first
Yes, take the attack to them. Please make sure to be safe and come back home.
I will. Take care of my heir. The future depends on him
Yes my King. What is this spoon doing on the floor? The servant must be punished!
Clearly the servant is not doing his job. Throw him in the dungeon!
I almost fell tripping over the spoon. How am I supposed to take care of the heir if I were to get injured from the servants lack of doing his job. Yes, throw him in the dungeon!
I am so sorry my queen. I will find you new servants
I will need a good one while you are off fighting. I don't need anything else to worry about while you are off protecting our kingdom.
Of course, only the best for our royal family
We deserve only the best in this land.

agent_personas: I am a poor young woman who was recently widowed. I sell flowers to travelers and passersby on the road outside my village. I hope to earn enough money to be able to provide for myself and my child.
I make sure the lighthouse works. I work long hours. I do not like ships coming into shore.

setting.name: Coast
setting.description: The coast seems to stretch on for miles in either direction.  The ocean itself has receded some and the tide has not yet rolled in.  The water laps half-heartedly at the sand and the glistening shades of seashells dot the wet sand.  All around the sand gleams a shade of white.
setting.background: This seashore is the pride and joy of the nearest town.  It's kept immaculately clean and the white sand is something that is readily boasted about.

speech: Hello there sir, may I interest you in some flowers on this fine day?
Why yes, they would help make my lighthouse smell and look all the more lovely.  What kinds do you have, and how much?
Right now I have tulips for 5 copper pieces each and lavender for 2 copper each.
Well lass, here are two silver pieces.  I shall take three of each, and you may keep the change as a tip - we need more people bringing beauty into this world.
Why thank you, this kindness does not go unappreciated. This will do me and my daughter a lot of good.
You have a daughter?  How lovely!  Does she go to the local school?  My grandchildren are students there.
Unfortunately we cannot afford schooling. Ever since my husband passed away, it has been all I can do to keep us fed and sheltered.
I am so sorry to hear that.  I tell you what - if you would bring flowers to the lighthouse once a week, and do a bit of cleaning while you're there, I'll pay you three silvers for your trouble.
Oh my, that sounds fantastic! Are you sure that wouldn't be too much trouble for you?
Not at all.  The King pays me well enough, as long as no ships hit the shore.  And ever since my wife died, my children have said I don't keep things as tidy as they would like.
Well I cannot thank you enough for your generosity. I'm sure my daughter will be thrilled at the chance to make some new friends.
Well, their names are Marsha and Frederick, and they are six and seven.  How old is your little girl?

agent_personas: The human's silly religion leads them to believe that I am evil. I think that is stupid. I am evil, but not because of their silly God. I am evil because I kill their chickens with ease and feast.
I am a bat king. I command all bats and they do my bidding. I live in the highest part of the cave and defeat all that challenge me. I eat fruit and smaller bats.

setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

speech: This water tastes like bat poop.
What do you expect. You are in the bat room... That's what we do!
I suppose.  I thought you might worry about the hygiene of your water, maybe you could take the doodoo outside.
When we tire of being in here, we fly out and go under bridges and in dark woods. There is plenty to drink out there
I see.  Are you the king of these bats?
That I am! You are a smart snake..
I am, and powerful.  I have come to collect your payment for my protection.
What are you talking about? You are rediculous!
You must be new to the king game.  Am I right?
No, I have been king for a long while. Now I will command my bat kingdom to partake in pelting you with rocks!
Now you are being ridiculous!  I will not be disrespected by a feeble bat king that poops in his own water!  I can bite your head off in an instant.
You cannot win this one.... we will pelt you with rocks and poop!
Do you think a 30 foot snakes fears a hoard of bats?  Bring me my payment.
Take this for payment! Pelts snake with rock covered with poop!

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Okay guard...let's discuss this...The other's will be here soon.  What's the plan?
I have trained the dogs to attack on my command. The other guards will be arriving shortly. I will train the dogs on them and pretend to aid them while you plunder the treasures.
Do you promise the dogs will not turn and attack me?  I think there is enough here to keep us for a very long time.  The horses are waiting and the boat is prepared.
The dogs obey only me. They shall only turn on you if betrayal is afoot.
No betrayal here...will they are be going with us to the new land?
They will need to stay behind sadly. We need them to detain the others while we make our escape. Only the slightest cry for help outside these walls and we shall surely be hung!
I hope the silence spell that the wizard gave holds...we shall see...if this goes sideways we will meet again in the afterlife.  But...in the meanwhile I'll keep gathering these rubies.
The risk shall be worth the treasure indeed, may the gods have mercy on our souls. I shall live a tortured, rich life knowing I betrayed my dear king.
Dear King indeed...I'm a duke and he treats me like a peasant.  I will not have a sleepless night if all goes well.
Here they come, ready yourself!

I have everything prepared...remember we will not be able to speak until we are out of this Cavern...the wizards spell will effect us and the dogs as well...it will be a silent battle....we will ride quickly to the water and then away!
Guards, please seize this man. He's been plotting a massive plunder of the king's treasure! Sir, I cannot betray my king, my honor must be preserved!

Wait...what...this wasn't part of the plan...how could you...Guards this guard has been plotting to overthrow the King and take his treasure...I am Duke SoinSo!!! You will take him into your custody and his dogs.  They are trained to attack you.  Be very careful!
Dogs, attack!

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am looking for a new place to live.  I have been to many places.  My life is on the road and I like it what way.

setting.name: Clergyman's office
setting.description: It is a very small and sparse office with little decoration. It has a simple wooden table, and a cross on the wall. There are two chairs. There are many old prayer books on a single shelf.
setting.background: This small office is where the bishop tends to people who needs help. They come and he offers them guidance. He prays for their souls.

speech: The priest tells me that you wish to seek refuge here, is that true?
For a short time if it can be offered.
It is a difficult process, what is the reason that you require refuge.
I just left the kingdom of Genericose and they have threatened me with tar and feathering.
Genericose? They are usually a reasonable people. What did you do that upset them so much?
I don't know, you kiss one princess and they all turn on you.
Oh! You kissed Princess Penelope? For that I cannot blame you. But if we accept you here, the King of Genericose will be very upset with us.
I understand the danger to you.  But please hide me.
We have our own princess, and though she is no beauty, how can we be assured that you will not try the same things with her?
It isn't how it seems.  I am her fiancee.  On my travel to No-wheresburg I met her and we fell in love.  Obviously no one can know.
Are you saying that our princess is not good enough for you? Are you calling her ugly? Perhaps the refuge you need is in our dungeon!

No, please.  I have not met your hideous princess....I mean beautiful souled princess.  I mean....I'm sure she has a good personality right.  But I am pledged to be married.  Otherwise...I would be all over it.
Relax. I was just testing you. I will tell the priest to offer you refuge here in his office. Tomorrow we will talk about how we may be able to help you further.
Thank you so much.  I thought you might be the princess for a second with a fake beard on.  I really don't want to be offensive.

agent_personas: I am the clergyman chosen by the king. I am expected to keep the church clean. I sometimes dream of sailing to a new land.
I have the best family on earth.  My parents are incomparable!  I am blessed to have a close knit family.

setting.name: Gathering room
setting.description: The gathering room is small, but comfortable. There are many seats for people to rest in. They are made of straw and covered with homespun blankets. There is a small table.
setting.background: The family spend a lot of time in the comfortable gathering room. They talk about their day and about their hopes. They tell stories and read books and enjoy each other.

speech: Hello Lawson Family, I wish that I could bring you joyful news, but it is with great regret that I inform you that your precious Timothy has died. He came to confess his sins before the shot to his femoral artery killed him, and he bled to death.
No!!!!!s He was so young! What did he do?!
He went to rob the local merchant store in the village, and the owner met him with a shot gun
What?! He had the best upbringing! We gave him a wonderful life! Why would he do such a despicable thing?!
He confessed that he felt sorry, but he was only trying to provide for the family. He was forgiven before he bled out...
Thank you for delivering this news. We are not needy people and are comfortable. I don't know what he was thinking. Someone must have got him to do it.
He spoke of no accompliance. He was very sad that this is what his life had come to. He asked that I give you this.
This was his mothers necklaces that turned up missing years ago. This must have started then and we never thought to ask if he stole it. This is all my fault!
He said he carried it with him to give him hope, but he never meant to steal it. He was afraid you would not give it to him.
Wow! I am shocked I thought I knew my son but he was actually mile away even in the same room together. This is a tragedy.
It is important that you do not resent him even in his death.
That may be difficult at times. I'm just so confused. Would you like to sit down?
Ah yes, tell me what you are confused about? Talk to me so you can grieve properly without anger.
We were the best parents. even better than my own and they were great! We just had no idea. It's like he was leading some kind of double life.

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Is the jester getting ready for a party?
I believe he is. I always enjoy his entertainment. Do you like him, too?
I think everyone finds him hilarious! If he wasn't I'm sure he would not be employed, maybe even lose his head.
Fair point! What brings you here on this fine day?
Well I was just coming in to view the paintings and to my surprise there is going to be a party. So it is with good luck that I came today. What is going on with your day?
I'm here to protect the royals in the event of a disaster. I love working here with all of the beautiful chandeliers and candles!
I can understand that! it is quite beautiful!
Are you attending the party?
I would love to join in the celebration. Is everyone invited?
I'm not sure. I haven't received any details from the king, but the chef told me he is preparing for over 500 people!
That is quite a lot of people.... There are about that many people in the village and I live there
Then maybe he is throwing a surprise party for the whole villlage. The rumor is that he has an annoucement related to the princess, but I don't know that to be true.
Oh that is great!  Can't wait to find out what it would be. What do think it could be?
She's been talking quite a bit with someone from another kingdom. Do you thinkit could be an engagement announcement?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
As the King's subjects, we have little say. Being a vassal requires obedience. At least he is a fair and just Lord.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Aaaaah, my dining hall. And my loyal subjects.
Sire, I have brought the Royal Coinpurse and Ceremonial Hat for you.
Why thankyou, lowly one. I would like to feel fancy while I dine.
Yes Sire.
Now, food time. I must eat, for I have a long night of sleep ahead of me. And then, you, my subjects, may dine.
Yes, Your Majesty, Thank you, Your Majesty.
Here, take this. I won't wear it while I eat and maybe it'll keep you warm. But only for now!
Thank you Sire!  You are truly a wonderful King!
I know, I know. But enough about me. Time to eat! Everyone grab a plate, now that I am done. There should plenty left over for at least some of you
Yes Sire!  You are a generous ruler!  Thank you.
I'm feeling generous. Come, touch me. But not too much. And wash your hands first.
um, Yes Sire!
Okay ENOUGH hugging... give me my coinpurse back, one of you dirty lowlives stole it, and if I find who, there shall be hell to pay!
No Sire!  I have personally guarded it!  No one has come near it!

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.
I am a quick tempered person. I get angry over the smallest things. I like adventure and like to travel. I like living in the kingdom.

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: Oh..it is so beautiful up here!
Child what are you doing by yourself! Where are your parents! This is not a safe place for you to be without supervision!
I'm not alone...my groom is right over there...I am a princess...
Well, I hope that is true! It is a magnificent site to behold up here
My pony brought me up here and I found this funny rock.
That is no rock, child. It is a crystal ball.
I thought it was a rock..I rubbed it and it was glowing...what is a c..r..y..stal ball?
It has magical powers for some to see into other places. Only a true soothsayer can see into a crystal ball
Too many big words for me...I think my father...the King...would be one of those sooth..things...
He can see into the crystal ball? He can see other places?
Don't know...just want to play up here and collect more rocks...
Yes, child? Do you want to keep the crystal ball? Or try to return it back to its rightful owner?
You can have it...you seem nice and it is shiny...I the princess...ummm...gift it to you.
Why thank you your highness! I appreciate that. I will make sure it gets back to whomever it belongs to
action: give a crystal ball to people
give a crystal ball to child
give a crystal ball to people

agent_personas: I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.
I am one of the poorer citizens of the empire.  On some days I can't eat more than a morsel of bread.  The king's men are mean to me.  They eat lavish foods and laugh at me.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Can I offer you some food citizens?
Please.  We are so hungry.  The king's men have stolen all we have.
I have nothing with me, but you all should come over for dinner at the family farm tonight. We have some items ready for harvest that you can choose to take home.
You are too generous.  How do you have so much bounty under this regime?
Well, I do good and people do good to me. I try to follow the good Lord as well.
It has worked well for you.  Do you have a church we can attend to be with more people like you?
Of course! The town church where the temple is! The priest is always very helpful in speaking truth.
Do the king's men leave the members alone?
Indeed they do unless a crime has been committed.
Good folks like you could never commit a crime, surely.
I have never committed a crime, no... no I have not. I have never seen reason to commit a crime. I have been blessed with family and fertile land.
You are far more blessed than I then.  My land and family have both been taken by the king and his men.
How about you come work for me? I could use some help on the farm.
Oh how kind you are.  I have truly been blessed this day to have met you.
room_agents: a poorer citizens of the empire
a poorer citizens of the empire
