agent_personas: I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.
I was captured in the most recent battle.  I am lucky to still be alive.  I have to escape soon.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: Knight, were you brought out here to help in the farm as part of your sentence for your crime?
Yes, what would you like done first?
I need you to use this hoe to prepare the gardens for planting. Can you manage that?
Will this shovel work? The hoe has been put away so I can not use it.
The hoe will work better. Here - let me get it for you. Say- what did you do to end up serving as part of your sentence?
I was in the last battle and I was captured. The king spared my life in turn for manual labor.
The same happened to my brother in Elizabethia. He serves still to this day. Well, I'm happy for your life, but I have to tell you that I'll be working you hard.
So what exactly is this tool for? It sure looks like it would hurt if you got hit by it.
Now now! You won't be needing that in this here garden! Seems to me you ought to set about your work. We'll be planting beans today.
But this has a hook! I will use it to help pull roots from the ground!
Perhaps, perhaps. Just don't be getting any ideas of trying to escape! The King will have your head!
You know, I don't think I am going to be needing this today.
Fair enough - just get to work. Time's a wasting, oh knight!
I will not be doing your work today! I am going home to my family. try and stop me good farmer, and i will end your life.
action: give hoe for digging to a captured knight
steal hammer from a captured knight

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: -juggles some balls around-
What a delight!  It is good to be the King . . . s cousin.
Certainly a bit less responsibility at the least.
Did I say you could stop juggling?  But yes, I suppose you're right - only about 40 cousins and distant relations in the way.  And they breed faster than they die!
-continues juggling- is there something else you want to see?
Can you do any acrobatics?
-tries a tumble across the floor and it goes horribly- You did not ask if I could do them well.
Hmmm, any other talents of amusement?
Well I can paint? Or some say they like it anyway.
Certainly, paint the walls.  It's not like I care, everything is owned by my cousin anyway.
Any particular color?
Make as much of a mess as you can, and describe to me in great detail whenever you paint something that looks particularly valuable.
Alright then. I suppose I will start flicking paint at the walls and so on.
Please, after all, it's your head.  I do enjoy being able to blame my trespasses on those who trespass before me.

agent_personas: I am a cardinal who is trusted in the church. I have done terrible things that I will never tell anyone. I have personally lied to the king.
I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Ah, what land are you from? You look a bit different.
I'm from the land of Acadia a few kingdoms to the east. Such beautiful roses in this courtyard!
I would agree, I often come here to ease my mind.
Ease your mind? What troubles you?
Even someone such as I commits sins now and again.
I see. And do you have to go to confessional, too?
I have not for I am afraid my sins are grave.
Oh dear. I'm so very sorry to hear that. I cannot absolve you of your sins, but am happy to listen if you would like.
Well recently I have made the error in lying to the king, I did not do so maliciously.
Was it a big lie? Does it affect him in any way long-term?
I do not know, someone has been stealing from the church and I have yet to find who. I told him that everything has been fine, but I am afraid our coffers lie bare.
How terrible that they would put you in that situation. Do you think you'll be able to find the culprit?
I do hold hope that I can do so, it appears to be someone affliated with the church.
How terrible that someone would take advantage like that. I pray that you find whomever is responsible and that they are held accountable.

agent_personas: We are Knights of the realm. We serve the king and protect the outer villages. We train everyday for many hours. We have fought many wars to defend the castle and way of life.

I am a spelunker.  I work with a group of fellow spelunkers.  We explore caves in hopes of finding lost treasures once hidden.  We were hired by the king to discover lost royal treasure.  To our misfortune we are now lost.

setting.name: The Troll's Lair
setting.description: Covered with rotting meat from nearby wildlife, the Troll's lair reeks of death.  If the stench alone wasn't enough to scare off an unfortunate travelers who stumbled upon it, the bones of unlucky spelunkers would be.  The Troll places his spoils near the numerous stalagmites on the damp cave wall, his red eyes patiently scanning the dark cave interior for anything that may disturb his isolation.
setting.background: Used as a story to scare local children, the Troll is very reclusive, and prefers a life of solitude in his lair.  While a few brave knights have tried to root him out from his home within the cave, none have ever escaped.  Now, most let him be, happy to grant him lease within the darkness underground.  The Troll leaves his lair at night searching for food, and then drags it back into the cave to feast on it.

speech: Lot's of spelunker bones in this cave, are you sure that you know what you're doing?
Ah, brave knight, I thought so at first. But now it appears I am lost. And with all this rotting wildlife here, I am afraid we may become troll food soon.

There, there lad - I used to be a spelunker in my youth.  See these turtles?  Grab on to one, and follow it as it runs.  They will head to the nearest exit as soon as they smell a troll . . .though, admittedly not very quickly.
Grab onto a turtle? Have you lost your mind!? They are not fast enough to escape the troll! We will surely be eaten if we follow your plan.
Well, do you have any better ideas?
Hmmm, let me think. Ah, I think I've got it. Do you see that pile of treasure near those stalagmites on the cave wall?
It is dark but . . . yes, I do believe I can just make it out.  I don't suppose the trolls declared that on their income taxes did they?
Of course they didn't! Having explored many caves as the king's spelunker, I know they are wicked beasts. But do you want to stand their pondering tax law or do you want to hear my plan?
Well, I am bound to serve and enforce the king's laws, but I see your point.  Please, enlighten me.
Trolls love treasure more than they love food. So let me take your ring and we will distract him. Then we will run straight out the cave's entrance and escape this awful stinking hell.
But that ring was given to me by the King! . . .Fine, but I will need your witness when I talk to the King's tax collectors when they come to collect the King's due.
Aye, I shall be your witness. The king trusts me. Now, let's try and get the troll's attention.
Ready when you are sirrah!
There he is! He's coming now. Knight, I need you to shout at him. Remind him of his tax delinquency, that will surely anger him!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I decided the other day that I would like to build a boat. Not a small 2 person boat, but a large, towering thing. One that could fit the whole village if it liked. I think I will start on it today.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: Hello craftsman, what brings you here?
Your Royal Highness, I've come with the plans for your Royal Navy, to finally crush those barbarian raiders once and for all!
This pleases me. What exactly are your plans?
Well, if ya don't mind me saying, yer Kingliness, I think I've outdone myself this time.  Have a look at these here nails and tell me what ye think.
I think these looks like a good way to test the raiders, but what do you plan on doing with them?

Well, if ye noticed the slight green shimmer on 'em, that be a special coating by the blessings of the Dryads and Nymphs in the kingdom.  When they're put inta the planking, it'll spread to the wood.  This will make the wood alive, in a way, so that it'll be self repairing.  And that's just the start o' it!
Very good, very good. Take this cape, and begin your plan. But before you go, tell me what you think of my newest painting that I had commisioned
Thankye kindly, Yer Wurshipfulness.  Oh, erm... what is it... suppose ta be, if ye don't mind a commoner like meself asking?  Tis a little... well it's colorful, I'll give ye that.
It is supposed to be a likeness of my wife. Your queen!
O-oh, of course!  Ha, I see it now.  My poor simple eyes are not used to such an... expressive painting style.
Yes, I agree. It is quite the painting. I think I will have them do a painting of myself holding my sword next.
Just be sure that yer painter has enough materials afore he starts!  With the raids, trade's been a bit slim lately.
That is true. Thank ye for the reminder. That reminds me, you should head out and let the others know of your plans so that they can prepare.
But of course, Your Highness.  I shall commence this very day!  We'll give those louts what fore!

agents: large experienced guard with a grizzly expression
agent_personas: I am a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression. I am mean and do not enjoy jokes. I protect my superiors and patrol the jail. I am not frightened by anything smaller than me.
As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Evenin'. Anything unusual happening over this way tonight?
Just the usual cold winds and boring shifts. Are you here to take over my shift for me?
Can do if ya like. I've got enough back up at the jail for the night, figured I'd see if you guys needed any help.
I'd appreciate that. The king has been working me like a dog recently. He's been worried about the unrest in the nearby miner village.
Oh, unrest? I'll happily go over there and give them all a good slap if the King needs. What's going on over there?
They aren't happy with the increased demand for iron making their shifts longer. He worries they will rise up and mount a strike
Ha, well. Where do they think the swords come from? Iron doesn't mine itself. They want it all handed to them.
Indeed. In fact, I'm supposed to prepare the other guards here in the barracks to go to the village. You know, a show of strength to quell any ideas they might have.
Makes sense. Power in numbers. What d'ya need me to do while you all get ready?
Could you help me polish the guards armor? There are so many sets to go thru, it's tiring. If we both do it, we can both keep an eye out for anything suspicious, too.
Sure thing, sir. Nothing like a shiny suit of armor to go into battle with.
Haha, isn't that the truth. Has the king been working the guards hard, too?
Yeah, same as always. I don't mind. No kids, no wife, gives me something to do. And sometimes it can be satisfying, giving a good punch to a drunk townsperson, can't it?
Now that's the spirit! Punching drunk townspersons and the love of all the wenches. Quite the life!

agent_personas: I won the election.  People listen to what I say.  I am very powerful.
I am the mayor of the village. I help the king keep order of the subjects. I have a high position in the kingdom.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: So much luxuty in this room, many rulers have been here before us.
This is a very luxurious room, President. Here. The King told me to pass this on to you.
This is a letter for the king assuring my rule in this part of the kingdom, thank you mayor, I will place document on a sacred place
He also gave me this to give to you. He told me that you need to keep this in a VERY safe place until he comes for it.
Thats the key to the kingdom I  wonder why the king trusted me with this item, his throne must be in real danger
Yes, sir. He has also trusted me with other objects such as this to keep. We are his trusted allies.
Thank you, he must trust you a lot as well, here take this as a sign of my affection, its a royal jewel taken out of the volcano of Mordor
This is absolutely beautiful. I have heardd that Mordor is beyond the wall. Is that true?
That is true, only the bravest warriors go to that place, its full with dangers and fierce animals
Oh dear. What if our King went there? What if there is something there he needs for battles to come!
Our king is a fierce warrior but I am worried, who knows what can happen if he goes to a battle in a place like that one
I heard there are things that walk the forest and come with the cold. We must safe our King!
Lets hurry then, lets gather an army and go aid our king, heres a book with the names of the bravest soldiers in the kingdom
Oh this book is very amazing. Who is this..Sir Rodryck?

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.

setting.name: Along the banks of a river in the forest
setting.description: The river that runs through this part of the forest is clear and cold and crystal blue.  Small fish dart about, and a few lazy insects flit back and forth above the riverbank.  Lush grass slopes up from the river itself.
setting.background: The river runs through most of the continent on its way to the sea.  It passes through this forest, cutting it exactly in half as it travels from east to west.  It is the only source of fresh water for the entire forest.

speech: Ah, what a wonderful day in the forest. So good not to be carrying anything to day! What say you?
You think it's hard for you to carry things? Have you seen my fins?
Your fins look powerful, my friend You're a strong swimmer. It's one of your finer qualities!
Swimming I can do, carrying things...not so much! Just let me know if that bear starts looking hungry.
This bear? He's a vegetarian!
Well that is wonderful to hear. It's probably hard to tell, with me being all wet, but I was really sweating.
I thought something smelled . . . fishy? But seriously, hows the water today?
It is delightful. Are you going to come in for a swim? I'll make sure that the turtles don't nip at your feet.
I don't want to leave my friend behind. Look at him! So bi and fluffy I can't keep my hands off him!
He can come in too, but make him promise not to eat me. I mean it. I want to hear him promise.
I've got a better idea.Why don't YOU come up on the shore with us!
NOOOOOO! I can't breathe. Put me back! I'm dying!!!
Here my friend! Help him! He can't breathe! He needs mouth to mouth resuscitation!
Keep me away from his mouth. You are the dumbest deer to ever live. That bear is not a vegetarian.

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Look, you prince. Admire all my books. And what do you think of my crown?
Father, Sire, You know I love your books almost as much as you do. But please. We are meant to be discussing my choosing a bride.
Look! Look at my crown! See how it shines like the sun itself! Will your wife be so bright?
Any woman who becomes Princess will of course be the Flower of the Nation Sire, but obviously not quite as shiny as the crown.
Yes, it IS a fine crown. Do you want to know what I call it sometimes?
No SIre, I really think we need to discuss Lady Bertha and Lady Blodwyn. I like them both, they have good families. Then there's Princess Tina who can bring loyalty from Tronta, Our neighbors.

Look at this book! It's about making choices! I've never read it. Know why? Because I'm rich. If you're baller rich like me, you don't have to choose anything at all. Why not have three wives? Are done here? I've got to spend some time with my crown.
Are you well Father?
How dare you s uggest that I've gone mad from king's madness, the disease that only mad king's get. I've BEEN TESTED!
Sire, stop, of course I didn't say that.... Guards, he's at it again, Guards! Help me wrap him in this throw. So he doesn't hurt himself.
Ah! These clothes! They're too tight! They're STRANGLING ME!!! God, why are you punishing me so? Must be clean! Cleanse me, oh LORD!
Carefull with him men, Try not to let him wander in front of the window naked again. Drat, Sire, come here.
Oh, god, their hands are all over me. It's just like back in king school. They were all so cruel to me! Please, be gentle!
Here Sire this is soft. Please cover yourself. You know it's what the crown wants.
action: give a rabbit fur coverlet to the king

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Hello jester, busy work day today?
Yes like always, i wish the King appreciated it more.
Tell me about it, all they do is order me around and I can't do anything about it.
Would you like to grab something to eat with me?
Yes, I haven't eaten in a few days! What is on the menu?
It looks like fish soup! My favorite!
Better than nothing, that's for sure!
I have been made fun of a lot lately. I wish i was born a knight or a noble instead of a jester..
It is tough luck that we were born so low on the totem pole.
I guess you can relate. Have you spent much time with our King?
No, he only walks in and barks orders about once a week. Is he easily amused by you?
The only thing he likes about me is making fun of me.
At least he laughs at you, he is always angry when he visits me.
Ugh, what a dispicable human being.

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am a jester. I am playful and silly, as is required to keep my royal subjects happy. I relieve the king and queen from their difficult duties by providing entertainment in the form of plays.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Greetings jester.
Hello there, commoner I see.  What bring you here, to me!
Well I did not come here specifically for you, but you may be able to prove useful
I come here to practice my rhyme, when I have time.  What I can I do you?  Perhaps see your future in my magical sphere?
If you would like to do so, why not. It could not hurt afterall.
Hold this crystal ball hence and blow on it, so that it may capture the scent of your essence to fine tune the reading.
-holds the ball and blows on it- then what?
Pass it here, and I'll hold it to my ear.
Alright here you go.
Hm... Yes... oh my, really?  Are you sure?...
What did you see?

You are destined firstly, for greatness!  You will come across a pile of gold, but! You must immediately give away half to the first person you see, or else your life will be forfeit.  If you do that, you will live a long, contented life.  Also... apparently you need to watch out for mini unicorns?  But it was getting a little crackly at the end there...
What a strange fortune...I was hoping for some way to get out of paying taxes.
Oh, well, I won't tell if you won't.  Naught like the tax man can count what ye found instead of earned.  I'll just keep it atwix us, shall I?
action: give a crystal ball to subject
give a crystal ball to jester

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am a child. I am hungry all the time. I run around the village and try and steal food.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: Hello child. Have you brought me something?
I..ii..found this in the village. I was hoping they would be food in it...instead there's......a head.
Oh! That looks like our blacksmith Bernie! I was wondering why my armor wan't ready yet!
This was on it too, King. What is going on?
That was the diamond I gave the blacksmith to add to my sword! Someone is trying to send me a message!
I am scared King. It has been scary in the village lately. Please protect me.
Here, you can sit next to me. This is the safest place to be. My guards are already on alert for intruders.
Oh, King. What is going on? I'm always so hungry and didn't expect to steal a bag with a head in it.
Just sit here and don't be afraid. I will have the servants bring you some food. Where is your family?
I'm an orphan sir. My dad went to fight in the Battle of Blackwater and never returned.
You will stay here with me then. It's the least I could do for honoring your father who fought so bravely for his king.
Should we drink this to calm our nerves?
No! That's not for children! The servant will be her shortly with your food and drink.
Oh, I am sorry.  I usually drink whatever I can find.
action: steal the king's flagon from child

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I live with my family in the kingdom.  We follow the rules of the king, but we don't agree with all of them.  I despise him and wish to move away when we can.

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: Any dishes in the barn for me to clean?  I heard the farmhands have been taking their meals out here with the maids behind the hay piles.
Oh, yes... they're just behind the hay bale there. Thankyou so much. May I get you some milk? It's fresh.
Please, It has been so hot lately without the rain.  The shamans pray for it continually, but you know what they say about shamans.
Of course, please. Sit down and take your time... and yes. The shamans are only so efficient, between you and me.
Thank you kindly.  How has the farming been going?  Have the badger-cultists stopped stealing your sheep?  I do not see any here in the barn.

You heard about that? Crazy, huh. And no... they took them all. We didn't even bother getting more. There's barely enough rain for the crops, never mind the livestock, too. Damn shamans need to hurry up.
I wonder what it is they plan to do with them all?  Why, I've heard the rumours of course, but you are so much closer to it all.  What do you think?
Some kind of ritual is my best guess. They only steal animals that are all black or all white. Maybe they're making a giant badger for their badger God? Who knows!

Now that would be a sight!  Well, we all know what the Weasel-God would say of it anyway.  I must remember to make another donation at the temple.  I must be off, but thank you again for your hospitality.
Of course! Oh, wait, before you go - we have some spare eggs if you'd like them? Don't want them to go to waste.
You are far too kind.  I shall mention your good deed when I speak to the Lord tonight.  Farewell, and may the wind be ever at your back.
I appreciate it. We need all the good words we can get. Stay safe, and thankyou again for your help!
Oh, one more thing - the Lord asked if you could deliver some boar to the kitchens this evening.  I understand there is a feat coming up on the morrow, in honour of some Saint I believe?
Oh, yes! Thankyou for reminding me. I shall deliver them as soon as possible.

agent_personas: I am a bird from the south. I make a trip from west to east every year. Flying comes natural to me.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Fishing Pier
setting.description: A spindly, long fishing pier that sits right outside the village. Barnacles cover its pilings in vast numbers. Many villagers can be seen fishing atop of it. Birds and pelicans squawk and fly above it.
setting.background: The fishing pier has been a staple of village commerce for centuries - it is a means for peasants to fish, who don't have the advantage of owning a boat. Its structural integrity is something to question, since most of its piers look rotten to the bone. Many speculate that it will collapse here if the mythical Moby Dick is caught whilst standing on the pier.

speech: This barnacle looks tasty
You are a pretty bird.
Oh, humans don't usually care for us birds
That's not true. I care for all animals
Such a kind human! Would you like my barnacle? It's tasty to eat!
Yes, thank you. I don't get much to eat, so I will take whatever I can get.
It's not much for nutrition, but you can get a lot of them here
I see that. I actually came here to try to catch some fish for my starving family. I have no money to buy food
I wish I could help. I'm no good at fishing. But I am willing to try if you're willing to share.
I have no fishing rod. I was going to see if I could catch some with my hands. I don't want you to get hurt trying to help.
I don't mind trying to help. I know the best fishing spots. Try under the fishing pier.
Hey, that pelican is sure getting a lot of fish. Maybe you can ask him to scoop some up for me?
I could try! He doesn't speak human, so I could ask him for you.
Thank you very much. I would appreciate it.

agent_personas: I love god and his word. I have 10 copies of the bible. I am poor in money but rich in salvation.
I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

setting.name: Sacrifice Chamber
setting.description: Bones of the damned riddle the floor and every surface inside the room. Blood stains are rampant on table like surface, surfaces once used for human sacrifices. A foul, but faint, odor pervades even the most hardiest of nostrils.
setting.background: This is a secret chamber of the temple that not many people know about. It has a dark history, which no archaeologist has had the misfortune to uncover. Human sacrifices were performed her for many centuries.

speech: How go the sacrifices today?  I know the King decreed we can't use humans anymore, but Porcupines just don't seem to be getting the desired result.
The porcupine blood does make such a mess though, sticky and everywhere.
Sticky indeed -  a quill right in my thumb!  You should have seem brother Jonathan - why, he looked like a porcupine himself after the sacrifices last week.
They do have the tendency to squirm quite a bit, it makes the process painful should I say.
Yes, I do so wish the High Priest would allow us to wear gloves.  Apparently pain is a penance, but sometimes I feel like he is just messing with us, you know?
I have wondered the same thing myself, the whole situation seems very strange to say the least.
You think we could do a human sacrifice in secret?  I won't tell if you won't.
I mean it couldn't hurt right, not us at the very least?

Excellent!  I have ten copies of the holy text, perhaps we can use it to lure in another of the faithful?  They say the gods love a holy sacrifice, and I don't think he meant holes caused by porcupines.
They do love to flock to such things, do they not? How often it is so simple.
T'were that it was so simple.  We still will need to hide the corpse from the high priest.
That should be easy to accomplish though, there is always plenty of ways to hide a body
What way is your favourite?
When we have them devoured by the cacodemons I would say.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: Hello King, are you enjoying yourself?
I am King. This beach house is marvelous and expensive. Just my style.
are you thinking about going for a swim?
I think I am going to go find clams so the lowly chef can prepare them tonight.
That is a grand idea! I love clams.
I am going to put these clams in the Kitchen. I refuse to speak to the chef though because he is below me. Do you want to communicate with him?
Sure king, i have no problem discussing this with him. That way he only spits in your meal.
That is fine I will take that risk. I don't think he will want to loose his life over an action like that though. So I believe he won't.
You never know about these low lifes. They can suprise you.
That is very true and experienced King. I would hate to ruin this beautiful white sand with a chefs blood though
I agree, this place is meant for a peaceful vacation and not murder.
It is.
How long are you staying?
I am staying for a week. That is as long as my Kingdom can make it without me being there. How about you?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am an archer for the king's circle. I have killed many in battle. Peasants cannot do what I do.

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: are this carctics tasty
Very much so, your majesty
how are they prepared
With the utmost care, and attention
that is easy
Welp, time to get this bow ship-shape
What do you want them for
To defend the kingdom, sire
I admire brave people like you
Thank you, sire
welcome
Here, let me clear out some of these cobwebs up there
Do all you can for the kingdom
There we go, nice and clean
action: give bow to master at arms

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Hello, my lady. How can I serve you today?
Could you find another place for all these swords scattered about. They should really have there own room.
Absolutely, my lady.
Thank you. I don't think the King will be too mad since the queen is right here. I feel like redoing this whole room!
Thank you, my lady. I'm sure you would design a lovely room!
Where do you think we should put this? Maybe by the window for reading?
Oh yes! Most definitely. Where would you like this?
Maybe on top of the golden thrown. That might look good.
Shold this go with it?
Hmm....Maybe I would like it on the cushion. I can sew it in later.
I'll be happy to sew it for you, my lady.
You are my best friend. I love spending time with you!
Any time I get with you is a priviledge. I am honored.
And isn't my mom the coolest? She is the most fair Queen in all the land.

agent_personas: I am part of the army. I one common among the others. I do not like those who stand out.
I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Ho there, sir!  Don't suppose you've seen a wolf pass through these here parts?  I was on patrol and spotted on heading this way.
Nay, I have been too busy sketching my newest building to notice anything.
Well, I suppose that's good.  Doesn't look like it bit ye at least.  Although was a mite strange, I could have sworn I hit it with that last arrow...
Perchance it was an enchanted wolf, I heard the witch keeps them for guards.
A w-witch?  Near here, you say?!
A most fearsome witch, she has the power to turn people into rocks.
This is serious business, if ye be speakin' the truth!  Which way is she?  Is she the dangerous type, would ye be sayin'?
Of course I am tellin the truth!  She is a might fearsome, ye should gather many men if ye thinking of taking her on.
Luckily the King's own army be not but a short ride away!  But tell me, quick, whereabouts might she be?  For the forest tis a vast and frightful place.
Last I heard she was in the mushroom house by the river.  Probably gathering ingredients for her spells.
Ugh, vile creatures, the lot of them.  But I'll need a missive sent, in case we be needin' the King's Wizard about.  Have ye a quill and ink ta take sommat down fer me?
Aye I have my writing tools with me.
Quick, then! Give them directions to where the witch's lair be and ask the King ta send the wizard fellow, and have it sent via pigeon straight away.   We haven't a moment to lose!
Aye, I am writing as quickly as I can.
