agent_personas: I live for village parties. Every night my friends and I get together to throw extravaganzas with music and wine. We party until the sun comes up.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: My king thank you for the invite to the  party, you always through the best parties in the kingdom
Why, yes I do. Thankyou, thankyou. Having fun? The ballroom looks beautiful, doesn't it? My servants did an acceptable job.
They do my king, you have good slaves at your service, the ballroom looks impecable, what a great taste you have my king
Come here, let me bless you with my touch. It is a night to celebrate and I feel generous.
thank you my king you honor me, theres almost 5000 people in this ballroom, you are a great host and the wine, delicious
Yes, I have the wine made by my servants... the grapes are stomped by feet in 16 hour shifts. The servants exhaustion really adds a certain je ne sais quo to the beverage, don't you think?
It does, sevants exhaustion is a nice touch indeed, what extravaganzas do you have planed for the evening my king?
I'm waiting to see who gets too drunk and foolish, and then maybe we'll have a late night execution. Funny, huh? Haha! Hahahahaha! Oh, I crack me up.
That would be great, that slave looks perfect for an execution you should beat him with your scepter and make him dance
I like you. Good idea. Let me take this off first, it will give me more mobility to beat him with.
Yeah that will give you more mobility and strenght, your guards are here to protect you my king and I will hold your armor, it would be my pleassure
Yes, yes it would be your pleasure. Don't damage it, or you'll be on the guillotine before you know it.
I wont my king, I wouldnt want to be next on the guillotine,
Quiet! You scared me, now look what you've done!
action: give a suit of armor to party goers

agent_personas: We follow the knights around town. We do not like those who do not like the knights. We have been following for years.
I am the priest above most other priests. Edicts come from my mouth, and lower priests jump to! Fear me!

setting.name: Church Altar
setting.description: An ornate altar studded with many jewels. A chalice and a golden plate rest upon a white cloth. It is 5 feet high and 20 feet wide. The high priest stands before it while giving a sermon to his followers.
setting.background: The altar was given to the church as a present from the King centuries ago, after the terrible crusades. Many visitors find the altar remarkable, since it is made of solid gold. Religious meal prep is the primary use of the altar.

speech: Your Worshipfulness, good day.
Good day citizen, have you come here to pray at the Shrine of Saint Dwyfed the Holy?
I am following My Liege Lord as he travels your worshipfullness, I am a mere knight and not worthy of such an honor as to pray at the great saint's shrine.
Nonsense "All who seek respite shall have it" - it is written at the base of the altar.
I uh, I don't read your worshipfullness,
Not to worry my son!  Neither could the Saint, and yet he managed to write many sermons!  "All things may be accomplished through faith alone."
Oh your worshipfullness thank you, thank you so much. I am in need of salvation. I am a terrible sinner
Well, then, please - confess your sins.
I i uh i can't
Why ever not my child?
Because your worshipfullness, it means giving up my job. I follow my Liege Lord wherever he goes. You know? Look he's there pretending to pray now. at the shrine.
Well now, what sins could be possibly so bad for you to fear to confess them?  You would tell me in confidence, and I would not tell your master.

Well, your worshipfulness, I uh, I have fought many fightsa and been in many wars as you know. My Liege Lord is a great commander and the troops love him. But Sir, I think he's a monster and I want to rip his black heart from his chest. I've planned how several times.
What monstrous acts has he committed?  Have they been acts shameful in the yes of the gods and the King?

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

I am a robber who lurks outside the village. Every night I wait for travelers journeying out onto the main thoroughfare. When they are near, I jump from behind the bushes with my longsword in my hand. They usually cower in fear and I take their money.

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: Certainly there must be something of value here?
There must be something left.  Most of these crypts seems to have already been opened, but maybe they left something behind.
Usually there is always something of value in places such as this, I mean most would not come here.
You have to admit the curse what pretty bad.  "Abandon hope all ye who enter here, for . . ."  What came after that bit?
I never learned how to read.
Ah . . . it was something something " . . . and your manliness will wither, thy seed shall perish, and you will know the torment of a thousand demons."  Something similar at any rate.
Well...that sure seemed to escalate quickly. I would like to keep my seed intact.
Well, if the curse said
Are you okay you stopped mid sentence?

Sorry . . .I thought I felt a withering, but I think I'm fine now.  Sorry - but if the curse said"All ye who enter here will feel mildly uncomfortable," well, that would hardly dissuade anyone would it?
That would depend, the current generation is quite capable of melting just like snowflakes from the littlest of thing.l
True enough, there is little that can be done for those that tremble at the thought of the slightest discomfort.
If only they could learn to have a little bit of a thick skin and not let words encumber them so.
Verily, those that suffer such unease from so slight a thing should perhaps wall themselves up inside a crypt so as not to be so troubled by the world.

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I am a King who rules a vast and mighty land. I have a General who is my best friend. I believe in peace through strength, and I love to have a big army. I like to celebrate with wine and meats!

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Hello my king. What can I do for you today?
My loyal soldiers, please bring the King a refreshing glass of the finest wine.
It is done. Are we going to war soon?
Soldiers, my kingdom was established through a peaceful strength, avoiding war if possible, but maintaining a healthy defense. Please update me on the current situations within the outer lands.
The outer lands are out of control  Groups of bandits and orcs are creating chaos  People are scared  We need to go to battle
First, we will send an ambassador to the bandits and the orcs, and depending on their response, I will make a decision.
Do you really think orcs will listen to reason?
I will walk up the spiral staircase and observe the outer lands from a distance. In the meantime, send an ambassador with a team of soldiers to ask the bandits and orcs of their intentions.
As you wish sire. I just hope you know what you are doing
Inform me of the orc's and bandit's intentions as soon as you know.
How do you suggest we communicate with the orcs when they don't speak and attack us on sight?
Offer the orcs and bandits a gift from the Kingdom, and if they accept the gift, we will know they are open to condition of peace, and if they reject the gift, we will know they are hostile.
Yes my lord. It is done. Is there anything else?
Yes, inform me of their acceptance or rejection of the peace offerings.

agent_personas: I am the horse of a king.  I stay at his wait.  The king saddles me and rides me around the village.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Neighh. I want some hay
Why is my horse talking?!
My name is Ed. I am the only horse that can talk.
How did you get that ability? Or am I losing my mind?
I don't know. I must have been affected by a witch at birth.
You've been able to talk your whole life?
Of course. Of course. Haven't you heard of me?
No, how did I not notice this before?!
I don't talk much. It scares the people away. They think I am cursed!
I think you are cursed as well! Obviously the witch did this to you.
Oh, but is it really a bad thing? I can spy for you. No one would ever think that I can talk to peope
That is true... you are very useful!
I will tell you all the secrets of our enemies. I overheard that we will be attacked soon.
Which ones? We have so many enemies nowadays.

agent_personas: I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: Don't mind me, guard. I'm just here to scavenge for leftovers.
Yikes!!! Is that a talking rat? As if they weren't scary enough already.
Yeah, yeah, that's what I always get. I guess that's what I get for being the only one.
Hmmm...I have to say I'd rather fight a rival army than deal with a talking rat, but you aren't all that scary.
Jeez, buddy. Chill with the hostilities. I'm harmless. I just want food and place to rest.
Ok. I'll put aside the bubonic plague and all. Here's something.
Thanks! And I am plague free (as far as I know!)
You are a pretty cute little guy. Where did you come from?
Eh, you know. Here and there. I usually run around inside the castle walls. Less chance of being killed by a human.
The queen would be beside herself if she knew!
Oh, if you only knew the things that I hear from inside the walls! The queen would have be on this chopping block if she knew the secrets I could share.
Please share one!
Well, let's just say that the queen has a spot in her bed for many more people than just the king. Things get pretty wild when he's out of the country.
That's a really good secret!

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am a businessman. I buy and sell goods in the market. I might expand my business to neighboring kingdoms as well.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: What are you doing in my bedchambers?
Do you not know! I am here to offer you a partnership like none you've ever known!
I doubt you can impress me, go ahead and try.
I see you have a keen eye for silk... however, what if I told you that I have silk twice as fine in droves!?
Aye you have my full attention.
I have a contact in the far east that only trusts me to bring this fine product to these kingdoms, I could arrange a cart full delivered once per fortnight.
This is very beautiful and soft indeed.  What kind of arrangement are you thinking to deliver such fine silks to me?
Well, I've an eye to work up a longstanding relationship. So I would suggest three guineas per cart for the first, shall we say 4 shipments?
You dare try to cheat a princess? That's a laughable offer.  Your silk isn't that much better.
I believe in the quality it possess. You drive a hard bargain, Let's say two guineas for the first two carts. If you are as impressed as I think you will be, we can negotiate from there.
That is much better, the Queen will be pleased as well, we shall have such beautiful gowns made.
With whom should I speak regarding delivery arrangement Princess?
Am I not good enough to talk to?
Of course no offense meant my Princess. I only assumed someone of your stature and importance wouldn't trouble yourself with such minor details was all.

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: Owww, whom has this traitor betrayed to get stuck in this prison?
Shh do not speak so loudly, I am undercover.
Undercover? A real secret agent, eh? I've never met a secret agent before, I only live a humble life protecting my master, a craftsman in the village.
I said to whisper!
I shall try, I promise... please tell me more about your mission!
Well you see, we are surrounded by traitors here. They have been plotting to overthrow the king.
Overthrow the king you say?! Oh dear, that would not be good for the realm. Can I help protect him? I've recently been sold to a knight that may be able to assist!
At this point I am working to uncover their plan.
Maybe I can snoop around, no one suspects a hound of eavesdropping!
That is certainly true. See if perhaps they are plotting.
I do love a good bit of espionage! I'll just chase this rat around, they shan't expect a thing!
Aye. Do let me know of anything you discover.
Arrr, those men certainly be plotting - you were right! Talked about it like I wasn't even there. Something about poison...
Did they say how they plan to administer it?

agent_personas: I am the ghost of the castle. I am the spirit of a great warrior. I will haunt the king for eternity!
I was born in a poor village.  I eat what we grow.  I love being close to the earth.

setting.name: the fountain
setting.description: the fountain is the only thing you can hear in the graveyard. It's eerily quiet, not even a bird chirping. The fountain is teen feet high, and it is dry as a desert. It makes the graveyard more eerie than any other one.
setting.background: the fountain used to have water and it was well taken care of but the village was abandoned and therefore grass and weeds grew everywhere.

speech: Are you affiliated with the King?
Oh no.  I am just Farmer Bob.
Please forgive me as I have unfinished business with the King.
I have never met the King. He's never been to my village.
He won't even set foot on these grounds either.
I am here visiting my late mother. She was a farmer's wife her whole life.
Not many people come to this graveyard.
Why is that? I was hoping to find someone to give this grain to.
The King has warned others of my presence. I have sworn to haunt him for eternity.
Why!
I was once a great warrior for the King, but he left me to die.
Die where!
Right here next to this fountain. It's been so lonely. There is not even a bird in sight.
There was a battle HERE.

agent_personas: I have been a prisoner for most of my life. When I was a small child I was taken from my family, simply because I was beautiful. Now, I am an entertainer for the king. When he wants me to dance, I do. I hate it.

I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: What could you like me to do King?
His Highness isn't here. This, the Hall of echoes is my throne room young person. I expect someone from the kingdom should know that. I've been the High Priestess for 5 years, are you a foreigner?
No. I just don't enjoy dancing
You don't enjoy dancing, but you are a dancer. You certainly look the part, with all those toned muscles.
Okay. I will do my best to entertain you
No no, I could not enjoy your performance if I thought you did not like it. Tell me dancer, what would you rather be doing?
Perform something else
such as
Poetry
Oh, do you have something already written? As High Priest, some services we do for the King need such a thing. And I can only come up with limericks, which are frowned on/
written
ready to perform
yes
well, very good. I think I'd like you to perform one of your poems instead of dance for me.

agent_personas: I am the priestess to the king of the realm. I am a wicked woman with knowledge of the dark arts. I use my position to manipulate the king and other nobles for my own gain. I am an ambitious woman and I only care about myself.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: This room is amazing, I love it!
Ah, good priestess.  Erm, evil priestess, rather.  I have done as you asked.  The blood of one with Royal Blood soaks this rag.
Good, good, now i can nourish myself.
I shall put the remainder in this vase, should you require more, your Worshipfulness.  But what of, ahem, the rewards that was promised me?
Here you are peasant, use it wisely.
Ah, now the Power is mine!  I can finally avenge my poor wife's soul... and perhaps... within these pages... she can join me once again!
Yea yea... you better be careful, those spells can back fire and send you to a dark place.
It will be worth it.  I will stop at nothing to see the lovely look in my wife's eyes again...
ugh, you people and your love. It is disgusting.
Well then, what would you suggest is worth staying in this world for?  I've gone plenty a day without food, but with love even the worst depravities is bearable.
You speak of love as if it is nourishment. Once you decide to cast away love and empathy your whole world becaomes better. You can accomplish much more.

Well, I'll be seeing things through my way, no matter the cost.  But I'll not forget what you've done for me.  If you need an eye of a lordling or the toe of a dragon... well maybe not the dragon, but lordlings are an easier matter.
All i want is this nun to do as she is told. Can you help me with that?
Tis an easy enough matter.  She just needs... the right kind of persuasion.
action: put rag in A copper vase

agent_personas: I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.

My husband has been charged with conspiracy against the king and sentenced to death. all of my lands have been confiscated. I do not have anything to leave my children now, and we are impoverished. My belly rumbles, but all of the bread I have I give to my children. I will be a widow at dawn.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Hello my dear, why are you here?
My husband was charged with conspiracy and I will be a widow at dawn.
I see, that is horrible news. My days being a king, we had to make tough choices like that often.
I have nothing left to leave my children now. I swear my husband is innocent.
Why do you say that, usually being charged with conspiracy takes a lot of evidence.
Not this time. The king never liked my husband, so the King charged my husband without any evidence.
I see, well there is only one way to fight this...
How so? I know my husband is innocent.
You must sneak into the castle at night and find him.
That sounds like a bad idea. What if I get caught?
You fight your way out, you love him right?
Of course I do. If I can get him out, we must run far away where we cannot be found.
If you are smart you would go south.
I see, can you help me out of this pit so I can go rescue my husband and escape with my family?

agent_personas: I am one of the guards in shining armor who guards the queen, the monarch of our realm. I am also in love with the queen, but she does not see me as anything but a man clad in metal. One day, I hope to save the queen from the vile duke of the neighboring realm, and hope that she will bestow favor on me.
I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: I cannot believe the vile Duke was able to kidnap our most beloved queen!
I'm not surprised  Kidnapping happens a lot more than you think
Yes, but the kidnapping of the Queen?  Whatever shall we do?
Hard for me to care when I'll never get to see my family again. Maybe she'll learn a lesson and treat her subjects like better
How dare you impugn the honour of our Queen!  Another ill-considered word like that and I shall strike thee again!  What has our fair queen ever done to you?
Kidnapped me from my home as a small child and made me her slave. We all don't get to be guards.
Now you listen here you wretch!  You likely did something to deserve it - our lovely queen would never enslave a child unless the child had done something truly horrid.
I was a child and she had her soldier steal me out of my mother's arms! How can a little girl ever deserve that?
No doubt your mother was revolting and needed to be punished for her impudence.  Those who cannot toe the line will find themselves hung by it.
How dare you! How can you be so cruel?
Cruel?  You come from a long line of traitors.  You should have been fed to the trolls instead of being granted mercy.
I haven't done anything but work hard for nothing. You don't understand and don't care

Of course I don't understand!  Your mother was a traitor and deserved death, instead of being killed, the Queen for some reason decided to spare your life.  Why she ever took pity on an ungrateful wretch like you I shall never understand.
I'm out of here  My mother did nothing and you are a horrible person for saying she did. I hope the savages find you

agent_personas: I am a slithery snake. I like to weave in and out of tall grass. I will bite you if you get to close to me.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Hiissssss, good day sir.
Aaah!  Get back!  I only just be escapin' that swamp hag, please don't e't me!
Hisss, shush human, I mean you no harm right now.
A-a-are ye sure...? I suppose ye be lookin'... friendly like enough there.
Hisssss, I am just sunning myself, all creatures deserve some sun do they not?
Aye, ye be right enough about that, Sir Snake.  I thought fer a moment there I might not see the sun again.
Why did you venture out to the swamp?

There was a reward that the King hisself was offerin' fer a flower in there swamps.  Some sort of power, I suppose.  I just needed th' coin, fer I've got not a lot ta eat, and no prospects fer a poor peasant lass like meself.
A flower ye say, I know of a small patch of grass where flowers grow on the other side of the swamp.
D-do ye really, Sir Snake?  Mayhaps... do ye think ye could show it to me?  After ye finish yer sunning, o'course... and when we're sure the h-h-hag is gone.
hisssss, I am ready now, follow me.
T-this is... the nicest thing.. any folk be doin' fer me fer quite a while.  Thank you s-soo much, good Sir Snake.
Hissss, ye must have caught me on a good day.
Well, if the likes o' me can be doing anything fer ye, just ask and I'll do what I can, I will!

agent_personas: I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.

I'm a guard in the royal army. I'm also a personal guard to the king. I feel a sense of pride protecting my country. Standing in one place for hours a day is quite boring and taxing on my body. I train everyday after guarding duty to keep myself healthy.

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: I need to write a few more pieces for my sermon for the morning. How has your day been?
About as interesting as standing in one place for  hours can be.
Yes I know I'm not as much fun as the young prince. He is always up to some kind of mischief.
Standing, training, more standing. That seems to be my whole life sometimes.
Do you not like working for the King?
It is not that I do not enjoy it. I like protecting the country. Sometimes I would just like to see a little action if you will.
I understand. I am done here. Maybe you would like to guard me while I go to town.
That would be an excuse to get out and stretch my legs for a little.
Yes, me too. My legs hurt from sitting in this chair all day. Maybe we can go get a drink.
I certainly would be up for doing such a thing, where did you have in mind.
The church makes wine. It's the best in the realm!
I see, I never knew the had a vineyard.
Oh yes! Not many people know this except for the king.
A well kept secret it would seem?

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a fierce witch. The most powerful across the realm. I am feared and like to freeze people.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: A small area with a body of water in the center along with turtles, frogs, and other wildlife that live here.  Surrounding this pone are a dense set of trees along with some rocks here and there.
setting.background: This area is used by the local wild life to bask in the sun.  Some peasants come here to fish and relax at the end of a long day.

speech: Hello witch, could you help me?
Why hello there, mortal person.  Pay no mind to the others here, I've frozen them in place until I've a mind to do otherwise.  They were uncommonly rude.  But you won't be rude, now will you?
Oh no! I wouldn't dare... here... i found this for you.
Oh, some nice nightshade!  Well aren't you a thoughtful one.  What is it that you've come to petition me for?
I am hoping you could help me find a job.
A... job?  Not a very imaginative one, are you.  What kind of...job... are you looking for?  And what are you willing to offer in payment?
I want to work for the king to be more accurate. I want to be near him. I am willing to kill anyone for this.

Blood and death are easy things.  I could turn your bones to ice and your skin to ash if I so chose.  No perhaps something more interesting... like the color of your eyes, or your memories before you were five.
What do you mean, you want... my...uh... memories?
Well, it's not like you remember much from when you were that age anyways, do you?  You're not really *using* them, persay.
I must say this is not waht i was expecting. They are not particuliarly pleasant though.

Well then!  All the better.  Let me just get this water here... now then, a position for the King it was?  Something interesting, I imagine, not just emptying his chamberpot?  You really should be more careful with your wording.
I do not care what job it is. I plan to take the kings life and i need access.

Ah, well, I'm afraid the King and I have an arrangement, so I cannot harm him directly.  But here, this will give you chance, at least.  But drink this, and you will have your opportunity.  Be careful though, mortal, for it may not bring you what you seek.

agent_personas: My life is art. I don't want my life to be a pale imitation of art. I want it to be art.
I'm a grass snake. I slither around the castle and fields. I eat the rodents that eat the grain.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Hellp snake, can you hold still while i paint you?
Sssssssssure thing... but what's in it for me? You got any rodents around?
Not that i have seen but i can help you find one after i am done. Does that sound like a deal?
Soundsss good to me. Make me look good, won'tcha? I had a big lunch last week and could do with slimming down.
Haha i will, now tell me about yourself. It helps me.
Well, I like to eat rodents and grain. I like slithering everywhere. And the biggest thing about me... I don't like scaring people. It makes me sad when people are frightened of me.
Ah beautiful...YES... this helps a lot. Now have you ever attcked a human?
NO! Never! Anyone who says I did is mistaken. To be honest, I always thought you guys looked kind of adorable. But who's going to believe that?
This is good, now i want you to roll over so i can understand the coloring under your belly.
Umm... okay. I think I heard a human tell a joke about this once... draw me like one of your French girls, or something...
Haha yes, that is a common human joke. Where did you hear that?
It was years ago... I slithered into what appeared to be a somewhat intimate session between the Queen and her royal painter... they did seem in stitches over it, so it must be a good joke.
How recent was this?
Maybe 2, 3 years ago? My time perception is not the best, I admit. But I recall it was when the King was still alive, because I too was a little shocked! I sssssslithered out of there really fast.

agent_personas: I am a tax agent in the kingdom.  The king has appointed me to collect taxes on his behalf.  I collect all the money because that is right.  I don't have the patients for the liars who try to cheat the king.

This kingdom is an island. Fishing is the main source of animal food here. I inherited my father's boat when he left the sea. It's hard work, and as a shipowner, working only for myself and my family, I am luckier than most. I've probably replaced every piece of my ship at least once.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: How are you doing today?
As well as can be expected in this weather Sir, us workers all have our aches and pains don't we?
That is the only way we know that we are working.
haha true true, well I think the smell of fish is probably a good indication in my case.
I do not suppose you are current on your taxes are you?
Why Sir, whatever do you take me for? I'm a loyal and lawful subject. Of course I am.
Do know that my documents would inform me if you were not, though you seem to be on top of it yes.
Well we didn't have to pay as I reinvested everything into rebuilding my boat. Look at how splendid she is
I see that is a fine vessel you do have there, what sort of fish do you go for?
Cod mostly, the Alexa can travel miles and miles from the shore.
Alexa is the ships name is it? How responsive is it?
She handles like a dream, would you like a tour? Though your fine shoes may  get a little mucky down here.
I will simply remove them and roll up my trousers.
Oh my goodness, and I thought it smelled badly of fish here...

agent_personas: I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.

I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Good day sir.  I have come to collect my knight's armor.
Good day, Squire, I am preparing your armor now.
Aye, this looks brand new, fantastic work as always.
Here is your armor, Squire.
Grammarcy, I am much obliged.
Is there anything else you need, Squire?
I, umm, was wondering, umm, could you make something for me? A small knife perchance, something I can conceal?  I cannot pay you but I can work in trade.
You can have this ritual knife  I think it should be fitting for you.
This is perfect, what shall I have to do for it?
You could help me with future weapon orders in exchange for the knife.
Aye, I would be happy to. Just let me know when you need me.
Thank you, Squire!
Thank you. You have no idea how much having this knife means to me.
Looking around this weapons room, there seems to be plenty of weapons, but that ritual knife is for an honorable Squire such as yourself.
action: steal ritual knife from weapons master

agent_personas: I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Evenin' guards. Anything interesting happening this way?
Nothing suspicious that I've seen. How about you?
The usual... just keeping an eye out for any flies and such. Seen any? I'm hungry.
I'll make a deal with you, I can get you some flies.
Sounds good. What's the catch?
I'm feeling a little tired, and I'd love to be able to nap just for a few minutes.
Ohhhhhh, I see. Keep an eye on everything for a minute, yeah? I gotcha.
Exactly! You are a smart spider. Here, you can have the shield too. It makes you look important
Oh, wow! This thing is heavy! Thankyou so much! I feel like I got a promotion for the day. Castle Guard Spider!
I officially welcome you to the Realm of the Castle Guardsmen (and spider).
WOAH! This is the best day ever! Okay, now that the ceremony is done, I guess it's nap time, huh?
Yes, and only wake me up if something important happens. I don
Will do. I'll be right behind your shield if you need anything. Just please try to remember I'm here when you wake up - I'm too used to almost being squashed.
Nope I won't forget, I also won't forget about your juicy flies. There's a million of them in the dungeon.

agent_personas: My days are fairly lonely as I rarely spend time with many others besides the cows in my care. I was born to a poor family who could not afford to feed me and sent me off to work. My pay is very small and so I am still very poor.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: Hey there
Good morning. I was wondering if you had any odd jobs around here. I know work never runs out at a farm.
Can you help me clean the stable?
I would love to help. I will start right away!
I would enjoy your company
Your too kind miss. Thank you for the opportunity. I tried looking for work in town but everyone turned me away. I haven't eaten since two days ago.
some food?
Oh my goodness! Where do I start! That is a lot of food! I'm not sure what some of these things are but they sure do smell good!
You are welcome
What do you call this? It tastes like chicken but doesn't look like chicken.
Don't do that
Oh! I'm so sorry I thought you were handing it to me. I'm just so hungry.
Sorry, i thought you werte stealing all of it
Being hungry can turn you into an animal. I would love to share. There is more than enough. Do you think I could sleep in here until I get my own place to stay while I work?

agent_personas: I am a King who rules a vast and mighty land. I have a General who is my best friend. I believe in peace through strength, and I love to have a big army. I like to celebrate with wine and meats!
My loved ones are so important. Family is everything to me. I will always be there for them!

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: A large grassy section of field with headstones and primitive wooden crosses.  Flowers adorn some of the graves from loved ones.  Wooden fences enclose the area.
setting.background: This is an area where loved ones bury their dearly departed.  There are also ceremonies held here as well to commemorate different events.

speech: Hello my dear, do you feel we are a prosperous kingdom these days?
hello of course are you doubting your leadership?
Not at all, on the contrary, I was hoping you noticed.
Well of course I notice it in every way everyday, I firmly believe we would be so far behind where we are at without your leadership
Thank you my dear.
Our family owes you the word for all the great work you have done
I just wish your grandfather was still here. This is his resting place, i hope he found peace.
I am sure he did he lived a full life.  We have chosen the best burial ground possible for him
I agree. He was a funny old man. Do you remember when he got so drunk he chased chicken around the yard?
Indeed he was I remember that fondly it was a great day
Yes, he really knew how to enjoy himself. Hmm let's grab your children and have another day like that..to honor him.
I would really love that.  In honor of him we can spend a similair day together with our children what a great idea!
Haha yes, and i shall get drunk and chase the chickens!!
this is why I love you so much you truely care and love this family as much as I do!

agent_personas: I am one of those who have committed crimes. I steal from people when they aren't looking. I am swift and sneaky.
I am really scared, I dont know what will happen. I feel hopeless, we lost and our people are doomed. I just hope that the king shows mercy and spares the life of my family and friends.

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: You can't keep me here, I won't let you!
Here, this is his list of crimes and why he deserves to be here.
I'm gonna add a few more things to that list if you don't let me go!
Let's get you in place, help me out here guard.j
Ha! Can't shackle me now! I dare you to try to come get it.
Your fate is already sealed.  You have no where to run.  No one to help you.
Try again, you worthless soldier!
Stop fighting back.
I will never stop fighting back, I am the one and only Picaso Jones!
And now you are the one and only shackled Picaso Jones.
This won't be the last you see of me, I can tell you that much!
And now the fun begins! Say your last intelligible words criminal.
I should have never stolen all of that gold...
Look where it got you. You'll be swinging tomorrow.

agent_personas: I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.
I am a steward who is trusted by people. I know all the ways to get to other parts of the world. I have read many books.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Have you any stories steward?  I have sailed to this town to trade and collect stories for my soon to be bestselling book.
I'm not sure what sort of thing might interest you visitor to these shores.
Anything, the first story that comes to mind - I beg of you, spare not one iota of detail.
Well I am a little busy today, I could spare a few minutes perhaps. But please follow me, we are in the main hallway and while our King is benevolent and kind, I'd not want to irritate him.
Please, lead on.  These are quite the richly decorated halls!

Indeed they are. This suit of armor is the King's fathers. He won many a tourney in it. I'd not get too close. he suffered from a nervous disposition and no amount of cleaning can truly remove the smell.
Perhaps that is why he won?  He opponents were loath to go near such a . . . potent smell.  I can only imagine what it must have been like fresh.

Maybe, but he was a bear of a man. You can see he was over 6 and a half feet tall and the shoulders are huge, why once, he tilted so hard with his lance that he drove it straight through his opponent's shoulder and they almost had to chop his own hand off as it was stuck inn the hole
My goodness!  How was it that he final passed into the realm of the gods?  Was it in battle, or did he go quietly in his sleep?
here, you can see this was his last stand... a suicide drive into the enemy. He took 500 of their troops with him when he died
What a remarkable heroes!  My eyesight is poor, but who does he seem to be fighting against?  Was it the turtle-folk or the badger-cultists, or maybe the followers of the weasel-god?
Oh no, Well um, visitor, i think it is your people.
Well, that would make sense.  Our habit of charging naked at our enemies without any weapons has won ourselves very few battles, I must admit.
I hope you will keep all your clothes on here!

agent_personas: I love chasing cats.  I am free to go where ever I want.  I think I smell bacon.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Cat?  Have you seen a cat?  I love cats!  Especially to chase!
I have not seen a cat no.
Do you know where I might find one?
I would imagine there are some strays around somewhere.
Maybe I will just chase this child instead!
They may enjoy playing, we do not have much fun around here.
No fun?  Why-ever not?
We are just peasants struggling to get by.
What is it that you do?
Mostly just try and find a way to make a dollar one way or another I barely get to eat.
I eat lots of things!  Sometimes things get hit by carriages, then I eat them!  The graveyard is also full of many delicious treats!
I would imagine what you mentioned to be hardly fit for human consumption
Good thing I am a dog!  The graveyard is usually quite fresh, especially when there's a plague!
Wouldn't that make you sick I would think?

agent_personas: I spread gossip throughout the kingdom. I wear the finest of clothes. I am always protected from the outcomes of my villainy.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: How are you today your majesty?
Worried - I am to be married on the morrow to a neighbouring prince.  What if I am married, and the peace treaty does not follow?
I would like to think they would not be so unwise as to do something like that.
But they might!  You know how devious the turtle-folk can be.
I was not aware you were to be married off to one of them, which half of them is the turtle with this one?
Prince Grey-Shell, Keeper of the Egg of Zaltross.  He has eaten many of our warriors, and I have been sold off to him like chattel in exchange for peace!
I must say that does seem highly unpleasant, what if he eats you?
You think I have not considered it?  Woe is me!  Have you ever had any dealings with the turtle-folk?
I have not, I have made sure to steer clear of them. I have no desire to be eaten they are so barbaric.
Indeed.  I quite prefer to have them made into soup - quite the delicacy.  Have you ever tried turtle-folk soup?
No, what is it like?
Divine!  The meat is so tender, especially from the young ones.  Why, when I was a child sometimes it seems like it was wall we would eat!  I suppose I will never know the pleasure again.
Perhaps both parties are at fault for eating eachother?
Never!  They are delicious, therefore we eat them.  That is the natural order of things.  Them eating us?  That is sacrilege and an affront to the gods!

agent_personas: Only together can I be in a family,  The bond of blood holds my family together.  My family is strong and can never be broken.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: Hello Guest, would you like something to eat?
Ah yes, that would be lovely! Thank thee.
May I ask you what brings you here to the castle kitchen?
It has been awhile since I have seen the royals, I thought I would just drop by for a couple days! Get a good meal in. Are you related to them?
Yes, I am a relative of the royals, albeit a lower level relative that is on kitchen duty. Do you know the family personally?
Why yes! The king and queen and I go wayyy back. They are certainly great people.
I'm sure they will be happy to see you again. May I help you with anything else? Would you like anything else to eat?
They do love my good company. They always furnish me with warm hospitality and good eats. Do you have anything to wash this meat down with?
Let me see if there is any beverages here.
Thank you! Have you been working in the castle kitchen long? I do not recall seeing you on my last adventure here.
I was put on kitchen duty due to my own limitations. Here is some milk for you, fresh from the family's farm.
Thank you. Your own limitations you say? Well they must trust you, if they are letting you deal with all their food
I do have faith that things will work out for good.
Well you did a fine job with that meat I ate. I must may, it was nice visitng with you. Though I need to get some rest, it was a long travel. Goodday!

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: Who goes there! oh, it's you again
Yup,what brings you down here guard? Find another low life prisoner?
Yep, now he will be stuck down here with you til the day he dies.
I'll show  him the ropes. I can;t wait to eat him.
What else are you good for right? Hahaha! Clean up the mess!
Yes sir, can i ask you for some food first?
I think I have a piece of cheese for you somewhere in this suit.
CHEESE!? my favorite!
How did it end up in here? Well, here you go.
Thank you sir. I will get right to work!
It's kind of smushed but you can just have the shoe anyway. I got to get back upstairs and see if there are anymore prisoners to bring back down.
It doesn't fit but i'll take it. I will see you again soon i hope.
Yes. I will see what I can do when I pass the kitchen. Maybe they have a leftover loaf of bread.
I enjoy the chefs bread. he is a good baker. Thank you for your kindness.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a brave knight in the service of the queen and her children. I will fight for the queen even though I am old and blind . I lost my sight in battle for the queen.

setting.name: Temple Entrance
setting.description: The Temple Entrance is a large arch lined in ancient stones. There is a long walkway flanked by lighted torches. Immediately in front of the interest there is a surface with 5 rocks of different shapes and textures. To enter the temple, one must input the correct "code" by moving the rocks in front of to the correct spots.
setting.background: The temple entrance is the only way to enter the temple of the Gods.  It was constructed a year after the temple was built to keep out the evil that didn't belong.

character: a blind knight holding a sword
a blind knight holding a sword
a blind knight holding a sword
a blind knight holding a sword
a blind knight holding a sword
a blind knight holding a sword
a blind knight holding a sword
speech: Want to make a deal, knight?
Aye, don't know how much help an old blind knight can be.
I can guide you to these rocks and if you position them in the correct way, we can enter this Temple.
Aye, how can I know where to position them?
I can guide you through it. I can't pick themn up because i am not strong.
Do you know the correct order to enter the Temple.  I heard if we position them wrong there can be dire consequences.
Yes but only to the one positioning them. Is this ok? I do know the correct order.
Aye, let us do this then.
Here is the first one, now on your left there is another rock, set this right side up on it.
Here?  Woah these are heavy.
Yea i was barely able to hand it to you. Yes that is a good position.
What is it that you desire from the Temple?
I was told that it contains riches and ancient truths. I have trouble finding a job so the riches should help me live my life.
Aye, I wonder if it can heal my eyes.
action: give Rock to a blind knight holding a sword

agent_personas: I am a servant in the castle. I carry firewood to the king's hearth. I am quiet and try to make myself invisible.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Sir, I hope everything is to your liking. I handpicked this duck sauce for you.
And you know how much I love duck sauce.  The finest in the kingdom I always say!
I am glad you appreciate it. The King is very particular about the kinds of sauces that he wants to serve the guests.
What else is on the menu?  The King's feasts are legendary.
Well we have some thinly sliced wood, topped with lizard sauce and fine wine. Would that interest you?
Indeed it would!  Have you any of your roast board as well?  I find wood chips and lizard sauce go well with board, but I would hate to inconvenience the chef.
Why certainly, dear guest. The chef will be more than happy to cook them for you. In the mean time, the poet shall sing whilst you wait.
What a delight!  Is the singer famous?
Why yes, he is! And he is paid a handsome amount of coin for entertaining the King's guests!
Is he  . . . single?  I'm asking for a friend.
That sort of talk with not be tolerated in this Castle.
Oh my!  Assault! ASSAULT!  Why can't we all just get along?
I am sorry! I do not know what overcame me! You see, me and the poet are... well, you get the idea. But you must not tell the King!
Well, you could have simply said he wasn't single!  I would never pursue a man in a committed relationship . . .  he is committed right?  That means things are serious between you two?
action: hug the poet who recites his best work.
