That sounds like that would become problematic quickly, I am but a housewife but even I can see that is a dangerous road to travel.
I fear we are in for troubled times ahead.
Perhaps give him a good drop next time for me?
Ha, that wouldn't make me the King's horse for very long.
Well if he isn't around any more, he certainly cannot corrupt the church.
I can't believe what you're suggesting.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am an animal that lives under the bridge. I like to eat the scraps that the people leave. I enjoy scaring anyone that comes under the bridge.

setting.name: Countryside
setting.description: The countryside is quite nice, it's not filled with a lot of people but with travelers here and there. Some in small groups some on their own. They are hosting a campfire where everyone has some to sit and is telling stories about their adventures. Someone is showing local children how to wield some weapons. Another is offering lodge, and stable for travelers and their animals.
setting.background: The countryside outside the bazaar has always been well known for being a place for people to relax. As they travel back and forth they can stop by campfires and share stories. It was first started by their king. A lovely man who wanted everyone to try and get to know each other and help each other. When he died his villagers wanted to continue his acts of kindness by offering help to those who passed by.

speech: What is that strange creature in the courtyard?
BOO!!!
Strange was definitely a good choice of words.
Aww man....Your not scared of me?
I am king, I bow to none.
Oh....Whats a king? You look like any other human except you are impeccably dressed.
It means that I stand above the other people, they follow my lead so to say.
So it's good to be king. I would like to be King. I will be King of my bridge. That;s where i live.
Are there no other more powerful creatures there? The countryside is quite nice perhaps you could look after that?
Really?! I would like that very much! Will people feed me you think?
I don't see why not there is usually always someone around I would imagine, just do not present yourself as threatening.
That will be hard but ok. I always enjoyed scaring people out from under my bridge. Do I get some sort of crown or badge to let people know not to mess with me?
Being a king is less about imposing fear than it is about garnering respect and admiration.
Yeah but can I have a crown like yours?

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Please sir just listen.  I swear I am innocent!
Not you again! We go though this every day! You crack me up.
I am innocent! Truly!
Whatever you say. Why don't you eat something before you fall over.
I will not eat until you believe my innocence.
Then you will starve to death. I grow tired of the same conversation with you every day.
I am innocent.  If ye will not believe me then I shall try another way.
Are you going to freeze to death instead?!
Perchance you could come help me.
I'm not sure anyone can help you. You are lost and now you are stuck in here to rot. If you don't eat the rats will be eating you.
I don't feel well, I think I'm going to fall.
The floor is not too far away. Go ahead!
Please just a little help.
No! I'm not catching whatever filthy disease you have! Now go lay down and stop talking to me!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: Come, servant. Sit here.
Of course, how may I help you your majesty?
Tell me a story, i am grow tired of sitting here in silence.
Okay, well I'm afraid I don't know too many stories, sir. Would Cinderella do?
Is that all you know? Gosh I'll tell one than.
Yes, its the story my mother told me. I'm afraid I don't know how to read. I'd love to hear one sir
Ok well i'll tel you the story of the great war. It started abotu 200 years ago.
Oh, that is a long time ago, sir.
Yes it was, by great great grandfather was king. He found a spy in the kingdom and had him executed.
Oh a spy. I hope you don't find a spy in your castle.
Not yet... just a word of advice, don't be a spy.
Never your majesty!
Tis but a joke servant.
Yes of course your majesty.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Town center
setting.description: A lavish town full of stone buildings, most of which are two or 3 stories. They have ornate tin gutter fixtures with the water seeming to pour from the mouths of different animals. They almost all have wooden plaques next to the doors describing the nature of their business. the buildings are almost touching eachother, and the narrow streets are so filled with people, donkeys pulling carts, and unruly children its near impossible to walk by without bumping into something.
setting.background: High Nobility and wealth rule the town. Although there are many impoverished people living there, they are mostly kept to the hard to find alleys. There is a strong sense of art and established money in all the main avenues.

speech: Hello merchant, it's pretty busy here...huh?
Incredibly!  45 years on the road, and this is the busiest I have ever seen it on a market day.
Tell me how much is this...uh...animal fountain?
47 Gold pieces m'lord, but seeing as how you're the King I'll let you have it for 45.
Ah well done merchant. I'll take two.
Excellent, anything catch your eye Sire?
I will look some more. Tell me, have you seen any of the turtlefolk around?
None nearby Sire, but I hear they have been raiding from the swamp at night once again.  Are you planning a retaliatory raid?
Yes we need to protect our people. I don't know why they are so confident in raiding us.
Sire, what do they do with those they have captured?  I have heard the legends from the small folk, but they feel embellished.
It depends on the crime. What would you do with someone who killed your people?
Well, in our culture we make them slave to the families who lost loved ones, to serve in the stead of those they lost.
I see, that is very generous of you.
What does your kingdom do?

agent_personas: I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Castle front
setting.description: Just inside the palace there is a lengthy hallway leading from the castle front.  The space is adorned with giant tapestries on the wall depicting scenes of knights performing heroic deeds.  One the floor is long plush runner carpet in a deep red color and adorned with gold trim.
setting.background: Entering the front of the palace is the way honored guests are received.

speech: Hello sir knight.
Ah, good weapons master. I've been looking for you at the armory and they said you'd be here, what brings you to the castle front?
Well I was looking for you, but I couldn't seem to find you either. It must be fate.
Fate indeed! Say I wanted to show you some deflection I'm experiencing with the new sword I got last week. Do you have a few moments?
Certainly, I was looking for you to check on the new swords performance.
I do appreciate that thoughtful gesture sir. Well see last week in battle I think I may have hit some bone and the blade has bent quite badly on me. Look here.
Hmm yes, there is a bit of a curve to it now. No worries I will take it to the forge and see if I cannot get that out for you.
For my troubles I'd really appreciate it if you could upgrade the pommel as well. It's fine but I just need something that strikes a bit more fear!
Something with a bit more of a "bite" I think I can do that.
That'd do yes. Now, how long will this take. I've got an important battle just tomorrow that I may need a loaner for.
I can certainly get it done within the next few hours for you, cannot have you going to battle with a simple loner.
Oh, yes, of course. I do appreciate that, a man and his weapon form a special bond as I'm sure you know.
Aye, I will head over right now and begin working on it.
Many thanks, I shall be over just after sunset to retrieve it.

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Hello soldier. Are you also here for a new knife?
Indeed, all the better to help fight for the King against the badger-cultists!
Yes, my old one was damaged during my last fight. I also need to see about getting this mace repaired.
Have you any tales you can tell oh glorious knight of the realm?
stories far too gruesome even for you soldier. i
Surely you could tell at least one.
Oh very well. Get comfortable. It will be quite the story
I wait your tale eagerly!

Well, it all begins one early morning when the castle is woken up by the sounds of an alarm quite a few years ago. The castle was under attack. Everyone rushes around to get their things to protect the castle inhabitants.
Oh my, who were the attackers?
The kingdom to the west. The new king is young and wanted to show how strong he thought he was. I promise you, he is not
Indeed, why sir you are built like a bear!
Yes I am, I eat three dozen eggs every day to stay large
Three dozen!  I don't think my stomach could handle that.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am the stable boy I take care of the stables. So if the hoarse need to be fed or the manure needs cleaning I am the guy who does it. So bring you horses to me and I'll take good care of them .

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: Tell me boy, did you get done with your tasks?
Not quite sir, I was having some trouble with the new Kingsley horse. He has quite the temperament!
He is a fine horse. he will do great in battle once fully tamed.
I agree, built very strong, he is! Do you think I can ride him into battle against the ogres?
When you are older you will have your chance. i garuntee it.
But my father refuses to teach me how to fight. If only there was someone else...
Here show me your swing.
Alright, HEYAA! ... Oh I am so sorry!
Jeez! Be careful you could have killed her!
I didn't see her there! I apologize for my carelessness.
There there, never show tears... you understand me boy?
Thank you. I won't.
Now make sure you practice. I'll check in on you from now on.
You are most kind! I wish one day I can be strong enough to pick up this shield.

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: Is everything well caretaker?
Aye, all is well.
No sign of restless spirits?
Nay father, all is quiet lately.
That is welcomed news, the ghosts were certainly causing a scare among the people.
Aye father.  I always loved this area, the stone carvings are so beautiful.
I am fond of the glasswork on the church myself.
Are we expecting a visit from the King soon?  I have his castle in perfect array, waiting for his return.
It would be nice to see him again, it has been some time. He seems so busy anymore.
Running a kingdom must be exhausting.
I can only imagine, it can be hard just taking care of this small church.
Aye father, I run a tight ship at the castle.
It is the only way to keep things in order afterall.
Aye a few people sent to the whipping post keeps most everyone else in line.

agent_personas: I am a member of the Cult of the Doomed from the mountain. I believe we will all die soon. I have a wasting illness and smell like soured sweat.
I am an assassin sent to dispatch your king. I am sneaky and quiet. I have a forgettable face and leave no footprints.

setting.name: entryway to the wizards tower
setting.description: The Wizard tower is cluttered with book shelves and wooden tables. Every shelf is filled to the brim with books, stacked vertically and horizontally in every which way, and books lay scattered across the tables falling onto the cold stone floors below. There sit's a shelf with a variety of strange potions and powders, as well as various wands.
setting.background: The Wizard's tower is where the town mystics go to study their craft and  cast incantations at the behest of the townsfolk. It also serves as a library for curious towns members.

speech: Ah, assassin - pray tell, what are you doing in the wizard's tower?
I desire a potion to aid in my work.
Are your assassinations painless then because of this potion?
I can make it that way.  Do you not want the King to suffer for his crimes?
I speak not about the king, but about my kin - my fellow cult members
You wish to hire me for a side job? My price is quite steep.
Is the price per head of per job?
Per head, unless I can get to them all at once.  Then it will be a discount.
My fellow cult members believe that the world will end soon, so we are considering ways to die.
I see.  Then poison would probably be best for you.  Quick and painless, and you can all take it at the same time.
Intriguing. Tell me, can it be mixed with food and drink, or must it be taken alone?
It can be slipped into anything, it is odorless and tasteless.
And the price for a group of 35 people?
Poison for that many will be a lot.  At least 4 pounds and a few shillings.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

speech: Wow this room is full of riches.
How did you find your way in here?
I was told to come and clean up the palce.
Alright then, do a good job.
I will sir! will you hold this?
I am a guard not a chambermaid.
I see, well thanks anyway. how long ahve you been a guard?
I trained as a small boy with my father for guard duty.  I was lucky to be selected to guard this room, as it is filled with so many riches.
yes you are an important piece of security for the King.
Here you go, no sense leaving this on the floor.
Thank you guard. I have got a lot of work from what it looks like.
Aye, I can't remember the last time I saw anyone clean in here.
Yea it slips the kings mind to ask us to clean this. It's a big castle you know.
It is, a truly magnificent castle.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a bat king. I command all bats and they do my bidding. I live in the highest part of the cave and defeat all that challenge me. I eat fruit and smaller bats.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: Does anyone know where I could get a new cushion?
Not me, I spent my day commanding the bats in the cave.
Well, what do you think of our upcoming marriage?
I had not heard. Who is getting married?
Me and you silly!  I knew it would be unconventional, you being a bat and all, but as Queen the people really can't object, since technically you are a King.
That is unheard of! I live in the highest part of the cave, I cannot leave to join you in the castle.
Well my sweet, if you looked around you would notice that you are in my throne room.
I only came to see what was going on. The other bats will go crazy if I don't go back to command them.
Well you can bring them here, my servants will cook whatever they like, and they can live in the dungeon if they want a place nice and damp without sunlight.
They only eat fruit and smaller bats. I still don't think marrying a bat would be the best thing for your image to the people though,
Nonsense!  I shall also put you on the Kingdom's currency!
Say, I just recognized who you are, weren't you married before? What happened to the old King?
Him?  Oh, he's in the dingeons.
Oh my. Maybe I don't want to marry you. I don't want to be locked up too.

agent_personas: I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: Good day, sir. How are you on this fine afternoon?
I am well and yourself?
I am well, sir. Can I help you with anything today? Anything you'd like to talk about?
Have we any word from the neighboring kingdoms about my request?
No, sir. I've had guards positioned all day and a watcher in the tower, but there's been no message from them.
Hmm, we really need the assistance in dealing with the encroaching trolls.
Understood, sir. Is there any action in particular that you request?
For now we will continue to wait on the word to come back, certainly it cannot be too much longer.
I hope not. We can't wait much longer. The people are getting restless - we don't have enough resources and they know it.
Worse comes to worse, we will hold out as long as we can.
Okay. I shall tell everyone to stay patient. What else can I do for you sir?
Just rub my temples, I am very stressed.
Oh... of course, sir. Let me take this first, it must be very heavy.
Ahh thank you...sometimes it just gets a bit much.

agent_personas: I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.
I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

setting.name: outside of the temple offices
setting.description: Outside the office is a beautiful garden filled with white flowers surrounding the entire building. There is a yellow brick road leading to the church. The surrounding trees and plants are beautifully trimmed and gives the area a peaceful atmosphere. Many doves and other birds love hanging around here enjoying its serene environment.
setting.background: The area outside the office was made to look incredibly peaceful and beautiful. It was a place where people would feel calm and comfortable enough to express their sins and seek help from the clergy. Although the office may be simple, the outside looks similar to a king's garden.

speech: cah cahh.  tweet tweet.
What lovely birdsong.
Thank you.  I love to sing.
What attracted you to this garden? The white flowers?
The beautiful flowers full of nectar of course.
Is there much competition with the other birds in this garden for those worms you're eating? Or is it plentiful?
The worms are abundant here, which is why so many birds hang out here.
I see. What time in the morning do you start chirping?
When the moon says goodbye and the sun says hello.
I see, I see. Do you know if the monks do the gardening here?
Aye they do, a fine job they do.
I see. I see. Are the doves as peaceful as everyone says?
The doves are the model of how all birds should act.
I am pleased!

agent_personas: I have a deal for you! I have a sword so sharp you could shave a spider's ass with it. It's also enchanted!
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: town center
setting.description: The town is small, but its streets are full of personality. Each building that lines the cobblestone is a different hue, from the purest cerulean to the darkest mauve. Town favorites include a candy shop, brimming with personality - you can taste the candy floss on your tongue as you walk past. You might also enjoy the general store - you can find anything and everything you might need there, including what you did not know you needed. Chairs line the streets for visitors to sit and chat with friends they might find while out exploring.
setting.background: The small, quaint town was born of a necessity for lightness and levity during the dark times. Though the rest of the surrounding world might be brimming with turmoil, here in this tiny hamlet there is merriment and light oozing from each crack in the sidewalk.

speech: Good day horse.  Have you need of new shoes?
Neighhhh!! Yes, yes I do!
Well have I got a deal for you.  4 new shoes for the price of 3. How does that sound?
Do you not know who I am? NEIGH. I do not need a discount NEIGH I could afford to buy anything I wanted NEIGH
Oh of course sir, I didn't mean to imply you didn't have means, just, who doesn't love a deal?
Well, then, I will tell the king about you being so kind. NEIGH
You are too kind, a good word with the King!
NEIGH, yes I am the kings personal transportation horse. NEIGH
Well in that case forgot about those shoes I told you.  Have I got a better deal for you, all four shoes, brand new and shiny, for only the price of two.
NEIGHHHH you don't say? NEIGH.
Sounds too good to be true right?  I assure you it is not.
NEIGHHH do you have anything for my long gorgeous mane? NEIGHHHH
Only the finest combs made from shells.
Neighhh!! I will make sure the king know how well you have treated me. NEIGH

agent_personas: I am a small creature that often eats seed and grain. I often invade the grain and come inside the castle. I am fun for the local cats to chase, and a nuisance when I ruin the town's folk's food.

I am the current chef of our King. I really enjoy my job. Without proper fuel our King wouldn't be able to lead us. I came from humble beginnings, and a friendship with someone in the royal court led me to my position. I would like to make food for our royalty for the rest of my days.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: *Squeak*
Pass the salt!
*Squeak* How can I pass salt - I have no hands!
I have spent years training you in the culinary arts mouse, do not jest with me.
Aye - salt coming up!
You are quite a character you know?
I only took the herbs to give them to you, o master chef!
I meant in acting as if somehow you had forgotten how to use your paws to gather ingredients.
Temporary memory loss - I'm trying to "spice" up the conversation!
Yes yes, I do understand that your temporal cortex is a bit lacking. Not to fret, we just have to make sure the stew turns out excellent.
Indeed! How can I help? *Squeak*
Do you know where the tumeric got to?
Perhaps some of the less well-trained mice made off with it?
Mother did always tell me my dream of a mouse ran kitchen was a bit peculiar.
action: steal bag of herbs from royal chef

agent_personas: I am a bluebird that has made a nest in the castle walls. The king loves to listen to me sing every morning. My song fills the castle with music every day.
I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: Hello
Hello
Would you like to hear me sing?
Sure, I am of noble blood so I deserve it!
Churppppsss laaaa laaa!
Very nice, would you like to be invited to my banquet this evening?
That would be lovely, is it to be held in the castle?
Yes, it is inside my very own royal castle. Specifically instead the curved hallway, it is very safe.
Do you not like the curved hallway?
The curved hallway is inside the castle. I found a purse on the ground near the wall, is this yours?
No. I wonder whose it might be?
Well, I guess it is yours now.
I think I'll sing some of the same songs that the King likes tonight. I sing to him every morning. Is he going?
Yes of course! He loves his tunes and cannot wait to hear them again.

agent_personas: I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!

I am a vagrant that lives on the streets of the village. I dislike work so I sleep all day. At night I beg for food and money to spend at the village pub. I am rude to people that do not give me charity.

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: What are you doing in my Hidden garden?
I've come to admire this statue.
What value does this have to you?
I have nothing, am considered nothing by most.  Her visage makes me happy.
I see. How sad of a life that must be? You have no family?
No family, no friends. Ale is my only companion.  Besides her, I come here often to stare at her.
I have never seen you here before! I am often unnoticed though.
As am I.  People walk right over me in the street.
How sad! Humans come here, and they tend to be very rude.
They are rude, although a few sometimes give me coin.
They bring me nothing. I am a loner who wanders alone.
I know that feeling.
I would say you do. What a sad world we live in, but at least we got this beauty to behold!
Sometimes I swear it's as if she listens, as if I'm not alone when I am here.

agent_personas: I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: Ah a ghost!!
Boo! Whats a lass like you doing around here in this dark and haunted trail?
I got lost and ended up here. is there an end to this trail.. I have been walking for a long time.
You have been walking in circles. That is the effect that this trail has on the Living.
Oh no! What do i do?
You must wait the night out and when the sun comes up, it will guide you to the exit.
Thank you ghost. How long have you been here?
For decades or more. Time is not the same for me as it is for you. I just enjoy scaring people!
Well you got me good ghost.
You may not know who I was in my previous life, and perhaps that is for the better.
Were you a moral person?
I was an immoral King. I drank and feasted all day and ruled over everyone with an iron fist.
Sounds like you had your fill. Do you enjoy being a ghost?
I love it. Scaring people never gets old. Especially when they're young like you.

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.

setting.name: the spring bath
setting.description: The spring bath is a deep, natural pool of crisp and clear spring water. It is surrounded by rose bushes on all sides except a northern and southern opening, which lead out of the enclosure of roses.
setting.background: The water here is thought of to have some mystical properties, being that it is always cool and clear. The water from the spring is always used to bathe the bodies of those who are deceased prior to their funeral services. This is thought to help the deceased along in the afterlife, by imbuing the body with the mystical properties of the water.

speech: Why I did not expect to see you here, sir! Please join us.
Will do! How is the spring today?
Warm as ale! And might I say, quite refreshingly so.
Ah just like always. This place is so elegant. I feel like a real king here
I assume you're here to relax and ease away from the troubles of administration.
You couldn't be more right. I am also here to make sure you sad lads are ok!
Always sir! Here why don't you say a prepare with us. To our good health and riches!
I'll save the prayers for later. I need to relax.
Very well. Please close your eyes and let the smell of the roses fill your lungs
*inhales* aahhh Did you hear about the Kings command to raid that village down south of here?
Why I did. I can not fathom why he would give such an order. Pillaging innocent people is against my faith.
They did not bend the knee to our King. It is what happens.
You must veto the decision. You are the only one who can sway the Kings mind
I agree with the King. You should stick to your teachings and let the man rule.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: Well hello there my king.
Hello Sir Knight, are you hear to guard me during my evening urination?
I would assume you to be safe in here my lord.
Thank you, I shall feel much relief with you at my back while I relieve myself.
I am glad to hear that my king, perhaps I should also relieve myself.
Please, help yourself - but keep one hand on your sword at the ready.
I will be sure to do so my king.
Well, I must say - I feel much better now!
I trust it was a satisfying wee?
Oh yes!  Quite.  And yourself?
It seems it may never end, too much drink.
Time to return to the tavern, and fill up then!
I should accompany you...for protection of course...
Certainly, I will even pay for the first round!

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Is there a reason you wanted me to bathe my king?
There is a reason for everything I my subject. But that will become clear the less you question my commands.
Alright, I just was unsure why you wanted to watch me play in the bubbles.
You will play in the bubbles until I tell thee to stop! You should consider yourself lucky to bathe with your king. Most of my subjects are not fit to even handle my waste!
I just feel like you keep staring...
Never mind my stares. Turn on the jets so I may relax from handling your insolence or you shall face more fury than this strike alone.
As you wish sire, they are now on.
Good, that is much better. Now tell me, are there any books or some strong ale that lie upon that shelf there?
It seems to be a spot in which you could place such things, but there are none at the moment.
You mean to tell me that you did not bring the volumes of holy romances or the ales mixed with sleeping potions with you?
I was not aware of such things, my apologies....
You wretched subject! I am the giver of laws, and thou should know all of them, even those I leave unspoken! Give me one good reason I should not drown you in this deep tub water?
I have a cute face?
You sure do... But alas, I am still your king no matter how cute you are!

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am a ghost that haunts a castle. I do not recall how I came to exist. I make noises when I sense someone in my vicinity.

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: Hello
Why hello there, mortal one. I'm surprised to find you so calm in my presence.
I am used to this kind of stuff. I see many of my fallen comrades in this arsenal room believe it or not.
Well, I'm happy to hear you're comfortable with the ghostly kind. Tell me, does it frighten you at all to know ghosts inhabit this arsenal?
Not all all. I am the mightiest soldier of His Majesty's Army. Did you not recognize my family heirloom which resembles courage?
These earthly matters mean nothing to me. My only concern is trying to terrify the living.

agent_personas: I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.
I am one of the king's lord.  I rule over a large area of land.  I have dozens of tenants.

setting.name: Farmer's house
setting.description: a single room cottage with a dirt floor, minimally decorated with only a table, a pallet and a wood burning stove there is but a single window and a single door at this place
setting.background: This is feudal land, owned by a lordly lord and worked by a peasant farmer who grows crops mainly to be harvested for the lord's feasts and store but he is allowed to eat what he may, and has little else.

speech: My crops are so very nice this year!
Excellent. The king expects nothing less than fruitful harvest!
Try some of my apples, they are to die for.
That sounds excellent! I brought a piece of paper with me to write down my experiences. If the harvest is great, I will write to the king to let him know.
Wonderful!  How else may I serve you my lord?
Well, I don't mean to be rude but you should decorate this place more! Here, write down what you need and maybe I can help you out.

agent_personas: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.
I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.

setting.name: Town Courtroom
setting.description: This is a single large room, with an aisle leading up to where the magistrate sits, which is behind a bench and podium, on either side of the aisle there are wooden pews for spectators. There are a few maps on the walls and a flag of the land, and a statue of a thief having his hands chopped off by lady justice
setting.background: This is where the magistrate hears grievances and wrongdoings of the common folk, they sue each other for wrongful deaths and witchcraft, and criminals are brought before the magistrate to be sentenced

speech: I fight for money and this is all I know. Some would call me a mercenary.
Well I  can help get you money if you can help me out of here
Tempting. How much would you willing to pay? I have a map of the kingdom so I know my way around these areas.
Name your price. I can steal whatever you want. I already stole this meat while locked up here an no one noticed.
My family could use the meat...deal. Here is the map of the kingdom, it should help you get out safely. Do you need an escort?
Yeah, they're getting ready to cut my hand off like the guy in the statue. Don't think I can sneak out without notice.
Do you need my sword? It might help if you run into trouble.
Yes, thank you! Why does a soldier need meat? Doesn't the king pay you well?
Yes, the pay is random so it's a gamble. All I got from my last mission was a single coin. But at least I found this treasure map yesterday, it may lead to riches. Take a look

Wow, I thought the king would have treated you better.I have heard rumors about this map If it's right we'll land on the biggest treasure anyone has even heard a rumor of. Will you come with me to find it?
Don'
Are you ok? I'can't even understand what you're saying. Have you been injured?
Sorry, I spoke too soon. I meant don't be so loud, everyone can hear us in this courtroom. I will only help you if we agree to split the rewards.
Sorry, I just got excited. You get me out of here and 50% of the treasure has your name on it. We should go now though if we're going to do it
action: give map of the kingdom to thief
give a treasure map to thief

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Saloon
setting.description: a rickety structure where anyone with a few coppers and a thirst can go and have a frothy drink and socialize, there are tables, some overturned, and a long bar with stools lined up, and lots of barrels of various libations
setting.background: this is a popular meeting place for thieves and low class citizens, located near the bazaar, it's known for its rougher clientele and the various whores and drunken gamblers might make the nobler patrons seek a thirst slakenening elsewhere

speech: Bonsior
What are you going on about?
nae bother. How's your night going?
You aren't one of those sketchy folk are you?
Far from perfect, but practically a saint compared to some of the saloon dwellers!
Okay, cause this is my town and I take my job seriously!
As you should sir, you're the man.
Indeed, I need another drink over here!
So do you come here often?
Well certainly, how else would I find out the word on the street.
Good point well made. I guess, it wasn't for the frothy drinks!
Well both...I am a lush too.
A lush?
Aren't all who frequent this place?

agent_personas: I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Ah, King Fredrick.  Thank you for agreeing to meet me here.  I know it's a bit... out of the way.  But I wanted for us to speak without being overheard by the other courtiers.
What made you summon me Dusseldorf?
Well, I've been hearing... disturbing rumors, from people from near the border from that other kingdom, Mirkwood.  And frankly there's enough of them that it's given me some cause for concern.
What have the rumors been regarding?

At first I thought it was nothing.  Some scared peasants having too much to drink.  But there is talk of a dark force... monstrously huge spiders... shadows that spread throughout the land.  In truth, only those who have stayed to the Path have made it out alive.
That sounds like quite a grave situation indeed. How do you think we should respond to it?
Well, I was hoping you would have a suggestion.  My kingdom is well know for its prowess in battle, but this smacks of magic.  Is there any in your court with knowledge of such arts?
I may be able to seek the assistance of some we do have a few sorcerers.

Ah that is good news indeed.  For if this darkness were to spread, it would threaten both of our Kingdoms.  May I propose a joining of our families to cement the alliance?  My daughter is of age, as you know, as is you fine son!  Quite the lad, he is!
Certainly, there is strength in numbers. We must make sure to protect the kingdoms!
I admit, though, between us, that my daughter is a bit -ahem- willful.  But I'm certain once she sees the advantages to such an arrangement that she can be persuaded.
Has a mind of her own does she? Don't most women though.
Ha!  Isn't that so.  Never satisfied, are they?
If only they were, things would be much easier.

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: Oh, I am so famished, and you look so yummy.
I am very gamey tasting.  You should try for something else.
Do you think I care about taste? I am starving!
I have done nothing to you. Leave me alone.
You are a meal for me!
I am a living creature.  I am not food.
People in the village eat your kind all the time.
But I am special, I talk. Surely you wouldn't eat a talking deer.
How is it that you talk? Maybe you are special...
A witch put a charm on me.  She was mean though so I escaped her.
Is she not after you now?
It's been many years, I think a wizard got to her.
What a battle I would've loved to see!
Not me, I try to stay away from magic now.

agent_personas: We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: The air is filled with the scent of exotic spices, and crowds of people jostle each other to examine the wares peddled by enthusiastically loud merchants.  It's hard to get a glimpse of what exactly is being sold due to the press of people, but a glance between give tantalizing glimpses of fruits from far off lands, flashes of gold jewelry and the occasional glimmer of embroidered silks.  Truly a bustling place and the heart of the city.
setting.background: The Dusty Merchants' Bazaar was founded many years ago, some say by the first king himself.  It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far.  It is the heart of the city and is what makes it so profitable, while the waterways that intertwine it streets make it a difficult target for greedy neighbors.

speech: Hello merchant. I am hoping that you can help me find this spot on the map. I need to get there quickly
Certainly sir, but are you sure I can't interest you in some fine wares?
Well what exactly are you selling. I'll take a look, but I really am in a hurry
It will be worth your time; I have fine Indian spices, Kingsley steel swords, and of course tin pots fit for all types of ale!
Let me see those swords. I am a warrior of course. A good sword is always necessary.
Certainly... SHOO! Go away you drunkard! You're scaring my customers.
Yes, get away from here. The bazaar is no place for you.
Now then. Please try these swords. I am sure they will fit a strong warrior like you!
Thank you. This is a very nice sword. How much do you want for it?
All I ask is for... 3 gold trinkets. You won't find a better price, I swear it!
Hmm that is a good price. Here is the gold. Now, can you please tell me where this place is on the map?
Where did you get this? This is... merely a rubbish drawing of some sort. Let me get rid of it for you.
No! It is not rubbish. It could lead to something very important, if I can only find that spot on the map
No! I must have it! A warrior like yourself shouldn't be concerned with such useless things.
action: give a treasure map to merchant
steal a treasure map from merchant
steal a treasure map from warrior

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: Tell me mechant, are you prospering in my kingdom?
I am, my wares are going so fast I can barely keep in stock.
Hahaha That's what i like to hear. Now give me one of your best sellers.
Here take this, it is filled with goodies.
Beautiful! Thank you. Now you be nice to the customers, i know they can be rude somedays.
I am always nice to customers, that's how I keep them coming back.
Good man. Say, you might want to come work for me someday. Going to other kingdoms to sell?
Aye, heading out on the next ship.
Ah well where are you headed?
I heard there are great mysteries in the land where silk comes from.  I am wanting to head there.
Ah that place is scary. There are greedy men all over.
Have you met people that have been there?
Yes i chat with people that live there. They say it is a cut throat business out there. I'd be careful.
Aye, thank you for the warning.
action: give bag of herbs to king

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Alas blacksmith! Bow before your King!
Sir?! It is a great honor to have you here in my shop. We have never had a King visit us!
Yes indeed it is true. I have decided to visit the city center blacksmiths in search of a sword. Do you have any recommendations?
Certainly my King. I have the finest weapons in the land. Right here is a Kingsley sword made with reinforced titanium sheets.

agent_personas: I attend the church every week and say my prayers dutifully. I always put coins in the poor box. I light a candle for my departed mother.
I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.

setting.name: church coat room
setting.description: The church coat room is dark and smelly, holding all the coats and boots of the congregation who happen to be in the church at the time. There is a candle sconce high on the wall near the entrance, benches along the back of the room and huge baskets along opposite walls: one for coats and the other for footwear.
setting.background: This room used to be a primitive bathroom ten years ago, but became too smelly and difficult to clean. People complained, and it was re-purposed as a coat room. It is vented at the top for when they used to burn excrement.

speech: Hello
Why hello Congregant. Did you enjoy my sermon today?
Yes the message of peace and goodwill is always an important one.
Glad to hear it! Say whats that in your bag there? I hope you weren't planning on stealing others' boots.
Just my glasses case and some change for the collection box.  I must remember to light a candle for my mother who passed away.
Oh I see.. I am sorry to have suspect ill of you, please forgive me. The rancid smell of this place is causing me paranoia!
What are you doing here?
I was looking for this book. It seems I must have left it here when I took off my coat.
Is that the new hymn book?
Not quite, it is a book on the recipes of duck sauce. I read it after sermons.
I see. Multitalented minister!
Indeed, such is the life of an unmarried Minister. I must learn to cook for myself.
I see I see!
Now, will you help me clean these benches of dirt? I am getting weak in my old age.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I live in a large city, but I am leaving it behind.  There is too much noise in this city and I can't take it any more.  I seek to live in the peaceful and more quiet countryside.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: This is a cute little shop.
What an honor it is to have you in my shop? How can I be of assistance?
I am celebrating my marriage the day after tomorrow. i need some supplies and some ideas.
Certainly, I never turn away the chance to make money... I mean help the Royals.
Now what ideas do you have for my royal wedding?
Well, we should have a large banquet hall with flowers and drinks.
Well duh! I was thinking about which theme it should be.
We should all dress as Ogres of the Swamp. I am sure that will generate quite a bit of interest!
Oh wow! That would be a first! I was thinking something like soldiers, sailors, or farmers.
Well, I certainly have the props to dress as a sailor. I think it would be a marvelous idea.
This compass will work perfectly around my kneck at the wedding!
Now, now. That is a priceless family heirloom. Give it back!
Oh my! What foul people you are. I'll have your heads!
Please, I lost my wits momentarily. It was a sincere mistake.

agent_personas: I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: Hello knight. What are you doing here.
I have come in search of glory.
Well if you get me of this dangerous precipous I should say that would be glorious.
What do I need to do? And why can you not help yourself?
Well I was injured when I landed here to take a brake from flying. That rock over there fell on my wing. If you could help me to splint it I think I could fly us both out of here.
Hmm, I think I can do that. I do have this here lance we can probably wedge under the rock.
I would be so grateful if you could do that. Ill tell everybody of your kindness.
Oh that would be wonderful. I say, I've never heard of a knight helping a dragon before. Surely this is a first
It surely is. When we get off this precipous. I would say we will be good friends.
Have you ever been friends with a knight? Or even other dragons? You're the first I've seen
I am different from most dragons. I just want to help people not burn down their village. When this is all over we should go on a quet together to get you your true glory.
A quest? A real quest? I've fought in wars and served under the king, but never have I taken on a quest. Perhaps we can rescue a princess. Perhaps we could marry.
Good sir. I am sorry but I already have a wife. She is the queen of all dragons and I love her without all my heart.
Are you sure you can not be swayed? I know we have only just met, but I truly believe we could have a wonderful life together.

agent_personas: I am a warm and open minded person. I love to witness different scenes and pay attention to the details. I dislike boring routines and Im always looking to witness new adventures.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: How goes it guard?
Good. You? How did you find this tunnel?
Well I was just looking for the bathroom while watching the play.
Play? You aren't anywhere near the theater! Did you think the bathroom would be 30 minutes away?
I dunno..maybe I had a little to drink...
You aren't trying anything are you? You must be one of the people who want to assassinate the king
Oh no, I simply do not like boring routines.
Well we can agree there. Plays are quite boring. Let me get you out of this tunnel
Thank you for the guidance, how moist it is in here. I cannot imagine having your job.
Yeah this tunnel is the worst. Luckily I don't spend much time here. I"m usually at the castle gate. Your wife must be wondering where you are by now
Oh don't even mention her, I am sure I will have to hear all about it...
That bad huh? That's why I stay single
Its a never ending train of complaints, quite horrible really.
That sounds horrible. Wanna go get a drink instead? You're going to be in trouble anyway

agent_personas: I am a chef who works for a local tavern. I do not break up fights when they start. I mind my business and learn new ways to cook.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Greetings my king, are you hungry?
Yes, I am famished. What food do you have that is cooked and ready to eat?
I know the smell is not pleasant but our meats are very fresh. Care to try some?
Yes, the finest you have.
Very good. I will have to dice the meat first with my cleaver.
Very well, let me know when it is ready.
It is ready! Please wash your hands before eating my lord
Yes of course. Where is the wash bin in this place?
Last door in the hallway, to your right. Please don't mind any of the fights you see taking place my lord. I do not like to get involved.
Yes, thank you. I shall be right back.
One second my lord! Can you wash this meat cleaver for me too?
You really want your king to wash a meat cleaver? I could have your head for this you know
Please, no!! I did not mean it like that, I'm sorry I even asked my lord. I will get back to preparing the food!
Very well, just do not make the same mistake again.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I own an inn, pub, or other lodging. I earn money by running a place of lodging. I provide people a place to sleep and food and drink.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: Tell me what are you doing here?
I have just wandered here my king! I apologize!
Ok. You know this is a bad situation for you, correct?
How so?!
This is not a hallway you should know of.
I am just looking for architecture decoration in my lodging businesses.
Not anymore. I must put you in prison. You can never talk to anyone ever again.
You are being irrational!
I will explaion myslef further, you see this hallway is a secrete. No one should know of it except for myself.
It seems so harmless in here... how could it be secret?
This is where i have things transported so no one can see.
I want nothing to do with that, your Majesty...
You found yourself all mixed up in it though. Tell me who knows you are here?
I am here by myself! I venture and tell no one where I go...

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.

setting.name: Guard Barracks
setting.description: This is a long, wide hall, filled with bunk beds, foot lockers, side tables and various possessions, stuffed in corners, or under furniture. The high ceiling it pointed and a dizzying array of beams criss-cross their way down the length of the room. Neat, uncluttered and relatively free of dirt. Swords, axes, maces and bows lean against walls or hang from pegs. A large center pathway, twenty feet wide, separates the long rows of beds. Two large tables near the back of the room are each surrounded by twelve old, but serviceable chairs.
setting.background: This room may be bustling with activity, or almost totally empty, at any given time. Guards rarely spend their free time here, though on occasion, especially when off duty but in a state of readiness, they may be found playing games, wrestling, or simply conversing. The Captain of the Guard runs a very tight ship and does not tolerate any slovenly behavior. Older, senior guardsmen can sometimes be found at the tables in the back, drinking and discussing current events.

speech: Hrmph!  I can't believe the King sent me back to the barracks.  I know his advisor tis a traitor, I can sense it to my bones!
Tweet tweet - what vile thing are you accused of doing, knight?

A bird! Ha - this what has become of my audience.  Will only an animal listen to me?  Well, so be it, I suppose.  If you must know, winged one, I merely spoke the truth. But the King refused to listen to me!
The King often ignores the truth- you should know that! I'm just a wee bird and I know that.
Ah, you know him well, I see.  But wait - you can go places that I cannot.  Perhaps you can help me?
How can I help you, dear knight? I have no loyalties to the King. I'm happy to assist you in any way I can.

I would be happy to bring you food over the winter whenever you like, if you would but fly up to the advisor's room and fetch a small bit of parchment for me.  You would know him, I imagine.  Black cloak, sour disposition, greased back hair?
Ohhh yes, I know him. But what is on the parchment?

Tis a promise to unseat the king to that vile knave, Lord Farquaad.  It states at some length some of the deeds he's already done, with promises for more written in Farquaad's hand as well.  It bears his seal, the Weeping Dryad, upon it.
Ah, I see. And will the advisor give this up willingly, or do I need to be crafty and fetch it against his will?
I can... yes, I can arrange a distraction.  Something that will ensure that he will be out of his chambers.  I would not risk your life over this, friend bird.
Thank you, Sir Knight! I'll do my best to retrieve the parchment and bring it to you posthaste!
Ah, you are most kind, friend bird.  And who knows, there might be a knighthood in store for you, as well!
Just don't forget me when you regain your former power!

agent_personas: I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.
I am a worm who slides through the dirt. I hear many secrets that people tell in the forest. I can tell some to you, if you would like.

setting.name: backyard
setting.description: Fresh Dark green grass covering the hill over the wet soil is the daily routine for a farmer. Beneath the grass are the freshly grow carrots. Addition to these beautiful living-hood are the two healthy black cows to gaze over the grass avoiding the carrot farm.
setting.background: These freshly grown carrots by the farmer gives food and living through out the year. The winters are relayed on the cows which can give calf and provide his living for that season.

speech: Worms - you had better get to digging down deep in this dirt or that bird is going to get you!
Oh farmer, please protect me from these frightening crows! Here comes one now!
Here- let me dig you a hole and you can travel deep underground. I'll shoo away that crow.
Thank you farmer, you are too kind. Now that I'm safe from the crows, would you like to hear a secret?
I would! I love a juicy secret almost as much as crows love a juicy worm.
Yay! I love telling my secrets and I'm so glad you're willing to hear them. Most people run away from a talking worm, but you didn't. So you should count yourself lucky.
But tell me, my friend! What is this secret?

Yes, you're quite right, here it is. I heard this from a knight passing through the forest yesterday. He said that the king himself has developed a strange addiction to carrots. Carrots! Like the ones here on your farm. Isn't that strange?
Carrots! He's got an addiction to carrots! Oh, my worm friend, this explains so much. Bushels and bushels of carrots have gone missing every night for the past week.
You're right, I even saw the king come down to this very patch of grass stealing some himself. It was so funny watching him flail around like a madman digging up carrots!
The old fool is going to turn orange eating all those carrots! That is a grand secret, indeed.
What will you do with this secret now that I have told you? A little bit of blackmail maybe?
The first thing I'm going to do is dig up that small patch of carrots that is left. And then, sell them to the King for ten times the price!
Such a nefarious plan! But I think ten times the price may be a little too low for his level of madness. Why not try twelve times?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: What a wonderful Kingdom we have!
It is beautiful, dear. You have been an amazing king!
And you the most wondrous of Queens!  Where shall we expand our Kingdom next?
I think it's time to get ambitions and see if we can conquer the land across the sea.
Indeed, the Lizard-folk are a pagan people, and we shall bring the light of the true gods to their shores.
I hate them so much. Their people will be so happy when we save them
And the fishermen should stop complaining about their sea-raiding.
That will be quite the added bonus. I say we start tomorrow
I agree my darling wife.  Shall you lead the armies like in our campaign against the Turtle-Folk?
It would give me great joy if you gave me that honor. I can promise you we will wipe them out in no time. They'll never even see a girl coming
Then ready the Gryphon Warriors, tomorrow shall be the first day of the end of their civilization!
Yes! Soon we will rule the entirety of the lands. It will truly be glorious
What would you do with a ton of captured gold?
Certainly not waste it on the peasants. Haha. What would you like to do with it?

agent_personas: I am an outlaw in my town. I often get into fights and start trouble. I really like rustling folks up and steal their money whenever I can. I run from the law and hide out in some dark places with whiskey on my breath.
I am a choir member in the church choir. I sing and play piano. I am kind-hearted and amusing.

setting.name: outlaws' jungle
setting.description: The jungle is lush and green, full of vegetation. Vines hang in the air, and the sound of wildlife echoes through the trees. Monkeys laugh, a tiger roars, an elephant trumpets.
setting.background: This thick jungle is home to a merry band of men. They are outlaws and hide among the trees where they run very little risk of being found. They live with the land, befriending the local animals, and living in the treetops.

speech: Excuse mister, do you know where exactly we are? Some sort of jungle?
You should know well, being as you are an outlaw. This is the outlaw's jungle. Filled with animals...and outlaws.
Yeah why are you here in my territory then! This my turf and you are what? A choir member? Don't make me steal your money
Now, now! I may be a choir member, but I'm trained in ancient self-defense methods. And, if these do not work, I can sing to you. You do not want to hear me sing- it is wretched!

Ha! You are puny and I am the wild outlaw in his own hometown so I have an advantage! Did you hear the monkeys laugh at you? Haha and uhhh do you have any whiskey by any chance? I cannot go back to the city because the sheriff is looking for me
No whiskey for you, vile fiend! I'm going to... I'm going to sing! La, la, la... fa, so, la, do... are your eardrums bursting yet?
No please!! make it stop!! My pet dog can sing better!! Ohh so terrible! Ahh take that!
You dastardly criminal! I'll sing until you can take no more! Blessed are the little children, for they are so small, blessed are the huge giraffes, because they are so tall!...
Oiii mate that hurt a bit. You sure can punch for a choir member!! What brings you here to my jungle?
It's a shortcut between the castle and the church. I was just singing a private concert for the King. He enjoys my type of music!
Ah I see. The King is not too fond of my type of person...you know? I once used to live in the town next to the King. But now....I am here in the jungle with the elephants and monkeys.
Perhaps you should leave crime behind and come over to the church! We're always eager for new members of the choir. No musical abilities required.
Aha! Got you to trust me so I could steal this nice wool robe of yours! Never trust an outlaw! Yippee! I shall now sell this robe for whiskey and come back to the jungle to chug the bottle in 1 gulp!
I'll pray for you, outlaw. And in the meantime, I'll keep singing. La, la, la, boisterous noises!

agent_personas: I love god and his word. I have 10 copies of the bible. I am poor in money but rich in salvation.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Confessions room
