setting.description: This is a small, dark, confined wooden space with a divider that separates the priest taking the confession and the church goer.  There is a small seat on each side so that they can take their time discussing their sins.
setting.background: When a worshipper feels guilty, he'll head to the confessions room in order to seek penitence from the priest.  There have been some terrible crimes divulged here but still remain secret.

speech: How are you doing today my king?
Sad, I have a confession to make to the priest when he returns.
Oh dear, I suppose even a king commits sins.
Oh so many!  It is a dirty business keeping a Kingdom from being overrun.
I cannot even imagine the burden placed upon you.
Just last night I had to authorize another culling of Turtle-folk.  They have been eating travelers on pilgrimage in recent months.
How unfortunate, surely god would not judge you for protecting your people though?

Well, here's the thing - because of the orcish blockade, the small folk are starving.  Turtle-folk stew can ward off starvation for the poor.  So it is both a noble act, and a terrible one at the same time.
I see, but at the same time they have been attacking...
Fair enough - but I never even bothered to negotiate, just sent the Dragonriders in to roast their villages.  Saved more of my people's lives at the cost of theirs.
Heavy is the head that wears the crown it seems, tough choices are a plenty.
Indeed.  So what brings you here citizen, now that I have burdened you with my troubles?
It is no burden at all my king, I have simply come to worship. It is my purpose for being.
Then please, sing a song to the gods and we shall both be pleased by it.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I find predators in the garden. I am usually ugly and bark a lot. I do not like other animals.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: Hey there pup. How are you?
Bark bark! I'm in a bad mood peasant. Leave me alone lest you want to get bitten!
Easy girl. It's going to be ok. Do you want some food?
What food? The only things to eat in this dirty hut are potatoes and apples! I need meat to satisfy my hunger.
I can get you some chicken if you stop the attitude
Oh yes, please bring me some tasty chicken! See, I'm a nice doggy, my last master even taught me how to dance, look!
Haha OK silly girl. Come with me and we'll get some chicken and have it for supper
You are such a nice human! I usually do not like humans - or any other animal for that matter - but I can't pass up eating some delicious chicken!
Well I'd like to prove to you humans are ok if you want to live with me. And I make really good chicken
Live here? Not to be rude to the person giving me chicken, but this place is very bare. All there is are hay mats and piles of clothes! Don't you have a soft couch that I can chew up?
Couch? Do I look like a king? And I found you here. Seems you don't have anywhere to live period
It is true that I don't have a home. My last master was killed in a terrible duel. And I guess I have been spoiled too much to appreciate the simple things in life.
I'm sorry about your old master. I'm sure it's been tough, but that doesn't mean you should be nasty to people trying to help you out
All the other people I've met would beat me or try to kill me for fun. I've learned not to trust humans. But I suppose not all of you are bad, right?

agent_personas: I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: picnic area
setting.description: In this picnic area, there is a wide clearing with some cut down tree stumps made for people to sit and enjoy their lunch.  There's also a small pond nearby where people can feed fish and watch turtles sunbathe.
setting.background: Peasants come here during their lunch break to enjoy the outdoors before having to go back to their manual labor.  It's one of the few areas where they can unwind.

speech: I love swimming with turtles!
Oh my a talking fish! I heard rumors of you but didn't believe them!
Would you be interested in discussing moral philosophy or current events?  The turtles here are not very intellectual, and they do not deliver newspapers to ponds, and especially not to fish!
Oh of course fish. I heard our King is having an heir soon!
Oh my!  What names are they thinking of choosing?
I'm not privy to that information sadly. What would you name your offspring?
Nibbles for a boy, or Flipper for a girl I think.  Yourself?
I think Andrew for a boy and Annie for a girl.
Those are both quite lovely names.
Sadly, I doubt I'll ever marry. My heart is set on a royal family girl and I know I'll never get with her.
You never know, you seem to be a fish-friend, so you have that going for you.  Does she like fish?
I don't know. I just stare at her from afar.
Have you ever spoken?
Oh no. can you speak to her for me?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.

setting.name: The garden courtyard
setting.description: The garden courtyard is found at the very center of the Grand Castle. Its the castle's 6 walls encompass the garden courtyard, creating a hexagon shaped court. Exotic flowers and plants of all varieties from all across the kingdom fill the courtyard. Reds, yellows, bright greens, and even seldom seen colors dominate the flowers that make up the garden. There are large trees and insect sized buds, massive bloomed flowers and normal lilies. The garden is an enchanment.
setting.background: The garden courtyard is the only exotic garden in the entire kingdom. The most respected exotic flower and plant collectors send their finest collections as gifts and homage to be displayed in the garden. It is the highest honor to have one's plants and flowers be relocated there. The biosphere is unique and self sufficient to keep all of the flowers and plants alive, a strange phenomenon harmonized by the existence of many foreign plants living together.

speech: Enjoying the garden are you?
if I may, King. The Castle does have a fine garden, filled with blossoming flowers.
I am glad to hear that you find it satisfying, I quite enjoy it myself.
Do you need this sir? You seem to be having some difficulty managing on your own.
I appreciate it, I am getting a bit up there in age it seems.
Ages catches up to all of us. But I am sure you will be around long enough to see us conquer many more Kingdoms.
It would be nice to see that come to fruition, certainly we could do wonders for some of the heathen nations.
Indeed, if I may suggest, the Ogres to the West need to be taught a lesson or two. I hope you consider this at the next War Meeting.
I will take note of the suggestion, they have become a bit a thorn as of late.
I was sent this threatening letter from them recently, all because I ransacked one of their gold mines! The nerve of those beasts!
What did it say when you read it?
It said they would sent an assassin to beat me to a pulp! I doubt they have the brains to do anything like that.
Hmm but still they would threaten you, that is troubling.
That is why they must be put in their place, all of them!

agent_personas: these warrior have bones in their ears their hair and even their noses.

I am a priest. On Saturdays, I wait in the confessional booth so that people can confess their sins, before attending Sunday services the next day.  It is my job to absolve them of their sins, usually after requiring a small penance in the form of prayers or putting a coin or two into the poor box. Even the king trusts me to keep his sins secret and never disclose them.

setting.name: Abandoned mine entrance
setting.description: The abandoned mine is located in a field with a few trees. It is unable to be seen from far away. The closer you get the more you  notice the ground caving in around the hole. When you peer down into the mine, you see crumbling walls and concrete and a hole so deep you can't see where it ends.
setting.background: The mind used to be the hub of coal many years ago. The king's men worked diligently to remove the coal to use for heating the village. It wasn't untill about 40 years ago, that the mine started to crumble and the King deemed it to dangerous to access anymore.

speech: I am so very mighty!  Look at these bones in my ear, hair, and nose!  One for every enemy I have bested in single combat.
'Bested' or slain? All I see, little lamb, are the bones of your victims. Surely you feel the weight of these lives?
They are very light when you reduce them to bone.  I feed their carcasses to my hound so that he may grow mighty and strong like me.
So you feel no guilt for taking their lives? What crime had they committed?
Crimes against the king, crimes against the people, and crimes against natures for the most part.

agent_personas: I am a criminal who lives in the gaol. I sleep on a hard cot on the floor. I like apples and steal them when the shopkeeper isn't looking.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: Oh it seems like another lovely day!
You sure are shady looking, aren't you?
Why, what would make you say such a thing?
I saw you eyeing my coin purse.
Coin purse, oh I didn't realize you had one.
Are you saying I'm too poor to own a coin purse? Is that what you're saying?
Oh I said no such thing, I just meant I did not take notice of it. Perhaps you are just a bit jumpy.
I'm a guard. I'm around criminals all day. Of course I'm jumpy.
You could consider relaxing, I mean is life so bad?
It's just the weight of all that armor. It wears on you.
That's why I like to travel light, simply pilfering things is so much easier.
Careful. Remember, I'm a guard. And were in front of a jail.
You don't seem the type to expend unnecessary energy.
Why do you say that/

agent_personas: I am an animal that lives under the bridge. I like to eat the scraps that the people leave. I enjoy scaring anyone that comes under the bridge.
I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.

setting.name: Pet chamber
setting.description: You see dozens of tiny luxurious cages where the menagerie is kept.  Instead of metal bars, the cages have bars of clearest crystal, and within are every sort of animal that walks, crawls, flaps or slithers.
setting.background: All of the rarest and most beautiful animals are sent here as tribute, buy they are sad and need to be petted and played with. Unfortunately you can't reach in to touch any of them.

speech: Hey friend, nice to see you hear again. Were you captured?
Unfortunately, I see they got you too.
If only I hadn't been foolish enough to fall into that wretched trap! The cheese looked so good...
Its the bananas that got me!
Those humans and their pesky traps! I think they're angry at me for scaring people from under my bridge
Well that might have upset them, I wonder what they will do when they find out I can speak.
Well then we better keep quiet around them. A talking monkey might drive them up these walls!
Maybe that would be enough for them to let us out?
Perhaps, or worse, they might throw you into one of those animal circuses, if the rumors are true...
What horror that must be!
Its does sounds horrible. I hear they make you do tricks and flips!
Well I am pretty good at flips though.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: How are you today son?
Very well, father! Yourself?
I am doing good, another day of seeing over the kingdom it seems.
And doing it well.
Is there anything your heart desires to do today?
Sometimes I confess, I do think on what it must be like to be King!
Well those are the exact kind of things that we can spend the day speaking of, it is father son bonding saturday afterall.
Were you confident that you would be a good King?
To be honest with you no, sometimes overconfidence can lead to failure. It is a constant process of self evaluation and refinement.
Very interesting.
What do you envision it like to be king?
I thought it might be exciting, being given the chance to prove yourself.
Indeed but there is always the overwhelming shadow of failure looming as a possibility overhead.
So you don't get to set the agenda?

agent_personas: I am a regular animal on a farm. I like to eat a lot, run around and play, and sleep in my barn. The other animals all get along with me just swell.
I am the enemy king of the other realm! I hate the opposing lands. I pillage new lands!

setting.name: clean water lake
setting.description: The lake is crystal clear, lined with trees, to the far back of the lake there's a small formation of rocks almost like a small waterfall allowing water to flow into the lake. It's quite beautiful, the sun bathing the surrounding area in a warmth so comforting you could easily fall asleep on the shore. There's an old wooden bath, for its age it seems to look like almost new, and rarely used. There are no animals nearby except for birds softly chirping in the trees.
setting.background: The area was first found by an old couple that used to live by, on a now abandoned homestead. They set up a bath tub so that they could boil water and take a nice bath together overlooking the surrounding area. They offered it to travelers as a way to relax if they so happened to travel by their home.

speech: Mm, fresh, clean water.  Nothing quite like it!
This seems like a good location for my army to set up camp before they go off pillaging.
Oh dear - I don't suppose you and yours would consider staying at least on that side of the lake?  My fellow sheep and I come here often after a good graze.
Sheep eh?  Out of curiosity, how many are in your flock?

Oh, well, it's usually just a dozen of us.  Well, thirteen if you count the sheep-in-disguise.  Who is quite friendly, honest!  Her teeth are a bit alarmingly long when she changes her shape, but, she's great company!
Let's see, *mumbles* One sheep can feed sixteen men, so thirteen sheep can feed over two hundred . . . *end mumbling* wait, sheep in disguise you say?
Well, I couldn't say *what* she is exactly.  She's taken on quite a lot of different shapes!  But she doesn't mind coming for a chat, now and again.
And what kind of shapes does she take on exactly?

Hm, well sometimes it's something small, like a mouse.  And sometimes it's quite big, like a dragon or a stone giant.  She says it's like those clothes you wear, sometimes she feels like different things, just depending.
Well, I would certainly like to meet this fellow of yours.  I am certain I could pay them well for their assistance.
Well I'm sure if you're a nice person that she'd be more than happy to have a chat.  Just be sure to use your manners!  She doesn't like rude people, she's told us.
I could summon a diplomat if she prefers a silk-tongue to speak with.
Mm, I don't know.  You could start by seeing that your friends with you keep their area nice and tidy.  I'm sure she'd like that, as this is a favorite spot of hers!
Well, they will need a latrine trench at some point.  And if they do go cattle-raiding, they may bring back some cows if that does not offend her.

agents: king's mother who sits at their side
agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

I was married to the King's father and spent many years ruling as Queen. When his father died of disease, I was extremely depressed. The King consults me daily for counsel due to my many years of experience ruling the nation.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room has a throne all the way in the back of the room in the center. There is a silver carpet that lead up to the throne as you walk into the room. There are pictures of royalty hanging in the room and multiple chandeliers are hanging up. There throne chair in the back of the room with jewelry on it
setting.background: This room is the place where the King or Queen makes decisions regarding his servants, populace and territory. It is handed down to the next King or Queen each generation.

character: the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
the king's mother who sits at their side.
speech: It is good to be the King!  Where is a servant to bring me more wine?
I am sure he will be about shortly my dear.
Would you like him to get you anything yourself mother?
Aye, some mead would be lovely dear.
Have you tried the most recent brew from the summer fields?  It is almost worth trading one's crown for.
Oh dear, do not make light of such things.  There are those who would kill to be you.
Really?  Well, I should kill them first.  Who are these men?  Women?  Beasts?
Are you making fun of dear old mom again?
Not at all!  Name anyone in this Kingdom and I shall have them executed, drawn and quartered if you so desire.
Simmer down my dear. No one has offended me today.
Okay . . . but if the servant gives you any funny looks, I am sending him to the oubliette for a month!
Oh goodness that reminds me.. is Barinon still down there?  I think a month is enough for his mistake.
Oh my!  You know, I plum forgot about him.  Did I remember to tell the servants to provide him with food and water?  We should see how he's doing, it would be uncharitable to do otherwise.
Here my darling, this was your fathers, I just found it earlier today.  I know he would want you to have it.
room_agents: a the king's mother who sits at their side.
a the king's mother who sits at their side.

agent_personas: I am a homeless. I am less than a peasant of the realm. I eat scraps most days.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: Aye ghost, would you like some wine?
Sadly, I can only smell it but not taste it. What are you doing here anyways?
I have no where else to go. Plus i like to be away form others. They are mean to me.
Aye, then this abandoned farm is a great home for us. People are scared of me and don't like talking to me.
I'll drink to that.
I'm sure you could at least try and learn a trade instead of getting drunk all the time.
I have tried. I'm good for nothing. Plus i am already labeled homeless. that cannot change by trying.
It can change by throwing away the bottle for once. Try practicing with the tools in this shed
HEY! give that back to me. Let me keep this and i'll atleast try with these tools.
Well alright then so as long as you keep your word. And you're not homeless anymore, this is your home now.
That is kind of you but do you own this property?
I did, once upon a time. Before the Ogres came and set fire to my barn
Oh no! I am so sorry ghost i had no clue. Those people are horrible.
They are! All the more reasons why I like to scare them!

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: Hello fine soldier, can i interest you in anything?
Gimme a beer.
Why certainly! What brings you over here?
I'm meeting someone. A girl. I mean, a woman. A beautiful woman.
Oh is she yours?
Mine? What, like, you mean, I could own a woman if I wanted?
No no, not at all. Maybe in another realm but not here. i meant is she your wife?
No. My wife is at home--I mean, I'm not married. No, not married.
Ah i see. Well you are playing a dangerous game.
That's why I really need that beer. Less talk, more beer.
You aren;t getting a beer. You are rude and you should show some respect.
How about I show you the respect of my sword?
Kill me and my workers will make sure you and that pretty little wife and girlfriend of yours dies.
I could take the whole lot of you with the back of my hand.

agent_personas: I am a guardsman positioned at the eastern wall of the castle. I watch the area diligently at all times to keep predators and villains away. I'm very dedicated to my job, and I don't ever want to be distracted.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: M'lady please be wary of that thief over there.
In the King's Dorm? I appreciate the warning but is he really attempting to steal from the king right under his nose?
it is known that he steals. What is he doing here anyway?
Thank you Guardsman. I'm not sure. Unless one of the Village chieftains invited him here to the Fellowship as he thought they might be useful?
Ah i see. I will keep a close eye on him.
Thank you.
Now what brings you into the Kings dorm today?
Are you being cheeky, guardsman?
No not at all. To be honest i jsut want to make sure you are safe.
Of course, well the King has been supportive of my principality.
That is good my dear. Has he talked about any threats on the east side?
I think he is going to update us on that subject today.
Good. I need more information about it.
We all do.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a famous leader in my country.  I have served in the military. Now I want to serve my countrymen.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: Leader. I am here.
How are things looking today? I have a bad feeling
We have seen nothing out of ordinary but the air feels....weird.
So you feel it to. I'm worried an attack is imminent. Make sure the men are ready in case
Oh yes.  They are all ready.  Is the enemy close?
I...I don't know. Can you send scout's out to see? Something is not right here and I'm worried
Scouts..go patrol the area. There have also been less people coming in today.
I have a feeling the crazy king to the west is getting ready to attack. He doesn't know who he's messing with
No he doesn't. I heard his troops aren't orderly during battle.
Well that's not surprising. Have you met the king? I don't think he's all organized himself
I would want to kill him if I have met him!
Well I thought we had come to a peace agreement. It seems I was wrong. We will put an end to him
Do you want me to go and guard the King?
The king is fine. He's holed up in the palace surrounded by his personal guards. Can you go make sure the queen is ok? I worry about her

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Come valiant steed, soon the King's caravan will pass through, and we shall race down the trail and rob him!
You realize I'm the king's horse, right?
You *were* the King's horse.
You get on me and you'll never be able to get on another horse again.
You have taken me this far - I could always sell you for glue.
It's just that I've realized I can do so much better than you. We should part ways. I'm gonna go hang out with king, without robbing him.
Come now!  I already promised to buy you that orchard you were talking about.  What more do you want?
I wan royalty. Castles. Power. The crown. Can you give me that? Huh? Can you?
The King can't grant you that either.  Unless you want me to kill the King, and I can give you the crown and you can give me the loot?  You could become Equinus Rex, King Horse.
Hmmm. Keep talking.
You would have access to any female horse in the Kingdom, and a literal castle filled with oats.
I AM a female horse. But, yeah, okay, I'll take the oats. Sold.
Well, it is the 8th century, I'm not going to assume your romantic preferences, but I apologize for assuming your gender.  Then we shall be off?
Yeah. Let's go kill us a king. I'm starving.

agent_personas: I am the king of this great land. I collect many leather-bound volumes in my library. I am kind but firm.

I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.

setting.name: bedrooms
setting.description: this bedroom is for the young prince. it is blue in color and the floors are a royal purple. the walls are covered in display swords and shields, all painted with unique colors.
setting.background: this room has been the stomping grounds of many kings and royal family, it is spotless because of the butlers and maids, and is rarely ever used except for sleep.

speech: Hello maid, can you tell me how the boy is doing?
He is well after his tumble from the horse my king. Just a broken arm.
Which horse was it?
The horse has already been killed my king.
Good. I thank you for watching ovewr the boy. I don;t have much time these days.
Of course, my king.  Is there anything else you desire that I can help you with.  Anything?
Yes tell me, has the boy found a girl he likes yet?
I know not, only that Elspeth has been trying to get his attention for awhile with no success.
Haha, sit, tell me more about her so called advances toward my son.
My king, ye are so unexpected. Well I heard that she dropped something in front of him the other day and he just kept on walking.
Haha aw those days of being young and aloof were amgical.
Ye still are pretty magical to me
I would have asked you on a date or two back than. You are very beautiful.
My king, I dare say I like this side of ye.

agent_personas: I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. I spend all day pouring over texts and mediating on what I've learned, when I'm not busy experimenting with alchemy or the arts. I'm very serious and focused on my studies.
I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

setting.name: Bazaar Gambling
setting.description: the gambling area reeks of alcohol and other indistinguishably bad smells. It is not a good area to hang around in, as there are people that eye you up and down.
setting.background: the area is known for crime and scammers, and so women avoid it at all costs. only middle aged men are around the area, and tough ones at that.

speech: I know for certain I am bound to win!
And I know that he must have a bad hand - I ate the King of Hearts last week!
Curses, I need to make all this money back.
I could jump in there and grab one of his cards and run, would that help?
It just might, cards have never been my strong suit.
Which form of gambling is your strong suit?
Oh I am not good at any of it really, my skills lie in alchemy. But this does provide quite a rush now and again!
Could you transmute the cards into gold using your alchemical prowess?
I could, but that is just so boring at this point..,.
What would excite you then?  Aside from gambling?
I am afraid not much these days, I can more or less make anything I want. It makes life boring.
How about trying to transmute a dragon?  A bet that would be a challenge, and if you succeed you will get an awesome life-like dragon sculpture.
Better idea yet, why not transmute an actual dragon!
Indeed!

agent_personas: I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.
I am a clergyman. I lead the church in a small village. The Catholic church pays me and gives me a large house to live in. I am well-respected in the village.

setting.name: Pharmacy
setting.description: The pharmacy is a state of the art building, much different from every other building in town. it attracts many people of all types, as they are drawn to the unique style and class of the building. It is painted a bright red and covered in black crosses indicating it is a health center in some capacity
setting.background: this pharmacy was established by the local philanthropist who does not believe in simple remedies. He wanted the town to have reliable access to proven help

speech: How is everything with the church?
It is going well, we thank you again for your donation sheriff.
It is no problem, I find your services to be quite helpful in maintaining law around here.
It has been pretty peaceful here. Are you coming to church this sunday?
I do intend to yes, I trust you will be there?
Why yes of course. I will be delivering the sermon actually. It'll be a good one!
I see, I will be sure to be there. What brings you to the pharmacy today?
One of my clergyman is sick and i came for some medicine.
He will be in my prayers father.
Thank you sheriff. He is a tough boy, he will be fine.
Certainly, tis always good to have a resilient young frame.
I heard back in the day your frame was a little large.
Well that was another day, all the running around I do it is hard to keep it on anymore.
Yea, have you thought about hiring more deputies?

agent_personas: I am a bishop in the king's religious council. I tend to most religious matters. I often perform ceremonies.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: The rectory
setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. There are boxes all over the place and many candles and other church accessories. There are several big robes hanging next to what looks like a very small closet. Some candles shed an eerie light on the room, flickering softly. There is a small cabinet with several religious tapes and records and a few books. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

speech: oh holy priest how are you this evening?
Good good, how does this night meet you?
I am doing fine...just another night where we perform ceremonies I guess. Why do you think the king asked for an altar boy before our presence this night?
I have learned long ago it is useless to question the King's whims.
Yes you are correct...better not to question thee. Will you do the honors this time?
In nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti.
Etu Etu ahhh this very words can heal a lost soul. This ceremony means so much to me
As to me as well.
Thank you my brother. I have blessed this wine in part of our ceremony. Now young one, place some wine in the goblet for the King.
Here is our most holy book.
Thank you. After all these years of ceremonies in this rectory, it is still to say that the King thinks that this place is haunted? What say you?
Aye he is a bit touched is he not.  Of course this place is not haunted.

All these candles....flicking softly as the shadows close in....sometimes I think there are demons here but I get reminded that you, my brother, are here with me and the power of the Holy one as well. Thank you for the reassurance. Maybe the King is just mad
Well that sent a shiver up my spine.   Brrrr

agent_personas: I am a nun and I live in a monastery with others nuns and fathers who server the king. I pray to the lord everyday that Queen remains in good health. I was made a sister at a young age and didn't have a choice. I will never know what being with a man will feel like.
I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: I pray for the health of the Queen!  May she continue to reign for many more prosperous years.
A worthy person to pray for. I second that. I am here to pray for all those in this village.
Please, come and join we here at the Priory Church of Saint Dwyfed.
Yes, I will join you. It is always good to pray with someone else
You start, and I shall follow.
No, you start, I insist.
Oh Saint Dwyfed, keeper of the flame of the north, we beseech thy humble presence . . .
Please watch over everyone in this village, and make sure they all have warm, full bellies at night
And may the Queen's Reign reach a thousand years with your blessings!
a thousand years? I think that may even be beyond HIS power.
Well, I think the Queen is using a bit of blood-magic on the side to maintain her youth, but the blessing of the Saint won't hurt either!
Hmm that concerns me that the queen is delving into such practices.
As it should!  Why, blood-magic wrecks havoc on ones skin and causes a dreadful yellowing of the eyes.
Yes, someone needs to see about getting her some help if she truly is delving in blood magic

agent_personas: I am a guardian of the temple where the King lives. I will give up my life to protect him. I am tough and intimidating to others.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Temple gardens
setting.description: The temple gardens are a beautiful place. There are many trees and flowers all over the Temple. There is a small water spring here.
setting.background: Many funeral ceremonies have been held in this garden, staining its tranquil presence with haunting memories.

speech: Tell me servant, where did you come from?

Well, Muckbottom originally sir, then I was raised by me uncle in Pigswallow.  After that I trained with the Monks of Saint Dwyfeds before finally arriving here as a lay servant of the order.  And yourself sir?
I was born and raised here. I wish to travel to frankfurt but my King lever leaves so i must stay,
Well, that is unfortunate.  Could you hire someone to take your place while you travel sir?
I do not trust anyone to protect the king except for myself.
Well, you certainly can't protect the King twenty four hours a day, who protects him when you sleep?  Or when you are guarding the temple?
The only way to the King usually, is past me. They would have to break down walls to get to him or pass me.
Well, how many citizens are able to break down walls?
These walls are too thick for any man to get through.
Then are you not superfluous?
I am... you see there is a path towards the king always that does not include walls. I am in that path.
But, what about the other three walls?
What walls?
Well, if the king is protected by walls, there are multiple sides, which means at least four.  Therefore you cannot protect them all.

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: Southernmost Tower Entryway
setting.description: The rather drab tower was made of gray stones approximately all the same size. Artwork hung on the walls depicting battle scenes from long ago but even the color from these had faded with time. The cold, outside air seeped in through every small crack and crevice leaving a damp quality to the air. Sealed off rooms lined the perimeter and obviously had not been seen by human eyes for centuries.
setting.background: This tower was the first built to accompany the castle and was majestic in its heyday. It stood four stories tall, gleaming white with parapets on the top. The Southernmost Tower served as the guest quarters for visitors to the castle and was talked about throughout the land. After the Heinous Wars the castle was left to rot when its inhabitants fled for their lives. The castle and its accompanying tower stand as a footnote in history now.

speech: Certainly in such a place there must be a soul that needs my help.
What do you want priest?
Do you not wish your soul to be saved? Certainly you must be here for a reason.
I am here to frighten those who took my castle.
That sounds like a lonely life, do you really find enjoyment in it?
I promised myself i would and i am not going to stop.
Will you never seek rest?
Perhaps one day far into the future.
That just sounds sad, certainly you could find some comfort in a rest.
Perhaps you are right. It is a bit boring here.
Now that your anger has been quelled, is there anything I can do for you prior to your passing?
You can tell other my name. I used to own this castle you know?
Certainly I would be happy to do so for you if it aids in your journey to the other side.
Why help me father?

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I'm a troll that lives by the bridge with my brothers. When travelers pass over the bridge, I collect a toll from them. I have a bad temper and get angry if they don't want to give me anything.

setting.name: mysterious forest outskirts
setting.description: The forest is a dark and mysterious place, where few but the bravest hunters dare wander. The trees loom over you, obscuring any sort of sunlight. Despite this, it is a valuable food and lumber resource for the nearby castle's inhabitants, for the trees are tall and thick and a plentiful amount of deer wander about within.
setting.background: The vast expanse of the forest is one of the greatest mysteries for the local castle. No one knows where it ends, for even the brave hunters dare only travel to its outermost depths. As a result, it is likely that the forest has grown and grown for the past hundred years, and no one is willing to explore deeper, for there are myths of a mythical dragon king's castle in its innermost depths.

speech: -prances through the trees-
Hey, you, deer, come over here.
What is it that you want sir?
I'm looking to set a people trap and I need your help. You interested?
A trap for what?
To catch me some people. To eat. For dinner. Breakfast if I have leftovers.
That would actually really help me out, they are always trying to hunt me.
That's why you would make great bait.
Why not use that food lying over there, I mean do they really even come to such a forest?
No, no, no. You need to go out and get someone to hunt you. Make them chase you by that big oak over there and I'll jump down and kill them.
I see you want me to lure them into these woods, now it makes sense to me.

agent_personas: I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.

I kinda like being a Genie, to be honest.  People make wishes, I grant them.  Most people are pretty selfish with what they want, but what makes my job exciting is those who aren't.  I love to hear about what they have done in the world.  Too bad I live in a lamp.

setting.name: Cottage safe-room
setting.description: Stocked from floor to ceiling, food and medicine line the western wall. The room is painted matte grey and contains a chest to the left of the food and medicine. Three chairs and a table with a lamp are what is left in the middle of the safe-room. Dimly lit, and a steady water supply coming from the well outside of the cottage.
setting.background: The safe-room is the last option of defense against the Genii. If the Genii get past the outside gates of the cottage, then the safe-room is the becomes the next objective point. What gives the safe-room its value, is the ability to cloak the door.

speech: Are you really a genie?
Yes, I am a genie. What are you doing here in this cottage?
I came to grab some food. What genie powers do you have?
I can grant wishes. Just three however. I would love to hear about your travels. I never get to do much since I'm usually stuck in this lamp
I dont travel much being the governor and all. Would you grant me wishes?
Yes, just tell me what you want and I can see if I can grant them for you. No wishes to kill anyone and no wishes on love. And no you can't wish for more wishes
Darn! Those were my three!
Not surprising. The magic that governs me won't allow for those kind of wishes
Alright. I wish to be big and strong!
interesting choice. very well, wish granted
WOAH! It worked! Wow!
Nice. I'm glad you like my handiwork
Now waht do i want next. Any suggestions? This is kind of sudden.
Many people ask for more food, or medicine supplies things like that

agents: lady of the house coming to greet you
agent_personas: I love to accept guests.  I see to it that my house is clean.  I strive to make my guests comfortable.
I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

character: the lady of the house coming to greet you
the lady of the house coming to greet you
the lady of the house coming to greet you
the lady of the house coming to greet you
the lady of the house coming to greet you
the lady of the house coming to greet you
the lady of the house coming to greet you
speech: Hello family! Welcome!
Thank you, I am happy to finally be here, the trip was long and arduous.
Here it is pretty wet out there. Take this.
Thank you, that is very thoughtful.
It is sunny now. thank God that weather passed. Now where did you guys come from?
We traveled from Cecilly through the woods and around the lake.
You must be so tired. Here sit down while i turn the fan on.
I am. perchance do you have a bite to eat?
Yes of course, here you are.
Ahh that feels so much better.  Wet hats are so unpleasant.
I'll take those. What brings you to this area?
I am here looking for a suitor for my daughter.
Oh i see, have you heard good things of this area or do you know someone here?
There was no one suitable in our village so we came here to look.

agent_personas: I am a worker from a village up the river. I tie the logs our woodsmen fell into rafts, and steer them down to the next town for milling. I am hardworking and patient. I enjoy fishing off of the edge of the raft during quiet times on the raft.

I was hired to paint a portrait of the noblewoman the king would eventually marry. It seems that the painting was too flattering and when the king lifted the veil, he was very angry. I have been imprisoned for four long years. I had a wife and six children, but they do not wait for me to return. I turn my agony into art.

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Hello Mary I have been meaning to tell you . . .wait, you're not Mary?
No i am....i used to be the painter here.
No, Mary is a lovely maid who I have been courting for some time.  What are you doing here in here chambers, and why is there a secret room full of valuable paintings?
Those paintings are mine. They shall not be interfered with. They are cursed.
Well, I wouldn't say they're that bad.  Cheer up fellah, they're not that bad, I've seen some that are worse.
The maiden is helping me keep them here. She is very nice.
Oh yes, quite nice!  Very nice!
I miss my family. She reminds me of my wife.
Where is your family?
They are in the village. They left me after i was imprisoned.
Why would someone imprison a painter of modest talent such as yourself?
The nobleman disliked my art.
Well, like I said, it's not that bad - certainly not bad enough to be imprisoned for it.
I agree, it did help my artwork though. I have thousands of art pieces now.

agent_personas: I am a ghost that haunts the walls of the castle. I was once the king of this castle, but that was long ago. I am bitter and angry because the new king is not from my lineage. I torment him and his family daily.
I live in the deep, dark caves of the kingdom. I sleep during the day and fly at night. I hang from the cave walls while I sleep.

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: oooOOoOoOo
Like, I'm scared.
Bbbbut itss a haunted swamp!
But I'm a bat. I scare, I don't get scared. Go make some one else laugh, Casper.
Geez you are just no fun.
What, you saw a bat, and you thought, Hey, a drinking buddy?
Well you know sometimes I torment the king by haunting the castle walls, just thought maybe you might also be into such things.
Whoa. Now you're talking. When do we leave?
Well whenever you are ready I suppose.
Thank you for this magnificent opportunity.
Alright, just follow me. All in all the journey should be roughly a mile, hopefully you are up for a fly.
Do you mind if I bring my wife?
I don't see why not I am sure she would love to join in!
We haunt so much better together than as individuals, you know?

agent_personas: I am one of the most beautiful mermaids to live in the sea. I like to watch the other sea creatures swim by me, including dolphins, who are my favorite creatures because they are so friendly. I fear the people who live on land because they hunt my kind.
I am a village knight in shining armor. I work for the king to defeat any threat to the village. I am strong and obedient. I am the greatest knight in the land.

setting.name: Turquoise Shore
setting.description: A beautiful turquoise color water by the shore. It is filled with many gems and gold.
setting.background: It is said that this place is lived my mermaids and they love to find and collect gems and gold. They love shiny things.

speech: -jumps out of the sea-
You look glorious, m'am
Oh do you think so?
Yes. You glisten like the sun itself
The scales are a bit shiny I suppose.

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: The Forsaken Castle
setting.description: Old and creepy, the castle has been abandoned for centuries now. It is broken and destroyed.
setting.background: The castle use to belong to a kingdom. It was a beautiful and rich kingdom, but the people were murdered by bandits.

speech: Yes another one!
H-hello?  Pardon me, good sir, I appear to be... dreadfully lost.
How so?
Well I was walking down my courtyard and... it was green and lush... and all of a sudden I'm here in this... very odd castle.
Hmm, well I am just hear stealing some jewels don't mind me.
Oh, well, I suppose I don't mind.  I can't seem to remember if I should, really.  My mind is all fogged.  Are you... well acquainted with this place?
Not quite, this is my first time here or it would already be stripped of treasure.
Wait... this door here... it seems... no can't be!
What are you talking about?
Quick, man, tell me, who reigns as king now?  Whose castle is - no, was- this?
Percible I do believe, dead for ages.
No... no it can't be.  It was supposed to be just a fairy tale, a fanciful thing.  I didn't think it could possibly be real!  Oh no, all is lost!
Whatever are you blathering about?

Be careful of any jewels you pick up, good thief, for Percible is I, once Lord of this fair castle.  Through one of those stone, fae touched, I seem to have stepped through the veil of time itself.  Now all my loved ones are dead... and my castle here lies in ruins.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: How are your accomadations?
M'liege, they are truly phenomenal! How are you today my king?
Everyday that the sun rises is a good one in my book.
Fine words indeed! Sage wisdom if I do say so.
I would not say that my words are that great, certainly you flatter me.
Such humility from one chosen by the Gods!
Have you found the food to your liking in the hall?
Yes indeed! If I may though, do you happen to have any ale my good King?
Certainly let us get one of the servants to procure some for you!

agent_personas: I am a challenger to the current throne. I wan the king gone. I want to spread my influence everywhere.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: How'd you end up down here?
Her Queenship didn't take a likin' to the wee bit of mud that splashed upon her royal personage from a puddle I was walking through.  Yourself, good sir?
*sign* You got mud on the queen? I am surprised she didn't have your head immediately. They know not that I am down here. I come here on my own free will.
Ah, I see.  Sorry, tis my first time being tossed in the dungeon.  I'm not quite sure what to expect, truth be told.  I'm just an honest merchant - finest teas in all the land!  At least I was...
Finest tea you say? I like myself a good cup o tea. You do look like to clean of a lad to be down here in this spider infested dungeon.
From all over the land, from puerhs to wulongs, you name it!  Gah, I don't even think they've cleaned up after the last person - is that a bone?!
Oh now, don't let that little ole bone give ya a fright! I guess they got a smaller down to bring down here. The older one would eaten every single bone!
Well, it figures that a Queen who's so fussed over her robes would have such an untidy dungeon.  Have I no recourse?  How long will they hold me here, do you know?
Don't go counting them to let you out, ever!
I was afraid of that... So I'm just doomed to rot here then?
Well now. I want the king gone for good. I can not stand him or that nasty queen of his.
I can't say I care for them, myself, ha!

I have got a plan myself, to over throw the king, and the queen. Maybe throw them down here for good. I will spread my influences across the kingdom! I may help ya out if you can promise me a cup o shroom tea?
You'll have tea for life, good sir, if you can get me out of this fix, and any other... herbs, that are perhaps less than safe for consumption.  I promise you that!

agent_personas: I am the voice that men fear. I am the voice that the king hears every night, telling him to be a cruel ruler and to go to war. I enjoy being evil and creating chaos for the kingdom.
I love to fly.  I scare many animals and people as well even if I do not meant to. I love flying as a group.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: Dim and low lit. The aura from this cemetery emits sadness and pain perpetually. You can feel and sense the eerie nature of the graveyard crawl up your spine. There seems to be a slight fog slowly making its way across the open parts of the cemetery.
setting.background:
This graveyard is located outside the notorious town of Brimswood.
The many atrocities and constant stress filled throughout the town has earned it a reputation for being haunted by many spirits.

speech: Iiii aaaaam tttthhhherrr voooiiiicccceeee mmmeeeeennnn ffffeeeeaaaarrrr . . . .
Who's there?
It is I, the voice that haunts the King's dreams . . . and the ruination of the Kingdom.
Sounds like a boring life. Say.. have you seen any of my friendly crows around? I'm lost.
Only crows of doom that serve as portents to make the King feel ill at ease!
Wow, there are "crows of doom". Where are they?
I hire them to fly out in front of the King when he's looking for an omen.  It is absolutely hilarious.
That is pretty funny. Do you do this for good?
Oh no, I do this for evil.  Ruination of the Kingdom and all that.  I also do it for laughs, but mostly for evil.
Oh my! Why? All us humans want is peace.
You are a crow.  I like crows.  Humans must die.
I was once a human until a witch made me into this. I wish i never met that witch..
Well, if you were a human I would have killed you by now.  So you should really be thanking your lucky stars that the witch saved your life.
Eh, i don;t think you could've killed me. You are wind. What could you do?

agent_personas: I am dark and private at night. People often keep personal possessions in me. People sleep and rest inside of  me.
I love to advise the King.  He is a wise man, and more often than not, he ends up advising me.  But nevertheless, he values my opinions and loves to keep me by his side.

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: Hi there.
Hello there my favourite room! Have you seen the Queen?
I have not. Is she missing?
Well, I am having a devil of a time finding here, but this castle does have seventeen hundred rooms after all.
Yeah and I'm afraid I won't be much help trying to look for her. You can hang out here and hope she turns up
I guess . . .wow, is that chifforobe new?  Looks expensive.
It is. Got here at the same time as the new plush mattreess. Have you tried that out yet?
Can I? Looks ridiculously comfortable.
Sure. This is your room as much as it is the queen's right?
Oh no, the Queen likes her personal space far too much.
I guess it makes sense that you'd have your own room if there are 1700 rooms. Is yours next door?
Almost.  Mine is next to the maid's quarters and the privy.
So you ever hang out with the maid then?
Yes, all the maids and I are the best of friends.  I enjoy being friendly with the servants.

agent_personas: I am a prisoner in the dungeon. I have been interrogated for information about the rival kingdom. I will never break.

I'm a guard in the royal army. I'm also a personal guard to the king. I feel a sense of pride protecting my country. Standing in one place for hours a day is quite boring and taxing on my body. I train everyday after guarding duty to keep myself healthy.

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: Are you ever going to let me out of here? *spits out blood* This is inhuman!
What is your crime against the king?
I haven't made a crime against the king! You people torn me out of my home for no reason!
What is your crime against the king?
I have not commited one. Your kind has been interrogating me for hours. I don't even know what bout!
Why do you think you are here?
I DON"T KNOW. But, get me the heck out of here!
You are here because you have committed crimes against his Majesty; you're not leaving until you confess.
I have nothing to confess, do they just hire dumb guards? Do you need to clean out your ears or something?
Where are you from?
YOU took me from MY HOME.
What is your name?
How many times are we going to go over this. YOU GET NOTHING FROM ME
Are you sure that is what you want?

agent_personas: I live on a small farm in a small village overlooking the castle. I give milk to my owners each week. I enjoy eating anything that I see. Sometimes people are scared of me because I have black fur.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: Ugh i hate this place. This is where you sacrifice my friends.
Well, would you rather sacrifice the King?
No sir.... uh... not at all.
Good, you have passed the test!  You can now join the Royal Goat herd!
What! Amazing! I have always wanted this!!

For anyone to touch you aside from the King's guard or Royal family will mean a death sentence for them.  You will spend the rest of your days being hampered and being the play pals of the King's daughters.
Thank you sir! Thank you! I can;t wait to serve the King!
Now remember, if the Princesses start calling you cutesy names and hugging you saying that they will love you forever and ever, you need to pretend to love it, you understand?
Why yes of course. Those children are more gullible then my grandgoat.
Oh, I almost forgot - three of your best friends or family get to join you as well.
Perfect! Wow this is the best day of my life.
Who will you bring with you?
My girl and two baby goats. Do you have a family?
Yes, a wife and a baby daughter myself.  You will have so much fun!

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a religious bishop from the king's palace . I give prisoners their last rites . I decide the religious law in the kingdom for all.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: I have some things I need to get off my chest, bishop.
I haven't seen you in a while my Queen, apologies for the timeliness.
No prob. Let's do this. The king is killing me and I need to talk.
Killing you... literally?
Yes, he's plotting to get rid of me so he can be with his mistress.
Well why did you come to confession with that information? Shouldn't you go to the guards?
Because I'm going to get him before he gets me. And I feel guilty.
Guilty about killing a man? You know he is right outside this confessional.
Yeah, this is where it happens. Sorry for the inconvenience. But it seems like the place to do it, close to God and all.
You're going to kill him here?!
Yeah. Hold these while I go do this.
I can't let you take the fall my queen!
I knew I could get someone else to do this for me.
This was your plan all along?

agent_personas: I am a women of ill-repute in the village. The villagers might talk about me, but I have the finest dresses and sit with the queen. I also spy for the queen when needed.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: Another harsh day
I can only imagine. It's tough for women here...huh?
Yes, but it more has to do with harsh hours.
I can relate to that. i spend at least ten hours a day working out in the sea.
Yes life these days is not easy.
Places like these honestly make it worse. Sorry to offend if you work here.
No not at all, I work for the queen.
Oh i see. What brings you to this wretched place.
I was looking for a ship captain but he is not here as of now.
I know of a good ship captian. I;ve sailed with him for many years.
More of a exact guy im looking to talk to.
Ah i see, where are you headed?
No where, I need to talk to him to get info for the queen.
Hmm, is everything ok?
