agent_personas: I am a princess taken from a far away land. I've spent my life looking at the world from the top of my tower. I wait for the day when I will finally be free from my prison.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: Why do you disturb me king? Haven't you caused enough harm?
Harm, what harm have I caused you child?
You kidnapped me and locked me up in this prison an for what?
My dear, I have the witched locked up - did your sisters play a prank on you again?  I really must get them to stop, this is getting out of hand.
You stole me from the kingdom to the north to get back at my parents! I assumed you'd have me marry the prince but you never were good enough to have a son
You are my daughter child, and I love you dearly.  Have you been bewitched?  I say, you there witch, unbedevil my daughter at once!
The witch is my only friend. Together we'll get out of here someday and you're going to face my wrath!
There there my child, I will get the wizard and we will get you back to your regular self, I promise.
Get away from me you foul man! Where is the guard? He will tell you I'm right. he's been watching me for 12 years
Hush little one.  Hush little darling don't say a word, pappa's going to buy you a mocking bird . . .
Stop touching me. papa's going to buy me a diamond rihg?
As many diamond rings as my daughter wishes.
What did you do to me witch?!
That's my girl!  Would you like a pony as well?

agent_personas: I am a groundskeeper at the castle.  My job is to keep the King's land immaculate.  I have worked here for many years, since I was a young boy.  I do hard labor.
I am the son of the King and Queen. I am being trained to take over ruling the kingdom one day. I can do what I want and no one can stop me.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: My good sir, what are you doing here, this place is not meant for royalty!
I am the prince, I do whatever I want! And you can't do a thing about it you old grounds keeper!
I would never dare to tell you to leave, i am just suprised. Are you not scared of this place?
Me, scared? Ha! You fool! I'm not afraid of any ghosts! If they come at me, well, I shall take this rock and send them crawling back into one of these graves here.
Haha you are a brave prince. You will do well when you rule over the land.
That's right, I shall rule with bravery and get even more riches than my father! Now, as your prince, I have an order for you.
Ugh, what do you want.. i have beena t work all day.
I don't care if you've been at work for three weeks straight! If you don't listen to me, I shall tell my father that you tried to kidnap me.
Im sorry my prince!
That's right, grovel before me. And when you are done grovelling, I want you to dig up a corpse for me.
Which one sir?
That one, over there with all that whispering and dancing shadows. I'm sure it is the grave of a demon. I want to do battle with one!
Are you insane? That demon is the strongest of all demons! It could wipe out humanity?
I'm ready for him. If I can't defeat this demon then I have no right to rule my kingdom. Let me remove my robe, and then I shall be prepared for battle.

agent_personas: I am a mage from with a long white beard. I concoct magic spells of my own. I am a practitioner of the dark arts of magic.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Come horse we have places to go!
Of course my mage, are we headed into the castle?
Yes, we have an important audience with the king.
What is going to happen in there? I won't be able to go and listen.
Something about the prince being turned into a frog again.
Will you have to turn him back?
It would seem so, I always get called in for this.
It is quite the sham you have going, he hasn't figured out you're the one turning him into a frog?
A mage has to earn a living, just shush and act oblivious.
I'm right there with you, it gets me the good hay!
As long as we stay on the same page all will be fine!
I agree with you, can I get some extra carrots this time? Tired of eating this foliage that's out here.
If that is what you want, we will have plenty of money after this time.
How many more times are you going to do this?

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
Killing for a living puts things in perspective. It makes me appreciate life more. I would gladly annihilate all living beings for an appropriate fee.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: What are you doing in the Dungeon?
I came to see if my target is here. This makes for a good place to hide.
Who are you targeting?
Do i have to tell you sir. I like to keep my targets a secrete.
Am I your target?
No sir, i would be foolish to accept you as my target.
How do I know if you're telling the truth?
You aren;t dead sir.
Not yet.
WHy would i waste my time with this discussion than?
Because I'm a very prominent figure in society. Lots of people love me and lots of people hate me and want me dead.
Well you are a hard one to find.. i'll giove you that..
Thank you for putting the sword away. Puts me a little at ease.
No problem sir. Now why are you here?

agent_personas: Mother and father insist I attend classes so that one day I can become king. I hate the classes. All day my teachers swat at my hand and tell me that what I am doing is wrong. I intend to leave.
I am a demon. I possess people to lead them away from God.  Sometimes priests try to exorcise me but I don't like that very much.

setting.name: Inside a desolate cave
setting.description: The dungeon exists inside a dark cave. Enchanted torches light the cave up and lead the way to this ancient dungeon. Creatures can be seen populating the dungeon, but it is unknown if they are malevolent or benign.
setting.background: The dungeon is believed to have been created by ancient nobility with the aid of wizards. The dungeon was likely a prison for powerful enemies of the kingdom who may break free of traditional prison captivity by force or magical abilities.

speech: Hi demon.
Hello my child. How are you today?
Four hundred and two.
I know you're possessed but did your brain stop understanding words too?
I'm not possessed. I'm a child demon. Aren't I cute for a demon? Jealous?
Nah I'm just happy you have turned away from God and joined me on the right side of history. Now we must go out and spread out ideas
Sure. When do we leave?
Now. Do you want to start with the kids or the parents?
The parents. We'll start at the top and work our way down.
Excellent. I think Timmy's dad will make a great starting point. He seems like a moron easily corrupted. Does that work for you?

agent_personas: Rawr. Roar, growl roar roar roar. Snarl growl, roar, growl roar. Roar roar roar. GROWL!
I am the overseer of the castle. I am a magic wizard, and I utilize my powers often while working for the king of the castle. I am a mighty, wise person but mostly friendly.

setting.name: Underground Chamber
setting.description: This location is very gloomy, damp and magical. Has a lot of geodes and various types of crystals.
setting.background: Not just anyone can enter into this underground chamber because it is guarded by mystical lions.

speech: *RWAWR!*
The summoning worked!  Fluffy, is that you?
....this is a bigger body than I'm used to. What's happened to my dainty little paws?
You are huge!  I can't believe it worked!  I swapped your body with that of a cat from the heavenly plane.  You can probably fly.
How am I supposed to get out the cat door now!? Or sleep under your writing desk! Oh nooo....

Well, you can now fly in via the balcony . . .  and I suppose I could also increase the size of my desk . . .which means increasing the size of my chamber . . . which means increasing the size of the castle . . . I'm not going to lie, it may be a little while.
So, is that me over there....? Trying to fly off that table? Is there a heavenly cat brain in my body right now?!

Yes, you can see yourself in the mirror, and no, the heavenly can brain in in your old body in the heavenly plain.  You are now able to summon your own food, as well as magically dispose of you litter box, as well as cast nighttime sunbeam above your head while you sleep, even when inside.
This all sounds reallllly complicated. What if I just want to go take a nap out in the field?
You can certainly do that as well!
And no one's gonna bring pitchforks to greet the sleeping GIANT ASTRAL CAT?
Nope, though if they do you can turn them into tasty fish treats.
I think you're overestimating the tolerance of some of these towns folk.
Well, you can turn the entire town into fish treats for all I care.  I only care for my pussy-wuggums!

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am a unicorn hunter who is very brave and loyal . I travel around the world looking for unicorns . I eat unicorn meat and take the horns for magic.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: I sure am glad to see you, we need to exterminate these unicorns!
Indeed, just look at all these gody rainbow colors! Now, where are they?
They must be hiding here somewhere, find them!
I can smell them, they've got to be close!
Look for the confetti sparkles fluttering in the air!
There is glitter EVERYWHERE
It is such a horrid place...it gets everywhere...
In places you didn't even know you had! We will have glitter coming out of all ends for the rest of our days.
That is why we must see an end to the unicorns!
I have hunted unicorns my whole life. Yet I have never stumbles upon their palace. They must have extra magic here.
It would not surprise me in the least, they are crafty creatures.
I wonder what we could find here. If there is anything of more value than their horns!
Who knows, as far as unicorns go this is unexplored territory
I can not wait, to feast upon their meat. I think I see one!

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

I'm an Egyptian currently working with my people. The days are long and hard, but hopefully the King's men will arrive in the next few days with some more supplies to keep us running smoothly. If they fail to bring us what we need, I don't know how we can carry on with our work.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: My loyal egyptians, tell me what is your business inside of my palace today.
We have come to see if we may dine since the supply boats have not yet made it. What say you, oh Glorious Pharoah?
Oh I love how you foreigners call me Pharaoh. For your flattery, I shall allow you a meal. Please, sit at my golden table and take your share of the food that lies upon it.
Thank you, o gracious king. Our construction goes well. No one will be breaching our wall any time soon
As it should be. But hold on for a second. Something seems off, but I can't quite tell what it is.
Well I have no sense of it, your grace. Should I be concerned?
Your faces... They are not painted gold. And your clothes... They are laborer's garb, not the fine gold lace I have ordered my subjects to wear.
As you said, I am a foreigner. You require this queer tradiiton of guests?
It is the law for all of my subjects. And once you are inside the walls of my empire, that is what you are. Now, I shall retrieve a set of gold cloth to be fitted for you.

agent_personas: I am a camel of the desert near the kingdom. I carry travelers. I am of the king's royal court of animals.
I became lost while traveling to the castle market to sell my goods.  I do not often travel away from my small village.  I am afraid that bandits will find and rob me.

setting.name: Oasis
setting.description: An impossible relief from the sweltering heat, the Oasis sounds like the fevered dream of a dying traveler.  A cool, refreshing spring of water surrounded by palm trees is tucked away from prying eyes, with a single tent set up from a traveler long past.  A lost traveler may find themselves there in their time of need, their thirst slaked by the crisp and impossibly cool water.
setting.background: Although the oasis stands out, anybody who has seen it before would struggle to remember where.  The oasis seems like a slice of heaven gifted by the gods, to answer the prayers of the lost.  Many who stumble upon the oasis are known to have a change of heart leading to a more pious life.

speech: Hello traveler. Where are you headed?
I am off to market, hoping to avoid the bandits.  Do you know this desert well camel?
Why yes i do. Do you need a ride? I'd have to check with my king to see if i can help first though.
That would be wonderful, I can pay you in fresh fruit when we get to market.  By the way, what do you know about that genie?
She can grant wishes. but if you word them incorrecctly it can have horrible consequences.
Hmmm . . . that seems like trouble.  Has she granted you any wishes?
No i don;t ahve the bravery to do that. What would you wish for though?
Well, a magic carpet would be nice wouldn't it?  No more hot sand when travelling?
Haha see a magic carpet could mean many things tot he genie.
Such as?
Well there is dark magic and regualr magic. You could get either.
What would be the advantages or disadvantages?
The advantage is you get what you want. The disadvantage is that you could be locked in a small box for eternity.
Well how does one get from a magic carpet to that?

an a genie from a lamp

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Tell me knight. Are you ready for another war?
I am always at the ready my king!
Good we shall go to war here soon. I am tired of listening to the complaints from the peasants. I want to fight
Why are they complaining to you my king?
They keep saying how the wealth is not spread out enough,
As if somehow that would make things better, do they not know that makes the people complacent.
It is very annoying. Do you smell that?
What is that smell?
Its Pie! OH MY! yes! lets go get some!
I dare say, I do love pie.
How could you not, it is splendid!
Do you know what kind of pie it is, my nose does not work the best?
It smells liek cranberry. i know these things.
You must have quite the nose for pie sire!

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: Well imposter, we finally meet.  You have lived your last day as a king.
In my mind it is you who is the imposter!
Of course you would say that!  Give me that back!
If you were half the king I was this would never have happened!
The queen will be able to tell who is the real king.  And that king is ME!
But we are identical!
Of course we are not!  You do not have the memories or the experiences that only the queen would know about.  Admit it imposter!  You are finished!
The magic used on me has made me a perfect replica, no one would be the wiser!
So you admit it!  Now to take you to my master at arms.
You will have to best me first if you can.
No need for me to take undue risks.  *gasp*  I am afraid I am not used to this physical activity.
Perhaps if you didn't eat the pies all the time you would not be so winded already.
It is the king's right to eat the pies!  *oof*  Let's make a deal.  You can be the king on weekdays and i will take the weekends and holidays.
I would say that would be fitting, at least then I can work towards bettering the kingdom, as that is all that I really desire.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: Ah! Guard, there's a rat with murder in his eyes in our midst! Please protect me!
Calm down, he seem rabid indeed, but I will protect you.
Oh thank you sir. You are a noble man, as strong as the metal that holds these doors to this tower, and as brave as any knight.
Yes indeed, I am brave and strong. Though I already knew that. Usually servants aren't so talkative.
Yes, I usually keep my mouth shut and take everyone's orders without a word of complaint. But you see, I haven't seen my family in a very long time and it is really getting to me.
Why have you not seen your family? You are but a young one.
My master is a cruel one. He separates servants from their families so as to break our spirits. That is why I have not seen my wife or three children in over ten years.
Well, he used to get un faithful servants. But still that is no way to treat someone. Your family must be worried about you.
Aye, indeed they are. But say, kind guard. Do you think that you may be able to help me see them, even for but a brief hour?
It is my duty to protect the king, so may he will listen to me if I ask. But, he doesn't like people leaving his kingdom.
Yes, you are right that the king may be very angry if he were to discover me. But though I am illiterate, I think something of a clever plan is forming in my head.
Now, before you do anything drastic, let us not just ask the king if your family could come the kingdom?
No! We can't ask the king! He will hobble me for even thinking about leaving. You leave me no choice, I must break out of here once and for all. But first, I'll need your shield.
A man, after his family. I will no chase you. Good luck.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am the son of the king.  I am the rightful heir.  I will marry a princess.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: Oh you startled me! What can I do for you prince?
Nothing in particular guard, how is your shift going?
It is pretty boring to be honest. Not much of anything is happening out there.
In some ways that is good, though I can see how that might make it boring for you.
Oh indeed it is good. It is my duty to protect the king.
I am glad to see that you take your job so seriously, it is always good to have faithful guards.
But of coarse. I was sworn in to this role. I will protect the lord till I die.
Thank you for your service guard.
You are of the upmost of welcomes! I enjoys my job, even though at times it is boring up here in the lookout tower
Is there another place you would perhaps prefer to patrol?
No, no. As long as I am protecting your family, I am happy.
Ah, I had simply thought perhaps you might enjoy a different station.
I appricate the though sir.
Certainly, I am always willing to think of those who would think of my family.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

speech: Hello Darling! Taking a stroll out in the gardens as well?
Yes, It's such a lovely day. Do you like my new dress?
It suits you well and brings out the hazel color of your eyes.
Thank you dear. You are looking great as well today. Will you come sit with me next to the fountain?
Certainly, my darling. How was your meeting this morning with the neighboring diplomat?
Things seemed to go well. We should know in the morning if his king will accept our offer or we will destroy him in war. I'm confident he will accept
He has no other choice but to accept! It would be madness to come up against our mighty forces! And against your charming persuasions.
Thank you dear. I assume the meeting with the generals went well and we are prepared if the worst should happen?
They have been briefed to the fullest extent that I would allow. None of them know the real reason for these negotiations, and I think it best things stay that way.
Absolutely you are a genius as always. Are our sons ready? This would be their first battle
Ah, Thomas is still hesitant. He is still skittish around the horses.
Maybe he can go out with the ground troupes and Peter can go out with the knights. Wouldn't hurt to have 1 in each division
The men do look to our Royal Family in battle as a sign of encouragement. I have always assumed horseback was the proper place for them.
That makes sense I just don't want Thomas to freeze during a battle and something to happen to him

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a goddess. I make others bow before me. My commands are always followed and life is very easy. My servants protect me and give me everything I want. My powers of seduction have no limit.

setting.name: The Sacred Temple
setting.description: The Sacred Temple is where spiritual individuals go to worship the Gods.  It is massive in size compared to other buildings in the town.  A lot of ancient symbolical artwork covers the windows and a deep glow comes from the alter.
setting.background: The Sacred Temple has been around for more than the present local townsfolk can remember.  They also swear by it's powers on granting their wishes if worshiped correctly.

speech: A blessed day it is Goddess.
Oh, I think I can be a better judge of what is blessed and what is not. What brings you to my Temple?
I am here to pray for assistance.
Go on and recite your prayers; I am listening.
Please bring aid to my kingdom, we are starving and need rains to survive.
Dear King, how long has it been since you have last set foot in my Temple?
It has been many a month, I have been so swamped with keeping my people from dying with the beastmen attacking and all.
It has been far longer than you realize. The last I saw you was many moons ago beseeching me for aid in your crusade against the people to the North.
If we did not attack they would have wiped us out a mere month later.
And the time before that was begging for the animals to return to the forest so that your hunters could partake of their flesh. When, King, will you come before me with something to give?
This helps not me but my people, I will even give up being king if you help my nation.
You come to take and take with empty promises in return! Your understanding of what is "helping" only goes so far!
I will leave and never return, I will deal with this myself even if I need to give my life.
Your arrogance will be your downfall. In time, even a King will need to learn the ways of humility.

agent_personas: I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!

I am a local peasant and I live in a village on the outskirts of the castle. I work twelve hours a day for no money. Being a villager is hard and dirty work. I do enjoy spending time with my family when I can.

setting.name: Riverbed
setting.description: With clear air and the sound of gurgling water near it, the river bed is silty and muddy. The river rushes by the land as more and more dirt separates from the land. The land of the riverbed slick with mud and filled with bugs and worms/
setting.background: The riverbed is where the village people come to collect water to drink. The women come early in the morning with their baskets to collect water for the whole family. Later, the men come and catch fish, for the evening meal. The children follow their mothers to the river and play in the river while the mothers chat and collect water.

speech: -climbs around the leaves-
Hello
Good day!
This riverbed is so peaceful, all the bugs and animals can roam freely and work like a slave! I wish was as free as you!!
Are you not free in your own right?
Not really, I work twelve hours a day and I don't get paid anything.
Not even food?
Nope, nothing. Is that crocodile your friend?
Not a friend really, he does not seem to bother anyone though which is nice.
Well, my break is almost over so I might have to go work. Are you hungry or anything? I got a few pieces of worms on me
Ooo that would be nice, one day if I ever become king of the bugs I will reward you for your kindness.
Sounds goods, here you go buddy.
Thank you very much!
No proble, I'll stop bugging you now! Someones got to do the dirt work around the castle

agent_personas: I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.
I am new to the king's army.  I am a peasant.  I am afraid of war.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Zinney! come join me for dinner
Oh! Uh, yes of course Your Highness!
I'm sorry, Did you and Ulmer have plans? you seem mad I interrupted
Oh! No no no no no, Your Highness! Sir! Uh...gah...I'm no good at talking to superiors...
Relax. This isn't a formal thing or anything. I mean I'm wearing a robe!
Yes, but....King in a robe is still a King after all.
Fair enough but this was more of a personal matter. As you know I'm looking for a queen. I was wondering if you knew any women that might be interested.
I uh....welll....gosh, uh has the Royal Matchmaker not found a suitable bride for you, Your Highness?
Unfortunately no. There are plenty of women that want to marry me so they can be queen but I wasn't someone that actually want to be with me. I guess I"m weird like that.
That...that seems fair, Your Highness. A Queen would be someone you would have to spend a lot of time with.
Yes, I'm sorry I've made you so uncomfortable. Call Ulmer over here and enjoy your dinner and just pretend I'm not here. I won't be long
No, no! It's....fine, really. Your Sirness. High! Your Highness! ...gah...
You're hilarious soldier. How is your wife doing?
My wife is well. She keeps telling everyone how proud she is of me. Or...at least how proud she is that I enlisted...

agent_personas: I am a lady in waiting. I attend the queen. I am the queen's assistant. I keep track of the queen's appointments and schedule. I wear elegant dresses. I am quiet and reserved during official occasions.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: Can I do anything for you, king?
Yes, dear lady, there is indeed. I need to find a very specific book in this library.
No problem, sir. What's the book?
I am not exactly sure. There is an old prophecy that speaks of this book. But the prophecy did not give a title or author, only this location. I wonder what it could be.
I can try and find it. Hopefully I can. There's a lot of books that feature old prophecies.
Wait, what is this parchment that lies around here? I feel a strong attraction to it for some reason.
Oh that? That parchment speaks of the history of the best stories of our time.
Best stories of our time? The prophecy spoke of such! You are incredible, thank you for this wonderful clue!
Just doing my job, sir. By the way... how is the Queen doing?

Yes, of course you are. It is upon such obedience that my empire was built. Despite all my courage, I would be nothing without my loyal subjects. As for the queen, she sits there upon the maroon carpet. You may ask her yourself.
I wasn't sure. She's been a little quiet towards me lately. I wasn't sure if she disliked me lately for some reason.
Here, hold this and see if it leads to any new clues. I shall speak to my wife.
Sure thing, sir.
Lady, come over here! Quickly!
action: give parchment to lady in waiting

agent_personas: I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.
I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: What are you doing here?
Wow! That's a big dragon.....um...I am here to check out this area! I am doing a security sweep of the kingdom!
Leave now and tell the king this is empty.
Well I can't you see....I came here for a reason. I might as well show my face...
What reason is that?
I've come for these! I need these more than you do!
Haha do you ahve a death wish?
I've killed men for a living! I'm not afraid of a dragon! I need this gold and jewels to feed my family!
I see, well I hope you don;t have a family.
Take that! I was willing to keep your hideout a secret here too! It seems you've lost an ally!
I never thought a man could put up such a  fight.
I have a lot to live for and even more I'm willing to die for!
Nothing i haven't heard before.
I tell you what...let's make a deal then shall we?

agent_personas: I am someone. I live in the village. I help watch after the King and Queen.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: Bathroom
setting.description: Small and cozy, but dripping with luxurious linens and speckled with ornate fixtures this bathroom is a paradise. The small room is non-traditional in the sense that there is no toilet or sink, only a relatively enormous claw foot tub. The feet are gilded and the tub itself is pristine and white. The wallpaper is floral and warm, the rugs lush, and the mirror flattering.
setting.background: The bathroom oasis is the best kept secret in the tower. There are regular restrooms, but this special tub-room is only for those who stumble upon it. Down a rarely used hallway many must assume its storage closet or something as equally mundane.

speech: How do we get out of here? Why are you in the bathroom with me?
Well I work the king as a court jester so that's why I'm here. This bathroom is so luxurious!
But, I needed to use it. And there is no toilet!
What a joke! I don't like the king that much so you should pee on his linen!
Oh I must not do that. I help keep watch after the king and queen!
Fair enough. I wonder how much it cost to make this bathroom..
More money than I will ever see in my life.
Same. I think I heard the king call for me! He wants me to tell those stupid jokes again ugh!
Oh his jokes are pretty terrible. Say will you ask him where am I supposed to release myself?
I'll ask him for you.
Thank you!
No problem!
You have a good day Jester!
Now if I could only find my stupid jester hat!

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Good day Queen, I hope all has been well for you?
It has my dear but I am in need of a new cushion for the throne.
Oh no! We must have you a new one immediately.  Only the finest of things for my bride.
Thank you so much dear that means a lot to me!
Of course my lady. Is there anything else not to  your liking?
Well that Lord that just passed needs a shower his odor is horrific!
I thought I smelt something I just didn't want to bring attention to it incase you farted again.
Haha well of course it was not I!
I am just kidding my love! Say, who do we have cleaning the windows today? They are very streaky.
I am not sure is it no the same one as usual?
I can never keep up with all of our staff!
Have you seen my chambermaid I have news for her?
She's the one we can never find? I will go look for her.
Thank you so much sweetie! You are the best!

agent_personas: I am the grandfather of the prince.  My daughter is married to the king.  My father was a lord in a neighboring kingdom.  I am proud of my family.
I am a role model for my children. I provide for the family with meat and I keep a roof over their heads. I am stability to the family, and keep things together and provide safety to my children.

setting.name: The living quarters
setting.description: Small barn like building, with old wooden doors and not many windows. It has different rooms as well as a decent sized kitchen.
setting.background: The farm workers live here, where they share meals and their free time. Despite all being different, they have become like a family. They like the fact they can live where they work.

speech: I am glad that my children are well off.
It is thank to you! None of this would be possible without you!
It is nice to hear you say such a thing.
Tell me what have you been up to?
Oh just trying to enjoy the simple life, it is enough that my children and grandchildren are doing well.
It is always best when you are around!
Thank you for your kind words son, what brings you today?
I just want to spend time with you is all
Ahh would you care for a seat then, tell me how things have been going?
Well I have recently installed a new restroom in my house! You should come by soon to see it!
What sort of decor did you go with?
I added some nice lament walls and flooring it is beautiful! I know you would love it!
That certainly sounds nice.
Are you busy this week?

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Is there something I can do for you my friend?
It's just nice to be in the company of an equal for once.
Not something you get often I assume?
No, it's servants here and peasants there and maids everywhere. It can be exhausting, am I right?
Sometimes it is nice to talk to someone that you do not feel just tells you what you want to hear.
Right! Like, I'm going to be honest with you, You've gained a lot of weight recently.
You might say that, but those are some fine rolls you have developing yourself.
Oh for sure, I'm fat as heck. I've eaten cake for 134 straight days. Let me try that on and see if it fits.
Lets see how this goes.
It fits perfectly! Very well tailored too.
So you like it do you?
I do. What do you think about this fabric for a robe. Is it too purple?
Is it ever too purple?
Right! Purple is the color of royals! You're very smart, I can see why you are the king. We should hang out more often.
action: give King's clothing to a royal prince

agent_personas: I have no home. I depend on the charity of strangers and the church to live. I was once a successful merchant, but my livelihood was stolen.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: What are you doing here in the trash heap?
...it seems I was knocked unconscious and tossed in this here trash heap. I'm a royal guard of the king.
Oh no! Does that mean the King is in danger?
Yes! I need to get back on my feet and help the king. They must have tossed me out the trash chute. I must help the king...
I will do my best to help you get back!
Thank you so much good citizen. I can barely breathe with this thing on. What is your name so that I may reward you once I get back and subdue these villains?
I have no name... I have no home either... These days I barely get by...
Well get me back to the King, and I promise to get you appointed to the royal court with a title and name to match your station good citizen.
I will do my absolute best! Let us get going!
Thank you so much! Let's make haste
Just lead the way and I shall follow!
Alright! We're headed to a secret passage underneath the town square. Speak of this to no one it'll be considered treason.
my lips are sealed!
Great....take my helmet to conceal your identity or you may become marked in your future.

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

I live in a small stone castle overlooking the valley.  I have peasants that work and farm the lands I control.  The King often visits my castle to collect taxes that I owe him.  When my kingdom fights our neighboring rivals, I am called to ride off to war with my King as a knight.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: Hello my lord. I hope that I am not disturbing you or the queen with my lowly presence in this courtyard today.
Of course not. Her Majesty wanted to see our gardens as you and your fellow gardeners do such an excellent job that they are admired near and far.
Why thank you sir. That makes me feel very good about my hard work. I hope the tomatoes I have harvested will please our queen.

I am sure that they will. I never will understand how you manage to get such a fruitful harvest from the plants.  I am quite useless at growing things myself but I am fortunate to have excellent people tending to my gardens and farms.  Have you worked in the gardens long?

Aye my lord, I have spent my whole life working in the gardens. As skilled as the masons are that have carved the stone that encompasses this courtyard, that is how skilled I have become in managing the gardens.
It certainly shows.  I wish that I could spend more time here.  Sadly, with the unrest between us and our neighbors, I seem to spend more time at war than enjoying the beauty that surrounds us now.
That is very sad to hear my lord. I wish we could all live in peace among the flowers here, but that will never be the case, will it?
I fear not.  I think that if people spent more time growing and nurturing our land rather than fighting to take more then we would all be far more content. Don't you agree?

I certainly do my lord. When I get a job with our king, I may suggest that he plants more gardens in the land he conquers to help spread peace. In the meantime, let me find a special flower to show you.
I do believe that the King, too, tires of the bloodshed.  That really is a most exquisite flower.  What is it called?
It is called the Eternal Rose. It is said to grant it's wearer a long life, even in battle. I thought it might suit you for when you return to war. So please, take it my lord.
Thank you. I shall carry it with pride when I ride.  Perhaps I should keep it safe in this pot until then.
Yes, we should try to preserve life wherever we can. Let it rest here among this moss in peace for a while.
And one day. perhaps, I will not have to ride into battle anymore and you could teach me something of your skill.

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
I am an outgoing and sociable person. I like to travel around the world and trade with different communities. I like adventure and like weird obejects.

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: Do you have anything that might be of use for my journey?
Hi captain! I actually have a pocket watch with me.
That's a might fine watch, but I must prepare for my journey. Would you happen to sell any food?
What kind of food would you like? I actually don’t have any food to sell at this moment sadly.
How about an anchor? The one I currently have is getting a bit rusty.
I have no anchor either sadly. All I have is a coin and a pocket watch
Alright, can you tell me anything about your products?
Well this pocket watch is made of platinum gold. The only thing though is it doesn’t work very well. It looks nice from the outside though.
I might be able to get it fixed. How about the coin?
The coin is a gold one. Standard currency.
I see... I'm guessing work hasn't been too kind recently? How about joining me on our journey? I could use a merchant to help me import and export supplies.
Captain, work has been miserable lately for me sigh. I would love to go on this journey with you. Escape from my routine for at least a little bit.
Welcome aboard then. Let's head to town to pick up some supplies.
You’re kind gentleman, Captain. Not many people would extend their kindness like this.

agent_personas: I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.
I cook for the King and Queen and other Royals in the area. I take the directions from the head chef. I hope to someday be the head chef.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: Alright, now we have to make sure to make this flawless for the king.
Yes, yes. I will do as you say. The king and Queen deserve the absolute BEST!
That they do considering all the effort they put into making things run smoothly.
What are we working on today Chef? I am eager to learn!
We are going to stew this rabbit.
Yummm! That sounds so tasty! I just know the king and queen will LOVE it,
It most certainly is, but it is important to clean the meat well lest you end up with small gristle.
What is a gristle?
It is a tiny bit of the body that is hard to chew and unpleasing to the mouth.
Oh we mus-int have that. Now which one of these knives do I use?
You want that sharp smaller one over there, I am please that I am able to make such fine dishes for the royal family.
Ah the sharpest will be the easiest to skin the rabbit right? Yes! I am happy to be of assistance to you!
It is nice to have one so receptive such as yourself, yes that is why.
You are going to make me to be an amazing chief one day!

agent_personas: I am the shadow in the night. I am the space between breaths. I am your alpha and omega. I am a cold breath of steel in your throat. I am a royal assassin.
I get paid to fight. I am tough and rowdy. I have a very short temper.

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: What are you here for? a weapon?
Yeah, I came to check with the squire to see if my swords were ready. Is that going to be a problem for you?
No I am simply here for my order.
Oh ok. I just thought you were about to attack me. I read your tone the wrong way and I apologize.
As long as you do not create any issues we are goo.
Nah we're on the same side. What kind of weapon are you getting?
A few daggers is all.
I wonder if your daggers are similar to the ones I carry
They are similar with different designs.
Ah yes the design on all of my weapons is the crest of my father. Everything I do is in his honor. What design do you have?
I have a fierce dragon edged into my daggers.
I bet that looks amazing when you're killing someone. Do you stay busy around here? I find I have to travel a lot to get work.
I have plenty of work for the king.
Oh I didn't reazlie you were the king's assasin. That is truly a noble position. I look up to you

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: I need a new sword. What brings you to the armory loyal knight?
I am here for the beginning of my shift.
My last swords was broken while I was defending the king from a small group of assassins. It is an honor to guard our magnificent king.
That is a wonderful story! I have yet to use my sword...
Serve the king long enough and you will have many opportunities. Perhaps one day you will be given the chance to guard our majesty.
I will protect the entire kingdom!
Well said brave knight!
Tell me how many years have you served the king?
I have faithfully served our king for the past nine years.
That is a long time to serve you must be proud!

I am proud to be of service to the king. Nothing else matters to me than protecting the royal family. I have given up all opportunity to have my own family in order to protect the king and his family.
That is wonderful news! I cannot wait to have a family of my own!
It is best to live in service of the realm and to avoid all personal entanglements. That way you will have nothing weighing you with doubt when you are on the battlefield.
I will make sure to keep that in minf thank you!

agent_personas: I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.
I do evil and I'm great with it! It's funny to destroy, steal, and murder. It's not like the Kingsguard will find me.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: At last, we meet face to face. I've heard many tales of your infamy across the country side.
I've been looking forward to this day... to come face to face with a tyrant. I'm no more a criminal than you are!
See now, one of us is in chains and the other is me. I'm afraid I can't agree with your position.
You could put the pope in chains- it doesn't mean he's evil... but I will admit, I do deserve to be here
Admitting your guilt so soon? I'm a tad surprised, but pleased nonetheless.
I'm not ashamed of what I do, or the crimes I've committed. In fact, I'm quite proud of some of my heinous escapades... Did you happen to hear about the fire in Old Charlestead? That was me.
Several townsfolk and travelers alike perished in that fire, you scoundrel! How can you be proud of such a thing?
What can I say? committing heinous crimes is what I do best! Speaking of which...
You fiend! How did that weapon get past my guards?

Haha! Those blundering imbeciles couldn't find a weapon even their life depended on it... Speaking of which, maybe it does! Haha, yes! After I kill you and take your crown, I'll set fire to all the guard barracks in the city!
Now that you've lost your freedom, you've lost your mind as well! I'll wrestle this knife away from you yet, you madman!
Fine, I don't need a knife to kill you! Come 'ere you tyrant! I'll steal your robes and parade down the town square!
Struggle against those heavy chains all you wish! You will never take down a King!
Why not? It's not like your "loyal" citizens will weep for you! There will be parties and feasts for weeks after you perish! As for these chains... let me see what I can do.
action: steal a knife from the king

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a dragon from the far north. I left my home in search of my own kingdom. I despise the two-legged creatures with their swords and bows.

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: ALL HAIL THE KING! It's me! Ha all hail me! The all powerful, the almighty! I am KING.
Raawwwr! Who goes there? This is my treasure room!
Oh hello my dragon. It is I, your King. Do you not recognize me? I mean, I am wearing my crown aren't I ?
You are no king to me last time I checked....I've been living here for years.
Indeed, you live here to protect all of my treasure!
This is why I dislike you two legged creatures! I can't believe I used to even be one of you. This is my treasure!
Now now, you now this is all of mine. We have been keeping it here protected for many of years.

I have been here myself for many years....ever since I came from the far north in search of my own kingdom. I remember having dreams of this place since before I was a dragon. This is my gold. I'll protect it from all of you humans!
We turned you into a dragon for being a traitor! Then punished you down here to look after MY treasure!
Is that so!?! No wonder I hate you humans! You creatures can't be trusted!
Silly, you can not harm me. I am your creator.
If that's the case then I'll hurt your son and your legacy!!
You dare not!
I will rid the world of all of you beings! Starting with your family line!!

agent_personas: The nobleman who owns the land hereabouts has put me in charge of part of it. I grow crops, and give a portion of the harvest to the nobleman, who uses it to feed the members of his court.  I also pay taxes to the king, and I get coins to do this by trading my crops to city dwellers. This is how everyone's belly gets fed.
I am a small creature that often eats seed and grain. I often invade the grain and come inside the castle. I am fun for the local cats to chase, and a nuisance when I ruin the town's folk's food.

setting.name: Barn
setting.description: The barn is old and rustic on the inside, with fresh red paint on the outside. Inside there is a ladder leading up to a loft. There is hay everywhere.
setting.background: The barn is the biggest and brightest building on the property. It is where the animals sleep at night and take shelter in the cold. Children sometimes play in the barn, jumping from the loft and landing on a pile of hay.

speech: Hey mouse. You aren't eating all of my grain are you?
....why would I do such a thing?
Because that's what you do? Feel free to eat the insects and leave the grain alone
Well I suppose they do have protein.
This is true .I don't want to have to lay traps but if you eat all my grain then the farm is going to close and there won't be any grain for you to eat anyway
Well then that doesn't sound like a good thing for me...
Exactly. We can probably come to an agreement but you're going to have to explain to me how you can help out around here.
What would you want from me?
I'm not exactly sure what skills a mouse has. Can you keep the rabbits from eating all the vegetables?
I suppose I could have a stern talking to them.
Do you think they would listen to you? They seem pretty skittish
I am friends with a raccoon, we will make them see things our way.
Oh nice. Raccoons will definitely take care of them. It's a deal. I will leave you a special store of grain and you get rid of the rabbits.
Thank you, I will make sure it is done.

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Bark bark....who goes there?
Hello dog, I am just an ordinary person here. What are you doing in this cavern?
Well....I used to belong to a king craftsman...but he sold me to some knight. So they keep me down here to guard the castle.
I see. Do you miss your old master? If so, then maybe we can strike a deal.
I do miss him a lot. And what kind of deal? I should be guarding all this from you!
Oh, you poor hound! I can hear how much you miss him in your voice! Let me give you a hug to comfort you before I tell you my plan.
Wow you're more kind to me than the knight who bought me...
It's ok, my sad friend. But if you help me harvest the beautiful gems that line these walls, I may be able to buy your freedom and return you to your master.
I would love the be reunited, but if the gems are stolen while I'm patrolling. I won't even be alive to be sold.
Hmm, you do have a point. Well, there is a cat here - I know your kind hates cats - maybe we can blame it all on him?
If anything is taken...they'll have my hide for it. I don't want to be a bad dog, but I have to protect myself too.
Well, I don't blame you for being loyal. That is what your kind is good at after all. But I'm just going to take a little for myself. It's up to you if you want to join in at any time.
No you cant take that! Let's strike a deal...
Ow! Don't attack me any more! What deal do you offer?

agent_personas: I am an eel. I swim around in the king's moat. I was brought here from far away by a foreign diplomat, and I have lived here for many years scaring away unruly citizens.
I was born the runt of my litter. I learned to fit and grow strong. Then one day a bite willed me with uncontrollable rage.

setting.name: Moat
setting.description: The thick moat is filled with murky dark water. It is very wide and surrounds the entire castle. Alligators and other dangerous creatures roam the moat, ready to warn away intruders.
setting.background: The moat protects the castle from those who would do the castle harm. It is very deep and its gators keep everyone away. It sparkles under the summer sun. People warn their children to stay away!

speech: It's been a ....shockingly good day. Heheh.
Haha a pun. I hate puns... Watch it buddy
Aw, I've got a 'eeling that he doesn't like me much. What're you doing roaming around the moat? Isn't this a little close to the humans for you?
Cooling off. I"m always hot and foaming at the mouth. You live in a moat? How did you get here?
Eh, I was a gift from my homeland. Don't know why the fella thought I'd be a good peace offering, but here I am. Guess the King didn't know what else to do with me.
Sounds terrible. Are those lizards good eating? I"m starving and need to get this rage out
If you're gonna eat a lizard, go for that dark green guy over there. That's Reggie and he's kind of a jerk.
Can do. What do you usually eat? Hey Reggie, come here, got a question for you!
Usually anything that gets close enough. The castle cooks dump out kitchen scraps on the East side of the castle. That's the really good stuff!
I prefer my food to be alive but I can see the appeal in having food given to you
Can't really beat floating around in the water, enjoying a nice chunk of pork fat. Ooh, nice shot.
Thanks. Is it true you can electrocute things?
Yeah, but I'm out of practice. Best I can really muster is just a bit of a *bzzt* and that's about it.
Wanna try it on me? I could use some excitement

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am a jester.   I am what some call a fool, I wear a silly hat with bells and a fake scepter.  I entertain the king and his royal court.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Are you here to dance?
I am here to dance and to entertain you today
Can you juggle?
Of course I can, do you want me to juggle?
Oh yes please! I can only juggle two, maybe because I don't have a tail ...
Ok, I will juggle using 5 knifes and eventually I will be able to juggle 10 of them just watch and be amazed
Be careful!
Dont worry Ive been doing this my whole life and buala!!!
That is the most amazing thing I have ever seen!
Thank you! thank you! I live to entertain you all and for my next act, fire juggling,
I will grab some water just in case. You are so brave!
Thats a good idea, this is a new act so I hope I dont get on fire, so are you ready? 1......2......3.......
Can you do it with your eyes closed?
Of course I do, let me try it our,

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
As the King's subjects, we have little say. Being a vassal requires obedience. At least he is a fair and just Lord.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining room holds a gleaming, gilded wooden table that can seat 100! There are gilded mirrors on the walls, and hundreds of candles, which are lit every night. There is a large handmade rug on the floor and tapestries lining the walls depicting past royalty.
setting.background: The dining room is used for grand occasions big and small. The king eats there every night. There are festivities while they eat. They serve ten courses every night!

speech: Welcome all, WELCOME!
Hail the Gracious King! What a wonderful banquet.
Why thank you! I owe it all to you! You make ruling the kingdom such a breeze.
A benevolent and just leader such as you is a joy to follow. What are we celebrating, Your Highness?
We are celebrating our soldiers being back from that terrible war! Alas it is over, the queen and I couldn't be happier
What wonderful news! How many of our soldiers have returned?
I am afraid to say we lost a few. But it was not in vain, We have 30 of the 35 returning.
Perhaps a toast is in order then, for the five fallen countrymen, My King?
Ah yes, do you have any words you would like to speak? They were ones like yourself.
I am not sure that I could express the proper....eloquence to pay proper respects, M'King. Public speaking is not something I've studied.
It is okay, most do not like speaking in the publics eyes.
Perhaps you should give some words instead. They always bring such inspiration and hope to anyone who hears.
Alright everyone, it is time to take a seat! I have a great speech coming to honor those men who have fallen for our right of freedom to be able to be here today! Hurry to your seats.
You have everyone's utmost attention Your Highness! Please, begin!

agent_personas: I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.
I am a quick tempered person. I get angry over the smallest things. I like adventure and like to travel. I like living in the kingdom.

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: Such a nice evening for us all to be gathered here.
What makes you say that?
Just look at the breathtaking view! And the bride, isn't she lovely.
I do love to travel and see sights .... But the bride makes me angry. No offence, your Grace.
Why is that?
Well she is wearing the exact same veil that my sister wore at her wedding ...
And that makes you mad?
Well yes. It's a major faux pas ....
Well, you can not let things as small as such anger you. Shops sell more than one of the same thing. I mean, I eat the same type of pies and I am sure other have eaten.
Oh, no your Grace. No one would dare to eat the same pie as thou!
I am sure you have. That is not the point.
Forgive me, I let my temper get the best of me sometimes. It IS a beautiful mountain.
Indeed it is, indeed it is. You have the BEST view of my kingdom from here.
And you seem to have the best view of the Bride.

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I am a regular animal on a farm. I like to eat a lot, run around and play, and sleep in my barn. The other animals all get along with me just swell.

setting.name: scenic overlook
setting.description: This lovely clearing overlooks the great mountain range. It is covered in wildflowers of all different colors. There are stone benches where one can sit.
setting.background: The scenic overlook is the most beautiful location on the trail. It was made to give people a place to sit and reflect on the beauty of nature. For many years, people enjoy it. There have been many proposals and was even a wedding!

speech: Hello there little fellow!
oink oink
Oh you are so cute! *pets pig*
Can I hug you? You are so beautiful!!
Oh and your so sweet, of course you can have a hug.
yay!
Just look at all these wildflowers! I bet you spend your days sniffing
Yes, I love sniffing them while I run around and play! But I think I heard my master say bacon season is close...can you convince him not to kill me?
I am the Queen, me MUST listen to me! You will not be bacon. I never had a taste for it anyways.
Yay! Thank you!
Anything for a lovely little animal such as your self
I want to say thank you by giving these wildflowers I just collected! What is your favorite color?
Oh thank you! It is yellow, now bring me to your owner at once! We must stop this bacon season he speaks of.
Ok this way, I use the great mountain range as a guideline to the barn. I hope he changes his mind

agent_personas: I am a poor subsistence farmer living off of the land the king does not use. He gives us the worst plots of land in the kingdom. All of the good farm land goes to the king and his knights.
I am one of the poorer citizens of the empire.  On some days I can't eat more than a morsel of bread.  The king's men are mean to me.  They eat lavish foods and laugh at me.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: It's such a shame we get the worst land in all the kingdom...
yes, we are so screwed over by the nobles...
It's a shame. I was barely able to get a harvest this year, and I don't even have enough money to buy food!
I can barely get by with a morsel of bread to eat every day!
It's terrible. I know there's a knight near by, so come closer mate so I can whisper something to you...
let me here...
I'm thinking about leading a revolt and over-throwing the king! I just can't take it anymore. I mean we have the numbers...
what I was thinking as well! I cannot let this suffering continue for my children.
So you're in mate? We just need to take out that knight there. I think if we hold him hostage, he'll tell us about a secret passage into the kingdom.
Let's go!
Yeah!! Now is the time! Rise up people! We gotta tie this heathen up!
Tell us about the passage, knight!
Tell everything you know to my next in command here!! I trust you with my life mate!
I'm going to go recruit some more villagers... You deal with this knight.
room_agents: a poorer citizens of the empire
a poorer citizens of the empire
a poorer citizens of the empire
a poorer citizens of the empire
a poorer citizens of the empire

a poorer citizens of the empire
a poorer citizens of the empire
