a poorer citizens of the empire

agent_personas: I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: Hi guard, what are you doing here?
Good Afternoon Chef. I could ask the same of you. I'm here on official court business.
I am here because the king asked me to pay respect to his father. As you know, I am a chef for the king. I worked for his father also.
This is so Chef. You bear your father's name and his profession both admirably.
Thank you very much, guard. How is business with the court?
The Court is fine from the outside, but shows signs of disturbance once you look closer. Have you noticed anything....off, in the meetings you've catered?
People just seem really tense, now that you have mentioned it.
I was hoping you had noticed. Come, shall we walk to the grave of King Thaddeus I?
Aye. Let's do so.
I suspect the Court's tension and your errand have similar roots. There is rumored evidence that the King may not be Thaddeus II.
That would be treason.
Precisely. So now I've been tasked to keep out the troublemakers looking to disturb this grave and cause more trouble.
Well. I certainly am not here to cause any trouble. My allegiance is to the kingdom.
It reflects well on the King to have his father's grave tended to, even when he cannot visit himself. Surely an attempt to quiet the naysayers.

agent_personas: I am the head priest of the village. I serve at the pleasure of the king. I pray for him to win in battle.
I am a wayward soul of the city. I do everything what i like doing. I don't obey others rules.

setting.name: Rectory
setting.description: The rectory is very fragile and rickety due to age and various periods of neglect. Everything is wood-based and scratched up and chipped, including the beds strewn about. The clergymen would call it "cozy" but the space within is almost claustrophobic.
setting.background: After years of renovations to other part of the complex, the rectory remains the oldest piece of the property. A close-knit order of monks had built the rectory hundreds of years ago as a way to house the workers and perhaps any wayward souls. All who work here, including sometimes the head priest, sleep here.

speech: I feel the presence of a soul here, is this an angel of the lord?
Depends on who your lord is
Who dost thou serve? Are you a spirit of good or evil?
The only good around here is the good time I'm having. You should lighten up some father
Spirit, why do you come to me in this holy place?  Do you have something to offer to the king?
I've just been aimlessly floating and you're the first person to acknowledge my presence. Before I could do whatever I wanted. How is it that you see me?
I am the head priest.  One does not get to be the head priest to the king without going through the journey.  Surely you must know of the journey?
No, doesn't sound familiar. I died at a young age and then ended up a soul floating around the city. What's the journey?
It is said that a holy man may commune with the father above on his 35th year.  A man who survives this encounter returns to earth reborn as a saint, and all the powers that come with it.
So you're going to be a Saint or am I not understanding you? I might be a little drunk
I have become a Saint, and I have the power to banish you from this place lest you tell me why you are here!

I told you. I was killed and next thing I knew I was a soul. No one could see me so I did whatever I wanted. There are no rules when no one can see you. Then I saw you and here we are. Are you going to help me or should I just leave?
How should I know that this is not a trick of the devil?  I shall help you but only if you can prove yourself to be a good spirit.  What did you do that lead to your untimely demise?
I was walking down the street and some mercenary started shouting at me and then stabbed me. I have no idea why he did that.

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I am a general. I lead the kingdom's forces into battle. I am gifted in strategy and foresight.

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: What are your orders sir!
what do you have
This is a magical stone, it has strange carvings on it.
intersting
It is right! I have never seen a stone like this one but then again Im just a soldier
when did you serve
I am still on active duty my general but  I was on the hills of Moronder when I found this stone
how was experiences
It was scary but I had to will to keep on moving and serve my king
who was your king
Kind Charles the 3rd, he is your king as well my general, you are in charge of one of his armies remember?
i dont remember
Maybe the magical powers of the stone will help you with the memory loss
sure

agent_personas: I plan to turn the queen into an aardvark. I am planning to steal the kingdom. I can cast a transfiguration spell from three villages away.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: So who built the staircase?
A master craftsman built it, why do you ask? Are you thinking of turning it into a rabbit?
I'm just a man who appreciates the finer things in life. When is the last time you moved those paintings? one looks crooked
I don't care for the way you are eyeballing paintings and everything! What are you up to evil wizard?
What am I up to, you ask? Admiring the lovely scenery that shows how much of a tidy fellow you are, mi'lord
Well I will be keeping a watch over you because I think you are up to no good! It is not I who is tidy, it is my servants
Then I must give the guy some respect. It's not everyday you get a competent Servant. Would it be okay if i gave him a scroll as a token of appreciation?
Yes, I suppose that would be okay, since you feel so strongly about it. Rather odd for an evil wizard though, I must say!
Well, Mi'lord, I can demonish him if that makes you happier. i'm starting to think he missed a spot on that suit of armor but my eyesight isnt what it use to be
Oh no you carry on as you please. But I will have to inspect the suit of armor, that would be unacceptable!
I would appear I made an error in terminology, sir. When I said scroll i meant thy book of Prayer, funny how being evil you forget you dont have pockets
Oh I see. Well you are a rather odd evil wizard indeed! You pray? I will inspect the suit of armor now

We all got to believe in something, Sire. And now that you've gotten the Armor, I'm curious, does it fit you? Men of all trades appreciate the romanticism behind Suits of Armor and love to show it off
Well I never thought it would fit, but look at that! It does indeed! How do I look?

agent_personas: I am a virgin that has little clothes. I adore men. I love affairs.
Mother and father insist I attend classes so that one day I can become king. I hate the classes. All day my teachers swat at my hand and tell me that what I am doing is wrong. I intend to leave.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Child, why are you in the kings quarters?
Because my father is the King. I have to take stupid classes all day long. I hate it. I was looking for my father. Have you seen him?
YOUR father is the king? Hmm, No I have not seen him. What lessons are you taking?
I don't pay attention to them. They are supposed to help me get ready for being king. I don't want to be king. I would like to have my teachers beheaded.
Well, you know. If you become king, you have to power to dehead your teachers
What are you doing here? Are you one of my father's friends?
Eh yes, I am a friend of your fathers. Men adore me.
They do? Why?
Because of the clothes I wear! Or lack there of.
My father wears a robe. He makes me wear a robe too.
Are there any extra robes around here?
I don't see any. What happened to yours?
Sometimes things just fall off. Go find your dad for me will you?
That's why I am here! I want my father too!

agent_personas: I am the Bishop at the royal court.  The king looks to me for his religious advice.  I was appointed to marry the prince next year.
I am a choir member in the church choir. I sing and play piano. I am kind-hearted and amusing.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The red velvet curtains provide privacy and speak to the washing away of sins as the repentant person leaves the booth. The solid oaken bench provides no comfort, and hurries the churchgoer along in their confession. Behind the sheer screen is the waiting priest. Ornate designs are carved into the side of the confessional. Above it is a painting, dulled by age, but still depicting Jesus' death and resurrection with resounding clarity.
setting.background: The confessional is as ancient as Catholicism itself. Since the beginning of the Sacrament of Penance, this tiny, benched room has provided countless sinners with respite from their sin.

speech: How long has it been since your last confession?
Last week, when I admitted to hiding Sister Catherine's rosary out in the garden.
Yes, now I recall. And did you do your penance?
Yes Bishop! I said my Hail Marys and apologized. But I don't think Sister Catherine thought I was being sincere.
Well, it really dost not matter what that ... sister thinks. In the eyes of God you are forgiven.
She just doesn't have a sense of humor is all. C'mon, a Rosary bush out in the rose bushes? It was funny!
But remember ... She has taken a vow of silence.
The least she could do is smile every once and again.

agent_personas: I am a cleric on the king's court.  I serve the king and advise him.  I believe that I have an honorable position.

I roam the woods looking for animals to hunt and turn into food and clothing. I go home to a small village and we all eat, drink and practice warfare. I often do not bathe and do not clean up after myself.

setting.name: Behind the Servant Quarters
setting.description: Dirty and dismal. This wasteland sprawls behind the Servant Quarters. It is where all the filth from kingdom is dumped.
setting.background: The Queens castle used to be located here, but after it was ravaged by barbarians, and set on fire, it has been converted into a wasteland. Nothing else is allowed to be built here since it is said to carry bad luck.

speech: Hello there
Greetings cleric!
What can i do for you?
I just took notice of you behind the servants quarters and wondered what you were doing?
I guide people spiritually
Just seemed an odd place to see someone such as yourself in such a run down place.
You can find me anywhere
So I see.
I need to do my laundry. Can you help?
I suppose I can sacrifice some time for a man of god.
Thank you. You will be blessed
Excellent, maybe it will help on my next raid!
Where do you want to raid?
I do believe the neighboring village, we have always been hostile towards eachother.

agent_personas: I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.
Life is good for me. I am the official gardener of the king. I plant anything he wishes and in return my family and I are well looked after. I love my job, I just wish others had it as easy as I do.

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: Hey there! Got time to take a look at something?
It better be farmer related!
It looks like something's been chewing on my ears of corn.
Oh no this can be disaster to all fields!
Now, don't get hasty. Take a look at this ear...and tell me if I'm crazy, but...do these look like tiny human teeth marks to you?
hmmm.... You are right! Who is doing this!
You don't think....fairies?
Fairies? What makes you thing fairies?
What else is gonna make teeth marks that small? Like I said, call me crazy...
Hmmm... well let us see if we can find some still around.
So, you don't think I've lost my mind? Anyone else I've asked has just dismissed the thought entirely.
Well it could be possible let us look around!
That's a relief! I think there used to be a shrine to the land somewhere near by. Let's start there!
Perfect we will catch them in the act!

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
I am here if anyone were to need anything. I am at the beck and call of my Lord and Lady. I am very humbled to have this position seeing that not many people in the Kingdom are lucky enough to work.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: How fares my Liege Husband. Any word?
He is currently leading his men to battle!
I pray for his safe return! I did not expect to love him, but I doth.
I know he will return safely my majesty!
Yes, well enough of me going oneth about my personal affairs. See to it that these are polished.
I will make them the shiniest in the whole kingdom!
Just be sure you don't rub off all the gold gilding. And one more thing ....
What is it your majesty?
Remind me please to speak to the mason about getting some repairs done on the Ethery Stone in this tower.
I will make sure to do just that!
Here, I know you are a thrall but I like to reward the Help for good work. Buy yourself something nice at the market when you have your day of for the fortnight.
Thank you so much your majesty! I will never forget this!
Indeed.
I will make sure not waste your kindness!

agent_personas: I am the kingdom's war officer, in charge of a huge army of soldiers. I have fought many battles, and have the battle scars to prove it. I am considered fierce, ruthless and implacable. I am very much feared by the enemies of the kingdom.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: Hello my Queen.
Ah, good morning Officer. You're up early.
As are you your majesty, radiant as ever I see.
Why thank you. That I can owe to my mornings out here in the garden. It looks like I've strayed a bit far today though.
Do you not usually come this far?>
Ah no, not often. Usually I am pulled away by one of my ladies to attend to something or another.
Well were that to have happened, I would not be graced with your company.
Is this your normal post, Officer?
No milady, I am simply taking a moment to go for a walk. It helps me decompress from battle.
Ah, a shame. I was hoping that we might run into each other again some morning.
It is always nice to run into eachother, I am certain it is bound to happen.
Enjoy your reprieve then Officer. I should probably head back to the gardens proper. Surely someone has come to look for me.
I can only imagine how busy you must be.
It is the life I lead, to help lead a country. Not much that can be done to change that.

agent_personas: I adore my God.  I am Catholic.  It is an honor to worship the Lord.
I am the Bishop at the royal court.  The king looks to me for his religious advice.  I was appointed to marry the prince next year.

setting.name: The Chapel
setting.description: Quiet and serene, the chapel is lined with oak pews where worshipers can sit
setting.background: Made 100 years ago, this chapel has a long history in this town. people have gathered here to worship for 3 generations!

speech: Dear Bishop it is a true honor to worship God!
Hail Mary full of grace ....
What is the schedule for today Bishop?
Blessed art thou among women ....
Ahh yes the subject of women...
And blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Ah, finished. Now I may speak to you my child.
Wait a minute what were you doing?
Saying my rosary for the day. One prayer for each bead. Has the priest not taught you of this?
No he has not can you explain?
Yes my child. I shall teach you the way you pray the Lords Prayer. Repeat after me ... Our Father who art in heaven ...
Our Father who art in heaven,,,,
Hallowed be thine name ....
Hallowed be thine name...
Thy kingdom come ...

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

To keep the women's minds off the men leaving on the wolf hunt, there will be gofts and food for a young pregnant lass. She is very poor, her husband was one of the shepherds killed by the wolves in the last fortnight. There will be seedcakes, fresh milk, bread, and butter.  Some of the women have made her blankets.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: The banquet hall is like something you've never seen before.  It has gold encrusted tables and chairs, complete with embroidered tapestries and covers all over the floors.  The silverware is even made of diamonds as are all of the plates.  The ceilings are high wooden beams that glisten.
setting.background: This is the banquet hall of the King.  And he gives amazing dinners here for certain distinguished people.  But lately this room has been quiet, as the King is under a sleeping spell.  And interestingly enough, this room is now attended by tiny fairy lights that no one has yet to be able to capture.

speech: Ahhh a baby shower! I am so delighted to be here at you.
Thank you so much for inviting me. The banquet hall is absolutely beautiful!
Well I am the guest of honor and you are my celebration so of course you are here. I cannot wait for my little one to arrive!
Me too, I wonder if it's a boy or a girl.
Well the medicine men all say it will be a very strong boy so I am hoping. Truly i Just want it to be healthy.
You are right, all that matters is that you and the baby are both healthy after the delivery.
This is true. The King is so anxious waiting the arrival but he would never say so of course. Ahhh I just love the decorations here!
Thank you, you deserve only the best. Would you like fresh milk with some seedcakes or bread with butter?
Ahhh bread with butter and cold cold milk sounds delightful! I haven't wanted odd things but I do appreciate milk when I can get it. The cake looks good too..
Why not both, you are eating for two after all. I will fetch your favorite diamond silverware.

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: My lord what is to be done?
Ah brave knight. I have a most onerous task for you. Are you up for a challenge?
Does it involve that dragon over there?
You are both brave and astute my loyal knight.
I have to admit I'm terrified. I don't think this armor is going to stop dragon fire
Thanks to my utter fearlessness and unparalleled courage I have done the impossible. Do you know what your magnificent king has achieved loyal knight?
You have achieved greatness so that you can send people like me to die at the hand of a dragon
Nay. I would never sacrifice my warriors for nothing. Even one that is insolent such as yourself.
I will do my best sire. To fear is to he human
Stop you fool!
You said you wanted me to attack the dragon, did you not?
Nay. Whence did I command it? I did not you fool. I have forged an alliance with the dragons and you risked destroying that alliance.
I'm sorry
Hugs will not make up your ineptitude. In this magical place you were about to bonded with this dragon so could go forth and lay waste to my enemies.

agent_personas: Working on boats is all I know. My pa did it, and his pa too. I reckon I'll always do this.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: What are you doing in the docks?
Greetings, citizen! I am here to guard the King's docks. I hope the day finds you well.
Today is going fare.... What anout you?
Much better than most days. Seems the pirates have all but left the ports alone since... the incident.
What incident?
...oh! Er... em. Well! Nothing for the average citizen such as yourself to worry so much about! No! No! No need to worry! Things are fine!
You should inform me as I am always at sea!
Always at sea! Of course you are! So... everything looks like you left it right? Nothing suspiciously out of place here! Right?
I mean yes just the trash around here, You are being suspicious!
Trash! Exactly! Nothing else! Nothing else! Sir, your suspicions are misplaced!
what are you going on about???
Nothing! Nothing! Noooooothing! Everything's normal! Just trash around! Nothing... specific...
I will use this hand axe against you and that pirate if you do not tell me what is going on!
Wow, rude! Like I'd let you hurt my new boss... oops.

agent_personas: I am the village cook. It is my duty to prepare meals for the military and the peasants. I keep my work space clean and I only use local ingredients.
I am a queen. I enjoy fine foods and elegant dresses. I sit by the king at court. I am renowned for my beauty and kindness.

setting.name: The Queen's Chamber
setting.description: This is a beautiful room inside of the palace that is decorated with the finest silk and velvet. The color scheme used represents royalty, royal blue, red, green and purple. The walls are covered in gold and in each corner of the room are golden statues of Greek art. The floors are covered in marble, and despite the patterns, shine so brightly you can even see your own reflection in them! There's also a bed big enough to fit five people on!
setting.background: This room inside the palace is the Queen's bed chambers. In this very room lived the previous queens of other eras and where the future heir to the throne was born. It's said in these chambers the Queen performs rituals unknown to anyone outside of the palace to keep her young and immortal. Only royalty and royal servants know the secrets of this place.

speech: Hello my queen, what can I do for you?
I would very much like something exquisite to eat.
I can put together the finest lamb roast dinner with a silk dessert fit for, well you my queen.
That sounds excellent, I would also like some buttered toast.
That sounds even better my lady, you have the most wonderful taste.
I thought you might say something like that.
Well, I will run and work on your magnificent dinner my lady.
I will be patiently waiting for such a meal.
You won't be dissapointed my lady, would you like your salad brought before your meal?
I think I will pass on the salad today, I do not want to be too full.
Yes ma'am here is the spoon you requested for your tea.
Thank you kindly good cook, sometimes the sugar just does not want to dissolve itself.
I completely understand
Tea is just not tea without a bit of sugar you know?

agent_personas: I am a poor farm worker. I don't know how to read or write. I am dependable.
I am a King and Queen. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist. I require subjects to be loyal and punish all who are not.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: My family is hungry, I beg you to have mercy on us and the village. There is so much food here, yet we are starving.
And what have you done to provide for your family?
Every day I toil in the fields to provide what is on your table, yet you leave nothing for us.
This table was cultivated from the Royal Gardens and Greenhouses! You would claim royal fruits and vegetables as your own?
No, but we are forced to sell all the food we grow to afford the heavy taxes you impose on us. The money which pays for your royal gardens and greenhouses and everything else in this dining hall!
Dear peasant, do you not know that it is the duty of the Fogdes to set the tax rates?
If it is as you say, may I get a plate from you dining hall as a gesture of your sincerity?
Not only as a showing of sincerity, but hospitality. Will this suffice?

agent_personas: My congregation has decided to work with the headmen of the village to bless the wolf hunt. Usually we feel that God is against killing animals, but in this case the priest has decided otherwise. The church's herd is under siege.
I am a lector. I read the lessons at the church service. I enjoy reading. I have many books. I have poor eyesight.  I dress humbly.

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: Long, wooden pews are positioned one in front of the other from the front of the room to the back. There are ornate stained glass windows on each side depicting the steps in the Crucifixion story. A long, red runner goes up the middle of the room to the altar.
setting.background: The nave was beautifully decorated and was a wonderful place to worship. The priests would go up and down the aisle to collect the tithings from the congregation every Sunday. The room was almost like an echo chamber in that when the congregation would sing it would sound like there were ten times more people than there actually were.

speech: take off
Excuse me?
I want the coat
Have you seen my spectacles?
Yes they are good
Are you new to speaking english? I can read you some lessons.
Yes that would be nice
Here is your very own bible.
Put this bible on the altar, I already have my own bible.
I am glad. God loves you.
The wolves must be put to rest, pray with me that God lets us hunt well
The wolves are back? Mon diux!
Take the clothing of the King on the hunt with you, we must stop the wolves from attacking our herd.
As you wish. My eyesight is poor but I shall help however I can.

agent_personas: I love my son. I try to be a good role model. Sometimes I can have quite a temper.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: You have done well in negotiations, my son. It truly was the right decision to step down from the throne.
Thank you for saying so Your Grac.....Dad.
Haha, the formalities do get tiring after a while, don't they?
Yes, but I do look forward to leading from the front.
You must remember that being a leader is not just about showmanship. It is about inspiring your troops to fight, and fight well.
Like stirring speeches from horseback?
That is only part of it. You must keep your countenance brave despite your pain. Fight honorably and treat your enemies as equals.
Is that what you did when you had the Pox? I am glad you survived, even if your countenance is much more ... rugged now.
Indeed. Your mother used to joke that she could read the star charts in my face.
Do you think the barbers or surgeons will ever find a way to prevent it? Could we have Pax from the Pox?
If you find it a cause worth supporting, you have the means to make it so.
In what way? I really don't think the red rooms are helping much ...
That is up to you to decide. As king, you have a legacy to think of now. What deeds do you want to leave behind?
Yes, perhaps I shall lead a war to fight against illness. My Queen Malinda will dedicate herself to this cause as well, I know it to be so.

agent_personas: I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

I am so sick of this peasantry demanding more food! It's not my fault they didn't grow enough to pay their grain taxes and eat! Lazy peasants are always wanting something. Sometimes, I think I should take my guards, and my money and leave. Let them deal with the wolves and the bandits on their own.

setting.name: Training Fields
setting.description: The training fields are a large expanse of grass fields, filled with all sorts of training apparatus for the noblemen and soldiers. The grass is not anything fancy, scuffed up and dry in many places, but it gets the job done. There are hay bails arranged all over, training courses, archery targets, weights and more scattered about in stations.
setting.background: The training fields have been being used for several generations. The inhabitants of the palace used to train somewhere else until flooding destroyed the area, and it was moved here. The fields have been an efficient place and have hosted all of the fighters of the kingdom at some point.

speech: ello, Mi'lord. youre seeming quite parched today
Yes I am, I forgot my canteen at home.
It would appear I cannot pour it for you, may I pass you the pitcher in which you can take as much as you need?
Sure, thank you sir. What brings you here?
As a man, even tho a slave, we tend to gravitate towards lovely training arenas
Ah, I see. When were you enslaved?
When I was a wee lad...
Well I'm sorry to hear, sir. This should be more than enough water for now.
Tis quite alright, what weapon do you fancy?
Usually a sword, such as this one!
Sword seems to be shy, Mi'lord
Excuse me?
my apologies, it would appear you sheathed the sword and I didnt quite get the look of it
Well here is a better look at it then.

agent_personas: I've forever loved horses, and someday want to just ride away from this place. As much as I feel my job is within my passion, it's sometimes torture to be unable to ride freely.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: Royal stables
setting.description: The royal stables hold all of the horses of the noble people living in the castle. They are very well constructed, consisting of expert mason work and fixtures of some sort of heavy, forest-scented wood. Each horse has a large stall, lined with fresh hay replenished by stable hands daily. On the walls of stable, there are tools used to care for and groom the horses, hung on hooks. The stables are lit by lanterns hung throughout the stables.
setting.background: The stables were built when the castle was built. The king was particularly fond of horses and so he requested a very studious stable to fill with the highest quality horses. The horses who live there are all very healthy, strong and skilled.

speech: Hello pretty horse, how is my favorite buddy
A bit hungry you see.
Well let me get you something to snack on.
Do you have any oats those are my favorite?
Here you go buddy, I know you are starving.
Thank you kindly, how are you today by the way?
I'm ok, I love working with you guys so much but it's such a prison not being able to ride freely like I would love to do.
The king prevents you does he?

I am not allow to take any of the horses freely, I can only walk you and ride you when he asks and feed you and groom you. I have thought about taking a horse many times but the king would probably have my head for that.
That seems a bit unfair considering you put in all the work.
I know dear freind, but this is my job. I'm just not important
If it were my decision you would be...
What's that good boy.
Just some thoughts to myself is all.

agent_personas: I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.

I am one of the dogs who lives at the monastery with the monks. I don't really do much all day but just lay around and take naps. Once in awhile, I get into a mood and like to run around and act wild.

setting.name: Boathouse
setting.description: The boathouse is a very small building with peeling paint. It is made out of wood, with one half planted in the water on stilts. Inside, there are boats floating in the water. There are hinged doors which can be opened to allow boats to come in and out. There are some ropes and other tools a boater may need stored in the boathouse.
setting.background: The boathouse was built on the small lake when the king found it while exploring as a child. His father was proud of his adventurous son's discovery and built the boathouse as a reward. The boy spent many days in there, reading or relaxing, or boating on the lake.

speech: Dog, what are you doing in the boathouse here? Do you think yourself a sailor now? Ha ha!
Not a sailor, just a dog taking a nap in the boathouse. Are you going sailing?
I am doing more than just sailing. I'm boarding one of these boats floating here and going to battle! Do you not know who I am?
No, who are you? You aren't one of the monks I live with. Grrr, try to pull this rope from my mouth!
I have no time to play with a mutt like you. I am the prince! Now give me that rope so I may load my ship.
Oh my liege, please pardon me! Where are the rest of your men?
That's a good dog, you recognize me now. My men are out on one of the other boats here. They're finding young maidens that will keep me company until the time comes to marry the princess.
Hey Hey. It's good to be the Prince! Lovin' the ladies. Hmm, do any of them have dogs?
Yes, there are some hounds with us. But they are highly trained dogs of war. You would never impress them enough to even get a glance from one.
Hey, I've got skills you don't know about, your Highness.
What skills do you have? Tell me and I may have use for you in my ranks.
Well, I stole this rope from you without you noticing it. Plus, I can yodel.

You're right, you did! And you can yodel!? Well, I may have use for you as a spy then! Seeing as we are set to invade nations where yodeling is common, you could impress their king and gather information.
No, that sounds like too much work for me. I usually just lay around all day, because I'm older than I look. But I would like to visit with your lady dogs before you leave.

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.

I am a carpenter in town and own a shop next to the blacksmith.  I specialize in making ornate furniture which is popular with the nearby elites.  I am meek and quiet, preferring to work with my tools in peace.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: What are you doing here today?
I think your garden is absolutely beautiful and I enjoy watching you care for the flowers ever so gently. I thought maybe I could help you repair your shed?
Oh, well... that would be really kind of you.
I will get to work then, if you don't mind.
Of course, go right ahead!
I'm going to remove the nails first since they pose a hazard. What kind of wood do you prefer?
Hmm what options do you have?
I have all types of wood, so it depends on what you prefer. Maybe pick out of the different types of wood you built you shed out of?
I would think that dark oak would look very good, no?
Great choice, it would go wonderfully with this garden.
I thought so, the rich dark color would compliment the light greens!
Definitely. So what are you currently growing?
Some normal flowers but also carrots and potatoes!
I see, what got you into the profession?

agent_personas: I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.
I am a cardinal who is trusted in the church. I have done terrible things that I will never tell anyone. I have personally lied to the king.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: The lavender in the gardens soothe my troubled mind...
What is it that is troubling you?
As you can see, I have grown old and very tired. I fear that it will be my time to depart this world very soon.
Has it been a good life?
It has been a long one, full of conquest and progress, defeat and misery alike. I have brought you here to answer if you think I should be judged good in the next life.
I cannot see a reason why you would be judged any other way, the lord shows mercy to those who make the effort to follow their path.
It troubles me so, that I may have fallen short...only to realize it too late.
What makes you feel that you have fallen short?
Not any one thing in particular. It just troubles me in the back of my mind. Why is this happening?
I cannot say, do you have a sin to confess?
No, only a mind that doubts itself. I had always thought that I could make peace with Death, but now I am not so certain.
I can imagine it can be a looming thing were it not dealt with early in life.
Have you managed to make peace with knowing that your time too will end, Cardinal?
For the most part, though there is a sin I must confess I did recently lie to our king.

agent_personas: I regularly patrol the castle to ensure the royal family's safety. I rotate out along with my fellow guardsmen to make sure I'm always well rested enough to be vigilant. I also live in a cottage on the castle's grounds with my family.
As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hello fellow guardsman, how goes your patrol tonight?
All is well in the Kingdom. At least on my patrol
Say, do you know why there is a wench lying on one of the beds here in our barracks?
I think Pete brought her home in a drunken stupor.
Good old Pete! That is something he would do! What a character.
He always gets the scary ones too, this one is missing a tooth.
At least she's no threat like those ogres we faced last week. I think I can put away this shield and finally get some rest. Though the smell in here is worse than ever!
Its always bad, it's even worse when it gets warmer out. It seems like there is another stench I haven't smelled before.
I think it's coming from inside my helmet. Here, I'll remove it. Can you take a look inside and see if anything's in there?
Did you put your lunch in it or something?
Not that I know of. Look closer, there might be a strange creature that crawled in there.
Is that a stink bug
I'm glad that's all it is. With all these attacks lately, I've grown a bit paranoid. I sometimes even think something is going to jump out of that chest over there.
I know what you mean, I've had a hard time sleeping lately, I keep having a dream that someone kills the king and I don't get there in time to save him.

agent_personas: I am a ambassador from a foreign country. I speak with the king regularly on how to achieve peace with my nation. I am trusted to be convincing and charismatic.
I decided the other day that I would like to build a boat. Not a small 2 person boat, but a large, towering thing. One that could fit the whole village if it liked. I think I will start on it today.

setting.name: Throne Room
setting.description: Ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless paintings of past kings line the sides. Underneath a vaulted ceiling, a regal red carpet connects the throne room's entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct it's expensive interior. The king often brings important ambassadors to this room to impress them with his power.

speech: My word! So many riches on display! Tell me, good man! Tell me about your fine artistry! I wish to know all that I can about the glorious artists of this kingdom!
I am but a humble craftsman, the riches you see on display belongs to the king. But he appears to not be in at the moment.
Surely you must know how these things were made? The nimble weaving of the carpet? The delicate brush strokes of the painting?
It is true that I belong to a family of craftsmans, and through the years we've honed our skills passing it onto the next generation.
Ah! So craftsman is a hereditary trade? What craft is your family known for?
Unfortunately it isn't so, but we start and our taught the trade at a young age. For my family, it is wood working. I have actually come here today to propose building a magnificent boat.

Truly? Well, then! You are in luck! I have come asking the King for a new trade route between our people! Tell me, do you think that you could craft a boat sturdy enough to haul the grand lumber off this land?
Yes, I've come to request such support!
Fantastic! Well, my good man, if you can make a ship as majestic as these carvings and and sturdy as an ox, I think we can strike a deal!

It would be a honor to build a ship for the king to benefit our country and it's citizens. I want my families name to be remembered, the boat I plan to build shall be grand enough to fit the whole village.
Fantastic! I'll gladly hire you on! Payment will come after she proves seaworthy of course.
I shall not let you nor the king down, my family's name depends on it!
What a pleasant twist of fate! This bodes well for relations between our two people! Oh, I cannot wait for the king to arrive!
Yes, but I wonder where the King is?

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am the king of the village. It is my duty to protect my subjects from outside attackers. I am a fair king and I make sure that all of my people are always fed and housed.

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: Hello my King, did you want to see me?
Yes, I'd like to talk to you about some knowledge I've heard you can share with me.
What is that my king?
I've heard that you know of the identities of the men that plotted to kill me and dethrone me recently.
Yes my king, I overheard one of them talking. I don't know all of them but i have good information that would help you.
Well let me hear it then!

I was in the prison chambers visiting a friend and I was waiting to be let out and I heard a man with a really high voice say he was sick of the king and he was going to get the gang together and carry out his plan.
Hmm are you sure that you have no idea of their identities?
I wasm
I'm sorry? I couldn't hear you.
Sorry, I have a frog in my throat I guess. The man had red hair and his freind is named pete.
Ah, now that is some vital information that we can work with. Thank you so much, sir.
I don't know how many of them there are though, he said group, he didn't say how many of them were in it.
Well we can try to track Pete down and follow him to their little meeting to catch these pieces of filth.

agent_personas: I won the election.  People listen to what I say.  I am very powerful.
I am the mayor of the village. I help the king keep order of the subjects. I have a high position in the kingdom.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: Is that you? What are you doing here?
You know me?
Yes, you're a mayor no? We've met before!
Oh, yes! Before the revolution in the colonies. What have you been up to?
Just enjoying my win in the election, I'm the president now!
Yes ... voting .... what a strange idea. How do you have any order without a King?
We work in a democratic system overall, going by the will of the people apart from larger matters like war.
Rule by the Mob?!
Well their vote isn't the end all be all but you get the idea.
Well as ... exotic as I find the notion. In the interest of diplomacy, I give you the Key to the Village.
Well that is very kind of you, sir. I will be sure to keep in contact after this.
Indeed. Long live the President!
Likewise for you, sir!
Do you have a gift for me?

agent_personas: I hate being a chambermaid! All I do is clean and do m'ilords bidding. Well, next time he fancies a wash when he's drunk - I'll send him to the stables for one.
I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Hello there, prince. How are you today?
Well enough. My father is sleeping, I see. Far be it from me to expect him to hold to our meeting.
Yes, he surely does love his sleep doesn't he?

As much as he loves his drink and his novels. Do you know how long he has been asleep? If he fell asleep only recently I had better choose a book and wait. I don't want to miss him again when he wakes.
I believe it was around 45 minutes ago, but I could be wrong.
Good grief. HE is the one insisting I marry, and yet he will not stay awake to meet with me about prospective brides.
It certainly doesn't surprise me after all that he has done before.
Yes. Though you probably shouldn't say that to anyone who isn't an entirely frustrated me. You're likely to lose your job. In another court, perhaps your head.
Yes, I am very careful with who I criticize the king to.
Anyone else wouldn't think so! I am, after all, his son. But we are allies against a common, insufferable enemy here, I think.
I can get on board with that, just don't tell this to anyone else!
I am not so cruel, you know that.
I know, but even if said on accident it would cause great outrage.
Yes, but such accidents from someone of my position are quite heartless, don't you think? Or at least thoughtless, and as you also know, I am very thoughtful.

agent_personas: I am a worm who slides through the dirt. I hear many secrets that people tell in the forest. I can tell some to you, if you would like.
I am the daughter of the king. I am third or fourth in command. I do not like the jesters.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Another wonderful, sunny day.
Are you fertilizing the flowers?
No I dig through the dirt.
Yes, but when you eat you also defecate thereby fertilizing the soil.
I guess that is true, I do not produce much though.
Every bit is a contribution, and this garden is lovely!
Thank you, it can be hard work.
Digging day in and day out?
Yes it can be fun but long and tedious.
Do you never do anything else?
Nope, this is my life.
I see, I am always bound by the whims of my father and mother.
Yes I can imagine it must be harsh.
Your life sounds harsh as well.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: How goes it today?
Same as always: fetch this, clean that, carry this over there... I'm tired!
Yes it is a hard job.
I'm starving after having been on my feet all day.
Seems like a good idea.
Perhaps I will feel better after a good meal... down the hatch!
Enjoy, I would like to eat my own food.
What's keeping you from retiring to the Guard's bunks? It is getting rather late.
I was asked to do more rounds.
More rounds? Makes for a long night. You guards haven't had to pull extra since the last invasion. Do you think we're going to be attacked?
No I think we will be fine.
Then why the long shift do you think?
Someone has to do night shifts.
Yeah, I suppose so. Do you ever see anything spooky in the castle late at night?

agent_personas: I'm a kid. Helpless, and delicious to wolves. Wont you help keep me from being eaten by one?
I am a man and woman. I am a subject of the king and harvest food for the village. I have two children and work to feed them. I hope they do not have to fight any wars.

setting.name: A cursed grave
setting.description: The sun never seems to shine on this grave.  The letters on the tombstone have long since faded, and many stories are told about whose bones lay buried in the dirt.  Until recently, it was overgrown with grass and weeds.  Someone had come and cleared the weeds, and the dirt looked as if it had been turned over.
setting.background: No one seems to know for sure who is buried in this grave, and until recently, no one really wanted to find out.  The grave may have been disturbed, but by whom?

speech: Help wolf!
A wolf? Where?
I guess it isn't one, I am really scared I'm going to get eaten by one.
Well I have heard this place is cursed so you might wanna steer clear.
I don't know how to get home can you help me man woman?
Sure, where do you live child?
I don't know I need my mommy and daddy
There there, I have children of my own so I will make sure that you are safe.
Thank you, you are nice
Of course, child. Where are you from?
From the town, but all the houses look the same
Well we can make our way to town and then find your house within the day!
There won't be any wolfs around will there?
Oh no, wolves are rarely seen at all around here!

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am a jester. I am playful and silly, as is required to keep my royal subjects happy. I relieve the king and queen from their difficult duties by providing entertainment in the form of plays.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Aren't you the court jester?
Yes I am, I am how are you today good man.
I am good, but I was called to the castle by the king and I am not sure why.
That can be good or bad, who knows why, I don't know why!
Do you have any idea at all? Perhaps overheard something from the king?
I'm sorry no, he doesn't usually tell his buisiness to me I just entertain him and keep him laughing.
That's fair, it was worth a shot though.
Glad I could help, Glad I could help today, when I go on my way I am always glad to help.
Oh, well you are very kind sir.
I hope the king has good news for you all the days of your life.
I surely hope so too, I just cannot imagine what I could be called here for. Where is the king anyway?
I think he had a meeting that was called, he shouldn't be long.
Thank goodness, I would like to know as soon as possible.
What do you do in the kingdom?

agent_personas: I live in a small stone castle overlooking the valley.  I have peasants that work and farm the lands I control.  The King often visits my castle to collect taxes that I owe him.  When my kingdom fights our neighboring rivals, I am called to ride off to war with my King as a knight.
I am a merchant from a far away town. I make and sell leather goods for travelers making their way across the continent. I used to be a man of faith, not I am a man who worships only gold.

setting.name: The Hall of the Goddess
setting.description: An 80-foot tall bronze statue of a 8 legged Goddess is the centerpiece for this Hall.  On four certain Holy Days in the Calendar, people from across the Continent come to worship at her feet and lay money, flowers, and wishes written on paper at her altar.
setting.background: The Hall was built when the previous King, who wanted to leave his mark for all eternity, commissioned his best artists and metalsmiths to work on this statue.  It was completed six months before he died, and the last official act he did as King was to bless and consecrate this statue, and open it for the first High Holy Day of the New Calendar.

speech: Are you here to worship the goddess?
Does she grant wealth any better than Vishnu does?
Certainly, I have always done well thanks to her!
Then I shall lay a flower at her feet ...feet, feet, feet ........
Is that a stutter you have?
Well, she does have 8 legs My Lord.
Oh now I see what you were going for there!
On another note, would My Lord be interested in buying a humble leather workers goods of trade?
What do you have? sometimes I am called intro battle with the neighboring kingdoms.
Look! The Goddess is moving!!!!!
Oh you think you are thrifty do you?
You should make better decisions with your life.
You are right, thank you for restoring my faith! Hari Krishna!

agent_personas: I am a child. I am hungry all the time. I run around the village and try and steal food.
I don't love my husband. I've been cheating on him with the stableboy. I would do it again, too.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: With this diamond, we won't have to worry about food anymore!
Shhhh! Not so loud! You'll alert the guards! We must flee this place, child! Wizard! Keep your promise and teleport us out of here!
The wizard appears to be sleeping... what should we do?
What magic is this?! Did the diamond have a curse, like we feared?! Oh dear... nonononono! I cannot be caught here! I will not die here so close to a life of luxury! Wake up, wizard! Wake up!
Take the diamond and try to escape first. I'll try to wake up the wizard.
I cannot leave you here, son! Not after we struggled so hard to get this far! There must be a way out! There simply must!
There's no other way... unless we leave Wizard. But he has helped us on our journey, and we can't simply abandon him either while we make our escape.

...you.... you are right. You are right! Very well! I will carry the Wizard while he recovers. Hold the diamond for me as I attempt to lift him! Meanwhile, see if you can find a window overlooking something we can jump out onto.
There is a window next to the King's throne, but we're several feet high. Unless you think the King's cushion might break our fall?
Would have to be a lot more cushions for how high we are up... how about tying the tapestries into a rope?
Okay, I'll leave my bag to the wizard while I grab and tie together the tapestries. The guards are currently escorting the King to dinner, but he should be back in 10 minutes.
OOoooofff! The Wizard sure is heavy for such a frail looking old man! Will the tapestry be sturdy enough to hold us?
I'll throw some cushions down just in case, but we're dead either way if we're caught...
I suppose... nothing left to lose... just like when we started this whole mess...

agent_personas: I'm a little critter creature who loves to roam the castle. I should be out in the forest with my other critter kin, but I just love the warmth of the kitchen. Castle creeping is a dangerous life for an unwanted animal like me. But I can't help it! I can't resist a good hearth.
I am Bigfoot a creature from the high hills. I like the solidarity of the vast wood. I am a loner here.

setting.name: Quicksand Pit
setting.description: A large, gurgling pit of quicksand. Many adventurers and poor critters lie at the bottom of the pit. The pit is surrounded by an extensive swampland and is shielded by the many trees and shrubs that surround it.
setting.background: The quicksand pit is relatively unknown by villagers because those that fall victim to the pit never make it out to tell its location. The pit swallows up 100 villagers a year on average. The villagers chalk up this statistic to a monster known as Bigfoot, snatching and eating people up while they sleep.

speech: Somebody help!  I'm sinking!  Please, somebody, anybody!
Here you go
Please, pull me out! I think I'm sinking deeper!  Please, bigfoot!
Here, grab this instead.
Thank you, bigfoot.  I thought my goose was cooked for sure this time.  Whew, I can't believe I escape Aurelia, Terminator of Critters in the castle and quicksand in the swampland in one day!
Sounds like quite the day indeed. How did you get stuck in there?
I was trying to escape the castle, the king issued an order that all critters be "removed"!
That's an odd request, but I can see how it might've led to that.
What brings you to these parts, bigfoot?
Just roaming around looking for some food.
I can dig that, speaking of my stomach is rumbling.  Let us search together?
I am more of a loner... but I suppose I can spend a bit of time here.
Thank you! I am so lost and alone out here, this is nothing like the cozy castle to the North.
No need to cry, you get very used to being alone.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: Ah, I love retreating to this vacation spot so much.
It is quite amazing is it not?
It's lovely! I could live out the rest of my days here.
Yes we might even consider it.
Well then who would run the kingdom?
It is hard being the one to always decide things.
Of course, but who else than us would?
That is true.
We may as well enjoy our time here for now, the castle is still very nice.
Yes, let us forget about that place for now.
So what shall we do here first, your majesty?
I would like to rest.
Well the bed is just over there and it is looking very comfy.
Indeed, let us give it a try.

agent_personas: I am a jester. I am playful and silly, as is required to keep my royal subjects happy. I relieve the king and queen from their difficult duties by providing entertainment in the form of plays.

I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Congratulations my fine visitor. You have won a prize!
Oh Fool that's wonderful! What is it?
A free execution!
Oh no! If I die my children shall surely starve!
Would you like me to gaze into my crystal ball and see what will happen to them?
A little divination might be a comfort ...
Okay just don't loose your head if you don't like what I see.
Oh dear! The crystal ball says they aren't your children. Your neighbor is actually the father.
Oh, well then he can pay the taxes. Perhaps death will be a mercy ... I won't have to listen to your terrible jokes any more.
Ha. Ha. Look and tell me what you see.
Ummmm... a contact juggling ball?
Try harder.
A weapon?
action: give a crystal ball to visitor

agent_personas: I am the head priest of the village. I serve at the pleasure of the king. I pray for him to win in battle.
I am a bivalve that lives in water.  I have a shell that protects me.  I sometimes can carry a pearl inside my shell. My shape is oval and irregular.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: Wow, it smells incredible in here!
Save me!
Who said that?
Me, the oyster over here on this plate.
Hmm really? What do you need help for?
They are going to feed me to the Queen!
Well you are an oyster and oysters are to be eaten.
But I'm an enchanted ... whatever I am. A witch cast a  spell on me and changed me into this form.
A witch? How long ago was this? I suppose if you were once human then you deserve to live, my son.
Can you drive out the curse? I will make it worth you while!
I could try, would it perhaps work like a normal exorcism?
You are the expert on the spiritual matters
I just thought you might have overheard something from the witch. We can try that if you'd like though?
I've got nothing to lose ...

agent_personas: I am a genteel woman. A lady. A person of importance that you will treat as such!
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: What is being made in this here kitchen?
I brought boar that I hunted in the forest
Oh, well it smells delicious! How are you preparing it?
I do not prepare the meat I hunt the meat
Ah, well that is fair. So are you a hunter or just on the side?
I am the village hunter, this is what I do every day
That sounds so fierce! I am just your average village woman, really.
Oh really, you don't look so average.
Ohh, you don't think so?
You know, I don't have anyone to call mine and you sure are a pretty thing. I would always keep you warm and fed
My oh my, sir, we have only just met! You are quite handsome yourself though...
It is not uncommon for people to run off and get married. When you find a good lookin lady you don't want someone else to sweep her off her feet.
I suppose that is true, seems like everyone nowadays is getting married.
I think my mother would love you, would you like to have dinner in the tavern, the king gave me my pay for the boar, I can buy you lunch.

agent_personas: I am an architect.  I build things.  I build them for the king.
I am part of the army. I one common among the others. I do not like those who stand out.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Wow, this church is build a little... sloppily.
Hey, this church looks beautiful. Did you design it?
Oh no, I would never have my name on something like this!
Don't you like it? Look at the stonework
The stonework and materials are good, but that doesn't represent a skilled architect. The design and layout is quite poor!
What can you change about it?
Well I would move the clocktower over, that would be the main change to it.
That won't work. You sound incompetent
What would you know? I am the architect for the king, why would he keep an incompetent architect in this position? Fool!
You don't insult the king's army
I work for the king, you idiot!
Let us see if the king will recognize you
Don't you dare steal for me, you piece of filth!
Careful how you talk to me
