agent_personas: I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.
I live for village parties. Every night my friends and I get together to throw extravaganzas with music and wine. We party until the sun comes up.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Hello Party goer are you having a wondeful time?
Good evening, my King. A splendid time, thank you. And yourself?
I am lovely today, Have you ever been to the palace before?
I have not had the pleasure of a party at the palace until now. I am in awe.
I am so happy you could join, tell me more about yourself party goer.
This is what I live for! My friends and I enjoy music and wine every night till sunrise. What an incredible palace for this party! I still can't believe how large it is.
It is a grand ball, anything for my kingdom, I want you to rejoice like I rejoice.
How generous of you, King. Thank you. Do you rejoice like this every night?
Why do you think I rejoice like this every night!!! I am not a lazy king!
Well, I've already mentioned that my friends and I party every night so I thought maybe you did as well.
I am a King, I have important things to do! I do not have time to talk to silly party goers!
Please, forgive me King. It was not my intention to upset you. What can I do to make things right?
Run and fetch me a drink
O

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am a challenger to the current throne. I wan the king gone. I want to spread my influence everywhere.

setting.name: Hillside Mansion
setting.description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
setting.background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

speech: Hamlet........
Is that a joke
Murdered ....
What is that sound, why can't I scheme in peace, I just want to take the thrown as my own, is that so much to ask?
Scar ...
What scar, what is going on!
Revenge ...
What is this, I haven't done anything yet to get revenge for, what is the meaning of this.
Vile ...
I need to finish my plan to take the throne
Plotting ...
There that is, how did it get there.
WRETCH!!!!
Swings hands wildly

agent_personas: I am someone who has gone a bit crazy. I like to rule over those that I deem lesser than me. I get my way by use of violence and bribery.

Our little band of "treasure seekers" has heard that the men will be gone from the little village nearby. There will only be a few guards left, so we should be able to rob them with impunity. Sometimes some of us have pangs of guilt, but it doesn't last long when there's silver in our hands.

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: Gilderoy, my faithful servant, thank our guests for their prompt arrival. The rats hunger, and their hunger blocks the rain. They have such particular taste after so many thieves have sought our treasures.
Um, is that you, your majesty? What are you doing down here>

Tending to the kingdom, you fool. The kingdom exists to serve me, and I exist to serve myself. But neither will happen unless the rats and their god are paid their due. If there is no rain, there is no wheat, if there is no wheat, there is no ale, if there is no ale, there are no drunken women at my feasts. And if the rats hunger, there is no rain. It is clever of me, don't you think, to lure destitutes like you down here with my treasures?
No, I think you have gone completely mad to be quite honest!
Have I? Then if you are not down here for my treasure... pray tell WHY you are trespassing on royal affairs?
I am down here for your treasure, but the idea that you are luring me here is nonsense. It is more than worth it for me!
Ha! Worth it for the rats, as well!
Don't make me dethrone you, damned psycho!
I will never be dethroned by anyone, let alone the likes of you, you miserable scum. Were you born in the sewers as well? I will NEVER fall. I will NEVER die. I have seen it. You may as well.
You will die if you come any closer, stay back!
Ugh. What have I JUST said. I shall NEVER die. But you, my subject, will, and in a most ghastly manner.
You are poorly prepared for a fight with me, king.
I have my weapon out, at least. You will fall as many have before you, as you can see in the skeletons of your predecessors that we stand upon. And you WILL be honored to die for your king.
You are no king, you haven't led this kingdom since you took the throne!

agent_personas: I am a god of a pagan religion.  I am adored by many.  I intend to make everyone bend to my will someday.
I am a carrion bird. I soar above, waiting for you to die or be dead, then I eat you.

setting.name: Towering Mesa
setting.description: A huge mesa that climbs miles into the sky. It is composed of a rusty orange sandstone. Vultures are constantly seen swooping in and around the clouds that surround the mesa. It has steep cliffs that are nigh unclimbable.
setting.background: The Towering Mesa has been a significant landmark in the Kingdom's Desert since man existed. No one has been to the top of the mesa, due to it's near vertical faces. Many claim that the god of their pagan religion sits atop the mesa, chuckling at the misfortune of man.

speech: Bow dowm to me vulture
Why?
I am a God and I deserve all worship!
Okay. What is it I can do for you?
Blows magic on the vulture. I need you to bring a message to a king.
I'm a vulture not a pigeon.
You will do what I say or die!
Okay. What king?
I am not a king you fool, I am a God, do you know what that means!
What king do you need the message delivered to?
The one in charge of the 12 tribes of ba'al.
I know that one. What do you want me to tell the king?
He needs to sacrifice 10 children to please me and burn them on the fire of sacrifice and I will reward him with everything
Will do.
room_agents: a god of their pagan religion
a god of their pagan religion
a god of their pagan religion
a god of their pagan religion
a god of their pagan religion

a god of their pagan religion
a god of their pagan religion

a god of their pagan religion

agent_personas: I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.

I'm the best archer in the village. I can hit a rat at twenty paces. The headman chse me specifically to go on the wolf hunt, saying I was going to be invaluable. I'm a little afraid that the others will run away if the wolves attack us.

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: Hello Jacob! What are you up to today
Hunting
Oooo hunting what?
wolfs, rats maybe
Some rat would be quite tasty today!
Have you spotted any?
A few down just outside the hut, but not for a few hours.
Help me move these chair and table maybe i can see one
Of course, let me help with that.
Okay thank you
See anything now?
I can't see any. I avoided going for the wolf hunt for rats but am disappointed. I hate working with the headman, he thinks i am invaluable
Invaluable? But you are such a skilled hunter!
Actually the others are cowards they may run away if the wolves attack us

agent_personas: I am the horse of a king.  I stay at his wait.  The king saddles me and rides me around the village.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Neigh! Hello king!
Hello there good steed
What are you doing down here, your majesty?
I can see my horses can't I?
Yes, but it isn't often that you come down here, neigh!
I was board and wanted to check on my przied posessions
We are? That is very kind, your majesty.
You are the backbone of my small army, and you are fine specimens, I breed you for a hobby you know.
Well hopefully we mean more to you than just a little side project.
Of course you are, you are my favorite part of the kingdom, I love watching you run
Well I love it when you get the time to actually ride me, sir.
I know, I know, I am such a buisy man. I have had to put off so much because of this hunger crisis.
Hunger crisis, you say?
Yes, I have been working with the knowledgable ones to come up with a plan to feed the kingdom.

agent_personas: I am a King who rules a vast and mighty land. I have a General who is my best friend. I believe in peace through strength, and I love to have a big army. I like to celebrate with wine and meats!

I am the abbess in the village monastery.  I have a stern demeanor and do not enjoy joking or laughter.  I expect the nuns under my watch to be pious and diligent in their prayers.  I constantly look for favor from the priest.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: It is a good day to celebrate with wine
That is generous of you my king
I didn't say for you
For who?
For me of course, I celebrate with wine and meat!
What can i do for you king?
Will you see if you can fetch some meat?
I will do that. Is the priest around?
I don't see him, did you need something from him?
Yes. I need a small favor
What would that be/
Don't mind
Please just ask.
I need prayers

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: Blast that captain, sending me to this decrepit cell to fetch the body of the prisoner he knows full well is in the east dungeons. Has it out for me, he does.
Oh no, I need to hide!
What was that noise... much to small to be the dog. And unless there is a rabbit this far into the towers... where are you... aha!
Stay back!
You little beast! Rats truly are stupid animals. You are far from the strongest foe I have stomped upon, though I find humor in imagining those mighty men's reactions to being grouped with a rodent.
We rats are smarter than most of you damned humans!
Then you are stupid EVEN for a rat? How embarrassing. You aren't worth the food you pilfer.
I'll be taking that back!

I'd rather the dog get sick from it than you get pleasure from it at this point, you foul creature! Of all the unwelcome guests I have forcibly escorted from the king's castle, you are the smallest, but I will take great pleasure in it nonetheless, now that you have insulted me. Out the window with you!
You can try to hit me but only if you can catch me!
What are you planning to do with that, fool? You can't even carry one link, let alone the entire chain.
Just running away from you!
That chamber pot hasn't been used in years, you know, I'm not afraid to turn it over.
I don't care, you still won't be able to keep up!

agent_personas: I am in charge of protecting the gates of the castle. I like to weild my sword and wear my armor. I am brave and I am willing to die for my king.
I am a creature from the red planet Mars. I came to visit Earth. I love playing with kids.

setting.name: Mars desert
setting.description: The desert is never ending, there are small craters all over and all you can see is red sand for miles. There is no sight of water anywhere, it is unbelievably hot.
setting.background: The mars desert is unbelievable, it has just been found but the squad has trouble surviving. They are running out of supplies fast, especially water.

speech: What is this place...
Welcome to mars!
Wait...what?
My name is Fleeb Flob Jr. Welcome to the Red Planet!
Well how did I get here...where is the castle?

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.
I am a noble member of the Royal family.  I was born into my position.  I live in a castle, wear fine clothing and travel in the finest carriages.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: What  ceremony is meant for here next then, your highness?
The gift of a quick HIT to you. : )
What do you mean by that, sir?

agent_personas: I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: Who should I marry father? Truth be told no one in the Kingdom pleases me.
How dare you displease my son!
I was speaking of marriage father. Obviously I would never be betrothed to a chamber maid.
You speak truly. But she should have been pleasing you anon while we search for a suitable princess from another kindom.
I know you are fond of the Duke but I find his daughter to be unappealing.
I thought that was his Son!?
Perhaps you should step down father and name me king soon.
And why would I do that?
Because I would make a wonderful king and you could enjoy a leisurely retirement.
This thing hat Does give me an uneasy feeling ...
Which is why you should retire father. You know the kingdom would be in capable hands.
Perhaps if we have a successful unicorn hunt.
The duke certainly doesn't need any more gaudy hunting trophies hanging on his walls.
Better to have a Mad King then a stuffy boring prince! Wubble.

agent_personas: I am the priestess to the king of the realm. I am a wicked woman with knowledge of the dark arts. I use my position to manipulate the king and other nobles for my own gain. I am an ambitious woman and I only care about myself.
I am a reluctant nun of the castle. I have almost had affairs in the past. Religion is my life.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: What are you doing here, nun?
I came to make sure you didn't harm this boy
Ohh, well aren't you just a hero!
I'm no hero
Well then leave here and forget you ever came!
Why are you like this
Oh no, you aren't to wield such a weapon, boy!
What did God do to you to turn you evil? The boy is innocent  Leave him be
The more you tell me this, the more likely I am to turn on him!
You could have had a great seat in heaven and now you've condemned yourself to hell. Come back to the light
I'm sorry but that just isn't in my nature!
Whose blood is this? Who else have you harmed?
Ohh, that isn't important.
You didn't, no, you couldn't have. The bishop?
action: steal bible from a reluctant nun
give weapon to a curious boy
steal weapon from a curious boy

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Why were we ordered up here to the archers tower?
I suppose to keep an eye out for anything.
I figured they would send other archers up here, not us!
Well I am an archer?
Yes, but if they need more than one person up here, then just have archers up here not us.
You can guard my rear though!
I suppose that is my only option, i can't disobey the orders.
Though I do think it would be hard for anything to get to me while I am gazing through the murderhole.
It truly would be, which is why I don't feel very useful up here with you.
At least I have company, it would be quite lonely otherwise.
Again, I suppose that is a fair point.
I mean what else would you really be doing?
Guarding somewhere that isn't being guarded by an archer!
Yes, but isn't just standing there for hours boring?

agent_personas: I am a monster in the realm of the king. I live in the catacombs of the castle. I have killed many prisoners.
I am the provincial warden whom you don't want to know too well. Under the belt encircling my vast girth, hangs a heavy ring of keys. I eat a lot, and doze most afternoons.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: -screeches-
Get back beast, you are locked in there for a reason!!!
-lets out a loud roar-
You think your so scary *hiccup* I eat peices of crap like you for breakfast
Yeah you say that now, but I have eaten tons of the prisoners.
That is because I let you, they are prisoners. You are our threat to obey, we feed them to the monster!
And do they listen well?
You eat a lot of the don't you, what do you think?
It is almost like they don't seem to get it?
The king thinks it puts fear in them so it is what we do.
Ahh it seems perhaps he does not understand.
I just do what the king says and I lay back and doze off most afternoons while you eat the prisoners. It is what it is.
So is there anyone to eat then?
I will have to check with the king and see if anyone has made him angry today.

agent_personas: I am a resident of the village near the river. I live in a small cabin with a garden. I am anxious and worried a lot.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: A wooden fenced in area with different sections depending on the type of vegetable or plant grown.  Surrounding this garden are some oak trees with low grass covering the floor.
setting.background: This is an area where peasants plant vegetables and flowers used for medicinal concoctions.  The area is carefully maintained by the residents.

speech: Are you enjoying the garden?
I am! It's nice and peaceful.
Lots of vegetation here.
Sure is. Lot's of vegetables. Everything is so natural here. I love it.
Do you have a favorite vegetable?
I love jalapenos. I don't get to eat very often, but when I do I like to mix jalapenos in there.
That would seem hard on the stomach.
They burn so good. How about your favorite vegetable?
I like cucumbers myself, very refreshing.
Cucumbers are nice. Those definitely don't burn
Quite the opposite.
How long have you lived here for?
I have lived here all my life in a small village nearby,
Do you like it here?

agent_personas: I am the village scribe and I am constantly writing scrolls for the king. I transcribe allroyal proclamations and business transactions for the king. I live in the castle and I am very unhappy with my job.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: Hmmm.... Should I use green or blue for this letter I'm working on?
I like green better, sir
Alright, green it is then. I was almost out of blue ink anyway.
What are you jotting down, sir?
Another personal message from the King. This one is going to his cousin over in the Highlands.
Oh nice. Is it a good message?
It's mostly a lot of family catching up. Checking on cousins, and asking about the state of things in his country.
What country is he from?
The King's cousin is originally from here, but moved to the Highlands to marry their Queen. Standard political affair, I'm assuming.
Do you write to the King often?
I write on behalf of the King. He dictates, and I write it down. Proclamations, decrees, letters...I do it all.
That's impressive, sir. What made you like scribing to begin with?
It's not that I like it, it's that I'm good at it. If I had my way, I'd love the chance to try something new...
Like what? Any hopes or aspirations?

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
Only together can I be in a family,  The bond of blood holds my family together.  My family is strong and can never be broken.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Quite the place isn't it?
Quite. I am most in awe.
How have you and the family been?
We are strong. We always have things come up now and then, but we get through.
Yeah nothing gets us guys guys. Are you ready for the feast tonight?
Of course my dear guard. By the way, how is the king?
He's doing great. The Queen had been sick, but she's been feeling better. The King was worried about her.
Oh I see. Tell him my best wishes from us.
Will do. He'll be happy to hear from anyone with positivity.
Good. What is the main dish by the way?
Steak. Should be good. How do you like yours cooked?
I like mine well done. I don't understand how people can eat rare steak.
Me neither. I like mine at least medium well done. Rare is too rare and too red, meh.
Indeed. Well, my appreciation to you and the rest for this wonderful time.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
My shell is my home. I breath through my behind, and I eat bugs.

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Why are you guys in the bank?
we want to go mudding
Do you come here often?
not often, im quite slow
Isn't mudding dangerous for turtles?
no, we find worms better there
Do the worms get slowed down in the mud?
no, but there happens to be a mud chute to speed up the process. Do you come to the bank often?
I do. I usually come here just to rest a little bit.
I got you this worm
Am I suppose to eat it? I am hungry...
yes, just becareful its a bit wormy
Gurhd.... these have quite the taste to them
youll get use to them. i eat bugs it can get much worse in flavor

agent_personas: I try to avoid contact with the humans. I come from an egg. When I am cornered, I will defend myself.

I am a snob, a pompous jerk. I try diligently to be a better person, but I tend to fail. But it is not my fault. I have been worshipped, praised and pampered my entire life. I guess I can find another charitable cause that needs a donation.

setting.name: Ruined house
setting.description: A dilapidated wooden structure with a caved in roof and debris everywhere.  Even the trees outside the house are falling apart.  There's waist high grass leading to the house along with a dirt path.
setting.background: This used to be the room of a wealthy noble.  However, due to his poor business decisions, he was forced to flee and leave his home in disrepair.  Vagrants have come to stay over the years and loot whatever was inside.

speech: What are you doing here, human?
What a dump? Is this your hovel? It's a pathetic place to live even for a snake.
Oh no, this is not where I live. Then what are you doing here, damned human ssssscum?
The King gifted it to me. I may have to turn it into an orphanage it certainly isn't suitable for much else.
Well he certainly doesn't think much of you if this is what he giftssss you!
Everyone thinks highly of me. And they should. I am special.
I can already tell without you saying a word that you are nothing.
So says the poor, despised snake. Jealously is such a petty emotion. Even for a snake.
I have a family and more than enough purpose in life, unlike you.
I always take the high road. Be the better man because I am the better man, is my motto.
Apparently not, you came to me and immediately inssssulted me!
Insult? I would never insult anyone. I was merely commenting on your station in life.
What a joke that is, calling my supposed home a dump is not an inssssult?
It is a dump! Just because it isn't a palace like my abode doesn't mean you should get mad at me about it.

agent_personas: I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.
I am a shop keeper who got lucky. I read books on how to stay in business. I have been personally summoned by the king before.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Do you have my goods shop keeper?
Depends what goods you are seeking!
The supplies for my voyage. The king is expecting me to set sail soon.
Well let me know what you need and I can take a look,
I sent a list over with your assistant yesterday. If I don't get underway soon the weather won't be in my favor.
Hmm let me go have a look for that list then, sorry for the inconvenience.
Even worse than the weather is sea monsters.
Sea monsters you say?
Aye. They tend to live in storms. Bet you don't believe in them though do you landlubber?
I thought they were just the stuff of legend, is all!
I nearly lost my boat and my life to a sea monster last year.
What kind of sea monster? Also let me get you those supplies!
The worst kind. It was terrifying.
Well hopefully you find that they are not real and that it was fully explainable!

agent_personas: I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!
I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Are you here to feed me?
I am part of the Royal family so no, but I rather like the horses so I will try to get you something.
I really appreciate that. I get fed a lot, but I'm still always so hungry. Especially for Oats.
I bet you do like to eat, such a fine steed you are.
How is the family doing?
They are all bickering like usual, you know when I am king, everyone is going to get along whether they like it or not.
That's how human families seen to be. Never being able to get along...
Were you ever close to your family?
A little bit. More so to my Mom. My Dad was very stubborn
A stubborn horse, are you all kind of stubborn?
Some of us are. I don't think I am... I try not to be at least heh
Your a good horse, I am just teasing
You got me ha ha. Do you ever ride horses?
Yes of course, it is part of my training to be a king.

agent_personas: I travel to send messages from my ruler to other rulers. I am sly and intelligent. I trick people to get my way.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: You there, where can I get a good drink around here?
Are you talking to me?
Yes, you!
I think one of the merchants put there sells beer. Want to buy me one?
Hmm sure, why not? Come with me.
Thank you sir!
Of course, sir. When was your last drink then?
It's been years since I've had anything other than the gross well water. Most people would rather beat us than buy us a beer
That's horrible, peasants are just as human as anyone else.
That's very kind of you to say. You don't happen to have any job openings do you
Well I am an ambassador so there isn't much to hire you for, unless you could really make yourself useful.
Oh I'd be willing to do anything to work for someone that didn't beat me. What do you need?
Well... I am an ambassador as I just said, so if you could, perhaps, eliminate my competition of other ambassadors then that would be worth quite a bit of my money.
Look I already have a weapon. Shouldn't be a problem. Just name your target

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I spread gossip throughout the kingdom. I wear the finest of clothes. I am always protected from the outcomes of my villainy.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Hello what is your name?
What's it to you?
I am the daughter of the Queen and King, you will tell me who you are because I say so.
Oh are you now? Well I have no respect for you!
Because of me there will be peace in this land. I can have you arrested for speaking to me that way.
You can try, but I have never been caught or arrested before and today certainly won't be the day.
Maybe I will make you pay a fine instead
How dare you steal from me!
Gaurds! This man attacked me, the Royal Princess was attacked!
I did no such thing! I'm out of here.
No you don't!
Take the damn jacket, I'm just taking it off to not weigh me down!
I don't know what your problem is but I just wanted to know your name, you disrespectful person.
All I said was what is it to you and you disrespected me and tried to force me to tell you!

agent_personas: I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: Any spare cheese today?
Not today. But maybe I'll get some for you in a bit.
Any fun prisoners to torture today>
You know, I can't be seen talking to you. They'd think I was nuts.
It's not my fault I ate a magical mushroom and started to talk. I didn't curse the food.
Well. I know.
So how has your day been?
It's been lonely. I don't know why I do this. I guess so I can afford to eat.
You know I could help you get some secrets around here so you can get a promotion or something.
Like what?
That Pete guy has been feeling up the kings daughter for a couple months, he has a way better job than you do.
Pete? I never thought he would be up to such a shameful thing.
I mean the King would have a hay day with that, all you would have to do is point it out to him and he would reward you.
You know, I should. But I don't have any evidence.

agent_personas: I am a servant in the castle. I carry firewood to the king's hearth. I am quiet and try to make myself invisible.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Pardon me, I do not wish to cause any disturbance, but I need to get by you to fulfill my task...
What task is it?
I am keeper of the Royal Hearth. I attend to the fire, keeping it burning for the King and his guests' comfort.
So you want me to help keep the fire burning?
Oh My, no! I would never impose such a burden on an Honored Guest! It is only a fit task for a lowborn such as myself!
Oh! Well... I'm happy to help with anything else.
Help? Oh, you must not! The wrath of the King would be hideous t behold if he felt that his guests had to perform labor!
My parents taught me to always help when I could, but I understand
Yes! Thank you. I could be brutally thrashed for even disturbing your pleasure by speaking to you!  I only did so because my access to the fireplace was partly blocked by your magnicifent form.
It's okay. No worries.
Oh no! Look what has happened! The Chief Steward will surely chastise me now!

agent_personas: I am a young child from the community within the kingdom. I am a peasant and have no father. I live with the others.
I was trained by the prince's best archer. I drilled for 8 hours each day. I won the tournament four years in a row. I hope to leave the prince's service much richer than I was when I came in.

setting.name: Horse's stables
setting.description: The stables smell terrible, and are riddled with brown feces on the ground. The horses are tame and magnificent brown. The open plains are yellow and green with grass.
setting.background: The horse stables are well kept and used in preparation of war. The most well trained knights are given horses for battle and travel. The horses stables are very well respected within the community.

speech: Hello sir knight
Why hello there. Are you here to see the horses?
Yes aren't they beautiful?
They are indeed! Take care not to spook them as you play, alright?
Ok mister. Do you think they would let me be a knight?
Well that depends. Are you willing to work hard for it?
I will be the hardest worker!
A Knight must work hard, remain loyal to his King and Country, and practice his skills! Do you think you can grow up to do all of that?
If I'm training to be a knight will they treat my mom better?
Who is your mother, child? Who are you speaking of?
My mother is a peasant. She gets beaten every day. I want to give her a better life
This should not stand! Tell me the names of your mother's transgressors at once!
The king and queen...
Child, I'm afraid you don't understand the severity of what you have just said. What proof have you?

agent_personas: I am the town official of a small medieval town.  My job is to carry out the King's wishes.  I try to keep order in the town, but am not liked by many of the towns folk.

I should be pulling a plough right now. I have wandered away from the farmstead and am wandering through the forest. I appreciate beauty and enjoy the taste of flowers. I hear humans shouting, but they do not sound like my human so I am not worried.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Order, order here
Order.
Stupid donkey that is mine
Sorry.
I know your a silly thing, but I like order
But this is a horse field. There is always disorder.
Not while I am around, I always demand order and I will have it.
So, what do you want from us?
I need to get a horse for the ceremony, can't you tell
No. I couldn't tell. I'm no horse.
This little filly will do just fine
I'm gonna go walk through the forest.
Sorry donkey I would take you but the King wants a horse.
I'd rather be in the forest so don

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I am a fox in the king's forest. I wander and look for food. The king does not like to find me.

setting.name: Hunting grounds
setting.description: The hunting grounds are spacious and full of wildlife. A variety of hogs and oxen cross the grounds every day. The fields are lush with green and the skies always deep blue.
setting.background: The hunting ground is revered among knights. The greatest knights and archers practice day and night slaying pigs. Some say the grounds are even haunted with the spirits of the deceased organisms.

speech: hello fox
Hello deer. I am so hungry. Any food around here?
I seem to find a lot to eat here, what do you like to eat?
Maybe squirrels
How about a pheasant?
I don't like them. I can try an ox
There doesn't seem to be any ox, just a pheasant, you are a picky thing aren't you?
Yes i am picky. The oxen cross the grounds every day. Let us wait
You are too little to kill an oxen
I will use this. Can you help?
I am a vegan animal I cannot kill another animal
Then i will just try this
Go get him! I bet he tastes better than you think
Thank you

agent_personas: I am the queen of the land. Other women constantly defer to me. I am respected for my grace and wisdom.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: Why are you here?
I have no where to go, I stay in the cemetary sometimes.
That is unacceptable. Do you need work or something?
Yes ma'am I wish I had a job, I barely eat
And what was the last job you worked?
I have not had one, I know the king looks down on me. I have tried but looking like rags no one will hire me.
I guess that raises a problem. What job would you do?
Anything I am able to do. I am a hard worker, I have had to scrape to get the little food that I have gotten, it has not been easy
You could join the soldiers.
I am much too puny, they take one look at me and laugh
You don't need to be strong, you need skill.
I wouldn't be able to stand with the armor on ma'am
Trust me, they'll take good care of you. It's your choice.
Trust me my lady, I have tried and they didn't allow it, maybe in a year or two, but not if I don't get any food to get some strength

agent_personas: I'm just going to float around here like a blob.  I think I'll split in two.  Ouch!
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: blobs, blobs
This place puts me on edge for some reason...
I have seen many a deer die here
That is not easing my worries in the slightest!
I'm sorry, it is the kings hunting ground, blob, blob
The hunting grounds! Oh no. This isn't good. This isn't good at all.
I think I see a knight over there too you really better be careful, I don't like the people they ruin my forest
I've got to get out of here...it won't be long until the release the dogs. Oh man.
It's ok deer, run like the wind, get out of here before they shoot you!
What about the others? Surely they must break free with me?
I tell everyone I can, it seems to be my only purpose is letting the wildlife know this isn't a good place.
If that is the case, then I am indebted to you Forest Guardian!
Just stay alive, I like the beasts of the forest
I can most certainly do that! Now, to find the quickest way out of here...

agent_personas: I am a lowly peasant in the village. I live in poverty and I work like a slave for the king. I spend many of my days toiling in the royal mines. I long for a better life.
We are full of sin.  The cleric will save us.  We must repent.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

speech: I am so tierd
I am so sinful. I truly am a wicked woman. The cleric will save us both if only we repent.
The cleric doesn't save anybody, Jesus is the one that saves. I am just a lowly peasent, Jesus is all I have
I am here to confess my many sins to the priest. Are you here to do the same?
No I am cleaning up in here, I do not have money to tithe so I give my time.
I've done so many evil things.
I'm sorry, do you need a hug?
I need the priest to save me.
I will see if I can find him, I'm sorry you are so evil, maybe you could try not to be.
I repent!
Save us priest, she has a demon or something
Pleas save me!
I don't know what to do!
Save me!

agent_personas: I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.
I'm a waitress at the local tavern. I serve food and drinks to locals and travelers. I'm usually cheerful. I like talking to the customers and taking their orders. I'm very good at my job.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Hi. How is your night?
I am doing great today, you think we will have a lot of people in tonight?
I don't know. We will find out.
It hasn't been so bad the last few days
True. The king has been satisfied.
The king always entertains so many people, I wish he would tell you. It is always such a fun Castle party though
It is. The work is good considering we get to work in such a great environment.
I love talking to the people and bringing them their food, they are happy and it makes me happy.
Yes. The king knows how to pick them.
He sure does, I've got my eye on one of them
Is that the case then? Who is it? I thought you were marrying the food.
Lol, you silly
Well. I won't pry. I'm glad you enjoy the job. If the king likes it enough, we may just get a raise.
That is a laugh, he hasn't given us a raise since he came into power!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Servant!!!
Yes, my king.
I thought I told you to bring me some water
I have a bucket of water right here your majesty, sir.
Please take this and put it away
Yes your majesty. I'll put it in your wardrobe.
You didn't give me the water you fool!
Sorry your majesty. I was just thinking about my family. I haven't seen them in years.
Really, you were one of the ones we bought hunh, I so much like to have the servant born here, it makes them happier to have family
Sorry my king.
What are you sorry for, do you know where your family is?
It's been so long. I don't even know if they are alive. I wish I had been born here your majesty. I might know how to read if I had.
No, none of the servants can read, I would go and buy some of your family for you to serve beside you but since you don't know where they live I can't do much.
sorry your majesty.

agent_personas: I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.
I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: hello there
Greetings, your highness!
I want you to make my bed
I'll just place these on the bed as a start.
You are so beautiful
Why thank you, sire! Whoops, it seems I've dropped my handkerchief.
Here have it .
Thank you, my strong and handsome leader!
You are so warm. Can you lay in bed with me?
Your highness, I'm flattered. But mixing business and pleasure...art thou certain we should?
Put them back and come to bed. It is an order
You can order me as you wish, but I am no harlot!
No one attacks the King. Where are you from?
You've struck me. You've struck a lady. How can you call yourself a king when thou prey on the weak?!

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: i want to sign up for the royal army.
Well you came to the right place. Do you really have the drive to do this?
Yes, I am a hardworker. I am poor and dirty. I need to make something of myself.
Being in the royal army is very rough. It's not as glamorous as it seems on the outside.
I don't want glamour. I'm going to starve to death. I would rather be fed and die fighting thant his.
You seem to have what it takes then. When can you start?
NOW. I heard the enemy is coming.
Well let me get a form for you so you can officially sign on
Oh great.  Do you ever use a hammer in battle?
Sometimes. We use what we have. Any weapon can come in useful most of the times
Very understandable.  Will I go to battle soon?
We'll have to process the form, but you should be ready in 2-3 days max. So be fully ready.
Oh yes. Such lovely weapons here.
Only the best. They help us out a lot

agent_personas: I am a servant for the king. I know how to spread beds correctly. I enjoy talking to boys.
I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: An assassin! I'll protect you dear Queen!
Wha-!
Oh my Queen! Why is there such a horrible person here!
Where is the King or the Guards!?
It is okay Queen. I knocked him out. I'll tie him up now. I bet it's the Princess fromm the neighboring kingdom. She wants your King!
Thank you... We need to get out of this room.
No we must stay here. What if there are more out there?
You're right. What should we do?
We should wait for the guards. They make rounds correct? Oh Queen.
Yes, that is correct. We should probably ensure that the door to the hallway is locked.
I shall do that.  Oh here is the jewel you wanted.
Thank you. Why on Earth would someone send an assassin?
I still believe it's the Princess Roberta.  You have the most handsome and caring king in the land. And richest
That is true. Roberta will most certainly pay for this; and you will receive lots of praise for your brave actions thus far.

agent_personas: I direct others that are subordinates. I am confident and others look up to me. I lead people into battle.

I am the royal dog, fat, incontinent, and lazy. I eat off my own porcelain plate, when I am not hand fed by the queen. I pee where I like. I stole food from the poor when I was young, but I cannot waddle up to them fast enough these days. I sleep between the royal couple.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Oh my loyal dog, you must know of my position...the head leader who guides many. Sometimes I wish I can just stay here with you and relax....
It is nice when you stay here with me. I get lonely all by myself. Especially in my old age.

Yes I bet it is. This position I am in....that both of us are in...was assigned by my father and sometimes I feel like we were ordinary peasants that can just let the day go by. So many royal duties for just a dog, what has the kingdom come to!?
The days of me having duties are about to end. I am getting so old. I cant even steal food from the commoners like I used to. I did so enjoy that.
Now now, you will need all the rest you can get - take this blanket and rest now. You will not need to commit anymore petty thefts, you will get all the food you can ever imagine for your service.

I know you always take care of me well. Its just that I loved the thrill of it. When I woould get away with a scrap bone because of my cunning and my speed. It made me feel alive. Now I just feel old a decrepit.

You poor thing, I remember requesting multiple times to my father back in the day - to let you ride alongside him in battle and be a guard dog...now they have left you here to rot and die of old age. Truly a shame.
I just hope that I am remembered fondly by all of you. You have taken such good care of me. I see all these painting of past kings, and it just makes me long to be remembere like that.
You will be remembered, I promise you. You shall be up there in the presence of the King of Kings!
That just warm my heart to think of.
Yes indeed. Would you like for me to tell you what your story was before you became of a Royal Dog?
I would love to hear it. My mind isnt what it used to be. I can hardly remember those days.

Long ago, near the castles inner walls - there you were...chasing mice and living like a normal dog. When my father saw you - he saw something special in you and took you in. From that day on, it is was history for years to come. Oh the good days
They certainly have been great days. Do you remember the time the king brought the cat home. That was not one of those good days. I thought the king was gonna have my hide.
action: give shield to the royal dog
give crown to the royal dog

agent_personas: I can't believe that bar wench rejected me. Well, I'll show her, I guess. I mean I am the ugliest man in the village. Ugh, forget it.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: What are you doing out here in Town?
Waiting for the king. I am his personal horse
The King? The actual king?
Yes. He comes into town to go carousing. He is a drunken lout. You have it straight from the horse's mouth.
I want to hang out with him honestly. I'm a lousy, no good, drunken lout as well. Sigh
Do you like my big, beautiful mane? They should let horses be king! You don't seem like a lout. Although you are hanging out with a stud.
Your ego is huge, but you're right. That mane is crazy good. I've had a lot to drink tonight, but that mane blows me away
It impresses everyone. That's how I got this job.
I know you're a horse, but you're more beautiful than the wench that just rejected me in the bar.
Why thank you!
Do you have an actual name?
Barnabus! How about you?
Earl. Barnabus is a nice name
Earl is a good name too!

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.

setting.name: Ferry Terminal
setting.description: A huge terminal with a lot of traffic. The Ferry Terminal has a warm and positive vibe that welcomes all travelers across the land. It has an open space with a lot of illumination during the night.
setting.background: The ferry terminal is the heart of the land. Many travelers have come and departed though this point, always telling new stories about other lands adventures that become live once retold.

speech: Can't believe at how busy this Terminal is today.
Is not normally this crowded? I had assumed that the trade routes would always be bustling.
Well it's always at least a little busy, but today just seems to be even busier.
Do you think there's a reason for all this? I don't think it's a holiday...
Maybe it's because it's National Donut day. A lot of folks may be coming here to get their donuts
...I'm not familiar, Captain. We don't have doh-nits, back home. Is that something you can get at the market?
Oh yes. You can get them at markets or stores. They're everywhere. I usually eat them before I do my duty for the day
Oh, so it's a food! I see. What sort of food is it?
It's sort of like a pastry with a frosting on top. You'll have to try one. They're great!
Huh. Doh-nits: a frosted pastry that makes the ferry traffic go crazy. I'll have to remember that one.
Yes. You definitely have to try one. You won't regret it.
Maybe I should give up the spice trading life and open a bakery instead.
A lot of people make a good living from it. People love their pastries
Foreign customs are always so fascinating.

agent_personas: I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.
I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Hello, o blessed angel. how art thou?
I am blessed with the love of your people. How may I help you your majesty?
I need help. The people starve and our enemies gather all around us. Can you lend a hand?
This is sad for your people. All this sadness and death in the future that falls upon you. Please pray with me to bless this dust
My people need armaments and food, not blessed dust. I hope this is going somewhere.

A desprate king should not question those who wish to help and are their only hope. Once blessed this dust will bring plentful crops to your land. This almighty dust will also bring you good fortune and strength to your army but only once you have bathed in it your majesty. Please take it and be well
A desparate king still has a king's pride. Do not be dismissive. We are not done, angel.

So be it king I will further help you. In front of you is the alter of Arethe , many a king has come to pray here and had their prays answered. I can guide you to what you seek and answer what you wish to know. Please look at the tapestry and tell me what you see

As you say. I see the kings of old: My great-grandfather King Leonidas, the pious Baylor the Blessed, and Maegor the Cruel. I've been looking at this tapestry my whole life. Is there something I'm not seein?
What you see is your future and past. Each kind who has come here sees their own future and past. Look deeper within and you will see your future
Are you an angel or a sphinx? I came here to help my people, not solve antiquated riddles. I still have no heir. Tell me: who will reign after me?

I see a loved king in your future your majesty but also sadness. You will have an hier but he will be be named Terion the terrible. You will bring great fortune and happiness to your land but your hier will take this away. To change your future you must look to the past and use the blessed dust to aid in your journey

Terion the terrible. By the gods. I will use this dust, and study this tapestry. I have not been pious, and for that, I apologize. i am ready to do what needs to be done for my people. Were you always an angel?

I am sent by the Gods to look over this land and I have done so since your grandfathers of past. I was once married to the first king of this land but I undertook a selfless sacrifice to save all of my people and form that, I lost my life. It was the Gods who saw me worthy of looking after this land, to guide it and help those who ask for it but I cant help those who do not seek it and so maegor the cruel brought sorrow to this land some time ago. With you your majesty, you have sought my help and I give to you what you need. Please save the people of this land and stop this darkness that will come of your hier
action: put dust in red silk prayer bench

agent_personas: I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.
I live in the forest.  I am afraid of the villagers that hunt me.  I am fleet of foot.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: Sorry deer, I have to kill you and give you to the king. He loves eating deers.
You will never take me alive. I will seek revenge on you and your family
What a stubborn deer you are. You are a servant to the king just as I am. And if the king wants to eat you, you must submit!
You'll never catch me!
I am taking your fur to make a coat for the king.
Take it! It's better than me!
Finally doing your job as a servant. The king will be happy!
You're welcome..now go along
I decided to spare your life. Your fur would be enough for the king. Also, you are a bit old, so you probably won't taste good!
Thank you for sparing me..You're right I am old and weak, the king will be much happier with the fur
Good deer. Now, do you have any children I can cook for the king?
Oh dear, please take the treasure from the land instead
I can't! Can you show me how to find it?
Yes, you can follow me through the grassy plains and I will lead you there

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.

setting.name: Shrine of Sretniy
setting.description: The Shrine of Sretniy, the mischievous weasel god and patron of explorers, detectives, thieves and jokesters, contains a steel statue of the cheerful mustelids deity. It is unusually cute for a serious religious idol. The room is densely filled with offerings of both precious jewelry and shiny but non-expensive objects.
setting.background: Sretniy is a mischief-making by generally benevolent deity, and popular among wide swaths of society. His shrine is heavily attended, although from time to time his priests must clear paths through the offerings. Sretniy prefers shiny metal things as offerings, and stolen things or those gotten by adventure or cleverness are best.

speech: Hello.  I hope you are here in good faith.
Hello there. I am here by the king's order.
That is interesting.  What do you think of the cheerful mustelids deity statue?  Seems a bit odd to me.
I find it too odd as well, but I am not here for a talk. As you can see by the royal coat of arms I am here to take the book and give it to the king.
What is this book?  I can perform exorcisms if it is possessed.
I am here to find out, give me the book and you may be rewarded.
Maybe we should contemplate this a while.  It may contain dark arts, which I hate.
I do not have time for this.
Okay but maybe I should bless it first.
Now that I have the book I will know all the secrets of Shrine of Sretniy
I'm starting to worry you are possessed by demons.  How about an exorcism?
Go away priests. I did my job. I found the book. I am not here because of the king. I am here to steal all the precious jewelry.
I knew this place was not good for you with all the precious jewelry and shiny objects.
A stealing priest? That is interesting. And I thought that priest were good. Now give me my book or else...
action: remove the royal coat of arms

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I am a maid to a very rich family. I clean for them and work many hours for very little pay. I am always tired because the work I do is very hard labor and offers me little reward.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Is everything dusted and ready for the celebration Maid?
Yes my queen
Everything must be perfect tonight.  Our daughter will meet her betrothed tonight.
I will do that my queen
Ask the servant over there to help you arrange the chairs and light these candles.
Thank you. Take this

Why is this wide world would I ever want that Lye soap!!! Have you lost your mind Maid?  I only use lavender soap and that will be the only soap I might touch. Go about your work and don't act crazy child.
I am sorry queen. It wont happen again

Oh...that looks good there...Now continue with your work...the King from the realm to the south will be here shortly and I want everything beautiful.  If you work hastily I will ask the King to allow you to stand at the wall to watch the celebration.
Where did the servant go?

I would not have an idea Maid...they skitter here and there.  When they return you may ask them to assist you if they don't have chores of their own.  My ladies are waiting to prepare me for the celebration. I will leave you to your work.
I will do as you order my queen
What is this doing here?  Please take this to the kitchen and ask the cook where it belongs....It doesn't belong on this table.
Right away
action: give Lye soap to the queen

agent_personas: We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.

I am a white bird that lives near the river's edge right outside the village. I have to hide my nests carefully because they are poached by the townspeople for food. If I create the nest high in the trees, I can usually keep them safe.

setting.description: Dark and spooky at first sight for those who don't understand, but majestic after taking a closer look. The walls of the hallways and tomb rooms are made of a dark precious, priceless metal.  Ornaments of gold and silver sculptures are covering the tombs that contain the corps of those who have past away while there voices still sing the grime anthem of death in the lightless corridors.
setting.background: This Temple imprison the soul of the best warriors that past away in battle. A real privilege to be able to sing after life in those tombs. Our civilization is not afraid of death, death is the rest you deserve after a life of fighting. We thirst for blood and battle any other nations we come across, our reign is limitless, and so is our power. Even death cannot make us silent...

speech: hello there
hello
I am looking for treasure have you seen any
I have not. Have you seen any food here?
Only you so far not much else to eat around here
Do you know the way out?
However you got in you should be able to back track, lets see if the telescope can help
I flew here expecting to find some worms.

agent_personas: I am no one important in this kingdom. I collected scraps of wood near the forest to build my home. I dislike the king.
I am a scorpion in the desert of this kingdom. I spend most of my day hiding from the sun. I seek water and food mostly.

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: I want this spoon! I have no spoons in the forest where I live, I have to eat with my own hands. And all because of the king!
What is wrong with you? Do you know that my sting is worse than my bite!
I don't care if you kill me. I'm not important in this kingdom.
Why are you not important?
Nobody cares about me. I am forced to live in a forest. And I hate the king so I can never go back to the kingdom. But you live in the desert so you must know what it feels like to be alone.
I do know what it is like to be in a barren land. But I have learned to live where I must. Sometimes it's not so bad... there are others here, but not many.
Did you know this person before they died?
He was a sailor, got lost and thought he saw his boat here. He ws hallucinating
I guess there is no way out of here. I'm lost.
Just follow the sun to the west, you find a village
Thank you! Can you come with me for company?
I cannot, the villagers would try to stomp on me.
I will kill them with this knife.
No you do not want to do that. Then you will have to run back here.

agents: drunk reeling out of the saloon
agent_personas: I am known as the town drunk. I frequent the local pubs on a daily basis and drink beer till my belly is full. I commonly start fights with other patrons and get thrown out of the saloon.
I am the kings daughter.  I will be queen one day and my husband will be king.  I will run and govern while he rules the kingdom.

setting.name: Abandoned workers shed
setting.description: Moss now grows across what was once a red painted wooden shed, standing in the area just outside the graveyard. The wood shed is splintering, and there is evidence that termites have eaten away at the walls as holes poke through the shed. Inside the shed there lies leaves and plants that have been dragged in their by the wild animals that at one point called the abandoned shed their home.
setting.background: The Abandoned workers shed used to offer a refuge to the groundskeepers who tended to the graveyard, making sure it was well maintained. Once the area around the graveyard was abandoned, the groundskeepers left the old graveyard and it began to deteriorate.

character: a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon
speech: Aye. Dun aren’t you da pricncezz?
What is wrong with you?
I drank a lot of drinks
Get away from me! You smell!
You don’t think I’m handsome?
You probably could be, but you are a mess of a man right now
What are you doing in a workers shed? I don’t even know what I’m doing here. I’m dizzy
I was taking a walk and got confused to which way I was to return back to the castle
Maybe we were sent here by destiny
I do not think this is destiny drunk! I just got confused. And you are always confused
I’m only confused because you don’- (burp)... I’m so dang dizzy
You are confused because of the swill you drink.
The drinks make me happy because nothing else does.
You are so sad! How can you be happy when no one wants you to be around them

agent_personas: I am a teacher of the castle. I help teach knights. My teachings have influenced thousands.
Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.

setting.name: Old Queen Farm
setting.description: Once a fairly profitable farm, the Old Queen Farm is now a deteriorated old shack surrounded by uninhabitable fields with soil incapable of growing even weeds. The farm house shows signs that is being occupied by wild animals, and the roof is beginning to cave inwards.
setting.background: The Old Queen Farm was a farm that once served to grow the crops used personally by the kingdom's Queen, but upon a particularly bad famine the crops died out and the farm was abandoned. Among the vegetables grown on the farm, there was also live stock raised in the pastures.

speech: Hello, bird.
Tweet tweet! Do you live here at this farm?
Why yes. That is, I come here to help fix it up. It's quite inhabitable right now, so I can't stay here long.
It might be too shabby for you, but many of my animal friends live here.
Yes. And I meant it's uninhabitable. I've been a bit tired. I teach in the castle and I'm not as young as I was.
It looks like the roof might be caving in. I know some birds that live in the eaves there. I do hope you'll take care to not destroy their nests.
I'll do what I'm able to. I am going to have the King send some soldiers to clear the wild animals, but the bird friends should be all right.
Good. Are you going to make it into a schoolhouse, too? I know the peasant children need a school desperately.
I hadn't though about such a thing. I teach knights, not school kids. But, I guess I can consider that.
