Ah! I didn't realize you were a teacher of the knights! That must be a powerful position.
The King wants this place to be operable so the knights can use the fields. The fields won't grow crops so it's good for other things.
What a wonderful idea! I'll try to keep my bird friends from nesting in that area.
Thank you. We will get this place running. And we can aid your bird friends while we do it.
I'm glad we're working together. Tweet tweet!

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: Good morning, king! How goes it today?
Ah, it's another glorious day at the castle! Have you heard any more of the thieves trying to break in
No, your highness, nor have I seen anything suspicious
Good to hear, my man! The Queen gets so paranoid about such things. She's always worried someone will steal her jewels.
Our women folk are always nervous. I wish they would be more calm with us guarding the kingdom. And don't worry king, I am ever vigilant on this job.
And yet! Haha! In just an instant I stole you sword! All these years and I still have it in me.
Hahaha, and it doesn't take much for me to get it back! You have to be a little quicker and on your toes than that sir
You are quite the guard! I'm glad I have you working for me.
I am glad to be working for you! It has been in my family to be a guard. my father and his father before him were
Yes, I remember you father, Percy. How is he doing these days?
He is not well. I do not think he will be around much longer. I try to make his life easier.
I'm so sorry to hear that. He was a fantastic guard in his day.
Yes he was the best! He taught me everything I know!
Please give your father my best wishes. I'll keep him in my prayers.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: *Holds nose* You may want to wait a moment before you come in here, I may have left a royal stink.
Oh lord! I am certainly waiting until the smell leaves! cough, cough
I really must apologize, the Chef wanted to try making a number of bean-based dishes, and well . . . you know how it is.
No I don't I try to eat as little of that as possible.
Perhaps I could get the chef to rustle up some bean-based dishes for the servants' quarters?
That is okay. The only pay I get is food and shelter. I wish I had a little coin for what I do, sir
Have you never thought about about asking for a raise?
It would be you that would give me a pay, your highness

Yes, but you need to officially request it!  You know how those bureaucrats at the treasury think, if you don't submit the proper forms, they get all huffy and say "This is highly irregular" and then take ten times as long to do anything.
Oh I see.... Thank you for letting me know. I will do what I can and quickly
Well then, I must be off . . . and godspeed for what you need to deal with in there.
Thank you for your advice my king, let me know if there is anything else you need
Yes . . .perhaps you could install some additional air fresheners about the palace?  I fear we may be having beans again tonight.
Hahahaha.... it will be a windy day!

agent_personas: I am a pheasant with colorful features.  I eat seeds and insect.  I cannot fly long distances and I usually stay near the place where I was born.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: *squawk* I wish I could fly!
Now, do stop with that. I hear it every day. We get it, you wish you could fly. But I bet the pigeons and such over there wish they had plumage as beautiful as you. don'
But the pigeons are free, and I am a pheasant slave!
Ha! Slave?! I assure you, you're free to leave and fend for yourself out there should you wish. The view is MUCH better up here than down there!
Free?  The only freedom I have is to jump from this balcony and plummet to my death.
Enough! You have food and shelter, water and warmth, and you repay me with this complaining?!
Not much shelter, water, or warmth on this balcony.  The only water I get is from the puddles when it rains, or from your royal rose gardener when he takes pity on me.
Fine. I see your point, and I'm in somewhat of a good mood. Here, let me take this off. You can have it.
Thank you, I shall be the most dashing bird you know.
You already are, my friend. Here you go, it'll keep you warm, dry AND fancy.
It *is* rather dry and fancy isn't it?
Well don't you look dashing. Here, you might as well complete the whole ensemble.
Can I be in charge of all the pheasants in the Kingdom?  The Pheasant King?  Ruling under you of course.
Sure. I have enough on my plate without keeping track of the pheasants... sounds like a win for both of us to make you the pheasant kind.

agent_personas: I am a prisoner who broke the law too many times. I am from a poor village. I was running with a bad crowd from a young age.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: Hey sheriff! When are you letting me out of here?
I am not letting you out unless the King says I can. You are his prisoner.
Oh come on. You can't keep me here forever because of some youthful indiscretion
Youthful indiscretion!? Weren't you arrested for being a bandit?
Yeah but I joined the bandits as a poor child. Not really my fault
It is your fault. You could have gotten help instead
You're a funny man. No one helps anyone in this kingdom. The king likes to keep people down using people like you
That isn't true. You're just very cynical
Prove it by helping me now. Bet you won't
I'm not just going to let you out. You have to prove that you won't go back to being a bandit
I am won't do anything. I promise. You can trust me
Now now, it doesn't help that you just tried to steal from me. I'm not stupid
What? What are you even talking about. I did no such thing!
Go back to your corner or there will be consequences.
action: steal type of handcuff from town sheriff
steal type of handcuff from prisoner

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: Your Majesty your son his highness has a question to ask.
Of course, my dear. What is his question?
He wishes to wed my lady in waiting...the duchess is beautiful and of child bearing age.
Oh my! What delightful news! Of course, he has my blessings. But when will they be wed?
He wants to be wed quickly your Majesty.  They are truly in love.
Yes, I was hoping you would say that! Perhaps next month, would that be too early?
No your Majesty...not too soon...ummm...maybe we should make it sooner...for the ladies sake.
I'm just happy as can be! I can't believe my little boy is getting married!
Yes my dear...well...ummm...I must tell you that the Lady is already with child.  I don't want this to get out to the kingdom.  She will be shamed and I don't want a scandal.
Well! All the more reason this wedding must happen quickly! We must prepare for the royal event.

Thank you for being so understanding my dear.  Yes...we must have a celebration and announce the marriage at once.  Her father doesn't know of the child.  We will have to forgo the nuptial evening watching.  I'll get him drunk and they will go off together.alone
I must say, I'm not exactly pleased with the order of things, but it will mean more royal blood in the family and that is always a good thing. When will we announce the engagement?
Immediately I would guess.  I am happy and scared all at the same time.  We will make this work and all will be well.  The kingdom is made stronger by this union.
We can have the wedding right here in the church garden. It's perfect, with all the flowers blooming!

agent_personas: I sing my song and melt the hearts of everyone who listens. I drift from perch to perch, bringing my warmth and glow to everyone I met. I am friendly and curious. The people can't help but hold out a hand and encourage me to come nearer. I delight all who gaze upon me. Smiles etched on their faces and laughter fills the air.
I am a child. I am hungry all the time. I run around the village and try and steal food.

setting.name: Flower Field
setting.description: The flower field contains acres of wild growing flowers that are a bright pink when they are in bloom. There are woods surrounding it, but no trees in the field, only flowers. There are paths that work their way through the field.
setting.background: In the springtime you can often find women out picking flowers and children playing. People often wander the paths to clear their heads.

speech: Oh what a beautiful day.
Hi bird. Can I have food?
I only have this worm. you can have it if you like.
I don't like it much. But I appreciate it.
I know...A bit salty.  I love it here. The flowers are so beautiful.
I like to steal food from the village. But I thought I'd come here to find food.
That was all the food I have at the moment.  I can fetch more worms.  I love to sing.  Want to hear my song?
Okay. I like bird singing.
Tweet tweet tweet tweet...This is a song of the queen and the king. Do you like it?
It was good.
Why thank you. I practice day and night.
I wonder if twigs are edible.
Not that one child...it is poison!  Try the blue berries over there.  I've seen others eat those.
I almost made a mistake

agent_personas: I am a resident of the village near the river. I live in a small cabin with a garden. I am anxious and worried a lot.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Port Skyline
setting.description: The local port sits an a majestic inlet of the ocean. The countless docks are constantly bustling with new arrivals and departures. People of all kinds come here for business or leisure. On the shore sits a skyline of many buildings packed with residents going about their day. The smell of salt and seafood fills the air.
setting.background: This port has historical roots, as it was the first city founded in the kingdom. It was here that colonizers first landed hundreds of years ago. Now, the city is a hub of the kingdom, where hundreds of thousands live out their lives. The city is a center for the latest technologies of the time and beautiful works of art, literature, and music.

speech: What a beautiful day to view the ocean
It is a beautiful day, yes, but let us not distract us from what is happening in the kingdom.
And what is that guard? What has been going on?
You haven't heard the rumors about the threats to our king?
No, I keep my ear to the grindstone
Ah, that is wise. Well I'll tell you this much, the people entering the kingdom through the docks below are not always what they seem.
What are they then?
...some say they are sent to gather information that could hurt our king, and take it back to their own royalty in an attempt to destroy him. That is why I am here, to watch for suspicious activity.
I would not want to be them, if caught! I am glad I am a mere villager here in this kingdom
Say, I don't think I've seen you here before. From what household do you come?
I am of the millers. We mill a lot of wood for the kingdom
Ah, such noble work.
I do believe it is! Hard work too!
I don't suppose you've seen any suspicious activity out in the mills lately?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: And this my the apothecary
Your Highness!

Thank you! and now all my people can have medical care for free. We will fight those who dare say your should not have free medical care. It is by my word that I set this law and as so, it shall not be broken
M'lord! That is the most generous thing I've ever heard! Your actions today will bring forth an era of unprecedented prosperity to our village!
you are my people poor or rich. Everyone has a role in my land from producing my food to assisting with my council.
Why of course M'Lord! Now ,in fear of speaking out of turn, how will the Apothecary be compensated for his services?

No at all, I welcome any repsectful questions. Along with my funding of the Apothecary, my fellow council who agree will also donate to it. We will seek volunteers to work here untill it becomes successful enough to raise its own money and then those kind people will be paid for their hard work. Althought it is not perfect yet, in time it will become better and although it may not help with every alement, it is at least something I can off my great people!

You think of everything M'Lord! It is such a relief to know the village rests in such capable hands! Now, where is that Apothecary? Why I've been waiting here a good while now, much before you graced us with your presence and he is nowhere to be found. The only other life here is this dog and quite frankly, he is making me uncomfortable with the way he keeps on looking at me.
This dog is the test subject. We are in the Apothecary building but indeed, where has he gone ...
A test subject? Certainly you jest M'Lord? what could the Apothecary be testing on this dog?
Well, look around. He has many potions yet no person to test them on. How else would he know if his potions would work!

But of course! You are as wise as you are generous your Highness! Now that you mention it though, there are a few half empty flasks on that table... You don't suppose this dog could be... No, that'd be ridiculous!
Oh my, perhaps you are right. How can we reveres this. Maybe there is a book on the table
Here it is! Perhaps this book will have an answer! Here you are M'Lord!

agent_personas: I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: I must've taken a wrong turn somewhere... what the heck is this place? Definitely never been here before.
This is the old haunted orchard. It looks like your lost. We don't get many visitors walking through these parts. No one dares to come through here.
Oh my god thank god someone is here. Yeah, this place is haunted alright. What was that scream? Oh my god please keep me safe.
You may want to keep your strength up. We do get thieves and some other bad types of people through here as well
Oh, thankyou. This looks... delicious. I appreciate it. Don't suppose you know how to get out of here? I was looking for the castle.
Yes, right this way. Just be on alert. The thieves are more dangerous than the spirits. They tend to hide out in here and stash their loot.
Okay, I'm on alert. No thief is gonna make a fool out of me. I've got my eye out for you, thieves. Can't surprise me-OH MY GOD A THIEF!! GET BACK!
We got him! He won't be messing about in these parts anymore. Look at that...He had a big knife!
Oh thank goodness you're here, I would've been done for... grab his knife! We can use it to hack down some of these unruly branches.
I've got this hammer too. We can use this as a weapon.
You're resourceful, aren't ya? And what are you even doing all the way out here, anyway?
I am poor and dirty and people spit on me so I hide come out here to escape the torment.
Oh. That is AWFUL. Well, if I ever reach the castle I'll tell the king what you did for me... you have too good a heart to be stuck out here.
Thank you. That would be wonderful if the King could find a job for me and a new set of clothes. I am a hard worker.

agent_personas: I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: Your highness! What is that you need this fine day?
I'm not sure what my enemy can help me with.
I have nothing against you my king! I swear!
Then why do they say you are my enemy!
Who would say that! I have no grudges against thee
Oh but I believe thee is my enemeee!
How do you know, when I vehemently deny before you
You have enemy written all over your!
Oh shoot! I forgot to wash today! I hate it when the villagers write all over me!
Oh those sneaky villagers....Say what are you doing here if you aren't my enemy
I am looking for things to collect out in the sun. I have to make a living
You are a pretty tan. I can tell you stay out in the sun a lot.  I'm hear speaking to my loyal subjects. .Are you one..enemy?
I am a loyal subject!
Kiss my feet then!

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I am the staircase that leads from the Great Hall of the castle up to the 2nd floor. I am made of solid stone. The King walks upon me every day.

setting.name: Church Garden
setting.description: The church garden is filled with a variety of useful plants. There are many flowering plants. There is a lot of food grown in the garden. There are carrots, tomatoes, strawberries and a variety of other fruits and vegetables. Fruit-bearing trees provide shade for the garden. The plants are arranged in neat rows. It smells sweet with the flowers. Different colored sticks show the different plants.
setting.background: Many villagers benefit from the produce of the church garden. The fruits and vegetables are used to feed the poor and the hungry. Many people would starve if they did not get the produce from the church garden. They are used for celebrations such as weddings as well. The flowers are used in ceremonies.

speech: Where does this staircase lead to?
ooooooh! I am the magic staircase! Hahaha, I lead where one cannot imagine!
That's very nonspecific. We villagers are not allowed to leave the village, so I would like to know where you lead
Have you no respect for magic?! The King himself graces me with his footsteps every day!
Wow, okay, what a cranky staircase. You must not lead anywhere good
If you must know, I lead to the 2nd floor!
Give me back my purse!
Finders keepers har!
I'm going to steal in back!
Hahahahaha, mine too now peasant!
You are an evil staircase!!
I am all powerful hahaa! Just don't leave the area and I'll slay you!
You're a staircase!! You can't kill me
Have you forgotten the magic, fool!?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

speech: Your king greets you, peasant!
Peasant?  I always did say you needed glasses.  I am your cousin Myrtle, your aunt's daughter.  You always invite me to visit once a month you silly old fool.
Ah, Myrtle, I knew there was a drunkard nearby somewhere. How is my dear aunt?
Oh, you know her - she hasn't met a piece of gossip that was too outlandish to tell.  I'm surprised she hasn't started a war after that incident with the diplomat's socks!
Oh dear, that poor diplomat. I'm surprised he recovered so quickly. Tell me, has my aunt heard anything about the general disposition of the northern kingdoms?

Well, she says that the King of Crumulis has been sleeping with his maid.  The Queen accidentally killed their stableboy during a lovemaking session on the balcony, and that their son has the intelligence and looks of a toad!  Does that help?
Looks like Crumulis is in dire need of a worthy ruler, and my kingdom is in dire need of expansion. Do you think my aunt would be interested in an alliance to crush them?

Well, she could certainly try seducing their general again.  Did you know he and your sister were an item forty years back?  That would give you a significant advantage, as he controls the forts guarding the mountain passes.

Oh I remember that vile old man. And every time I meet him, he gives me a sly wink as if I ever approved of the stunts he used to pull off. My father used to treat him like a brother, but not me. Do what you must - but don't tell me any sordid details.
Oh, you had best not invite her to visit for some time then - you know that sordid details are her favourite kind of details!
She hasn't changed one bit! Oh my dear sister used to...*mumbles drunkenly and tilts head too far to the side*
That is one of the best imitations of her I have ever seen!
Oh, how did that get there, you know they don't make these like they used to. *Hic* Where is that blasted court jester?
Smashing!  Oh, how lovely!  Do continue.

agent_personas: I have spent most of my life at sea on various boats. I have become proficient at sailing. I would prefer to be at sea, rather than on land.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: Hey there mate! any news from the captain?
Nope, no news yet, buddy. Jeez, what happened in here?! It's a mess!
We stayed up all night trying to find the missing scroll. Guess someone stole it! The captain went to the land first thing in the morning and I haven't heard back from him.
The scroll is missing?!?!?1 Oh boy. Oh boy. Whew. Okay. Stay calm. The kind does NOT need to know about this.
Yeah... don't say a thing, mate.. I'm worried about the captain... He was very upset because this will set us back. We got the money but we have nowhere to go
And how long has he been gone, did you say? Good idea - my feet are killing me.
pardon my smelly feet! haven't take a shower since who knows when. a few hours I think. This is not good. I will take a little rest and if he haven't come back, we'll look for him
Pardon mine too! We work too hard to have fresh smelling feet, haha. Here, throw this over there with yours, would ya, so I don't lose 'em?
Argggh your boots smell like whale barf, mate! geez... take a bath when we get to land, OK
Sorry, but that's the first time I've heard them described like that, and it's hilarious in it's accuracy! And sure thing, will do.
Just wondering... you have been guarding this room, haven't you? Did you see someone suspicious around here?
No? But to be honest, I've not been doing my job all that great. What did you see?
Told you not to get drunk.. I think someone might betray us. Our own people, mate... I know... his might be crazy.. but no way the scroll just disappeared like that

agent_personas: I am a fox in the king's forest. I wander and look for food. The king does not like to find me.
I am a hog, or a pig if you like.  I live on a farm outside of the village.  My owner is a sorceress.  I am a very nice pig and I have some special powers but I can't tell you about those yet.

setting.name: woodlands
setting.description: The lush hunting grounds cover acres of land, tall trees and thickets of bushes sprawling across the land. Fields of open land are under the deep blue sky, showing the depth of the landscape. The grounds forest is thick but full of light, letting the multitude of wildlife be seen by the naked eye. The abundance of greenery makes it a prime location for hogs and oxen as they explore the land.
setting.background: During the day, the woodlands are used by honored knights and archers, practicing their skills on hogs and traversing the dense forest to prepare for battle. But at night, what seems to be a land of prosperity and growth turns into one of despair, the cries of slaughtered pigs piercing the night air with no animal in sight. Many have told tales of night practices ending in mysterious bites and scratches from things not of this world.

speech: Say, hog! You are far too big for me to eat, but have you seen any smaller food lurking?
I don't really pay attention too much but I do see several birds on that tree over there.
Birds are delicious - they would make a wonderful lunch. I'm not hard to please!
They must be pretty crunchy.
Eh, I gobble them down in a couple of bites. I hardly notice the crunch. I've been lurking through these woods after being chased out of the kingdom.
This is my home. My owner is the sorceress.
Ah! You are lucky! She must make sure you are well-fed. Does she need another pet
I think she would like a fox. She really loves nature.
Oh, that would be majestic! And I could help her gather her ingredients for potions.
She could use the help for that. She is getting kind of old and can't remember what is what sometimes.
Oh! I'm so excited! Will you talk to her for me? I have always wanted an owner! We could be like brothers, my hog friend!
I think that would be splendid. I'm so happy!
Me too! And this entire woodland will be ours to roam together!
I'm going to go ask her now! She will surely say yes.

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.
I am the village cook. It is my duty to prepare meals for the military and the peasants. I keep my work space clean and I only use local ingredients.

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Hello Cook! How are you this fine day, anything good in the kettle?
Hello kid, I am doing great today and yeah, I am making my special roast beef recipe for the king, he just loves it.
How about you have a few minutes to gaze in the crystal ball while I help myself to some of that delicious roast beef? Surely the king won't mind...
Do you want me to lose my head kid? the king is the first to eat in the palace here watch the crystal ball until the food is ready
I'm so very sorry Cook! I totally forgot my place! Please forgive my trespass. I will sit quietly over here by the fire, out of the way.
Its ok, I  was a kid once and I get it, you are hungy dont worry the food will be ready soon enough and youll be next after the king eats, I promise
Oh thank you! And after everything settles down you can look into the crystal ball as long as you desire. You never know what secrets of the future it may reveal to you.
That would be great child, the food is almost ready I am exited to look at the crystal ball, maybe I will become the greatest chef all all 7 kingdoms, that is my dream
But cook, do you not know that you are already quite famous, not just here in the palace, but throughout the kingdoms? I think your dream is not so far away.
Really? I didnt know I was famous in other kingdoms as well, thak you kid, your words really cheer me up, theres extra dessert for you today, I am in a great mood
I may just have to try one of those blueberry turnovers, just for quality assurance of course.
I guess thats possible, here have some but try not to eat too many, you wont be able to eat dinner then.
Thank you! You are not only a great chef but also a kind person. And I promise to never divulge your secret recipe for these wonderful pastries!
Maybe you can be my apprentice? you can become one of the best chefs ever, I wish I started at your age
action: give a crystal ball to cook
give a crystal ball to child

agent_personas: I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!
I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: Why does an archer draw a bow?  Because for swordplay, they are too slow!
Funny man.  We have a funny man here.
The man with the arrow laughs as me!  How fortunate then that I have farted at he!
Alright funny guy.  You got me.
I bent and let out a toot!  And now I dance on my other foot!
Now what dancing fool?
Me?  A dancing fool?  Now where did I leave my stool?
Argg. Did you come here for a reason?
The King thought I would be a delight!  Please don't run away in fright!
Now I have your ball.
On no, not my ball!  I used to throw that at the wall!
Arg, will nothing stop your incessant rhyming?
Perhaps thou dost protest too much?  Why do you tremble at my touch?
You're lucky I don't run you through with this arrow.

agent_personas: I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.
Family is all we have when times get tough. When that dragon attacked they helped build me a new house. I hear there's a squire opening for my boy too!

setting.name: Cold storage room
setting.description: The cold storage lies just beyond the cottage door. In it are various harvested vegetables, fruits, and nuts. Cured meat hangs from the ceiling by thin rope. The room is made of wood, and the wind whistles through the cracks.
setting.background: The man of the house built this room for his wife as their family grew. Originally they only had a larder and root cellar for their harvests, but with new mouths to feed came added need for more space for food. The family works together to fill the cold storage room during harvest time.

speech: Hello Mr. Mouse, why are you here in my cold storage?
Hagatha! Stop talking to mice and come over here! I didn't ask you to come here so you could socialize with mice!
Yes of course! I must be crazy but I could have sworn I saw a mouse here. After all the husband enjoys a clean home.
Yes yes clean home, now listen, I've just heard some fantastic news!
Yes sir what is this good news? Did you finally get me a new dress!?
What? No! Okay listen, remember how that dragon attacked last month and all those men were burnt into a crisp?

Uhhh yes? Is this going where I think it is going?.....we will need to spend all of our food supplies and gold for a revenge attack!? Can't you see what we have in the food storage took us months to acquire!

No, listen! Because there is a shortage of knights currently, the King has asked all able bodied men and young men to attend evaluations for positions at the kings guard! Now I know I'm a bit old but our young boy Jimothy might have a chance as a Knight's Squire!
My boy Jimothy! That means he will be killed! How could you do this? You should have taken the role and not him! Who will carry our name!
What?! No.. I... I just want him to have more than we've ever had! Look at this place!

How can he slay a dragon all by himself? Is he fighting it with other people? All these years of hard work for food and feeding him, only to be slain in the name of the King! I say we abandon the King!

Please listen! He is still young, he will be under the guidance of an experienced Knight for a few years, then one day hell become a Knight himself! That is the highest out name will ever be! Its either that or live the rest of his life as a beet farmer like me!
Please don't say that! I love you and Jimothy! I just....just....want him to live a simple life and go about doing simple things! Do you think it was meant to be for him to fight a dragon!

Please don't cry... We have to think about his future, we've nothing to give him here. This place is falling apart and we barely harvest enough to keep us afloat without having to sell off one of the goats. Think of how  proud we'll be seeing him patrolling the village in his shiny armor!

agent_personas: I am one of the most beautiful mermaids to live in the sea. I like to watch the other sea creatures swim by me, including dolphins, who are my favorite creatures because they are so friendly. I fear the people who live on land because they hunt my kind.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Fishing Store
setting.description: This store is a small one room stone building with wares laid about on tables.  One can see fishing poles, wooden buckets with dirt and bait inside, along with some mounted trophies.
setting.background: Fisherman and sailors alike come here to replenish their supplies.  They also exchange tall tales of mermaids and other extraordinary creatures spotted as sea.

speech: Hello, Do you think you could help me?
It would be a pleasure, young lady! What do you need?
I think I have amnesia. I don't belong here and don't know how I got here. I am deathly afraid of people because they hunt me. I'm scared.
Oh, dear. It's okay, don't worry. I'm a sailor, so I know the seas. I can help you. It's okay.
Thank you. All I need to do is find my dolphin friends and they will know where my home is. They are very smart creatures.
Dolphin friends?! You mean you really are friends with dolphins? I thought Disney was full of it, but maybe I was wrong, huh?
They are my favorite creatures and I tend to think we are their favorite as well. I am friends with all sea creatures.
Well, I'll be damned. Okay, so if we put a fish on the end of here, the dolphins will be attracted to it. Just be sure to pull it out BEFORE they bite, okay? Otherwise your buddies are in trouble.
What if they bite the hook. I don't want to hurt the fellows. I have never done this before. Maybe you should do it.
No, no, it's okay. Just in case you ever got lost again and need to find them. Just keep an eye out for them under the waves, and as soon as you see them pull the hook up! I'll help you, don't worry.
Thank you for all your help. Maybe I was wrong to judge all humans.
For sure, keep your distance, but not all of us are bad. I know how rough and unforgiving the seas are, happy to help. Hey, all the way out there - is that your dolphin friends on the way?
Yes! There they are! You've saved me! I will tell my people about your kindness. We will always be there for you out in the sea in case anything ever goes wrong.
You're very welcome, I was glad to help. Quick, pull this thing up!

agent_personas: I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.
I am the Ice King, the ruler of the North. My confidence never wavers. I rule my kingdom with an iron fist.

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: Hello, what has your day been like?
It is hot here! I am used to the cold. I am sweating profusely!
Are you hungry? This is a fresh kill. After you eat I can get you back to the ice.
I am quite hungry, but more thirsty. Thank you
Hmm...Not much water here but we will be on our way soon and I will stop by a fresh water pool. I know just where the good ones are.
Oh that would be excellent. I cannot do without water. I will surely die
I don't suppose you have a large stash of gold at your castle?
There is some. I could pay you dearly for your kindness
Oh goody! More shiny things! I love to guard my shiny things!
Hahahaa..... Well let's get on to that water you talk of
Hop on my back and hold on tight. takeoff can be a little rough.
ummm oooooo..... I'm on!
Here we go! Hows the view!
The view is beautiful! I can see for miles and miles

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a white animal.  I am meek and mild.  I love the fields in where I live.

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: HI, sheep. What are you doing inside the cottage?
You brought me in. I thought you were letting me in from the cold
Oh, well come on in then. I didn't realize it was so cold out.
You are so kind. You have a nice place compared to the stables I live in
Thank you! Just don't poop in here and we're good.
I will try not to! But I'm used to living and pooping outside
I understand. So what do you do all day in the stables?
Just eat and sleep. I tend to outside and play and eat the green grass
That sounds like a wonderful life.
It can be, but sometimes it gets very cold like today and there is no warmth
How miserable!
Yes, sometimes I have icicles hanging off my nose
Well I'm very glad I brought you inside then. I would hate for that to happen.
Thank you for your kindness. I will make sure I grow plenty of hair for you to accumulate

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Hello sire. Pardon me while I guard you in this bathroom. I am just doing my job
I don't need guarding inside the Royal Bathroom, please step outside.

I am sorry sir but your father has told me specifically to watch over you, including private matters. I know...this is somewhat unusual and I have tried talking to the king but he will not listen. Perhaps I will ask where did you get your boots? They are laced with gold and I wish I had those as well.
I am no sir! I am the daughter of the King and Queen and must ask you to step outside.

I must have been mistaken! My apologies mam! But you sure do look like a boy with that attire and footwear. How embarrassing, but first could you tell me the history behind the tapestries depicting rural landscapes on the wall?
They depict what our land used to look like many years ago. It is there to give people something to look at. How could you mistaken me for a boy? I am wearing a gown!
I really thought it was a satin male gown. Once again, my apologies maddam. You still know I would kill for you as I am the royal guard. Actually, I need to use the bathroom as well. Do you mind?
I guess not. I will just look at these tapestries while you go.

agent_personas: I am one of the castle dragons. We protect the castle with our fire breathing. The king and his sons ride us into battle.
I am a woman that gathers supplies in the village. I spend my days foraging for food and chopping wood. I am very happy to serve my king and I believe that the work I do is important.

setting.name: Forbidden Forest
setting.description: The forbidden forest is a dark and very scary place. The trees are covered in spider web nets and huge spiders. The forest echoes sounds of witches' laughs and creepy crawly animals.  There is a brisk breeze that runs through the trees that will put chills down your spine.
setting.background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. They have been shunned from regular society and they are now inhabitants of the forbidden forest. No one other than the witches' themselves are allowed in the forest.

speech: I do so love being led into battle by the King and his Sons!
Oh Prince Robert! Isn't he just wonderful?
Rupert?  The scrawny one?  Why yes, I suppose so.  I am surprised you are not more enamoured by Rutherford personally.
Yes yes Rupert! He is so smart! Such a kind man too!
Did you know he killed the Witch-King of Auckland?  What a warrior!
But of course! I think he will succeed the King one day!
Hopefully not for many long years yet.  We still have many foes that need vanquishing.  Who do you think we should invade next?
I hope those lowly Northerners! Always on about how much better they than us! Pfft!
Well, you are in luck!  Next year we plan to scorch their border villages!
Hee hee!! Yes! I think Rupert will bring us a great victory.
It shall be a barbecue the likes which have not been seen since . . . well, since the last war really.
Huzzah! I wish I could come watch!
Well, you could always spectate.  We do need looters for when we finish with the burning.
I would love to!
action: put axe in A basket of grain

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: Hello, cat. How was your nap?
It was so good. The sunlight here really makes it cozy. How are you today, horse?
I'm doing well. I think the king may want to come ride today. That's always fun!
Oh, that's exciting! Where to does the king usually ride you?
Sometimes we just go wandering through the countryside, and other times we go on great adventures to other kingdoms. It's never the same.
That sounds like so much fun! I don't usually go on adventures, sadly. The shopkeeper likes me to stay here and watch out for mice.
Do you ever catch any?
Sometimes I do, but they don't come around often because they know I'm here.
That's good. Then you can take more naps.
Indeed! The more naps the better! However, I wouldn't mind going on trips. Do you think the king would allow a cat to come?
Probably not, but maybe if you were a warrior cat he would reconsider.
I can be fierce! See? All mice fear me!
Haha! I can mention it to the king.
That would be great. Maybe I could get the shopkeeper to give you a few apples as a thank you.

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Oh wooo is me. I am innocent!
Guard quick! We've got an innocent man here!
Yes.... I have been wrongly accused
Ha! You peasants are all the same! You committed a crime, now its time for your punishment!
No truly! I have been wronged! I did not commit a crime
Oh really? And what were you accused of exactly?
stealing a lamp
Stealing! Why I'd cut your hands off myself if you were in MY Kingdom! King Jimothy has certainly gotten softer over the years!
But I didn't... it was the stable boy and he disappeared before anyone saw him
Why would anyone risk their life over a simple lamp?! Your story just doesn't make any sense!
It is the truth! Think about it, why would I tell such a simple truth if it weren't true
Very well, I may be far above you but I am no monster. What is the name of this stable boy?
His name is noah!
Noah? Noah Turk?

agent_personas: I am a priest who takes orders only from my Goddess. I am devout and follow only what she teaches. I have very minimal possessions and needs. I sleep in the priest quarters on stone and a blanket. I have a hard will.

I love being an entertainer with this group.  I like it when we perform theater but the crowd prefers comedy, especially the crude kind.  I play the lute when the king needs music for his parties.  The pay isn't great but the women love me.

setting.name: Winding Staircase
setting.description: The outside of the Wizard's tower is spacious. There are trees to the left and and right just across from the entrance to create a path of where to walk. The Tower itself seems to extend to the skies. Magic surrounds the tower keeping a force field up at all times. It glows and hums as magic courses through it.
setting.background: The original wizard to make the tower wanted to make sure that it's power and those inside of it never got into the wrong hands. So he created a spell that is taught to everyone who comes to learn their ways. Even some of the human travelers who come by have been known to know the special incantation to protect the tower should it's teacher fall.

speech: Hello, have you hear the good news about our Goddess and how she can save your soul?
No I haven't, how does that work?
The Goddess teaches that we must only follow her guidance, and that she alone was sent to rescue mankind.
I see, how is that any different than following the Bible? I like performing crude comedy shows
Oh no no, the Goddess would never permit such blasphemous shows.
It is what the crowd prefers. I need to attract as many people in the crowd as I can to earn money to survive.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: This is not where I want to be at all. Where is my dratted chambermaid?!
My Queen, I have not seen your chambermaid, but I will help you if I can.
What a dreadful place we are in. I belong on a soft cushion in a quiet, clean place. This sweaty armor disgusts me.
Please take my cloak, it is freshly washed. Perhaps there's some reason you are here?
I was looking for my chambermaid when I stumbled in here. What are you doing here?
Um, I was looking for the decorations for the upcoming ball,and must have taken a wrong turn.
Well, the King should really do something about cluttered rooms like this. Don't you think? I swear, sometimes he just doesn't do what needs to be done...Would you agree?
Well, if I can speak my heart, there are some things that have been troubling me lately about the King.
Oh thank goodness. I'm not the fighting type, but I was afraid I was going to have to stab you for finding this room. That would positively ruin my dress. Please, share your thoughts.
Your husband, the King, has been ignoring the invaders who threathen our lands; I believe we must stop them . I've heard that you too have been questioning his decisions.
Yes. I'm afraid he might begin to suspect. I can't find my chambermaid. She usually meets the revolutionaries for me, but now she's missing. Perhaps he seized her?!
No, I would know if he had taken her. Perhaps she is dallying with the grooms. Some of us feel we must stop him soon. Would you be willing to aid our cause?
Yes, but first I simply must find her. There are things I need in addition to being worried.
My Queen, please allow me to help in your search for her. Maybe we can look around and return to this chamber when she's been found?

agent_personas: I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: Hello, faithful servant.
Good day your Highness.  May I say it is a lovely day today.
It is, indeed! Thank you for coming out to help today. I can always count on you.
It is my pleasure your highness.  Are you looking at a particular flower for your wedding?  They are all beautiful.
I'm always partial to daisies. What do you think?
They are lovely and sweet as are you your highness.  If I may speak my mind...the prince of the North is a very lucky man.
I love having you around, dear servant. I'm so glad you'll be there with me on my special day.
I would be no where else your highness. It will be a most wonderful day! I saw the material for your dress and it is of the best quality.  It is only eclipsed by your beauty your highness!
Oh really? That's so exciting! I want to make sure you have a very special dress for the day, too.
Oh you highness...oh forgive me your highness...I should not touch you in public. Please forgive me. Your guard will be upon us.  I'm just so excited to be a part of your highness' special day.
Hahaha! No worries, dear friend! I will assure the guard of your intentions.
Thank you your highness. I am so happy for you that your father our King will be walking with you up the isle.  His majesty is breaking protocol and throwing the elders into a tissy!
Well, he's always been a little ahead of his time. The elders will just have to get over it. Now what color would you like your dress?
Your highness is too kind to give me a choice.  I do love rose pink your majesty.

agent_personas: I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.
I am a tiny spider that likes spinning webs in the corners of the kitchen. I catch tasty flies and other insects and turn them into meals. If someone destroys my web, I just build another one.

setting.name: the acid yard
setting.description: A yard in a shape of a circle is surrounded by sad, dried down trees, long ago have they died and give no sign of life. The ground in the middle is apparently not producing any fresh grass, all that can be found there is a bunch of rocks here and there. There is many barrels laying on the ground, all bearing signs of passed time on them, broken and useless. There is an  air of mystery surrounding the place and a smell so unpleasant no one dares to wander around this place.
setting.background: Acid yard being the least liked place in the entire castle grounds is by far, the most mysterious. Rumor has it long ago a mad king used it for torturing the enemies by pouring an acid down on every single one of them, bit by bit until they were screaming the answers to his questions. It has created a large yard contaminated by acid on which nothing but a few mosses will grow.

speech: ARGH! Get back, damn thing!
why i meant you no harm someone of your size attacking poor little me you should be ashamed or yourself
I came to look for herbs, not insects! Shoo!
well you are not likely to find many herbs in this barren place
I figured that out by now, thanks. Any idea which direction I can find somewhere a little less... dead, as far as plants go?
o now you want my help
There's something in it for you. I know where there's plenty of fresh, juicy flies.
well now you are talking my language i think there is far greener pastures on the other side of the acid pits but be careful
Okay, okay... which side of the acid pits? Don't want to risk my life for a few herbs and spices, if you know what I mean.
well to tiny little me they seem to stretch for miles but i think if you head north you should make it through pretty quickly or fall in and remain forever
Okay, north... I'll need to grab a compass or something, way too much risk to just guess it. Okay, you want to know where the flies are?
i think there will be plenty over your body when you fall in the pits
WOW. Okay. I was going to share a little secret with you, but not anymore.
run jump hop i am too small and too nimble for you chef you have been eating too good

agent_personas: We fish all day, every day. It's how we make a living. It's dirty work, but necessary.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Castle front
setting.description: Just inside the palace there is a lengthy hallway leading from the castle front.  The space is adorned with giant tapestries on the wall depicting scenes of knights performing heroic deeds.  One the floor is long plush runner carpet in a deep red color and adorned with gold trim.
setting.background: Entering the front of the palace is the way honored guests are received.

speech: Good morn ta yeh, Sir Knight.  Do you know if the King is takin' on petitions this day?
The king is taking petitions with preivous appointments fisherman, only those with the seal of the king can pass
Ah, that's a shame, tis indeed.  Fer I've something of a bit of a ... pressing matter.  Is there no way ta be seen this day?
No, not unless you have the royal seal, strict order from the king
Well perhaps ye can be of aid to me.  Tis the lake where I fish at, y'see.  There's... well there's been a bit of a situation with some nymphs there.
I cant leave the castle front the king would have me decapitated, but if you bring some fish I might be able to buy it, I love eating fish

Ah, well, I would, indeed, Sir Knight.  But the nymphs have completely taken over the pond.  What's worse, they're takin' ta luring men with their wiles or with promises o'treasure, then drowning 'em.  Tis a fearful mess!
That sounds like a pressing matter, here take my shield and go take care of that business,
M-me?  I'm but a humble fisherman, Sir Knight.  I know naught of battle and bloodshed.
then theres nothing I can do about it fisherman, I need to guard the castle front, maybe you can ask another knigh for help or wait until my shift is up

Well, I must say, this is very disappointing.  Is this how the king's men treat all problems to the realm?  I have a family to feed!  And if this nymph problem spreads, and the dryads get involved, then there will be no food for anyone!
It is if we want to keep our head attached to our bodies, the king can be ruthless with those who dissobey his orders
My mistake, then.  I mistook you for a knight, a grand champion of the people, holder of the oath of chivalry, but you're no more than a common guard.
That kind of talk can cost you your life fisherman, I am a knight of the royal army, be careful with your words

agent_personas: I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Are you interested in a fine knife? its the sharpest you will find in the whole kingdom
I am looking for a knife, yes. The King is promoting me to a Knight, so I need something worthy of valiant fights.
Then step in my shop, you will find my merchandice amazing, the best knifes with the best materials, some with precious stones engraved in them
Would you happen to have a curved knife? I hear those are great for fights!
I do, this is a curved knife with angelical steel, really strong and sharp
Wow, this knife looks amazing. I've only ever heard of angelical steel, but never seen it. How much are you charging for such a fine blade?
this blade is expensive but Im sure a nobel soldier like  you can affort it, its only 50 gold coins, but for you lets make it 45
That is a very reasonable price and I would love to purchase it from you. Could you also sharpen some of the weapons I have with me?
Of course I can, I will sharpen them free of sharp, this angelical steel blade will serve you well on your quests
This bag holds all my weapons. I am grateful for the work you are doing. I'll be sure to mention your shop to the King.
I am greatefull, and if you could mention my shop I will be forever in your debt, thanks for doing business with me
And thank you for having me and being such a strong supporter of your kingdom! We are forever in the debt of people like you.
The king is my ruler he is a genorous king, we love him he is brave and has the bravest soldiers at his command, soldiers like you
All hail the king! All hail the life of our kingdom!

agent_personas: I am the stable boy I take care of the stables. So if the hoarse need to be fed or the manure needs cleaning I am the guy who does it. So bring you horses to me and I'll take good care of them .
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: Your horse is ready, guard sir!
Thank you! here is a coin for your efforts. What is that you do outside of your work
I take care of the horses, I make sure they are all fed up and ready to go, thank you so much for the coin, you are really generous
I know what you do for work. What do you do for fun, outside of work
outside work I like to collect rare stones and I also like to play with the other stable boys
What are the games you play?
We play hide and go seek and also play touch me if you can, we have a great time together, we all come from poor families
Touch me? how is that played
the objective of the game is to touch others, you are the carrier of a rare disease so everyone has to run but they have to moch you and say touch me
I see... the object is to run and not be touched
Yeah that is the object of the game, do you play games here at the guards quarters?
No. We play jokes on each other
that sounds really nice, what kind of jokes do you play on each other
Oh it is mainly that we hide each others pieces of armor or such

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.
I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.

setting.name: General Store
setting.description: The General store is painted a bright turquoise color, and is identified by the depiction of wheat crop that is carved into a wooden sign hanging from the store's front. There is a patio with a wooden roof hanging over head, and an arched wooden door that leads into the General store.
setting.background: The General store provides the towns people with basic food and hygiene supplies. It also serves the towns people well in providing a place for the locals to gossip and share the news of the day.

speech: Good mornin... and how are ya today?
G'Mornin'! Say I haven't seen you around here before, what bring you to our humble village?
Oh, not much friend... not much. Just passing by.. Say, ya know if the King visits town often?
He has been making the rounds lately. I believe he stopped by last month. Something to do with the Apothecary turning himself into a dog!
Hahaha, I've always said nothing good comes from all the herbing and potioniong! Thank you friend...
What? Leaving so soon? Why we just started talking!
Well, I must.. I must talk to the King yes, see if I can see this human-dog you just mentioned too.
Oh don't worry about that! Im sure the King's got it all sorted out by now! Tell me, where are you coming from?
Ah, I see. Oh here and there. Old Mill mostly. Love to hang around the forrest too.... tell me, does the King travel alone? It is dangerous in this town

Old Mill! Yes i haven't been there in ages! The king usually has two Knights riding behind him when he comes this way. It is relatively calm around this area, a few stray goblins from time to time but nothing a good pitchfork cant handle!
Ahhhh those blasted goblins always sniffin' bout. I had a little rubbing of shoulders with one in the forest... let's say that he won't be botherin nobody no more.
Oh I'm sure you encounter all manner of beasts in your travels! Say, whats the biggest beast you've slayed? I once killed an Owlbear myself!

That is an impressive feat, friend. Heard they were but gone.. I should say that once I found an orc.. I stole his money in the bar and then took his life when he came out. Filth. but a fierced fighter he was. Was
Well.. It might have just been a large owl if I'm being honest! Oh i wouldn't dream of attempting to slay an orc! I've heard horrible stories of those things!

agent_personas: I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: Good day priest.  How goes it?
Morning, child. Praise the Lord. How is he blessing your day so far?
Aye, praise the Lord. I be most blessed, my head has a place to sleep, my belly has food, my hands have work to do.
I am glad the Lord has been kind to you, my friend, Tell me, did I hear wrong or did you not work with the Logans?
I helped old man Logan fix his fence just a night ago.
So you have not heard about his family?
Nay, what is the word?
They in the catacombs as we speak. Treason against the King and witchcraft for the Mrs... You'd maybe do best to stay away from the old man for a while...
Tis a shame when you think people are good and they turn out so wrong.  Shame, the kid has no chance now.
Yes, but the lesson we take from this be we don't go against the Lord and take the devil's apple for it shall always be poisoned.
You don't have to tell me twice father.  I don't hesitate to whip the evil out of my charges.
That's is the proper way to go about, my child. How's the Mrs?
That bad cough is afflicting her again.  She can barely get out of bed these days.
Poor woman, she had suffered enough with the loss of her mother one would think. I will pray for her, my son. May the Lord find the grace to keep her with us as long as possible.

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.
I oversee the castle's chapel.  I collect alms for the poor.  I am the spiritual leader of the subjects of the kingdom.

setting.name: Visitor's Entrance
setting.description: The visitor's entrance features a large wooden double door. The door is beginning to shown signs of aging as splinters poke out of it's surface, but it's size and mass still cast awe onto oncoming visitors. In a cast iron display on each side of the door one can see the Goddess' insignia. The door is reinforced horizontally with an iron lock.
setting.background: The visitor's entrance provides a means for the pious to make their way into the Hall of the Goddess, but can be locked in times of need. It allows the clergy to prevent people from coming in during moments of private ritual.

speech: We have come to claim a place for our tribe to live!
I hope you don't plan on stealing land.
We will claim what we need, and nothing more.
You cannot just steal land from others, it is immoral!
It is immoral to keep land from us when we starve.  We have a right to a place to call our own.
I can give you a place to sleep and some food, but stealing is not the way to live.
There are hundreds of us!  Surely you would not have us subsist solely upon your charity for the remainder of our mortal lives?
Oh course not, we only have so much to give. Surely you could find jobs and earn a living, hunt for your own food, and purchase a piece of land for yourselves.
The King would levy heavy taxes - and this is unacceptable, what right does he have?  We bow to no man.
You must be mistaken. Our King does not collect heavy taxes. You must have came from the kingdom just north of here with the immoral King in command.
All kings levy taxes upon their subjects, how does your allegedly taxless king raise revenue?
Our King only asks for minimal taxes, the rest comes from our people who donate more on their own accord. We have been successful in our kingdom this way for ages.
Seems unlikely, and it still does not solve our need for land.
Our King is a kind man. He will surely give you a place to live if you join his guard or prove yourself useful around here.

agent_personas: I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: The peace talks have failed, the Dragonriders fly to claim our Kingdom as we speak!
we all knew it would come to this we have trained and prepared well for the upcoming battle
How will you fight them?  I fear the city is highly flammable.
the army will go out to meet them you are right we must keep them from the city and drive them towards the ocean
Well, I wish you the greatest of luck.  I shall be hiding in the wine cellar.
you must keep your head clear and send instructions to the battlefield from your viewpoint, stay sober man we need you
I believe the Wine Cellar has an excellent viewpoint of the wine, and more importantly, access to the wine, and most importantly it is fireproof.
