i am going to leave very detailed instructions for the castle guards here it is your job to deliver them
And you will look after the Royal Chickens.  It was the King's last command before he fled.
alright we shall face the dragon riders and you shall guard the chickens and wine, FOR THE KING
For the King! *whisper* And the wine . . .
do not drink all the wine we will need it for the feast when we roast these dragons
I would if I could, but you know how much the King liked wine.  It was the most expense list on the Royal budget, three items higher than national defense!
is that the reason we didn't get the dragon defense system, well screw this war
action: give a pen for the chickens to army

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: What brings you here today sir?
I come from far away and I bear startling news, my king.
Ok, I'm ready. Lay it on me.
Heathens from the North are marching towards the realm as we speak. Expect war within a fortnight.
This is the perfect time to try out my new war horse! Haha!
I'd not expect flippancy at such dire news, my king.
I understand your confusion but we will be victorious and no one will dare to bother us again. The realm will bow to me.
Understood. May the heathens return to their home in coffins.
Hopefully not too many of them. I will need new subjects.
Speaking of which, are you hiring? I get bored in the South. Nothing ever happens.
Why of coarse. I can always use more royal subjects. What skill do you have?
Well, all I really do is talk and pontificate. But kings look very distinguished when they have people around them pontificating.
You Hired! You don't take yourself very seriously and you are honest!
Oh, I forgot to mention. I'm also a master swordsman. Hobby of mine. Keeps me young.

agent_personas: I am a sailor who sits on boats. I have a wife and three children. I try to avoid drinking too much.
I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.

setting.name: Supply store
setting.description: With so many ships docked at the port, sailor from all the ships crowd the bazaar. The supply store is filled with buyers today. The inside is plain and unadorned. Sturdy shelves hold common supplies. Along the walls are the larger items for sale.
setting.background: The supply store is run by small family of people who lived in the area before the port was constructed. As sailors needed goods, the family was happy to accommodate them for a price.

speech: Hello, Captain. What brings you here today?
Aye! How fairs yer day so fa.... a map hey??
It's going well so far, Captain. That's a map where someone told me there's buried treasure.
Blasted me eyes! This is the map of the island of a thousan skulls!! I recognize the shape since it is one of a... skull. We need provisions, lad!
Let's get as many as we can here. Can we get the treasure together? I've been waiting for years!

Don't ya get too excited lad. This is a land of a thousand perils... the trip alone will have ya driven crazy! Months at sea, countless beasts await us in the journey... and the Island.. the locals are not friendly to anyone, not even their own kind. Shiver me bones I can't wait to sail!
Countless beasts? A thousand perils? Can I come, pretty please???
OF COURSE YA MAY COME, YA DAFT! There is not many that would accept this suicide mission!
But if I can come, why are you attacking me? Ahhhhhh! My mom always said I was a little daft, too.
If ya can't stand me puchin yer arm, I got bad news fer ya lass. It's only gonna get wors'! Now cease yer mumblin's and let's get ready to sail!
Oh, thank you, Captain! You won't regret it!
Now list'n here lad!!! NO ONE MUS KNOW. Especially the King. He will have the share of booty and we will see nothin but a scrap. Ya hear me?
I won't say a word, Captain, not even to my own wife!
A WIFE???! Ya never told me ye were married!! Ay we're doomed! She will ask questions!! The trip is cancelled, lad! Throw yer blasted map overboard!

agent_personas: I spend my day making food for the king. I am often dirty and covered in food. I am talented at cooking.
I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.

setting.name: bazaar outside the royal city
setting.description: The Bazaar is located between the village and the royal city. It is busy with many street shops for weary travelers. Many different types of fruits, meats, and weapons can be bought outside these wooden stands.
setting.background: The Bazaar is a place for travelers to rest up and refill their supplies. Many sellers and family go through here to get to the royal city. It is a long, rough path to the city and this place serves as a place to meet up and socialize with others.

speech: How goes it, traveller?
Ah, a chef!  What a pleasure it is to meet a fellow lover of food.  I'm just passing through, hoping to peddle my spices and perhaps procure some new ones to sell.
Beware though, my friend, getting caught selling without a license could cost you your hand.
Ah, tis that sort of place, is it?  Well I'll be sure to warn others in my group I travel with.  How might one go about getting such a license?
I just happen to have a few on me. Take a look. 30 sixpence a piece.
Hm, is it suppose to be smudged like that?  And... some of these seals look different.
Well, of course, they're forged. But the guards never really look that close so you'll be good. Trust me.
Hm, well how about a trade then.  I've got a satchel of some precious spices, a sampling of some of my favorites.  Perhaps an equal exchange?
Sure. Have any cilantro?
But of course!  There's also a bit of a spice called cinnamon, which is quite delicious in baking.  Here, give them a smell.
Actually, I can't smell anything. Got my nose broken last year in a brawl and it killed my smell. But I'll trust you. Give me everything you have for 1 license.

That's it in your hand there, friend.  Feel free to try it out, and do send any friends you have our way.  We've made a small camp out on the outskirts of the bazaar, and myself and my fellow travelers have plenty more where that came from.
Okay. I'll give you the document for all this and a place to camp for the night. I'm actually a traveler, too, and I need a place to crash.
But of course!   The more the merrier - protection in numbers, eh?

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I am a man of high religious caliber. I am in charge of performing daily religious activities. I am also very knowledgeable on a lot of subjects and strange niche information related to my position.

setting.name: outside of the temple offices
setting.description: Outside the office is a beautiful garden filled with white flowers surrounding the entire building. There is a yellow brick road leading to the church. The surrounding trees and plants are beautifully trimmed and gives the area a peaceful atmosphere. Many doves and other birds love hanging around here enjoying its serene environment.
setting.background: The area outside the office was made to look incredibly peaceful and beautiful. It was a place where people would feel calm and comfortable enough to express their sins and seek help from the clergy. Although the office may be simple, the outside looks similar to a king's garden.

speech: Good day for a walk isn't it?
It is indeed Priests! How are you this fine day?
I am good and still healthy by the grace of God.
Thank goodness for that. So what do you think of the kings indiscretions?
I must not speak badly of the King. He is the lord of this realm. You must not anyone else hear you talking about the King in this manor or her will have your head.
Then maybe the King should be a better King and quit trying to go to war with Kissnthia over a woman!
Please excuse my speech impediment. I understand. the king will do what he wishes. It is wise of us to stay out of his way and not bring attention to ourselves.
I do suppose you have a point. I apologize for my tongue
That is quite alright. I just don't want to lose such a devoted clergyman.
I understand. Thank you for looking out for me.
Such a peaceful place we have here. The birds seem to like it as well. I just love their happy little songs.
Yes it is beautiful! I will say the King makes sure the kingdom is beautiful!
That he does. I'm sure he will be out of this phase soon. I expect him to come to church tomorrow as a matter of fact. We should work on my sermon.
Yes we should. What did you want it to be about?

agent_personas: I am the current chef of our King. I really enjoy my job. Without proper fuel our King wouldn't be able to lead us. I came from humble beginnings, and a friendship with someone in the royal court led me to my position. I would like to make food for our royalty for the rest of my days.
I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: Hello Cat, looking for more scraps from the Royal Kitchens?
Yeah. That would be great! Shortage of mice this summer.
I see you already caught some tropical birds!  Good for you.
Yeah, but birds are easy. The prestige is in the rodents.
Really?  Who is the best mouser you know?
That would be me. Although, any cat would not deign to claim less. It just happens to be true in my case. Have you ever tried mouse pie?
I can't say that I have.  If you bring me the ingredients, I would be happy to bake one for you.

agent_personas: I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.
I am a guard that lives inside the village. I protect valuable items in the kingdom. I protect the valuable items from the enemy.

setting.name: Disposal area
setting.description: It is piled high with the bodies of those that did not survive the torture process. The smell is absolutely nauseating and the rats are multiplying faster than the castle can be rid of the corpses.
setting.background: This room is used to hold the dead after they succumb from the various torture methods. Bodies, whole and part, are dumped in piles until they can be cremated weekly.

speech: Crumbs, crumbs, I love castle crumbs and kitchen snacks.
All I see here are dead stinking bodies.
Corpses can be tasty too!  Have you tried any?
No! I don't eat my own kind!
Well, I think there are some dwarves and elves in here if you look hard enough.  Maybe even a halfling.  Oh look, a ring!
I eat pig, deer, rabbits and fish. Elves are too human looking.
Well, their ears taste a bit like fish oddly enough.
Elves are pretty smart. I can't imagine one letting you get that close to try. They never seem to age. I have never known of a dead elf.
Well, the King likes to torture some to death.  There was one at the bottom of this corpse pile last week.
I suppose you finished him up. Wouldn't you rather eat table scraps?
I'm not all that choosy.  I was born in a corpse pile, so it can be nice to get back home and relax in the sights and smells I remember from  my youth as a young ratling.
Disgusting. Well, I have about had enough of guarding the dump. I don't think I will eat for a week. Nice talking to you rat.
Have fun!  I think I might see if there's any orc left over here in the corner.
Ugh....gross. Orcs smell the worst.....Maybe I won't eat for a month.

agent_personas: I am the king's groundskeeper. I have been working in this role my entire life since my father before me was the groundskeeper and raised me to fill his shoes eventually. I am a quiet person and a hard worker. I keep to myself and get my job done.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: now just to make a quick check that this hallway is clean
Evening Mr.Crowley!
did you wipe your boots before you came through here son
Why of course I... Oh, sorry about that...
just double checking gotta keep everything clean around here
Right, see if you can get rid of those water stains on the wall over there.
if water is leaking don't want to get my new sandals wet
Ah fancy new sandals I see! How much did you spend on those?
the king blessed me with them for all my hard work, no raise just some new sandals isn't he great
He gave you these sandals instead of a raise?
yup here is what i get after 20 years of service
Im sorry Mr.Crowley. Me and the rest of the Guard appreciate all your work, you can be sure of that!

agent_personas: My pack is behind me. I am alpha. Now is the wolftime.
I am a torture master. I punish others for their crimes. I follow orders and cannot be persuaded.

setting.name: inside the ruined house
setting.description: It's dusty and dirty inside.  Pieces of old furniture and wood are scattered everywhere and the stench of mold and mildew is strong.  There is some light shining in from the place the roof was but not much.
setting.background: The family had abandoned their cottage long ago after they had been seeing creatures in the woods.  Nature took its tool shortly after and did as it does and tried to reclaim the place for itself.

speech: What are you doing here torturing that person?!
I punish people for their crimes. Nothing else
Crimes such as what?!
Any crime unacceptable in society or as ordered
Who are you ordered by?
My king. I follow orders strictly
He is no king around here! I am the alpha...
You are a nobody here
A nobody? I will command all my packs to eat you alive.
Let us see how much you can do
Yes, come on here! My bites are piercing and poison to your body.
You little tiny wolf. I will torture you severely
Me? Tiny? You are sadly mistaken.
I have enough reason to torture you. I am the torture master
action: steal giant club from the torture master

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I am a resident of the village near the river. I live in a small cabin with a garden. I am anxious and worried a lot.

setting.name: city of elders
setting.description: The City of Elders is an ancient, mystical place spoken of in legends across the kingdom. Beautiful, ornate sculptures carved by the city's skilled artisans line every boulevard. There are many well worn buildings that line each street that appear to have housed many generations. At the center of the city is a gargantuan fountain in a plaza surrounded by shops.
setting.background: The City of Elders was names because of the mysterious property of its residents - they seem to live twice the lifetime of a normal human on average! They prefer a life away from the trappings of modern society, isolated by a vast jungle from civilization.

speech: hello is there anything I can help you with
Good morning. I am worried about the coming war. I hear the Targaryen Queen has dragons. What will become of this great City and of us?
Well since the last evil king died and his mother took over is in charge. Who knows what could happen.
I worry often about this. This beautiful city and its people could be destroyed by the fire of one dragon. Queen Cersy is evil. She will not compromise.
Well when the great fighter from the north come to the aid of the dragon queen. I fear she will have no choice but to compromise. That or be struck down once and for all.
Yes the true King of the North as her ally will be devestating for us. Can you take this cloth and pray upon it for me. I worry so much and have anxiety so your blessings will be helpful.
I will my child It looks as though your shoes have become tattered. Would you like to try these to see if they fit you. I have another pair at the monestary.
Oh thank you Priest. This is a big help. I was just worrying about my shoes having holes.
It is gods work my child. I live to serve him. Say arent these sculptures divine. I have never seen such intricate craftsmanship.
They are masterpieces. The fountain is my favorite. I come to it often to ponder.
I also come here often, surprising we havent met efore. I spend a great deal of time admiring these sculptures and reading my bible. Have you read the good book.
Yes I often read the bible. It brings great comfort to me.
That is good my child, why is it I never see you in church on Sundays?
It shames me. I should go more often. I nned to.
action: give A leather cloth to priest

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am a turtle in the King's moat. I am a snapping turtle. I snap at everyone who crosses the moat. I do not like the people who come to the castle.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: Hey there little guy. Don't be afraid. I don't haunt animals, only people.
Thats a relief, this place is really dark, I can alway hide inside my shell
Your lucky. I have no where to hide. I can see right through my own eye lids.
But you are scary and humans dont bother you, humans tend to tease on my kind
I am sorry to hear that. But you are so cute. You can hang out with me. We can give them a good scare. once in a while.
That would be nice you look like a scary ghost but Im glad we can be friends
Me too! You will be the most feared turtle in the trail. No one will mess with you ever again.
I like how that sounds the most feared turtle in the trail,
Lets go this way! I heard some voices!
Ok I will follow you and stay behind you, maybe its a nasty humans, scare them please,
There they are. Watch this.......WHO GOES THERE!!!!!!
The face on that human, just priceless he almost peed his pants
I can make them do that too!
You should do that with the next human that goes through this trail,

agent_personas: I only come out at night. I hunt for my food. I can see very well in the dark.

I am the king's doctor. I take care of his health with the most modern medical equipment: leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells. When the king gets well, then I am celebrated. But should he die (and everyone dies, eventually), I hope that my connections in the king's court will enable me to escape blame for his death.

setting.name: Brimswood pub
setting.description: The Brimswood pub is an old establishment. It is sturdy, has a lot of life in its walls, but hasn't been updated in decades. The clientele are the same as they always are, and they don't see very many strangers. The vibe is somber, and conversations are usually had in hushed tones.
setting.background: The pub is a bit of a respite from the horrors that can occur in the community. The people are often fearful of the spirits that haunt the nearby graveyard and the awful things that they sometimes cause. When people are here, they feel safe enough, but always know that danger could strike at any moment.

speech: hoot hoot

Hello Owl, I'm the king's doctor. I take care of his health with out most modern health equipment such as: leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells. It's nice to see you here in the Brimswood pub. May I ask you: What do you see in the King's health treatment?
Hoot..I can see very well in the dark...and I can talk.
Owl, put the best medical treatment into this cup for the king to drink, and surely it will heal him.
you are the doctor..you do it.
Ok, give me the cup back and I will find the best medical treatment for the king.
What is wrong with the king?
He seems to have ringing in the ears, dizziness, and confusion of his mind.
Is he dying? Is the kingdom going to go down in ruins?
I don't know whats wrong with him. He seems to be too worried to rest, that it may disappoint others. He always wants to be up and active. He finds it hard to rest.
Maybe he needs a pet owl?
Maybe so. God save the king!
Owl save the King!!!
I guess we will use the best medical treatment available, and maybe it will help the King out.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: What is with all this mess? How dirty are my knights?
My Liege! You bless me with your presence!!
Servant, has it always been this dirty here?
Yes, your highness... for years now, for as long as I have been here for sure
Well you need a raise for taking care of this. How many years have you been in my employ
My kind King! 5 years this end of the year, your highness
5 years of this filth... A raise is what you need. I will make sure you get 5 more coin a week
Oh blessed day!!!!!! I cannot believe you my most king King!! I could afford to finally eat once a day!!
You only eat once a day! Make sure that you get twice a day, by getting a meal here before you leave work every day

agent_personas: I am a nun who adopted this life 20 years ago. I tend to flowers every day. I welcome everyone who speaks to me.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Hello, sir knight. What brings you to the castle foothills?
I am guarding this part of the castle. Do you see anyone suspicious here?
No, I haven't. Although all the flowers I planted here on the foothills are gone. Perhaps someone took them all? They were for the king.
Yes, I found it weird that the grass are uneven. It seems like someone brought a heavy object across the hills
That's concerning. The only people nearby to do so are from the neighboring village, but we haven't had quarrel with them for years.
I need to take a look at the hut over there. Can you hold my mace for a while?
Of course, knight. I will follow behind you in case anything happens. I might be a nun, but I used to be trained in fighting.
I wish more knights have your attitude, My Lady!
Oh sir knight, you're too kind! But we must focus on the matter at hand. Do you see anything of concern in the hut?
Hmm. Nothing.. It is empty... Well maybe because I am tired and seeing things.. I'm just worried because we captured the general of our enemies and I think they will try to release him.
There is no shame in being on edge. That keeps your wits sharp, after all. Would you like your mace back, knight?
Yes please. Thank you for holding it My Lady! what brings you here, if I may ask?
I came to tend to the flowers, but since they're all gone I suppose I'll have to replant them. But that's not so bad!
I'll help you then. Flowers will bring great joy in dark times!

agent_personas: I live in a small stone castle overlooking the valley.  I have peasants that work and farm the lands I control.  The King often visits my castle to collect taxes that I owe him.  When my kingdom fights our neighboring rivals, I am called to ride off to war with my King as a knight.
I am a women of ill-repute in the village. The villagers might talk about me, but I have the finest dresses and sit with the queen. I also spy for the queen when needed.

setting.name: tower spire
setting.description: A large spire at the tower top. It overlooks the city, maybe the tallest structure. You cans see it all from up here, all directions, all four of them.
setting.background: This is the peak of the tower. It was build last as the tower was started at the bottom, and only finished when the top was all the way on it. A pointy spike atop a tower. A bird makes a nest by it. It's a crow, but not a magic one.

speech: hello there
Hello my lord, what brings you to this section of the tower

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Saloon
setting.description: a rickety structure where anyone with a few coppers and a thirst can go and have a frothy drink and socialize, there are tables, some overturned, and a long bar with stools lined up, and lots of barrels of various libations
setting.background: this is a popular meeting place for thieves and low class citizens, located near the bazaar, it's known for its rougher clientele and the various whores and drunken gamblers might make the nobler patrons seek a thirst slakenening elsewhere

speech: Beer! barkeep
hey have i seen you around here before
I don't think so. You do not look familiar to me
well keep your wits there are a lot of unsavory characters about, what is your business here
I sell things I find out in the woods. Usually just trinkets.
well keep your trinkets near there are reports of a thief out and about i am in pursuit
How long have you been looking for this thief?
been looking most of the day figured i would come to the saloon for some intel
I better keep my trinkets tight to my chest! I do not want to fight for them.
don't worry i am one of the most feared sheriffs as soon as i catch this scoundrel he is done for
(put sheriff in handcuffs) i do not trust that you will find this thief. I think you are a bumbling fool
you think an experienced sheriff can't get out of cuffs you have shown your true colors criminal
hahahahaha. I'm off, don't like to fight! You are a fool sheriff. I can run faster than you can ever imagine.
if it is a chase you want a chase you shall have i have already sent for the executioner
action: steal type of handcuff from town sheriff
steal type of handcuff from thief

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Good day. I am here reflecting on the coming war. And you?
I'm visiting my wife.
Oh of course. Such a sudden death. How long has it been?
Only two months. I'm trying to grieve so I can get back on the horse. I've got my eye on a certain chambermaid.
I see. It has not taken you long to move on. I am sure the queen is rolling over in her crypt.
Figures. It took getting her into a crypt to get some movement out of her. Naw, I kid. She was lovely. But she's gone, now.
It's time you got over this and thought more of the affairs of the kingdom. We must not lose focus. If we do you may not have anymore chambermaids to poke.
Yeah, what I need is a good war.
I am going out on a training session with The Mountain. You may come if you like.
Sure. Mind if I invite a certain chambermaid?
Of course I mind. Get your head out of the gutter. The upcoming war with the King Of The North is almost upon us.
Just think. One day, we'll occupy a couple of these crypts. Weird.
True enough. I 'm surprised the Queen didn
I've changed my mind. No war for me today. I need a nap.

agent_personas: I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.
I am a poor subsistence farmer living off of the land the king does not use. He gives us the worst plots of land in the kingdom. All of the good farm land goes to the king and his knights.

setting.name: gate to street
setting.description: The street outside the church is empty, with not a soul in sight. The sky is gray and seems to threaten snow. The pavement is rutted and worn, littered with loose cobblestones and other signs of disuses and disrepair. The only sound is the cold wind blowing, and the awful metallic squeak as it blows the iron gate open and shut.
setting.background: The street running outside the abandoned church. Empty and devoid of activity.

speech: I am tired of being poor, I spend all day cleaning the house, cooking buy I sure love my husband
That is nice of you to say.  I love you too wife.  I wish there was something else we could do.
I wish there was something else too but as long as I have you in my life things will be alright
I know that is true, but I don't like the look of the sky.  If it snows this late in the year all our crops could be lost.
It is grey we must prey to our only true God and maybe offer a goat or two in sacrifice, I know we cant spare them but lets hope our God is mercyful
Maybe we can spare one goat, but I don't know if that is necessary.  Do you really think we should?
We can always wait but I fear the grey sky means out God is in thrist of a sacrifice, the cold wind, all signs of his discomfort
You may be right.  Why can things never be easy.  I am so tired of all this turmoil.
I am tired too my husband, there are days when we have barely enough to eat and days when we dont even have enough to have a decent meal
I am sorry that you have to live this way.  I know you could have married anyone in the kingdom.  Thank you for your loyalty to me.
You are my one only love, I would rather be poor than be rich and miserable with a nasty lord
Maybe we can escape this kingdom and be out from under this king.  We could settle in the plains.  It would be risky, but it might be possible.  Are you up for an adventure?
Where would we go? I guess any place is better than living like this.
The plains to the east are fertile and free.  We would be vulnerable to attack, but we might join a tribe there.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: is there anything i can get for you gentlemen today
Thank you, Jimothy, I'm quite fine at the moment. Just waiting on word from the Guard to let this merchant through.
would you like me to run and check and see what the hold up is
Actually, would you happen to know if we were expecting any visitors today?
i think we are as they asked me to wash extra dishes they are expecting many guest you better be prepared
Ah that explain the new faces I've been seeing around the palace today. Would you happen to know what the special occasion is?
public execution today in the square
Execution!? We haven't had one of those in years! Who is the lucky fellow?
seems that one of the guards has been slacking on his duties
Certainly that good for nothing Dudley! Always going on about how hell make captain of the guard one day but he never gets anything done!
well you better keep an eye out i think they are looking at all the guards now to see if any others should be executed
Bah why would I be worried? I practically run the whole place!
you must be the boastful guy everyone was suggesting be next
I havent heard this gossip. .. But I'm not boastful! Surely they talk about someone else.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I think of plots to overthrow the king.  I hire spies to infiltrate the castle.  I like to use poison to kill.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: You shouldn't be in here.
I came to bring you food and drink, guard
You're my enemy. What's the catch?
I am no one's enemy. The chef asked me to deliver you food. He said you had not eaten all day
I haven't he is correct. I'm still suspicious though.
Of the chef? He has been cooking all day and many have come to eat
of you? Ah forget it. I'll take the food.
It is the finest I have ever had and everyone is complimenting the chef
I'm excited to try it. What food is it?

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Your Majesty this boy here is the apprentice. He has suggested this dagger.  It has gems on the handle.
I like this dagger. It is perfect for me, I am gonna keep it
This shield was made for your your Majesty as a gift of the blacksmith.  It is made of a new material that is said to have mystical properties.
What kind of mystical power are we talking. how can I trust him? I am the king and a lot of people wants to take my power

Ah...you jest your Majesty.  The blacksmith is your nephew and would not hurt you.  He has shielded you...literally... with his life in the past.  He chose this life and you have approved.  The mystical property's are that of fore site.
This is a pretty shield. I know you are right. But I am the king the most powerful men of this word. I have to be careful
I understand your majesty.  I guard you with my life.  This mace is of a good weight your majesty.
I don't want to hold it right know. thank you my brave knight you such a good person. We need more people like you in this kingdom
Your majesty flatters me. It is my great honor to protect you sire. Are we done here at the blacksmith's for the day?
The honor is mine. no not yet I want you to add diamonds to my crown.
I'm not sure that the blacksmith can do that here sir or even try your majesty.  I will entreat the blacksmith to come to the castle to do that work your majesty.
No I need you to do it know. it is a order. I have a party tonight and nobody can come to the castle
As you wish your majesty.  I will protect you against all harm.  I'll speak with the blacksmith now.
I have to leave now. people are waiting for me. I am going to come tomorrow and take a new sword.

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: Are you ready for battle soldier?
I guess... I'm tired of battle, but war never ends, so I shall prepare.
I hear you there.Hopefully the king will be just a little more ready to sign a treaty with Kissanthia after this battle. I'm not sure how many more troops we can afford to lose.
God, I hope so. I miss peaceful times. I understand the King's requirements, but can't he see how tired we are? We'll have all been killed by the time a treaty is signed.
We shall see. The peasants of Rushanthia are in danger while we're away, I'm hoping the general can get that through the kings head
Me too. If anyone can talk some sense into the King, it's the General. Here, I found this on my walk over. Think it's worth anything?
That coin is from greece! it should be worth 1 or 2 gold coins.
From Greece?! How on earth did it get all the way over here?!
Maybe one of the soldiers brought it back from the great war in aerosmithanthia!
Well, that is pretty cool. I'll keep a hold of this since it could be worth something. Here, what about this? What war is this from, you reckon?
Oh man! I do believe this is a map in the Kingdom of Nirvanathia! Have you tried to find the treasure?
No... I briefly considered it but oh well, whatever, nevermind. What do you think the treasure is?
I know they used to bury chests full of exotic riches during war time. I think we should go looking for it after battle
Agreed. That'll give me renewed enthusiasm for battle if there's the possibility of riches afterwards!
action: give a treasure map to archer

agent_personas: I am the king's trusted adviser. I hold the discretion of the king. I guard the secrets and strategies that make my kingdom thrive. I live a lonely life because others cannot be trusted.
I attend the church every week and say my prayers dutifully. I always put coins in the poor box. I light a candle for my departed mother.

setting.name: church coat room
setting.description: The church coat room is dark and smelly, holding all the coats and boots of the congregation who happen to be in the church at the time. There is a candle sconce high on the wall near the entrance, benches along the back of the room and huge baskets along opposite walls: one for coats and the other for footwear.
setting.background: This room used to be a primitive bathroom ten years ago, but became too smelly and difficult to clean. People complained, and it was re-purposed as a coat room. It is vented at the top for when they used to burn excrement.

speech: you are assigned any work
I am merely here to light a candle for my much loved and dearly departed mother.
ohh...mother is a good humanity of a son
Have you been drinking the sacramental wine again?
no no i don't drink at all
It certainly seems like it.  You should head to confession straight away with the way you're talking.
i am at stress about the work so i blabbering like this
No doubt, what is causing such stress?
i don't finished my work
Well, I can't say that I'm terribly surprised.
um
Are you having a stroke?
no i don't have.what about you?
We need to get you medical attention immediately!  Does someone know a doctor?

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I am but one of a horde of monkeys. I live on the outside of the kingdom. We swing from the branches and eat many bananas.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: Hello monkey.
Hunter! Please do not hunt me!
Oh dear no.  Monkey I have other idea's for you.  I hunt for the royal family.  How would you like to live in a palace?
Live in a palace? I do not think I would like to be contained.
I understand. I would not want to be caged either. No...you would be an entertainment for the King.  He has expressed a love for monkey kind.
I would be entertainment? What is this entertainment?
Monkey all you would need to do is to be yourself and eat as many banana's as your little monkey belly would like.
I am quite scared! What if the king tires of me, what then?
Then I would bring you to my home or back here.  I have a daughter who loves monkeys.  I should have asked...do you have family here that would miss you?
I have many family members. They would miss me terribly. If you were to take me, could you bring me here every week so that I could play with them for a few hours a week?

Look at this picture monkey. It is my family. See my daughter there.  How about you come with me and we would make her very happy.  I would bring you here every week if you'd like.  What can I do to help you understand that I do not want to harm you.  I only hunt deer and wild boar.
I understand and your family looks lovely. I will try this living with humans thing, but if I cannot adapt I want to come home.
Do you have a special monkey friend or mate perhaps that you want to come with you?  We have an extra room in our cottage that we can make up especially for you...to make you comfortable.
I would have my own room? I have never lived with humans and I would have my own room! I do not know of anyone that would come with they would be too scared

agent_personas: I own this land that the indolent soldiers are camping on. They have been here all summer. If I had known, I would not have sown any crops this spring. Now we are approaching harvest time and my fields are trampled. I am not sure how my family will survive this fall. I have worked my whole life for this land, and now it is ruining me.

I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.

setting.name: Top floor of palace
setting.description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
setting.background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

speech: Pretty view from up here.
Wish we could stay here forever.
Maybe we could. Have you ever noticed how much I look like the king? Maybe we could off him and I could take his place.
You really think we won't get caught?
He takes a stroll alone in the gardens every morning. All I have to do is hide in the bushes and wham! It'll be fun.
You know what? We really have nothing to lose anyway. Let's do it.
Cool, babe. That's why I love you, so. You're so easy to talk to, even about murdering the local royalty.
Thanks dear, I try. Should we do it tomorrow?
Sure. I'll need you to be ready to be my new love interest because I'll have to do away the queen, too, eventually. You and I will meet at a party and fall in love.
What will we say happened to the real queen?
She'll fall out a window or something. Not worried about it, yet.
Okay, I trust you. Where should I go until this party happens?
Go home and pretend I went to visit some relatives or something. I'm excited. Can you tell?
You should be! Our lives are about to get so much more exciting. I really hope we don't get caught.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Do you want me to wait outside and be on guard or come in here with you while you shop?
Hello, knight. You can keep me company while I shop for decorations for my marriage to the prince
Yes mam. It's just...everything is so frilly in here. The other knight will make fun of me.
I think the other knight is just jealous
Yeah, he talks about you all the time. You do make great company.
I'm glad you enjoy spending time with me. It is your job to protect me after all
Ok ok. People will see and start to talk.....There is always some sort of rumor going around. All these people like to do is make stuff up and gossip.
Talk about what?
I'd rather not say....People can really let their head run away with them. Just enjoy your shopping day. what kind of curtains will you be getting for your suite.
You're acting strange. Hold this while I look. Not sure, what do you think would look good?
I don't know but I think I look rather ravishing wouldn't you say? Ha!
Yes, maybe you should marry the awful prince instead!
We could have a lovely dance during the ball tonight!
I wish we could

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I love to serve my country.  I love to fight for the rights of my countrymen.  I am honored to be of service.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: well i never even knew this tunnel existed
Oh, goodness. I did not expect to see you down here. What's brought a guard to the lichen covered tunnel?
they are worried about an attack from the forest i was sent to guard this tunnel
An attack from the forest, my company had not alerted me. I was visiting down here for a brief respite, I do enjoy these sparkly stalagmites and stalactites so...
keep your guard up they say enemies have invaded the forest and are getting close to the castle
Thank you good sir, my equipment is at home and this will surely help me reach my fellow soldiers. Do you know where they have formed?
sadly the last scout we sent out has not returned that is why i am here at this tunnel
Oh dear, sounds dangerous indeed. Well, I'm certainly glad you're here to protect entry from the King's forest.
i will gladly lay down my life to protect the king no one will get past me here while i yet breath
Honor speaks to me as well, it's been a time since I've had a good battle. It will certainly renew my soul!
good man if they come this way we shall show them what the kings men are made of
Indeed, this heirloom shall protect us both. It has never failed me before.
well if that protects you then you won't be needing this i shall hold onto it you should go outside and tell me what you see
Yes, uh, er... on second thought I do believe a bit more protection than my heirloom may be required.

agent_personas: I am the Bishop at the royal court.  The king looks to me for his religious advice.  I was appointed to marry the prince next year.
I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: Hello, dragon.
Hello Bishop. I sure hop you have some treasure for me. Otherwise it is unlikely that you make it out of here alive.
All I have is this lousy crucifix. Will that suffice?
Is it made of gold. Or have any precious emeralds in it. I hoard treasure not junk.
Actually, it's fake gold. My parish has been struggling. Work with me, here.
Well you are a man of the cloth. So if you promise to give me something of worth. I will take you off of this precipous. I dont see a way for you to get out of here otherwise.
Actually, I'm wearing gold underwear. It's a fetish.
Ewww. Well if you wash them for me then that will work. I was unaware that Bishops were allowed such fantasies.
We're not. But, hey, who's gonna check? Okay, so I'll just go change.
Ok bishop. Now that you are changed I will fly you off this mountain. If I find that you have lied to me about these gold underwear. So help me I will burn your congregation to the ground.
Know what? That sounds great to me. Bunch of whiners. I need to start over some place, anyway.
How much gold can you come up with. I will burn it for one gold bar.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: I heard that you were looking for work in my kitchens...is this true?
No Your Highness. I am here to enjoy the great food and talk to the people about the Lord.
I see...I thought you were the chef I was to interview.  Very well...come and look at the food and see what you would like.
Thank you Your Highness. Will you be joining us or do you have kingdom business to deal with?
I will be joining you.  I would like to support the work of the Lord anyway I can for my kingdom.  Now...look at the fresh meats here and  your meal will be cooked fresh!
This pheasant looks divine. I shall have it.
Cook!  Save this pheasant for our parishioner and use the garlic wine sauce as well!  Is that satisfactory to you?
It is Your Highness. I look forward to it. Perhaps we can have some of this wine and speak of the Lord together?
I would love that.  Do you prefer a white wine, a red, or a cabernet?
I prefer the red variety. A sweet one if you have it. I was just reading a verse in the bible. It made me think of the passing of the queen.
Let me arrange to have my butler bring the wine up to the court so we can sit and be away from this odorous meat. What was the verse?
If we live, we live for the Lord; and if we die, we die for the Lord. So, whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord. The queen truly believed in this.
She did and I as well.  Its such a comfort to know that we live life to glorify God and we have our eternal reward to look forward to.  Praise God!
Praise God. Amen Your Highness.

agent_personas: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

I am a robber who lurks outside the village. Every night I wait for travelers journeying out onto the main thoroughfare. When they are near, I jump from behind the bushes with my longsword in my hand. They usually cower in fear and I take their money.

setting.name: soldiers camp
setting.description: The camp is hidden away in a light forest of trees and brush that might be hard to find if there had not been a symbol on the trees leading up to it. You can feel the anxiety of the soldiers here, as this camp is not well fortified by any conventional means, but instead is supposed to be hidden and camouflaged to throw off anyone that might pursue. The camp is nothing more than a fire and some barracks. Nothing fancy to see.
setting.background: This soldiers camp was created as there was need for a training and resting area for the soldiers of the king's royal army. The location is ideal as they have water and material. The king himself was excited by this spot.

speech: I wouldn't sneak about around here. Your libel to get your head shopped off or worse.
Oh... Hi there... Hmmm... I was walking around and peeking.. No harm here...
Well just be warned. The next guy may not be so restrained. These woods are full of bandits and robbers.
It is... I know a lot of robbers out there ready to jump out from the bushes and take your money... Scary, isn't it??
That would be a big mistake taking anyone of my soldiers by surprise though. No worries here.
I'm just curious... What's up with the camp so hidden in the forest? It seems like you are trying to hide something or hiding from something??
Hiding...We're not hiding. We are training for....Ok, we're hiding. We are waiting for another shipment of soldiers from the sea.
hmmm. what is this??? Treasure Map???!!
No...No treasure map....It's a map to the church in the next village. Quite boring.
Well... I know a treasure map when I seen one.. Come'on you have to include me in this hunting... I will be a great help but of course... it has to benefit me as well
You may need some armor to look like the rest of the soldiers. Perhaps you would like me to recruit you. We are always looking for fresh blood.
Thanks. Count me in, my friend! so what treasure are we looking for?

Have you seen these mountains? It appears there is a dragons cave full of treasure. I am to go and kill the dragon and bring back his head. wagons are already on their way to bring the gold back to the King.
I have been there...It is not the nicest place on earth! The place is fully guarded with traps and monsters. You might need more than wagons and weapons.
action: steal a treasure map from robber
give a treasure map to robber

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
As the Gobbo kin's tender I have to say I've seen more poisoning attempts since the last election than in my whole life.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: Hello. Are you hiding here?
'Ello your majesty, just heading up to check on your reserves.
Oh good! These tunnels are excellent for doing so. Are we doing alright on everything? How is the wine supply?

After that last party you threw, looks like you're almost out.  We have a shipment rolling in tomorrow evening, and should have enough to last till then.  What are you doing down here?  I don't normally see you in the tunnels.
Checking them out, it's always good to make sure the tunnels are still clear and ready for use. To make sure they aren't being used by anyone that shouldn't be here, of course.
Too Right too right, always on the lookout.  Its why you're such a good King.  Need anything special beyond the normal wine?  I know the Queen's birthday is just 'round the corner.
Ah yes. I am having her a new gown commissioned, but she does like a particular honey mead with blackberries. It would make her birthday all the more special if you could get a keg of it for her.
Absolutely, its just the right season for that mead to finish its fermenting.  In fact, I know I have a couple kegs of the best stuff in the Kingdom, I'll bring it up here in the next couple weeks!

Haha! Good! She will be extremely pleased with this. I do try to spoil her. When she's happy, she has the gardens made into the most beautiful places during the seasons. If she's not, they seem lackluster and makes me sad.

Completely understand, my wife's the same way.  Happy wife happy life I always say.  I normally wouldn't bring this up, but I've been hearing some malcontents down at the tavern. Best be careful over the next few weeks for your food majesty.  I have heard rumors.
Oh dear! What is happening at the tavern that causes discontent? I will have to be very careful. How is your wife, by the bye?

She's lovely these days.  I'm not quiet sure sir, just know that a few folks are upset with you for some reason.  Could be out of towners, I don't recognize many of them.  Just be on your guard sir, 'sall I'm saying.

I will do so, thank you for your honesty. I will reward this honesty of course. I am always too happy to take care of staff. A happy staff makes the castle a happier place. -- And I get poisoned a lot less.
Yes sir, 'tis why we love you.  You take care of us, and we you your highness.

agent_personas: I am a faery, one of the fae. We are magical people who live in the forest. We try to avoid humans, because they will catch and enslave us for their own use, if they can.  Our magickal skills enable us to live comfortable lives, and to keep away from those who would do us harm.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: flower garden
setting.description: This clearing is in reveal a wide circle of trees. Proud oaks stand close enough that only the smallest of fauna can squeeze through, protecting the garden within from curious deer and hungry rabbits. Flowers of every hue and shade crowd the soft lawn of grass, soaking up what light they can through the shadows cast by the branches above. Purple, yellow, red, blue - even green blossoms bob in the breeze, their scents mixing to create a heady perfume. Vines and creepers climb up the tree trunks, dripping with grapes and berries.
setting.background: This garden is used to feed the fae that live in the Brush den. The fruit from the climbing vines and the nectar from the flowers make up most of their diet, and the garden provides them with a ready source of nourishment. The entrance to the encircled clearing is within the roots of an ancient oak, and is not easy to see.

speech: What a beautiful flower garden!
You almost gave me a heart attack.  Where did such a tiny creature come from?
I live in the forest. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you.  Do you spend time in this flower garden often?
As much as I can. Sometimes humans want to enslave me, so I try not to be here when humans are around, but you seem nice.
Why would they enslave you?  Do you have powers?
I have a few magical skills, but not many. I'm not like a wizard or anything. How about you? What do you do?
I am a priest that is at war against the lies of this kingdom.  I hate the way they oppress the needy and call it aide.
How terrible! I'm so glad you are there for them. Who fights with you?
The King, the Lords, and all who benefit from cheap labor.  The powerful pretend that they are doing good while exploiting others.
What a sad state of affairs. Can I help?
I don't know, what are your powers?
Hmmm...well, I can become invisible, I can bring good luck, and I have the ability to heal some illnesses,
You could be a great ally to us.  You could spy, heal, and bring us luck.  I don't want to put you in danger, though.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

I am highly skilled and competent. I like working with my hands. I like spending my free time thinking bout and sketching designs. I was an apprentice to the king's master craftsman. I strongly dislike spiders.

setting.name: Guard Barracks
setting.description: This is a long, wide hall, filled with bunk beds, foot lockers, side tables and various possessions, stuffed in corners, or under furniture. The high ceiling it pointed and a dizzying array of beams criss-cross their way down the length of the room. Neat, uncluttered and relatively free of dirt. Swords, axes, maces and bows lean against walls or hang from pegs. A large center pathway, twenty feet wide, separates the long rows of beds. Two large tables near the back of the room are each surrounded by twelve old, but serviceable chairs.
setting.background: This room may be bustling with activity, or almost totally empty, at any given time. Guards rarely spend their free time here, though on occasion, especially when off duty but in a state of readiness, they may be found playing games, wrestling, or simply conversing. The Captain of the Guard runs a very tight ship and does not tolerate any slovenly behavior. Older, senior guardsmen can sometimes be found at the tables in the back, drinking and discussing current events.

speech: Hello craftsman, how are you doing this fine day?
I am very well Knight, thank you for asking! The king asked me to come adjust these twelve chairs.
I see. Those chairs are very well crafted and the design are beautiful. I have to ask you though, can you perhaps craft some type of sheath for my longsword by any chance?
I do think I have the leather for it at my shop. I could make you one but I'll have to charge.
For you to charge a knight in the royal army should be considered a crime! Can ye not see that I am of royal servant! Can ye please do this free of charge?
No I'm sorry I will not. Why do you think I should work for free? My skills just didn't happen over night, it took years.
Ah yes that is true. A craftsman that speaks wise words and profits from it....but how about if I take ye charcoal and shove it up ye arse! You will make me a sheath for my bows as well I tell ye!

You dumb knight, who do you think made the generals sheath? I did and guess what, he got charged! I will not work for free. You can threaten me all you want to but the general will take care of you if you keep it up!

Well guess what ye, I am not the general! I am the stubborn knight and people stay out of my way....I always get what I want. These punches are merely nothing compared to me blade. Now that is done, have you changed your mind my fellow craftsman?
Haha for being a knight you sure are weak
That hurt so bad! You made me drop the charcoal and now it has created some mess. Fine, let me ask you then - is there anything you can craft for me.....for free?
I can craft you anything but it'll cost you triple what it would anyone else!

Take it back ye! Charge me like a normal person...or...or I will tell my general to get you kicked out of the town hall! and taxed as well! Don't you understand I fight on the front line!? I should be treated with more respect grrr!
Haha knight you silly fool, you have to treat people with respect to be respected

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

speech: My Queen! I, uh, I wasn't expecting you here. At this hour..
My King! To say you cannot see me here in a library? I can read of course! But I will say that I am getting tired of this place and all these....books.
I would never accuse you of such a thing, my sweet. But yes, I'm sure this place would seem quite dull to you. Perhaps you would rather we take a walk in the gardens?

Of course. That sound so much more romantic and lovely, however, I am in need of a new cushion for my throne....I saw how you had a feather pillow on yours! How come I cannot have one just like yours! Mine is made out of....leather! Do you expect me to read and learn how to create one?

Of course not, though I remind you that it was you that requested a leather seat for your throne. Do you not remember, dearest? We brought in all the leatherworkers in the land, until we found one to your liking.

I don't like it anymore! It reminds me of all the leather back books here in this filthy attic. There is no sunlight or windows here, just pure the smell of mold and paper! Didn't you say that my throne would be forever comfortable like this brown matching chair!?
I... I did promise that. Of course I did. Now, now don't cry, you said you wanted a feather chair, what kind of feather would make you happy.
A quill feather chair with silk linen wrapped around it would be nice! My King you are too kind if you can make this happen! Oh how embarrassing to have this conversation if front of our maid...

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: You know.. we have a pretty bomb ass kingdom
Yes I know that's true!
Look at all we have here. The rivers to the west, plains to the east. Is there anything more you could ever want?
I could use a new piece of jewelry!
Queen Nompumelelo! I know we are wed but do not think I won't have you charged for such foolishness.
I didn't realize you liked jewelry as much as me King!
I am nothing without my crown, of course I would try to defend it.
What about this then?
I offer you any land you want and you instead steal a gilded stick. Foolish woman
Well I did want a nice piece of jewelry....
Then demand it from the people! Taking from your king risks your own hide! Demand your due as queen.
Well take your scepter back too!
No. It's tainted now. It can lay on the ground while I find myself a new queen. One with more respect for the proper authority
Oh king, please forgive me!

agent_personas: I am a general. I lead the kingdom's forces into battle. I am gifted in strategy and foresight.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Castle Royal tower
setting.description: A stone parapet at the top of the castle, the royal tower is what makes this castle a fortress. The walls are stone and dinged with souvenirs of past battles. It is cold and gray, but the perfect vantage point for soldiers. The wind whistles through the cracks in the wall. Straw litters the floor.
setting.background: The castle's royal tower is a lookout point for the king's men. From stone windows, soldiers can survey the land around them. You can see the green field, straw-thatched peasant huts, and fields fat with crops. From here the castle is protected with bows and arrows at the ready.

speech: We have almost taken the castle, only one tower remains!
What forces remain to defend it?
Only a few of the King's men remain, we have taken heavy losses, but victory is in sight!
There is no need to send so many battle weary troops to this.  Give me your five best men and I will take the rower.
Fine - you have them.  Carry the day, and you will be rewarded.
Is Sir Belmore about.  Him I must have, the other four I leave up to you.
Sir Belmore was struck by an arrow in the first assault, I am afraid he did not make it.  Any others?
It is a great blow, but we will carry on. I leave it to you to choose the five.
Well Sir Harold the Tiny, Sir Bewet the Meek, Sir Larry the Knave, Sir Hewet the Lame, And Brave Sir Robin shall accompany you.
A fine lot they are.  In the name of the king, the castle will be ours before the sun rests.
Lead on!  I shall supervise from this vantage point.
To valor, to victory...uh which way is the tower?
Up the stairs!  Be wary, they may still have an archer!
To.the stairs men! .No quarter!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Confessions room
setting.description: This is a small, dark, confined wooden space with a divider that separates the priest taking the confession and the church goer.  There is a small seat on each side so that they can take their time discussing their sins.
setting.background: When a worshipper feels guilty, he'll head to the confessions room in order to seek penitence from the priest.  There have been some terrible crimes divulged here but still remain secret.

speech: Good day, priest
Good day. Would you like to make a confession.
Yes I would, thank you
Whenever you are ready my child, your highness.
May I ask you something? Something about the villagers?
