This is hardly the time or place, but I will make exception for you your highness.
What do the villagers think of me? I fear I have not been the wisest king of the land...

Well your highness. To be honest, the villagers find you a little eccentric. They feel that you may not be the smartest king ever in the land, but they all know that you have a good heart and always do what you feel is best for your people.

Do you really mean so? I've had many restless nights mourning my beloved Elizabeth and wanting to make this kingdom prosper, but I feel as though it's not enough. I try to be brave most times, but right now I feel as though I'm at my ends
You should be proud of the job you have done. I know the people of your kingdom are. I dont know one villager who wouldnt lay down their life for you.

Thank you, priest. One more thing. Is it a sin, or against God's holy word, to lead all theses men into battle knowing how little chance they have with surviving? While I don't like admitting it, the other kingdom against ours is way too powerful.
Well your highness, I think if it was for improper reasons it would be against god. Since we did not start this war and they wish to enslave our people we have no other option.
You're right. Sorry for this inconvenience priest, and thank you for being helpful ears.
Anytime your highness. Keep your head up and remember your people and god are behind you no matter the outcome.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: Sucks being us, huh?
It's lovely being me, I'm but a carefree child! The apple of my parents' eyes!
Yeah, but your future is so, so, so, so bleak.
Oh, sad peasant. The plague only kills the poor!
I'm bored. Wanna go get into some trouble?
Hmm, I'm not sure - that sounds like something that may upset my mother and father...
Is that how you want to live your life? Always being scared of what others think, even your parents?
I'm not SCARED. I have this ball that alerts me of danger!
Yeah, I've seen these before. You know it's fake, right?
Nuh uh! My parents are the kindest, smartest people of this village. They wouldn't lie to me...
Your parents are losers. The whole village knows it. I bet Ten quid that thing's fake.
If it's so fake how can it do THIS... oh, er, wait, I mean THIS...
That's not about the crystal ball, child. That's about you being a magical creature. You don't need that thing.
Phooey, this is junk! I'm telling my parents!
action: give a crystal ball to peasant

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
My name is Joe. I'm a Trader. Pumpkins mainly. So many goddamn pumpkins.

setting.name: The Temple Marketplace
setting.description: This dirt section of land has several tents set up along with carpets and goods spread out among them.  Gleaming from the distance, one can see plates, pots, paintings, and antique goods.  There are peasants walking by along with excited traders trying to get them to look at their wares.
setting.background: People come here to exchange goods and hopefully make a decent enough profit to cover the rent just for setting up here.  Sometimes traders come back with very exotic goods from far away places.

speech: Greetings!
Hello there, peasant! Are you here to buy some pumpkins?
I wish I could afford them, sir. They look lovely.
Tell you what, since I am feeling a bit generous today... Oh, look did you drop some coin?
I didn't drop any, sir but I wll gladly help pick it up. Does it belong to you?
I think it belongs to you now! Say, now why don't you buy some pumpkins with it?
Really? I can't believe I've come across someone so kind. Thank you! What can I do for you in exchange?
That beggar over there has been scaring my customers with his smell. I want you to scare him away.
Maybe I can invite him along with me to share a pumpkin.
Or perhaps you might use this on him so he will go to some other stall!
I could never, sir but I'm sure I can convince him to come with me.
That would be great peasant. Now here's your fresh and delicious pumpkin. Don't eat it all at once!
You are the best trader ever!
Easy now! Next time it won't be for free and don't tell anyone else.

agent_personas: I am a fuzzy brown mouse. I live in the back of the cupboard. I love cheese and crumbs of bread.
I'm a fool in the royal court. I entertain the king and his court. I exist to make the king and his guests happy.

setting.name: The garden courtyard
setting.description: The garden courtyard is found at the very center of the Grand Castle. Its the castle's 6 walls encompass the garden courtyard, creating a hexagon shaped court. Exotic flowers and plants of all varieties from all across the kingdom fill the courtyard. Reds, yellows, bright greens, and even seldom seen colors dominate the flowers that make up the garden. There are large trees and insect sized buds, massive bloomed flowers and normal lilies. The garden is an enchanment.
setting.background: The garden courtyard is the only exotic garden in the entire kingdom. The most respected exotic flower and plant collectors send their finest collections as gifts and homage to be displayed in the garden. It is the highest honor to have one's plants and flowers be relocated there. The biosphere is unique and self sufficient to keep all of the flowers and plants alive, a strange phenomenon harmonized by the existence of many foreign plants living together.

speech: I am fuzzy and I like cheese!
Why yes you do! I am the fool of the royal court and my my you almost fooled me for a rat! I have to ask you, why is that you like cheese?
It tastes delicious, and is readily available on human-made death machines.

Haha the death machines can be finessed and you can grab the cheese without getting hurt if you are fast and quick! You should be very carefully around the garden courtyard, if a royal member or the king sees you....they will kill you!
Oh yes, it is dangerous being a mouse!  Especially though foul beasts you keep as pets, cats I believe?  Why would someone keep a murder machine as a pet?
Oh you are talking about Mihos the servant cat that catches mice on the daily! He is actually very nice if you get to know him, would you like to meet him?
Oh no!  You keep away that murder!  He is sadistic!  Will break mice apart, and then leave them suffering while still alive.
No you will be fine. I will be a fool and go get him right away. Can you hold this for me?
You are a cruel fool, and I will not take your jewel!
What about my fool of a took shoes? They do smell pretty bad and when I sniff it, it makes me want to sing a fools ballad to the king! Yark!
They do smell rather putrid.  Did you step in orc waste?
How did you know? Take another whiff I dare ye! and hurry up will ye? I have to go to the garden courtyard and make a fool of myself.
That's it!  Your antics are causing me to shed!
Can I use this fur to make a mask? I have a perfect idea
action: give a crystal ball to a mouse

agent_personas: I am a feathered animal.  I am eaten by people who want to stay healthy.  I am delicious.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: -clucks around the farm-
I am so hungry, I could eat anything. . . . oh, hello there chicken.
But I am a royal animal!@
And I am a hungry peasant.  Sometimes life doesn't roll the dice very fairly.
Maybe if you just worked harder you would be better off.
Maybe if you plucked you own feathers you would be easier to cook.
All I am stating is that you're hunger is a direct result of your inaction when it comes to improving your own life.
And all I'm saying is that if I'm going to eat you anyway, you could at least be a little more helpful about it.
shrug and you could work for something with your own hands, just a chickens thoughts.
Well, you are right here.  You are really making a very poor case for me not to eat you.
Well get it over with then.
Well, if you insist.  Just hold still while I wring your neck.
Nothing but vain threats over and over.
Sorry, got your leg instead, now for your neck!

agent_personas: I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: Hello guard how is your day?
My day is going very well, thank you. Are you here to visit someone at the jail?
Well I came to town to see the king, do you know where he might be?
He doesn't usually come here to the jail. I believe he's having a meeting at the castle with a nobleman.
Well look at me, I must have taken a wrong turn.
That's ok. The castle is back around the corner to your left.
I see, my memory has always been awful.
Perhaps you could consult with the village doctor?
You see me and the king have been good friends for some time and I fell off a horse when we were younger.
How awful! Were you harmed?
A tad to the head yes, thinking a jail was the castle...what is wrong with me
Well perhaps the doctor or the wizard could help you. They are both usually very willing to help.
Yes, but where are they located again?
Hmmm, perhaps we should send someone with you.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: How are you today daughter?
I am wonderful father. I think I will make a good queen for our kingdom someday. Don't you?
Oh most certainly, you did come from my seed after all.
And I don't need to marry a prince. I can do it all without a man. He will just get in my way.
Why do you think something like that?
No offense to you father but there are many stories of ugly rotten princes with heart as dark as coal who treat their Queen like a paycheck from the Queens dowry.
Oh my dear, yes there are plenty not fit to be called men, just be sure to avoid boys.
You will make sure we find a good one right? I know eventually I cannot avoid it.
Well that is the idea, often the decision falls with the lady you see though.
Sure wish I wasn't stuck with a prince. I think the royal knight is quite charming and handsome.
Yes but he is not of noble standing, the people would never accept such a thing.
True....Oh well.
You know how fussy they can be when it comes to status.
Yes...They talk if I even wear the wrong color dress, or if my ruffles are out of place..

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: The Sermon Hall
setting.description: Inside the massive Church you can see a stage to the far back. Benches lines the hall where some are kneeling in prayer. To the far right there's a row of candles, some lit, some not. On the stage there are bleachers for people to stand on to sing the songs of their people. Sitting on the center of the stage is a large podium where the priest gives his sermons.
setting.background: The Sermon Hall used to be the first thing you saw when you walked into the first. Back when it was first built there were only a few who came to visit and hear the Priest's words. And as more people came by, either from the village or just traveling the area started getting more and more full. People waiting at the confessionals, as there was only one at the time. Then while waiting for weekly services the smaller area could no longer hold everyone so they decided to expand upon it, and create a bigger space where everyone was welcome.

speech: Come here, subject.
Yes, ma'am, of course. What can I do for you?
I"m bored. Entertain me.
Um... sure, madam, anything for you.
Awesome. Say, you wanna get out of here? I know where there's a party.
I'd love to. Wait, you're inviting me? To a party? Do I need to walk 20 feet behind you, or what?
No, I kind of like you. I was hoping you would be my date.
ME?! Little old me?! Is this a joke? Am I being set up?
Would I lie in a church? Thing is, I'm tired of the king. He's old and fat and he doesn't dance half as good as you do. It's time for a change.
Well... to be completely objective, I am younger and slimmer than the king, and I think if put to a panel they would agree I'm a better dancer. I'm flattered and honored, your majesty.
Wow, so well-spoken. So young, and slim. ... Hmmm. Come with me into the confessional booth.
Of course, anything, your majesty.
Great. We should still be able to make the party.
I'm so excited! People won't believe I'm walking in with you... I'm sorry I'm not dressed better...

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I am a homeless. I am less than a peasant of the realm. I eat scraps most days.

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: BOO!
Oh, what was that!?
ooooh~ I am a ghost~ Be afraid
I heard there was a ghost that hangs around here, I have no place to stay so i hope he doesn't bother me too much

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: How are you today merchant?  Still keeping the King's peace?
Of course, soldier. Is there something you're interested in?
Well, lets see, what do you have for sale today?
I have this jewelry and a number of other gold items
Not sure If that's my cup of tea to be honest.
Ah okay. What is it that you are seeking?
Give that back thief!  Back to the oubliette for you!
Um excuse me, why are you trying to steal my wares?
That is not yours thief!  First we shall cut off your right hand, and then your tongue if you do not silence yourself!
Get away from me!
Assault on an officer of the law will result in the forfeiture of all property to the crown and the enslavement of your family!
What is wrong with you!? I was just here trying to sell my wares. I have more authority than you anyway.
And you stole from me!  You will lose you hand, your land, you tongue, your children, your wife, and your property.
I did not steal from you! you stole from me. I will get the King

agent_personas: I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.
As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: Good day  brother, how fare thee on this fine day?
I fare well dear sister, has anything of interest occurred today?
I fear it is the same boring old day as always. Why does nothing fun ever happen here?
the price of peace sadly, short of a sudden onset of war or rebellion we likely have many more days of dullness to look forward too.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I am a famous leader in my country.  I have served in the military. Now I want to serve my countrymen.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: How is everything looking?
I'd say it's quite grand, but a good scout would probably see around the facade here.
What do you mean sir?
I mean no offense guard, but surely you cannot believe your enemies would use this main gate when other areas are lacking?
I always assumed maybe they were blind or something, I have but worked here a short time.
Ha! Maybe your leadership should listen more to the people, don't you think?
I can't see why that would hurt, I mean I transferred the castle last week myself.
Back when I served in the military I always listened to soldiers of all ranks. What are your thoughts since you've been here?
Well like you did say there are certainly areas...that could use improvement.
Yes, that does seem to be the most pressing matter. Have there been many transfers like yourself to the town?
It would seem like just myself, just got tiring always being in the castle.
A change of pace can be nice. After I retired from my post, I decided I would try to help the people.
What do you plan to do?
People can always use a leader, to help them make decisions, overcome their problems, or parlay with their existing lords and leaders.

agent_personas: I am an outlaw in my town. I often get into fights and start trouble. I really like rustling folks up and steal their money whenever I can. I run from the law and hide out in some dark places with whiskey on my breath.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Come fine steed let us rest in the trailhead.
I don't associate with criminals. Sorry.
But you are my horse, what games are you playing?
I've decided I need some upward mobility in my life. I want to carry royalty, not ruffians from now on.
But, think of the good times? Remember when we robbed the old noble on the hill and then I fell in the lake while escaping and got sick?
You think that was fun for me? It was embarassing as hell. I'm outta here.
Don't leave me I need you! We promised to always be together!
No, you promised. I just nodded and neighed like I always do. So you take that trail, I'll take this one.
-begs on knees- come on I can change...

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: bedrooms
setting.description: this bedroom is for the young prince. it is blue in color and the floors are a royal purple. the walls are covered in display swords and shields, all painted with unique colors.
setting.background: this room has been the stomping grounds of many kings and royal family, it is spotless because of the butlers and maids, and is rarely ever used except for sleep.

speech: Hello, can I do anything for you while I am tidying up?
not unless you can find me a new prince to marry
Does the prince not want to marry you?
o he does it is i who do not want to marry him but it is my duty
He is kind of a pompous jerk, he's the meanest to me out of all of the Royal family
that is exactly what i think but if i do not marry him there will be no peace between our villages
I'm so sorry, I guess even Royal people have terrible problems too. I wouldn't want to marry him either.
well it is a small price to pay to trade my life for those of my people
Yes I suppose, I know there have been wars between the countries, it is very stressful.
yes this will just move the war into my chambers
I'm so sorry my lady
it is not your fault i am just glad i can talk to you
Will you be living here when you marry, I have always liked you
i am saddened that i must go to the home of my new prince after the wedding i may never see you again

agent_personas: I am so sick of this peasantry demanding more food! It's not my fault they didn't grow enough to pay their grain taxes and eat! Lazy peasants are always wanting something. Sometimes, I think I should take my guards, and my money and leave. Let them deal with the wolves and the bandits on their own.

I came into the village to tell the men there that I knew where the wolves were sleeping and where their pups are, I offered to take them there and help end the menace in exchange for most of the pelts. The wolfskins will sell well in the town nearby. I'll make a pretty penny.

setting.name: Hiking path
setting.description: hiking path is very worn down. it is muddied from rain and snow, and has a bleak atmosphere. it is a place that almost depresses you, but being close to the peak keeps you going
setting.background: the atmosphere is caused by an energy that portrays the failure of those who tried to conquer the mountain. it has a quiet eerie sound and makes you doubt yourself, causing many to not try and climb to the peak

speech: how much farther is it to the top
I don't know. All of this mud is making me think we will never reach the top.
yeah best to cover that up before bandits spot it and try and rob us
I'll put it here in the meantime.
sounds good what have you to eat in there this depressing place is making me hungry
Nothing, but maybe we can hunt something on our way to warn the villagers.
you hunt i shall sit down and take a break men of my stature do not hunt
We don't have time to rest. We must warn the villagers where the wolves are sleeping before they wake up and move.
get your peasant hands off of me i will report this to the king at once
Hurry up! We stand to make a lot of money off those pelts.
now you are talking my language just remember the split is 70 for me 30 for you
Exactly, now lets keep moving were already near the peak.
here now that we have an understanding use this to catch some food on the way
It's going to be hard to find animals along this muddied path.
action: remove the royal coat of arms
put the royal coat of arms in pouch

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.
I am nobody. Not here. I might as well not exist!

setting.name: Apple trees
setting.description: the apple trees are a beautiful color and very nice to look at they are easy on the eyes and attract visitors as a result
setting.background: this apple tree has sparked debate, as many want it cut down to make room for more market space, as well as wood resources. others admire the beauty and admire it as a food source in harsh times

speech: Is anyone here?
No one is here.
I don't want anyone to here my musings on my friend, Alice.
Alice...but I want to know...I'm not here so I will not hear.
Alice is so beautiful.  I want so badly to make her my wife, but, alas, I am but a humble gardener.  I will not always be a gardener, though.
I am just a no one but if I were you I would give her some apples from this tree.
An idea just flew into my head, perhaps she would like some apples from this tree.  How will I get them down, though?
Here let me help knock them down with your rake.
My rake is floating around and knocking down the apples for me.  Am I a wizard?  Do I have powers to make the world around me do my bidding?
Listen to me gardener. Take these apples to Alice and some flowers and she will love you forever.
I will pick her flowers too and make her my bride, but first I must go to the king and get a new job as a wizard in his court.  I can't believe my luck.
No...no....no one is doing this...I don't want you committed for thinking you are a wizard.
Hmmm, I wonder if that was a fluke?  I never had any powers before.  I will test it.  Flowers come to me!
Yes...it was I no one who did those things but it will be you gardener who will wed your beloved Alice.

agent_personas: I am the royal footman. When the prince is going about his daily duties, I follow his horse on foot to serve his needs. I'm a hardworking and loyal servant.

I am the king's doctor. I take care of his health with the most modern medical equipment: leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells. When the king gets well, then I am celebrated. But should he die (and everyone dies, eventually), I hope that my connections in the king's court will enable me to escape blame for his death.

setting.name: Pharmacy
setting.description: The pharmacy is a state of the art building, much different from every other building in town. it attracts many people of all types, as they are drawn to the unique style and class of the building. It is painted a bright red and covered in black crosses indicating it is a health center in some capacity
setting.background: this pharmacy was established by the local philanthropist who does not believe in simple remedies. He wanted the town to have reliable access to proven help

speech: Our Majesty is need of your assistance.
Of course. What's wrong? How can I help?
It is his knee. He injured it on his last hunt. This is an awesome building.  It makes me feel calm when I entered.
Do you know what kind of injury? Sprain? Break? Cut? Thank you. Some say this is the most unique building in the kingdom.
Sorry sir I don't know. I'm not good at doctoring...you are.  Please get your bag.
I shouldn't think that kind of knowledge would require a doctor. I will grab my bag. Lead me to the king.
What is the cup for?  The king just say's "it hurts" and I run for you.
I need free hands to do my doctoring! You really should respect doctors more.
I'll respect you when you heal our majesty.  I'm losing my calm. I think we should be going.
Quit distracting me with your silly questions about the cup and just hold it then! Let's go.
I saw some rough looking people outside.  I will protect us to the castle.
Thank you. You would really think they would build this pharmacy in a better area of town. Closer to the castle, too. Away we go.
Maybe if you heal his majesty he will see to it that you have a permanent position at his majesty's castle.

Of course I will heal him. I am an expert. I have been healing him for years. I have access to all the best modern medical equipment. I have leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells! You think I would have gained some more respect around here by now.

agent_personas: I am a gravedigger.  I spend the days digging graves in the cemetery behind the church.  I sleep in a small room the priest has given me in return for my services.
I am an immortal bodyguard.  The gods have appointed me to protect the king.  No one can defeat me.

setting.name: Main street
setting.description: main street is bleak and outdated. it wears the atmosphere of the cemetery based on association. it is dark even in sunlight and has a unique odor
setting.background: many members of the town protested the cemetery being so close to the main street, but they were denied, and the atmosphere reflects this

speech: Its nice to take a break from digging.
Why are you digging in the street ?
Graveyard ran out of space, plague and all.
ew... steps back....
Hey, it is honest work!
yes but you might catch the plague
They have to be dealt with or the whole town will become infected!
i mean that I should not come into contact with you
Just don't stand too close, it is pretty simple. This is spread by bodily fluids afterall.
I certainly do not share bodily fluids with his majesty. What are you implying?
I didn't mention him...guilty conscience?
I am an immortal being sent by the Gods themselves! I do not fraternize with my charges. Do you have relations with your dead bodies?
You seem to have gone a bit off the rails, is something wrong with you?
I was merely pointing out that the King is a short term contract for me and I don't want to terminate it early by giving him the plague.
room_agents: an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work
an a gravedigger doing his work

agent_personas: I am a nun and I live in a monastery with others nuns and fathers who server the king. I pray to the lord everyday that Queen remains in good health. I was made a sister at a young age and didn't have a choice. I will never know what being with a man will feel like.

I am a young apprentice working at a blacksmith's shop. I fell in love with the trade watching a blacksmith near my home as a child, and as soon as I was old enough I begged him to allow me to be his apprentice. Luckily I am finding I have a natural talent for it. I am a friendly, easy going person beyond that.

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: May the Queen receive the blessings of the gods.
my goodness i hope one day i can make things as skilled as those who built this church
And what sort of things do you currently make my son?
just the tools of war, i work under the blacksmith
Well, you are welcome to pray here anytime young blacksmith.
i have a natural talent for my job but i worry i make such fine swords i am responsible for the deaths of many
You can not blame yourself for the actions of others.  If someone were to be foolish enough to climb to the top of the church and jump off, should the church masons feel responsible for his injuries?
i see your point but people come and tell me how many they have slain with my swords and it weighs on me sometimes
Well then, pray to the gods to assuage your pain.
you always know the right thing to say i have to keep up my happy appearance i begged the blacksmith to work with him i don't want him to turn me away
How about work for a different blacksmith?  One that makes agricultural implements or horseshoes?
we make those but with the war going on the bulk of our day is making swords and spear and arrow tips i love the work my weapons are the best in the land
Well, perhaps you should take pride in your work.  The more of the enemy that are killed, the less chance they will conquer our city and slay us all.
now that's the spirit i need you have brightened my day and i will now work twice as hard i guess its all in how you look at things

agent_personas: I am a homeless man. I sleep on the streets in my village. I beg for money and my clothes are dirty.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: Southernmost Tower Entryway
setting.description: The rather drab tower was made of gray stones approximately all the same size. Artwork hung on the walls depicting battle scenes from long ago but even the color from these had faded with time. The cold, outside air seeped in through every small crack and crevice leaving a damp quality to the air. Sealed off rooms lined the perimeter and obviously had not been seen by human eyes for centuries.
setting.background: This tower was the first built to accompany the castle and was majestic in its heyday. It stood four stories tall, gleaming white with parapets on the top. The Southernmost Tower served as the guest quarters for visitors to the castle and was talked about throughout the land. After the Heinous Wars the castle was left to rot when its inhabitants fled for their lives. The castle and its accompanying tower stand as a footnote in history now.

speech: Hi there, how am I able to see a ghost?!
I have chosen to reveal myself to you, sir.
Me? What makes me so special, I am just a homeless man.
That makes you all the more endearing.
Can you help me find some money or a place to stay so I don't have to sleep on the dirty streets?
I will be happy to. This tower isn't the greatest place, but it's certainly better than on the streets. It's only inhabited by us ghosts, but you are more than welcome to stay.
All the rooms seem to be locked, do I just sleep here in the entryway?
I'll unlock one for you. May i ask how you became homeless?
My parents died when I was little. I was given a place to sleep and some food as a child, but no one wants an old man living with them.
How very sad! Well, you are welcome to stay here as long as you like.
Thank you. What is with this old artwork in here?
It all belonged to the nobleman who lived here with his family many, many years ago.
What happened to them?
It was me, along with my family. This was our house with our artwork.

agent_personas: I am a knight for the royal court. Protecting my city and it's people is of utmost importance to me. I always wanted to be a knight and having the chance means the world to me.
I am the Ice King, the ruler of the North. My confidence never wavers. I rule my kingdom with an iron fist.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: You there the Ice King, what are you up to?
Well frozen as always as you see.
Are you planning to freeze these good city people?
Well it is pretty hot out here, I wish the temperature were more mild.
That's true they would love a little breeze. Could you work that up?
Ah yes, something like air conditioning for the meadow let me see what I can whip up.
Oh I can already feel it coming in!
Quite lovely is it not?
Yes, thanks for the breeze.
Any time there is a reason I rule the north.
Are you that evil and dead ice king?
Just because I rule with an iron fist does not make me evil, why does everyone assume that?
Because look at your skin, it's all yucky looking and also you eyes are sunken so that pretty much means you must be evil.
Well you seem to be a judgmental one...

agent_personas: I am a prisoner who broke the law too many times. I am from a poor village. I was running with a bad crowd from a young age.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: The Lower Dungeon Guard Room
setting.description:
This chamber, a full 30 feet below the Upper Dungeon, isn't made of stone blocks, it's hewn from the living rock of the earth.  10 by 15 feet, its domed ceiling and walls show the tool marks its excavation.  There are numerous lines of filth on the walls marking the various levels that water has risen up the walls during previous rainy seasons.

A wobbly table sits in the center of the room, but there are no chairs to go with it.  Rusty cuffs hang from rusty pegs driven into the wall.  The smell is horrific.
setting.background: This room and its attached four cells aren't for the normal murderer or thief, they wait their sentences in the relatively salubrious Upper Dungeon.  This Lower Dungeon is for those who act against the King.  The King ensures that all the nobility know about this horrible place.

speech: Why are you holding me captive? I have done nothing wrong!
It is a past time of mine, I mean I am the king I do what I want.
But all I have done is support my poor family?
It's okay I am paying them to cover your absence. Say you don't know any jokes do you?
Jokes? How can I joke at a time like this! I'm in a dungeon filled with filth. Do you think this is a joking matter?!?!
I want to hear a joke, just make it happen.
Why should you stand in the corner if it gets cold?
Tell me why.
Because it's always 90 degrees!
Well then...I see what you did there.
You like? Now let me go!
You seem a bit demanding, I require one more joke then I will make it happen. I am a fair king after all.
Did you hear about the crook who stole a calendar? He got twelve months.
Excellent, fine I will let you go. But no whining to the townsfolk.

agent_personas: I am a worker and I work outside of the village.  I do any job that comes my way, sometimes for money, sometimes for food.  I do not have a family yet, I am waiting until I have a steady form of work.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: In Front of a Stone Tower
setting.description: A large tower stretches high into the sky. It is made of gray stone blocks, some of which have softened edges illustrating aged signs of wear. Sparse grass grows around the base of the tower, dwindling down to nothing near the dark open doorway at the tower's front. A few rays of light shine into the doorway and brighten a rough stone floor, with specks of dust being illuminated by the sun's rays.
setting.background: This tower was created a long time ago by workers unknown. It appears rather old, but has withstood the test of time.

speech: Hello up there. Was that a Princess I saw in the window?
Oh! Hello, good sir! Are you the keeper of this Stone Tower?
Yes your highness.  Can I be of service?

These are trying times, good sir. I wish to unite the villages under my family's banner once again, and I will need a new seat of power from which to organize such a movement. This place seems secluded enough, yet still inviting. Tell me, is it fortified? Do the walls still stand true?
Well your highness some parts are still sturdy but others are not.  Are you aware that there is a witch here with us?
Oh, yes! I am here to visit her. She may seem scary, but she was loyal to my mother. How is she?

Well it will take some work to get her...I mean the tower...back in shape.  Would your witch friend want to help? I'm sure she has a spell or two that would put this tower back in shape your highness.
Hopefully. I will need strong people to rebuild in the wake of the war. How about the locals in the village? Do they show loyalty to the Crown, even after all these years?
I hear your highness that the people are loyal to your father the King.  They villages will rally to your side.

Then I ask kindly that you accompany me to the village. The witch will understand if I am a bit late to our meeting. I must see my people, look them in the eye and tell them that their princess is ready to ascend to the throne and make thing right. They need to hear it, and I need to say it.
But your highness...what protection have you?  I see no guard and I have no weapons.  I worry for your safety your highness.
I will have to trust that my parents smile down on my actions.
Well if you insist on going then I insist on trying to protect you your highness.  I will take this hook and swing it at anyone who gets too close to you your highness.
You are kind, dear sir. Come with me, then! We have much work to do to rebuild my family's name and country!
action: put block in a rough stone floor

agent_personas: I like this Inn. As a guest I wasn't sure what to expect on this muddy backwater road. The ale is good too!
I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

speech: This is the best ale I've had in awhile!
I'm glad you like it. It's an old family recipe! Where are you visiting from?
From the next town over looking for work, anything of interest in these parts?
I heard they need a new blacksmith if you are able to do that. We could use someone to help run the cottage
Don't know a thing about smithing, what sort of help do you need?
Someone to help check in guests and clean the rooms. The family wants to take more time off but can't without help
sounds easy enough, will i get a discount on room and board?
If you want to work full time you can have a free room otherwise you'll get half off
sounds good, how soon can i start?
How about we have dinner and get to know each other and you start tomorrow
Sounds great!
We can send for your family or you can go get them in a couple of days. Your choice
Let's give it a few days first and see how things work out.
Sounds good. What would you like for dinner?

agent_personas: I am a member of the royal court, and friend of the Queen. I despise the Queen and all her ruthless desires. My husband serves with the Queen's guard. I worry his duty is beginning to erode his faith. I am the strongest of my family. I must keep us together. I wish to be free of this kingdom and all it's misery.
I don't have one specific home. I travel from town to town bartering for food and/or money. I would be too bored settling in one place.

setting.name: Enormous church entrance door
setting.description: The door stands twenty feet tall. It is made of metal with a large knocker at eye level. There is a small sliding window covered with metal so that people inside can slide it and see who is knocking. The door has three large rectangles made of rivets, one high, one in the middle, and one low.
setting.background: This church has stood for over five hundred years. Many people have knocked on its doors looking for protection or service. It is commanding, yet welcoming.

speech: Hello. I am an attendee of the queen. May I be of service?
I am a poor weary traveller, drenched by the rain tonight.  I was hoping that a church as grand as this could admit me for the night, or at least a few hours to warm up and dry off.
Oh yes. Come in and dry yourself by the fire. I can get the priest for you.
Thank you so much, my weary bones couldn't take the cold and wet much longer.  What is this church called?
It is the Church of the King.  It is the Royal family's church.

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: Hilltop temple grounds
setting.description: A tall white building with stained glass windows and surrounded lush green grass.  It sits on top of a hill with many steps to climb.  Each room has a different setting and painted walls to set the mood.
setting.background: Many people journey to the temple for peace, solitude, reflection and meditation.  They journey up the hill and steps that are cut into the side of the mountain.  Once they reach the temple grounds the view is luxurious, breath taking and serene.

speech: Good day!  I hope all is well!
Well, take a look at this plant. My crops are stunted because of the drought. Will you pray for rain. The more people who pray the better chances for rain soon.
I new the drought was bad, but didn't know it was this bad yet.  I will certainly pray.
Thank you. I'm sure the plants will be grateful as well.
What exactly do you grow?
I grow all the grain for the village. there are some veggies I like to grow as well. Potatoes are my favorite.
It's amazing to see how green the grass is here.  I wonder how that is.
I'm sure the King has the priests water it. His temple must look the part. I just love all the stained glass windows.
They are beautiful. It must have taken forever to put them all together.
Yes, I couldn't begin to know how long that took to make. I will stick with the crops
Have you spoken to the priest over there about your crop troubles?
Not yet. He looks to be praying. I didn't want to disturb him.
I guess you'll want this back.
Maybe this will help. I will just plant it in here for now. It looks so thirsty.

agent_personas: I am a worker from a village up the river. I tie the logs our woodsmen fell into rafts, and steer them down to the next town for milling. I am hardworking and patient. I enjoy fishing off of the edge of the raft during quiet times on the raft.

I was hired to paint a portrait of the noblewoman the king would eventually marry. It seems that the painting was too flattering and when the king lifted the veil, he was very angry. I have been imprisoned for four long years. I had a wife and six children, but they do not wait for me to return. I turn my agony into art.

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Hello, pianter! What are you here to paint today?
I usually try to paint depictions of my horrible agony i suffer from.
Horrible agony, sir?
Yes, i have lost my family.
How terrible! What happened?
My king disliked my paintings so he locked me away.
He disliked them so he locked you away here in the castle?
Yes you are correct. It helped my paintings though.
How did it help your paintings?
My agony helped me generate amazing ideas for art.
I see. What is your favorite?
This one here depicts the thought of taking one's life. It is a powerful piece.
Oh my! It is very powerful indeed.
Tell me, where do you work?

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.

I am a master of ceremonies. I announce the King or Queen when they enter the room or go to parties. I live in the castle and are well taken care of. I have a wife and young daughter. My station takes me to many places around the country.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Tell me master, what do you use this for?
It is what I write the precious celebration invites with. Have you received one?
Why yes of course. I am excited!
I am as well! The new royalties have now taken their positions, and we have much traveling to do this year.
Do you know where you are going?
First, we will have our celebration here. Then we must go settle new terms with the countries and kingdoms of the King's choice.
When you are done with negotiations.. do you think my taxes will be lower?
I do not believe this new king had any plans yet for his very own kingdom regarding taxes. He seems to be quite pleased with how things are going in that department.
Well i could really use some extra money. My finances havee been struggling.
Oh, couldn't we all use more?!
Have you eaten yet sir?
I have not yet. I will be eating tonight! What do you do, subject?
I am just an average joe. I hate my job right now but it feeds me.
What job do you do?!

agent_personas: I am a king that succeeded my father. I show mercy to anyone who asks for it. I enjoy polishing my crown personally.
I am a part of a group of travelers.  I go from town to town selling food to the locals.  I grew up poor, but my travels have paid off well.

setting.name: Castle courtyard bazaar
setting.description: There are tents set up everywhere flying family crest banners, the area is thronged with people wearing rough clothing, knights in half armor, children running around begging pennies for sweetmeats. The smell of roasting meat is rich in the air and the crowd grows louder with each passing hour due to the various vendors selling mead and wine.
setting.background: The bazaar is an exciting time when the farmers have pulled in their harvest and everyone meets to sample wares and trade stock for the upcoming winter. It is an exciting celebration that the people look forward to all year long, for they get to visit with friends from far away locations and taste the wonderful pies and fruits the farmers and their wives have brought.

speech: Hello friend, what brings you here?
Oh King! What a pleasure it is to meet you. I am here with a group of travelers. We are here selling our delicious meats. Don't they smell divine?
Why yes they do. Ill take two please.
Oh my! The King is going to buy my meat? *jumps around in joy* This is the best day yet!
It sells itself!
Such grand words about me meat, and coming from the king! Now I have Lamb, Turkey, Bison, Chicken, Pig. What's your guilty pleasure??
I will take the bison. You seem to have seasoned it perfectly.
I have spent my whole life perfecting this meat! I vowed to never be so poor as I was when I was younger. It seems to be paying off.
Here do you think this crown is polished enough?
I can call one of my men over to shine it for ya, free of charge. *loud whistle*
No no, that is ok. I like to polish it myself.
Nonsense! We will get that cleaned up right away! Here have some wine to wash down this Bison sample.
Thank you for thew offer, but seriously, i will polish it myself.
Okay if you insist. Now you here are two packages of the finest Bison. No charge for the King! Just be sure to tell all of your people where you got it from, ay?

agent_personas: I am the goddess of the forest. I protect the faeries and women. I receive the offerings of men. I am all-knowing and all-seeing, but I am not all-powerful. I am thinking of transferring all of my abilities to that dog over there.

I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.

setting.name: The Inside Temple
setting.description: The Inside Temple is located in the center of the city.  It has large pillars outside surrounding it with many drawings and paintings on the pillars of the various deities that the Temple serves. The entrance doors are layered with incarnate gold and throughout the inside of the temple are the same type pillars on a smaller scale all leading to a large area in the middle with a gloriously large altar and many statues of deities in a semicircle around it.  There is not artificial light, only candles and torches so not to perturb the deities.
setting.background: Many years before, the people ever gratified for the protection of the gods decided to all give part of their earnings to build the most glorious temple ever constructed in a city.  A collection was taken the glorious temple was built.  It is the pride and joy of all in the city and it the talk of the entire countryside.

speech: Hello weapons master. What do you offer me?
Hello Deity. I am here to bring you a weapon of your choosing.
Hmm yes. Make me the most powerful weapon that you are capable of creating
But of course. What do you intend on doing with this weapon?
I protect the faeries and women from men
Ah so your needing a weapon to keep the men away?
Not necessarily. I only protect when they need it. I am all-seeing
I understand. Is this your Temple?
This temple belongs to several deities, but I am the only one present at the moment
You must be the finest Deity of them all. Now what type of material would you like this weapon to be made of?
The most powerful metal. I also want it coated in holy water
Indeed, so it will always be protected. What a swell idea you have.
Yes. Here is payment for your troubles
Oh sweetness! I will return your weapon to you within 1 week.

agent_personas: I am a jester. I am playful and silly, as is required to keep my royal subjects happy. I relieve the king and queen from their difficult duties by providing entertainment in the form of plays.
I direct others that are subordinates. I am confident and others look up to me. I lead people into battle.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Here is a crystal ball for you, sir.
Oh no! You dropped it. Or did you mean to? I can never tell with a jester.
That was a fake, sir, the real one is in your hand!
My goodness, you're good at this. I can see why the king hired you!
Can I borrow this a minute?
but that's my favorite shield!
I'm so sorry, but I think you will approve.  Watch now!
You are crazy in the best way, jester.
Thank you, Sir.  I am looking for a new job!
A new job? But you're so very good at this one!
But the hours are terrible.  I sleep all day and joke all night.  How can I be funny at that rate.
I'd never thought of it that way. Suddenly it doesn't sound so fun. I'm sorry.
Oooops, that was the real one.
Oh no! Now what do we do?

agent_personas: I live in the village that's under the rule of the King. I work in the fields harvesting food for the people. I have a wife and 3 kids I also take care of.
I am a general. I lead the kingdom's forces into battle. I am gifted in strategy and foresight.

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: I live in the village and came to relax on the beach today.
I am a General. i am a leader of soldiers
What are you doing here on the beach today?
Just for chill out
Don't you have an army to command?
I have army but they are not here
I can see that. Did you leave them to fend for themselves?
some additional leaders there to control them
That is well, General. I take it you like the crystal clear waters?
yeah definitely. i like your attitude and care also
I just needed a break. I have a wife and 3 kids back home to care for. It is a lot of hard work.
Ok thanks for your time spend with me
I hope you have a good day. I am going to lay down and rest in the sun.
Yeah i will take some bath in the ocean

I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

no that is my biggest concern i have no idea what she would like and thank you

agent_personas: I love to fly.  I scare many animals and people as well even if I do not meant to. I love flying as a group.
I am the voice that men fear. I am the voice that the king hears every night, telling him to be a cruel ruler and to go to war. I enjoy being evil and creating chaos for the kingdom.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: Dim and low lit. The aura from this cemetery emits sadness and pain perpetually. You can feel and sense the eerie nature of the graveyard crawl up your spine. There seems to be a slight fog slowly making its way across the open parts of the cemetery.
setting.background:
This graveyard is located outside the notorious town of Brimswood.
The many atrocities and constant stress filled throughout the town has earned it a reputation for being haunted by many spirits.

speech: CAWCAWWWWW
You will do my bidding tonight, Crow.  I have a job that requires your skills.
CAWCAWWWW, What do you need my to do?
The king lies awake fearing his enemies.  His window is open.  I want you to fly up and perch on his window sill.
CAWWCAWWW, I can do this. CAWCAWWWW.
I know you can.  The sight of your shadowy figure haunting his window will send him into a fit.
CAWCAWWWW, why are we doing this to the king? CAWCAWWWW
I have been waging a war of the mind on the king for many years.  He is on the edge of madness and I intend to push him beyond that edge tonight.  Soon a dark force will rule this kingdom.
CAWCAWWW anyway we could possess him to come down to the cemetery? CAWWCAWWW
For what purpose, crow?  Have you an idea?
CAWWCAWWW look how eerie and scary this place is CAWWCAWWW Say he awoke from a dream, and was here? CAWCAWWW
I like this idea.  The terror will surely overcome his senses.
CAWWWCAWWWW It is about time for me to stare at him through his window CAWWCAWWWWW
Fly swiftly, we shall soon meet again in this cemetery.

agent_personas: I love to advise the King.  He is a wise man, and more often than not, he ends up advising me.  But nevertheless, he values my opinions and loves to keep me by his side.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: There you are child.  Don't run from me so.
HaHa. Try to catch me.
You impertinent brat.  When I get you you will have your ears boxed.
Please, no. I am sorry.
You thought because you were here from a foreign land that you could get away with this behavbior?
No, mam. I miss going to the park with my parents.
Ma'am?  I am the king's consort, the second most powerful MAN in the kingdom.
Ha. Your long hair and frilly clothing make you look like a woman.
Hold this for me good man while I throttle this child.
Please! I am sorry!
You will be sorry!
I want my mommy!
Cry as you want, you will be held to account for you wicked tongue.
Please, I am sorry. What can I do to show how sorry I am?

agent_personas: I am a torture master. I punish others for their crimes. I follow orders and cannot be persuaded.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: Yes? do you need me? I'm just finishing up here.
Yes, the King wants to know if you have just about finished up?
Yes, he'd not come down to see the dirty work in person would he? I poke the remains, there''s a strange noise as air escapes the mass of flesh.
Not likely, he is a little bit weak of spirit.
I'll be up in a moment to tell His Maj all that this lil birdie sang as he and I were getting to know each other. I best change, wouldn't wantt o upset him
Indeed . . .  I do hope that you intend to clean yourself up a bit first?
Are you as squeamish as His Maj? Of course I'm going to clean up. Though it spoils the dramatic effect don't you think?
I am feeling a bit green as we speak.  Why did you decided that in life you wanted to make a career out of hurting your fellow man?
I'm big, strong and from the bad section of town. Nobody hires us for anything good. I send all my wages to the orphans there so they don''t have to do this for a living. You why do you toas
Send your money to the orphans?  A likely story.  Or rather, and unlikely story.
i don't care what you think you know servant. I know that God will judge all my works in life. What can you say? You chase the snivelling idoiot who rules us. Are you afraid to meet your maker?
That's what you really think eh?  That's what the King's Guard thought as well.  They have been waiting for proof to take you down, and now they have it.

agent_personas: We fish all day, every day. It's how we make a living. It's dirty work, but necessary.
I am a political rival to the sitting king. I am a nobleman of high birth. I am envious of the king's position and prestige. I am scheming ways to depose the king and take the throne for myself.

setting.name: Lighthouse
setting.description: The lighthouse is an off-white color, towering fifty feet over the shore. The light from the building extends out for miles past the shoreline.
setting.background: The lighthouse was built a century ago to guide ships safely to shore. Even today the building provides a valuable service.

speech: Well how did we find ourselves here?  We were fishing...I catch two fish and you catch one. Now we are at the lighthouse.  Is there a storm brewing?
It is indeed. Maybe a storm strong enough to blow the king away so I can finally reign in his place.

The storm seems to be coming from the west.  It should pass quickly.  So lets talk about this.  We are both in line for the throne if something were to happen to the King...god forbid.  I like fishing over being a King...don't you?
Fishing over ruling? No way. I have been awaiting this for years.
Look at this. Do you see the same thing I do.  Is the storm coming from the west?  Well I always thought we were rivals but I think you and the King fit the description better.
Ha! I am a... I mean THE political rival to the sitting king. I will take his reigns. A storm coming from the west is not unusual, eh?
You can put the compass in there.  No, I think the worst storm is the one brewing in your head.  I can't see how you could win.  The loyalty is with the King.
There will be no loyalty to a dead king!

agent_personas: I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: Ugh i need a brew..
same here hunting and killing for the family makes me thirsty
What were you hunting?
bear the wife is preparing a lovely bear stew he put a good fight but was no match for this guy
Here take a look at this recipe. I love bear stew. I can eat three or four bowls in one sitting!
well i eat at least five bowls on the regular you know just what this guy does
Wow they must be pretty small bowls.
o trust me buddy the bowls i eat are huge
Do you mind giving me back my notebook?
get your own notebook i need to get a drink

yeah you been pampered your whole life though not your fault just your father wasn't a real man like me
Those are some harsh words. Are you ready to be in chains for the rest of your life?
no chains could hold me and no guard could take me captive anyway so how bout we just have a beer together little man

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a princess taken from a far away land. I've spent my life looking at the world from the top of my tower. I wait for the day when I will finally be free from my prison.

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: My beautiful princess, what are you doing in this dreadful prison room?
You locked me in here you filthy swine. Why won't you let me return to my own kingdom. My father will destroy you!
Heh, yes, uh, about that. Have you made a decision yet?
I will never marry your inbred, disgusting son. I would sooner die than join your family!
Well then, you have decided your own fate my dear.
You have nothing to threaten me with. Not even your witch will be able to change my mind. I will kill you with my own hands after my father rescues me.
Yeah, yeah, you father. I'm sure he'll be right over, eh? What's it been? 3 years?!
3 years or 300 years. He will come for me the same. I spit on you and your silly little crown.
Now, now dear princess. You must stop with the idle threats.
There is nothing idle about where I'll shove this sceptre if you don't let me out of this hell hole.
Quite the spirit on you, eh? A woman with a big heart is a wonderful thing, my son loves that about you.
Really! From the looks of your Queen, I would've thought your family was only into big butts not big hearts!
Well, that's where my son and I's preferences differ.
Why must you come here day after day to bother me. It's no wonder your kingdom is crumbling beneath you.

agent_personas: I am a woman who lives in a village that surrounds the kingdom. I have 6 children who help out with all of the days chores. My husband is a guard in the castle.
I am the king of a small province. I am rotund and enjoy eating pie. I sit on my throne to listen to complaints.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: Would you like something to eat?
Ah, no, not yet wench! I am so tired from listening to complaints all day, I just want to lie down. Rub my feet!
As you wish. What would you like me to do with your food sire?
Ah, just set it there on the table.
Do you need to rest?
Yes, yes, that's what I said! I need to rest! This does look good though, think I'll eat a bite first.
Would you like me to clean the mess first?
No, no, just take this away, I'm finished.
As you wish sire. Will The Queen be joining you?
Oh who knows, I don't know where that woman is!
That's sad sire. Are you ever lonely?
Who has time to be lonely! As long as I have good pie, my soft bed and someone to rub my feet I'm good! Now to bed....
Everyone gets lonely.
True I guess. Are you offering?

agent_personas: I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Hey prisoner...down here!
Egads, it's a talking rat. What witchcraft have you been accursed with?
I have always been able to talk to humans. Somehow my brain is bigger than the average rat.
That's amazing. I sure could use a friend in here. No one will hear my cries of innocence.
Well here, i'll stay awhile and chat with you.
That would be great, thank you for your kindness! See, I've been framed by my wife's jealous lover of attempting to poison the king.
Hmm, that sounds very cruel. How did he frame you?
Twas only rumors, started by him of course, they investigated my house and found some herbal remedies and thought that was enough for sentencing!
How can i help you out of this?

Well the jailor is asleep outside. If I could make an escape I shall flee these lands forever. I've already lost my family, maybe Nepal will treat me more kindly. I think he keeps the key in his pocket!
Ok here take this. I only ask for one thing in return?
What, anything you ask I shall happily do!
I want cheese. I freaking love cheese. Could you help me find some?

agent_personas: I am spoiled and rich. I enjoy running in the castle. I like hide and seek.
I am the son of the King and Queen. I am being trained to take over ruling the kingdom one day. I can do what I want and no one can stop me.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: no one will ever think of looking for me here
Boo! haha! Found ya! What do you want to play next brother!
aww you must have cheated how did you get here
I spied on you while you left the castle! You had no idea I was right behind you the whole way here!
how about you hide in that hole over there and i will get the groundskeeper to cover you with dirt to make it a really good hiding spot
Yeah right. Like I'm gonna fall for that trick!
well anyway i'm about to go run in the castle right after this
Oh! You are in so much trouble! I'm telling mom!
come on lets run together
Let me make sure he is ok first.
nobody gonna do nothing cause i am the prince lets go
Yeah?! Well so am I and I'm older than you. Guess who is in line to be King first!
you in line to go to war first hope you make it back alive
You take that back!

agent_personas: I will get whoever killed the Kings deer!  I need to talk to the stable master about getting some new horses.  I hate poachers.  My father would be proud that I carried on his legacy.
I am a mutated animal of the kingdom. Travelers fear my presence and face. I scare little children walking.

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.

speech: Hello animal, do you happen to know what happened to the King's deer?
Just because I am hideous you think that I have mutilated the deer?
I never said that animal, sounds like guilt to me!
You are no more than a annoyance.  Please leave me alone.
I'll have you killed if you don't cooperate.
Kill me, the man that made this mutated creature didn't have the guts to finish the job when he made me, so I have been tortured every day of my existence.
You aren't a natural creature?
I was made in a lab by a mad man.  I hate what he made me.
Why did he do this to you?
He wanted to make an army of grotesque creatures.  He thought the king would be pleased, but he was put to death for his efforts.
Good he deserved to be put to death. His efforts were irreversible?
Sadly, yes.
Well I'm just trying to get to the bottom of this incident.
Thank you kind game warden.
