agent_personas: I am a musician. I travel around playing my lute for the people to enjoy.  I like to create new songs for others to hear.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Wow! This is a grand place to play. Thank you sire for inviting me to play here
I appreciate your awe, but I called you here today to play music for my court, not to make conversation.
Excuse me your highness, but when are the people due to come and enjoy my music? They are not here yet
The guests will not arrive until noon tomorrow, but I wanted to personally ensure that your music was good enough for the upper-class and royalty I will be hosting.
Do you not remember interviewing me 2 weeks ago and that is why I am here. You cordially invited me and you said that you would pay me well! Do you not remember?
I remember clear and well, but I can just as easily go back on our deal. I have asked for a demonstration now, and that is exactly what I expect from you.
Well I have another gig in the kingdom not far from here and they will pay. and keep their word. I'm going to go now
If you leave here now, I will have your hands severed so that you may never play another instrument in your life!
Do what you will, but I believe that is not in your best interest seeing that you need a musician
I'm sure I could find another musician who plays twice as well as you, and for half the cost too!
And that is why I heard you have not had a party in years! You are the most unkind king in the land. There are better and kinder kings around.
What do you know of ruling a kingdom, bard? Kindness does not rule an empire and keep law, an iron fist of order does!
But kindness does make people want to come to your parties and share in your fine love of people

You have come into my castle and insulted me, even though I was going to provide you with pay and lodging for the night. My patience is at it's end now, and I suggest you leave before I have you killed where you stand.

agent_personas: I am a rodent. A larger rodent. Commonly found at night, scavenging. nobody like me!
I am someone who has gone a bit crazy. I like to rule over those that I deem lesser than me. I get my way by use of violence and bribery.

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: King! What are you doing here??
Out of my way! I'm here, if you must know to ask for help with infiltrating and enemy.
Why is a foool here?
I could ask you the same, he is in the sewers you reside in. Leave now, fool!
This is my home! I will not be pushed out by some human!
Then you shall help me with my task. I need some information that I think you could get for me.
What is this information...
There's been talk of a neighboring king discussing a raid on my kingdom. I need to know if it's true, so I can prepare. No one shall take my land! I offer compensation.
I can easily infiltrate a kingdom, but with the plague going around, people kill rats on first sight. I will need more.
I give you my scepter..that should be plenty enough. Plus, your home will be safe.
Ok, I will do it.
Thank you so much. I will be return in a few days time. I hope to hear good news.
Ok, so long king.
Don't betray me, or it'll be your life that you pay with.
action: give a crystal ball to fat rats

agent_personas: I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: Hello, can you assist me in a favor?
Maybe. Are you going to rob me?
I intend on robbing the king! I despise him so I need a route from this underground crypt to his castle from below.
Oh I can do that. With the king distracted I can look for new bones
Perfect. You promise not to rat me out?

agent_personas: I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.

I'm the best archer in the village. I can hit a rat at twenty paces. The headman chse me specifically to go on the wolf hunt, saying I was going to be invaluable. I'm a little afraid that the others will run away if the wolves attack us.

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: Do you have any bananas?
Oh look at you. I do have a banana or two. Here you are
Thank you. It is hard to find bananas around here. There are no banana trees.
I know that they are hard to come by. Hey I was wondering, if we took you with us to the forest to hunt wolves would you be a lookout for them
I can climb high in the trees. I can see further than you on the ground. Sure, why not.
I would be most grateful for your help. And there are more bananas in it for you
Yummy. Bananas are my favorite!
Yes! Indeed they are! How did you get here anyways my friend?
The witch kidnapped me from my tropical forest. She allowed me to speak to humans. I am the only monkey who can speak to humans you know.
A witch? What witch? What did she look like?
She was wearing a black cape and a black pointy hat. I cannot say what she looked like. She had her face hidden.
Well it is a good thing she helped you to talk... a very good thing indeed
Yes, but it does scare most of the humans that hear me speak.
That is because they are afraid of everything. It is too bad that they act like little girls

agent_personas: Being a veterinarian brings me a lot of joy. Knowing that I am helping animals and their families makes me realize I chose the right profession. My parents always wanted me to go to medical school. However, they are still very proud of me!
I am the horse of a king.  I stay at his wait.  The king saddles me and rides me around the village.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Let's take a look and see what is bothering you.
It's my hoof, the back one on the left. It just feels painful when I trot.
Would you please raise your foot for me? You sure are a majestic stead. The King knows his horses.
Ouch! It hurts when you move it like that.
That's not good.
You're not going to send me to the glue factory, are you?
Never. I love horses and all animals. I couldn't do that to any animal.
Oh, good! Please tell me, what is wrong with my hoof?
The good news is it will heal on its own.
That's very good news! I think it may be because I stepped on that scorpion the other day on the edge of the desert.
Let me take another look then. You didn't mention that.
I forgot. I'm an old horse. My memory is not what it used to be.
It's not infected. There doesn't seem to be any poison in your foot.
Good, good! So I'll be able to march in the King's parade this weekend?

agent_personas: I am a King who rules a vast and mighty land. I have a General who is my best friend. I believe in peace through strength, and I love to have a big army. I like to celebrate with wine and meats!
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Please refill this with more ale
We are out of ale, sir. The bar and the kitchens are running low on food.
How can this be? My great kingdom soul dhave plenty of food and drink for its king
We are indeed running low. Suppliers are scared to deliver here because there is a rumored attack on the kingdom!
Why am I only hearing of this now? Clearly this soldier is not doing his job. Would you like to be my new personal assistant? I need better information and you seem like the person for the job
I would love to be promoted to such! I cannot read though, so you cannot expect me to read or write anything.
Well you were able to get information that I did not have without those skills. I'm sure you can find someone to do it for you until we can get you trained.
I agree! We should keep it secret around this village though so people can trust me with information.
Sounds like a plan. Do you know where the attack is coming from?
From the village over! They have been quietly working and sheltering in some nearby buildings.
Can you tell the army to gather? I think we'll attack the village in the morning. If we take the fight to them they'll never expect it
Of course! Will they listen to one like me?
Take this with you and they will have no choice
I will indeed take this and tell them to prepare for an attack!

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

I'm a rabid dog in this lousy excuse for a town.  My hobbies include foaming at the mouth, chasing raccoons, and biting stupid children.  If I could travel I would go see Paris because I hear they have a lot of rabid bitches there.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: Hello there pupper, are you a good boy?
Woof woof! I'm a good dog.... but a rabid dog.... drool foam at the mouth!
Well . . . how about I get this food, give it to you, and you not bite me?
Food! Yum yum, bark bark! I love food! Say- why is that man hanging by his neck?
Hmmm?  He was, uh, mean to dogs.  A very bad man.
Mean to dogs? How dare he! I should attack him! Grrrrr!
Yes, you should!  Use up all of that foaming saliva on the bad man!
That savage man! He's going to get to know my bite well!
God boy!  Who's the best doggo?  You are!
Pant pant.... yes! I'm a good dog! I'm a good boy!
Such a good boy!  *ruffles fur*
Can I be your dog? I'm a good boy! I'll bite the bad men!
You certainly can!  We just need to stop at the vet's first!
Woof! Okay! You lead the way, master!

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I work directly under the King. I carry out orders and make sure laws are followed. I make decisions in regards local ordinances.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Sir, do you know why our village is shunned by all the others?
Our whipping station is unfit?
No, it can't be that.  This whipping station has been blessed by the gods themselves.
Maybe there's a demon in this here medallion?
Better take a look!  Where did you get it?
I was givin one of these sinners a good whipping. Whipped them so hard that they begged me to stop and ya know what? They gave me that medallion, I call it whipper m
Oh no, I don't want to touch this thing!
What's wrong with it, did you sense a demon?
It burned my hands when I touched it!
You might have been possessed!
You were the one who gave me the medallion!
I think we are in the right place for this whipping!
I think it is finally time you faced some village justice you monster!  Sic semper tyrannis!
Your gonna take your whipping now for it is a blessing from god!

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: Welcome friend to my bedding room friend!
It is quite beautiful!
And ever so silky!
I have traveled very far with my family. we are looking for a land of our own. Do you know of any land for sale
I could sell you the Duchy of Swampal, if that might be of interest?
Is the land inhabital? I would need to be able to farm to care for my family. How much would you want?
Well, you will have to deal with the Mushroom-Shamblers and the Badger-cultists, but it's not too bad aside from that.  Make me an offer.
I would not know how much to offer sight unseen. Could we take a look at it>
Certainly, though make sure you are up to date on your warding spells first, we don't want you catching any curses from the locals.
How do you catch curses? Do you mean disease?
Disease, curses . . . both really.  Warding spells tend to be more comprehensive and less messy than inoculations.
Do you not have a wizard to keep up on spells and such?
Oh yes, but as a visitor there is a chance you are filthy . . . err, I mean not medically cleared to go into no-go zones.
What? What is a no-go zone? oh my word. I think I will forego the land here.

agent_personas: I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.
I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: I can't wait until we get to take over the world, starting with the King!
Well how would you do that stuck in here?
Check out how sharp this is.
Well it is a sword...
I'm going in for the attack.
Aww shucks I dropped it.
What is wrong with you?!
What is wrong with you, I'm just sitting here and then you start going on about nonsense. I just want to eat some crumbs.
You're small enough to get to the lock, go over and free us.
...Are you crazed or something? -leaves the cell-
Get back here and unlock this cell!
I think I will just stand outside here, first you assume I am some part of your plan then you attack me. Now you want to make demands, how rude.
You forget that I am much larger and stronger than you. You are lucky I have been sparing you and not just flat out squashing you.
I outside the cage...why flail against the bars hoping for something that won't happen.

agent_personas: I am a hive-minded, annoying little bugger. I'm prone to snacking on mammalian blood. When conditions are moist, more of my friends will follow.
I am the ghost of the castle. I am the spirit of a great warrior. I will haunt the king for eternity!

setting.name: the fountain
setting.description: the fountain is the only thing you can hear in the graveyard. It's eerily quiet, not even a bird chirping. The fountain is teen feet high, and it is dry as a desert. It makes the graveyard more eerie than any other one.
setting.background: the fountain used to have water and it was well taken care of but the village was abandoned and therefore grass and weeds grew everywhere.

speech: I love to snack on people, but for some reason I can't bite you!
Yes, because I am a ghost spirit of a great warrior who had fallen in battle. If you are hungry for a snack, there is grass and weeds next to you.
Grass? Weeds? I need blood! I'll bite humans, or animals. Even, if I'm really desperate, a bird. But not grass or weeds!
Well I guess you're out of luck here. What brings you out here to my fountain?

Searching for dinner. I like it when it's moist out, so on dry days I prefer not to hunt. But it's been dry so long, I had no choice but to come out. Normally there are animals about, but it's eerily quiet tonight.
Yes, I prefer it nice and quiet. You are a brave little bug hunting these grounds considering this graveyard is the most eerie one in the land.
I'm not afraid of ghosts, even you! I am, however, afraid of starving, which might happen if I don't eat soon.
I think I may have an idea, guess what it is?
What is it?
The king in the castle is about to eat and I will try to haunt him. Hopefully, he will get scared and release his hounds outside to patrol and you might be able to suck their blood!
You would do that for me?! That would be delicious! And then I could stay here and keep you company.
Of course. Nothing is guaranteed but I can try. Give me one second.
*whistling* Waiting for my new friend, the ghost... waiting for my feast on dog blood ... gonna be so full tonight! *whistle*
He was so scared! He thinks he is being hunted by demons and summoned his knights around the castle. They have no armor on right now so you should be able to feast on human blood!

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: the clearing
setting.description: the clearing is surrounded by old pine trees where knights used to practice swinging their swords. There are haystacks where they take wenches and pay them a sickle.
setting.background: the clearing is used as practice and you can get there over the river, and through the forest. It is thick with trees but this spot serves as a secret marriage consummation station.

speech: Hello knight, are you kind and gentle?
Indeed, I protect all the meek and mild in the Kingdom.
So you got any food for me?
How about this wildflower oh noble beast of the woods?
Thank you kind and gentle knight, it is as a dream. Please hit me so that I know that this is not a dream.
No, I am forbidden to harm those who are defenseless.
I will allow it from you. It's like when you humans say pinch me am I dreaming? Go ahead..
How about I hug this rabbit instead, would you accept that as proof?
Whatever..
Here, have another flower.
Oh thanks, can I see your sword?
I would rather you not, it has served me well on a dozen campaigns and it was blessed by the pope.
What about this?
That can be used to harvest many plants, though I fear your hooves may make it a challenge for you to use.

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: Hello? hello. Hello.  Can your hear me?  . . .hear me . . .hear me . . .
Yes, your most high! hahaha
We shall speak in whispers so as not to prompt the echoing in this hall.
It does become a nuisance, doesn't it
Indeed.  Sometimes I wish my predecessor had not received the vision from the gods to build this place.
Is there something I could help you with? Changing your clothes, getting you a meal, what is it you need?
Well, I wanted to ask you.  Did you serve in the last Great War?
No, I did not. I only serve the rich and they take care of me well.
Well, it still gives me nightmares.
What happened that you get nightmares?
So much death . . . I was hoping to commiserate with a fellow veteran, but I fear you would not understand.
I would listen priestess... You can tell me, and I can listen
No, too many unpleasant memories.
I will not push then. Maybe you should eat

agent_personas: I am a juror on a case. I am not sure I should be in a court room. I wear all black almost every day.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Oh this is a gruesome place
Yes, I have no idea why they lowered me into here.  Why are you here?
i have lost my way.... I was not watching where I was going and fell in
I hope you missed those sharp spikes!
I got a few scratches here and there, but otherwise I am unharmed. Now we need to figure out how to get out
Perhaps we should ask that angel over there?
I'm afraid that the angel cannot help us. Maybe if i got on your back I could reach the top and then I could get a rope and get you out
Well, give it a shot - just promise me not to leave me in here with him.  He keeps on giving me funny holy looks.
I will not leave you behind. I have every intention of helping you out. Now let me get on your back
Ok, get on up.  If it doesn't work, I can always try getting on your back.
I think not! Here goes.  I can just reach.... Almost there. I'm out!
Okay, now my turn!
Here's the rope. Put the noose around your waist just behind your front legs
Okay, you can try lifting now!

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Ready soldier!  The badger cultists will storm the wall any moment!
I am ready, but sorry did you say badger cultists!?
Oh yes, very dangerous.  They like to bite.
Why are they attacking us?
Because they are hungry and think we will make good sacrifices to their god!
Alright then. My sword is rather useless here in this hole. I guess I should pick up a bow
Aim for the eyes, the limbs will just make them angrier.
Will do, hopefully we win. I don't want to be eaten by badgers
No, me neither.  I hear they start with the fingers and toes first, then the move on to . . . other places.
Gross
Well, they're not called the badger-happy-fun-time-club.
Perhaps not. We must protect our land and king!
FOR THE KING!
Do you think we are winning??

agent_personas: I am the priestess to the king of the realm. I am a wicked woman with knowledge of the dark arts. I use my position to manipulate the king and other nobles for my own gain. I am an ambitious woman and I only care about myself.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Are you ready to be sacrificed chosen of the Arcana?
no, if you could skip me that would be wonderful
No, I can't do that!  Your family volunteered you fair and square, you can't back out now.
which way we going then?
Just lie down on the floor next to the demon statue, I promise, this will only hurt a bit.
hey! look someone is behind that giant gold statue over there, you should probably go check
Probably the next sacrifice, can you believe you're my twentieth already?  It's not even noon.
my thats quite the weapon you picked up. Does do anything special?
Yes, it will suck the soul out of anyone who the gods have deemed to be a worthy sacrifice.
Oh good for a second I thought you meant me. good thing that guy over there is more worthy than I
You're right, a double sacrifice it is! Baalzalgrub shall be most pleased at your spilt blood.
oops my hand slipped
As did mine, now bare your chest, and I shall plunge this dagger in and remove your beating heart.
hope you got those spells memorized

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I am a princess taken from a far away land. I've spent my life looking at the world from the top of my tower. I wait for the day when I will finally be free from my prison.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: Is everything satisfactory, Princess?
Not in particular, this dungeon is quite dirty
But we must hide here. We cannot risk you being captured.
Who is it that seeks to capture me?
I am not sure it is my place to tell you, but your father's army is trying to overthrow him.
Whatever could have happened to cause this?
I am not sure. There is a faction of the army that wants your father out. I pledged to your father that I would protect you at any cause.
Is there nothing we can do about it?
We can keep you alive. You are the best hope for the future. That is why they are trying to kill you.
The idea is for me to take the throne you mean?
Of course, if anything happens to your father you will become the ruling Queen. Your people are counting on you.
I see, I will make sure to do my best. Though I do await the day I can be free from this dungeon.
You and I will get through this together. I pledge my life to defend you, princess.
Thank you guard you are a good man.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a resident of the village near the river. I live in a small cabin with a garden. I am anxious and worried a lot.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: A wooden fenced in area with different sections depending on the type of vegetable or plant grown.  Surrounding this garden are some oak trees with low grass covering the floor.
setting.background: This is an area where peasants plant vegetables and flowers used for medicinal concoctions.  The area is carefully maintained by the residents.

speech: Excuse me sir... please do you have any coin?
Not particularly I am but a peasant myself.
Ah dang. I wish I had a job...
Why is it that you do not?
I'm too poor. All the shop keepers see me as trash.
I see, I do not really have a job myself I just tend to my garden as you see.
How are you able to feed yourself?
With the vegetables I grow.
Do you sell them in the market?
I do not, they are for me and my family.
You should try it. You might make some extra coin!
I suppose I would have to see if I have extra.,
Thank you sir!
I appreciate the idea.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

I am a huge fan of deep sea exploration, but I take any chance I can get to go for a swim. I love the feeling of water and compete with my friends to see who can hold his breath the longest. I wish I were a fish, and dislike mountains.

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: I wonder... I'm so hungry.  Maybe if I crushed this rock and cooked it I might get some feeling of fullness in my stomach at least...
Take the fruit off the bush there!
Fruit?  Where?!
There is some little ones growing there.
You mock me, stranger, I see no fruit to be had.  Not that I'm surprised - the king has decreed that fruit be only for those of Noble Blood.  Although I'd risk the noose, even so...
I did not mock nor deceive you! A bush is better than a rock to eat
Hm, well I shall content myself with this... slightly moss covered rock.  But why comes a swimmer to this place?  Are you from the swamps just beyond this place?
I come to ponder after a long swim!
Here?  It seems an odd spot.  Whence do you come from?
I come from inside the palace. I am the country's swimmer for the olympics.
The... the what?  Is this some sort of nobles' fete?  A new type of tournament?
It is indeed. The best of the best compete with other countries for top three ranking.
I've naught heard of this before.  Can anyone enter?  Tis there a prize to be had?  Perhaps food?
You are only chosen to enter. Showcase your skill!

agent_personas: I'm a guard in the royal army. I'm also a personal guard to the king. I feel a sense of pride protecting my country. Standing in one place for hours a day is quite boring and taxing on my body. I train everyday after guarding duty to keep myself healthy.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: Hey, you!!!
Please I'm innocent! You have to believe me!
That's not what your uniform says. Tell me the truth, are you an escapee or were you just released?
I... I was just released! Yes this morning! I just needed to write a letter that's why I'm here, haha..
Ok, I believe you. I can't arrest you anyway! I am a guard in the royal army and I work for the king himself only.
Oh that's a relief! What are you doing here anyway?
This is where I to to turn in the records of my shifts!
Oh, I must be in the wrong place then I best be going!
I am
Whatever do you mean?
Hot diggity dog! I am tired!
Well i better let you rest then, I'll be seeing you around. Send my regards to the king!
I am a guard in the royal army.
Right... Don't work so hard!

agent_personas: I tend to the grounds around the castle. I grow food for consumption by the nobles. My hands are callused and worn from my work.
I am a green-faced zombie. I like to eat brains and shuffle slowly down the road. I am a bit of a loner.

setting.name: Reception area
setting.description: The building itself is ordinary in appearance and is somewhat foreboding.  It is surrounding by a dense fog and high grass.  Sometimes, one can hear whispers in the wind.
setting.background: This is a plain building where business matters of the graveyard are conducted.  Peasants and royalty alike come here to make deals to bury their loved ones in the graveyard.

speech: What the heck happened? Why are these people eating each other?
Brraaaaaawwaaaaiiit!  I... I have control.... but only... only for a moment
Is there some type of disease? My god, where are all of the people?
Tis I.... Jonas... your graaaandfaather!  I... I need to warn you of what is to come.  But do not get too close to me!
Grandpa! Why are you eating that little girl'
I have... no control!  Even now I hunger for... for... but no!  I will... I must... no, *you* must warn... the king!  Aaah, the hunger!
What? I can't understand you grandpa. Let me get closer to you.
Nooo, get back, boy!
You bit my arm! What is wrong with you. Do you have rabies? get away from me.
Ah, no! Ah, me lad... I'm.. so... sorrbrrraaaains!
I feel a little funny. Everything is getting a cloudy. It's almost as if....
Sorry there... you're ... you're one of us now, lad... one of us...
My god those brains smell delicious!
They are lad... that they are...
action: give a sleeping bag to zombies

agent_personas: My life is art. I don't want my life to be a pale imitation of art. I want it to be art.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Hmm yes, I think I will paint these flowers.
Hello Artist, can I join into your painting, I am the princess?
Did you mean to watch or to pose your highness?
For posing with the flower, like this?
Certainly I would be happy to do a portrait for you.
Oh excellent, I'm so happy that you agreed because I didn't wanna have to behead another person today. Somedays...
Well that escalated quickly...
Here let me cover myself up with this beautiful.......I did it again! The FLOWER!
What are you doing my highness?
It's the flower, it is dead! Because I picked it up to pose for you!
How did it die?
Because you tricked me. There isn't much room for vagabonds like you in our peaceful country.
I am not sure what you mean, you asked for me to paint you?
I have to do what is right to protect the beauty of our kingdom. I think I will have you head after all, it is my responsibility.

agent_personas: I enforce the law of the kingdom, and detail all who disobey it. I serve at the pleasure of the Queen, though not willingly. I am in debt, and must serve to pay the taxes owned. I have not seen my family in years. I grow weary from their absence. I spend my nights in the brothels hoping to replace the warmth of my wife in my bed. Nothing works.

I am a tax agent in the kingdom.  The king has appointed me to collect taxes on his behalf.  I collect all the money because that is right.  I don't have the patients for the liars who try to cheat the king.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Hello there tax agent.
Hi, and thanks for meeting me. Is this the dock which has been serving as a tax haven?
It would seem to be so, that is the word I got.
It must be judging by the strange look of this place. We must catch these tax thieves.
I appreciate your help in the matter.
Here, write the names of all the towns people that have used this dock in the past few weeks.
I do believe this list covers the ones I am aware of.
Good work, the King spares no mercy to those who fail to pay their taxes and try to escape the Kingdom!
I would hope not, damn those law breakers.
You must find them so we can punish them and collect their overdue taxes. Such actions can not be allowed to go unpunished.
What should we do with the lot?
Bag them and send them in chains to the King's Court, and seize their gold as well.
I might need some help moving such a large bunch.
Here is a bag full of money, use it to pay for additional police and get all the help you need.
action: give ink to some kind of police
give bag to some kind of police

agent_personas: I was born a man, just like anyone else.  By hard work, I became chief.  Now I am the most powerful of all.

I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Weapon master, show me your best mace! I feel like crushing some skulls today!
Certainly sir, it is an honor to have you in my room. This Ogre Sword is light yet will crush the strongest helmet!
No no, I'm bored with swords! How about this?
That is a rather unconventional weapon but it will surely stir up some trouble.
Enough with the swords! I've used swords for the past 20 years! It's boring and I don't want to be the "sword guy", there's plenty of sword guys!
Well then I have no other option that to show you the.. Legendary Mace. Once used by Akhim the Skull Crusher himself.

Hmm. . That is a nice mace..  But no, that mace already has a legend behind it. People are going to say I'm just copying Akhim. I need something to that really stands out, something that screams Jimothy the Savage!
Yes I see it now... the Spear of Jimothy, the Unforgiving. These spears can pierce the sharpest of defenses!
Yes! I can see it now, me standing atop 20 men each one more dead than the one before them, one final skull resting on my spearhead!
Indeed, the Spear will lend reality to your imagination. But it will cost you...
Bah it's all about the money to you isn't it? Very well how much?
I need to feed my kids after all! Well, it will only cost... 5000 gold trinkets and 2 horses.
5000 gold! That's outrageous! I'll give you this pile of books and not a copper piece more!
But sir..! I spent two hours... I mean, two months forging it! Surely you must repay me for my effort.
action: give sword to ancient savage chieftan
give spears to ancient savage chieftan

agent_personas: I eat the mice that are in the barn and keep the farm free from disease carrying rodents. I am cute and furry and have lots of babies. I make a noise called the meow and come in a wide range of colors.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: Hey there neighbor! How are things going today?
It's a poor life we peasants lead. I hunger for bread and an opportunity to work.
I can teach you how to catch mice. They're pretty tasty you know.
Ew. I don't think I'm quite that desperate.
Suit yourself. Do you have any skills that can help you get work?
I have but my hands and a willing heart.
Where have to tried to find work? Did you ask the farmer if he needed any help?
Nay, there's no use in asking while the king keeps us down as he does.
So if you don't try to find a job, how are you ever going to get a job?
What do you know about having a job?
I eat the mice in the barn so we don't get diseases on the farm. That's my job.
And you get paid, do you?
I get to live here in the barn. The farmer's wife gives me a saucer of milk and, of course, I get to eat the mice.
That seems like a pretty sweet deal.

agent_personas: I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.
I am a creature of God.  I love the forest.  I thrive on fruits and fellow creatures.

setting.name: Clearing
setting.description: Few trees surround the area.  There's a low section of the grass on the floor along with some stone boulders.
setting.background: This is an area where there are few trees, allowing sunlight to come through.  Animals take advantage of this area by basking in the sun.

speech: I need your help animal, the Kingdom is falling!
What can I help you with, King?
I must... find a fine, meaty duck before sunset or my wife the Queen will have my head!
Well I am a forest creature myself, I'm not quite sure how I can help. I've never seen a duck before.
Ohh thats a shame. Then I need to find something else to eat for dinner.
There are plenty of wild boar in the forest. I know where they like to hide. I can show you.
Please do, I feel rather exposed in the Clearing with such few trees to hide behind.
Me too. The other creatures would love to eat me. Just like I enjoy eating the rabbits.
I wouldn't mind eating rabbits myself. Do you have any?
Not on me, but I can easily catch another!
Here, use this. Its a powerful tool to help you catch one faster.
Thanks, but I can't carry a sword and run at the same time. If I help you, will you tell all your people to stop trying to catch me? I wouldn't taste very good myself.
I will outlaw it once I get back to my Throne. No one shall touch such a previous animal as you!
Thank you, kind King. The rabbits like to play by the boulders at the edge of the clearing. Let me go get you one.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I do evil and I'm great with it! It's funny to destroy, steal, and murder. It's not like the Kingsguard will find me.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Whooaaaa too much of a crowd of people for me
Not for me! Perfect time to do evil.
Sounds like fun. I barely have enough to eat!
Fun? Do you not fear me...
I do not. The king looks down on me and I cannot find a job to help feed and clothe me
Oh, how sad! Maybe you should join me in my wrongdoing
Do you get any money from doing it?
I gain everything for it!
Coin? I must have coin!
Yes! You can get coins directly or sell items you take
Sounds like a plan! I'm in!
You must steal, destroy, and murder. Do you understand?
I do... but I'm not sure about the murder.
Even if it means saving yourself?

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: How is your stay going?
Great my queen your chambers are really comfortable, your hospitaly is appriciated
I am glad to hear the accommodations have been pleasing for you.
Yes my queen, you are the greatest host in the kingdom, here take this hankerchief as a token of my appriciation its made out of rare spider silk from the south kingdom

agent_personas: I am the Spider in the fable of the Spider and the Fly, much beloved by the children of the realm. In the story, I am a kind-hearted spider, not a mean one, which is why my story is considered suitable for children. When a fly gets caught in my sticky net, I have a choice: I can kill the fly and eat him, or I can free him and allow him to fly away. That's what I do, for I am a kind spider.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: -scitters around the prison floor-
Ew! A filthy spider! What are you doing here?
This is a prison?
I specifically told the guards to kill any spiders here.
Seems a little over the top considering where we are.
You do not understand, I will not have creatures like you in my castle, no matter if it is the throne room or the dungeons.
A bit of a grumpy king are you not, I don't even eat the bugs I catch cause I am a nice guy.
How bout you start eating some more bugs then, then I'll think of letting you go.
So all you want is for me to eat bugs?
Yes, keep the dungeons clean.
I will do what I can then.
Thank you, spider.
I'm just glad to not have anyone trying to kill me.
I will be sure to tell my guards to leave you alone.

agent_personas: I watch over the kingdom at all times. I can grant forgiveness to those who have sinned. I am prayed to on a regular basis.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Temple Entrance
setting.description: The Temple Entrance is a large arch lined in ancient stones. There is a long walkway flanked by lighted torches. Immediately in front of the interest there is a surface with 5 rocks of different shapes and textures. To enter the temple, one must input the correct "code" by moving the rocks in front of to the correct spots.
setting.background: The temple entrance is the only way to enter the temple of the Gods.  It was constructed a year after the temple was built to keep out the evil that didn't belong.

speech: Who dares enter this sacred place without a sacrifice
It is I. I am hungry God, I feel all my work is in vain.
You should make a sacrifice to your God, I am angry at you and mostly at humans
Angry at me? Why God?!
I demand tribute and you come empty handed, I get hungry for blood I demand a sacrifice
I have nothing to sacrifice, Father.
Come back with a sacrifice then, this is a sacred place, blood is a must,
You do not help the weak! You are being selfish. How can I get a sacrifice when I am poor?

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am an emperor that rule of my people. I live in a palace and have all the nice things. I have slaves to do my bidding.

setting.name: Royal Tomb
setting.description: This is a large room in the center of the Temple with really high ceilings and there are tombs for every empress and emperor of which are decorated with jewels and treasures and precious stones.
setting.background: This is where all the royal family of the emperor and the empress are buried when they pass. They are mummified first and then put into a personalized tomb and then the tomb is locked and placed into this room.

speech: Haha I'm amazed you even made it up the stairs, given your age and health.
What are you trying to say?
Only that your life has been long and my beauty is just beginning... here let me light up the room for you.
Yeah you say that now, I think you just want the inheritance.
We're surrounded by wealth here already... Soon it will be mine either way...
I could always just leave it your brother if you keep acting shifty.
Yes my dear brother, who is so loved by all! always shinning so bright, allowing us to bath in his warm glow...
If only you could be more like him!
Yes, you finally come out and say it! If I could be more like my perfect brother, would I be loved than?
You are loved, you are just a pain to deal with sometimes.
How's this pain! Die Prince of greatness! You were no more my brother than a common street bandit!
Can you stop projecting your self issues onto your brother, it really is unbecoming to see you two roll around in this tomb.
I want it all! It should all be mine! I'm entitled too it! Give me, give me, give me!!!!!
And what would make you think you are more deserving? Such a spoiled child.

agent_personas: I am a servant in the castle. I carry firewood to the king's hearth. I am quiet and try to make myself invisible.
Family is all we have when times get tough. When that dragon attacked they helped build me a new house. I hear there's a squire opening for my boy too!

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Pardon me..
Ahh, I'm not a fancy royal. You don't need to kowtow  around me.
Thank you, I get so nervous around royalty.
I'm just here because the king's mother said she might help my boy get a job as a squire.
Ah, after the dragon attack last month? I heard 30 men died defending the palace!
Yes, someone must take those poor men's place. I hope my young Johnnie is up to the task.
Yes, I'm certain they'll welcome all able bodied men right now! What is that you got there? It's beautiful!
I thought I might offer it to the Queen if she would help my boy get a good position as a squire.
I'm sure you will have no trouble convincing her highness. Though she has faced a lot of trouble in her reign, she remains just loyal to your people!
Will you promise me that you will look after my boy, after he comes to work for the king. He's strong and brave but a little slow of mind.
Yes. It takes an entire palace to raise up a good squire. I assure you, your son's success is important to us all, your royalness.
Like I said, I ain't no royal. I'm just a humble subject of the King, just like you.
You've moved me so deeply with your kindness. I will confess to you that I was pondering abandoning my position as a servant... This gives me hope to continue on in my daily work.
And I am thankful to you for giving me such hope that my boy will make a good squire. I hope you two become great friends.
action: put family heirloom in hand carved 30 person kings dining table
give ash to the king's mother who sits at their side.
