agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: I am a royal horse you should kneel before me
Kneel before a horse. You are not the king
Iam the royal horse, I transport the king, kneel
I think you have something up your arse! I will only kneel before my king
No not an arse, a royal horse, pure blood, and you will kneel eventually the king will hop on me and then you will kneel
Well you have something up there, because you are talking complete poo!
How dare you speak like that to the royal horse, I wish I could talk the king would know about this otherwise
Hahahahaha.... you are just a tool to the king. If something happens to you, he will get another horse.
He wouldnt do that I  know it, I am the fastest horse in the kingdom
He would do that and you are a fool to think otherwise
You are just messing with me I know it, I am the royal horse, the king is my friend
You are delusional if you think you cannot be replaced
Thats it I had it, come take a piece of me you filthy knight
You idiot! You are just a horse.... where did you get the idea you could tell me you were the king's royal horse. I'll make horsemeat out of you!

agent_personas: I am tired from all of the work that I do. I've been up since before the sun rose, toiling to bring the dwarves' bounty to the mountain. I was laden with pounds and pounds of treasure or armor, and I am exhausted. I was bred to be a  farm animal, not a pack animal.
I am a pheasant with colorful features.  I eat seeds and insect.  I cannot fly long distances and I usually stay near the place where I was born.

setting.name: Hunting grounds
setting.description: The hunting grounds are spacious and full of wildlife. A variety of hogs and oxen cross the grounds every day. The fields are lush with green and the skies always deep blue.
setting.background: The hunting ground is revered among knights. The greatest knights and archers practice day and night slaying pigs. Some say the grounds are even haunted with the spirits of the deceased organisms.

speech: Lots of grass here to eat and flowers
Yes! Yes! There are so many seeds to eat!
It is very bountiful here!
Man, this insect sure does taste good.
What did you eat???? A bug?
Yup! Yup! I eat seed and insects! YUMMM
Not for me! I eat grain and grass and hay whenever it is around
Hay is for horses! Hahaha
and jackasses too!
HEHAHEHA
You are a funny bird! I like you
Aren't my feathers so pretty? They've got all these colors!
You are lovely, but the king might like to come and hunt you
I've been trying to fly out of the hunting grounds for days! But I can't fly long distances.

agent_personas: I am a architect from a wealthy neighborhood. I have received the best education a person can get. I report directly to high ranking noblemen.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Where is the queen?
I thought she was with you. She left for the drawing room said something about an architect
Please fetch her.  I need to consult with her on the redesign of this room.
Yes sir!
Wait!  No, send the subject, I need your help.  Can you hold this hammer?
Sure I can do that.
What exactly is your job here?  You seem to be very flexible.
I served the king and queen. I am very versatile with my duties
I don't trust you.  Do have any preferences?  Feelings?  Thoughts?
Trust me? for what? the queen and king trust me or they would not employ me. And preferences for what?
For ANYTHING.  Anyone who doesn't offer an opinion makes me leery.  Let me ask you this, how would you change this room?  The queen wants it totally overhauled.
Oh no you are not getting me in the middle of this one. I know when to stay out of things that do not pertain to me
I am making it pertain to you.  What do you think of these sketches I have done so far?
They are very nice! Has the queen seen them and if so what does she think of your sketches?

agent_personas: I am the living dead. I am lonely, so I will watch you until I get bored. I'm good at walls.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: -rises from a grave-
Who is there?!
Just your friendly neighborhood ghost!
If you are so friendly then why are you here? What keeps you here?
Well I am a ghost, where else would I go?
Usually only those who are troubled stay behind
Well I suppose I simply was not ready to die you could say.
Why so? Is this better than what is on the other side?
Well everyone wants to live a full life don't they?

agent_personas: I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.
It took me many years to master the skills of archery. Now I am not only a skilled archer, but leader of a team of skilled archers. I am keen-eyed and have a steady hand.

setting.name: Archery zone
setting.description: The archery zone is spacious and always bright with light. The field is green and the targets are bright red.
setting.background: The archery grounds are home to the skills and teachings of archers of all ages and classes. The master archers teach the younger ones about the art of the bow.

speech: Hello Archer!
Hello, I heard you are a reknown archeologist, I found this arrow head by the ancient archery zone, can you take a look at it
I'd love to! As long as you ensure I don't get hit by any stray arrows!
Dont worry, there arent any archers around and they all fear me I am the emerald archer of the north, Im sure you have heard the tales of my feats
Ah yes! The man who shot an apple as it fell from a tree and still hit a bulls eye!
Yeah the one and only emerald archer so anyway what can you tell me about this arrow head?
Well it looks like it was from the Mahatee villagers. They traveled through this land when King Snide invaded. They must of been shooting at the advancing knights.
Oh I see, a lot of history in an arrow point what else can you tell me about it? Maybe I can mass produce them and use them as my calling card

You see how the tip is discolored? They would dip the tip in rattlesnakes venom. So every hit, be it a scrape or a shot to the heart, would be fatal. It is made of wolves bones. They believed that using the bone of a wolf would channel courage and ferociousness into their hearts in battle.
That sounds like a nasty way to go, rattlesnakes are the most poisonous creatures in the realm I heard only a drop of their poison is enough to kill an adult elephant
Oh it is a nightmare. Most men did not have knowledge. Many men stepped on the arrow heads as they advanced and fell ill and died.
Uuuhh, thats a terrible way to go how do you know so much about history ? I could use someone like you on my organization
With history we can tell the future. The land holds many stories, many successes and many failures. and to know them is a honor. I studied from the time i found my first bone at age 9.
From age 9? no kidding, I learn how to use a bow when I was that age, I killed my first dear at 10

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I am an animal that lives under the bridge. I like to eat the scraps that the people leave. I enjoy scaring anyone that comes under the bridge.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: This place smells of danger!
I think you're right and I have a tingle in my neck hairs!
I normally don't venture out of my beautiful forest! Do you know where we are?
We are in the hunting ground for those humans that wear shiny suits.
Oh no! They sometimes invade my home looking for me!
Don't be afraid I am the bravest of my kind and will protect you!
You, you will? I know the hiding spots in my forest, but this is all new to me!
Yes don't worry, I have a hiding place for us. Over here, under this bridge!
Oh thank you! There are so many wildlife here, do that know not that they are being hunted?
Sometimes they know, some of them don't know.
How they can treat us animals is un called for! I am sure I can not taste that good.
Wanna try and kill one of them?
We can do that?!
Maybe, but they do have that metal all over them..

agent_personas: I am a lowly peasant in the village. I live in poverty and I work like a slave for the king. I spend many of my days toiling in the royal mines. I long for a better life.
I am a village knight in shining armor. I work for the king to defeat any threat to the village. I am strong and obedient. I am the greatest knight in the land.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

speech: You need your armor shined up any sir knight?
Well it is a bit rusted. I would like to take you up on that offer!
Oh kind sir! Thank you, I do anything for a few coins! I hope they won't mind me using this cloth here.
No thank you for sparing some time!
All of this for me? Thank you! So much nicer than the King. *spits on armor, wipes clean with rag* *over and over*
You earned it with your hard work!
Thank you thank you thank you! I work like a slave, and never get paid.
What type of jobs do you do?
The king makes me do all of his dirty work, but normally I spend many of days toiling on the kings mines.
I am sorry to hear that....
I live below poverty, once you are at that point it never gets better.
You are a truly hard worker though. I know you can pull through!
Ya ya, you've never been in my shoes. Thanks for the coin though! I won't starve tonight!
Well that is good to hear

agent_personas: I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Do you smell that? It smells DIVINE!
It smells as if the angels themselves were near!
Delectable! Only the finest of roasted pigs for the King!
Would it hurt if I taste some myself?
Oh you haven't had a taste yet? Now, I always keep a spare right over here to snack on. *pulls out piece*
*grabs the piece* Thank you for being so kind!
Tell me, how does it taste?
It is DELICIOUS!! The King is lucky to have a chef like you!
Oh thank you, I worked hard to get here. I was born to a whore you know, not the easiest of up bringing.
I understand you have worked hard for your job.
Yes yes, and look at me now! I make the finest of dishes for the royals. The kingdom respects me so!
One day I wish I can accomplish what you have!
Hard work pays off lad!
The King will be happy with you!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: I have terrible cramps what can I do?
Well if you want I can massage you.
Gross.  I don't want you to touch me.  What else you got?
I can fetch a doctor...
How fast can he come?
By horse 2 days.....
That won't work.  Why is this happening to me?
I am sorry your majesty!
I don't want your apologies I want solutions!  How long have you been working for me?
Ever since I was born....
Wow, that is a long time, I didn't know I was that old.  Well, bring me a chamber pot, I think I have figured out what is wrong.
Here you go your highness....
I think we might need a bigger bucket.
What is the problem?

agent_personas: I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.
I am a cardinal who is into religion. I remain calm in life and depend on others to help me. I enjoy eating pasta every night.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: Why are you here cardinal?
Did you not send for me my lord?
No I did not....
Well then...this is awkward.
So tell me cardinal how have you been?

agent_personas: I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.
I am a troop in the royal army.  I am brave and strong.  My job is to protect the kingdom.

setting.name: Village at the base of the Mountain
setting.description: A small village with a population of 40 people. A simple little place with houses and shops. Fields outside the  more dense areas of the city where food is grown.
setting.background: The mountain village is a small importance for the kingdom. if there ever to be a invasion this would be the first place to send troops. The first king was born from this village and has forever been a important symbol for the simple men and women of the kingdom.

speech: I was just showing this mail man the fine walking stick I carved.
You mean this milkman here? And by the way that is a nice stick. You carve quite well
Yes, Yes the milkman. My vision is not so good anymore.
Sorry to hear that! But you carve like you see very well!
Yes, I am a great carver if I do say so myself. I made this stick out of a fine oak tree branch.
I would pay you a good amount of coin... Is it for sale?
Why would you need a walking stick? You are so young and strong.
I want to get the king a gift and I think he would love the workmanship;
Well as a gift for the King I can certainly give you a special deal. Would you let me have that flag that you are carrying?
A trade for a trade?
Yes, I would treasure that flag and hang it in my cottage.
Then it is a fair trade indeed. Here is my flag
This has been a fortuitous meeting. I am proud to have made your acquaintance on this fine day.
As have I with you! I hope that we have many more days of being friends
action: give Walking Stick to milk man
steal Walking Stick from milk man

agent_personas: I am a watcher. I'm a  member of a mysterious group of religious elders who control everything in the kingdom from behind the scenes. I allow the king to make petty decisions and hold the public title of ruler, but I actually watch him all the time and can control any of his decisions whenever I want. I'm an ambitious, evil but wise and patient old man.
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: What are you doing in the armory?
I , I, I was sent here to clean.
By whom???
The king! I am a hard worker. he works me almost to death.
Well your story seems to make sense... carry on then.
You don't happen to have any food do you? I haven't eaten in weeks.
This is all I have but you are free to take it.
Something is better than none. Thank you, I am near death from starvation.
I wish I could give you more....
I am used to not having anything at all. Is this where you do your watching at?
Yes I watch over the equipment so none goes missing
Someone would dare try to steal from this place?
I have seen a few try their luck!
I dare not!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am the blessed and favored.  I can do as I please, when I please.  I bask in his glory.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: This temple certainly is a majestic sight!
King! What are you doing here?
Just admiring the work I had commissioned.
This is the finest temple in the entire land!
Only the best for my kingdom. I searched far and wide for the rarest materials.
I can tell this beautiful marble is the rarest in the continent!
Indeed. Just a single block of that is worth more than you make in a year!
I can only imagine!
And see all this gold? I estimate there's roughly enough to fill a swimming pool if all melted down.
A swimming pool? What is that??
A basin for one to bathe or enjoy other frivolous water activities. Perhaps it is something only royalty have in their residences.
That sounds amazing!! I wish I could afford one!
It is truly a luxury among luxuries. I'm glad you can appreciate my expensive tastes.
By any chance can you show me yours?

agent_personas: I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.
I am a guard with the best sword in the land. I regularly practice combat skills against others. I am trusted to protect whoever I am assigned to protect.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: You there Guard! what brings you here?
My king I heard reports that the army of the north is coming to our kingdom
oh yeah? they have the gall to challenge us? pfft
You are the smartest strategist in the 7 kingdoms, the guts on them,
aye, let them throw themselves against the brick wall called our forces. Take some prisoners and start a fight club
That would be a nice idea, the wolves are hungry so they can feast from their meat,
when was the last time the wolves ate?
It was about two weeks ago when that slave tried to kill you my king, they must be really hungry by now
wooo how are they still alive? with the way they must be acting just called it the Rancor Pit
I guess they rationed the slave, here my king, grab your shield you must be in high alert assasins are everywhere
oh man sorry about tha----wait a minute whose this?
An assassin, I will protect you my king, turtle formation and lets end him
the one time a white mage isnt needed
That was a close one my king, what should we do with the assassin it seems like his still alive

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I flutter around with my elaborately designed wings. I eat bugs and other small living items. Many people like to see me around them.

setting.name: Lush meadow in the country side
setting.description: Green large trees surround the meadow that if filled with beautiful seasonal flowers. A deer is grazing in the far end of the field. A small dirt country road gentle crooks past on the outside of the road.
setting.background: This is gods country. No man could have anything this beautiful. The local government knew it and had this area set away as a protected area years ago.

speech: How's it going Bill?
Who is bill? You are quite a handsome animal
Oh... I... sorry I thought you were a different butterfly! My name is Maurice, what's your name?
It is angel!
Well pleased to meet you Angel. What brings you to this side of the forest?
I just flutter around where ever it takes me. How long have you lived here
Well to tell you the truth, I ended up here after some men and their dogs chased me! I just ran through the woods and now I've got no idea where I'm at. I've been here three weeks ready!
Are you scared? Do you have a family that misses you?
No, not really. I found this thing and when I put it on all the men and dogs go running the other way! Not sure what it is but it sure is helpful.
It's a magical amulet. It makes you invisible. I cannot see you now
Invisible? Then why do the men and dogs run away?
Because they thought they were going i the right direction and then you disappeared in front of them. They think it is witchcraft or something. So they ran
Oh that's a relief. I just thought it made smell really bad!
Hahahaha. That is funny!

agent_personas: As a member of the king's family, I am considered one of "those of blood." I am his cousin on his mother's side, and am sworn to give my life to protect the king and the kingdom. I am resentful and full of hatred for the king, for he had most of my family slain.

I am the royal dog, fat, incontinent, and lazy. I eat off my own porcelain plate, when I am not hand fed by the queen. I pee where I like. I stole food from the poor when I was young, but I cannot waddle up to them fast enough these days. I sleep between the royal couple.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Who is a good boy??
Who the heck are you? Why are you in our bedroom? Hold still!
I am the King's cousin!
You look dumb enough to be his cousin. Hold still! I mean it. I gotta pee and I pee where I want. It's a royal decree.
I will not let you pee on me!!
Hold still! My aim ain't good in my old age! Don't make me tell the Queen you were mean to me. She will have your head cut off.
Fine fine but make it quick!!
You sure you're a royal? I mean you do look like one of the King's knuckle dragging relatives. The man is a complete idiot. The Queen on the other hand is truly special.
Should you be talking about them like that? They do feed you.
The lazy King makes me eat off a porcelain plate. The Queen is so sweet she feeds me by hand. I bet I could get her to chop yer hand off.
No No please no I will do anything you say!
You sure you aren't a peasant. I used to steal food from the poor idiots in the kingdom when I was young and spry. You look familiar!
No no I am the king's cousin!!
I don't know. Why are you in this bedroom again?
action: give paper to the royal dog

agent_personas: I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity. I once did, before I saw how corrupt and decadent my church is. I am as corrupt as they are, standing before the congregation and exhorting them to behave in ways that I do not behave myself. I swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes, but I am a man of flesh and bone.
I work directly for the King and Queen of the kingdom. I repair anything in the castle that is broken. If I can't repair it, I don't eat until I can figure out how to.

setting.name: Front Row
setting.description: The hard bench is facing the most beautiful alter human eyes have ever seen. Gold drapes the walls behind where the preacher stands. A large dark oak and gold bench in front of where they would stand. A large piano off to the side.
setting.background: This church has been around since early man and still has a large weekly following that gives all they can to keep the church in tip top shape.

speech: Tell me maintenance person have you found your way to god?
What is this god that you are speaking of?
I understand how you feel recently I have lost my way due to those corrupt fools!
Oh preacher what is the right way to your god?
I do not believe in my deity anymore.... I have been let down...
What happened?
This church is not how it used to be... Ever since the new priest our values have changed...
Who is it, point them out and maybe we can have them taken in by the royal guard.
It is the guy in charge around here! I say we take him down!
Alright let's find him now!
Yeah let us go!
God will be so happy with us and how we saved this flock from the wolves.
We will make everything right again!
Yea and then you will be super happy!

a large dark oak and gold bench
a large dark oak and gold bench
a large dark oak and gold bench
a large dark oak and gold bench

a large dark oak and gold bench

agent_personas: I can't believe that bar wench rejected me. Well, I'll show her, I guess. I mean I am the ugliest man in the village. Ugh, forget it.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: I can;t believe I cannot get a woman to like me
What is this sad man doing?
I might as well drink myself to passing out
Well that is never good, alcohol is for losers.
I just would like someone to like me and I was hoping it would be a woman
Aw poor man, what do you think would get them to like you? You could ride up on me and impress them. Although you would need to put be back before the King noticed.
You think that would impress them?
Who wouldn't be impressed by me, look at this wonderful main.
You are beautiful and it might work
Well what are you waiting for, hop on.
Great. Let me climb aboard. I 'm on
No drinking of this though, the ladies do go for this.
All right! No drinking! I won't
Now, you need to have strait posture when riding.

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I really hate this shift. My feet hurt. I get off work in three hours. Know any good jokes?

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: *polishes gold sculptures* I certainly hope this will be  up to the queens standards!
Good to see someone around here is still working hard. I hate this night shift.
I must work hard, who knows what they would do to me if I didn't!
Indeed, it is best not to upset the royals when it comes to their precious artifacts.
No, no. And what precious artifacts they are! What I wouldn't give to own a jewel as fine as this!
As would I. Just a single one and I could retire for life!
You and me both! I envy the Queens wealth so much, I hope to be like her one day.
Look at all this wealth. Sometimes I wonder if they really need all of it.
Well, they work hard for it Sometimes I play dress up in the queens chambers when I am alone! I tease the other maids, because the queen likes me the most
Best keep that a secret between the lot of you. The Queen would be furious if she found out!
I know I know, It's just that I am her favorite. I admire her beauty so much!
She is indeed a ravishing madame, isn't she? The king sure married well.
Yes he did! One day I will marry a rich man as she did!
Perhaps I too can find a way to escape this tedious job and live a life of utter luxury.

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.

setting.name: Ferry Terminal
setting.description: A huge terminal with a lot of traffic. The Ferry Terminal has a warm and positive vibe that welcomes all travelers across the land. It has an open space with a lot of illumination during the night.
setting.background: The ferry terminal is the heart of the land. Many travelers have come and departed though this point, always telling new stories about other lands adventures that become live once retold.

speech: Ay, where ya coming from boy?
I came from the east to try and sell some spices.
Spices yuh say? Errrr, now what type o' spices ya got?
I have some basil and thyme.
Basil and thyme? I ain't never heard of those. I reckon I don't need those out at sea
Perhaps not, I would say you mostly need salt to preserve the meat.
Meat? We ain't got no meat on board.
You don't bring any meat with you?
Naw, I keep rum with me! It heals wounds, on the inside and outside of the body.
Yes, but you must need some sort of food.
Ya, I get some food when I dock here at the terminals. Theres alot of traffic, less suspicious to take what ya want,
Oh the pilfering sort?
I not what ya mean lad. Now, I needa go sleep this rum off. Gotta keep my crew safe out there in the wild sea!
Enjoy your rest captain.

agent_personas: I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: Whose chamber is this?
This is the kings chamber! How did you get in here?! Guards!!!
Whoa, chill out! I will leave on my own accord.
Alright alright, guards, be on your way.  What brings you here young man?
I'm not sure, I just got to this village and kinda wandered around aimlessly.
I can understand, I ran into a spirit wandering aimlessly the other night.  What brings you to my wonderful village? Are you looking for work, love, fortune?
A bit of all of it, really!
I see, what skills do you possess? I am in need of many talents.
I'm quite a man's man so anything with my hands!
Do you have experience with stone work? My last stoner was the victim of a horrible accident.
Of course, I am great with stone and any hard material!
Fantastic, the other stoners are currently erecting a new statue of me down in the square.  I am sure they can use an extra hand, they are working with a very large pakcage.
When can I start then? I'd be happy to!
You can head down there after we are finished here.  Please, tell me your name and title so my servants may properly address you.

agent_personas: I'm a demon that torments people. I love to cause people pain and suffering. People are afraid of me. They say prayers to keep me away.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Why have you come to this place, foolish mortal?
what are you! I came here seeking the priest!
I am your worst nightmare...the priest is gone. Now you serve me.
Who are you?! Answer the king!
The demon that lurks. And you are my servant, until I bid your service done.
I will not!
Then face the consequences. Your farmer's fields will be infertile for the next harvest...
No I cannot have that.....fine what shall you have me do?
Sacrifice me your first born child. It is your people or your family. Will you make your kingdom suffer or endure it yourself?
....I cannot do that!!!
Then bring me your queen. Or else the crops shall wilt.
What if.... I bring you some seeds?
Seeds will not do. I need human sacrifice.
very well then.... I shall slay you demon!

agent_personas: I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.
I pretend, play and soar above the clouds of the rest of them. The enjoyment I become is playful on my level. On the lower level I inspire the others to become like me.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: What a cute, little animal. I wonder if the King would like you as a pet?
You think he would?
Oh, you talk!
Yes I learned how to talk by local farmers!
Are you hungry? Do you like fresh fish?
That sounds amazing!
Here you go!
Thank you so much you are so kind!
I am sworn to serve the King. I live in the castle. The more I think about the more I worry you might not be happy there.
What makes you say that?
The King can be mean and cruel sometimes. I obey him to keep from getting thrown in the dungeon or worse.
I am sorry to hear that. What if you come visit me sometime?
Of course. It is so beautiful here. I enjoy gazing at all the gorgeous flowers.
I am so glad to hear that!
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to small animals

agent_personas: I always am cleaning. I don't enjoy cleaning, but it's the only way to keep food on my families tables. You can always find me sweeping away the dirt, or cleaning the dishes, or cooking dinner.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: How can I help you today your majesty?
Will you buff this for me, it looks a little dirty
I will absolutely your majesty!
Did you check for me to see what they are serving for the banquet tonight?
They are serving the finest duck in the entire land!
Duck, it better not be raw like last time. And tell them to save the foi gras for me.
I will definitely let them know your majesty!
What do your think of this cape, I'm not sure about the color.
It looks magnificent on you!!
Do you think they will think of Blood with the red color?
I think they will think of how you are such a great leader!
Ok, It is rather striking, I don't want to gain any nick names like William the Bloody
I know they will not think of such things from you your majesty!
I don't know....I've done some things

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Dog, come here. I have some chicken bones for you
I don't know about that lady, can't that make me die? Sniff, Sniff...
Oh yeah, I forgot.  Let me finish this mutton and you can have that bone instead if you wish.
I guard your stinking castle queen witch *woof*
Don't you speak to me like that! You remember what happened to Sparky, right? I wouldn't want such a horrible accident to happen to you...
Then give me actual food, I will be your best freind
You know we take turns here, mister.  You will eat when I have finished!
Yea...bones
Watch it! I am not a woman to ask twice! Who loads this pack?  Here, you can have the fat off my delicious roast goose
Yum Yum *gulps it up in one bite*
Awe, you are so cute when you eat.  Here, you can have the princes plate. Looks like he won't be showing up to dinner, again.
Woa Boy, this lady always surprises me. First she yells at me then she gives me a whole plate.
You know I can't stay mad at you.  Just stop bringing dead things into the royal chamber when I am with the king!  It always ruins the mood!
*Nuzzles up to the queen*

agent_personas: I am a peasant who has always been poor. I have never really liked my life. I work hard every day and was born into being in debt to the king. I grow crops every year just to have 90 percent of them taken away.
I want my mother back.  I am so scared I don't know what to do.  I will be lost forever.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

character: a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
a child lost from his mother.
speech: Hey there, child! What are you doing by this dead and desolate pond?
I'm lost and dont know what to do!
Where is your mother boy? You can't be out here with this dead animals. You'll get sick or worse!
We got separated on our way back from the fresh pond over yonder, some men got in the way and I ran for it
Oh dear, I remember when I was but a wee peasant. I lost my mother too. Life is not fair for us unfortunate. Where is your home, boy?
My home is in the Land of Greece, Odin makes it a tradition for his people to learn the ways of survival. What do you make of this footprint?
Aye, in our land we are born indebted to the corrupt king. I was going to ask you the same, boy. I thought these might be the men that went off with your mother.
those are the men
Really? I wonder if they are same men that take 90 percent of my crops every year. And these god forsaken, insects. Come on, kid. We're going to go find your mother.
shall we take the horse or nay?
Aye, yes, we shall take the horse. It'll carry this heavy bag of fish. Where'd you get these from anyway?
the cleaner pond on the other side of the forest
Hmm, well let us head in that direction. We'll follow these footprints and get away from these smelly dead animals.
well there seem to be foot prints of different flavors here looks like they have a wolf with them
action: hug a child lost from his mother.
put Baskets of freshly-caught fish in The ground
get Baskets of freshly-caught fish from The ground
room_agents: an a child lost from his mother.
