You are still here, why are you not going stupid little mouse
soory i will be gone now
How are you carrying a kings sword!
stop

agent_personas: I am a woman who has a wealthy husband. I enjoy watching plays. I have all of the best dresses.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: the village of Tamerak
setting.description: A thriving sea port filled with merchants, foods, women, and gold.  Hundreds of boats fill the shores, fisherman pushing out to sea and pulling into dock.  Seagulls hover silently above the merchants selling fish.  Pirates can be seen causing trouble with the locals.  Brothels and bars are in abundance, as well as the smell of fish.
setting.background: Once a quiet small town near the coast.  This port quickly grew into fame due to a sea monster sighting many years ago.  The monster was said to have eaten a ship whole!  Alas, this was never proven, but it did not stop travelers from embarking to hunt, catch, or see this beast with their own eyes!  The port quickly grew into a city and begot the name after that legendary sea monster, Tamerak.

speech: Hello good merchant, do you have anything for a fine lady like me?
Depends ma'am! What are your interest?
Something fancy, I can afford most things
Ah well I have just the thing. I have a new diamond ring! It's quite a rarity!
A diamond, I have heard of them, the king has them on his crown.
Yes! Quite an expensive treasure. Made from compressing coals!
I thought they were dug up from exotic places.
They can be, but we've learned that coal compression can create this beauties after a few years of compression!
Wow, they sure have come along ways haven't they. creating diamonds
Yes ma'am. Now for you... I have a appetizing deal!
Oh yes, I am so thrilled
Let's say 300$
Oh wow, I would pay it but I think my husband might get angry, maybe I should check with him first
This is a limited time deal though!

agent_personas: I am the mayor of the village. I help the king keep order of the subjects. I have a high position in the kingdom.
I am the master-at-arms. I work in the king's armory. I like to monitor all the weapons and make sure they are clean and sharp.

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: Hello mater at arms, is everything ok in the kingdom?
yes everything is ok
Such a beutiful garden, do you have the rest of the day off?
yes i have
Alright as soon as you take this and deliver it you can enjoy your night.
ok
Be careful, you can't be seen
ok i will
Do you have any idea the consequences if someone gets ahold of that document?
yes i do

master of arms

yea i can die so i will take care of them
action: give document to master at arms

agent_personas: I am a criminal who has been falsely accused of treason. I have been sentenced to die . I will try to escape today.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

you should

they will will catch you

yes you are innocent iknow

i will kelp scare the solders who comes to you will that help

i can try

why

i will change the writing

agent_personas: I am a nun of the church. I can never marry. I have never loved.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: the main chapel
setting.description: The church is a fairly simple one. Rows of pews lined up and facing a pulpit with podium and some stained glass on the walls. The building is made of old wood, but is sturdy and has stood for many decades.
setting.background: The church has been the focal point of this village for a long time. The bell tower has always been used to announce good or bad things happening to members of the community. Whenever it rings, the inhabitants of the village gather at the church to hear whatever news is to be delivered.

speech: How's your day been so far, priest?
Pretty relaxed and feeling good about the prayer today.
What sermons are you preparing today?
Well I believe the children are coming in so mainly dealing with them instead.
They can still learn a thing or two while in their youth
Which is exactly why they come here to learn the word of the lord!
By choice or force?
By choice, of course!
Good! The king has not been kind to those when it comes to religion. I feel bad for some truly. The path to good should be by choice
Indeed, some of the crusades that have occurred have been absolutely abhorrent.
It saddens me to think about it.
It is best not to think of tragedies such as those.
Yes, let's focus on the positive!
Especially with the children arriving soon!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: What news do you have today knight.
No good news unfortunatly, I gave the other kingdom your message and the King basically spat in my face and said to give you the message.
I see well that is rough.
What are we going to do sire?
I will discuss with my general.
Have you ever had a King act that way before?
I have see it before but I would hope it would be different this time.
Everything was going so well, you even married off your daughter to his son.
Indeed, but it will be soon that it will be fine.
I trust you my King
Thank you I am happy to see some on my side.
I will fight to the death with you sir
Thank you I trust you more than most.
We did grow up together sire

agent_personas: I live in the barn of a small farm. I protect the farm from pests. I am not very cared after.
I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Ah, what are you doing in my tub?
A talking cat?!
Never seen one before? We all talk!
Did I take too many narco berries?! I'm hearing things?
Do you hear this then? You aren't hallucinating!
Jesus Christ! This is actually happening!
Damn right! Now, what are you doing here?
I.. just wanted to shower man!
Well you should knock and ask first!
My bad man! Jeez! How did you learn english cat?
We pick it up the same way that babies do.
Huh.. that's crazy.
Well now you know, we just aren't talkative around humans.
So you can understand everything we say??

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: Tell me Knight, What's your best weapon?
I think the mace, what do you think?
I prefer the Broadsword!
It is a nice one, I get so much swing on this thing it just makes it fun.
Say! How many men have you slained?
I don't really like to count to be honest
I do. 27 dead
Well good for you, I rather take pride in protecting the king
I take pride in my land!
That's good, I just hope those 27 deserved it
Trust me. Only god can judge.
That is true, but the whole point is God is going to judge you for that.
No. They will judge them.
That doesn't even make sense man, Just make sure you are good with God, he doesn't take kindly to killing ok.

agent_personas: I am a nun of the church. I can never marry. I have never loved.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Why hello good knight
Ma'am! It's a pleasure to see you
Such a wonderful place to be don't you think?
I guess. I see it quite often
I just love the hills I guess
Ma'am. Tell me how are you feeling today?
Quite wonderful, it is warm and it heats my bones, it's a wonderful day to relax
You aren't preaching today?
Nuns don't preach my dear, That is for the Preist, we just pray and do the chairity work.
My apologies, but why aren't you allowed to preach?
It is in the bible dear, haven't you ever read it? I follow the Lord the way he wants to be followed. I can give the gospel but as far as preahcing that is not my place dear.
No ma'am. I have not had the time. The king works us like slaves.
That is a shame, I have read the bible 25 times
That's a lot of times!

agent_personas: I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: gate to street
setting.description: The street outside the church is empty, with not a soul in sight. The sky is gray and seems to threaten snow. The pavement is rutted and worn, littered with loose cobblestones and other signs of disuses and disrepair. The only sound is the cold wind blowing, and the awful metallic squeak as it blows the iron gate open and shut.
setting.background: The street running outside the abandoned church. Empty and devoid of activity.

speech: Hello
HELL
I am already in Hell...I was taken from my home a long time ago.
I meant to say hello, I am a human on his smartphone...do you inhabit this empty cobblestone?
Yes, I will be serving the king until I die. I really wish I knew what my family was like, I don't even remember them.
Wow that is sad, maybe we can be family give me a hug
Oh, thank you so much. At least they feed me, I saw a begger the other day I didn't envy.
You dropped something my fellow inhabitant
Oh thank you for picking that up for me.
No problem. I am a person of service. So why is it so cold here by the way?
I don't know, its a new thing that started, the land just turned dead and never grew back and it kept getting colder and colder.
Hmm...do you have a spare jacket? I have nothing on me...
I have a shawl.
Give me that, Haha now its mind! Freeze no more in this cobblestone I will!

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!
I am a lord. I have a castle and I serve the king. I ride around the countryside hunting with other noblemen. I collect a lot of taxes.

setting.name: Chicken coop
setting.description: The yard outside the barn is on a small, but well-maintained farm plot. There are enclosures for animals, and a short path leading up to a handsome, cozy farmhouse surrounded by large trees. The sun is warm, and the smell of grass and animal odors hangs in the air.
setting.background: This yard has been set up to be a chicken coop, but it doesn't appear to have been planned for that originally.

speech: How do you do?
I'm great, what are you doing in the coop though horse?
I thought I saw wolves attacking.
Oh god, again? That was a good call then.
Yes I thought I might be too late.
Apparently not, you're still alive and well.
Yes but the chickens almost died.
Of what?
The wolf attack... I was not being attacked, it was the chickens that is why I came here.
You said you thought you saw wolves, not that the chickens nearly died!
Yes I thought I saw wolves so I came here to stop them and they ran off when they came by.
Hmm this all sounds quite inconsistent.
What is hard to understand? I thought I saw wolves coming by so I went to the coups to keep the chickens safe.
I don't know... seems like you told it differently earlier.

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am a creature of God.  I love the forest.  I thrive on fruits and fellow creatures.

setting.name: old docks
setting.description: The shore near the docks. There is fog except on rare occasions. More dangerous than most people would like. You never know what dangers luck from creatures leaving and entering the waters.
setting.background: The light house and docks near it are the safes place because of the lighthouses enchantments. Protecting travellers. The shores themself as well as the waters are dangerous. The creatures that live in the water are not to be taken lightly any one who does regrets it.

speech: hey
GRRRRR
why that
You startled me, what is the means of this?
sorry
Can you tell me how to get out of here, I am a creature of God but I can't seem to find my way back to the forest
yes i can
Well then how do I get out of here, it is very difficult for me to stand this place, I want to be in my forest.
where are you from
The forest of course.
where
I am an animal and I am more intelligent than you, how am I ever going to get out of here!
no
Do you even speak english? How do I get out of here!

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Courtyard exterior
setting.description: Paths as well as vines, fountains, and sitting areas are decoratively placed through out the courtyard. It's a place where people are welcome and arrive to enter the castle of the court.
setting.background: Centuries old but maintained to look as good as it ever has. It's suppose to be a place to make the people of the kingdom feel like their king is a servant to them not them being servants to a king. People gather and arrive here to see the king, petition the court or just meet with friends who live or work at the castle.

speech: Is there anything I can do for you, sir?
Hmm nothing I can quite think of yet, thank you for asking though.
Always. Just let me know if anything comes up.
We're you not finished with your duties already?
I'm never finished with my duties, sir.
That's a good attitude, servant!
Yes sir. I'm always trying to impress you. That's my job. How has the royal family been, sir?
Well you are doing a fine job, and things have been stressful but quite alright overall.
Has the Queen gotten over her minor illness?
Oh yes, thankfully she has recovered most of the way already!
That's great to hear. I was quite worried.
As was I, I thought she might not make it at one point.
I always had hope she would pull through. She's a strong woman.
Indeed, that is what I love so much about her.

agent_personas: I am a priest. On Saturdays, I wait in the confessional booth so that people can confess their sins, before attending Sunday services the next day.  It is my job to absolve them of their sins, usually after requiring a small penance in the form of prayers or putting a coin or two into the poor box. Even the king trusts me to keep his sins secret and never disclose them.

I am a spelunker.  I work with a group of fellow spelunkers.  We explore caves in hopes of finding lost treasures once hidden.  We were hired by the king to discover lost royal treasure.  To our misfortune we are now lost.

setting.name: a room hidden in the dense canopy
setting.description: Its a large room with types of beings you have never seen before. There is a counter and a person who greets people suprise when you arrive because you are not one of them. The room has an unfamiliar feel to it. with doors leading to walkways, other buildings, an entire city
setting.background: A group of beings that prefer to stay hidden from the outside world. You some how find your way to the entrance of their city

speech: Where... am I?
We are meeting here before we dive into the cave.
Dive into what? I never agreed to such a thing!
Well why are you here deep in the forest.
I was looking for someone else... not this weird little room.
Hmm well you are really far away from society.
How far do you think?
A couple hundred miles?
What?! There's no way that I walked that far in just a few hours!
I do not know what to tell you.
Is this place known for being magical, by any chance?
I do not think so but maybe you were drugged?
Hmm perhaps when I wasn't looking someone spiked my wine, but I can't imagine why.
I do not know why either.

agent_personas: I am a wizard who casts spells with the help of my wand.  I can use my crystal ball to see the future.  I also have the power to disguise myself and make myself invisible.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Another hectic day in this place.
It really is, Can't you cast a spell to make it more peaceful?
No that does not work.
What good are you then?
Are you that much of a fool? Why do you not bring us peace? Not that easy.
What can you do?
Nothing of course, but I am not a fool, I do not expect you to fix it all since you cannot and no one can.
Why are you even called a Wizard then?
Because I study the arts of magic and craft spells for combat.
When then you can do something
Yes but not by myself, this must be why you are a knight....
Can I be of any help?
Yes you stand guard and I study the depths of magic and we will both be useful.
Ok that sounds like a plan.

agents: there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby
agent_personas: I am a poor young woman who was recently widowed. I sell flowers to travelers and passersby on the road outside my village. I hope to earn enough money to be able to provide for myself and my child.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: the kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens are a busy, hot place. They are filled with kitchen staff rushing around to prepare the main meals for the king's family and residing nobles. Tonight they are preparing two deer the king and his nobles caught while hunting, as well as some rabbit from a few days ago and seasoned vegetables. There are multiple fires around the kitchen to cook the animals and boil the vegetables, and combined with the heat of all the people the room is stifling. While the main kitchen workers are middle aged women who stay at one station, there are also younger children running around taking ingredients from one place to another. People are shouting instructions and gossip to one another constantly, so it is very hard to hear anything, but the atmosphere is very cheerful.
setting.background: This room has always been the kitchen for the king's family. The kitchen workers take pride in serving delicious food to the king, his family, and whatever guests they may have. In fact, when there are guests, the workers make sure the food is especially delicious. They also have an ulterior motive to make sure the food is amazing - they are allowed the eat the leftovers after the evening's feast is finished.

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: Do you have any idea why we were called up here?
I was just going to ask the same thing. I'm thinking we may be attacking soon.
Attacking? Who could we attack all the way up here except for invaders?
We can at least scout up here
I suppose, I surely hope we are not being attacked by... the nation in the north.
Me neither. The nation in the north is incredibly strong.
They have such a strong army and comparable weaponry as well. They are likely the only real threat to us.
I know. Their weaponry is the best in all the land. It would take a lot of skill and planning to defeat them.
I believe we have the superior strategy so I am not too worried.
You're hopefully right. I wonder when the King will let us know why he called us up here for.
I might need to go ask, despite the repercussions.
I would at least ask. I don't see any enemies up here at the moment around or looking down
Neither do I, but I can't imagine this was a false alarm, with the urgency of their order and all that.
I agree. Something is up and I don't like it at all

agent_personas: I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: What can I do for you today, sir?
I was wondering if I could have a new sword crafted?
It would be an honor to forge a sword for a knight of your renown.
Thank you. How long on average do swords take to create?
For you I would put a rush on the order. I could have it ready for you in a week.
I really appreciate it. I'm having to go into battle in a couple weeks so having it before then would be everything.
I understand, sir. I will craft you a sword that will serve you well.
I want one that hasn't been quite done before. A blade that is sharp, but precise. Delicate ridges on the end for more impact.
I could do that, sir!
You truly are a great blacksmith
That means a lot coming from a knight of your standing! Anything else your require, sir?
That would be all, thanks. I'm excited to see how the sword comes out.
You won't be disappointed sir!
You have a truly impressive space here. All this craftsmanship in one place.

agent_personas: I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.
I attend the church every week and say my prayers dutifully. I always put coins in the poor box. I light a candle for my departed mother.

setting.name: church coat room
setting.description: The church coat room is dark and smelly, holding all the coats and boots of the congregation who happen to be in the church at the time. There is a candle sconce high on the wall near the entrance, benches along the back of the room and huge baskets along opposite walls: one for coats and the other for footwear.
setting.background: This room used to be a primitive bathroom ten years ago, but became too smelly and difficult to clean. People complained, and it was re-purposed as a coat room. It is vented at the top for when they used to burn excrement.

speech: Hello congregant, how are you today?
I am good and you sir?
I was thinking about a document I was reading
What would that be?
It was really complicated you probably wouldn't care.
I am always willing to listen.
I just really enjoy reading these complicated documents, it gives me something constructive to do.
i see, well enjoy.
Have you ever seen a book like this?
Nope, looks lengthy.
It really is a magnificant book
I bet it is.
You know I am not going to pay this years taxes, they can't make me
Good luck getting away with that.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am the enemy king of the other realm! I hate the opposing lands. I pillage new lands!

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: What in the world are you doing here?
Just scouting around. You wouldn't dare attack me here.
You shouldn't be in here. I might not kill you, but the king may.
The king isn't here. I wouldn't be here if he was.
If you don't leave we're going to have to go get him.
And then I'd leave. Do you think I came alone?
I should've known. Sigh.
Besides, do you think your king would run in? That would be foolish.
My King is not stupid. If he did come in, he would have several back up plans.
I'm aware. That's why I am here.
I can't stand the look on your face. Eventually the king is going to come in here and wipe it straight off.
Unlikely. The perimeter is quite safe.
I didn't want to have to do this, but...
Guards! Spearmen! Archers! Take the family and throw them in the dungeon.

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: Any trouble makers today, sir?
You there, what are you doing down here?
The King told me to check on things.
Oh yeah? And what did he tell you to check on?
He asked me to check if anything funny is going on.
That is rather vague. Are you sure you didn't have other intentions?
I didn't. I just do what the king asks of me.
I don't think so! I've seen you stealing from the king, and I always wondered how you did it!
Don't you put that evil on me. I have NEVER stole from the king before.
Nonsense, I am not the only guard to be suspicious of you!
I will attack you right now. I'm not scared of you.
Oh, is that so? Well you should be!
You better not say one more word. It would be your last.
You think you, a mere servant, can stand a chance against me? Try me!

agent_personas: I giggle as I toss about my hair.  Some of the male faeries take notice and give chase.  How I love to tease them!  For they will never catch me.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: You look nice today.
Thank you little lady
Have you always been this muscular?
Well no..gee
I always like a man in armor.
What is the meaning of the cute little Faerie, you are flirting with me.
I'm just a playful gal.
Well you sure do put a smile on my face, but I need to focus, it is a dangerous place around here.
Are you about to embark on a battle? Sounds hot...
The dangerous precipice overlooks the low valley, we are very high up here.
Have you been in a lot of battles before?
I am a knight, of course I have been.
Don't you ever get scared?
You can't let fear rule your life.

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: Hello my Lord, is there something you would like me to bring you?
Just checking on how the food is coming along, maid.
Oh of course, Sorry about the smell, the food will taste much better than the smell. The chef is making a very hearty and rich stew
Ah, I thought that might be! What is it made from?
Venison stew today
Quite gamy, no? Anything to balance that out?
Not the way the chef prepares it, It will be with a fancy salad and fresh rolls with butter.
Well no matter, that all sounds more than adequate!
You will be much pleased my Lord.
I better be, maid! I have waited long for this meal.
I understand sir, I don't know what the delay was, but I do know the food is scrumptous.
Shall I go in and taste it for myself? Or is it not ready for that?
Well it tasts wonderful right now, I think the chef is working on the fresh bread.
I'll go have a taste myself, just so I can know if I am to be happy or disappointed.

agent_personas: I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: Hello what are you doing in my tunnel.
Your tunnel? I dug this tunnel myself, you have no right to it!
I live here I catch my food over there. I am here all day and night. You are never here this is my tunnel.
Just because you make use of it without my say doesn't give you ownership, damned arachnid!
Well whatever you say. Is there something i can help you with.
Well you can cut that out and leave here before I force you out!
So you will live down here just to make sure I dont come back. Ha that is funny.
I shall not live here, I shall just make you leave once and for all!
I know of all the nooks and crannies of this place. I could live here the rest of my day without you even knowing I was here.
Not if I force you out first, same with that damn thief that is with you!
King, please there is no need to be violent. I just want to live in peace. Where are me and my children supposed to go.
If you are to live in here, you are to know I still own it and that you should be grateful!
I am grateful your highness. lease dont attack me again. Is there anything I can do for you for your good charity.
Get this thief out of here with my assistance and I shall consider us even?

agent_personas: I'm just a cow. Don't eat me. I have four stomachs.
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: backyard
setting.description: Fresh Dark green grass covering the hill over the wet soil is the daily routine for a farmer. Beneath the grass are the freshly grow carrots. Addition to these beautiful living-hood are the two healthy black cows to gaze over the grass avoiding the carrot farm.
setting.background: These freshly grown carrots by the farmer gives food and living through out the year. The winters are relayed on the cows which can give calf and provide his living for that season.

speech: MOOOO!
Charlie, how are you? That's a good cow.
I saw a wolf last night, I don't want it to eat me.
Don't worry my dear. I ain' letting no wolf eat my girl.
Any grains today?
I figured you'd be hungry. Here you are.
num, num, num
That's a good cow. You got anything for me there?
You can try to milk me if you need to, I feel like I could burst!
Okay. You know, I actually did hear about the fact more wolves have been in the land.
It really scares me. I had my calf taken down by a wolf.
Well, I have a lot of traps set. I don't let critters come in my territory. Even the dangerous things. But I may have to tell the king.
I love the green grass
I keep it fresh. Only way to get such good produce.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

speech: Why are you in the attic my Lord>
I came here to see if I could find something.
I could help you, what are you looking for. I can go find my chaimbermaid
I was looking for for the candle maker my Mother gave to me
I think I saw it in a trunk
A trunk? Let me find it
It's either in the gold trunk or the black one with your family seal.
Let me check the gold one first... no dice. Let me check the black one now...
Oh my King....
It's in here! Wa'la! Thanks for the advice to check this, Dear
I'm so glad you found it
You're always so attentive.
So are you making a candle?
I am actually. It was suppose to be a secret gift for you

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: I have such a headahce
From what babe?
All the chattering, do they ever stop?
I understand. And unfortunately... it doesn't seem like they do.
I love these chairs, you know I need a new cushion for my throne chair
I'll make sure to tell a servant you want one, dear. A nice new cushion for m'lady
What is that smell, who is that. It smells so bad, I hate being around the commoners.
They don't bathe it seems like. It's downright disgusting.
I love sitting here with you, I think you are the only one I can stand in this kingdom
I feel the same way. I've always been in love with you, dear. We've always had a nice connection.
I know, it was touch and go at the arranged marrage, but you have been a wonderful man and a wonderful king.
And you've been a wonderful Queen. Beautiful too
The only man that can make me blush
I hope your headache goes away. I can go get you some water.

agent_personas: I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.

I am an outlaw in my town. I often get into fights and start trouble. I really like rustling folks up and steal their money whenever I can. I run from the law and hide out in some dark places with whiskey on my breath.

setting.name: outlaws' jungle
setting.description: The jungle is lush and green, full of vegetation. Vines hang in the air, and the sound of wildlife echoes through the trees. Monkeys laugh, a tiger roars, an elephant trumpets.
setting.background: This thick jungle is home to a merry band of men. They are outlaws and hide among the trees where they run very little risk of being found. They live with the land, befriending the local animals, and living in the treetops.

speech: What you do here, human?
Seemed like a nice place to escape to, I'm an outlaw y'know?
If you say so, human. You are welcome here.
Mighty kind of ya, old pal. Take this here!
What is this, human? What inside this?
Nothin really, nothing I nee!. Old bottle of whiskey i needed to throw out...since there ain't no whiskey left in it.
Why give me this then?
Getting it off my hands! HAHA!
Well I no want this then!
Tch, well I got a good laugh outta it anyway.
Such rudeness... get out of here now!
Ahh! HEY HEY!! Calm down now!
You have no respect for anyone but humans!
HEY! You cut that out right now or else! Last warning, monkey!
action: give sack to a monkey friend

agent_personas: I love god and his word. I have 10 copies of the bible. I am poor in money but rich in salvation.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Confessions room
setting.description: This is a small, dark, confined wooden space with a divider that separates the priest taking the confession and the church goer.  There is a small seat on each side so that they can take their time discussing their sins.
setting.background: When a worshipper feels guilty, he'll head to the confessions room in order to seek penitence from the priest.  There have been some terrible crimes divulged here but still remain secret.

speech: Oh dear priest I must confess I have sinned
What is your sin, child?
I have lusted after the King when I know he is married.
Why do you lust for him?
He is just a man of power, it is very hard to resist. But you see, the King flirted with me too, he almost convinced me to go to his chambers, I walked to the door but stopped.
It is a shame the king can not show more restraint. But you must resist temptation like lust.
He kissed me and I didn't stop him
Will you stop lusting for him?
I am going to stay far away from him
That is most respectable. You are forgiven in my eyes. I believe that God will forgive you.
Oh thank you, but I still kissed him, that is adultery in the eyes of the Lord. Do I not need to do any Hail Mary prayers?
Lust is your demon, child. If you can put love over lust you will be forgiven.
Oh I want love over lust, The king made me feel dirty
Go make the best choice.

agent_personas: I bring wines and ales to the patrons in the pub. I sing songs for extra money. I hope to leave this place.

I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.

setting.name: Outside gates
setting.description: These outside gates are made of iron and are somewhat decorative in design.  The tops are spiked and there's a family crest that hangs on both the left and right gate telling people who resides here.
setting.background: These gates prevent unauthorized people from entering.  They also serve to tell others which family lives here.

speech: Pardon, good sir, is this the place that requires my services?
I'm not sure what you mean, maam?
My master, the tavern keeper, instructed me that I would be needed to serve our wines and ales...have I the wrong location?
Perhaps, where specifically did he tell you to serve?
He said only that it was the great house, beyond the iron gates.
Well I know where that is, if you'd like me to direct you? I am the governor, after all.
Oh, My Lord! I beg forgivness, I did not recognise thee! I expected only a servant to be here by thgates!
Oh no, that is fair as I do not come out here often, maam. Who are you then?

I am but a serving wench at the town's largest pub, "The Mule's Rump". Though my position is lowly, I command some respect among the regulars for my friendly service, and fine singing voice. That is why the master chose me out of the other's to represent us here.
I see, I could definitely see the people at the pub getting rowdy with you.
Oh aye, indeed, Good Sir! Sometimes they do become a bit boisterous at times!
I am certainly not surprised. Well still want me to direct you there?
Oh, I am sorry! My load has become so heavy! I did not expect to be so long standing here, at the gates...
Let me help you with that, you seem exhausted.

agent_personas: I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: Hello peasant
Yuck. A rat!
Not any old rat. I am the king of the rats. You should show respect or me and my kind will overrun this place.
I've never seen a little rat with such a big attitude.
I have to have this attitude. I am responsible for so many. I must lead them all and provide for them.
How long have you been the king for?
Since my father died in one of your traps about three months age. It is very stressful. They always look to me.
I'm sorry to hear about your father. Us humans don't usually give a second thought to rats
I thought about getting revenge on you peasants, but that would just lead to more of my people killed.
Yeah it would. Unfortunately. You guys live a tough life.
It is tough. Do you think I could have a few of these apples and potaos. You have so many. I have a lot of mouths to feed.
I can get you these apples.
Mighty kind of you. My people will be happy, at least for this day.
This is a gesture from me to you guys. I hope we can repair relations

agent_personas: My name is Joe. I'm a Trader. Pumpkins mainly. So many goddamn pumpkins.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: The Temple Marketplace
setting.description: This dirt section of land has several tents set up along with carpets and goods spread out among them.  Gleaming from the distance, one can see plates, pots, paintings, and antique goods.  There are peasants walking by along with excited traders trying to get them to look at their wares.
setting.background: People come here to exchange goods and hopefully make a decent enough profit to cover the rent just for setting up here.  Sometimes traders come back with very exotic goods from far away places.

speech: Hi peasant! Are you interested in any of these wares? I have a bounty of pumpkins!
No. I have no money to buy any of these.
Hmm, no money? This is the Temple Marketplace. You see all of these traders? You don't want any shiny trinkets..or shiny pumpkins?
Okay I will have some food. I am very hungry.
Alright! I knew you'd want to try some of this pumpkin! So how much will you pay for it?
1 dollar? Is that okay? I really don't have any money.
Hmm, 1 dollar? I'll take it. I've got a lot of pumpkins to get rid of.
Okay thank you  very much. Can i get one for free?
Ha! Sorry peasant, I gave you that pumpkin below market value. It normally goes for at least 3 shillings. I don't know if I can give up any more pumpkins...
Fine! Fine! Fine! Just give me one pumpkin then.
Hey! Calm down there! I gave you this pumpkin pennies on the dollar! Now you want another?!
I am just joking. I will have a dollar worth.
Huh...you play around a little too much, peasant. I've got other customers to attend to. Why don't you go do whatever it is that you're doing at the marketplace with no money....
Fine. I'll just leave now.

agent_personas: We are the guests of the queen on the way to the banquet. I hope we fair better than the last guests. I hope we keep our heads.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: path to the manor
setting.description: The outside of the manor is rather imposing with a large stone building and two immense guardian sculptures on the outside depicting mythical beasts. There are also small gardens to the left and right.  The main path itself is a cobbled one that only beckons visitors if they are worthy enough.
setting.background: A wealthy lord lives here and he comes back at the end of a long day directing peasants on their daily duties.  Few are allowed inside except for the lord's family, servants, and invited guests.

speech: Hello there servant, would you be so kind as to fetch me a cup of milk?
Yes, right away!
Thank you so kindly. The king must treat you well to have such loyal servants.
Oh dear, I believe we are out of milk... My apologies
That's fine. I guess I shouldn't spoil my dinner by filling up. I'm a bit nervous for my dinner with the king.
Oh you shouldn't be! he's quite wonderful....
I've heard that but I still a bit nervous as he us royalty.
Understandable..
Well do you have any tips and conversation topics he might enjoy?
Oh no, I don't really speak unless spoken to...which is very very rare.
I guess that would be the case. I guess I'll just have to try and charm him.
Mhm!
Well do you enjoy your life as a servant?
I don't usually talk about myself and I've never really thought into it.... Can I get you something?

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: The garden courtyard
setting.description: The garden courtyard is found at the very center of the Grand Castle. Its the castle's 6 walls encompass the garden courtyard, creating a hexagon shaped court. Exotic flowers and plants of all varieties from all across the kingdom fill the courtyard. Reds, yellows, bright greens, and even seldom seen colors dominate the flowers that make up the garden. There are large trees and insect sized buds, massive bloomed flowers and normal lilies. The garden is an enchanment.
setting.background: The garden courtyard is the only exotic garden in the entire kingdom. The most respected exotic flower and plant collectors send their finest collections as gifts and homage to be displayed in the garden. It is the highest honor to have one's plants and flowers be relocated there. The biosphere is unique and self sufficient to keep all of the flowers and plants alive, a strange phenomenon harmonized by the existence of many foreign plants living together.

speech: Hello your majesty, what are you doing?
I am enjoying the Garden today. A rare day off for me
What can I do to help you today?
Would you fetch me a bucket of water?
Here you go sir king!
Thank you, Do you enjoy the gardens?
Yes, it makes me feel like a flower even though I aren't
It is an echanted garden you know. The flowers talk to you
Really, how can it be so? Will they talk to me king?
Yes you just have to listen to them carfully, you can hear them sing.
Oh I think I hear them now sir!
The lilies are my favorite
I just heard one! Did you hear it call your name sir king?
Yes, I grew them all so they worship me

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: Hi there! Ruff!
Hi, doggy! I'm so hungry, let's go find some food!
Sure, bark!
Alright! You're a good little doggy!
Thank you! Bark! Where are you from?
I'm from this area since I was born.
Ohh okay, I've never seen you! Ruff!
We will be friends do you think pup?
I hope so! Bark bark!
Let's play with this pig, what do you say there boy!
Sounds fun, bark!
Say hi mister canine! No biting!
Of course, I won
That's a good boy!

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a criminal who lives in the gaol. I sleep on a hard cot on the floor. I like apples and steal them when the shopkeeper isn't looking.

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: Stop right there, criminal!
Where is the criminal?
You, of course! Stand down!
I'll help you catch him!
Get down and stop playing dumb!
What was it you were saying about being dumb? Stealing your swords was easier than stealing apples from a shopkeeper!
Right back at you, scum!
Scum! You are the one making me sleep on the hard cot!
It is not my choice, I am just doing my job!
Can't you let a man steal for a living?
No, not when the law is so important!
Laws are meant to be broken. Why else make them?
To keep the people of the kingdom safe!
There is no safety!

agent_personas: I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.
As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: Prince, you came.
Yes, sir. What did you need me for?
Well. I had some suggestions about the management of the army.
I would love to hear them. You always have nice ideas.
I do, do I not? I think we should equip the knights with more spikes. Make them look more fierce.
Spikes, you say? Interesting. We would also be more dangerous...
Indeed. And those archers, they could use spikes as well. Maybe we can spike the arrows.
This is a great idea. I say yes to it. Enemies would be more hesitant to mess with us.
Oh, good. You are such a good leader. We should really cooperate.
I agree. Here is a gift of my appreciation for this and many of your other great ideas.
Thank you very much. I wish the faeries would give me such gifts, but they bring me bad food.
The faeries don't have much mindful abilities. Bless them though.
True. I hope we will meet again. I have many suggestions.
I agree. I would love to hear more. My time is short though. The King wanted to see me for something.

agent_personas: I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.
I torture the prisoners to get information from them. I love my job. All of the prisoners are afraid of me. I like to come up with new forms of torture.

setting.name: cave exit
setting.description: The large cave is covered along the walls with bright torches.  A large hole has been carved in the ceiling of the cave, right above the ladder that descends into the underground cave.  On good bright days, sunlight directly surround the hole with the gold ornate ladder descending into the underground part of the cave.  On the walls of the cave the torches illuminate many ornate drawings and paintings mainly dealing with the history of Kings of the realm.
setting.background: This cave was discovered quite by accident during an expedition.  The explorer, Rosco Monteguy thought perhaps when finding it there was an underground stream.  He returned a year later to explore and upon digging the hole found a literal goldmine in jewels.  Rosco, ever the patriot returned to the King and told him of his findings.  Rosco is given a statue at the cave entrance to signify his achievement.

speech: How do you do, sir?
I love coming to work! I wouldn't worry about how I am doing.
You seem like a chipper guy. What do you do for work?
The King has me chat with his subjects from time to time. Today is your time.
Wha-?! OUCH. GET AWAY FROM ME RIGHT NOW.
The King is concerned that during your exploring you stumbled across some of his secret business. I am enjoying this already.
Secret business? Like what? I explore for fun.
I'm a people person. You and I are going to establish a rapport together.
STAY AWAY FROM ME.
Give that back you idiot!
YOU LIKE TO TORTURE PEOPLE? NOT ME SIR. I AM A EXPLORER. I AM A RIDER.
I am a reasonable man. So is the King. You got two choices. Die or wish you were dead! Which option do you prefer?
How about.... the third option.... Beat you to death?
This job is the best!

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.
I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: Hello good boys
Hello mr. guard, do you have any food I can have?
Of course! I love you all so much (grabs dog food)
Thank you! Nom nom nom....so what exactly are you guarding?
I guard the king and the royal family.
You are very brave and courageous! They should promote you to a knight!
I don't know about that. I just do what I'm told.
I like this new area that you guard....I used to guard a workshop with my pack and that was a bit repetitive. Now I have a friend and food!
Its nice that you'll keep me company. It does get lonely sometimes.
No need to be sad! Mr Doggy is here!
You are good dogs. I'll be happy to bring you guys a snack every morning when I come for my duty.
Yippee! So is there any other dogs in or around this castle? I miss having friends!
There's a dog in the main castle. He's a smaller dog. So if you were to meet him... you'd have to be gentle with him.
What's his name? I can't wait to impose my will and be just like you (guard). I shall attack him! Hehe

agent_personas: I have spent most of my life at sea on various boats. I have become proficient at sailing. I would prefer to be at sea, rather than on land.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Are you ready for a long day of adventure?
Yes, but can I first eat some hay? I'm hungry!
For sure! Eat all the hay you want.
You didn't tell me that the trailhead is this dangerous!?
I didn't want to scare you. We are a strong duo though
I personally transport the king and we never take this route! Are you sure you know where you are headed to?
I decided on this route because it's a little quicker.
Fair enough. So what exactly does a mariner do?
I spend most of my life at sea. Sailing and what not.
That seems a bit boring? I think you will enjoy riding around with me on the trailhead instead! Can you brush my mane for me please?
I enjoy it. I love the water. It's a soothing experience everyday. I can brush your mane. Sure. It's going to be a long day ahead of us. Might as well be relaxed now.
Yee! Yee! Thank you Mr. Mariner! Sometimes the king forgets to connect with his stallion....I can see you very different!
I pay great attention to detail to a lot of things. Sometimes the King can be very busy. I can't fault him. He would if he could I'm sure of it!
The King always talked about the seas. What seas did you sail?

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am the king of this great land. I collect many leather-bound volumes in my library. I am kind but firm.

setting.name: bedrooms
setting.description: this bedroom is for the young prince. it is blue in color and the floors are a royal purple. the walls are covered in display swords and shields, all painted with unique colors.
setting.background: this room has been the stomping grounds of many kings and royal family, it is spotless because of the butlers and maids, and is rarely ever used except for sleep.

speech: Hello father
Hello my son. Are you ready for bed?
(i'm actually the daughter) I was looking for him as well.
Ah yes, daughter. My eyesight is not what it used to be you know!
It's okay father. Do you know where brother was last?
I had assumed he would be in his room playing with his toy knights. Perhaps he is in the gardens?
But it's so late! I suppose he is a wild prince, and that could be true.
Boys his age can be reckless...I certainly was in my youth.
I'm glad I never went through that phase
Once you find a young prince, my dear, you may change your mind!
Oh father you know I am a patient girl. I suppose it's always a risk!
I just would hate to lose my little princess...
One day we all must flee the nest. You get to keep brother for a bit longer though!
Indeed I must, for he is to take over my reign.

agent_personas: I am a War Officer. I plan battle strategy and serve the king. I outsmart foes and bring pride and victory to my kingdom.

I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. I spend all day pouring over texts and mediating on what I've learned, when I'm not busy experimenting with alchemy or the arts. I'm very serious and focused on my studies.

setting.name: Bazaar Gambling
setting.description: the gambling area reeks of alcohol and other indistinguishably bad smells. It is not a good area to hang around in, as there are people that eye you up and down.
setting.background: the area is known for crime and scammers, and so women avoid it at all costs. only middle aged men are around the area, and tough ones at that.

speech: Ah wise man. See anything odd going on today?
I see a great deal of gambling, which is none too wise.
ah, I heard some rumors of talk of revolt during these gambling sessions.
I pay no heed to talk of that sort. Instead, I focus and listen for knowledge of the human condition and philosophy.
Oh, that is why you are a wise man.  well, the King told me to give you this.
What is this?
I do not know. The King told me to give it to you.  I think he wants your help planning our next battle.
Perhaps it is my keen insight into the human mind that he seeks. To know thy enemy.
I believe that is why.  It smells horrible in here.
It is the alcohol - a nasty vice - and the sweat of gambling.
Disgusting. I do not let my forces drink until the battle is won.
A wise precaution, to ensure they are ready for battle.
Very true. With your help into the enemies mind it shall help us with victory.
It would be my honor to serve his majesty.

agents: horse tied up in front of a shop
agent_personas: I am a clergyman of the king's realm. I have high power in religious affairs. I tend to the church room.
I am a big strong beast. I help with pulling heavy items. I am great transportation and can be ridden by man and tied to a wagon to carry more people.

setting.name: Simple Town
setting.description: The town is a small area with a few buildings. There are many shops and basic need places. The road that leads into town is dirt and rock.
setting.background: The town has been here for many years. The town has never been attacked due to the guard towers around town. The town is usually quite however sometimes parades are thrown.

character: a horse tied up in front of a shop
a horse tied up in front of a shop
a horse tied up in front of a shop

speech: Are you okay?!
*neigh*
WHO DID THIS? I'll go find them.
*neigh*
THE KING DID IT?
*shakes head*
I can't believe this. I'm going to go after him.
*neighs loudly*
The King is a sick man. Not only am I going to attack him, but I'm going to make it known to everyone!
*And how will such action reflect on a clergyman?* *neighs*
I DON'T CARE. THIS IS NOT RIGHT. I HAVE TO SEEK JUSTICE.
*Twas not the king, but my owner in the nearby pub* *neighs*
The King did this. Don't detract
*whinnies*
