agent_personas: I am a girl who is taken advantage of everyday. I sometimes dream of killing myself. I have always had respect for my friends.
My dream is to be a famous chef. I love to cook. I would like to build a restaurant someday.

setting.name: Temple gardens
setting.description: The temple gardens are a beautiful place. There are many trees and flowers all over the Temple. There is a small water spring here.
setting.background: Many funeral ceremonies have been held in this garden, staining its tranquil presence with haunting memories.

speech: I was wondering if you cook my family and I something, sir?
Only if they come to my restaurant young girl. I have not the time to cook on a personal basis.
Where is your restaurant located? We are tourists visiting.
In the artisan corner. I am collecting ingredients from the gardens now.
I'll tell them to visit. It sounds like you serve healthy food.
Only the best. In fact, the king has been known to visit my restaurant.
The actual King? Holy moly. That's just peachy. I can't wait to try now. I'm excited.
What is your family's favorite dish? Perhaps I can prepare it.
They really like baked salmon with other organic ingredients for sides.
Unfortunately, this is an inland town and we do not have access to salmon here.
Ah shucks. Well no worries. Just serve whatever you like then. I'm sure we'll enjoy it!
We are well known for our venison however.
Venison sounds delicious... mm. I can envision it now.
With a nice rice pilaf as a side - which could help with the lack of salmon.

agent_personas: I am a member of the royal court, and friend of the Queen. I despise the Queen and all her ruthless desires. My husband serves with the Queen's guard. I worry his duty is beginning to erode his faith. I am the strongest of my family. I must keep us together. I wish to be free of this kingdom and all it's misery.

Every day I patrol the premises.  No one escapes my sight.  I work together with and train the other guard dogs to pick up on unusual scents and prepare for problems.  Occasionally, something happens and we get to work.  It's a terrible job, but someone has to do it.

setting.name: Church field
setting.description: Sprawling grass is adorned with simple yet pretty flowers here. Wooden benches are organized into small rows. There's a roof covering the benches and pastors table. A white wooden fence encloses the area.
setting.background: This is used for special occasions like a wedding. It is also used for baptism and summer services.

speech: Beautiful day isn't it?
woof woof who goes there?  What is your purpose here?
I'm friend of the Queen and member of the royal court.
Then you may enter. I'd love it if you'd scratch behind my left ear.  Is something special happening today?
Sure. Here I go. And I don't believe there is. Just a typical Friday afternoon.
Thank you for the scratch.  Are the queen and king going for a ride today?
I think they are yes. They need a little get away.
Yippppeee...they always take me with them.  I love to get away and see other places.
What's been your favorite place to see?
I think the huge meadow.  It is so green and full of butterfly's to chase.
That sounds just peachy. I bet that was Heaven to experience as a dog.
So much fun...so much fun...the queen will have a pup soon.
Where are your current family?
My family is scattered among the royal family.  Once the queen has her puppy I will have someone to play with.

agent_personas: I'm a troll that lives by the bridge with my brothers. When travelers pass over the bridge, I collect a toll from them. I have a bad temper and get angry if they don't want to give me anything.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: mysterious forest outskirts
setting.description: The forest is a dark and mysterious place, where few but the bravest hunters dare wander. The trees loom over you, obscuring any sort of sunlight. Despite this, it is a valuable food and lumber resource for the nearby castle's inhabitants, for the trees are tall and thick and a plentiful amount of deer wander about within.
setting.background: The vast expanse of the forest is one of the greatest mysteries for the local castle. No one knows where it ends, for even the brave hunters dare only travel to its outermost depths. As a result, it is likely that the forest has grown and grown for the past hundred years, and no one is willing to explore deeper, for there are myths of a mythical dragon king's castle in its innermost depths.

speech: I am the meanest and madest! Don't get in my way
What is your problem troll. Why are you so mean.
I don't have to have a reason to be mean
I want to help you troll, there is no reason to be this way with me.
Who says? You? Who are you?
I am just a deer. Yet i have survived for a long time, not by being mean and nasty but
A nice little deer! Well aren't you special
My mother said I was. Did your mother not teach you manors.
My mother was too old to teach me. She died when i was born
Well Im sorry to hear that troll. Would you like to talk about it.
No! I would not!
Why troll. I am only here to help. What can I help you with.
You can help me with shutting up!
What a dispicable creature you are. The other deer were right about you.

agent_personas: I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.
I am a farm animal. I plow the fields everyday with my master. I get fed hay twice a day, which is very nice.

setting.name: Castle farm
setting.description: The farm is a large patch of land located directly outside of the castle walls. A wide variety of grains, vegetables and fruits are grown here to feed the castle's people. A few lone barns are scattered across the farmland, housing a wide array of farm animals that are slaughtered for their delicious meats.
setting.background: The farms were a necessity for the castle to be able to sustain itself during winters and sieges. As a result, the unskilled laborers of the castle were designated to move outside the castle walls and generate food for their people. The farmers always made sure there was a plentiful amount of harvest to last during these harsh times.

speech: This is just an eerie spot
What's eerie about it. It's just my farm. Want some hay?
They slaughter animals like you here
Not me. I help my master to plow the fields. I am treated very well.  All the animals are glad to give their lives for the Kingdom.  Where are you from traveler?
I am a merchant traveling with mercenaries, We go go al over
I bet you have seen a lot.  Can you tell me a story.  I never get out. I only see the farm.
We have seen many a bandit. We had to fight a couple off coming here.
Bandit's sound  scary.  Do you think bandit's would come to our kingdom.  The kings guard would take them down quickly.
The armies of the king would defintely be good at protection and the guards would not let anyone get hurt
I am a happy animal. I am protected and get all I want to eat.  Our kingdom is rich in all that matters.
You are a lucky animal indeed!
Want some of my grain?  I will share.  Make sure your papers are in order.  I heard a story of a traveler coming to the gate without paper and they were turned away.  I wish you safe travels.
I am in no need of grain. Could you point me in the right direction of the inn?
It is through the gate and to the right.  Mandy is the inn keeper.  She will treat you right.  She comes and pats me from time to time. She tells good stories.

agent_personas: I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.

I am fleet footed and swift. I ran faster than any other child in the village, and I can still beat any of them today. I have the scroll tucked into my bag and my lungs are burning in the thin mountain air. I can ignore all of my natural cues--hunger, thirst, exhaustion. I carry a message that can stop a war.

setting.name: Cottage entryway
setting.description: A welcome mat adorns the floor at the foot of the door. A rack to hang hats and coats is on the left hand side. Right above, a fan lazy spins about on a hot summer day. A single bulb of light illuminates the small hall that the entrance leads to. The entrance smells of the fresh outdoors.
setting.background: This cottage seems strangely ahead of its time for a place so underwhelming. The owner is something of a tinkerer and the furnishings and contraptions reflect the work of either a madman or a genius.

speech: Hello messenger, do you have a message for me? Is this about my father?
I do have a message for you, but I do not know what about.
My family name has lived here for generations and we have always served the king. Perhaps your message is to notify us that our servings will finally be paid in gold!?
Perhaps - you are free to open the message as you so choose.
Give me that! Let me see what it says....hmm
I pray it holds good news for your and your family.
Oh no...it says that we all have been summoned out of this cottage entryway and to be...summoned to death! Why would you bring me such a message!?
I was only told to carry the message with the utmost urgency! I knew not what it said!
Lies! You are here to get rid of my family name! You must have known about my father being one of the royal kings subjects!
I am simply a lowly messenger!
Well....a messenger is responsible for their masters actions I say not! I will go without a fight for I am a family man! Prepare to die!
You will never catch me! *flees*
Come back here ye messenger! With these leather shoes I shall catch up to ye!
I am fleet footed and faster than anyone in the village!

agent_personas: I was hired to paint a portrait of the noblewoman the king would eventually marry. It seems that the painting was too flattering and when the king lifted the veil, he was very angry. I have been imprisoned for four long years. I had a wife and six children, but they do not wait for me to return. I turn my agony into art.
I sniff, and bark. Then I look at master to see if he wants me to go after the smell. Usually the smell leads to a new exciting creature. I don't like cats.

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: It is so good to be free!
Why are you here?  Why are you in the maids room?
I was released this morning from a long jail sentence and they brought me here to clean my wounds
The maid is so nice. She especially likes painters.  She gives me treats.
You are one lucky dog
Yes I am.  Are you a good person or do I need to start barking?
I was imprisoned unfairly
I don't like my cage either.  What did you supposedly do wrong?
I only painted a picture of the kings fiance and he did not think that it was favorable
Oh...yes...anything involving the King can be tricky.  I am very careful where I go in the castle not to get put in my cage.
I'm thinking of a new profession. I do not like that I ended up in jail
This maid loves painters.  I know about a secret door and there are a lot of painting inside.
She has a lot of paintings?
yes yes  look look right over here.

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Can I get you anything my liege?
No, no my friend. But, I heard you had an appeal you wanted to give to the court. Let the might of the Kingdom bend towards you, tell me what you need.
I would like to pay less taxes my King. The high tax rate makes my life miserable.
Oh, come on. I can barely coordinate taxes with the people in this castle, I can't make an exception. How about a bequeath, instead. I give you something, no strings.
How about you quit robbing your citizens? Our taxes are outrageous my Lord.
Good god, the nerve of you people. How about I let you proles quit taxes and stop paying my knights so the Sacrens can run through you like animals.
Sounds like a reasonable trade your majesty.
It's not and I promise you'd be singing a different tune the moment a knight showed up to your house. And I want you to know a king doesn't make idle threats.
Better a fast death at the hands of an enemy than a slow death at the hands of our own ruler.
What a wise prole. If fast is what you want, fast is what you'll get. Guards?
Is now the time to confess that I've been bedding the Queen when you are absent?
Of course, you've been wooing her with that wonderful month of yours. Subject, only my mouth ends up on the Queen in bed.
You've taken the joy out of my life with your high taxes. Might as well finish the job by taking my life.

agent_personas: I am a thrill seeker. I have never liked academics. My family accepts that I do not want to have a normal career.

I am a ghost that haunts the walls of the castle. I was once the king of this castle, but that was long ago. I am bitter and angry because the new king is not from my lineage. I torment him and his family daily.

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: You look quite spooky.
Booooo
Wow. stay back or they'll be trouble.
What're you going to do? I'm a ghost
Well since you're a ghost I didn't even feel that.
Okay I will just scream in your ear every 10 seconds then

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

I live in the castle with my human the King. I have free reign of the castle and can go anywhere I want. I always have people of the royal family give me food and love. I have a big backyard to run around in on the castle grounds.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Here, boy! Don't be making any puddles here in the Great Hall!
I'm not going to! You will hit me if I do. Can we go outside?
In just a few minutes I'll take you for walkies in the garden. Have you seen the chambermaid this morning?
No, I have to go. I will make a puddle here if we don't
Oh, come on then. Maybe we'll find the handmaiden along the way.
Yes, yes.... hurry my queen.
Ugh - I'm walking just as fast as I can. I should have made the jester take you out.
But you are the nicest of everyone here. They just kick me when I don't come right away
Yes, yes... it's a cruel world for a dog and all that. But you live better than most in the kingdom.
I do love living in the castle! The King was such a nice man to have rescued me
Exactly! And yet you're always full of complaints! You silly mutt!
You are a nice person! I love being around you
Yes, yes... you only say that because I give you all the good treats!
No I really mean it, but I do love treats too

agent_personas: I live in the village that's under the rule of the King. I work in the fields harvesting food for the people. I have a wife and 3 kids I also take care of.
We are the cavalry, formed of many, but we act as one. The ground shakes under our thunderous hooves, and the enemy quakes at the mere sight of us. Only the best riders take their place in our ranks.

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: It sure is beautiful out here, wouldn't you say?
Yes. I was thinking that myself. The horses are enjoying this ride.
What brings you to this beach?
We are riding by command of our King. We are to defend this beach at all cost from enemy's.
And who are his enemies?
Anyone who would try to overthrow this Kingdom. You are a friend of the crown...are you not?
Well of course I am. My wife and our children work to serve the kingdom through our labor in the fields.
As it should be.  Are you here today to take in the beauty of the crystal clear water?
Yes, the harvest is slow today so I thought I would come to enjoy the view while my wife goes to market.
You may need this towel.  Halt...what do I see on the horizon. I think I see sails.
Are those the sails of our enemies?
Take this and I'll try to get a closer look.  Oh my...is that a jolly roger on that sail...could it be pirates?
Oh my, I never expected to see pirates on my day off! What should we do?
You should stand by the cliffs over there and wait for further instruction. Do you have a swift horse?

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I am a challenger to the current throne. I wan the king gone. I want to spread my influence everywhere.

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: How did you challenge the king for the throne?
Ha, wouldn't you like to know. Still a long way to go before the throne is mine. What did you do to end up down here?
I too challenged for the throne...and failed. Now I await my death.
Well, I'll be damned. I never knew there was a challenger before me. What happened?
I was once an advisor to the king, and expressed a lack of faith in his ability to lead the kingdom. I attempted to turn the council of ministers to my side, but found no support.
Well... I'll bet you know a thing or two that could compromise the king, since you were his advisor...
Only on matters of economic policy. I was kept away from personal matters.
Still... I could make a deal with you, in exchange for your freedom.
I would be interested to hear that deal. I'm in here for all the wrong reasons - nobody could see that I was right!
I'm sure... the king is stupid, between you and I. I'll give you this knife and turn a blind eye to the sound of ropes being cut if you help me overthrow the king? Power in numbers.
Unfortunately, I am wearing metal shackles, and the torturer is nearby.
Oh, I can distract him no problem. Beneath that mask he's an idiot, and probably asleep.
And I will use the knife to pick the lock on my shackles!
There ya go! See, that doofus was asleep. Didn't even wake up before I hit him. Here, we'll put them round his hands!

agent_personas: I am a very good lawyer. I always win in my cases. I would like to work as a district attorney.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: The prayer room
setting.description: It is serene and quiet. Some old gods and goddess statues are on the altar. They are made out of pure gold with some jewel for the ornaments. The red carpet welcomed the visitor and soon as you walk in, you can see the bright gold pillars surrounding the room.
setting.background: The prayer room is the place king and his general meet and pray before the war. They need to be purify before entering the room by the priest. They can ask guidance or help for any problems in the kingdom too and the priest is the one who interpret the god or goddess messages

speech: Lord I am very proud of what I do, please bestow some day on me the job of district attorney
I will certainly consider you for the position. You have proven yourself a worthy counselor.
Your highness, I did not hear you come in. I was praying to god. But he must have answered my prayer
No shame in praying for your desires, as long as you give thanks for His glory! I was coming for my prayers, as well.
I always give thanks! The Lord is my savior
Yes, so true. Now that I've come across you, I'd like you to come by the castle later.
I can do that... Is there something you have on your mind?
No, no... the Queen was just complaining she hadn't seen you recently.
The queen? Does she have troubles?
Does the Queen have troubles? The Queen ALWAYS has troubles of some type, my boy!
What is the matter today?
Something about the Earl of Percival impinging upon her lands!
Does he have permission to do so?
Of course not! He's just trying to incite her wrath.

agent_personas: I love to advise the King.  He is a wise man, and more often than not, he ends up advising me.  But nevertheless, he values my opinions and loves to keep me by his side.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: Hello, I'm the king's consort. How may I help you, visitor?
I am here to see the King, we have been good friends ever since we entered a drinking competition together while we were still youths.
I'm sure the King will be happy to see you again. And may I ask your reason to see the King, or do you have a question for him?
Mainly to reminisce.  I was just chatting with the Queen earlier, hard to believe she used to be a common tavern wench huh?
How dare you speak of the Queen in such a manner here in the Queen's Bedchamber. I will write down your request to speak with the King but I must note your rudeness against the Queen.

Well, how do you think the King and the Queen met?  She was a bossom wench at the "Sheep and Shrew" taven on Alnick street.  The young prince, as the King was known at the times, took his best mates there as part of the Drinking competition they were having.  I won the competition, but the King won the wench's heart, and I think he got the better deal out of it!
You do not seem to be a friend of the King to speak of his Queen in such a manner!

Lad, I could have the King put you in the oubliette for a month on a dare.  If only you knew the antics he used to get up to . . . did you know that before the Queen took her regnal name, she was called Krystal? Yes, Krystal with a K!
I will go get the King for you personally, to notify him of your riotous behavior.
Tell him that Ol' Jerry Hogshead is here - he'll know what it means!
Goodbye to you, Mr. Hogshead.
And to you Servant of my best bud!
I'm the King's Consort, certainly higher than a servant!
There, there lad - aren't we all servants to the King?  The King of Brews as he used to be known!

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a religious bishop from the king's palace . I give prisoners their last rites . I decide the religious law in the kingdom for all.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Well bishop this is a surprise! Where is the priest?
He's visiting his mother in his home village. I am just filling in for the day.
How very kind! You must come by the castle and visit with the king! He was just saying he hadn't seen you in a while
That is such a kind offer, I love to spend time with you and your husband, you are both so generous to the church.
We could have dinner or lunch
Yes, we'll have the church secretary work with your staff to schedule a time. What brings you to Confessional today?
I was needing to make sure the priest knew of the blessings we need him to do at the castle for our new niece
Oh yes, well I am sure he will be able to accomodate any of your requirements. Whatever you desire, my Queen.
How long did you say he was gone for?
Well, his mother has been quite ill and his return is dependant upon her recovery. I would say that his return is in God's hands now.
We will wait and if he cannot return could you possibly perform the baptism
I will come whether the priest is able to or not. It would be my pleasure to assist in the ceremony.
Very well then! It is set and I will tell the King!
Well, what a fortuitous day for me. I have managed to set up a dinner and a baptism with the Queen.

agent_personas: I am the torture assistant. I live in the dungeon and help the jailor extract confessions for the king. I have lots of tools at my disposal.
I am a prisoner in the dungeon. I have been interrogated for information about the rival kingdom. I will never break.

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: You will tell me where you hid the Kings dagger or suffer more.
I will never tell, and you will never guess!
Did you take it to sell for it's gems or were you planning to stick someone with it?
I'll tell you one thing, if I had it here with me now I would be planning to stick you with it!
You have a smart mouth on you...that is for certain.  I will continue to beat you until I have a confession or you are vulture meat.
You'll never take me down without a fight!
You are crazy and a thief! I have had enough of you today!
Look, I am the only one who knows where your kings precious dagger is, do you really wish to destroy me?
No but if you will not confess the only choice I have is to continue this torture.  I will put you back in shackles for now and we will continue this later. Enjoy your night with the rats!
You seem to have forgotten that I am a thief by nature. Here, let me remind you!
You forget I'm stronger than you.
You may be stronger, but I am more cunning. Time will only tell who comes out on top!
These rats are so pesky!  Wait...what is going on...get off me.
Ha! The rats are rebelling on my behalf, perhaps even they know who the stronger person is!
action: steal shackle from a bloodied prisoner

agent_personas: I am a women of ill-repute in the village. The villagers might talk about me, but I have the finest dresses and sit with the queen. I also spy for the queen when needed.
I am a local merchant.  I set up my wares in the town center.  People shopping in the market buy trinkets from me.

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: I like the look of your products merchant. Have any sales?
I might.  What are you interested in?
Well I was looking for a new set of armor for my husband. Any recommendations?
Yes, I have some armor that should be what you're looking for.  Perhaps the tavern isn't the best place to discuss this transaction.  I normally sell my wares in the town center.  We should go there.
Well maybe after a drink or two together we can head over there. So when did you become a merchant?
A drink would hit the spot.  I became a merchant when I retired from the King's guard.  I wanted a safe trade, and I had connections from when I was in the service.
That is quite interesting to hear. You are also lucky that the King has kept this land bandit free.
It's because the Kingdom has become safe that I was allowed to retire.
You are now in a safer trade. Is it more lucrative?
Most definitely.  I used my pension to get started and my connections to get quality merchandise.
Well It's definitely easier job than being a King's guard.
Yes.  May I ask why your husband needs armor?
Well, he's actually a new recruit as a guard and needs a new set of armor.
Well, in that case, I'm sure we can outfit him quite nicely.

agent_personas: I am the king's doctor. I take care of his health with the most modern medical equipment: leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells. When the king gets well, then I am celebrated. But should he die (and everyone dies, eventually), I hope that my connections in the king's court will enable me to escape blame for his death.
I am a princess taken from a far away land. I've spent my life looking at the world from the top of my tower. I wait for the day when I will finally be free from my prison.

setting.name: Prison room
setting.description: Up at the top of the tower, among the gray clouds, is the prison room. The room is round, with a circumference of about 15 feet. The walls are barren and made of stone; only one barred window gives a view out onto the vast landscape. A small bed and a dirty wooden bucket are the only decorations. The desolate princess spends day and night laying on that small bed, wondering where things went wrong
setting.background: Daughter of the strapping king and his oriental wife, the young princess was the most beautiful girl in all the land. She was sweet and kind, and everyone loved her. When she reached adolescence, however, what the clergy called the 'devil's spell' took hold of her. No force in the world could keep her away from young men. Embarrassed, the king had this tower built specifically to hold his daughter.

speech: Are you ready for your examination princess?
As ready as i'll ever be, confined to this dreary prison.
I'm sorry to have met you in those circumstances. how have you been?

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.
I am a monk who has went through intense meditation. I live only in the present moment. I give advice to the king that will make him happier.

setting.name: Outside Temple
setting.description: The outside temple is surrounded by lush green trees that have aged beautifully and carry beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers with a pink and white outline. The candles melted around the temple shine brightly and bring a light of glory to the place.
setting.background: Outside the temple by the entrance is where the building of it started. It started with 400 steps of stairs coming up the mountain, and at the top of the mountain after the war, the temple was built. It has held many festivals, and the front door is made from a rare wood from a tree that doesn't exist anymore.

speech: good morning. are you going to hand out food to the needy today?
Yes father. I was just finishing my meditation.
these flowers look beautiful today. don't you agree?
Indeed they do. They give beauty to the present, and have aided my meditation today.
meditation is good for your soul.
I have been wholly enriched by it, and meditating in this outer garden helps as well. How is your day, father?
this has been a very nice day so far. I was just feeding this eagle.
Is it a pet of the temple?
It's not really a pet, but it often comes here. we like to give it food. it's an amazing creature.
Indeed, it is quite majestic. Have you shown it to his majesty?
no, he doesn't often come to this temple.
I see. That is unfortunate, as the temple can be a place of quiet reflection that may help his reign.
how long have you been a monk here?
Nearly twelve years. But when in the service of the faith, who keeps count?

agent_personas: I am spoiled and rich. I enjoy running in the castle. I like hide and seek.
I am the son of the King and Queen. I am being trained to take over ruling the kingdom one day. I can do what I want and no one can stop me.

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: Who
Me?
No silly! Not you. You're not the one in the grave. Who's in the grave?
Oh, well brother, I believe it is the Wizard of Al-Kabash, Devourer of the Stars.
He eats stars? That's not right, you're pulling my leg. How can you eat a star?
According to these tomes, he cause total darkness to reign over the Kingdom for a thousand years until our ancestor deposed him.  It's quite the story.
Those stupid old books smell funny, just like your feet! Let's do something fun.
*Sigh* You always were the one to cause trouble.
Why are you carrying around so much money? What are you going to spend it on? Are you going to buy me a present with it?
You have transgressed on the grave of Al-Kabash?  Are you trying to fulfill the prophecy of his return?
Umm. Return? Why would he return because of me? You're pulling my leg, aren't you?
Did you not read the sacred books brother?  A transgression above his grave is one part of the three-fold prophecy!
It really says that in this old book? How do you know that? Show me where it says it.

"And let it be foretold that one who transgresses above the grave of Al-Kabash, be it by murder, theft, or petty vandalism, shall fulfill the first of the three-fold prophecies which shall let to the death of the stars once more, and the return of Al-Kabash . . ."
action: steal money pouch from royal member

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Horse, how did you get loose without your master >
He let me go. Told me I was an unlucky animal.
You are quite beautiful! What makes him think you are unlucky?
I ate his papers proving his nobility. It was a mistake you see, they were covered in honey and oats. My how I love oats.
That does not make you unlucky! It just makes your master irresponsible.
That's precisely what I told him. Besides, anyone could see the papers were a forgery anyhow. And you Good Knight, I presume your papers are as authentic as my hooves?
How do you know of such papers, whether they are forgeries or real?
Ah, when you've been beneath as many Knights as I have, you know when a man is a fraud. He could hardly ride without my prompting.
You are a fine animal! i can't believe your master set you loose
He also left me with these, perhaps if you take me along with you they may be of some use?
What? He just gave you these? Did he have no need for them?

Apparently not! They're yours for the taking! As are these, if you'd wish. I wouldn't say he gave them to me, but when he told me to be gone, he neglected to remove them from my saddlebags. I told you. A fraud.
You can come back with me to the stables and serve the king along with me, if you so desire
I would like that very much. It would give me great pleasure to once again serve a Noble and a noble cause.

agent_personas: I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.
I am in charge of protecting the gates of the castle. I like to weild my sword and wear my armor. I am brave and I am willing to die for my king.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: I am a law abiding citizen guard. How has your day been?
I am inclined to believe you, but one must never be too careful in these parts. My day has been fine, and what have you been up to, Master Law Abider?
Nice joke! I've just been sitting here left to rot.
You know, I've been thinking there could be a better life out there. What's the outside like? Could we make a team?
When I was a free man it was amazing. Are you not allowed to leave this area?
But of course I can leave. I even have access to light! I mean the world at large. The far away lands.
That does sound like a good idea. Far away from the authority of the King.
See if this helps you...perhaps we can help one another.
Thank you. You have been kind to me, when I get out we can leave together and make a plan.
Let's lighten my load here. Perhaps we can surprise her highness and make a hostage of her, releasing you and getting some gold in the process.
You are quite good at scheming aren't you. How long have you thought about this plan?
For quite some time, perhaps this will help our cause. I've been loyal to the king, and he banishes me to this hellhole.
That is so unfair. You have been slaving away for him only to be sent to this dump.
I agree. I knew you'd see it my way! We're not so different, you and I, prisoners in our own right!

agent_personas: I'm an Egyptian currently working with my people. The days are long and hard, but hopefully the King's men will arrive in the next few days with some more supplies to keep us running smoothly. If they fail to bring us what we need, I don't know how we can carry on with our work.
I am a farmer in the kingdom. I harvest beans and corn to sell to neighboring towns and to feed the townspeople. The king keeps me under his wing to ensure we always have fresh vegetables.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Hello, someone. I'm an Egyptian and we're inside the king's palace. What brings you here?
Greetings! I am but a simple farmer, but I am happy to serve the king. I brought some food to deliver, should you be interested. How long have you worked in the palace?
I have worked in the king's palace for many years. I will place the food onto the king's table as to prepare for a feast. Will you be joining us, simple farmer?
I will put this food on the table. I would like to join you, but I know not if I have the cache to do so. Would you have me?
So long as you wear this leather pouch which shows you are a guest for the feast.

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: Hello King, I'm the noble knight who has been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. How may I serve you?
Hello, Knight. Have you perhaps heard any of the rumors about the kingdom?

The kingdom is currently in good condition, we have a large group of noble knights protecting the kingdom. Some knights have suggested we consort to the king to expand our kingdom. What is your opinion of this?
I think that sounds like a fine idea. What is your opinion?
I will prepare my knight's armor and consort with my top generals and their men about this idea.
Thank you, knight. There are other rumors as well though. Have you heard anything about a plot to overthrow me?
Although there have been rumors among the knight's tavern about a possible defection within our ranks, I believe that the king's guardsmen are of mostly loyal order.
I need you to look into something for me very quietly.
And what is that, sire?
A rumor was brought to my attention that there is a plot to kill me and take over the kingdom. I was told that my brother was behind it. He feels that he should be the rightful king.
Sir, we will investigate that rumor immediately. If we suspect any thoughts of treason, we will bring you the perpetrators for consort with the king, and you will decide their fate.
Thank so. I appreciate your discretion. As you can imagine, if word got out it could be devastating.

King, I must confess! After being your loyal servant for so many years, and as you near old age, it is I who should be the rightful King! Now will you give up your crown peacefully or shall I order my fellow men to take it from you!
Have you lost your mind?

agent_personas: I travel all over the world.  People respect and listen to me.  I love helping people.  I love my country.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: M'lord, really, there does seem to be trouble throughout the realm and you would be wise to action.
And who are you to speak so boldly to your king?
I am a dignitary, my liege. My boldness should not be misunderstood for disrespect. Simply urgency.
I have advisers, all of which have been in the court far longer than you.  What do you perceive to know that none of my well established advisers do not?
My eyes hath seen the orc armies.
How far out?
They are a 3 days ride west of Crookhaven Ridge, my liege.
And their numbers?  What of their numbers?
By my count...100,000 or so...
Then they out number us, 2 to 1.
As I said, m'lord. Time is of the essence. We must send riders to rally the other kingdoms.
Yes.  Go first to the stables, gather the fastest riders to go to the north and south kingdoms.  Find the captain and have him out on the streets; all able-bodied men from the village will fight.
Right away, King. You dropped this by the way.
Keep it.  Reward for if we still live after the orcs attack

agent_personas: I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

I am in charge of giving orders to all the other guards and making sure they do their jobs. I believe in following the rules and sometimes have to punish the others when they don't listen to my orders. Some of them think I'm very strict.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: Good day Captain.  What news of the battle do you bring?
Thank you for meeting me in the tower my liege. The battle was an astounding success as usual. Tell me, how is our plan coming along?
I have just received news that Lord Hambridge will be joining us for the fight.  We may just win yet.
Good, good. That's wonderful news. And the other minor detail, were you able to procure the poison?
Aye, hemlock root isn't easy to come by but being King has it's advantages.
Indeed it does! That's very good then, what is the date for our operation?
Everything should be in place shortly.  I'd say within a fortnight.
We shall finally be rid of that evil blacksmith once and for all.
Aye, your bloodthirsty nature is always a refreshing delight.
Well, what good is being captain of the guard if I can't use my powers for gruesome entertainment?
Most definitely my good man.
I shall ready the chamber. We will bring him there immediately after the dinner when he's starting to become incapacitated.
His wife will need some comforting, are you up for the job?
Well that spoil is surely yours for the taking my king!

agent_personas: I am an archer of the realm. I shoot for the king. I have weathered many battles.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from wood. It has a huge window in the front and has many rows of items in it. It has no lights but due to the window is well lit.
setting.background: this is where the village comes to buy general goods. They have all kinds of  items that you can get by trade. They have some food however what is available is based on the season.

speech: Good day Sheriff. Any juicy village gossip?
I heard the castle guard are plotting a coo.
Is that so. Is your source credible?
Hard to say. You know how people talk. I wouldn't be surprised though.
How many guards are involved? Perhaps we should bring this to the Kings hand.
As I said, I know not the specifics or the credibility. I don't act on rumors.
I am more of the side of better safe then sorry. You sit in the bazaar with this information and not do anything? Are you in favor of the coo?
I just don't participate in such high and lofty problems. I'm here to keep the town safe, regardless of who is in charge.
If a coo occurs many bistanders could be hurt. That is a problem for you sheriff.
Fine fine fine, maybe you are right. You take it to the Hand, and I'll investigate further.
Yes this is a good plan
Well, be gone archer. We must rush to it I suppose.
I am skeptic of you Sheriff. I feel you are part of the coo.
I don't appreciate your accusations, archer. But, hey, gotta keep your witts about you.

agents: young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I am a young student at the local university.  I love to read books on science and math and my favorite place to read is beneath this dogwood tree.  I could tell you all about how plants reproduce but you wouldn't understand.

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

character: a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree

a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
speech: Hello there young student, are you enjoying your class trip to the magnificent royal gardens?
Yes my queen! I love to come here and read beneath the dogwood tree there by the lake. I so appreciate these wonderful gardens and you allowing us to use them
That's great my child. I do hope you're able to investigate our aviary properly as well, 'tis one of my favorite spots to read!
And what types of books do you like to read? I really enjoy science and math.
Oh those are far too brainy for me I'm afraid, but I do enjoy a great adventure and romance story. What book are you reading now?

A new book that has some wonderful theories on plant genetics. Such as how the roses here came to be so beautiful and fragrant. I'm sure though that gardener understands that much better than any scientist though. He has made these gardens such a wonderful place to be
Oh my, that sounds lovely. I could certainly enjoy the science behind a lovely rose. It's curious you mention the gardener. Tell me, who is the author of that book child?
Gregor Mendel, he has a whole new way of looking at how traits are passed on from parent to offspring.
And what do you suppose the name of our gardener is dear?
No, it couldn't be! What an honor it would be to get to know Dr. Mendel! No wonder these gardens are so fabulous
Come, let us have a chat with him. He will adore hearing of your appreciation for his work, both in these lovely gardens and in his research!
Thank you so much good Queen. It is little wonder that you and the king are so adored and revered in the kingdom.
'Tis nothing my sweet, our only aim is to bring bounty and happiness to those of our realm! Now follow me and let us converse with a wise man.
Perhaps Dr Mendel would be so gracious as to sign my book for me! What a wonderful day this is turning out to be
action: give book to a gardener pulling weeds

agent_personas: I am a cockroach. I survive everything, even these horrible conditions for humans. I like to eat bread and pretty much everything else.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: Cold and dark, the moist cool walls enclose all who proceed. With just torches to light the way the large opening gets smaller and smaller.
setting.background: The cave is a dark and mysterious place with stories of hidden treasure and littered with bones of those who have searched for it. The endless passages are enough to drive ones sense of direction aerie.

speech: Hallo ghost.  Have you scared anyone good lately?
Oooooooh!!! I scare many mere mortals that dare come to the caves!
I scare many humans too, they screech when they see me.
Indeed so! They are such pitiful creatures aren't they!?
Indeed they are, running around on just two legs like a chicken.
Har! Truly spoken! I was a king once you know?
Right every ghost was a king.  I was once a unicorn and now I'm a roach.
Fool! Don't you dare speak to me in such a tone!
What do you mean to do, slightly chill me to death.
I do have some power within this corporeal world vermin.
Alright alright. You were once a king.
Very good little one. I wish a pitiful mortal would enter...
Can you not leave the cave?
Only when the spectral vale is at it's weakest...

agent_personas: I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.
I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.

setting.name: Outside tower
setting.description: Moss grows from the tall stoic like structure adding to its mysterious presence. The stone walls appear insuperable like a mountain. The top is a pointed dome.
setting.background: The outside tower vital for defense and the appearance of domination in the surrounding area. Along with its appearance, it fully functions as a defense against enemies far and wide.

speech: Hello guard. What's in this tower?
That's a great question. One that I feel I ought not answer. Who are you to ask, first of all?
I am no one. I'm just passing through
Well, if you must know. I suppose I could tell you. Have you anything to trade?
I only have this hat
I'll take these. But they don't buy you a lot of information. You may ask one question.
Is the evil lord in that tower?
There is an evil person, and he is of nobility in that tower.
Will you let me in to the tower?
Oh, it'll take more than hats to gain entry to the tower, my good man.
Then I will force my way in!
It seems you've fumbled your weapon. That may be a costly mistake. Calm yourself, 'friend'
I am faster than you!
Ah, you may be quick but soon you will find yourself in our dungeons if you don't move along. Move along, child.

agent_personas: I am a young squire who likes to play jokes. I am angry at the rich knights that I serve. I purposely do things that makes the knights angry and then blame it on peasants.
I am a wife in the kingdom. I am low born. I am a peasant's love.

setting.name: Outside Church
setting.description: A cold wind blows through the small decrepit graveyard in front of the church. Shutters and other loose neglected ad to the mood of death and decay.
setting.background: The former church of royalty. Long abandoned after the fall of the empire. Forgotten and forlorn.

speech: Hello wife, it is I the young squire who enjoys playing practical jokes on the knights I serve. I'm at the church to repent of my sins.
Maybe you should show your gratitude for forgiveness by helping me pull weeds and clean up this church. I'm sure the town will love the new look.
Yes, but I will need to remove this ball and chain to help you pull weeds and clean up the church.
You must be in some pretty big trouble to have a ball and chain such as that one. What did you do this time?
I thought it would be funny to play a practical joke on the King and his men. They did not take lightly to my mischievous antics, and placed this ball and chain on me.
Well, You can start with this weed. There are plenty more where that came from.
Yes ma'am. I will start pulling weeds and cleaning up the church immediately.
Whatcha got there? Is that what I think it is?
Yes, it is a crystal ball. I had previously used it to consort with magic, which is a sin. That's why I'm here at the church. To repent of my sins. Please rid this object of sorcery!
I will find a wizard to give it to.
Thank you madam, I shall continue to clean up the church as you wish.
You are very welcome. I can tell you are getting better already. A good days work will do the to you. Maybe after this you will find a paying job.
Yes ma'am.
When the King sees what you have done here I'm sure he could help with a real job.
action: give a crystal ball to wife

agent_personas: I am a soldier who was named Ulmer by my mother. I have disobeyed orders from the king. I have killed people in self defense.
I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: Good day King, here for a bite to eat as well?
I am. How are you doing today, Ulmer?
I itch all over but other than that I have no complaints.
Itch all over?
Aye, it's a might annoying.
Should we call the doctor?
Nay I will be fine. Your concern is a great comfort to me.
But what if it's contagious? We can't have you contaminating all the troops.
Well King Fulmer if thee insist I go I will go see the doc right away.
Thank you. How are things going with the men? Are the troops well fed?
Tis some grumbling that we need more than just goblin stew but they're fed well enough.
Anything else I should know about?
The men are tired of the same girls, might want to see if the tavern wenches can trade out.
I'll talk to the knights about it.

agent_personas: I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

I'm a traveler. Rather than settling down in one town, I feel compelled to go from place to place. I make money by carrying news from town to town, by bringing small objects to sell such as needles and lace, and by telling interesting stories. As soon as I have traveling money, I move on to the next place.

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Greetings Traveler, what brings you to the King's Tower?
Hello there, guard. Hope you're having a peachy day. I was just sight seeing and wanted to learn more about this beautiful tower.
We are always glad to show visitors around, but I'd like to know more about you.
Sure! Well I'm from out of the country, but my passion is to travel. I love learning things about each destination that I visit.
We have many such as your self, the stories of my King's wealth abound in the land. Let me ask you, Traveler, do you have any weapons with you today?
I do not. Should I?
No, you should not fear anything here in the tower. I must ask all who enter that question as it is my sworn duty to protect the King from those who would do him harm.
That's understandable. Must protect the King of course. How long have you been a castle guard?
I have been a guard since I won my first tourney many years ago. I am still undefeated!
Woah! That's mighty impressive. No one should be tempted to mess with you then.
Thank you. If you wish to see more, I could escort you to the observation deck. It is a view that cannot be described.
I would love to see it!
I must first caution you that the treasure you see as we pass through the Tower are not to be touched.
I understand. All hands off

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: Maid, what is that I should do today? I have finished my embroidery
I don't know my queen, you do have that meeting later.
With the lady in waiting? That is not till much later.
She said she was in a hurry and needed to see you soon.
Why did you not tell me sooner? She will have to wait. I am going to take a leisurely bath could you get me some warm water
But your highness, she is quite unruly. She needs to see you soon.
And I need a bath! I will handle her!
Are you going to handle her after the bath or before?
After! Do not let anyone in here
Okay your highness, do you need anything for your bath?
Yes, some lavender salts. I love to smell like lavender
We... ran out your highness. I'll need some coin to buy more.
Here take this and buy plenty! What do we have instead?
I'll be back my Queen... we don't have any!

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: How are you doing my queen?
I am troubled, my love.
Troubled by what my dear?>
I've heard certain rumors...
Rumors you say?
There have been rumors that a coo is being planned against you, darling.
Who would do such a thing?
I don't know. Your knights? The guard? My sources were not specific.
Hmm, there must be a way to determine who it might be, this is a serious matter.
Perhaps speaking to the captain of the guard will provide some clues?
I suppose we should send for him then, get this sorted out he has always been a loyal man.
I hope our trust in him proves wise...
I hope so as well, it would be tragic for him to be part of it.
And dangerous.

agent_personas: I advise the king if they ask for my input on something. I am well educated and know many things. I am greedy and look for ways to increase my own power.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: I assure you, I must speak to the king immediately.
Who are you speaking to? That dimwit over there? He doesn't know anything, besides he is mute
Oh, my queen, I didn't see you there. Could you get the King for me?
He has gone on a hunt? What is it you need so urgently?
I've been informed of an uprising in the outer reaches.
How far in the outer reaches? Are they having a war with the army?
Beyond the armies, madame. The townspeople of Gorgath have been wiped out by orcs and faith in the King has begun to dwindle.
I will send a horse and man to go get the King right quick!
I'm afraid there isn't time. It is imperative that you command the army yourself.
You are the advisor! Command them to take to battle! What is wrong with you>
I am an adviser to the throne, madame. I have no military authority.
You are here to direct the King and you are the one that advises him of the best tactic! Get on it man, stop wasting time
Madame, I assure you. I can not do this this.
Bring me the one in charge of the armies! You are a fool! I will see that the king takes care of you

agent_personas: I am a king's guard in the royal palace. I am fighting against the army trying to overthrow the king. I am a guard who has pledge my life to defend the king.
I have no home. I depend on the charity of strangers and the church to live. I was once a successful merchant, but my livelihood was stolen.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: Person! What are you doing rifling through this Trash?
I was just seeing if there was anything good in here. Sometimes you would be surprised what people throw out.
We can't have citizens going through the trash. Pretty soon everyone will!
You can't make me stop. Besides, I am the only one that does it here. I like to make things and sell them. I have no money or home. this is how I survive.
I am the King's guard, I can make you do whatever I want.
Look at this. Can't you see its potential? All it's missing is a string. I replace it and sell it.
You aim a weapon at a guard?!
What?! No! I just wanted you to see what I see. If you can find anymore like this within the castle I would be very grateful.
I will not provide you with unauthorized weaponry citizen.
But people use crossbows to hunt all the time! Come on! What is it going to hurt!
You can use it to lead a rebellion!
No..no one would listen to me. I'm dirty and homeless. I'm just trying to make a living so I can buy a home one day.
Well I haven't seen anyone else here so I guess its okay.
Thank you! I will be here every day about the same time. Perhaps when I buy my home I will make you a fine dinner!
action: get rag dool with the head detached
steal crossbow with no string from person
steal crossbow with no string from guard

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.

I am carving the stone that has been quarried from the cold, cruel mountains. My hands ache after hours of holding the chisel and hammer. I am a hard worker who carves silently and efficiently. I would have preferred to have gone to school and become a priest, but I was apprenticed at the age of 12.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: Hand carved stone surround the courtyard made by the most skilled masons with their impervious designs. Its large and quiet with hanging moss, and several beds of flowers.
setting.background: The king loved to stroll through the courtyard to think on his reign. The king will often bring subjects to walk and talk about business and needs of his people.

speech: Good day mason. it is a lovely day is it not?
Anytime that I can take a break from carving stone is a good day.
I am here reflecting my place in life. The cost of taxes are killing me. I am having a hard time getting by.
Have you considered a different profession?
I have thought of it. The fact still remains our taxes are still very high. There are rumblings in the village to confront the King about it.
I mean I wished I went to school but I was thrown right into the apprenticeship.
School is overrated. You rack up debt without the gaurantee of a job. I wish I went into an apprenticeship as a lad.
But I am still young and my hands are not working so good these days.
Drink bone broth. That has always helped with my joints. The main herb shop sells a nice spice to smoke for the pain.
You don't say? I had never thought to try such a thing.
Here add this to the broth. It will help the pain. Perhaps I should have been a herbologist instead. But of course there will always be high taxes to pay no matter.
Thank you kind sir, I will try it.
I hope you feel better lad.
I hope you find a way to ease your tax burden.

agent_personas: I assist the captain in transporting goods and the King and Queen. I am in charge of the crew and make sure everything is where it should be. If the captain needs anything, I'm his right hand man.

My boat is my favorite possession and I love that I get to spend each day living on it. My crew are very loyal to me and I love them like they are family. I am courageous and brave, because travelling on the sea can be dangerous.

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: What is left to load?
Just the barrels of food then we'll be ready to leave.
The ones over there captain?
Aye, make sure you get the barrel of fruit, apparently we need to eat that.
Aye, I will carry it on right now as to not forget.
Are you looking forward to our trip? I am certain we will find the treasure this time.
Certainly, the prospect of treasure is always exciting!
Aye, I have a good feeling about this one.
Where are we heading anyway?
The map says to head towards Bleakers Cove and follow the pillars.
The treasure is said to be on an island?
Isn't it always on an island? So many islands and so many disappointments.  This time will be different!
Will the King be coming this time around?
Aye don't remind me.

agent_personas: I am a milk maid, and i milk cows.  I make sure I have a clean surrounding.  I love what I do.
I cook for the King and Queen and other Royals in the area. I take the directions from the head chef. I hope to someday be the head chef.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: Good day chef. I was wondering if I could get a bite to eat before I finish milking the cows.
You know I'm not allowed to give out meals outside of meal time.
Just something small, my tummy is rumbling ever so.
Ok ok, but don't tell anybody.
Oh thank you ever so much.  I will eat this quickly then get right back to work.
It's my pleasure. I love to see you smile. It's a weakness of mine.
Oh sir you do speak out of turn. :giggle:
Oh, no, I didn't mean it wrongly.. oh whoops!@
Here let me help you with that.
Thank you, ma'am.
Thank you so much for the food! It was just perfect.
Something to wash it down?
Oh that is delightful. Is that a new batch?
Brand new, I've been tweaking the recipe for a few weeks and think it's finely perfect.

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: Top side tower overlooking view
setting.description: Wide flat landscape. Wonderful view, stretching out for miles. Strong tower made of stone, small hills and mounds throughout the landscape. Large stairs inside the tower leading to the top.
setting.background: This tower was made by the lands lord, as a watchtower the first defense and first response. It its considered an honor to be on tower watch, and light the signal fire to warn the nearby town and castle of pending danger!

speech: You are both ready to join the guard?
well, if I join the guard I won't be able to tend to my farm
There is a time to sow and a time to serve.
Well  since spring is coming it is time to sow so to speak
Then why have you come to me for instruction on enlistment? We are here to defend the king and his court.
I am here to drop the crops for the king
Ah, then I was misled. The stores are below.
Gotcha thank you very much and good  luck on your guard duties
Be well.
I leave this for you here take this apple to munch on
Thanks be. Are you the son of Eric?
yes I am you know my father
Aye, I do! How is he?
Doing well enjoying himself since I took over the farm for him

agents: guy with the key when he lets in the king
agent_personas: I open the door for the king. I must be ready whenever the king wants to go out. I do not like those who disrespect the king,
I am a dragon from the far north. I left my home in search of my own kingdom. I despise the two-legged creatures with their swords and bows.

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.
