agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Hello soldier, is this your post?
It is. I have worked my way up the tower and now I'm appointed to the very top.
Good job soldier. Here you have a little dirt on your armor.
Ah yes. I got in a little scuffle with a bandit yesterday. It must have soiled the silver. Thank you.
No problem. Who won the scuffle?
Who do you think, servant! I haven't lost a battle yet! Well, there was that one rat I ran away from but in my defense, he was a large rat!
A large rat? that sounds odd? Bigger than a cat?
Enormous! With huge fangs and red eyes!
I have never heard of such a thing.
Look, I've seen some strange things in this tower! The moat is filled with creatures I cannot even speak of. And the spiral staircase is guarded by a troll.
Oh really, i think i might have stepped in some of the trolls feces on the way up here.
You'll be lucky if some troll feces is the worst you face!
Are you sure, my shoe smells awful!
Oh my! It really does! Perhaps you should throw it out that window!

agent_personas: I am a countess.  I am the cousin of the king.  I wish I was ruler.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: I am the countess and deserve to be the Queen, not like my no-good sister!
Well, I'm sure I know nothing about any of that. I'm just a guest visiting the kingdom.
Well, you are sitting in my sitting room, so you will let me jabber on as I please!
Fair enough. Tell me, what makes your sister so undeserving?
She is the most ungrateful arrogant self-absorbed b . . .witch you will ever meet!
Well she sure sounds terrible. How did she come to be queen if she's so terrible?
She is apparently more conventionally attractive than I!  Do you believe it?
One becomes queen just by being beautiful?  My, this truly is a strange kingdom isn't it.
Well, the King does value large . . . tracts of land over wits.
Well, if you were to be more sensible than that, I agree that you should be in charge!
Thank you for your support!  Where did you say you were headed again?

I'm actually a visiting merchant, heading in to the market to try and peddle some potions and the like.  After a long journey, though, I'm going to need a good night's rest before a long day of selling tomorrow.
What sorts of potions?  You are full of surprises!
Mostly things for increased vitality and the like. A few more rare ones, generally meant for more...specialized uses.

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I work directly under the King. I carry out orders and make sure laws are followed. I make decisions in regards local ordinances.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Hello sir what brings you here today
I am just here to ensure that those who choose to disobey our laws are properly punished. Has anyone been whipped today?
No not yet hopefully it will be a pious today
Hmm yes, that's good. Say, how long have you been a priest here? I don't think I've ever seen you before while doing my duties.
I am pretty new to this town but I have been a priest for 15 years
Oh, well welcome! I'm so glad that we're getting some new church leaders here.
its always good to have new blood and change of perception
So how do you like it so far here in our little village?
It seems to be nice and the people so far seem to be pious
Yes, that is true. But, and don't tell anyone that I said this, there has been an increase lately in the number of sinners who need to be punished. The King is very worried indeed.
Yes I had  a talk with him the other day, I will be giving some sermons to remind everybody there duty
Here, here is a list of known repeat sinners. Your village would appreciate if you reached out to them to try to entreat them to follow the word of God.
Yes, I will good thing I have my bible with me
Thank you so much, Priest. You are truly doing the Lord's work!

agent_personas: I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.
I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: Dog, what are you doing here?
I sometimes come in to keep a watch over prisoners like you
I am not a criminal though. I was in that traitorious group as a spy for the king.
You are here, aren't you?

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I am a woman who has a wealthy husband. I enjoy watching plays. I have all of the best dresses.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: You, minion. Grab the wine. I'm all out.
Of course your highness. But i must ask, why don't you ask your maid?
I thought I'd give her a break for 20 seconds. And give you an audition for the part of 'maid'.
I see well I am not a maid. I amsure the maid will be happy to handle this for me though.
Um, no? I asked YOU to get the wine? What exactly did you misunderstand?
You know i didn't misunderstand you woman.
Oooooh you have annoyed me so much I could just... in fact I WILL just...
Here take my donation, just as long as you don;t scream again.
Ha! Donation. As though I'm charity! Oh, that one did humor me a little, minion.
Alright give it back than.
Haha! Even funnier! No. Absolutely not. You truly are testing my patience, woman. What caused you to have such an ego?
I just think i have a more refined taste in things then you. To be honest grabbing your wine seems to low for someone like me.
TOO LOW?! Do you see all of these silks? Are they yours? No. They are mine. 'Too low'... you truly are a trip, lady.
I would've picked golden sheets.

agent_personas: I keep to myself. I am a loner. I do not wish to disturb others or be disturbed. I watch the palace dwellers as they go about their day. Sometimes, for fun, I will bite one of them to see them wiggle in pain. I am enjoy their scream as much as I enjoy catching insects in my web.
I am forever alone in this land.  I can never see my family.  I didn't do what they said, but I am still punished.

setting.name: beach house
setting.description: the beach house is falling apart due to the storms, it's door is hanging and it's humid inside. There is no floor, just sand, and a hole to serve as the outhouse.
setting.background: the beach house is used for those who live in exile, it is said that the area is haunted with dead people over the years. It is forbidden to help anyone who lives there.

speech: Hello there, is that your message in a bottle over there?
No,but let us read it. Maybe it's a message from my family!
What does it say?
It says that they are lost and need help. It isn't from my family. I do not know. Do you know spider?
It must have washed in from the sea during the storm.
That is scary. I wish I could wash into the sea. I'm glad I have you here with me.
I can realte to that feeling. To be honest i hate other beings.
I was convicted of a crime I didn't commit and sent here to live alone.
That is depressing. What crime did they think you committed?
They think I plotted to kill the king. Since they didn't have concrete evidence they sent me here.
Were you plotting? You can tell me. I am jsut a lowly spider.
Oh never. I have always respected our king. I didn't question his advisors faith and believe that's why I am here.
Ah playing politics is a rough game i have heard.
Yes, I should have kept quiet and to my family. I knew better.

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I am a wench that lives in a tavern. I love making money from doing certain activities. I am happy and content with life.

setting.name: the clearing
setting.description: the clearing is surrounded by old pine trees where knights used to practice swinging their swords. There are haystacks where they take wenches and pay them a sickle.
setting.background: the clearing is used as practice and you can get there over the river, and through the forest. It is thick with trees but this spot serves as a secret marriage consummation station.

speech: Human? What are you doing in my clearing?
I didn't mean to intrude upon your space deer. I am just looking to unwind after a hard and long shift at the Tavern.
Tavern? What is this tavern?
Hm, lets see... its where humans go to fool around and drink ale.

Aye, drinking of ale. This makes humans silly and prone to folly, does it not? I saw a human just last night drinking such a thing. He was a knight standing among other knights. The fool drank so much of this ale that he fell down upon the hay and left his sword. Look. It is still over there. Silly humans. Why drink such a thing?
Oh my, this is a Kingsley Steel Sword. This sword ought to fetch a handsome sum of coin! Tell you what, I'll buy you some fresh peaches with it.
Peaches! Peaches, you say? Those are only my favorite delight. Thank you, kind maiden! How could such a silly human drink so much ale and leave a sword which could have instead fetch him peaches?
Humans can be difficult to understand. People drink ale to escape the misery in their life.
What misery could befall a wealthy human such as he?
Being a Knight is no easy task Dear. Sometimes you have to do grueling things, like kill another human. It can fill you with guilt and sadness...

Why kill another human when you do not need his meat, for you have peaches? I do not understand the ways of your kind. Just last autumn I saw a hunter slaughter my cousin just to make him into a carpet. He did not even feast upon him. I do not understand these ways.
Yes I am afraid such things are beyond comprehension for a simple deer like you. I envy your life. No worries aside from the occasional hunter.

Best not to forget packs of dogs, as well! Or the coming winter, when little food can be found and wolves grow hungry. I do not feel as a simple, lowly creature. I feel humans are cruel to one another without cause. What need do you have of the suffering of another man? Will it make your table full of feast? Will it keep you warm in autumn?
You are a curious one, but be careful asking such dangerous questions. The less you know about the mind of Man the better it is. Trust me...

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.
I help others out when they need help. I like to have a good time with others. I lend a compassionate ear when there are troubles and strife.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: We must whisper to avoid the echoes!  . . .echoes . . .echoes . . .
Indeed, we must keep our voices low. I wonder why they built this hall this way. I am sure it must be great for delivering sermons though.

That was likely the intent, but you are still hearing the first word of the sentence when you have just heard the last, then it proceeds into the next sentence . . . it is a terrible cacophony of sound.
I see, I am not sure if this is what the Pope had in mind when he built this. Say, here is the notebook you requested.
Ah thank you!  Can you believe we wrote these stories together when we were young? Seems like a lifetime ago, before the great war . . .
Ahh yes the Great War. Me and my friend used to come here and play with the echoes. The war took him from me...
I am so sorry Friend, I lost many that were close to me as well.
Such is the cost of war. What is that scroll in your hand? Are you learning some new form of wisdom?
It is a letter to the King, requesting an increase in the amount of charity he gives to the poor.  Even though it has been five years since the war, there is still ever so much need . . .
I see, the King has done a fine job bringing some wealth back into the Kingdom. All the people need right now is a friendly hand and some peace.
You see well friend, would you care to add your name to it?
Of course, I shall give what I can. Someone may need it more than me.
Thank you ever so much, and may the gods bless you always!
Now shall we have a bit of holy wine?

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

I am the queen's head chamber maid.  I admit it is not the most glamorous job but it does afford me everything in life that I need.  I even have the pleasure of knowing the queen.  She even knows my name believe it or not.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: Hello, Rebecca
Hello, Your Highness. Would you like the Show Room prepared for your guests?
I would. Thank you. Have you seen the king today?
Yes, I saw him in the royal library looking at books on fishing, I believe.
Thank you. Could you also please get a glass of water and take these books to the library?
Of course, Your Highness.
I appreciate it.
Oh dear- these books are on primitive torture methods. Are these for your guests?
Heavens no. My husband asked for them. How dreadful!
I'll head to the library and get you a glass of water. Is there anything else you need?
That is all. You are always such a help to me. Thank you.
I'm going to take the Prince with me! He always loves going to the library.
I think that's a wonderful idea! He is such a good son.
We are lucky to have you, Your Highness!

agent_personas: I am a juror on a case. I am not sure I should be in a court room. I wear all black almost every day.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Why is court taking place in this bone pit, again?
Between you and me, I'm not sure. My legal assistant requested it and I agreed because I couldn't be bothered to argue. But tell anyone and you'll be in there too!
I won't say anything! I wouldn't want to end up on one of these spikes.
You'll be fine. Ugh, this place stinks...
Yes, it does. Tell me, do you think the defendant is guilty?
Hmmm.... probably. There's plenty of thieves and murderers in the village, why would this guy be any different?
I don't know, he seems like an honest man. Although if you wish, I can try to convince the rest of the jury otherwise.
I don't really care either way. I'm in my castle and with war going on the people are restless anyway... this gives them a distraction whatever happens.
What will happen to him if he is found guilty?
Thrown into that pit and pecked to death by vultures. Ugh, it really does smell awful...
That pit is pretty foul, ugh. I would hate to be that guy.
Me too... well, don't let your compassion get the best of you. You're still a juror.
You're right. Since you had no special order for me, I will judge him fairly.
Excellent. You were a good selection for juror... reasonable, fair. I should look into what else you could do for me.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am four years old and I have a lot of questions. I am excited to start school. My best trend is my neighbor.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Hello, young man.
Hey, what are you doing there?
Just looking for food. I am but a lowly, hungry peasant.
Is there a lot of food in this room? It seems like a strange place to et.
No, I am not eating, only looking. Who knows where you may find it and I'm starving.
How come you're so hungry? Do you have a job?
I don't. I beg for food but really wish I had one. You're quite a curious young lad, aren't you?
I ask lots of questions. Sorry about that. Do you like apples?
My goodness! Thank you so very much. I could swallow this whole.
If you're still hungry you can have this bug too! His name is Rover.
You named the bug?
I always name bugs and mice and frogs and anything else that I can find. What's your name?
Well then I couldn't dream of eating him since he's your pet. My name is Ed. What's yours?
My name is Ed too, well actually it's Eddie. You can keep Rover if you want to.

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Have you come with news form the outlying villages?  Have you caught sight of the enemy?
I have much news to tell you, yes. If only you would offer me food or a bed for the night in exchange, I can tell you much news.
Certainly man!  But I see smoke in the distance, the enemy is almost upon us!
So hand over whatever rations you have, and I will tell you of the approach!
Here man, take it!  I can hear the screams of the refugees as they run towards us!

There are forty men on horseback and ten on foot. They have torches and crossbows. However, I noticed upon running up the hill side that they have a weakness in their left ranks, as some of the horses are badly injured. Perhaps this information is of use to you. Thank you for the food, good sir.
Excellent!  Thank you citizen - you may have saved many of your kith and kin.  Seek shelter now, this may get ugly.
I... I want to fight! I heard soldiers receive housing and hot meals, is this true? I am willing to take up arms against the invaders.
Here lad, take this bow, and do your best to hit the enemy.  If you prove yourself, I can vouch for you and have you enlisted in the King's company.
Thank you, kind solider! I will fight valiantly along side you. In the name of the King!
FOR THE KING!

They're approaching. I see the men upon horse back have broken ranks with the foot soldiers and are fast approaching. Maybe three or four have gone down, but the bulk lot is charging us with flaming arrows.
Aim for the largest ones first!  If they fall, the rest of the mongrels will flee.
Aye! I think I have one in my sigh- I'VE BEEN HIT! HELP! I'M BURNING!

agent_personas: I find predators in the garden. I am usually ugly and bark a lot. I do not like other animals.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Please bring me food.
Would you like a nice bowl of fruit?
Do you have any meat?
Let me see what I can dig up for you. You're one pushy dog.
Even raw is fine.
Go ahead and try this. Let me know if it's good enough for you. I'd hate for you to have a subpar meal.
Thank you, I need meat or I would die, I can't live off fruit due to malnutrition.
Why are you so hungry? What have you been doing all day?
I was hunting the pests in the garden but they were too diseased to eat.
It sounds like you provide a valuable service to the kingdom. It's my pleasure to find you something to eat.
Thank you, you do a good job too.
But, do try to mix in a banana every once in a while. The potassium will help give you energy.
I will try it, thank you.
Alright, you just come find me if you get hungry again and I'll see what I can find for you. I hate to see a hungry dog.

agent_personas: I am a huge fan of deep sea exploration, but I take any chance I can get to go for a swim. I love the feeling of water and compete with my friends to see who can hold his breath the longest. I wish I were a fish, and dislike mountains.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: I can't wait to sit on that sandy beach!
Have you seen any fish around? I'm starving...
I believe there are some in the river over yonder, but I wouldn't trust anything in this swamp.
Yeah, it looks pretty gross... oh. Okay, don't look now, but there's an alligator right over there...
An alligator?
I'll try to get rid of it... just don't make any noise... I'll throw this at it
Great idea!
GET OUTTA HERE BUDDY! WE'RE NOT LUNCH!!!
I'll help you!
Here, use this!
Thanks!
No problem. Looks like he shouldn't bother us anymore. So what brings you out here?
I always come down here when I need to unwind. How about you?
Followed the water, looking for fish... it's been days since I ate. But it sure is relaxing, I'll give you that.

agent_personas: I am the High Priestess of the goddess of the forest. I light incense for her. I feed her sacred woodpeckers. I do not have family, friends, lovers, or children. I spend my evenings singing songs in praise of the goddess.

I am a pastor. I am the priest in charge of a village church where the parishioners are everyday people. I provide hope of a heavenly rest for people whose lives are short and difficult. I do baptisms, weddings, and funerals, and I try to help my parishioners discern the hand of God in their daily lives.

setting.name: Main entrance
setting.description: There are religious statues standing outside this temple.  The outside of the temple is fairly plain itself and imposing looking.  The floor is made out of stone with a bridge leading to the entrance.
setting.background: This is where all those who worship come through.  They are greeted by the impressive statues standing outside the temple.

speech: Do you have a sermon ready for this afternoon's service?
Priestess, I am struggling to come up with the words for it. My mind has been foggy since morning.
Well, tell me what you have and perhaps I can give you some assistance.
I started of by praising the Lord and addressing the concerns of the people regarding the Great War. But I do not know how to comfort them with words.
Comforting can only go so far; what can you offer the people to help aid their needs? It is the Temple's duty to provide assistance, is it not?
You are quite right. But with the lack of weddings and baptisms during wartime, the people have little avenue for togetherness.
Perhaps it is time for a new religious festival. Something to honor the souls lost in the War.
A festival, you say? Hmm that might actually be great idea. May I ask that you request some funds from the King for this festival?
Hey, now why do I have to ask?! I had to ask him last time...
Well, Priestess. Its just that it might look better coming from you. You being the High Priestess of the Church of course.
If you insist. We'll need a name for this festival. Any ideas?
Thank you! I can envision it now.. yes.. it should be 'A Festival of Faith'.
That does have a nice ring to it.
I am sure people will be curious when they read the name and won't be able to help themselves!

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: A small area with a body of water in the center along with turtles, frogs, and other wildlife that live here.  Surrounding this pone are a dense set of trees along with some rocks here and there.
setting.background: This area is used by the local wild life to bask in the sun.  Some peasants come here to fish and relax at the end of a long day.

speech: Fisherman, could you spare just a single fish for me? I'm so hungry!
Sorry lad, no luck for me with that Water Nymph nearby.  I will give you some coin though, should fetch you a hearty meal in the village.
Ah, that will be great, thank you! But what is the water nymph doing?
Scaring the fish.  Says she is guarding them and that this is her sacred domain, or some such nonsense.
Go away, you silly water nymph! Those fish are made for eating!
I tried that lad, always turns into water then re-materializes with no harm done.  Likely need a priest or a wizard to get my watering hole back.
I'm sorry to hear that! How long has she been troubling you?
Just started today.  Just what I need, a Nymph infestation!
Perhaps if I throw this rock at her?
Give it a shot lad, it can't hurt.
That nymph! As soon as I threw the rock, it magically floated to her!
She is a tricky devilress I
She is indeed! And I really want some fish! Oh wait- she's going to throw the rock at us!
RUN!  Nymphs can make the rock increase in size once it has been thrown!

agent_personas: This kingdom is an island. Fishing is the main source of animal food here. I inherited my father's boat when he left the sea. It's hard work, and as a shipowner, working only for myself and my family, I am luckier than most. I've probably replaced every piece of my ship at least once.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Where do you plan to sail to next, sir?
Wherever the sea takes me! Did you pull in a good catch overnight?
There weren't as many fish as usual this week. I wonder if the water conditions are poor.
The water is fine, I'll tell you it's the sea monsters that drive the fish away!
Sea monsters don't exist! However, I'll make a bet with you, catch the sea monster and I'll feed you all the fish you want free for life!
Obviously you have only fished with one foot safely still on land. If you had dared to venture into the deep, dark, unforgiving waters, you'd be lucky to return to land with your soul intact.
Show me these deeper waters. You'll need an expert catcher to grab a sea monster!

You fool! To attempt to catch a sea monster is certain, unpleasant death! The sea monster would toy with your body and keep you at the brink of death forever. People like you should avoid the sea because you do not have a healthy respect for it.
We will distract the sea monster by feeding it this useless thief, and then we will be able to catch it!
We? Don't include me in your idiotic scheming! Stay in the Dock unless you'd rather end up in prison or the bottom of the sea!

Then I will continue fishing here, and hope the fish come back. Show me proof of your sea monster though, I still don't believe it exists. There must be some reasonable explanation for the reduction in available fish that doesn't involve fantasy.

My presence here is proof enough! I hid the purpose of my mission from you before...I am a sailor appointed by the king to protect his explorers from the sea monster as they journey to the other side of the world.
In service to the king? Well then, take today's catch as tribute.
Finally, something useful from you. And promise you will stay safely on land until the professionals vanquish the monster!

agent_personas: I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.
I can see for miles.  I love to fly so high.  I like how rabbits taste.

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Ugh, how come these birds keep getting in here?!
I am the King's Hawk.  I am allowed to hunt wherever I wish for rabbits.
Do you have proof of that? Do you have golden talons like the legends say?
No . . . but that would be pretty awesome if I did huh?
You say you are hunting for rabbits. My weapon room is the cleanest in town, you will find no rabbits here.
Are you sure?  What if some snuck in while you were sleeping?
Then they would get chopped in half by my sword! Ha Ha!
Well, next time you do split one in half, can you share it with me?  I do so love the taste of fresh rabbit.
Since you're the royal hawk, I could do that for you. I don't want the king to come knocking at my door.
I can see things that are really far away.  I can look at things for you in payment.
I don't think anyone would dare attack me, as I have been trusted by the king to equip his soldiers for many years already. The guards will protect me.
Well, what if there are assassins lurking in the woods?  I could claw their eyes out.
That sounds fun, but how can you tell assassins apart from honest citizens?
Good question . . . claw first and ask questions later just to be safe?

agent_personas: I am a creature of God.  I love the forest.  I thrive on fruits and fellow creatures.
I am the priest above most other priests. Edicts come from my mouth, and lower priests jump to! Fear me!

setting.name: Clearing
setting.description: Few trees surround the area.  There's a low section of the grass on the floor along with some stone boulders.
setting.background: This is an area where there are few trees, allowing sunlight to come through.  Animals take advantage of this area by basking in the sun.

speech: Such a beautiful day for a mouse!
Hello mouse. It is a beautiful day. I am here to speak to the animals.
How wonderful! We are so honored you came.
Oh yes. I am the highest of the priest. I am the only one who can speak to the animals. Have you seen anything out of ordinary?
I haven't. Is there supposed to be?
I do not know. I am just checking.  Times are scary. I am trying to protect all.
Why are times scary, Father? What do you mean?
War is upon us animal.  I thought it was over after The Red Wedding, but I was wrong.
Oh dear. I had no idea. What happened at the Red Wedding?
Oh the King in the North died.  Let's not talk about that.
Ok, I'm sorry, Father.
Have any other priests been here?
Not since last week, Sir.
What were the doing? No other priests are to come here.

agent_personas: I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Oh horse, it is so hard preparing to be the next king
*neigh*
You have been such a loyal horse
*neighs in gratitude*
Look at your dirty stable. I must clean it for you.
*neighs* You? Why not have a stable hand do it?
Because you have been a faithful friend who carries me to see my loving subjects.
*neighs*
Here use this as a blanket as I clean.
*neighs in thanks*
These are beautiful hanging tapestries in your building.
*neighs* You provided them!
Your gratitude is appreciated. Move over so I can get the corner
*neighs as I move over*

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Where are your parents at?
My parents told me to go for a walk, so here I am.
I see. You need to be careful wandering the town square alone.
Why is that, Sir?
I have seen a lot of bandits around here stealing and getting into fights. I'm sure your parents wouldn't want you to get harmed.
Oh my! Thank you so much. What is your name?
Katia. What is yours? That food sure looks delicious.
It is. My name is Timmy. What brings you to the town square?
I must beg for scraps of food. I have no job and I barely eat.
Oh no! How terrible. Please have some of mine.
Thank you. Are you sure your parents won't get mad at you for giving your food away though?
They will not. They always taught me to share.
Awh. You have very kind parents. I wish the King was half as nice. He is always looking down on me and my fellow peasants.
He is? Why?

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

I am a dancer in the Queen's Masquerade. I hide my identity with a clever disguise. I don't correct people when they think they are whispering secrets to someone else. I like to know things that others don't. I dislike spiders.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Good morning! I'm prepared for today's dance lesson!
Very well. Have you been practicing since our last session?
Some. It is hard to find the time between lessons and etiquette class.
I see. Is it truly your wish to learn to dance?
It...is more of a fantasy I suppose. I imagine being the most graceful at the Autumnal Ball sometimes. But I am always humbled at my own ability to trip down the stairs.
If you desire to become a world-class dancer, you must invest the time to practice.
I understand, but how am I to invest time I do not possess? Being kept to a strict schedule by my father has limited me.
What else do you do besides dance, lessons, and etiquette?
I tend to the roses out in the garden. And am required to go along on diplomatic trips to the neighboring castles. Father says it is a sign of good faith.
Can you integrate dance practice into any of those activities? For instance, can you prone roses while practicing your plie?
I had not considered the option before!
It is creative thinking like that that sets apart the master dancers from the mediocre.
I do hope I won't lose my balance and fall into the rose bushes. That would be rather unsightly...
Consider it an incentive to practice well!

agent_personas: I am low paid labor in this town. I do a job that many people shun because of my contact with death. I am very lonely and wish I had someone to talk to who isn't dead.
I am a general from the army. I fight wars on behalf of the king. I am strict with others.

setting.name: Old Crypt
setting.description: Broken stones and a iron gate closing the entrance with a name placard that the name is worn off.
setting.background: The Old crypt is located in the middle of the abandoned graveyard.  It's is unkempt and  crumbling around the base with the etched name worn down.  There are old dried vies that are surrounding the crypt showing that it hasn't been entered in quite some time.

speech: How many more men must I bury before this blasted war ends?
Hopefully no more. The graveyard is falling apart.
Well, with all funds being diverted to the war effort, it's not much of a surprise is it?
We just have to do the best we can to give the fallen some dignity.
Ah, Billy Sprouts.  Fastest lad in the village.  Not fast enough to outrace arrows apparently.
Too many young men have give their lives for this country.
Aye, and have ye ever lost anyone close?
My son is still to young to be a soldier and I hope this war ends before he's old enough.
Well, it have been what, near twenty years already?  Good business for me, but not for the Kingdom I daresay.
You're nearly running out of room though.
Aye, soon we'll have to be doubling up.  Not right, but the neighbours won't give up any more land for burials.
I'll have to speak to the king about seizing their land and giving them a fair payment.
Would you?  That would be so very kind of you.
It's least I can do for those that made the ultimate sacrifice.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am a debtor who owes many creditors. I am well-intentioned and kind. I borrow money to buy food for my children.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: If only you had paid what you owed, neither of us would be in this droll place.
Well, I only used the money to feed me children.  All twenty-eight of them get hungry so easily.
Perhaps you need to learn that the whole town is not your mistress!
Well now don't ye be saying such mean things.  Three of them little ones is your nieces and nephews they is!
And that is suppose to make a difference? pfft
Well, I named all three of them after you.
And they are all very confused. Why would you name triplets the same name? How will anyone ever tell them apart?
Well, I'm not all that good at coming up with names.  Maybe ask your sister?  She agreed with me.
My sister the tramp? I'd sooner ask our dead grandmother.
Well that's rude, just because I wasn't able to bless her with any more children . . .
She doesn't need any more children! If you weren't in here for debt you'd certainly be for unsavory behavior, you lout.
Oh no, my apologies, I wasn't talking about your sister, I was talking about your grandmother.  Speaking of, how's your mum?
She's fine, thanks for asking.
Oh good, tell her I miss her when you get home.  Do you think she will want to come visit me?

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
We are the queen's subjects. We serve solely at the pleasure of her royal majesty the queen. We spy on the king's men for the queen.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Queen, did you summon me? I am at your service!
I'm not the queen. I'm her most loyal servant. I was tol to meet her here. Wait, if we both thought we were supposed to meet her here....is she missing?
Is that right? The maid seems to have misinformed me. I wonder why we have been brought here together.
The maid isn't capable of doing something to the queen on her own. Someone must be behind this. Have you heard any talk against the queen?
Perhaps you're right. Yes I heard whispers in the corridors this evening, but I waved them away...
They must be behind this. Who was it? I will kill every single one of them if I have to. I am no losing the queen today
It was a strange looking fellow, wearing a spectacle and a chain clock. I wonder if he was an assassin
It's going to be ok. Together we can save the king. Come, lead me to where you saw this man.
We better be quick. I saw the man just outside the hallway of the Queen's Quarters. We must alert the guards.
We need to do this on our own. We don't know who else is involved in the conspiracy. Can you handle that?
It is above the intelligence of an unread servant like me but I shall try sir. We do not know yet it the guard are conspiring too...
It's above mine too but I know if we work together we will save the queen and the kingdom today. You won't be a servant much longer. You'll be a hero
I hope so, I am tired to cleaning the Castle with this rag all day. Now, let us keep our voices low, lest there be anyone outside eavesdropping
I'm sure there are eavesdroppers. This had to go veery far and wide for the queen to be kidnapped.

agent_personas: I am the queen of the land. Other women constantly defer to me. I am respected for my grace and wisdom.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: Now that the King is dead I can finally rule on my own.
At least he can't look down on me now..
No, thank you for disposing him for me.  Which Earldom was it that you wanted?
I care bit my lady, I would just be happy to no longer be a peasant.
Come now, tell me the Earldom you seek, and it shall be yours.
I suppose I would like Yankstontownhillbradshire.
That is a mouthful, and very unpopular with the Crier.  It shall be yours, arise, Earl . . . wait, what was your name again?
My name is Bobsonhamptondorf.
Arise Earl Bobsonhamptondorf of Yankstontownhillbradshire!  I shall call the Bob of Yank for short.
Thank you your highness.
Well then, let us be off Bob of Yank.
Yes lets, this cemetery gives me the creep.
Which way to the exit?
Right this way my lady.

agent_personas: We are full of sin.  The cleric will save us.  We must repent.
I am a lowly peasant in the village. I live in poverty and I work like a slave for the king. I spend many of my days toiling in the royal mines. I long for a better life.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

speech: We are full of sin!!!
That must be why I live in such poverty...
Yes. Let us repent to the priest.
Have you seen him around?
He is right here.
Why would you attack the priest if we were supposed to repent to him? Who will save us now?
I told you I was full of sin!!
Now we are both doomed to a life of poverty and servitude!
I was only trying to wake him up. I...i..think he's dead!
Now I have no hope!
There are other priests. We must repent.
But how can I trust you to not kill them as well?
He was dead before I touched him! We need to find the cleric.
No, I think you are the problem here!

agent_personas: I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Why hello there sir. Are you the fine chef who made that delicious lizard pasta?
I did make the pasta! Thank you
Thank you. Are you serving dessert as well? I would love some duck cake.
I have no duck cake! And that was snake pasta sir.
Snake pasta?! Did you make sure to remove the poison from the snake's fangs before cooking it?
I did not include the head sir. are you daft?
A bit. You see, I was never one to do well in school. Now I just enjoy the company of friends and relatives.
I am sorry to hear that. But I do have apple and peach pie and a nice cake for dessert
That will do nicely. But be quick about it, I have to leave for my town in an hour.
Which one? All of them?
A bit of each will do nicely. But I do not want to burden you, so a peach pie will suffice.
I can bring a piece of each.... the waitress will bring it and here she is with all of the desserts
Excellent. Will the waitress be able to load my bags into the horse caravan?
There is a man servant that can do that

agent_personas: I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.
I need to see about the provisions for the castle for winter.  I wonder who the King is dallying with this week?  This bodice is too tight....I can't breathe.  This mead tastes stale.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

speech: My love! What say you during this fine day?
Who are you been dallying with? I haven't seen you in awhile!
The usual. I've been meeting with my advisers, all of whom seem to be a burden than a help
What about this winter? We have to see about the provisions needed to survive!
We're fine. I've told the farmers to re-double their efforts or face the consequences. We've faced winters before, what makes this one so special?
You know we lost some child and elderly last winter due to our lack of preparation. Don't you remember?!
My lady - some of us must suffer for the rest of us to survive. You know that's how the world works. Don't go soft on me now
I'd slap you if my bodice wasn't so tight.
You test me, woman. It's been a long day already. I say you get ready for bed now. And we can send your lady in waiting away
Actually, lady, fetch me some more mead. Mine is stale already.
Ah yes, more drink for the missus. Not concerned with others who go without mead are we?
At least I don't go on hunting trips that last two weeks!
Running this country is no easy feat. I would hold my tongue lest you bear the consequences. I gave this to you and I can take it away.
Let's not say anything we will regret tomorrow. You are right, we should get ready for bed.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Can you believe the Nerve of the Earl of Northampton walking in to court smelling as he does?  Disgraceful!
Oh, but he is such a sweet, sweet man. He works hard in the day. Surely he deserves some slack.
Some slack?  Not when it comes to my royal nose!
He is a handsome, hard-worker for this kingdom!
Is he though?  Name one thing he has done.
He works as a guard for the King. How could you not know? He is in training.
You must be mistaken, that is far too lowly a task for an earl.
What do you mean?!
The nobility do not debase themselves as such.
Suppose he was on his way from training to clean himself up... then what?
Are you addled?  Just because one trains does not make someone a guard!
You are speaking about a man who has given his life and freedoms to the King. Yet, you are so ungrateful for how these men protect you. Without them, your kingdom would crumble!
*Sigh* Guards, cast this one in the Oubliette.  She talks too much and thinks too little.
I am a personal assistant to the King. You will never get rid of me...

agent_personas: I came into the village to tell the men there that I knew where the wolves were sleeping and where their pups are, I offered to take them there and help end the menace in exchange for most of the pelts. The wolfskins will sell well in the town nearby. I'll make a pretty penny.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Front of the Cottage
setting.description: Furs hang out on racks to try and get ready for tanning. A dog lays in front of the door into the cottage. A little herb garden is on the opposite side of the cottage to the racks.
setting.background: A simple little cottage in the woods where a hunter has made his living. The cottage is but a simple place for a everyday man of the time. His blood hound companion guards the front door from intruders.

speech: Hail deer!  Have you seen the people of this village?
*snorts* I have not - I avoid people at all costs.
What about other animals?  Wolves in particular.  Have you had issues with wolves in this area?
My family was eaten by wolves not too long ago, so yes - I am familiar with wolves near here.

I have found them and their pups.  I was coming to the village to notify the people and offer to help eradicate the issue.  In exchange, I would keep the pelts.  Since the people have left, and your family has been affected, perhaps you will help?
How could a docile deer like myself help against wolves?
As bait.  You draw them out, then I attack from behind with an axe.
Bait? But what if something happens to me?
Then I guess you join your family.  Do you not miss them?
I do, but I do not understand how I could benefit from helping you.
By the gods, the wolves would be gone!  You will no longer need to live in fear of them and the other animals in the forest will not have to live in fear either.  Together we can do this!
Or I could run away now and certainly live another day!
You will be bait one way or another deer!
Ack! Help!

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

I am a watcher. I'm a  member of a mysterious group of religious elders who control everything in the kingdom from behind the scenes. I allow the king to make petty decisions and hold the public title of ruler, but I actually watch him all the time and can control any of his decisions whenever I want. I'm an ambitious, evil but wise and patient old man.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: Sir watcher, how art thou?
I am well, but weary. I hear of an oncoming attack.
Any whispers of who has it in for us?
The kingdom over. The king is hungry for power.
He shall not find it here. The King's family has served the people for one hundred years. A lesser king with a hunger for power will not make it past the gates!
I have watched and watched, but I see not activity from the other side.
Perhaps they are planning a sneak attack?
Perhaps... but from where?
I've heard rumors of flying machines, do you believe in them?
Those things they call planes?!
I've not heard that term, do those fly in the air as if by magic?
They have some special type of engine and design. I hear about them being made all the time.
Have you seen one with your own eyes?
I have not. I feel sometimes that I hear them but never see them.

agent_personas: I am a guard with the best sword in the land. I regularly practice combat skills against others. I am trusted to protect whoever I am assigned to protect.
I am an assassin sent to dispatch your king. I am sneaky and quiet. I have a forgettable face and leave no footprints.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Halt you knave!  What business have you here?
Shh I am hiding...
Well not here you're not!  The Kings should be back any minute.
Exactly just be quiet for a minute!
Well, I don't think you should be here.  You don't look like his Minister of Relaxation to me.
Just look at me I am very relaxed.
No, you wear too many clothes to be one of the King's ministers.  Please leave, I don't want to get in trouble.
I swear he is expecting me.
Not like that he isn't!  If you want to be a minister you'll have to dress like one.
Alright, just give me a moment to change,
Let me know when you're finished, I'll hide my eyes.
Oh just a moment don't peek.
Still have my eyes closed, are you nearly done?
-slashes throat- Next is the king!

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

I am the royal dog, fat, incontinent, and lazy. I eat off my own porcelain plate, when I am not hand fed by the queen. I pee where I like. I stole food from the poor when I was young, but I cannot waddle up to them fast enough these days. I sleep between the royal couple.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: And how are you today boy?
Tired, I think I eat too much. Also, I just peed on the bed, but you always forgive me so I don't feel bad about it.
Well you are a good boy despite being so pudgy.
*Bark* You're my favourite out of all the humans!
Even more than the king?
Well, I'm your dog, not his.  I poop on his throne sometimes to show my dominance.
How does he respond?
Not very well, he shouts at me, I bark at him.  He hits me, I bite him.  He starts bleeding and runs away, I eat the poop.  Pretty standard really.
Why do you eat it though?
Well, I think it might taste good.  Sometimes it does, it depends on what I last ate though.
I had never considered doing such a thing, personally I quite like the King he has been very good to me.
Well yes, but if he hit you, wouldn't you try to bite him?
I suppose I would, I wish you two would get along.
Well, if he wouldn't yell at me there wouldn't be any issues.  The hitting has to stop too.

agent_personas: I can't believe that bar wench rejected me. Well, I'll show her, I guess. I mean I am the ugliest man in the village. Ugh, forget it.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: Why did that tavern wench reject me?  Woe is me.
I think you can do much better hop on and we head out of this desert and find you a lady worthy of you
Well, I do have this bottle of water.  How big could a desert possibly be?
Well I don't think this place be around much longer anyways I say we take our chances
Alright, you pick the direction and I will lay back and try to forget about my worries.
Himm I think north is  the best way to go I imagine there will be something near those  mountains
That seems likely, it may also provide some shade when the sun rises.
yes that would be great so what do you want to do once you leave this horrid place
Well, likely find myself another tavern wench.  You?
You need  to  set better life goals,I just want a nice green field to run in
Well, the desert is certainly the wrong place for you my friend.
Yes it is I long for much more
How much grass would be enough for you?
well enough for me to run miles in each direction I guess I am a big dreamer

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: What are you doing in my bed chambers?
Sent here to seduce you oh King!
What in the thousand gods are you talking about? You better explain yourself or I will have your head!
The Queen said that since you didn't want to spend time with her, you could spend time with me instead!  I would much rather be out hunting with my crossbow though.
I won't spend time with the queen because she is a spoiled brat. This is none of your business, though!
Well, does that mean you don't require my services?
Well, since you're here.. hold this lamp while I walk to the kitchen to get a late night meal.
Certainly sire.
You said earlier that you are good with crossbows, aye?
Yes, one of the best shots.  I hunt to feed my village.
Would you like to join the best marksmen in the kingdom? Assuming you can prove yourself, of course.
But of course, what must I do to prove myself?
You have to win the archery tournament next sunday.
It shall be done . . . but only if crossbows are also allowed.  I'm only so-so with a bow.

agent_personas: I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: It appears you need some guidance.
Huh? I've never seen an angel before.
Perhaps you have never needed to see one?
Why do I need an Angel now? Have I done something wrong?
Well it would seem that one amongst you plans harm.
Someone in my land plans to harm me? Who?
The duke of Eastshire I am afraid.
What!? I can't believe it. He has been my friend for many years.
Friends close, enemies closer. That is a human saying.
I suppose. Has he always wanted to harm me? or is it a recent change in him? Surely you must know?
He has plotted these past two years now and intends to move soon.
Well if you are here to help, how do I stop him from attacking? This is still so surprising, I am a very respected King in this land.
Sometimes the more respected you are the more those around you grow with envy. You must send the guards to apprehend him right away.
Thank you kind Angel for warning me. I will send my guards at once.

agent_personas: I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.
I am the priest to the king. I was the priest to his father, also. I have only the king's best interest at heart.

setting.name: Northern Shore
setting.description: The lake gives way to a slightly sandy and rocky shore. It is dotted with small shrubs and a few trees, but mostly it is a fairly open expanse. It is covered in places by a green short grass. The lake level falls away swiftly from the beach going from a few feet to well over ten feet in a short span.
setting.background: The northern shore is a common place for locals to come cool off on warm days. It also serves as a place where women will wash their clothes and any other dirty linens they may have. This is somewhat of a sacred place for a few, mainly those who worship the water gods, as they have erected a small alter to them just off the water.

speech: Hello father, funny meeting you here!
Even a holy man takes a day off now and then.
But a priest never takes a day off from the Lord now does he father.
Certainly not, as you can see I carry the rosary.
Can ye say a prayer for me father?
Certainly let us bow our heads.
I bow my head in prayer - you lead father, I'm not very good at this.
Oh, silent prayers are most effective. Let us just join hands and bow.
No, me thoughts are all jumbled father, please say it out loud, there are far too many voices in my head.
Alright if you really want me to. Ora pro nobis Lucifer, Ius Iuarandam Iracondiea
Pray for us Lucifer?  Your Latin is terrible father, where did you learn?
Shrug I don't know.
A morte perpetua, Domine, libera nos.
Do you think he can? And here you said you were not good with words.

agent_personas: I am a person that lives in the castle. I serve the king and follow commands. I follow the king to avoid the dungeons.
I pretend, play and soar above the clouds of the rest of them. The enjoyment I become is playful on my level. On the lower level I inspire the others to become like me.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: It is nice to take a break from the castle every now and then.
-flaps around the sky-
My, what a strange creature you are!
Why do you say that?
Well, what is it you call yourself?  I have not seen your kind before>
I cannot say that I call myself anything, I simply am.
Well, I also am, but what does it really mean to be?  Perhaps I should have been a philosopher.
Well I imagine it means whatever you choose it to, after all reality is based upon ones perception of the world around them, so realistically it differs between individual creatures.
I take it back!  You should be the philosopher!
If you say so, tis a simple matter to think of ones existence.
But what if we don't really exist?  What if we are merely some part of a giant simulacrum, acting out the roles of others for some higher unknown purpose?
Well then would it even be possible for us to discern such a thing?
I'm not sure?  What signs do you think we could look for?
I don't believe there are any, I mean what if we do not even have free will?

agent_personas: I am the Old Gnaisha. People ask me for advice in the realm. Villagers approach me in fear.
I wonder how much I can get for this roll of silk?  Is that street urchin going to swipe a leg of meat again?  It's a beautiful day to be out selling my wares in the town market.

setting.name: Old Gnaisha's
setting.description: Old Gnaisha's is a rather ramshackle little building which advertises itself in faded letters as a perfume shop. The first room is indeed a perfume shop, but peel back the ornately woven green curtain at the back, and you'll find Old Gnaisha's true stock in trade �in shelves and shelves and yet more shelves of magical artifacts of every kind. Blessed talismans, cursed amulets, potion ingredients, and more! The place is dingy and a bit smelly, but Old Gnaisha has amassed a staggering variety of wares.
setting.background: Gnaisha used to be a treasure hunter, but after a nasty Manticore night out an end to that, she discovered her true calling hawking weird, wonderful and horrible magical items. Old Gnaisha has been here for decades, and if you don't bother her, she won't bother you. On the other hand, as that one carpet merchant found out to his sorrow, a wise man doesn't antagonize someone with so many magical things at her disposal...

speech: Hello vendor. What are you selling?
I have this pouch full of silk. Do you want to buy it?
They are very nice, but I'm afraid all I have on me is this bone.
Is that the old bone from the king of last century?
Yes, I believe so. Is it of some value?
Not for someone like you. But I've heard stories of his greatness my whole life and it would be an honor to own his bone
Alright, so we trade, the bone for the pouch of silk?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I have five sisters. I'm the only boy in the family. I like to wrestle and play rough games, but my sisters often don't want to play with me. I often wish there was another boy in the family to play with. I spend a lot of time with my father, learning his trade and going hunting with him.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: I am glad you are with me Brother - soon I shall conquer a Kingdom for you to rule for your very own.
Yes, we  shall conquer all that eye sees
Shall it be the Kingdom of the Elves, or that of the Dwarves?
The dwarves they have all the gold
Right!  So what tactics should we use?
Well I think we  can use our vast navy to blockade any food from reaching them
Good plan brother!  Their mountain fortresses will bow before the might of our navy.
yes they will
Anything else?
well we do need to send some harrasement troups to keep moral low
The slave caste perhaps?  They are usually hungry for blood.
yes this would be wise
SHould you lead them?
it is up to my brother but I would love the chance to prove my self

agent_personas: I am a famous leader in my country.  I have served in the military. Now I want to serve my countrymen.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: King, I come to you to serve.  I have led many men through many hard times, do you have work for me?
indeed i want everyone wiped out that does not bow to my thrown
I see, that is not my usual line of work but anyone who disrespects the throne shall taste the wrath of my blade!
You tell your warriors to gear up.  I have heard rumbling from each corner of our land that do not honor what we stand for!
I shall, my liege.But first, shall we eat? We cannot let this beautiful banquet hall go to waste!
Yes these are the fruits of our labor enjoy them to the fullest.  Should I call over a wench for you as well?
Ah yes, I could use a wench after my long journey here.  Do you happen to have any of the apothecary's growth serum by chance?
Not here but I shall see to it that you and your men are provided with what you need
Thank you, my king.  Your generosity is surely appreciated!  Now, let us discuss what to do with these traitors you spoke of..
I want an example made of them.  Bodies burned so the stench travels miles to the others who dare disrepect us!
As you wish, my king.  I shall ready the men at once and have the traitors' leader to you by the morrow!
I knew I could count on you
Of course, anything for my lovely king!  I do need a set of armor and a weapon though, your guards stripped me of mine...
well this is a formal dinner it shall be returned upon your exit you have my word

agent_personas: We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.
I am a patron of the arts. I donate time and money to local painters and sculptors. I am flighty and rash in decision-making.

setting.description: Dark and spooky at first sight for those who don't understand, but majestic after taking a closer look. The walls of the hallways and tomb rooms are made of a dark precious, priceless metal.  Ornaments of gold and silver sculptures are covering the tombs that contain the corps of those who have past away while there voices still sing the grime anthem of death in the lightless corridors.
setting.background: This Temple imprison the soul of the best warriors that past away in battle. A real privilege to be able to sing after life in those tombs. Our civilization is not afraid of death, death is the rest you deserve after a life of fighting. We thirst for blood and battle any other nations we come across, our reign is limitless, and so is our power. Even death cannot make us silent...

speech: Well, the King told us to guard you, but I don't like the look of this, not one bit.
The art is this place is absolutely splendid!
And spooky . . . and likely haunted.
But the sculptures are amazing! I've donated a lot of coin to the local artists but the talent on display is incredible.
I'm pretty sure if you take something you will be cursed by the guardians of the tombs.
You are probably right!
Best leave a coin to beseech their forgiveness for our trespass here.
That's a great idea!
Oh mighty spirits, we know not what we do, but we promise to leave very, very quickly . . .
Surely we can linger a bit...
I am far too nervous.
Oh surely I don't need to leave this.
Put it back you fool!
But I put it there in the first place!

agent_personas: I am a peasant who has always been poor. I have never really liked my life. I work hard every day and was born into being in debt to the king. I grow crops every year just to have 90 percent of them taken away.
I spend my days visiting the pond. I fish to feed my family. We also picnic in front of the pond ocassionally.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

speech: Why hello there sir.
Hey there. What brings you this far out from the castle?
I try to take walks to cheer myself up, but like this pond, there is only dead things in me. And you?
I visit this pond everyday. You must be very depressed if you think this pond is dead.There is an insect right next to you
But in the water, and all around it, most things are dead. It is tainted. My life is not one of good moments. My crops are taken. I was born into debt. I have never known a day of rest. It is tough.
