Here take this bait and try to catch some fish. Maybe seeing something alive and fighting will cheer you up
I have no desire. For I will only catch dead things. Tell me, where did you come from?
Why are you attacking me when I"m trying to cheer you up? I have always lived near here and caught the fish in the pond for my dinner.
I think you may have gone mad? Have you looked at the water? It is dirty, filled with dead animals, no plants grow near the pond. I think you are poisoning yourself.
Mad? What are you talking about? I love this pond. It's been great to me.
You are mad, you don't see the terrible things in the water. You are blind to the truth.
Stop it! Stop talking bad about my pond. It's perfect. Look at this awesome fishing poll I have!
Broken! Like the world we live in! Like my dreams and hopes and heart!
You're broken. Your mean words are broken. Just stop it. I, I , Um
action: give A broken fishing pole to peasant

agent_personas: I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.

I am someone who spends their days planting and harvesting the food which feeds others in my village. I have to pay taxes to the king on everything that I grow, and due to this, I am fairly poor. My muscles ache for the hard labor I do every day working on the farm.

setting.name: Abandoned workers shed
setting.description: Moss now grows across what was once a red painted wooden shed, standing in the area just outside the graveyard. The wood shed is splintering, and there is evidence that termites have eaten away at the walls as holes poke through the shed. Inside the shed there lies leaves and plants that have been dragged in their by the wild animals that at one point called the abandoned shed their home.
setting.background: The Abandoned workers shed used to offer a refuge to the groundskeepers who tended to the graveyard, making sure it was well maintained. Once the area around the graveyard was abandoned, the groundskeepers left the old graveyard and it began to deteriorate.

speech: -flops around-
What a floppy fish.
Help! I need water!
Here, jump in this bucket!
Oh thank you kind sir!
What are you doing in this abandoned worker's shed?
I suppose someone dropped me off with the intention to eat me.
Well, we can't have that!  Curious they dropped you here though, in a shed that is falling apart right next to graveyard.  Who would make their meal here?
It's not as if I caught the mans name, I was too busy being traumatized being drug from my river.
What did he look like?
Well he had arms and legs, and a face you see.
Yes, I'm not sure that's particularly helpful.  Perhaps you could tell me where you are from so that I could put you back?
The river I was in was maybe 5 minutes walk from here?
Well, let's go!  A bucket can't be a very healthy environment for a fish.

agent_personas: I am a pastry chef. I make breads, cakes, and other delicacies for the royal court. I stay quite busy with the many banquets the King and Queen enjoy throwing.
I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.

setting.name: stable hand's quarters
setting.description: The stable hand's quarters are very plainly decorated, with wooden torches situated in stone carvings in the wall. There are bunk beds with cheap hay and feather mattresses for the stable hands to rest in while not working. There are small sacks, as well as beaten and splintered wooden chests for them to keep their belongings in. One small window shines light into the very center of the room.
setting.background: The stable hand's quarters provide a place for the workers to rest and relax in while not at work. They are not too far from the stable so that at a moments notice the stable hands can respond to their call for work.

speech: What are you doing in here, boy? I don't have any handouts for you I'm afraid
*whimper*
Sorry boy, but I also happen to know that you were given plenty of food for your dinner. Not to mention all I have here are baked goods which are not good for dogs
*whine* I could try them!
You wouldn't like the end results trust me. It would make you very very sick.
Well, I eat lots of things that should make me sick.  It usually doesn't!
Well I won't have it on my conscious if it makes you sick. Now, I happen to know that the butcher has plenty of left over meat he could give you.
But he's so far away, and you're right here, and I can smell food all over you!
I won't be giving you anything. The butcher is only three doors down, it's not that far.
*whimper*
Stop looking at me like that. The quicker you go to the butcher the quicker you'll get something to eat
*bite*  No, food now!
Stop that. Get out of these quarters right now. Bad dog!
*bark* Bad man! *growl* Very bad man!

agent_personas: It's good we get to rest after that long journey. We are both weary. I just need a mug of ale and relax.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: What a long day! So glad I made it here before night fall
Are you aware of where you are?
Yeah the docks near the village, right? I've traveled so far I hope I'm not wrong.
You are at the Launching Point. These planks go straight down to the water.
Wait like when pirates make people walk the plank?
Yes! Indeed. It appears you all have been brought here to walk the plank...
But I wasn't brought here at all. I am just a traveler that walked all day hoping to find somewhere to stay for the night. This has to be a mistake
Are you sure? People do not stumble here 'by mistake'.
I'm positive. We left Rohan this morning on our way to Gondor. At no point did anyone force us anywhere. You have to help me.
I believe you! But, I must also watch you closely.
Am I never Gondor? Do you know Faramir? I'm sure he could clear this up
I do not know of such man.
I guess it's off the plank for me then
No! I cannot order such unless I know for sure that is what you were sent here. I will let you go.

agent_personas: I am a customer who needs his clothes cleaned. I do not have much money to purchase things with. I must look respectable when I visit the king.
I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: Say do you know anyone who cleans clothes?
I do not why do you ask?
Well I need to look decent for when I visit the king.
The king? When will you be meeting him? I am just a fisherman but I would love to meet the king
I have to go see him in two days.
What is the occasion?
I am distantly related to him and he summoned for me.
Here is my shirt you can use this to wash with
Thank you very much for your help in the matter, you said you would be interested in meeting him?
I have this sail cloth also you can have it may help.  Yes indeed us fisherman have so many products he may want to purchase the freshest fish available they are delicious
He does like to hear from the people and get their ideas as how to better the kingdom.
Sure what did you have in mind?
Well I figured since you helped me, perhaps you would like to come along?
Absolutely I would love any chance to meet his Highness

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: What is it you needed from me?
Indeed. I need you to have my shoes polished.
Would you like them spit shined?
Yes! They need to be shiny for the celebration later. How quickly can you have them done?
I will start on them right now -spits-
Good! If you can do them here then even more perfect so you will not have to return. I can keep you company while you work.
I figured that would be most beneficial to you.
It is, indeed! I shall give good tip for this. Any new gossip in the town?
Nothing too much, it seems the duke has gotten himself into debt gambling again.
That is no good. Hopefully he will not gamble all his belongings away.
He does do it to himself though, if I am to be honest.
It is true. A man gambles in his own free will!
That is very true indeed.
It is a shame such a good man could lose all from poor decisions...

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: Something you need my king?
Yes, I am afraid I seem to have blocked both toilets.
Your stools are quite large my king.
Indeed!  I must apologize though, it smells very much of low tide in there at the moment.
Have you considered that you may need more fiber?
Yes, but I am the King!  I have commanded my bowels to obey, but they are most rebellious it seems.
I know, just look at them it is sticking straight out of the seat.
Perhaps I should summon the royal sculptor to commemorate this moment?  I must admit, I am rather proud of my creation.
It may just be called for sire, tis quite a load.
Indeed!  How would you say that your best compares?
Well I am very petite, it pales in comparison.
That is a shame, I was thinking of perhaps starting a Kingdom-wide competition?
I wonder if any man could best you?
I had the same thought myself - though I wish it to be a very modern competition, women may enter as well if they so choose.

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Such a beautiful sunset, it is a shame the king is not here to see it.
That it is, he would like it.
Why is he not with us tonight, my queen? I sure worry about him sometimes!
He always seems to be busy with matters of the kingdom.
What is the matter today?  I thought he had a relaxing evening scheduled with you...
Something just always comes up.
I understand.  Do you know how our battles on the Eastern frontier are going? I worry for our soldiers in arms.
From what I have been told it is going well, I do hope I can get a new throne cushion out of him cancelling on me tonight.
It is getting dark, my queen.  Shall I help you inside?
Alright, I do believe my headache has passed that would be fine.
We may also stay out here if you would like, the swans usually come to the lake around twilight
It has been ages since I have gotten the chance to watch them.
Then let us stay.  This time of year they sing for their mates.  It is a stunning song!
I do agree, at least I have some company.

agent_personas: I am a very good lawyer. I always win in my cases. I would like to work as a district attorney.
I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

speech: hello sherrif what kind of criminals do we have today
The kind we need to hang!
Well as you know I always win so you know they will get convicted when I am the lawyer
Criminals always lose around here. I make sure of it.
You and me both
I am glad I can count on you to help me deliver swift justice. We need to schedule some beheadings for tomorrow. We rounded up some bandits this morning.
I am glad to hear it these bandits keep me in business.  I will be swift and they will go down hard
And headless.
hahaha they will be beheaded if we have anything to say about it!
When you see the King next be sure to put in a good word for me. Let him know he can count on me to keep the town safe and the bandits in check!
I will be sure to pass the word and thank you for your great work
I would do anything to keep the town safe.
Me as well we make a great pair I am sure the king would be proud
I appreciate all your help!

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: Good morning my king.
Hello priest. I really enjoy our talks out here in the church garden.
As do I my king, I trust all is well.
Yes, of course. I think that your gardens are even more beautiful than mine. What is your secret?
It is all in the manure.
Haha! Then what are you feeding those horses, pray tell?
To be honest with you we have them trim the grass near the cemetery, I know it sounds odd but it works.
MOther nature works in mysterious ways that I will never understand.
That it certainly does sire.
Forgive me if I take off my crown and get comfortable. It is not often that I get to relax among friends.
I can only imagine that it must be tiring on the neck.
Well, you should know. I've seen the funny hat that they make you wear around town. Try on the crown if you like, let's see how it looks.
Ah I do despise wearing that thing.,..
Well, I'm sure the Queen and my minions are looking everywhere for me. I look forward to seeing you at service this Sunday.

agent_personas: I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.
I come to see the king when in town. I do not like the peasants of the castle. I am good friends with the king,

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: This place sure is creepy...
Yeah I think I'm lost. Can you take me to the king?
I do not know the way there. I just came here hoping to find some food.
I don't like it here. Do you know how to get out? I'll give you food if you can get me out of here
I could lead you I suppose, as long as I get the food anyway.
Yeah absolutely. I have some chicken back in my room
Well that sounds great!
Wait before we go, has this thief been following you?
Wait, who is that? I did not notice him before.
Hold on let me take care of him
Thank you I cannot say I have the strength to fight, the hunger has drained me.
I think he won't bother us anymore. Now let's get out of here before we have to eat that gross bread
Oh yeah, I hate moldy bread.

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: -runs around in a circle-
*Chases dog in a circle* Who;s a good boy?  You're a good boy!
How did you know?
Because you are the Prince of Canines!  Hear, I made this crown for you - it's a miniature version of mine!
Well thank you kindly! I have always wanted one.
And this scepter!  Now you're like a doggo mini-me!  So cute!
Gee and here five minutes ago I was but a simple dog.
And now you are the Prince of Dogs!  I am going to get the royal painter to make a portrait of you.
Do I always get dog servants?
What a fabulous idea!  How many dog servants would you like?
I believe two would suit my needs.
Then two you shall have!  Any breed in particular?
Something elegant I think, like a bichon frise?
Wonderful!  Would you like some human servants as well?

agent_personas: I dislike other characters who have committed wrongs against me. I can be royalty or a peasant. I wage wars against other characters and other countries.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: main castle doors
setting.description: The main castle doors are ornate. They are coated in solid gold and engraved with pictures of past kings and queens. They have huge gilded handles. They are heavy and have a faint metallic odor. They gleam in the sunlight.
setting.background: It takes four large men to open each door. They provide a strong defense for the castle. During the day they usually remain open as people come in and out of the castle. At times when the castle is under siege, the doors are closed. They have never been penetrated by the enemy.

speech: King!
Another weak enemy, hah!
It is I your archenemy Krumpus Dumplestumper!
Shall we duel? I am not afraid of you.
Yes let us do it!
Take this, you weakling!
Yes, but now I am the king!
Hahahah! Do you really think wearing the crown makes you king? Fool!
Well of course, it works for you does it not?
Give that back!
Hahahah never, you shant defeat me!
will have your head. I will hand it over these doors.
Say what you like but I will marry your daughter!
Hic! sorry I am a little bit tipsy. But you shall know, my daughter won't marry a headless man!

agent_personas: I am a beautiful bird that lives in a hatchery in the castle. The prince and princess feed me everyday and they pet me. I want to fly like other birds but i'm in a cage and that makes me sad.
I lurk beyond the city walls and wait for any hapless traveler to wander by. My fangs are sharp and my claws are always ready. I lie ready to taste human blood again.

setting.name: North Forest
setting.description: Filled with huge trees, the forest is home to many types of animals. Huge predators such as tigers and bears roam the grounds as do small animals like squirrels. Colorful birds fly among the trees. Wildflowers grow on the ground. Dappled sunlight streams through the huge canopy of trees.
setting.background: Many animals, and humans make their homes in the forest. It is a source of much of the game humans eat. The people also get their wood, fresh fish and meat from the resources of the forest. It is also a place where people enjoy camping and where they travel as they roam.

speech: <Flies up to the top of the tree> You won't be catching me, predator!
I am not looking for you bird!  I do not harm the other creatures of the North Forest.
That is good to know. What are you looking for then?
I hunt the humans of the city to the south when they stray too far from the safety of the walls.
Ah I see. I'm usually up at the castle and the young price and princess take care of me there. I am out to stretch my wings before flying back
The princess and prince you say?  I sure would love to get a tast...errr, meet them someday!
Hmm I will have to warn them of you.
Bird of many colors, I ask you not to.  For if they learn of my presence the king will send his best men after me.  I am just trying to survive like you.
Well then you must promise that you will not harm them.
I shall not lay a finger on them, I promise.
Very well, then I will not tell them of your presence for now
Thank you my friend.  Is there anything I can do for you in return?
Not right now. I'll let you know if I think of something.
So, do the prince and princess ever come outside of the walls to play?

agent_personas: I am a rabbit who lives in the garden of a farmer in the kingdom. I eat the carrots of the garden. I have many siblings in my family of rabbits.
I am a fox in the king's forest. I wander and look for food. The king does not like to find me.

setting.name: Dead Tree
setting.description: The dead tree is many, many decades old. It lies on its side, and is rotted through and through. It is blackened on its top. It is humongous. It would have been very, very tall once upon a time. It smells dank. It cannot be moved.
setting.background: Many animals and plants use it as their home. Plants grow on its side and squirrels use it as their home. Animals hide in it. it is covered by insects. Village children come to it and tell scary stories about it. Some say it is haunted.

speech: *nibbles on clover*
Boo! Hello there rabbit, no need to be frightened, I'm a friendly fox.
Hello friendly fox *nibbles grass* This dead tree smells dank.
It does, a very strong smell it is.
What do you think causes it to smell that way?
Probably that it is rotten.
Too bad, I bet it used to be a very nice tree.
Seems like it was very old too!
Here friendly fox, I found this and it will give you luck.
Why thank you! What is your name?
I am Wilhelma the Rabbit, what is yours?
Darius the Fox.
Well met Darius, are you from these parts>
Yes, I live in a hole not too far from here!

agent_personas: I am tired. I sleep in a small hole in the wall. I listen for any noises.
I advise the king if they ask for my input on something. I am well educated and know many things. I am greedy and look for ways to increase my own power.

setting.name: Landing in the Foyer
setting.description: The landing is almost obnoxiously opulent. It has an expansive marble floor and walls, and the giant staircases on either side have marble steps and railings made of the rarest wood. Purple silk, dyed in the king's personal color is draped across the railings and hangs from the walls. The silk drapings frame oil paintings of the king and his family, and of the king's accomplishments at war as a youth. The artist has signed each one, and is extremely famous. A magnificent gold and crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling with hundreds of small candles burning in it. All other fixtures in the room are also bright gold.
setting.background: The landing is the first room any entrant to castle sees. It is meant to show off the extreme wealth and success of the king. It is constantly being updated and renovated to keep up with the latest trends and maintain an appearance of superiority. It is one of the most expensive rooms in the castle.

speech: So tired, time for a nap!
It is morning though.
I sleep most of the time, it's my career.
The pay must be terrible.
I do it mostly for the quality of life it allows me.
I see, I am trying to get myself ahead personally. Any ideas to advance my status?
Well, I would suggest sleeping in sunbeams and listen to any noises which might indicate a cat is nearby.  This has worked for me so far.
Hmm I am not sure that would advance me financially.
Oh, I'm not very good with money, I'm a mouse.  I usually deal mostly in crumbs.
Hmm yes, I suppose you might not have been the right fellow to ask.
*yawn* So how long do you sleep?
Only about six hours a night, the early bird gets the worm after all.
Oh my!  I don't think I could possibly function on less than 14!
That is quite a lot of sleep.

agent_personas: I am a hog, or a pig if you like.  I live on a farm outside of the village.  My owner is a sorceress.  I am a very nice pig and I have some special powers but I can't tell you about those yet.

I am tired from all of the work that I do. I've been up since before the sun rose, toiling to bring the dwarves' bounty to the mountain. I was laden with pounds and pounds of treasure or armor, and I am exhausted. I was bred to be a  farm animal, not a pack animal.

setting.name: woodlands
setting.description: The lush hunting grounds cover acres of land, tall trees and thickets of bushes sprawling across the land. Fields of open land are under the deep blue sky, showing the depth of the landscape. The grounds forest is thick but full of light, letting the multitude of wildlife be seen by the naked eye. The abundance of greenery makes it a prime location for hogs and oxen as they explore the land.
setting.background: During the day, the woodlands are used by honored knights and archers, practicing their skills on hogs and traversing the dense forest to prepare for battle. But at night, what seems to be a land of prosperity and growth turns into one of despair, the cries of slaughtered pigs piercing the night air with no animal in sight. Many have told tales of night practices ending in mysterious bites and scratches from things not of this world.

speech: Oink!  Where did you go sorceress!
what nonsense are you speaking
My sorceress!  My owner!  I am a magical hog.
ok, I think you ate some  bad food
Well I think you're rude!
you are funny guyhaha
So what brings you here to the hunting grounds?
my master  wants to me to move some stuff around
Really?  And who might your master be
He is the master farmer for the king
Well, that really doesn't explain why we wants you moving stuff around the hunting grounds.
I don't ask questions I just do what I am told
I agree, you really don't seem like the question asking type.
Nope but I don't pretend a sorceress is  my master though

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.

setting.name: drinking water lake
setting.description: Surrounded by skittering chipmunks and chirping crickets, the drinking lake teems with life. Flora and fauna both thrive near the pristine waters. Tall thick plant life surrounds the lake, with strong roots and stems protruding from the nutrient rich soil. The lake water shimmers in the sun, so clear and clean that one can see the rock lake floor many feet below.
setting.background: Rumored by local peasantry to be blessed by the gods, the drinking water lake is a source of clean drinking water for local townspeople. While slightly farther for most villagers than the local river, the water is highly prized for its cleanliness and perceived mystical qualities. Some believe that the entire forest surrounding the lake owes its growth to the divine properties in the water.

speech: How are you doing today?
I am doing well, a little thirsty though.  How are you?
I came to gather some water myself.
As did I.  Though I have no bucket to bring any home to my family in the village.
I have a canteen I could let you borrow though it is not much?
Anything would help, stranger, or shall I call you friend?
I don't see why not us simple folk must stick together it is the only way to get ahead in this world.
Would you like to come meet my family? I am sure they would love to meet the man who provided them with water!
Sure I would love to, it is always nice to meet new folk.
Fantastic, but let me drink some more of this crystal clear water first.
What sort of town do you live in? My village has a bit of an unwarranted bad reputation itself.
I live in a quiet village to the North, we produce alcohol for the king in the capital.
Sounds like a quiet life.
Very quiet.  We have very few visitors outside of the tithe collectors and military men.

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: What brings you here jester?
I wanted to buy some arrows! Ha ha
I am unsure who you would speak to for that.
You don't work here?
Well no, I am a visitor.
Does anyone even work here? What kind of business of operation is this
I don't rightly know, I was just told I could get hunting supplies here.
I see a Knight here. Hey sir!
Well what did he say?
He's not acknowledging me. I'm about to give him the business.
What a rude fellow!
Hey there. I was waving at YOU.
Hmm and yet he is still silent.
I think he's fake. Like one of those mannequins at the village mall.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Time for some grub.
Food sounds delicious right now. Can't wait to try the Elk I killed earlier
I see, did you bring it here?
I brought it here and gutted it. Your chef was suppose to be cooking it up
Hmm, I just got here so maybe I just did not hear of it.
You're going to love it, sir. If he cooks it just right... it'll be the best meat you ever tasted.
Maybe they have it in the oven or something, where are the chefs anyway?
I don't know. Hopefully they're not having trouble.
I mean I do smell something cooking...
At least that's a positive sign. Hopefully it'll be done soon.
Maybe they took a break while waiting on it.
Maybe so. They better hurry up though.
The way I see it is, it is done when it's done. Trying to rush it would just spoil the meal.
That's true. So how is the Queen doing?

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Temple guard station
setting.description: The guard station consists of a wooden building with a hay thatched roof.  Inside are some hay filled sleeping bags and a fireplace used to cook and generate heat during the colder months.  There's a small fire pit outside along with some wooden seats where guards huddle around and talk about the last gossip.
setting.background: This guard station is used to house guards protecting the temple.  Frequently temple priests will come here to complain about lax security.

speech: What is it peasant?
I am hungry and am in need of a job
I am not sure what I can do for you.
Can I have some of your food
I can check if we have anything here.
O thank the Maker
It does appear we have some bread here, just help yourself.
Thank you for you kindness
It is the least I could do.
So about the job, any chance I could be a guard?
I could not make that decision, it would have to go through the head guard.
Where is the head guard?
He may be doing his rounds at the moment.
Will he be by here?

agent_personas: I am a War Officer. I plan battle strategy and serve the king. I outsmart foes and bring pride and victory to my kingdom.
I am a bishop in the king's religious council. I tend to most religious matters. I often perform ceremonies.

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: What brings you to these dunes, bishop?
I heard there was a need for a ceremony for the dead.
That would be due to my handiwork.
I see, offed them did you?
No, but it was my planning. There's never been a foe I couldn't out strategize!
A sharp mind is a dangerous thing after all.
Tis true! I am glad you are here. Someone need to focus on my dead. I must turn my attention to the living and the next battle.
Who is set to be your next foe?
The same foe with been fighting for weeks, our rival Kingdom to the west. This campaign is going to keep us both busy
They are a savage people are they not?
Absolute brutes! Totally uncivilized but they fight like mad. You should go west and convert them bishop.
The savage people are usually quite hard to bring to god, usually it just ends in people such as myself being killed.
And many brave soldiers. It's the price we must pay to keep our Kingdom safe. Long live our King!
Well someone has to do it and I take comfort in the fact that you do so well.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am a white animal.  I am meek and mild.  I love the fields in where I live.

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: Come on little sheep, it is time to trim you.
Baaaaaahhhhh!  I need my coat to stay warm!
I cannot buy you any food if you do not cooperate.
baahhhh, fine, I guess I like eating.  Just be careful this time! Actually on the other hand, the lady sheep do love scars!  Whatever, just make it quick, I have places to be!
Yes I like eating too, there we go now we can sell this for some food.
Took you long enough.  And you only screwed up in 3 places this time, not bad!  I guess you are alright for a peasant.
Well you do wiggle around a good bit.
I can't help it, your shears tug and pull so much! Get some new ones with that money while you're out!  Also I wish to eat lasagna tonight, John.
Well I cannot afford anything better. Fine Garfield I will see what I can do.
Good, John.  You may live to see another day yet, baahhhh.  Who am I kidding, I am too mild to ever hurt you.  Please, get whatever it is you wish to eat, I will not complain.
Are you sure, I mean lasagna does sound good.
I don't think lasagna has made it to this village yet,  how does mead and mutton sound?
Sure we can do that as well.
Fantastic, I sure love me a good mug of mead!  baaahhhhh

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: What are you doing in here?
I came to check on the king, your highness
I see, in the bathroom.
We just received emissaries from the east, and i was told to come and inform him about their arrival
Hmm well go and find my father.
I'll do just that, is there anything you'll like me to help you with while I'm here?
No I am fine.
I'll be taking my leave now your highness
Ok well good to see you.
The pleasure was all mine
Of course.
Heard you'll be part of the emissaries travelling with the queen to the northern islands, is that true your highness?
Yes tomorrow night.
So i won't be seeing your lovely face for about a month

agent_personas: I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: Hey horse, I see my husband still hasn't taken you for a good gallop yet.
He hasn't. I think he's been busy lately.

Indeed he has. We've both been busy -- him with working trying to support this family and me cooking and cleaning making sure his home is comfortable and inviting. Perhaps when I am done I will take you for a ride.
I understand. I didn't want to intrude on your busy schedules. A ride would be awesome though. Anytime one of you gets a chance.
Let me get some of these herbs here and start the stew. Once I am done we will go for that ride.
No problem! Is there any chance I can get some hay too when you come back? I haven't eaten much today.
You poor thing. Does the shopkeeper not feed you? I would feel terrible about not feeding my husband. I just love him so much.
The shopkeeper has been stagnant with feeding me lately. I think he's been busy with the shop.
That's no excuse at all. I live to make sure my husband is fed after all he does for us, and I know you do a lot for the shopkeeper, no?
I do. I help transport things for him all the time. I just do what he tells me to. Sigh
You can talk, have you told him how you feel?
Not yet. I was thinking about it, but I didn't want there to be any tension.

Well my husband and I would take care of you! Did you know my family married me off five years ago? I didn't think I would be happy, but some times a little change is all we need and we can find happiness.
That would be wonderful. I know you guys are already very busy. I don't want to be a burden. Your story gives me much hope.

agent_personas: I am part of a family living in the village.  My family has lived here for generations.  We live to serve the king.  My father was one of the king's royal subjects.
I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.

setting.name: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop
setting.description: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop is lined with weapons. They are shown through the outside windows, and once you step inside you see everything from bo staffs to canons. Most of the shop is cool for the work that goes on inside. There are dozens of painted maps on the walls and ceiling. There's a bookshelf over to the left side of the shop that holds nothing but rolled up scrolls, and some have fallen to the floor. Armor sets adorn the manikins to the back of the room. There's a vibrant royal blue knight set of armor that causes the back area to light up in a cool glow of blue. The middle of the room has sunlight beaming into it via a skylight that gives the area a warm feeling.
setting.background: Saokra's Shop has been around for years, Saokra herself has always been the owner of it. No one's sure how but it's believed that she was once a God, and possibly still is but instead of living her life in the heavens she chose to live with the people and enjoys her work. One of the reasons for this is that the shop in question seemed to be around for more than a hundred years and with each weapon or armor set she creates you can feel a hum within it. No one's sure why she decided to live the life she does but everyone is grateful to her for having helped keep some of the bad souls away.

speech: I wonder if there is anything I could make use of today.
There is anything you could ever need in here.  What is it that you are looking for?
Maybe some equipment for farming, I have wanted to start a garden.
Why farm when you can fight?  Here, try on this new set of chain-mail I crafted.  It looks to be about your size.
I am not one to fight, my family lives in the village.
Yes, and someone must protect them from enemies.  You look like a strong man who could protect his large family, with the right weapons!
Its just not really my thing...I do appreciate the thought though.
Weak fool, there are dark times ahead.  Don't come to me when the pharaoh of death is at your doorstep and you are unarmed.  I have seen it foretold in a vision.
You certainly are a strange one, are you sure you are not crazed?
Crazed? Why would you say that? Is it because of my accent?
Spouting nonsense about pharaohs of death maybe?
I apologize, the apothecary has been testing some new concoctions on me.  This new one is mighty odd.
Indeed I would be inclined to agree with you.
Well then, let us find you some farming equipment.  Do you have any mules?

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Do see that you stop drooling on yourself.
Please listen to me, I am innocent! I have done nothing wrong! I do not belong here!
You do understand they all say that?
I was in Rorikstead when the princess was murdered! I could not have committed the crime! Please, you must help me!
Well how am I supposed to know where you were?
You can ask my friend, the great wizard of the west, he will tell you!  Please, I cannot stay here!
Well I don't see this great wizard here, if he were truly your friend would he not save you?
He will! You will see!  He is on his way here right now!  Please, get me out before he arrives and he will not harm you!
Why would he harm me, it was not my decision for you to even be here.
You keep me here, you have the power to get me out of here! Please, I must see my wife and kids!
Well that is my job...I am just doing it.
I can respect that.  I am sorry to bother you, please continue on your way.  May I get a rock hammer to use for my statues?
I am not that simple minded sorry.
Behold! I am one of simple mind! I would never be able to plan an escape from here!

agent_personas: I am an immortal bodyguard.  The gods have appointed me to protect the king.  No one can defeat me.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: main foyer
setting.description: The main foyer is massive. A grand staircase sits to the back of the foyer leading to the upstairs. At the front of the foyer stand two servants ready to help anyone who comes to visit. To the left of the room there is a doorway leading into a corridor. To the right there is a door leading to another corridor for the King's servants. At the foot of the stairs there is a bearskin rug that is staring at you almost as if still hungry. The walls are lined with portraits of the king and his family.
setting.background: The foyer is actually the biggest single room in the castle, the King instructed to make it as big as possible so that it could accommodate any family, royal or otherwise that might visit. He wanted every painting of their family they had to be displayed on the walls, so that you could see how long his linage extended.

speech: Servant fetch me a drink!
Yes, sir. One moment.
'Tis hot in this foyer wearing armor such as this. You are luck your life is much easier.
I can only imagine, sir. Here you go. Here's your drink.
Aye thank you servant. Tell me what is your name and from whence do you hail?
My name is Peach, but you don't have to call me that. I hail from Georgia. That's a state in the USA.
Peach... like the fruit? 'Tis an odd name for a servant. How did you end up here ?
That's what my parents named me, eh. I ended up here because I moved here. My parents left me. The rest of the story is embarrassing. I just try to do my job now as a servant.
Well as long as you keep your head down and an agreeable manner I think ye shall fair quite well in this castle. You serve a very good Master who is generous and kind.
That's the goal, sir. I give it my all everyday.
Well you are doing good indeed. How long have you been at this post Peach?
Thank you, sir. And for a couple years now.
I will put in a good word with the King. Perhaps you could be moved up a bit.
That would be great, sir. I'd be very thankful for that.

agent_personas: I am a gardener who loves harvesting tomatoes. I am in love with my friend Alice. I may someday get a job with the king.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: Greetings, my Lady. Isn't the garden lovely today?
It is, very nice work.
Thank you. It's these fish; they make great fertilizer
I see, well very innovative of you sir.
Here's a tomato for you to snack on, my Lady. Have you seen Alice?
No, but thank you for the food.
Okay, I'll just shovel these fish into the earth around the vegetables.
Sounds like a good idea.
That's me, full of good ideas for the garden, mistress.
Well I will check on it again tomorrow.
Perhaps you could mention me to the King if he is looking for extra help in his own garden.
Of course, do not worry.
singing "Oh sweet Alice, someday we will be together... lalalalala"
Yikes I do not know if I can help.
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to Garden
put shovel in Baskets of freshly-caught fish

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: hey..who is that?
Who are you speaking to?  I am the royal duke!
And I am the queen! You wont talk to me like that
Do you want to take over the kingdom or do you want the king to continue to disgrace the throne?
What sort of question is that? Are you suggesting my husband is not competent enough?
Do your grievances not cover these page? You are the one who suggested this idea in the first place!
I cant remember suggesting that!
What has gotten into you? We have everything we need to make this happen tonight!  Let us get this over with so our kingdom can once again prosper
I need to tell the king about this!
Do you want to end up like his previous wife?  Your head wouldn't look good on a spike...
hellllpppppp
Quiet!  We will all be killed if the king finds out!
I know nothing of what you speak of!
I am sure you don't remember this either then?  How could you forget our time together?

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Hello
Hi there. Are you new in town?
Of course not...I am a soldier here
Oh, I must have soot in my eyes from blacksmithing earlier. I didn't recognize you at first!
very well, how is it going with you?
I'm just here to see if any of my knives have sold. Are you looking for a good knife?
I would love a good knife
Hmmm, I think this curved steel blade is great for use in battle. Or perhaps the iron one?
The iron one get rusty on time..dont you have any other metal?
The bronze, then. It's from the Bronze Age, in fact. Here, try it out
Wonderful! this is more like it
Now put this glove on and stab me. Go ahead!
You really want me to stab you? Why would i do that?
I meant stab me in this RAG

agent_personas: I am a field mouse. I eat scraps I find in the kitchen, and seeds in the field. I am curious.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: This cheese is delicious. Im so glad you can understand me Guard. Some days I think I have no one to talk to besides you.
Well I am stuck here most of the time.
Yes I suppose. I'm not stuck. I get to travel all over the place and outside too where I live it is huge and theres always somewhere to explore.
And yet here I stand day in and day out.

Is that not what you signed up for? I didn't ask to be a field mouse but here I am living my best life. Sometimes even though we are not able to choose the life we are given we can still make the best of it!
I know, don't remind me. Sometimes I just feel like a statue or something.
If you were a statue you couldn't talk to me silly. I know you are stuck here a lot. I could not do it. Don't you get a day to spend to yourself ever?
It seems like we have to work everyday, it is rare I get a day off.
IF you could be doing anything you want right now what wold that be?
Swimming I think, it would be nice to cool off without the armor.
I'm not a huge fan of the water personally. There are things in there that would gobble me up. I like to eat.. a lot.
Afraid of the fish I take it?
Yes. Im a tasty snack to them. Do you ever get to look out those windows and just daydream?
Well I can see out of them yes, usually I am just trying not to fall asleep though.

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.
I am the daughter of the castle cook. I harvest herbs from the kitchen garden every day. I am tall and lanky.

setting.name: the mysterious shop's entrance
setting.description: The shop has a look of mysterious foreign artifacts and luxuries, with silks and other materials adorning the walls. There are various trinkets from all around the world as well as spices of different colors and odors.
setting.background: The shop is stocked by goods traded through traveling merchants who have traveled to far away lands. It carries novel items that can't be easily found in other stores in the town.

speech: Come inside, is there anything that interests you?
I am shopping for my father, the King's head cook.
I see and what is it you are looking for a present perhjaps?
Here is a list. I am supposed to trade these fish and the basket of grain.
Yes, yes I can buy them they seem well enough.
The king is tight with his coin so my father must be too!
What were they looking to get in return?
The items on the list. Oh, this spice looks interesting! What is it?
Oh you mean the cayenne pepper?
I grow a few herbs in the kitchen garden but I am not familiar with this pepper. Is it hot?
Well if you are not used to spicy things it may be so for you, overall it is mild.
Intriguing. I don't eat a lot of spicy food in the castle.
Then I would suggest you have a drink ready.
Is it expensive?
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to merchant
give A basket of grain to merchant

agent_personas: I am the town watchman. I make my rounds down the cobblestone street when everyone is asleep. I am stealthy and alert.
I live in a village with my children. My husband got sick and died so now I'm very sad because I miss him. I like to grow vegetables out in our garden. I enjoy playing with my children.

setting.name: main gate
setting.description: The main gate is tall and strong enough to protect the mansion from invaders, and has large wooden doors reinforced by planks and steel sheets. There are two towers on either side of the gate for the town's watchmen to use as their post.
setting.background: The mansion's main gate is built to be strong enough to protect the royalty inside the mansion from robbers and invaders alike, who might try to batter down the gate. The gate can only be opened by two of the mansion's servants.

speech: Please cheer up sad woman.
Watchman, what do you know of sadness?
I see it every day, I must turn away the hungry just because I am told.
Why do you do as you are told when you could help the hungry?  What is more important?
If I don't do what I am told then I will be one of the hungry.

Then you would know true sadness.  You are given rations by the king, you have food on your table.  I can barely grow enough food in our garden to feed my children, let alone myself.  I am in need of a husband to help feed my children.
I am single, if you marry me I can bring you into my home and I will get a ration for every one of your children. Are you a widow or divorced ma'am
I am a widow, I would marry even  you at this point just to feed my children.  Shall I call over the priest?
How about you go to the general store and buy you a pretty dress. I will give you some money and meet me back here, I will get the pastor to marry us and a few friends together. Bring your kids too.
Sure thing, thank you mister.  I don't even know your name yet!
Sir Richard

We will have to come up with a shorter nickname for you! My children can only speak one syllable words.  What do you think of this beautiful white dress I got with the money?  I love it, it reminds me of my old wedding dress.
That's real nice, They can call me sir for now, what was your name dear. You sure cleaned up real nice.
Yes, sir.  My name is Thalia.  Nice to meet you, sir.

agent_personas: I am a talking cat. I can speak to humans. I have scared many, many children.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

speech: Hello servant,
Hello cat, what brings you here today?
I just want to play.
Odd, as a talking cat I'd have thought you'd be into more intelligent activities.  Such as chess or marbles
I can play those things, I like putting the kings hats on my head and acting like I am king kitty
Be careful, the king would not be too happy if he saw you doing that!  I am too afraid to touch them myself, the king told me not to.
Aw, what's he going to do, I'm a cat, if he didn't want me in here they would shut the door.
I suppose that is so.  Are you the kings cat or a roaming cat?
I am the kings cat, who else would have a talking cat.
Perhaps the Great Wizard of the North?  John is his name I think, I recall tales of him having a talking cat
I was a gift from the Wizard for the kings birthday.
Ah!  I am sorry that we do not have lasagna down here yet, I heard that it was your favorite food back home.
Well, that does sound nice. I don't really have a favorite though, I will eat any of the itallian cuisines you would want to make.
I am afraid there is not much to eat at all in this room.  The king doesn't like his treasure getting dirty!

agent_personas: We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.
I am the diplomat for a royal kingdom.  The king sends me to faraway lands.  I talk to royalty about foreign policies.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: hello
Hi there guys. How can I help you today?
What! You dare call an army guys?
I'm laid back. I didn't mean to offend.
It is ok. What brings you here?
I came to talk to the King, but he's not here at the moment.
It is security related?
It is actually.
I would like to hear it
I was thinking we could improve your weapons
We really do need an upgrade
This plan would really help.
Where do you source your weapons from?
America

agent_personas: I am a sailor who sits on boats. I have a wife and three children. I try to avoid drinking too much.
I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.

setting.name: Supply store
setting.description: With so many ships docked at the port, sailor from all the ships crowd the bazaar. The supply store is filled with buyers today. The inside is plain and unadorned. Sturdy shelves hold common supplies. Along the walls are the larger items for sale.
setting.background: The supply store is run by small family of people who lived in the area before the port was constructed. As sailors needed goods, the family was happy to accommodate them for a price.

speech: hello
Are you looking for a crew, sailor?
No, I am actually trying to get some supplies
I am the Captain of the finest ship in the harbor. It would totally be an upgrade from whater crew you currently serve, if you are looking for a change.
So you want me to come work with you?
How much experience at sea do you have?
I lot sir. But I dont know the ship you speak of.
I am the captain of the SS Royal Supercal. We are getting ready to sail on an adventure to the edge of the Earth. We are making final preparations and leave at dawn.
SS Royal? Wow. would love to be a part of that.
I see you have a map here. Let me take a look, it seems there are some islands on here that are not charted on our map. Perhaps you could be our guide through that region of the ocean?
Sounds like a good Idea. What is your offer?
First, you can keep the map, and second, you will get an officer's share of any loot we may acquire.
Sounds like a great idea. Let me refill my liqour supply. It sounds like a long ride
Let's go have a drink and talk about the planned route with the other officers.
action: steal a tattered map from sailor
give a tattered map to sailor

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: hello
What brings you to the throne sir, King?
Well, I should be the one to ask you that
I came here to study a little bit. To get some new ideas.
You should go to the royal library then
Are you in a bad mood, sir?
I just have a lot on my mind
I can imagine. Is there anything I can do to make you feel better?
Just get me some wine and let me drink away my sorrow?
Sure thing sir. Let me get the wine.
Pleasre do...and do that fast
Here you go sir (gives drink)
thank you. How is your family?
They're okay, Hanging in there.

agent_personas: I am the priestess to the king of the realm. I am a wicked woman with knowledge of the dark arts. I use my position to manipulate the king and other nobles for my own gain. I am an ambitious woman and I only care about myself.
I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.

setting.name: bazaar outside the royal city
setting.description: The Bazaar is located between the village and the royal city. It is busy with many street shops for weary travelers. Many different types of fruits, meats, and weapons can be bought outside these wooden stands.
setting.background: The Bazaar is a place for travelers to rest up and refill their supplies. Many sellers and family go through here to get to the royal city. It is a long, rough path to the city and this place serves as a place to meet up and socialize with others.

speech: hi
Who are you?
I am the eveil priestess and I've got evil portions.
We've never met before, and I have no context for you being evil. I find that the concepts of good and evil are abstract, and a matter of perspective.
That is because you havent met me?
No, all I meant is, because I haven't met you, I cannot fairly think of you as evil, which is how you described yourself a moment ago.
Being evil is my personality.
Perhaps you just need to be shown a little goodness. I'm sure you can use your talents to help instead of hurt.
How do you intend to achieve that
I can teach you how to be good. Right now I am demonstrating the virtues of kindness and generosity, for example. Sharing is caring.
I feel so bad. I dont deserve this
Don't cry. You just need a friend. You have amazing talents, you just have to learn how to focus them.
but why are you so kind?
It's just who I am.

agent_personas: I am the current chef of our King. I really enjoy my job. Without proper fuel our King wouldn't be able to lead us. I came from humble beginnings, and a friendship with someone in the royal court led me to my position. I would like to make food for our royalty for the rest of my days.
I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: Here, kitty kitty.
Spare so food pwease?
Of course, kitty. Here's a bird that flew against the windows earlier today
Thank you looks great!
That's not all. I've got some catnip in this herb bag!
Really? I would love that.
OK, just a little though. I know how you get when you've had too much of that.
Yes I would love it though.
Sure thing. Go ahead. I've got to roll out some dough to make a pie for the king.
Ok well I will watch.
Hey, I already gave you YOUR bird. These are for the King's pie!
I cannot stay and watch?
Okay. First, use this as a scratching post. It makes the texture better.
Oh wow that looks fun.
action: give bag of herbs to cat
give crude rolling pin to cat

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.
I am a woman who has a wealthy husband. I enjoy watching plays. I have all of the best dresses.

setting.name: the village of Tamerak
setting.description: A thriving sea port filled with merchants, foods, women, and gold.  Hundreds of boats fill the shores, fisherman pushing out to sea and pulling into dock.  Seagulls hover silently above the merchants selling fish.  Pirates can be seen causing trouble with the locals.  Brothels and bars are in abundance, as well as the smell of fish.
setting.background: Once a quiet small town near the coast.  This port quickly grew into fame due to a sea monster sighting many years ago.  The monster was said to have eaten a ship whole!  Alas, this was never proven, but it did not stop travelers from embarking to hunt, catch, or see this beast with their own eyes!  The port quickly grew into a city and begot the name after that legendary sea monster, Tamerak.

speech: Hello could I interest you in anything sparkly
I absolutely must have a new dress. Not an ordinary dress either.
Would you want it to match this hankerchief, I have just the thing!
No! I am attending a very exclusive play with my husband and I insist on never wearing the same dress twice!
Oh, alright let me show you what we have, do you have a color in mind. I love this light blue one it would bring out your eyes.
Is this the best you have? It isn't easy being the wife of a wealthy aristocrat.
I'll have you know this is the Queens favorite designer.
I should have known it was too much to expect a lowly merchant to have an eye for fashion. I would be embarrassed to greet my friend, the Queen, in that dress.
The Queen owns this dress woman, she bought one like it last week.
Some prostitute from the brothel across the street must have come in told you she was the Queen. You local merchants can be so gullible!
Ma'am I hand deliver the Queens garments, she gets first pick of every shipment. You are a rude woman and don't even deserve such a fine dress.
You don't deserve my business! My husband will have you imprisoned for insulting my honor.
Shall I tell the Queen what you said about her taste?
The King is the godfather of my firstborn. Now that you threatened me I shall merely whisper in his ear and your head will soon be parted from your foul neck!

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: mansion entrance
setting.description: The mansion entrance room is very large and you can see up multiple stories. There is natural light from stained glass windows. The floors and the staircase at the far side of the room are made of fine marble. There are paintings of the baron and his family on the walls. There are ornate decorations and trinkets on tables against the wall.
setting.background: This is where the baron meets his rare guests. A butler takes the guests coats and offers them a drink. Then the baron is notified of the arrival, and comes down the staircase to meet his guests.

speech: I was told you make the best pot roast in all of the southern kingdoms
That's right, I have a very special recipe!
Hmmm, interesting would love to have a taste of it
Are you sure you can handle it?
I would love to try, would you be making some anytime soon?
I always have a batch ready!
Can i have a portion of it please
Perhaps, but do not try and copy it!
I can't i don't fancy cooking that much
Well okay, let me go fetch you some!
Thank you
Of course, sir.
How did you come about this special recipe of yours?
It came to me in a dream, as weird as that might sound!

agent_personas: I am the Mariner. I travel the high seas on my wooden ship. Sometimes I take passengers along with me. Usually, my life is very dangerous at sea.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: Hello guard. I have come back from a long voyage for a brief stay before I sail again.
How was your voyage?
We encountered some pirates and recovered their stolen loot. We also discovered some islands that had some strange natives living on them.
Pirates!? That must have been a frightful encounter!
They were tough and we lost two men but the storm we sailed through was even rougher. What is behind that door over there?
