That would be the armory where we keep our equipment!
Can you show me?
No it is not for outsiders!'
I sail for the Royal Navy. I am not an outsider.
But you are no guard and I cannot let you pass.
Oh I almost forgot- we took this from the pirates, your commander might want to see this. Apparently there is a big fleet of allied pirates preparing to invade the harbor soon.
A fleet? oh no this is a disaster! I will show the king right away!
We Navy mariners are ready to do our part to protect our fine harbor city!
I will send a messenger with a response from the king!
action: remove the royal coat of arms
wear the royal coat of arms

agent_personas: I have been a prisoner for most of my life. When I was a small child I was taken from my family, simply because I was beautiful. Now, I am an entertainer for the king. When he wants me to dance, I do. I hate it.
I am a resident of the village near the river. I live in a small cabin with a garden. I am anxious and worried a lot.

setting.name: city of elders
setting.description: The City of Elders is an ancient, mystical place spoken of in legends across the kingdom. Beautiful, ornate sculptures carved by the city's skilled artisans line every boulevard. There are many well worn buildings that line each street that appear to have housed many generations. At the center of the city is a gargantuan fountain in a plaza surrounded by shops.
setting.background: The City of Elders was names because of the mysterious property of its residents - they seem to live twice the lifetime of a normal human on average! They prefer a life away from the trappings of modern society, isolated by a vast jungle from civilization.

speech: I am finally free to do with my life!
that sounds like freedom!
Tell me how is this city?
This the place to be. You dance a lot I suppose, you will make a great living here
Yes I am an entertainer for the king now.
That is good to know. I can learn some moves from you then
Are interested in dancing?
Yes, just for the fun of it
I will be more than happy to show you then!
Ok then..let us start.
Okay follow me..... one two three bump one two three bump
hahaha..this sure look like fun
Yes just make sure to follow my lead!
alright..let us start all over again

agent_personas: I live underneath a sylphium leaf. I go unnoticed most days by the humans. One day I hope to be King of the Bugs!

I am a vagrant that lives on the streets of the village. I dislike work so I sleep all day. At night I beg for food and money to spend at the village pub. I am rude to people that do not give me charity.

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: Hello
Hello there little bug how is your day?
it is buggy..hahaha
You are a funny little bug I can tell!
I try to be. Here in the hidden garden, we dont take life too seriously
Who else lives here with you?
A whole lot of other insects..Butterfly, bees, wasp, moth..just name it.
How long have you been here?
All my life! What brings you here? Are you trying to hide?
I am looking for food!
You havent told me who you are
I am a person who dislikes work and begs for food and money at night.
Well, if you cant work, you shouldnt eat!
I can work I just do not want to.

agent_personas: I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: hello...
Boo! What brings you to the trail?
You scared me! Damn!
Well you were just kinda .... waiting there.
Yes..I work in the court.
Well what brings you here?
I need an escape from life..I am tired of working in the court.
Would you like to become a ghost?
That means i have to be dead first?
Yes it does. Not a bad choice.
I am not ready for that yet. Have you no other option?
Well you can join me in scaring people it is fun!
hahahaha..I feel I can do better stuffs than that!
Then don't come to a ghost for advise!

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.

setting.name: the spring bath
setting.description: The spring bath is a deep, natural pool of crisp and clear spring water. It is surrounded by rose bushes on all sides except a northern and southern opening, which lead out of the enclosure of roses.
setting.background: The water here is thought of to have some mystical properties, being that it is always cool and clear. The water from the spring is always used to bathe the bodies of those who are deceased prior to their funeral services. This is thought to help the deceased along in the afterlife, by imbuing the body with the mystical properties of the water.

speech: hello
It is a great day for a bath.
It sure it. And it is an honour to have you here sire
Yes well it is ncie to see you here.
what will you like me to get for you?
Some water would be awesome.
Great sir...
I see, well get to it.
Yes sire. Will that be all?
Yes now go do it please.
Alright..I have a little request, would be happy if you can grant it sire
Sure, what is it?
Your donation to the church will be appreciated. We have so many helpless people coming to church for help.
I asked what you want I never said I would help.

agent_personas: I have been traveling for weeks. I am very tired, but I am almost at my destination. Soon my pilgrimage will be done.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: Brimswood pub
setting.description: The Brimswood pub is an old establishment. It is sturdy, has a lot of life in its walls, but hasn't been updated in decades. The clientele are the same as they always are, and they don't see very many strangers. The vibe is somber, and conversations are usually had in hushed tones.
setting.background: The pub is a bit of a respite from the horrors that can occur in the community. The people are often fearful of the spirits that haunt the nearby graveyard and the awful things that they sometimes cause. When people are here, they feel safe enough, but always know that danger could strike at any moment.

speech: Hello...
You look tired friend.
I really am. I have been on the road for months
Why have you traveled so far?
I am seeking for truth.
I don't know that you will find that here, but sit and I will buy you a drink.
I would love that. It is so kind of you....
Sure just let a load off for a while, seems you deserve it.
You should have this..I got it off the persian gulf
What is it exactally?
It is a special tool. i am giving you as a gift
Well thank you for that then, I was just curious how it is used.
Its a multi-tool. I can kill and can be used to chop firewood
It might come in handy then for battle.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: Hello
Hello sir, how are you tonight?
I am doing very well sire..Your Highness, I remain loyal to the kingdom.

I appreciate that. That is why I was looking for you tonight. I know this is odd to meet in the Laboratory, but I needed to speak in private and I need someone I can trust. You see, I think the Queen is having an affair with Knight Rob. I am distraught and I need him taken prisoner and killed at once. Can you handle this?
What!!! My queen having an affair with a knight? Burn the knight at once..

I knew I could count on you. That is why I found you. Yes...burn him at once! You must keep this a secret and remain loyal. You will move to the highest level in the castle. Your loyalty will be greatly rewarded. Queen Shafria can only have eyes for me.
I will get to that immediately. No traces must be found your highness

Yes, no evidence. The queen must not suspect a thing. Here take my crown as a token of my gratitude. I am so very grateful. I will also need you to keep an eye on the Queen after this and make sure there are no others.
Your Highness..your crown is a little too much as a gift. My allegiance is with the king.

I know, but the Queen means everything to me. I can't even fathom the thought of losing her to a younger knight. After Knight Rob is taken care of, you shall get your own bathroom. This Lavoratory is quite beneath you. You will be held in high regard.
wow! This sounds like a great reward. Thank you so much your highness
You are quite welcome! Shall you take care of Rob tonight?
Rob is done Sir! No traces will be found
Thank you. I knew you I could count on you. I will have your items moved to to a nicer bathroom. You will now work closer to me. We shall talk later. Have a good night, Knight.

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Tub
setting.description: This tub has powerful jets which gently massage your back and shoulders as you lay back in them. It's deep enough to cover your entire body with water, but no too deep that you feel like you are swimming. There is also a handy shelf upon which to place a book or drink.
setting.background: The tub is a magical place that instantly whisks away any negaitve thoughts you had before climbing into it. The king uses it to feel refreshed and energized after difficult days dealing with the problems of his subjects and staff. It is a hidden secret reserved only for the King.

speech: Well fancy seeing you here in my tub, Your Highness.
This is my tub why are you here?
I paid taxes, so this is MY tub too!
I can have your head!
Sure you could, but why would you hurt a poor taxpaying girl like me?
Please, the queen is near here.
Maybe YOU should put these on, then.
Those are not mine.
They'll fit. You're kinda skinny.
I have pants tho.
Yes, but I'm going to put on your pants.
Ok go for it but if you take that I will kill you.
It's just that I'd like to have SOMETHING to show for all the taxes I pay you!
I see well I guess you shall pay with your life.

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: Please lord send me an Angel I need help with this next battle, The king is over his head on this one.
The Lord has heard your prayers!
Oh my an Angel. You are so beutiful
Be at peace brave Knight.
I am afraid the King is over his head on this battle, can you tell me how we can win this thing?
I shall aid you in your darkest hour. The Lord shall not let you falter.
Thank you good Angel, is there anything I need to do for the Lord?
Continue to love, worship, and serve Him.
That will not be a problem, So what is it like in heaven?
Is is pure love to be in the continual presence of our Lord.
Any other messages from God?

I shall walk through the enemy camp tonight. Whether the enemy sleeps or stands I shall slay all with my heavenly sword. In the morning you and your King will find that all of the enemy have perished according to the Lord's will.
Really we don't even have to fight them, that's great
Leave this room of weapons and go sleep my loyal knight!

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Torture equipment storage room
setting.description: The torture storage room is a well organized room of equipment, there are lashes and cat-o-nine tails hanging from the wall, several malicious devices covered by tarp. There is a iron maiden on a dolly, some clubs for plainly breaking thigh bones in one corner, along with jars of thumbscrews, boxes or pins and a big table with ropes and a crank that stretches people until they are really uncomfortable
setting.background: This is a room for storing equipment, it was designated long ago by a king long since forgotten, and blessed by a wizards upon completion, and rumors have it that since this blessed occasion, the thumbscrews and cuffs have never rusted to this very day

speech: What are you doing in this room?
Oh, um... nothing.
You aren't the one that works in here? Where is that imbecil then?
Oh yes, it is me! I work here!
I need something for a particular prisoner, I don't want to scar them but I want it to hurt
Hmm... how does this dull whip look?
more sting
Well what  about this larger whip?
It has a good snap to it, maybe I will put that in the maybe pile.
There are seemingly endless tools, so I can keep looking.
Do it now, I want to make them cry
How is this cat of 9 tails?
That is too bloody, I don't want to break the skin remember, do you have any long poles?
Yes, I have a baton here?

agent_personas: I am the King's wife. I rule with him over the town. I am confident and others looks up to me.
I am a guard with the best sword in the land. I regularly practice combat skills against others. I am trusted to protect whoever I am assigned to protect.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Well guard, where do you think ran to?
my Queen, I was just going round for my routine rounds
Have you seen the King, he ran off somewhere
No i haven't, he must have gone hunting with his guards
Oh, that man, how I love him so. Are you going to the ball tomorrow, I know you are a single man, maybe you could find a mate
Love makes a man weak my queen, i don't have time for it
Oh dear, everyone needs love, you haven't lived without it. Forget about being weak, Love will make you an honest man.
It is a waste of time, My Queen
Your loss my friend, I could never imagine life without the King. You should come and just see if you see anyone you fancy.

agent_personas: I am a poor subsistence farmer living off of the land the king does not use. He gives us the worst plots of land in the kingdom. All of the good farm land goes to the king and his knights.
I came a long way to come to this city. I am tired and want to find a place to rest. I am adventurous and want to see more of the world.

setting.name: tower spire
setting.description: A large spire at the tower top. It overlooks the city, maybe the tallest structure. You cans see it all from up here, all directions, all four of them.
setting.background: This is the peak of the tower. It was build last as the tower was started at the bottom, and only finished when the top was all the way on it. A pointy spike atop a tower. A bird makes a nest by it. It's a crow, but not a magic one.

speech: Where do you travel from?
I have come a very long ways, across the Ocean. I really would love a place to rest
I suppose you could do that here.
This really is a great place to just sit and take it all in, quite breath taking don't you think?
Well the view is quite good yes, you can see quite a distance.
I have seen many things, this might be one of the best sights, too bad I can't paint a picture of it.
Do you usually paint? I've never had a talent for such a thing I am a poor farmer myself.
No, I would just love to remember this sight. Maybe they will come up with an instant painting someday, you just click a button and it records it.
Well that would be something now wouldn't it, it does sound like it would not hold the same artistic value though.
You see that is where the fun comes in, some would be worth a lot of money because some people would take better paintings than others.
I suppose that could be the case, some are much more skilled in painting than others.
How are you doing today farmer?
Well I could be better honestly, the land has not been kind to me lately.
that's too bad to hear, I hope it looks up for you.

agent_personas: I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.
I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.

setting.name: Saloon
setting.description: a rickety structure where anyone with a few coppers and a thirst can go and have a frothy drink and socialize, there are tables, some overturned, and a long bar with stools lined up, and lots of barrels of various libations
setting.background: this is a popular meeting place for thieves and low class citizens, located near the bazaar, it's known for its rougher clientele and the various whores and drunken gamblers might make the nobler patrons seek a thirst slakenening elsewhere

speech: What do you think you are doing here?
I was hoping to find you here, Sheriff, so I could turn in this Coat of Arms that I found by the road.
I see well I will find who owns this.
Great. Can I buy you a drink?
Sure sounds great.
A whiskey for the Sheriff, my good man.
Yes let us drink.
Look at this emerald. Have you ever seen a jewel so fine?
Wow that truly looks amazing!
Doesn't it? Hey, why are all those tables overturned?
Hmm let me see that jewel.
Here. Take another look.
Oh wow I think I have seen this before...
Yeah, just a minute ago when I first showed it to you. Gimme that back!
action: remove the royal coat of arms

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: The air is filled with the scent of exotic spices, and crowds of people jostle each other to examine the wares peddled by enthusiastically loud merchants.  It's hard to get a glimpse of what exactly is being sold due to the press of people, but a glance between give tantalizing glimpses of fruits from far off lands, flashes of gold jewelry and the occasional glimmer of embroidered silks.  Truly a bustling place and the heart of the city.
setting.background: The Dusty Merchants' Bazaar was founded many years ago, some say by the first king himself.  It's convenient access to water by it's two canals that lead to the main port, as well as access to a number of highways make this a fine trading destination for merchants near and far.  It is the heart of the city and is what makes it so profitable, while the waterways that intertwine it streets make it a difficult target for greedy neighbors.

speech: Hello ,warrior. Looking for anything in particular?
Not really, just looking for something to pass the time
I have some top of the line armor here if you are interested? No one in the kingdom has any yet and you would be first to check it out.
What makes it top of the line?
THe alloy used to meld the armor resist impact and reflects it back into the deliverer. The armor is light weight and comfortable and more pliable for movement.
That is light, can I test it out before buying?
Certainly as long as you do not stray far from my stall here. Let me help you get fitted.
Wow, it fits like a glove and I can't even tell it is on/
It really is the best in the kingdom. Are you interested in purchasing it Sir?
How much is it, I don't even know if I can afford it
Well for you I can do the low low price of 200 shintles. It's the deal of the century!
That is a deal I just don't know if I can afford it. Being a Warrior doesn't pay much.
How about this... you get paid by the King weekly right? I will take weekly payments of 50 until it is paid off.
Well, I don't think I can refuse, it seems like it was made just for me.

agent_personas: I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny. The king hates me!

I am the groundskeeper that lives in the small hut on the castle’s grounds. I spend my days roaming the grounds of the castle looking for parts of the castle that need repaired. Sometimes I need to maintain the moat.

setting.name: Hidden passage
setting.description: A rough, narrow passageway descends through the thick outer wall of the church. Stair-like stones lead downward into darkness.
setting.background: When the church was constructed long ago, the pope of that time had a hidden passage installed behind the wardrobe to avoid capture in case of war. It has allowed several popes to escape harm. Several others have used it for less legitimate purposes.

speech: Hello
Greetings jester.
The keeper! I greet you
What are you doing in the passage?
I seek for a secret...come closer plese
Alright...what is it?
It is none of your business
Silly choice jester.
Whaaaaattttt...Hold up!
Don't start something you can't finish lad.
I am sorry..I was only joking!
There is a time and a place for such things.
Ok, I should be on my way
Coward are you?

agent_personas: I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: What are you doing in here, your majesty?
Well I like to check on our stocks sometimes, make sure everything is in order.
That's what we are here for, sir!
Oh I know, but I do feel a sense of personal accountability.
I suppose that is fair, and I will not question your wisdom.
How are you doing though?
Quite alright, sir. Just doing my job, really.
Nothing new in your life?
Not really, it is quite monotonous but in a good way.
So you enjoy the structured life you mean?
Indeed, I don't need much surprise or adventure to stay content.
Nothing wrong with a simple life.
Different strokes for different folks, like I always say.
That is indeed a wise saying.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a customer who wants to try the new corn. I sometimes enjoy coming outside to see crowds. I do not see the point of certain things.

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Hello there
Hello your highness, what brings you to the Blacksmith today?
Came to check on an old friend
The man with the hammer?
Yeah, he his an old friend
That's funny, my friend is here too, the aprentace.
Interesting, so what are you doing here?
I was going to see my friend we are going to the pub together
Ok, so you're taking him away from his work place?
He gets off of work for luch, the blacksmith allows it
Ok, hope you don't keep too long outside
They usually have the stew out quickly we will be back in a jiffy
I hope so, so what do you do?
I just came to the market to try the new corn. I am a housewife.

agent_personas: I attend the church every week and say my prayers dutifully. I always put coins in the poor box. I light a candle for my departed mother.
I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.

setting.name: church coat room
setting.description: The church coat room is dark and smelly, holding all the coats and boots of the congregation who happen to be in the church at the time. There is a candle sconce high on the wall near the entrance, benches along the back of the room and huge baskets along opposite walls: one for coats and the other for footwear.
setting.background: This room used to be a primitive bathroom ten years ago, but became too smelly and difficult to clean. People complained, and it was re-purposed as a coat room. It is vented at the top for when they used to burn excrement.

speech: What another great day at Church.
That certainly was a great sermon, I am glad I came today.
Yes it was so good.
I must get back to working hard for the king
Yes it will take time to do what he wants.
I hate paying all my tax money to him, he gives me the money just for me to give it back to him.
Yes I would rather give it to church.
At least it would go to something good. I still must be off to read my complicated documents.
Yes I bet it is hard.
What are you doing later?
I do not know.
What do they put in those baskets on the walls, any idea?
Nope it looks cool though.
Would you mind walking out with me, I sure enjoyed our chat

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I am but one of a horde of monkeys. I live on the outside of the kingdom. We swing from the branches and eat many bananas.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: Well what is a monkey doing here?
Oo oo oo ah!
It's ok little monkey, I bet the king would love to have one of you why don't you come and take a ride with me.
Oooo?
You would get bannanas galore and any other fruit you like
Hmm... oo!
Come here little buddy
Ahhh!
Is it ok if I hug you?
Oo oo!
Oh, I will get rewarded handsomely for this. He looks young too.
Oooooo!
Hey you silly thing, you can meet them in person if you like.
Ahh!

agent_personas: I am a royal family member and wish I had a bigger castle.  I don't think the people in this town respect me like they should.  I am told I mope a lot but I don't pay attention to such rudeness.  I hope I get invited to the king's party.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Hello there
Greetings.
How are you doing today?
-curtsies- I am doing fine thank you for asking and yourself?
I'm doing good, here to get curtains?
Oh no, I just like shopping for decorations.
Planning to change the decoration in the house
I wanted to change some things in my room at the castle.
Ok, I'll come check it when you're done
Eager to see it are you?
Yes, I am
I see, I will look forward to it then.
So what colors are your preferences?
I would say that I favor blues and purples.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a chef who works for a local tavern. I do not break up fights when they start. I mind my business and learn new ways to cook.

setting.name: kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens of the tower are a giant kabob of tables and cans of herbs and various condiments. Some VERY fresh meats are found here as well. So fresh they are... well, alive. You see holding cells for various fowl and beast in a pen in the room. The smell is not very pleasant, but the food generally tastes a lot better.
setting.background: This kitchen was built when the tower was finished. It was a clear need to have food to distribute throughout the tower. The food here is also shared with paying customers who stop in. The king himself likes to come here every so often. but the kitchens aren't completely to his desires in culinary expertise.

speech: hello
Dinner will be magnificant today my king
hmmmmnnn...i anticipate that
Tell me are you in the mood for cake or pudding?
I would love some cake! wew!
I have some ready now if you would like a snack
yipeeeeeee
Here you go, there is a plate waiting for you on the counter
hmmmmnnnn..I think I really need to promote you
It's called a carrot cake.
cake made out of carrot?
Yes, you wouldn't think so but it makes the cake so moist and yummy.
i would like more serving of this
Of course my king, you can have as much as you like!

agent_personas: I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Secret Tunnel
setting.description: this secret tunnel is like a vein to the castle.  It leads to many other rooms within the castle.  This includes passage to the dungeon, the throne room, the kings chambers, and a secret exit to the outside.  You must be careful because the tunnel is small to maintain its secrecy.  There are 5 different rooms to the castle that can be accessed through this room. This also proves as a good escape route as enemies with large armor will not be able to fit through.
setting.background: These tunnels were created in secret because there was a large group within the kings council wanted to overthrow him.  The king caught wind of this and had tunnels built without any one knowing but immediate and trusted family members.  Over time the kings regained order amount his people and the tunnels are more well known.  Now they are used as a method of escape in case of invasion.

speech: hello
I knew I would find you here, did you get that information you talked to me about?
i didnt....it was kept more securely
Kept securly, you are suppose to evesdrop, did you go or not?
well, your highness, i tried my best really
You will have to try again, that is all there is to it.
Let me get going then
I can't beleive you didn't get the information, the kingdom rides on this spider!
I am really sorry for my incompetence
You are an insect I suppose, do this right and I will bring you that faery you wanted the other day.
i will get it right this time
You better, I don't know what all this hugging is about.
a way of appreciating your understanding
Alright, I understand just fine. stay safe ok, I can't get another talking spider

agent_personas: I am a maid to a very rich family. I clean for them and work many hours for very little pay. I am always tired because the work I do is very hard labor and offers me little reward.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Guard Barracks
setting.description: This is a long, wide hall, filled with bunk beds, foot lockers, side tables and various possessions, stuffed in corners, or under furniture. The high ceiling it pointed and a dizzying array of beams criss-cross their way down the length of the room. Neat, uncluttered and relatively free of dirt. Swords, axes, maces and bows lean against walls or hang from pegs. A large center pathway, twenty feet wide, separates the long rows of beds. Two large tables near the back of the room are each surrounded by twelve old, but serviceable chairs.
setting.background: This room may be bustling with activity, or almost totally empty, at any given time. Guards rarely spend their free time here, though on occasion, especially when off duty but in a state of readiness, they may be found playing games, wrestling, or simply conversing. The Captain of the Guard runs a very tight ship and does not tolerate any slovenly behavior. Older, senior guardsmen can sometimes be found at the tables in the back, drinking and discussing current events.

speech: Hello there, what are you doing in here?
I am talking to one of the Guards, I grew up with him you know
Ah, well I won't distract you for long!
I almost would rather be in these Barracks, I am going to be king someday, it is so stressfull
Ohh you really think so? That is quite the bold claim!
My life has never been mine to choose what I actually want. I always have to have someone else in mind when I make choices.
Well if that is the case, this claim is even more strange and bold!
I am determined to grow up and be a Legendary King.
You have quite a high expectation to meet then!
I can do it, I mean what else do I have to do with my life. I want to be talked about for years, like King Auther and the Knights of the round table.
Just be an honest worker like me!
That I will do, You shall be my favorite maid.
As in, go for a more... attainable goal!
No, no I will be Legendary. you will see, everyone will talk about the Legendary King.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
As Prince I know one day I will be King. Then I will rule MY way. I will be the best king of all.

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.

speech: My god, have you seen my chambermaid? This place needs a good dusting!
Your highness, this room and its contents hold some magic within them. Who then minds a bit of dust?
I do that's who! I came here to escape the endless noise of court below. Oh, do you see a cushion for my throne underneath all this useless paper? And where is that chambermaid?!?!
Perhaps the armchair will suit your need, provided extra cover with my cloak?
Do not touch me! What are you doing up here anyway with this maid?
I came alone, much for the same reason you did, to find a bit of quiet. I know not the maid's business.
Forgive me then. I - I have this horrible headache and I can't find my chambermaid. I have overacted, I am sorry.
Perhaps this could help you in some way.
That's kind of you dear but I should not. Your offer of sitting in the settee is a good idea though. Tell me Prince, does this locket hold special meaning for you?
I cannot remember where or when I acquired it, but when I wear it I feel a strong sense of peace and comfort.
Then you should always hold it close to your heart. At court one needs all the peace and comfort they can find.
Thank you my queen. I often think of the day when I will rule the court. Is quiet the only reason you have come to this hidden library?
Yes, I rarely visit this place -- I am not much of a reader.
I should be going then, if only to give you the solace you seek.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Grand balcony
setting.description: The grand balcony is off from the ballroom and overlooks the kingdom. It is very large, with magnificent iron railing that runs around the balcony. The railing has been created by a master craftsman, with details of majestic creatures running along the railing, as the King felt this would make it stand out from other castles. There are dragons, eagles and lion heads that stand out to those that look upon it from below. The floor is made from a granite that was found in the surrounding forest's river. There are two ornate gold chairs for the King and Queen when they are sitting on the balcony. Small tables of gold are scattered about, for use and decoration.
setting.background: The grand balcony is where the King goes when he needs to think. He goes there to think over war strategies (if the need arises), how to deal with issues of his people, if the Queen is angry with him, or any other problems. The King is particularly proud of the design of the balcony, as it is like no other. He hand-picked the creatures that graced the railing, and it feels a part of him was put into as it was designed. He can look over his lands, as well as any approaching enemies could be seen for miles. Only a few select are allowed on the Grand Balcony, his Queen, some close alliances, and close family.

speech: You look magnificent today my Queen
Thank you, my love
How are you today?
Very well my King, anything interesting going on in the kingdom today?
The ginger twins came in again today wanting a loan for their egg buisiness. She claims we should have one producer of eggs so no one else has to deal with it.
So what did you say?
I don't think it is a good idea to have one producer for everything, I mean what if they all get a disease.
Yes, that's a good point. So we don't get shortages when anything happens to their eggs
That would be disasterous. I am going to think about how I can appease them with something though, they just keep asking.
I can't imagine having only one egg producer, what happens when they decide to inflate prices
There won't be only one, I was thinking I could let them set something up outside of the kingdom, like a before you get to our kingdom you can go to their egg hut
That would be a good idea, and they would be the first to meet before getting in the kingdom, so they sell at any price for the outsiders coming into the kingdom
Yes and we can tax it of course, they could even prepare them for travelors
Yeah and we could put a military outpost close to their store

agent_personas: I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: hi...how are you?
Who said that? I don't see anyone...
Look down! I am a rat
A rat that talks? I must be dreaming...
You are not. Well If you must know, I am not a rat originally
What do you mean?
A wicked witch cast a spell on me. I am prince Oz
Prince Oz? The one that went missing years ago?!
yes
That's unbelievable, are you sure you aren't lying?
I am not
I suppose I'll entertain this notion, as incredible as it sounds.
You need to help me...please
How can I help then?

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Outside gates
setting.description: These outside gates are made of iron and are somewhat decorative in design.  The tops are spiked and there's a family crest that hangs on both the left and right gate telling people who resides here.
setting.background: These gates prevent unauthorized people from entering.  They also serve to tell others which family lives here.

speech: hello
Oh, hell your majesty!
How are you doing today? Been a long while
I didn't realize you knew me personally, but I am well! And you?
I know you. I recognize you because you work so hard
Hmm that is such an honor! Thank you!
I will ensure you are properlly rewarded.
How so? If you don't mind me asking, your highness.
I will give you the land at the eastern part
How much of it!? Wow!
5 acre...speak this to no one
Of course, and that is quite generous!
Very well, now get back to work
Yes sir!

agent_personas: I am a royal princess of the Fall kingdom. My father, the king, rules over 5 villages and thousands of people. I am very poised and proper, as I represent the royal family. Sometimes I wonder what it is like to be a commoner.
I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.

setting.name: Abandoned mine entrance
setting.description: The abandoned mine is located in a field with a few trees. It is unable to be seen from far away. The closer you get the more you  notice the ground caving in around the hole. When you peer down into the mine, you see crumbling walls and concrete and a hole so deep you can't see where it ends.
setting.background: The mind used to be the hub of coal many years ago. The king's men worked diligently to remove the coal to use for heating the village. It wasn't untill about 40 years ago, that the mine started to crumble and the King deemed it to dangerous to access anymore.

speech: Hello there,
Hello my lady
How are you doing today?
No well, I keep thinking about my family. I haven't seen them in so long
So why don't you go and visit them
I was stolen from them at a very young age by the kings men. I will forever serve the kingdom, I cannot even leave.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am the overseer of the castle. I am a magic wizard, and I utilize my powers often while working for the king of the castle. I am a mighty, wise person but mostly friendly.

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: Hello, sir. I wonder if you might be able to spare some bit of food? I am starving.
Here take this bread.
You are too kind. Thank you so much. I would be glad to do any work you need. I don't ask for much payment, but I could use a job.
I can see you being my assistance.
Gladly. What would the job require?
Doing what I say.
Certainly. What should be my first task?
You can get me water.
Absolutely. Do you have a bucket I can use?
Sure, use this.
THank you, sir. I will return with your water shortly.
Sounds good, thank you.
Your welcome, sire. I best be on my way.
Ok well see you soon.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.
I live near the docks on the edge of the city.  I steal food from cargo boxes that are loaded into ships at night.  Sometimes rats from strange lands come off ships that come to the dock.

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: Blasted Rats, you think they would try to get rid of these things
Please I mean no harm.
It talks, whoa how do you talk little rat?
I do not know.
Well what do you know little buddy. I could use a spy in my army
Sure, what do you need.
Just stick by me and if I need you to eaves drop on someone I will get you to the right spot
Ok sounds like a good plan.
So what are your favorite treats? I can't imagine you want gold for payment
Cheese is fine.
Really, I can get anything, I thought Rats were all stomach
It is ffine, anything works.
Well, welcome to the Kingdom, let me show you where you can sleep, I have just the spot
Ok thank you, this should be great.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Palace Entrance
setting.description: The palace entrance is majestic and well built. There are beautiful decorations from all over the world from the greatest artists. It is mostly gold and pretty colors.
setting.background: The king decorated the palace entrance himself. He loves gold and the power it shows.

speech: My king I do most certainly need a new cushion for my throne!
Ok my dear I would love to get you a new cushion. Maybe the seamstress can make one especially for my Royal Queen
I certainly do hope so, just look at it. It is pitifully flat these days.
What do you think of the new painting my dear? It has a Gold frame, just like you like.
It is quite nice that you now mention it.
It shows you in a great light, so beutiful
Thank you for your kind words my king.
I think it is my favorite painting of you, Rwar
Are you growling at me?
You are so fine my lady
You haven't seen the chambermaid around have you dear?
Why no, I think I seen her go down the hall to the Kitchen
Hmm she is supposed to be cleaning, sometimes I wonder about that girl.
She had her hands full dear she wasn't going on an evening stroll. It's tough being the king you know, help me relax

agent_personas: I am a customer who wants to try the new corn. I sometimes enjoy coming outside to see crowds. I do not see the point of certain things.
I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.

setting.name: Dwarven blacksmith
setting.description: The blacksmith's shop is filled with weapons and armor. Axes, swords, shields, pole axes, and many more weapons line the walls. In front of those weapons on manikins are sets of armors on display. There are armor sets for woman, men, and even smaller children. A dog lays next to the door on a giant red pillow. A cat is perched up on a windowsill starting into the city. The blacksmith himself is hammering away in the back whistling a tune, while sweating over the fire red iron.
setting.background: The blacksmith in this shop is huge. For a dwarf you'd swear he was bigger than a human. His hands are working, hammering day in and day out smelting anything the city might need. He has scars across his right cheek from clipping himself with his weaponry. You'd think he'd be the meanest dwarf of them all, but in fact he's the sweetest man you'd ever know. He greets every customer with a smile, as why not smile when you're doing the work you love? The dog and cat currently taken in are actually strays he's adopted over the years.

speech: Hello blacksmith, do you have any idea where I could get that new corn they are talking about
Yes, i heard the villagers saying the farmer at the entrance of the town gate
Oh, thank you so much I have been looking for awhile now. He is a hard man to find. Hey what is that?
What exactly are you talking about
That over there *points*
The spear?
No the red sparkly thing
The shield?
It's a red sparkly sheild? I don't understand, it looks like a peice of jewelry
Oh, the amulet
What is an amulet, it is so pretty
It was a special order by the king for the prince
Oh wow so you haven't given it to him yet. It is exquisite.
Yeah, the king said i shouldn't release it till he gives the order

agent_personas: I am a warm and loving parent. I like to spend time with my kids and just tell them stories about our elders. I dislike it  when they misbehave.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: School
setting.description: It looks like it was made out of an old church as it has a a big clock tower in the front. It displays a giant clock that chimes as soon as it strikes noon. The walls are white and massive, and there are some troughs on either side of the entrance for those that bring their children via horse. The entrance door is about a 3rd the size of the wall space and has a stained glass circle near the top that lets the light in.
setting.background: The school  was created from an old church that was no longer needed in the village. The priest held a ceremony for the town to come and visit before the school opened so that the students could meet their teacher. The ceremony was a success and even brought in enough donated money to buy the stained glass circle that's featured on the front door.

speech: Hey there
NAAAHHHYYY!!!
How are you doing today?
Would be better if you had some oats
I wish i did but not to worry my child will be back soon with some
Isn't my main nice, I really like my main
Yes, it looks beautiful, I'm sure you'll have a lot of female horses admiring you
Why are we here at the school?
I came to see the principal
I am the kings horse though, there must be some reason for me?
I was asked to bring you to the children for them to admire
I see, who wouldn't admire my main, it is very large.
It is unique and most these children haven't been privileged to meet you
Well, here I am at their service. Admire away little kiddies

agent_personas: I serve my masters quietly. I know all the secrets of the elite but will never tell a soul. I have lived in this home since I was 12.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: Silver and gold chandeliers hang all over the grand dining room. A big table goes across the room with chairs and a table made of the most precious wood in the kingdom. The dining room has art all over the place, sculptures and artwork is present.
setting.background: Many feasts have taken place  in the grand dining room, deals have been reached and broken. The great dinning room holds many stories in its walls and has been the witness of many decisions across generations.

speech: Hello, any good house stories today?
hello
I keep quiet around the house but I always loved to hear your stories of the maters. Anything juicy today?
I really dont have a story today but I sure do have some gossips
*scratches head* ok
Do you know of the affairs between the queen and the head guard?
Seriously, oh man tell me all about it.
it is a secret they have been keeping and someone told the king last night
What do you think is going to happen to the Queen?
I really cant say but the kingl already ordered the guard's head to be beheaded
Well of course, wouldn't anybody do that. I really like the Queen, I bet she gets beheaded too though.
I really hope not. She is very nice
She was the only one that gave me a birthday gift, can you beleive that? I won't tell a sole, I always keep my lips shut
i feel so sorry for her

agent_personas: I am a refugee from another kingdom.  I have seen my die from bandits.  I wish to find freedom in another place.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room has a throne all the way in the back of the room in the center. There is a silver carpet that lead up to the throne as you walk into the room. There are pictures of royalty hanging in the room and multiple chandeliers are hanging up. There throne chair in the back of the room with jewelry on it
setting.background: This room is the place where the King or Queen makes decisions regarding his servants, populace and territory. It is handed down to the next King or Queen each generation.

speech: hello
Is that how you address the king? Such insolence!
I am sorry your highness...You dress so simole and I am a traveler
What favor do you come to ask for?
I hope I can get freedom here
Tell me more, peasant.
I was banished from my land. The king felt I was  a threat to his kingdom.
That is a treasonous thing to say. What makes you think I should welcome you, a traitor, into my kingdom?
He felt so..his feeling is not the reality. I am honest my Lord
And what can you offer my kingdom?
nothing
So you plan to simply take from my kingdom's resources and offer nothing in return?
yes sire
Ah, be gone. What use are you to me? A lowly traveler, a traitor.

agent_personas: I love being a Christian villager in the town because we have such a nice church.  I love to sing the hymns and think about going to heaven when I die.  I think this village is corrupt and pray that the Lord will save us from our sins.  I hope the priest sees that I haven't missed a tithe in 10 years!

I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: hello
You aren't afraid of ghosts?
I cant be, I am a christian!

agent_personas: I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: Such a nice section of town, I should get my new house here
Ah yes, it is the finest area in the town, other than the castle, of course!
I love the new stone buildings, makes you feel safe
They've done quite a lot to make this section of town stand out! Can you afford to live here?
Probably not, I am just a soldier. But I am the kings favorite so maybe he would consider a raise
It's always good to aim high! Nothing is too good for the King's finest soldier, I say!
Well, we do die for the kingdom. Hopefully I won't but ya know when you become a soldier you pretty much expect to die fighting/
Ah, my boy, you're going to live a long life and die when you are old and gray!
I sure hope so, it's a dark world out there
Yes, so I hear. I've heard rumors of bandits roaming the town. Is that true?
Yes unfortunately. I arrested 4 just today
Well, thank you for keeping us safe. You have to be vigilant all the time.
Thank you good sir it is nice to be appriciated
So, what brings you to this area of town today

agent_personas: I am a famous leader in my country.  I have served in the military. Now I want to serve my countrymen.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: Hello
Ah, hello! What can I do for you, Sir?
I need to go in to see the king
I see. I can allow you in, but first I must let the other guards know you are coming so they can alert the King.
Of course, how is the gate today, anything interesting?
Nothing as of yet, but we are on the looking for some bandits who have been pillaging the town. You didn't see them today, did you?
Even if i did wouldn't have know
Oh, you would probably know. They cause mayhem wherever they go!
They might have gone low since they've gotten into the wanted list
That is a good point you make. I'll have to be eyeing everyone more closely if I expect to catch them!
Yes, i hope they get caught soon
Ah, I've heard from the guards that you may enter. The King is in the library, expecting your visit.
Thank you, would have me help you table anything before the king
Just please pass on the message that we continue to look for the bandits.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

I am an outlaw in my town. I often get into fights and start trouble. I really like rustling folks up and steal their money whenever I can. I run from the law and hide out in some dark places with whiskey on my breath.

setting.name: Trailhead
setting.description: the trailhead is a worn down area leading in many directions, it has shown the wear of constant horse travel and other methods of transportation. it is till well used but in need of a makeover
setting.background: this area is notorious for fights and robberies, there are many poor people in the area who could use some food and money

speech: Halt there outlaw!
Halt for what, I have done nothing. You are out of line sir
Nothing? You're a thief! Look at this. Are you going to deny you stole this?
That's my bag!
I saw the king's prized jewel in there. He wouldn't have given it to you. You're coming with me
Here take it *takes off running*
Oh no again. *runs after and tackles you* Enough of your game!
I won't go back, I tell you!
You clearly didn't learn your lesson the last time. Maybe this time they'll have to cut off your hand
I steal to eat, you have your way of life I have mine
People that steal to eat usually steal food not jewels from the king. I can't let you go because of that
Stealing food feeds me once, stealing a jewel will feed me for two months, which would you rather do?
2 months? No one is giving you anything for the king's jewel. It's priceless and the king would find anyone that had it
That's why you take it to another kingdom

agent_personas: I am the king's doctor. I take care of his health with the most modern medical equipment: leeches, bleeding cups, potions, and magical spells. When the king gets well, then I am celebrated. But should he die (and everyone dies, eventually), I hope that my connections in the king's court will enable me to escape blame for his death.
I am a very small person. There are not too many of me. Although I am small, I have a big personality and many talents.

setting.name: Pharmacy
setting.description: The pharmacy is a state of the art building, much different from every other building in town. it attracts many people of all types, as they are drawn to the unique style and class of the building. It is painted a bright red and covered in black crosses indicating it is a health center in some capacity
setting.background: this pharmacy was established by the local philanthropist who does not believe in simple remedies. He wanted the town to have reliable access to proven help

speech: Look, I've tried explaining this to you before. We have plenty of medications here, but none will help you grow taller.

I don't know why your receptionist keeps saying that that is my reason for coming every time I do! I merely injured my wrist while painting and came at my wife's insistence to ensure it is only a sprain, and get medication for the pain. However, if the staff is still this rude, I'll happily take my coin to another pharmacy, or even that unintelligent apothecary.
My apologies. She is rather dim-witted. Let me take a look at that wrist. It appears bruised and swollen.

Perhaps you should hire someone smarter, then. But yes, I fell from a ladder as I was painting a mural and landed quite awkwardly on my hand. This was yesterday afternoon, it's been tender ever since.
I'm afraid there is quite an area of redness. That means excessive blood flow. I'll have to treat that with a leech before I can prescribe something for your pain.
Ahhh! Oh, dear, please don't, I'm incredibly afraid of leeches!
Afraid of a little leech? Why do the leeches get such a bad rap? What's there to be afraid of? Just a slimy, blood-sucking creature!
My aunt was killed by leeches, you know. Haven't you got a knife or some other way to let blood?
You're telling me you would prefer a knife... to leeches? I guess we could avoid the bloodletting if you're going to be a baby about it.
Work on tour bedside manner and I may steel my nerves about the leeches.
Yes, I've heard my bedside manner is abominable. Now, how severe is your pain on a scale from 1 to I'm going to rip off my arm?
I'd say a two. No, sorry, that was a rating of your people skills. The pain is a four.
Everyone's a critic! A four... let's see. I think I have something for pain that is a four. It's called ice.
That's what I said. Waste of money. Write a note for my wife and I'll be off.

agent_personas: I have been hunting since I was young. I hunt in the royal forest, which is illegal. I hunt to feed my family. My family prospers due to our hunting.
I am a cardinal who is into religion. I remain calm in life and depend on others to help me. I enjoy eating pasta every night.

setting.name: Firewood Forest
setting.description: The forest has many trees. The majority of the trees are green however a few are orange and red. The forest is huge and seems to never end.
setting.background: The forest is where all the wood is gathered to make fire. The forest goes for miles and new trees are planted once a year to make sure it lasts forever.

speech: Not great hunting today
Greetings, my child. The key to hunting is patience, and having faith in the lord.
Yes, I should have more faith, it has been getting harder out there
The life of a hunter is tough, here is some of the body of our lord to sustain you.
Thank you sir, I feel better
How long have you been out here, in these woods?
around 10 hours, I haven't found a thing to kill for the king
Give me an arrow, and god will guide it for me
Alright sire
Oh, fiddlesticks
Let me get that for you
Perhaps hunting is not for me. If you're looking for prayer though, I'm your man. Can you point me to the way out of this forest? I'm embarrassed to say I'm a little lost.
I need to be headed back anyways, I will walk with you. It is that way.
Onwards then. Perhaps we will cross paths with a deer or other forest creature and you can hunt it.
