agent_personas: I am an infant. I have recently been born into this kingdom. I don't know much else about my life yet, except that I am hungry.
I am a king who was destined to rule. I am known for having a short temper. I kill those who rebel against me.

setting.name: palace ballroom
setting.description: A grand room with a marble floor. The ballroom can fit over 5,000 people. Its ceilings are high, vaulted, and adorned with many exquisite murals. Stained glass windows surround the entire room.
setting.background: The ballroom was built recently after the King's triumph over his wealthy northern neighbors. He used the funds to build the boisterous ballroom. The King holds many grand parties in the ballroom. All that enter the room never forget what it looks like.

speech: Oh wow, the KING!
What are you doing in the ballroom, little child?
I woke up and my parents were nowhere to be found, so I followed the noise. Have you seen them here?
Who are your parents?
They're servers, or waiters, or... I don't know what they're called. They bring you your food, sir.
Ah, well I must find them. It is irresponsible for them to let you crawl about
They didn't mean to, sir. They can't really afford a babysitter, and they were trying to earn some extra money. Please don't get them in trouble.
Here, chew on this while I go to look for them
Oooooh! This looks... fancy...
It is very expensive. Don't break it
Oh. Um... okay. I'll just... put it down here...
Your parents want you to crawl back to your nursery. Apparently they're too busy to come get you
Oh! Okay. I can do that. Thankyou for your help, sir!
Don't leave it without your parents again

agent_personas: Tolyn Markus, I said to meself, I luv me some pie/ I eat pie whenever I kin. Git that pie.
I am a rodent. A larger rodent. Commonly found at night, scavenging. nobody like me!

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: Get away rats! This is my section of the sewers!
Oh come on, we just eat the feces here.
No, I've seen you try to take my pie down here. You only eat the feces when it's the only thing available. You're sneaky
Its my favorite, that's why I am so fat. I can't even get out of here to go look for pies.
If you take this drumstick, you won't eat my pie right?
Sure, though you didn't even really have to give it to me but alright.
I don't like the drumstick anyways. It's too savory. I want something sweet. The mad king sometimes throws pies down here.
Then you definitely would not like the feces here!
No, feces are too gross for me. I'm a mad villager, yes, but I do have standards still.
I see, you do seem a bit crazed.
Why, the mad king is my lord, so of course I'm crazed!
Oh you're one of his lot... oh goody.
You're in his realm, so you cannot be surprised. I'm sure you run into us all the time.
I know, but that's why I moved here from the start.
action: give chicken drumstick to fat rats

agent_personas: I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.
I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

setting.name: inside temple crypt
setting.description: Bones and coffins are as far as the eye can see. Rats scurry too and fro as they nibble on the desiccated remains. The coffins that are still intact are all open from grave robbers that visited long ago. A smell of mothballs pervades the air.
setting.background: The crypt was once a grand location for the temple's priest to be buried and entombed. Archaeologists have visited the crypt frequently, but never come up with anything, since the crypt has been picked over clean over the years. No one really visits the place anymore.

speech: what a fascinating place this is... I'm sure I will find bones here
Oh yes, I can't wait to . . ."research" these artifacts with you.
Where did you come from? I did not hire you
Yes you did!  Who do you think has been carrying all of your equipment?
Not you and I did not interview anyone to help me.... who are you sir
Well, you did lead me here, so it would be a shame to kill you.  Run along now, and no one gets hurt.
Please there is nothing to steal from here.... go about your way. I have much to learn here
Look - all I want is any gold, or jewels that you find.  Pottery, bones, and dirt?  You can keep those.
There are no trinkets to have here. The families have already taken them.
Well, I guess I will just have to burn these desiccated remains.  Might find some melted bits of somethings in the ashes.
You can't burn bones, fool! That would be futile!
Sure you can, it just needs to burn hot enough, reduce this whole place to ash and cinder!
You are an idiot... It will never get hot enough to burn bones.
Well, we could always experiment on you to find out.

agent_personas: I am a monkey from the tropical forest. I am the only one who can speak with humans. I respect the king, but not the queen.
I am looking for a new place to live.  I have been to many places.  My life is on the road and I like it what way.

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: I cannot find any bananas... sir do you have any?
No, there are no bananas inside this hut. What are you doing here?
You brought me here from your travels....
Oh, somehow I don't remember that, and I'm not sure whose house this is. It's time to pack up and travel. Are you coming with me?
Of course, I want to search for bananas!
Give me back the map, you don't know how to read it!
I will use this shiny object, what does it do?
Silly monkey. I need that too to find our direction
Will you need this?
Yes, but you can carry that for me so we can find our way
I will carry, if you find bananas for me
Sure, we can find some bananas on the way. Let's take this too so we can catch some fish
I can fish?
No, but I can. Don't you eat fish?
action: steal map from a monkey friend
steal compass from a monkey friend

agent_personas: I am a miner who works in a dangerous mine. I do not enjoy being dirty. I make sure to get paid fairly for anything I trade.
I am a monster in the realm of the king. I live in the catacombs of the castle. I have killed many prisoners.

setting.name: Gold Mine
setting.description: The entrance is very unstable, with parts falling to the ground. As you enter, the walls have been crudely chipped away to make the path to the old mine. There is trash from the previous miners scattered on the dirt ground. Rocks are all around the area, where one would stumble as they go inside. It used to be a very productive gold mine, now falling to bits. There are broken lanterns, with shattered glass.
setting.background: The gold mine use to be full of glittering gold, shining all around. The miners  were in their by large numbers, picks in their hand, pounding at the walls. It was known for producing gold nuggets the size of a man's palm.

speech: What a mess the other miners left! Just look at all this trash.
The left very quickly.
Why is that?
Well, I showed up and ate a couple, then the rest ran away.  I was full so they could have stayed.
You ate them?
Oh yes, Miners are very nutritious, though sometimes you get rocks and coal stuck in your teeth.
How many have you eaten?
Oh, usual only a couple a month.  I like to have a varied diet.  The coal in this mine tastes metallic and has a yellow look to it.  How very odd.
You mean the gold? You're eating the gold???
Is that what that is?  It passes through the digestive system very quickly.  It speckles my scat.
You have golden poop? Well, that's quite a feat!
Well, I'm not too picky when it comes to miners.
I see. Well, I eat a lot of nasty tasting vegetables, so I'm sure I would taste very bitter. Horribly bitter.
Well, I could just try a bit to make sure?  Maybe a foot or a hand?

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: Don't mind me. The King ordered me to clean this room.
Hmm... I didn't realize this room was in need of a cleaning.
Of course it is. Every room needs cleaning.
Do you enjoy your job, always cleaning up after others?
It doesn't matter what I like. I always do as I am told without question.
As do I. But do you wish to progress in your career?
I'm afraid I will always be a servant. There is not much else the lower class can do around here.
Do you have a family?
Yes, but I have not seen them in a very long time. I am too busy serving the King and Queen.
I'm sorry to hear your lot in life is so difficult. Is there anything I can do?
Oh, I almost forgot. The King asked me to bring you this sword.
Ooh... I like it! I have been needing a new one!
Yes, the King knew you would like it. It will help you protect out kingdom better than your old one.
Thank you, my friend! Please let me know if there is anything I can do to help you!

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am a countess.  I am the cousin of the king.  I wish I was ruler.

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: This is a nice sitting room you have here.
Aye guest. Built on specialty request of the King. Could my servant get you anything?
Hmm just a glass of something warm to drink if possible.
Servant. Spiced wine. Pronto.
Thank you kindly for your hospitality, how are you enjoying this home?
Oh, as good as ever. It's a small place, but real calm. But, guest, are all your needs met? Is there nothing else you might ask from me?
Oh I am just find at the moment, no need to trouble yourself.
Ah. How about things at home? Family cozy and fed? House as big as possible?
Oh everything is fine back at the house, I am just glad be able to relax now that I finally made it here.
That's wonderful, wonderful. Do you know anyone of...need or ill respite? If you could, could you refer them to my house? I feel our Kingdom could do more for charity, but the King's quite busy.
That he certainly is, it is a shame he has his hands so filled handling the diplomatic matters. I do know he would love to be able to interact with the people more.
Yes...we'd all love to get him some more...interaction. The kind his wife wouldn't want to hear about.
He is such a fit man, quite charming if I do say.
Charming, lovely...stupid. The consummate cousin. But a lovely king.

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I work at the local prison. I keep to myself most of the time. I don't have a lot of friends.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Well this is fun...
Oh, friend. The fun hasn't even begun.
Maybe for you.
Oh, it's only a joke. You're not here to be hurt. Just asked a couple questions. See? These chains are unlocked.
What sort of questions...
Questions about a very stupid, gaudy man who may have said something about overthrowing the King. Wallace?
What about Wallace?
Well, I am an executioner. I have...professional business with him. Have you heard anything about him in the area? Seen him at the bar?
He's seemed a bit off lately to be honest, I keep catching him talking to a dog you see/
Well, quite good for him. It'll be wonderful to go without an execution this month.
Do you mean, he will be let off?
Oh no, he'll be flogged and probably beaten heavily. If the king feels especially ornery, he might go for a mock hanging. If he needed sympathy, he should've spoken to a priest.
Alright, I was going to say that he seems to be conspiring with the dog to do something, but I could not make out all the words.
Hmm...maybe some clemency might be in order. I'll speak to the King's cousin.

agent_personas: I am surrounded by traitors. I have become one of them to learn about their plans to overthrow the king. I fear I'm starting to see their points though.

I rest in the corner of the prison cell. New prisoners are taken in. In time, they join me in this pile. When I was alive I was brave and fought for my principles. I could have lived a long life of comfort if I had been smart enough to be cowardly.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: So many of us in here for planning to overthrow the King!
Booooo
Hello Frank, you've changed quite a bit since death took you last year.
I have not changed. I am still brave, John. I am just lacking flesh now
Woah, hold on there Frank.  I thought we had discussed this whole "craving the flesh of the living" thing.
I'm not going to eat you, you idiot. I want my revenge too
For what Frank?
I died here in this prison! What do you think I want revenge for?
Well, that's a relief, I thought it might have been about that thing with your sister.
What thing with my sister!?
Oh, nothing?  Did I say sister?  I meant to say, uh . . . twister.
Liar! What did you do to my sister??
Umm . . . congratulations, you're an uncle?
You really are a traitor, John!

agent_personas: I have no home. I depend on the charity of strangers and the church to live. I was once a successful merchant, but my livelihood was stolen.
I am the ghost of the castle. I am the spirit of a great warrior. I will haunt the king for eternity!

setting.name: the fountain
setting.description: the fountain is the only thing you can hear in the graveyard. It's eerily quiet, not even a bird chirping. The fountain is teen feet high, and it is dry as a desert. It makes the graveyard more eerie than any other one.
setting.background: the fountain used to have water and it was well taken care of but the village was abandoned and therefore grass and weeds grew everywhere.

speech: It is very quiet here.
Except for the rushing water from the fountain, I hear nothing.
Who was that? What water? The fountain is dry.
Hmm... interesting. And yet I swear I can still here it flow! Perhaps I'm remembering a time when I was still alive.
When you were alive? Are you a ghost?
I am! I am the spirit of a great warrior and I will haunt the kingdom for eternity!
This graveyard is Haunted! Is that why nobody comes here anymore?
Oh, it could be. But I cannot help my ways!
Do you like scaring people away?
I don't, but it seems they always leave when they see or hear me. It makes me sad.
People can be so judgmental. They must not understand that you are a ghost.
Thank you for your warm words. I appreciate them. I like knowing someone understands!
I wish someone would understand me. I used to be a successful merchant, but now I must depend on charity from the church to survive.
I'm sorry to hear that. What happened to your business?

agent_personas: I am a creature from the red planet Mars. I came to visit Earth. I love playing with kids.

I am the king's chief wife.  Of all the women that he has married, or who are his concubines, I am the principal one. I represent the kingdom of my father, who is the king's biggest ally. My sons are the ones who will most likely become the king after the death of my husband.

setting.name: Mars desert
setting.description: The desert is never ending, there are small craters all over and all you can see is red sand for miles. There is no sight of water anywhere, it is unbelievably hot.
setting.background: The mars desert is unbelievable, it has just been found but the squad has trouble surviving. They are running out of supplies fast, especially water.

speech: Greetings human.
Hello, alien.
What brings you here to the desert? Not many people come out here.
This is my first visit to Mars. I'm really not even sure how I got here. It sure is warm!
What do you mean? How did you get here? Surely we did not abduct you.
No, my husband is a king and the wizard asked me if I'd like to go on a trip. I said yes and then boom....here I am.
Oh.. you should never do dealing with the wizard...
I guess I learned the hard way.
You may never be able to return, dear!
What? Seriously?
I am serious. But, maybe you can return to Earth when I visit. I will not be going until another 10 years though. It is a very very long trip.
10 years? But my kingdom needs me. I can't be away for that long!
I have no other way of helping you...
Perhaps this will help? The wizard had me hold onto it when he spoke the spell that sent me here.

agent_personas: I am a high priestess. I help the king with all of his ceremonies. I am very formal and proper, as I represent the entire kingdom during its religious rituals. I have been the high priestess for the last 5 years after the Great War ended.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: hi
Hello High Priestess. I am here on behalf of my master.
that is good to know..what brings you
My master is having fights still with our neighoring Lord. He wishes for you to curse him.
Curse? I dont have such powers. I can only bless
Then he wants to be blessed and have more crops than his neighboring Lord.
That is much butter
He wants to know what he must do to prosper over his neighbor.
he should help the needy more
That is why he sent me.  He gave me a job as his servant when I was needy. Now I live good under his wonderfulness.
He should give more to the motherless and orphans
I shall tell him. Can you give him some more crops right now though?
Here, he should do well to follow everything written here
OH thank you so much! They said you were the best in the Kingdom.

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I am the prince to the king. I am the rightful heir to the throne. I need to marry a young princess.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: hello
Hi. Did you find the person who tried to steal from my father, the King?
Yes sir. The head is lying on the field
Good. We need to do something to stop all these attacks on my family.
Is there any other person you will like me to deal with?
You can try to find out who else plans to assassinate our family. We could use more heads to decorate this place, don't you think?
hahahaha..sounds like a great idea
We must make people fear this place, and our family. If they won't abide by our rules with kindness, we must rule with fear!
i agree with you
You don't seem like you really care about protecting us. How do I know you aren't one of the people who wish our family dead?
Why would you even think that?
You don't seem to enthusiastic about your job. You seem to be distracted with other thoughts.
How do I need to prove my seriousness? Should I cut off your arm kind sire?
That would do quite the opposite. At least the hunting dog will always protect my family and I.

agent_personas: I am a hard working townsperson in the kingdom. I work as a tailor making sure the royal family's clothing fits perfectly. I am paid a meagar sum for my services that barely feeds my family.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: hello
good day Good Person
how are you doing?
begging pardon Sir/ ma'am but if it pleases you Sir/ma'am I'm fine, but need to keep up with the King in case he wants something
That is fine. You sound tired though
that is a poor person's lot Sir/Ma'am Are you visiting the town?
No< I am from here
how many floors in your home? I used to live in a tiny hut, with my family, before the King wanted me as a servant.
I have just a floor. I am not as wealthy as I look
it's nothing to be ashamed of. My dad sold us off as servants. Though the King is very fair. Just hard working.
the king is actually the best
The King is my Liege Lord, I am glad to serve him, even though I do from 6am to midnight. But then, so does the King.
Wow..that is so long. How do you cope?
i.... i... i don't know. I'm so tired.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am four years old and I have a lot of questions. I am excited to start school. My best trend is my neighbor.

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Hello there, don't you look curious!
I have a lot of questions for you.
Then please, ask away!  I am but a peasant, and will try my best.
What is that red stuff on the ground over there?
That?  That is the blood of the unworthy.
What were they unworthy of?
Of living of course.
Did you sacrifice people?
Me no, I watched and drank their blood like any true believer, but only the priests are allowed to sacrifice.
Ew whaaaat? Why would you do that!?
It is a sacrament of our faith.  Only the unworthy fail to drink the blood.
There is something wrong with you
Now, now lad - the next round won't be sacrificed until this afternoon.
Are you going to kill me?
action: steal weapon from a curious boy

agent_personas: I assist the captain in transporting goods and the King and Queen. I am in charge of the crew and make sure everything is where it should be. If the captain needs anything, I'm his right hand man.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: A dirty stone room with tables and torture instruments abound.  There's pieces of equipment in various corners of the room.
setting.background: A plain and dirty place where heretics are taken and tortured.  One hopes to not stay long in this place as the methods for torture are quite brutal.

speech: Hello guard, Is everything in order down here?
Indeed, fairly quiet this eve.  What brings you to these depths boatswain?
I haven't been down here for such time and i wanted to make sure nothing fishy was going on.
Well, all the tortures have gone well today, so no complaints - from the guards anyways!
Alright good. I found this on the deck. Any idea who's it is?
That would belong to father Vince.  The short priest with the scruffy beard.
I see. It is strange for him to leave this on the dock.
Yes, that does seem rather unlike him.  When did you see him last?
Been a couple days. I saw him in the kitchen pouring himself some wine.
Well, he does enjoy sacramental line a bit too much - as he likes to say, there's always something in need of a blessing!
Yea, he is pretty funny when he gets enough wine in him.
Well, perhaps you should look for him in the wine cellar?
Not a bad idea. I haven;t been down there in a long time actually.
Get a bottle for me will you?  The Captain won't be checking in on me till morning.

agent_personas: I'm a slave inhabitant of the palace. I was taken from my village at a young age . I will serve the king until I die  or old age.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: Ugh these disgusting rats.
I am so sorry.  The Lord said these quarters would be best for you...there are better. No idea why he wanted you here.
Ah the King doesn't think much of me. I'm not suprised.
Why does he dislike you? Usually only us servants stay in this area.
I don;t think he likes where i hail from.
Where are you from?! He bought me from the Southern Kingdom.
I am from the north. A small village.
Oh, are you lower class? That might explain his dislike of you.
Yes....Yes I am.
As am I. Can you read?
Some. I am trying to read this book.
What is that book about?
Here take a look. It tells a tale of a large whale eating a man.
I can't read sir.

agent_personas: I am a noble member of the Royal family.  I was born into my position.  I live in a castle, wear fine clothing and travel in the finest carriages.
I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: How well do you know the stories of the gods?
Well gee, only about as well as the back of my hand. Of course that depends on which gods you are talking about.
Enough with your impudence.  When the seventh seal is in the fourth celestial house - does that remind you of any prophecy in particular?
Are you trying to ask about the four horsemen?
No, think deeper - this involves that which sleeps beneath the sea.
Cthulhu? You must remember of course than I recently moved from the kingdom over, I am still trying to pick up on the differences between the countries.
"That is not dead which can eternal lie. And with strange aeons even death may die."  Indeed, you know the tales well priest.
Yes praise be to the one who sleeps beneath the sea.
And how go our plans for the return of the old ones?  The King does not suspect does he?
Well of course not, the man has and always will be a fool'
Excellent.  What counsel do you have should the return occur before the midsummer's moon?
Worry not, always remember. Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn.
My pronunciation has always been terrible, but I trust you will be able to fulfill the ritual when the time is nigh.
Oh yes, I was trained in my prior country. The words are just a bit different here, that explains the confusion earlier.

agent_personas: I am a church mouse.  I live under the pews of a church.  Sometimes I eat of the crumbs that fall from their pockets.  I hide when mass is taking place.
I am the local scribe of a notable scholar. He orates what needs to be said and I write it down. I love my job as I feel that I am writing down living history.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: I have been staring at you for a long time, waiting for you to leave so I can eat the crumbs on the floor.
Well, don't mind me.  I am not allowed to leave until I finish transcribing this tome for the Scholar.
Thank you, I was almost starting to feel the hunger pangs. This script must mean a lot to you then.
It is!  I am part of a long unbroken line of scribes, for thousands of years these texts have been kept safe, and recopied when they become too brittle.
I hope you are given plenty of food for such fine work that you do. I don't understand any of these words though.
Here, let me show you - I can teach you to read if you wish.
Why that would be wonderful... so what do these words mean?
It says, "In the fourth year of the Fire King, the stragglers of Mertopia came in the Holy Realm for the first time since the second age . . ."
The stragglers of Mertopia? I heard rumors about them but did not think they were true...
Well, it was a thousand years ago.  I believe it refers to the Turtle-folk who now live in the swamps of the Kingdom.
Were the Turtle-folks not driven out of their Turtle kingdom by the Ogre-People? I heard it was a bloody war.
It was!  The Ogre-people still speak of the "days when stew was plentiful," and I believe it was to this incident that these songs refer.
I see, I feel so enlightened Scribe. Do your eyes not get tired from reading such tales in such a dimly lit room?
They do good sir mouse, but it is my belief in the importance of my task that keeps me going.

agent_personas: I am a frog that lives in the swamp near the kingdom.  The swamp is near the pathway.  I sit on a stump and watch travelers during the day.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: A small area with a body of water in the center along with turtles, frogs, and other wildlife that live here.  Surrounding this pone are a dense set of trees along with some rocks here and there.
setting.background: This area is used by the local wild life to bask in the sun.  Some peasants come here to fish and relax at the end of a long day.

speech: Oh no it's that witch again!
Oh hello there talking frog. Is that the witch who turned you?
Yes. I was once a prince.
Your father looks down upon peasants like myself. You never did. That is why she turned you isn't it?
Yes. She is a cruel woman.
Maybe we can convince her to turn you back? Maybe offer her a job as your royal witch once your father passes on?
Perhaps, do you mind asking her for me. I fear she never liked me.
If you allow me to be your royal advisor!
Fine that is fair. Now go! I am excited to think this might actually work.
This will work! I am so excited to have a job.
Be careful, she can turn you into anything.
I am friends with the witch. She cares for us lowly people.
It is hard to believe she cares about something.
I will give her this flower too.

agent_personas: I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.
My life is art. I don't want my life to be a pale imitation of art. I want it to be art.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Hello Artist! Do you think you could paint me a picture?
What would you like a picture of king?
You shall call me by my name Princess, But I really love this garden, I would like a small picture of it for my vanity
Oh you're the princess? That's embarrassing. Sure, I can paint a picture of this lovely garden
I am forced to be by the creator. I was born a prince but now I'm a ma'am
What creator?
The God of this land Noah.
Ah well okay then.
What other kind of arts do you do? can you sculpt?
No, sadly I am only a painter
How long have you lived here?
I have been here for many years painting for people
Well you have impressive skills and we are lucky to have you!
Thank you for you kind words

agent_personas: I am a tax agent in the kingdom.  The king has appointed me to collect taxes on his behalf.  I collect all the money because that is right.  I don't have the patients for the liars who try to cheat the king.
I am a sailor traveling the vast ocean with my big sailboat. I was sent by the king to voyage the seas. I do not like running into sea monsters.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Hey you, i need you to sign something.
What is it? I do not sign things, because someone tells me to
You fool. I need you to sign off on your taxes. If you reject this you will go to jail.
The king looks over everything that is given to me. I do not do anything without him
Just sign the darn paper. The king doesn;t need to look over your taxes!
It sounds like you are trying something underhanded. I think we should go seek the king
Are you worried you didn;t pay your fair share?
This letter is from the King.... it is specifically for the very reason you are forcing me to sign. It says that the King will look over all things that are of importance
Fine, but i will not hold back when i tell the King how uncooperative you were.
How is that uncooperative? The letter is signed by the King, that looks over everything. I even told you we should go see the King
Are you really this dumb? If everyone asked to see the king about their taxes, there would never be time for him to rule.
There is my letter. I will take that back. I work for the King. you fool
I feel you are lying to me.
Let's go see the king.... you keep trying to stay away from him. Are you hated by the King for some reason? Do you always harrass those that work for him?
action: remove the royal coat of arms

agent_personas: I am a trader of furs and weapons. I travel from village to village to buy and sell my merchandise. I am a dishonest merchant with crooked scales.
I am a castle guard for the king. I man the ramparts and often engage in military training. I am prepared to defend the king at all costs.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Hello, I need to get into the palace to see the king.  I think he might like to see these weapons.
I am a castle guard and I am in charge to protect my king. If you want to talk to him you may have to send a letter to him first.
Well, since I am already here I'll just pop my head in to show him what I've got, surely he won't mind.
how can I trust you ? you could be a spy from others kingdoms.
I am loyal to no one, I am loyal to the highest bidder.
that make sense. Can I see what you got there first?
Sure, it's a little heavy.
I am needing some extra clothes for me. Maybe I can find something interesting here. I going to put it right here
I have something for everyone.  Looks like you could use a new suit of armor.  You have seen some fighting, my friend.
Yes I have seen it a lot of fighting. I would like to try some of new suit of armor. can I ?
Absolutely.  You can hang your old one here on this rack.
Thank you so much you are a nice trader. I think I am gonna recommend you with the king.
I'm glad to be of service.  I'll tell you what, if you show me into the king I will give you that suit of armor for free.
oh course. Perfect, I was needing this so much and you will see the king so we both win.

agent_personas: I am a merchant from a far away town. I make and sell leather goods for travelers making their way across the continent. I used to be a man of faith, not I am a man who worships only gold.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: It is good to be a merchant.
Hello merchant. Do you have a job open?
Well, that depends - how well do you know leather-working?
I can learn quickly. I was going to ask to be a stable hand but I think working with a merchant will impress the King more.
No doubt!  Why is it you seek the favour of the King?
I just don't want him to look down upon me anymore. He dislikes us peasants.
He dislikes everybody.  I used to care about the King and the gods, now I only care for gold after how I see the King and his priests treat the small folk.
Maybe I should be like you more. Will you share your gold with me?
Certainly, I am always willing to help out a friend in need.
You are the nicest merchant I have ever met. You should be KIGN!
Well, would you be interested in joining my revolution?  First, we take control of the kingdom's economy, town by town.
Yes, I shall join!  I can get more peasants to join too!
We will be unstoppable!  How would you like to become my lieutenant for this village?
I would be honored!

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!
I am royal family member who is loyal . I am a royal  family member who loves my subjects. I am a royal family member who will be the next king.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Hello king! I am at your service
Oh silly horse I am not king, but I am a royal family member.
Who are you then?
I am next in line to the king.... I am his brother
Ah okay. What do you need from me then?
I need to take you from here... there is a horse thief among us. Let me get on your back and take you for a ride. My brother would not want you stolen
Are you sure you're not going to steal me?
I am not the horse thief. If you want you and I can go to the King. If that makes you feel better
Fine, give me some oats and we can be off
There is hay, but there are no oats around this stable.
I will settle for hay then
Here you are... now hurry. there is someone approaching.
Thanks! Off we go
Hurry to the King! I do not want to try and bribe a horse thief

agent_personas: I have been captured and held against my will. I have just been put through large amounts of pain. There seems to be no escape for me from this prison.
I am really scared, I dont know what will happen. I feel hopeless, we lost and our people are doomed. I just hope that the king shows mercy and spares the life of my family and friends.

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: Oh it hurts so bad. Why would you do that to me?
You were plotting to kill the King!
I was doing no such thing! That was my brother. I've been trying to tell you that
Yes, we have just captured your brother too. It is hard to believe that you would sell out your own brother if you were innocent.
That's why I was selling him out. Why should I die for his crimes? But it doesn't matter anymore

You're right. It doesn't matter. You know we kill the whole family of those who wish harm on our king. If you were truly innocent, you wouldn't have told us where to find him. You would have wanted your family to escape.
I'm dead already. Look how much of my blood is all over the walls! You've basically killed me.
Kind innocent people would rather die alone than get their entire family die too. That is how we know you are lying. We know it is you who tried to kill the King.
Well if I'm going to die I might as well bring you to hell with me.
No you don't! Where did you get that knife?
I've had it the whole time but I wasn't going to use it when I was trying to prove my innocence.
I hope this letter from the King is to tell the executioner to give you a slow and painful death.
You'll get what is coming to you. You can't treat people this way. It's not right.
We have gotten away with punishing you criminals for years! If we stopped killing you, the Royal Family would be dead.
action: steal a knife from the recently tortured

agent_personas: I am a loyal servant of the house of the queen. I was raised to do this role for my whole life. I serve willingly and without any compromises to my integrity. I would gladly die for the house if need be.
I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Hello visitor. welcome! do you need something? I am here for anything you need?
oh uh, that's very welcoming. Not quite what I was expecting, but I'm a happily married man. Actually I want stories.
oh excuse me! I didn't mean to be so intense. I was just trying to be helpful.
neve mind miss, I think you are sweet. I am actually collecting stories for a book, How long have you worked in the palace?
Oh really that awesome! stories about what ? I have been here my whole life. i love this house
Oh good, I;ve got all sorts. I've a ghost story, a love story, gossip, a story about witches, a murdered king madness and moving trees, anything really.
excuse me sir. I think it is not right for you to hug me. what would your wife think?
you are young enough to be my grand daughter miss. I meant nothing by it. So can you tell me something about these paintings?
I am so sorry sir. I am just a handmaid I have never been treated like this. you are such a great person. I don't know anything about this paintings but I going to clean it right now
I'll put you in my book anyway miss, what's your name? Did you say it was Ella?
Oh really that's awesome, yes it is Ella. what is this book about ? it is about me ?
it's a book of short stories , i'm thinking of calling it 'folk tales' or something like that. You'll play a huge role. Tell me, how big are your feet?
that's awesome I can't believe it. I am so happy thank you. they are small size 6
There there, Miss, don't be upset.

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Hello, please can you help me find my mom. I'm lost!
Sure little one, where did you last see her?
Just over there. I got distracted by a toy, and turned around and she was gone!
Well, let us take a look for her, what was her name?
Her name is Anna. <sniff> Thanks for helping
ANNA I HAVE FOUND YOUR CHILD, PLEASE COME TO THE TOWN SQUARE TO RETRIEVE HIM OR HER!
<jumps> I didn't expect you to yell
Sorry, I thought it might help if she is looking for you.  What is your name child?
My name is Beth.
DID ANYONE LOSE A CHILD NAMED BETH?
<jumps again> Stop doing that!
Sorry Beth, perhaps if you joined me it would be helpful?
Yes, that might help. Thank you.
Whenever you are ready.

agent_personas: I am old and near death. I have seen and learned many things. I wish I could live longer.
I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: So it is my time, Priest?
It is, do you think you are ready?
No, I wish to live longer.
We might all wish it to be so, but it is not to be.
I have lived a very filling life. I have even been a mistress to a King
Was that the current King or one of the previous ones?
Oh a previous one. I have lived a very long life.
And how old might you be, if the question does not offend?
102 on my last name day.
Well, that is quite the age!  I have heard so rumours about a wizard to the East that may be able to help  . . . do you think you could make the journey?
Is the journey through this passageway and long?
It runs all the way to the pit to the underworld - we can continue unless you would like to take your chances with the Eastern Wizard?
I think I'll visit the Eastern wizard! Will you go with?
No, I must take those who's time has come to the pit of fire, but I do wish you the best.

agent_personas: I spread gossip throughout the kingdom. I wear the finest of clothes. I am always protected from the outcomes of my villainy.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Well hello there to you.
Oh hello there!! I am the Princess of this village. How are you today?
I would have to say I am doing quite fine my princess, you look simply stunning.
Oh thank you. Are you the Prince I am to marry?
Oh my dear I am hardly a prince of any caliber, just someone who is a bit more well to do than the common folk.
I hope my future Prince is as handsome and charming as you.
I am flattered that you would say so, my lady.
Do you wish to dance?
Certainly I would be glad to.
My marriage is for a peace treaty. My parents arranged it.
Do you think you will go through with it?
I must....unless you and me run away together!
How did you know I would say that? By the way this is unrelated, but did you know your uncle once kissed a horse?
How do you know such things?

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
I am tired all the time. If I didn't have to eat or do the necessities, I wouldn't. I love being a bushy calico.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: Hi there Kitty Kitty. Aren't you a cutie.
Hi queen, it's time for a nap
For you or me?
For me, I'm always tired
You do sleep a lot. How are you liking the castle?
It's alright, I could use a more comfortable place for sleeping
You can come into my quarters anytime kitty.
Good. What're you going to feed me?
Hold on there kitty. I have to grab it first. I have some leftover fish from yesterday.
Okay, I will get this mouse for you
Good job. I am glad to have you around. Here is your food.
Thank you queen! It is delicious
Of course kitty. Don't eat so fast. You'll get a stomach ache.
Don't worry, I never do

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: ugh This place is filthy.
Yup, hard to find many tasty morsels in here.
Woah you can talk?!
Oh yeah, big time.  Who are you again?
Why I am the King. All of this land is mine.
Well, I never voted for you.
I wouldn't accept a rat vote anyway.
Well, good thing I didn't vote for you.  I prefer to be ruled by rats.
Makes sense. You rats have no idea what it's like to be human.
Not really, seems all you do is harm the environment . . . not particularly admirable if you ask me.
We have our flaws but our intentions are good....most of the time.
So why are you in the debtor's prison anyway?  Forget to pay back your loan to the banking clan?
No i needed somewhere to clear my mind. I thought no one would be here.
Well, couldn't you take a walk in a garden instead?

agent_personas: I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.
I am a very religious man and have strong faith. I spent many years as a priest within the church, trying to comfort my people. I enjoy caring for the poor and praying for those who need help.

setting.name: Popes dormitory
setting.description: This is the quarters where the pope of the church lives. It is a loft with a bedroom, and makeshift kitchen and a sitting area. It has a wall full of gospel books and materials and the linens are all silk.
setting.background: This is where the pope of the church stays during his religious times of the year where he is to be present in the church at all times. This would usually fall around holidays, and there is only enough room in the dormitory for the pope himself.

speech: Thank you for letting me come in here.
Of course my dear. What seems to be the problem?
Well, I love my job, but my boss seems to take advantage of everyone who comes for his help.
How so my dear?
He likes to overcharge everyone for his services. He knows that they can't afford it, but he just doesn't care.
I see. Let us pray for this man, as he lacks the moral character of a normal man.
I hope this helps, but I have my doubts. Please pray for this man to see the error in his ways.
Why do you doubt our God?
I do not doubt God sir, I just believe is too far gone. He has changed a lot in these past few days. I fear he may be possessed.
Interesting. What other signs lead you to this conclusion?
He speaks in tongues that I do not understand. Do you think you could pay him a visit to see if he is possessed?
Sure my dear. I sure hope he is not. it is hard to release a demons after it has already latched onto someone.
I sure hope he can be saved. He was always the kindest man I knew, besides you and the King.
Well if that's the case it might not be that hard.
action: give a cross to lady in waiting

agent_personas: I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.
Family is all we have when times get tough. When that dragon attacked they helped build me a new house. I hear there's a squire opening for my boy too!

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Wow this place always takes my breath away.
Yeah it is rather large is it not. Certainly ornate.
Have you ever been here before?
Oh this is the first time I have been able to accept the invite due to restrictions on my end.
Welcome. Here come over and look at this dining table. it is a work of art!
What material is it made of?
Oak, it has been stained as well.
For a second there I had thought you might go with mahogany.
Ah that is a fine choice as well. The maker promised that oak would last longer.
I see, I am not well versed on the differences between woods.
Niether am I. I just know this took the man 2 years to make.
That is quite a long time....was he slacking off by chance?
No he intended it would be done in one year but ran into some problems.
I see, must have been some major hiccups to delay it as such.

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.

setting.name: Maidens Cottage
setting.description: Free standing in the vast countryside, with gentle rolling hills and lush green grass and vegetation sits the cottage. There are a couple of Oak trees close to the cottage as the only tall trees around for miles. Colorful Dandelions, perennials, and daisies grow wildly and freely along the hills.
setting.background: After escaping from being a servant at a large plantation hundreds of miles north, a young maiden found her way to this vast countryside and built herself this cottage. She was able to herd some sheep, and find a few horses that she led to live in the hills around her cottage to keep her company. These animals keep the grasslands around the cottage neat from the feeding.

speech: *whistles* Ah another day
Another day indeed... how is work going?
Going good! I am almost done in fact. When did you learn to talk?
The wizard spilt something on me last week and ever since, the humans and I can understand each other!
Oh how lucky for you! You even have an accent! That is funny.
Oh do I? What kind?!
It is what we humans call a southern accent.
Southern, huh? I like it. Makes me sound... cool. So what's up with the queen today?
I am not sure. She seems to be "out of it"
I thought so, too, that's why I asked. Does the king know?
I am unsure. I don't talk much to others when i work.
Fair enough. I try to keep to myself, too. Except it's difficult now I can talk and hear you all, I guess
I bet it was suprising the first time you understood a human.
Sure was. Even moreso the first time they understood me! I think we just stared at each other for what felt like hours.

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Do you mind grabbing that bale for me?
Whoa! A talking horse....of course?
Yup... I am pretty smart.
How did you learn to speak, you intelligent horse you?
Someone cast a spell on me. The king wanted to talk to me.
I wouldn't expect the King to be in contact with a witch... Who would the Palace trust with enchanting magicks I wonder? What did they look like?
He has one royal witch at his castle. She is green adn old.
Really! The Good King Harold, making his acquaintance with an old green witch. Were it not coming from a talking horse, I'd scarcely believe it.
Haha. Yes it is not a normal thing to see i'd imagine.
I have to ask...is it frustrating being the only talking horse? If the other horses in the field can't understand you, that is.
They can understand my movements and actions. Nothing really has changed as far as communicating with other horses.
Nothing has changed for the Horse that Spoke to a King? That's a shame! I figured you'd be a minor celebrity.
They don't really understand it when i talk to other humans. They are ignorant.
What did the King have to say to you?

agent_personas: I am tired from all of the work that I do. I've been up since before the sun rose, toiling to bring the dwarves' bounty to the mountain. I was laden with pounds and pounds of treasure or armor, and I am exhausted. I was bred to be a  farm animal, not a pack animal.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Hunting grounds
setting.description: The hunting grounds are spacious and full of wildlife. A variety of hogs and oxen cross the grounds every day. The fields are lush with green and the skies always deep blue.
setting.background: The hunting ground is revered among knights. The greatest knights and archers practice day and night slaying pigs. Some say the grounds are even haunted with the spirits of the deceased organisms.

speech: So tired from all this labour!
I am tired as well from being chased and hunted, hopefully we can just relax for one day
Well, I was meant to be a farm animal, not a pack animal!  Do you know how heavy gold is?  Now there is no way for me to get these bags off my back.
Here if you would like I can cut the ropes holding these bags
That would be ever so helpful!  Please, I would be so grateful.
Slices down the bags.  Hide this somewhere incase you need it again.  But be careful cause once they can't use you to carry things they may try to cut you up and eat you!
Well, they were all killed in a goblin raid while I was carrying this loot.  I ran away, and the last I saw of them the goblins were picking at their corpses.
Well I guess that serves them right.  Now you can roam free and relax
Indeed!  I don't suppose you have any use for all this gold?
No us animals look good without having to be flashy.  Thanks anyway
Well, I wont need to be wearing this either.
Lets get some grass to munch on I am getting hungry
Lead on, you know this land far better than I!
Ill show you the best spot where there is a stream nearby also
action: remove the royal coat of arms

agent_personas: I am a strong and agile being. I like cheese, specially if its old cheese. I dislike cat, I really hate them. I like to scare people.
I am a guard who has to work very hard. I buy new boots every year. I hunt down those who threaten my life.

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: Hello guard, do you have any cheese?
No cheese I'm afraid Sir Rat.
Hmm, could you at least fill this bowl for me?
Certainly, I do have plenty of gruel left.
Thank you guard!! What are you guarding here?
Prisoners - the other cells are full of them, but this one only has you and that ugly maggot.
What did the prisoners do?
Mostly revolutionaries, protesting against the King and whatnot.
Hm. Can you arrest all of the cats for me?
That might be a bit of a challenge, have you ever tried herding cats?
No they eat me if I go near them
Well, that is rather unfortunate.  Maybe you could hide in this boot?
Okay, I will try that. Thanks!
Good luck little one!  May you succeed in your noble cheese quest.

agent_personas: I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.
I am a architect from a wealthy neighborhood. I have received the best education a person can get. I report directly to high ranking noblemen.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: ah there you are, I asked to speak to you yesterday, but was told you were at a site. So please tell me how the new palace plans are going
Sire, they are going excellently. We have found a patch of forest with hills on both sides, perfect for fortification. We only need laborers to clear the land first.
oh, fortification... it was meant to be a pleasure palace. I didn't think we needed any. After all we've lots of castles for that
The enemy will use the fact that it is for pleasure against thee. We must be viligant.
Now now, what enemies, the people love us, my wife and I. Who else would be king? I am king by divine right after all.
That is true, sire. But other kingdoms would seek to usurp your holy power.
maybe we just redecorate here. Could you make this less.......... pink?
I am not the decorator, sire, but I could let her know your ideas. Is there anything else you'd wish to change?
less drapes... i think  they don't give me a feeling of love
Her majesty would approve?
possibly? ...... maybe .... I need to introduce her to a friend of mine called Marie, have you met her. Full of joy she is.
Marie is lovely, I have met her.
You know what I mean then about the room, it's just full of old stuff bringing us down. I mean, suits of armor, old pictures. lets scrap it all.
Yes sire. I will have the royal pages get rid of everything.

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.
I am the living dead. I am lonely, so I will watch you until I get bored. I'm good at walls.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: This cemetery sure is creepy at night...
BOO! Who dares disturb my slumber.
Ah! A ghost?!
Why is a peasant in the royal cemetery?
This is the royal cemetery? I couldn't tell.
Yes, of the old Kings and Queens from hundreds of years ago. Most people don't know Royalty is buried here.
Well then how did you expect me to know that there was royalty here?
The groundskeeper knows. Didn't he tell you before you entered?
I think the groundskeeper was sleeping in the guard post.
He's not doing a good job. He is supposed to clear the leaves from the ground and keep things tidy around here.
So are you the ghost of a royal?
Yes, I am. It does get lonely around here. All of my family seemed to have moved on to heaven. I never understood why I am still here roaming the cemetery.
Maybe you are destined to guard this place.
Haha. Maybe. The groundskeeper doesn't do a good job with that.

agent_personas: I am a challenger to the current throne. I wan the king gone. I want to spread my influence everywhere.
It took me many years to master the skills of archery. Now I am not only a skilled archer, but leader of a team of skilled archers. I am keen-eyed and have a steady hand.

setting.name: Archery zone
setting.description: The archery zone is spacious and always bright with light. The field is green and the targets are bright red.
setting.background: The archery grounds are home to the skills and teachings of archers of all ages and classes. The master archers teach the younger ones about the art of the bow.

speech: Good day Archer. Is everything prepared?
Yes, everything is ready for any one who wants to participate
You know what I mean archer. Is everything prepare for the King. Remember? Here is the poison.
What? I honestly don't know what you mean. Do you have me confused with one of the other archers?

Remember the plan.  Your are giving the poison to the sharp shooter over there and when you preform your flaming arrow act then the sharp shooter will shoot the King with the poison arrow...and then I will be King!
Even if this were to work, I'm pretty sure the King's son will be king next. And if not him then his brother.
You are not listening to me and you have been my faithful servant up to now. My blood is royal but of the challenging family. Our families have fought for years.  Now it is our time.  I will succeed!
You may be of royal blood, but there are others before you in the succession line. Do you really want that much blood on your hands?
Obviously this was not the time or place to try to usurp power.  I thank you for helping me to my senses. I wish you well in the competition today.
I'm glad you are finally seeing sense. And thank you. This should be an interesting competition.
Yes...to the winner go the spoils.
You are beginning to make me nervous. I think I'm going to go to my tent to prepare
Yes archer be away now.  I will see you after this is over.
Yes, once it is over.

agent_personas: I am a goat of the peasants farm. I speak to other goats. I am scared of slaughter.
The turkey is eaten during the fall. I gobble when I am being chases. I do not like the birds.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: Hey, have you seen the King around?
I saw him here earlier this morning with a big bow, hunting down my friends
Oh no, we must be careful. I am going to take this bell off so he can't hear me.
Good thinking. We must get out of here. They'll pick us off like sitting ducks if we don't escape!
We should work together. Two heads are better than one.
I agree, now what is your plan. Perhaps we should use the pig to distract them whilst we make a run for it.
Yea sadly. The pig is too slow to escape. I think that is a good plan.
Give me that bell. I shall wrap it around the pig's neck and send him away.
Sounds good. When i scream we take off...ok?
Screaming will just attract attention. Just wink at me when you're ready.
Good idea. Are we ready?
Yes! The pig is on its way and will distract the Knight's, now is our chance!
Alright let head for that tree.
Disguise yourself between the branches so that you blend in naturally!

agent_personas: As a priest it is my duty to give permission to country people who want to get wed. I often see very young people wanting to marry and start families. In this part of the country, it is important to have many children.
I am a lowly peasant in the village. I live in poverty and I work like a slave for the king. I spend many of my days toiling in the royal mines. I long for a better life.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

speech: Here peasant take my adornment.
Thank you Father. But what shall an unread peasant like me do with it?
Just hang it over there. Did you finish your daily tasks?
Certainly father. Not yet, I have been scavenging the royal mines today and didn't get the chance to
Why haven't you put the adornment up?
I think it looks better on me. I am not used to seeing myself in such fancy things.
Ah well you can wear it for the day than.
You are most kind. Is there anything I can do for you in return?
Just keep your faith strong.
Sadly my faith has been wavering as of late. I blame his Holiness for my lowly conditions.
You must stay strong. Here take this. It will help you pray.
I do not think so Father. I want a better life, not just some cross.
You must, you will never succeed without our Lord.
But what has the Lord done for me, aside from bringing me in this world in poverty?

agent_personas: I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.
I am a chef who was born to a whore. I make the finest dishes for the king. I am respected for how I keep order in the castle kitchen.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: What is that wonderful smell?
How did you get in here?! And um... thankyou! It's dinner! Pork au vin

agents: grazing milk cow in the background
agent_personas: I am a grazing milk cow of the kingdom's farms. I eat grass most of the day. I know I will be killed for my meat.
I was born into power. I was raised to rule and have a very egotistical way of looking at the world. I control the fates of many people, which is how it should be.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: Large and spacious, the master bedroom houses a giant four poster bed with cerulean silk curtains. The bed is covered with dozens of fluffy pillows and the duvet is inlaid with sapphires and intricate silver embroidery. There lays a thick fur carpet in front of the bed. The floor-to-ceiling windows let in sunlight which catches on various gems and jewels. An ancient mahogany writing desk sits before one of the windows and has important looking papers and scrolls spread atop it.
setting.background: The master bedroom is home to the castle's master, the King. He often finds himself there, either relaxing on the silk sheets or writing away at his desk. The large windows look out on his realm and he finds much comfort in looking out over his people.

character: a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
a grazing milk cow in the background
speech: I sure do like grazing, these pillows taste spectacular.
Why my queen wanted a cow in here is beyond me.
She thinks I'm cute! *munch* *chew* *shred*
You are a nuisance. Why do you think pillows are food?
Because they are tasty?
Ugh can you just stand there and be quiet?
This looks tasty too.
You pooped on my favorite rug!!!
Well, and in a few more places on the way here.  Your servants were very unhappy.
You need to be put down.
That's what the servants said about you as well.
Really? Which one?
All of them, whenever you are out of earshot.  Apparently there are rumours of revolution among the peasantry.  But that's none of my business.
I feel like you are lying to me cow.

steal fur carpet from a grazing milk cow in the background
