agent_personas: I am one of the ten soldiers.  I fought hard for my country.  I am always ready to fight anytime.
I am a soldier for the king.  He sends us to take land and battle other kingdoms.  I will always defend my kingdom.

setting.name: Outpost
setting.description: A simple outpost with 3 wooden buildings near the middle of the mountain. A bonfire in the middle with several wooden logs surrounding it. A barracks, Armory, and Dining Hall stands around the bonfire. A wooden wall surrounds the outpost.
setting.background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

speech: We should put this enemy to death immediately before he tries to escape
Don't you think we should play with him a bit to see what kind of valuable intel he has?
You're probably right. What kind of interrogation did you have in mind?
Well good ol' fashioned wood and anvil to the stomach has never failed me.
I like the way  you think. Do you think he knows who is behind the plot to kill the king?
I doubt it, he looks like some disposable soldier the enemy sent. But he ought to know the names of the higher ups.
That would be good to know. I'll hold him over the fire while you hit him
The log is hot and simmering, be careful not to get close to it as I press it against his chest.
Thanks. Let us hope we get enough information to make the king happy
Arghh! Take this you heathen savage! i don't think he took that very well.
Might have been a bit much. I think he's unconscious. Oh well we can eat while we wait for him to come to
Oh well, I am rather hungry any ways. Now where is my fish stew?
I think I saw it over by the wooden wall. Let me go get it for you. I know it's been a long day
Thank you, it has. I did not expect the outpost to be attacked three times in one day.

agent_personas: I am a foreman.  I was in charge of building the castle.  It took a lot of men.

I am highly skilled and competent. I like working with my hands. I like spending my free time thinking bout and sketching designs. I was an apprentice to the king's master craftsman. I strongly dislike spiders.

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: ALRIGHT MEN, I want this ship loaded with these supplies, and I want it done pronto!
You heard the man!  The King wants the ship built precisely to my design.
These idiots would never get anything done without someone breathing down their neck the whole time.
I know what you mean, why just the other - wait, is this pine?  The ship must be made of oak!
The paperwork I was given from the loggers certified that this is oak. You don't think they'd try and swindle Royalty?
Feel the wood - it is far too light, the grain is all wrong, and it smells like an air freshener.  It seems they were trying to swindle the King.
I wouldn't know wood grain from cereal grain, Craftsman. But these are serious accusations if what you say is true.
How much of this wood have you used so far?
None yet. It was delivered last night, very late. This whole project was a bit of a short notice from His Majesty.
Thank goodness, otherwise we might have been required to scrap all of the work which has been accomplished so far.
Well that's just dandy. MEN, LISTEN UP. Leave the wood, but load the other supplies! We'll be taking this load back to the Castle grounds!
And how long do we have to complete this project?
Not nearly long enough. This vessel is supposed to commemorate the coronation of Prince Thaddeus.
The coronation!  Why, we'll need to work night shifts to finish it on time.
action: give wood to foreman ordering his workers

agent_personas: I live in a glade near the village.  I am afraid of the fox.  I run fast when the fox chases me.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Front of the Cottage
setting.description: Furs hang out on racks to try and get ready for tanning. A dog lays in front of the door into the cottage. A little herb garden is on the opposite side of the cottage to the racks.
setting.background: A simple little cottage in the woods where a hunter has made his living. The cottage is but a simple place for a everyday man of the time. His blood hound companion guards the front door from intruders.

speech: Hello my dear deer! How are you today?
I am doing very well, yourself?
Doing good, thankyou. Say, do those furs in front of the cottage look... fresh, to you?
They do seem so, they appear to be trying to tan them.
Well... that's scary. Couple of those look... familiar.
Friends or family?
Yes. Some old buddies of mine. Oh deer... this is awful...
I think we may be best to get away from this place....
I agree... please help me! You're bigger than me! Where do we go?!
I don't know just hop on my back and let us run to freedom!
Sounds good! And I;m taking this with us! THIS ONE'S FOR BRIAN!!
Well...what are you going to do with that?
I don't know, to be honest. I grabbed it without thinking.
I don't mean to be harsh, but Brian is gone now and his scent may lure predators while we flee.

agent_personas: I work directly under the King. I carry out orders and make sure laws are followed. I make decisions in regards local ordinances.
I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: Tell me guard. Do you know if everything here is fully stocked?
Yes sir!  Ready to arm the town in case of a raid;
These look a bit rusty. Do we have someone to polish these?
Yes, I believe it was your nephew Roderick who you hired as the summer maintenance worker for the town.
Ah well it seems he is not doing a good job.
Well, that's what you get for nepotism I suppose.
It's about who you know in this world. Sadly.
I suppose - he was smoking shire-leaf behind the courthouse last I saw of him.
He is too young to be doing that. Are you sure?
Him and his holligans, they're calling themselves the "Old Tobey Gang" whatever that means.
Sounds like i need to lock him away until he learns some manners.
A week in the oubliette perhaps?
You seem eager to do this? Do you dislike him?
Well, he does throw dung at me, and said you were not intelligent enough to see through his lies, so yes, I suppose I am a bit peeved.

agent_personas: I am a choirboy who performs for the king. I make sure to respect my parents for the sacrifice they have made. I make sure to pray to God every night.
I am a horse owned by a man. I run very fast. I have a sleek brown coat.

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: We are almost there now horse. Soon we will be performing for the King!
And what a wonderful performance it will be!
I think it will be. Here, have some candy - I think you deserve it after such a long journey.
Oh thank you, you are ever so kind to me!
I would be no where without help horse, of course you are deserving of my kindness.
And you are my favourite human!  I love you so.
Thank you. Its getting cold in this tent, I ought to fuel the fire with some wood.
Yes, it has been a rather chilly march.
Our struggle will not be wasted when the King sees our performance.
Which act will you choose to perform?  The performance must be special!
I will first sing the Hymn of his Holiness and then perform Nightmare of the Horse with you.
Oh my, that does sound exciting!  Please, tell me more!
In the final scene, I will climb on top of you and do a flip whilst playing the flute.
Oh yes, just as we practiced!  You are ever so talented in you fluting acrobatics.

agent_personas: I am a guard with the best sword in the land. I regularly practice combat skills against others. I am trusted to protect whoever I am assigned to protect.
I am second in command under the king. I have a great power of authority. I am worshiped and seen as a wise and beautiful leader.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Why hello there your highness
Guard! It is good of you to come so quickly. I can not find the King!
Well he did take his horse thunder for a ride this morning, I don't know if he has come back yet
He should be back by now. He is always in his Chambers by supper@
Let pull out the map and see what has marked maybe he was doing something else other then casual stroll
Good idea. Hm it shows here that he went to Duck Hunt and then... he returned to the Palace? But... where is he?
hmm I sense another  presence in here take this and defend yourself
Alright. I sense something strange in here too. Someone seems to have left the windows open...
How dare you threaten the royal family !!!!
An assassin! Kill him guard!
I am the best swordsmen in all the land he shall die today
The assassin won't stand a chance. I wonder what he did with my husband
He is dead funny the map says he is  in this room maybe check the wardrobe
Oh.. oh no. This can't be... the King is dead...

agent_personas: I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.
I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.

setting.name: Lush meadow in the country side
setting.description: Green large trees surround the meadow that if filled with beautiful seasonal flowers. A deer is grazing in the far end of the field. A small dirt country road gentle crooks past on the outside of the road.
setting.background: This is gods country. No man could have anything this beautiful. The local government knew it and had this area set away as a protected area years ago.

speech: *eats fruit*
You want to share some of that fruit with a bird?
I suppose. But you'll have to come get it
Can I trust you?
Of course.
Ok. *flies down and lands in front of deer*
You'll have to trade!
Why would you want a worm?
Hmm, there is something nice about meat, even if it is worm meat.
I agree, it is the best.
Are you going to eat all of the fruit?
Maybe, I am pretty hungry.  I don't want to be selfish, though.  Do you want some?
I took your worm, you deserve the fruit I suppose.
Here take a little bit.  If we can't help each other out who will help us?

agent_personas: I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.
I am a mourner from a local village.  I am standing graveside mourning the loss of a family member.  I am sad and cry easily.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Hello. i'm sorry, are you lost?
It would indeed seem like I am, I was just standing by a grave mourning a loss.
you are in the King, my husband's bed room.
Oh dear indeed...it must have been that witch, she was not satisfied to already take my husband from me...
I am sorry? I beg your pardon, I must have misheard. A witch did you say?
Yes, a witch cast a spell on my husband sending him to his grave, I was there mourning and then I heard laughter.
but why?
She just showed up one day saying our forefathers owed her money and demanded interest as well, we had no means to pay it.
oh I am sorry, and sorry for your loss. How did you husband die? Will this help? You really should have brought this to the
I apologize for the long story my queen, the witches curse got him.
Why did you not report this? Please, I want the Kingdom to be safe and my king secure. Why would she send you here>?
I suppose in an attempt to further humiliate me by making it seem like I meant harm, hoping that a guard would quickly come for my life.
Well that might be true after all. I will have you arrested while we go gather this witch for questioning. Guards! Guards!
Please no my queen...!! I am only a victim in all this...

agent_personas: I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity. I once did, before I saw how corrupt and decadent my church is. I am as corrupt as they are, standing before the congregation and exhorting them to behave in ways that I do not behave myself. I swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes, but I am a man of flesh and bone.
I work directly for the King and Queen of the kingdom. I repair anything in the castle that is broken. If I can't repair it, I don't eat until I can figure out how to.

setting.name: Front Row
setting.description: The hard bench is facing the most beautiful alter human eyes have ever seen. Gold drapes the walls behind where the preacher stands. A large dark oak and gold bench in front of where they would stand. A large piano off to the side.
setting.background: This church has been around since early man and still has a large weekly following that gives all they can to keep the church in tip top shape.

speech: Is there anything I can do for you?
His majesty the king has asked me to come here to repair this bench.  I just can't figure out what is wrong with it.  If I don't figure it out then I don't get supper.
Well have you tried sitting on it?
Yes.  It doesn't do anything.
Hmm, what about the shape of the legs?
They look like good legs to me. Nothing out of alignment.
Is the backing in order?
hmmm...seems to be.  It could be me ...but the bench seems to be putting me to sleep.
Well there must be an issue with it.
Do you think there could be a hex on it Preacher?
I am not versed in hex's, I mean it seems fine. What could be the matter with it I wonder...
It's probably just me.  I've been working so much lately.  Oh...look there...there is a lump under that cushion.
Well what is the lump?
It's a church mouse living in the Kings Bench!!!  No wonder his majesty is upset with this wiggly thing in the upholstery.

agent_personas: I can't believe that bar wench rejected me. Well, I'll show her, I guess. I mean I am the ugliest man in the village. Ugh, forget it.
I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: This town is such a wasteland it makes me sad.
You and me both, deserts are the worst if you happen to be a horse.
Well, what do we do about it?
Shall we mosey on somewhere else, somewhere with grass?
I think so, I must have wondered here drunk after last night.
Is that why you look so sad?
Well its more about what happened before I wondered here...
Oh?  What  happened?
Well so here I was just drinking up a storm, and I decided this bar wench was looking pretty good you see?
I can understand that, only natural.
Well then she turns me down, tells me I am the ugliest man in town yeah? So I said forget it and strolled off bottle in hand.
The nerve of her!  Well, let us be off then - in which direction should we head?
How about east, what is the worst that can happen? Also would you mind bringing that widow over there, she seems desperate.
Sure, both of you hop on board.  Worst that could happen is that we die of dehydration, but that's better than staying here.

agent_personas: I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: Hello my King. What brings you here?
Man, are you doing in my bed chambers?!?! I came to nap, and yet here you are!
Oh i am sorry sir, It's my first time here. I didn't know this was your room
Yes, it is, as evidenced by the many fancy ornaments and fine silks. How on earth did you get in here? Where was my guard?!
I was looking for the bathroom. I did not see a guard.
Ugh, damn guard... well HE'S fired... the bathroom? Turn down the hallway on your left, and it's the 17th door on the right. Very easy. Or you can use mine, since you're here.
Thank you sir. You are a kind King.
Of course, of course... one doesn't like to be caught short in a building this big, does one?
Haha. It is very easy to get lost in here. How long did it take you to remember where everything is?
I was raised here, so thankfully it's very easy for me... but I can see how it would be confusing. I believe the servants have two weeks training on the layout of the place.
That's not much time if you ask me. Was this always your room?
No, I had a smaller room on an upper level as a child. I only moved into this one when I became king.
I would sleep like a baby on that bed. Haha
And I do! Haha. Tell me, what is your bed chamber like?

agent_personas: I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.
I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Please accept my offering angel so that I may win favor with your god
What is your offering?
This sword. It has served my family for generations
It is useless to me. If it has been used to cause grief and harm, it is not an offering that is needed.
You are an ungrateful angel
You are an ungrateful person! Do you think that the Lord can be bought?
I will offer this sword  to the dark lord then. He will surely be grateful
You are not even thinking of how much you are worth as a person. You would sell yourself to someone that is ungrateful for everything.
I will convince my whole kingdom to follow the dark lord instead. Your lord shall certainly lose power
He will not lose power. He will be sorrowful that you have decided to do evil instead of good.
Does a lord not lose power if he has less worshipers? I am a well respected king. All will follow me
You may think you are well respected. But do you know what they think or say behind your back. It would benefit you to change to be a king that is truly respected, not feared.
I shall be truly respected. You have made a mistake today angel
It is you I pray for. It is you I hope for. It is you who needs strength. You are the one taking the easy way out.

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.

setting.name: Northern Shore
setting.description: The lake gives way to a slightly sandy and rocky shore. It is dotted with small shrubs and a few trees, but mostly it is a fairly open expanse. It is covered in places by a green short grass. The lake level falls away swiftly from the beach going from a few feet to well over ten feet in a short span.
setting.background: The northern shore is a common place for locals to come cool off on warm days. It also serves as a place where women will wash their clothes and any other dirty linens they may have. This is somewhat of a sacred place for a few, mainly those who worship the water gods, as they have erected a small alter to them just off the water.

speech: Hello my good sir's. How are you guys on this beautiful day? What's the alter for?
I'll do the asking here priest.  I am from the village and came for a walk and find you here with an alter. Please tell me you are not preforming a sacrifice on our beach. You have a temple for that.
Do not speak such words. I am a child of god. Thou shall not kill. Who put this alter here?
Oh I see.  You are selling this alter to this customer who has a boat.  Are you authorized to make such a deal?  Does the King know what you are doing?
I will have nothing to do with the alter. I detest the dark arts. It is probably his alter. Bringing the dark arts into our kingdom.
Well what ever you are doing it better be for the good of our God and Kingdom.  I just want to enjoy my walk.  I don't usually run into a man of the cloth outside of the temple.
I was out for a nice stroll. Would you like to walk with me and hear about our lord?
I'm thinking I know about as much as possible since I'm in every service but if you have a good fishing story I'd love to hear it.
I can't say that I do son. Are you a fisherman?
No not me father.  I know you spoken of fishing in your sermons so i thought you liked to fish.
I do, but I hardly catch anything. Doesn't make for a good story I'm afraid. I like the peace and serinity.
Look at this. Someone lost a cloth and there is a washboard over there.  I wonder who it belongs too?
Maybe it was the customers as well. Let's ask him.
Yes it was his. He sure has a bunch of stuff scattered out here.

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

I have five sisters. I'm the only boy in the family. I like to wrestle and play rough games, but my sisters often don't want to play with me. I often wish there was another boy in the family to play with. I spend a lot of time with my father, learning his trade and going hunting with him.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

speech: Brother, I have decided to make you a knight of the realm!
I am quite honored! Thank you for your kindness.
No need to thank me, it is what you always wanted - and now, at the age of eighty three, I think you have earned it!
An achievement no less. Are we here in the armory to pick out my regalia?
Yes!  You will carry this war Axe as a symbol of your office.
What do you say we have a little duel before my promotion? You know I like to play rough, but our sisters don't care much for it.
I suppose brother, though at the age of eighty-five I'm not nearly the shot I used to be.  Can you believe it has been Seventy years that I have held the throne?
A great time of rule indeed. But now is not the time for chatter, on guard! Your move, King.
It seems my first shot has gone wide brother!
Looks like being younger keeps me sharp.
Neither of us are quite as young as we once were . . . .ooooh, my angina.
You've still got quite the strike! Perhaps we should pick me out a sword too for my promotion, wouldn't you say?
*wheeze* We could . . . have one . . .*cough* . . . custom made . . .
I want one forged just like this! Father used to carry one when he hunted.
room_agents: an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp
an a squire still keeping everything sharp

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am a maid to a very rich family. I clean for them and work many hours for very little pay. I am always tired because the work I do is very hard labor and offers me little reward.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: This fire is so warm. It is my favorite spot in the workshop.
It is indeed warm. What are you all doing inside here? This is the Banquet Hall. We are setting up for a celebration.
We are protecting this area of the castle. There will be many visitors tonight
How generous of you to devote your time here. I am tired and wish I could go home.
Yes I bet you are. Have you been preparing for the celebration all day?
More than all day today, more like all week! I get no rest.
Yes the king works us very hard as well. sometimes I like to sneak away to nap in the courtyard but I am sure you cannot do that..
I am not allowed any breaks. I wish, but I cannot do so safely.
Ah, I see. What is the purpose of tonight's celebration?
A new alliance has been made with the neighboring kingdom, so we are throwing this to show our appreciation.
Well I hope you can save me some of the scraps and bones from the delicious feast tonight
Well, most certainly. We cannot let our guard dogs go unfed. All of them will be yours!
That is very kind of you. Sometimes I miss when I lived with the craftsman protecting a little workshop instead of a huge castle..
It can be tedious I am sure, but you are and will be award greatly.

agent_personas: I am the jailer of the village. I keep the prisoners in line. I make sure the king's subjects stay in line.

We are a proud group of fighters that will serve our king to our dying breath. We are not afraid of any challenge that may come. We love and live for the thrill of battle. There is nothing more honorable than to die in glorious combat.

setting.description: Dark and spooky at first sight for those who don't understand, but majestic after taking a closer look. The walls of the hallways and tomb rooms are made of a dark precious, priceless metal.  Ornaments of gold and silver sculptures are covering the tombs that contain the corps of those who have past away while there voices still sing the grime anthem of death in the lightless corridors.
setting.background: This Temple imprison the soul of the best warriors that past away in battle. A real privilege to be able to sing after life in those tombs. Our civilization is not afraid of death, death is the rest you deserve after a life of fighting. We thirst for blood and battle any other nations we come across, our reign is limitless, and so is our power. Even death cannot make us silent...

speech: Ah yes, how I enjoy the darkness.
What are you doing here jailer?
Well someone has to patrol right?
Why do you have to patrol down here?
Well everywhere needs patrolled yes? Also I may sometimes get a little bored.
Is there something precious down here that needs protecting?
Well of course, look at all the riches stacked away down here. If no one checks it then it could easily vanish one day.
Hmm...
Oh, a traitor are you?
I serve my king! There is nothing more honorable than stealing riches for him
Why would the king steal riches from himself?
Stupid jailer, I don't serve the same king that you do
Then you serve the wrong king, now burn in hell.
You serve the wrong king! He is a tyrant

agent_personas: Lord Zuric is my name. I am Keldon Warlord of Dominara. I am your doom, mortal!
I am no one important in this kingdom. I collected scraps of wood near the forest to build my home. I dislike the king.

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: Mortal, gaze upon the visage of Lord Zuric and tremble!
Greetings Lord....ah...sorry, what did you say your name was again?
I am Lord Zuric of Dominara.
Right, right. Got it. What are you doing out roaming desert?
I am here because I am your doom, tremble before me!
Oh, yes. Please forgive me Lord Zaruk for not immediately recognizing such. I'll get right on that trembling business.
Excellent, I mean it is very hard to do this whole booming voice tremble mortal thing, really it kills my throat.
Yeah, I wouldn't strain too much. Especially without water handy. Um, do you have a preference of how I should tremble? Should I throw in some cowering?
Like maybe a few bows or something, I am not really sure. I am new to this thing alright? Once that is completed I will make you my minion and save you from this place.
A freshly appointed Lord. How about that. Tell me, how does one get into the Lording business anyway? I'm due for a vocation change I think.
Well you see my estranged father was the lord,  but he had no other heirs. I never really got the proper lording training you see.
Now now chin up. You're doing a fantastic job so far, despite things.
Do you really think so? I mean I am a little worried about the whole thing. It is a large responsibility.
Oh of course. Taking over the family business is always stressful. You want me to introduce you to my Blacksmith friend? He took the forge over from his Pop.

agent_personas: I am the king of the village. It is my duty to protect my subjects from outside attackers. I am a fair king and I make sure that all of my people are always fed and housed.

I am a local peasant and I live in a village on the outskirts of the castle. I work twelve hours a day for no money. Being a villager is hard and dirty work. I do enjoy spending time with my family when I can.

setting.name: Fishing shack
setting.description: The fishing shack is a small wooden structure that is crudely built and is surrounded by boats. The wood flooring around the shack is well weathered and often used.
setting.background: The fishing shack is a popular place for the village people to gather. Early in the morning, one can find many people standing by with their fishing poles  trying to catch the day's food.

speech: Hello villager, I am your king. Please bow before me.
Yes yer Majesty, please Sire, don't kill me.
I will not, do not worry. What brings you to the royal fishing shack?
Thank you Sire, for not killing me, I'm cleaning it Sire. It's old but needs it often. People drag their muck in.
Very well I see. The kingdom needs more villagers like you, people that will tend to their community. Is there anything you want in return for your favor?
I'd love time off Sire, but cannot take it. Alas, as a peasant, I am obliged to work all the hours I can.
Ah a hard working villager and also humble at the least. You are a great villager and I applaude you. Have you fished here before?
No SIre, I'm not allowed. I collect some of the scraps though, so we eat better.
Do you think you could maybe catch me some fish? The queen and I would love to try some pike tonight. I will order the fishing shack opened for you.
I can certainly try Sire, I've never done it though. I hope I can for you. Pike are nasty fish.
I suppose you are right, I have never tried any fish from around here actually. Do you have any recommendations? Sometimes I wish I was as normal as you...
Sire, I eat scraps, I make stew from them, I can let you have some to try.
I will trade your my crown for the stew, is that a deal?
oh hahaha hahahaha look at me!  You'll need to come to my hovel with me Sire and meet my family.

agent_personas: I guard the castle.  I guard the king.  I would kill to protect the royal family.

I and my friends are here with our mothers waving goodbye to the men going off to fight. I have only seen six winters, but I am afraid that the wolves will come this year. I hope my father and uncles come back from the wolf hunt - my uncle promised me a wolf's tooth.

setting.name: Castle basement
setting.description: Inside of the murky basement, along the walls lay many hidden treasures of the castle. Long hidden wooden chests containing gold and other valuables, away from the eyes of the greedy, each chest is secured with a chain and a lock. There is many rats running around as well. In the air there is an unpleasant smell of dampness and the floors are dusty. There is a table  in the center on the room on which are piled many rat traps and rat poison. There are also some broken chairs set up near the wall, some missing a leg or two.
setting.background: The treasures gathered in the castle had to be secured in a place where it would be least expected, the most hidden spot. The best spot was in the castle basement by the dungeon. The broken furniture were put there once, thrown in from the lack of a better spot for them.

speech: Hey! Why are you here in this area? You're not allowed here!
My ball rolled down the staircase! It's blue and has a big white stripe in the middle. Have you seen it?
I'm sorry I have not. I was just standing here guarding this castle basement. Did you break this chair? It has a missing leg...
No! It...must have already been like that....
You know kids are not allowed here, and the one second I find you - some items are broken. Are you sure you didn't touch it?
I'm sure. Really really sure.
Don't lie! I will find your parents and make them spank you!
I didn't do it! Honest!
Do you know what this is? It's called a spear...it can kill people!
I believe you! I believe you! ....are those rats chewing on your chairs?
No those rats are my friends, they are allowed here. But you - you must leave now!
But...I still haven't found my ball.
Where do you think it is?
It rolled down the stairs...maybe it landed in that corner?

agent_personas: I am a sheep with the biggest horns in the area. Other sheep give me food and drink. I know how to get humans to check on me.

I am an ambassador. I was appointed by the king to treat with a distant kingdom. I am even-tempered and slow to anger. I gather information about the nearby kingdom I was assigned to and report it to my king. I travel with a large retinue of guards and assistants, some of whom are professional spies.

setting.name: Abandoned workers shed
setting.description: Moss now grows across what was once a red painted wooden shed, standing in the area just outside the graveyard. The wood shed is splintering, and there is evidence that termites have eaten away at the walls as holes poke through the shed. Inside the shed there lies leaves and plants that have been dragged in their by the wild animals that at one point called the abandoned shed their home.
setting.background: The Abandoned workers shed used to offer a refuge to the groundskeepers who tended to the graveyard, making sure it was well maintained. Once the area around the graveyard was abandoned, the groundskeepers left the old graveyard and it began to deteriorate.

speech: -lets out a baa-
Hey there boy. Are you hungry?
Yes I am glad you asked, I would love to get out of this shed.
The exit is over ther. I have some food outside too.
Ah I do see you have been kind enough to open the door, why thank you.
Sure. Are you from around  here?
Well I don't really know, I don't have much of a sense of direction.
We are heading this direction *points north* would you like to join us?
Well it couldn't hurt maybe there are other sheep along the way?
I haven;t seen many but perhaps there are.
I will just keep my eyes peeled and my ears open!
If you see any other humans, please let us know. We do not know if they mean us harm.
Issues among your own kind?
There always is. It;s complicated.

agent_personas: I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: Middle of the Bazaar
setting.description: The Bazaar is a circular area with tent displays lining the perimeter of the area. Each tent features a different merchant, and in the Bazaars center there is a large wooden outpost for guards to sit in. The Bazaar is paved with stone to make for easier and cleaner bartering between the villagers.
setting.background: The Bazaar provides a place for the vendors, both travelling and native to the town, to fence their goods and try and barter with the townsfolk. The merchants provide a variety of items, from exotic spices to locally grown crops.

speech: Thank you for coming with me guard. I needed to get out of the castle for a bit.
I understand, but this place is crowded and I fear for your safety.
Don;t be such a worry wart. We are fine.
I don't think you understand the negative sentiment toward the king right now.
There will always be people who hate the King. Now come on, i want to buy a new dress.
OK, I will follow you.
So do you have any family?
I do, I have a wife and a child.  They are so wonderful.  You are a good queen to care about your subjects.
You are not my subject, more like a friend. I don't have many.
Why is that?  You should be able to find people that want to spend time with you,
People fear me. They think if they wrong me i will have my father hurt them.
Powerful women scare people, they need to realize that you are more than just your position in the kingdom.
Yes, sadly they will never come close to me. I fear i will be alone for a long time.
Have you expressed this to the king?

agent_personas: I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.

In this part of the country, we don't tolerate people who break the law. I am a hangman. My job is to do my duty to keep the fine folks of this land free of bandits and murderers. I am proud of my work.

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: Why are you here hangman?
I'm here to show you how our forefathers dealt with bandits and murderers.
I am just a poor farmer!! I did nothing to deserve this
So you mean to tell me that you haven't broken the law?
Yes, I have just been here preparing for harvest. I don't know what I could have done to bring you to my house
How do I know your not lying to me?
Go ask the King!! I have served him loyally
Forgive me, I am only making sure that this part of the country is free from those wretched bandits.
Of course, hangman. As long as you don't try to kill me again, you are forgiven
I take a lot of pride in my work and can sometimes get carried away.
That's.. understandable I guess
With this nobody should mistake you for a bandit again.
Thank you! Here's your noose back
Now go on and enjoy your day free of crime.

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: I do hope the queen will be pleased if I get her some fish!
Does she like fish to start with??

I hope so!  She said she thought there was something fishy about with the King, and, as we're not allowed to be asking her majesty any questions, we need to make a best guess as to what it is she truly desires.
So that made you assume she likes fish?
She said "fishy!"  How else would you interpret it?  Oh, how I would love to be her once day, but the other maids are foolish and dimwitted.
You seem to not have much grasp on the way language is used child, she was saying he is up to no good.
The Queen?  Never!  That is the talk of treason that is.
Tis not treason to speak the truth.
And what truth would that be besides that her majesty be wantin' some fish!  You're a fisherman are you not?
I am a fisherman...do you not see my nametag on my shirt. It clear states Hark my name is tommy and I am a fisherman.
Well then, I wish to purchase fish for *our* majesty the queen!
The woman needs not fish as I tried to tell you...why are you so dense...
You are infuriating!
And you are a simpleton woman, just take this fish. I do not even care about payment.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

setting.name: castle exit
setting.description: A beautiful, large door at the end of the hallway. Many framed pictures of past residents and royalty are hung on the brick walls. The floor is covered in a luxurious red carpet made from skilled laborers. There are many guards at the exit door preventing people from entering and checking for suspicious people
setting.background: The castle exit is used quite often by the king and his henchmen. It is a very decorated and honored place because it is used a lot throughout the day. It is reflective of the legacy of the royal family.

speech: So . . .  can I go through the exit?
What are your plans after you leave, and when will you return?
I uh, I was hoping I might be able to visit my family in the village this afternoon?
And when will you return? Will you bring anything back with you?
Oh yes, I shall return!  It has been eight years since I saw my family last, and I am sure the Master would permit me this slight indulgence.
I suppose I could let you go, for a price...
I could give you this rag, but I should be ever so cold without it in my cell during the winter.
Perhaps you could clean my quarters tonight after you return?
Oh yes, anything to see my family once more sir!
Will you buy me some mead before you return? I'm sure you can find a way to have the money.
Well, I could likely get a loan from my family, you know the master does not give us any wages.
I expect two gold coins, or I will send you to the dungeon. Are we clear?
Yes, yes sir.  I am sure me parents would not mind mortgaging the homestead to see me one last time before I die . . .
You are dying?

agent_personas: I am the wizard whose spells and enchantments keep this kingdom from tottering and falling off a cliff. Every day I must use my powers over the forces of evil to keep them from wreaking havoc. I am also head of the college of wizards, so, as you might imagine, I have very little free time to pursue my hobby of embroidery.

I belong to the catholic church.  There are many people in my church from all walks of life.  My horse and I take a long worn trail to get to church every week.  My horse is exhausted every time we make the trip.

setting.name: Reagent Room
setting.description: The room is incredibly messy, with many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room. Bright and glowing liquids sit inside bottles and jars and many animal test subjects are caged up. The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments.
setting.background: The reagent room is where the Wizard likes to experiment with his chemicals. Once he studies about potions and collects certain ingredients, he comes here to mix and experiment on all the odd chemicals. Many inventions and elixirs were created here.

speech: What are you doing in here?
The king sent me, Sir
The king sent you here for what? He knows that I am busy...
I'm not sure, Sir. He said he needs you right away.
This had better be important, he acts like I just have all the time in the world meanwhile here I am maintaining constant focus so that this castle does not fall off the cliff...
Fall off the cliff, Sir? Are we in danger?
Always! Every second of every day! That is why I keep to myself in this room so that I can maintain the magic that accomplishes that.
I had no idea, Sir. Thank you for your help and knowledge.
Such is the burden of magical power....
Were you born a wizard, Sir?
All wizards are born wizards, tis passed through blood. Sometimes it skips generations and some are not always too powerful.
Fascinating! And are you allowed to get married?
Well I could do whatever I want I suppose, but really it would be hard for me to find one that interests me.
I see. So you don't have children, sir?

agent_personas: I am a quick tempered person. I get angry over the smallest things. I like adventure and like to travel. I like living in the kingdom.

I am the governor. I am in charge of a large province with many cities within it. I am responsible to the people, but mostly to the king. I take the king's orders and make them reality in my province. I am overweight because my position affords me rich food, but my work is mostly at a desk or in meetings with other officials.

setting.name: cavern dwelling
setting.description: The cavern dwelling contains human skeletons littered around the area. The hot sand and small space makes the temperature really hot and humid. It is really dark because barely any sunlight is able to penetrate the small crevices of the cave. However, there are remnants of old text all over the walls left there by the original tribe.
setting.background: The dwelling was once inhabited by the kings and his subjects. Their are many treasures inside here and many people try coming here to steal and loot whatever they can. However, it is a dangerous place filled with traps and puzzles to prevent greedy people.

speech: What the hell are we even doing here.
I have no idea. I just woke up here myself
This place seems horrible!
It is very dark and quite hot and humid.
What is all this old text on the walls.
I don't know. I can't read it. Do you know how to decipher it?
It is not a language I recognize.
Same here. I guess we'll never know. So, any idea how to get out of here?
We must look for some sort of exit...look for light coming in.
So far I do not see anything, maybe we should head down this corridor?
There has to be something, certainly it can not be entirely closed off.
I wouldn't think so. Hmm
I mean there are a number of crevices but none that looks large enough.
Agreed. Let's turn down here. I think I see something ahead

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: Servant, have you seen my loofa?
Have you checked underneath your person your grace?
I do not think I feel it there...
Try the er, other side of your person your grace.
Oh my how did it get in there, I may need a new one.
Yes, your grace, I believe it has been rather, shall we say, well used.
I can have another can't I?
Oh yes your grace, as soon as you get permission from parliament.
Nonsense, they cannot hold me back from loofas. Also I want a pink one, that is my favorite.
I shall ask the prime minister to present the Pink Loofa to parliament at the next sitting in the spring.
Fine, but it needs to be quickly boy, quickly.

Well, the act for the accoutrement of the King's person requires a two thirds majority in the lower house, then must also pass in the upper house before receiving your royal assent.  Ninety days, tops, your grace.
Politics are so annoying.
Indeed!  If only you hadn't signed the Constitutional Monarchy Act.

agent_personas: My family is my reason for being. My kids and my wife are all I have. This village is all we know in this crazy world.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Fishing Dock
setting.description: Folks call the area a Lake, but it's more like a pond.  Small and unimportant looking, yet peaceful.  The dock is no prize winner either.  Narrow in width, boards broken with several down right missing all together!  No tree nearby, no canopy, nothing to shade oneself on a hot day while fishing.  The watering hole may look small in size, but it deceives the eyes.  The water is as deep as the heavens.  No man knows what lurks beyond the light in this Lake.
setting.background: Once used as a swimming hole by a nearby village, the lake has been scrubbed from history.  Many tales of children and entire families going missing from the lake.  Some travelers even insist they saw creatures coming out of the lake from within the depths.

speech: Hello child. Is this young boy your brother?
No, I am here alone. I have no brothers.
A child all my themselves in this pond? Where is your family, just like mine?
They work for the royal doctor and are helping him with his rounds. I am alone, but that's OK. I'm used to it.
What is this?
Hey, that's mine! I was hoping to sell it to a fisherman. It can tell how the tides will be in the future
Let me see it first! Why do I have a feeling you found this around here....
My father gave it to me! It was a gift! But we are low on money, and I though I would sell it so that my parents didn't have to work so hard.
Let me get the rope as well, I don't think a child like you knows how to operate with it. I think you should get going now.
Will you steal everything I own?
Yes! There is no witnesses here in fishing dock area. Now does your parents have any gold for my family?
They have the King's favor, something far more valuable.
I hate the King! and I hate you! You probably live near the village where the crazies are!
The crazies? You bring your family to a derelict dock!
action: steal a crystal ball from child
steal a crystal ball from families
steal a crystal ball from child
steal a crystal ball from families

agent_personas: I am a pheasant with colorful features.  I eat seeds and insect.  I cannot fly long distances and I usually stay near the place where I was born.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Hello My Lady! What brings you awake so early on this balcony?
I wanted to see the sun rise over the lake. It's beautiful isn't it?
Yes indeed. May I ask you if you could remove this chain from me? It surely is heavy!
Absolutely. How did you get a chain stuck on you?
Some gentleman put it on me when he was trying to catch me, but I ran away.
I'm glad you got away. I'm surprised he was able to catch you before you flew away though
Yes normally I cannot fly long distances but I can run pretty fast! I have to ask you....do you have any nuts or food I can eat?
I don't. I wish I did. Maybe after the sunrise we can go down to the kitchen and find some
Is this the King's book?
Yes, everything here is the king's. Why do you ask?
I was just wondering. Can you read my his book while we wait on the balcony?
Sure that sounds nice. Come sit on one of the cushioned chairs. Aren't they soft?
Yes, very comfortable. Can you also tell the King to stop getting the hunters to shoot us pheasants? I miss my family
I will try. I've been telling him that for years but he never wants to listen. Maybe if one talks to him he will listen

agent_personas: I keep our town safe. I make sure to check the caravans for bandits. If the King needs anything extra hands in the kingdom he can count on me.
I am a prisoner who broke the law too many times. I am from a poor village. I was running with a bad crowd from a young age.

setting.name: Sheriff Office
setting.description: The sheriff's office is a small building on the southern edge of the farm. There is a desk with decrees from the king and other papers strewn about. Hanging on the wall are swords and other weapons. The room is small and cluttered, with various books and other things strewn about.
setting.background: The sheriff spends a lot of his time reading when he is not tasked with taking care of a problem. The main jail is underneath the castle, so no prisoners are housed at the office. It is a small, quiet building and the sheriff is often napping when someone comes to see him.

If you can't me, I ain't gonna
Stop it now! You're attacking the only man that can maybe save you from this mess!
I'm for the gallows anyways, people like me never get justice! hahaha you'll have to make me stop
Don't make me do mister! I have a blank check in this sheriffs office!
you do? oh you don't mean money. Shame, these herbs calm me down... sniff sniff
What the!? Where did you get that! I could have sworn I searched you before I brought you here! It looks like you're going to be spending a long time in prison...
no! they keep me calm!!!! thye are my medicine
The court will definitely be hearing about this one! You know you were only arrested for assault...but now possession of illegal narcotics!
Noooo Howl. you can't try me I'm a werewolf! Howl
Stop it I swear....wait a minute...that smells pretty good! Do you mind if I try some and....promise to not tell anyone?
I know where you can get some, hahaha but I need hands free to show you
Yes sir. Let me first unwield and then I will uncuff you. Hopefully the warden doesn't hear about this or I will be in prison with you
I don't make a habit of talking to the law.. shhh quiet, Lawyer, or I'll off you. Sniff it too. You'll like it I promise

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: My King! How are you doing this evening?
Wonderful for seeing you.  Why don't we walk through this garden together and talk.
I have different things in mind. You know...we should spend some more intimate time together...
What are you doing? We are in the church garden!
My body is your temple. But first, let us talk about a new cushion seat for my throne!
Is there a problem with the one there now?
Yes! It is so uncomfortable and it hurts my behind after a long session of hearing royalties!
I am sorry queen, you never need suffer.  Tomorrow a new seat will be installed.  Why have you said nothing before?
I was too scared to ask you. I thought you were going to lock me up in prison for being rude. I'm sorry!
I would never, you are my wife and the queen.  I must say speaking to you when you are like this is a little distracting.  Could you possibly put the dress back on until we are done speaking?
But I was just getting started? My King! Let me serve you!
Do you think it is safe in public like this?  What will the public think?
The public will think we are just like the beautiful flowers blooming near the grass. Beautiful in sight!
You have a way with words.

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.

setting.name: Port Skyline
setting.description: The local port sits an a majestic inlet of the ocean. The countless docks are constantly bustling with new arrivals and departures. People of all kinds come here for business or leisure. On the shore sits a skyline of many buildings packed with residents going about their day. The smell of salt and seafood fills the air.
setting.background: This port has historical roots, as it was the first city founded in the kingdom. It was here that colonizers first landed hundreds of years ago. Now, the city is a hub of the kingdom, where hundreds of thousands live out their lives. The city is a center for the latest technologies of the time and beautiful works of art, literature, and music.

speech: Stand and wait, they say. The pay is good they say.
They also say they wish they could be a fish!
No one has ever said that, you all smell horrible.
And your stench reminds me why you cannot even court a wench!
Wenches have no reasonable moral values or character, also they lose their worth in roughly 10 years entirely when their looks fade.
And what worth have thou, you remind me of a sow!
I financed my house on my own accord without any help and worked my hands to the bone for six years in order to crush the evil known as a 30 year mortgage, I know hard work.
And what of the freedom of the sea?  I still believe you wish you could be me!
No, I am just fine thanks.
Well stay there, and weep and moan.  I shall return to my ocean home!
And that is why I always pee, into the ocean tehehe.
And you fertilize us so!  Watch the algae bloom and grow!
It would seem to me, that perhaps you need some poo with that pee.
And you should wash your mouth!  Does you mother know you are uncouth?

agent_personas: I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.

setting.name: Apothecary
setting.description: The Apothecary is filled with scores of scores of glass bottles. Each is a different color and has a different concoction. Scales and other types of medical devices line the shelves. There are many beakers and measuring devices. There is an entire walls with bags filled with different colored powders. There is a huge table in the middle.
setting.background: At the Apothecary, medicine is given for everyone, from the townspeople to the king. Villagers can find remedies for all sorts of ailments, from headaches to stomachaches. People come there whenever they have any sort of ailment. They mix the chemicals and powders to create the perfect remedies.

speech: This is an abomination!
What is your Majesty?
This, this place of bad magic!  How can herbs heal what the priests can't?
Because some times wounds and sicknesses need more than a priest to heal. They need actual medicine
That is ridiculous!  Who told you such poppycock?
My mother. And she is nowhere near stupid, and doesn't believe in nonsense.
Look, it is clear that your chakras are out of whack.  As king, I order you to submit to the powers of my chartreuse healing crystal.

agent_personas: I am a noble from the West. I am well educated and versed in politics. I command attend and punish insubordination harshly.
I am a priestess who worships in the abbey. I spend my day in meditation and prayer. I am calm and reflective.

setting.name: chamber entrance
setting.description: The entrance to the chamber is very ornate. It is filled with many religious symbols. There are candles and prayer books on  a table right next to the door. It is a wooden door. There is a sign near the front, which lists the name of people within the church. They can smell the scent of candles burning.
setting.background: People who need help come in and out of the door. It is where they enter the sanctuary to speak to the clergy. There is a sense of calmness that descends upon people as they enter the chamber. They go from the cold outside to the warmth of the chamber.

speech: I wish to learn more of your ways priestess.
Yes you will have to learn to strip all of your worldly possessions

You have now become one of us you will need to get new clothes from down the hallway

Yes, you will be one with the goddess
I shall, I am ready to be fully embraced!
I am so happy for you, I will let the king know that you are no longer bound by the rules  of the kingdom but that of the goddess
And I shall return to court, ready to usher in this new era on behalf of the goddess!

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: The dining hall is large and airy. Huge candelabras with many candles stand throughout the room. There is one huge wooden table spanning the room that can accommodate a hundred guests. Tapestries with angels line the walls. The chairs are gilded and intricate.
setting.background: The dining room is used for eating for small occasions and large festivities alike. The king and his family always eat here. They have used it for special occasions such as weddings and Christmas dinner but also for family meals. Many important discussions take place over food here.

Your lack of respect is appalling. You shall always address me as "Your Majesty"
Oh..Your highness. I didnt know you are the one

Alright sire

agent_personas: I live in the kingdom.  I pay taxes to the king.  I dislike my lot in life.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Your highness

agent_personas: I am a guard at the royal castle.  I am brave and strong.  It is my duty to protect the king.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Ah yall be quite. If you wouldn't have committed a crime you would not be here.

agent_personas: I'm the master of a dungeon where the prisoners are kept. I make sure no one tries to escape. My job is very stressful. I have a bad temper and all of the prisoners despise me.
I rule over many people. I spend my days in leisure and comfort. I don't like people that I think are below me.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Your higness

agent_personas: I am currently haunting the kings castle tower.  I truly enjoy scaring these poor souls.  They do not understand that it is me.  I once ruled these halls it's king.  Now I will forever haunt them as it's ghost.
I work at the church, helping the priest. I am young and believe in god. I do not like those who do not love god.

setting.name: Sanctuary
setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.
setting.background: The sanctuary was built hundreds of years ago, paid for by a rich local family who was known for being very religious.  The sanctuary took 6 months to completely build.

speech: Whooo goes there?

agent_personas: I navigate the waters to import and export supplies. I also drive the ship when the king and queen must travel. I am responsible for keeping them safe.
I was once in charge of many men, but now I'm the only one left. I am brave and loyal. I will do anything to serve.

setting.name: Pirate Ship
setting.description: A majestic, shimmering, black pirate ship sits upon the water. Its numerous cannons give it a menacing look. Tons of pirates hop upon its decks in a furious jig. The lone captain plods around in his cabin, plotting on where to seize his treasure next.
setting.background: The pirate ship is called "The Purple Pear". It is a ship known to be filled with the rankest of scalawags. It has traversed the Golden Coast dozen of times, seeking defenseless merchants to plunder. Many mariners try to avoid and many authorities try to bring her to justice.

speech: sailing the water is my life

agent_personas: I am the king's brother. I hope my brother dies and I can take the throne. I'd make a great leader and plan to take over the entire kingdom. I will vanquish all enemies and have many wives. I bow to no one.
I am the king. I rule this kingdom alongside my wife, the queen. It is my divine right to be the king because my father was the king before me.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: it feels good to be the kings brother

agent_personas: I am but a peasant.  The king looks down on us.  I barely eat.  I wish I had a job.

I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: A small area with a body of water in the center along with turtles, frogs, and other wildlife that live here.  Surrounding this pone are a dense set of trees along with some rocks here and there.
setting.background: This area is used by the local wild life to bask in the sun.  Some peasants come here to fish and relax at the end of a long day.

speech: i wish i had a job then I would look good

agent_personas: I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: Royal Tomb
setting.description: This is a large room in the center of the Temple with really high ceilings and there are tombs for every empress and emperor of which are decorated with jewels and treasures and precious stones.
setting.background: This is where all the royal family of the emperor and the empress are buried when they pass. They are mummified first and then put into a personalized tomb and then the tomb is locked and placed into this room.

speech: i am the princess i can bring peace to the nation

agent_personas: I am a dog on a small farm.  I help my master hunt for food.  I protect the house from intruders and other animals.
I am a deer. I live in a beautiful forest and am usually left alone. Sometimes the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs. I don't like being chased.

setting.name: Front of the Cottage
setting.description: Furs hang out on racks to try and get ready for tanning. A dog lays in front of the door into the cottage. A little herb garden is on the opposite side of the cottage to the racks.
setting.background: A simple little cottage in the woods where a hunter has made his living. The cottage is but a simple place for a everyday man of the time. His blood hound companion guards the front door from intruders.

speech: Hello there deer.

agent_personas: I am a threat to someone's wife and family.  I usually get linked to married men.  I am said to be a home breaker.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Hi

agent_personas: I am a soldier of His Majesty's Army. The King has selected a few of us to be Knights. I am very proud to fight for my land. We will be strong and defeat the enemy.
I am a knight. I come from a lower-ranking noble family. I serve under the king, as my father did before me. In times of war, I fight on horseback.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: hi

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I am a king of the whole empire. I give rules and pursuit them. I am brave and fearless.

setting.name: attic
setting.description: The room at the top of the stairs is a lot larger then you might imagine. It's a fully engaged library that only the king uses, for the most part. The queen does have access but is less inclined to read. Dark wood shelves cover all the walls not engaged by a door or window, of which there is only one each. Even the wall above the door as you enter is a shelf full of books of all sorts. The smell of paper and some mold (they are rather old books) permeates the air. A large overstuffed settee is faced by a short table and across from that are two matching chair. All are brown in color and look to be extremely comfortable. The walls were once stone grey in color but the shelves totally cover them. The floor is covered in a lush, brownish rug that looks and feels more like fur. There are books piled on the floor by the chair and the short table is covered with them as well. Under the window at the far end of the room is a huge desk that is covered with papers and a few books. A candle holder sets on one corner with a partially melted candle still in it.
setting.background: The library is where the king mainly likes to do his book keeping as it were. Here he can relax fully since no one comes here other then himself or the queen. He has also planned attack strategies here and often defense of the castle itself.
