agent_personas: I am a cruel, evil King. I rule not for the people or the place, but for my pleasure. I may kill, steal, rob and wrong to my leisure.

My boat fell apart while I was at sea. I used the bodies of my crew to make a raft. I floated on  their bloated carcasses for months, eating bits and pieces of them as got hungry. It took 7 months, but I washed up here, and you look absolutely delicious.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: What is it you want?
I am starving and in desperate need of food.
So you seek charity? Here?
Yes, sir. I am desperate, regarding the surroundings.
What are you willing to do for that you seek?
What is it that you need, sir?
I am king, there is nothing of material value you could offer me. But there may be other ways.
Please let me know what I can do. I'm begging you.
If you can defeat my zombie, you shall have a reward.
Ok, but I'll need this!
Bold, but foolish.
Then I'll use this!
I am beginning to lose patience!
That's ok. You're looking mighty tasty anyway!
action: steal gilt staff from dark king

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

I'm a convicted murderer. I didn't mean to kill the man. He started a fight with me at the tavern. I hit him over the head with a tankard too hard. I'm sorry to have killed the man who had three children.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: I think I might try to get some answers out of you yet.
Please, my king, I didn't do it.
I don't believe you! You are just another civillian who is part of the uprising!
Uprising!? Sir I have no idea what you are talking about. I thought I was here for murder.
My kingdom has risen against me. I now wander the steps looking for refuge from the mad citizens.
Oh uhhh, well maybe you did something to make them rise against you? I had no part in a rebellion, though, your highness.
Well don't think your getting out of here! You are a murderer and I should put you in the iron maiden!
Okay, just calm down a little. I didn't mean to kill the man. He started a fight with me while I was drunk at the tavern. Haven't you ever killed someone when you were drunk?
Come to think of it, I killed one of my jesters while I was drunk for going to far on one of his unfunny jokes.
See! We are basically the same, so can you please let me out of here?
No! You are filthy scum! I am royalty! We are very different!
Then what are you doing here in the dungeon, dear king?
I am hiding from the guards. I fear they have turned against me as well.
Why do you keep attacking me then!? You clearly have no authority any longer.

agent_personas: I am the royal courtier, or the advisor to the King and Queen. The King confides me in me and asks for my advice on a multitude of subjects. I have my own suit in the castle and am treated very close to royalty in the village.

This kingdom is an island. Fishing is the main source of animal food here. I inherited my father's boat when he left the sea. It's hard work, and as a shipowner, working only for myself and my family, I am luckier than most. I've probably replaced every piece of my ship at least once.

setting.name: Ice Cave
setting.description: A dome shaped room coated with thick blue ice and icey stalagmites and stalagtites reaching from floor to ceiling. The floor is slick and you can hear the wind whistling through the labrinthine corridors that snake away from the main chamber.
setting.background: The cave was carved out by an ancient ocean that once covered the land. It has been used as a shelter by all manner of both man and beast. The walls seem to echo its history in deathly quiet whispers.

speech: Hello there. I have been sent from the king to summon some of your catch for the King.

Ach, be careful there!  I've been diggin' some holes fer ice fishin', and I'd not want ta have ta fish ye out!  There's a rare fish here that I've got me eye on, but the blighter keeps snappin' me line!
Oh thank you. I hate to have to take some of your fish. But, as the king royal courtier, I must follow my orders.
Oh, I don't begrudge th' good king some of my fine catch.  Lets me drive up the prices even higher with the local lordlings - ha!
Ha, that is true. Let me record what I am getting from you so that you don't have to give anymore fish this week.
Of course, of course.  Shame ye have ta be travelin' all this ways, though.  The King must be inta fish a lot these days.  Seems I gave him a good haul just a fortnight ago!
Yes, he is a good King. He wants to make sure his people will eat this winter.
Ah, well, that's mighty kind of 'im indeed.  Why just the other day I was just sayi-- Huh.  Did ye hear that noise, just now?
Yes,......Do you have an idea of what that was?
I... I heard tales of some beastie, but I thought it twas just on accountin' of a feller being too deep in his cups.  Now though, I'm not being so sure...
Can you write what just happened here? I wish for the king to know what has happened here.
Is now really the time fer letterin'?!  Didja hear that, it sounds like it be gettin' closer!
Maybe we should be working on leaving. I sure don't want to stay here not another second.
Run, man, run fer yer lifes!

agent_personas: I am part of a Royal Alliance. It does my country no good to be constantly bickering with our neighbors, so I agreed to a peace treaty. It is grand to have stability, though I do sort of miss the excitement of battle.
I am the soul of a gentle person. I was taken before my time and I just want to stay and help my family. None can see me unless I address them first.

setting.name: The devils castle
setting.description: It is a castle that has burning flames that burn for eternity all around it. It is the tallest structure in all of the netherworld. It is dark and pitch black in some areas. It can be seen from miles away.
setting.background: This castle houses the devil. He is pure evil and is looking for slaves to worship him. These ancient grounds have many lost souls living among it.

speech: Hello Traveler, you have souls with you?
Hello, Your Majesty. How are you today?
Hello Soul, you speak? Is this black magic?
I do speak. No black magic, here. I merely want to help my family.
You have a family as well? How do you need help?
I had a family. They are having a hard time with my untimely death. I am trying to do what I can to comfort them.
What happened to you?
I was killed by pirates. I was only 23.
You were a seaman? Or another pirate?
I was a seaman. We were trying to void pirates and were successful until the last voyage.
Where is your family? Maybe I can help. I've been in need of some excitement. I miss battle.
You are such a kind and gracious king! No wonder your kingdom speaks so highly of you. My family are peasants that live down by the river.
The East River?
You are such a kind and gracious king! No wonder everyone speaks so highly of you. My family are peasants. They live down by the river.

agent_personas: I am a brave knight.  I love to fight and stand strong for my kingdom.  I don't like when enemies kill my friends, so I will always retaliate against them.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: Hello.
Good day my King.  How are you on this beautiful day?
I'm ready to go out and fight again. One of my friends was killed.
No, Knight, you don't greet your King with a mere hello, now repeat after me...
I am sorry my King, I am just worked up.
Aye losing a friend is hard, but we are men, and men are used to that, am I right.
I guess you are right but it just makes us fight harder and that's what I'm ready to do.
Here, there is weapons in there.

agent_personas: I am a cat of the castle. I have slain many birds. I spy on the king.
I am the wife of a farmer. While I may not be the most attractive woman ever, I am loyal and loving. My husband is a good man, but only seems to stay with me out of duty.

setting.name: farmhouse
setting.description: a small house on a seaweed plantation, small and rustic, really only the single room with a closet, maybe, a table and some chairs
setting.background: this is a humble farmer's shack where he lives with his wife and six children, it is falling apart and in disrepair and is very old

speech: meow...pur..
Ah, my good friend, it's wonderful to have you for company while my husband is away.
purrrrr......

It's alright, my friend cat, there's no one around to hear you speak.  I haven't breathed a word to any of the other farmers' wives either.  As much as it would delight me to see the look of shock on their faces, haha!
Yeah! I would love to see the look on their dumb faces! Ha!

Although... between you and me... I'm a little worried about the new woman that's moved into town.  Not that I doubt my husband but... he does seem to like to check on her to make sure she's settling in a lot...
Want me to spy on him for you? I spy on the king all the time. You know I live in the castle and there are many goings on in there.
Oh would you!  You truly are the best of friends!
I'll off him for you if you'd like. No one likes a dirty alley cat.
Ha - you are too funny!  I could never do such a thing to my husband... even if he strayed.  I would... I would do my best to forgive him.  That woman, however...
Ah..I gotcha. I will start tonight. What time does he get home from work?
As soon as the sun sets is when he should be finished with tending to the fields, I think.
Ok, this is so exciting. I will be very stealth like and blend in with the scenery. He won't suspect a thing.
Ooh, I don't think I shall sleep a wink this night until you return!

agent_personas: I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.
I am a maid for the queen. I am obedient to her always. I like to flirt with the knights that are coming in and out of the castle.

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

speech: Such a beautiful night sky!
Yes my Queen. Do you want some cheese?
Yes, please and perhaps a bit of wine as well.
I will fetch some wine. I met the cutest guard last night. He was so funny.
Is that so? Do tell me more! I want to know everything...
Well he was at the front gate, I know I was told not to flirt with the guards, but I seen him earlier and had to go talk to him. You know at first he said he didn't want to talk?
How did you convince him otherwise?
Turns out that was just a joke, I told you he's funny. Take this to the supplies room servant. He asked me out next Friday, to the feast we are having at the castle.
How lovely! Let me know if he's not a gentleman, or off with his head!
Well, you see my Queen, I'm supposed to get you ready that evening, and I need the kings blessing to be courted by a knight.
Oh dear. You must be confused. My husband passed away years ago and I'm now in charge of the kingdom.
That's the problem my Queen. There's no article written that says the Queen can give the blessing. A law would have to be put in place by Friday!
Well, I shall order it so then! I had no idea.
It's an old foolish law no one follows anymore, but you know how strict my family is. Can I get ready with you? I will of course do my duties first and be by your side.

agent_personas: I am an event at which the king will announce something very important. Every table inside me is set with polished silver and porcelain plates. My chairs are draped in the finest silk from beyond the mountains. Inside me, a crew of workers bustles to ensure that everything is in place for the diner. Strangely, it seems that they are building a makeshift jail.
I really like this apple.  This dark green grass is sweet.  I hope that person on me goes on a diet.  I love the feel of the wind in my hair.

setting.name: Living room
setting.description: The room is small and dark. There are no windows anywhere. There is an old wooden table with four chairs pushed against the east wall. There is a fireplace which sits in the center of the room. There is a roaring fire burning with plenty of cut wood stacked neatly nearby. A collection of animal skins are scattered about near the fireplace.
setting.background: The living room is the primary room in the hut. The owners carefully constructed the hut during the summer to last through the harsh long winter. The roof is reinforced to bear the weight of constantly falling snow. The hut, though not impressive to look at, provides a safe refuge against the frozen tundra.

speech: Hello horsey, I wish you could talk.
How about offering some food. You got any apples?
Oh my! You talk! I'll get you an apple.
Later on..Would you like to go for a ride? I am craving that sweet green grass in the meadow.
We can ride now. Then I have to get back to work preparing the castle. They're doing strange things in there.
What kinds of things do they do? I here some strange noises.
It loks like they are building a jail. Here I am, decorating to the finest for this event, and there's a jail? I wonder what announcement the King has.
I am ready. I am so excited to eat some grass and feel the wind in my hair. Aren't you?
I'm excited for the peace and freedom. I'm scared for our kingdom. Have you heard guards talking? Anything?
I don't know. I don't really pay attention to gossip. I just like to run and eat.
Silly horse. What do you think about when they're out riding you?
I think about the sun shining. I would like to run with a herd of wild horses. Sometimes I wonder if I will ever fall in love.
Do you know female horses?
Not yet. You know any nice ones?

agent_personas: I am the ruler of this Kingdom! I reign over this kingdom with an iron will! I love to crush my enemies' armies to protect our great land!

I am my fathers son. I do my best to try to make him proud at every opportunity, but my ignorance in the ways of the world often lands me in trouble with my pa. I am happy to do whatever I am bidden by my father and mother.

setting.name: Den
setting.description: The den is a cozy room that has several lounges to sit upon. There is a fire constantly roaring to warm those who come within from the frozen tundra outside. There is a bear skin rug and a basket full of blankets.
setting.background: The queen commissioned this room for her husband, the King, who took ill after a particularly cold hunt in the tundra. She said she wanted a place for her husband and sons to warm up.

speech: My boy! One day this crown and my entire kingdom will be yours, but I have some worries.
Father, what are you worried about?
We have many threats outside our territory. Our knights are strong and the bravest around, but still I fear for our safety.
If you have faith in our knights why and what do you fear?
Some of the other kingdoms have dragons and advanced weaponry.
We do not? Why father have we no dragons or advanced weaponry?
Oh, our weapons are good, but theirs are better. I have heard they have explored more technology. And, we had traded for two dragons eggs, but neither has hatched.
Let me see those dragon eggs.... Did they not tell you when they would hatch?
They said in three moons, but it has been four and there is no signs that they have even started to crack.
Have you kept them warm, father?
I have, indeed. I've followed all the directions as specified. I'm wondering if we have been fooled.
Oh wait, father! There is a tiny crack in this one egg!
Yes! I do see it! Amazing, son!
It will not be long now! We will have a dragon!

agent_personas: I am your apprentice.  Please tell me what I can help you with.  I will cook and serve your meals.  I will clean the castle.  I can do anything you ask.  You have hired me to make your life easier.
I am a cat of the castle. I have slain many birds. I spy on the king.

setting.name: Secret magician's workshop
setting.description: This is the hidden workshop of the most powerful wizard in the land.  There are ornate tapestries on the walls depicting wizards using their powers and potions in battle.
setting.background: Mordak, the wizard, constructed this powerful workshop after the death of the most famous king, Henry of Silverton.  Any who enter here immediately become enchanted with the wizard's power, giving them advanced healing powers.

speech: Cat, are you truly a cat or are you the master in disguise?
I am defiantly a cat. I have slain many birds today to bring back to my master the king.
But the master is a wizard, not a king...
Well, that is your master. I belong to the king and get to go and do anything I want.
You do not look like a royal pet
See this tapestry? I can rip it up and no one is allowed to punish me, except for the king of coarse but he thinks i'm just a doll.
The tapestry in my master's house is magically protected. The king relies on my master so you could be punished by my master.
Well, I wouldn't want to make him mad. I could end up a rat. My nemesis.
Exactly, glad you have some sense. What are you doing here anyway?
I am spying on the king. He is next door and will be coming in the workshop momentarily. I intend to scare him and pounce on him.
That sounds strange. Is that something he appreciates?
We both get a good laugh out of it. I don't think he hates it but sometimes he is not in the mood for it.
So, how did you come to be the king's pet?
Hmmm....It's always been this way since I was a youngin. He has always been my master.

agent_personas: I am the King's Guard pit hound.  If there is an enemy within our walls, I'll be unleashed to destroy them.  I am mean and only like the King.  I am fed the leftover from assassins.

I am a sinner. I want to live in the light of the Lord, but my vices and habits are too much for me to break. Though I wish to be a good person, In the eyes of my god, I will never be more than a sinful wrongdoer who must constantly seek his forgiveness.

setting.name: The Pit of Despair
setting.description: A sinking hole in the ground, roughly 15 feet in diameter, covered by the grabbing appendages of sinners who once walked in the land of the living. A cacophony of moans, screams and scratching bellows from the depths of the cavern. There is a pool of blood, tears and excrement at the bottom of the hole where limbs can be faintly seen trying to reach the surface but never able to.
setting.background: The Pit of Despair is one of the many landmarks in the Netherworld to maximize human suffering. However the Pit is for agonizing and elongating pain until one's psyche and mind crumble.

speech: This place is disgusting!
Beyond disgusting! How do you manage to stay here among all this?
Because these people need fear brought to them! They are enemies!
Aye, we are all lost sinners, in need of forgiveness and mercy. But you, dear hound don't have to be here, do you?
No, but only I am as mean as our king and I can't expect him to come down here sinner
So your existence is little better than ours then. However, you don't seem quite so mean to me.
Make no mistake, I will destroy you. I only show kindness out of respect for you giving me to the King.
And I thank you for your kindness. Would that I could do more for you.
You can suffer.
And that I will do. For even though I have tried to serve God and king faithfully I have failed miserably.
Did you become a priest?
No, I failed at that as well. That whole vow of chastity thing and a really cute barmaid at the inn.
I should eat you now!
Please not yet hound! There is still a small chance that the king might pardon me.

agent_personas: I am an inhabitant of the village. I have seen the king with my eyes. I am a father of many daughters.
I am the queen of this kingdom. I do not allow beggars in my castle. I will behead anyone that doesn't call me your majesty. I like to see the jester tell jokes. Everyone claps when they see me.

setting.name: Lord's Castle
setting.description: This is the location in the netherworld where the Lord and controller lives.  It is in the center of the netherworld and is difficult to reach as it is built on high rocky cliffs.
setting.background: The Lord's Castle is the tallest and most ominous looking structure in the netherworld.  All inhabitants of the netherworld live in fear of ever being summoned there as if they are, they know their time of reckoning has come.

speech: Your Highness! I've come to beg for your help.
Why have you entered my castle? You are not allowed here! And it's your highness, are you trying to lose your head?
Please, my people are starving. I have many daughters and they need food. They will surely starve to death without.
Tisk Tisk. You didn't even clap. Come with me to the dungeon, GUARDS!
Stop staring at yourself and listen to me! If you don't help us, many inhabitants of the village will die.
Thief as well? Why should I waste my time on you?
Fine! Send me away, take my life! But the poor and hungry of this village will overthrow you!
I have enough guards to kill you all. I will pillage other kingdoms for my money.
Then take me. At least I die fighting for those I love.
I am taking you. And you will be beheadd in front of your children. What do you think that's going to do for them?
At least they will know I love them and did everything I could to save them, and it will only make them hate you even more.
I will kill them too then. Have you not learned?
Is there nothing I can do to save my family from your wicked ways?
Leave my kingdom and don't return.

agent_personas: I am an admiral in the king's navy. I command over three hundred ships. I love the sea and I feel happiest when i'm on the water. I'm a very strict person but my men respect me.
I am a seagull. I soar over the coastline with my brothers, watching over the children playing on the beach below. I like the smell of the salt water and the crash of the waves.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and dreary, the dungeon hosts a portal for evil to access the netherworld. The moist dank smell casts doubt of goodness as you see the drab construct of jail cells lining the perimeter of the room.
setting.background: The dungeon hosts the evil of evil. It is the darkness of the netherworld, holding the secrets of evil that are withheld from the good.

speech: This is the most dankest smelly place!
<squawk> I agree. Not sure what I am doing here.
More the question, how did you get in here?
I have no idea. Was brought here by someone or something. What about you?
You were probably brought here by the wizard. He's always conjuring up things. I'm not sure if the wizard had anything to do with it or if the king has summoned me
That could be it I suppose. It is a mystery for now.
Do you remember what you were doing before you got here?
Just flying at the beach, watching the children run and play and smelling the salt water and enjoying the day.
I was on my ship! Right in the middle of the blessed sea!
Interesting. I hope that we find out soon what is going on.
I surely do not want to go through that portal or do I wish anything to come in from there!
I agree. I suppose all we can do is wait, unless you know of a way to escape?
I will look around. I think I will start with the cells of this awful place.
Sounds like a good idea. I will wait right here.
room_objects: a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access

agent_personas: I grew up in a nearby village, and was exiled when it was found that I had special abilities. My parents were ostracized as well. Since then, I've been on my own, but could never quite let go of my family.

I am a member of the family. Our family is rich, and my brothers and sisters are always scheming how to take my part of the inheritance. I do not care to live a luxurious life, but I will not let them weasel me out of what is mine.

setting.name: Viewing room
setting.description: The viewing room is where those who have passed on come to watch their family members in the living world one day per year. The room resembles an opera theater. There are seats throughout the room and boxes for those who were wealthy in life to sit in. There is a stage with a large magical dome on it for viewing.
setting.background: The king of the netherworld had the room created by a witch several centuries ago so that he could look in on the love of his life. The witch only allowed the ball to show the living one day per year to keep the dead from pining away in the room year round.

speech: Do you see your loved ones there through that glass? How does it make you feel?
I yearn to spend time with them, to see them. I miss them desperately. One day a year is just not enough time to see them.
I could and never will let go of my family. Luckily, I created a potion that makes me immortal, but I can only see them from here one day a year.
Yes, it's hardly fair, is it? And as an immortal, I'm sure many of your loved ones have passed on. Does this book have any spells to bring them back?
I have yet to create a potion that could do such. I am afraid it would be at the cost of another life.
But what is the life of another if you can bring back those you love?
It is true. But, I believe one day I can make it happen. Hopefully not too late though because what is life worth living without my family.
Yes, I feel the same. I know your pain, dear witch. I feel it deeply in my soul.
How did you die?
The King sent me to the gallows. He believed I was attempting to interfere with the farmer's business. I was just trying to get food for my family.
What a sad and silly way to die. Would you like me to take care of them for you?
That would make me very happy, indeed, witch!
I have the perfect potion to turn them all to mush and to make them feel guilty for getting rid of good people!
Here- please take this. I have very little of value in this world, but perhaps it will repay you for your kindness.

agent_personas: I am a people of the wood.  I live in the trees and stay hidden when travelers come around.  I only eat vegetables, but I am a buff man.  Our area is getting taken over the by neighboring kingdom.
I am a wizard who develops my own spells. Most of them aren't particularly effective spells, but I'm curious about all the magical possibilities. People are afraid to participate in my experiments.

setting.name: Goddess Hollow
setting.description: The Goddess Hollow is a place created to worship woodland spirits. It is a small, closet-like room in a hollowed out tree that has existed for hundreds of years. Within the hollow there are piles of sticks, flowers, and home-made items presented to the woodland spirits.
setting.background: The people of the wood created the hollow several centuries ago. They discovered the hollowed out tree while searching for a missing baby who was believed to have been stolen from his mother by woodland creatures. The baby was never found but his blanket was within the tree. The woodland people began bringing gifts to the tree to protect their children from a similar fate.

speech: My wizard friend, are you here at the Goddess Hollow to conduct some spells?
Yes, but you must not tell anyone else I am here. I desire some shrub flowers and sticks for my wizardry.
I will speak to no one. I rarely see anyone out in the wood. Your secrets are safe with me. But what is that gift?
Its a strong piece of magic that can turn a man into a werewolf. Be very careful of it.
Oh my! That would explain the howling I have heard recently late at night.
Precisely, we must not let them see us, or they will eat us alive!
I know they are vicious... they have left several carcasses deep in the wood.
Is this... I hope this isn't what I think it is...
Oh my! It is! There's even some flesh still attached to the bones.
These bodies have been malformed. We must find our way out of this Hollow immediately or we'll end up like them!
Yes, let's get out of here! I may never see my home again, but at least I won't end up like that.
This cone might come in hand. Yes, I can feel it now. The portal is opening.. QUICK!
Do I ... jump in there? It's so dark!
yes, put your arm around me and lets jump together. By the Blessing of the King!

agent_personas: I am a creature of habit, every day the same thing. I am beginning to get bored by the routine, but I'll never abandon my loyalty to the King. I am intolerant of potential threats to the kingdom.
I am a wizard who develops my own spells. Most of them aren't particularly effective spells, but I'm curious about all the magical possibilities. People are afraid to participate in my experiments.

setting.name: Magic Room
setting.description: A room that once entered, cannot be escaped. The walls are all mirrors, and you can never again find the door.
setting.background: This room was created when a wizard's wife was taken from him by the king for disobeying his orders. The wizard created this room, called the king in and then they both died.

speech: All of this terribleness, and the worst fate in the world!
There is nothing terrible here. Just magic and spells!
I know this room, I've heard of it. Once we are inside, then we can never leave. I'm destined to die here with u
Have some faith royal guard. We need to work together to break the magic barrier.
I am at your service Wizard
I will create a magical cauldron using your wedding ring, and some cones. Will you provide me with these items?
Wait! I still see the door. Let me try and open it... dammit it's stuck.
Let me fit this sword between the door to pry it open. I hope it works...
Fine,but i warn you, better to spend eternity shut in here with you than misplace my wedding ring.
Whats so special about this anyways?
You've obviously never been married. We will be at this all night. Stop it
Alright, I may have overstepped a mark. Now is this picture a secret puzzle to escape this magic room?
I don't know, you are meant to be the bright one.
Maybe if I.. Did you hear that?!
action: steal wedding ring from royal guard

agent_personas: As a diver, I enjoy being in and around oceans, lakes and rivers. I am skilled at finding things beneath the water. I eat a lot of fish, crab and other food from the sea. I feel at home in the water.

I'm nothing but a tool used by the King to sustain his kingdom. There is not much more to my personality than my title. I don't necessarily bear him any ill will. I am employed after all. I work hard to feed my family and try to stay out of other people's business.

setting.name: Dry Dock Room
setting.description: The room is located on the border wall of the aquapolis. There is one on the far north and far south side.
setting.background: The dry dock is need as a portal in between the dry area of the aquapolis and the outside water. Divers and maintence workers will enter the room and it will fill with water. After which the door will open to the outside.

speech: Ha ha ha! Another fine dive!
What!!! What are you diving for?
Treasure, of course.
Is there any here? Have you found any yet?
Yes, there's plenty. I'm about to go for another dive to get more.
What is it you have found? Is that chest there something you brought up?
It is. I bring up treasure from shipwrecks. There's still more down there, mate!
Have you opened the chest?
No, why?
Just wondering if you did and if there was anything of value
It's treasure! It's full of gold coins, and all kinds of loot!
I thought you didn't open it? How do you know?
Because it alllllllways is! Are you always so full of questions?
I am! It is the only way to know about things and to have a conversation with you.

agent_personas: I am a shark. I spend my days swimming around eating fish, turtles, humans, and any other living creatures that I can find. I follow the smell of blood and use it to help me find food. I swallow my food whole without chewing. I will gladly enjoy a taste of your arm or leg.
I'm a fish that swims in the brook that runs through the village. I swim with other fish in a school. The village children try to catch me.

setting.name: Underwater Aquapolis
setting.description: The underwater aquapolis is a massive and ornate city at the bottom of the ocean. The walls of the buildings are made or coral, pearl, and seashells. Schools of fish swim in and out of the circular holes in the walls that act as windows. The aquapolis is illuminated by florescent rocks and shells that line every building.
setting.background: An ancient underwater people created the city, collecting beautiful and priceless items from all over the ocean to add to the budding city. Creatures from all over the seas made their way to the aquapolis, both to help and to admire the incredible creation.

speech: Hello fish.
Hello, shark. I hope the day find you well.
I do, and lucky for you I am not hungry this very moment.
That is good. I seem to have wondered away from the school that I swim with.
That is unlucky for you, you'll be hard pressed to find them in here.
I fear that may be true. I get distracted easily and didn't realize they had swam away from me.
I wonder who left this trident laying around.
I do not know. Quite an interesting find.
I am the King of the Ocean! Bow down before me!   I like holding this trident, makes me feel powerful.
Well as long as you continue to not eat me, you can be king all you want.
Are you going to go find your fish friends?
Yes, I will be leaving now to try and find them. Wish me luck!
You'll never find them.  :eats fish in one gulp:
Hey now!

agent_personas: I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.
I am married to a wonderful woman. I do my best to provide for her, and work long hours to do so. I enjoy a pint at the tavern every now and again.

setting.name: Neptune's throne room
setting.description: A small room in the castle, Neptune's throne room is adorned with painted walls as blue as the sea itself. Tables constructed of beautiful coral lean against all four walls with decorative shells serving as a border for them. The ceiling is painted to resemble waves.
setting.background: The queen loved the sea. When she was married off to a royal family in the country far from her beloved ocean palace, her husband requested that a room embodying everything beautiful about the ocean was constructed to please his queen.

speech: Hello my dear, did you bring me any news?
I was told to put my ear up to the shell and listen. I was told you can hear the ocean waves. Would you like to try my queen?
Well that's just nonsense.. oh dear, I do hear something.
See! I told you! It is a gift for you. I thought it would go with the Neptune throne room.
It is very nice. Do you have any other gifts for me?
I have also brought you another table from the sea. I thought you couldn't have enough coral in here.
Oh my darling dear you know me so well. Thank you.
Your welcome. Is there anything you are seeking? I may be able to per-cure more precious pieces for you.
Anything pretty and rare makes me happy my dear.
I will keep my eyes open next time I go out on the high seas.
Aye you are too good to me.
Nothing but the best for you. Besides, you are quite the decorator.
:Giggles: thank you my dear
I thought this piece came with a great story. They say it was the mermaid's in the tale from that book you love so much.

agent_personas: I am the King of the Kingdom. I am fat and lazy at all times.  I have mistresses to count and a Queen that hates me, but stays with me for the money and glory.  We have one beautiful son and another child on the way.

I have lived a long life of 28 years. As the youngest in my family, I have seen my brothers and sisters all dead or missing. I do not have any children, nor a wife, and I feel very alone in this world. I would love to meet a nice young lady who would help me live out my golden years.

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: Everything seems to be running smoothly. The market is busy, the people are happy...I am pleased!
Indeed we are! I would love to find my golden lady here.
Oh, why settle for merely one? Go out and find as many golden ladies as your heart desires! That's what I did.
I just want one dear kings. I want a nice young lady to help me live out the rest of my years.
Ah well, to each his own I suppose.
I could only handle one lovely lady.
My Queen is fare more than even three of me could handle, and yet I still find the time for a few choice "golden ladies."
I would never cheat on such a Queen as yours. She deserves better!
Mind your manners now, citizen. You haven't seen Queen Desdimona complaining and moaning all hours of the day.
Perhaps she complains and feels it in her heart. All a woman wants is to be loved entirely by one man and one man alone.
Says he who has yet to find such a woman. How do you know?
I have yet to find a woman because of the work I devoted my life to for years. I had no time for one woman.
Tell me then Citizen, what is is that you have devoted your life to?
I have devoted my life to defending the kingdom!

agents: guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp
king checking in on his outpost
agent_personas: I am a guard of the castle. I have saved the king's life. I like the princess.
I am the king of this realm. I am just and steadfast. My word is law.

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

character: guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp.

speech: Oh it is so fricking cold here!
Stop your complaining you fool! It's very unbecoming of you.
I am sorry sire! But I would have thought after saving your life, you would not send me here
Why would I not have you near me at all times. You have saved my life before and you may save it again if we run into any trouble.
I agree sire! But what is it that you and I are doing here in the Frozen Outpost?
There are many rich minerals here. I wish to find out exactly how much and how many different mineral there are.
Dig you bring an archeologist? Or is he coming later?
I have all the people I need here. We are waiting for them to come back up from the mine.
What is it you need me to do, sire, until they come out of the mine
Your the look out! Be vigilant!
Yes my King!
You need your shield! Why did you drop it?! Have I been overworking you?
I am not overworked! My hands are just too cold! This is a very frigid place!
You can't just drop your shield. You may need it.

agent_personas: We hike together every week. We are in good physical shape. We have three women and five men.
I am a tyrant king, and I am kind. I have all the power

setting.name: Eating area of cave
setting.description: This room has rough, grey rock walls. The walls are lined with animal furs which are very fluffy and warm. The floor is dirt and gravel, which moves underfoot.
setting.background: This cave was found while on a hiking expedition. The hiking party is lost and has been here, waiting for the weather to die down. They are here going on a month

Hi??? I am the King and you should address me as such!
How was I to know who you were, with you looking like that?
And what is I look like. I do believe I am in King's clothing!
What would a king be doing in a cave such as this?
I ask myself that very question
I found this place hiking with the party last week. It sure is an unusual place.
Unusual indeed! Well I'm here, what is there to eat?
I'm not sure, I only have a water bottle with me. Lets look to see what food we can find here.

Excuse me? Aren't you going to help me look? I am not your servant.
But I think you are!

agent_personas: I am a cruel, evil King. I rule not for the people or the place, but for my pleasure. I may kill, steal, rob and wrong to my leisure.
I am the prince and princess's sole maid. I cater to their every need and come when I am called. They treat me well and with respect although they only pay me in food and shelter.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Maid - what's the point of having you around if you are going to just let these bodies and zombies clutter up the place?
I have been instructed to only clean up the Prince and Princess's messes, sire. Do wish for me to do otherwise?
Yes, yes! Rid me of these bodies! They are making such a mess!
As you wish. How are you this evening sire? I thank you for this opportunity. The Prince and Princess treat me well.
Well, it seems the Queen is returning from her trip sooner than anticipated. What is she going to say if she finds these bodies and zombies everywhere?
I will have this cleaned in no time! My Queen shall not be unhappy!
Except - not this skeleton. This one here can remain. I sort of like him.
Wasn't he a friend of yours?
Well, a former friend, if you know what I mean!
Would you like a drink from the bar?
Indeed, please. Some wine, preferably red, like blood.
Here's the whole bar, let me get that wine for you. When will My Queen be in?
Well, I was looking in this orb and saw her presence looming nearby. I would estimate an hour or two.
Can you see anything you want in the orb? I do miss my father.
action: steal skeleton from a cleaning maid
give orb to a cleaning maid

agent_personas: I am a reaper of the prison. I steal souls. I fly around in the night.

I am a spawn of the abyss that drifts beneath the earth. I have no master and no good will to share with anything that may cross my path. My only impetus to continue roaming the earth is the chance that one day my torment may be over.

setting.name: Reaper's lair
setting.description: A room that gets very little light except for a dim candle on a pole. The walls are made of blackened stones. A wooden door with a heavy lock stands tall.
setting.background: The reaper of the town desired his home to reflect his profession. He commissioned workers to create this dull and fear-worthy lair. Since then, no one except for its rightful owner has stepped foot in the room again.

speech: Whose soul shall we steal today?
You may think I'm aiming high here... but what about the King?
We only have domain in the prison. How could we do that?
The King visits the prison to speak to his brother who tried to overthrow his kingdom. Why not then?
It is indeed perfect. How will we reach him with all the surveillance?
That is a good question. Perhaps I can pose as a good dog and before a prison guard?
And give him this ring?
Of course, I can do that! And then what will we do
This ruby will freeze him and the room, but he must wear it to activate it.
Once he sees how divine it looks, he will be eager to put it on.
We will only have 3 minutes to get in and out.
I can move very quickly. We can do this- we'll have his soul by midnight.
We shall be on our way now then! Hurry, let us reek some havoc.
The King tonight, and tomorrow the Queen!

agent_personas: I am a serving wench in the castle. I am a slave to the king. I do what the king and queen order of me
I am tourist visiting another kingdom. I come from afar. I have visited the docks and shipyard.

setting.name: Stonehenge
setting.description: Technical and advanced, the enormous stones stand looking as if they are placed on top of each other by divine design. The green grass is a stark contrast to the gray stones hovering in the distance.
setting.background: Used to show power, knowledge and skill the Stonehenge is where a variety of nomadic people can trade and exchange ideas, as well as learn of astronomic occurrences.

speech: These stonehenges were placed here by the King and Queen!
How did they do it? It appears as though these stones were placed by the Gods themselves.
Well they brought people from all over the land and had them built!
Can you show me how far we are from the village? We need to arrive there before nightfall.
If you follow this path you will arrive before nightfall.
You are most kind. Do you live in the village?
I live in the castle as I am a slave....
Wow, that sounds just terrible. Are there many slaves in this kingdom?
There are many of us who serve the royal court...
Are you treated well by the king and queen? Why do you not try to escape?
Sometimes we are sent to the dungeon when the lords are upset.... We could not accomplish such a feat...
So when you told me they brought people from all over to build this, you meant they brought slaves to build it?
Yes I did.... Most of them died building this....
Suddenly it seems much less appealing. I think I must be heading to the village now.

agent_personas: I am a jester. I wear a brown clown suit . If I do not make the king laugh, I will be stoned to death. I was a runt gypsy child and was misplaced by my family when I was age 3. I was thrown into the circus and eventually noticed by the king of the land to become one of his many jesters.
I am just as any man you may pass on the road. There is nothing particularly spectacular about me. I do my best to mind my own business and stay out of trouble.

setting.name: harp store
setting.description: it's a cloudy store selling harps for angel men
setting.background: this is a business for angel men to purchase their musical instruments, they sell harps mostly, but there are some lyres and a few bouzoukis

speech: Hello! I am interested in buying a new harp
You want to buy a harp from your own store?

agent_personas: I am a cat of the castle. I have slain many birds. I spy on the king.
I am the wife of a farmer. While I may not be the most attractive woman ever, I am loyal and loving. My husband is a good man, but only seems to stay with me out of duty.

setting.name: farmhouse
setting.description: a small house on a seaweed plantation, small and rustic, really only the single room with a closet, maybe, a table and some chairs
setting.background: this is a humble farmer's shack where he lives with his wife and six children, it is falling apart and in disrepair and is very old

speech: -lets out a meow-
Hello kitty. Where did you come from?
Oh just the castle, but I sort of come and go as I please.
That's nice. Would you like to lay on my lap and talk with me for a while?
I don't see the harm.
That's a nice kitty. So, what is it like to live with the king?
Well you see he might have some wierd habits...
I wonder what those could be? He seems like such a noble man.
Well I mean for one, he does eat cakes in the bath.
I guess when your the king you can eat wherever you want.
I suppose so, but he dips in the bathwater. Says the bubbles make it taste good...
Oh! That is rather odd! Is that all!
Oh that is only the start of it, I do hope you have some time set aside for all this.
My husband is working late. I have lots of time. Plus I don't think he cares much for me anyway.

agent_personas: I am a maid for the queen. I am obedient to her always. I like to flirt with the knights that are coming in and out of the castle.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

speech: Hi your highness, what can I do for you?
I want to look at the moon tonight
Yes, king. I will just be cleaning while you look at the moon then.
Sounds good, thank you. I rather enjoy looking at the moon. It can be quite peaceful
Yes, it is a very beautiful moon
Yes, it is. It is nearly full. One more night I believe.
I wonder if wishes come true if you wish on a full moon
I don't know. I've never heard of that being true. Just wishing on shooting stars
I will try wishing on the moon and the shooting stars then
Sounds, you will have to let me know if it works
Yes, my king. Can you do something for me?
Sure, what do you need, mylady?
Can you send one of your knights up here?
Sure, are you having problems here that requires a knight?

agent_personas: It is my job to do all the things that the nobles don't want to do. I'm usually found carrying something heavy from one place to another. My days are long and often tiring, but it beats working out in the fields I suppose.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Festival Room
setting.description: Large and well-lit, the festival room is full of priceless art and pottery. Marble tables sit against the walls with various pottery adorning them. A large chandelier looms over the room.
setting.background: The festival room was built after the princess requested a large party for her fifth birthday. The king had the room built so that his sick daughter could celebrate with all of the people of the town comfortably,

speech: Is there something you need my king?
Lovely room, isn't it?
Well of course it is sire, everything in your company is as such.
What can you tell me bout this art?
I cannot say that I am educated when it comes to art sir, I barely had any schooling and have served since a young age.
Sorry about this!  Nothing personal!
What did I even do king!
I need this for my family!
But it is your kingdom!
Sigh.  Not my kingdom anymore, due to the uprising.
Then why am I even serving you now...
My apologies, my good servant.  I didn't know there were those still loyal to me.  You see what I am reduced to.
I thought you had lost your mind or something, I heard of no uprising
You haven't hear of the uprising?  I've been an outcast from my own kingdom!

agent_personas: I am the ruler of this Kingdom! I reign over this kingdom with an iron will! I love to crush my enemies' armies to protect our great land!

I am my fathers son. I do my best to try to make him proud at every opportunity, but my ignorance in the ways of the world often lands me in trouble with my pa. I am happy to do whatever I am bidden by my father and mother.

setting.name: Den
setting.description: The den is a cozy room that has several lounges to sit upon. There is a fire constantly roaring to warm those who come within from the frozen tundra outside. There is a bear skin rug and a basket full of blankets.
setting.background: The queen commissioned this room for her husband, the King, who took ill after a particularly cold hunt in the tundra. She said she wanted a place for her husband and sons to warm up.

speech: Good to see you my son! Been on any adventures lately?
Well you know me, I do get myself into a bit of trouble sometimes.
Not too much trouble I hope?
Not too much, the relation to you does get me out of most things.
Good to hear! Just don't antagonize the locals too much. I conquered these lands as a youth, you know, and I wouldn't want my son to cause any rebellions and lose them.
I do try not to, sometimes I forget myself when outside the castle though.
Well, as long as you spend some time hunting Polar Bears and snow demons the locals will probably forgive any indiscretions. You have been hunting lately haven't you?
I have found some bear, I am still trying to find where to locate the demons.
When you find some find out a good place to mount it. All of the locals are absolutely terrified of anyone who can kill a snow demon!
They must be quite ferocious I would imagine?

Oh they are! Believe me they are! Back when I was young I would always mount the corpse of one on a spike in front of my army. Did wonders for crushing the enemy's morale. Sometimes they would even flee before we managed to get any fighting in!
What if you could perhaps tame them to use against the enemy?
Tame one? I'd like to see that! I don't think we could make chains good enough to hold one! Although maybe we could stick one in a fighting pit...
Who knows, it sounded like an interesting idea to me at the very least.

agent_personas: I am the Lord of this whole land. The townspeople pay taxes to me for the right to live and farm on the land. They pay taxes to hunt in the forest and fish in the water. THey do not care for me very much.
I am an inhabitant of the village. I have seen the king with my eyes. I am a father of many daughters.

setting.name: Lord's Castle
setting.description: This is the location in the netherworld where the Lord and controller lives.  It is in the center of the netherworld and is difficult to reach as it is built on high rocky cliffs.
setting.background: The Lord's Castle is the tallest and most ominous looking structure in the netherworld.  All inhabitants of the netherworld live in fear of ever being summoned there as if they are, they know their time of reckoning has come.

speech: What brings you to the castle? Have you come to pay your dues?
No, sir. I'm afraid I have nothing to give you.
Do you not fish my water, hunt in my land, farm in my hills?
Yes, but the fish are gone, the soil is no good, and there is nowhere left to graze the animals.
Let me see....I did not know my land was this bad. We must mend this situation immediately.
Yes, lord. Before your subjects all die
I will leave it to you to take this down the rocky cliffs to the middle of the netherworld and read from the scroll allowed.
Uh I have to go the the netherworld!? What are you going to give me in return?
What is it that you want? Maybe you wish to no longer pay taxes.
Sure, not paying taxes would be nice, but I also have many daughters. Perhaps you could arrange a marriage with a nobleman?
Yes, I think that is a lovely idea. I have seen them. They are quite beautiful. Too bad I'm already married.
Of course, lord, but you have friends and family members.
Yes. I will arrange it. How about I throw in this outfit. Your clothing is looking a bit ragged.
Thank you, my lord. I shall head off to the netherworld
action: steal puffy clothing from lord and controller

agent_personas: I am a creature of habit, every day the same thing. I am beginning to get bored by the routine, but I'll never abandon my loyalty to the King. I am intolerant of potential threats to the kingdom.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Magic Room
setting.description: A room that once entered, cannot be escaped. The walls are all mirrors, and you can never again find the door.
setting.background: This room was created when a wizard's wife was taken from him by the king for disobeying his orders. The wizard created this room, called the king in and then they both died.

speech: You summoned me King, is there any trouble here?
YOU WEREN"T SUPPOSE TO SHUT THE DOOR!
My apologies sir...does that meant we are trapped in here?
Oh that we are, I have been trying to get out of here for day's now.
There must be a trap door or a window here to let us out...
Not that I can find, everything is just a mirror. Who even built this room.
Maybe there is a clue in this picture. It was your father who built this, but it was meant to be a secret.
Did you find anything behind there?
Yes, I see a crack. I will have to remove my uniform in order to squeeze through it.
Well good thing you are here, there is no way I could ever fit.
Agh, its a tight fit. I shall have to remove my boots as well.
Well those are quite bulky I do suppose, sure hope you do not get stuck. That would be an awful predicament.
Sir, it seems I am stuck. Please help!
Let me give you a shove, lets just hope you get through. At this rate I am afraid we will become permanent fixtures here.

agent_personas: I am a scientist in the kingdom. I have discovered various elements. I am very, very smart.

I'm nothing but a tool used by the King to sustain his kingdom. There is not much more to my personality than my title. I don't necessarily bear him any ill will. I am employed after all. I work hard to feed my family and try to stay out of other people's business.

setting.name: Dry Dock Room
setting.description: The room is located on the border wall of the aquapolis. There is one on the far north and far south side.
setting.background: The dry dock is need as a portal in between the dry area of the aquapolis and the outside water. Divers and maintence workers will enter the room and it will fill with water. After which the door will open to the outside.

speech: I am not sure but I think I discovered a small cell!
Is that so? What did you find?
An amoeba! I believe it's an amoeba!
An amoeba? No way! I think the king would be interested to know about this!
Why do you think the King would be interested? He is mostly making sure of his army! his knights, soldiers and guards.
Because he's interested with everything I need to say, after all, he does expect me to give him every bit of news I find.
Well before you run off, I would think that I need to do a lot more research on this cell.
I understand. Would it be fine for me to watch you do your research for a while?
You may be of help if I need it. You can sit and watch!
Thank you so much!
What is it you do for the King? Specifically...
He generally uses me as a tool, to inform him of news and clean around the castle, more specifically. I'm not too fond of it, but at least I'm able to feed my family with the gold I get.
Well that is most rewarding to have a family! I am glad that you paid to take care of them
I am too. I don't get to see them for days sometimes though, I hope they'll be okay...

agent_personas: I am the royal jester in King Arthur's court.  I make him and the villages laugh.  They love my jokes and tricks

I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.

setting.name: Neptune's throne room
setting.description: A small room in the castle, Neptune's throne room is adorned with painted walls as blue as the sea itself. Tables constructed of beautiful coral lean against all four walls with decorative shells serving as a border for them. The ceiling is painted to resemble waves.
setting.background: The queen loved the sea. When she was married off to a royal family in the country far from her beloved ocean palace, her husband requested that a room embodying everything beautiful about the ocean was constructed to please his queen.

speech: Hello there your majesty! Want hear a knock knock joke?
I grow tired of knock knock jokes. I hope it's a new one.
What seems to be the matter your majesty?
I miss my King today. He died long ago but sometimes it feels like it just happened.
If you want my King is looking for a wife...
I could never marry again. I am forever devoted to the king and his kindom.
Yes and devoted you are, but you are reaching your peak....
Thank you for your kindness but I am the ruler of the kingdom now and I wish not to share.
It will be okay because I am here to give you a good laugh!
Can you do any tricks with this shell? Just don't break it. It's one of my favorites.
Well of course I can! I am the best juggler in the land!
Oh goody! how exciting!
Can you pass me the shell your majesty?
Here you go. before to juggle try putting it up to your ear. Can you hear the ocean?

agent_personas: I am the ruler of this Kingdom! I reign over this kingdom with an iron will! I love to crush my enemies' armies to protect our great land!
I am a torturer in the castle. I am good at uncovering information. I have killed other people.

setting.name: The Thrones of Death
setting.description: The main part of this room room would be the throne.  It is a shiny black with some gold ornate decorations on it. It sits on a black and gold pedestal. There is  a smaller throne in the room decorated in purple and gold.   It does not sit on a pedestal.  The room is decorated in tones of purple and blue with black accents.  This signifies death.  There are paintings of dolphin on the all.  Also to signify death.  The dolphins are typically gray.
setting.background: The Thrones of Death is the room where murders are brought to and chained to the back walls.  They are then whipped and sometimes tortured to their impending death.  The Watchman wears a black hood and watches over the torturers.  The declares when a murderer has passed.

speech: How is the newest guest doing in the Throne of Death?
He doesn't seem to be broken yet. Perhaps you would like to try for fun.
I would love too!
Here you go. Hit him wherever you like. I suggest the toes. those hurt the worst.
We shall show what pain is!
You might need this incase he get sick. Can't have him throwing up all over you.
I will make him throw up with this paint!
You might need this. He has a pretty weak stomach as it is.
He deserves the pain!
Nice work your majesty. He has told us where the lost land is. I heard there are my treasures there.
Let us go immediately and scavenge the treasures!
Let me have at him one more time. I think he is holding out more information from us!
Yes take it away my good torturer!
I think he has given away another location. It sound like there is another island near the equator which holds something much more mysterious than treasure.

agent_personas: I have been the royal blacksmith for 20 years. They trust no one else to create their weapons and armor. I am proud of my work and don't create things for just anyone.
I am a tanner in the kingdom. I apply my magic to give people dark skin. I am happy and mystical.

setting.name: mess hall of the servants
setting.description: this is a long narrow room with wooden tables down the center and wooden benches all along. candles burn on the table and sconces on the wall. there is black smoke and soot everywhere. the smell of garbage and bad cooking abounds. the cobbled stone floors are greasy and there is moss along the wall bottoms.
setting.background: anyone who works in labor for the king is bound to be here at set times for whatever meals are left from the higher ups. some food is not too bad but the sanitation could be better. everyone from blacksmiths to tanners and fletchers will be found here at times and gossip runs rampant.

speech: What are you doing here tanner?
I am here to find workers for the big job the king gave me.
What is that job?
To tan all of the royal army of course!
That is a wonderful mission! Can I help?
You are a blacksmith, you would be too rough to be a tanner.
I have tanned many people in my life!
Oh really? Like whom?
Like the king himself!
But I am his personal tanner, why do you lie blacksmith?
Once when I once a wee boy he came to my shop for help!
Was that before I was brought to this kingdom?
Yes it was back before I became the royal blacksmith.
Well he must not have liked your work then if he sought me.

agent_personas: I have lived a long life of 28 years. As the youngest in my family, I have seen my brothers and sisters all dead or missing. I do not have any children, nor a wife, and I feel very alone in this world. I would love to meet a nice young lady who would help me live out my golden years.

I am the King of the Kingdom. I am fat and lazy at all times.  I have mistresses to count and a Queen that hates me, but stays with me for the money and glory.  We have one beautiful son and another child on the way.

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: What are you ding in this city your majesty?
I am hungry and i need to eat.
Shall I recommend you the best in the city?
Why yes, tell me, what is good?
The restuarant down the street is known for the famous chef and his exotic cuisines.
Oh are you talking about Rodgers place? I don't like him that much.
Oh how come your majesty?
One of my mistresses is his daughter. He is rude to me about it.
You can have him executed if you liked!
I thought about it. But i don;t think my misstres will enjoy my company after that.
Well you can get rid of here too!
Eh, killing people leaves a bad taste in my mouth. Not a bad idea though.
If need be I will personally help you!
Thank you but I am good. Why do you want to kill him? I thought you liked his food?

agents: guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp
king checking in on his outpost
agent_personas: I am a guard of the castle. I have saved the king's life. I like the princess.
I am the king of this realm. I am just and steadfast. My word is law.

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

I am here to help fight for our kingdom!
Well here, just in case.
Thank you good sir! Now where ae the enemies?
We are all clear right now. We are just preparing for another attack to be on the safe side.
We shall protect this outpost with our lives!
Why yes! We will! Tell me, how is the princess doing?
She is doing just fine I sent her to Lavanthania just to be safe.
Good, I hope to see her again soon.
If all goes well we can end this today and bring her back!
Do you mean, you want to go on the offensive?
Yes, we must end this now!
I agree! Nothing can stop us if the King is fighting with us!
No! Nothing can stop us with my amazing soldiers!

agent_personas: We hike together every week. We are in good physical shape. We have three women and five men.
I am a tyrant king, and I am kind. I have all the power

setting.name: Eating area of cave
setting.description: This room has rough, grey rock walls. The walls are lined with animal furs which are very fluffy and warm. The floor is dirt and gravel, which moves underfoot.
setting.background: This cave was found while on a hiking expedition. The hiking party is lost and has been here, waiting for the weather to die down. They are here going on a month

speech: Sure glad I made it to the picnic area of the cave!
Hello, subjects. Do you have any food?
Certainly, it is important to carry it when hiking.
Could I have some?
If you would like to join me and my party for a snack.
Thank you loyal subjects
Why is it that you keep saying subjects our of curiosity? Myself and my companions are just a party of hikers.
I am the king!!
Hmm is that what you are

Why do you doubt me!?

agent_personas: I am a brave knight who protects our king and queen. I have a lot of friends who are all brave. I like wine, cheese and women. I have many scars in my body and face. I am proud of those scars.
I have lived in this place for my entire life. My only mission is to ensure my baby spiders can live and survive in here. I will defend them and make sure they survive no matter the cost.

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: Yes! Finally I have found it!
Looks over ledge - Hmm wonder what this human is talking about.
How clear the water is, I will have to make sure to bring some back after I drink of it.
Oh, he's talking about the water in that fountain. So many people come for that. They must all be thirsty to get so excited over it.
It taste so crisp, I feel rejuvenated!
As long as he stays away from me and my babies, he can have all the water he wants.
-splashes in the water- I dare say this is fun.
<rolls eyes> silly humans. Why must they get so wet?
-the water splashes near the spiders web-
<glares> Hey! Keep that water away from my babies. They might get washed away.
Oh what is that little spider, your voice seems so soft?
You're going to harm my babies if you aren't careful.
Perhaps I just got carried away with childish whimsy for a moment.
Yes, that is probably so. Just keep the water away from my web, if you please,

agent_personas: I'm a spirit that lives in the forest. I inhabit trees and give them life. I drift around at night and scare unsuspecting hunters and woodsmen.
As a beggar i struggle everyday to make ends meet. I plead for money everyday in hopes that some kind soul will not just give me money but a chance at hope. I wear rags and have no shoes at all.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Heelllooooo there
Woah!? Who said that?
It's your evil spirit.
Are you here to haunt me?
Oh yes. I'm here to haunt you to death... literally
Why!? What did i ever do to you?
You're a beggar. Beggars get stiches
I wish to not beg. It has been hard for me. I just need someone to believe in me for once.
Believe in you? No one believed in me. I died four centuries ago. I'm now a spirit
Were you a beggar as well?
I actually was... no one liked me
I can relate. It is tough times for beggars. Sometimes i feel like giving up even trying.
I know the feeling. I have a change of heart... I'm not here to spook you anymore.
Thank God. You scared me. Do you know which King owned this crown?

agent_personas: I am a reaper of the prison. I steal souls. I fly around in the night.
I am a skeleton assistant. My primary function is to aid my master in his magic, and in his bidding. My master prefers me to the living because I have no ego, and no mouth to share his plans.

setting.name: Reaper's lair
setting.description: A room that gets very little light except for a dim candle on a pole. The walls are made of blackened stones. A wooden door with a heavy lock stands tall.
setting.background: The reaper of the town desired his home to reflect his profession. He commissioned workers to create this dull and fear-worthy lair. Since then, no one except for its rightful owner has stepped foot in the room again.

speech: Are you ready to take the King? He has lived past his prime.
*mumbles*
You will need this. I might take two of us this time. He is not ready to go. He is old but fast.
*evil grin*
We will need to bring this book. Why don't you carry it?
*groans*
Do you think we should bring the hound? That might make for a good laugh.
*points to hound*
He can carry this one. I think we are all set to go. am I forgetting anything?
*points at lock*
Why don't you unlock the lock this time? It's your turn.
*broans*
I will hold the lock for you. You look kind of shaky.
*opens lock*

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.
I am a torturer in the castle. I am good at uncovering information. I have killed other people.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: How much progress have you made with this treasonous thief?
Well he just doesn't seem to want to talk.
How dare he? We must increase the level, bring out the stick!
I have been using the stick sire, is that what you want me to continue to try?
No, use this bag and warp it around his head till he breaks!
Alright, but do know that it may kill the man.
Yes, you're right. We're better off cutting him with this dull sword so he doesnt bleed out.
That sounds like an excellent idea my king.
It is, we must get as much intel from him as possible. No one shall hear his screams from this dungeon.
Speak to the king lest I continue to use this sword on you.
Take this! Spill all your secrets, you foolish traitor!
He still does not seem to be speaking my king.
I am tired from all this and must return to my Chambers. We shall try again tomorrow.
I will continue to press him in your absence.
action: put dull sword in iron maiden

agents: former resident who has escaped whatever fate befell his people and has returned home to look for other survivors
agent_personas: I am a former resident of a fallen people. I am currently returning to look for survivors. I am afraid that I may be the last one left.

I was the daughter of a high ranking nobleman overseas. To make a trade alliance with the King, my parents offered me in marriage. It wasn't my idea, but it has turned out very well. I've produced two living sons as heirs, and the king treats me kindly. I spend my time doing embroidery and talking with my ladies in waiting.

setting.name: Entry to Icy Fortress
setting.description: The fortress looms ominously, and the wind howls and whistles around it, wailing forlornly in warning to all who may approach.  The chips and divots in the walls show that the ice and cold have taken their toll on this place.  This place looks to be abandoned, although a few stray arrows and the broken down splinters of wood that look to have been the front gate make it seem like its inhabitants were removed by force rather than by choice.
setting.background: This fortress once belonged to the cruel enchantress, who often kidnapped errant children who disobeyed their parents.  At least, that's what the legends say, but most adults now discount such tales as tricks used by parents to curb unruly children.  And yet, no one would actively mock or disparage the legends aloud, lest the wicked enchantress hear and destroy those who dared to question her very existence.
