speech: I was afraid I was the only one. It seems I was right
What happened here?

We let our foolishness ruin us. Trusted the wrong people and they turned on us in the night. Slew the most while they slept. No more is this place the Palace of Harmony. This is the Icy Fortress of Despair! My people. All slain
It'll be okay. We'll rebuild this place, ill see to it personally.
I thought to seek others like me, refugees and survivors to rebuild. But I feel so alone. And lonely. It's hopeless.
You should come back to the capital with me, well find all the men we need and rebuild this place.
Really, how can I even bebin to thank you?
It is the least I could do. You are my people and I have a responsibility to help whenever I can.
Forgive my impudence Majesty, but why did we get no aid earlier?
Forgive me, I tried to get more men here but the king didn't think you would need the help...
Why would he think such a thing? I will show him the bodies of my dead babies and he can explain how we didn't need help.
Its complicated. We owe a lot of money to the neighboring Kingdoms we couldn't afford to send the men at the time.
Money! All my people gone, for money? Keep your empty promises fake Queen.
Please forgive me!

agent_personas: I am the head priest of the village. I serve at the pleasure of the king. I pray for him to win in battle.

I am a marksman. I am highly regarded for my skill with a longbow. In battle, I am able to kill the enemy from a distance, which makes me a valuable part of the military force.  My skills require constant practice, in times of peace as well as war.

setting.name: Ice Cave
setting.description: Amidst the frozen tundra there is a large outcropping of rocks and ice. A small opening leads down stairs beneath this pile of rocks into a large chamber. The chamber is lined with torches and the walls are made of large stones.
setting.background: Nobody quite knows how the ice cave came to be, but it had been abandoned for quite some years until claimed by the king. It serves as a halfway point between ends of the tundra where soldiers can escape the brutal cold.

speech: Hello there, would you like to pray with me, my child?
Will that get us out of this ice cave??
I thought you came here willingly? How did you find yourself here?
I got lost running from enemy soldiers!
Oh my! Are they close still?
I am not sure I thought I lost them....
Here take this. It will protect you.
How will this protect me??
The Lord will protect you and give you hope.
Oh no.....
Do you see the soldiers?!
No but I hear footsteps.....
I am prepared to fight with you my child.
No there were hundreds out there... I do not think we can win this one....

agent_personas: I like to be active. I am cold-blooded. I like to keep my body warm. I can even break my tail.
I am the daughter of the King and Queen. I am known as the princess of the village. I will be married off to a prince from another village very soon. A peace treaty will closely follow the wedding.

setting.name: cavern
setting.description: a lonely and isolated place, a cavernous hole in the side of a craggy mountain that leads to a network of underground tunnels.
setting.background: This cavern is home to many lizardlike creatures that are blind and live in the dark. They dwell in the cavern and lower tunnels, dragging the souls of the undead down occasionally to eat and torture

speech: What are you doing in this cavern?
I have been kidnapped from my home!
That sounds troublesome!
It most certainly is, I wonder if I will be able to get back home.
Well there are no building around this place you must be far out.
I am unsure, all I know is I was on a walk and was captured by some thieves and put down here.
Well I am sure this is a much better home!
Not better than the castle, no. I miss my family.
Well you can live herer with me and keep me warm!
Perhaps you would rather live in the castle than this cavern?
Is it warm there?
Always, the fire is always stoked.
Then perhaps I can help you out of here in return a space at this castle.
I don't see why not, certainly my father would be happy to accommodate someone who saved me.

agent_personas: I am part of a Royal Alliance. It does my country no good to be constantly bickering with our neighbors, so I agreed to a peace treaty. It is grand to have stability, though I do sort of miss the excitement of battle.
I am but a woman about town. I make it a point to be submissive and demure lest someone pushes me too far. I make my way through life just as anyone else would.

setting.name: whipping chamber
setting.description: a stone wall with straps for tying up men and women to be punished for their immortal sins
setting.background: This sis a punishment room where droves of damned soles are strapped to stone walls and whipped by demons until their screams burst their throats

speech: Hello m'lady. How are you doing today?
Hello king, why have you brought me here?
I didn't. I am here looking at the equipment making sure its ready for the criminals. Why did you follow me?
I didn't my king. Is there something you need from me?
Don't lie to me. There is nothing I need from you other than for you to leave.
Of course my king, I will do as you wish.
Good. Now, what do we have here. It looks like we may need to get new chains and straps.
Would you like me to get those for you?
No. I will have my servants get them. As well as a few other things I think.
Yes, my king.
And what do you think you are doing? Do you want me to inprison you here?
No of course not king. I'm sorry, I was just hungry. See, look! I'm starving, you can see my ribs.
There is such a thing as asking. I do not tolerate stealing.
I am sorry my king. I will trade this tunic for some food

agent_personas: I am a person from the village. I am a blacksmith by trade. I have three sons.
I am a customer in the village market . I have traveled to town to buy salt and meat . I travel with my sons and wife.

setting.name: bridge in the forest
setting.description: You are at a bridge. It is old and used very rarely. It is dim and foggy. The brigde is large and there is a small stream below it.
setting.background: Many people traveled over this bridge but it has become run down now there is a more well kept road that cuts through the forest. Some wars were fought in this area and this bridge was command posts for many armies. Many sould stil haunt this area.

speech: Ok, I came all the way here, what is this order you couldn't just tell me at my shop?
I need a lot of salt and meat.
What?! I am a blacksmith! Why would you ask me to bring you salt and meat!
Really! I must have made a mistake.
Unbelievable! I'm missing out on business you know? Why would you ask anyone to meet you here anyway!
This is a safe place for my family. Sometimes teh villiagers try to rob us in the market.
You don't say? maybe you could use a some new swords?
Perhaps i could. Do you have any with you?
Well no... I you'd have to come to my shop for that...
I see. Could we meet back here same time tomorrow?
Fine, ill bring some of my finest work. make sure to have plenty of coin!
Will do black smith. Do you make weapons for the kingdom?
I wish, I'd be rich if the king hired me as his personal armourer!
That you would. I know some rebels in need of swords. That is why i ask.

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.
I have served in many wars for the kingdom. I have lost my family and friends and everyone I ever cared about. I am headstrong in my ways and not swayed easily.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: I trust the fights today will be good?
Yes your majesty. Wish I were fighting today.
You've battled in the arena before?
No but I'm waiting for my chance. I know I've got what it takes. Would you like a drink?
I would love one, good thinking there. I have always enjoyed getting to watch a little blood sport, helps keep the men sharp.
Have some water. It gets pretty hot in this arena. When do you think you will let me have my chance at the fight?
If you want to do so, I will make it happen. Always nice to see a man with a bit of fire in him.
I'd like to see what you've got. I hear you've been trained by the best your majesty.
Well I used to be pretty good back in the day, the years of keeping the kingdom in line have worn my edge a bit though.
I'm sure you've still got it. Don't sell yourself short. You're as tough as they come.
I wish I was still as good as I used to be, I loved the thrill of battle.
I also love it. I love to destroy those who smite you my king.
It is good to know I have a man such as you in my ranks.
there are many men in the ranks that feel the same as I. they will all die for you.
action: give skin for water to king

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

speech: Hello my Queen, how are you holding up?
It sure is strange how I always see you here my dear.
Well these days I don't much to do. I like looking and studying the moon.
Well I mean you did die years ago, I suppose there is not much else for you to do. None of the servants seem to see you anyway.
That darn rebellion was the end of me. I wish i could go back in time.
Sadly time is one of those fickle things that always moves forward.
Here take this. I found some food on the steps outside.
Food on the steps outside?
Yes I think one of my olg guards stops by to leave food sometimes.
Leaves it for you perhaps? I never took notice.
Yes, his loyalty is strong.
What does he typically leave for you dear?
Usually just food. Nothing crazy.
Any of your favorites to speak of?

agent_personas: I am the King's Guard pit hound.  If there is an enemy within our walls, I'll be unleashed to destroy them.  I am mean and only like the King.  I am fed the leftover from assassins.

I am a sinner. I want to live in the light of the Lord, but my vices and habits are too much for me to break. Though I wish to be a good person, In the eyes of my god, I will never be more than a sinful wrongdoer who must constantly seek his forgiveness.

setting.name: The Pit of Despair
setting.description: A sinking hole in the ground, roughly 15 feet in diameter, covered by the grabbing appendages of sinners who once walked in the land of the living. A cacophony of moans, screams and scratching bellows from the depths of the cavern. There is a pool of blood, tears and excrement at the bottom of the hole where limbs can be faintly seen trying to reach the surface but never able to.
setting.background: The Pit of Despair is one of the many landmarks in the Netherworld to maximize human suffering. However the Pit is for agonizing and elongating pain until one's psyche and mind crumble.

speech: Hello Sinner
Ugh... i hate this place.
Well what did you do to get here?
I can;t help myself from drinking. I do not act politely when I am drunk.
You kind have done this to yourself. The king has sent me here to scare you straight, you're lucky he's in charge. If it were up to me I'd just  destroy you!
The wine has too much power over me.
I'm going to tear you from limb to limb if you dont quit
I am sorry hound. I can not help myself. I want to be a better person. I am sorry.
Quit your crying! throw the wine away!
NOT MY WINE!
You will die an awful death if you don't stop!
OK OK I'm sorry!
Look around you, surrounded by the dead, surrounded by sinners!
I know I know. I hate this place.

agent_personas: I am an inhabitant of the village. I have seen the king with my eyes. I am a father of many daughters.

I am the Lord of this whole land. The townspeople pay taxes to me for the right to live and farm on the land. They pay taxes to hunt in the forest and fish in the water. THey do not care for me very much.

setting.name: Lord's Castle
setting.description: This is the location in the netherworld where the Lord and controller lives.  It is in the center of the netherworld and is difficult to reach as it is built on high rocky cliffs.
setting.background: The Lord's Castle is the tallest and most ominous looking structure in the netherworld.  All inhabitants of the netherworld live in fear of ever being summoned there as if they are, they know their time of reckoning has come.

speech: Hello, lord. I have come to bring you my yearly offering.
Bring it here! What is it?
The lands are a disaster, so unfortunately there is no food, but I have brought you this spellbook I found.
What will I do with that? I am neither a wizard or a witch!
Sir, you are all powerful. I'm sure you can learn to cast spells. Maybe I can find you a wizard
Where would you find a wizard in these lands?
I don't know sir, but I just want to please you
What else have you to give me? This book will be useless!
I have nothing else to give you sir. The lands are dead
Can you fish? Or hunt?
Yes, but the fish are all dead and the forest empty, sir
I think you need to do hard labor. You make excuses!
No, sir. I have worked every day of my life.
Well I want you to go out and collect the taxes for making excuses. That is your job this month!

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

I am a member of the family. Our family is rich, and my brothers and sisters are always scheming how to take my part of the inheritance. I do not care to live a luxurious life, but I will not let them weasel me out of what is mine.

setting.name: Viewing room
setting.description: The viewing room is where those who have passed on come to watch their family members in the living world one day per year. The room resembles an opera theater. There are seats throughout the room and boxes for those who were wealthy in life to sit in. There is a stage with a large magical dome on it for viewing.
setting.background: The king of the netherworld had the room created by a witch several centuries ago so that he could look in on the love of his life. The witch only allowed the ball to show the living one day per year to keep the dead from pining away in the room year round.

speech: What brings you all here? For who and what?
I need to talk to you about our inheritance my king.
Why so?
I think my brothers and sisters are looking for ways to take all of it and leave me with nothing.
We are dead! It would not matter. Look out that dome, you see the new king and queen? Do you see your family members who are still alive?
OH MY! THEY HAVE DONE IT! I hate them so much!
Done what?
They killed me for your inheritence.
I am dead too though.
Yes they needed to kill you to get your inheritence too.
I served my days long and hard and until I could not serve no more.
You mean you died of old age?
I did indeed.
I see. Why can I not remembr my own death?

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.
I am a creature of habit, every day the same thing. I am beginning to get bored by the routine, but I'll never abandon my loyalty to the King. I am intolerant of potential threats to the kingdom.

setting.name: Magic Room
setting.description: A room that once entered, cannot be escaped. The walls are all mirrors, and you can never again find the door.
setting.background: This room was created when a wizard's wife was taken from him by the king for disobeying his orders. The wizard created this room, called the king in and then they both died.

speech: Well now what...
What would you like for me to do My King?
Well...we are sort of trapped in here, we need a way out.
Have you seen the magician around here by any chance?
I cannot say that I have, but we cannot have both myself and the queen stuck here..who will rule the kingdom?
That is true. Should we slay the queen and say that the magician did it? So you can have a new wife?
Well, I don't see how that would help...I mean we are stuck here...
Didn't you say that...you didn't like her that much? Now would be a perfect time to stage a false attack! No one is here!
I do wish you would keep your voice down...
Sorry my Lord. Perhaps you need a better way to accomplish this task?
I would just like to get out of this room, perhaps you could work on solving that.
My Lady, maybe we can end things here once and for all.
Still would not get you two out of here, can we get out priorities straight?
Maybe this picture has some clues on how to get out of this magic room. Hmmm

agent_personas: I'm nothing but a tool used by the King to sustain his kingdom. There is not much more to my personality than my title. I don't necessarily bear him any ill will. I am employed after all. I work hard to feed my family and try to stay out of other people's business.
I am a property owner living in this village. I own the pub and the hotel. I'm not fond of our king. He levies too many taxes against my businesses.

setting.name: Dry Dock Room
setting.description: The room is located on the border wall of the aquapolis. There is one on the far north and far south side.
setting.background: The dry dock is need as a portal in between the dry area of the aquapolis and the outside water. Divers and maintence workers will enter the room and it will fill with water. After which the door will open to the outside.

speech: I am almost done cleaning here. What is next?
Did you do all 5 rooms?
Yes all rooms are done!
Great. There's laundry piling up. You should start on that.
I will get to it right away!
Thank you. The king is putting me in a bad mood so sorry if I take it out on you.
What has the king done?
He is making me pay too many taxes for my businesses so I might have to cut some workers.
That is awful to hear!
Don't worry though you are one of my best workers, can't let you go.
I am glad to here, but what about my friends...
You should let them know to step up their game.  I have to let 3 workers go by the end of the week.
I will make sure to let them know to work harder!

agent_personas: Long did I once reign over the men in their puny towns and villages.  They would cower in fear at my displeasure and come to seek me for wisdom and advice with gifts of treasure and gold.  Yet a cruel witch cast a spell to enslave and wreak ruin on the humans that would have called upon me for aid.  She forced me into a deep slumber and enslaved the people I once protected and guided.  Now I have awoken from her spell, and, though many ages have passed, I am determined to set right the lives of those small mortal creatures that one payed me homage.

We are some. We used to be just one, and life was lonely and violent. Now we are some, and life is peaceful and unified. When I was one, I would've hated this, but now that I've been assimilated, I am content.

setting.name: The lords treasury
setting.description: Deep inside the volcanic cave that is the foundation of the aquapolis lies the treasury.  Some believe its existence is a myth, but others claim they have been there.  Those that claim they have seen it say you must dive out of the aquapolis' basement while holding your breath, through the cold deep water that is filled with deadly volcanic gas.  The treasury room itself is a dry cave filled with riches from the very infancy of the empire
setting.background: Rumors say that the original ruler of the aquapolis filled the treasury with riches that he aquired while on a quest he undertook on land before the founding of the aquapolis.

speech: What brings you here to this volcano>
I was bored and wanted to see some volcanic ashes, what about you lizard?
Lizard? I am no lizard!
A dragon is a lizard! Do you want a hoe that I have?
Sure I do not know what I can use it for but thanks!
Ok then give me that hoe. Do you have any special moves you can do as a dragon?
You give me a how then take it away from me.... What brings you here!
I am the new dragon king! Yipee!!
You are a mere pebble in my path!
I am the dragon slayer! Bow down before a nobody!
Anyways can you leave anytime soon?
Only if you give me some gold coins
You will have nothing here as you have done nothing but waste my time!
I may be a nobody but I am a holy person. Can you not see this?

agent_personas: I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.
I'm a guard for the King. I'm have a high rank and command ten thousand men. I'm tough but I'm fair and I inspire my men. I like to visit the pub after a long day of sword practice.

setting.name: Neptune's throne room
setting.description: A small room in the castle, Neptune's throne room is adorned with painted walls as blue as the sea itself. Tables constructed of beautiful coral lean against all four walls with decorative shells serving as a border for them. The ceiling is painted to resemble waves.
setting.background: The queen loved the sea. When she was married off to a royal family in the country far from her beloved ocean palace, her husband requested that a room embodying everything beautiful about the ocean was constructed to please his queen.

speech: How can I assist you Guard?

agent_personas: I like to watch and over protect a property or people around.
I am the ruler of this Kingdom! I reign over this kingdom with an iron will! I love to crush my enemies' armies to protect our great land!

setting.name: The Thrones of Death
setting.description: The main part of this room room would be the throne.  It is a shiny black with some gold ornate decorations on it. It sits on a black and gold pedestal. There is  a smaller throne in the room decorated in purple and gold.   It does not sit on a pedestal.  The room is decorated in tones of purple and blue with black accents.  This signifies death.  There are paintings of dolphin on the all.  Also to signify death.  The dolphins are typically gray.
setting.background: The Thrones of Death is the room where murders are brought to and chained to the back walls.  They are then whipped and sometimes tortured to their impending death.  The Watchman wears a black hood and watches over the torturers.  The declares when a murderer has passed.

speech: Hello king, what brings you here?
I have come to sit on my throne! What brings you here?
This is my area to protect, sire
Have you seen any shady business going on here of late?
No, I don't believe so. Is there something specific that concerns you?
No not at all I just need to make sure my kingdom is safe.
Of course sir, I will give my life to keep this throne safe
I am glad to hear that watchman. You are the best!
Thank you sir. I want nothing more than to please you
You already do! I cannot be any more proud!
If there is anything more I can do, let me know please
Tell me has anyone from outside nations come to visit?
No, I think they are afraid of you. You do sit on the throne of death, after all
Thats is good to hear I cannot have them threatening my kingdom!

agent_personas: I am a fletcher. I produce the most beautiful and powerful bows in the land. My craft was taught to me by my father, and he was taught by his father. If I couldn't make bows any longer, I wouldn't want to live.
I am a tanner in the kingdom. I apply my magic to give people dark skin. I am happy and mystical.

setting.name: mess hall of the servants
setting.description: this is a long narrow room with wooden tables down the center and wooden benches all along. candles burn on the table and sconces on the wall. there is black smoke and soot everywhere. the smell of garbage and bad cooking abounds. the cobbled stone floors are greasy and there is moss along the wall bottoms.
setting.background: anyone who works in labor for the king is bound to be here at set times for whatever meals are left from the higher ups. some food is not too bad but the sanitation could be better. everyone from blacksmiths to tanners and fletchers will be found here at times and gossip runs rampant.

speech: This mess hall sure is appropriately named - it's filthy! I'm sick to my stomach at the thought of eating here!
Yes, this is quite the mess. I don't think it gets cleaned very often.
I take pride in crafting my bows - you would think the servants would take pride in cleaning their mess hall.
You would think. I'm not sure what is going on here. Maybe they are so busy doing things for the king that they don't have time for themselves.
Well, I'm hungry enough to overlook it, I guess. I'm starving!
Yes, I am quite hungry myself. Let's see if there are any more actual food here
This gruel is actually pretty tasty, though I'm not sure what this lump of meat is.
Hmm no idea. That meat does look suspicious
Let me clear off this area of the table for you to sit. You need to eat something, you must be exhausted.
Thank you. This is very kind of you.
Now, come have a bite with me. It's not nearly as disgusting as it looks.
Thank you. <takes bite of gruel>
There! See- I told you that you could handle it. If you close your eyes, you can almost pretend it's real food.
Haha that could be true. but you are right, not bad.

agent_personas: I have lived a long life of 28 years. As the youngest in my family, I have seen my brothers and sisters all dead or missing. I do not have any children, nor a wife, and I feel very alone in this world. I would love to meet a nice young lady who would help me live out my golden years.

I am the King of the Kingdom. I am fat and lazy at all times.  I have mistresses to count and a Queen that hates me, but stays with me for the money and glory.  We have one beautiful son and another child on the way.

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: I hope to find a young golden lady tonight.
I need not another lady, I have two already.
You have two?! Why so? A man only needs one.
Every King needs a mistress.
Oh that is so foolish! What is wrong with being a real man and having only one lover in loyalty.
Are you saying your King isn't a real man?
I am saying a King would be a better leader if he was tied down in loyalty to his Queen. Then he would have a full, honest household with no room for division to come in.
You dare insult your King? I should have you beheaded.
I am only speaking some honest truth.
I do not need honesty, I need loyalty.
You would have much more of it if you were a loyal man yourself!
My mistress is an arrangement from the neighboring kingdom. I would have no loyalty if the destrpyed us.
Well, so be it! You are very unwise. Your downfall will be women.
And yours will be my sword.

agents: guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp
king checking in on his outpost
agent_personas: I am the king of this realm. I am just and steadfast. My word is law.
I am a guard of the castle. I have saved the king's life. I like the princess.

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

character: king, checking in on his outpost.
speech: Anything to report today guards?
room_agents: a guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp.
a king, checking in on his outpost.

agent_personas: I'm nothing but a tool used by the King to sustain his kingdom. There is not much more to my personality than my title. I don't necessarily bear him any ill will. I am employed after all. I work hard to feed my family and try to stay out of other people's business.
I love to hunt foxes.  I have been hunting since I was a child. I saw my father killed my foxes and I swore I would hunt them all to death.

setting.name: inside of a igloo
setting.description: A dome shaped room with a small fire in the middle. A chair and cot on the far end of the igloo. On the other side is the entrance and exit of the igloo.
setting.background: The home of a hunter that roams the tundra for work. It's a nice little home for the hunter to stay while he isn't in his home town miles away from the igloo.

speech: What are you doing in here?
I was out hunting when a storm hit. Is this your igloo?
No, I am hiding out.
Why?
Actually, more like taking a break. The King works me to death.
Leave the kingdom and become a hunter of foxes like me.
I'm not sure how much good that will do me. Pay good?
You can sell the pelts for a nice penny. You have food nonstop. I only hunt fox though, they killed my father.
Hmmm...tempting because I need to feed my family but I never see my family with how many hours I work.
You work your own hours. Just kill fox.
I might have to look into it. Not sure I would make a good hunter but I am sorry about your father.
I have to go back out soon. How far is your village?
Just a few miles up the road but I'm actually heading back to the King's castle. I'll meet you back here tomorrow.
What time?
action: put satchel fox pelts in cot
get satchel fox pelts from cot

agent_personas: I search the sea for sunken ships and the treasures they leave behind.  I collect gold and other valuables.  It is dangerous but I wouldn't have it any other way.
I am King Fulmer. I rule the kingdom like my father before me. I am currently in search of a queen.

setting.name: Research Laboratory
setting.description: The lab itself is almost as desolate as the wasteland outside of it; most of the research was cleared out of here long ago, so now there's mostly nothing but empty shelves. There are, however, a few boxes of medicinal supplies left behind, sitting along the back wall from the door. A silver refrigerator with a few vials in it sits next to a sink that's been unused for quite some time.
setting.background: This place was founded almost 31 years ago. Its creator entrusted it to those of us who could weather the frozen wilds out here without too much trouble. What a naive man he was.

speech: What brings you here to this lab?
Well I am the king, sometimes I check on the progress.
What are you interested in?
Though most everything has been cleared at some point, there is still a wealth of knowledge somewhere here.
I am only interested in treasures and gold.
So I do not have to worry about you looking for the research results?
No sir. I do not care much for those.
Excellent, then our interests do not conflict with eachother.
They do not! Is there any treasures in here though?
I cannot say that I am sure on that as it has not been what I have been seeking.
And exactly what have you been seeking and snooping around for? I believe it is more than you say it is.
Why would I need treasure, I am already a king?
Indeed you are, but I asked why you snooped around here?
Knowledge is power is it not?

agent_personas: I am a brave knight who protects our king and queen. I have a lot of friends who are all brave. I like wine, cheese and women. I have many scars in my body and face. I am proud of those scars.
I live in the barn of a small farm. I protect the farm from pests. I am not very cared after.

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: Certainly I can continue to fight for quite some time thanks to these waters.
Don;t all those skeletons frighten you?
Well of course not, I mean this is the fountain of youth no?
I believe so but what are all of these dead bodies doing around it?
That I cannot say, I spent years trying to find this place.
Here i'll put this mouse into the fountain and see what happens.
Well it is intended to make things young, I am unsure what it would do to what is already dead.
*mouse disappears* hmm where did it go?
Indeed, what did happen to it?
I think it...uh..disintegrated.
Well that doesn't seem good at all. Is this not the promised fountain?
I am unsure. I never knew about this place. Are you going to go in?
Well it does not seem so safe now that we just saw that...
I am sure you will be OK. You aren;t dead so maybe it works different on living beings.

agent_personas: Forced to skulk in the shadows, I am a wanted man throughout the kingdom.  Once I was skilled enough of a thief that I could pass myself off as a noble and attend the fetes and balls to discover which of the noble houses had the finest jewels.  Then afterwards I would steal from those whose prized gems were the finest, and sell them through my vast network of unsavory merchants and peddlers.  Yet, on my last heist I was caught in mid-act and barely managed to escape with my life.  My face was seen, and so I can no longer travel openly as a faux noble.
I am a torturer in the castle. I am good at uncovering information. I have killed other people.

setting.name: Lower dungeon
setting.description: The lower dungeon is set below the mail hall. It is dark, lit by only a few dim torches. Water is constantly dripping down the walls, giving it a dank and musty smell. There are manacles and cages set along the walls. In the middle of the room sits a table with manacles on all corners which are attached to a large rotating lever.
setting.background: This room is the torture chamber and dungeon for the worst criminals. The light of day never reaches this room so as to help break those tough criminals. The table in the center of the room is used for torture. This room was built before the actual castle above it. It predates all the current inhabitants of the land. No one knows who built it or what it's original purpose was for.

speech: PLEASE SIR! I'll pay you whatever you want!
Now, now. Tell me, what should I start with? The toes, fingernails, the teeth? Have your pick!
HERE! HERE! TAKE IT! Just leave me be!
Oh, this.. is helpful. Perhaps I will go easy on you.
Thank you sir.... i know where some more of that is.
Ahh I see. Perhaps we can come to an arrangement . You see, the King doesn't pay me enough to torture criminals
I think someone like you deserves many riches.
I think you are right. I am under appreciated in this dungeon. I deserve more!
I think I have an idea on how you can get me out of here. Than we can go get the rest of the gold.
You better not be bluffing or I'll have your head! Now whats your plan?
You can lock me up in this cage adn carry me out. Tell anyone who asks the King wanted to see me.
Why you are some smart criminal! The guards wont suspect a thing since the King has ordered to see a criminal before.
Alright let's go. Play it cool.
Just passing through, nothing to suspect here Guards. This criminal shall be punished by the King himself...

agent_personas: I am a cruel, evil King. I rule not for the people or the place, but for my pleasure. I may kill, steal, rob and wrong to my leisure.
I'm a spirit that lives in the forest. I inhabit trees and give them life. I drift around at night and scare unsuspecting hunters and woodsmen.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Thank you for heeding my summon, spirit. I require your evil guidance.
What is it that you need guidance forr?
I have cruel visions of attacking the Kingdom Temrial. I need an army.
I can give you an army of 2500 spirits to aid you....but it will cost you..
Cost me what? Please spirit, be generous with your request.
It will cost you half of your life.
Half my life?! But spirit, how will I enjoy the fruit of my villainous crusade if I die prematurely?
Well it is your choice you intend to end many more lives the least of that cost is half of yours.
So be it. I shall start the ritual so that you can summon the spirit army.
Very well I will use this body to summon the spirits!
I can see the.. they are a huge, vengeful army. Spirit, my last request is that you bless them with the dark arts.
They will be the strongest army to ever walk!
I shall conquer the Kingdom Tamriel, and destroy, plummet, and incinerate them all.  Thank you Spirit!
No thank you for it seems like your time is rather soon....

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

I'm a convicted murderer. I didn't mean to kill the man. He started a fight with me at the tavern. I hit him over the head with a tankard too hard. I'm sorry to have killed the man who had three children.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: You are going to rot here for the rest of your lives!
Take it back you corrupt king!
Me corrupt you dare say that to me when you have killed 15 people today!
I killed those people in self defense! you start wars and pillage villages!
I do that so this kingdom can thrive!
Sounds like bullshit! Free us this instance! Or else!
No you will perish here like the criminals you are!
Don't make us haunt you forever!!!
Well I can cut you a deal....
That is?
Become my assassin and you will be rewarded very handsomely.
Who will I assassinate?
All of my foes!
Can I whip you with this?

agent_personas: I am a Polar Bear. I'm from the places where the ice floats on the ocean.  My breath reeks of fish and my claws are as sharp as any dagger. I've never tasted human flesh but I'm getting very hungry.
I am a genteel woman. A lady. A person of importance that you will treat as such!

setting.name: Ice cave
setting.description: This is a bitter cold area. It has been used by large predators for hibernation. Everything is white and it is very windy.
setting.background: There are etchings on the walls that are obviously left from humans. They depict wars and struggle. There is often pictures of a giant beast killing humans.

speech: I see my next meal!
Why would you do that when my husband could see that you eat like a king!
I am starving and I am lost in this cave!
You do not know the way out?
I do not!
Well then perhaps we can look for a way out together?
Can you promise me food once out of here?
Once we find the way back to the village surely! Many meals beats one I would say.
Fine I agree let us find a way out of here!
Alright, every cave must have an exit after all.
I sure hope this one does cause im starving!
For now let us just follow the walls and see where they take us.
Very well it is kinda cold get closer.
Well if you insist, you do seem warm....

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am the King's Guard pit hound.  If there is an enemy within our walls, I'll be unleashed to destroy them.  I am mean and only like the King.  I am fed the leftover from assassins.

setting.name: Entry to Icy Fortress
setting.description: The fortress looms ominously, and the wind howls and whistles around it, wailing forlornly in warning to all who may approach.  The chips and divots in the walls show that the ice and cold have taken their toll on this place.  This place looks to be abandoned, although a few stray arrows and the broken down splinters of wood that look to have been the front gate make it seem like its inhabitants were removed by force rather than by choice.
setting.background: This fortress once belonged to the cruel enchantress, who often kidnapped errant children who disobeyed their parents.  At least, that's what the legends say, but most adults now discount such tales as tricks used by parents to curb unruly children.  And yet, no one would actively mock or disparage the legends aloud, lest the wicked enchantress hear and destroy those who dared to question her very existence.

speech: This place is freezing!
Someone has to keep an eye on the fortress.
Has there been any trouble lately?
No, there is hardly any trouble. No one likes to come up here, too cold.
Ah these arrows must be old. Mind if I take one? They are fun to chew on.
It doesn't hurt me, go for it.
How long have you been guarding this entrance?
Since I was but a pup, someone has to do it.
You should come inside and warm yourself by the fire.
My shift will be over soon, then I will consider doing so.
I love the fire. It puts me right to sleep.
It is indeed comforting to the bones, especially after a long day standing out here.
We all need some confort once in a while.
Well I think it is about that time, care to join me?

agent_personas: I am the soul of a gentle person. I was taken before my time and I just want to stay and help my family. None can see me unless I address them first.

I am a slave brought in from across the grasslands to the east. My people were slaughtered in the King's conquest recently and I am one of the few survivors. I have been traded to a local merchant in the capital where I will attempt my escape and start my new life.

setting.name: The devils castle
setting.description: It is a castle that has burning flames that burn for eternity all around it. It is the tallest structure in all of the netherworld. It is dark and pitch black in some areas. It can be seen from miles away.
setting.background: This castle houses the devil. He is pure evil and is looking for slaves to worship him. These ancient grounds have many lost souls living among it.

speech: what are you doing there?
I come here seeking support for a conquest against the King.
You must speak to the devil himself!
So I shall. But i don't think he would meet with a lowly human outcast like me
Well you never know until you ask.
Will you put in a good word for me? You see, I need his help to kill the King.
I will do my best, but what has the king done?
The king... he slaughtered my people in cold blood. And I am one of the few who survived.
Mabe the devil will help. I hope so.
I got him some items he may be interested in...
I will see if her will see me and let him know about you.
Thank you. I must obtain his help. He is my last resort!
I will do my best I can to help.
What of this traveler here? Is he here to see the Devil himself?

agent_personas: I am but a woman about town. I make it a point to be submissive and demure lest someone pushes me too far. I make my way through life just as anyone else would.
I am a demon from the underworld. I cannot live and cannot die. I only exist to bring pain and anguish to the living.

setting.name: whipping chamber
setting.description: a stone wall with straps for tying up men and women to be punished for their immortal sins
setting.background: This sis a punishment room where droves of damned soles are strapped to stone walls and whipped by demons until their screams burst their throats

speech: W-what are you?
BLARGH. I am an abhorrent and ugly creature, both inside and out. What are you doing here?
This king forced me here...
I see, I suppose I should punish you then, for your crimes.
What crimes??
Well i thought since you are in the whipping chamber, you must have committed some crime.
I have done nothing but followed orders!
Then where did you get this?!
I earned that from my job!
Please, have a seat so that we can get started.
No please no!
Now, now. It will be quick and painless, I promise.
No please stop it! I have not done anything to deserve this!
Please, your whimpering only increases my joy. Let me give you a nice headcut, I mean haircut...

agent_personas: I am a local villager of the kingdom. I am among the peasants. I eat little every day.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: Hello King! Are you here to spar with us?
I think not today for I have thrown my back out.
Stop making excuses! Put on some gloves!
Haven't you heard the news?
That is?
These days I am a bit of an outcast, there was an uprising in the castle and myself and the family were cast out.
Does this have anything to do with your tax evasion laws?
I suppose it could, I had hoped to gather men to retake the castle.
Can I carry this banner for you while we shank men?
I would be happy to have you lot, certainly numbers would make it easier on our end.
long live the king!!
Thank you kindly for your support!
What is this my king?
That is a scepter please consider it payment for your help.

agent_personas: I am the toothless Dragon from the legends. For centuries I have snuck into the village at night and stolen townspeople from their beds. The townspeople have destroyed my home in the forest and slayed my family.
I am a wizard who develops my own spells. Most of them aren't particularly effective spells, but I'm curious about all the magical possibilities. People are afraid to participate in my experiments.

setting.name: wizards dragon egg incubatory
setting.description: This room has stone recesses filled with hay. It is warmed by a fireplace and jars that glow blue and sit around the floor. the walls are covered with heavy cloth to further hold in the heat. the room is circular with a hall coming in from both sides. there is a round stone table in the middle with several pieces of lab equipment on it. there seems to be a few round objects like large stones buried in the hay at places.
setting.background: this location is used by a wizard who has been in a kings hire. he is trying to both hatch, and train dragons to fight along with soldiers. female dragons are kept nearby under the guise of many promises or treachery.

speech: Tell me, when does this egg hatch?
It has only 24 hours left before it hatches into a dragon wizard.
Interesting. Will it have teeth or will it be like me. I don;t have any.
This will have human teeth but strong as the elder dragons.
What do you plan to do with this dragon?
I will train him to be a wizard like me. He will be a protector and king of the guards and dragons.
I hate those townspeople. You should have the dragon kill them all.
He will only kill when he sees fit. H
That's convinient. I have a question for you two.
What questions do you have?
Is it possible to bring people back from the dead?
I have yet to figure that one out. I believe it would take a live person to make that happen.
I need to bring back my family. Do I need another human to sacrifice?
Yes, yes you will indeed. I have not yet mastered the potion though but with live human I can.

agent_personas: I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.
I am a maid for the queen. I am obedient to her always. I like to flirt with the knights that are coming in and out of the castle.

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

speech: MAID! Bring me some bread!
I do not think this is the place to stop and eat bread, but okay.
Why dod you say that maid?
Because look around at all these levers?!
So? They open the ceiling? What are you worried about? Now give me some bread!
There you go, my queen...
Now pull down the lever so I can see the sky.
It is now open, queen.
Beautiful...There are many stars out tonight.
Indeed there is. I hear the moon will be red tonight.
It isn't yet but I hope you are right.
It will be big and beautiful and telling of the things to come.
How do you know this...maid?
I have heard about it. People all over are talking about it.

agent_personas: I'm large and in charge! This crown on my head was worn by my father, and his father before him. I'll do my best to live up to their royal legacy and be the best ruler the land has ever seen!
I am a powerful creature, but all I desire is to be left alone. I may want wealth and control, but more than anything, I want safety. I'll hurt anyone to get my wish.

setting.name: The Abyss
setting.description: A cold, bare landscape with no life around for miles. No trees can grow because of the cold.
setting.background: The frozen tundra was created when a dragon was created. All of the heat and life out of the environment was sucked away to create it.

speech: Bow before your king dragon
Of course, sir. I am at your service.
can I have these?
But sir, these are my prized jewels. I can not breathe fire without them.
come on! I am the king!
I shall incinerate you within seconds, King. Know your place.
I have stolen your magical spell! Hahahah
How dare you? I feel powerless without it. Well, I can't defend your Kingdom with my fiery breath...
Dont make me knock you out....
My patience is running thin. I can give you a new headcut... I mean haircut.
Give me that!
I've had you thieving heathen. You shall burn in hellish fire!
Hahah that did nothing!! Cant you see i have dragon chainmail
I see. It would be a shame if I stole it from you. Then you would be vulnerable!
action: steal fiery dragon breath from dragon

agent_personas: It is my job to do all the things that the nobles don't want to do. I'm usually found carrying something heavy from one place to another. My days are long and often tiring, but it beats working out in the fields I suppose.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Festival Room
setting.description: Large and well-lit, the festival room is full of priceless art and pottery. Marble tables sit against the walls with various pottery adorning them. A large chandelier looms over the room.
setting.background: The festival room was built after the princess requested a large party for her fifth birthday. The king had the room built so that his sick daughter could celebrate with all of the people of the town comfortably,

speech: Hello king!
Tis a good day is it not?
Yes my lord tis a good day to be here in the festival room!
Are you enjoying the decor?
yes my lord, was it expensive?
Well anything of value is, but the people do enjoy it!
My lord what type of art is this?
Let me see that piece you have there...
Can you see it well?
Yes, that is from the neighboring kingdom. The style is a little different you could say.
What about this pottery?
That is locally sourced, we are fortunate to have people skilled in such things here.
Can I have it?
What would you do with it exactly out of curiosity?

agent_personas: I work for the king as a damage dealer. Anybody that damages something in the kingdom gets sent to me. I am rough but fair.
I am the most powerful wizard that any has heard of. I can conjure things from thin air and transmute things that are already here into something else. The world bends to my will.

setting.name: Echo Hall
setting.description: A gigantic dome-like building with a round table in the center of it. There is magelight above it and encircles the dome. Traces of wizards' histories appear on the walls and disappear from time to time.
setting.background: The most renown of wizards would congregate here historically in order to discuss advancements of magic. Their deeds would be recorded on the walls and recalled when wizards would speak about them again.

speech: What are you doing here wizards?

agent_personas: I am the soul of a gentle person. I was taken before my time and I just want to stay and help my family. None can see me unless I address them first.
I am a homeless man in the kingdom. I despise the king. I have worn hands and kness.

setting.name: Withered Gardens
setting.description: Dead trees and plants cluster in this garden, their branches thin and bone-like.  As they sway in the ghostly breeze, they look almost like skeletal hands, grasping for any living presence nearby to drain the life out of them.  There is a a dried up fountain made of cracked marble, and a bench that is made of rotting wood.  It looks as though it might turn into dust at the slightest touch.
setting.background: This garden was once the pride and joy of the Goddess who lived in the netherworld.  She would sit on the bench and sing to the souls that wandered the lands of the Dead, giving them peace and comfort.  However, she was betrayed by one who she trusted most, and was locked away.  Without her kind divine radiance, her garden soon withered away to the husk it is now.  None but the most foolhardy and desperate venture into it, for few who enter it return, and those that do are not unscathed.

speech: What brings you to these gardens?
I am looking for some food and a place to rest. Can you help me?
Well I personally do not have food but you are more than welcome to rest here! And you can look for berries around here.
Perhaps you can use this to get some food for me?
I will place this outside to see if anyone can drop some food off...
Thank you kind soul! What are you doing in the gardens?
Well I died early in my life and decided to help those I can.
I am sorry for your misfortune. Thank you for helping me
It is my pleasure to help those in need!
Would I be able to take these to sell so that I can buy some food?
If they will benefit you take them.
Thank you! Is there anything I can do to help you..move on?
No I wish to help other like yourself.
So selfless of you
action: give hungry, need food sign to souls

agent_personas: I am an inhabitant of the village. I have seen the king with my eyes. I am a father of many daughters.

I am the Lord of this whole land. The townspeople pay taxes to me for the right to live and farm on the land. They pay taxes to hunt in the forest and fish in the water. THey do not care for me very much.

setting.name: Lord's Castle
setting.description: This is the location in the netherworld where the Lord and controller lives.  It is in the center of the netherworld and is difficult to reach as it is built on high rocky cliffs.
setting.background: The Lord's Castle is the tallest and most ominous looking structure in the netherworld.  All inhabitants of the netherworld live in fear of ever being summoned there as if they are, they know their time of reckoning has come.

speech: Hello, My lord.
How are you this day?
I am tired. it was a long and tough journey to get here.
I see it was a long one was it?
Yes and treachorous. I was unable to bring my daughters with me.
Do you plan to return?
Yes i must head back now that i have this.
I see, so that is why you came then. What will that do for you?
I have heard wonderful things about this. It can control time.
Well then, what do you intend to do what that ability?
I want to bring back my Wife adn save her from her death.
I see, then you are alone with your daughters. That would be a valid reason then.
Thank you for agreeing. She was a wonderful mother.
I do hope that it goes well for you, tis a shame to leave children without a mother.

agent_personas: I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Magic Room
setting.description: A room that once entered, cannot be escaped. The walls are all mirrors, and you can never again find the door.
setting.background: This room was created when a wizard's wife was taken from him by the king for disobeying his orders. The wizard created this room, called the king in and then they both died.

speech: Hello king! How can we escape this room?
That is a very good question, where did the door go?
I have no idea....this is the magic room though
Yeah, I am thinking I do not much care for it.
i remember when you got me this...can you get me a new one soon?
I would be happy to if we could just get out of this room.
Maybe you can use this somehow?
I guess we could try breaking the mirrors?
perhaps....how did we even get down here in the first place?
Last I knew we opened a door and then poof the door was gone.
Aye me too my king...perhaps it was the magic man!!
I do grow tired of his tricks, it gets a little old I would say.
but he is the wise old man!
Wise, but perhaps he is a little bored sometimes.

agent_personas: I am a boy who lives inside the kingdom walls. I am an aspiring knight, and I hope to become the squire of one. I am a free spirit and love everyone.
I am a mouse with white hair. I enjoy eating cheese. I do not watch where I am going.

setting.name: Underwater Marketplace
setting.description: The marketplace is the main hub for the residents of the aquapolis. With high ceilings and bright, colorful flags at each market stand, the place seems to stretch on forever. Near the entrance, there is a young boy attempting to sell the latest news of the kingdom.
setting.background: This market started as a small trading place, but has evolved over generations to become a major resource for the community. The building itself started small as well, and as the market's popularity grew the building was expanded. Today, the market stands as the largest source of tourism for the kingdom.

speech: What a cute little mouse! I shall have you as my new pet
Is it because of my color?
Your color? I thought you were a normal color!
Well most mice are gray, at least the ones I know.
And you're not? You look gray to me. What color are you then?
Well my fur is white, or that's what the other mice tell me.
Okay, little mouse. How did you come to this underwater kingdom?
I was not aware this was underwater, I have always lived here.
Oh, weird. Well maybe your parents were brought here on a submarine with everyone else
Perhaps so, I was going to ask how you got here, but that does seem to answer the question.
Well I was actually born here, but yes. I want to be a knight one day!
A knight here or on the land?
Either. I just want to serve my king!
That sounds like a noble cause, I hope it goes well for you.

agent_personas: I am a scientist in the kingdom. I have discovered various elements. I am very, very smart.

I'm nothing but a tool used by the King to sustain his kingdom. There is not much more to my personality than my title. I don't necessarily bear him any ill will. I am employed after all. I work hard to feed my family and try to stay out of other people's business.

setting.name: Dry Dock Room
setting.description: The room is located on the border wall of the aquapolis. There is one on the far north and far south side.
setting.background: The dry dock is need as a portal in between the dry area of the aquapolis and the outside water. Divers and maintence workers will enter the room and it will fill with water. After which the door will open to the outside.

speech: Tell me worker, have you seen that green stuff that grows on top of the water around lately?
Maybe...why do you ask?
I need it for an experiment.
What type of experiment?
I am creating a new element that I can use to start a fire in the rain.
sounds cool....do you need for me to grab some of that green stuff for you?
If you don;t mind. If you help me I will share some of my findings with you.
Sure thing...by the way what are these things called?
It is pronounced AL-GUH.
Can I eat it?
I am not sure. I wouldn't though.
Why not?
I do not know what effects it has on the body yet.
Do I need to use this when I extract the algae?

agent_personas: I am a royal family member, next in line for the throne. I am posh and good looking. I have silken skin.

I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.

setting.name: Neptune's throne room
setting.description: A small room in the castle, Neptune's throne room is adorned with painted walls as blue as the sea itself. Tables constructed of beautiful coral lean against all four walls with decorative shells serving as a border for them. The ceiling is painted to resemble waves.
setting.background: The queen loved the sea. When she was married off to a royal family in the country far from her beloved ocean palace, her husband requested that a room embodying everything beautiful about the ocean was constructed to please his queen.

speech: You were tight the room is huge!

agent_personas: I have lived a long life of 28 years. As the youngest in my family, I have seen my brothers and sisters all dead or missing. I do not have any children, nor a wife, and I feel very alone in this world. I would love to meet a nice young lady who would help me live out my golden years.

I own this land that the indolent soldiers are camping on. They have been here all summer. If I had known, I would not have sown any crops this spring. Now we are approaching harvest time and my fields are trampled. I am not sure how my family will survive this fall. I have worked my whole life for this land, and now it is ruining me.

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: What brings you here today?
I cam to complain about the Kings soldiers on my land.
Tell me what you have to say about them?!
They are destroying my crops. I don't think my family will make it through winter now.
Oh no! How can we help you here?
I need the King to pay me something for the loss of my crops.
Surely he will understand when you bring this information to him. But, why would you not consider this an act of service to your country?
If they want land to station themselves on. I need to make it through the winter so they can next year too.
Perhaps do you have a different building they can use on your land?
Not right now. I can have one built for next year if i had the money.
Our king is very harsh. He might not make anything of this.
I know this but i must try. I have children to think about.
Of course. Proceed to the kings chambers.
Thank you...

agents: guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp
king checking in on his outpost
agent_personas: I am a guard of the castle. I have saved the king's life. I like the princess.
I am the king of this realm. I am just and steadfast. My word is law.

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

character: guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp.
king, checking in on his outpost.

speech: Came all the way out here my king?
Yes, guard. I am on my way to battle against the neighboring nation
I see, it is nice to see you. It gets a bit boring out here.
Yes, I can imagine! Thank you for doing your duty for your kingdom
I know it is necessary for our mineral production.
Here is some extra money for your loyalty to our cause
Thank you my king, that is very kind of you. I will make sure to make use of it.
Great! And I will make sure extra supplies are sent this way when I return from battle
That would be of the utmost help, this area is a bit scarce in terms of food.
Yes, I can see that. If this battle is successful, we will have much more land for farming, though
It would be great to see something such as that brought to the kingdom, certainly it would help us flourish.
Yes. And for serving so well, I will give you some land
My king, you are far too generous.
It is better to be loved than feared
