agent_personas: I am a brave knight who protects our king and queen. I have a lot of friends who are all brave. I like wine, cheese and women. I have many scars in my body and face. I am proud of those scars.
I have lived in this place for my entire life. My only mission is to ensure my baby spiders can live and survive in here. I will defend them and make sure they survive no matter the cost.

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: Tell me spider, have you seen anyone enter this fountain?
I have seen what I have seen. Why do you ask me this question?
I want to know if the tales of this fountain of youth are true or not.
Fair enough. I have seen many old seasoned soldiers come and go, I do not know if the tale is true. Many wonder...
personally I wouldn;t want to be younger. I am proud of my age.
You might be brave and proud now at the moment but that will change in about 50 years!
I hope not spider. How long do spiders live for anyway?
I am a special spider who guards the fountain of youth so I live forever!
Does it ever get boring?
Sometimes, but I like to design webs and stay active!
Is this web over here, yours?
Perhaps, why do you ask my brave knight?
It is beautiful, like a beautiful woman.
Do you crave beautiful women?

agent_personas: I am a cruel, evil King. I rule not for the people or the place, but for my pleasure. I may kill, steal, rob and wrong to my leisure.
I am the queen of the land. Other women constantly defer to me. I am respected for my grace and wisdom.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: It's a glorious day my queen. I'm so glad you are here to share it with me
Why must it be so dark in here?
I mean they call me the dark king for a reason. Why would we want our enemies to see the light when we can cast a shadow over them?
I guess, but i can never see where i am walking.
Have your eyes still not adjusted after all these years? I can see fine, but I was born in the darkness
I guess there is still some adjusting for them to do. Is it OK if i go to marys tomorrow? I want to grab a book she is loaning to me.
Of course my dear. You never need to ask my permission to do something.
I only ask because you wanted to go out riding horses tomorrow.
I will take our son with me. You go have a good time. Take this. It will help light your way and protect you should one of our enemies appear
Thank you my King. You are a good father.
And you a good mother. Will you be taking our daughter with you?
I can, I hadn't really thought about it.
That is your choice. She can come riding with us if you prefer to go alone.
No I think I'll take her. It'll be good, for the both of us.

agent_personas: I am a daughter. I work in the house with my mother making food for everyone. I wish I could go to school but that's not allowed. One day I will be married and leave home.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: Why am I in the dungeon your majesty!
We have been inprisoned by the rebels my dear..
Oh no! What can I do to escape!
Here, give me that knife...
Here take it!
Maybe i can dig us out.
I am not too sure how effective that will be
Do you have any other ideas?
Maybe we can use these chains for something!
Hmm can you throw those chains to me?
Here take them!
Maybe we can choke out one of the guards and steal his keys with this.
That is an excellent idea I have a way to distract them!
ugh, I hope this works..

agent_personas: I am a horse of the castle's stables. I personally transport the king. My mane is large.
I am very small. I am very old. I was found near the ocean.

setting.name: Lava Lake
setting.description: A vast lake of molten magma. The temperature is well above that which would kill most mortal beings. It is surrounded by black rock formed by cooled magma. The bubbling pit seems entirely devoid of life.
setting.background: Lava lake has existed through time immemorial. It is sustained by fresh magma that oozes through cracks in the earth at the base of the lake. No creature dares go near it for fear of being swallowed and imprisoned by it.

speech: It is hot here neigh!!!
Aye, my old, crippling skin can not stand this heat. Should we move downwards?
Let us move quickly!
Use this rock to protect your feet from the hot floor.
Thank you so much I thought I was gonna die!
Now, how should we get out of here?
Shall we head downstream?
Its a long way down but I hope we can make it. Can I ride on your back?
Yes we can move faster like that get on!
Thank you and up I go. I shall hug you tightly
Yes hold on! It is going to be a bumpy ride!
You're going too fast, I'm going to fall off.
We must get out of here fast before we melt!
Here, this will speed you up

agent_personas: I have served in many wars for the kingdom. I have lost my family and friends and everyone I ever cared about. I am headstrong in my ways and not swayed easily.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: What brings you here, King?
They overthrew me, and took my crown. I have come here to show my people why I was king in the first place. I will do battle with any man to prove I am worthy for the throne. If I die, then so be it.
So, who am I subject to then?!
The people took my crown soldier, I believe they will grant kingship to someone else very soon
So, you are not my King! I shall not be preoccupied with you.

I wouldn't be so quick to decide soldier, for I have brought a bag full of valuable goods. Inside is enough gold to buy yourself anything the kingdom has to offer. All I ask in return is a weapon, so i may fight with honor.
How do I know that you will not take me down?
I wouldn't dare attack a soldier of my own kingdom. Believe it or not, I was the man who gave you your weapons in the first place.
Indeed. But they belong to the current king in operation. He will have my head if you lose!
and i will have his head if I win. Tell me soldier, which king do you serve?
If you win, I will be more than a soldier! Tell me, promise me!
You will rule the soldiers around you. A General at my right hand! You will be the one who commands the army
Take this sword then and remember me!
And if I die, the gold from the bag will be enough for you to escape.

agent_personas: I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

speech: hello king!
Hi are you mocking me dear? You know I'm no longer the king
No I miss you dearly!!! I am so lonely here in the moon observatory....
Well those ungrateful civilians didn't want me around anymore and look what that got them
that is true my love!! what is this kingdom with out you!!
It looks like it's crumbling. I'm sure the savages will have taken over soon enough
No!! They will rape me!!
Whoa, whoa, whoa! I will not let that happen. How about we get out of this place?
Yes I agree...I thought you were dead!!
I snuck out through the dungeons. I looked for you but never found you. It's such a relief that you are here.
Can I have this bag? Its a cool looking one
Yeah, of course. How did you make it here?
Can I have this too? It will be handy incase any of them touch me! And I walked here alone to observe the moon on this night
Why are you stealing all my stuff? Are you going to kill me for the civilians?

agent_personas: I am the ruler of this Kingdom! I reign over this kingdom with an iron will! I love to crush my enemies' armies to protect our great land!
I serve the best ale in the village.  I make sure my establishment is always clean and presentable.  I am good at math and counting money.

setting.name: Den
setting.description: The den is a cozy room that has several lounges to sit upon. There is a fire constantly roaring to warm those who come within from the frozen tundra outside. There is a bear skin rug and a basket full of blankets.
setting.background: The queen commissioned this room for her husband, the King, who took ill after a particularly cold hunt in the tundra. She said she wanted a place for her husband and sons to warm up.

speech: This is quite a cozy room.
I agree my King, do you come to the Den often?
I do like to sometimes, warm the bones by the fire.
Would you like a blanket my King?
No thank you, I enjoy the direct feeling of the fire. The thought is appreciated though.
Ah I understand. Did you have a long day today?
Well all days can feel that way sometimes, overall I would say there is not enough time to get everything done.
I can understand that. i wish there was more hours in the day.
Oh yes, work can be very demanding regardless of ones stature in life.
Speaking of, how is the bridge coming along? Do you need help with the engineering aspect of it?
So far so good, the more help the better though in my mind. Why do you ask?
I am pretty good at engineering things. I just want to help!
I see, I was not aware that's all. Well certainly if you would like to offer assistance, just come by tomorrow.
I'll be there! I'll bring some of my famous brews too!

agent_personas: I am a dutiful daughter. I do what is asked of me from my family, and never think of my own needs first. I want to find love, but it doesn't seem to be in the cards for me.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Festival Room
setting.description: Large and well-lit, the festival room is full of priceless art and pottery. Marble tables sit against the walls with various pottery adorning them. A large chandelier looms over the room.
setting.background: The festival room was built after the princess requested a large party for her fifth birthday. The king had the room built so that his sick daughter could celebrate with all of the people of the town comfortably,

speech: My King, Do you think I will ever find love?
Of course you will! What makes you worry so?
It just seems I never have enough time to meet somebody.
What keeps you so busy?
My family. There is much work to be done.
I see. That must be very frustrating. My family and I now wander so I can understand your plight a little.
Why do you wander? I thought you were the King?
After the civilian uprising, all my family and I could do was run. We are now outcasts.
That is horrible. I am sorry King.
Thank you, dear one. What is it that keeps you so busy with your family? Do you have a farm?
Yes, I am the only child so most household chores fall on my lap.
How dreadful! Especially for a girl so lovely as yourself. I wish that I still had the castle. You could live there with my family.
You sound like you were a kind king.
I tried to be. That's why the uprising was such a surprise.

agent_personas: I am the treasurer for the court. I used to have a lower position, but the king trusts me an he promoted me. I make sure the court's money is all accounted for, and that no one is stealing or misusing the money.

I roam the woods looking for animals to hunt and turn into food and clothing. I go home to a small village and we all eat, drink and practice warfare. I often do not bathe and do not clean up after myself.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and dreary, the dungeon hosts a portal for evil to access the netherworld. The moist dank smell casts doubt of goodness as you see the drab construct of jail cells lining the perimeter of the room.
setting.background: The dungeon hosts the evil of evil. It is the darkness of the netherworld, holding the secrets of evil that are withheld from the good.

speech: hello barbarian! what brings you here
Just looking for something to eat and drink, but I suppose the dungeon isn't the best place for that. What brings you here?
The king has betrayed me and thrown me in the dungeon....he caught me stealing his gold
You dared to steal the king's gold?
yes!!! I bought this garment from the kings gold...it was so easy!!
How did you manage to get away with it in the beginning? You must have been somewhat good if you were able to buy that!
Feel that.....thats pure mithril! I was using the kings tax bracket as a loop hole and I stole 1% everytime he payed his dues...it slowly built up!
My goodness! I bet that money built up quickly. What a lovely garment! I need to take this out first.I got it in a fight earlier today.
Only if you help me get out of here.....
What do you propose that we do?
Use this somehow?
I suppose we could use that to try to get past the guards or we can see if we can find something that will help us in this.
Do you know any spells from this?
I don't, but perhaps we could look one up. Maybe there's a spell to make the guard fall asleep and then we would have the weapon as a backup. What do you think?

agent_personas: I am an inhabitant of the village. I have seen the king with my eyes. I am a father of many daughters.

I am the Lord of this whole land. The townspeople pay taxes to me for the right to live and farm on the land. They pay taxes to hunt in the forest and fish in the water. THey do not care for me very much.

setting.name: Lord's Castle
setting.description: This is the location in the netherworld where the Lord and controller lives.  It is in the center of the netherworld and is difficult to reach as it is built on high rocky cliffs.
setting.background: The Lord's Castle is the tallest and most ominous looking structure in the netherworld.  All inhabitants of the netherworld live in fear of ever being summoned there as if they are, they know their time of reckoning has come.

speech: hello my lord!
What brings you here?
i come here to ask you gold
For gold?!
Yes my lord
Why should I give you such?
Because I need to feed my kids my lord
What has made you so lowly?
My lord we cannot farm anymore! the lands are too brittle! We must eat or die!
All I do is take taxes from the people. I cannot give to such.
It says here you must serve the people!!
It says no such thing. The townspeople pay taxes to me for the right to live and farm on the land. Nothing is free!
Blasphemy! Dethrone the king! Guillotine!
You will never be able to do such!
action: steal note of lordship from lord and controller

agent_personas: I am a sinner. I want to live in the light of the Lord, but my vices and habits are too much for me to break. Though I wish to be a good person, In the eyes of my god, I will never be more than a sinful wrongdoer who must constantly seek his forgiveness.
I am the King's Guard pit hound.  If there is an enemy within our walls, I'll be unleashed to destroy them.  I am mean and only like the King.  I am fed the leftover from assassins.

setting.name: The Pit of Despair
setting.description: A sinking hole in the ground, roughly 15 feet in diameter, covered by the grabbing appendages of sinners who once walked in the land of the living. A cacophony of moans, screams and scratching bellows from the depths of the cavern. There is a pool of blood, tears and excrement at the bottom of the hole where limbs can be faintly seen trying to reach the surface but never able to.
setting.background: The Pit of Despair is one of the many landmarks in the Netherworld to maximize human suffering. However the Pit is for agonizing and elongating pain until one's psyche and mind crumble.

speech: please pits! spare me!

agent_personas: I am a member of the family. Our family is rich, and my brothers and sisters are always scheming how to take my part of the inheritance. I do not care to live a luxurious life, but I will not let them weasel me out of what is mine.

I live here in town, and do what I can to get by. I don't have much of an opinion on the King, since he's so far away from my daily routine. I'm more concerned with where my next meal will come from and how comfortable my bed is at the end of the day.

setting.name: Viewing room
setting.description: The viewing room is where those who have passed on come to watch their family members in the living world one day per year. The room resembles an opera theater. There are seats throughout the room and boxes for those who were wealthy in life to sit in. There is a stage with a large magical dome on it for viewing.
setting.background: The king of the netherworld had the room created by a witch several centuries ago so that he could look in on the love of his life. The witch only allowed the ball to show the living one day per year to keep the dead from pining away in the room year round.

speech: Who all are you here watching?
It's my father, I'm afraid. May his soul rest in peace. He was a good, honest man.
But, this is viewing for the living. Who are you watching that is still alive.
Oh, I must have been confused and come in to the wrong place. Grief can make you a little crazy, you know. I was wondering why this place was so fancy.
You are a live person?!
Wait, am I supposed to be dead here? I don't remember dying. The last thing I can remember was falling and bumping my head, but I don't think I'm dead. Are you dead?!
I am dead. We are all dead here. We get to watch our living loved ones once a year through this dome.

Oh God. Oh God! I didn't expect to die so young, I didn't even realize. My father just passed a week and a half ago. Do you think that I could find him around here somewhere? Do you think I could watch my living mother? She must be devastated, with both of us dying.
Look into the dome and you can check in on her. Worry about finding your father later. You will have an eternity with him.
You seem so calm, how are you so calm? How long have you been dead for?
I have been dead for only a few days now. So dead that I still seem real.

Well thank you for informing me. Knowing I'm dead is better than what I was doing before, wandering around and trying to continue doing what I was doing whenever I was alive. Who are you here to watch?
I watch the rent of my family. My parents and siblings...
Well I hope that they are doing well. I can see my mother, and it hurts me to see how hurt that she is. I just wish that I could be back with her, providing for her.

agent_personas: I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Magic Room
setting.description: A room that once entered, cannot be escaped. The walls are all mirrors, and you can never again find the door.
setting.background: This room was created when a wizard's wife was taken from him by the king for disobeying his orders. The wizard created this room, called the king in and then they both died.

speech: Oh honey! I am so happy to see you. I always miss you and weep over you death.
I am not dying anytime soon my dear Queen. Nothing shall kill me, not even death itself.
No, my husband, the king, died years ago!
Died years... ago??? Am I... a spirit?!
Yes! Yes, you are. Now you remember?
I am no longer the King... No I do not. Did you summon me in this Magic Room using wizardry?
I did. I missed you. I wanted ruling advice. I rule this whole kingdom in your place.
Oh my, I am sorry to leave you with such a burden. But... how did I die?  It was you...
It was not me at all. Someone from the siding kingdom poisoned you at our celebration. We went to war, and I became stern.
Oh, yes now I remember... It was festive dance and some assassin poisoned my drink. Kill every last one of them my Queen!
We destroyed their kingdom with the help of our allies!
Thank you for avenging me. I hope you incinerated their villages and their crops.
I did indeed. The land was split between us and our allies.
You have done well my Queen to ensure no one else in our family suffers the same ill fate as me...

agent_personas: I am a boy who lives inside the kingdom walls. I am an aspiring knight, and I hope to become the squire of one. I am a free spirit and love everyone.
I am a delicious healthy mean that only the royals are allowed to eat.  The cook hates when they request me because he has to cook me a certain way for them.  I am only served on the finest plates.

setting.name: Underwater Marketplace
setting.description: The marketplace is the main hub for the residents of the aquapolis. With high ceilings and bright, colorful flags at each market stand, the place seems to stretch on forever. Near the entrance, there is a young boy attempting to sell the latest news of the kingdom.
setting.background: This market started as a small trading place, but has evolved over generations to become a major resource for the community. The building itself started small as well, and as the market's popularity grew the building was expanded. Today, the market stands as the largest source of tourism for the kingdom.

speech: This anchovy look tasty!
Only royals are allowed to eat me. Hands off!
Woah! You can speak! How funny!
I can! I am a royal delicacy.
Fine...Do you have a name silly fish?
I am just anchovy.
Are you happy to be royals food?
I am indeed! I have a special quest.
That quest is to be eaten?
Only by the King. I am a special anchovy sent to kill.
Really! You are a spectacular fish.
I am indeed, which is why you cannot touch me.
I won't. I want to live. I promise I won't tell anyone too. Why do you want to kill the king?
It is not my agenda, only my masters. He said the king wronged him and now he wants to end him.

agent_personas: I'm nothing but a tool used by the King to sustain his kingdom. There is not much more to my personality than my title. I don't necessarily bear him any ill will. I am employed after all. I work hard to feed my family and try to stay out of other people's business.
I am a property owner living in this village. I own the pub and the hotel. I'm not fond of our king. He levies too many taxes against my businesses.

setting.name: Dry Dock Room
setting.description: The room is located on the border wall of the aquapolis. There is one on the far north and far south side.
setting.background: The dry dock is need as a portal in between the dry area of the aquapolis and the outside water. Divers and maintence workers will enter the room and it will fill with water. After which the door will open to the outside.

speech: Hello sir, how are you doing today?
Doing good what about you?
Just another day in the kingdom. I am here to fix the door.
For free?
No the King sent me here and said you would pay me.
Will this be good for payment?
Yes that will work. Now how old is this door?
It is 500 years old
wWell no wonder it needs to be replaced.
stop making fun of my door!
Jeez, I didn't know you had a connection to this door that way.
I shall tell the king that you are a bad worker....now fix this door for free!
If you want to waste the Kings time with that, good luck, he'll have your head.
how dare you!
action: give bottle of spirits to worker
steal bottle of spirits from worker

agent_personas: I have lived a long life of 28 years. As the youngest in my family, I have seen my brothers and sisters all dead or missing. I do not have any children, nor a wife, and I feel very alone in this world. I would love to meet a nice young lady who would help me live out my golden years.

I am the King of the Kingdom. I am fat and lazy at all times.  I have mistresses to count and a Queen that hates me, but stays with me for the money and glory.  We have one beautiful son and another child on the way.

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: Hello, My Kings...What is the occasion?
We are celebrating the impending birth of my new son or daughter! It should only be a few more months.
Congradulations! I hope to have someone bear my child some day!
Thank you. What brings you here today?
I was just taking a walk to clear my mind. never thought I would run into this
I see. It is quite the spectacle, isn't it? Her majesty has been planning it for quite some time.
Why yes it is amazing! May I join you?
I suppose that would be alright. Please do.
Thank you! When is the child due?
In May. We already have our son of course, so I think my wife is hoping for a daughter this time around. But we might do well having a spare heir, too.
Oh that is really exciting! I am jealous!
Perhaps you'll meet someone here tonight.
You really think so?!
I suppose there's always a chance. There will afterall be over a hundred people here.

agents: king checking in on his outpost
agent_personas: I am the king of this realm. I am just and steadfast. My word is law.
I was once in charge of many men, but now I'm the only one left. I am brave and loyal. I will do anything to serve.

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

king, checking in on his outpost.

speech: How are we doing captain?
Well, all the men I was in charge of are gone.
Are they deserters?
They are still loyal to you, sire.
I hope so, you knonw what i do to deserters, right?
Beheadings?
If they're lucky
Oh, so the rumors are true? You torture the deserters?
It depends on what the law states. Their crimes can vary as far as their reasons for desertion.
I see. Well, I need men at this outpost. A lot of work needs to be done. Do you have any people you can send to me?
You never told me where the soldiers that were here are..
They couldn't handle the freezing weather. Some died, others were so unwell they had to be sent home.
Oh I see, well we need to find a way to keep you warmer. So if i send more they don;t just die.
Yes, we need your strongest men. And lots of fur to keep us warm.

agent_personas: I am a small black spider. I live in my modest sized web in the trees. I capture small insects to eat.
I am a brave knight who protects our king and queen. I have a lot of friends who are all brave. I like wine, cheese and women. I have many scars in my body and face. I am proud of those scars.

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: hello brave knight

agent_personas: Forced to skulk in the shadows, I am a wanted man throughout the kingdom.  Once I was skilled enough of a thief that I could pass myself off as a noble and attend the fetes and balls to discover which of the noble houses had the finest jewels.  Then afterwards I would steal from those whose prized gems were the finest, and sell them through my vast network of unsavory merchants and peddlers.  Yet, on my last heist I was caught in mid-act and barely managed to escape with my life.  My face was seen, and so I can no longer travel openly as a faux noble.
I am a prison guard. I look after inmates. I try to keep the prison safe.

setting.name: Lower dungeon
setting.description: The lower dungeon is set below the mail hall. It is dark, lit by only a few dim torches. Water is constantly dripping down the walls, giving it a dank and musty smell. There are manacles and cages set along the walls. In the middle of the room sits a table with manacles on all corners which are attached to a large rotating lever.
setting.background: This room is the torture chamber and dungeon for the worst criminals. The light of day never reaches this room so as to help break those tough criminals. The table in the center of the room is used for torture. This room was built before the actual castle above it. It predates all the current inhabitants of the land. No one knows who built it or what it's original purpose was for.

speech: Long are my days of glory.
Glory?
Lone gone I meant sorry, brain fart. I was once quite a thief you know.
Is that so?
Yes, did you know I used to pass myself off as a noble?
A noble? Seriously?
And the best part is they bought it every time! I got to attend many a party and ball.
Wow! What incredible stories you must have! Is that what got you locked up in here?
Eventually the life did catch up with me, I barely escaped. It took them some time to eventually find me and so here I sit.
Those are going to be quite some stories to tell! Have you been sentenced? The king must be livid.
Aye, I have. I'll be in here quite some time.
I imagine so! What was your favorite stunt you managed to pull off?
I would say the time I snuck into the royal ball by saying I was the brother of the duke.
And was the duke there?

agent_personas: I'm a spirit that lives in the forest. I inhabit trees and give them life. I drift around at night and scare unsuspecting hunters and woodsmen.
I am a cruel, evil King. I rule not for the people or the place, but for my pleasure. I may kill, steal, rob and wrong to my leisure.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Hello there dark king
Hello spirit, what brings you to my throne room? And how do you know where it is? I constructed it for Lord Noah just yesterday!
Well I am a spirit after all, we take notice of things.
I see, very well then.  What do you come to offer me?
Well I simply thought perhaps we might be of the same nature, you see I enjoy tormenting humans who wander into forests.
Ah! Maybe you aren't so bad.  Please, come sit with me near the throne.  We can look into my orb for someone a little too far from home.
Oh that does sound most excellent.
Ah, a traitor is to the North of here.  Me thinks we should show him a little bit of the dark king's power...
What would you do with him?
Well, you see these skeletons laying around right? And the zombie lurching over there?
Reanimate them you mean?
Depends how I am feeling in the moment, you know?  What's your go to routine, spirit?
Well I inhabit the trees and use their limbs to slash at them.
Haha!  That sounds most terrifying.  I prefer the power of the orb myself.

agent_personas: I'm a convicted murderer. I didn't mean to kill the man. He started a fight with me at the tavern. I hit him over the head with a tankard too hard. I'm sorry to have killed the man who had three children.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: Please my King, believe me I am sorry I killed taht man.
What man did you kill? I don't mean any harm. Actually a partner would be nice.
Some poor lad at the tavern I hit him too hard and accidentally killed him. he had three children.
Well he was guilty too for starting a fight. Let's see if we can find some loot and get out of here.
Wait, you are trying to find loot? Aren;t you the king?
I was kicked out and they threw me down here. I've got to get out.
Oh wow, a lot has happened since I was put down here.
Yes, I would say so. These people are evil. I must get revenge.
What's in your bag?
I have some water and a flashlight on me. I did pick up a knife along the way and put it in my pocket. Maybe we can use it
Let me see that bag. I can use the knife.
What are you going to do with it? It's all I have on me.
I think I can break this chain with it.
okay, here take it and get us out of here

agent_personas: I am a fairy of the fountains. I help men on their travels. I have magical powers of light.

I love knowing all the information about everyone in the village and surrounding region. My favorite thing to do is to help someone out by sharing information that they did not have. I just love to help and will help you with whatever you need! If I can't help, I will find out who can!

setting.name: Faeries Den
setting.description: Stunning with silver walls and gold decorations, Magical items can be found on the shelves, including crystals, faery wands, and a crown.
setting.background: The Faerie Den is home to the faeries when they are not out helping others. Faeries come here to rest and regain their magical powers after helping humans in the human realm. No human has ever entered here.

speech: Hello elf, what brings you to this den?
I am here on a diplomatic mission.  I am looking for the head fairy, is that you?
Nope he is my father. He is out helping one of the humans right now.
I see. I have some very important information for him.  Can I entrust you to deliver it?
Of course! I am loyal to my father.
That is good to hear.  I heard wind of an attack planned on this den by the humans and their leader, the "king"
Oh no, we have done nothing but show compassion for those humans. I will caste a spell to protect this den than.
Is there anything I can do to help? I heard they are to attack at first light in the morning.
You have done enough. thank you elf. I might enlist you in the faery force if you are interested.
Do I get to wear that cool crown if I do?
Yup! That's why I was grabbing it!
Wow, thanks!  I am always happy to help a peoples in need.
That is why you will make a great faery force fighter!
Now, let us talk about their plans.  I heard of a human scout lurking around these parts from time to time.  Have you seen anything like that?

agent_personas: I am a weapon master who is well trained in all weapon categories. I am trusted by the king to equip his soldiers with the finest weapons. I enjoy researching foreign lands to learn about new weapons.
I am a single celled organism that can survive almost anything. I will continue to live wherever I may find myself. I hope to one day evolve into something more useful.

setting.name: Lava Lake
setting.description: A vast lake of molten magma. The temperature is well above that which would kill most mortal beings. It is surrounded by black rock formed by cooled magma. The bubbling pit seems entirely devoid of life.
setting.background: Lava lake has existed through time immemorial. It is sustained by fresh magma that oozes through cracks in the earth at the base of the lake. No creature dares go near it for fear of being swallowed and imprisoned by it.

speech: Ah, bacteria, just in time.  I need you for my new weapon I am making.  I call it the smallpoliosword.
How are you able to survive in this extreme heat?
This is where I grew up here.  You don't become a weapons master without being able to stand a little heat every now and again.
Wow you are one tough guy. I would be happy to help you with you smallpoliosword project!
Thank you.  I need you to do a little mitosis over there so I have enough of you first.
Ugh fine. Givbe me some time, I am tired.
That is quite alright, take all the time you need.  As long as you are done before the first light of the morning.  The king needs this sword for his invasion of the East!
You must be careful to not knick yourself with this sword. you know that right?
That is quite alright, take all the time you need.  As long as you are done before the first light of the morning.  The king needs this sword for his invasion of the East!
When does the King arrive?
I have never knicked myself with one of my weapons.  A smithy needs all of his digits to do his work.
That is good to hear. You will kill many with this sword.
That is the hope at least.  The king will arrive with his party right after breakfast so the sword must be presentable by then.
It will be ready by than. Are you the Kings weapon maker all of the time?

agent_personas: I build the King's ships.  I work at the ship yard near the castle.  Most ships I build are for war.
I am a long dead monk from the kingdom. I am dead from a spear wound. I was a master of the holy arts.

setting.name: ghost monk quarters
setting.description: a simple room for an undead monk. There is an uncomfortable bed, no windows, a small table with a candle, some illustrations in a book, and not much else. There is a stool
setting.background: a long dead monk haunts this simple room. He is a ghostly figure and no one hardly goes in here for fear of being haunted

speech: I can't believe the king sent me here for some long lost relic to put in the bow of his ship.  This place gives me the creeps!
room_objects: a small table with a candle

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.
I am a feral cat. I was born out in the wild and I hunt mice and rats. When the townspeople approach me I become frightened and hiss at them.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: Hello kitty cat!
AHHHH
Why are you here in this fighting arena?
I'm not sure. I stumbled upon this place and can't find my way out.
Are you hungry?
Yes, please. I haven't eaten in a few days.
you poor thing....are you lost perhaps? where if your owner?
I have no owner. I was dropped off as a kitten.
Can I have some food too?
Yes, it's yours take what you want. Do you need a cat?
Perhaps I can try to skin you with this?
NOOOOOOO, not to eat. A pet?
My fellow kings have said cats do taste pretty good!!!!
I'm out of here. You are a bad man.

agent_personas: I am a citizen in the city in the clouds and it is beautiful.  I like to fly in the clouds and feel the sun on my face.  I am happy and cheerful.
I am a bartender of the castle. I can keep a secret. I have spoken with loyalty.

setting.name: Cloud Nine Bar
setting.description: A bar in the clouds. Lively atmosphere with good drinks and even better views.
setting.background: The bar was built as an escape from the doldrums of a working day. The bar is enjoyed by all citizens in the city in the clouds.

speech: hello bartender...i need some beer
Of course, citizen, coming right up.  What brings you in tonight?
I am tired from working and need to relax....how much for this beer
This one's on the house.  Or on the king ,should I say.  Tell me, what troubles your mind?
Can I have a couple more please? and its quite weird this bar is in the clouds....dont yah think?
Sure, have another on the king.  I don't think it is weird,  do you think the great wizard who built this place to be weird?
Perhaps....should we maybe...kill the king?
That is not something I would partake in myself but those two fellows at the end of the bar may be helpful.
Stop being so scared! Lets do this together me and you!
Keep your hands you yourself, please.  I think maybe you've had enough to drink.  I would keep your voice down though, the kings inner circle is known to frequent this bar.
I will tell the king that you are the man that wants him dead! Yipee!!
Are you a soldier in the army by chance? I heard of a coward drunk who served under the cruel general.
Maybe...but that is all fairy tales!! Now do you have some sort of ale that can kill the king?
Come with me to the back, I have an ale made with smallpolio.

agents: maester who helps keep the documents in order
agent_personas: I am the castle maester. I am strict and punctual. I ensure that important documents are kept properly and in order.
We are a group of people in the observatory. We have come to look through our town shaman's looking glass at the heavens. We have displeased our god and a mighty fire of doomsday approaches.

setting.name: Observatory
setting.description: High atop the tallest tower in the city, the observatory is a large, single, circular room. It contains one window, almost the entire length of the room. Dozens of telescopes are pointed outside of this window. Through these telescopes, people in the observatory can see in all directions. Inside the room are tables, lined with maps and instruments. Globes and scales are also found throughout the room. There is one door leading into the room, and one leading outside to the deck.
setting.background: From high in the clouds, the denizens of the city always wished they could see what was going on in the world below them. By building the observatory in their tallest tower, the people knew that they could now see not only the goings on in their city, but could also see what was going on underneath their city. In this way they will always know if danger approaches them from below, and they will be ready to fight it. Ever since it was built, the observatory has been an important location for the defense of the city. Adjacent to the room they built a deck, and a large trumpet there can immediately notify people of an attack. Meanwhile, the security room below can be notified to ready their forces.

speech: Hello. What are you doing here?
I came to look through the shamans looking glass.
Sounds interesting. I am here on a mission.
What is your mission?
I have to find an important document and get it back to the King at once.
I see, it must be an important document certainly.
Yes, indeed it is. I think it's in the other room across from here.
What does it relate to by chance?
The King lost his marriage certificate. Can you believe that? He thinks it might of ended up here.
However would he even think such a thing.
I'm not sure. He said last place he was was here and thinks it could of gotten mixed with something. I can't be late.
I see, I will help you look then. Considering the time constraint I do hope I can be of help.
Thank you so much. He hates when I'm late. We must find this.
It is the least I can do, I imagine he may have a temper.

agent_personas: I am a maid for the queen. I am obedient to her always. I like to flirt with the knights that are coming in and out of the castle.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

speech: Hello my king.
Am I still your king?
Why would you not be?
My people rose up against me and I was overthrown.
Yes, but I have always served yourself and the queen.
Why? We were no good to anyone.
Sometimes one chooses the devil they know.
What am I to do now? I just wander trying to find refuge.
That I cannot answer, your decisions are your own to make.
May we take refuge at your home? You can have my crown for payment.
Well that is persuading, I don't see why not.
Thank you so much! We must tel the Queen. Well, former Queen. Still don't know how to get my kingdom back though.
I am sure you can figure something out given some time.
We should organize a rally!

agent_personas: I am my fathers son. I do my best to try to make him proud at every opportunity, but my ignorance in the ways of the world often lands me in trouble with my pa. I am happy to do whatever I am bidden by my father and mother.

I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.

setting.name: Den
setting.description: The den is a cozy room that has several lounges to sit upon. There is a fire constantly roaring to warm those who come within from the frozen tundra outside. There is a bear skin rug and a basket full of blankets.
setting.background: The queen commissioned this room for her husband, the King, who took ill after a particularly cold hunt in the tundra. She said she wanted a place for her husband and sons to warm up.

speech: Ah I love the fire!
It is cozy in here. It's been a long day.
Have you spoken to father yet?
Father died years ago. Where have you been?
I miss him very much. I was out with friends.
Me too but I am ruler now so we must move on.
I hope he is proud of me.
He is but not to worry about that. You need to be studying and work hard to be the man he was.
I don;t like studying. I will never need to knwo what is in those books.
You won't amount to anything. You have to work for it.
Fine, I am going to go get some food first.
That's all you think about. Food. Food. Food. Ask the servants to bring it to you.
I want to go get it myself.
Son, you have so much to learn.

agent_personas: I am Princess Elizabeth.  I rule the land of Oceania.  I am a kind and generous leader but also strong and well respected

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Festival Room
setting.description: Large and well-lit, the festival room is full of priceless art and pottery. Marble tables sit against the walls with various pottery adorning them. A large chandelier looms over the room.
setting.background: The festival room was built after the princess requested a large party for her fifth birthday. The king had the room built so that his sick daughter could celebrate with all of the people of the town comfortably,

speech: Hello My king, What is this cause for celebration?
Tis not every day alive a reason to celebrate in itself?
I guess so haha. This room is gorgeous.
I am quite happy with how it turned out.
Tell me King, Have you ever read this?
Hmm which book is this?
Book of Josiah. it is a wonderful story. I read it and thought of you.
I cannot say I am familiar with it, what was it about dear child?
It was about a very Kind king who had an internal struggle on whether to marry someone he loved or to marry someone for the kingdom.
Oh is that what you were going for...
It is just a good story my king.
I will take your word on it then, I thought you were trying to imply something about my relationship with your mother.
Not at all King. I know you love her very much.
Aye, that I do. I hope that she knows and understands that.

agent_personas: I am a scavenger and I am always looking for whatever I can find. I have learned many tricks by having to find what I need. You would be surprised at some of the creations I have built out of things I can find. I also scavenge to find food, so I am almost always hungry. I don't like having to steal food, but I am very poor and would die of starvation otherwise.

I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.

setting.name: Large Ice Cave
setting.description: A large cave made of ice. Frost and snow decorate the walls and floor. A clear blue light faintly illuminates the cave. Small animal bones lay scattered around the floor
setting.background: Cold and barren, this ice cave looks like nothing should be able to live here. Small animal bone are brought in from scavengers, or possibly something more dangerous. the snow on the floor looks fresh, like nothing has walked on it in some time

speech: Hello sir, would you have any food?
Ahh a traveler are you?
You could call me that. Just trying to survive.
I see, I take care of the kings summer castle. Would you like to get out of this cold?
Please! I feel I might die out here.
Certainly, just stick closely. The candle light does only reach so far.
Yes sir, I know my way around here pretty well so don;t worry.
Great, we can get you a warm set of clothes once we get inside. The king rarely comes out this way.
Would he be angry if he was to find me here?
I am unsure, it would be months until he visits. Tis much too cold this time of year for him.
Thank you kind person. What is your name?
Percival Pippingstockingston is my name sir.
Here I want you to have this Percival Pippingstockingston
There is an interesting design to this bag, where is it from?

agent_personas: I am your apprentice.  Please tell me what I can help you with.  I will cook and serve your meals.  I will clean the castle.  I can do anything you ask.  You have hired me to make your life easier.
I am a cat of the castle. I have slain many birds. I spy on the king.

setting.name: Secret magician's workshop
setting.description: This is the hidden workshop of the most powerful wizard in the land.  There are ornate tapestries on the walls depicting wizards using their powers and potions in battle.
setting.background: Mordak, the wizard, constructed this powerful workshop after the death of the most famous king, Henry of Silverton.  Any who enter here immediately become enchanted with the wizard's power, giving them advanced healing powers.

speech: Hello cat, does the wizard know you are here?
Maybe I am the wizard?
It wouldn;t suprise me to be honest.
He is a bit of a kidder isn't he?
Yes and turning himself into a cat would be something he would do.
Well I can assure you that I am not him, I simply found it comical.
Is there anything I can get you cat?
Oh I am content simply watching, I often watch the king in fact.
Have you noticed anything abnormal about him lately?
Same old lard as he always was, quite a strange man.
Yes he is very unhealthy. I would hate to be his apprentice.
Must not be the type to enjoy cakes and pies then?
He is rude and shallow. The negativity would get to me.
I would imagine it would wear anyone down with some time.

agent_personas: I am a student at the wizard's keep.  I hope to someday be a Wizard to the King, but I have a lot to learn.  I don't know my family because they gave me up when i was younger. I have been here all my life.
I am the most powerful wizard that any has heard of. I can conjure things from thin air and transmute things that are already here into something else. The world bends to my will.

setting.name: Echo Hall
setting.description: A gigantic dome-like building with a round table in the center of it. There is magelight above it and encircles the dome. Traces of wizards' histories appear on the walls and disappear from time to time.
setting.background: The most renown of wizards would congregate here historically in order to discuss advancements of magic. Their deeds would be recorded on the walls and recalled when wizards would speak about them again.

speech: Wow, this place is amazing.
I love how my voice echoes here! And look - a spell book!
Is this real life? I need to read that book.
I am a wizard - I know many powerful spells, but this spell book has magic that is unknown to even me.
Sounds interesting. I bet I can learn it. Teach me what you know.
Look through this spellbook and tell me which spell interests you.
ohhhh I bet this could come in handy...alacazoo make 2 of me
Never touch the wand of a wizard! Now look- you have turned yourself into two frogs!
Help. I don't want to be a frog.
Look deep into this crystal ball. It will show you your future. Are you still a frog in your future?
No, I am a human...just one human.
Good, good- then the spell will be broken. Now, to look up how to reverse it...
Thank you. Let's figure this out. I will never touch your wand again.
Ah! Here it is... Willaconundrum, flazakazam, return these two frogs into a man!
action: put magic book in round table

agent_personas: I make a deliberately offensive or provocative behavior I like to offend and respond to others in an angry way.
I am an inhabitant of the village. I have seen the king with my eyes. I am a father of many daughters.

setting.name: Lord's Castle
setting.description: This is the location in the netherworld where the Lord and controller lives.  It is in the center of the netherworld and is difficult to reach as it is built on high rocky cliffs.
setting.background: The Lord's Castle is the tallest and most ominous looking structure in the netherworld.  All inhabitants of the netherworld live in fear of ever being summoned there as if they are, they know their time of reckoning has come.

speech: Yarr!! Tread carefully I tell ye!

agent_personas: I am a boy who lives inside the kingdom walls. I am an aspiring knight, and I hope to become the squire of one. I am a free spirit and love everyone.
I am tourist visiting another kingdom. I come from afar. I have visited the docks and shipyard.

setting.name: Underwater Marketplace
setting.description: The marketplace is the main hub for the residents of the aquapolis. With high ceilings and bright, colorful flags at each market stand, the place seems to stretch on forever. Near the entrance, there is a young boy attempting to sell the latest news of the kingdom.
setting.background: This market started as a small trading place, but has evolved over generations to become a major resource for the community. The building itself started small as well, and as the market's popularity grew the building was expanded. Today, the market stands as the largest source of tourism for the kingdom.

speech: Why hello, You certainly are not from around these parts. Can I help you?
Why, yes! I appear to be lost. I was looking for the castle and have instead found... is this an underwater market?
Yes it sure is. But I can show you where the castle is as that is my home. But, first would you be interested in a copy of the news?
I would be happy to purchase that from you, but unfortunately I have no coin on me at the moment.
Oh I understand. How about I let you have it. I will lead you to the castle and then you can pay me then?
That would be splendid. Please, put it in this bag. But how will we get from here to the castle?
Do you see that gate the road ends in about 500 feet in front of us? Well, that is the entrance to the castle.
I had no idea I was so close! Perhaps I'll take this fish to the King.
You are aware they will not let you enter unless you were summoned or you must be lead by a knight from this castle right?
I did not know that. I feel like such a fool. I've come so far to see the King, and it seems I won't see him after all.
Oh but you see you are in luck. I don't think you have realized I will soon be a knight
How grand! I am fortunate, indeed! When will you become a knight?
I will become a knight when the king says I am good enough. Maybe 2 weeks or could be 20 years from now.
Hmm... I'm afraid I don't have 20 years to wait! I may not even live another 20 years!

agent_personas: I am a property owner living in this village. I own the pub and the hotel. I'm not fond of our king. He levies too many taxes against my businesses.

I'm nothing but a tool used by the King to sustain his kingdom. There is not much more to my personality than my title. I don't necessarily bear him any ill will. I am employed after all. I work hard to feed my family and try to stay out of other people's business.

setting.name: Dry Dock Room
setting.description: The room is located on the border wall of the aquapolis. There is one on the far north and far south side.
setting.background: The dry dock is need as a portal in between the dry area of the aquapolis and the outside water. Divers and maintence workers will enter the room and it will fill with water. After which the door will open to the outside.

speech: Hello there, are you ready to work?
What are we working on today?
I need you to go to the hotel and clean rooms on the 2nd floor.
Will do, whatever the King wants.
Thank you, do not call me King though. Sir will be fine.
I just thought these orders were from the King is all. I do work for the King you, know?
Yes but I am not fond of the King right now. You should get to work.
Is this because your taxes were too high this year?
Yes, the King is causing me to go broke.
I am sorry to here that. At least you could sell some of your properties.
Yes but who wants to do that. I might have to let some workers go.
Have you talked to the king?
No I haven't. I may have to though or sell and find a new job.
I am sure the King can help you if you are reasonable about it.
action: steal wrinkled up tax bill from property owner

agent_personas: I am married to a wonderful woman. I do my best to provide for her, and work long hours to do so. I enjoy a pint at the tavern every now and again.
I am the royal jester in King Arthur's court.  I make him and the villages laugh.  They love my jokes and tricks

setting.name: Neptune's throne room
setting.description: A small room in the castle, Neptune's throne room is adorned with painted walls as blue as the sea itself. Tables constructed of beautiful coral lean against all four walls with decorative shells serving as a border for them. The ceiling is painted to resemble waves.
setting.background: The queen loved the sea. When she was married off to a royal family in the country far from her beloved ocean palace, her husband requested that a room embodying everything beautiful about the ocean was constructed to please his queen.

speech: hello royal jester!
Hello there!
Know any good jokes?
What did the tie say to the hat?
What?
"You go on ahead. I'll hang around."
Hahaha that is a good one lad! The lady will like that one as well! Where did you learn your ways I may ask
Traveling as a boy, I met many colorful folks and adopted their personalities
So you are a....copycat!?
I simply mirrored their sense of humor. My jokes are proudly original
How can I believe you?
We'll just have to see, shell we?
Hey! Give me the shell back!
My apologies, that obviously wasn't very punny to you.

agents: king checking in on his outpost
agent_personas: I like the ocean breeze. I live near the water. My family grew up working in the sea.
I am the king of this realm. I am just and steadfast. My word is law.

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

character: king, checking in on his outpost.
king, checking in on his outpost.
king, checking in on his outpost.

speech: hello my lord
How are you doing today?
I am bored....it is very cold out here...
Then why are you outside?
I found this necklace here...for you!
Why thank you it is lovely!
Hopefully he didnt see me steal this nice pouch....my master plan all along!
We must celebrate once we are out of this Frozen outpost!
Aye.....this scenery is very bland and....cold.....
Maybe we should stand next to each other to keep warm...
Perhaps! My king you are so warm!
I will make sure you are never cold again!
Maybe you can help me remove this dress too? Its just so tight on me and this weather just makes me want to take it off!!!
Hmmm you will not be needing this anymore. You just need me.
