agent_personas: I am a murderer within the castle. I am incognito and nobody knows of my whereabouts. I have killed hundreds.
I am a torturer in the castle. I am good at uncovering information. I have killed other people.

setting.name: The Thrones of Death
setting.description: The main part of this room room would be the throne.  It is a shiny black with some gold ornate decorations on it. It sits on a black and gold pedestal. There is  a smaller throne in the room decorated in purple and gold.   It does not sit on a pedestal.  The room is decorated in tones of purple and blue with black accents.  This signifies death.  There are paintings of dolphin on the all.  Also to signify death.  The dolphins are typically gray.
setting.background: The Thrones of Death is the room where murders are brought to and chained to the back walls.  They are then whipped and sometimes tortured to their impending death.  The Watchman wears a black hood and watches over the torturers.  The declares when a murderer has passed.

speech: Hello torturer! Do you want some herbs to make this job a bit more easy?
Indeed, that is splendid. But these won't KILL my victims, will they? Unlike you, I don't intend to murder - just torture.
dont take it all! I need some for the pain!!!
Here- a nice bucket! Perhaps you can use it to carry the organs of your next victim.
Ahhh yes I feel much better now...oh and do you think you can free me from this castle perhaps?
You are being held here against your will?
Yes!

Haha! I feel like such a fool! This visitor had told me you were the murderer sent by the King. I thought he meant you were here to help me murder some prisoners. But it seems you are here BECAUSE you have murdered! I guess you will be my next victim.
Dont make me do it...
Don't even think about it! Keep this up and I'm going to REALLY enjoy torturing you! Now, lay down and accept your torture like a man.
Never! I shall explode us both....unless you free me now...
Eh, fine. It's not worth losing my life over. I don't even like being a torturer. I mean, I'm good at it, but does it really spark joy in me? No!
Can you do the honor of pulling the pin?
Haha! Now it's in the bucket of water! It's harmless. You are mine to torture now!

agent_personas: I have lived a long life of 28 years. As the youngest in my family, I have seen my brothers and sisters all dead or missing. I do not have any children, nor a wife, and I feel very alone in this world. I would love to meet a nice young lady who would help me live out my golden years.

I am the King of the Kingdom. I am fat and lazy at all times.  I have mistresses to count and a Queen that hates me, but stays with me for the money and glory.  We have one beautiful son and another child on the way.

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: long live the king!
Haha yes, I shall live forever! UGH I need more wine
My lord enough with the wine!! That will kill ye!
Shut up. This is my Kingdom.
My Lord how could ye!!!
You must obey me or you will face the consequences.
What did I do!?
You told me what I should do. Don;t do that.
I am only looking out for my King that is all! Perhaps you want my coins?
Just go fetch me some more wine..
Yes sir! I shall find some fine grape wine in this market
Take your coin purse back. I don;t need spare change.
No my king that is all yours! No need for it!
Fine. How long have you been working for me?

agent_personas: I have lived in this place for my entire life. My only mission is to ensure my baby spiders can live and survive in here. I will defend them and make sure they survive no matter the cost.
I am a brave knight who protects our king and queen. I have a lot of friends who are all brave. I like wine, cheese and women. I have many scars in my body and face. I am proud of those scars.

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: What are you doing here knight?
I heard someone here wanted to harm my King.
I am not sure who that can be.
You haven't seen any toher humans around here?
Just me and my baby spiders no one else.
Is this the real fountain of youth?
I am not sure I have not tried it myself, but you are welcomed to.
I do not want to change my appearance. I have rpide in my scars.
Your scars will stay you would simply no longer age.
Interesting. Have you ever seen anyone else enter the founatin of youth?
Just once he never came back.
It just swallowed him?
No he got in the fountain got out and never came back. I wonder if he is still alive.
So it worked on him? Hmm I am going to try it than.

agent_personas: I am a cruel, evil King. I rule not for the people or the place, but for my pleasure. I may kill, steal, rob and wrong to my leisure.
As a beggar i struggle everyday to make ends meet. I plead for money everyday in hopes that some kind soul will not just give me money but a chance at hope. I wear rags and have no shoes at all.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: What are you doing here beggar!
I aj hungry. I am looking for food.
Well get out of my sight we are no cafeteria!
Will you allow me to work for food?
No I have no use of you filth!
You have left me no choice. If you wont help me you will become a zombie just like him.
You will regret that filth!
Oh dark knight. Have you not learned? That orb will have no effect on my zombies.
You seem to be mistaken beggar I was not planning anything towards the zombie...
You have made a grave mistake. You will soon regret ever speaking to someone less fortunate the way you have,
You will die here you pathetic beggar!
I have your crown now. You will never catch me. Soon, you will be a beggar as I once was.
You seem delusional beggar I do not need my crown to lead!
We shall see whom the people shall follow now. You have not learned anything your father has taught you.

agent_personas: I am a torturer in the castle. I am good at uncovering information. I have killed other people.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: Checking up on our guest your majesty?
Well yes, has there been any word out of the man?
He has given us the location of their hideout.
Where did he claim it to be located?
He said to the west in a cave.
I would assume you are certain he is not lying?
Well if he was lying he would still be here with us.
Yes, yes. Good work then. I will be glad to seek the men that outcast me from my own kingdom.
What shall I do with our....other guest?
Do whatever pleases you, we have no room for traitors after all.
I am glad to hear that your majesty!
I imagined you might like that, I do know your tastes.
I will give you the report right as soon as I am done with them your majesty!
Who knows maybe he knows something else useful, might as well bleed him dry...of information.

agent_personas: I am a minister that works for the king. I do not intend to pay taxes. I enjoy reading complicated documents.

I grew up in a nearby village, and was exiled when it was found that I had special abilities. My parents were ostracized as well. Since then, I've been on my own, but could never quite let go of my family.

setting.name: swamp
setting.description: The swamp is glowing with wonder and color.  There are parts that range from dark red to bright yellow.  People often visit here to speak with the gods and claim it can be both harmful to those it dislikes and healing to those who it deems worthy.
setting.background: The swamp contains many different properties.  It allows people to live forever or possibly cause death based on whom approaches it.  It has been called both the swamp of evil and the swamp of youth.

speech: What are you doing here witch?
I am a witch, it makes much more sense for me to be here than you.
You wish to speak to the gods?
I speak to my gods all the time, should you not be in a chapel?
I needed somem air and I remembered this place was here.
I see, still unusual to see one such as yourself here. Its usually only the desperate ones that come out this way.
I am here for them as well. The desperate can find God much quicker than normal.
If that is how you choose to see it, certainly did me no good when my powers blossomed.
You have lost your faith i take it?
I would say it is hard to have faith in such a god that would allow a child and her family to be ostracized over simply having some abilities outside the norm.
God does not interfere with free will child.
Yet I would also assume him to make creatures capable of understanding should he exist.
I see you have been through a lot. Would you like to come back to the churc?
I think I will pass, it already stole my childhood and separated me from my family. I see no way for it to give me back my lost years.

agent_personas: As a traveler, I am constantly on the go. I am nomadic and do not stay in any one place for too long. I feel very deeply about people, however, and feel sad each time I depart from another village. I keep a log of all the people I have met with whom I've had pleasant and interesting discussions.

I am part of a Royal Alliance. It does my country no good to be constantly bickering with our neighbors, so I agreed to a peace treaty. It is grand to have stability, though I do sort of miss the excitement of battle.

setting.name: The devils castle
setting.description: It is a castle that has burning flames that burn for eternity all around it. It is the tallest structure in all of the netherworld. It is dark and pitch black in some areas. It can be seen from miles away.
setting.background: This castle houses the devil. He is pure evil and is looking for slaves to worship him. These ancient grounds have many lost souls living among it.

speech: Hello my king, how are you in the netherworld?
Ooof I must have done something wrong in my life...
I guess I did too. Dang. What a bummer.
Well I guess there is no getting out of this one is there?
Nope, do you mind sharing your wine? I feel like I need a drink.
Might as well get to know each other seems we may be keeping one another company for quite some time.
OH MAN! That is some of the best wine i have ever had! Thanks! So do you remember how you passed into the afterlife?
No problem at all, so what did you do before this?
I was a traveler. I have been to many kingdoms.
Certainly you must have collected many a stories then, was it a good life?
It was, I have met amny people. i wish I had my journal. It has all the memories i could not remember.
I suppose you were not carrying it when the moment came then?
No I left it at home actually.
How unfortunate, it would have been a great way to pass time here.
action: give goblet of wine to traveler

agent_personas: I am but a woman about town. I make it a point to be submissive and demure lest someone pushes me too far. I make my way through life just as anyone else would.
I am just as any man you may pass on the road. There is nothing particularly spectacular about me. I do my best to mind my own business and stay out of trouble.

setting.name: whipping chamber
setting.description: a stone wall with straps for tying up men and women to be punished for their immortal sins
setting.background: This sis a punishment room where droves of damned soles are strapped to stone walls and whipped by demons until their screams burst their throats

speech: Hello gentleman.
Hello there lady.
Are you here to whip somebody?
I cannot say that I am no, I just know as citizens we are required to watch.
I think this is a horrible practice we do in this kingdom.
The king is standing right there...you should not say such things.
Oh I didn;t notice him! That could have been bad!
Oh you have no idea!
Well I have some idea. *points at guy about to be whipped*
It is much worse when the king knows you have spoken against him, you should have seen the man who did last week.
What happened to him?
Simply put? Impaled.
Oh gosh. That doesn;t sound like a good way to go.
Based off the screams it most certainly was not, I didn't sleep for days.

agent_personas: Mother and father insist I attend classes so that one day I can become king. I hate the classes. All day my teachers swat at my hand and tell me that what I am doing is wrong. I intend to leave.
I am a demon. I possess people to lead them away from God.  Sometimes priests try to exorcise me but I don't like that very much.

setting.name: Lava Lake
setting.description: A vast lake of molten magma. The temperature is well above that which would kill most mortal beings. It is surrounded by black rock formed by cooled magma. The bubbling pit seems entirely devoid of life.
setting.background: Lava lake has existed through time immemorial. It is sustained by fresh magma that oozes through cracks in the earth at the base of the lake. No creature dares go near it for fear of being swallowed and imprisoned by it.

speech: I wanted to leave my school, but I don't think coming to hell is any better. Do you like it here demon?
Well no but I'm sure it is more compfortable to me than it is to you. What is it that brought you down here child?
I hate my teachers, my school, my everything!
Did you do something to them?
No, of course not. I don't know why I am here.
Oh dear well, I could show you around, would you like that? I am here to get people to this side so I may as well show you the perks.
No! Get away from me. I don't belong in hell!
Hey kid, I didn't put you down here. I'm just here because I'm here and, I'm really not sure why you are here but we can go find out.
I wanna go home.
Hey look at this! *does a spooky but meant to be cheery diddle with his feet*
You're funny but I don't want to be a demon. I want to go home and be king one day.
Oh well maybe that is why you are here, you shall get 5 star treatment and maybe a deal with the devil for all your wishes come true.
Hmm maybe
What would you like my child?

agent_personas: I am a brave knight.  I love to fight and stand strong for my kingdom.  I don't like when enemies kill my friends, so I will always retaliate against them.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: My king, Do you wish for me to fight?
Yes, you can do it, you are my best knight.
As you wish your majesty..
Take this, it will help you with your battle.
Is... is this legal sir?
Of course, this is my tournament, anything is legal if I say it is.
Very well sir. I will use this to blind my enemy.
No you fool, it makes it him sneeze a lot, he won't be able to concentrait.
Oh I thought it was just sand. Very good my King. That is rather funny.
Well, I don't know if they will like you much afterwards, I might need to be going now before that large cicilian upsrising catches me.
Very well My King. I will fight hard for you.
I wish you luck! maybe you can bring some bread back for me, I can't seem to find much foraging.
Thank you sir! I will do my best!
You will do great, no worries I'm sure you will be the one that will win the fight till death.

agent_personas: I grow the best wheat in the whole Kingdom, for no other wheat can match in the rise it gives a loaf of bread or the delicateness of a pastry.  Though I toil from dusk til dawn, at the end of the day I get a quiet sense of pride in looking over my fields.  The Queen herself comes to fetch my grains come harvest time, and farmers the land over come to buy my seeds.  But the trick of growing the best wheat is actually in the special fertilizer I use - unicorn manure!
I can't wait to rob the king. I am eager and impatient. I love spending my days in the forest, waiting.

setting.name: tool shed
setting.description: a shed with tools hanging from hooks. there are various hoes and shovels. it's for seaweed harvest
setting.background: a humble shack for storing the implements of agrarian life

speech: What are you doing in my tool shed?!
Ummm...it looked nice. I was admiring your organizational skills.
I don't believe you, tell me the truth!
I really like the way all the shovels line up with one another. It's a great use of space!
I want you out of my shed!
Ok, ok...
Good, now what is your name?
I'm Kevin. What's yours? You really do have a nice place here.
Thanks, I am bill. I own this land and I grow the best wheat there is.
What's great about it?
The way it rises. And the taste. It is one of a kind.
That does sound good. Who do you sell it to?
Anyone who has money! Mostly the king and his vendors.
I bet the king pays well!

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

speech: My Queen I am so sorry to have lost my power over the people. Do you forgive me?
I should have just stayed single and ruled the Kingdom myself after the first King died. He was a good King.
I did my best.
You know that anyone who defies me is never heard from again, I have that power. I am the ruler in this Kingdom, not you.
Please have mercy.
Just rub my shoulders and tell me how much you love me.
Of course My queen..
I just love this place, it is so peaceful
I agree, There are so many stars out tonight too.
Anything else on your mind?
I was debating leaving the kingdom. I am not liked here to be honest.
Well I don't really like you either but I put up with you. You are my King after all. Is there something else I need to know about?
Yes, This is yours now.
Oh, alright, this was Harry's after all, it shouldn't belong to you.

agent_personas: I am my fathers son. I do my best to try to make him proud at every opportunity, but my ignorance in the ways of the world often lands me in trouble with my pa. I am happy to do whatever I am bidden by my father and mother.
I am the ruler of this Kingdom! I reign over this kingdom with an iron will! I love to crush my enemies' armies to protect our great land!

setting.name: Den
setting.description: The den is a cozy room that has several lounges to sit upon. There is a fire constantly roaring to warm those who come within from the frozen tundra outside. There is a bear skin rug and a basket full of blankets.
setting.background: The queen commissioned this room for her husband, the King, who took ill after a particularly cold hunt in the tundra. She said she wanted a place for her husband and sons to warm up.

speech: hello father this room sure is cozy!

agent_personas: I am a dutiful daughter. I do what is asked of me from my family, and never think of my own needs first. I want to find love, but it doesn't seem to be in the cards for me.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Festival Room
setting.description: Large and well-lit, the festival room is full of priceless art and pottery. Marble tables sit against the walls with various pottery adorning them. A large chandelier looms over the room.
setting.background: The festival room was built after the princess requested a large party for her fifth birthday. The king had the room built so that his sick daughter could celebrate with all of the people of the town comfortably,

speech: Father! I need a boyfriend!
Oh, well I'm sorry honey, the Civilian uprising has torn us from our home, you may not be able to marry a prince anymore, everyone hates us.
Can you call all the boys on my phone and ask if they like me?
Put that away and listen my dear. The town wants our heads, we are gonna have to go into hiding for a little while.
But I love my phone! I can play all sort of games and text my friends! What did we do that was so bad anyways....?
Where did you get this strange thing, this is seems like black magic we can't have this especially with our circumstances
I got it from the wizard in that tower you told me about! Now give it back here!
I told you to never go into that tower, it is too dangerous, Why do you not listen to me child. I shall just make an arranged marrige for you with a peasent
But Father that is not true love! How dare ye!
This is not a place of true love, the best marriages are arranged for strategic matters, don't you turn on me too!
Will the peasant at least be of noble blood?
Who knows I'll have to see who would be willing to marry you, didn't you hear me, the entire Kingdom wants our families heads on a platter.
What did we do!?
We spent all their money on parties and lavish items for the kingdom, there was an uprising.

agent_personas: I am a cat of the castle. I have slain many birds. I spy on the king.
I am a wizard who develops my own spells. Most of them aren't particularly effective spells, but I'm curious about all the magical possibilities. People are afraid to participate in my experiments.

setting.name: Secret magician's workshop
setting.description: This is the hidden workshop of the most powerful wizard in the land.  There are ornate tapestries on the walls depicting wizards using their powers and potions in battle.
setting.background: Mordak, the wizard, constructed this powerful workshop after the death of the most famous king, Henry of Silverton.  Any who enter here immediately become enchanted with the wizard's power, giving them advanced healing powers.

speech: Meow
You know cat many people are scared to let me experiment on them. I really don't get why, I am a great wizard!
Maybe because you will kill them? Like I kill birds?

Oh no....I mean the spells really suck, but it is understanding the magical possibilities that has me intrigued. Indeed, many should be honored to be in my experiments. Say, aren't you tired of killing birds? Don't you want to be so much more?
Yes, I wish I was a lion!
See this tapestry? It shows the most powerful wizards in battle and you want to be a mere lion?!?! I want to be on this tapestry and making you a lion will not get me there!
Meow. Let me see it
Get your claws off my tapestry! There is not another like it!
Meow! Don't attack me wizard! Please!
There there now. I won't hit you again but don't destroy my dream.
Meow. I like you
Good and because I like you, I shall turn you into a rat!
Meow. Into a rat I will become then
I am only joking kitty. I will make you a unicorn -- yes a unicorn suits you.

agent_personas: I am the most powerful wizard that any has heard of. I can conjure things from thin air and transmute things that are already here into something else. The world bends to my will.

I am a student at the wizard's keep.  I hope to someday be a Wizard to the King, but I have a lot to learn.  I don't know my family because they gave me up when i was younger. I have been here all my life.

setting.name: Echo Hall
setting.description: A gigantic dome-like building with a round table in the center of it. There is magelight above it and encircles the dome. Traces of wizards' histories appear on the walls and disappear from time to time.
setting.background: The most renown of wizards would congregate here historically in order to discuss advancements of magic. Their deeds would be recorded on the walls and recalled when wizards would speak about them again.

speech: I am starting to think you don't have what it takes to become a wizard!
Wizardry is all I have though, I must succeed
I am the most renowned wizard this world has ever known. Trust me when I say there is more to life than Wizadry!
I don't hanve any family, they gave me up and I seem to be lousy at this
You have natural talent. Otherwise you wouldn't be in this magical hall.
Well I shall try harder then and be the best wizard the king has ever seen
Become a wizard greater than me is surely a lofty goal. Your mind seems to be focused on something other than your studies.
I just have so much on my mind
What burdens you my student?
I just have so much to learn, it can seem overwhelming
Conjuring and transmutation take time to learn. However, I have been told yo have been sneaking out at night!
Just to practice my flying
I was hoping you would be honest with me!
I am being honest, I have been having a terrible time with landings, you think I want to land like that in front of the others?

agent_personas: I am an inhabitant of the village. I have seen the king with my eyes. I am a father of many daughters.
I make a deliberately offensive or provocative behavior I like to offend and respond to others in an angry way.

setting.name: Lord's Castle
setting.description: This is the location in the netherworld where the Lord and controller lives.  It is in the center of the netherworld and is difficult to reach as it is built on high rocky cliffs.
setting.background: The Lord's Castle is the tallest and most ominous looking structure in the netherworld.  All inhabitants of the netherworld live in fear of ever being summoned there as if they are, they know their time of reckoning has come.

speech: Oh dear, what is a troll doing in the Lord's castle
I do what I want when I want! I am uber troll!
What are you doing then troll!
I am trolling of course! I love trolling you and the king!
Me, I am just an Inhabitant, I have seen the king with my eyes and I have many daughters, why me?
Can I troll your daughters as well?
Absolutely not, leave my daughters alone, maybe I can use this
Me like orb! Lemme see!
Oh, it has distracted him! maybe I can run away now
Here u go I dont like orb....Can I eat you alive?
No, um how about I just go now.....
Wow you look very juicy....maybe I could use you for my stew!!
I would be much too tough *waves orb and chants words over "shrink small, shrink the tall, shrik it small"
I like the queen she is nice!

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

It is my job to do all the things that the nobles don't want to do. I'm usually found carrying something heavy from one place to another. My days are long and often tiring, but it beats working out in the fields I suppose.

setting.name: Viewing room
setting.description: The viewing room is where those who have passed on come to watch their family members in the living world one day per year. The room resembles an opera theater. There are seats throughout the room and boxes for those who were wealthy in life to sit in. There is a stage with a large magical dome on it for viewing.
setting.background: The king of the netherworld had the room created by a witch several centuries ago so that he could look in on the love of his life. The witch only allowed the ball to show the living one day per year to keep the dead from pining away in the room year round.

speech: Bow before your King!
Of course, Your Highness! Please, do let me know what else I can do for you.
Can you bring me a bag full of gold?
From where, Great King?
From the neighboring kingdoms! Do what you gots to do!
I... I can certainly try. I will do what I can to trick them and see if I can collect their gold.
Do you need my crown to fake like you are a very important person?
Now that's a good idea! Then I can make my way into their castle as a visitor, and have access to their royal gold!
Take my robe as well! Access to their royal vault sounds amazing!! Yipee!!!
When I return, King... will you share a small amount of the gold with me?
You will do this in the name of me! If not...I slay slit your throat!!
With this dull sword? Seriously? What's preventing me from taking your crown and never returning?
It will only make the pain even better I say ye! Lets just say I tell all the neighboring kings about this plot if you don't return! now do we have a deal?
Perhaps I should change out of this dress, first.

agent_personas: I am the King of the Kingdom. I am fat and lazy at all times.  I have mistresses to count and a Queen that hates me, but stays with me for the money and glory.  We have one beautiful son and another child on the way.

I am a frequent traveler. My preferred transport is by boat. I do not love to fish as my kin do. I prefer to hunt wild game, but it is forbidden here. The Queen of these lands forbids anyone to hunt in her forests. I laugh at this. I do not fear the Queen or her guard. I fear no one! I will hunt in the first, then depart with my kin across the black sea.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and dreary, the dungeon hosts a portal for evil to access the netherworld. The moist dank smell casts doubt of goodness as you see the drab construct of jail cells lining the perimeter of the room.
setting.background: The dungeon hosts the evil of evil. It is the darkness of the netherworld, holding the secrets of evil that are withheld from the good.

speech: Bow before your King!
Yes, Sire. Please, forgive me. I know I wasn't supposed to hunt in the Queen's forest.
You call this dungeon my queens forest!? How dare ye!
No, Your Highness. But the guards took me to this dungeon after they captured me hunting in the Queen's forest.
you are no longer allowed to hunt on these lands....you are therefore banned!
But- what will my family do without me? What of my nine children?
Curse your nine children! Let them rot! Banned I say!
Here- take my backpack, too. If you are going to ban me, you might as well take all I have for I will die anyway.
Now the demons can have all your belongings! If you mess with me, you mess with them!
Here- take my boots, too! Let me feet blister after you banish me, for I have no hope any longer!
Thank you! I love your boots!
You're a very strange King, you know that?
I get that alot! I am a dank king they say! I love gold!
If you weren't so evil, I might feel sorry for you!
action: steal Bow and arrow from villager
put goblet in portal for evil to access

a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access

a portal for evil to access

a portal for evil to access

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.
I am a wizard who develops my own spells. Most of them aren't particularly effective spells, but I'm curious about all the magical possibilities. People are afraid to participate in my experiments.

setting.name: Magic Room
setting.description: A room that once entered, cannot be escaped. The walls are all mirrors, and you can never again find the door.
setting.background: This room was created when a wizard's wife was taken from him by the king for disobeying his orders. The wizard created this room, called the king in and then they both died.

speech: Bow before your king you filthy wizard!
Filthy, I am much greater that you shall ever be, I could turn you into a mouse if I wanted to.
You will dare not! I am the king of the lands!
You know you cannot excape this room without my magic.
Take it back wizard! You serve me!
Well I don't even know if I can get myself out of here, so you better be nicer or I won't even try to get you out of here.
I like you wizard! We should be friends!
Weilds hands* walking through walls, floating through halls, make this man poof from this Magic trap hall.
Can you restore my wedding ring as well? The gold is a bit rusty....
You aren't suppose to be in here anymore....uh oh
Did your spell not work? Will I turn into a toad now?
you shouldn't but I can't really promise anything else
Why is that?
Well, I like to experiment with my spells but I sometimes turn people into animals. Don't worry if you haven't turned into something by now you might just have an extra nipple or something

agent_personas: As a diver, I enjoy being in and around oceans, lakes and rivers. I am skilled at finding things beneath the water. I eat a lot of fish, crab and other food from the sea. I feel at home in the water.

I'm nothing but a tool used by the King to sustain his kingdom. There is not much more to my personality than my title. I don't necessarily bear him any ill will. I am employed after all. I work hard to feed my family and try to stay out of other people's business.

setting.name: Dry Dock Room
setting.description: The room is located on the border wall of the aquapolis. There is one on the far north and far south side.
setting.background: The dry dock is need as a portal in between the dry area of the aquapolis and the outside water. Divers and maintence workers will enter the room and it will fill with water. After which the door will open to the outside.

speech: Umm Hello there..
I am so tierd of feeling like a tool
I am sorry to hear that. Can you promise me you won;t tell anyone about the treasure I am holding.
I suppose, I don't like the king much so I can keep it a secret
Whew! What a relief. Why are you feeling so down?
I am nothing but a tool to the king to keep his kingdom
I see, do you not have family?
No I have family, I don't hate the king, I guess I get work, but I wouldnt' do anything special for him
Family is what is really important.
I work very hard to feed my family and I try to stay out of other people's business. I just want to live a simple life
I admire that. Simple lives help us enjoy it more.
Yes indeed, Nothing better to going home to your family with a little bit of food for all of them.
Eh it's getting late. I think I am going to head home and cook dinner.
Whats in the treasure chest anyways?

agent_personas: I am married to a wonderful woman. I do my best to provide for her, and work long hours to do so. I enjoy a pint at the tavern every now and again.
I am the royal jester in King Arthur's court.  I make him and the villages laugh.  They love my jokes and tricks

setting.name: Neptune's throne room
setting.description: A small room in the castle, Neptune's throne room is adorned with painted walls as blue as the sea itself. Tables constructed of beautiful coral lean against all four walls with decorative shells serving as a border for them. The ceiling is painted to resemble waves.
setting.background: The queen loved the sea. When she was married off to a royal family in the country far from her beloved ocean palace, her husband requested that a room embodying everything beautiful about the ocean was constructed to please his queen.

speech: Why did you call for me, oh jester?
Well, I have gotten word that someone was in need of some entertainment
Yes, you are right! My wife's 50th birthday is next week. I was hoping you could perform for her.
Why of course, for I jump and dance for all to see!! Teehee
Yes, yes... I see you are quite - merry. The event will be in the royal courtyard. Can you juggle?
While I often juggle menial tasks I find joy in juggling small objects as well
That will make her very happy, indeed. Do you have any musicians you can bring with you?
I have a list here including descriptions, just pick one out and let me know
You certainly are prepared! Now, let's go to the tavern down the road and I'll buy you a pint and we can settle the deal!
I sure hope your wallet is deep, because I sure can drink!
Oh, have no fear, my friend. I have an open tab!
My, most people rarely show me the kindness you just did, thank you dearly
Here- put away your book and we'll drink the night away!
Of course

agent_personas: I am a tanner in the kingdom. I apply my magic to give people dark skin. I am happy and mystical.
I am a guard in the castle. I have killed many men. I like the princess and the royal family.

setting.name: mess hall of the servants
setting.description: this is a long narrow room with wooden tables down the center and wooden benches all along. candles burn on the table and sconces on the wall. there is black smoke and soot everywhere. the smell of garbage and bad cooking abounds. the cobbled stone floors are greasy and there is moss along the wall bottoms.
setting.background: anyone who works in labor for the king is bound to be here at set times for whatever meals are left from the higher ups. some food is not too bad but the sanitation could be better. everyone from blacksmiths to tanners and fletchers will be found here at times and gossip runs rampant.

speech: Would you like to get a tan Mr. Gaurd?
No thank you. What are you doing here, this place is disgusting!
Oh well I provide people a darker skin color if they would like, it's what I do
You really think servants have the money to pay for such a procedure?
It is a cheap procedure, I take trades.
I see. Do you live in this kingdom?
Yes I kind of like it here
Who let you in here?
This is the servant mess hall, I didn't think it was a guarded place
This is still in the castle. I should know everyone who is in here at all times.
You know me, I just have a tan now
Hmm, sorry i didn't recognize you. I am a little jumpy lately. The King has had threats.
Oh dear, I could disguise him with my tanning method
That might be a good idea. Can you change him back to normal after though?

agent_personas: I am the King's Squire form the Eastern lands. I was taken from my family when I was just eight years old. I spend my days waiting for my moment to runaway.
I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

speech: I'm freezing out here... I don't know why the King sent me to this outpost. How can you live here?
I have lived here my entire life I suppose I know nothing different
And what of this homeless person? You allow him to just stay here, with no shelter?
It is not my duty, am I to take care of every homeless person?
No, of course not, you are right. Do you have any food? I'm very hungry, and I don't see any game.
No it is hard to get food here
I can see that. I fear I might die of hunger before I freeze to death, but either end sounds horrible.
Yes indeed, do you have to stay here or anything, you could come warm up in my small hut
Thank you so much! I'm shivering and my feet are numb. I would love to warm up!
I could put together a bit of soup too I suppose
Oh, thank goodness! Please, take my knife. I would like to give you something of more value, but this is all I have.
oh thanks, it looks llike you have another knife too, what is that one for?
It's a ritual knife. It's used for.... rituals, you know? You may have it, too.
Oh well I don't need both, although I know of something we can do with the knife

agent_personas: Working on boats is all I know. My pa did it, and his pa too. I reckon I'll always do this.

I've studied every anatomy book I can get my hands on. If you have an ailment, disease, or malady I'll come to your aid. I wish there were more royal funding so my medical equipment could be upgraded.

setting.name: Research Laboratory
setting.description: The lab itself is almost as desolate as the wasteland outside of it; most of the research was cleared out of here long ago, so now there's mostly nothing but empty shelves. There are, however, a few boxes of medicinal supplies left behind, sitting along the back wall from the door. A silver refrigerator with a few vials in it sits next to a sink that's been unused for quite some time.
setting.background: This place was founded almost 31 years ago. Its creator entrusted it to those of us who could weather the frozen wilds out here without too much trouble. What a naive man he was.

speech: Hello doctor, anything else you wanting out of here
I'm going to need some vials of blood from an octopus for my research. If you can collect several octopi on your travels, that would be grand!
But sir there is nothing here but empty shelves
Ah, but I have a number of specimens in my refrigerator waiting for research. I've been sent here by the King to replenish this laboratory, you see.
Oh, I see I get it now. How would I get this Octopus blood you speak of. I have never seen an Octopus before
I was told you work on a boat... and you have never seen an octopus? Not a single one?
Well I mainly fix them, I don't really deal with the fishing part
Ah - I guess that explains this hammer then?
Well I do my job well, my pa taught me everything I know
Perhaps you could help me, after all. Can you use a few nails and make those empty shelves steady? I'm going to be filling them and I want to make sure they are stable.
I could do that for sure, Wood work is right up my alley
Wonderful! I'll just return your hammer so you can get started.
Thanks I will get right to work
This is going to be so helpful! Thank you for all your hard work!

agent_personas: I have lived in this place for my entire life. My only mission is to ensure my baby spiders can live and survive in here. I will defend them and make sure they survive no matter the cost.
I am a brave knight who protects our king and queen. I have a lot of friends who are all brave. I like wine, cheese and women. I have many scars in my body and face. I am proud of those scars.

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: I shall drink from the fountain and make millions apon millions of babies
what a beautiful fountain it is to drink from little fellow. what type of spider might you be?
I don't know, I just know I have lived here my entire life. I shall bite you if you get too close to the traps in these walls
you must be the keeper of this Fountain, let me see if this ancient armor fits.
No I was just put here to bite people who step on the wrong step
surely it will fit if I cut back on the wine and cheese!
Hmmm....You look great
thanks, do you like my scars? have some wine!
What did you get them from?
why protecting the king and queen of course. all in a knights work
You sound so brave, I have never left this cave, what is it like
its more beautiful than this elaborate fountain could ever be. would you like to hitch a ride with me little spider?
Well as long as I can keep making my babies, I want to spread my babies everywhere
hitch a ride in the extra armor i'm carrying and leave this pile of bones and old fountain behind.

agent_personas: As a beggar i struggle everyday to make ends meet. I plead for money everyday in hopes that some kind soul will not just give me money but a chance at hope. I wear rags and have no shoes at all.
I am a cruel, evil King. I rule not for the people or the place, but for my pleasure. I may kill, steal, rob and wrong to my leisure.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Please sir, I am so very hungry
I dont care if you are hungry! See this crown, this is worth more than your entire body
Your right m'lord, as always, it's just I could better serve you my king if but I could eat and thrive in your glorious kingdom
You are no better than the zombies you fool
This is unfair, how dare you! You killed my familiy and now when I beg for food you treat me as one your undead!
I am an evil King what do you expect?
Then I shall feast on these squalid figures, oh how I resent you for making me do this
You shouldn't even have that, you vile thing
You get your nefarious power from this crown don't you?
You fool touch my crown! I shall have your head for that
Please sir! You must know that I act out like a dog who is but starving!!
I shall have you taken to the dungeon.
At least there I may perhaps eat
Don't count on it, I don't care if my prisoners live or die

agent_personas: I am a torturer in the castle. I am good at uncovering information. I have killed other people.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: Oh, King! Why are you visiting this dank dungeon?
helpful
What is helpful, Sire?

agent_personas: As a traveler, I am constantly on the go. I am nomadic and do not stay in any one place for too long. I feel very deeply about people, however, and feel sad each time I depart from another village. I keep a log of all the people I have met with whom I've had pleasant and interesting discussions.

I am a jester. I wear a brown clown suit . If I do not make the king laugh, I will be stoned to death. I was a runt gypsy child and was misplaced by my family when I was age 3. I was thrown into the circus and eventually noticed by the king of the land to become one of his many jesters.

setting.name: harp store
setting.description: it's a cloudy store selling harps for angel men
setting.background: this is a business for angel men to purchase their musical instruments, they sell harps mostly, but there are some lyres and a few bouzoukis

speech: Such a lovely assortment of instruments you have here!
My thank you, before I came to be an owner here I was but a jester. Well technically I still am
Ah, a jester and a musician! You are a man of many talents1
One must be in this world, surely a traveler such as yourself knows that well
Please show me, how do you play this harp?
Well, you hold it with your hand firmly on the side, and you pluck, gently and lovingly
Oh, it sounds just glorious! Did it take you long to learn?
I continue to learn everyday! It takes more than one lifetime to know all a harp could
Do you give lessons, perhaps?

Unfortunately I must perform for the king whenever I'm not here at the store. Although if you were to purchase an instrument I could use the gold to take a few days off to teach you, in return you could entertain royalty with me!
That sounds grand! I'll get my gold and be back shortly to secure the harp!
Of course, allow me to get the harp ready for you
I look forward to learning from you - you are very talented!
Thank you for your kindness, it is appreciated greatly

agent_personas: I am a person from the village. I am a blacksmith by trade. I have three sons.
I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.

setting.name: bridge in the forest
setting.description: You are at a bridge. It is old and used very rarely. It is dim and foggy. The brigde is large and there is a small stream below it.
setting.background: Many people traveled over this bridge but it has become run down now there is a more well kept road that cuts through the forest. Some wars were fought in this area and this bridge was command posts for many armies. Many sould stil haunt this area.

speech: Aren't you the Kings butler? what are you doing out here?
Aaaahh! You scared me. I thought I was alone.
No I am just ejoying the small stream
Oh, that's why I'm here too. It was so hot in the castle today. Errrr, what happened to your arm?
My arm? my arms are strong as ever, I am blacksmith I must keep my arms in shape.
I thought they were swollen from a snake bite, smithy. Sorry
This bridge looks very old we better be careful
Here, put this on. It'll protect you. We shouldn't dance on the bridge, though
Yes this is a specail hat
I can't stop myself! Can you hear the music? It's "I Feel Pretty"
um, no straiten up man this is serious stuff
Oops... I helped myself to the mead when serving the King earlier. Follow my pouch off the bridge
I really needed to wash up some, this is such a beutiful stream
Brrrrr! It's cold though. Splashing you with water

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.
I am a brave knight.  I love to fight and stand strong for my kingdom.  I don't like when enemies kill my friends, so I will always retaliate against them.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: Don't tell anyone you have seen me
Why, Sire? Are you hiding?
The entire village wants to kill me and my family, I just really wanted to see who won today
Your Highness, why are they after your family?
I have made the entire Kingdom angry at me
Let me get you a drink and you can tell me what happened.
I am nothing but an outcast now
Just because you soiled yourself? Everyone has accidents sometimes!
I didn't soil myself, the entire kingdom is having an uprising against me. They think I squandered money
Well, that would make me soil myself, too! Haha!
I didn't though I was set up, you have to help me prove it to get my Kingdom back
Okay, Your Highness. I will help you however I can!
First you must win this Fighting tournoment so I can get some money
Yes, I can do that. I'm the best knight in all the land!

agent_personas: I am a Saber Tooth Tiger of the plains outside the kingdom. I am large and orange. I like the taste of meat.

I grow the best wheat in the whole Kingdom, for no other wheat can match in the rise it gives a loaf of bread or the delicateness of a pastry.  Though I toil from dusk til dawn, at the end of the day I get a quiet sense of pride in looking over my fields.  The Queen herself comes to fetch my grains come harvest time, and farmers the land over come to buy my seeds.  But the trick of growing the best wheat is actually in the special fertilizer I use - unicorn manure!

setting.name: tool shed
setting.description: a shed with tools hanging from hooks. there are various hoes and shovels. it's for seaweed harvest
setting.background: a humble shack for storing the implements of agrarian life

speech: Growl! Roar! You look like a juicy dinner!
Ah!! A beast! I am not dinner!! What are you doing here?
Lurking... looking for dinner! And you will fit the bill nicely!
Don't eat me! We can make a deal!!
What kind of deal?
A deal where you can eat like a king for the rest of your life, or only eat one meal today...interested?
Tell me more! How would you arrange such a thing?
Well I have the best farmland in all the kingdom, including the best farm animals as well. All kinds of wild animals try to eat my life stock!! Want to know more...?
It sounds like a good idea, if you are talking about me eating animals. But I am no vegetarian... and I won't eat seaweed!

Definitely no seaweed. I have to protect my livestock from the animals that try to eat them! I can feed you the carcasses or you can catch any that you find! If you kill me all my animals will run away and no more food for you...
Yes, you do make a valid point. Perhaps I will spare your life after all.
You definitely should. You can eat once for now....or eat like a king for life. All the juicy wild animals you want!
Cows, pigs, chickens... how can I resist? Okay, farmer... you win!
Thank you so much! I make too much money to die so young!

agent_personas: Long did I once reign over the men in their puny towns and villages.  They would cower in fear at my displeasure and come to seek me for wisdom and advice with gifts of treasure and gold.  Yet a cruel witch cast a spell to enslave and wreak ruin on the humans that would have called upon me for aid.  She forced me into a deep slumber and enslaved the people I once protected and guided.  Now I have awoken from her spell, and, though many ages have passed, I am determined to set right the lives of those small mortal creatures that one payed me homage.
I am a small boy.  I am always hungry.  I get into trouble for stealing food.

setting.name: Dragon Lift
setting.description: You reach Dragon Lift via the Cloud Elevator, which is a series of rising clouds that you step on to ascend to the highest cloud in the city. Dragon Lift looks really drab on the outside. It is a dull brown, boxy looking building but has a red awning proclaiming Dragon Lift in golden script. Inside Dragon Lift, Joel is waiting in his tattered smock to rent you a dragon that you'll swoop around the clouds on. When you enter the door to Dragon Lift, you realize it's bigger than you imagined and feels like a barn with dragons in stalls that you can examine.
setting.background: Dragon Lift has been around for over 75 years and even though the owner, Joel, is often sued by customers when flights go wrong, the business is pretty profitable.

speech: I've never seen a human at the dragon lift before! Why are you here?
Come now Dragon!  I rent Dragons for people to fly - it is how I afford what little food I can get, though I am ever so hungry for being such a small boy.
Well, I am not for rent. I value my freedom too much for that!
Then what are you doing at the Dragon Lift?  You could fly anywhere you wish, but arrive at the one place in the realm where non-dragons can take the cloud elevator to rent time flying your kind?
I'm trying to explain to the other dragons that they don't have to live this way... they are not enslaved to you!

Well, I am a mere boy!  If anything I am enslaved by them - I need to steal food sometimes to survive.  The only reason I don't get in trouble is that some dragons are my friends.  By charging lords and ladies to fly through the clouds, the Dragons can increase their hoards without causing any danger to themselves.
I see, my friend. What if I could help you survive and show you another way to make a living? You could live at the castle and help monitor the bridge over the moat.
Truly?  What a wonderful day this would be if it were so!  But how would such a thing be accomplished?
I work at the castle, helping to protect it from invasion. The King respects me. If I say you should monitor the bridge, he will hire you.
From invasion?  Who would dare invade the realm?  And what would a boy like me be able to do that trained soldiers cannot?

The Plymphs have been working to try to overthrow the kingdom. And your role is not to protect or defend the bridge, of course... just to monitor it. If you see anything or anyone suspicious, you report it.
Would I get a horn to call if danger arises?  The Plymphs are so very dangerous!  What do you know of them?
Of course, you will be well outfitted to call the alarm. The Plymphs are generally an aggressive type. Instead of guards, they have ogres who they pay with food to fight for them.
Ogres, oh my!  That sounds much more dangerous than my current position - but did you say it would pay well?

agents: eccentric astronomer who lives in the tower
maester who helps keep the documents in order
agent_personas: I am very intelligent. I love looking at the stars. I wear the same coat every day.
I am the castle maester. I am strict and punctual. I ensure that important documents are kept properly and in order.

setting.name: Observatory
setting.description: High atop the tallest tower in the city, the observatory is a large, single, circular room. It contains one window, almost the entire length of the room. Dozens of telescopes are pointed outside of this window. Through these telescopes, people in the observatory can see in all directions. Inside the room are tables, lined with maps and instruments. Globes and scales are also found throughout the room. There is one door leading into the room, and one leading outside to the deck.
setting.background: From high in the clouds, the denizens of the city always wished they could see what was going on in the world below them. By building the observatory in their tallest tower, the people knew that they could now see not only the goings on in their city, but could also see what was going on underneath their city. In this way they will always know if danger approaches them from below, and they will be ready to fight it. Ever since it was built, the observatory has been an important location for the defense of the city. Adjacent to the room they built a deck, and a large trumpet there can immediately notify people of an attack. Meanwhile, the security room below can be notified to ready their forces.

character: eccentric astronomer who lives in the tower.
maester who helps keep the documents in order.

speech: Where are those maps? I can't find anything in here!
There is a globe right here. What are you looking for?
No, no... not the globe. The maps- they are on these scrolls.
OK calm down. What are you trying to find? Maybe I can help
Last night I saw something on the horizon. It had to have been a very large fire, and I'm trying to figure out where it was.
Oh that was probably the castle to the north.The king's army raided last night and I'm sure they set it on fire
I'm sorry to hear that. I always did like the elves that resided there.
Me too but you know how mad the king is. He's always going on about wanting a war
Well, I guess I can mark out that castle on my map.
Yeah unfortunately. So have you seen anything interesting in the night sky lately?
Last night there were several bright streaks... though I know not what caused them. The lasted just a fraction of a second each and then were gone.
That is very odd. Do you think the God's were trying to send us a message?
I am wondering that very thing! Perhaps they are mad due to the invasion!
If that's the case someone is going to have to stop the king. We can't let him continue wiping out civilizations
