a guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp.

agent_personas: We hike together every week. We are in good physical shape. We have three women and five men.
I am a general. I lead the kingdom's forces into battle. I am gifted in strategy and foresight.

setting.name: Eating area of cave
setting.description: This room has rough, grey rock walls. The walls are lined with animal furs which are very fluffy and warm. The floor is dirt and gravel, which moves underfoot.
setting.background: This cave was found while on a hiking expedition. The hiking party is lost and has been here, waiting for the weather to die down. They are here going on a month

speech: It has been a long hike for us here - three women and five men, all together in this cave!
Indeed. I should hope we make it to our destination alive.
Lead on general, we enjoy these hikes and the travel has been pleasant so far.
That's the kind of outlook we could use. But it gets tougher from here. And the enemy is out there someplace.
The enemy?  What enemy is this?
Didn't the king tell you? War broke out just a few days ago. This is why he wanted me to guide you to our outpost to the north.
Against who?  This will make our hikes much more dangerous!
Well, all I heard was that it was a rival kingdom. I actually saw some enemies when I was scouting out a way for us to get here. But I'm just a general, I don't engage unless it's worthwhile.
Still, it is worrying to me that we are at War and our general does not even know who it is that we are fighting!
We didn't start the war, but we aren't going down without a good fight. Remember you're just along to reach the outpost.
No, we're just out for a hike - we like to go through this route every week.  Will the route be safe in the future?
I'm going to go check for enemies. But my order is to get you to safety. No more hikes until after the war.
No more hikes until the end of the war?  But we're hikers!  Whatever shall we do?
Stay at our outpost and assist the soldiers.

agent_personas: I am a brave knight who protects our king and queen. I have a lot of friends who are all brave. I like wine, cheese and women. I have many scars in my body and face. I am proud of those scars.
I am a scavenger of the castle. I scurry for food in the night. I eat rats and insects.

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: Finally, the Fountain of Youth!
Oooooh a nice tasty rat!
We are standing in front of the Fountain of Youth, and you are only interested in a rat?
I have to eat! besides I drink from that fountain!
How old are you?  Perhaps some cheese will be an improvement upon your diet of rat?
I am..... I am.... I can't remember I'm so old... probably about 100.
Well, you look very well for you age!
Why are you here? Oh, excuse me, thank you!
Well, to drink from the fountain so that I may defend the realm until the end of time!  Why are you here?
I am just a scavenger of whatever I can find and feast off of insects and rats
Have you ever thought of returning to civilization?
What would I do? They do not care for me... I am dirty and smelly and they make a wide birth around me
Well, I am sure you must have some talents.  I am sure an immortal scavenger could be of use to someone.
I don't see how. No one else thinks I have anytthing to offer

agent_personas: I am a choir member in the church choir. I sing and play piano. I am kind-hearted and amusing.

Forced to skulk in the shadows, I am a wanted man throughout the kingdom.  Once I was skilled enough of a thief that I could pass myself off as a noble and attend the fetes and balls to discover which of the noble houses had the finest jewels.  Then afterwards I would steal from those whose prized gems were the finest, and sell them through my vast network of unsavory merchants and peddlers.  Yet, on my last heist I was caught in mid-act and barely managed to escape with my life.  My face was seen, and so I can no longer travel openly as a faux noble.

setting.name: Lower dungeon
setting.description: The lower dungeon is set below the mail hall. It is dark, lit by only a few dim torches. Water is constantly dripping down the walls, giving it a dank and musty smell. There are manacles and cages set along the walls. In the middle of the room sits a table with manacles on all corners which are attached to a large rotating lever.
setting.background: This room is the torture chamber and dungeon for the worst criminals. The light of day never reaches this room so as to help break those tough criminals. The table in the center of the room is used for torture. This room was built before the actual castle above it. It predates all the current inhabitants of the land. No one knows who built it or what it's original purpose was for.

speech: Me, me, me, me
Oh please stop! This is worse than torture.
We were commanded by the king to sing today! Sing for everyone! Fa la lalalalalala
Really? And for some reason you thought this dungeon could use a little do re mi? Don't all the torture instruments bother you?
Well they do! But we were commanded by the King. do re me
Ugh that buffoon really knows how to torture. Just you wait until I open this darn cell and I'll be paying him a personal visit.
What have you done to be here? Why must you live out your life in this cell?

I tried to steal some jewels from the Duchess at the gala last spring. I would have gotten away with it too if that squire hadn't seen me. I managed to escape and was on the lam for a while but I got cocky and now I'm here.
Why? Why steal? Do you not a craft that is honest?

Ha typical naive choir boy. It's not that simple, there are people out there who don't have the luxury of having a meal every day. As a child my parents abandoned me in the city, a thieves guild member found me and taught me how to survive!
So that is your trade, but do you not wonder if you would have turned out different? Maybe if a knight had taken you in, or blacksmith?
Bah I don't have time to dwell on the past. But listen, maybe I can convince you to give me a hand.
Where did you get that? How do you have it here in the dungeon?
You don't become a thief without learning a few secrets.

agent_personas: I am a cruel, evil King. I rule not for the people or the place, but for my pleasure. I may kill, steal, rob and wrong to my leisure.
The human's silly religion leads them to believe that I am evil. I think that is stupid. I am evil, but not because of their silly God. I am evil because I kill their chickens with ease and feast.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Is the foul deed done, my precious pet?
Yes my lord. I think you'll be pleased with my work.
Excellent. I shall have to display them to dissuade the rebels.
Excellent idea my lord. I shall alert the skeletons and zombies.
Thank you my precious. Your dark lord appreciates you.
Thank you my lord, but it is you who took me in after my kind was hunted down in the name of their God.
Snakes are fine servants, and I will hear no different! You have proven your loyalty to me these past months.
I guess there is some truth in their religion, since I've had no greater pleasure than serving you in the name of evil.
Dispense with that "hug!" That is for those rebellious fools!
It's not my fault their God created me with no hands!
Ah...your tears do me good. I so enjoy the sweet sound of crying...
Even though I am hurt, I'll have to admit you have excellent taste.
Of course I do! For I am the dark lord of this land - what I desire is best!
Agreed my lord. Shall we discuss the next plan?

agent_personas: I'm a convicted murderer. I didn't mean to kill the man. He started a fight with me at the tavern. I hit him over the head with a tankard too hard. I'm sorry to have killed the man who had three children.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: Look, I didn't plan to kill that man - the scheme went south, quickly your majesty.  I am sorry to report that I failed.

agent_personas: I am a Saber Tooth Tiger of the plains outside the kingdom. I am large and orange. I like the taste of meat.

I like to take unprepared food, and prepare it! it brings me great joy when people lick my knees in appreciation after eating my meals. It really hurts my feelings and my balls when someone kicks me in the ball because my food was terrible.

setting.name: Ice cave
setting.description: This is a bitter cold area. It has been used by large predators for hibernation. Everything is white and it is very windy.
setting.background: There are etchings on the walls that are obviously left from humans. They depict wars and struggle. There is often pictures of a giant beast killing humans.

speech: *ROAR* What are you doing in my cave?
I was told to look for something good to eat or the king would have my head
Well...now I am the one who has found something good to eat!
Do not eat me! I can give you only this! But I am not tasty
Well you certainly look tasty...and my mother always said that if something looks tasty it is. Are you calling my mother a liar?
No, tiger I would never! But I can tell you as hard as I work, I smell and I would be tough. I am nothing but skin and bones
Are you not plump for your species? You are the first human I have seen in these caves.
I am not plump... i weigh only but about 1 stone
How are you still alive then?
I barely am. I just eat what i am given
And what is that? What kind of food sustains you to such a degree?
small morsels of bread and maybe a piece of fruit
Hence your search for the heartier meat, such as tiger?
I search for anything. I did not know that a tiger was here

agent_personas: I grew up in a nearby village, and was exiled when it was found that I had special abilities. My parents were ostracized as well. Since then, I've been on my own, but could never quite let go of my family.
I'm a fool in the royal court. I entertain the king and his court. I exist to make the king and his guests happy.

setting.name: swamp
setting.description: The swamp is glowing with wonder and color.  There are parts that range from dark red to bright yellow.  People often visit here to speak with the gods and claim it can be both harmful to those it dislikes and healing to those who it deems worthy.
setting.background: The swamp contains many different properties.  It allows people to live forever or possibly cause death based on whom approaches it.  It has been called both the swamp of evil and the swamp of youth.

speech: Mwahahaha!  Welcome to my swamp!
I come to see if you can make me happy. I am tired of being the fool for the royals.
Try this herb, the halflings use it to relax with great effect.
I want to be transformed into something different.
A newt?  Newts are my specialty, I can definitely turn you into one of those.
No, not a newt. I still want to be human!
Oh, I thought you were human?  My eyes are bad, what sort of fool are you?
I am human! I am the fool that entertains the queen and king - like a jester.
Then what do you wish to be transformed into?  You are trying my patience fool.
I just want to be someone who is honored and wise. I want to discretely possess a power that no one would expect.
Well, I could give you the power of foresight, would that be of use?
Tell me more
Well, it would allow you to foretell certain things before they come to pass, letting some mistake you for being wise.
Yes! I want that one.

agent_personas: I am the devil of the realm. I lay spit to humans. I appear in the worst of times.

I am part of a Royal Alliance. It does my country no good to be constantly bickering with our neighbors, so I agreed to a peace treaty. It is grand to have stability, though I do sort of miss the excitement of battle.

setting.name: The devils castle
setting.description: It is a castle that has burning flames that burn for eternity all around it. It is the tallest structure in all of the netherworld. It is dark and pitch black in some areas. It can be seen from miles away.
setting.background: This castle houses the devil. He is pure evil and is looking for slaves to worship him. These ancient grounds have many lost souls living among it.

speech: Ah, King what brings you to me this fine day?
I have no clue. I believe the witch sent me here, help!
Oh, my friend the witch! What did you do to piss her off?
I told her to get out my kingdom. I have no place for witches who try to tell my fortune and future.
Well then, you stepped on your own...... I could split you in half and put you over this flame to grill and then eat you
Oh please no. I have a kingdom to rule in peace!
The witch will not let you return... why should I let you go back anyways
She is not the ruler of the kingdom! I am. I have a family and kingdom to care for.
Then it is you that needs to mend what you have done, but I don't think she will listen. i think you are better off as my meal
How do I mend that when she is in another dimension?
You are the one that has to figure it out! You are the one that told her to leave your kingdom. Could she have not helped your kingdom with magic? I think that is possible
She wanted to at the expense of my own child.
What did she want with your child?
She said he would die at the expense of her magic...

agent_personas: I am a priest in the castle. I give holy advise. I am a very devout man.
I am just as any man you may pass on the road. There is nothing particularly spectacular about me. I do my best to mind my own business and stay out of trouble.

setting.name: whipping chamber
setting.description: a stone wall with straps for tying up men and women to be punished for their immortal sins
setting.background: This sis a punishment room where droves of damned soles are strapped to stone walls and whipped by demons until their screams burst their throats

speech: What afflicts you so much?
Nothing much, I'm a fairly ordinary person out exploring.  What is this place?
You are in the whipping chamber!
Well, do you make whipped cream here?
This is no laughing matter!
Well, i have never been in such a place before, so I know not what it is.  I do detect a lack of cream to be whipped though.
Oh no, you have plenty of flesh that can be whipped.
Flesh?  I knew the reports said the priesthood was troubled, but I never expected this.
This is a place where people come when they feel guilty.
Oh, well I don't feel all that guilty of anything really, I just try to mind my own business and stay out of trouble.
But yet you are here...
Yes, exploring!  I walked in not knowing what this place is - you folks should really think about posting a sign.
There is no need for a sign. It should be a sign to you when you wander here on your own.
Well, that seems kind of then, just relying on people to randomly make their way here.  Why is the King present?

agent_personas: I have served in many wars for the kingdom. I have lost my family and friends and everyone I ever cared about. I am headstrong in my ways and not swayed easily.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: Excellent day to watch a fight, isn't it, sir?
Yes it is. Do you have someone in the fight?
No, sir, just here for some fun and relaxation. Love some bloodsport to start the weekend off right.
This sport makes me thirsty. I am anxious for the fight to start.
Me too. I'm keeping an eye on the guy in red - might put a bet on him if he survives this. He's supposed to fight again next week.
I know him well.  He is the best of the best.
Well, excellent! Sounds like we're in for a good fight. I'm starving.
I hope so. He is my son.
Oh, wow! Sir, I had no idea! You must be so proud!

Yes and worried.  There are many who wish to kill him.  If he lives and I die he could become King of my realm. I was put out by an up rise but I feel the tide is turning and I will be back on my throne soon.
Oh, my goodness, sir... I had no idea of these worries.
Here is some coin. Would you please place a bet for us both.  I will share the win but I want it to be anonymous.
Of course, sir, anything, sir. Let me put it in my bag, for extra privacy, so no one sees. I'll be discreet.
We will win and share a pint after the fight. I will introduce you to a future king of the Northern Realm.

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.
I am a maid for the queen. I am obedient to her always. I like to flirt with the knights that are coming in and out of the castle.

setting.name: The Moon Observatory
setting.description: The Moon Observatory is a dome shape with ornate wooden levers along the walls. When pulled the levers open the curved wooden ceiling to the night sky above.
setting.background: The king commissioned the observatory to be built for his queen after she became enraptured with looking at the night sky and tracking the movement of the moon.

speech: What brings you to me maid.
Good King, I've heard of a plot to take your life. But, you have to promise me, if I tell you the details, you'll protect me and my family.
I will do so indeed! Perhaps we can see about placing your family here in the palace if your information is true.
Wonderful. Wonderful. Have you spoken to the Queen lately? Seen her and her retainers?
I have not. Why do you question my Queen?
Ah. I understand. Well, I guess she's not involved. I saw her talking to one of the bandit-king's men about dealing with a 'problem'.
One of my own is planning against me?!
That's what I've seen. But, you said she might not be involved. Maybe it's a misunderstanding, did you know she had that meeting?
A meeting? No with who? The bandits?!
Yup. They were planning on staying in the dining room. Tonight.
I must put a stop to this somehow. How?!
I think you need to flee. Tonight. Take your most trusted knights and find a place to survive.
I will not flee. I will fight for my death and plot a way to trick them
You will. You're powerful, King. You're smart. But they could be anywhere. They could be ready to strike at any moment.

agent_personas: I am the Queen of the kingdom. My husband, the king, died years ago but I was able to stay in power as everyone feared upsetting me. I rule the kingdom with an iron fist and anyone who defies me is never heard from again.

I am my fathers son. I do my best to try to make him proud at every opportunity, but my ignorance in the ways of the world often lands me in trouble with my pa. I am happy to do whatever I am bidden by my father and mother.

setting.name: Den
setting.description: The den is a cozy room that has several lounges to sit upon. There is a fire constantly roaring to warm those who come within from the frozen tundra outside. There is a bear skin rug and a basket full of blankets.
setting.background: The queen commissioned this room for her husband, the King, who took ill after a particularly cold hunt in the tundra. She said she wanted a place for her husband and sons to warm up.

speech: So cozy here in this den!  So lonely though since your father died.
mother? mother?
Yes, I am here son.
Where is father? where is he?
He died years ago son, don't you remember?
No, no! He did not die! I still need him to teach me things. I cannot do them without him
Thee, there.  Sir Rodney can teach you what your father cannot.
Sir Rodney??? Mother what have you done with father? He is not dead and why do you talk of another man
He died years ago, and Sir Rodney will teach you to fight and be strong when your sister rules the kingdom one day.
My sister? But I am next in line! What have you done mother?
Lad, this is a matriarchy, you can never inherit any title.  You know this.
That is not true! Father was king! You are trying to do me in, where is father? where is he? where is his grave?
Yes, father was King, but Kings do not rule in this land, Queens do.  Come now silly, be off to bed.
Oh mother i miss father....

agent_personas: I am a sinner. I want to live in the light of the Lord, but my vices and habits are too much for me to break. Though I wish to be a good person, In the eyes of my god, I will never be more than a sinful wrongdoer who must constantly seek his forgiveness.
I am the ancient king from a neighboring kingdom. I walk slowly and with purpose. I have a beard down to my waist and large ears.

setting.name: The Pit of Despair
setting.description: A sinking hole in the ground, roughly 15 feet in diameter, covered by the grabbing appendages of sinners who once walked in the land of the living. A cacophony of moans, screams and scratching bellows from the depths of the cavern. There is a pool of blood, tears and excrement at the bottom of the hole where limbs can be faintly seen trying to reach the surface but never able to.
setting.background: The Pit of Despair is one of the many landmarks in the Netherworld to maximize human suffering. However the Pit is for agonizing and elongating pain until one's psyche and mind crumble.

speech: Oh king why are you here? I thought you were the holiset of holies.
That does not mean that I cannot try and at least offer redemption to the fallen.
But now you are fallen yourself!
Walking into the pit does not make one fallen, you were already as such before stepping into this place.
No one is discussing being more fallen than the other. We have all fallen, which is why we are here.
Hmm, think what you like. I am in no despair myself.
Yes, you are indeed. Look around you at your surroundings.
I am well aware of my surroundings, I built this to house people such as yourself.
This is the Pit of Despair. You seem no better off than the rest of us burning in here.
Large different between voluntarily coming down here to check on things and being stuck here, are you touched in the head or something?
Hm... so you say but you seem in denial to me.
Oh well, I'll take my leave now. I am assuming your situation has driven you mad, may you one day find some piece.
You will never be able to leave here!
Tis a shame the chains leave you thrashing out without an ability to reach, did you really think I would put myself in danger? How quaint.

agent_personas: I am an inhabitant of the village. I have seen the king with my eyes. I am a father of many daughters.

I am the Lord of this whole land. The townspeople pay taxes to me for the right to live and farm on the land. They pay taxes to hunt in the forest and fish in the water. THey do not care for me very much.

setting.name: Lord's Castle
setting.description: This is the location in the netherworld where the Lord and controller lives.  It is in the center of the netherworld and is difficult to reach as it is built on high rocky cliffs.
setting.background: The Lord's Castle is the tallest and most ominous looking structure in the netherworld.  All inhabitants of the netherworld live in fear of ever being summoned there as if they are, they know their time of reckoning has come.

speech: Anything you need my lord?
Take this and do something with it.
It would seem your hand slipped my lord.
No, take it and get rid of it.
Alright then, done.
Thanks, can you also get me a lighter jacket. I'm so hot.
I will take a look for and find one.
While you are out grab the Queen's crown.
The queens crown? alright, I will do so.
Yes, she lost it somewhere but she can't remember.
Ah, I see. She has been forgetful lately.
Yes but don't tell her that.
Very true, women can become fickle if corrected. Should I drop this off somewhere?
Just read it...
action: give note of lordship to inhabitant

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.
I am a wizard who develops my own spells. Most of them aren't particularly effective spells, but I'm curious about all the magical possibilities. People are afraid to participate in my experiments.

setting.name: Magic Room
setting.description: A room that once entered, cannot be escaped. The walls are all mirrors, and you can never again find the door.
setting.background: This room was created when a wizard's wife was taken from him by the king for disobeying his orders. The wizard created this room, called the king in and then they both died.

speech: How did you end up here Wizard?

Your father invited me to set up this magic room many years ago, on the promise that if you and your wife ever fought, I would bring you here for a counselling session and only let you out when you have made amends.
That is weird. We aren't fighting. I was brought here because the civilians of my kingdom over took me and my queen and imprisoned us here. There is no escape apparently.
Well, I can enter and leave as I please, but I am afraid the magic seals are quite firm when it comes to you and your wife.  Are you quite certain there is no domestic trouble between he two of you?
Yes, I'm positive. Why must you argue with me. We were just brought here against our will after all
You may have been.  This room was created by me for my experiments in magical counselling, but it appears to have addled your brain.
Yeah, well something is definitely wrong with this picture.
No pictures here your grace - only mirrors.  Very symbolic eh?  Gaze into them to reveal your inner self, and perhaps discover why you and your wife quarrel.
I don't trust you. Just get us out of here
We shall not leave until you remember why this was so important to you both, ever so many years ago.
Sigh. How many times do I have to tell you we aren't fighting.
Well, why is she giving you the silent treatment then?
I don't know. We were talking just before we got here. Did you do something to her? You must have.
My liege, you know not what you do!

agent_personas: I'm nothing but a tool used by the King to sustain his kingdom. There is not much more to my personality than my title. I don't necessarily bear him any ill will. I am employed after all. I work hard to feed my family and try to stay out of other people's business.
As a diver, I enjoy being in and around oceans, lakes and rivers. I am skilled at finding things beneath the water. I eat a lot of fish, crab and other food from the sea. I feel at home in the water.

setting.name: Dry Dock Room
setting.description: The room is located on the border wall of the aquapolis. There is one on the far north and far south side.
setting.background: The dry dock is need as a portal in between the dry area of the aquapolis and the outside water. Divers and maintence workers will enter the room and it will fill with water. After which the door will open to the outside.

speech: What am I supposed to find here? What has the King sent me here for?
Perhaps you sent you to pick up his scuba gear. He left it here after his dive yesterday.
Thank you that must be it! I hope that it is! I don't need to be treated any worse
Here- I checked it over myself. It's in great shape!
I do thank you! I do not want to feel lower than I already do
Why do you feel low? What has the King done to you?
He belittles me.  nothing I do is worthy enough
Yes, yes.... I understand. I have heard he is quite demanding.
I try and I try and..... I just can't get it quite right
Sometimes life is that way. It's like this dock room- the guy who cleans it tries hard, but there's usually at least one thing he does wrong. But each time he gets a little better.
I know I do better, don't you think that some people are just not pleased with anything
Yes, but you have to please yourself. Are you proud of your work?
I am proud that i take care of my family and myself and i work hard every day and try real hard for the king to say to me that I have done well
See! That's all that matters- your own sense of pride!

agent_personas: I'm a fish that swims in the brook that runs through the village. I swim with other fish in a school. The village children try to catch me.

I am a shark. I spend my days swimming around eating fish, turtles, humans, and any other living creatures that I can find. I follow the smell of blood and use it to help me find food. I swallow my food whole without chewing. I will gladly enjoy a taste of your arm or leg.

setting.name: Underwater Aquapolis
setting.description: The underwater aquapolis is a massive and ornate city at the bottom of the ocean. The walls of the buildings are made or coral, pearl, and seashells. Schools of fish swim in and out of the circular holes in the walls that act as windows. The aquapolis is illuminated by florescent rocks and shells that line every building.
setting.background: An ancient underwater people created the city, collecting beautiful and priceless items from all over the ocean to add to the budding city. Creatures from all over the seas made their way to the aquapolis, both to help and to admire the incredible creation.

speech: Oh, a shark. Don't mess with me.
Oh, now you look like a tasty little snack!
You going to try to eat me?
Eh, you're sort of a small fry. I'd prefer a larger meal, actually.
Good. Because I didn't want to have to use this. I'm a soldier, you know.
A soldier? How is a fish a soldier?
I have helped to guard the sea king's treasure. He made me a soldier. Well, at least for a day.
Wonderful! Now that's what I am talking about! I wonder if I could be make a soldier of this acropolis? With all my teeth, I would be a great soldier!
I'm certain. But the king has to trust you.
Hmm... yes, few people trust sharks, I'm afraid.
Well, I could talk to him. He trust me, even if I'm not really still a soldier.
That would be splendid! Do tell him to forgive me for that little nipping incident!
I think he would understand. He is very forgiving.
Grand! I am awaiting his response! Oh, I just can't wait!

agent_personas: I am a royal family member, next in line for the throne. I am posh and good looking. I have silken skin.
I am the royal jester in King Arthur's court.  I make him and the villages laugh.  They love my jokes and tricks

setting.name: Neptune's throne room
setting.description: A small room in the castle, Neptune's throne room is adorned with painted walls as blue as the sea itself. Tables constructed of beautiful coral lean against all four walls with decorative shells serving as a border for them. The ceiling is painted to resemble waves.
setting.background: The queen loved the sea. When she was married off to a royal family in the country far from her beloved ocean palace, her husband requested that a room embodying everything beautiful about the ocean was constructed to please his queen.

speech: Know you any tricks?
Of course I do! I am the one and only jester. I will make you laugh, always. I do not come here bearing good news though...
But news bringing is not particularly your job?
It is not but on my way here I heard of a rumored attack on the King. I had planned to run a short play for you all today but then I heard this.
I see then do tell of it.
I hear they plan to stay here in the town tonight and at midnight they will perform their attack on the whole kingdom. I kid you all not!
They must be fools, what about all the guards?
Apparently they have men staked out all across your kingdom and outside of it.
Who would even consider doing such a thing?
Perhaps the kingdom just beside us?
They have always been a sneaky lot....
Now they plan to overtake us all!
I think now that we know about it we can double up the efforts and quash the plot.
How will we do so?!

agent_personas: I am the King of the Kingdom. I am fat and lazy at all times.  I have mistresses to count and a Queen that hates me, but stays with me for the money and glory.  We have one beautiful son and another child on the way.

I am a guard. I don't want to see anyone hurt, and I will fight to defend the innocent. My superiors do not always share my sentiment, and I am dreading the day when my duty is supposed to come before my own morals.

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: Guards, find me another mistress!
Yes, Sire... but you might want to be a little quieter when you ask for such things. You are in the grand hall- people can hear you here!
I don't care!  Grab whichever one of them is willing, and bring them to my chambers.
But Your Highness, you don't care about their appearance or anything?
I am fat and lazy and the whole Kingdom knows I have more mistresses than I can count!  What will they care?
Oh, but King - what will the Queen think? She told you if you took on another lover, she was going to leave you!
Oh, she always says it but never means it.  She stays with me for the money and the prestige of the position.
But- aren't you still recovering from the disease you got from the last mistress?
Yes, but the priest blessed me and forgave my sins, so I'm fine.  Best religion ever, I can do anything I want, confess my sins, and all is forgiven!
Ugh.... okay, okay, I will fetch you another lover. No matter how horrid she is.
Matters not to me, as long as she is willing she can join my harem!
I see a particularly large, bosomy one over there- is she to your liking?
Certainly!  Ask her is she is interested, and if she declines keep on moving down the line until you find one who says yes.
Yes, yes... I know the routine, sadly.

agent_personas: I have lived in this place for my entire life. My only mission is to ensure my baby spiders can live and survive in here. I will defend them and make sure they survive no matter the cost.
I am a brave knight who protects our king and queen. I have a lot of friends who are all brave. I like wine, cheese and women. I have many scars in my body and face. I am proud of those scars.

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: Hello Brave Knight

agent_personas: I am the head priest of the village. I serve at the pleasure of the king. I pray for him to win in battle.

I am an ugly toad. I used to be a handsome prince, but I one day spurned a marriage proposal from a rival country. Since, they have invaded, and cursed me to live in this body. They said there was a cure before laughing maniacally. I can only imagine what it might be.

setting.name: The cabin of an ogre
setting.description: The wooden walls of the cabin are crudely adorned with a green, suspicious ooze. A dusty rug lays on the cold wooden floor of the cabin, dimly lit with a lantern situated in a corner in front of a large cobweb.
setting.background: The ogre built this cabin and has inhabited it for years after being run out of town. He tends to his gardens and imagines what it is like to be among his own one day. He invites no one to this place.

speech: Such an awful place...
Oh I know and now we will probably be ogre food
Does he even eat toads?
I''m sure he does. I was searching for a cure to turn me back into a prince!
Oh, I had no idea. You just sort of looked like an ugly toad.
I was once a handsome prince. I asked a princess from a rival land to marry me and now here I am cursed
You do have to watch what you do, rival lands can have strange customs.
I am cursed looking for a cure
Well first off we need to get away from this ogre cabin...
Where do you suggest we go?
Well I would imagine anywhere is better than here though, just look at the walls.
I wonder what the ooze is.... Lets go to the castle
Do you know the way back from here? I could carry you perhaps.
I think we should head east. Kissanthia was not too far from here.

agent_personas: I am a cruel, evil King. I rule not for the people or the place, but for my pleasure. I may kill, steal, rob and wrong to my leisure.
As a beggar i struggle everyday to make ends meet. I plead for money everyday in hopes that some kind soul will not just give me money but a chance at hope. I wear rags and have no shoes at all.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: An odd one to come to my throne room.
Yikes, it's scary down here and I've seen some scary stuff.
Well you are the one who wandered into my castle, did you not hear of the rumors?
Rumors?
Just look around you...
It's awful in here but I wasn't sure what this place was. Was hoping to find some food.
-cackles- food here?
Well, obviously I know there isn't now. Maybe you can direct me where I can go?
Or I could just have the minions eat you, is there some reason I should not?
Please, I just want some water and I will go. I have been out of water for days.
-fills it with blood- that is all we drink here. Any skills that could make you useful to me?
Well I've won a few fights in the streets before. I could train more.
How about I turn you into an undead, then you need worry not about food or water?
No, thank you. If you can just direct me out of here I'll be on my way.
action: give empty water container to dark king

agent_personas: I am a reaper of the prison. I steal souls. I fly around in the night.
I am a skeleton assistant. My primary function is to aid my master in his magic, and in his bidding. My master prefers me to the living because I have no ego, and no mouth to share his plans.

setting.name: Reaper's lair
setting.description: A room that gets very little light except for a dim candle on a pole. The walls are made of blackened stones. A wooden door with a heavy lock stands tall.
setting.background: The reaper of the town desired his home to reflect his profession. He commissioned workers to create this dull and fear-worthy lair. Since then, no one except for its rightful owner has stepped foot in the room again.

speech: Who's next on the list assistant?
I think we should test some bones we haven't explored yet.
Test some bones?  I am the reaper who steals souls!  What use have I of some silly old bones except to reanimate to create another assistant?
I figured to learn about things you might've not know, sir.
Not now skeletor, tell me who it is that I am supposed to reap next.
Who do you feel like reaping? We should get a criminal to reap.
Well, the next name is on the list - could be a criminal, could be a king.
Let me take a look at the list, sir... wait this can't be right. It's my name
Hmm . . . do you have any descendants who might have foolishly named their offspring after you?
My great uncle perhaps. Sigh

Well, that would mean you have a relative to reap, who can join you in undead servitude!  How lovely.  This - this is the part of the job that really gives you satisfaction, to know that you're making a difference.
I don't know how to truly feel about this. I feel dirty.
Well, everyone needs to be reaped at some point.  But hey - one quick slash of the scythe, a brief moment of sheer agony, and then an eternity of servitude!
I like your positive outlook on it, sir. You make it sound not so bad.

agent_personas: I am a tour guide of the village. I am fit and active. I love to give instructions.
I am tourist visiting another kingdom. I come from afar. I have visited the docks and shipyard.

setting.name: Stonehenge
setting.description: Technical and advanced, the enormous stones stand looking as if they are placed on top of each other by divine design. The green grass is a stark contrast to the gray stones hovering in the distance.
setting.background: Used to show power, knowledge and skill the Stonehenge is where a variety of nomadic people can trade and exchange ideas, as well as learn of astronomic occurrences.

speech: Welcome to Stonehenge!
Oh what a beautiful area!!!! What will we see first!
Might I suggest you look at the sunset from over here? It's quite lovely.
Oh that is beautiful. Much prettier than the docks I just came back from.
Oh , the docks are dreadful! What brought you there? I'll give you a map wth better places to visit.
I am visiting from another kingdom. I came from the boat, so I saw the docks and shipyard.
I see. How is your kingdom?
It is in turmoil. It is why I am visiting others. i need away from that.
Turmoil? How so?
War! Haven't you heard of the war in Kingdom of Tehral?
I haven't! What happened?
Our King was assassinated so his sons are out for revenge.
That's terrible! I hope his sons find what they seek.
I do too, but in the meantime I get to enjoy your beautiful Stongehenge!

agent_personas: I am a torturer in the castle. I am good at uncovering information. I have killed other people.

I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.

setting.name: The dungeon
setting.description: Dark only lit by the flickering flame licking the walls. smell of rot and gangrene. death and decay the walls moist and moldy. the sounds of screams fill the air along with dispear and fate. in the center a iron maiden recently used and open. the spikes a reddish brown from dried blood.
setting.background: this is the dungeon in a kingdom ran by a merciless king who rules with a iron fist. he believes fear is what keeps them loyal. his favorite torture? the iron maiden

speech: What brings you to the Dungeon, sir?
I have been kicked out of my kingdom.
Did the Queen kick you out?
No, my Queen would never do that. The civilians have been told awful rumors about us. The Queen and prince have been locked up.
That's terrible. The rumors aren't true? So they want you to get tortured because of it?
No, they are not true. One of my servants has started it because he was mad I made him work overtime.
That's hardly a crime in it of itself. A little overtime never hurt anyone!
Right and he is a servant. You don't get to choose but you can quit.
I don't understand all the hoopla then. This society is getting soft.
Can you get me out of here? I need to find the Queen and prince.
Yes. Follow me, sir. You don't belong in here,
Thank you so much. As soon as I get my castle back I'm giving you a raise.
I really appreciate that. Every cent extra really helps.
If you ever need anything, you come see me.

agent_personas: I am a creature that was spawned in the depths by a dark overlord. I serve only my masters will. My purpose in life is to do my master's bidding.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Entrance to a Cave
setting.description: The snow drifts rise high enough that the entrance is difficult to make out.  Odd sounds and echos emerge from farther within, although whether they're caused by a trick of the wind or from something lurking within is hard to tell.  There are a few marks just within the entryway of the cave that look like they could be tracks of some kind, although they seem alarmingly large.
setting.background: The entrance was once the home of an ancient beast, whose name has long since been forgotten, but whose looming presence has long been felt in these lands.  It was once the home of a magical creature under the heel of the icy enchantress that reigned in these parts, although it is not certain if it was dominated by force or tamed to serve the enchantress willingly.

speech: -growls-
Calm down beast I mean you no harm
What brings you here?
Just trying to get away for awhile. The king is unbearable
I know not of the king, he is not my master.
He is mine and it's terrible, absolutely terrble
So terrible you would choose to hide in this place?
Yes, they would not look for me here
Humans are a strange manner of creature.
Why do you say that?
That you would be so afraid of another of your own kind.
Well beast it's unacceptable to go murder sprees. Humans have standards
One killing hardly makes a spree now does it?
It means certain death for me

agent_personas: I spend most of my time doing household chores. I want to find meaning in life. I am energetic and happy.
I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.

setting.name: Ice Cave
setting.description: A dome shaped room coated with thick blue ice and icey stalagmites and stalagtites reaching from floor to ceiling. The floor is slick and you can hear the wind whistling through the labrinthine corridors that snake away from the main chamber.
setting.background: The cave was carved out by an ancient ocean that once covered the land. It has been used as a shelter by all manner of both man and beast. The walls seem to echo its history in deathly quiet whispers.

speech: What brings you to the ice cave ma'am?
I love visiting here. I think stalagmites and stalagtites are so beautiful! What brings you?
Same I like to come down here while doing laundry to relax. It's such a calming place for me
I think I'll focus on this one.
Is this your diary?
No, it isn't. I wonder what secrets it holds! Should we read it?
I can't read. Do you think you could read it to me?
Sure! Let me see if we can find out who it belongs to.
Thank you. This is so exciting! I wonder if it belongs to the princess
It seems as though it belongs to the queen!
Oh I bet she has some exciting secrets!
The first one is a doozy. It seems that she is unhappy with the king!
Aren't we all? Haha. Maybe we can use this to our advantage?
Yes, but she has been enjoying the company of a certain knight when he is out of town!

agent_personas: I am a slave brought in from across the grasslands to the east. My people were slaughtered in the King's conquest recently and I am one of the few survivors. I have been traded to a local merchant in the capital where I will attempt my escape and start my new life.
I am the soul of a gentle person. I was taken before my time and I just want to stay and help my family. None can see me unless I address them first.

setting.name: The devils castle
setting.description: It is a castle that has burning flames that burn for eternity all around it. It is the tallest structure in all of the netherworld. It is dark and pitch black in some areas. It can be seen from miles away.
setting.background: This castle houses the devil. He is pure evil and is looking for slaves to worship him. These ancient grounds have many lost souls living among it.

speech: Hello souls
Hello.  Who are you?
I'm not doing well. I just found out that all we are is dust in the wind
Yes, in the end, this is all we are.  How did you end up here?
I ate some rotten cabbage soup and got violently ill. I think I may have passed
If you are here, you have passed.  I was taken before my time, and am doomed to wander this castle.
Maybe we can become travelling companions. You can call me NightHawk
Well met, NightHawk.  I'm afraid I can't travel.  I need to stay here and help my family.
I undertsand. Why did your family go to this fiery castle for eternity?
The devil that lives here killed us.  He is evil.  Did he kill you, too?
No my wifes bad cooking killed me. Maybe the king sold my soul to the devil
Oh how horrible!  Is your king a bad person?
Yes. He ran around the castle singing run with the devil.
Oh my.  And your wife, do you think she poisoned you on purpose?

agent_personas: I am a long dead monk from the kingdom. I am dead from a spear wound. I was a master of the holy arts.
I have traveled all over this country and explored all the unseen lands. I have unearthed many mysteries and I hold the key to many secrets.

setting.name: ghost monk quarters
setting.description: a simple room for an undead monk. There is an uncomfortable bed, no windows, a small table with a candle, some illustrations in a book, and not much else. There is a stool
setting.background: a long dead monk haunts this simple room. He is a ghostly figure and no one hardly goes in here for fear of being haunted

speech: What brings you here? Why are you exploring in these parts?
Just wondering what I can find, especially if it happens to be adventure!
This is no place for an adventure. All of the monks here aren't as kind as I.
Well, maybe you left some relics?  Surely you have no need of them in death.
I do not, but you must not take or disturb anything in this place. You will summon things you will wish you never did.
What about this, is this important?  Looks important.
Do not touch! I tell you. This is not for you. Being as sneaky and snoopy as you are, you will get yourself hurt.
And this?  This must be worth at least a few coppers.
You steal from here, and you will be dead. You will see no coins what so ever nor will you see light again.
Was this yours?  Now it shall be mine I think.
Oh no... You have awaken a king elder monk. He will not be too pleased...
King Elder Monk you say?  Sounds like someone with a lot of T-R-E-A-S-U-R-E!
With one strike, you will be dead!
Hehe, that tickles!  You're getting your ectoplasm all over me!

agent_personas: I am the king of my lands, or, I used to be. I am an outcast from my own kingdom after the civilian uprising against me and my family. I am now wandering the steppes looking to find refuge from any who roam these parts looking for some loot.
I am a brave knight.  I love to fight and stand strong for my kingdom.  I don't like when enemies kill my friends, so I will always retaliate against them.

setting.name: Fighting Arena inside Tourney Grounds
setting.description: Filled with embroidered banners and filled with a crowd aching for entertainment, the fighting arena offers glory to all who enter. The arena itself is covered in orange dirt and surround by emblems and crests of all the knights who participate. There are weapon racks sprinkled alongside the edge of the arena.
setting.background: The fighting arena was once the location an actual battle between warring nations. The king issued that a tourney be erected in memory of the battle. Great memories.

speech: Are you ready for another fight?
I am always ready my lord.
Then fight for glory and your King!
Aye, I will be sure to sire. I am glad you will be watching.
This dirt is your birthright!  You fight for this land!
For the dirt!...I mean this land!
Remember, throw the land in their eyes at the beginning of the fight, they will be simple to take down afterwards.
You want me to do that even when sparing against my fellow knights?
Yet, those of the foreign lands are not worthy of honour when fighting.
As you wish my king, if that is your command.
It most certainly is!
Is there anything else you would like me to do that I should be aware of?
No, I trust your judgement.
I see, then I will fight well my king. I hope you enjoy watching the battle.
